stem: A woman from State A was hit in State B by a driver who is a citizen and resident of a foreign country. The driver frequently visited family in State A. Each state is composed of only one federal judicial district.
stemZh: 一名来自 A 州的女子在 B 州被一名国籍和居住地均为外国的司机撞伤。该司机经常前往 A 州探望家人。每个州仅包含一个联邦司法区。
ask: If the woman files a diversity action against the driver in the federal court in State A, which of the following is the woman's strongest argument that venue is proper?
askZh: 如果该女子在 A 州的联邦法院提起一项基于基于不同州籍管辖权的诉讼，针对该司机，以下哪一项是她主张审判地适当的最强有力论据？

options.en: Venue is proper in any judicial district because the driver resides in a foreign country.
options.zh: 审判地在任何司法区都是适当的，因为司机居住在外国。

options.en: Venue is proper in any judicial district because the Federal Tort Claims Act applies.
options.zh: 审判地在任何司法区都是适当的，因为联邦侵权法适用。

options.en: Venue is proper in State A because that is where the woman resides.
options.zh: 审判地在 A 州适当，因为该女子居住在 A 州。

options.en: Venue is proper in State A because the driver is subject to personal jurisdiction there.
options.zh: 审判地在 A 州适当，因为司机在该地受属人管辖权约束。

explanation.en:
Special rules for where venue is proper

Removal • Federal district where state action was pending

Foreign resident • Any judicial district

Federal official sued in official capacity

• Where defendant resides

• Where substantial events occurred or property is located

• Where plaintiff resides if no real property is involved in suit Foreign government • Where substantial events occurred or property is located

• In federal district court of Washington, D.C. Multiparty, multiforum litigation

• Where defendant resides

• Where substantial part of accident occurred

Federal Tort Claims Act • Where plaintiff resides

• Where act/omission occurred Venue is the geographic location of a federal district court where a case may be heard. Under the general venue statute, venue is proper in a judicial district where:

• any defendant resides—but only if all defendants reside in the same state

• a substantial portion of the events occurred or a substantial part of the property at issue is located or

• any defendant is subject to the court's personal jurisdiction—but only if venue cannot be established under the above provisions.

However, special venue rules apply in certain situations, including when a defendant is a nonresident of the U.S. In this situation, venue is proper in any judicial district.* And since the driver is a resident of a foreign country, this is the woman's strongest argument that venue is proper in State A.

*Additionally, when a non-U.S. resident is joined (ie, added) as a defendant, the non-U.S. resident is disregarded when determining proper venue as to the other defendants in the action.

(Choice B) The Federal Tort Claims Act applies to suits brought against the U.S. government for the tortious conduct of a federal employee—not suits against a nonresident for his/her tortious conduct (as seen here). But had the Act applied, venue would be proper

only in the judicial district where the plaintiff resides (State A) or where the act or omission occurred (State B).

(Choice C) Venue is never based on the plaintiff's residence unless the Federal Tort Claims Act applies or a federal officer or employee is sued in his/her official capacity or under color of legal authority—none of which is seen here. Therefore, the woman cannot successfully argue that venue is proper based on where she resides.

(Choice D) Since venue is proper in any judicial district in an action against a non-U.S. resident, personal jurisdiction has no bearing on where venue is proper.

Educational objective:

Venue is the geographic location of a federal district court where a case may be heard. When a defendant is a nonresident of the U.S., venue is proper in any federal judicial district.

References

• 28 U.S.C. § 1391(c)(3) (setting forth the proper venue for non-U.S. residents).

explanation.zh:
适当地点的特别规则

• 州级行动待定的联邦区

• 任何司法区

联邦官员以官方身份被起诉

• 被告居住的地方

• 发生重大事件或财产所在地

• 如果原告居住,如果没有不动产参与诉讼 外国政府发生了重大事件或财产被发现

• 在华盛顿特区联邦地区法院,多当事方、多论坛诉讼

• 被告居住的地方

• 事故有相当一部分发生的地方

• 《联邦侵权索赔法》

• 发生行为/不行为的地点是联邦地区法院的地理位置,而联邦地区法院根据一般地点法规,地点在司法区是适当的,如果:

• 任何被告居住——但只有所有被告居住在同一州

• 大部分事件发生,或所涉财产中有很大一部分位于或

· 任何被告都受法院的属人管辖权管辖——但只有在根据上述规定无法确定地点的情况下。

然而,在某些情况下,包括被告是美国非居民的情况下,适用特别地点规则。在这种情况下,任何司法管辖区的地点都是适当的。 * 由于司机是外国居民,这是妇女最强烈的论点,即地点在A州是适当的。

* 此外,当非美国居民作为被告(即加上)加入诉讼时,在确定诉讼其他被告的适当审判地时,不考虑非美国居民。

(Choice B) 《联邦侵权索赔法》适用于就联邦雇员的侵权行为对美国政府提起的诉讼,而不是就非居民的侵权行为提起的诉讼(如此处所示)。

只在原告居住的司法区(A州)或作为或不作为发生地(B州)。

除非适用《联邦侵权索赔法》,或联邦官员或雇员以其官方身份或以法律权威的肤色受到起诉,否则地点绝不以原告的住所为依据。因此,该妇女不能以她居住地点为依据,成功地声称地点是适当的。

由于任何司法区对非美国居民提起诉讼的地点都是适当的,因此属人管辖权对地点是否适当没有影响。

学习要点：

地点是可以审理案件的联邦地区法院的地理位置。 当被告是非美国居民时,地点是任何联邦司法区的合适地点。

参考资料

• 《美国法典》第28篇第1391(c)(3)条(规定非美国居民的适当审判地)。

stem:
A woman from State A contacted an attorney after she developed a lung disorder, which she claims was caused by e-cigarettes. After researching the woman's claim, the attorney discovered that other individuals across the country developed similar lung disorders from the use of the same brand of e-cigarettes manufactured by a company incorporated and with its principal place of business in State B.

The attorney filed a class action in federal court in State A on behalf of 70 individuals against the company. The woman was the only named plaintiff. Each class member's claim amounted to $100,000, and the damages on behalf of the entire class amount to $7 million. Ten of the unnamed plaintiffs live in State B.

The company filed an answer denying responsibility. Twenty days later, it filed a motion to dismiss the class action for lack of subject-matter jurisdiction.
stemZh:
一名来自 A 州的女子患上肺部疾病，她认为电子烟是病因，于是联系了律师。律师调查后发现，全国还有其他人使用同一品牌的电子烟后患上类似肺病。该品牌电子烟由一家在 B 州注册成立、主要营业地也在 B 州的公司生产。

律师代表 70 人在 A 州联邦法院对该公司提起集体诉讼。该女子是唯一的具名原告。每名集体成员的请求金额为 100,000 美元，整个集体的损害赔偿总额为 700 万美元。另有 10 名未具名的集体成员居住在 B 州。

该公司提交答辩状，否认责任。20 天后，该公司又以缺乏事项管辖权为由，申请驳回集体诉讼。
ask: How will the court likely rule on the company's motion?
askZh: 法院对该公司的动议将如何裁定？

options.en: Deny the motion, because diversity jurisdiction exists.
options.zh: 驳回动议，因为存在不同州籍管辖权。

options.en: Deny the motion, because the company waived its claim for lack of subject-matter jurisdiction by filing its motion after its answer.
options.zh: 驳回动议，因为该公司在提交答辩状后才提出缺乏事项管辖权的主张，因此放弃了该主张。

options.en: Grant the motion, because members of the class and the company are citizens of State B.
options.zh: 批准动议，因为类成员和公司都是 B 州的公民。

options.en: Grant the motion, because the class only contains 70 members.
options.zh: 批准动议，因为该类仅包含 70 名成员。

explanation.en:
Subject-matter jurisdiction in class actions

Type Requirements

Federal question • Class action arises under U.S. Constitution, treaty, or federal law Diversity • Amount in controversy for any named plaintiff's claim exceeds $75,000* and

• named opposing parties are citizens of different states Class Action Fairness Act

• Class contains ≥ 100 members

• at least one class member & one defendant are diverse and

• amount in controversy for aggregated claims exceeds $5 million *A federal court can acquire subject-matter jurisdiction over class members' claims that do not exceed $75,000 through supplemental jurisdiction.

A class action is a suit filed by one or more named plaintiffs (ie, class representatives) on behalf of similarly harmed unnamed plaintiffs. As in any other lawsuit, a federal court can obtain subject-matter jurisdiction over a class action through either:

• federal-question jurisdiction – when the class action arises from the U.S. Constitution, a treaty, or federal law (not seen here) or

• diversity jurisdiction – when the named opposing parties are citizens of different states (ie, are diverse) and the amount in controversy for any named plaintiff's claim exceeds $75,000.*

Here, the woman from State A (named plaintiff) and the company incorporated and headquartered in State B (named defendant) are diverse. The fact that 10 unnamed plaintiffs are also citizens of State B does not destroy diversity (Choice C). Additionally, the woman—and every other class member—asserted a claim for $100,000, which satisfies the amount-in-controversy requirement. Therefore, the federal court has diversity jurisdiction and will likely deny the company's motion to dismiss.

*A federal court can acquire subject-matter jurisdiction over class members' claims that do not exceed $75,000 through supplemental jurisdiction.

(Choice B) Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 12(h), a defendant waives certain defenses if they are not asserted in a pre-answer motion or an answer—whichever occurs first. But a defense based on lack of subject-matter jurisdiction is never waived and can be asserted at any time.

(Choice D) The Class Action Fairness Act provides an alternate basis for subject-matter jurisdiction when (1) the class contains at least 100 members, (2) any member is diverse from at least one defendant, and (3) the aggregated amount in controversy exceeds $5 million. This Act does not apply here because the class has only 70 members, but the court still has subject-matter jurisdiction based on diversity.

Educational objective:

A federal court has diversity jurisdiction over a class action when (1) the named opposing parties are citizens of different states and (2) the amount in controversy for any named plaintiff's claim exceeds $75,000.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 23 (class actions).

• 28 U.S.C. § 1332(a) (diversity jurisdiction).

• Supreme Tribe of Ben-Hur v. Cauble, 255 U.S. 356, 366 (1921) (holding that only the named opposing parties in a class action need to be diverse to satisfy diversity jurisdiction).

explanation.zh:
集体诉讼的属事管辖权

所需经费类型

联邦问题 • 在美国下产生类别诉讼。• 任何被点名的原告的争议金额索赔额超过75 000美元*

• 被点名的对立方是不同州的公民,《行动公平法》

• 100名成员

• 至少有一个类别成员和一名被告是不同的,

• 争议总额超过500万美元对类别成员不超过75 000美元的索赔的属事管辖权补充管辖权。

集体诉讼是一名或多名被指名原告(即阶级代表)代表其提起的诉讼。类似伤害的无名原告。与任何其他诉讼一样,联邦法院可取得对集体诉讼的属事管辖权。通过下列方式:

• 联邦问题管辖权——当集体诉讼产生于美国宪法、条约或联邦法律(此处不见)或

• 异籍管辖权——当被点名的对立方是不同国家的公民时(即多样性),任何被点名的原告的诉求的争议金额超过75 000美元。 *

这里,来自A州(原告)和在B州(被告)注册和总部的公司的妇女多种多样,10名无名原告也是B州公民这一事实并不破坏多样性(Choice C)。此外,该妇女——以及所有其他阶级成员——提出了10万美元的索赔要求,满足了争议中的数额要求,因此,联邦法院具有异籍管辖权,并可能拒绝该公司的驳回申请。

* 联邦法院可通过补充管辖权获得对阶级成员不超过75 000美元的索赔的属事管辖权。

(Choice B) 根据联邦民事诉讼规则第12(h)条,被告放弃某些辩护,如果这些辩护不是在预先回答的动议或答复中主张的——无论哪一种首先发生。但是,基于缺乏属事管辖权的辩护从未放弃过,可以在任何时候提出。

(Choice D)"类别行动公平法"为事项管辖权提供了替代依据,当(1)该类别至少包含100名成员,(2)任何成员与至少一名被告不同,(3)争议总额超过500万美元.该法案在此不适用,因为该阶层只有70名成员,但法院仍然根据多样性拥有属事管辖权。

学习要点：

联邦法院对集体诉讼具有异籍管辖权,条件是:(1) 被点名的对立方是不同州的公民;(2) 任何被点名的原告的诉讼争议金额超过75,000美元。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P.23(类行动)。

• 《美国法典》第28篇第1332(a)(异籍管辖权)。

• Ben-Hur诉Cauble案的最高部落,255 U.S.356,366 (1921年)(认为集体诉讼中只有指定的对立方才能满足异籍管辖权)。

stem:
A foreign exchange student from Germany was on vacation in State B with his host family, all citizens of State A, when their car collided with a truck owned by a company headquartered and incorporated in Germany. The truck was driven by a citizen of State B.

The student and the host family brought a negligence suit against the company and the truck driver in a federal court in State B. The student seeks to recover $200,000 and the family seeks $500,000 in damages. The company and the truck driver have filed a motion to dismiss for lack of subject-matter jurisdiction.
stemZh:
一名来自德国的交换生在 B 州与他的寄宿家庭一起度假，该寄宿家庭均为 A 州公民，当他们的车与一辆卡车相撞，该卡车由一家总部和注册地均在德国的公司所有，且由 B 州公民驾驶。

该交换生和寄宿家庭在 B 州的联邦法院对该公司和卡车司机提起疏忽诉讼。交换生要求赔偿 200,000 美元，寄宿家庭要求赔偿 500,000 美元。该公司和卡车司机已提出驳回诉讼动议，理由是缺乏事项管辖权。
ask: Is the court likely to grant the motion?
askZh: 法院很可能批准该动议吗？

options.en: No, because actions involving foreign citizens pose a federal question.
options.zh: 不，因为涉及外国公民的案件构成联邦问题。

options.en: No, because the requirements for diversity jurisdiction are satisfied.
options.zh: 不，因为满足不同州籍管辖权的要求。

options.en: Yes, because the doctrine of forum non conveniens requires that the action be heard in Germany.
options.zh: 是，因为不方便法院原则要求该诉讼应在德国审理。

options.en: Yes, because the foreign exchange student and the company are citizens of the same country.
options.zh: 是，因为交换生和该公司同属一国公民。

explanation.en:
Subject-matter jurisdiction refers to a federal court's authority to hear a particular type of case. This jurisdictional requirement can be established through federal-question jurisdiction or diversity jurisdiction. Diversity jurisdiction is established when (1) the amount in controversy exceeds $75,000 and (2) complete diversity of citizenship exists between the opposing parties. As a result, diverse citizenship exists if the suit is between:

• U.S. citizens domiciled in the U.S. and foreign citizens

• U.S. citizens and permanent residents domiciled in different states or

• U.S. citizens domiciled in different states with foreign citizens as additional parties. Here, the host family from State A and the German exchange student brought a negligence suit against the truck driver from State B and the German company. Since the suit is between U.S. citizens domiciled in different states with foreign citizens as additional parties, diverse citizenship exists. Additionally, the amount-in-controversy requirement is met because the student seeks $200,000 and the family seeks $500,000 in damages. Therefore, the requirements for diversity jurisdiction are satisfied.

(Choice A) Judicial actions involving foreign citizens do not automatically pose a federal question. The cause of action must arise from the U.S. Constitution, a treaty, or a federal statute. Since the negligence action asserted here arises from state law, federal-question jurisdiction does not exist.

(Choice C) The doctrine of forum non conveniens allows, but does not require, a federal court to dismiss or stay a lawsuit if a state or foreign judicial system provides a more convenient forum to hear the case. Additionally, this doctrine is unrelated to subject-matter jurisdiction.

(Choice D) The fact that the foreign exchange student and the company are both German citizens is irrelevant. Diverse citizenship is established since the host family and the truck driver are U.S. citizens domiciled in different states and the foreign citizens are additional parties.

Educational objective:

Diverse citizenship exists in a suit between (1) U.S. citizens domiciled in the U.S. and foreign citizens, (2) U.S. citizens and permanent residents domiciled in different states, or (3) U.S. citizens domiciled in different states with foreign citizens as additional parties.

References

• 28 U.S.C. § 1332(a) (diversity jurisdiction).

• 32A Am. Jur. 2d Federal Courts § 628 (2020) (explaining that diverse citizenship exists in a suit between U.S. citizens domiciled in different states with foreign citizens as additional parties).

explanation.zh:
属事管辖权是指联邦法院有权审理某一类案件,可通过联邦问题管辖权或异籍管辖权确立这一管辖权要求。(1) 争议金额超过75 000美元,(2) 对立方之间存在完全多样化的公民身份,因此,如果诉讼发生在下列两种情况下,则存在不同的公民身份。

• 在美国居住的美国公民和外国公民

• 居住在不同国家的美国公民和永久居民或

• 美国公民居住在不同州,外国公民作为附加方,这里来自A州的东道主家庭和德国交换学生对来自B州和德国公司的卡车司机提起了过失诉讼。由于该诉讼是美国公民之间的诉讼,而美国公民居住在不同的州,其外国公民是额外的当事方,因此存在不同的公民身份。此外,由于学生要求200 000美元,家庭要求50万美元的赔偿,因此满足了对异籍管辖权的要求。

(Choice A) 涉及外国公民的司法行动不会自动引起联邦问题. 行动的原因必须来自美国宪法,条约或联邦法规.由于此处所称的过失行为来自州法律,因此不存在联邦问题管辖权。

(Choice C)法院不方便的理论允许,但并不要求,如果一个国家或外国司法系统为审理案件提供了更方便的法院,联邦法院可以驳回或中止诉讼。此外,这一理论与属事管辖权无关。

(Choice D) 外汇学生和公司都是德国公民的事实无关紧要,由于东道主家族和卡车司机都是美国,所以建立了多样化的国籍.居住在不同国家的公民和外国公民是额外的当事人。

学习要点：

在(1)美国户籍的美国公民和外国公民,(2)美国公民和在不同州户籍的永久居民,或(3)美国居民之间的诉讼案中存在不同国籍.居住在不同国家的公民,外国公民作为补充当事人。

参考资料

• 《美国法典》第28篇第1332(a)(异籍管辖权)。

• 32A Am.Jur. 2d联邦法院§628(2020年)(解释在居住在不同州的美国公民与外国公民之间的诉讼中存在不同的国籍)。

stem:
A senior executive domiciled in State B brought an action in a state court in State A against her former employer, a corporation that is incorporated and has its principal place of business in State A. In her complaint, the executive alleges that she was wrongfully terminated after 17 years of employment and seeks $100,000 in lost wages and benefits.

The corporation filed an answer two weeks after it received service of process. The answer claimed that the executive was terminated for attempting to license a patent owned by the corporation without its permission, in violation of patent law. The corporation contemporaneously filed a notice of removal in federal court. Twenty-three days later, the executive filed a motion to remand.
stemZh:
一名高级主管在 B 州有住所，她在 A 州的州法院提起诉讼，起诉其前雇主一家公司，该公司在 A 州注册并设有主要营业地。在她的起诉书中，该主管声称她在任职 17 年后被错误解雇，并要求赔偿 100,000 美元的工资和福利损失。

该公司在收到诉讼文书送达两周后提交了答辩状。答辩状声称该主管因试图在未经公司许可的情况下获得公司拥有的专利授权而被解雇，违反了专利法。该公司同时在联邦法院提交了移送通知。23 天后，该主管提交了发回州法院动议。
ask: Should the federal court grant the motion to remand?
askZh: 联邦法院应否批准该发回州法院动议？

options.en: No, because federal courts have exclusive jurisdiction over patent-law violations.
options.zh: 否，因为联邦法院对专利法违规行为拥有专属管辖权。

options.en: No, because the motion to remand was due within 21 days after the notice of removal was filed.
options.zh: 否，因为发回州法院动议应在移送通知提交后 21 天内提出。

options.en: Yes, because the corporation, as a citizen of State A, cannot remove the case to federal court.
options.zh: 是，因为该公司作为 A 州的公民，不能将案件移送至联邦法院。

options.en: Yes, because the corporation should have filed its notice of removal in state court.
options.zh: 是，因为该公司应在州法院提交移送通知。

explanation.en:
A defendant may remove a case from state to federal court if the case falls within the federal court's original subject-matter jurisdiction. Original jurisdiction arises from either:

• federal-question jurisdiction – when a claim arises under the U.S. Constitution, a federal treaty, or federal law or

• diversity jurisdiction – when the amount in controversy exceeds $75,000 and the opposing parties are citizens of different states.

Diversity jurisdiction seeks to protect out-of-state defendants from potential bias in state courts. However, in-state defendants do not face the same risk of bias. Therefore, the forum-defendant rule (ie, home-court advantage rule) prohibits removal when (1) subject-matter jurisdiction arises from diversity jurisdiction and (2) the defendant is a citizen of the state in which the case was filed.

Here, diversity jurisdiction exists because the amount in controversy is $100,000 and the executive and the corporation are citizens of different states (States B and A, respectively). But since the corporation is a citizen of State A—where the case was filed— the forum-defendant rule prohibits removal. Therefore, the federal court should grant the executive's motion to remand the case to state court.

(Choice A) Federal courts have exclusive jurisdiction over patent claims, and any party that asserts a patent claim can remove the case to federal court. But here, the corporation has not asserted a patent claim—it merely raised the alleged patent violation to explain why the executive was terminated.

(Choice B) A motion to remand must be filed within 30 days after the notice of removal was filed. Therefore, the executive timely filed her motion 23 days after the corporation filed its notice of removal.

(Choice D) A notice of removal must be filed in the federal court located in the same district in which the suit is pending—as the corporation did here. A copy of the notice of removal should then be delivered to the parties and the state court.

Educational objective:

The forum-defendant rule prohibits removal when (1) subject-matter jurisdiction arises from diversity jurisdiction and (2) the defendant is a citizen of the state in which the case was filed.

References

• 28 U.S.C. § 1441(b)(2) (forum-defendant rule).

explanation.zh:
如果案件属于联邦法院原来的属事管辖权,被告可将案件从州级法院移送联邦法院。

• 联邦问题管辖权——当根据美国宪法、联邦条约或联邦法律提出求偿时;

• 异籍管辖权——当争议金额超过75 000美元,而对立方是不同国家的公民时。

异籍管辖权旨在保护州外被告免受州法院可能存在的偏见,但州内被告并不会面临同样的偏见风险。因此,法院地被告规则(即法院地主优势规则)禁止在:(1) 属事管辖权产生于异籍管辖权和(2) 被告是案件提交国公民的情况下予以撤销。

这里存在异籍管辖权,因为争议金额是10万美元,而行政部门和公司是不同国家(分别为B州和A州)的公民。但是,由于该公司是A州公民(案件所在),法院被告规则禁止驱逐。 因此,联邦法院应当批准执行官将案件发回州法院的动议。

(Choice A)联邦法院对专利请求拥有专属管辖权,任何主张专利请求的当事人都可以将案件提交联邦法院.但是,在这方面,该公司没有提出专利要求——它只是提出所称的侵犯专利权行为,以解释为何终止执行官的职务。

(Choice B) 发回重审的请求必须在提出移送通知后30天内提出,因此,在公司提出移送通知23天后,执行部门及时提出。

(Choice D) 驱逐通知必须像公司在这里所做的那样,提交位于诉讼正在审理的同一地区的联邦法院,然后将驱逐通知的副本送交当事各方和州法院。

学习要点：

诉讼地被告规则禁止在(1) 属事管辖权产生于异籍管辖权和(2) 被告是案件提交国公民的情况下予以撤销。

参考资料

• 《美国法典》第28篇第1441(b)(2)条(本州被告规则)。

stem: A beneficiary of a trust, who is a citizen of State A, has sued the trustee in federal court in State A for failing to correctly distribute the income from the trust, seeking an accounting. The trustee was personally served with process and the complaint by the beneficiary's attorney while the trustee was vacationing in State A. The trustee is a citizen of State B, and the accounts that are the subject of the trust are located in State B.
stemZh: 一名信托受益人，其公民身份为 A 州，于是在 A 州的联邦法院起诉了受托人，指控其未能正确分配信托的收入，并要求进行账目清算。受托人被其律师当面送达了诉讼文书，而当时受托人正在 A 州度假。受托人是 B 州的公民，信托相关的账目位于 B 州。
ask: What is the trustee's best response to the complaint?
askZh: 受托人对诉讼的最佳回应是什么？

options.en: Answer the complaint and counterclaim for abuse of process.
options.zh: 回应诉讼并提出滥用程序的反诉。

options.en: File an action in a State B court and move to enjoin the State A action.
options.zh: 在 B 州法院提起诉讼并申请禁令阻止 A 州的诉讼。

options.en: Move to dismiss for improper service by the attorney.
options.zh: 以律师不当送达为由提出驳回诉讼的动议。

options.en: Move to dismiss for improper venue.
options.zh: 以不当审判地为由提出驳回诉讼的动议。

explanation.en:
Venue

Proper venue

(28 U.S.C. § 1391)

Case may be brought in any federal district where:

• any defendant resides, if defendants all reside in same state

• substantial part of events giving rise to claim occurred or property at issue is located

• any defendant is subject to court's personal jurisdiction (if neither of the above provisions applies) Transfer from proper venue

(28 U.S.C. § 1404)

When venue is proper, district court may transfer case to any other proper venue for convenience of parties/witnesses & in interest of justice

Transfer or dismissal from improper venue

(28 U.S.C. § 1406)

When venue is improper, district court must either:

• dismiss case

• transfer case to proper venue (if interest of justice requires) Venue can be established in any federal judicial district where:

• any defendant resides (only applies when all defendants reside in the same state)

• a substantial part of the events that gave rise to the suit occurred or a substantial part of the property at issue is located or

• any defendant is subject to the court's personal jurisdiction (only applies if neither of the above provisions applies).

Here, the trustee resides and the trust accounts are located in State B. Additionally, the events giving rise to the suit likely occurred in State B since that is where the trust is administered. This means that venue is proper in State B—not State A, where the suit was filed. Therefore, the trustee's best response is to move to dismiss for improper venue.

(Choice A) Abuse of process is a tort claim alleging that a party intentionally misused the legal process for an ulterior, improper purpose. Since there is no indication that the beneficiary sued the trustee for an improper purpose, a counterclaim for abuse of process is not the trustee's best response.

(Choice B) If the trustee filed an action in State B, the State B court would only enjoin an action in another court in the extremely rare circumstance in which the party seeking the injunction has no adequate alternative remedy. But here, the trustee does not need

injunctive relief since the trustee could raise the same issues in the State A action as in a State B action.

(Choice C) Service of process is proper if it is personally delivered to the defendant by a person who is at least 18 years old and not a party to the suit (eg, the beneficiary's attorney).

Educational objective:

Venue is proper in any district where (1) any defendant resides, if all defendants reside in the same state, (2) a substantial part of the events giving rise to the suit occurred or the property at issue is located, or (3) any defendant is subject to the court's personal jurisdiction, if the first two provisions do not apply.

References

• 28 U.S.C. § 1391(b) (proper venue).

explanation.zh:
地点

适当审判地

(《美国法典》第28编第1391条)

在下列情况下,可在任何联邦区提起诉讼:

• 被告居住,如果被告都居住在同一状态;

• 引起索赔的大部分事件或所涉财产所在地

• 任何被告都受法院的属人管辖权管辖(如果上述条款均不适用)

(《美国法典》第28编第1404条)

在地点合适时,区法院可将案件移交任何其他适当审判地,以便于当事方/证人和司法公正

调离或不适当审判地

(《美国法典》第28编第1406条)

如果地点不当,地区法院必须:

• 驳回案件

• 将案件移交适当审判地(如果司法公正需要),可在任何联邦司法区设立地点,条件是:

• 任何被告居住(只适用于所有被告居住在同一国家的情况)

• 导致诉讼的事件有相当一部分发生,或所涉财产有相当一部分被发现,或

• 任何被告受法院的属人管辖权管辖(只有在上述两项规定均不适用的情况下适用)。

在此,受托人居住在B州,信托账户设在B州。 此外,引起诉讼的事件可能发生在B州,因为这是信托的管理地。这意味着在提出诉讼的B州——不是A州——地点是适当的,因此受托人的最佳答复是因地点不当而驳回。

(Choice A)滥用程序是一种侵权主张,声称一方当事人故意滥用法律程序达到别有用心的不正当目的。由于没有迹象表明受益人为不正当目的起诉受托人,对滥用程序提出反诉不是受托人的最佳回应。

(Choice B) 如果受托人在B州提起诉讼,B州法院仅在极罕见的情况下责令另一法院提起诉讼,在这种情况下,寻求强制令的当事人没有适当的替代补救办法。

由于受托人在A州的行动和B州的行动可能引起同样的问题,因此不得强制补救。

(选择C)如果由至少18岁且不是诉讼当事方的人(如受益人的律师)亲自向被告交付诉讼文书送达是适当的。

学习要点：

地点在任何地区是适当的:(1) 任何被告居住的地方,如果所有被告居住在同一州,(2) 导致诉讼的事件中有相当一部分发生,或所涉财产被找到,或(3) 任何被告受法院管辖。属人管辖权,如果前两项规定不适用。

参考资料

• 《美国法典》第28篇第1391(b)(适当审判地)。

stem:
An entrepreneur from State A sued a website owner from State B in a State A federal court. The complaint alleges that the owner breached an advertising contract by failing to prominently display the entrepreneur's latest product on the website's homepage, resulting in lost profits totaling $50,000. The entrepreneur also asserted a defamation claim against the owner for $20,000 in damages. Additionally, the complaint includes a request for the court to award the entrepreneur $7,000 in costs related to the action.

The website owner has moved to dismiss the case for lack of subject-matter jurisdiction.
stemZh: 一名来自 A 州的企业家在 A 州联邦法院起诉来自 B 州的网站所有者。起诉状称，网站所有者未在网站首页显著展示该企业家的最新产品，违反广告合同，造成 5 万美元利润损失；企业家还就诽谤请求 2 万美元赔偿，并请求法院判给 7,000 美元诉讼费用。网站所有者以法院缺乏事项管辖权为由申请驳回案件。
ask: How will the court likely rule on the motion?
askZh: 法院对该动议的裁决可能性如何？

options.en: Deny the motion, because the court has supplemental jurisdiction over the claims.
options.zh: 驳回动议，因为法院对这些主张具有补充管辖权。

options.en: Deny the motion, because the parties are diverse and the amount-in-controversy requirement is satisfied.
options.zh: 驳回动议，因为当事人具有多样性且争议金额符合要求。

options.en: Grant the motion, because the action does not present a federal question and the amount-in-controversy requirement is not satisfied.
options.zh: 批准动或，因为本案不涉及联邦问题且争议金额要求未被满足。

options.en: Grant the motion, because the action should have been asserted in a State B federal court.
options.zh: 批准动议，因为本案应在 B 州联邦法院提出。

explanation.en:
Subject-matter jurisdiction can be established through either:

• federal-question jurisdiction – when a claim arises under the U.S. Constitution, a federal treaty, or a federal statute (not seen here) or

• diversity jurisdiction – when the opposing parties are citizens of different states (as seen here) and the amount in controversy exceeds $75,000.

The amount in controversy refers to the amount demanded in the plaintiff's complaint. To meet the required amount, a single plaintiff may aggregate (ie, combine) joined claims asserted against a single defendant. However, costs and interest are excluded from the amount-in-controversy calculation.

Here, the entrepreneur asserted a $50,000 breach-of-contract claim and a $20,000 defamation claim ($70,000 total) against the website owner. Although the complaint also requested $7,000 in costs related to the action, such costs are excluded from the amount-in-controversy calculation. Since the $70,000 amount in controversy is inadequate, the federal

court lacks diversity jurisdiction (Choice B). Therefore, the court will likely grant the owner's motion to dismiss.

(Choice A) When a dispute involves multiple claims and only some fall within the court's original subject-matter jurisdiction, supplemental jurisdiction may exist over the remaining claims. Here, no claim falls within the court's original subject-matter jurisdiction, so supplemental jurisdiction does not exist.

(Choice D) Whether the action should have been commenced in a State B federal court is irrelevant for determining subject-matter jurisdiction. The location of the federal court is relevant when venue is challenged.

Educational objective:

Diversity jurisdiction requires that the opposing parties be citizens of different states and the amount in controversy exceed $75,000. The amount in controversy refers to the amount demanded in the plaintiff's complaint (excluding costs and interest).

References

• 28 U.S.C. § 1332 (diversity jurisdiction).

• 32A Am. Jur. 2d Federal Courts § 959 (2020) (explaining that costs are excluded from the amount-in-controversy calculation).

explanation.zh:
属事管辖权可通过下列方式确立:

• 联邦问题管辖权 -- -- 根据《美国宪法》、联邦条约或联邦法规(此处不见)提出要求时;

• 异籍管辖权——当对立方是不同国家的公民时(如本文所示),争议金额超过75 000美元。

争议金额是指原告起诉状中要求的金额,为满足要求金额,单一原告可以合并(即合并)对单一被告提出的诉讼。但是,费用和利息不包括在有争议数额的计算中。

在此,该企业家声称有5万美元违约索赔和2万美元诽谤索赔(共计70 000美元)针对网站所有人。虽然起诉状还要求支付与行动有关的7 000美元,但这些费用不包括在内。从有争议的计算中得出的金额。由于争议的7万美元不够,联邦

法院缺乏异籍管辖权(Choice B)。 因此,法院可能同意业主提出的驳回动议。

(选择A) 当争端涉及多项债权,而且只有某些债权属于法院原来的属事管辖权时,对其余债权可能存在补充管辖权。在这方面,任何索赔都不属于法院原来的事项管辖权,因此不存在补充管辖权。

(Choice D) 诉讼是否应在B州联邦法院启动与确定标的物管辖权无关,当地点受到质疑时,联邦法院的所在地是相关的.

学习要点：

异籍管辖权要求对立方必须是不同国家的公民,争议金额超过75,000美元,争议金额是指原告起诉状中要求的数额(不包括费用和利息).

参考资料

• 《美国法典》第28编第1332条(异籍管辖权)。

• 32A Am. Jur. 2d联邦法院§959(2020年)(解释费用不计入有争议的金额计算)。

stem:
Before filing a federal civil action against a seller, a buyer's attorney unsuccessfully tried to settle with the seller's attorney. Three days before the limitations period on the buyer's claim expired, the buyer's attorney told the seller's attorney that she would file a complaint that day and asked the seller's attorney whether he would accept service of the summons and complaint. The seller's attorney agreed to do so. The buyer's attorney promptly filed the complaint but forgot to serve the seller's attorney.

Four months later, the buyer's attorney received a voicemail from the seller's attorney asking whether she had ever filed the buyer's complaint. The buyer's attorney immediately mailed a copy of the complaint to the seller's attorney.

The following week, the seller's attorney moved to dismiss the complaint for failure to effect timely service of process.
stemZh:
在提起针对卖方的联邦民事诉讼之前，买方的律师曾试图与卖方的律师达成和解，但未能成功。在买方主张的诉讼时效期满前三天，买方的律师告诉卖方的律师，她当天将提起诉讼，并询问卖方的律师是否同意接受传唤和诉状的送达。卖方的律师同意这样做。买方的律师随即提交了诉状，但忘记了送达卖方的律师。

四个月后，买方的律师收到卖方律师的一条语音留言，询问她是否曾提起买方的诉讼。买方的律师立即邮寄了一份诉状副本给卖方的律师。

接下来的一周，卖方的律师提出了驳回诉讼的动议，理由是未能及时送达诉讼文书。
ask: Is the court likely to grant the seller's motion to dismiss?
askZh: 法院很可能批准卖方的驳回动议吗？

options.en: No, because under the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure, the filing of the complaint commences an action and the buyer's complaint was timely filed.
options.zh: 不，因为根据联邦民事诉讼规则，提交诉状即开始诉讼，买方的诉状已及时提交。

options.en: No, because the seller's attorney had notice of the complaint and agreed to accept service.
options.zh: 不，因为卖方的律师已知悉诉状并同意接受送达。

options.en: Yes, because the buyer's attorney did not show good cause for her failure to effect timely service.
options.zh: 是的，因为买方的律师未能证明其未能及时送达诉讼文书的正当理由。

options.en: Yes, because the limitations period expired without timely service.
options.zh: 是的，因为诉讼时效期满时未能及时送达诉讼文书。

explanation.en:
A plaintiff must provide a defendant with notice of a lawsuit through service of process— ie, the delivery of a summons and a complaint. Process must be served on a defendant in the U.S. within 90 days after the complaint is filed.* Here, service of process was untimely because the buyer's attorney failed to effectuate service until four months (120 days) after filing the complaint. When this occurs, the court generally must either:

• dismiss the action without prejudice or

• order service of process within a specified time. However, if the plaintiff provides good cause for why service was untimely, the court must extend the time for service for an appropriate period. Good cause exists if service was delayed due to matters outside of the plaintiff's control—not the plaintiff's own mistake or ignorance. Since the buyer's attorney simply forgot to serve the seller's attorney, good cause does not exist. Therefore, the court will likely grant the seller's motion to dismiss.

*The 90-day deadline for service of process applies to defendants in the U.S. For defendants in a foreign country, most federal courts require that process be served with due diligence.

(Choice A) FRCP 3 provides that an action is commenced when the plaintiff files the complaint. However, the plaintiff still must timely serve process or provide good cause for failing to do so (neither seen here).

(Choice B) The fact that the seller's attorney had informal notice of the complaint and agreed to accept service of process does not excuse the untimely service of process. This formal notice is required so that a defendant has definitive knowledge that the plaintiff intends to litigate the action in court.

(Choice D) A statute of limitations is the statutory deadline for a plaintiff to file that claim in court—not serve process on the defendant. Since the buyer's attorney filed the complaint three days before the limitations period on the claim expired, this is not a reason justifying dismissal.

Educational objective:

A court must extend the time for a plaintiff to serve the defendant with process when the plaintiff provides good cause for failing to timely effectuate service. Good cause exists if service was delayed due to matters outside of the plaintiff's control.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 4(m) (deadline for service of process).

• 4B Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 1137 (4th ed. 2020) (explaining the general time limit for service of process and the good-cause exception).

explanation.zh:
原告必须通过诉讼文书送达向被告提供诉讼通知 — — 即送达传票和起诉状。 诉讼必须在美国的被告身上送达。* 在此,诉讼的送达不及时,因为买方的律师在提交合同后四个月(120天)才送达。发生这种情况时,法院通常必须:

• 不带偏见地驳回诉讼;

• 在规定的时间内发出诉讼令,但是,如果原告为服务不及时提供了充分的理由,法院必须将服务期延长一段适当的时间。如果由于原告无法控制的事项——而不是原告自己的错误或无知——而延误服务,则存在正当理由,因为买方的律师完全忘记为卖方的律师服务,不存在正当理由。因此,法院可能同意卖方提出的驳回动议。

* 诉讼的90天期限适用于美国境内的被告。 对于外国的被告,大多数联邦法院都要求以应有的努力履行这一程序。

(Choice A)FRCP 3规定,原告在提出起诉状时提起诉讼,但原告仍必须及时送达程序,或提供不这样做的良好理由(此处没有看到)。

(Choice B)卖方的律师收到关于起诉状的非正式通知并同意接受诉讼文书送达这一事实并不能作为不及时诉讼文书送达的借口。要求发出这种正式通知,以便被告确切知道原告打算向法院提起诉讼。

(Choice D) 诉讼时效是原告向法院提起诉讼的法定最后期限,而不是向被告送达诉讼文书。由于买方的律师在索赔时效期限到期三天前提出了起诉状,这不是驳回的理由。

学习要点：

当原告为未能及时提供服务提供正当理由时,法院必须延长原告向被告提供诉讼服务的时间,如果由于原告无法控制的事项而延误服务,则存在正当理由。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 4(m)(流程服务死线)。

• 4B Charles Alan Wright等人,《联邦惯例和程序》第1137节(第4版,2020年)(解释程序服务的一般时限和因公例外)。

stem:
An investor from State A filed an action against his State B stockbroker in federal court in State A. The summons and complaint were served at the stockbroker's office in State B, where the process server handed the documents to the stockbroker's administrative assistant.

The stockbroker has answered the complaint, asserting the defense of improper service of process. Assume that both states' requirements for service of process are identical to the requirements of the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure.
stemZh:
一名来自 A 州的投资者在 A 州的联邦法院对他的 B 州股票经纪人提起诉讼。传票和诉状是在 B 州股票经纪人的办公室送达的，那里的送达人在该股票经纪人的行政助理手中交给了文件。

股票经纪人已对诉状作出答复，提出了送达程序不当的抗辩。假设两个州对送达程序的要求与联邦民事诉讼规则的要求相同。
ask: Is the court likely to dismiss the action for improper service of process?
askZh: 法院是否会因送达程序不当而驳回该诉讼？

options.en: No, because service was made on a person of suitable age found at the stockbroker's place of employment.
options.zh: 不会，因为送达是在股票经纪人办公场所的适龄人员手中进行的。

options.en: No, because the stockbroker waived her claim for improper service of process by asserting it in her answer.
options.zh: 不会，因为股票经纪人通过其答复提出了送达程序不当的主张，从而放弃了该主张。

options.en: Yes, because an individual defendant may not be served by delivering process to a third party found at the defendant's place of employment.
options.zh: 会，因为个人被告不能通过将诉讼文件交给在被告办公场所发现的第三方来送达。

options.en: Yes, because the process of State A courts is not effective in State B.
options.zh: 会，因为 A 州法院的送达程序在 B 州无效。

explanation.en:
A defendant receives notice of a lawsuit through service of process—ie, delivery of a summons and complaint. Under FRCP 4, a defendant who is an individual in the U.S. can be properly served with process within 90 days after the original complaint* is filed by:

• following the rules for serving process in the state where the court is located or the state where service is made

• delivering process to the defendant personally (or to an agent authorized by appointment or law to receive service of process) or

• leaving process at the defendant's dwelling with a resident of suitable age and discretion.

Here, the service-of-process requirements for State A (where the court is located) and State B (where service was made) are identical to those of FRCP 4. But the process server delivered the summons and complaint to the stockbroker's administrative assistant—not to the stockbroker personally or to her authorized agent. And though the assistant was likely of suitable age and discretion, the documents were left at the stockbroker's office—not her dwelling (Choice A). Therefore, the court will likely dismiss the action for improper service of process.

*Copies of other pleadings (eg, amended complaint, answer), motions, and other papers must also be served (ie, delivered) on the opposing party; however, a summons is not required and the deadline for service is governed by other procedural rules.

(Choice B) A claim for improper service of process is waived if it is not asserted in a pre-answer motion or answer, whichever occurs first. Therefore, the stockbroker preserved

this claim by asserting it in her answer since no pre-answer motion had been filed.

(Choice D) Service of process is proper if it complies with the rules of the state where service is made or where the court is located—even when service is made in a different state. Therefore, service of process under the rules of State A courts can be effective in State B.

Educational objective:

Process can be served by (1) following the rules of the state where the court is located or where service is made, (2) delivering the summons and complaint to the defendant personally (or to his/her authorized agent), or (3) leaving the summons and complaint at the defendant's dwelling with a resident of suitable age and discretion.

FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 4(e) (serving process on an individual in the U.S.).

explanation.zh:
被告通过送达诉讼文书、送达传票和根据FRCP 4,一名在美国是个人的被告。在提出原起诉状* 后90天内,以下人员可适当送达:

• 遵循法院所在地州或法院所在地州的服务程序规则已提供服务

• 向被告个人(或经指定或法律授权接受诉讼文书送达的代理人)交付诉讼,或

• 在被告住所与适龄居民离开程序,并斟酌决定。

在此,A州(法院所在地)和B州(服务所在地)的流程服务要求与FRCP 4相同。但过程服务器将传票和起诉状交给股票经纪人的行政助理,而不是股票经纪人本人或她授权的代理人。尽管该助理的年龄和酌处权可能适当,但文件留在股票经纪人的办公室,而不是她的住所(Choice A)。 因此,法院可能会驳回因诉讼文书送达不当而提出的诉讼。

* 其他书状(如修正后的起诉状、答复)、动议和其他文件也必须送达对方一方(即送达);但是,不需要传票,送达期限受其他程序规则管辖。

(Choice B) 如果在预先答复动议或答复中未提出诉讼文书送达不当的索赔要求,则放弃索赔,以先发生者为准。

由于没有提出答复前动议,因此在她的答复中坚持这一说法。

(Choice D) 程序服务如果符合提供服务的州或法院所在地的规则,即使服务是在不同的州进行的,也是适当的。因此,A州法院规则下的诉讼程序在B州可以有效。

学习要点：

程序可以通过以下方式实现:(1) 遵循法院所在地国或送达地国的规则,(2) 向被告个人(或其授权代理人)送交传票和控告,或(3) 将传票和控告留在法院所在地国。被告与适龄居民的住所和酌处权。

FRCP = 联邦民事诉讼规则

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 4(e)(在美国为个人服务)。

stem:
A bank sued a foreign investor for fraud in a federal court in State A. The bank was unable to ascertain the investor's primary address for 120 days after filing its complaint, but immediately thereafter mailed the investor a copy of the summons and complaint through certified mail to that address. The investor, upon receipt of the summons and complaint, retained counsel in State A.

State A permits service of process on an individual outside its borders by mailing the summons and complaint to the individual's primary residence. The foreign country where the investor resides is not a signatory to any international agreement that provides service-of-process rules, and there is no applicable federal statute. The foreign country does not

permit service by mail.

The investor has moved to dismiss the suit for improper service of process.
stemZh:
一家银行在 A 州 的联邦法院起诉一名外国投资者进行欺诈。银行在提起诉讼后 120 天内无法确定投资者的主地址，但此后立即通过挂号邮件将传唤和诉状邮寄到该地址。投资者在收到传唤和诉状后，在 A 州 保留了律师。

A 州 允许通过邮寄传唤和诉状至个人的主居所，即使该居所位于 A 州 之外。投资者居住的外国国家未签署任何提供送达规则的国际协议，且不存在适用的联邦法规。该外国国家不允许通过邮寄送达。

投资者提出了驳回诉讼的动议，理由是送达方式不当。
ask: What is the investor's best argument in support of the motion to dismiss?
askZh: 投资者支持驳回诉讼动议的最佳论点是什么？

options.en: The bank did not request that the federal court send a letter rogatory.
options.zh: 银行没有请求联邦法院发送请求书。

options.en: The bank served the summons and complaint more than 45 days after filing its complaint with the court.
options.zh: 银行在提起诉讼后超过 45 天才送达传唤和诉状。

options.en: The foreign country does not permit service by mail.
options.zh: 该外国国家不允许通过邮寄送达。

options.en: The investor can only be served by an internationally agreed method of service.
options.zh: 投资者只能通过国际同意的送达方式被送达。

explanation.en:
Methods of serving process in foreign country

Individual or organization

• Following international agreement reasonably calculated to give notice

• If no international agreement & not prohibited by federal law: – following foreign country's rules – as foreign country directs in response to letter rogatory or – unless prohibited by foreign country, by personal delivery* or mail with request for signed return receipt

• Following court order, unless prohibited by international agreement Foreign government

• Following special arrangement between plaintiff & foreign state

• If no special arrangement, by international convention

• If no convention, by mail to head of foreign affairs ministry with request for signed return receipt

• If service by mail cannot be made within 30 days, by sending two copies to U.S. Secretary of State via mail requiring signed receipt *Organizations cannot be served by personal delivery in foreign countries.

A plaintiff must give a defendant notice of a lawsuit through service of process—ie, delivery of the summons and complaint. Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 4(f), a defendant who is an individual can be served in a foreign country by any internationally agreed method of service that is reasonably calculated to give notice (Choice D). However, if there is no such method and no applicable federal law (as seen here), then the defendant can be served:

• by following the foreign country's rules for service of process

• as the foreign country directs in response to a letter rogatory—ie, a letter from a domestic court asking a foreign court for assistance or

• by delivering the summons and complaint to the defendant personally or by mail with a request for a signed return receipt (eg, certified mail)—unless prohibited by the foreign country.*

Here, the bank served the investor with a copy of the summons and complaint by certified mail. However, this method of service is prohibited by the foreign country. Therefore, this is the investor's best argument in support of the motion to dismiss.

*An individual in a foreign country can also be served by any other court-ordered method that does not violate an international agreement.

(Choice A) While asking the foreign country for assistance through a letter rogatory is one method to properly serve a foreign defendant, it is not the only method.

(Choice B) Absent good cause, a defendant located in the U.S. must be served with process within 90 days (not 45 days) after the complaint is filed. However, this 90-day deadline does not apply to a defendant located in a foreign country. Instead, most federal courts require that the plaintiff exercise due diligence in attempting to serve such a defendant.

Educational objective:

When no internationally agreed method of service or applicable federal law exists, an individual defendant in a foreign country can be served (1) by following the foreign country's service-of-process rules, (2) as the foreign country directs in response to a letter rogatory, or (3) by delivering process to the defendant personally or by mail—if permitted by the foreign country.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 4(f) (service on individual in foreign country).

explanation.zh:
在外国任职的程序方法

个人或组织

• 在达成通知的国际协定之后

• 如果联邦法律没有禁止的国际协定:——按照外国的规则——作为外国对调查委托书的指令,或——除非外国禁止个人递送* 或要求签字返回的邮件收据

• 根据法院命令,除非国际协定禁止外国政府

• 遵循原告与外国之间的特殊安排

• 如果没有特别安排,则根据国际公约

• 如果没有公约,则通过邮寄给外交部主管,请其签署收据

• 如果在30天内无法通过邮件送达,通过邮件向美国国务卿发送两份副本,需要签名的收据。

原告必须通过送达诉讼文书、发出传票和提出起诉状,向被告发出诉讼通知。根据《联邦民事诉讼法》第4(f)条,作为个人的被告可以在外国通过任何国际议定的服务方式得到服务,这种服务方式是经过合理计算以发出通知的(Choice D)。但是,如果没有这种方法,也没有适用的联邦法律(如此处所示),被告可以得到以下服务:

• 遵守外国关于送达诉讼文书的规则

· 如外国对调查委托书——即国内法院要求外国法院给予协助的信函——作出回复,或

• 亲自向被告送交传票和控告书,或邮寄要求签收的回信(例如,核证的邮件)——除非受到外国的禁止。

在此,银行向投资者提供了一份传票副本和经认证的邮件起诉状,但外国禁止这种服务方式,因此,这是投资者支持驳回动议的最佳论据。

* 在外国的个人也可以采用法院命令的不违反国际协定的任何其他方法。

(选择A)虽然通过委托书要求外国提供协助是适当服务外国被告的一种方法,但这不是唯一的方法。

(Choice B)如果没有好的理由,位于美国的被告必须在提出起诉状后90天内(而不是45天内)得到送达手续,但这一90天的期限不适用于位于外国的被告。相反,大多数联邦法院要求原告在试图为这种被告服务时应尽心尽力。

学习要点：

如果不存在国际商定的服务方法或适用的联邦法律,则可以(1)按照外国的流程服务规则向外国的个别被告提供服务,(2) 由外国根据信函发出指示。调查,或(3)在外国允许的情况下,亲自或通过邮件向被告交付程序。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 4(f)(在外国对个人的服务)。

stem:
A journalist domiciled in State A entered into a contract to write an article about a professor who works in State B and is domiciled in State C. The journalist and the professor negotiated and signed the contract in State A. When the journalist failed to produce the article by the deadline stated in the contract, the professor sued the journalist for breach of contract in a federal district court in State B.

The following week, the journalist traveled to State B for a court proceeding unrelated to the professor's suit. The professor had the journalist served with process while the journalist walked into the courthouse. The journalist had never traveled to State B prior to this court appearance and has no other contacts with State B. The journalist has moved to dismiss the professor's suit, asserting that the federal court lacks personal jurisdiction over him.
stemZh:
一名记者居住在 A 州，与一位在 B 州工作且居住在 C 州的教授签订合同，撰写一篇关于该教授的文章。记者与教授在 A 州协商并签署了该合同。当记者未能在合同中规定的截止日期内完成文章时，教授在 B 州的联邦地区法院对记者提起违约诉讼。

一周后，记者前往 B 州参加与教授诉讼无关的法院程序。教授在记者走进法院时向其送达了诉讼文书。记者此前从未到过 B 州，也没有与其他 B 州的联系。记者提出动议，主张联邦法院对其没有属人管辖权。
ask: Is the journalist's assertion correct?
askZh: 记者的主张是否正确？

options.en: No, because the journalist established minimum contacts with State B by traveling to the state.
options.zh: 不，因为记者通过前往 B 州建立了与 B 州的最低联系。

options.en: No, because the professor had the journalist served with process in State B.
options.zh: 不，因为教授在 B 州向记者送达了诉讼文书。

options.en: Yes, because the journalist was in State B to attend an unrelated court proceeding.
options.zh: 是的，因为记者前往 B 州参加与该诉讼无关的法院程序。

options.en: Yes, because the professor is domiciled in State C.
options.zh: 是的，因为教授居住在 C 州。

explanation.en:
Personal jurisdiction is a court's authority over the parties or property before it. One way a federal court can establish personal jurisdiction over a defendant is through tag jurisdiction (ie, transient jurisdiction). Tag jurisdiction exists when the defendant is served with process while voluntarily present in the forum state. As a result, tag jurisdiction does not exist when the defendant was:

• fraudulently or forcefully brought into the forum state to be served with process or

• present in the forum state to attend an unrelated judicial proceeding. Here, the professor had the journalist served with process in State B, the forum state where the federal court is located. But since the journalist was in State B for an unrelated judicial proceeding, tag jurisdiction does not exist (Choice B). Therefore, the journalist is correct that the federal court lacks personal jurisdiction over him.

(Choice A) Personal jurisdiction is established through specific jurisdiction when the plaintiff's claim arises from or is closely related to the defendant's minimum contacts with the forum state. In the unlikely event that the journalist's single trip to State B established minimum contacts, specific jurisdiction does not exist because the claim does not arise from nor is it closely related to that trip.

(Choice D) The fact that the professor (plaintiff) is domiciled in State C is irrelevant in determining whether the State B federal court has personal jurisdiction over the journalist (defendant). Because a plaintiff consents to personal jurisdiction by filing the suit, only a defendant's domicile is relevant in determining whether personal jurisdiction can be established through general jurisdiction.

Educational objective:

A federal court obtains personal jurisdiction over a defendant served with process while voluntarily present in the forum state unless the defendant was (1) fraudulently or forcefully brought into the state to be served with process or (2) present in the state to attend an unrelated judicial proceeding.

References

• Burnham v. Super. Ct. of Cal., 495 U.S. 604, 613 (1990) (explaining that tag jurisdiction exists unless the defendant was fraudulently or forcefully brought into the forum state or is present for another judicial proceeding).

explanation.zh:
属人管辖权是法院对其面前的当事人或财产的管辖权。 联邦法院可以确定对被告的属人管辖权的一种方式是通过标记管辖权(即暂时管辖权).当被告被送达程序时,就存在标记管辖权自愿出席论坛国家会议。因此,当被告是:

• 欺诈或强力带入法院地国接受诉讼程序或

· 在法院地州出席无关的司法程序,教授曾让该名记者在联邦法院所在地法院地B州州参与诉讼程序。但是,由于该记者是在B州进行一项无关的司法程序,因此不存在标记管辖权(Choice B)。 因此,该记者正确地认为,联邦法院对他没有属人管辖权。

(Choice A)当原告的要求产生于或与被告与法院地国的最低接触关系密切时,通过具体管辖权确立属人管辖权.如果记者在B州的一次旅行不可能建立最低限度的接触,则不存在具体的管辖权,因为这一旅行没有引起要求,也没有与该次旅行密切相关。

(Choice D)教授(原告)居住在C州的事实与确定B州联邦法院是否对记者(被告)拥有属人管辖权无关.由于原告同意提出诉讼而拥有属人管辖权,在确定是否可以通过一般管辖权确立属人管辖权时,只有被告的住所才是相关的。

学习要点：

联邦法院对在法院所在地国自愿出庭的被告拥有属人管辖权,除非被告(1) 被欺诈或强行带入该州接受诉讼,或者(2) 在州内出庭。一个无关紧要的司法程序。

参考资料

· Burnham诉Super. Ct. of Cal., 495 U.S. 604, 613(1990)(解释存在标记管辖权,除非被告被欺诈或强行带入法院地国或出席另一司法程序)。

stem:
A tire company is incorporated and has its principal place of business in Asia. The company assembles all its tires in Asia and sells them throughout the world. The company purchases tire valves from a manufacturer incorporated and headquartered in Europe. All of the valves are manufactured in Europe and sold exclusively to tire companies in Asia. The manufacturer was aware that tires with its valves were sold in State A, but it never contemplated that its sales to the company would subject it to suit there.

A tire assembled by the company exploded when a motorcyclist from State A was driving on a road in State A. The motorcyclist sued the company in a federal court in State A to recover $225,000 in medical expenses and property damage. The motorcyclist alleged that the valve in the tire was defective and caused the accident. The company impleaded the manufacturer for indemnification.

The motorcyclist settled his claim with the company, which left the company's indemnity claim against the manufacturer. In its answer, the manufacturer moved to dismiss the indemnity claim for lack of personal jurisdiction.

State A has a long-arm statute that gives its courts personal jurisdiction to the full extent allowed under the U.S. Constitution.
stemZh:
一家轮胎公司注册成立，其主要营业地在亚洲。该公司在亚洲组装所有轮胎，并将其销售到世界各地。该公司从一家在欧洲注册并总部设在欧洲的制造商处购买轮胎阀门。所有阀门均在欧洲制造，并且仅出售给亚洲的轮胎公司。制造商知道其阀门被安装在该公司生产的轮胎上并被销售到A 州，但从未预料到其对A 州 的销售会使其面临诉讼。

该公司组装的轮胎在A 州 的一条道路上爆炸，导致一名来自A 州 的摩托车手受伤。摩托车手在A 州 的联邦法院起诉该公司，要求赔偿 225,000 美元的医疗费用和财产损失。摩托车手声称轮胎中的阀门有缺陷并导致了事故。该公司将制造商列为第三人，要求其承担赔偿责任。

摩托车手与该公司达成和解，该公司因此放弃了对制造商的赔偿请求。在答辩中，制造商提出了驳回赔偿请求的动议，理由是没有对人管辖权。

A 州 有一个长臂条款，允许其法院行使对人管辖权，范围不超过美国宪法所允许的限度。
ask: How will the federal court likely rule on the manufacturer's motion to dismiss?
askZh: 联邦法院如何裁定制造商的驳回动议？

options.en: Deny the motion, because the manufacturer has continuous, systemic, and substantial contacts with State A.
options.zh: 驳回动议，因为制造商与A 州 有持续、系统且实质性的联系。

options.en: Deny the motion, because the manufacturer waived any objection to personal jurisdiction by failing to assert it in a pre-answer motion.
options.zh: 驳回动议，因为制造商未能在答辩前的动议中提出对管辖权的异议，因此放弃了异议。

options.en: Grant the motion, because the manufacturer did not purposefully avail itself of State A and exercising jurisdiction would offend notions of fair play and substantial justice.
options.zh: 批准动议，因为制造商并未有意利用A 州 的司法管辖，行使管辖权会违背公平和实质正义的原则。

options.en: Grant the motion, because the manufacturer never contemplated that its sales to the company would subject it to suit in State A.
options.zh: 批准动议，因为制造商从未预料到其对公司的销售会使其在A 州 面临诉讼。

explanation.en:
Requirements for specific jurisdiction

Long-arm statute

Forum state statute must authorize jurisdiction under specific circumstances

Due process

Minimum contacts

Purposeful availment of forum state's laws so suit is foreseeable:

• Stream of commerce test – defendant places goods in stream of commerce & takes action that intentionally targets forum state

• Effects test – defendant commits intentional tort in one state with intent that effects will be felt in forum state Fair play & substantial justice

Reasonableness factors:

• Burden on defendant to appear & defend in forum state

• Plaintiff's interest in obtaining relief in forum state

• Forum state's interest

• Interstate judicial system's interest in obtaining most efficient resolution of disputes

• Interest of several states in furthering fundamental substantive social policies Long-arm statutes specify when a court within the forum state can exercise specific personal jurisdiction over a nonresident defendant (eg, European manufacturer). However, due process only permits application of that statute when:

• the plaintiff's claim arises from or is closely related to the defendant's minimum contacts with the forum state and

• the exercise of jurisdiction complies with notions of fair play and substantial justice. Minimum contacts exist when the defendant purposefully avails itself of the state's protections and benefits so that it should reasonably foresee being sued there. For a defendant-manufacturer, this occurs when it places goods in the stream of commerce plus purposefully targets the forum state (eg, advertises there). Here, the manufacturer's valves happened to be (but were not purposely) sold in State A, so no minimum contacts exist.

Even if minimum contacts existed, the court would still dismiss the company's indemnity claim since exercising jurisdiction would offend notions of fair play and substantial justice. That is because:

• adjudicating the claim in State A would significantly burden the European manufacturer

• the company has minimal interest in adjudicating its claim there since it can be asserted in a foreign judicial forum

• State A has no interest in this dispute since the motorcyclist (State A citizen) has already been compensated through the settlement and

• the interstate judicial system and other states have little interest in the indemnity dispute since neither party resides in the U.S.

(Choice A) General personal jurisdiction exists when the defendant's continuous and systematic contacts with the forum state are so substantial that the defendant is "at home" there. Here, the manufacturer has no such contacts with State A because it is domiciled in Europe.

(Choice B) An objection to personal jurisdiction must be asserted in a pre-answer motion or answer, whichever occurs first. Therefore, the manufacturer's objection was not waived.

(Choice D) Minimum contacts only require that the defendant reasonably foresee—not actually contemplate—that it could be sued in the forum state.

Educational objective:

A defendant-manufacturer has minimum contacts with the forum state when it places goods in the stream of commerce plus purposefully targets that state.

References

• Asahi Metal Indus. Co. v. Super. Ct. of Cal., 480 U.S. 102, 114–16 (1987) (holding that the exercise of personal jurisdiction over a suit between foreign parties offended notions of fair play and substantial justice).

• J. McIntyre Mach., Ltd. v. Nicastro, 564 U.S. 873, 886–87 (2011) (Kennedy, J., plurality) (reaffirming that purposeful availment requires a defendant-manufacturer to purposefully target the forum state).

explanation.zh:
对具体管辖权的要求

长臂法规

论坛州法规必须在特定情况下授权管辖权

正当程序

最小联系人

可以预见到有意利用法院地国的法律:

• 商业流试 -- -- 被告将货物放在商业流中,并采取行动,蓄意针对法院地国

• 效果测试 -- -- 被告在一个国家犯下故意侵权罪,目的是在诉讼地州博览会中感受到效果和实质性正义

合理性因素:

• 被告在法院地国出庭和辩护的负担

• 原告在法院地国获得救济的利益

• 论坛国家的利益

• 州际司法制度对最有效地解决争端的兴趣

• 若干国家有兴趣推动基本的实质性社会政策具体说明法院所在地国的法院何时可对法院所在地国行使具体的属人管辖权。非居民被告(如欧洲制造商)。然而,正当程序只允许在下列情况下适用该规约:

• 原告的要求来自或与被告与法院地国的最低限度联系密切相关;

• 行使管辖权符合公平竞争和实质正义的概念,当被告有意利用国家的保护和利益,从而合理地预见到在该国被起诉时,有最低限度的接触。对于被告 -- -- 制造商来说,如果将货物放在商业流中,加上故意针对法院地国(例如在那里作广告),就会产生这种情况。在这里,制造商的阀门碰巧是在A州销售的(但并非有意销售),因此不存在最低限度的接触.

即使存在最低限度的联系,法院仍将驳回公司的赔偿要求,因为行使管辖权会违反公平竞争和实质性正义的概念。

• 在A州裁定索赔将给欧洲制造商带来很大负担

• 该公司在裁决其索赔方面的兴趣很小,因为它可以在外国司法论坛上提出;

• A州对这一争端没有兴趣,因为摩托车手(A州公民)已经通过解决得到赔偿,而且

· 州际司法制度和其他国家对赔偿争端兴趣不大,因为双方都不住美国。

(Choice A)当被告与法院地国的连续和系统的接触如此实质性以致被告"在家"时,一般属人管辖权就存在.在此,制造商与A州没有这种联系,因为它的住所在欧洲。

(Choice B) 必须在预先回答的动议或答复中申明反对属人管辖权,以先发生者为准。

(Choice D) 最低限度的接触只要求被告合理预见——实际上没有设想——可以在法院地国起诉。

学习要点：

被告 -- -- 制造商在将货物放在商业流中时与法院地国保持最低限度的联系,并故意以该地国为目标。

参考资料

• Asahi Metal Indus. Co.诉Super. Ct. of Cal., 480 U.S. 102,114-16(1987年)(认为对外国当事方之间的诉讼行使属人管辖权违反了公平竞争和实质正义的概念)。

• J. McIntyre Mach.有限公司诉Nicastro, 564 U.S.873,886–87 (2011)(Kennedy, J.,多元性)(重申有目的的利用要求被告-制造商故意以法院地国为目标)。

stem:
A woman from State A drove to visit her friend in a foreign country. During the visit, the brakes on the woman's car began to squeal, so she took the car to a nearby auto repair shop. The shop is owned by a company incorporated in State B and headquartered in the Eastern District of State C. The shop replaced her brakes with a set made by a brake manufacturer incorporated in State C and headquartered in State D. In State C, articles of incorporation must be filed with the Secretary of State's office located in the Western District of State C.

Two days later, the woman was driving her car in the foreign country when her brakes failed. This caused her to lose control of the car and crash. She suffered over $500,000 in injuries and property damage.

The woman seeks to file a joint complaint against the auto repair company and the manufacturer in federal court in State C.
stemZh:
一名来自 A 州的女子前往外国拜访她的朋友。在访问期间，女子的汽车刹车开始发出刺耳的声音，因此她将车开到了附近的汽车修理店。该修理店由一家在 B 州注册、总部位于 C 州东部地区的一家公司所有。修理店将她的刹车更换为由一家在 C 州注册、总部位于 D 州的刹车制造商生产的刹车片。在 C 州，公司注册文件必须提交给位于 C 州西部地区的州务卿办公室。

两天后，该女子在外国驾驶她的车时，刹车失灵。这导致她失去对车辆的控制并发生事故。她遭受了超过 500,000 美元的伤害和财产损失。

该女子希望在 C 州的联邦法院提起联合诉讼，起诉汽车修理公司和制造商。
ask: In which federal judicial district would venue be proper?
askZh: 审判地应为哪个联邦司法管辖区？

options.en: No judicial district.
options.zh: 没有司法管辖区。

options.en: The Eastern District of State C only.
options.zh: 仅 C 州东部地区。

options.en: The Western District of State C only.
options.zh: 仅 C 州西部地区。

options.en: The Eastern and Western Districts of State C.
options.zh: C 州东部和西部地区。

explanation.en:
Venue is the geographical location of specific federal districts in which a plaintiff's claim may be heard. A state can have multiple federal districts within its borders. And venue may be proper in more than one district because it is proper in any district where:

• any defendant resides—so long as all defendants reside in the same state (ie, residency-based venue)

• a substantial part of the events that gave rise to the suit occurred (ie, events-based venue) or a substantial part of the property at issue is located (property-based venue) or

• any defendant is subject to the court's personal jurisdiction—but only if neither of the above provisions applies (ie, fallback provision).

A defendant corporation resides in any district in which it is subject to personal jurisdiction. In a state with multiple judicial districts (as seen here), each district is treated as a separate state. And the defendant is deemed to reside in any district in which its contacts would create personal jurisdiction—eg, where the defendant filed its articles of incorporation or has its principal place of business. If no such district exists, then the defendant resides in the district where it has the most significant contacts.

Here, the auto repair company's headquarters (ie, principal place of business) are in the Eastern District of State C, and the manufacturer filed its articles of incorporation in the Western District of State C. As a result, both defendants are subject to personal jurisdiction in, and are therefore residents of, State C. This means that venue would be proper in any district in State C where one of the defendants resides—ie, the Eastern and Western Districts of State C (Choices A, B & C).

Educational objective:

Residency-based venue is proper in any judicial district where a defendant resides—as long as all defendants reside in the same state. And a defendant corporation only resides in judicial districts where it would be subject to personal jurisdiction if each district were a state.

References

• 28 U.S.C. § 1391(b)–(d) (residency-based venue for corporate defendants).

explanation.zh:
地点是可以听取原告申诉的具体联邦区的地理位置。州可以在其边界内设立多个联邦区。 地点可能在一个以上的区是适当的,因为任何区:

· 任何被告居住——只要所有被告居住在同一州(即基于居住地点)

• 引发诉讼的很大一部分事件(即基于事件的地点)或所涉财产的很大一部分位于该地点(基于财产的地点)或

• 任何被告均受法院的属人管辖权管辖——但只有在上述两项规定都不适用的情况下(即背对条款)才适用。

被告公司居住在受其属人管辖的任何地区,在一个拥有多个司法区的州(如这里所示),每个地区都被视为一个独立的州。被告被认为居住在其联系人将产生属人管辖权的任何地区,例如,被告提交了公司章程或有其主要营业地。如果没有这种地区,被告就居住在其联系最密切的地区。

在这里,汽车修理公司的总部(即主要营业地)位于C州东部地区,制造商在C州西部地区提交了公司章程。因此,两名被告在C州都受属人管辖,因此是C州居民。这意味着在被告之一居住的C州的任何地区——即C州东部和西部地区(Choices A, B & C)——的地点都是适当的。

学习要点：

在被告居住的任何司法区,只要所有被告居住在同一州,以居住为基础的地点都是适当的。被告公司只居住在司法区,如果每个区都是国家,则该区将受到属人管辖。

参考资料

• 《美国法典》第28篇第1391(b)-(d)条(公司被告的居住地点)。

stem:
A photographer sued a foreign publisher in a federal district court in State A for copyright infringement. The photographer followed the foreign country's service of process rules to serve the publisher with a copy of the summons and complaint. The publisher has never been to State A and conducts no business there.

The publisher filed a pre-answer motion to dismiss the case for improper service of process. The district court denied this motion. Twelve days after receiving notice of the denial, the publisher filed and served an answer that included a motion to dismiss the case for lack of personal jurisdiction.
stemZh:
一名摄影师在 A 州的联邦地区法院起诉一家外国出版商，指控其侵犯版权。摄影师根据该外国国家的诉讼文书送达规则，向出版商送达了起诉状和诉状副本。出版商从未到过 A 州，且在该州没有开展任何业务。

出版商在收到诉状前提交了驳回诉讼的动议，理由是诉讼文书送达不当。地区法院驳回了该动议。在收到法院驳回通知 12 天后，出版商提交并送达了答辩状，其中包含一项动议，要求驳回本案因缺乏属人管辖权。
ask: Is the court likely to grant the publisher's motion?
askZh: 法院很可能批准出版商的动议吗？

options.en: No, because the publisher failed to file and serve his answer within 10 days after receiving notice of the court's denial of his pre-answer motion.
options.zh: 不，因为出版商在收到法院驳回其诉前动议通知后 10 天内未提交并送达其答辩状。

options.en: No, because the publisher waived any objection to personal jurisdiction.
options.zh: 不，因为出版商放弃了对属人管辖权的任何异议。

options.en: Yes, because the publisher has never physically traveled to State A and conducts no business there.
options.zh: 是，因为出版商从未到过 A 州，且在该州没有开展任何业务。

options.en: Yes, because the publisher properly filed and served his answer.
options.zh: 是，因为出版商正确地提交并送达了其答辩状。

explanation.en:
Waiver of defenses

Defenses Waiver

• Lack of subject-matter jurisdiction

Never waived

• Lack of personal jurisdiction

• Improper venue

• Insufficient process or service of process

Waived if not asserted in pre-answer motion or answer (whichever occurs first)

• Failure to state claim

• Failure to join required party

Waived if not asserted before end of trial

• All other legal defenses Waived if not asserted in answer or amended answer

Personal jurisdiction is a court's authority over the parties or property before it. One way to establish personal jurisdiction is through the parties' consent. A plaintiff consents to the court's jurisdiction by filing the complaint in that court. In contrast, a defendant can consent in any of the following ways:

• Express consent – by contractually agreeing to the court's jurisdiction (eg, forum-selection clause)

• Implied consent – by engaging in an activity that the forum state has a substantial interest in regulating (eg, driving on public roads)

• Waiver – by failing to assert a personal-jurisdiction objection in a pre-answer motion or answer, whichever occurs first

Here, the publisher filed a pre-answer motion to dismiss for improper* service of process. But he previously waived any objection to personal jurisdiction by failing to assert this objection in his pre-answer motion. As a result, the publisher consented to the court's jurisdiction, and the court will likely deny his motion to dismiss.

*Service of process is proper here because a foreign defendant can be served by following the foreign country's rules for service of process.

(Choices A & D) If the defendant files a pre-answer motion, the defendant must file and serve an answer within 14 days after receiving notice of the court's denial or postponement of that motion—as the publisher did here. Nevertheless, the publisher waived his personal-jurisdiction defense by failing to assert it in his pre-answer motion.

(Choice C) The fact that the publisher has never physically traveled to State A and conducts no business there shows that the court cannot establish personal jurisdiction over him through specific jurisdiction. However, it can still establish personal jurisdiction through the publisher's consent.

Educational objective:

A court can acquire personal jurisdiction through the defendant's consent—ie, express consent, implied consent, or waiver. A defendant waives a personal-jurisdiction objection by failing to assert it in a pre-answer motion or answer, whichever occurs first.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 12(h)(1) (waiver of personal-jurisdiction defense).

放弃辩护

放弃辩护

• 缺乏属事管辖权

永不放弃

• 缺乏属人管辖权

• 地点不当

• 进程或服务不足

如果在回答前的动议或回答中没有坚持的话(无论哪一种先发生)

• 未申报索赔

• 未加入规定的政党

如果在审判结束前没有断言,则放弃

• 所有其他法律辩护,如果没有答辩或修正答复,则不予辩护

属人管辖权是法院对其面前的当事人或财产的管辖权,确立属人管辖权的一种方式是通过当事人的同意,原告通过向该法院提出起诉状同意法院的管辖权。相反,被告可以下列任何一种方式表示同意:

• 明示同意——以合同方式同意法院的管辖权(例如法院选择条款)

• 默示同意 -- -- 参与论坛国对管制(如在公路上开车)有重大兴趣的活动。

• 放弃——在预先回答动议或答复中未能提出属人管辖权的反对意见,以先发生者为准

在这里,出版商提出预先回答动议,以不恰当* 诉讼文书送达为由驳回。 但他先前没有在事先回答动议中提出反对,从而放弃了对属人管辖权的任何异议。因此,出版商同意了法院的管辖权,法院很可能驳回他提出的驳回动议.

* 诉讼文书送达是适当的,因为外国被告可以通过遵守外国的诉讼文书送达规则得到服务。

(Choices A & D)如果被告提出预先答复动议,被告必须在收到法院拒绝或推迟该动议的通知后14天内提出并送达答复——如出版商在这里所做的那样。尽管如此,出版商还是放弃了个人管辖权的辩护,没有在回答前动议中坚持这一点.

(C) 出版商从未亲身前往A州并在那里从事任何业务这一事实表明,法院无法通过具体管辖权确立对他的属人管辖权。然而,它仍然可以通过出版商的同意来确立属人管辖权.

学习要点：

法院可以通过被告的同意(如明示同意、默示同意或放弃)获得属人管辖权。 被告放弃属人管辖权的异议,因为被告没有在预先回答的动议或答复中提出该异议,以时间在先者为准。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P.12(h)(1)(放弃属人管辖权辩护)。

stem:
An accounting firm incorporated and headquartered in State A advertised its estate-planning services. An attorney in State A saw the firm's advertisement and wrote a

newspaper editorial claiming that the firm violated State A's statute on the unauthorized practice of law by not employing licensed attorneys. After the editorial was published, demand for the firm's estate-planning services significantly declined. The firm then sued the attorney for defamation in a State A federal court to recover $150,000.

In his answer, the attorney asserted that the editorial contained truthful statements protected by the free speech clause of the First Amendment. The attorney also asserted a $100,000 counterclaim to recover damages suffered as a result of the firm's suit. The attorney did not object to venue or jurisdiction. After the pleadings were filed and served, the court dismissed the case for lack of subject-matter jurisdiction. The firm appealed.
stemZh:
一家会计事务所在A 州 注册并设立总部，发布了其遗产规划服务的广告。A 州 的一名律师看到该事务所的广告后，在报纸上发表了一篇社论，声称该事务所违反了A 州 的未经授权执业法律，因为其未雇佣持牌律师。在社论发表后，该事务所的遗产规划服务需求显著下降。该事务所随后在A 州 的联邦法院起诉该律师，要求赔偿 150,000 美元。

在答辩中，该律师声称社论中包含的陈述是真实的，受第一修正案言论自由条款的保护。该律师还提出 100,000 美元的反诉，要求赔偿因该事务所诉讼所遭受的损失。该律师未对管辖权或审判地提出异议。在诉状和送达文件提交后，法院因缺乏事项管辖权而驳回了案件。该事务所提出上诉。
ask: Is the appellate court likely to reverse the dismissal?
askZh: 上诉法院是否会撤销驳回决定？

options.en: No, because the final-judgment rule prevents the appellate court from considering the appeal.
options.zh: 否，因为最终判决规则阻止上诉法院考虑上诉。

options.en: No, because the firm failed to establish subject-matter jurisdiction.
options.zh: 否，因为该事务所未能确立事项管辖权。

options.en: Yes, because the attorney did not object to the court's jurisdiction.
options.zh: 是，因为该律师未对该法院的管辖权提出异议。

options.en: Yes, because the suit involves a federal question.
options.zh: 是，因为该诉讼涉及联邦问题。

explanation.en:
Subject-matter jurisdiction is a federal court's authority to hear the merits of a particular case or controversy. This is a pure legal issue that an appellate court reviews de novo, giving no deference to the legal conclusions made by the lower court. This jurisdictional requirement can be established through:

• diversity jurisdiction – when the amount in controversy in the plaintiff's complaint exceeds $75,000 and the opposing parties are citizens of different states (not seen here) or

• federal-question jurisdiction – when the plaintiff asserts a claim that arises under the Constitution, a federal law, or a federal treaty. Federal-question jurisdiction must be established on the face of the plaintiff's well-pleaded complaint—as opposed to the defendant's answer or counterclaim.* This means

that the complaint must show that the federal issue is a necessary element of the plaintiff's cause of action. If the asserted federal issue is frivolous or later abandoned, then federal-question jurisdiction ceases to exist.

Here, the firm sued the attorney for defamation, a state-law claim. The attorney defended on the ground that his editorial contained truthful statements protected by the First Amendment. Since this federal issue arose in the attorney's answer—not the firm's complaint—the court lacks federal-question jurisdiction (Choice D). Therefore, the appellate court is not likely to reverse the dismissal.

*Congress created an exception that authorizes federal-question jurisdiction when a defendant (1) asserts a counterclaim arising from a federal patent or copyright statute and (2) removes the case from state to federal court.

(Choice A) The final-judgment rule generally precludes federal appellate courts from hearing an appeal until the federal district court has entered a final judgment—ie, a decision that fully resolves a dispute on the merits and leaves nothing for the court to do but enforce the judgment. A dismissal for lack of subject-matter jurisdiction is a final judgment, so the appellate court here can consider the appeal.

(Choice C) Subject-matter jurisdiction cannot be waived or consented to, so it is immaterial that the attorney did not object to the court's jurisdiction. Instead, a court must dismiss a case on its own initiative (ie, sua sponte) if, at any time, it determines that it lacks subject-matter jurisdiction.

Educational objective:

Federal-question jurisdiction exists when a claim arising under the Constitution, a federal law, or a federal treaty appears on the face of the plaintiff's complaint. A federal issue raised in the defendant's answer or counterclaim does not establish federal-question jurisdiction.

References

• 28 U.S.C. § 1331 (federal-question jurisdiction).

• Louisville & Nashville R.R. Co. v. Mottley, 211 U.S. 149, 152 (1908) (establishing the well-pleaded complaint rule).

• Holmes Group, Inc. v. Vornado Air Circulation Sys., Inc., 535 U.S. 826, 831 (2002) (holding that a defendant's answer or counterclaim does not establish federal-question jurisdiction).

explanation.zh:
属事管辖权是联邦法院审理特定案件或争议案情的权力,这是上诉法院重新审查的纯粹法律问题,并不尊重下级法院的法律结论。可通过下列方式确立这一管辖权要求:

• 异籍管辖权——当原告起诉状的争议金额超过75 000美元,而对立方是不同国家的公民(此处不见)或

• 联邦问题管辖权——当原告根据《宪法》、联邦法律或联邦条约提出要求时。联邦问题管辖权必须从原告的表面确定。起诉状内容充分——而不是被告的答复或反诉。这意味着

起诉状必须表明联邦问题是原告理由的一个必要因素;如果声称的联邦问题无意义或后来被放弃,那么联邦问题管辖权不复存在。

在此,律师事务所起诉律师诽谤,这是州法的主张,律师以他的社论包含受第一修正案保护的真实陈述为理由进行辩护。由于这个联邦问题出现在律师的答复中,而不是公司的起诉状中,因此法院缺乏联邦问题管辖权(Choice D)。 因此,上诉法院不可能推翻驳回。

* 如果被告(1) 主张因联邦专利或版权法规而提出的反诉,(2) 将案件从州法院移到联邦法院,则国会规定了一项例外,授权联邦质疑管辖权。

(选择A)最后裁决规则一般禁止联邦上诉法院审理上诉,直到联邦地区法院作出最后判决,即完全解决案情纠纷的裁决,法院只能这样做。以缺乏属事管辖权为由予以驳回是最终判决,因此上诉法院可以审理上诉。

(C) 事由管辖权不能放弃或同意,因此,律师不反对法院管辖权这一点无关紧要。相反,如果法院在任何时候认定案件缺乏属事管辖权,它必须主动驳回案件(即sua sponte)。

学习要点：

当原告的起诉状表面出现根据宪法、联邦法律或联邦条约提出的诉讼时,就存在联邦问题管辖权。在被告的答复或反诉中提出的联邦问题并不确立联邦问题管辖权。

参考资料

• 《联邦法典》第28编第1331条(联邦问题管辖权)。

• Louisville & Nashville R.R. Co.诉Mottley, 211 U.S. 149, 152 (1908年)(制定完善的起诉状规则)。

• Holmes Group, Inc.诉Vornado Air Rounding Sys, Inc., 535 U.S.826,831(2002)(认为被告的回答或反诉没有确立联邦质疑管辖权)。

stem:
A bus passenger from State A was injured when a bus owned by a company incorporated and headquartered in State B negligently collided with another vehicle on a road in State A. The passenger agreed to release the company from liability in exchange for a free lifetime bus membership valued at $60,000. Two years later, Congress passed a law that prohibited bus companies from providing free lifetime bus memberships, so the company revoked the passenger's membership.

The passenger sued the company in federal court for breach of contract. In his complaint, the passenger stated that the company would likely argue that its breach was necessary to comply with the federal statute. The passenger claimed that this defense is invalid because the statute violates the U.S. Constitution.

The company filed a motion to dismiss the passenger's suit for lack of subject-matter jurisdiction before filing an answer.
stemZh:
一名来自 A 州的公交车乘客在一辆由总部设在 B 州的公司拥有的公交车因疏忽与另一辆车相撞时受伤。事故发生在 A 州的一条道路上。该乘客同意放弃公司责任，以换取价值 60,000 美元的终身免费公交会员资格。两年后，国会通过了一项法律，禁止公交公司提供免费终身会员资格，因此该公司撤销了该乘客的会员资格。

该乘客在美国联邦法院起诉该公司违反合同。在起诉状中，该乘客表示该公司可能会辩称其违约是为了遵守联邦法律。乘客声称该辩护无效，因为该法律违反了美国宪法。

该公司在提交答辩状之前，提出了一项驳回诉讼动议，理由是法院缺乏事项管辖权。
ask: How will the court likely rule on the company's motion?
askZh: 法院对该公司的动议将如何裁决？

options.en: Deny the motion, because the company failed to challenge subject-matter jurisdiction in its answer.
options.zh: 驳回动议，因为该公司未在答辩状中挑战事项管辖权。

options.en: Deny the motion, because the passenger's claim presents a federal issue.
options.zh: 驳回动议，因为乘客的主张涉及联邦问题。

options.en: Grant the motion, because state courts have exclusive jurisdiction over state-law claims.
options.zh: 批准动议，因为州法院对州法主张拥有专属管辖权。

options.en: Grant the motion, because the court lacks subject-matter jurisdiction.
options.zh: 批准动议，因为法院缺乏事项管辖权。

explanation.en:
Subject-matter jurisdiction is a court's authority to hear a case on the merits. The party seeking to invoke a federal court's subject-matter jurisdiction (generally the plaintiff) has the burden to prove by a preponderance of the evidence that the court has either:

• diversity jurisdiction – when the parties are citizens of different states and the amount in controversy exceeds $75,000 (not $60,000, as seen here) or

• federal-question jurisdiction – when the plaintiff asserts a cause of action that arises under the Constitution, a treaty, or a federal law.

For federal-question jurisdiction to be invoked, the federal issue must appear on the face of the plaintiff's well-pleaded complaint—not the defendant's answer or counterclaim. The jurisdictional statement in the complaint must show that the federal issue is a necessary element of the plaintiff's cause of action.* Merely mentioning a federal issue that may be asserted in the defendant's answer is insufficient.

Here, the passenger's complaint asserts a breach of contract claim. It also states that the company would likely argue that it breached the contract to comply with a federal statute, which the passenger alleges is unconstitutional. Since this federal issue arises from an anticipated defense—not the cause of action—the complaint fails to establish federal-question jurisdiction (Choice B). Therefore, the court will likely grant the company's

motion.

*In rare situations, the complete-preemption doctrine allows a state-law claim to be considered a federal-law claim when Congress clearly intended for a federal statute to completely preempt (ie, supersede) state law.

(Choice A) A party or the court can challenge subject-matter jurisdiction at any time, including in a pre-answer motion.

(Choice C) State and federal courts have concurrent (ie, shared) jurisdiction over most state-law claims. The only substantive areas over which state courts have exclusive jurisdiction are probate matters (eg, authenticating a will) and domestic relations (eg, issuing a divorce).

Educational objective:

Federal-question jurisdiction exists when the face of the plaintiff's well-pleaded complaint asserts a claim arising under the Constitution, a federal law, or a treaty. A complaint is well-pleaded when its jurisdictional statement shows that the federal issue is a necessary

element of the plaintiff's cause of action.

References

• 28 U.S.C. § 1331 (federal-question jurisdiction).

• Louisville & Nashville R.R. Co. v. Mottley, 211 U.S. 149, 152 (1908) (establishing the well-pleaded complaint rule).

• 32A Am. Jur. 2d Federal Courts § 854 (2020) (explaining that anticipated defenses cannot be the basis for federal-question jurisdiction).

事由管辖权是法院根据案情审理案件的权力。寻求援引联邦法院属事管辖权的当事人(一般为原告)多数证据必须证明法院有:

• 异籍管辖权——当当事方是不同国家的公民,争议金额超过75 000美元(不是6万美元,如本文所示)或

• 联邦问题管辖权 -- -- 当原告声称根据《宪法》、条约或联邦法律提起诉讼时。

若要援引联邦问题管辖权,联邦问题必须出现在原告充分起诉状的表面,而不是被告的答复或反诉。起诉状中的管辖权说明必须表明,联邦问题是原告诉讼理由的一个必要因素。 * 仅仅提到被告答复中可以主张的联邦问题是不够的。

在此,该乘客的起诉状声称违反了合同,还说,该公司很可能认为它违反了遵守联邦法规的合同,而该乘客声称这是违宪的。由于这一联邦问题产生于预期的辩护,而不是诉讼原因,因此起诉状未能确立联邦问题管辖权(Choice B)。

移动。

* 在极少数情况下,完全先决原则允许将州法权利主张视为联邦法权利主张,而国会显然打算将联邦法规完全先于(即取代)州法。

(选择A)一方或法院可以在任何时候,包括在预先回答的动议中,对事项管辖权提出质疑.

(选择C) 州法院和联邦法院对大多数州法律拥有并行(即共同)管辖权州法院具有专属管辖权的唯一实质性领域是遗嘱事务(例如,认证遗嘱)和家庭关系(例如,签发遗嘱)离婚问题)。

学习要点：

当原告的精心起诉状的表面提出根据《宪法》、联邦法律或条约提出的诉讼时,即存在联邦问题管辖权。如果一项起诉状的管辖权声明表明,联邦问题是必要的,则起诉状得到妥善处理。

原告的诉讼理由要素。

参考资料

• 《联邦法典》第28编第1331条(联邦问题管辖权)。

• Louisville & Nashville R.R. Co.诉Mottley, 211 U.S. 149, 152 (1908年)(制定完善的起诉状规则)。

• 32A Am. Jur. 2d联邦法院§854(2020年)(解释预期辩护不能作为联邦质疑管辖权的依据)。
