sourceSetLabel: 民事诉讼法 · 第 1 组
stem:
A business incorporated in State A hired an advertiser living in State B and a lawyer living in State C to help the business's advertising efforts in a foreign country. The contract was signed in the foreign country, and all work to be performed under the contract was to be done in that country. The advertiser and the lawyer failed to arrange for the advertising in the foreign country as required by the contract.

The business sued the advertiser and the lawyer in State B federal court for breach of contract, requesting $400,000 in damages. The advertiser was properly served with process at his residence, and the lawyer was properly served with process while conducting business in State B. The two defendants have timely filed a pre-answer motion to dismiss the case for improper venue.
stemZh:
一家在 A 州注册的公司雇佣了居住在 B 州的广告商和居住在 C 州的律师，帮助公司在外国开展广告业务。合同是在该外国签署的，合同项下所有工作均应在该国进行。广告商和律师未能按照合同要求在该外国安排广告业务。

公司在美国 B 州联邦法院起诉广告商和律师违反合同，要求赔偿 400,000 美元。广告商在其住所被合法送达诉讼文书，律师则在其于 B 州从事业务时被合法送达诉讼文书。两名被告及时提出了驳回诉讼动议，认为本案的审判地不适当。
ask: How should the federal court rule on the defendants' motion to dismiss?
askZh: 联邦法院应如何裁定被告的驳回诉讼动议？

options.en: Deny the motion, because the advertiser resides in State B.
options.zh: 驳回动议，因为广告商居住在 B 州。

options.en: Deny the motion, because the defendants are subject to personal jurisdiction in State B.
options.zh: 驳回动议，因为被告在 B 州具有属人管辖权。

options.en: Grant the motion, because a substantial portion of the events giving rise to the breach of contract claim did not occur in State B.
options.zh: 批准动议，因为导致违反合同索赔的大部分事件并未发生在 B 州。

options.en: Grant the motion, because the lawyer does not reside in State B.
options.zh: 批准动议，因为律师并不居住在 B 州。

explanation.en:
Under 28 U.S.C § 1391(b), venue is proper in any federal district where:

• any defendant resides—as long as all defendants reside in the same state (ie, residency-based venue)

• a substantial part of the events that gave rise to the suit occurred (ie, events-based venue) or a substantial part of the property at issue is located (ie, property-based venue) or

• any defendant is subject to the court's personal jurisdiction—but only when venue cannot be established under the first two provisions (ie, fallback provision).

Here, there is no residency-based venue because the defendants reside in different states— States B and C (Choice A). Additionally, there is no events-based venue because the events—where the contract was signed and to be performed—occurred in the foreign country. And since this case does not concern property, there is no property-based venue.

However, venue is proper in State B under the fallback provision because the State B federal court has personal jurisdiction over the advertiser who resides (ie, is domiciled) there. The court also has personal jurisdiction over the lawyer because he was served with process while voluntarily in State B on business. Therefore, the defendants' motion to dismiss for improper venue should be denied (Choices C & D).

Educational objective:

Venue is proper in any federal district where: (1) any defendant resides, so long as all defendants reside in the same state, (2) a substantial part of the events occurred or the property at issue is located, or (3) any defendant is subject to personal jurisdiction—but only if the first two provisions do not apply.

References

• 28 U.S.C. § 1391(b) (proper venue).

explanation.zh:
根据《美国法典》第28编第1391(b)节,任何联邦区,如:

• 任何被告居住——只要所有被告居住在同一州(即以居住为基地的地点)

• 导致诉讼的很大一部分事件(即以事件为基础的地点)或所涉财产的相当一部分被找到(即以财产为基础的地点)或

· 任何被告都受法院的属人管辖权管辖——但只有在根据前两项规定(即倒置条款)无法确定地点时才适用。

这里没有以居住为主的场所,因为被告居住在不同的州——B州和C州(选择A州)。 此外,没有以事件为主的场所,因为签订合同和履行合同的地点——发生在外国。由于此案不涉及财产,因此没有基于财产的地点.

然而,根据倒置条款,地点在B州是适当的,因为B州联邦法院对居住在(即户籍所在地)的广告商拥有属人管辖权。法院对该律师也拥有属人管辖权,因为他是在B州自愿从事商务时接受诉讼程序的,因此,应驳回被告因地点不当而驳回他的动议(Choices C & D)。

学习要点：

在下列任何联邦区地点是适当的:(1) 任何被告居住,只要所有被告居住在同一州;(2) 大部分事件发生或所涉财产所在地;或(3) 任何被告受属人管辖;只有在前两项规定不适用的情况下。

参考资料

• 《美国法典》第28篇第1391(b)(适当审判地)。

stem: A bicyclist from State A collided with a hiker from State B on a trail in State A. The hiker sued the bicyclist for negligence in a federal district court to recover $75,000 in medical expenses. The case was tried to the court. After the close of evidence, the judge announced findings of fact and conclusions of law from the bench and entered a judgment in favor of the hiker. The bicyclist appealed.
stemZh: 一名来自 A 州的自行车骑手在 A 州的一条小径上与一名来自 B 州的徒步旅行者发生碰撞。徒步旅行者在联邦地区法院起诉自行车骑手，指控其过失，并要求赔偿 75,000 美元的医疗费用。案件在法院审理完毕。在证据结束之后，法官在庭上宣布了事实认定和法律结论，并作出有利于徒步旅行者的判决。自行车骑手提出上诉。
ask: Is the appellate court likely to reverse the judgment?
askZh: 上诉法院很可能会推翻该判决吗？

options.en: No, because the judge properly issued findings and conclusions on the record.
options.zh: 不，因为法官在案卷记录上正确地发布了事实认定和结论。

options.en: No, because the judge's findings and conclusions are the law of the case.
options.zh: 不，因为法官的事实认定和结论是案件的法律。

options.en: Yes, because federal appellate courts do not have jurisdiction to decide issues of state law.
options.zh: 是的，因为联邦上诉法院无权决定州法律问题。

options.en: Yes, because the judge had no authority to hear the case.
options.zh: 是的，因为法官没有审理此案的权力。

explanation.en:
A federal court has authority to hear a case that falls within the court's subject-matter jurisdiction. This jurisdictional requirement, unlike personal jurisdiction, cannot be waived or established by the parties' consent. As a result, a challenge to subject-matter jurisdiction can be raised by a party or on the court's own initiative (ie, sua sponte) at any time—including on appeal* (as seen here).

Subject-matter jurisdiction can be established through either:

• federal-question jurisdiction – when a claim arises under the U.S. Constitution, a treaty, or federal law (not seen here) or

• diversity jurisdiction – when the opposing parties are citizens of different states and the amount in controversy exceeds $75,000 (not seen here). Since the hiker's claim does not satisfy federal-question or diversity jurisdiction, the district court judge had no authority to hear the case. Therefore, the appellate court will likely reverse the judgment and remand with instructions to dismiss the case for lack of subject-matter jurisdiction.

*If a party had an opportunity to challenge the court's subject-matter jurisdiction at some point during the proceedings, that party cannot collaterally attack the court's jurisdiction in subsequent litigation (eg, in a proceeding to enforce the court's judgment).

(Choice A) In a bench trial, the judge acts as the finder of fact and interpreter of the law. This dual role requires the judge to issue (orally or in writing) findings of fact and conclusions of law on the record. Although the judge did so here, she lacked authority to hear the case and so the judgment should be reversed.

(Choice B) The law-of-the-case doctrine prohibits the relitigation of legal (not factual) issues decided by a higher court in the same case. This means that a district court must apply an appellate court's legal determinations on remand, but an appellate court is not bound by a district court's conclusions.

(Choice C) Federal appellate courts do have jurisdiction to decide issues of state law appealed from a federal district court. However, federal courts (except the U.S. Supreme Court) lack jurisdiction over an appeal from a state's highest court pursuant to the Rooker-Feldman doctrine.

Educational objective:

A challenge to subject-matter jurisdiction cannot be waived. It can be raised by the parties or by the court on its own initiative at any time, including on appeal.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 12(h)(3) (stating that a court must dismiss an action once it determines, at any time, that it lacks subject-matter jurisdiction).

• Ins. Corp. of Ir., Ltd., et al. v. Compagnie des Bauxites de Guinee, 456 U.S. 694, 702 (1982) (explaining that an appellate court has the power to raise lack of subject-matter jurisdiction on its own initiative).

explanation.zh:
联邦法院有权审理属于法院属事管辖权的案件,而这种管辖权要求与属人管辖权不同,不能经当事人同意而放弃或确立。因此,对事项管辖权的质疑可以由当事人提出,也可以由法院主动提出(e, sua sponte),在任何时候提出,包括在上诉时提出(参见此处)。

属事管辖权可通过下列方式确立:

• 联邦问题管辖权 -- -- 根据美国宪法、条约或联邦法律(此处不见)提出要求时;或

· 异籍管辖权——当对立方是不同国家的公民,争议金额超过75,000美元(此处不见).由于徒步者的要求不符合联邦问题或异籍管辖权,地区法院法官无权审理此案。因此,上诉法院很可能推翻判决并发回重审,并指示以缺乏属事管辖权为由驳回案件。

* 如果当事一方有机会在诉讼期间的某个时候质疑法院的标的物管辖权,则该当事一方不能在以后的诉讼中(例如在执行法院判决的程序中)附带攻击法院的管辖权。

(Choice A)在庭上的审判中,法官充当事实的发现者和法律的诠释者,这种双重作用要求法官(或以口头或书面形式)发布对事实的调查结果和法律的结论,并记录在案.虽然法官在这里这样做,但她缺乏审理案件的权力,因此判决应当推翻。

(Choice B)案法学说禁止对上级法院在同一案件中裁定的法律(而非事实)问题进行重新诉讼.这意味着区法院必须在还押时适用上诉法院的法律裁定,但上诉法院不受区法院结论的约束。

(选择C)联邦上诉法院确实有权裁定向联邦上诉法院上诉的州法律问题。不过,联邦法院(美国除外)。最高法院根据Rooker-Feldman原则对州最高法院的上诉没有管辖权。

学习要点：

对属事管辖权的质疑不能放弃,当事人或法院可以在任何时候主动提出,包括在上诉时提出。

参考资料

• Fed.R. Civ.P.12(h)(3)(规定法院一旦确定在任何时候缺乏属事管辖权,就必须驳回诉讼)。

• Ins. Corp. of Ir., Ltd., et al. v. Compagnie des Bouxites de Guinee, 456 U.S. 694, 702(1982)(解释上诉法院有权主动提出缺乏属事管辖权的问题)。

stem: A bank located in State A sued a homeowner who resides in State B in a federal court in State A to recover $200,000. The bank's complaint alleges that the homeowner failed to pay his mortgage on a vacation home located in State A. The homeowner's answer admits that he completed and signed an online preapproval application for the mortgage but never finished the mortgage-application process because he decided to rent a time-share in State A instead. The homeowner claims that his signature on the mortgage was forged. The homeowner also included in his answer a motion to dismiss for lack of personal jurisdiction. The preapproval application contained a clause that states: "All disputes between the parties involved in this mortgage-application process are to be resolved in a state or federal court in State A."
stemZh: 一家位于 A 州的银行在 A 州的联邦法院起诉一名居住在 B 州的房主，要求偿还 200,000 美元。银行的起诉状指控房主未能支付位于 A 州的度假屋的按揭贷款。房主的答辩状承认他完成了并签署了该按揭贷款的在线预批准申请，但从未完成按揭贷款申请流程，因为他决定在 A 州租用一间分时度假屋。房主声称其在按揭贷款上的签名是伪造的。房主还在其答辩状中提出一项动议，要求驳回诉讼，理由是没有对房主的属人管辖权。该预批准申请包含一项条款，内容为："本按揭贷款申请过程中涉及的各方之间的所有争议应在 A 州的州或联邦法院解决。"
ask: How should the federal court rule on the homeowner's motion to dismiss?
askZh: 联邦法院应该如何裁定房主的驳回诉讼动议？

options.en: Deny the motion, because the forum-selection clause gives the court personal jurisdiction over the homeowner.
options.zh: 驳回该动议，因为法院选择条款赋予法院对房主的属人管辖权。

options.en: Deny the motion, because the homeowner's time-share is in State A.
options.zh: 驳回该动议，因为房主的分时度假屋位于 A 州。

options.en: Grant the motion, because forum-selection clauses are unenforceable in federal court.
options.zh: 批准该动议，因为法院选择条款在联邦法院不可执行。

options.en: Grant the motion, because the homeowner resides in State B.
options.zh: 批准该动议，因为房主居住在 B 州。

explanation.en:
Personal jurisdiction

(court's authority over defendant)

Type Requirements

Service of process

• Serving process on defendant voluntarily in state where court is located (ie, forum state)

Consent • Express – contractual agreement (eg, forum-selection clause)

• Implied – engaging in specific activity that state has substantial interest in regulating (eg, driving on public roads)

• Waiver – untimely objection to personal jurisdiction

• Appearance – voluntarily appearing in court to litigate merits of case Specific

(case-linked)

• Plaintiff's claim arises from or is closely related to defendant's minimum contacts (ie, purposeful availment) with forum state AND

• Exercise of jurisdiction complies with notions of fair play & substantial justice General

(all-purpose)

• Defendant has continuous & systematic contacts with forum state so substantial that defendant is essentially "at home" (ie, defendant's domicile) Personal jurisdiction refers to a court's authority over the parties (or property) in a lawsuit. Since a plaintiff consents to the court's jurisdiction by filing the lawsuit, the exercise of personal jurisdiction focuses on the defendant. A defendant can consent to the court's jurisdiction in any of the following ways:

• Waiver – by failing to assert an objection to personal jurisdiction in a pre-answer motion or answer (whichever occurs first)

• Implied consent – by engaging in an activity that the forum state has a substantial interest in regulating

• Express consent – by contractually agreeing to the court's jurisdiction (eg, forum-selection clause)

A forum-selection clause is a provision in a contract that designates the location and/or court where any dispute between the parties must be adjudicated. Such clauses are generally enforceable in state and federal courts so long as a party's agreement was not induced by fraud (Choice C).

Here, the mortgage-preapproval application has a forum-selection clause stating that "[a]ll disputes between the parties involved in this mortgage-application process are to be resolved in a state or federal court in State A." Since there is no indication that the homeowner was fraudulently induced to complete the preapproval application, he expressly consented to personal jurisdiction in State A. Therefore, the court should deny his motion to dismiss.

(Choice B) The fact that the homeowner's time-share is in State A does not establish personal jurisdiction. This is because the claim arises from the vacation home—not the time-share (no specific jurisdiction)—and the homeowner's domicile is State B (no general jurisdiction).

(Choice D) Although the homeowner resides in State B, he expressly consented to the State A court's personal jurisdiction by signing the mortgage-preapproval application with a forum-selection clause.

Educational objective:

Personal jurisdiction can be established through the defendant's waiver, implied consent, or express consent—eg, a forum-selection clause.

References

• Nat'l Equip. Rental, Ltd. v. Szukhent, 375 U.S. 311, 316 (1964) (stating that "parties to a contract may agree in advance to submit to the jurisdiction of a given court").

explanation.zh:
属人管辖权

(法院对被告的权力)

所需经费类型

流程服务

• 在法院所在地国(即法院所在地国)为被告自愿提供服务

• 明示-合同协议(如法院地选择条款)

• 参与国家非常有兴趣管理的具体活动(如在公共道路上驾驶)

• 放弃 -- -- 不及时反对属人管辖权

• 出庭——自愿出庭对案件案情提起诉讼

(与案件相关)

• 原告的要求产生于或与被告与法院地国的最低接触(即有意利用)密切相关;

• 行使管辖权符合公平竞争和实质性司法的概念

(全部用途)

• 被告与法院地国有持续和有系统的联系,以致被告基本上“在家里”(即被告的住所),个人管辖权是指法院在诉讼中对当事方(或财产)的权力。由于原告通过提起诉讼同意法院的管辖权,因此行使属人管辖权侧重于被告。被告可以下列任何一种方式同意法院的管辖权:

• 放弃——在预先回答的动议或答复中未能对属人管辖权提出反对(无论哪一种情况首先发生)

• 默示同意——参与论坛国对管制有重大利益的活动;

• 明示同意——以合同方式同意法院的管辖权(例如法院选择条款)

诉讼地选择条款是合同中的一项规定,它指定必须裁定当事人之间任何纠纷的地点和(或)法院。只要当事人的协议不是由欺诈引起的(C选择),这种条款一般可在州和联邦法院执行。

在此,抵押贷款申请的核准程序有一个诉讼地选择条款,规定“参与这一抵押贷款申请过程的当事人之间的所有纠纷应由A州的州法院或联邦法院解决。”房主被欺诈诱使完成预先批准的申请,他明确同意在A州拥有属人管辖权。 因此,法院应驳回其驳回申请的动议。

(Choice B) 房主的时间份额在A州的事实并不确立属人管辖权.这是因为索赔来自度假住宅——而不是时间分配(没有具体管辖权)——而房主的住所是B州(没有一般管辖权)。

(Choice D) 尽管房主居住在B州,但他明确同意A州法院的属人管辖权,签署了附有法院选择条款的抵押权预先核准申请。

学习要点：

可以通过被告的放弃、默示同意或明示同意——例如法院选择条款——确立属人管辖权。

参考资料

• Nat'l Equip Revolution, Ltd. v. Szukhent, 375 U.S. 311, 316(1964) (规定“合同的当事方可事先同意提交某一法院管辖”)。

stem:
A federal government employee, a citizen of State A, was driving home after his shift in State B when he lost control of his automobile and hit a pedestrian, a citizen of State C. The employee has never been to State C.

The pedestrian filed a negligence suit against the employee in federal court in State C to recover $80,000 in damages. The employee filed a motion to dismiss the action based on improper venue. The pedestrian responded that venue was proper in State C, where she resides, because the employee works for the federal government.
stemZh:
一名联邦政府雇员，A 州公民，在 B 州 完成工作后开车回家时失去对车辆的控制，撞上了一名行人，C 州公民。该雇员从未到过 C 州。

行人向 C 州的联邦法院提起诉讼，指控该雇员过失，要求赔偿 80,000 美元。雇员提出了动议，要求驳回诉讼，理由是诉讼地不当。行人回应称，诉讼应在 C 州提起，因为该雇员为联邦政府工作，而她居住在 C 州。
ask: If the court grants the employee's motion, what is the likely explanation?
askZh: 如果法院批准了雇员的动议，最可能的解释是什么？

options.en: A federal government employee cannot be sued where the plaintiff resides.
options.zh: 一名联邦政府雇员不能在原告居住地被起诉。

options.en: The employee must be sued in State A, where he resides.
options.zh: 该雇员必须在其居住地 A 州 被起诉。

options.en: The pedestrian sued the employee in his individual capacity.
options.zh: 行人以雇员个人身份提起诉讼。

options.en: The suit does not arise under a federal statute.
options.zh: 该诉讼并非基于联邦法律。

explanation.en:
Proper venue for suit against federal officer or employee

Official capacity

(recovery from government)

Special venue rules permit suit in district where:

• any Δ resides

• substantial portion of events occurred or property located

• π resides if no real property involved Individual capacity

(recovery from officer/employee)

General venue statute permits suit in district where:

• any Δ resides, if all Δs reside in same state

• substantial portion of events occurred or property located

• any Δ subject to personal jurisdiction if neither of above applies π = plaintiff; Δ = defendant.

Venue refers to the federal judicial district where a case may be heard. When a plaintiff sues a federal officer or employee, proper venue depends on whether the defendant is sued in his/her official or individual capacity. When an officer or employee is sued in an official capacity, recovery is sought from the federal government and special venue rules apply. Under one such rule, venue is proper where the plaintiff resides.

In contrast, when an officer or employee is sued in an individual capacity, recovery is sought from the officer or employee. In these suits, the general venue statute applies, and venue is proper only where:

• any defendant resides, so long as all defendants reside in the same state (residency-based venue)

• a substantial portion of the events giving rise to the suit occurred (events-based venue) or a substantial part of the property at issue is located (property-based venue) or

• any defendant is subject to the court's personal jurisdiction, but only if neither of the above provisions applies (fallback provision).

Here, the pedestrian (plaintiff) sued the federal employee (defendant) in State C, where the pedestrian resides. Therefore, venue would only be proper in State C if the employee was sued in his official capacity (Choice A). So, if the court dismisses the action for improper venue, it is likely because the pedestrian sued the employee in his individual capacity.

(Choice B) The employee could have been sued in State A, where he resides. However, he also could have been sued in State B, where the accident giving rise to the suit occurred.

(Choice D) The fact that the suit does not arise under a federal statute relates to subject-matter jurisdiction, not venue. Additionally, subject-matter jurisdiction exists through

diversity jurisdiction since the employee and pedestrian are citizens of different states and the amount in controversy exceeds $75,000.

Educational objective:

When a federal officer or employee is sued in his/her official capacity, special venue rules apply—eg, venue is proper where the plaintiff resides. However, the general venue statute applies when a federal officer or employee is sued in his/her individual capacity.

References

• 28 U.S.C. § 1391(e)(1) (proper venue for federal officer or employee sued in official capacity).

• Stafford v. Briggs, 444 U.S. 527, 542 (1980) (holding that the general venue statute applies when a federal officer or employee is sued in his/her individual capacity).

explanation.zh:
对联邦官员或雇员提起诉讼的适当审判地

官方能力

(从政府收回)

特别地点规则允许在以下地区提出诉讼:

• 任何居所

• 大部分事件或财产被发现

• 如果不涉及不动产,则居住

(向官员/雇员追偿)

一般地点法规允许在以下地区提起诉讼:

• 任何居住者,如果所有居住者居住在同一状态

• 大部分事件或财产被发现

• 受属人管辖权管辖的任何人,如果上述两者均不适用 = 原告; = 被告。

地点是指可以审理案件的联邦司法区,当原告起诉联邦官员或雇员时,适当的地点取决于被告是以官方或个人身份被起诉的。当一名官员或雇员以官方身份被起诉时,向联邦政府寻求追偿,并适用特别地点规则,根据其中一项规则,地点在原告居住的地方是适当的。

相反,当一名官员或雇员以个人身份被起诉时,向该官员或雇员寻求追偿,在这些诉讼案中,适用一般地点法规,地点只有在以下情况下才合适:

• 任何被告居住,只要所有被告居住在同一州(居住地点)

• 引发诉讼的事件有很大一部分发生(活动地点),或所涉财产中有很大一部分位于(财产地点)或

• 任何被告都受法院的属人管辖权管辖,但只有在上述两项规定都不适用的情况下才适用(后退条款)。

在此,行人(原告)在行人居住的C州起诉联邦雇员(被告),因此,只有在该雇员以官方身份被起诉(选择A)的情况下,C州的地点才合适。因此,如果法院驳回有关地点不当的诉讼,很可能是因为行人以个人身份起诉该雇员。

雇员本来可以在他居住的A州被起诉,但也可能在引起诉讼的事故发生的B州被起诉。

(Choice D) 在联邦法规下不发生诉讼的事实涉及属事管辖权,而不是地点。

由于雇员和行人是不同州的公民,争议金额超过75 000美元。

学习要点：

联邦官员或雇员以其官方身份被起诉时,适用特别地点规则——例如,原告居住的地点是适当的,但是,联邦官员或雇员以其个人身份被起诉时适用一般地点法规。

• Stafford诉Briggs, 444 U.S.527, 542(1980年)(认为联邦官员或雇员以个人身份被起诉时适用一般地点法规)。

stem:
An entrepreneur from State A decided to sell hot sauce to the public, labeling it "Best Hot Sauce."

A company incorporated in State B and headquartered in State C sued the entrepreneur in federal court in State C. The complaint sought $50,000 in damages and alleged that the entrepreneur's use of the name "Best Hot Sauce" infringed the company's federal trademark. The entrepreneur filed an answer denying the allegations, and the parties began discovery. Six months later, the entrepreneur moved to dismiss for lack of subject-matter jurisdiction.
stemZh:
一名来自 A 州的创业者决定向公众出售辣椒酱，并将其标注为 "最佳辣椒酱"。

一家在 B 州注册并在 C 州总部的公司在美国 C 州的联邦法院起诉该创业者。起诉状要求 50,000 美元的损害赔偿，并声称该创业者使用 "最佳辣椒酱" 的名称侵犯了该公司在美国的商标权。该创业者提交了答辩状，否认了这些指控，双方开始进行证据调查。六个月后，该创业者提出了驳回诉讼动议，理由是没有事项管辖权。
ask: Should the court grant the entrepreneur's motion?
askZh: 法院应否批准该创业者的动议？

options.en: No, because the company's claim arises under federal law.
options.zh: 不应，因为公司的主张基于联邦法律。

options.en: No, because the entrepreneur waived the right to challenge subject-matter jurisdiction by not raising the issue initially by motion or in the answer.
options.zh: 不应，因为该创业者通过未在动议或答辩状中最初提出管辖权问题而放弃了挑战事项管辖权的权利。

options.en: Yes, because although the claim arises under federal law, the amount in controversy is not satisfied.
options.zh: 应，因为尽管主张基于联邦法律，但争议金额未达到要求。

options.en: Yes, because although there is diversity, the amount in controversy is not satisfied.
options.zh: 应，因为尽管存在多元管辖，但争议金额未达到要求。

explanation.en:
Subject-matter jurisdiction refers to a court's authority to hear a particular type of case or controversy. A federal court* should presume that it lacks subject-matter jurisdiction until the party seeking to invoke the court's jurisdiction (generally the plaintiff) proves that the court has either:

• federal-question jurisdiction – the case arises under the Constitution, a federal law, or a treaty or

• diversity jurisdiction – the amount in controversy exceeds $75,000 and the parties are citizens of different states.

Here, the company alleges that the entrepreneur infringed upon the company's federal trademark, which involves federal law. As a result, the court has federal-question jurisdiction (and therefore subject-matter jurisdiction) to hear the case. Accordingly, the court should deny the entrepreneur's motion to dismiss.

*Most civil actions invoking federal subject-matter jurisdiction are brought before a federal district court and reviewed by the federal appellate court encompassing that district. However, Congress also created special federal courts with jurisdiction over specific types of cases.

(Choice B) A lack of personal jurisdiction (ie, a court's authority over a defendant) must be raised at the start of a case or it is waived. In contrast, the right to challenge subject-matter jurisdiction is never waived. Instead, this issue can be raised at any time by the parties or on the court's own initiative (ie, sua sponte). As a result, the timing of the entrepreneur's motion challenging subject-matter jurisdiction is immaterial.

(Choice C) Federal-question jurisdiction does not have an amount-in-controversy requirement.

(Choice D) Although the company and the entrepreneur are citizens of different states, the court lacks diversity jurisdiction because the amount in controversy is only $50,000 (less than $75,000). However, the court still has subject-matter jurisdiction because the case involves a federal question.

Educational objective:

Subject-matter jurisdiction exists if there is federal-question jurisdiction—ie, the case arises under the Constitution, a federal law, or a treaty—or diversity jurisdiction—ie, the amount in controversy exceeds $75,000 and the parties are citizens of different states.

References

• 28 U.S.C. § 1331 (federal-question jurisdiction).

• 28 U.S.C. § 1332 (diversity jurisdiction).

事由管辖权是指法院有权审理某一类案件或争议。联邦法院* 应假定它缺乏属事管辖权,直到寻求援引法院管辖权的当事人(一般是原告)证明法院有下列情形之一:

• 联邦问题管辖权 -- -- 案件由宪法、联邦法律或条约产生,或

• 异籍管辖权——争议金额超过75 000美元,当事方是不同国家的公民。

在此,该公司声称,企业家侵犯了公司的联邦商标,这涉及联邦法律,因此,法院拥有审理该案的联邦问题管辖权(因此也具有属事管辖权)。因此,法院应当驳回企业家提出的驳回动议。

* 援引联邦事项管辖权的民事诉讼大多提交联邦地区法院,并由包括该区的联邦上诉法院复审。然而,国会也设立了联邦特别法庭,对特定类型的案件拥有管辖权。

(选择B)在案件开始时必须提出或放弃缺乏属人管辖权的问题(即法院对被告的管辖权),相反,对属事管辖权提出质疑的权利从未放弃。相反,这个问题可以由当事人随时提出,也可以由法院主动提出(即sua sponte),因此,企业家对事项管辖权提出质疑的动议的时机无关紧要。

(C选择)联邦问题管辖权没有争议金额要求.

(Choice D) 虽然公司和企业家是不同州的公民,但法院缺乏异籍管辖权,因为争议金额只有5万美元(低于75,000美元).然而,法院仍然拥有属事管辖权,因为案件涉及联邦问题。

学习要点：

如果存在联邦问题管辖权,即案件是根据《宪法》、联邦法律或条约——或异籍管辖权——发生,争议金额超过75,000美元,当事方是不同州的公民,则存在属事管辖权。

stem:
Plaintiff, a new homeowner, entered into a contract with the defendants, a designer and an architect. The contract required the defendants to remodel the plaintiff's home in State A. The designer resides in the Eastern District of State B, and the architect resides in the Western District of State B.

The defendants failed to do any of the work, so the plaintiff sued them together in a federal court in the Eastern District of State B.

The defendants filed a motion to dismiss for improper venue.
stemZh:
原告是一名新业主，与被告（一名设计师和一名建筑师）签订了一份合同。合同要求被告在 A 州的原告家中进行房屋翻新。

被告未完成任何工作，因此原告在 B 州东部地区联邦法院一起起诉了被告。

被告提出动议，认为审判地不当。
ask: Will the federal court likely grant the motion?
askZh: 联邦法院很可能批准该动议吗？

options.en: No, because both defendants are subject to personal jurisdiction in State B.
options.zh: 不会，因为两名被告均受 B 州管辖。

options.en: No, because the designer resides in the Eastern District of State B and the architect resides in the Western District of State B.
options.zh: 不会，因为设计师居住在 B 州东部地区，而建筑师居住在 B 州西部地区。

options.en: Yes, because the contract was to be performed at the plaintiff's home in State A.
options.zh: 会，因为合同约定在原告位于 A 州的家中履行。

options.en: Yes, because the architect resides in the Western District of State B.
options.zh: 会，因为建筑师居住在 B 州西部地区。

explanation.en:
Venue—ie, the geographical location of the federal court that can hear a lawsuit—is proper in any judicial district where:

• any defendant resides—so long as all defendants reside in the same state (ie, residency-based venue)

• a substantial portion of the events that gave rise to the suit occurred (ie, events-based venue) or a substantial part of the property at issue is located (ie, property-based venue) or

• any defendant is subject to the court's personal jurisdiction—but only if neither of the above provisions applies (ie, fallback provision). Here, both defendants reside in State B. And since the designer resides in the Eastern District of State B, residency-based venue exists there. The fact that venue would also be proper in the Western District of State B (since the architect resides there) does not negate the proper venue in the Eastern District of State B (Choice D). Therefore, the court will likely deny the defendants' motion to dismiss.

(Choice A) Whether a defendant is subject to personal jurisdiction will only be considered for venue purposes if (1) the defendant is a corporation (since it resides where it is subject to personal jurisdiction) or (2) the fallback provision applies because residency, events, and property-based venue cannot be shown. Neither instance is seen here.

(Choice C) State A is a proper, events-based venue because the contract giving rise to the suit was to be performed there. But venue can be proper in multiple judicial districts— including the Eastern District of State B.

Educational objective:

Venue is proper in any federal district where (1) any defendant resides so long as all defendants reside in the same state, (2) a substantial portion of the events occurred or a substantial part of the property is located, or (3) any defendant is subject to personal jurisdiction—but only if the first two provisions do not exist.

References

• 28 U.S.C. § 1391(b) (proper venue).

stem:
After being fired, an executive from State A sued her former employer in state court in State B for $100,000 in damages. The executive's complaint alleged that her former employer, a citizen of State B, violated a federal statute that prohibits gender discrimination in the workplace.

The employer timely filed a notice of removal in the federal court in State B and delivered copies to the state court in State B and the executive. Twenty-two days later, the executive filed a motion to remand.
stemZh:
在被解雇后，一名来自 A 州的高管在 B 州的州法院起诉其前雇主，要求赔偿 100,000 美元。该高管的起诉状声称，其前雇主（B 州公民）违反了一项联邦法律，该法律禁止职场中的性别歧视。

雇主在 B 州联邦法院及时提交了移送通知，并将副本送达给 B 州的州法院和该高管。22 天后，该高管提出了发回州法院的动议。
ask: How will the federal court likely rule on the executive's motion to remand?
askZh: 联邦法院如何裁定该高管的发回动议？

options.en: Deny the motion, because the federal court has subject-matter jurisdiction over the case.
options.zh: 驳回动议，因为联邦法院对本案拥有事项管辖权。

options.en: Deny the motion, because the plaintiff did not consent to the removal.
options.zh: 驳回动议，因为原告未同意移送。

options.en: Grant the motion, because it was timely filed.
options.zh: 批准动议，因为动议及时提交。

options.en: Grant the motion, because the employer is a citizen of State B.
options.zh: 批准动议，因为雇主是 B 州公民。

explanation.en:
A plaintiff can choose to file certain lawsuits in state or federal court. When a suit is filed in state court, the defendant can remove the suit to the federal court located in the same district as the state court if the suit falls within the federal court's original (ie, subject-matter) jurisdiction. Original jurisdiction can arise from either:

• diversity jurisdiction – when the amount in controversy exceeds $75,000 and the opposing parties are citizens of different states or

• federal-question jurisdiction – when a claim arises under the U.S. Constitution, a treaty, or federal law (as seen here).

Removal requires the consent of all other defendants (if any) but not the plaintiff (Choice B). The defendant must then file a notice of removal in federal court within 30 days of receipt of the initial complaint or service of the summons—whichever period is shorter. A copy of the notice must also be delivered to the state court and the other parties.

The plaintiff can then seek to return the case to state court by filing a motion to remand in federal court within 30 days* after the notice of removal is filed. But the plaintiff's motion will be denied when, as here, subject-matter jurisdiction exists and the requirements for removal are met (Choice C).

*A motion to remand for lack of subject-matter jurisdiction does not need to meet this 30- day deadline and can be filed at any time.

(Choice D) The home-court advantage (ie, forum-defendant) rule prohibits removal when the federal court's original jurisdiction arises from diversity jurisdiction and a defendant is a citizen of the state in which the case was filed. Here, the State B federal court's original jurisdiction arises from federal-question jurisdiction, so the fact that the employer is a citizen of State B is irrelevant.

Educational objective:

A defendant can remove a case to federal court if (1) the case falls within that court's original jurisdiction, (2) all other defendants consent to removal, (3) the defendant files a notice of removal in federal court within 30 days of receiving the summons or complaint, and (4) a copy of the notice is provided to the state court and other parties.

References

• 28 U.S.C. § 1441 (removal requirements).

• 28 U.S.C. §§ 1446–1447 (removal procedures).

explanation.zh:
原告可以选择在州法院或联邦法院提起某些诉讼。 当在州法院提起诉讼时,被告可以向与州法院位于同一地区的联邦法院提起诉讼,如果诉讼属于联邦法院的原有诉讼。(e,主题事项)管辖权。

• 异籍管辖权——当争议金额超过75 000美元,而对立方是不同国家的公民时;

^ 联邦问题管辖权 — — 当根据美国宪法、条约或联邦法律提出要求时(见这里)。

驱逐要求所有其他被告的同意(如果有的话),但原告不同意(选择B)。 然后,被告必须在收到初始起诉状或传票送达后30天内向联邦法院提出驱逐通知,而传票送达期限则要短一些。通知副本也必须送交州法院和其他当事人。

然后,原告可寻求将案件退回州法院,在提出移送通知后30天内向联邦法院提出发回州法院动议。但是,原告的动议将被拒绝,因为在此情况下,属事管辖权已经存在,驱逐要求已经得到满足(Choice C)。

* 因缺乏属事管辖权而提出的发回州法院动议无须在30天期限内提出,可随时提出。

(Choice D)家庭法院优势(即法院-被告)规则禁止当联邦法院的原始管辖权来自异籍管辖权,而且被告是案件所在州的公民时,即予以撤销。在此,B州联邦法院的原始管辖权源于联邦问题管辖权,因此雇主是B州公民这一事实无关紧要.

学习要点：

如果(1) 案件属于该法院的原管辖权,(2) 所有其他被告同意移送,(3) 被告在收到传票后30天内向联邦法院提出移送通知,或向州法院和其他当事方提供一份通知副本。

参考资料

• 《美国法典》第28篇第1441条(迁移要求)。

• 28 U.S.C.§1446-1447(驱逐程序)。

stem:
An investor from State A purchased a house in State B for $300,000 and immediately rented it out. Shortly thereafter, a company incorporated and headquartered in State B sued the investor in a federal court in State B for breaching a shareholder's agreement. The investor signed and allegedly breached the agreement in State C and was served with process at his home in State A. The company sought to attach the investor's house in State B to satisfy any judgment in case the investor could not pay. The investor moved to dismiss the suit for lack of personal jurisdiction.

State B has a long-arm statute that gives its courts personal jurisdiction over property located within the state.
stemZh:
一名来自 A 州的投资者在 B 州购买了一栋价值 300,000 美元的房子，并立即将其出租。不久之后，一家在 B 州注册并设立总部的公司在美国 B 州的联邦法院起诉该投资者，指控其违反了股东协议。投资者在 C 州签署了该协议并被指控违约，诉讼文书送达至其位于 A 州的住所。该公司试图扣押投资者在 B 州的房产以满足可能的判决，如果投资者无法支付的话。投资者提出了驳回诉讼动议，理由是法院缺乏属人管辖权。

B 州拥有一个长臂条款，赋予其法院对位于本州内的财产行使属人管辖权。
ask: Is the court likely to grant the investor's motion?
askZh: 法院很可能批准投资者的动议吗？

options.en: No, because State B's long-arm statute establishes personal jurisdiction.
options.zh: 不，因为 B 州的长臂条款确立了属人管辖权。

options.en: No, because the presence of the house in State B confers personal jurisdiction over the investor.
options.zh: 不，因为 B 州的房产存在使法院对投资者行使属人管辖权。

options.en: Yes, because ownership of property cannot establish minimum contacts.
options.zh: 是，因为财产所有权不能建立最低联系。

options.en: Yes, because the company's claim is unrelated to the investor's ownership of the house.
options.zh: 是，因为公司的主张与投资者对该房产的所有权无关。

explanation.en:
Personal jurisdiction refers to a court's authority over the parties or property before it. A federal district court has the same personal jurisdiction as the courts of the state in which it is located. Therefore, a federal district court can use the forum state's long-arm statute to acquire personal jurisdiction over an out-of-state defendant—so long as the exercise of personal jurisdiction comports with due process. This constitutional requirement is met when:

• the plaintiff's claim arises from the defendant's minimum contacts with the state and

• the exercise of jurisdiction complies with notions of fair play and substantial justice.*

A defendant's ownership of property in the forum state establishes minimum contacts in an action related to that property—ie, in rem and quasi in rem type 1 actions (Choice C). However, this does not establish minimum contacts in an action unrelated to that property—ie, a quasi in rem type 2 action in which the property is attached to satisfy a judgment against the defendant.

Here, the company sued the investor and attached his house in State B to satisfy any judgment. The house cannot serve as the basis for minimum contacts since this suit for breach of a shareholder's agreement is unrelated to the house. And there is no indication that the investor has any other contacts with State B since he resides in State A and the agreement was signed and allegedly breached in State C (Choice B). Therefore, the court will likely grant the investor's motion.

*Due process is also satisfied if the defendant consented to jurisdiction or was served with process within the forum state.

(Choice A) State B's long-arm statute gives state and federal courts in State B personal jurisdiction over property in the state. But since the investor lacks minimum contacts with State B, using the long-arm statute would violate due process.

Educational objective:

Property located within the state can establish the minimum contacts necessary for personal jurisdiction if the property is related to the dispute—ie, in rem or quasi in rem type 1 action. However, minimum contacts are not established if the property is unrelated to the plaintiff's claim—ie, quasi in rem type 2 action.

References

• Shaffer v. Heitner, 433 U.S. 186, 212 (1977) (holding that personal jurisdiction over an out-of-state defendant must always satisfy the minimum contacts requirement).

explanation.zh:
属人管辖权是指法院对其受理的当事人或财产的管辖权,联邦地区法院与其所在地州的法院具有相同的属人管辖权.因此,联邦地区法院可以利用法院所在地国的长臂法规获得对州外被告的属人管辖权,只要行使属人管辖权符合正当程序。

• 原告的要求产生于被告与国家的最低接触;

• 行使管辖权符合公平竞争和实质正义的概念。

被告在法院地国对财产的所有权在有关该财产的诉讼中确立了最低限度的联系——即对物和准对物第1类行动(Choice C)。然而,在与该财产无关的诉讼中,这并没有确立最低限度的联系——即对物2类诉讼中的准联系,该财产是用来执行对被告的判决的。

在此,公司起诉投资人,并将他在B州的房子附属以满足任何判决,该房子不能作为最低限度联系的基础,因为这一违反股东协议的诉讼与该房子无关。而且没有迹象表明投资者与B州有任何其他联系,因为他居住在A州,协议在C州(选择B州)签署并据称被违反。 因此,法院可能批准投资者的动议。

* 如果被告同意管辖权或法院地国内部的程序已送达,程序也得到满足。

(Choice A)B州的长臂法规赋予B州的州和联邦法院对该州财产的个人管辖权。 但是,由于投资者与B州缺乏最低限度的联系,使用长臂法规将违反正当程序。

学习要点：

如果财产与纠纷有关,则位于该州境内的财产可建立属人管辖权所需的最低限度联系——即以物或准物形式在第1类行动中。但是,如果财产与原告的主张无关,则不能确定最低限度的接触,即对等物第2类诉讼。

参考资料

• Shaffer诉Heitner,433 U.S.186,212(1977)(认为对境外被告的属人管辖权必须始终满足最低接触要求)。

stem:
A plaintiff brought a diversity action against a defendant in a federal court in State A to quiet title to a farm. The plaintiff attempted to serve the defendant with process through certified mail, but the letter was returned to the plaintiff marked "unclaimed." The plaintiff attempted service through certified mail a second time, but the letter was returned to the plaintiff in the same fashion. The plaintiff did not attempt to contact the defendant again. At trial, the defendant did not appear and defend. As a result, the court entered a default judgment in the plaintiff's favor.

Two months later, the defendant discovered the plaintiff on the farm and learned about the default judgment. The defendant immediately moved for relief from the default judgment in the federal court in State A on the ground that the plaintiff failed to provide him with adequate notice of the suit.

State A's rules of procedure permit service of process by certified or ordinary mail.
stemZh:
一名原告在 A 州联邦法院基于不同州籍管辖权起诉被告，请求确认一处农场的产权。原告试图通过挂号邮件向被告送达诉讼文书，但邮件被标注为“未领取”并退回。原告又以挂号邮件送达一次，邮件仍以相同方式退回。此后，原告未再尝试联系被告。庭审时，被告未出庭应诉，因此法院作出了有利于原告的缺席判决。

两个月后，被告在农场发现原告，并得知该缺席判决。被告立即向 A 州联邦法院申请撤销缺席判决，理由是原告未向其充分通知本案诉讼。

A 州的诉讼程序规则允许通过挂号邮件或普通邮件送达诉讼文书。
ask: Will the federal court likely grant the defendant's motion for relief?
askZh: 联邦法院很可能批准被告的动议吗？

options.en: No, because the plaintiff attempted to serve the defendant with process twice.
options.zh: 否，因为原告曾两次尝试向被告送达诉讼文书。

options.en: No, because the plaintiff complied with State A's service-of-process rules.
options.zh: 否，因为原告遵守了 A 州的送达规则。

options.en: Yes, because the defendant did not receive actual notice of the lawsuit.
options.zh: 是，因为被告未实际收到诉讼通知。

options.en: Yes, because the plaintiff failed to take additional reasonable steps to provide notice.
options.zh: 是，因为原告未能采取额外的合理步骤提供通知。

explanation.en:
Service-of-process requirements

Procedural rules

(FRCP 4(e))

Process may be served on defendant-individual located in U.S. by:

• delivering process to defendant personally or authorized agent

• leaving process at defendant's dwelling with resident of suitable age & discretion or

• following rules of state where court sits or service is made Due process • Notice must reasonably apprise defendant of pending suit & afford opportunity to present objections

• If plaintiff knows defendant did not receive notice, plaintiff must take additional reasonable steps to provide notice FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

A defendant can obtain relief from a default judgment when the defendant's failure to timely serve an answer was due to excusable neglect. Excusable neglect can arise when the defendant failed to receive adequate notice of the suit through service of process as required by procedural rules and due process.

FRCP 4 provides several procedures for serving process on a defendant-individual in the U.S., including:

• delivering process to the defendant personally (or to an agent authorized to receive process)

• leaving process at the defendant's dwelling with a resident of suitable age and discretion or

• following the rules of the state where the court sits or service is made. Here, the plaintiff complied with the service-of-process rules for State A (where the federal court sits) by attempting to serve the defendant with process twice through certified mail. However, her attempt to provide adequate notice must also comply with due process.

Under this constitutional requirement, actual notice is not required (Choice C). Instead, notice must reasonably apprise the defendant of the pending suit and afford the defendant an opportunity to present objections. So if the plaintiff knows that the defendant did not receive notice (eg, because the letter was returned "unclaimed"), then the plaintiff must take additional reasonable steps to provide notice. The plaintiff here failed to take such steps, so the court will likely grant the defendant's motion for relief

(Choices A & B).

Educational objective:

Notice, as required by due process, means that a defendant must be reasonably apprised of the pending suit and afforded an opportunity to present objections. So if the plaintiff knows the defendant did not receive notice through service of process, then the plaintiff must take additional reasonable steps to provide notice.

FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

References

• Jones v. Flowers, 547 U.S. 220, 234 (2006) (explaining that when the plaintiff knows that the defendant has not received notice, additional reasonable steps need to be taken to provide such notice).

• Mullane v. Cent. Hanover Bank & Trust Co., 339 U.S. 306, 314 (1950) (stating that due process requires notice apprising the defendant of the action and affording an opportunity to be heard).

explanation.zh:
所需流程服务

程序规则

(FRCP 4(e))

程序可以通过以下方式送达位于美国的被告个人:

• 向被告个人或授权代理人交付程序

• 离开被告住所的过程,由适龄居民酌情决定;

• 遵循开庭或提供服务的国家规则;通知必须合理地告知被告未决诉讼,并给予机会。提出反对

• 如果原告知道被告没有收到通知,原告必须采取更多合理步骤,提供通知FRCP=联邦民事诉讼规则。

如果被告未能及时送达答复是由于可原谅的疏忽,被告可以免除违约判决。如果被告未能按照程序规则和正当程序的要求,通过送达诉讼文书,收到关于诉讼的充分通知,则可能出现可原谅的忽略。

FRCP 4规定了在美国为被告个人服务的程序,包括:

• 向被告个人(或授权接受程序的人员)交付程序

• 在被告住所与适龄居民离开程序,并斟酌决定;

• 遵循法院开庭或提供服务州的规则,在此,原告遵守A州(联邦法院开庭所在地)的流程服务规则,试图通过经认证的邮件两次为被告服务。然而,她发出适当通知的尝试也必须遵守正当程序。

根据宪法要求,不需要实际通知(C选择)。 相反,通知必须合理地告知待决诉讼的被告,并给予被告提出反对意见的机会。因此,如果原告知道被告没有收到通知(例如,因为信件被退回"无人索要"),那么原告必须采取额外的合理步骤提供通知.原告没有采取这些步骤,所以法院可能会批准被告的补救请求

(选择A和B).

学习要点：

根据正当程序的要求,通知意味着必须合理地将未决诉讼告知被告,并为其提供提出反对意见的机会。因此,如果原告知道被告没有通过诉讼送达收到通知,那么原告必须采取额外的合理步骤提供通知。

FRCP = 联邦民事诉讼规则。

参考资料

• Jones诉Flowers,547 U.S. 220,234(2006年)(解释原告知道被告没有收到通知时,需要采取额外合理步骤提供这种通知)。

• Mullane诉Cent.Hanover Bank & Trust Co.,339 U.S. 306, 314(1950年)(规定适当程序要求通知诉讼被告并给予陈述的机会)。

stem:
Two tourists from State A planned a trip to a foreign country. Before leaving, one of the tourists saw a television advertisement for a guided hike in the foreign country. The tourist called the company responsible for the advertisement, which is incorporated and has its principal place of business in the foreign country. During the phone call, the tourist told the company's representative that neither of the tourists had ever been on a professional hike. The representative ensured the tourist that all of the company's guides were properly trained. The tourist then hired a guide from that company.

In the foreign country, the guide led the tourists on a steep and dangerous mountain trail meant for expert hikers. During the hike, the tourists fell into a deep ravine and died. Another group of hikers, all of whom reside in the foreign country, witnessed the event.

The deceased tourists' personal representatives joined together to sue the company in federal court in State A for false advertisement and wrongful death. The company wants the suit to be heard in its own country instead of State A.
stemZh:
两名来自 A 州的游客计划前往一个外国国家旅行。出发前，其中一名游客看到一则电视广告，介绍在该外国国家有导游带领的徒步旅行。该游客致电了负责该广告的公司，该公司在外国国家注册并设有主要营业地。电话中，该游客告诉公司代表，两名游客从未参加过专业徒步旅行。代表保证该公司所有的导游都经过适当培训。该游客随后雇佣了该公司的一名导游。

在外国国家，导游带领两名游客在一条专为专家徒步者设计的陡峭危险山路上行走。徒步过程中，两名游客跌入深沟并死亡。另一组徒步者，全部居住在外国国家，目睹了这一事件。

死者的个人代表在 A 州的联邦法院提起诉讼，指控该公司虚假广告和过失致死。该公司希望诉讼能在其本国而非 A 州进行。
ask: Which of the following motions gives the company its best chance to achieve its goal?
askZh: 以下哪一项动议最能实现公司的目标？

options.en: A motion to dismiss the lawsuit for improper venue.
options.zh: 一项动议，以不当审判地为由驳回诉讼。

options.en: A motion to dismiss the lawsuit for lack of personal jurisdiction.
options.zh: 一项动议，以缺乏属人管辖权为由驳回诉讼。

options.en: A motion to dismiss the lawsuit under the doctrine of forum non conveniens.
options.zh: 一项动议，依据不方便法院原则驳回诉讼。

options.en: A motion to transfer the lawsuit to a court located in the foreign country.
options.zh: 一项动议，将诉讼移送至外国国家的法院。

explanation.en:
Doctrine of forum non conveniens

Definition • Power of federal court to dismiss or stay lawsuit when state or foreign judicial system is better suited to hear case Private interest factors

• Accessibility of evidence

• Availability of witnesses

• Burden on defendant

• Enforceability of judgment Public interest factors

• Ability to comprehend substantive law

• Choice of law

• Interest of jury/community

• Functionality of foreign judicial system The doctrine of forum non conveniens allows federal courts to dismiss or stay a lawsuit if a state or foreign judicial system is better suited to hear the case. This is permitted even when subject-matter jurisdiction, personal jurisdiction, and venue are proper—but should rarely be applied. As a result, the court must consider several private and public interest factors, including the accessibility of the evidence and the witnesses.

Here, the foreign company wants the lawsuit to be heard in its own country instead of in State A. Several factors weigh in the company's favor since much of the evidence and all the witnesses are in the foreign country. Therefore, the company's best chance to have the suit heard in its own country is to file a motion to dismiss under the doctrine of forum non conveniens.

(Choices A & B) Venue is proper in any federal district where a defendant resides as long as all the defendants reside in the same state. A defendant business resides in every district where it is subject to personal jurisdiction. Here, the company is subject to personal jurisdiction in any State A district since its minimum contacts with State A—the advertisement, business phone call, and agreement—gave rise to the tourists' claims. Therefore, motions to dismiss for improper venue or lack of personal jurisdiction would fail.

(Choice D) A federal court can only transfer a suit to another federal court. Therefore, a suit can only be moved to a state or foreign judicial system if the federal court dismisses or stays the suit under the doctrine of forum non conveniens so that the plaintiff can refile the suit in an alternative judicial system.

Educational objective:

Under the doctrine of forum non conveniens, a federal court can dismiss or stay a lawsuit if a state or foreign jurisdiction is better suited to hear it. When making this decision, the court will examine several factors, including accessibility of evidence and witnesses.

References

• Am. Dredging Co. v. Miller, 510 U.S. 443, 447–48 (1994) (explaining the doctrine of forum non conveniens).

• Gulf Oil Corp. v. Gilbert, 330 U.S. 501, 508–09 (1947) (listing private and public interest factors to consider in a forum non conveniens analysis).

explanation.zh:
论坛不方便的理论

• 在州或外国司法系统更适合审理案件时,联邦法院有权驳回或中止诉讼

• 获取证据

• 证人的提供

• 被告的负担

• 判决的可执行性

• 理解实体法的能力

• 法律选择

• 陪审团/社区的利益

· 外国司法系统的职能 非方便法院原则允许联邦法院在州或外国司法系统更适合审理案件时驳回或中止诉讼。即使属事管辖权、属人管辖权和地点是适当的,也允许这样做,但很少适用。因此,法院必须考虑若干私人和公共利益因素,包括获取证据和证人的问题。

在此,外国公司希望诉讼在其本国而不是在A州审理。 有几个因素对公司有利,因为许多证据和所有证人都在外国。因此,公司在其本国审理诉讼案件的最佳机会是提出动议,根据法院不方便原则驳回。

(Choices A & B)只要被告居住在同一州,在被告居住的任何联邦区,地点都是适当的,被告的企业都居住在受其属人管辖的每个区。在此,该公司在A区受个人管辖,因为它与A区的最低接触——广告、商业电话和协议——引起了游客的诉求。因此,因地点不当或缺乏属人管辖权而驳回动议将失败。

(Choice D) 联邦法院只能将诉讼移交另一联邦法院,因此,只有联邦法院根据法院不便原则驳回或中止诉讼,原告才能将诉讼移交州或外国司法系统。将诉讼重新提交另一司法系统。

学习要点：

根据不方便法院的理论,如果国家或外国司法机构更适合审理,联邦法院可以驳回或中止诉讼。在作出这一决定时,法院将审查若干因素,包括获取证据和证人。

参考资料

· Am. Dredging Co.诉Miller,510 U.S.443, 447–48(1994)(解释法院不方便的理论)。

• Gulf Oil Corp.诉Gilbert,330 U.S. 501, 508-09(1947)(列出私人和公共利益因素,供非召集人论坛分析审议)。

stem:
After 10 years of marriage, a husband and wife decided to separate. The husband remained in the family home in State A, while the wife moved into an apartment in State B.

Seven months later, the wife filed for divorce in a state court in State B. She knew that her husband would be attending a professional conference in State B the following week, so she hired a process server to personally hand-deliver a copy of the divorce petition and the State B summons to him at the conference.

The husband moved to dismiss for lack of personal jurisdiction.
stemZh:
结婚十年后，一对夫妻决定分居。丈夫留在 A 州的家庭住所，妻子则搬到 B 州的一套公寓。

七个月后，妻子在 B 州的州法院提起离婚诉讼。她知道丈夫下周会到 B 州参加专业会议，便雇用送达人在会议现场亲手将离婚申请书副本和 B 州法院的传票交给丈夫。

丈夫以法院缺乏对其属人管辖权为由，申请驳回诉讼。
ask: Should the court grant the husband's motion to dismiss?
askZh: 法院是否应批准丈夫的驳回诉讼动议？

options.en: No, because the husband was personally served with process in State B.
options.zh: 不应，因为丈夫在B 州被个人送达了诉讼文书。

options.en: No, because there is no other state that is more convenient for both of the parties than State B.
options.zh: 不应，因为没有其他州比B 州对双方更方便。

options.en: Yes, because State A was the couple's home state for 10 years.
options.zh: 应，因为A 州是这对夫妻过去10年的家庭州。

options.en: Yes, because the husband was in State B for a matter unrelated to the marriage.
options.zh: 应，因为丈夫在B 州的行程与婚姻无关。

explanation.en:
Personal jurisdiction

(court's authority over defendant)

Type Requirements

Service of process

• Serving process on defendant voluntarily in state where court is located (ie, forum state)

Consent • Express – contractual agreement (eg, forum-selection clause)

• Implied – engaging in specific activity that state has substantial interest in regulating (eg, driving on public roads)

• Waiver – untimely objection to personal jurisdiction

• Appearance – voluntarily appearing in court to litigate merits of case Specific

(case-linked)

• Plaintiff's claim arises from or is closely related to defendant's minimum contacts (ie, purposeful availment) with forum state AND

• Exercise of jurisdiction complies with notions of fair play & substantial justice General

(all-purpose)

• Defendant has continuous & systematic contacts with forum state so substantial that defendant is essentially "at home" (ie, defendant's domicile) Due process requires that a court have personal jurisdiction over all of the parties in a dispute before it. One way to establish personal jurisdiction is through tag jurisdiction (ie, transient jurisdiction). Under this method, personal jurisdiction is acquired by serving the defendant* with formal process while the defendant is voluntarily in the forum state— even if briefly and for a purpose unrelated to the plaintiff's claim.

Here, the husband was served with the divorce petition and State B summons while he was in State B for a conference—a matter unrelated to the marriage (Choice D). Therefore, the court has personal jurisdiction over the husband and should deny his motion to dismiss.

*Personal jurisdiction is always focused on the defendant because the plaintiff consents to personal jurisdiction by filing the suit in that court.

(Choice B) Whether another state or court is a more convenient forum for the parties is only considered when a change of venue is requested.

(Choice C) Although State A was the couple's home state for 10 years, State B has personal jurisdiction since the wife initiated the suit there and the husband was served with process there.

Educational objective:

Personal jurisdiction can be established by serving the defendant with formal process while the defendant is voluntarily in the forum state even if briefly and for a purpose unrelated to the plaintiff's claim.

References

• Burnham v. Super. Ct. of Cal., 495 U.S. 604, 619 (1990) (holding that personal jurisdiction is established when the defendant is served with process in the forum state).

explanation.zh:
属人管辖权

(法院对被告的权力)

所需经费类型

流程服务

• 在法院所在地国(即法院所在地国)为被告自愿提供服务

• 明示-合同协议(如法院地选择条款)

• 参与国家非常有兴趣管理的具体活动(如在公共道路上驾驶)

• 放弃 -- -- 不及时反对属人管辖权

• 出庭——自愿出庭对案件案情提起诉讼

(与案件相关)

• 原告的要求产生于或与被告与法院地国的最低接触(即有意利用)密切相关;

• 行使管辖权符合公平竞争和实质性司法的概念

(全部用途)

• 被告与法院地国有持续和系统的接触,其实质性程度以至于被告程序要求法院必须具备个人身份。(b) 对它审理的争端的所有当事方的管辖权。确立属人管辖权的一种方法是通过标记管辖权(即临时管辖权),根据这种方法,在被告自愿进入法院地国时,通过正式程序为被告提供服务,以取得属人管辖权——即使只是短暂的。并且目的与原告的要求无关。

在此,向丈夫送达了离婚申请和B州传票,当时他正在B州参加与婚姻无关的会议(Choice D)。 因此,法院对丈夫拥有属人管辖权,应当驳回他提出的驳回动议。

* 个人管辖权始终集中在被告身上,因为原告通过向该法院提起诉讼同意个人管辖权。

(Choice B) 只有当请求更改地点时,才考虑另一个州或法院是否是当事人更方便的法院.

(选择C)虽然A州是夫妇的10年故乡,但B州自妻子在那里提起诉讼和丈夫在那里得到程序服务以来,拥有属人管辖权。

学习要点：

可以通过在被告自愿进入法院地国时向被告提供正式程序服务来确定属人管辖权,即使时间短暂,目的与原告的要求无关。

参考资料

• Burnham v. Super. Ct. of Cal., 495 U.S. 604, 619(1990)(认为在被告在法院地国接受诉讼时,属人管辖权成立)。

stem:
A businesswoman sued a website owner in federal court for violating federal copyright law. The businesswoman sent a copy of the complaint and a form requesting waiver of service of process to the website owner's residence via first-class mail. The request named the court where the complaint was filed and the date when the request was sent.

The businesswoman did not receive anything back from the website owner, so 31 days after mailing the request, she had a process server hand-deliver a copy of the summons and complaint to the website owner.
stemZh:
一名女商人在联邦法院起诉一名网站所有者违反联邦版权法。她通过一类邮件（first-class mail）将起诉状副本和请求放弃正式送达的表格寄至网站所有者的住所。请求中写明了起诉状提交的法院和请求寄出的日期。

女商人未收到网站所有者的回复，因此在寄出请求 31 天后，委托送达人将传票和起诉状副本当面交给网站所有者。
ask: Is the website owner liable for the expenses associated with the process server?
askZh: 网站所有者是否需对送达员产生的费用承担责任？

options.en: No, because the businesswoman did not include all that was necessary for a waiver request.
options.zh: 否，因为商界女性并未包含免除送达请求所必需的所有内容。

options.en: No, because the businesswoman did not wait 60 days before hiring the process server.
options.zh: 否，因为商界女性在雇佣送达员之前并未等待60天。

options.en: Yes, because a court must impose the cost of service upon a defendant who fails to waive service.
options.zh: 是，因为法院必须将送达费用强加给未能免除送达的被告。

options.en: Yes, because a defendant has a duty to avoid unnecessary service-of-process expenses.
options.zh: 是，因为被告有责任避免不必要的诉讼文书送达费用。

explanation.en:
Waiving service of process

(FRCP 4(d))

Request for waiver • In writing

• Addressed to defendant (or authorized agent)

• Names court where complaint filed

• Provides copy of complaint, two waiver forms & prepaid means to return form

• Informs defendant about consequences of waiving & not waiving

• Lists date request is sent

• Sent via first-class mail or other reliable means

• Allows 30 days (or 60 days for defendant abroad) from date sent for defendant to return waiver Benefits of waiver • Defendant's time to file answer extended to 60 days (or 90 days if abroad) from date sent Consequences of failing to waive

• Defendant pays expenses of future service of process

• Defendant pays reasonable expenses of any motion required to collect service expenses (eg, attorney's fees) FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

A plaintiff must provide the defendant with adequate notice of a lawsuit through service of process—ie, by delivering a copy of the summons and complaint. Since this can be expensive and burdensome, defendants are encouraged to waive service of process upon the plaintiff's written request. That request must:

• be sent to the defendant via first-class mail or other reliable means

• name the court where the complaint was filed and the date the request was sent and

• contain one copy of the complaint, two copies of the waiver form, and a prepaid means for returning the signed waiver form (eg, a self-addressed and stamped envelope). If the defendant waives service of process, the defendant receives extra time to respond to the complaint—60 days from the date the request was sent instead of 21 days from the date of service (the carrot). But if the defendant (1) fails to waive service and (2) lacks good cause for doing so, the defendant must pay the expenses of future service and of any motion required to collect those expenses (the stick).

Here, the businesswoman's waiver request only contained one copy of the waiver form and did not include a prepaid means to return the signed form. Therefore, the website owner is not liable for the process-server expenses (Choices C & D).

(Choice B) A plaintiff must give a defendant reasonable time to return the waiver—ie, at least 30 days when the defendant is in the U.S. (as seen here) or at least 60 days if the defendant is abroad.

Educational objective:

A plaintiff must send a written waiver-of-service request to the defendant via first-class mail or other reliable means. The waiver must state the name of the court and the date the request was sent. It also must contain a copy of the complaint, two copies of the waiver form, and a prepaid means to return the signed form.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 4(d) (waiving service of process).

explanation.zh:
流程的放弃服务

(FRCP 4(d))

• 书面要求放弃

• 被告(或授权代理人)

• 起诉的命名法院

• 提供起诉状副本、两份豁免表和预付的返还表

• 通知被告放弃或不放弃的后果

• 发出清单日期请求

• 通过一等邮件或其他可靠方式发送

• 允许被告自被派回放弃豁免福利之日起30天(或被告在国外60天),被告提交答复的时间从未放弃的后果之日起延长至60天(或在国外90天)。

• 被告支付今后诉讼文书送达的费用

• 被告支付收取服务费所需的任何动议的合理费用(例如律师费)

原告必须通过以下方式向被告提供适当的诉讼通知:- 提供传票和起诉状的副本。由于费用高昂而且负担沉重,鼓励被告应原告的书面请求放弃诉讼文书送达。

• 通过头等邮件或其他可靠方式送交被告

• 指明提出起诉状的法院和提出请求的日期;

• 载有一份起诉状书副本、两份放弃表格副本以及退还签名放弃表格的预付手段(例如,一个自我地址和盖章的信封)。如果被告放弃诉讼文书送达,被告得到额外的时间答复起诉状——从发出请求之日起60天,而不是从送达之日起的21天(胡萝卜)。但是,如果被告(1)未放弃服务,而且(2)没有这样做的良好理由,被告必须支付未来服务的费用以及收取这些费用所需的任何动议的费用(棍子)。

在这里,女商人的放弃请求只包含一份放弃表,没有包括退还签名表格的预付手段,因此,网站所有者不承担流程服务器费用(Choices C & D).

(Choice B)原告必须给被告合理的时间归还放弃权——即被告在美国(如这里所见)至少30天,被告在国外至少60天。

学习要点：

原告必须通过头等邮件或其他可靠方式向被告发出书面放弃服务请求,放弃必须说明法院的名称和发出请求的日期。它还必须包含一份起诉状书副本、两份放弃申请表副本以及退还所签表格的预付手段。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 4(d)(放弃流程服务)。

stem:
A technology company incorporated and headquartered in State A hired an engineer domiciled in State B. The employment contract between the company and the engineer stated that all work product produced by the engineer was owned by the company. While employed by the company, the engineer developed a software program that was unrelated to the company's business. When the engineer left the company, she attempted to sell her program for $50,000.

The technology company sued the engineer in a federal court in State A to enjoin the sale and for a declaratory judgment that the company owned the rights to the software program. The company claimed that it could incorporate the program into its business and increase profits by $100,000. The engineer defended on the ground that the contract does not apply to work that is unrelated to the company's business.

The case proceeded to trial. After the close of evidence, the engineer moved to dismiss the case for lack of subject-matter jurisdiction.
stemZh:
一家在 A 州注册并总部设在 A 州的科技公司雇佣了一位居住在 B 州的工程师。公司与工程师之间的雇佣合同规定，工程师所创作的所有工作成果归公司所有。在任职期间，该工程师开发了一个与公司业务无关的软件程序。当该工程师离开公司时，她试图以 50,000 美元的价格出售该程序。

科技公司在美国联邦法院 A 州提起诉讼，请求法院颁布禁令阻止该工程师出售该程序，并要求法院作出裁决，确认该公司拥有该软件程序的权利。公司声称，它可以将该程序纳入其业务中，并增加 100,000 美元的利润。该工程师则辩称，合同不适用于与公司业务无关的工作。

案件进入庭审阶段。在证据提交结束后，该工程师提出动议，要求驳回诉讼，理由是缺乏事项管辖权。
ask: Should the court grant the engineer's motion?
askZh: 法院应否批准该工程师的动议？

options.en: No, because the engineer waived this defense by failing to assert it before the close of evidence.
options.zh: 不应批准，因为该工程师在证据提交结束前未提出此抗辩，因此放弃了该抗辩。

options.en: No, because the parties are diverse and the value of the requested relief exceeds $75,000.
options.zh: 不应批准，因为当事人具有多样性且请求的救济金价值超过 75,000 美元。

options.en: Yes, because the company failed to demand damages in addition to the requested relief.
options.zh: 应批准，因为公司未要求额外的损害赔偿作为请求的救济。

options.en: Yes, because the cost to the engineer to comply with the requested relief is only $50,000.
options.zh: 应批准，因为该工程师遵守请求救济的费用仅为 50,000 美元。

explanation.en:
Subject-matter jurisdiction is established when a federal court has federal-question jurisdiction (not seen here) or diversity jurisdiction over a particular case. Diversity jurisdiction exists when the opposing parties are citizens of different states and the amount in controversy exceeds $75,000.

The amount in controversy is generally determined by the monetary damages requested in the plaintiff's complaint. However, it can also be determined when a plaintiff requests equitable relief—eg, declaratory judgment, injunction (both requested here). Since equitable relief has no explicit monetary value, its implicit monetary value is calculated by the larger of the following:

• the cost to the defendant if forced to comply with the requested equitable relief (eg, lost sales) or

• the worth to the plaintiff if the requested equitable relief is granted (eg, expected profits). Here, the parties are diverse because the company is incorporated and headquartered in State A and the engineer is domiciled in State B. The cost to the engineer if forced to comply with the requested equitable relief is only the $50,000 she would lose if her sale is barred. However, the requested equitable relief is worth $100,000 in expected profits to the company, so the amount-in-controversy requirement is satisfied (Choice D). Therefore, diversity jurisdiction exists, and the court should deny the engineer's motion to dismiss.

(Choice A) The right to challenge subject-matter jurisdiction is never waived. Instead, this issue can be raised at any time by the parties or on the court's own initiative (ie, sua sponte).

(Choice C) A plaintiff need not demand damages to satisfy the amount-in-controversy requirement. The reason is that a request for equitable relief can satisfy the amount-in-controversy requirement on its own if the value of the relief—based on its cost to the

defendant or worth to the plaintiff—exceeds $75,000.

Educational objective:

In a diversity action, a request for equitable relief satisfies the amount-in-controversy requirement if the value of the relief exceeds $75,000 based on its (1) cost to the defendant or (2) worth to the plaintiff—whichever is larger.

References

• Hunt v. Wash. State Apple Advert. Comm'n, 432 U.S. 333, 347–48 (1977) (holding that the amount in controversy in an action requesting equitable relief is measured by the value of the object of the litigation).

• 32A Am. Jur. 2d Federal Courts § 962 (2020) (explaining how the amount in controversy is determined in actions that request equitable relief).

explanation.zh:
当联邦法院对某一特定案件拥有联邦质询管辖权(此处不见)或异籍管辖权时,就确立了属事管辖权。当对立方是不同国家的公民,争议金额超过75 000美元时,异籍管辖权就存在。

争议数额一般由原告起诉状中要求的金钱赔偿决定,但也可以在原告要求公平救济时确定,例如,宣告性判决、禁令(两者均在此要求)。由于公平救济没有明确的货币价值,其隐含的货币价值按下列数额中较大的数额计算:

• 如果被告被迫遵守所要求的公平救济(例如,销售损失)或

· 如果所请求的公平救济获准,对原告的价值(例如预期利润),当事方各不相同,因为公司在A州成立并总部设在B州,工程师在B州居住。工程师如果被迫遵守要求的公平救济,其费用只有5万美元,如果禁止出售,她就会损失。然而,要求的公平救济对公司的预期利润为10万美元,因此满足了有争议的数额要求(Choice D)。 因此,存在着异籍管辖权,法院应当驳回工程师提出的驳回动议。

(选择A)对事项管辖权提出质疑的权利从未放弃,相反,这一问题可以由当事人在任何时候提出,也可以由法院主动提出(即sua sponte)。

(选择C)原告无需要求损害赔偿以满足有争议的数额要求,理由是,如果救济的价值——以救济给索赔人造成的成本为基础——公平救济请求可以满足有争议的数额要求。

被告或对原告的价值——超过75,000美元。

学习要点：

在一项多样化诉讼中,如果补救的价值超过75,000美元,则根据对被告的(1)成本或对原告的(2)成本,公平救济请求满足了争议中的数额要求,而其中数额越大。

参考资料

• Hunt v. Wash. State Apple Advert. Communication, 432 U.S.333, 347–48 (1977)(认为请求公平救济的诉讼中有争议的金额以诉讼对象的价值来衡量)。

• 32A Am. Jur. 2d联邦法院§962(2020年)(解释在要求公平救济的行动中如何确定争议数额)。

stem: Two ranchers, both citizens of State A, brought an action in a state court in State A against a developer, a citizen of State B. The ranchers alleged a state-law tort claim for water runoff damage to their properties caused by construction on the developer's neighboring property. The first rancher claimed $250,000 in damages and the second rancher claimed $50,000. In their complaint, the ranchers cited federal law regarding the calculation of damages due to water runoff. The developer timely removed the action to federal court.
stemZh: 两名牧场主均为 A 州居民，在 A 州的州法院对一名 B 州居民开发商提起诉讼，指控其因邻近地产施工导致水土流失损害其财产，构成州法上的侵权行为。第一牧场主主张 250,000 美元损害赔偿，第二牧场主主张 50,000 美元。在起诉状中，牧场主援引联邦法律关于水土流失损害计算的规定。开发商及时将诉讼移送至联邦法院。
ask: Is removal proper?
askZh: 移送是否适当？

options.en: No, because the ranchers are not diverse from each other.
options.zh: 不，因为牧场主之间缺乏充分多样性。

options.en: No, because the second rancher's claim does not meet the amount-in-controversy requirement.
options.zh: 不，因为第二牧场主的主张未达到争议金额要求。

options.en: Yes, because the complaint includes a federal question.
options.zh: 是，因为起诉状包含联邦问题。

options.en: Yes, because the ranchers are diverse from the developer and both ranchers' claims arise from the same facts.
options.zh: 是，因为牧场主与开发商之间存在充分多样性，且两名牧场主的主张均基于同一事实。

explanation.en:
A defendant can remove a case from state to federal court if the claims fall within the federal court's subject-matter jurisdiction. Original jurisdiction can be established through either:

• federal-question jurisdiction – when a claim arises under the U.S. Constitution, a treaty, or federal law or

• diversity jurisdiction – when the amount in controversy exceeds $75,000 and the opposing parties are citizens of different states. Here, the ranchers' complaint cited federal law regarding the calculation of damages. But since their claim is based on a state-law tort, there is no federal-question jurisdiction

(Choice C). Instead, diversity jurisdiction exists over the first rancher's claim because it seeks $250,000 and the ranchers (State A citizens) are diverse from the developer (State B citizen). However, there is no diversity jurisdiction over the second rancher's claim since it seeks only $50,000.

When a claim fails to satisfy original jurisdiction, supplemental jurisdiction generally exists over that claim if it shares a common nucleus of operative facts with a claim within the court's original jurisdiction. But when the original claim is based on diversity jurisdiction (as seen here), supplemental jurisdiction is barred if the supplemental claim:

• would contaminate diversity of citizenship between the opposing parties or

• seeks $75,000 or less and is made by a plaintiff (1) against parties added through joinder, intervention, or impleader or (2) seeking to join through compulsory joinder or intervention. Here, the ranchers' claims arise from the same construction on the developer's property. Although the ranchers are not diverse from each other, this does not contaminate diversity between the ranchers and their opponent—the developer (Choice A). Additionally, the second rancher's $50,000 claim is asserted against the original defendant and the second rancher permissibly joined the suit. Therefore, the court has supplemental jurisdiction over this claim and removal is proper (Choice B).

Educational objective:

A case can be removed to federal court if a claim falls within that court's original jurisdiction. A claim that does not satisfy original jurisdiction generally can also be removed through supplemental jurisdiction if that claim shares a common nucleus of operative facts with a claim within the court's original jurisdiction.

References

• 28 U.S.C. § 1441 (removal requirements).

• 28 U.S.C. §§ 1331–32 (federal-question & diversity jurisdiction).

• 28 U.S.C. § 1367 (supplemental jurisdiction).

• Exxon Mobil Corp. v. Allapattah Services, 545 U.S. 546, 560 (2005) (explaining when the exercise of supplemental jurisdiction is barred).

explanation.zh:
如果案件属于联邦范围,被告可以将案件从州法院移交联邦法院。可通过下列方式确定原始管辖权:

· 联邦问题管辖权——当根据美国宪法、条约或联邦法律提出索赔时;

– 异籍管辖权 — — 当争议金额超过75 000美元,而对立方是不同州的公民时。 在这里,牧场主的起诉状引用了联邦法律中关于损失的计算。但是,由于他们的诉求是基于州法侵权,所以没有联邦问题管辖权.

相反,对第一个牧场主的要求存在异籍管辖权,因为它要求25万美元,牧场主(A州公民)不同于开发者(B州公民)。然而,对第二个牧场主的索赔没有多样性的管辖权,因为它只要求50,000美元。

如果一项请求不能满足原管辖权,如果该请求与法院原管辖权范围内的某项请求具有共同的核心运作事实,则该请求一般具有补充管辖权。但是,如果最初的要求是基于异籍管辖权(如此处所示),如果补充要求:

• 将污染对立方之间国籍的多样性;

• 原告(1)对通过合并、干预或执行人或(2)通过强制合并或干预而加入的当事方提出75,000美元或更少的要求。这里,牧场主的主张源于开发商的地产上的同一建筑. 虽然牧场主彼此并不不同,但这不会污染牧场主与其对手——开发商(Choice A)——之间的多样性.此外,第二牧场主对原被告提出了50,000美元的索赔要求,第二牧场主成功地加入了诉讼,因此,法院对这一索赔要求有补充管辖权,驱逐是适当的(Choice B)。

学习要点：

如果诉讼要求属于联邦法院的原管辖权范围,可以将案件移送联邦法院。一般也可以通过下列方式取消不能满足原始管辖权的要求:补充管辖权,如果该请求具有共同的核心执行职能在法院原管辖权范围内提出诉讼的事实。

参考资料

• 《美国法典》第28篇第1441条(迁移要求)。

• 28 U.S.C.§1331-32(联邦问题和异籍管辖权)。

• 《美国法典》第28篇第1367条(补充管辖权)。

• Exon Mobil公司诉Allapattah Services,545 U.S.546,560(2005)(解释何时禁止行使补充管辖权)。

stem: A bicyclist who was a citizen of a foreign country and a permanent resident of State A was riding on a road in State B when she was hit by a car driven by a man domiciled in State A. The bicyclist sued the man for negligence in a federal court in State B to recover $80,000 in damages. The man moved to dismiss the bicyclist's complaint for lack of subject-matter jurisdiction.
stemZh: 一名自行车骑手是外国公民且是 A 州的永久居民，她在 B 州的一条道路上骑行时被一辆由居住在 A 州的男子驾驶的汽车撞伤。该自行车骑手在 B 州的联邦法院起诉该男子，要求因其疏忽赔偿 80,000 美元。该男子提出动议，要求驳回该自行车骑手的起诉，理由是缺乏事项管辖权。
ask: How will the federal court likely rule on the man's motion?
askZh: 联邦法院对该男子的动议将如何裁定？

options.en: Deny the motion, because the bicyclist and the man are citizens of different countries and the amount in controversy is $80,000.
options.zh: 驳回动议，因为自行车骑手和该男子是不同国家的公民，且争议金额为 80,000 美元。

options.en: Deny the motion, because the collision occurred in State B.
options.zh: 驳回动议，因为碰撞发生在 B 州。

options.en: Grant the motion, because a foreign citizen cannot sue a U.S. citizen in federal court.
options.zh: 批准动议，因为外国公民不能在联邦法院起诉美国公民。

options.en: Grant the motion, because the parties are domiciled in the same state.
options.zh: 批准动议，因为双方的住所地在同一州。

explanation.en:
Subject-matter jurisdiction can be based on federal-question jurisdiction (not seen here) or diversity jurisdiction. Diversity jurisdiction is established when the amount in controversy exceeds $75,000 and there is diverse citizenship between the opposing parties. Diverse citizenship exists in a suit between U.S. citizens domiciled in different states. It also exists when the suit is between:

• U.S. citizens domiciled in the U.S. and foreign citizens

• U.S. citizens domiciled in different states, in which foreign citizens are additional parties or

• U.S. citizens and permanent residents domiciled in different states.* Here, the bicyclist (permanent resident domiciled in State A) sued the man (U.S. citizen domiciled in State A) in federal court for $80,000. Since the bicyclist and the man are domiciled in the same state, there is no diversity of citizenship. As a result, the court lacks diversity (and subject-matter) jurisdiction and will likely grant the man's motion to dismiss

(Choice A).

*Diverse citizenship also exists in the rare instance when a foreign government sues a U.S. citizen.

(Choice B) The location of the collision is irrelevant in analyzing subject-matter jurisdiction. Instead, this fact is relevant in determining whether other federal court requirements—ie, personal jurisdiction and venue—are satisfied.

(Choice C) A foreign citizen can sue a U.S. citizen in federal court if subject-matter jurisdiction is established through diversity or federal-question jurisdiction (not seen here).

Educational objective:

Diverse citizenship exists when a suit is between (1) U.S. citizens domiciled in the U.S. and foreign citizens, (2) U.S. citizens domiciled in different states, in which foreign citizens are additional parties, or (3) U.S. citizens and permanent residents domiciled in different states.

References

• 28 U.S.C. § 1332 (diversity jurisdiction).

• 32A Am. Jur. 2d Federal Courts § 616 (2020) (explaining when diverse citizenship exists between U.S. citizens and foreign citizens).

explanation.zh:
属事管辖权可以基于联邦问题管辖权(此处不见)或异籍管辖权,当争议金额超过75,000美元,而对立方之间的国籍也各不相同时,异籍管辖权就成立。在不同州居住的美国公民之间的诉讼案中存在不同的公民身份。

• 在美国居住的美国公民和外国公民

• 居住在不同国家的美国公民,其中外国公民是其他政党或

• 美国公民和居住在不同州的永久居民。 * 在此,自行车手(永久居民居住在A州)在联邦法院以8万美元起诉此人(美国公民居住在A州)。由于自行车手和男子的住所在同一州,公民身份没有多样性,因此法院缺乏多样性(和主题)管辖权,并可能同意男子提出的驳回动议。

(Choice A) (英语).

* 在外国政府起诉美国公民的罕见情况下,也存在不同的公民身份。

在分析事项管辖权时,碰撞地点无关紧要,相反,这一事实对于确定是否满足了其他联邦法院的要求——即属人管辖权和地点。

(C选择)如果通过多样性或联邦问题管辖权(此处不见)确定事项管辖权,外国公民可以在联邦法院起诉美国公民.

学习要点：

当一项诉讼发生在(1)美国居民与外国公民之间,(2)美国公民居住在不同的州,其中外国公民是额外的当事人,或者(3)美国.居住在不同州的公民和永久居民。

参考资料

• 《美国法典》第28编第1332条(异籍管辖权)。

• 32A Am. Jur. 2d 联邦法院第616条(2020年)(解释美国公民和外国公民之间存在不同国籍的情况)。

stem:
A popular food blogger from State A got into a heated online argument with the owner of a successful vegan restaurant located in State B about the merits of veganism. To get back at the owner, the blogger wrote a review of the owner's vegan restaurant in which she falsely claimed that the restaurant was infested with vermin and used animal products in its cuisine. The blogger had never eaten at the owner's restaurant or traveled to State B. The blog post had over 500,000 views from people around the United States. Within one month of the post, the restaurant shut down.

The owner sued the blogger in a federal court in State B for defamation. Based on the allegations in the owner's complaint, the blogger filed a motion to dismiss for lack of personal jurisdiction.

State B has a long-arm statute that gives its courts personal jurisdiction over out-of-state defendants that intentionally harm State B residents or businesses.
stemZh:
一名来自 A 州的知名美食博主与位于 B 州的一家成功素食餐厅的老板因素食主义的优劣展开了一场激烈的在线争论。为了报复老板，该博主撰写了一篇关于该素食餐厅的评论，其中错误地声称该餐厅被害虫侵扰，并在其菜肴中使用动物制品。该博主从未在该餐厅用餐或前往 B 州。该博客帖子在美国各地的浏览量超过 500,000 次。在该帖子发布一个月内，该餐厅关闭。

老板在 B 州的联邦法院起诉该博主，指控其诽谤。根据老板的起诉状中的指控，该博主提出了缺乏属人管辖权的驳回诉讼动议。

B 州有一项长臂条款，赋予其法院对故意损害 B 州居民或企业的非本州被告的属人管辖权。
ask: How will the federal court likely rule on the blogger's motion to dismiss?
askZh: 联邦法院如何裁定博主的驳回诉讼动议？

options.en: Deny the motion, because the blogger knew that her review would negatively impact the restaurant in State B.
options.zh: 驳回动议，因为博主知道她的评论会对 B 州的餐厅产生负面影响。

options.en: Deny the motion, unless the blogger failed to attach an affidavit to the motion demonstrating why personal jurisdiction does not exist.
options.zh: 驳回动议，除非博主未能在动议中附加一份证词，证明为何不存在属人管辖权。

options.en: Grant the motion, because the blogger has never traveled to State B.
options.zh: 批准动议，因为博主从未前往 B 州。

options.en: Grant the motion, because the blogger wrote the review in State A.
options.zh: 批准动议，因为博主是在 A 州撰写了这篇评论。

explanation.en:
Requirements for specific jurisdiction

Long-arm statute

Forum state statute must authorize jurisdiction under specific circumstances

Due process

Minimum contacts

Purposeful availment of forum state's laws so suit is foreseeable:

• Stream of commerce test – defendant places goods in stream of commerce & takes action that intentionally targets forum state

• Effects test – defendant commits intentional tort in one state with intent that effects will be felt in forum state Fair play & substantial justice

Reasonableness factors:

• Burden on defendant to appear & defend in forum state

• Plaintiff's interest in obtaining relief in forum state

• Forum state's interest

• Interstate judicial system's interest in obtaining most efficient resolution of disputes

• Interest of several states in furthering fundamental substantive social policies A federal court* has specific personal jurisdiction over a nonresident defendant if (1) the forum state has a long-arm statute that authorizes jurisdiction under the specific circumstances and (2) applying that statute complies with due process. This due process requirement is met when:

• the plaintiff's claim arises from or is closely related to the defendant's minimum contacts with the forum state and

• the exercise of jurisdiction complies with notions of fair play and substantial justice.

Minimum contacts exist when the defendant purposefully avails him/herself of the state's protections and benefits so that the defendant should reasonably foresee being sued there. Purposeful availment can occur even if the defendant never physically enters the forum state—eg, committing an intentional tort in one state with the intent that the effects will be felt in the forum state (Choices C & D).

Here, State B's long-arm statute authorizes jurisdiction over out-of-state defendants (the blogger) who intentionally harm a State B business or resident (the owner). Applying the statute complies with due process because the blogger purposefully availed herself of State B's benefits when she wrote a review to harm the owner in State B—making this defamation suit foreseeable there. And since there is no indication that exercising jurisdiction would offend notions of fair play and substantial justice, the State B federal court has specific jurisdiction over the blogger. Therefore, her motion to dismiss will likely be denied.

*Federal courts have the same jurisdictional reach as courts of the state in which they sit.

(Choice B) When a defendant asserts lack of personal jurisdiction in a pre-answer motion to dismiss (as seen here), the defendant can use the allegations in the pleadings or an attached affidavit to show why personal jurisdiction does not exist.

Educational objective:

A defendant has minimum contacts with a forum state when he/she purposefully avails him/herself of the state's protections and benefits, so that a lawsuit is reasonably foreseeable there. This can occur when the defendant commits an intentional tort in one state with the purpose or knowledge that the effects will be felt in the forum state.

References

• Calder v. Jones, 465 U.S. 783, 789–90 (1984) (holding that out-of-state defendants were subject to specific jurisdiction because their libelous article intentionally targeted the forum state's resident).

• Bristol-Myers Squibb Co. v. Super. Ct. of Cal., 137 S. Ct. 1773, 1780–82 (2017) (explaining the minimum contacts required for specific jurisdiction).

explanation.zh:
对具体管辖权的要求

长臂法规

论坛州法规必须在特定情况下授权管辖权

正当程序

最小联系人

可以预见到有意利用法院地国的法律:

• 商业流试 -- -- 被告将货物放在商业流中,并采取行动,蓄意针对法院地国

• 效果测试 -- -- 被告在一个国家犯下故意侵权罪,目的是在诉讼地州博览会中感受到效果和实质性正义

合理性因素:

• 被告在法院地国出庭和辩护的负担

• 原告在法院地国获得救济的利益

• 论坛国家的利益

• 州际司法制度对最有效地解决争端的兴趣

• 几个州促进基本实质性社会政策的兴趣对非居民被告具有特别的属人管辖权,如果(1)法院地国拥有授权根据《规约》(2) 适用该规约符合正当程序。在下列情况下,即符合正当程序要求:

• 原告的要求来自或与被告与法院地国的最低限度联系密切相关;

• 行使管辖权符合公平竞争和实质性正义的概念。

如果被告有意利用国家的保护和好处,以便被告能够合理地预见到会在那里被起诉,则存在最低限度的接触。即使被告从未实际进入法院地国——例如,在一个国家蓄意实施侵权行为,意图在法院地国感受到其影响(Choices C & D)。

B州的长臂法规授权对故意伤害B州企业或居民(所有人)的州外被告(博客)拥有管辖权。执行该法规符合正当程序,因为博客有意利用B州在她写一篇评论来伤害提出这一诽谤诉讼的B州所有人时的好处在那里可以预见由于没有任何迹象表明行使管辖权会违反公平竞争和实质性正义的概念,B州联邦法院对博客拥有具体管辖权。 因此,她提出的驳回动议很可能被拒绝。

* 联邦法院的管辖范围与其所在州的法院相同。

(Choice B) 当被告在驳回(如此处所示)的预先答复动议中声称没有属人管辖权时,被告可以利用诉状或所附宣誓书中的指控来表明为何不存在属人管辖权。

学习要点：

当被告有意利用国家的保护和利益时,他/她与法院地国的联系最少,因此可以合理地预见到诉讼。当被告在一个国家蓄意犯下侵权行为,其目的或知道后果将在法院地国感受到时,就可能发生这种情况。

参考资料

• Calder诉Jones案,465 U.S.783,789–90(1984年)(认为州外被告受到具体管辖,因为他们的诽谤文章故意针对法院地国居民)。

• Bristol-Myers Squibb Co. v. Super. Ct. of Cal.,137 S. Ct. 1773, 1780–82 (2017)(解释具体管辖权所需的最低限度联系)。
