stem:
A tire manufacturer sued its competitor in federal district court for infringing the patent on the manufacturer's best-selling tire design. The manufacturer sought compensatory damages as well as preliminary and permanent injunctions. After a pretrial hearing on the preliminary injunction, the court concluded that the manufacturer presented considerable evidence that it would suffer irreparable harm without the injunction and had a reasonable chance to succeed on the merits of its case. The court then issued the preliminary injunction.

The competitor immediately filed a notice of appeal with the clerk of the district court, arguing that the court improperly granted the preliminary injunction.
stemZh:
一家轮胎制造商在联邦地区法院起诉其竞争对手，指控其侵犯了制造商畅销轮胎设计的专利。制造商要求损害赔偿以及初步和永久禁令。在初步禁令的预审听证会上，法院得出结论认为，制造商提供了大量证据表明，如果没有禁令，将遭受不可挽回的损害，并且有合理的机会在案件的实质上取得成功。法院随后发布了初步禁令。

竞争对手立即向地区法院的书记官提交了上诉通知，认为法院错误地授予了初步禁令。
ask: What action will the appellate court likely take with respect to the competitor's appeal?
askZh: 上诉法院对竞争对手的上诉将采取什么行动？

options.en: Affirm the issuance of the preliminary injunction because the district court did not abuse its discretion.
options.zh: 确认初步禁令的发布，因为地区法院并未滥用自由裁量权。

options.en: Dismiss the appeal because the competitor did not file the notice of appeal with the clerk of the appellate court.
options.zh: 驳回上诉，因为竞争对手未向上诉法院的书记官提交上诉通知。

options.en: Dismiss the appeal because the district court has not yet entered a final judgment.
options.zh: 驳回上诉，因为地区法院尚未作出最终判决。

options.en: Overturn the issuance of the preliminary injunction because the district court's decision was clearly erroneous.
options.zh: 推翻初步禁令的发布，因为地区法院的决定明显错误。

explanation.en:
Under the final-judgment rule, an appeal cannot be taken before a final judgment has been entered except in limited circumstances. One circumstance arises when a district court rules on a request for a preliminary injunction—as seen here (Choice C). Since rulings on preliminary injunctions are discretionary, they are reviewed under the highly deferential abuse-of-discretion standard. This means the appellate court will only reverse the district court's ruling if it was clearly arbitrary or unreasonable.

A preliminary injunction may be granted if it is established that:

• the movant is likely to succeed on the merits

• the movant is likely to suffer irreparable harm in the absence of relief

• the balance of equities is in the movant's favor and

• the injunction is in the best interests of the public. Since the district court granted the preliminary injunction after the manufacturer presented considerable evidence supporting the above-listed elements, the court did not abuse its discretion in granting the preliminary injunction. Therefore, the appellate court will likely affirm the district court's decision.

(Choice B) Most appeals are initiated by filing a notice of appeal with the clerk of the district court (as seen here). Only certain interlocutory appeals (eg, appeals certified by a district court) require that a notice of appeal be filed with the clerk of the appellate court.

(Choice D) The clearly-erroneous standard is used to review factual findings in a bench trial—not a district court's discretionary rulings in a pretrial hearing (as seen here). Under that standard, the district court's factual findings will only be reversed if no reasonable judge would have made such a finding.

Educational objective:

An appellate court uses the abuse-of-discretion standard when reviewing a district court's discretionary rulings—eg, the grant or denial of a preliminary injunction. This is a highly deferential standard under which the appellate court will only reverse the district court's ruling if it was clearly arbitrary or unreasonable.

References

• Ashcroft v. Am. Civil Liberties Union, 542 U.S. 656, 664–66 (2004) (explaining that abuse-of-discretion review applies to preliminary injunctions and setting forth the traditional requirements to obtain a preliminary injunction).

根据最后判决规则,在作出最后判决之前,不能提出上诉,除非在有限的情况下,区法院对初步禁止令的请求作出裁定(如这里所见(Choice C)。由于关于初步禁令的裁决是自由裁量的,因此根据高度延迟的滥用裁量标准予以复审,这意味着上诉法院只有在地区法院的裁决明显武断或不合理的情况下才会推翻该裁决。

如果确定:

• 机动部队有可能根据案情取得成功

• 在缺乏救济的情况下,机动部队可能遭受无法弥补的损害

· 股票的平衡有利于Movant,

• 禁令符合公众的最佳利益。由于在制造商提出大量证据支持后,地区法院批准了初步禁令。法院没有滥用其裁量权批准《公约》。因此,上诉法院可能会确认地区法院的以下裁决:决定。

(Choice B) 大多数上诉都是通过向地区法院书记官提交上诉通知提起的(见这里)。只有某些中间上诉(如经地区法院认证的上诉)要求向上诉法院书记官提交上诉通知。

(Choice D) 使用明显不相干的标准来审查法庭审判中的事实结论,而不是地区法院在预审中酌情作出的裁决(见这里)。根据这项标准,只有在没有合理的法官作出这种裁决的情况下,区法院的事实结论才会被推翻。

学习要点：

上诉法院在审查地区法院的裁量性裁决时,例如准许或拒绝初步禁令时,采用滥用裁量标准。这是一种高度顺从的标准,根据这种标准,上诉法院只有在地区法院的裁决明显武断或不合理的情况下才会推翻该裁决。

参考资料

• Ashcroft诉Am. Civil Liberties Union, 542 U.S. 656, 664–66(2004年)(解释滥用自由审查适用于初步禁令,并规定了获得初步禁令的传统要求)。

stem:
Two days before his home was to be sold at a foreclosure sale, a homeowner obtained a temporary restraining order (TRO) in federal court that prevented his lender from proceeding with the sale for 14 days or until a preliminary injunction hearing could take place, whichever was sooner. When a preliminary injunction hearing could not be scheduled within the original 14-day period, the court extended the TRO for another 30 days.

The lender appealed the court's order extending the TRO. The homeowner has moved to dismiss the appeal.
stemZh:
在房屋即将在强制拍卖中出售两天前，一名房主在联邦法院获得了一项临时禁令（TRO），该禁令阻止其贷款人在此后的14天内或直到初步禁令听证会可以举行之前进行拍卖。当初步禁令听证会无法在最初的14天内安排时，法院将TRO延长了30天。

贷款人上诉了法院延长TRO的决定。房主提出了驳回上诉的动议。
ask: Is the appellate court likely to dismiss the appeal?
askZh: 上诉法院很可能驳回上诉吗？

options.en: No, because a TRO is immediately appealable.
options.zh: 不，因为临时禁令可以立即上诉。

options.en: No, because the 30-day extension makes the TRO equivalent to a preliminary injunction and therefore appealable.
options.zh: 不，因为30天的延长使临时禁令等同于初步禁令，因此可以上诉。

options.en: Yes, because a TRO is not appealable under the interlocutory appeals statute.
options.zh: 是，因为根据中间上诉法，临时禁令不可上诉。

options.en: Yes, because there is no final judgment from which an appeal may be taken.
options.zh: 是，因为没有可上诉的最终判决。

explanation.en:
Final-judgment rule

Rule Appeal only allowed after final judgment

• If multiple claims/parties, final judgment as to fewer than all claims/parties appropriate if court expressly determines no justifiable reason for delay Exceptions Interlocutory appeals* concerning:

• Injunction (grant/denial)

• Certification by district court

• Class action certification

• Appointment of receiver

• Admiralty case

• Collateral-order doctrine

• Bankruptcy cases (certain orders)

• Mandamus (petition for writ)

• Patent infringement order (only accounting left) Mnemonic: In Certain Circumstances, An Appeal Can Be Made Prematurely

*Appeal from trial court ruling that occurs before entry of final judgment.

*Appeal from trial court ruling that occurs before entry of final judgment

The final-judgment rule bars federal appellate courts from hearing an appeal until the federal district court has entered a final judgment—ie, a judicial decision that fully resolves the dispute on the merits and leaves nothing for the court to do but enforce the judgment. But the interlocutory appeals statute (28 U.S.C. § 1292) provides exceptions to this rule that allow an immediate appeal in limited circumstances.

One of those circumstances arises when a district court grants or denies a preliminary injunction—ie, a court order entered before or during trial that commands or prohibits a specified action while the case is before the court. In contrast, a temporary restraining order (TRO)—ie, a court order that commands or prohibits specified action for 14 days or until a preliminary injunction hearing can take place (whichever occurs first)—is not immediately appealable under this statute (Choice A).

But when a TRO is extended beyond 14 days (as seen here), it becomes equivalent to a preliminary injunction. As a result, the extended TRO is immediately appealable even though there is no final judgment (Choices C & D). Therefore, the appellate court is unlikely to dismiss the lender's appeal of the order extending the TRO.

Educational objective:

The interlocutory appeals statute allows certain orders to be appealed before the entry of a final judgment—eg, the grant or denial of a preliminary injunction. A temporary restraining order extended beyond 14 days is equivalent to a preliminary injunction and is immediately appealable under this statute.

References

• 28 U.S.C. § 1292 (exceptions to final judgment rule).

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 65 (preliminary injunctions and temporary restraining orders).

• Sampson v. Murray, 415 U.S. 61, 86–88 (1974) (holding that a temporary restraining order extended beyond its time limit is the equivalent of a preliminary injunction).

explanation.zh:
最后裁定规则

只有在最后判决后才允许上诉

• 如果多项债权/当事方,如果法院明确认定无正当理由拖延,则对以下事项作出最后判决:

• 禁止(赠款/拒绝)

• 地区法院的认证

• 类别行动认证

• 指定接收人

• 海军上将案

• 担保命令理论

• 破产案件(某些命令)

• 诉状

• 专利侵犯令(仅余会计)在某些情况下,上诉可不成熟

* 对审判法庭在作出最后判决之前作出的裁决提出上诉。

* 在作出最后判决之前对审判法庭的裁决提出上诉

最后裁决规则禁止联邦上诉法院审理上诉,直到联邦地区法院作出最后裁决,即一项司法裁决,根据案情充分解决了争端,法院只能执行该裁决。但中间上诉规约(《美国法典》第28编第1292条)对这一规则规定了例外情况,允许在有限的情况下立即上诉。

其中一个情况是,区法院准许或拒绝下达初步禁令,即在审判前或审判期间下达的法院命令,命令或禁止在法院审理案件期间采取特定行动。与此相反,临时限制令(TRO)——即在14天之内命令或禁止采取特定行动的法院命令,或直到可以举行初步禁止令听证(无论先发生哪一次)——根据本法规不能立即上诉(选择A)。

但是,当TRO被延长到14天之后(如本文所示),它就相当于初步禁令。 因此,即使没有最终判决(Choices C & D),延长的TRO也可以立即上诉。因此,上诉法院不可能驳回贷款人对延长TRO的命令提出的上诉。

学习要点：

中间上诉法规允许在作出最后判决之前就某些命令提出上诉,例如准许或拒绝下达初步禁令。超过14天的临时禁止令相当于初步禁令,可根据本规约立即上诉。

参考资料

• 《美国法典》第28编第1292条(最后判决规则的例外)。

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 65(初步禁令和临时限制令)。

• Sampson诉Murray,415 U.S.61,86-88(1974年)(认为临时禁止令超过时限相当于初步禁令)。

stem:
A woman from State A sued a pharmaceutical company incorporated and with its principal place of business in State B in federal district court for $1 million in damages. The woman alleged that the company engaged in deceptive marketing by failing to disclose all the health risks associated with one of its drugs. She claimed that this contributed to her becoming addicted to the drug, which led to severe medical complications.

The case was tried to the court. The woman presented evidence to support her claim and immediately after, the company moved for a judgment on partial findings. The judge announced her findings of fact and conclusions of law from the bench and explained that the woman had failed to present legally sufficient evidence to establish the causation element of her claim. Specifically, the judge did not believe that the woman's witnesses concerning that element were credible and discounted their testimony. The judge then granted the company's motion and entered a judgment in favor of the company.
stemZh:
一名来自 A 州的女子在联邦地区法院起诉了一家注册地和主要营业地在 B 州的制药公司，要求赔偿 100 万美元。该女子声称该公司通过未披露其一种药物的所有健康风险，进行了欺骗性营销。她表示，这导致她对该药物上瘾，进而引发了严重的医疗并发症。

案件在法院审理过程中进行。该女子提供了证据支持其主张，随即，该公司提出了部分事实判决动议。法官在庭上宣布了其对事实的认定和对法律的结论，并解释称该女子未能提供足够的法律证据来证明其主张中的因果关系要素。具体而言，法官不相信该女子关于该要素的证人证词具有可信度，并否定了他们的证词。法官随后批准了公司的动议，并作出有利于公司的判决。
ask: Were the judge's actions proper?
askZh: 法官的行为是否恰当？

options.en: No, because the judge acted improperly when she discounted the testimony of the witnesses.
options.zh: 否，因为法官在否定证人证词时行为不当。

options.en: No, because the judge failed to state her findings and conclusions in writing.
options.zh: 否，因为法官未以书面形式陈述其认定和结论。

options.en: Yes, because a judgment on partial findings may be entered at any time during trial.
options.zh: 是，因为可以在审判过程中随时作出部分事实判决。

options.en: Yes, because the woman had an opportunity to be fully heard on her claim.
options.zh: 是，因为该女子有机会就其主张进行充分陈述。

explanation.en:
When a case is tried to the court (ie, a bench trial), a party can file a motion for judgment on partial findings in lieu of a motion for judgment as a matter of law (JMOL). This motion requests that the court enter a partial finding against the nonmovant after the nonmovant has been fully heard on the issue. If that finding resolves a claim or defense, the court may enter a judgment on partial findings. The court must provide factual findings and legal conclusions (orally or in writing) on the record in support of that judgment (Choice B).

Here, the judge announced her findings and conclusions on the company's motion for judgment on partial findings from the bench (ie, on the record). The judge found that the woman's witnesses were not credible, so the woman did not have legally sufficient evidence to establish the causation element of her claim. And since the woman had been fully heard on her claim, the court acted properly in entering the judgment on partial findings.*

*The woman can still challenge the judge's decision on appeal. The appellate court will review the judge's factual findings for clear error (high deference) and the judge's conclusions of law de novo (no deference).

(Choice A) As the fact finder in a bench trial, a judge may consider the credibility of witnesses and the weight of the evidence to determine if they are sufficient to render a decision for the movant before entering a judgment on partial findings.** Therefore, the judge acted properly when she discounted the testimony of the woman's witnesses after assessing their credibility.

**In contrast, the court may not evaluate the credibility of witnesses or the weight of the evidence when considering an initial or renewed motion for JMOL.

(Choice C) A judgment on partial findings can be entered only after the nonmovant has had an opportunity to be fully heard. So had the company moved for a judgment on partial findings before the woman presented her case, the court could not have considered the motion.

Educational objective:

In a bench trial, a judge may enter a partial finding against the nonmovant after the nonmovant has been fully heard on the issue. If that finding resolves a party's claim or defense, the court may then enter a judgment on partial findings.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 52(c) (judgment on partial findings).

explanation.zh:
当案件被法庭审判(即合议庭审判)时,当事一方可就部分裁定提出判决动议,以代替作为法律问题的判决动议(JMOL)。这项动议要求法院在就该问题充分听取非动议方的意见后,对非动议方作出部分裁定,如果裁定解决了索赔或辩护,法院可就部分裁定作出判决。法院必须在记录中提供事实调查结果和法律结论(口头或书面),以支持该判决(Choice B)。

在此,法官宣布了她对公司请求从法官席上对部分调查结果作出判决的请求的调查结果和结论(i,记录上).法官认定,该妇女的证人不可信,因此该妇女没有法律上足够的证据来证实其申诉的因果关系。由于该妇女的申诉已得到充分审理,法院在就部分裁定作出判决时行为适当。

* 妇女仍可质疑法官的上诉决定,上诉法院将审查法官的事实调查结果,以发现明显错误(高度尊重)和法官对法律的结论(不尊重)。

(Choice A)法官作为法官审判中的事实发现者,可以考虑证人的可信性和证据的份量,以确定他们是否足以在对部分调查结果作出判决之前就机动车作出裁决。法官在评估女证人的可信度后,不考虑女证人的证词。

** 与此相反,法院在审议关于JMOL的初步或重新请求时,不得评价证人的可信度或证据的份量。

只有在非动议方有机会充分陈述意见之后,才能对部分调查结果作出判决,如果公司在妇女陈述其案件之前就要求就部分调查结果作出判决,那么法院不可能审议该动议。

学习要点：

在法庭审判中,法官可以在非动议方充分听取其意见后,对非动议方作出部分裁定,如果该裁定解决了当事一方的主张或辩护,法院可以就部分裁定作出判决。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 52(c)(对部分调查结果的判断)。

stem: A man brought a federal diversity action against his former business partner for breach of contract seeking $100,000 in damages. The business partner moved to dismiss for lack of personal jurisdiction. After the court denied the motion, the business partner filed and served an answer in which she denied the man's claim. Ten days later, the man filed and served a jury demand, which the business partner moved to strike.
stemZh: 一名男子就合同违约向其前商业伙伴提起联邦不同州籍管辖权诉讼，要求赔偿 100,000 美元。商业伙伴提出了缺乏属人管辖权的驳回诉讼动议。法院驳回该动议后，商业伙伴提交并送达了答辩状，否认男子的主张。十天后，男子提交并送达了陪审团审判要求，商业伙伴提出了反对该要求的动议。
ask: Is the court likely to grant the motion to strike?
askZh: 法院很可能批准反对陪审团审判要求的动议吗？

options.en: No, because the man properly demanded a jury trial.
options.zh: 不，因为男子正确地提出了陪审团审判要求。

options.en: No, because the right to a jury trial extends to civil claims.
options.zh: 不，因为陪审团审判权适用于民事索赔。

options.en: Yes, because the jury demand was untimely filed.
options.zh: 是的，因为陪审团审判要求提交时间不及时。

options.en: Yes, because the man failed to assert the jury demand in a pleading.
options.zh: 是的，因为男子未在诉状中提出陪审团审判要求。

explanation.en:
All civil litigants (plaintiffs and defendants) have the constitutional right to a jury trial for any legal claim where the amount in controversy exceeds $20 (as seen here). However, a party waives this right if a proper demand is not made. Under FRCP 38, a party may properly demand a jury trial by:

• serving the other parties with a written jury demand within 14 days after the last pleading (usually the defendant's answer) is served and

• filing the demand with the court within a reasonable time after service of the demand.*

Here, the man filed and served his written jury demand 10 days after being served with the business partner's answer. Since the demand was timely and properly made, the court is unlikely to strike it (Choice C).

*A jury trial demand is treated as a request that a jury decide all issues unless the party specifies otherwise. If so specified, another party may serve a jury trial demand for any other issue within 14 days after service of the original demand or a shorter time ordered by the court.

(Choice B) Parties have a jury trial right for legal claims—ie, claims seeking a monetary remedy to compensate for a loss (eg, damages). But this right does not extend to equitable claims—ie, claims seeking a nonmonetary remedy (eg, injunction).

(Choice D) A jury trial demand may, but need not, be included in a pleading. The demand can also be made in a separate, stand-alone document (as seen here).

Educational objective:

Any party may secure the right to a jury trial on any legal claim by (1) serving the other parties with a written jury demand no later than 14 days after the last pleading is served and (2) filing the demand with the court within a reasonable time after serving it.

FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 38(b) (jury trial demand).

explanation.zh:
所有民事诉讼人(原告和被告)在争议金额超过20美元(如此处所示)的任何法律诉求中均享有接受陪审团审判的宪法权利,但是,如果当事人没有提出适当要求,则放弃这一权利。根据《联邦刑事诉讼法》第38条,一方可适当要求陪审团审判:

• 在最后诉状(通常是被告的答复)送达后14天内向其他当事方提出书面陪审团要求;

• 在满足要求后的合理时间内向法院提出请求。

在此,这名男子在得到商业伙伴的回答10天后,提出并送达了书面陪审团的要求,由于要求是及时的和适当的,因此法院不太可能予以罢休(Choice C)。

* 陪审团审判要求被视为要求陪审团决定所有问题,除非当事方另有规定。如果有此规定,另一当事方可在原要求送达后14天内,或在法院下令的较短时间内,就任何其他问题满足陪审团的审判要求。

(Choice B) 当事方对法律索赔拥有陪审团审判权,即寻求金钱补救以补偿损失(例如损害)的索赔,但这项权利并不延伸至公平索赔,即寻求非金钱补救的索赔(例如强制令)。

(Choice D)陪审团的审判要求可以但不需要包含在申辩中,要求也可以以单独的独立文件提出(参见本文).

学习要点：

任何当事方均可通过以下方式确保获得任何法律要求的陪审团审判权:(1) 最迟在最后的诉状送达后14天内向其他当事方提出书面陪审团要求;(2) 在送达请求后的合理时间内向法院提出请求。

FRCP = 联邦民事诉讼规则。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P.38(b)(审判要求)。

stem:
A man was apprehended for illegally crossing the U.S. border. The man was held at a detention facility for over a month before the government realized that he was a U.S. citizen. After he was released, the man filed a complaint in federal court against the government under a federal statute that waives the federal government's immunity in these types of suits. The man sought $100,000 in damages and demanded a jury trial.

At the close of evidence at trial, the government and the man both submitted proposed jury instructions. The court decided to hear the parties' closing arguments before ruling on which instructions to use. Both parties made their closing arguments. The court then informed the parties outside the jury's presence of its proposed instructions, which differed significantly from the instructions proposed by the parties. Both parties objected on the record.
stemZh:
一名男子因非法越境美国边境被逮捕。该男子在被拘留设施中被关押了一个多月，直到政府意识到他是美国公民。在他被释放后，该男子在美国联邦法院对政府提起诉讼，援引一项联邦法律，该法律在这些类型的诉讼中豁免联邦政府的豁免权。该男子要求赔偿 100,000 美元，并要求陪审团审判。

在庭审结束时，政府和该男子都提交了陪审团指示的草案。法院决定在听取双方结案陈词后，再决定使用哪项指示。双方都进行了结案陈词。然后，法院在陪审团不在场的情况下，向双方告知其拟议的指示，这些指示与双方提出的指示差异显著。双方都在记录上提出了异议。
ask: Did the court err in providing its proposed jury instructions in this manner?
askZh: 法院以这种方式提供其拟议的陪审团指示是否错误？

options.en: No, because the court has complete authority to decide when and how to provide jury instructions.
options.zh: 否，因为法院有权决定何时以及如何提供陪审团指示。

options.en: No, because the court need not to inform the parties of its proposed instructions until after closing arguments.
options.zh: 否，因为法院不必在结案陈词之后才通知双方其拟议的指示。

options.en: Yes, because the court failed to inform the parties of its proposed instructions and give them an opportunity to object before closing arguments.
options.zh: 是，因为法院未能在结案陈词前通知双方其拟议的指示并给予他们提出异议的机会。

options.en: Yes, because the court failed to instruct the jury before closing arguments.
options.zh: 是，因为法院在结案陈词前未能向陪审团提供指示。

explanation.en:
Jury instructions

(FRCP 51)

Requests Party:

• must file request by close of evidence unless earlier, reasonable deadline set by court

• may file request after close of evidence when: – request relates to issue that party could not have reasonably anticipated by deadline or – court permits late submission related to any issue Instructions Court:

• must inform parties of proposed instructions before instructing jury & closing arguments

• must allow parties to object on record & outside jury's presence before instructing jury & closing arguments

• may consider objection made after court instructs jury if instruction constituted plain error

• may instruct jury at any time before discharge Objections Party:

• must distinctly state objection & its grounds on record

• must object at court-appointed time or promptly after learning of proposed instruction FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

In a jury trial, the court must provide jury instructions that advise jurors on their deliberation procedures and the applicable law. The court has the ultimate authority to decide when and how to provide jury instructions so long as it complies with the requirements of Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (FRCP) 51 (Choice A). Under FRCP 51, the court:

• may instruct the jury at any time before the jury is discharged—ie, released from its duties in the case

• must inform the parties of its proposed instructions before it instructs the jury and the parties give their closing arguments and

• must give the parties an opportunity to object on the record and outside the presence of the jury before the instructions and closing arguments are delivered to the jury.

Here, the court properly informed the parties of its proposed instructions and gave them an opportunity to object before it instructed the jury. But the court erred in failing to do so before closing arguments (Choice B). As a result, the parties could not tailor their closing arguments to the applicable law provided in the court's jury instructions.

(Choice D) The court did not err in failing to instruct the jury before the parties gave their closing arguments because a court may instruct the jury at any time before the jury is discharged. Instead, the court erred in failing to inform the parties of its proposed instructions and give them an opportunity to object before closing arguments.

Educational objective:

In a jury trial, a court (1) may instruct the jury at any time before the jury is discharged, (2) must inform the parties of its proposed instructions before instructing the jury and closing arguments, and (3) must allow the parties to object on the record and outside the presence of the jury before the instructions and closing arguments are delivered.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 51(b) (court requirements for providing jury instructions).

explanation.zh:
陪审团指示

(FRCP51)

请缔约方:

• 必须在证据结束时提出请求,除非法院规定更早的合理期限

· 在下列情况下,可在证据终结后提出请求: - 请求涉及当事人无法在最后期限前合理预期的问题或 - 法院允许延迟提交与任何问题有关的指令:

• 在指示陪审团和最后辩论之前,必须先将拟议指示通知当事方。

• 在指示陪审团和最后辩论之前,必须允许当事方在记录和陪审团之外提出异议

• 如果指示构成明显错误,可在法院指示陪审团后考虑提出异议

• 可以在解除反对方义务前的任何时候指示陪审团:

• 必须明确申明反对及其理由。

• 必须在法院指定的时间内提出异议,或在得知拟议指令后迅速提出异议。

在陪审团审判中,法院必须提供陪审团指示,就陪审员的审议程序和适用的法律向陪审员提供咨询。法院有最终权力决定何时以及如何提供陪审团指示,只要它符合联邦民事诉讼规则51(选择A)的要求。

• 在陪审团解除职责之前的任何时候,可以指示陪审团,即解除其在案件中的职责;

· 在指示陪审团和当事方作出最后陈述之前,必须将其拟议指示通知当事各方;

• 在向陪审团提交指示和最后陈述之前,必须让当事方有机会在记录上和陪审团在场之外提出异议。

在这方面,法院适当地将它提出的指示通知了双方,并给他们机会在它指示陪审团之前提出异议,但法院在最后辩论(Choice B)之前没有这样做是错误的。因此,当事双方不能根据法院陪审团指示中规定的适用法律调整其最后陈述。

(Choice D)法院在当事方作出最后陈述之前没有指示陪审团没有犯错,因为法院可以在陪审团解散前的任何时候指示陪审团。相反,法院错误地没有将拟议的指示通知当事各方,没有让他们有机会在最后辩论之前提出异议。

学习要点：

在陪审团审判中,法院(1) 在陪审团解散前的任何时候可以指示陪审团,(2) 在指示陪审团和最后辩论之前必须将其提议的指示通知当事各方,(3) 必须允许当事方在记录上和外部提出异议。在作出指示和最后陈述之前有陪审团在场。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P.51(b)(法院对提供陪审团指示的要求)。

stem:
A woman brought a diversity action against her former employer in a federal district court in State A. In her complaint, the woman alleged that she contracted a lung disease at work due to her employer's negligence. The employer moved to dismiss the woman's action for failure to state a claim. The court granted the motion because State A does not recognize claims for occupational diseases. The woman appealed.

While the woman's appeal was pending, the highest state court in State A issued a ruling that, for the first time, recognized claims for occupational diseases.
stemZh:
一名女子在A 州 的联邦地区法院对前雇主提起了一项基于不同州籍管辖权的诉讼。在她的起诉书中，女子声称她因雇主的疏忽在工作中患上了肺病。雇主提出了驳回诉讼动议，理由是起诉书未能提出有效主张。法院批准了该动议，因为A 州 不承认职业病索赔。女子提起上诉。

在女子的上诉尚未决期间，A 州 的最高州法院发布了一项裁决，首次承认职业病索赔。
ask: Is the appellate court likely to overturn the dismissal?
askZh: 上诉法院是否会很可能推翻驳回决定？

options.en: No, because federal law permits a dismissal for failure to state a claim.
options.zh: 否，因为联邦法律允许因未能提出有效主张而驳回诉讼。

options.en: No, because State A did not recognize claims for occupational diseases at the time the action was dismissed.
options.zh: 否，因为A 州 在诉讼被驳回时并不承认职业病索赔。

options.en: Yes, because the district court committed clear error when it dismissed the action.
options.zh: 是，因为地区法院在驳回诉讼时犯了明显的错误。

options.en: Yes, because the recent ruling by State A's highest court controls.
options.zh: 是，因为A 州 最高法院最近的裁决具有约束力。

explanation.en:
All federal courts sitting in diversity must apply federal law to procedural issues and state law to substantive issues. Issues concerning the elements of a claim or defense are clearly substantive and therefore determined by state law. Since the elements of a claim or defense are a pure legal issue, the appellate court will review the district court's interpretation of state law de novo.

Under this standard of review, the appellate court gives no deference to the district court's interpretation and decides the issue anew. However, the appellate court must follow any rulings issued by the state's highest court while the appeal was pending.

Here, the district court properly applied State A law when it dismissed the woman's action for failure to state a claim because State A did not recognize her claim at that time. However, while the appeal was pending, the highest state court in State A issued a ruling that recognized the woman's claim. Since the appellate court must follow that ruling, it will likely overturn the dismissal of the woman's action (Choice B).

(Choice A) Federal law provides procedural devices to dismiss an action for failure to state a claim. However, a federal court must apply state substantive law to determine if a claim was adequately stated. As a result, State A law governs whether the woman adequately stated a claim for relief.

(Choice C) A district court's factual findings in a bench trial are reviewed for clear error. Under this highly deferential standard of review, a district court's findings of facts will only be reversed if no reasonable judge would have made such a finding. But here, this pure legal issue will be reviewed de novo.

Educational objective:

Federal courts sitting in diversity must apply federal law to procedural issues and state law to substantive issues (eg, the elements of a claim or defense). An appellate court reviewing a district court's interpretation of state law must follow any rulings issued by the state's highest court while the appeal was pending.

References

• Vandenbark v. Owens-Ill. Glass Co., 311 U.S. 538, 543 (1941) (holding that federal appellate courts must follow any rulings issued by the state's highest court while the appeal was pending).

explanation.zh:
所有联邦法院在审理各种诉讼时必须适用联邦法律,对实质性问题必须适用州法律,有关索赔或辩护要素的问题显然具有实质性,因此由州法律决定。由于索赔或辩护的要件是一个纯粹的法律问题,上诉法院将重新审查地区法院对州法律的解释。

根据这一复审标准,上诉法院不理会地区法院的解释,重新决定这一问题,但上诉法院必须在上诉未决期间遵循州最高法院做出的任何裁决。

在此,地区法院在驳回该妇女因未能提出权利要求而提出的诉讼时适当适用了A州法律,因为A州当时不承认她的权利要求。然而,在上诉待决期间,A州最高州法院发布了一项裁决,承认了该妇女的申诉,因为上诉法院必须遵循该裁决,因此有可能推翻驳回该妇女的诉讼(Choice B)。

(Choice A) 联邦法律规定了程序手段,用以驳回因未陈述权利要求而提出的诉讼,但是,联邦法院必须适用州实体法来确定权利要求是否得到充分陈述。因此,A州法律规定妇女是否充分提出救济要求。

(C) 区法院在法庭审判中的事实结论被复审有明显的错误,根据这种高度延迟的复审标准,区法院对事实的结论只有在没有合理法官做出这样的裁决的情况下才会被推翻。但在这里,这一纯粹的法律问题将再次得到审查。

学习要点：

联邦法院必须采用联邦法律处理程序问题,州法律处理实质性问题(例如,求偿或辩护的要素)。上诉法院审查地区法院对州法律的解释时,必须遵循州最高法院在上诉待决期间作出的任何裁决。

参考资料

• Vandenbark诉Owens-Ill.Glass Co.,311 U.S.538, 543 (1941)(认为联邦上诉法院必须在上诉未决期间遵循州最高法院作出的任何裁决)。

stem: A truck driver from State A and a bus driver from State B were involved in a collision in State B that injured the truck driver. The truck driver filed a federal diversity action in State B based on negligence, seeking $100,000 in damages from the bus driver.
stemZh: 一名来自 A 州的卡车司机和一名来自 B 州的公交车司机在 B 州发生碰撞事故，导致卡车司机受伤。卡车司机在 B 州提起了一项基于过失的联邦不同州籍诉讼，要求公交车司机赔偿 100,000 美元。
ask: What law of negligence should the court apply?
askZh: 法院应适用哪一州的过失法？

options.en: The court should apply the federal common law of negligence.
options.zh: 法院应适用联邦的普通过失法。

options.en: The court should apply the negligence law of State A, the truck driver's state of citizenship.
options.zh: 法院应适用 A 州的过失法，即卡车司机的籍贯州。

options.en: The court should consider the negligence law of both State A and State B and apply the law that the court believes most appropriately governs negligence in this action.
options.zh: 法院应考虑 A 州和 B 州的过失法，并适用法院认为最适当地规制该诉讼中过失的法律。

options.en: The court should determine which state's negligence law a state court in State B would apply and apply that law in this action.
options.zh: 法院应确定 B 州法院会适用哪一州的过失法，并在本案中适用该法律。

explanation.en:
When a federal court's subject-matter jurisdiction is based on diversity jurisdiction, the dispute is between citizens of different states. As a result, the court must determine which state's substantive law applies to the case. If no federal rule, federal statute, or constitutional provision controls the substantive issue, then the court must follow the choice-of-law rules of the state where the court sits.

Here, the federal court in State B has diversity jurisdiction over this negligence case. There is no federal law on negligence. Therefore, the court must use the choice-of-law rules of the state where the court sits (State B) to determine which state's (State A's or State B's) negligence law a court in State B should apply.

(Choice A) There is no federal common law of negligence, so federal courts must adhere to state law on this substantive matter.

(Choice B) The court cannot simply select the law of the truck driver's state of citizenship. Instead, the court must look to the choice-of-law rules of the state where the court sits to determine which competing state's substantive law should apply to this case.

(Choice C) If the court were to review the negligence law of both states and select the law the court found most appropriate, then the court would be erroneously developing its own federal choice-of-law rules.

Educational objective:

In a federal diversity action where no federal substantive law applies, a federal court must look to the choice-of-law rules of the state where the court sits to determine which state's substantive law to follow.

References

• Klaxon Co. v. Stentor Elec. Mfg. Co., 313 U.S. 487, 496–97 (1941) (explaining that a federal court hearing a diversity case must apply the choice-of-law rules of the state in which the court sits).

explanation.zh:
当联邦法院的属事管辖权基于异籍管辖权时,争议是不同州公民之间的纠纷,因此,法院必须确定哪个州的实体法适用于案件。如果没有联邦规则、联邦法规或宪法规定控制实质性问题,那么法院必须遵循法院所在地州的法律选择规则。

在此,B州的联邦法院对这起疏忽案件有多样性的管辖权,没有关于疏忽的联邦法律.因此,法院必须使用法院所在地国(B州)的法律选择规则来确定B州法院应适用哪个国家(A州或B州)的过失法。

(Choice A)没有关于疏忽的联邦普通法,因此联邦法院必须在此实质性事项上遵守州法律.

(Choice B)法院不能简单地选择卡车司机国籍状态的法律,相反,法院必须参考法院所在地国家的法律选择规则,以确定哪个相竞州的实体法应适用于本案.

(C选择)如果法院要审查两个州的过失法并选择法院认为最适当的法律,那么法院就会错误地制定自己的联邦法律选择规则。

学习要点：

在联邦实体法不适用的联邦多样性诉讼中,联邦法院必须参照法院所在地州的法律选择规则,以确定该州实体法将遵循哪个州的法律。

参考资料

• Klaxon Co.诉Stentor Elec. Mfg Co.,313 U.S. 487, 496-97(1941)(解释联邦法院审理多样性案件必须适用法院所在地州的法律选择规则)。

stem:
A former secretary sued a large corporation in an appropriate federal district court for violating the federal sex discrimination statute. The secretary seeks to recover $1 million and properly requested a jury trial.

During voir dire to seat a six-person jury, potential jurors revealed several facts about themselves. An elderly woman stated that she did not believe that female employees fired for discriminatory reasons deserve compensation because "people blame everything on sex." A contractor explained that he did not want to serve on the jury because he really wanted to get back to work. A man revealed that he is the brother of the defendant's lawyer. A businesswoman said that she owned stock in a retirement fund that she did not think contained any of the corporation's stock, but she could not be 100% certain.
stemZh:
一名前秘书在适当的联邦地区法院起诉一家大公司，指控其违反联邦性别歧视法。该秘书要求赔偿 100 万美元，并正确地请求了陪审团审判。

在挑选六人陪审团的 voir dire 过程中，潜在陪审员透露了他们的一些情况。一位年长的女士表示，她不相信因歧视原因被解雇的女性员工应获得赔偿，因为 "人们总是把一切归咎于性别"。一位承包商解释说，他不想担任陪审员，因为他真的很想回到工作岗位。一位男士透露，他是被告律师的兄弟。一位女商人表示，她拥有一只退休基金的股票，她认为这只基金不包含该公司的股票，但她不能确定 100%。
ask: If the secretary's counsel seeks to strike each of these potential jurors from serving on the jury, which potential juror can only be stricken with a peremptory challenge?
askZh: 如果该秘书的律师希望将这些潜在陪审员中的一人从陪审团中剔除，哪一位潜在陪审员只能通过任意剔除权（peremptory challenge）被剔除？

options.en: The businesswoman.
options.zh: 女商人。

options.en: The contractor.
options.zh: 承包商。

options.en: The elderly woman.
options.zh: 年长的女士。

options.en: The man.
options.zh: 男士。

explanation.en:
Challenges to potential jurors

(FRCP 47)

Number allowed

Basis for disqualification

Peremptory 3 per party* • Any basis other than race, ethnicity, or gender

• No explanation needed For cause Unlimited • For bias or lack of impartiality—eg: – relationship with party – financial stake in party FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

*When a civil action involves multiple plaintiffs or defendants, the court may grant each side (1) three peremptory challenges or (2) more than three peremptory challenges that each side's parties exercise separately or jointly. In all federal civil cases where the amount in controversy exceeds $20, the Seventh Amendment guarantees the right to a jury trial. To select the jury, the court, the parties, or the parties' attorneys may question the potential jurors about their backgrounds and potential biases. During this voir dire process, each party can strike potential jurors from service through:

• challenges for cause – to strike a potential juror based on his/her inability to serve as a fair and impartial finder of fact (eg, financial stake in a party, bias, relation to party or party's counsel) and

• peremptory challenges – to strike a potential juror for any reason—except for race, ethnicity, or gender—without an explanation.

Here, the secretary's attorney can successfully challenge three of the four potential jurors for cause. The businesswoman may have a financial stake in the corporation through her retirement fund stock (Choice A). The elderly woman displayed a clear bias by stating that she did not believe that female employees fired for discriminatory reasons deserve compensation because "people blame everything on sex" (Choice C). And the man is the brother of the defendant's attorney (Choice D).

However, the contractor's statement that he did not want to serve on the jury because he wanted to get back to work reveals no basis for a challenge for cause. This response may cause the secretary's counsel concern as to whether the contractor will take jury service seriously but does not show that he will be unable to serve fairly and impartially. Therefore,

the secretary's counsel must use a peremptory challenge to strike the contractor. And since there is no indication of a racial, ethnic, or gender-based motive for the challenge, it should succeed.

Educational objective:

During jury selection in a federal civil action, each party may strike potential jurors from service through (1) challenges for cause—to strike a potential juror for bias or lack of impartiality—and (2) peremptory challenges—to strike a potential juror for any reason (except race, ethnicity, or gender) without explanation.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 47 (jury-selection process).

explanation.zh:
对潜在陪审员的挑战

(FRCP47)

允许的数量

取消资格的依据

• 种族、族裔或性别以外的任何理由

• 对于偏见或缺乏公正性的原因,不需要作出解释——例如:– 与政党的关系 – 政党FRCP = 联邦民事诉讼规则中的经济利益.

* 当一项民事诉讼涉及多个原告或被告时,法院可准许每一方(1)三项无因回避或(2)每一方当事人单独或共同提出的三项以上无因回避。在争议金额超过20美元的所有联邦民事案件中,第七修正案保障陪审团审判的权利.选择陪审团、法院、当事方或当事方的律师可以质疑陪审员关于他们的背景 和潜在的偏见。在此期间,每一方均可通过下列途径将潜在的陪审员从服役中除名:

· 理由挑战——以可能担任陪审员无法作为公正和公正的事实发现者(例如,当事一方的经济利益、偏见、与当事一方或当事一方律师的关系)为由,打击该陪审员;

• 强制性挑战——以任何理由——除种族、族裔或性别外——罢免潜在陪审员而不作解释。

在此,秘书的律师可以成功挑战四位潜在陪审员中的三位,女商人可能通过她的退休基金股票(Choice A)在公司中拥有经济利益.这名老年妇女表现出明显的偏见,称她并不认为女性员工因歧视性原因被解雇应得到赔偿,因为"人们将一切归咎于性"(Choice C).而此人是被告律师(Choice D)的弟弟.

然而,承包商关于他不想担任陪审团成员,因为他想回去工作的说法表明,没有理由提出质疑。这一答复可能会引起秘书律师的担心,即承包商是否将认真对待陪审团服务,但未能表明他无法公平和公正地服务。

秘书的律师必须使用强制性的质疑来打击承包商,而且由于没有迹象表明质疑的动机是种族、族裔或性别的,因此应当成功。

学习要点：

在联邦民事诉讼中挑选陪审团期间,每一方均可通过(1)因偏见或缺乏公正性而质疑潜在陪审员;(2)因任何理由而质疑潜在陪审员。(种族、族裔或性别除外)

参考资料

• Fed.R. Civ.P.47(陪审团选举程序)。

stem: An administrator brought a federal diversity action on behalf of a deceased woman's estate against a farmer to quiet title to 200 acres of land. The jury returned a verdict for the farmer, and the court entered judgment. The beneficiary of the woman's estate then sued the farmer in federal court contesting ownership of the land. The farmer has moved to dismiss the beneficiary's action on the basis of collateral estoppel (issue preclusion).
stemZh: 一名管理员代表一位已故妇女的遗产，在联邦法院提起基于不同州籍管辖权的诉讼，起诉一名农民以确认对200英亩土地的所有权。陪审团作出对农民有利的裁决，法院随后作出判决。该妇女遗产的受益人随后在联邦法院起诉农民，质疑土地的所有权。农民提出了驳回诉讼动议，理由是基于诉讼既判力（问题预判）（issue preclusion）。
ask: Should the court grant the farmer's motion?
askZh: 法院应否批准农民的驳回动议？

options.en: No, because the beneficiary was not a party to the action between the administrator and the farmer.
options.zh: 不应，因为受益人并非管理员与农民之间诉讼的当事人。

options.en: No, because the claims are not sufficiently identical.
options.zh: 不应，因为这些主张并不足够相同。

options.en: Yes, because the beneficiary's interests were adequately represented in the administrator's action.
options.zh: 应，因为受益人在管理员的诉讼中已得到充分代表。

options.en: Yes, because the farmer was a party to the first action.
options.zh: 应，因为农民是第一次诉讼的当事人。

explanation.en:
Exceptions to rule against nonparty preclusion

Issue preclusion may be asserted against nonparty who:

• agreed to be bound by judgment

• had substantial legal relationship with party (eg, bailor–bailee)

• was adequately represented by party with same interests (eg, class action)

• assumed control over case (eg, insurer–insured)

• attempts to relitigate through proxy or

• was sued under special statutes that bar relitigation & satisfy due process Collateral estoppel (ie, issue preclusion) is a defense that bars the relitigation of issues that were actually litigated, determined, and essential to a valid final judgment. This defense can be asserted against parties to the first action or their privies. But it typically cannot be asserted against a nonparty to the first action because the nonparty would be deprived of the opportunity to fully and fairly litigate his/her claims and defenses.

However, one exception arises when the nonparty's interests were adequately represented in the first action by a party with the same interests. For example, a beneficiary is adequately represented in a suit involving an administrator of an estate since the administrator represents the interests of the estate and the beneficiaries in that suit.

Here, the administrator of the woman's estate brought the first quiet title action against the farmer, and a final judgment was entered in the farmer's favor. The beneficiary of the woman's estate then filed a second quiet title action against the farmer contesting ownership of the same land. Although the beneficiary was not a party to the first action, the administrator adequately represented the beneficiary's interest in the land (Choice A). Therefore, the court should grant the farmer's motion to dismiss the beneficiary's action.

(Choice B) Claim preclusion bars identical claims, while issue preclusion (asserted here) bars subsequent cases that involve the same issues of fact or law as a prior action.

(Choice D) For collateral estoppel to apply, the party against whom it is asserted (here, the beneficiary) must have been a party to the first action—absent an exception. But whether the party asserting collateral estoppel (here, the farmer) was a party to the first action is irrelevant.

Educational objective:

Collateral estoppel bars the relitigation of issues that were actually litigated, determined, and essential to a valid final judgment and can be asserted against a nonparty to the first

action in limited situations—eg, when the nonparty's interests were adequately represented in the first action by a party with the same interests.

References

• Taylor v. Sturgell, 553 U.S. 880, 893–95 (2008) (listing the exceptions to the rule against nonparty preclusion).

• 18A Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 4454 (3rd ed. 2020) (explaining that issue preclusion can be asserted against a nonparty when he/she was adequately represented in the first action).

explanation.zh:
对非当事方排除作出裁决的例外

在下列情况下可对非缔约方提出排除问题:

• 同意受判决的约束

• 与当事方(如保释人-bailee)有实质性的法律关系

• 有相同利益方(如集体诉讼)充分代表

• 控制案件(例如保险人-投保人)

• 试图通过代理或代理重新进行诉讼

• 根据特别法规起诉,禁止重新起诉并满足正当程序 。 禁止反悔(ie, problem preclusion)是阻止对实际诉讼、确定和对有效最后判决至关重要的问题进行重新起诉的辩护。这种抗辩可以针对第一次诉讼的当事方或其私利提出,但一般不能针对第一次诉讼的非缔约国提出,因为非当事方将被剥夺机会,无法充分和公平地对其索赔进行诉讼;辩护。

但是,如果非当事人的利益在具有相同利益的当事人的第一次诉讼中得到充分代表,则会出现一种例外。例如,在涉及破产财产管理人的诉讼案中,受益人得到充分代表,因为管理人代表破产财产和该诉讼案中的受益人的利益。

在这里,女庄园的管理者对农夫提起了第一次静悄悄的产权诉讼,最终判决被写入了有利于农夫的判决.妇女财产的受益人随后对质疑同一土地所有权的农民提起了第二次静态产权诉讼。虽然受益人不是第一项诉讼的当事方,但管理人充分代表了受益人对土地的利益(选择A)。 因此,法院应当批准农民提出的驳回受益人诉讼的动议。

(Choice B) 索赔排除法禁止相同的索赔,而发出排除法则禁止涉及与先前行动相同的事实或法律问题的后续案件。

(选择D) 为了适用附带不容反悔原则,所指控的当事方(这里是受益人)必须是第一项诉讼的当事方,除非有例外。但主张抵押不容反悔的一方(这里是农民)是否是第一项诉讼的当事方则无关紧要。

学习要点：

单方面不容反悔禁止对实际上已经诉讼、确定和对有效终审判决至关重要的问题进行重新诉讼,并且可以对未参加第一种判决的当事方提出抗辩。

在有限情况下的行动——例如,非当事方的利益在具有相同利益的当事方的第一次行动中得到充分代表。

参考资料

• Taylor诉Sturgell案,553 U.S. 880,893–95(2008年)(列出禁止非当事方排除规则的例外情况)。

• 18A Charles Alan Wright 等人,《联邦惯例和程序》§4454(第3版,2020年)(解释在第一次诉讼中有适当代表时可以对非缔约国提出排除的问题)。

stem: A builder brought a federal diversity action against a homeowner for breach of contract, seeking $115,000 in damages. The homeowner answered and counterclaimed for $93,000 in damages for breach of warranty. Four weeks later, when the homeowner had not received any responsive pleading from the builder, the homeowner moved for entry of default and a default judgment on the counterclaim. After the clerk entered default, the homeowner asked the clerk to enter a default judgment.
stemZh: 一名建筑商就合同违约提起联邦不同州籍管辖权诉讼，要求一名房主赔偿 115,000 美元。房主回应并提出反诉，要求因担保违约赔偿 93,000 美元。四周后，当房主尚未收到建筑商的回应答辩时，房主提出申请，要求进入缺席判决并就反诉作出缺席判决。在书记官记录缺席后，房主要求书记官作出缺席判决。
ask: May the clerk enter a default judgment?
askZh: 书记官是否可以作出缺席判决？

options.en: No, because only the court can enter a default judgment under these circumstances.
options.zh: 否，因为在这些情况下，只有法院才能作出缺席判决。

options.en: No, because the builder's time to respond has not expired.
options.zh: 否，因为建筑商的回应期限尚未届满。

options.en: Yes, because the builder has failed to defend himself against the counterclaim.
options.zh: 是，因为建筑商未能就反诉进行答辩。

options.en: Yes, because the damages the homeowner seeks are a sum certain.
options.zh: 是，因为房主要求的赔偿金额是一个确定的数额。

explanation.en:
A default generally occurs when a defendant fails to timely serve an answer to a plaintiff's complaint. However, it can also occur when a plaintiff fails to timely answer a defendant's counterclaim within 21 days after it was served. When this failure is shown to the court clerk, the clerk must enter the default into the record. Since the builder has failed to respond to the homeowner's counterclaim four weeks after it was asserted, the clerk properly entered the builder's default (Choice B).

A default judgment can then be sought from the clerk or the court. The clerk may enter a default judgment only when:

• the claim is for a sum certain or a sum that can be made certain by calculation

• the request for default judgment includes an affidavit establishing the amount due

• the defaulting party failed to appear—ie, did not file a motion or otherwise act before the court—and

• the defaulting party is not legally incompetent or a minor. Here, the homeowner's $93,000 counterclaim is for a sum certain and there is no indication that the builder is legally incompetent or a minor. However, there is no indication that the homeowner included an affidavit in the request, and the builder appeared before the court by filing his complaint. This means that only the court, not the clerk, can enter a default judgment under these circumstances (Choice D).*

*Since the builder has appeared in the action, the court may enter a default judgment if the builder is served with written notice of the homeowner's application for default judgment at least seven days before a hearing on the matter.

(Choice C) The fact that the builder failed to timely defend himself against the homeowner's counterclaim allows the clerk to enter the builder's default into the record. However, the clerk may not enter a default judgment since the homeowner failed to include an affidavit in the request and the builder has appeared in the action.

Educational objective:

A clerk may enter a default judgment when (1) the claim is for a sum certain, (2) the request includes an affidavit establishing the amount due, (3) the defaulting party failed to appear, and (4) the defaulting party is not legally incompetent or a minor. Otherwise, only the court may enter a default judgment.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 55 (default judgments).

• 10A Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 2683 (4th ed. 2020) (explaining when a court clerk may enter a default judgment).

explanation.zh:
被告未能及时向被告提供答复时,通常发生违约。原告的起诉状,但当原告不履行该义务时也可能发生。在被告的反诉送达后21天内及时答复。当向法庭书记员显示这一失败时,书记员必须将默认事项输入记录中. 由于建筑商在声称房屋主的反索赔发生四周后没有回应,因此书记员正确地输入了建筑商的默认事项(Choice B).

然后可向书记员或法院寻求缺席判决。书记员只有在下列情况下才能作出缺席判决:

• 索赔涉及一定数额或可通过计算确定的金额

• 缺席判决请求包括一份确定应付款额的宣誓书

• 违约方没有出庭,即没有向法院提出动议或以其他方式行事,而且

• 违约方不是法律上无行为能力或未成年人,这里,房主93 000美元的反索赔是一笔金额,没有迹象表明建筑商在法律上无行为能力或未成年人。然而,没有迹象表明房主在请求中包括一份宣誓书,建筑商通过提出起诉状出庭,这意味着在这种情况下只有法院,而不是书记员可以作出缺席判决(Choice D)。

* 建筑商在诉讼中出现后,如果建筑商在就该事项举行听证会之前至少7天收到房主提出的违约判决申请的书面通知,法院可以作出违约判决。

(Choice C)建筑商未能及时针对房主的反诉进行辩护的事实,使得书记员能够将建筑商的违约情况输入记录.但是,由于房主在请求中未包括宣誓证词,而且建筑商已出现在诉讼中,因此书记官不得作出违约判决。

学习要点：

书记员可以在下列情况下作出违约判决:(1) 债权为一定金额,(2) 请求书包括一份确定到期金额的宣誓书,(3) 违约方未出庭,(4) 违约方在法律上并非无行为能力或未成年人。否则,只有法院可以作出缺席判决。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 55(违约判决)。

• 10A Charles Alan Wright等人,《联邦惯例和程序》第2683节(第4版,2020年)(解释法院书记官何时可作出缺席判决)。

stem:
A firm incorporated and headquartered in State A sued its competitor from State B in a State A state court. The firm sought $100,000 for the competitor's defamatory statements about the firm's business practices. The complaint did not include a jury demand. Under State A law, a party must request a jury trial in its initial pleading or the right to a jury is waived.

Fifteen days after the competitor served its answer, the competitor removed the case to federal court on the basis of diversity jurisdiction. Ten days after being served with the notice of removal, the firm served a written demand for a jury trial.
stemZh:
一家公司在 A 州注册并设立总部，起诉了来自 B 州的竞争对手，诉讼在 A 州的州法院进行。该公司要求赔偿 100,000 美元，因其商业做法被竞争对手的诽谤性言论损害。起诉状中未包含陪审团要求。根据 A 州法律，当事人必须在最初的诉状中请求陪审团审判，否则放弃陪审团审判的权利。

在竞争对手提交答辩状 15 天后，竞争对手依据不同州籍管辖权将案件移送到联邦法院。在收到移送通知后 10 天，该公司书面提出了陪审团审判的要求。
ask: Which of the following findings will the court likely make regarding the firm's demand?
askZh: 法院很可能就该公司提出陪审团审判要求作出以下哪项认定？

options.en: The firm preserved its right to a jury trial by asserting a legal claim in the complaint.
options.zh: 该公司通过在起诉状中提出法律主张，保留了陪审团审判的权利。

options.en: The firm preserved its right to a jury trial by timely serving its demand for a jury.
options.zh: 该公司通过在规定时间内提出陪审团审判要求，保留了陪审团审判的权利。

options.en: The firm waived its right to a jury trial by failing to assert the demand in state court.
options.zh: 该公司因未在州法院提出陪审团审判要求，而放弃了陪审团审判的权利。

options.en: The firm waived its right to a jury trial by serving the demand more than 14 days after service of the competitor's answer.
options.zh: 该公司因在竞争对手提交答辩状 14 天后才提出陪审团审判要求，而放弃了陪审团审判的权利。

explanation.en:
All civil litigants in federal court have the constitutional right to a jury trial for any legal claim in which the amount in controversy exceeds $20. A party generally preserves this right by demanding a jury trial within 14 days after the last pleading (usually the defendant's answer) is served. However, in an action removed from state to federal court, a party preserves this right by either:

• demanding a jury trial in state court before removal or

• serving a jury trial demand within 14 days after filing or being served with the notice of removal—so long as all necessary pleadings (ie, the complaint and answer) had been served before removal.*

Here, the firm did not demand a jury trial in state court before the competitor removed the case to federal court. However, the complaint and answer were served before removal and the firm timely served its demand for a jury trial 10 days after being served with the competitor's notice of removal. As a result, the federal court will likely find that the firm preserved its jury trial right (Choices C & D).

*If the necessary pleadings were not served before removal, then the general deadline for demanding a jury—ie, 14 days after the last pleading is served—applies.

(Choice A) The firm has the right to a jury trial because its complaint asserted a legal claim—ie, a claim that seeks a monetary remedy—in which the $100,000 amount in controversy far exceeds the $20 threshold. However, the firm may only exercise this right if it made a timely demand.

Educational objective:

In a removal action, a party preserves its right to a jury trial by (1) demanding a jury in state court before removal or (2) serving a jury trial demand within 14 days after filing or being served with the notice of removal, so long as all necessary pleadings had been served before removal.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 81(c)(3) (jury trial demand in removal action).

• 9 Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 2319 (3d ed. 2020) (explaining how to properly demand a jury trial in an action removed from state to federal court).

explanation.zh:
联邦法院的所有民事诉讼人均享有宪法权利,对争议金额超过20美元的任何法律索赔进行陪审团审判。当事方一般通过要求在最后一次答辩(通常是被告的答复)送达后14天内进行陪审团审判来维护这一权利。 但是,在州法院向联邦法院提出的诉讼中,一方通过下列方式维护这一权利:

• 要求州法院在移送前进行陪审团审判;或

• 在提出移送通知或收到移送通知后14天内满足陪审团的审判要求——只要在移送前已送达所有必要的书状(即起诉状和答复)。

在此,律所并未要求竞争者在将案件提交联邦法院之前在州法院进行陪审团审判.然而,起诉状和答复是在移送之前送达的,而且,在送交竞争对手的移送通知10天后,确定及时送达了对陪审团审判的要求。因此,联邦法院很可能认为该公司保留了陪审团审判权(Choices C & D).

* 如果在移送前未送达必要的书状,则要求陪审团审理的一般期限——即在最后一份书状送达后14天——适用。

(Choice A) 该公司有权接受陪审团审判,因为其起诉状主张一项法律要求,即要求金钱补救的要求,其中10万美元的争议金额远远超过20美元的门槛。然而,公司只有在及时提出要求时才能行使这项权利。

学习要点：

在递解行动中,一方通过(1) 要求州法院在递解前先由陪审团审理,或(2) 在提出递解通知或收到递解通知后14天内满足陪审团的审判要求,维护其接受陪审团审判的权利,只要所有必要的书状均已送达。在撤职前已服役。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 81(c)(3)(驱逐行动中的陪审团审判要求)。

• 9 Charles Alan Wright等人,《联邦惯例和程序》第2319条(第3d编,2020年)(解释如何在从州法院到联邦法院的诉讼中适当要求陪审团审判)。

stem:
An individual investor purchased stock through a company's stock offering. When the price of the stock plummeted, the investor sued the company in a state court in State A, claiming that the company's offering materials had fraudulently induced him to purchase the stock and seeking $25,000 in damages.

A university that had purchased the company's stock through the same offering sued the company in federal court in State B, claiming that the offering materials violated federal securities laws and seeking $1 million in damages.

The individual investor's suit proceeded to trial. The state court ruled that the company's offering materials contained false information and awarded the investor a $25,000 judgment. The university immediately moved for partial summary judgment in its federal action against the company, arguing that the state court judgment bound the federal court on the issue of whether the company's offering materials contained false information.

Neither State A nor State B permits nonmutual issue preclusion.
stemZh:
一名个人投资者通过一家公司的股票发行购买了股票。当股票价格暴跌时，该投资者在A 州的州法院起诉该公司，声称该公司发行材料欺诈性地诱使他购买股票，并要求赔偿25,000美元。

一所大学通过同一发行购买了该公司的股票，随后在B 州的联邦法院起诉该公司，声称发行材料违反了联邦证券法，并要求赔偿100万美元。

个人投资者的诉讼进入审判阶段。州法院裁定该公司发行材料包含虚假信息，并作出25,000美元的判决。大学立即在其联邦诉讼中提出部分即决判决动议，认为州法院的判决使联邦法院在该公司发行材料是否包含虚假信息的问题上受约束。

A 州和B 州均不允许非互斥性问题既判力。
ask: Should the court grant the university's motion?
askZh: 法院应否批准大学的动议？

options.en: No, because State A does not permit nonmutual issue preclusion.
options.zh: 否，因为A 州不允许非互斥性问题既判力。

options.en: No, because the federal court sits in a state that does not permit nonmutual issue preclusion.
options.zh: 否，因为联邦法院位于一个不允许非互斥性问题既判力的州。

options.en: Yes, because federal law permits nonmutual issue preclusion.
options.zh: 是，因为联邦法允许非互斥性问题既判力。

options.en: Yes, because the issue of whether the materials contained false information was actually litigated and necessarily decided.
options.zh: 是，因为发行材料是否包含虚假信息的问题已被实际诉讼并必然作出裁决。

explanation.en:
Issue preclusion (ie, collateral estoppel) precludes subsequent litigation of the same issue actually litigated, determined, and necessary to a valid final judgment issued on an earlier claim. There are two types of issue preclusion:

• Mutual – issue preclusion in second action asserted by parties to the first action against other parties to the first action

• Nonmutual – issue preclusion in second action asserted by nonparties to the first action against parties to the first action

The court will look to the court that entered the first judgment to determine which issue-preclusion rule applies to the second action. A judgment entered by a federal court means

federal preclusion law applies,* while a judgment entered by a state court means that state's preclusion law applies.

Here, the state court in State A entered the first judgment, so State A's preclusion law applies to the second action in federal court. State A does not permit nonmutual issue preclusion. As a result, the university (a nonparty to the first action) cannot argue that the state court judgment bound the federal court on the same issue. The federal court should therefore deny the university's motion for partial summary judgment.

*A federal court sitting in diversity will generally apply the preclusion law of the state in which it sits unless the state law is incompatible with federal interests.

(Choice B) A judgment's preclusive effect is determined by the law of the forum that entered the judgment (here, State A)—not the forum where the second court sits (here, State B).

(Choice C) Although federal law permits nonmutual issue preclusion, the State A law prohibiting nonmutual issue preclusion applies.

(Choice D) The issue of whether the company's materials contained false information was actually litigated and necessarily decided in the first action. But since State A does not permit nonmutual issue preclusion, the university cannot assert it in the second action.

Educational objective:

Issue preclusion can be asserted by parties to the first action (mutual) OR by nonparties to the first action (nonmutual) against parties to the first action. If the first action was decided by a state court, then that state's issue-preclusion rule applies.

References

• Allen v. McCurry, 449 U.S. 90, 96 (1980) (stating that federal courts must give the same preclusive effect to state court judgments that courts in the judgment-rendering state would apply).

• 47 Am. Jur. 2d Judgments § 549 (2020) (explaining mutual and nonmutual estoppel).

• 28 U.S.C. § 1738 (full faith and credit statute).

explanation.zh:
问题排除(即附带禁止反悔)排除了随后就同一问题提起的诉讼,而同一问题实际上已经诉讼,已经确定,而且是就先前的一项索赔作出有效最后判决所必需的。

• 相互 -- -- 将第一项行动对第一项行动其他当事方的当事方声称的第二项行动排除在外

• 非相互影响 -- -- 将非缔约方声称的第一项针对第一项行动缔约方的行动列入第二项行动

法院将要求作出第一个判决的法院确定哪些问题排除规则适用于第二项行动。联邦法院的判决意味着:

联邦禁止法适用,* 而州法院的判决意味着该州的禁止法适用。

在此,A州的州法院进入了第一个判决,因此A州的排除法适用于联邦法院的第二个诉讼. A州不允许非相互问题排除.因此,大学(不是第一次诉讼的当事方)不能认为州法院的判决在同一问题上约束了联邦法院,因此联邦法院应该驳回大学提出的部分即决判决的动议.

* 以多样性方式开庭的联邦法院一般将适用其所在地州的禁止法,除非州法与联邦利益不相容。

(选择B)判决的排除效力由进入判决的法院地(这里,A州)的法律确定,而不是第二法院所在地(这里,B州)的法院。

(C选择)虽然联邦法律允许非相互问题排除,但A州禁止非相互问题排除的法律适用.

(Choice D)公司材料中是否包含虚假信息的问题实际上是在第一次诉讼中提出诉讼的,并且必然在第一次诉讼中做出裁决。 但是,由于A州不允许非相互问题排除,因此大学不能在第二次诉讼中断言这一点。

学习要点：

第一次诉讼(相互诉讼)的当事方或第一次诉讼(非相互诉讼)的非当事方可以主张排除问题。 如果第一次诉讼是由州法院裁决的,那么适用州的问题排除规则。

参考资料

• Allen诉McCurry案,449 U.S.90,96(1980)(规定联邦法院必须对州法院的判决给予同样排除效力,以适用于判决移交州的法院)。

• 47 Am. Jur. 2d判决§549(2020年)(解释相互和非相互禁止反悔)。

• 《美国法典》第28篇第1738条(完全信仰和信用法规)。

stem:
A man was charged in a state court in State A with involuntary manslaughter for causing the death of a pedestrian while driving under the influence of alcohol. The jury found the man guilty, and the court entered a judgment of conviction.

The pedestrian's family has now filed a wrongful death action against the man in a federal district court in State B. The family has moved for partial summary judgment, arguing that the state court judgment binds the federal court on the issues of whether the man breached his duty and caused the pedestrian's death.

State A permits nonmutual issue preclusion. However, State B prohibits nonmutual issue preclusion.
stemZh:
一名男子在 A 州的州法院被指控犯有非故意杀人罪，因其在酒后驾车导致一名行人死亡。陪审团认定该男子有罪，法院作出有罪判决。

现在，该行人家庭在 B 州的联邦地区法院对这名男子提起了一项过失致人死亡的民事诉讼。家庭提出了部分即决判决动议，认为州法院的判决对联邦法院在该男子是否违反其义务以及导致行人死亡的问题上具有约束力。

A 州允许非互惠性问题既判力，但 B 州禁止非互惠性问题既判力。
ask: Should the federal court grant the family's motion?
askZh: 联邦法院是否应批准家庭的动议？

options.en: No, because the prior judgment was entered by a state court.
options.zh: 否，因为之前的判决是由州法院作出的。

options.en: No, because the state court action involved a criminal prosecution while the federal court action involves a civil claim.
options.zh: 否，因为州法院的诉讼涉及刑事指控，而联邦法院的诉讼涉及民事索赔。

options.en: Yes, because the issues of whether the man breached his duty and caused the pedestrian's death were actually litigated and necessarily decided in the state court action.
options.zh: 是，因为该男子是否违反其义务以及导致行人死亡的问题已在州法院的诉讼中实际审理并必然作出裁决。

options.en: Yes, because the state court judgment is the law of the case.
options.zh: 是，因为州法院的判决是本案的法律依据。

explanation.en:
Issue preclusion (ie, collateral estoppel) precludes the relitigation of issues that were actually litigated, determined, and necessary to a valid final judgment in a prior civil action OR criminal prosecution (Choice B). There are two types of issue preclusion:

• Mutual – when issue preclusion is asserted by parties to the first action against other parties to the first action

• Nonmutual – when issue preclusion is asserted by nonparties to the first action against parties to the first action

To determine which preclusion rule applies, the second court will look to the law of the forum that entered the first judgment. Here, the State A state court entered judgment in the prior criminal prosecution, so the State B federal court should now apply State A's preclusion law in this wrongful death action. Since State A permits nonmutual issue preclusion, the family (nonparty to the first action) may assert issue preclusion against the man (party to the first action).

In the criminal prosecution, the jury found the man guilty of involuntary manslaughter—ie, an unintentional killing with criminal negligence. This means that the issues of whether the man breached a duty and caused the pedestrian's death were actually litigated and necessarily decided in the first action. Therefore, the federal court should grant the family's motion for partial summary judgment on these issues.*

*The family cannot obtain full summary judgment because it still must prove damages, which were not actually litigated or necessarily determined in the criminal prosecution.

(Choice A) A court must give full faith and credit to federal and state court judgments. Therefore, the fact that the prior judgment was entered by a state court is irrelevant.

(Choice D) The law-of-the-case doctrine prohibits the relitigation of legal issues decided at a previous stage of the same case. This doctrine does not apply here since the criminal prosecution and the wrongful death action are two different cases.

Educational objective:

Issue preclusion bars the relitigation of issues that were actually litigated and necessarily determined by a valid final judgment in a prior civil action or criminal prosecution. The second court will look to the law of the forum that entered the first judgment to determine if mutual or nonmutual issue preclusion applies in the subsequent action.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Judgments § 85 (Am. Law Inst. 1982) (explaining the effect of a criminal judgment in a subsequent civil action).

• 18B Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 4474 (2d ed. 2020) (describing how nonparties to a criminal prosecution may assert issue preclusion against a party to the prosecution in a later civil action).

explanation.zh:
问题排除(即附带禁止反言)排除了对在前一次民事诉讼或刑事诉讼中实际诉讼、确定和有效最后判决所必需的问题(Choice B)的重新诉讼。

• 相互 -- -- 当第一次对第一次行动的其他当事方提起诉讼的当事方主张排除问题时

• 非相互影响 -- -- 当第一次行动针对第一次行动当事方的非缔约国主张发布排除令时

为了确定哪些排除规则适用,第二法院将参照作出第一项判决的法院所在地的法律。在此,A州法院在先前的刑事诉讼中做出了判决,因此B州联邦法院现在应该将A州的排除法适用于这一不法死亡诉讼.由于A州允许非相互禁止,因此家庭(不是第一项诉讼的当事方)可以主张对男子(第一项诉讼的当事方)实行禁止。

在刑事诉讼中,陪审团认定此人犯有非自愿过失杀人罪,这是无意的杀人行为,带有刑事过失。这意味着,该男子是否违反义务并造成行人死亡的问题实际上是在第一次诉讼中提出诉讼,并且必然在第一次诉讼中作出决定.因此,联邦法院应批准家庭关于就这些问题作出部分即决判决的动议。

* 家庭不能获得完全的即决判决,因为家庭仍必须证明损害,而损害实际上不是在刑事诉讼中提起诉讼的,也不是一定的。

(选择A)法院必须对联邦和州法院的判决给予充分的信任和肯定,因此,先前的判决是由州法院作出的这一事实无关紧要。

(Choice D)案法学说禁止重审同一案件前一个阶段裁定的法律问题,此学说在此不适用,因为刑事起诉和错误的死亡行动是两个不同的案件.

学习要点：

排除问题妨碍对实际受到诉讼并必然由先前的民事诉讼或刑事诉讼中有效的最后判决决定的问题进行重新诉讼。第二法院将依据作出第一项判决的法院地的法律来确定相互或非相互问题排除是否适用于随后的诉讼。

参考资料

• 重述(第二次)判决第85条(1982年《普通法》)(解释刑事判决在随后民事诉讼中的效力)。

• 18B Charles Alan Wright等人,《联邦惯例和程序》§4474(2d 2020年版)(说明非刑事诉讼当事方如何在以后的民事诉讼中主张对起诉一方作出排除)。

stem:
A writer and a publisher entered into a contract in which the publisher agreed to pay the writer royalties from the sale of her book at a set percentage. At the end of the first year of the contract, the writer received a royalty check for an amount that she believed was lower than agreed.

The writer sued the publisher in state court for breach of contract. The writer claimed that the contract set the royalty percentage at 7%. However, the publisher claimed that the contract only required 4% royalties due to a condition precedent. The jury returned a verdict in favor of the writer, and the court entered a judgment consistent with the verdict.

At the end of the second year of the contract, the writer received another royalty check for an amount she again believed was low. She sued the publisher in a federal court for breaching the same contractual provision. The publisher has asserted the defense of claim preclusion (res judicata) in its answer.
stemZh:
一名作家与一家出版社签订合同，约定出版社按固定比例向她支付图书销售版税。合同第一年末，作家收到一张版税支票，认为金额低于约定。

作家在州法院起诉出版社违约。作家主张合同约定的版税比例为 7%；出版社则主张，由于存在一项先决条件，合同只要求支付 4% 的版税。陪审团作出有利于作家的裁决，法院据此作出判决。

合同第二年末，作家又收到一张她认为金额偏低的版税支票。她在联邦法院起诉出版社违反同一合同条款。出版社在答辩状中提出了请求排除效力（claim preclusion，既判事项原则）的抗辩。
ask: Is the federal court likely to give preclusive effect to the state court judgment?
askZh: 联邦法院是否会给予州法院判决的既判力？

options.en: No, because the judgment was entered by a state court.
options.zh: 否，因为判决是由州法院作出的。

options.en: No, because the second action involves a different claim.
options.zh: 否，因为第二次诉讼涉及不同的主张。

options.en: Yes, because both actions involve identical claims between the same parties.
options.zh: 是，因为两次诉讼涉及相同当事人之间的相同主张。

options.en: Yes, because the first action was actually litigated.
options.zh: 是，因为第一次诉讼实际上已经进行了诉讼。

explanation.en:
Under the doctrine of claim preclusion (ie, res judicata), a valid final judgment on the merits precludes identical parties from relitigating identical claims. Claims are identical if they (1) arise from the same transaction, occurrence, or series thereof and (2) could have been raised in the first action. To determine whether claims arise from the same transaction or occurrence, courts consider the following factors:

• whether the facts are related in time, space, origin, or motivation

• whether the facts form a convenient trial unit and

• whether treatment of the facts as a unit conforms to the parties' expectations or business usage. Here, the state court entered a final judgment in favor of the writer for the publisher's year-one breach of the contract. The writer then sued the publisher in federal court for the

publisher's year-two breach. Although both claims arise from the same contractual provision, the writer's claim for her year-two royalties did not exist at the time of the first action. Therefore, the claims are not identical, and the federal court is unlikely to give preclusive effect to the state court judgment (Choice C).

(Choice A) The fact that a state court entered the judgment in the first action is irrelevant because all courts must give full faith and credit to state court judgments.

(Choice D) Claim preclusion applies even if the first action was not actually litigated (eg, when a default judgment was entered). In contrast, the related doctrine of issue preclusion (ie, collateral estoppel) applies only when issues that were actually litigated, determined, and essential to a valid final judgment are raised in a subsequent action.

Educational objective:

Claim preclusion (ie, res judicata) provides that a valid final judgment on the merits precludes identical parties from relitigating identical claims. Claims are identical if they (1) arise from the same transaction, occurrence, or series thereof and (2) could have been raised in the first action.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Judgments § 24 (Am. Law Inst. 1982) (defining identical claims).

• Lawlor v. Nat'l Screen Serv. Corp., 349 U.S. 322, 327–28 (1955) (holding that claim preclusion only applies to claims that existed at the time of the first action).

explanation.zh:
根据排除索赔原则(即既判案件),对案情作出有效的最后判决,使相同当事方无法重新提出相同的索赔。如果索赔(1)产生于同一交易、发生或一系列交易,则索赔相同;(2) 可在第一项行动中提出。为了确定索赔是否来自同一交易或事件,法院考虑:下列因素:

• 事实是否与时间、空间、起源或动机相关

• 事实是否构成一个方便的审判单位;

· 事实作为一个单位的处理是否符合当事人的期望或商业习惯,在这方面,州法院作出了有利于出版商第一年违反合同的作者的最后判决。编剧随后在联邦法院起诉出版商

虽然这两项索赔都是由同一合同条款引起的,但作者对她的第二年版税的索赔在第一次诉讼时并不存在。因此,索赔要求并不完全相同,联邦法院不太可能对州法院的判决(Choice C)给予排除性效力.

(Choice A) 州法院在第一次诉讼中进入判决的事实无关紧要,因为所有法院都必须对州法院的判决给予充分的信任和信用.

(Choice D)即使第一项诉讼实际上没有受到诉讼(例如,在作出缺省判决时),也适用索赔排除。与此相反,有关问题排除(即附带禁止反言)的学说只有在在随后的诉讼中提出实际诉讼、确定的问题以及对有效的最后判决至关重要的问题时才适用。

学习要点：

排除索赔(即已决案件)规定,对案情作出有效的最后判决,使相同当事方无法对相同的索赔要求重新提起诉讼。如果索赔(1)产生于同一交易、发生或一系列交易,而(2)可能在第一项行动中提出,则索赔是相同的。

参考资料

• 重述(第二次)判决§24(1982年《美国法律》)(界定相同的索赔)。

· Lawlor诉Nat'l Screen Serv. Corp.,349 U.S. 322, 327–28(1955年)(认为排除索赔仅适用于第一次诉讼时存在的索赔)。

stem:
A patient domiciled in State A sued a surgeon domiciled in State B in a federal court in State A, alleging claims for malpractice. The surgeon moved to dismiss the action for lack of personal jurisdiction. The court denied the motion and set discovery cutoff and trial dates.

The surgeon has appealed the denial of the motion.
stemZh:
一名患者在 A 州有住所，向在 A 州联邦法院提起诉讼，起诉一名在 B 州有住所的外科医生，指控其存在医疗过失。外科医生提出了驳回诉讼动议，声称法院缺乏属人管辖权。法院驳回了该动议，并设定了证据开示截止日期和庭审日期。

外科医生对法院驳回动议的决定提出上诉。
ask: Should the appellate court hear the merits of the surgeon's appeal?
askZh: 上诉法院应当审理外科医生上诉的实质问题吗？

options.en: No, because the appellate court lacks jurisdiction over the appeal.
options.zh: 否，因为上诉法院对上诉没有管辖权。

options.en: No, because the district court's decision on jurisdiction is final.
options.zh: 否，因为地区法院对管辖权的决定是最终的。

options.en: Yes, because a contrary appellate decision could terminate the action.
options.zh: 是，因为上诉法院的相反决定可能会终止该诉讼。

options.en: Yes, because the surgeon's personal-jurisdiction challenge raises a constitutional question.
options.zh: 是，因为外科医生的属人管辖权异议提出了一个宪法问题。

explanation.en:
Final-judgment rule

Rule Appeal only allowed after final judgment

• If multiple claims/parties, final judgment as to fewer than all claims/parties appropriate if court expressly determines no justifiable reason for delay Exceptions Interlocutory appeals* concerning:

• Injunction (grant/denial)

• Certification by district court

• Class action certification

• Appointment of receiver

• Admiralty case

• Collateral-order doctrine

• Bankruptcy cases (certain orders)

• Mandamus (petition for writ)

• Patent infringement order (only accounting left) Mnemonic: In Certain Circumstances, An Appeal Can Be Made Prematurely

*Appeal from trial court ruling that occurs before entry of final judgment.

*Appeal from trial court ruling that occurs before entry of final judgment

28 U.S.C. § 1291 limits appellate jurisdiction to appeals from a final judgment—ie, a decision that fully resolves a dispute on the merits and leaves nothing for the district court to do but enforce the judgment. This rule promotes judicial efficiency and avoids undue delay caused by multiple appeals. Therefore, absent specific exceptions, an appeal must be dismissed for lack of jurisdiction if no final judgment has been entered.

Here, the district court's denial of the surgeon's motion to dismiss for lack of personal jurisdiction is not a final judgment. That is because the denial did not fully resolve the dispute by deciding whether the surgeon is liable for malpractice. And since a denial of this motion is not excepted from the final-judgment rule, the appellate court lacks jurisdiction to hear the merits of the surgeon's appeal.

(Choice B) The district court's decision on jurisdiction is not final and can be challenged in an appeal from a final judgment.

(Choice C) Although a contrary appellate decision—ie, a decision that personal jurisdiction is lacking—could terminate the action, an appeal at this stage is premature because the district court has not issued a final judgment.

(Choice D) The fact that the surgeon's personal-jurisdiction challenge raises a constitutional question does not give the appellate court jurisdiction to hear the appeal at this time. Instead, the appellate court will decide all contested issues—constitutional and otherwise—in one appeal after a final judgment is issued.

Educational objective:

The final-judgment rule bars federal appellate courts from hearing an appeal until the district court has entered a final judgment—ie, a decision that fully resolves the dispute on the merits and simply requires the district court to enforce the judgment.

References

• 28 U.S.C. § 1291 (final-judgment rule).

• Lauro Lines s.r.l. v. Chasser, 490 U.S. 495, 497 (1989) (defining final judgment).

explanation.zh:
最后裁定规则

只有在最后判决后才允许上诉

• 如果多项债权/当事方,如果法院明确认定无正当理由拖延,则对以下事项作出最后判决:

• 禁止(赠款/拒绝)

• 地区法院的认证

• 类别行动认证

• 指定接收人

• 海军上将案

• 担保命令理论

• 破产案件(某些命令)

• 诉状

• 专利侵犯令(仅余会计)在某些情况下,上诉可不成熟

* 对审判法庭在作出最后判决之前作出的裁决提出上诉。

* 在作出最后判决之前对审判法庭的裁决提出上诉

《美国法典》第28篇第1291节将上诉管辖权限于对最后判决的上诉,即完全解决案情争端的裁决,而地方法院只能执行判决。这一规则提高了司法效率,避免了多次上诉造成的不应有的拖延,因此,如果没有具体的例外,如果没有最终判决,就必须驳回上诉。

在此,地区法院拒绝外科医生以无属人管辖权为由提出的驳回申请并不是最终判决,因为拒绝申请并没有通过决定外科医生是否应对渎职行为负责来充分解决争议。由于拒绝这项动议并不被排除在最后判决规则之外,上诉法院缺乏审理外科医生上诉案情的管辖权。

(Choice B)地区法院关于管辖权的裁决不是最终裁决,可以在对最终判决的上诉中提出质疑。

尽管一项相反的上诉决定——即缺乏属人管辖权的决定——可以终止诉讼,但目前阶段的上诉还为时过早,因为地区法院尚未作出最后判决。

(Choice D) 外科医生的个人管辖权质疑提出了宪法问题,这一事实并没有赋予上诉法院目前审理上诉的管辖权。相反,上诉法院将在作出最后判决后对一项上诉裁定所有有争议的问题——宪法问题和其他问题。

学习要点：

最后裁决规则禁止联邦上诉法院审理上诉,直到地区法院作出最后判决,即根据案情充分解决争议的裁决,而只是要求地区法院执行判决。

参考资料

• 《美国法典》第28篇第1291条(终审规则)。

• Lauro Lines S.r.l.诉Chasser案,490 U.S. 495,497(1989)(确定最后判决)。

stem:
A 50-year-old man was set to marry a 25-year-old woman when the woman called off the wedding two days before it was set to take place. The man had spent over $200,000 on the lavish ceremony, reception, and honeymoon. He sued the woman in federal court to recover half of this amount.

During voir dire, the man's attorney attempted to use all three of his peremptory challenges to exclude three potential jurors who were 25 years old. The woman's attorney objected. The man's attorney explained that he was striking the three potential jurors based on their age.
stemZh:
一名 50 岁男子原定与一名 25 岁女子结婚，但女子在婚礼举行前两天取消了婚礼。男子已为盛大的婚礼仪式、婚宴和蜜月花费超过 200,000 美元。他在联邦法院起诉女子，请求追回其中一半。

在陪审员遴选阶段，男子的律师试图用尽其三次无需说明理由的回避权，排除三名 25 岁的候选陪审员。女子的律师提出异议。男子的律师解释称，他以这三人的年龄为由要求将其排除。
ask: If the court believes the attorney's justification for the peremptory challenges, will it strike those potential jurors?
askZh: 如果法院相信该律师提出的回避理由，是否会排除这三名候选陪审员？

options.en: No, because civil litigants are entitled to only one peremptory challenge.
options.zh: 否，因为民事诉讼当事人仅被赋予一次 peremptory 挑战的权利。

options.en: No, because the age of the potential jurors does not reveal any bias or lack of impartiality.
options.zh: 否，因为潜在陪审员的年龄并不能显示任何偏见或缺乏公正性。

options.en: Yes, because peremptory challenges can be used for any reason.
options.zh: 是，因为 peremptory 挑战可以基于任何理由使用。

options.en: Yes, because peremptory challenges can be used to strike potential jurors based on their age.
options.zh: 是，因为 peremptory 挑战可以基于潜在陪审员的年龄来排除他们。

explanation.en:
Challenges to potential jurors

(FRCP 47)

Number allowed

Basis for disqualification

Peremptory 3 per party* • Any basis other than race, ethnicity, or gender

• No explanation needed For cause Unlimited • For bias or lack of impartiality—eg: – relationship with party – financial stake in party FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

*When a civil action involves multiple plaintiffs or defendants, the court may grant each side (1) three peremptory challenges or (2) more than three peremptory challenges that each side's parties exercise separately or jointly. Voir dire is the stage in a jury trial when the court, parties, or attorneys question potential jurors about their backgrounds and potential biases. During this process, each party may strike potential jurors from serving on the jury through:

• three peremptory challenges, which can be used to strike a potential juror for any reason (other than race, ethnicity, or gender) without explanation (Choices A & C) and

• unlimited challenges for cause, which can be used to strike a potential juror for bias or lack of impartiality (Choice B).

Here, the man's attorney attempted to use all of his peremptory challenges to exclude three potential jurors. He explained that he was striking the jurors based on their age. If the court believes this justification—ie, there is no indication that the challenges are based on race, ethnicity, or gender—then the court will strike the three potential jurors.

Educational objective:

During jury selection, each party is entitled to (1) three peremptory challenges to strike a potential juror for any reason (other than race, ethnicity, gender) without an explanation and (2) an unlimited number of challenges for cause to strike a potential juror for bias or lack of impartiality.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 47(b) (peremptory challenges).

• 28 U.S.C. § 1870 (jury challenges).

• J.E.B. v. Alabama, 511 U.S. 127, 143 (1994) (explaining that peremptory challenges may be used to remove potential jurors based on their age).

explanation.zh:
对潜在陪审员的挑战

(FRCP47)

允许的数量

取消资格的依据

• 种族、族裔或性别以外的任何理由

• 对于偏见或缺乏公正性的原因,不需要作出解释——例如:– 与政党的关系 – 政党FRCP = 联邦民事诉讼规则中的经济利益.

* 当一项民事诉讼涉及多个原告或被告时,法院可准许每一方(1)三项无因回避或(2)每一方当事人单独或共同提出的三项以上无因回避。当法庭、当事方或律师质疑陪审员关于他们的背景 和潜在的偏见。在这一过程中,每一方均可通过下列方式罢免潜在的陪审员:

• 三项强制性挑战,可用于以任何理由(种族、族裔或性别除外)不作解释(Choices A & C)打击潜在陪审员;

• 无限制的因果挑战,可用来打击有偏见或缺乏公正性的潜在陪审员(Choice B)。

在此,该男子的律师试图利用他所有的无因回避来排除三名潜在的陪审员,他解释说,他正根据陪审员的年龄来打他们.如果法院相信这一理由——即没有迹象表明质疑是基于种族、族裔或性别——则法院将打击三名潜在的陪审员。

学习要点：

在陪审团遴选期间,每一方均有权(1) 以任何理由(种族、族裔、性别除外)对罢免潜在陪审员提出3项无因回避,但没有解释;(2) 以理由罢免潜在陪审员的无限质疑。偏见或缺乏公正性。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P.47(b)(强制性挑战)。

• 28 U.S.C.§1870(审判挑战)。

• J.E.B.诉阿拉巴马州,511 U.S. 127, 143(1994年)(解释可使用强制性挑战来根据年龄排除潜在的陪审员)。

stem:
A man who owned riverfront property sued an upstream factory in federal court for polluting the river, seeking injunctive relief and $250,000 in damages. The factory moved for summary judgment on the ground of res judicata (claim preclusion), arguing that the man had sued on and lost an identical claim one year before. The court denied the motion.

The factory has asked its attorney's advice as to whether it may appeal the court's denial of summary judgment in order to avoid an expensive trial.
stemZh:
一名男子拥有河岸地产，起诉上游工厂在联邦法院因污染河流而承担责任，要求禁令救济和 250,000 美元的损害赔偿。工厂以既判力（主张权排除）为由提出即决判决动议，认为该男子一年前曾就相同主张提起诉讼并败诉。法院驳回了该动议。

工厂已向其律师咨询，询问是否可以就法院驳回即决判决的决定提出上诉，以避免昂贵的审判。
ask: What advice should the attorney give?
askZh: 律师应给予什么建议？

options.en: The factory may appeal if the appellate court finds that the case involves a controlling question of law upon which the courts are divided.
options.zh: 如果上诉法院认定本案涉及法院之间存在分歧的法律问题，工厂可以提出上诉。

options.en: The factory may appeal if the trial court certifies that there is no just reason for delay.
options.zh: 如果审判法院认定没有正当理由拖延，工厂可以提出上诉。

options.en: The factory may not appeal because the denial of summary judgment is a collateral order.
options.zh: 工厂不能提出上诉，因为即决判决的驳回属于附带性裁定。

options.en: The factory may not appeal until after a trial on the merits or other disposition resulting in a final judgment.
options.zh: 工厂必须在实质审理或其他导致最终判决后才能提出上诉。

explanation.en:
Final-judgment rule

Rule Appeal only allowed after final judgment

• If multiple claims/parties, final judgment as to fewer than all claims/parties appropriate if court expressly determines no justifiable reason for delay Exceptions Interlocutory appeals* concerning:

• Injunction (grant/denial)

• Certification by district court

• Class action certification

• Appointment of receiver

• Admiralty case

• Collateral-order doctrine

• Bankruptcy cases (certain orders)

• Mandamus (petition for writ)

• Patent infringement order (only accounting left) Mnemonic: In Certain Circumstances, An Appeal Can Be Made Prematurely

*Appeal from trial court ruling that occurs before entry of final judgment.

*Appeal from trial court ruling that occurs before entry of final judgment

A party may only appeal, absent limited exceptions, after the district court has entered a final judgment—ie, a decision that fully resolves a dispute on the merits and leaves nothing for the court to do but enforce the judgment. This rule is designed to promote judicial efficiency and avoid unnecessary delays in the litigation process.

Here, the court's denial of the factory's motion for summary judgment based on claim preclusion is not a final judgment. That is because the denial did not fully resolve the dispute on its merits by deciding whether the factory polluted the river and what relief (if any) to award the man. Therefore, the attorney should advise the factory that it may not appeal until after a trial on the merits or other disposition resulting in a final judgment.

(Choice A) A district court can certify (ie, approve) an issue for appeal before a final judgment when (1) there is a substantial difference of opinion on the controlling question of law and (2) an appeal will materially advance the ultimate termination of litigation. Only then will an appellate court decide whether to hear the appeal.

(Choice B) When an action involves multiple claims or parties (not seen here), a district court may enter final judgment as to fewer than all claims or parties if it expressly

determines that there is no just reason for delay. A party may then appeal that judgment without waiting for a final judgment to be entered on all claims in the action.

(Choice C) The denial of summary judgment is not a collateral order—ie, a district court order that conclusively resolves an important issue that is (1) separate from the merits of the claim and (2) effectively unreviewable on appeal from a final judgment. That is because an appellate court can easily (and routinely does) review the denial of summary judgment on appeal.

Educational objective:

Absent limited exceptions, an appellate court can only hear appeals from a final judgment— ie, a decision that fully resolves a dispute on the merits.

References

• 28 U.S.C. § 1291 (final-judgment rule).

• Lauro Lines s.r.l. v. Chasser, 490 U.S. 495, 497 (1989) (defining final judgment).

• Ortiz v. Jordan, 562 U.S. 180, 184 (2011) (explaining that almost all orders denying summary judgment are interlocutory orders that do not qualify as final judgments subject to immediate appeal).
