explanation.zh:
最后裁定规则

只有在最后判决后才允许上诉

• 如果多项债权/当事方,如果法院明确认定无正当理由拖延,则对以下事项作出最后判决:

• 禁止(赠款/拒绝)

• 地区法院的认证

• 类别行动认证

• 指定接收人

• 海军上将案

• 担保命令理论

• 破产案件(某些命令)

• 诉状

• 专利侵犯令(仅余会计)在某些情况下,上诉可不成熟

* 对审判法庭在作出最后判决之前作出的裁决提出上诉。

* 在作出最后判决之前对审判法庭的裁决提出上诉

当事方只有在地区法院作出最后判决之后,才能在没有有限例外的情况下提出上诉,即作出完全解决案情纠纷的裁决,法院只能执行判决。这一规则旨在提高司法效率,避免诉讼程序出现不必要的拖延。

在此,法院拒绝工厂基于排除索赔请求而提出的即决判决动议,并不是最终判决.这是因为,通过决定工厂是否污染了河流以及给予此人什么补救(如果有的话),拒绝没有根据案情充分解决争端。因此,律师应通知工厂,在对案情进行审判或作出最后判决的其他处置之后,方可上诉。

(Choice A)当(1)对控制性法律问题存在实质性的意见分歧,(2)上诉将实质性地推动最终结束诉讼时,地区法院可以证明(e,批准)上诉的问题。只有这样,上诉法院才能决定是否审理上诉。

(选择B) 当诉讼涉及多项债权或当事人(此处未见)时,区法院可作出最终判决,如果明确判决少于所有债权或当事人。

然后,当事一方可以就判决提出上诉,而不必等待对诉讼的所有要求作出最后判决。

(选择C) 拒绝即决判决并不是一项附带命令——即区法院命令,它最终解决了一个重要的问题,即(1) 与要求的案情分开,(2) 在对最后判决提出上诉时实际上无法审查。这是因为上诉法院可以(并经常)轻而易举地审查拒绝对上诉的即决判决。

学习要点：

在没有有限例外的情况下,上诉法院只能审理对最后判决的上诉,即根据案情充分解决争端的裁决。

参考资料

• 《美国法典》第28篇第1291条(终审规则)。

• Lauro Lines S.r.l.诉Chasser案,490 U.S. 495,497(1989)(确定最后判决)。

• Ortiz诉Jordan, 562 U.S.180, 184 (2011)(解释几乎所有拒绝即决判决的命令都是中间命令,不能作为可立即上诉的最后判决)。

stem:
The parents of a deceased teenager sued the manufacturer of an energy drink in federal court, alleging that their teenager had a heart attack and died after ingesting the energy drink. The parents further alleged that the manufacturer knew the drink could result in a heart attack but failed to disclose this risk in violation of federal law. The manufacturer denied the parents' allegations. Both parties demanded a jury trial.

At the conclusion of the trial, the judge instructed the jury to provide written answers to specific questions about each factual issue but to refrain from finding in favor of a party. The manufacturer objected to this procedure.
stemZh:
一名少年去世的父母在美国联邦法院起诉了能量饮料的制造商，指控他们的少年在饮用该能量饮料后发生心脏病并死亡。父母还进一步指控制造商知道该饮料可能导致心脏病，但未披露这一风险，违反了联邦法律。制造商否认了父母的指控。双方均要求陪审团审判。

在审判结束后，法官指示陪审团就每个事实问题提供书面答案，但不要为任何一方作出支持性裁决。制造商对此程序提出异议。
ask: Is this procedure permissible?
askZh: 这种程序是否允许？

options.en: No, because the jury must apply the law to its findings of fact and return a verdict in favor of a party.
options.zh: 否，因为陪审团必须将其法律适用与事实认定相结合，并作出支持某一方的裁决。

options.en: No, because this procedure violates the manufacturer's constitutional right to a jury trial.
options.zh: 否，因为这种程序侵犯了制造商的宪法性陪审团审判权利。

options.en: Yes, because the judge may apply the law and enter a judgment consistent with the jury's answers.
options.zh: 是，因为法官可以适用法律并根据陪审团的答案作出裁决。

options.en: Yes, because the judge may ask for the jury's advice on factual issues before deciding the case herself.
options.zh: 是，因为法官可以在自行决定案件前向陪审团征询事实问题的意见。

explanation.en:
Types of jury verdicts

(FRCP 49)

General verdict • Jury finds in favor of, and awards any damages to, particular party

• No statement on jury's findings of fact General verdict with answers

• Jury finds in favor of, and awards any damages to, particular party

• Jury answers questions on specified factual issues Special verdict • Jury answers questions on specified factual issues

• Judge applies law to jury's answers & enters appropriate judgment FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure

At the conclusion of a jury trial, the jury will issue a verdict that determines the factual issues in the case. There are three types of verdicts—general verdicts (most common), general verdicts with answers, and special verdicts—and the judge has complete discretion to choose which verdict to use. A special verdict requires that:

• the jury answer questions in writing on specified factual issues and

• the judge apply the law and enter a judgment consistent with those answers. The purposes of a special verdict are to prevent the jury's view of the correct result from interfering with its factual findings and to identify the bases for the jury's decision. Therefore, the judge permissibly instructed the jury to provide written answers to specific questions about each factual issue but to refrain from finding in favor of a party

(Choice A).

(Choice B) The Seventh Amendment guarantees civil litigants the right to a jury trial when the amount in controversy exceeds $20 and a party makes a timely jury trial demand. A special verdict does not violate this constitutional right because the jury still determines the factual issues in the case.

(Choice D) The judge cannot ask for the jury's advice on factual issues before deciding the case because the jury is the decider of fact. Once the jury has decided the issues of fact, the judge may apply the law and enter an appropriate judgment.

Educational objective:

In a jury trial, the judge has complete discretion to decide which verdict to use—general verdict, general verdict with answers, or special verdict. A special verdict requires that (1)

the jury answer questions in writing on specified factual issues and (2) the judge apply the law and enter a judgment consistent with those answers.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 49(a) (special verdicts).

explanation.zh:
陪审团判决的类型

(FRCP49)

• 陪审团裁定对特定当事方有利并判给任何损失

• 没有说明陪审团对事实的调查结果

• 陪审团裁定对特定当事方有利并判给任何损害赔偿

• 陪审团回答关于特定事实问题的问题 特别判决 陪审团回答关于特定事实问题的问题

• 法官对陪审团的答复适用法律,并作出适当的判决

在陪审团审判结束时,陪审团将作出裁定,确定案件的事实问题。判决有三种——一般判决(最常见的判决)、附有答案的一般判决和特别判决——法官有选择使用哪种判决的完全酌处权。

• 陪审团以书面形式回答关于具体事实问题的问题;

· 法官适用法律并作出与这些答复一致的判决,特别判决的目的是防止陪审团对正确结果的看法干扰其事实结论,并确定陪审团决定的依据。因此,法官允许地指示陪审团对有关每个事实问题的具体问题作出书面答复,但不得作出有利于一方的裁决。

(Choice A) (英语).

(Choice B) 第七修正案保障在争议金额超过20美元,且一方提出及时的陪审团审判要求时,民事诉讼人有权获得陪审团审判.特别判决并不违反这一宪法权利,因为陪审团仍然决定案件的事实问题。

(Choice D)法官不能在裁决案件前征求陪审团对事实问题的意见,因为陪审团是事实的决定者,一旦陪审团对事实问题作出裁决,法官可以适用法律,并做出适当的判决.

学习要点：

在陪审团审判中,法官有完全的自由裁量权,可以决定采用哪种判决——一般判决、附有答案的一般判决或特别判决。

陪审团就具体的事实问题书面答复问题,(2) 法官适用法律,并作出与这些答复一致的判决。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 49(a)(特别判决)。

stem: A patent holder brought a patent infringement action, which involves triable jury issues, in federal court against a licensee of the patent. The patent holder believed that a jury would be more sympathetic to his claims than a judge and asked his lawyer to obtain a jury trial.
stemZh: 一名专利权人在美国联邦法院提起了一项专利侵权诉讼，该诉讼涉及可由陪审团裁决的争议问题，起诉对象是该专利的被许可人。专利权人认为陪审团对其主张会比法官更加同情，因此要求他的律师获取陪审团审判的权利。
ask: What should the lawyer do to secure the patent holder's right to a jury trial?
askZh: 律师应采取什么措施以确保专利权人获得陪审团审判的权利？

options.en: File and serve a complaint that includes a jury trial demand.
options.zh: 提交并送达一份包含陪审团审判要求的起诉状。

options.en: File and serve a jury trial demand at the close of discovery.
options.zh: 在证据开示结束后提交并送达陪审团审判要求。

options.en: File and serve a jury trial demand within 30 days after the close of the pleadings.
options.zh: 在诉状终结后30天内提交并送达陪审团审判要求。

options.en: Make a jury trial demand at the initial pretrial conference.
options.zh: 在初次预审会议中提出陪审团审判要求。

explanation.en:
Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 38, a party may demand a jury trial on any triable jury issue by:

• serving the other parties with a written jury trial demand no later than 14 days after the last pleading directed to that issue is served and

• filing the jury trial demand with the court within a reasonable time after service of the demand.*

The demand can be included in a pleading or set forth in a separate document. And the right to a jury trial is waived if the above requirements are not met. The lawyer here can therefore secure a jury trial by including the jury trial demand in a filed and served complaint—ie, the pleading that starts a case.

*A proper jury trial demand may be withdrawn later, but only with the other parties' consent.

(Choice B) Discovery is a pretrial phase of a lawsuit during which the parties are compelled to disclose information related to the case. Since this is a lengthy process that often continues more than 14 days after the last pleading is served, a jury trial demand filed and served at the close of discovery would likely be untimely.

(Choice C) A jury trial demand must be served within 14 (not 30) days after the last pleading directed to the triable issue is served. And the demand would be even more untimely if the last pleading concerning the triable issue was served before pleadings closed.

(Choice D) An initial pretrial conference is typically held several weeks after the pleadings have closed, so a jury trial demand made at that conference would likely be untimely.

Educational objective:

A party may secure the right to a jury trial on any triable jury issue by (1) serving the other parties with a written jury trial demand no later than 14 days after the last pleading directed to the issue is served and (2) filing the jury trial demand with the court within a reasonable time after service of the demand.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 38 (jury trial demand).

explanation.zh:
根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第38条,当事一方可通过以下方式要求就任何可审理的陪审团问题进行陪审团审判:

• 最迟在向其他当事方提出书面陪审团审判要求后14天内,向该当事方送达针对该问题的最后一份诉状;

• 在满足要求后的合理时间内向法院提出陪审团审判要求。

这一要求可以包括在一份诉状中,也可以在另一份文件中提出,如果不符合上述要求,则放弃陪审团审判的权利。因此,这里的律师可以确保陪审团审判,将陪审团审判要求纳入已提出和已送达的起诉状,即启动案件的辩护。

* 适当的陪审团审判要求可稍后撤回,但须经其他当事方同意。

(Choice B)证据开示是一个诉讼的预审阶段,诉讼期间当事人被迫披露与案件有关的信息.由于这是一个漫长的过程,往往在最后一次申辩送达后14天多才结束,因此在证据开示结束时提出并送达的陪审团审判要求可能不及时。

(C选择 ) 陪审团审判要求必须在最后一次针对可审理问题的答辩书送达后14天(而不是30天)内送达。 如果在答辩书结案前就可审理问题的最后一次答辩书送达,这一要求将更加不及时。

(Choice D) 最初的预审会议通常在诉状结束后数周举行,因此,在会议上提出的陪审团审判要求可能不及时。

学习要点：

一方可通过以下方式确保就任何可审判的陪审团问题进行陪审团审判的权利:(1) 在针对该问题的最后诉状送达后14天内向其他各方提出书面陪审团审判要求;(2) 向法院提出陪审团审判要求。在满足需求后的合理时间内。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P.38(审判要求)。

stem:
A company incorporated and headquartered in State A sued a plumber domiciled in State B in a federal court in State A, alleging that the plumber had negligently installed pipes in a manner that resulted in $250,000 in damage to the company's headquarters building. In response to the complaint, the plumber filed a motion to dismiss for lack of personal jurisdiction. The court denied the motion. Thereafter, the plumber did not file an answer or any other response to the company's action.

Sixty days after the court's order denying the motion to dismiss, the company asked the clerk to enter the plumber's default, and the clerk did so. The company applied to the court for the entry of a default judgment and notified the plumber three days before the default-judgment hearing. After an ex parte hearing in which the court received evidence on the

damages amount, the court entered a default judgment for the full amount sought. Ten days later, the plumber filed a motion to set aside the default judgment.
stemZh:
一家在 A 州注册并设立总部的公司在美国 A 州联邦法院起诉了一名居住在 B 州的水管工，指控该水管工以疏忽的方式安装管道，导致公司总部建筑损失了 250,000 美元。针对起诉状，该水管工提出了缺乏属人管辖权的驳回诉讼动议。法院驳回了该动议。此后，该水管工未对公司的诉讼提出答辩或任何其他回应。

在法院驳回驳回诉讼动议的 60 天后，公司要求书记官将水管工的缺席认定为默认，书记官执行了该操作。公司向法院申请进入缺席判决，并在缺席判决听证会前三天通知了水管工。在一次未经对方出庭的听证会上，法院收到了有关损害金额的证据，随后法院下达了全额缺席判决。十天后，该水管工提出了撤销缺席判决的动议。
ask: Is the court likely to grant the plumber's motion?
askZh: 法院很可能批准水管工的动议吗？

options.en: No, because the court could fix the amount of damages without hearing the plumber's evidence.
options.zh: 不，因为法院可以在不听取水管工证据的情况下确定损害金额。

options.en: No, because the plumber failed to defend against the company's action for default judgment.
options.zh: 不，因为水管工未能对公司的缺席判决申请进行抗辩。

options.en: Yes, because the plumber was not given adequate notice of the hearing on the company's application for the entry of a default judgment.
options.zh: 是的，因为水管工未获得关于公司申请缺席判决听证会的充分通知。

options.en: Yes, because the State A federal court lacked personal jurisdiction over the plumber as a State B citizen.
options.zh: 是，因为 A 州联邦法院对作为 B 州公民的水管工缺乏属人管辖权。

explanation.en:
Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (FRCP) 55, there are two steps for securing a default judgment—ie, a judgment entered when the defendant has failed to timely serve an answer. The first step requires that the court clerk enter a default on the record once it is shown that the defendant failed to timely serve an answer—due within 14 days after an FRCP 12 motion (eg, challenging personal jurisdiction) is denied.

The second step requires that a default judgment be entered by the clerk or the court. The court may enter a default judgment even if:

• the plaintiff's claim is not for a sum certain

• the defendant is a minor or legally incompetent or

• the defendant has appeared by filing a motion (as seen here) or otherwise acting before the court. But if the defendant has appeared, the defendant must be served with written notice of the plaintiff's application for default judgment at least seven days before a hearing on the matter. Here, the company notified the plumber of its application only three days before the hearing. Therefore, the entry of default judgment was improper, and the plumber's motion to set aside that judgment will likely be granted.

(Choice A) The court could have fixed the amount of damages—which could be made certain by calculation—without hearing the plumber's evidence had he received proper notice.

(Choice B) Although the plumber failed to defend against the company's action for default judgment, he had made an appearance by filing a motion to dismiss. As a result, he was entitled to seven days' notice.

(Choice D) Although the plumber is a State B citizen, the State A federal court had personal jurisdiction because the plumber's minimum contacts with State A—working on the company's building—gave rise to the claim.

Educational objective:

To obtain a default judgment against a defendant who has appeared before the court, the plaintiff must serve the defendant with written notice of the default-judgment application at least seven days before a hearing on the matter.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 55 (default judgments).

explanation.zh:
根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第55条,有两项步骤可以确保一项缺席判决,即在被告未能及时答复时作出的判决。第一步要求法院书记员一旦证明被告未能及时作出答复(应在FRCP 12动议(例如对属人管辖权提出质疑)被拒绝后14天内作出答复,就应记录在案。

第二步要求书记员或法院作出缺席判决。法院可以作出缺席判决,即使:

• 原告的求偿要求不是针对某一数额

• 被告是未成年人或无法律行为能力的人;

• 被告通过向法院提出动议(如此处所示)或以其他方式出庭出庭,但如果被告出庭,必须至少在被告出庭前7天向被告发出书面通知,说明原告提出的缺席判决申请。在此,该公司仅在开庭三天前通知了水管工的申请,因此,列入违约判决是不适当的,水管工提出的撤销该判决的动议很可能获得批准。

(选择A) 如果水管工收到适当的通知,法院本来可以不听取他的证据,就确定损害的数额——可以通过计算确定。

(Choice B)虽然水管工未能针对公司违约判决的诉讼进行辩护,但他还是通过提出撤职动议而出庭,因此他有权获得7天的通知.

虽然水管工是B州公民,但A州联邦法院拥有属人管辖权,因为水管工与A州(负责公司建筑)的最低限度接触导致索赔上升。

学习要点：

为了获得对出庭被告的缺席判决,原告必须在就该事项举行听讯至少七天前向被告发出关于缺席判决申请的书面通知。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 55(违约判决)。

stem:
A man brought a diversity action against a woman in a federal court in State B for conversion. The man claimed that the woman stole several historic artifacts from his home in State A and sold them to a pawn shop in State B.

State A law requires that conversion be proven by a preponderance of the evidence, and its choice-of-law rules for all tort claims provide that a court must apply the law of the state where the injury occurred.

State B law requires that conversion be proven by clear and convincing evidence, and its choice-of-law rules provide that, in conversion actions, a court must apply the law of the state where the property was taken.
stemZh:
一名男子基于不同州籍管辖权，在 B 州联邦法院对一名女子提起侵占动产之诉。他主张该女子从其 A 州的家中偷走数件历史文物，并将其卖给 B 州的一家当铺。

A 州法律要求以优势证据证明侵占动产；其适用于所有侵权请求的法律适用规则规定，法院应适用损害发生地州的法律。

B 州法律要求以清楚且令人信服的证据证明侵占动产；其法律适用规则规定，在侵占动产之诉中，法院应适用财产被取走地州的法律。
ask: What body of law governs the burden of proof in this action?
askZh: 本案的举证责任适用哪一法律体系？

options.en: Federal common law.
options.zh: 联邦普通法。

options.en: Federal statutory law.
options.zh: 联邦成文法。

options.en: State A law.
options.zh: A 州法律。

options.en: State B law.
options.zh: B 州法律。

explanation.en:
Examples of procedural & substantive issues

Procedural

(processes & procedures)

• Filing deadlines

• Court rules & procedures

• Discovery practices

• Rules of evidence Substantive

(legal rights & duties)

• Elements of claim or defense

• Burdens of proof

• Statutes of limitations When a federal court's subject-matter jurisdiction is based on diversity jurisdiction (as seen here), the court must apply federal law to procedural issues and state law to substantive issues. Certain issues are clearly substantive, including the elements of a claim or defense, the statute of limitations, and the applicable burden of proof. As a result, state law—not federal statutory or common law—governs the burden of proof in the man's conversion action against the woman (Choices A & B).

However, the federal court must still determine which state's law governs by applying the choice-of-law rules of the state where the court sits. Here, the federal court sits in State B, so it must apply State B's choice-of-law rules. Those rules provide that a court must apply the law of the state where the property was taken. Since the historic artifacts were allegedly stolen in State A, State A's law governs the burden of proof in this action (Choice D).

Educational objective:

In a federal diversity action, the court must apply federal law to procedural issues and state law to substantive issues. To determine which state's substantive law applies, a federal court must apply the choice-of-law rules of the state where it sits.

References

• Bank of Am. Nat'l Tr. & Sav. Ass'n v. Parnell, 352 U.S. 29, 34 (1956) (holding that a federal court sitting in diversity must apply state law to the substantive issue of burden of proof).

• Klaxon Co. v. Stentor Elec. Mfg. Co., 313 U.S. 487, 496–97 (1941) (explaining that a federal court sitting in diversity must apply the choice-of-law rules of the state in which it sits).

explanation.zh:
程序性和实质性问题实例

程序性

(进程和程序)

• 提交最后期限

• 法院规则和程序

• 证据开示做法

• 证据规则

(法律权利和义务)

• 索赔或辩护要素

• 举证责任

当联邦法院的属事管辖权基于异籍管辖权时(如这里所示),法院必须对程序问题适用联邦法律,对实质性问题适用州法律。某些问题显然具有实质性,包括索赔或抗辩的要素、诉讼时效和适用的举证责任。因此,州法律——而不是联邦成文法或普通法——规定了男子对女性的皈依诉讼的举证责任(Choices A & B)。

然而,联邦法院仍必须通过适用法院所在地州的法律选择规则来确定哪个州的法律管辖。 在这里,联邦法院坐落在B州,因此它必须适用B州的法律选择规则。这些规则规定,法院必须适用被没收财产所在地国的法律,由于据称A州有历史文物被盗,因此A州的法律规定了这一诉讼的举证责任(Choice D)。

学习要点：

在联邦多样性诉讼中,法院必须对程序问题适用联邦法律,对实质性问题适用州法律。 为了确定适用哪个州的实体法,联邦法院必须适用其所在地州的法律选择规则。

参考资料

· Am Bank. Nat'l Tr. & Sav. Ass'n诉Parnell, 352 U.S.29, 34 (1956)(认为以多样性方式开庭的联邦法院必须对举证责任这一实质性问题适用州法律)。

· Klaxon Co.诉Stentor Elec. Mfg Co.,313 U.S. 487, 496-97(1941)(解释以多样性方式开庭的联邦法院必须适用其所在州的法律选择规则)。

stem:
While a consumer was using a product at home in State A, the product malfunctioned. The consumer sued the manufacturer of the product for $100,000 in damages in a federal district court in State A on a products liability claim. The manufacturer wants to transfer venue to a federal district court in State B, the state in which it is incorporated and has its principal place of business. The manufacturer believes that State B's products liability laws afford greater protections to defendants.

State A's choice-of-law rules require the application of State A's products liability laws. State B's choice-of-law rules require the application of State B's products liability laws.
stemZh:
一名消费者在 A 州家中使用某产品时，该产品发生故障。该消费者在 A 州的联邦地区法院对产品的制造商提起诉讼，索赔 100,000 美元，基于产品责任主张。制造商希望将审判地转移至其注册地和主要营业地所在的 B 州的联邦地区法院。制造商认为，B 州的产品责任法律对被告提供更多的保护。

A 州的法律选择规则要求适用 A 州的产品责任法律。B 州的法律选择规则要求适用 B 州的产品责任法律。
ask: Is the manufacturer likely to succeed in having State B's products liability laws apply upon transfer?
askZh: 制造商在转移审判地后，是否有可能成功适用 B 州的产品责任法律？

options.en: No, because State A's products liability laws will apply upon transfer.
options.zh: 否，因为转移后适用 A 州的产品责任法律。

options.en: No, because State B is an improper venue.
options.zh: 否，因为 B 州是不适当的审判地。

options.en: Yes, because State A is an improper venue.
options.zh: 是，因为 A 州是不适当的审判地。

options.en: Yes, because State B's choice-of-law rules require the application of State B's products liability laws.
options.zh: 是，因为 B 州的法律选择规则要求适用 B 州的产品责任法律。

explanation.en:
A federal court with proper venue can transfer a case to another federal judicial district where venue is proper for the convenience of the parties and witnesses and in the interest of justice. Proper venue exists where:

• any defendant resides, so long as all defendants reside in the same state

• a substantial portion of the events occurred or the property at issue is located or

• any defendant is subject to the court's personal jurisdiction—but only if neither of the above provisions applies.

Here, venue is proper in State A because the product malfunction and injury (substantial events) occurred there (Choice C). Venue is also proper in State B since the manufacturer is incorporated and has its principal place of business (residence) there (Choice B). As a result, the case may be transferred from the federal district court in State A to the federal district court in State B—so long as it is convenient for the parties and witnesses and in the interest of justice.

Upon transfer, the receiving court must apply the appropriate choice-of-law rules to determine which state's substantive laws govern the action. The original court's choice-of-law rules apply when (1) proper venue existed in the original court and (2) subject-matter jurisdiction arises under diversity jurisdiction. Diversity jurisdiction exists when

the opposing parties are citizens of different states and the amount in controversy exceeds $75,000.

Here, the consumer's products liability action arises under diversity jurisdiction because she is a citizen of State A while the manufacturer is a citizen of State B, and the amount in controversy is $100,000. And since venue was proper in the State A federal district court, State A's choice-of-law rules apply. Under these rules, State A's products liability laws govern the action, so the manufacturer is unlikely to succeed in having State B's products liability laws apply upon transfer (Choice D).

Educational objective:

When venue is transferred between federal districts, the original court's choice-of-law rules apply when (1) proper venue existed in the original court and (2) subject-matter jurisdiction arises under diversity jurisdiction.

References

• Ferens v. John Deere Co., 494 U.S. 516, 531 (1990) (holding that the original court's choice-of-law rules apply upon transfer when venue was proper in the original court and the action arises under diversity jurisdiction).

explanation.zh:
具有适当审判地的联邦法院可将案件移交另一联邦司法区,其地点适合当事方和证人,并有利于司法公正。

• 任何被告居住,只要所有被告居住在同一国家;

• 大部分事件或所涉财产已发生位于或位于

• 任何被告都受法院的属人管辖权管辖——但只有在上述两项规定都不适用的情况下。

这里,地点在A州是适当的,因为产品故障和伤害(重大事件)发生在那里(C选择)。 地点在B州也是适当的,因为制造商已经注册并在那里拥有其主要营业地(居住地点)(B选择)。因此,只要对当事方和证人方便并符合司法利益,案件可以从A州的联邦地区法院移交给B州的联邦地区法院。

移交后,接收法院必须适用适当的法律选择规则,以确定由哪个州的实体法管辖诉讼。原法院的法律选择规则适用于(1)原法院存在适当审判地,(2)属事项管辖权属于异籍管辖权的情况。

反对党是不同国家的公民,争议金额超过75 000美元。

在此,消费者的产品责任诉讼由多样性管辖,因为她是A州公民,而制造商是B州公民,争议金额是10万美元。由于A州级联邦地区法院的地点是合适的,因此适用A州级法律选择规则。 根据这些规则,A州级产品责任法管辖该诉讼,因此制造商不太可能成功适用B州级产品责任法。转让时(选择D)。

学习要点：

在联邦区之间转移地点时,当(1)原法院存在适当审判地,(2)属事项管辖权属于异籍管辖权时,适用原法院的法律选择规则。

参考资料

• Ferens诉John Deere Co.,494 U.S.516,531(1990)(认为原法院的法律选择规则在移交时适用于原法院的适当地点,而且诉讼是在多样性管辖下发生的)。

stem:
Ten months after surgery in a hospital, a patient who had suffered complications from the surgery sued the surgeon and the hospital in federal court for medical malpractice, seeking $750,000 in damages. Timely personal service was made on the surgeon and the hospital. Three months later, during discovery, the patient learned that the hospital was owned by a national health-care company and moved to amend the complaint to substitute the company for the hospital.

The company moved to dismiss, arguing that the forum state had enacted a one-year statute of limitations for medical malpractice actions and that the company had been served after the limitations period had expired. The company also noted that the state's highest court has interpreted the limitations statute as forbidding any relation back of amendments adding parties in medical malpractice actions. The patient argued that the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure control, and that they allow relation back under the circumstances of this case.
stemZh:
在医院手术后十个月，一名患者因手术并发症起诉了外科医生和医院，指控医疗过失，要求赔偿75万美元。外科医生和医院已及时完成个人送达。三个月后，在证据开示期间，患者了解到医院由一家全国性医疗公司拥有，于是动议修改诉状，将公司作为医院的替代方。

公司提出驳回诉讼动议，认为该州颁布了一项针对医疗过失诉讼的一年诉讼时效，并且公司是在时效期满后被送达的。公司还指出，该州最高法院解释该诉讼时效法禁止在医疗过失诉讼中，任何添加当事人的修改都不得追溯。患者则认为联邦民事诉讼规则适用，并且在本案情形下允许追溯。
ask: Which law governs whether relation back will be permitted under these circumstances?
askZh: 在这些情况下，哪项法律决定是否允许追溯？

options.en: Federal law, because the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure govern over conflicting state rules that deny relation back.
options.zh: 联邦法律，因为联邦民事诉讼规则优先于任何否认追溯的冲突州规则。

options.en: Federal law, because the state law on relation back is common law and federal courts are bound only by state statutory law.
options.zh: 联邦法律，因为州关于追溯的普通法是联邦法院仅受州成文法约束的。

options.en: State law, because statutes of limitation are substantive and state law controls substantive matters.
options.zh: 州法律，因为诉讼时效是实体法，州法律控制实体事项。

options.en: State law, because the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure authorize the use of state law for relation back.
options.zh: 州法律，因为联邦民事诉讼规则授权使用州法律进行追溯。

explanation.en:
When a federal court's subject-matter jurisdiction is based on diversity, the court must apply state law to substantive issues and federal law to procedural issues. When it is unclear whether an issue is substantive or procedural, the court must determine if a valid federal law (ie, federal rule, statute, or constitutional provision) directly addresses the issue. If so, federal-rule analysis provides that the federal law governs over a conflicting state law if the federal law is arguably procedural and does not modify a substantive right.

FRCP 15 directly addresses whether an amended pleading relates back to the date on which the original pleading was filed. This valid rule* is arguably procedural and does not modify a substantive right because it regulates the manner and means of a lawsuit (ie, the filing of a pleading)—not the parties' legal rights (ie, what they may sue for). As a result, this federal rule governs whether the patient's amended complaint substituting the company as the defendant relates back to the date that the original complaint was filed.

*No FRCP has ever been found unconstitutional or invalid. This is likely because the Supreme Court reviews and sends proposed rules to Congress before they are enacted.

(Choice B) Federal courts sitting in diversity are bound by both state statutory law and common law.

(Choice C) Statutes of limitation are substantive issues governed by state law. However, whether an amended pleading relates back to avoid the expiration of a statute of limitations is a procedural issue governed by FRCP 15.

(Choice D) FRCP 15 provides that an amended pleading relates back if the state statute-of-limitations law allows relation back. However, FRCP 15 provides other avenues for relation

back that govern if the state statute of limitations is silent about or prohibits relation back.

Educational objective:

Under federal-rule analysis, a federal court sitting in diversity must apply a valid federal law that is arguably procedural and does not modify a substantive right. FRCP 15 governs the procedural issue of whether an amended pleading relates back to the date that the original pleading was filed.

FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

References

• Hanna v. Plumer, 380 U.S. 460, 471 (1965) (establishing the federal-rule analysis).

• Burlington N. R.R. Co. v. Woods, 480 U.S. 1, 4–5 (1987) (discussing the federal-rule analysis).

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 15 (providing the "relation back" rule for federal court).

explanation.zh:
当联邦法院的属事管辖权基于多样性时,法院必须对实质性问题适用州法,对程序问题适用联邦法。在不清楚某一问题是实质性还是程序性的时,法院必须确定一项有效的联邦法律(即联邦规则、法规或宪法规定)是否直接涉及这一问题。如果是的话,联邦规则分析规定,如果联邦法律可以说是程序性的,并且不修改实质性权利,联邦法律管辖相互冲突的州法律。

FRCP 15直接述及修正的申辩是否与原申辩日期有关。这一有效的规则* 可以说是程序性的,没有修改实质性权利,因为它规定了诉讼(即提出诉状)的方式和手段,而不是当事人的合法权利(即他们可以起诉什么)。因此,这一联邦规则规定,病人修正后的起诉状是否取代被告的公司,追溯到最初的起诉状提出之日。

* 从未发现FRCP违宪或无效,这可能是因为最高法院在颁布规则之前审查并向国会发送拟议规则。

(选择B) 以多样性方式开庭的联邦法院受州成文法和普通法的约束。

(C) 时效法规是受州法律管辖的实质性问题,但是,为避免时效法规失效,修正后的抗辩是否回过头来是一个程序性问题,由FRCP 15.

(Choice D)FRCP 15规定,如果州限制法规允许恢复关系,修正后的抗辩应回溯。

如果国家诉讼时效规定对关系保持沉默或禁止关系恢复,则适用。

学习要点：

根据联邦规则的分析,以多样性方式开庭的联邦法院必须适用一项有效的联邦法律,该法律可以说是程序性的,不会修改实质性权利。FRCP 15对修正的抗辩是否与最初的抗辩日期有关这一程序问题作出了规定。

FRCP = 联邦民事诉讼规则。

参考资料

• Hanna诉Plumer案,380 U.S.460,471(1965)(建立联邦规则分析)。

· Burlington N.R.R.Co.诉Woods案,480 U.S. 1, 4–5 (1987)(讨论联邦规则分析)。

• Fed. R. Civ. P.15(为联邦法院提供"关系回溯"规则).

stem:
A man brought a diversity action against a pharmaceutical company in a federal district court in State A. In his complaint, the man alleged that the company violated State A's false advertising law. The company moved to dismiss the man's action for failure to state a claim on the ground that the false advertising law does not apply to advertising by pharmaceutical companies.

Several lower state courts in State A have recognized the company's defense. The highest state court in State A has never ruled or noted in dicta whether this defense is valid. Based on the lower state courts' decisions, the federal district court ruled that the company's defense applies and granted its motion to dismiss. The man appealed.

State A law permits a federal district court to certify an unsettled question of state substantive law to the state's highest court for clarification.
stemZh:
一名男子在 A 州的联邦地区法院提起了一项基于不同州籍管辖权的诉讼，起诉一家制药公司。在起诉书中，该男子声称该公司违反了 A 州的虚假广告法。该公司提出了驳回诉讼动议，理由是该虚假广告法不适用于制药公司的广告。

A 州的几个下级州法院已承认该公司的抗辩理由。A 州的最高州法院从未裁定或在附带意见中提及该抗辩理由是否有效。根据下级州法院的裁决，联邦地区法院裁定该公司的抗辩理由适用，并批准了其驳回诉讼动议。该男子提出上诉。

A 州法律允许联邦地区法院将一个尚未解决的州实体法问题提交给该州的最高法院进行澄清。
ask: Is the federal appellate court likely to overturn the dismissal?
askZh: 联邦上诉法院是否会很可能推翻驳回决定？

options.en: No, because the federal district court properly relied on the rulings issued by the state's lower courts.
options.zh: 否，因为联邦地区法院正确地依据了州下级法院的裁决。

options.en: No, because the federal district court's decision was not clearly erroneous.
options.zh: 否，因为联邦地区法院的裁决并不明显错误。

options.en: Yes, because the federal district court abused its discretion when it dismissed the action.
options.zh: 是，因为联邦地区法院在驳回诉讼时滥用裁量权。

options.en: Yes, because the federal district court failed to certify the issue to the highest state court in State A.
options.zh: 是，因为联邦地区法院未能将该问题提交给 A 州的最高法院。

explanation.en:
Federal courts sitting in diversity must apply state law to substantive issues, including the validity of a defense (as seen here). A federal court interpreting state substantive law must follow the rulings issued by the state's highest court. If the state's highest court has never definitively ruled on the issue, the federal court must predict how the state's highest court would rule by looking to other sources of law. Priority is given in the following order:

1. dicta in related decisions by the state's highest court 2. rulings issued by the state's lower courts (ie, intermediate appellate courts and trial courts) 3. other persuasive authority (eg, rulings issued in other jurisdictions, restatements, public policy) Here, State A's highest court has never ruled or noted in dicta whether the company's defense is valid, so the federal district court may look to rulings issued by the state's lower courts. Since several lower state courts in State A have recognized the company's defense, the federal district court properly relied on these rulings in dismissing the case. Therefore, the federal appellate court is unlikely to overturn the dismissal.

(Choices B & C) A federal district court's interpretation of a state's substantive law involves a pure legal issue that is subject to the de novo standard of review. A district court's findings of fact in a bench trial are subject to clearly erroneous review, and its discretionary rulings (eg, admissibility of evidence) are subject to abuse of discretion review.

(Choice D) A federal district court may, but is not required to, certify a question of unsettled state law to the state's highest court for clarification if certification is permitted by the state.

Educational objective:

A federal court sitting in diversity must interpret state substantive law pursuant to decisions issued by the state's highest court. When no such decisions exist, the federal court should prioritize other sources of law in this order: (1) dicta by the state's highest court, (2) rulings by the state's lower courts, (3) other persuasive authority.

References

• Stoner v. N.Y. Life Ins. Co., 311 U.S. 464, 467 (1940) (holding that lower state court decisions control in a federal diversity action if the state's highest court has not ruled and no evidence exists that it would rule differently).

• 32A Am. Jur. 2d Federal Courts §§ 351–52 (2020) (explaining that a federal court must determine how a state's highest court would rule on a substantive issue when the issue has not been ruled on by that court).

联邦法院必须运用州法律处理实质性问题,包括辩护的有效性(如本文所示 ) 。 联邦解释州实体法的法院必须遵循州最高法院的裁决。如果该州最高法院从未就该问题作出明确裁决,联邦法院必须预测该州最高法院如何通过寻找其他法律来源来作出裁决。

1. 州最高法院的相关裁决。3. 州下级法院(即中级上诉法院和审判法院)的裁决其他有说服力的权威机构(例如,在其他法域作出的裁决、重申、公共政策)在这方面,A州最高法院从未在公告中裁定或指出公司辩护是否有效,因此联邦地区法院可以参考法院作出的裁决。由于A州的一些下级州法院已经承认了公司的辩护,联邦地区法院在驳回该案时适当地依赖了这些裁决,因此联邦上诉法院不可能推翻驳回。

(Choices B & C) 联邦地区法院对州实体法的解释涉及一个纯粹的法律问题,受重新审查标准的制约.区法院在法庭审判中对事实的调查结果受到明显错误的审查,其酌情裁定(例如证据的可采性)受到滥用酌处权的审查。

(Choice D)如果州允许认证,联邦地区法院可以但不必向州最高法院证明一个尚未解决的州法问题,以便澄清。

学习要点：

以多样性方式开庭的联邦法院必须根据州法院的裁决解释州实体法。在没有此类裁决的情况下,联邦法院应优先处理其他法律来源:(1) 州最高法院的判决,(2) 州下级法院的裁决,(3) 其他有说服力的权威。

参考资料

• Stoner诉N.Y. Life Ins. Co.,311 U.S. 464,467 (1940年)(认为,如果州最高法院尚未作出裁决,而且没有证据表明它将作出不同的裁决,则下级州法院在联邦多样性诉讼中作出控制)。

• 32A Am. Jur. 2d联邦法院,第351至52条(2020年)(解释联邦法院必须确定当一个州最高法院尚未作出裁决时,该州最高法院如何对实质性问题作出裁决)。

stem: A student at a private university sued the university in federal court for negligence after he fell from scaffolding in a university-owned theater building. At trial, after briefing from both parties, the court permitted the jury to hear testimony that there had been several previous accidents in the same building. The jury found for the student, and the university appealed. One of the university's arguments on appeal is that the testimony about the previous accidents should have been excluded as irrelevant and highly prejudicial.
stemZh: 一名私立大学的学生在美国联邦法院起诉该大学，指控其疏忽导致他在大学所有的剧院大楼的脚手架上跌落受伤。在审判中，双方提交了简报后，法院允许陪审团听取证词，称该建筑之前发生过几次事故。陪审团裁定学生胜诉，大学提出上诉。大学在上诉中提出的论点之一是，关于之前事故的证词应当被排除，因为其无关且极具偏见。
ask: Which standard of review applies to this argument?
askZh: 该论点适用哪种审查标准？

options.en: Abuse of discretion.
options.zh: 滥用裁量权。

options.en: Clearly erroneous.
options.zh: 明显错误。

options.en: De novo.
options.zh: 从头开始审查。

options.en: Harmless error.
options.zh: 无害错误。

explanation.en:
Appellate standards of review

Standard Level of review Applicability

De novo • No deference to trial judge's legal determination

• Reverse if reasonably believe trial judge misinterpreted law

Pure legal issues, eg:

• conclusions of law

• content of jury instructions Clear error • Highly deferential to trial judge's factual findings

• Reverse if no reasonable judge would have made this finding

Factual issues in bench trials, eg:

• credibility of witnesses

• factual determinations Substantial evidence

• Highly deferential to jury's factual findings

• Reverse if no reasonable jury would have made this finding

Factual issues in jury trials, eg:

• credibility of witnesses

• jury's verdict Abuse of discretion

• Highly deferential to trial judge's discretionary decisions

• Reverse only if decision was unreasonable/arbitrary

Discretionary rulings by judge, eg:

• grant/denial of new trial

• admissibility of evidence A party can challenge a final judgment on appeal by alleging that the trial court erred. The standard of review used by the appellate court depends on the error alleged. A trial court's discretionary rulings are reviewed for abuse of discretion. Under this highly deferential standard, the trial court's ruling will only be reversed if it was clearly arbitrary or unreasonable. That is because the trial court is best suited to understand the circumstances surrounding the discretionary ruling.

Trial courts regularly make discretionary rulings on the admissibility of evidence—as the trial court did here by allowing the jury to hear testimony regarding the previous accidents. One of the university's arguments is that this testimony should have been

excluded as irrelevant and highly prejudicial. Since this argument challenges the trial court's discretionary ruling, abuse-of-discretion review applies.

(Choice B) The clearly-erroneous standard of review is used to review a trial court's factual findings in a bench trial—not discretionary rulings in a jury trial (as seen here). This standard gives great deference to the trial court, so a factual finding will only be reversed if no reasonable judge would have made such a finding.

(Choice C) An appellate court reviews pure legal issues under a de novo standard of review, which allows the appellate court to decide the issue anew without deferring to the lower court's legal interpretation. Evidentiary rulings are not pure issues of law because the trial court must apply the applicable legal rule to the facts.

(Choice D) Harmless error is a conclusion reached by an appellate court when it determines that an erroneous evidentiary ruling did not affect a party's substantial rights. It is not the standard of review that the appellate court applies to determine whether the evidence was erroneously admitted in the first instance.

Educational objective:

The abuse-of-discretion standard of appellate review applies to a trial court's discretionary rulings—eg, whether to admit evidence. Under this highly deferential standard, the appellate court will only reverse a clearly arbitrary or unreasonable ruling.

References

• Gen. Elec. Co. v. Joiner, 522 U.S. 136, 141 (1997) (stating that "abuse of discretion is the proper standard of review of a district court's evidentiary rulings").

explanation.zh:
上诉复审标准

标准审查级别

• 不尊重审判法官的法律裁定

• 如果有理由相信审判法官误解了法律,则予以扭转

纯法律问题,例如:

• 法律结论

• 陪审团指示的内容高度服从审判法官的事实调查结果

• 如果没有合理的法官作出这一裁定,则推翻

法官审判中的事实问题,例如:

• 证人的可信度

• 实质性证据

• 高度服从陪审团的事实调查结果

• 如果没有合理的陪审团作出这一结论,则推翻

陪审团审判中的事实问题,例如:

• 证人的可信度

• 陪审团的裁决

• 高度服从审判法官的裁量决定

• 只有在决定不合理/任意的情况下才予以撤销

法官酌情作出的裁决,例如:

• 批准/拒绝新的审判

· 证据的可采性 一方可以对上诉的最后判决提出质疑,声称审判法院有错误,上诉法院采用的复审标准取决于所指称的错误。审判法院的裁量性裁决因滥用裁量权而受到复审,根据这种高度推迟的标准,审判法院的裁决只有在明显武断或不合理的情况下才会被推翻。这是因为,审判法庭最适合于了解有关情况。酌情裁定。

审判法院经常就证据的可采性作出裁量裁决——正如审判法院在此所做的那样,允许陪审团听取关于以前事故的证词。

由于这一论点对审判法院的裁量裁决提出了质疑,滥用裁量权的复审适用。

(Choice B) 使用显然不相干的审查标准来审查审判法庭在陪审审判中的事实结论,而不是陪审团审判中的自由裁量裁决(见这里)。这一标准非常尊重审判法院,因此只有在没有合理的法官作出这样的裁决的情况下,事实结论才会被推翻。

(C) 上诉法院根据新的复审标准审查纯法律问题,允许上诉法院在不服从下级法院的法律解释的情况下重新裁决这一问题。证据裁决并非纯粹的法律问题,因为审判法院必须对事实适用适用的法律规则。

(选择D)无害错误是上诉法院在认定错误的证据裁决不影响一方当事人实质性权利时得出的结论。上诉法院申请复审以确定证据在一审中是否被错误采纳不是审查标准。

学习要点：

上诉复审的滥用权标准适用于审判法院的裁量裁决,例如是否采纳证据,根据这种高度顺从的标准,上诉法院只能推翻明显武断或不合理的裁决。

参考资料

• Elec. Co. Gen.诉Joiner,522 U.S.136,141(1997年)(规定“滥用酌处权是对地区法院的证据裁决进行复审的适当标准”)。

stem: A business owner sued a federal agency in federal district court, claiming that the agency's recent regulation requiring businesses to report the race and gender of all employees was unconstitutional. The business owner sought a permanent injunction to prevent the agency from enforcing the regulation. At the end of a bench trial, the district court entered a final judgment in favor of the business owner, granting a permanent injunction. Forty-five days later, the federal agency filed a notice of appeal with the clerk of the district court.
stemZh: 一名企业主在联邦地区法院起诉了一个联邦机构，声称该机构最近的一项规定要求企业报告所有员工的种族和性别是违宪的。该企业主寻求一项永久禁令，以阻止该机构执行该规定。在一次庭上审判结束时，地区法院作出最终判决，支持企业主，批准了永久禁令。45天后，联邦机构向地区法院的书记官提交了上诉通知。
ask: How is the federal appellate court likely to proceed?
askZh: 联邦上诉法院很可能如何处理此案？

options.en: The appellate court will hear the merits of the appeal, because a notice of appeal may be filed within 60 days of the entry of final judgment when a federal agency is a party to the suit.
options.zh: 上诉法院将审理上诉的实质问题，因为当联邦机构是诉讼当事人时，可以在最终判决作出后60天内提交上诉通知。

options.en: The appellate court will hear the merits of the appeal, because the district court's grant of an injunction is appealable under the interlocutory-appeals statute.
options.zh: 上诉法院将审理上诉的实质问题，因为地区法院批准禁令是可上诉的，根据中间上诉法。

options.en: The appellate court will refuse to hear the merits of the appeal and will dismiss it, because a notice of appeal of an injunction must be filed within 10 days of the entry of final judgment.
options.zh: 上诉法院将拒绝审理上诉的实质问题并将其驳回，因为禁令的上诉通知必须在最终判决作出后10天内提交。

options.en: The appellate court will refuse to hear the merits of the appeal and will dismiss it, because the federal agency did not file the notice of appeal with the clerk of the appellate court.
options.zh: 上诉法院将拒绝审理上诉的实质问题并将其驳回，因为联邦机构没有将上诉通知提交给上诉法院的书记官。

explanation.en:
A party may challenge an adverse federal district court ruling, finding, or conclusion by appealing to the federal appellate court encompassing that district. The party must generally file a notice of appeal with the district court clerk within 30 days after the entry of final judgment. However, the time to file a notice of appeal is extended to 60 days if one of the parties is (1) the United States, (2) a federal agency, or (3) a federal officer or employee sued for conduct that relates to government duties.

Here, a federal agency is a party to the suit, so the time to file a notice of appeal is extended to 60 days. This means that the federal agency timely filed its notice of appeal with the clerk of the district court 45 days after final judgment was entered. Therefore, the appellate court will hear the merits of the appeal.

(Choices B & C) An appeal is typically allowed only after a final judgment. However, the interlocutory-appeals statute provides certain exceptions to this final-judgment rule—one of which permits the immediate appeal of a preliminary injunction if the application is made within 10 days of the trial court's ruling. But this statute is inapplicable here because this permanent injunction constitutes a final judgment—not a temporary ruling.

(Choice D) A notice of appeal must be filed with the clerk of the district court—not the appellate court.

Educational objective:

The time to file a notice of appeal with the district court clerk is extended to 60 days after the entry of final judgment if one of the parties is the United States, a federal agency, or a federal officer or employee sued for conduct related to government duties.

References

• 28 U.S.C. § 2107 (timing of appeal).

• Fed. R. App. P. 4 (notice of appeal).

explanation.zh:
一方可向包括该区的联邦上诉法院上诉,对不利联邦地区法院的裁决、裁定或结论提出质疑。当事方一般必须在最后判决开始后30天内向地区法院书记官提交上诉通知。但是,如果当事方之一是(1)美国、(2)联邦机构或(3)联邦官员或雇员因与政府职责有关的行为被起诉,则提出上诉通知的时间延长至60天。

在此,联邦机构是诉讼的当事方,因此提出上诉通知的时间延长至60天,这意味着联邦机构在最后判决下达45天后及时向地区法院书记官提交上诉通知。因此,上诉法院将审理上诉的案情。

(选择B和C)上诉通常只有在最后判决之后才能进行,但中间上诉法规对这一最后判决规则规定了某些例外——其中之一允许在申请是立即对初步禁令提出上诉的情况下立即提出上诉。在审判法院作出裁决后10天内完成。但是,这一法规在此不适用,因为这一永久禁令构成最终禁令。判决,不是临时裁决。

(Choice D) 上诉通知书必须提交地区法院的书记员,而不是上诉法院。

学习要点：

如果当事方之一是美国、联邦机构或联邦官员或雇员因与政府职责有关的行为被起诉,则向地区法院书记官提出上诉通知的时间将延长至最终判决作出后60天。

参考资料

• 《美国法典》第28编第2107条(上诉时间表)。

• Fed. R. App. P.4(上诉通知)。

stem: A construction contractor brought a breach-of-contract claim in federal court against a homeowner who had hired the contractor to build an apartment over an existing garage. The action turned on the scope of the work covered by the contract. The contractor and the homeowner were the only witnesses at the bench trial, and they strongly disagreed about the scope of the work. At the end of the trial, the judge stated findings of fact on the record but never issued a written opinion. Neither party objected to the findings. The judge found in favor of the homeowner, and the contractor appealed.
stemZh: 一名建筑承包商在美国联邦法院提起诉讼，指控一名房主违反合同。该房主曾聘请该承包商在其现有车库上建造公寓。本案的关键在于合同所涵盖的工作范围。承包商和房主是庭审中唯一的证人，他们对工作范围存在严重分歧。庭审结束时，法官在庭审记录中陈述了事实认定，但从未发布书面意见。双方当事人均未对事实认定提出异议。法官裁定支持房主，承包商提起上诉。
ask: Is the appellate court likely to overturn the findings?
askZh: 上诉法院是否会推翻法官的事实认定？

options.en: No, because the appellate court must give due regard to the trial judge's opportunity to determine witness credibility.
options.zh: 不会，因为上诉法院必须充分尊重法官判断证人可信度的机会。

options.en: No, because the contractor failed to object to the findings when the judge stated them in open court.
options.zh: 不会，因为承包商在法官当庭陈述事实认定时未提出异议。

options.en: Yes, because a judge must set forth findings of fact in a written opinion or memorandum of decision.
options.zh: 会，因为法官必须在书面意见或判决书备忘录中陈述事实认定。

options.en: Yes, because there were disputed issues of fact at trial.
options.zh: 会，因为庭审中存在争议的事实问题。

explanation.en:
In a bench trial, the judge acts as both the finder of fact and interpreter of the law. As a result, Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (FRCP) 52 requires that the judge provide those factual findings and legal conclusions on the record (orally or in writing) after the close of evidence. The appellate court can then review the trial judge's decision under the following standards:

• de novo (no deference) – where a judge's conclusions of law (eg, elements of a claim) will be reversed if the appellate court reasonably believes that the judge misinterpreted the applicable law

• clear error (high deference) – where a judge's findings of fact (eg, witness credibility) will be reversed only if they were clearly erroneous such that no reasonable judge would have made them

Under clear-error review, the appellate court must give due regard to the trial judge's opportunity to determine witness credibility because the judge is the one who heard the witnesses' testimony. As a result, the appellate court will likely affirm the trial judge's findings of fact in this suit.

(Choice B) FRCP 52 allows a party to challenge a trial judge's factual findings on appeal even if no objection was made on the record at the bench trial (as seen here). This is an exception to the general rule requiring a party to formally object at trial to preserve an issue for appeal.

(Choice C) In a bench trial, a judge may set forth findings of fact in a written opinion or memorandum of decision but is not required to do so. The findings need only be stated on the record—orally or in writing.

(Choice D) A judge is responsible for resolving disputed issues of fact in a bench trial. Therefore, the presence of such disputes is not a basis to overturn the judge's findings.

Educational objective:

In a bench trial, the judge serves as the finder of fact and the interpreter of law. An appellate court reviews the judge's findings of fact for clear error (high deference) and conclusions of law de novo (no deference).

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 52(a) (findings of fact and conclusions of law).

• United States v. U.S. Gypsum Co., 333 U.S. 364, 394–95 (1948) (explaining clear-error appellate review).

explanation.zh:
在法庭审判中,法官既是事实的发现者,又是法律的解释者,因此,《联邦民事诉讼规则》第52条要求法官在诉讼结束后(口头或书面)提供这些事实调查结果和法律结论。上诉法院然后可以根据以下标准审查审判法官的决定:

• 不服从——如果上诉法院合理地认为法官误解了适用法律,法官的法律结论(例如,申诉的内容)将被推翻

• 明显错误(高度尊重)——法官对事实的调查结果(例如证人的可信度)只有在明显错误以致没有合理的法官会作出这些结论时才会推翻。

根据明确的审查,上诉法院必须适当考虑审判法官确定证人可信度的机会,因为法官是听取证人证词的人。因此,上诉法院可能会确认审判法官对此案的事实调查结果。

(Choice B)FRCP 52允许一方对审判法官在上诉中的事实结论提出质疑,即使法庭审判记录上没有提出异议(见这里)。这是一般规则的一个例外,该一般规则要求当事方在审判时正式反对保留上诉问题。

(C组)在审判法官时,法官可在书面意见或决定备忘录中提出事实调查结果,但不必这样做,其调查结果只需在记录中——或以书面形式加以说明。

(Choice D)法官负责在法庭审判中解决有争议的事实问题,因此,这种争端的存在不是推翻法官调查结果的依据。

学习要点：

在法庭审判中,法官是事实的发现者和法律的解释者,上诉法院对法官的事实调查结果进行审查,以找出明显的错误(高度尊重)和不尊重法律的结论。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 52(a)(事实调查和法律结论)。

• 美国诉美国Gypsum公司案,333 U.S. 364, 394–95(1948)(解释明确的上诉审查)。

stem:
A drunken man confronted a heavyweight boxer in a bar, and a fight ensued. During the melee, the boxer struck the man's head and the man instantly died. The boxer was convicted of manslaughter and sentenced to 15 years in prison.

While the boxer was serving his sentence, the man's spouse brought a wrongful death suit against the boxer in federal court. The spouse sought $10 million in damages for loss of future income and loss of companionship. The boxer was served with process while in prison, but he did not respond. Thirty days later, the spouse asked the clerk to enter the boxer's default, and the clerk did so. The spouse then applied to the clerk to enter a default judgment.
stemZh:
一名醉酒男子在酒吧里与一名重量级拳击手发生冲突，随后发生打斗。在混战中，拳击手击中了该男子的头部，该男子当场死亡。拳击手因此被判处过失杀人罪，监禁15年。

在拳击手服刑期间，该男子的配偶在联邦法院提起了一项死亡侵权诉讼，要求拳击手赔偿1000万美元的损失，包括未来收入损失和陪伴损失。拳击手在服刑期间被送达诉讼文书，但他未作出回应。30天后，配偶向书记员申请进入拳击手的缺席判决，书记员同意了。随后，配偶向书记员申请进入缺席判决。
ask: May the clerk enter a default judgment?
askZh: 书记员是否有权进入缺席判决？

options.en: No, because the boxer was not given notice of the spouse's application for the entry of default judgment.
options.zh: 否，因为拳击手未被通知配偶申请进入缺席判决。

options.en: No, because the spouse did not seek a sum certain or attach an affidavit showing the amount due.
options.zh: 否，因为配偶未要求确定金额或提交证明金额的宣誓书。

options.en: Yes, because the boxer failed to appear.
options.zh: 是，因为拳击手未出庭。

options.en: Yes, because the clerk may set damages at the amount demanded in the complaint.
options.zh: 是，因为书记员可以将赔偿金额定为诉状中要求的金额。

explanation.en:
Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 55 provides a two-step process for a plaintiff to secure a default judgment. First, the clerk must enter the defendant's default into the record once the plaintiff shows that the defendant failed to timely serve an answer—as the boxer failed to do within 21 days after being served with process. Second, the court or the clerk may enter a default judgment. However, the clerk is prohibited from doing so if any of the following apply:

• The defendant has appeared—ie, filed a motion or otherwise acted before the court.

• The defendant is legally incompetent or a minor.

• The plaintiff's claim is not for a sum certain (ie, a specified or set amount) or sum that can be made certain by calculation.

• The plaintiff failed to include an affidavit establishing the amount due.

Here, the boxer did not appear, and there is no indication that he is legally incompetent or a minor. However, the spouse's request for $10 million is not a sum certain and cannot be made certain by calculation. That is because the man's future earning potential and the value of his companionship are not specified or set amounts. Additionally, the spouse failed to attach an affidavit showing the amount due. Therefore, the clerk may not enter a default judgment (Choice C).*

*The court may still enter a default judgment after the judge conducts a hearing to determine the proper amount of damages to award.

(Choice A) Had the boxer appeared, he would have been entitled to written notice at least seven days before the court conducted a hearing on the entry of default judgment.

(Choice D) The clerk may set damages at the amount demanded in the complaint when the claim is for a sum certain and an attached affidavit establishes the amount due—neither of which is seen here.

Educational objective:

A default judgment may be entered by the clerk of the court unless: (1) the defendant has appeared, (2) the defendant is legally incompetent or a minor, (3) the plaintiff's claim is not for a sum certain or a sum that can be made certain by calculation, or (4) the plaintiff failed to include an affidavit establishing the amount due.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 55 (default judgments).

• 46 Am. Jur. 2d Judgments § 260 (2019) (explaining sum certain).

explanation.zh:
《联邦民事诉讼规则》第55条规定了原告确保缺席判决的两步程序。首先,一旦原告表明被告未能及时答复,书记员必须将被告的违约情况记入记录,因为拳击手在送达后21天内未能送达。二,法院或者书记员可以作出缺省判决,但是,有下列情形之一的,禁止书记员作出缺省判决: 1.

• 被告出庭,向法院提出动议或以其他方式采取行动。

• 被告在法律上无行为能力或未成年人。

• 原告的债权不是通过计算可以确定的某一数额(即特定数额或设定数额)或数额。

• 原告未能提供一份证明,证明应付款。

这里,拳击手没有出现,也没有迹象表明他在法律上是无行为能力或未成年人,但是,配偶要求的1000万美元不是一定的,也不能通过计算确定。这是因为没有具体说明或规定男子未来的收入潜力及其伴侣关系的价值,此外,配偶没有附上证明应付数额的书面证词,因此,书记员不得作出违约判决(Choice C)。

* 在法官举行听讯以确定裁定的适当损害赔偿数额之后,法院仍可作出缺席判决。

(Choice A)如果拳击手出现,他至少有权在法院就缺席判决进行审理前七天获得书面通知。

(Choice D) 书记员在索赔涉及一定数额时,可按起诉状中要求的数额确定损害赔偿金,并附上一份书面证词,确定应付数额,但此处不在此列。

学习要点：

法院书记员可以作出缺席判决,除非:(1) 被告已经出庭,(2) 被告在法律上无行为能力或未成年人,(3) 原告的诉讼请求不是针对一定数额或可通过计算确定的金额,或(4) 被告没有行为能力。原告未能提供一份书面证词,证实应付款。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 55(违约判决)。

• 46 Am. Jur. 2d判决§260(2019)(解释某些总和)。

stem:
A plaintiff sued a defendant in a federal district court for allegedly violating a recently enacted federal statute. The defendant moved to dismiss the plaintiff's complaint for failure to state a claim. The district court denied the defendant's motion, basing the ruling on a provision of the statute that has been interpreted differently by several district courts. In the written order denying the motion, the district court stated that "there is a substantial difference of opinion on the controlling question of law and an immediate appeal may materially advance the ultimate termination of this litigation."

Forty days after the district court entered this order, the defendant applied to the federal appellate court to hear the appeal of the order.
stemZh:
一名原告在联邦地区法院起诉被告，指控其违反了一项最近颁布的联邦法律。被告提出了驳回诉讼动议，理由是原告的诉状未能提出一个可成立的主张。地区法院驳回了被告的动议，其裁决依据的是该法律的一项条款，该条款已被多个地区法院作出不同解释。在驳回动议的书面裁定中，地区法院表示："在控制性法律问题上存在显著意见分歧，且立即上诉可能显著促进本案诉讼的最终终结。"

地区法院作出该裁定后四十天，被告向联邦上诉法院申请审理该裁定的上诉。
ask: May the appellate court consider this appeal?
askZh: 上诉法院可以考虑该上诉吗？

options.en: No, because only a final judgment can be appealed.
options.zh: 不可以，因为只有最终判决才可以被上诉。

options.en: No, because the application for appeal was untimely.
options.zh: 不可以，因为上诉申请已过时。

options.en: Yes, because an appellate court must consider an appeal if it is certified by the lower court.
options.zh: 可以，因为上诉法院必须考虑由下级法院认证的上诉。

options.en: Yes, because an immediate appeal is required to avoid protracted and expensive litigation.
options.zh: 可以，因为立即上诉是避免冗长且昂贵诉讼的必要条件。

explanation.en:
Appellate courts may only hear appeals from a final judgment—ie, a decision that fully resolves a dispute on the merits and leaves nothing for the court to do but enforce the judgment—absent limited exceptions. One exception to this final-judgment rule arises when the district court certifies an interlocutory appeal by stating in a written order that:

• there is a substantial difference of opinion on the controlling question of law and

• an appeal may materially advance the ultimate termination of the litigation. The party seeking an appeal must then apply to the appellate court within 10 days after the district court enters the order, and the appellate court will decide whether to hear the appeal (Choices A & C).* Since the defendant here did not file an application for appeal until 40 days after the district court entered its order certifying the interlocutory appeal, the application was untimely. Therefore, the appellate court cannot hear this appeal.

*An application for such an appeal will stay (ie, halt) the proceedings in the district court if the district or appellate court so orders.

(Choice D) The fact that an immediate appeal may avoid protracted and expensive litigation is not a basis for an interlocutory appeal. In fact, allowing interlocutory appeals may increase the cost of litigation if the litigants pursue repeated appeals instead of filing one appeal after final judgment is entered.

Educational objective:

A district court may certify an order for appeal if it states in writing that (1) there is a substantial difference of opinion on the controlling question of law and (2) an appeal may materially advance the ultimate termination of the litigation. The application to the appellate court must be made within 10 days after the entry of the order.

References

• 28 U.S.C. § 1291 (final-judgment rule).

• 28 U.S.C. § 1292(b) (district court certification).

• Liberty Mut. Ins. Co. v. Wetzel, 424 U.S. 737, 745 (1976) (explaining that an application for appeal based on a district court's certification must be made within 10 days after the entry of the order).

explanation.zh:
上诉法院只能审理对终审判决提出的上诉,即完全解决案情纠纷的裁决,而法院只能执行裁决的有限例外。区法院确认中间裁决时,该最后裁决规则有一个例外。以书面命令表明:

• 在法律控制问题上存在很大分歧,

• 上诉可以实质性地推动诉讼的最终结束,然后上诉方必须在地区法院下达命令后10天内向上诉法院提出申请,上诉法院将决定是否审理上诉(Choices A & C) * 由于被告在区法院发出证明中间上诉的命令后40天才提出上诉申请,申请时间不及时,因此上诉法院不能审理这一上诉。

* 如果区法院或上诉法院下令暂停(即停止)地区法院的诉讼程序,这种上诉申请将暂停。

(Choice D) 立即上诉可能避免旷日持久和昂贵的诉讼这一事实并不是中间上诉的依据。事实上,如果诉讼当事人重复上诉,而不是在作出最后判决后提出上诉,允许中间上诉可能会增加诉讼费用。

学习要点：

区法院如书面指出:(1) 在法律控制问题上存在实质性意见分歧,(2) 上诉可实质性地推动诉讼的最终结束,则可核准上诉令。必须在命令发出后10天内向上诉法院提出申请。

参考资料

• 《美国法典》第28篇第1291条(终审规则)。

• 28 U.S.C.§1292(b)(地区法院认证)。

• Liberty Mut. Ins. Co.诉Wetzel,424 U.S. 737, 745(1976)(解释根据地区法院的证明提出的上诉申请必须在命令生效后10天内提出)。

stem:
An investor sued a company's chief executive officer (CEO) for federal securities fraud in a federal court. The investor properly served process on the CEO, but the CEO did not file an answer or any other response.

Thirty days after service of process, the investor asked the clerk of the court to enter the CEO's default, which the clerk promptly did. The investor then submitted to the clerk a request for default judgment that included an affidavit stating that the CEO defrauded her of $100,000. The clerk entered a default judgment for this amount. Twenty days later, the CEO learned of the default judgment and immediately filed a motion to set it aside because he was abroad when the default judgment was entered.
stemZh:
一名投资者在美国联邦法院起诉一家公司首席执行官（CEO）的联邦证券欺诈行为。投资者已合法向CEO送达了诉讼文书，但CEO未提交任何答辩或回应。

在送达诉讼文书后30天，投资者向法院书记官申请记录CEO的缺席，书记官随即办理了该记录。投资者随后向书记官提交了一份要求缺席判决的申请，并附上一份证词，称CEO欺诈了她10万美元。书记官据此作出了一份10万美元的缺席判决。20天后，CEO得知了该缺席判决，并立即提出撤销该判决的动议，因为他是在该缺席判决作出时身处国外。
ask: How will the court likely rule on the CEO's motion?
askZh: 法院对该CEO的撤销动议将如何裁决？

options.en: Deny the motion, because a court may not set aside an entry of a default judgment.
options.zh: 驳回该动议，因为法院不得撤销缺席判决的记录。

options.en: Deny the motion, because the clerk properly entered the default judgment.
options.zh: 驳回该动议，因为书记官正确地作出了缺席判决。

options.en: Grant the motion, because only a judge may enter a default judgment.
options.zh: 批准该动议，因为只有法官才能作出缺席判决。

options.en: Grant the motion, because the CEO was not notified of the request for default judgment.
options.zh: 批准该动议，因为CEO未被通知要求作出缺席判决。

explanation.en:
A default refers to a defendant's failure to timely serve an answer to a lawsuit, which is generally due within 21 days after the defendant is served with process. When the plaintiff shows this failure to the court clerk, the clerk must enter the defendant's default into the record of the case (as seen here). The default can then be entered as a default judgment by the clerk or the court (Choice C). The clerk must enter a default judgment when:

• the plaintiff's claim is for a sum certain—ie, a specified or set amount—or a sum that can be made certain by calculation

• the plaintiff's request for default judgment includes an affidavit establishing the amount due

• the defendant failed to appear—ie, did not file a motion or otherwise act before the court—and

• the defendant is not legally incompetent or a minor.

Here, the investor filed an affidavit that claimed the CEO defrauded her of $100,000—a sum certain. And since the CEO failed to appear and is not legally incompetent or a minor, the clerk properly entered a default judgment. Therefore, the court will likely deny the CEO's motion to set aside the default judgment.

(Choice A) A court may set aside the clerk's entry of default for good cause. And a court may set aside a default judgment for any reason justifying relief from a final judgment— none of which apply here.

(Choice D) If the defendant previously appeared before the court, the plaintiff must serve the defendant with written notice of the application for default judgment seven days before a hearing on the matter. But here, the CEO failed to appear, so no such notice was required.

Educational objective:

A court clerk must enter a default judgment when (1) the plaintiff's claim is for a sum certain, (2) the plaintiff's request for default judgment includes an affidavit establishing the amount due, (3) the defendant failed to appear, and (4) the defendant is not legally incompetent or a minor.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 55 (default judgments).

explanation.zh:
违约是指被告未能及时送达对诉讼的答复,一般应在被告送达诉讼文书后21天内送达。原告向法庭书记员显示这一失职时,书记员必须将被告的违约情况记入案件记录(如此处所示),然后,该违约情况可以作为书记员或法院的违约判决(Choice C)录入.在下列情况下,书记员必须作出缺席判决:

• 原告的求偿要求为一定数额——具体数额或固定数额——或通过计算可以确定的数额

• 原告要求作出缺席判决的请求包括一份确定应付款的宣誓书;

• 被告没有出庭,即没有向法院提出动议或以其他方式采取行动;

被告在法律上不是无行为能力的人,也不是未成年人。

在此,投资方提交了一份宣誓书,声称首席执行官欺骗了她10万美元 — — 这是肯定的。 由于首席执行官未能出庭,且在法律上并非无行为能力或未成年人,因此书记官正确地做出了默认判决。因此,法院可能会驳回CEO提出的撤销缺席判决的动议.

(Choice A)法院可以出于正当理由撤销书记员的违约记录,法院可以出于任何理由撤销一项违约判决,以证明对终审判决的补救是正当的——这些都不适用。

(Choice D)如果被告先前出庭,原告必须在就该事项举行听证会7天前向被告提交缺席判决申请的书面通知。但在这里,CEO没有出现,所以不需要这样的通知.

学习要点：

法院书记员必须在下列情况下作出缺席判决:(1)原告的诉讼要求为一定数额,(2)原告的缺席判决请求包括一份确定应付数额的书面证词,(3)被告未出庭,(4)被告在法律上不是无能或小.

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 55(违约判决)。

stem:
A member of Congress fired a female employee because he believed that male employees are better workers. The female employee sued the member of Congress in federal court to recover monetary damages. She claimed that the termination of her employment constituted sex-based discrimination in violation of the Fifth Amendment. No federal statute authorizes an employment discrimination claim for damages against a member of Congress.

The member of Congress has moved to dismiss the female employee's suit for failure to state a claim upon which relief can be granted.
stemZh:
一位国会议员因为相信男性员工是更好的工人而解雇了一名女性员工。该女性员工在美国联邦法院起诉该国会议员，要求赔偿损失。她声称，她的解雇构成基于性别的歧视，违反了第五修正案。没有联邦法律授权对国会议员提出就业歧视索赔。

该国会议员提出了驳回诉讼动议，理由是原告的主张未能提出可以获得救济的主张。
ask: Is the court likely to grant the motion?
askZh: 法院很可能批准该动议吗？

options.en: No, because the federal court may fill a gap in a federal statutory scheme.
options.zh: 不，因为联邦法院可能填补联邦法律体系中的空白。

options.en: No, because the female employee's claim presents an implied cause of action.
options.zh: 不，因为该女性员工的主张提出了一个默示的请求权。

options.en: Yes, because the female employee's claim is not explicitly authorized by a federal statute.
options.zh: 是的，因为该女性员工的主张没有明确由联邦法律授权。

options.en: Yes, because the member of Congress filed the motion before filing his answer.
options.zh: 是的，因为该国会议员在提交答辩状之前提出了动议。

explanation.en:
Implied causes of action for damages

SCOTUS precedent Implied cause of action recognized*

Bivens v. Six Unknown Fed. Narcotics Agents

Fourth Amendment claim for unlawful search & seizure

Davis v. Passman Fifth Amendment due process claim for sex-based employment discrimination

Carlson v. Green Eighth Amendment cruel & unusual punishment claim for failure to provide medical treatment

SCOTUS = Supreme Court of the United States.

*SCOTUS has not recognized implied cause of action for damages in the last 40 years.

A federal court generally may award damages against a federal official only if expressly authorized by statute. But in the absence of authorization, federal common law may imply that damages are recoverable in rare instances involving unconstitutional conduct.

These implied causes of action (ie, Bivens actions) are disfavored because Congress can best determine the liability of federal officials. As a result, SCOTUS has recognized only three Bivens actions:

• A Fourth Amendment claim for an unlawful search and seizure

• A Fifth Amendment due process claim for sex-based employment discrimination

• An Eighth Amendment cruel and unusual punishment claim for failure to provide medical treatment Here, no federal statute explicitly authorized the female employee's claim for damages against the member of Congress, who is a federal official. But since a Fifth Amendment sex-based employment discrimination claim is a recognized Bivens action, the female employee

presented a claim upon which damages can be granted. Therefore, the federal court will likely deny the member's motion (Choice C).

(Choice A) A federal court may use federal common law to fill a gap in a federal statutory scheme (eg, by interpreting statutory terms). But since no federal statute is on point here, there is no gap to fill.

(Choice D) The defense of failure to state a claim upon which relief can be granted may be raised at any time before the end of trial without being waived (as seen here). However, the

member's motion should be denied since the female employee asserted a Bivens action upon which damages can be granted.

Educational objective:

The following implied causes of action permit the recovery of damages against a federal official: (1) a Fourth Amendment claim for unlawful search and seizure, (2) a Fifth Amendment claim for sex-based employment discrimination, and (3) an Eighth Amendment claim for failure to provide medical treatment.

References

• Bivens v. Six Unknown Named Agents of the Bureau of Fed. Narcotics, 403 U.S. 388, 389 (1971) (establishing implied causes of action for certain constitutional violations by federal officials).

• Davis v. Passman, 442 U.S. 228, 248–49 (1979) (holding that an implied cause of action exists to recover damages against a member of Congress who violated the Fifth Amendment).

explanation.zh:
损害诉讼的隐含原因

承认的隐含行动原因*

Bivens v. Six Unknown Fed. 缉毒人员

第四修正案关于非法搜查和扣押的索赔

Davis诉Passman案第五修正案关于基于性别的就业歧视的正当程序索赔

Carlson诉Green第八修正案 残忍和不寻常的惩罚要求

SCOTUS = 美国最高法院.

* 在过去40年中,SCOTUS没有认识到隐含的损害赔偿诉讼原因。

联邦法院通常只有在法规明确授权的情况下才能对联邦官员作出损害赔偿裁决。 但是,在没有授权的情况下,联邦普通法可能意味着在涉及违宪行为的罕见情况下可以赔偿损害赔偿。

这些隐含的行动原因(即比文斯行动)是不利的,因为国会可以最好地确定联邦官员的责任。 因此,SCOTUS只承认了三项比文斯行动:

• 第四修正案要求非法搜查和扣押

• 第五修正案关于基于性别的就业歧视的正当程序要求

• 第八修正案对未能提供医疗的残酷和不寻常的惩罚要求。 联邦法规没有明文授权女雇员对联邦官员的国会议员提出损害赔偿要求。但是由于第五修正案 基于性别的就业歧视 诉讼是公认的 Bivens 诉讼,女雇员

因此,联邦法院可能会驳回该成员的动议(Choice C)。

(Choice A) 联邦法院可以使用联邦普通法来填补联邦法定计划中的空白(比如通过解释法定条款 ) 。 但是,由于这里没有联邦法规,因此没有需要填补的空白。

(Choice D) 在审判结束前的任何时候,可以不放弃(如此处所示)提出未能提出可以给予救济的求偿的辩护。

由于女雇员声称Bivens提起诉讼,可据以判给损害赔偿,因此应驳回成员的请求。

学习要点：

以下隐含的诉讼原因允许对一名联邦官员提出损害赔偿:(1) 第四修正案关于非法搜查和扣押的索赔;(2) 第五修正案关于基于性别的就业歧视的索赔;(3) 第八修正案关于非法搜查和扣押的索赔。未能提供医疗。

参考资料

• Bivens诉联邦麻醉品局六名不明姓名代理人,403 U.S.388、389(1971)(为联邦官员违反宪法的某些行为确定隐含的行动原因)。

• Davis诉Passman案,442 U.S.228,248–49(1979年)(认为存在对违反第五修正案的国会议员要求赔偿损失的默示诉讼理由)。

stem:
A plaintiff residing in State A sues her former employer for $3 million, alleging employment discrimination in violation of federal law, breach of her employment contract, and infringement of her patent. The suit is filed in a federal court located in State B, which is the employer's state of incorporation and principal place of business.

Under State B's choice-of-law rules, State B law applies to all state substantive law claims.
stemZh:
一名原告居住在 A 州，起诉其前雇主 300 万美元，指控违反联邦法律的就业歧视、违反其雇佣合同以及侵犯其专利。该诉讼是在位于 B 州的联邦法院提起的，该州是雇主的注册州和主要营业地。

根据 B 州的法律选择规则，B 州法律适用于所有州实体法主张。
ask: What substantive law should the federal court apply to the plaintiff's various claims?
askZh: 联邦法院应根据什么实体法来审理原告的各项主张？

options.en: The court should apply federal law to all three claims.
options.zh: 法院应将联邦法律适用于所有三项主张。

options.en: The court should apply State B law to all three claims.
options.zh: 法院应将 B 州法律适用于所有三项主张。

options.en: The court should apply State B law to the breach of contract claim and federal law to the employment discrimination and patent claims.
options.zh: 法院应将 B 州法律适用于违反合同的主张，将联邦法律适用于就业歧视和专利主张。

options.en: The court should apply State B law to the employment discrimination and patent claims and federal law to the breach of contract claim.
options.zh: 法院应将 B 州法律适用于就业歧视和专利主张，将联邦法律适用于违反合同的主张。

explanation.en:
Choice of law in federal court

Type of jurisdiction

Applicability Substantive issues

Procedural issues

Federal question

• Claim arises under U.S. Constitution, federal law, or treaty

Apply federal law

Diversity • Amount in controversy > $75,000 AND

• Parties are citizens of different states

Apply state law*

Apply federal law

*Federal court must follow choice-of-law rules of state where it sits.

A party may join multiple claims against an opposing party in federal court (as seen here). This ensures judicial efficiency since a party does not need to file separate lawsuits for each claim. But the court must have subject-matter jurisdiction over each claim, which generally arises under either:

• federal-question jurisdiction – when the claim arises under the U.S. Constitution, a treaty, or a federal law (eg, federal statute, patent law) or

• diversity jurisdiction – when the claim arises under state law (eg, breach of contract), the amount in controversy exceeds $75,000, and the parties are citizens of different states. When a claim arises under federal question jurisdiction, the court must apply federal law to procedural and substantive issues. Here, the court has federal question jurisdiction over the plaintiff's employment discrimination and patent infringement claims since they arise under federal law. Therefore, the State B federal court should apply federal substantive law to these claims (Choices B & D).

But when a claim arises under diversity jurisdiction, the court must apply federal procedural law and state substantive law. To determine which state's substantive law applies, the court must follow the choice-of-law rules of the state where it sits. Here, the court has diversity jurisdiction over the breach of contract claim since it arises under state law, the amount in controversy is $3 million, and the parties are citizens of different states. Therefore, the court must follow State B's choice-of-law rules and apply State B substantive law to this claim (Choices A & D).

Educational objective:

Federal courts must apply federal procedural and substantive law to claims arising under federal question jurisdiction. And they must apply federal procedural law—but state substantive law based on the choice-of-law rules of the state where they sit—to claims arising under diversity jurisdiction.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 18 (joinder of claims).

• 28 U.S.C § 1652 (federal court must apply federal substantive law to claims arising under federal law but state substantive law to claims arising under state law).

explanation.zh:
联邦法院的法律选择

管辖权类型

实质性问题

程序性问题

联邦问题

• 根据《美国宪法》、联邦法律或条约提出要求

适用联邦法律

多样性 有争议的数额 > 75 000美元

• 政党是不同国家的公民

适用州法律*

适用联邦法律

* 联邦法院必须遵守其所在地国家的法律选择规则。

一方当事人可以将针对对方当事人的多项索赔合并到联邦法院(如本文所示),这确保了司法效率,因为一方当事人不需要为每项索赔单独提起诉讼。但法院必须对每项请求具有属事管辖权,这些请求一般产生于以下任一方面:

· 联邦问题管辖权——当根据美国宪法、条约或联邦法律(例如联邦法规、专利法)提出要求时;

异籍管辖权——当根据州法律(例如违反合同)提出求偿时,争议金额超过75 000美元,当事人是不同州的公民。在联邦问题管辖下提出求偿时,法院必须对程序性和实质性问题适用联邦法律。在这方面,法院对原告的就业歧视和专利侵权索赔具有联邦问题管辖权,因为这些索赔是根据联邦法律提出的,因此,B州联邦法院应对这些索赔适用联邦实体法(Choices B & D)。

但是,当权利要求是在多样性管辖下产生的,法院必须适用联邦程序法和州实体法。 为了确定哪个州适用实体法,法院必须遵循其所在州的法律选择规则。在此,法院对违反合同索赔具有异籍管辖权,因为它根据州法律产生,争议金额为300万美元,当事人是不同州的公民.因此,法院必须遵循B州的法律选择规则,并将B州实体法适用于这一主张(Choices A & D)。

学习要点：

联邦法院必须适用联邦程序和实体法处理在联邦问题管辖下产生的索赔。他们必须适用联邦程序法——但根据他们所在国家的法律选择规则制定的实体法——在多样性管辖下提出诉讼。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P.18(合并索赔)。

• 《美国法典》第28编第1652条(联邦法院必须适用联邦实体法处理根据联邦法提出的索赔,但将实体法处理根据州法提出的索赔)。

And they must apply federal procedural law—but state substantive law based on the choice-of-law rules of the state where they sit—to claims arising under diversity jurisdiction.

stem:
A bank sued a borrower in federal district court for violating the terms of a mortgage agreement between the two parties. The borrower filed an answer that denied the bank's claim and contained a counterclaim alleging that the bank had engaged in predatory lending in violation of a federal statute. Neither party demanded a jury trial.

At the close of evidence, the judge orally stated his findings of fact and conclusions of law on the record. He found that the overwhelming evidence established that the borrower failed to make her monthly mortgage payments on several occasions during the past year. Based on this fact, the judge concluded that the borrower violated the terms of the mortgage agreement. The judge also concluded that the evidence was insufficient for him to find that the bank engaged in predatory lending. The judge then entered a written final judgment in favor of the bank.

The borrower properly filed an appeal challenging the judge's finding that she had failed to make the mortgage payments.
stemZh:
一家银行在联邦地区法院起诉借款人，指控其违反了双方之间的抵押协议条款。借款人提交了一份答辩状，否认了银行的主张，并提出反诉，指控银行违反联邦法律从事掠夺性放贷行为。双方均未要求陪审团审判。

在证据结束时，法官在记录中口头陈述了其对事实和法律的认定。他认定， overwhelming 的证据表明借款人在过去一年中多次未能支付其月供。基于这一事实，法官得出结论，借款人违反了抵押协议的条款。法官还得出结论，证据不足以认定银行从事掠夺性放贷行为。随后，法官作出书面最终判决，支持银行。

借款人正确地提出上诉，挑战法官认定其未能支付抵押贷款的结论。
ask: How will the appellate court likely rule?
askZh: 上诉法院很可能如何裁决？

options.en: Affirm the judgment, because the judge is the final arbiter of facts in the absence of a jury.
options.zh: 维持判决，因为法官在没有陪审团的情况下是事实的最终裁决者。

options.en: Affirm the judgment, because there was no clearly erroneous finding of fact.
options.zh: 维持判决，因为没有明显错误的事实认定。

options.en: Reverse the judgment, because a jury must determine issues of fact.
options.zh: 推翻判决，因为陪审团必须决定事实问题。

options.en: Reverse the judgment, because the findings of fact and conclusions of law were not in writing.
options.zh: 推翻判决，因为事实认定和法律结论未以书面形式作出。

explanation.en:
Appellate standards of review

Standard Level of review Applicability

De novo • No deference to trial judge's legal determination

• Reverse if reasonably believe trial judge misinterpreted law

Pure legal issues, eg:

• conclusions of law

• content of jury instructions Clear error • Highly deferential to trial judge's factual findings

• Reverse if no reasonable judge would have made this finding

Factual issues in bench trials, eg:

• credibility of witnesses

• factual determinations Substantial evidence

• Highly deferential to jury's factual findings

• Reverse if no reasonable jury would have made this finding

Factual issues in jury trials, eg:

• credibility of witnesses

• jury's verdict Abuse of discretion

• Highly deferential to trial judge's discretionary decisions

• Reverse only if decision was unreasonable/arbitrary

Discretionary rulings by judge, eg:

• grant/denial of new trial

• admissibility of evidence The Seventh Amendment right to a jury trial is waived when, as here, no written jury demand is served on the other parties within 14 days after service of the last pleading related to the jury issue. The parties must then proceed with a bench trial, during which the judge serves as the finder of fact and interpreter of the law (Choice C). And after the close of evidence, the judge must provide—orally or in writing—findings of fact and conclusions of law on the record (Choice D).

However, the trial judge is not the final arbiter of the law or facts (Choice A). That is because an appellate court can review the trial judge's decision:

• for clear error (high deference) – where a judge's findings of fact will be reversed only if they were clearly erroneous such that no reasonable judge would have made them or

• de novo (no deference) – where a judge's conclusions of law will be reversed if the appellate court reasonably believes that the judge misinterpreted the applicable law.

And since there was overwhelming evidence that the borrower failed to make her monthly mortgage payments on several occasions, this finding of fact by the district court judge was not clearly erroneous. Therefore, the appellate court will likely affirm the district court's judgment.

Educational objective:

In a bench trial, the judge serves as the finder of fact and interpreter of law. On appeal, the judge's findings of fact are reviewed for clear error (high deference), while its conclusions of law are reviewed de novo (no deference).

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 52(a) (findings of fact and conclusions of law).

explanation.zh:
上诉复审标准

标准审查级别

• 不尊重审判法官的法律裁定

• 如果有理由相信审判法官误解了法律,则予以扭转

纯法律问题,例如:

• 法律结论

• 陪审团指示的内容高度服从审判法官的事实调查结果

• 如果没有合理的法官作出这一裁定,则推翻

法官审判中的事实问题,例如:

• 证人的可信度

• 实质性证据

• 高度服从陪审团的事实调查结果

• 如果没有合理的陪审团作出这一结论,则推翻

陪审团审判中的事实问题,例如:

• 证人的可信度

• 陪审团的裁决

• 高度服从审判法官的裁量决定

• 只有在决定不合理/任意的情况下才予以撤销

法官酌情作出的裁决,例如:

• 批准/拒绝新的审判

· 证据的可采性 第7项修正案放弃了接受陪审团审判的权利,因为与陪审团问题有关的最后一次申辩在送达后14天内未向其他当事方提交书面陪审团要求。当事方随后必须进行法庭审判,在此期间,法官充当法律的发现者和解释者(Choice C)。证据结束后,法官必须提供——或以书面形式提供——事实调查结果和记录的法律结论(Choice D)。

然而,审判法官不是法律或事实的最终仲裁人(Choice A)。这是因为上诉法院可以审查审判法官的决定:

· 明显错误(高度尊重)——法官对事实的调查结果只有在明显错误的情况下才会被推翻,以致没有合理的法官会作出这些结论,或者

· 不服从——如果上诉法院有理由认为法官误解了适用法律,法官的法律结论就会被推翻。

由于有压倒性证据表明借款人多次未能按月支付抵押贷款,地区法院法官的这一结论没有明显错误。因此,上诉法院可能会确认地区法院的判决。

学习要点：

在法庭审判中,法官是事实的发现者和法律的诠释者,在上诉中,法官对事实的调查结果会因明显错误(高度尊重)而被复审,而其法律结论则会被重新复审(不尊重)。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 52(a)(事实调查和法律结论)。

stem: A woman filed a class action on behalf of thousands of individuals against an insurance company in a federal court in State A. The individuals sought to recover $20 million in statutory penalties for the company's failure to pay claims within the time specified by State A law. The company moved to dismiss the case based on a State A statute that prohibits class actions seeking statutory penalties against insurance companies.
stemZh: 一名女子在A 州 的联邦法院代表数千名个人对一家保险公司提起集体诉讼。这些个人寻求因保险公司未能在A 州 法律规定的期限内支付索赔而获得 2000 万美元的法定罚金。公司以A 州 一项禁止对保险公司提起要求法定罚金的集体诉讼的法律为由，动议驳回诉讼。
ask: Will the federal court likely grant the company's motion to dismiss?
askZh: 联邦法院很可能批准公司的驳回诉讼动议吗？

options.en: No, because a state cannot prohibit class actions.
options.zh: 不会，因为州不能禁止针对保险公司的集体诉讼。

options.en: No, because maintenance of a class action in federal court is a procedural issue governed by federal law.
options.zh: 不会，因为在联邦法院维持集体诉讼属于程序问题，受联邦法律管辖。

options.en: Yes, because the federal court must apply State A substantive law, and State A prohibits this type of class action.
options.zh: 会，因为联邦法院必须适用A 州 的实体法，而A 州 禁止此类集体诉讼。

options.en: Yes, because there is no federal common law pertaining to class action requirements.
options.zh: 会，因为不存在关于集体诉讼要求的联邦普通法。

explanation.en:
A federal court sitting in diversity must apply state law to substantive issues and federal law to procedural issues. When it is unclear whether an issue is substantive or procedural, the court must determine if a valid federal law (ie, federal statute, rule, or constitutional provision) directly addresses the issue. If so, then pursuant to the federal-rule analysis, federal law applies if it is arguably procedural and does not modify a substantive right.

FRCP 23 directly addresses whether a class action can be maintained in federal court. This valid rule* is arguably procedural and does not modify a substantive right (Choice C). That is because it regulates the manner and means of a lawsuit (ie, who may join the suit)—not the parties' legal rights (ie, what they may sue for). As a result, the court will apply this federal rule and likely deny the company's motion to dismiss based on the State A statute prohibiting this type of class action.

*No FRCP has ever been found unconstitutional or invalid. This is likely because the Supreme Court reviews and sends proposed rules to Congress before they are enacted.

(Choice A) States can prohibit class actions in state courts. But federal courts must follow FRCP 23 to determine if a class action can be maintained in federal court.

(Choice D) Although there is no federal common law pertaining to class action requirements, FRCP 23 provides such requirements.

Educational objective:

Under federal-rule analysis, a federal court sitting in diversity must apply a valid federal law that directly addresses an issue so long as the law is arguably procedural and does not modify a substantive right.

FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

References

• Shady Grove Orthopedics Assocs., P.A. v. Allstate Ins. Co., 559 U.S. 393, 407–08 (2010) (explaining that class actions in federal court are governed by FRCP 23 and not state law).

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 23 (class actions).

explanation.zh:
以多样性方式开庭的联邦法院必须对实质性问题适用州法律,对程序问题适用联邦法律。如果不清楚某一问题是实质性还是程序性的,法院必须确定一项有效的联邦法律(即联邦法规、规则或宪法规定)是否直接涉及这一问题。如果是这样,那么根据联邦规则的分析,如果联邦法律可以说是程序性的,并且不修改实质性权利,则适用联邦法律。

FRCP 23直接涉及在联邦法院是否可以维持集体诉讼的问题,这一有效的规则* 可以说是程序性的,并不修改实质性权利(Choice C)。这是因为它规定了诉讼的方式和手段(即谁可以加入诉讼),而不是当事人的合法权利(即他们可以起诉什么)。因此,法院将适用这一联邦规则,并可能拒绝公司根据禁止这类集体诉讼的A州法规提出的驳回动议。

* 从未发现FRCP违宪或无效,这可能是因为最高法院在颁布规则之前审查并向国会发送拟议规则。

(Choice A)州可以禁止州法院进行集体诉讼,但联邦法院必须遵循FRCP 23来确定在联邦法院是否可以维持集体诉讼.

(Choice D) 虽然没有涉及集体诉讼要求的联邦普通法,但FRCP 23规定了这种要求。

学习要点：

根据联邦规则的分析,以多样性方式开庭的联邦法院必须适用一项有效的联邦法律,只要该法律具有程序性,并且不修改实质性权利,就可直接处理某一问题。

FRCP = 联邦民事诉讼规则。

参考资料

· Shady Grove Orthopedics Assocs, P.A.诉All State Ins. Co., 559 U.S. 393, 407-08(2010)(解释联邦法院的集体诉讼受FRCP 23而不是州法律管辖)。

• Fed. R. Civ. P.23(类行动)。
