stem:
Hundreds of same-sex couples domiciled across the country initiated a class action in a federal district court against a health insurance company. The suit alleged that the insurance company violated a federal statute by charging the couples higher insurance premiums solely because they were in a same-sex relationship. The suit sought an injunction to stop the insurance company's discriminatory premiums as well as individualized monetary damages of $5,000 to $20,000 for each couple.

The district court entered an order certifying the suit as a "final equitable relief" class action after it determined that injunctive relief was appropriate because the insurance company's actions applied generally to the whole class. The insurance company immediately appealed the certification order.
stemZh:
数百名居住在全国各地的同性伴侣在联邦地区法院提起集体诉讼，起诉一家保险公司。诉讼指控保险公司违反联邦法律，仅因这些伴侣处于同性关系中就对他们收取更高的保险费用。诉讼要求颁布禁令，停止保险公司的歧视性收费，并要求每对伴侣获得 5,000 到 20,000 美元的个别金钱赔偿。

地区法院在确定禁令救济适当，因为保险公司的行为适用于整个集体后，发布了一项裁定，将该诉讼认定为 "最终衡平救济" 的集体诉讼。保险公司随即上诉了该裁定的认证决定。
ask: Is the federal appellate court likely to overturn the certification order?
askZh: 联邦上诉法院很可能推翻该认证决定吗？

options.en: No, because subject-matter jurisdiction exists over the class action.
options.zh: 不，因为该集体诉讼存在事项管辖权。

options.en: No, because the district court has not entered a final judgment.
options.zh: 不，因为地区法院尚未作出最终判决。

options.en: Yes, because the amount-in-controversy requirement was not satisfied.
options.zh: 是，因为争议金额要求未被满足。

options.en: Yes, because the class action seeks individualized monetary damages.
options.zh: 是，因为该集体诉讼要求个别金钱赔偿。

explanation.en:
A federal appellate court applies the abuse of discretion standard when reviewing a district court's discretionary certification order authorizing a class action to proceed. Class action certification is proper if the case satisfies four prerequisites (shown above) and is one of the following types of class actions:

• Prejudicial risk – when separate actions would create a risk of (1) inconsistent decisions regarding the parties or (2) impairing absent class members' interests

• Common question – when common questions of law or fact predominate over individual questions and a class action is the best method to resolve the dispute

• Final equitable relief – when injunctive or declaratory relief is appropriate because the opposing party's actions generally apply to the whole class

A certified "final equitable relief" class action is valid if the suit also seeks incidental monetary damages. Such damages flow from liability to the class and do not require individualized determinations (eg, statutorily mandated damages). In contrast, a certified "final equitable relief" class action is invalid if the suit also seeks individualized monetary relief (as seen here).* Therefore, the district court abused its discretion in certifying the couples' suit as a "final equitable relief" class action, and the certification order will likely be overturned.

*A certified "final equitable relief" class action that seeks individualized monetary relief may violate due process because, unlike in "common question" class actions, class members are not entitled to notice or an opportunity to opt out and pursue individual suits.

(Choices A & C) Subject-matter jurisdiction exists through federal-question jurisdiction, which has no amount-in-controversy requirement, because this class action arises under a federal statute. However, this action was improperly certified since it contains individualized monetary claims.

(Choice B) The final-judgment rule bars a federal appellate court from hearing an appeal until the district court has entered a final judgment—absent limited exceptions. One such exception is an appeal of a district court's order granting or denying class action certification (as seen here).

Educational objective:

A suit may be certified as a "final equitable relief" class action when injunctive or declaratory relief is appropriate because the opposing party's actions generally apply to the whole class. Certification of such a class action is appropriate even if it also seeks incidental monetary damages—but not individualized monetary relief.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 23(a)–(b) (class action certification requirements).

• Wal-Mart Stores, Inc. v. Dukes, 564 U.S. 338, 360–62 (2011) (explaining that certification of a "final equitable relief" class action is invalid when the class members seek individualized monetary relief).

explanation.zh:
联邦上诉法院在审查地区法院授权进行集体诉讼的酌定认证令时,适用酌处权标准的滥用。如果案件满足四项先决条件(如上所述),并且是下列类型的集体诉讼之一,则集体诉讼认证是适当的:

• 司法前风险——如果单独行动会造成(1)对当事方作出不一致的决定,或(2)损害缺席的阶级成员的利益的风险

• 共同问题 -- -- 当共同的法律或事实问题凌驾于个别问题之上时,集体诉讼是解决争端的最佳方法

• 最后的公平救济——当禁止性或宣告性救济是适当的,因为对立方的行动一般适用于整个类别

经认证的"最终公平救济"集体诉讼,如果该诉讼还寻求附带的金钱损害,则有效. 这种损害从赔偿责任流向该类别,不需要个别确定(例如,法定的损害赔偿).与此相对照的是,如果诉讼也寻求个人化的金钱救济(如这里所示),经过认证的“最终公平救济”集体诉讼无效。 * 因此,地区法院滥用其裁量权,将夫妇的诉讼证明为“最终公平救济”类。操作,认证命令很可能会被推翻。

*经认证的寻求个性化金钱救济的"最终公平救济"集体诉讼可能违反正当程序,因为与"常见问题"集体诉讼不同的是,阶级成员无权通知或有机会选择退出和追求个人诉讼.

(Choices A & C) 事由管辖权通过联邦问题管辖权存在,该管辖权没有争议金额要求,因为这一集体诉讼是根据联邦法规提出的。然而,这项行动没有得到适当核证,因为它包含个人货币债权。

最后判决规则禁止联邦上诉法院在地区法院作出最后判决之前审理上诉,但有限度的例外。这种例外之一是对地区法院给予或拒绝集体诉讼证明的命令提出上诉(见这里)。

学习要点：

当禁止性或宣告性救济是适当的,因为对立方的行动一般适用于整个类别时,诉讼可以被认证为"最终公平救济"的集体诉讼.即使这种集体诉讼还寻求附带的金钱损害——但不是个别的金钱救济——的证明也是适当的。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P.23(a)-(b)(集体行动认证要求)。

• Wal-Mart Stores, Inc. v. Dukes, 564 U.S. 338, 360–62 (2011)(解释当阶级成员寻求个性化的金钱救济时,“最后公平救济”集体诉讼的认证无效)。

stem:
An entrepreneur from State A sued a company incorporated and headquartered in State B in federal court in State B to recover $100,000 in damages. The entrepreneur alleged that the company breached their contract by disclosing confidential information supplied by the entrepreneur's consultant, a U.S. citizen who resides in a foreign country. The company denies receiving this information from the consultant.

The entrepreneur asked the consultant to voluntarily attend a deposition or submit an affidavit, but he refused. The entrepreneur then moved for, and the court issued a subpoena requiring, the consultant's appearance at a deposition in State B. The consultant was served with the subpoena by mail in accordance with an international agreement signed by the foreign country. The subpoena contained the contents required by federal rules and stated that the consultant must pay his own expenses to attend the deposition.
stemZh:
一名来自 A 州的创业者在 B 州的联邦法院起诉了一家在 B 州注册并设立总部的公司，要求赔偿 100,000 美元的损失。该创业者声称该公司违反合同，泄露了其顾问提供的机密信息，该顾问是美国公民，居住在外国。该公司否认收到了来自该顾问的信息。

创业者要求该顾问自愿出席庭外宣誓询问或提交证词，但该顾问拒绝了。随后，创业者提出了动议，法院发出了一份传票，要求该顾问在 B 州出席庭外宣誓询问。该顾问根据外国签署的国际协议，通过邮寄方式收到了该传票。该传票包含联邦规则要求的内容，并说明该顾问需自行承担出席庭外宣誓询问的费用。
ask: What is the consultant's best argument that he does not need to comply with the subpoena?
askZh: 该顾问主张他不需要遵守传票的最佳理由是什么？

options.en: The consultant's testimony is unnecessary in the interest of justice.
options.zh: 该顾问的证词对司法正义无益。

options.en: The court lacks authority to issue a subpoena for a person in a foreign country.
options.zh: 法院无权向外国人士发出传票。

options.en: The entrepreneur failed to pay the consultant's travel and attendance expenses.
options.zh: 创业者未支付该顾问的旅行和出席费用。

options.en: The entrepreneur used an improper method to serve the subpoena.
options.zh: 创业者使用了不当的方法送达传票。

explanation.en:
A subpoena is a written court order that generally commands a person to testify at a trial, hearing, or deposition. Federal courts have the authority to subpoena U.S. citizens in a foreign country* (eg, the consultant) pursuant to special rules governing the issuance and service of such subpoenas (Choice B). Such a subpoena is validly issued when it:

• contains the required contents (as seen here)

• is issued from the court where the action is pending (as seen here) and

• seeks testimony that is (1) necessary in the interest of justice and (2) impractical to obtain in an admissible form without the witness's personal appearance. Here, the consultant's testimony about the disclosure of confidential information is necessary in the interest of justice because it is the basis for the entrepreneur's breach-of-contract claim (Choice A). And it is impractical to obtain this testimony without the

consultant's appearance because he refused to voluntarily attend a deposition or submit an affidavit. As a result, the subpoena was validly issued.

The entrepreneur then had to validly serve the subpoena on the consultant by:

• using a method of service that the federal rules allow for service of process in a foreign country (eg, pursuant to an international agreement) and

• paying the consultant's travel and attendance expenses. Here, the consultant was served with the subpoena by mail. This is a proper method of service since an international agreement signed by the foreign country permits such service

(Choice D). However, the subpoena was invalidly served because the entrepreneur failed to pay the consultant's travel and attendance expenses. As a result, this is the consultant's best argument that he does not need to comply with the subpoena.

*A federal court may not issue subpoenas to foreign citizens in foreign countries since they owe no allegiance to the U.S.

Educational objective:

Federal courts can subpoena U.S. citizens in a foreign country when their testimony is necessary in the interest of justice and impractical to obtain by other means. Such subpoenas are validly served when the serving party (1) uses a method of service allowed by the federal rules and (2) pays the citizen's attendance and travel expenses.

References

• 28 U.S.C. § 1783 (subpoena of person in foreign country).

• 9A Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 2462 (3d ed. 2020) (explaining the requirements to issue and serve subpoenas to U.S. citizens in foreign countries).

explanation.zh:
传票是法院的书面命令,通常命令一个人在审判、审讯或证词中作证。 联邦法院有权传票美国。根据关于发出和送达这种传票的特别规则(Choice B),外国公民*(如顾问)。

• 载有所需内容(见本文)

• 诉讼待决的法院签发(见这里);

• 寻求(1) 为公正起见所必需的证词和(2) 在证人本人不在场的情况下以可接受的形式获得的不切实际的证词。在此,顾问关于披露机密信息的证词对于伸张正义是必要的,因为它是企业家违反合同索赔(Choice A)的依据。

顾问的出庭是因为他拒绝自愿参加证词或提交宣誓书,因此,传票是有效的。

然后,该企业家必须通过以下方式向顾问有效送达传票:

• 使用联邦规则允许在外国提供诉讼文书送达的一种服务方法(例如根据国际协定)和

· 支付顾问的旅费和出勤费:通过邮件向顾问送达传票,这是适当的服务方法,因为外国签署的国际协定允许提供这种服务。

然而,该传票的送达无效,因为企业家没有支付顾问的旅费和出勤费,因此,这是顾问最好的论点,即他不需要遵守传票。

*联邦法院不得向外国的外国公民发出传票,因为他们不效忠美国。

学习要点：

联邦法院可以在外国传唤美国公民,如果为了司法公正,为了通过其他手段获取他们的证词是必要的,并且不切实际.当服务方(1)使用联邦规则允许的送达方式和(2)支付公民的出勤费和旅费时,这种传票有效送达.

参考资料

• 《美国法典》第28篇第1783条(在外国的潜伏)。

• 9A Charles Alan Wright等人,《联邦惯例和程序》第2462条(3d编,2020年)(解释向外国美国公民发出和送达传票的要求)。

stem:
A plaintiff brought a diversity action against a defendant in federal court. During discovery, the plaintiff orally deposed the defendant. Upon completion of that deposition, the plaintiff sought to depose the defendant again, which would be the tenth deposition taken by the plaintiff in the case.

The plaintiff served the defendant with written notice stating the time and place of the deposition. Upon receipt of the notice, the defendant's attorney called the plaintiff's attorney to tell him that the defendant would not appear at the deposition. The plaintiff's attorney demanded that the defendant appear as noticed. Neither the defendant nor the defendant's attorney appeared at the deposition. The plaintiff's attorney has moved for sanctions.
stemZh:
一名原告在联邦法院对被告提起了一项基于不同州籍管辖权的诉讼。在证据开示阶段，原告对被告进行了口头庭外宣誓询问。在完成此次询问后，原告希望再次对被告进行询问，这将是本案中原告进行的第十次询问。

原告向被告送达了书面通知，说明了询问的时间和地点。在收到通知后，被告的律师致电原告的律师，告知被告不会出席此次询问。原告的律师要求被告按通知出席。被告及其律师均未出席此次询问。原告的律师提出了制裁动议。
ask: Is the court likely to impose sanctions?
askZh: 法院是否很可能施加制裁？

options.en: No, because the defendant had already been deposed in the action.
options.zh: 否，因为被告已经在本案中被询问过。

options.en: No, because the plaintiff failed to serve a subpoena to compel the defendant's attendance.
options.zh: 否，因为原告未能送达传票以强制被告出席。

options.en: Yes, because the defendant received written notice of the deposition.
options.zh: 是，因为被告收到了询问的书面通知。

options.en: Yes, because the plaintiff is entitled to take up to 10 depositions.
options.zh: 是，因为原告有权进行最多 10 次询问。

explanation.en:
Leave of court for oral or written deposition

Court's leave* or parties' stipulation required to conduct deposition when:

• deposition exceeds 10-deposition limit

• deposition sought before parties' initial planning conference or

• deponent already deposed in action *Leave of court is always required when deponent is in prison.

An oral deposition is a method of discovery in which the deposing party conducts an oral examination of another party or nonparty (deponent) under oath and outside of court. To compel the attendance and testimony of a party deponent, the deposing party must provide the party deponent with written notice. If the party deponent fails to attend, the federal court may impose sanctions.

Notice may be provided and the deposition conducted without the court's leave (ie, permission) or the parties' stipulation unless:

• the deposition exceeds the 10-deposition limit (which includes both oral and written depositions)

• the deposition is sought before the parties' initial planning conference* or

• the deponent was already deposed in the action. Here, the plaintiff sought to conduct an oral deposition of the defendant after the defendant had already been deposed in the action. Since the plaintiff failed to obtain the court's leave and the parties did not stipulate to the second deposition, the plaintiff's written notice to the defendant was improper (Choice C). As a result, the defendant was not required to attend the deposition, and the court is unlikely to impose sanctions.

*Leave of court or the parties' stipulation is not required for an oral deposition conducted before the initial planning conference if the deposing party certifies (and provides supporting facts) in the notice that the deponent is expected to leave the U.S and be unavailable for examination.

(Choice B) A subpoena is required to compel a nonparty deponent's attendance at an oral deposition. But a party deponent can be compelled to attend through written notice.

(Choice D) Although the plaintiff was entitled to take up to 10 depositions, leave of court or a stipulation between the parties was required before the plaintiff could depose the defendant a second time.

Educational objective:

A party may provide notice of and conduct an oral deposition without the court's leave or the parties' stipulation unless (1) the deposition exceeds the 10-deposition limit, (2) the deposition is sought before the initial planning conference, or (3) the deponent was already deposed in the case.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 30(a) (when court's leave or parties' stipulation required for oral deposition).

explanation.zh:
口头或书面证词请假

在下列情况下,法院的许可* 或当事方必须作出证词的规定:

• 沉积量超过10度

• 在缔约方初步规划会议之前征求证词或

* 当被告在监狱里时,总是需要法庭的领导。

口头作证是一种证据开示方法,在这种方法中,质证方在宣誓后和庭外对另一方或非方(责任方)进行口头审查.为了强迫责任方出庭作证,责任方必须向责任方提供书面通知,责任方未能出庭的,联邦法院可以予以制裁.

未经法院许可(即允许)或当事人规定,可以发出通知和进行证词,除非:

• 证词超过10个沉积限度(包括口头和书面证词)

• 在双方初步规划会议之前征求证词* 或

• 被告在诉讼中已被推翻,在此,原告试图在被告在诉讼中已被推翻之后进行被告的口头证词。由于原告未能获得法院的许可,且双方当事人没有规定第二次证词,原告向被告发出的书面通知是不适当的(Choice C)。因此,被告没有被要求出庭作证,法院不可能施加制裁。

* 如果撤回义务的一方在通知中证明(并提供佐证事实)被告预期将离开美国,则在初步规划会议之前所作的口头陈述不需要法院或当事方的规定。无法检查 。

(Choice B) 需要传票来迫使非当事方的辩护人出席口头作证,但可以通过书面通知迫使辩护人出庭。

(Choice D)虽然原告有权接受最多10份证词,但是在原告可以第二次罢免被告之前,需要法院许可或当事人之间的规定。

学习要点：

当事人可以不经法院许可或当事人规定而提供口头证词的通知并进行口头证词,除非(1) 证词超过10个陈述限度,(2) 在初步规划会议之前寻求证词,或者(3) 被告是案件已经撤销

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 30(a)(当法院许可或口头作证所需的当事方规定时)。

stem: A company incorporated in State A and with its principal place of business in State B sued its former employee from State C in a federal district court in State A for allegedly embezzling $80,000. During a deposition of the employee in State B, the company's attorney asked the employee whether he stole the money. The employee's attorney objected and directed the employee not to answer to preserve his Fifth Amendment privilege against self-incrimination. The company's attorney thinks this privilege does not apply because she believes that the statute of limitations has run on any criminal proceedings that could be brought against the employee for his conduct.
stemZh: 一家在 A 州注册成立、其主要营业地在 B 州的公司，在 A 州的联邦地区法院起诉其前雇员，该雇员来自 C 州，指控其挪用 80,000 美元。在 B 州对雇员进行的庭外宣誓询问中，公司律师询问该雇员是否偷走了这笔钱。雇员的律师提出异议，并指示雇员不要作答，以保留其第五修正案的自我归罪特权。公司律师认为该特权不适用，因为她相信针对雇员因该行为可能提起的任何刑事诉讼的诉讼时效已经届满。
ask: How should the company's attorney proceed?
askZh: 公司律师应该如何继续进行？

options.en: Adjourn the deposition and file a motion with the federal court in State B to compel the employee to answer.
options.zh: 暂停庭外宣誓询问，并向 B 州的联邦法院提交一份动议，要求强制雇员作答。

options.en: Adjourn the deposition and file a motion with the federal court in State C to compel the employee to answer.
options.zh: 暂停庭外宣誓询问，并向 C 州的联邦法院提交一份动议，要求强制雇员作答。

options.en: Proceed with the deposition and then file a motion with the federal court in State A to compel the employee to answer.
options.zh: 继续进行庭外宣誓询问，然后向 A 州的联邦法院提交一份动议，要求强制雇员作答。

options.en: Proceed with the deposition and then file a motion with the federal court in State B to compel the employee to answer.
options.zh: 继续进行庭外宣誓询问，然后向 B 州的联邦法院提交一份动议，要求强制雇员作答。

explanation.en:
Depositions

Type Procedure Objections Answers

Oral

(most common)

• Questions asked by attorneys

• No notice of questions

• Responses recorded by officer

Concisely stated on record

Answer required unless:

• enforcing court-ordered limitation

• presenting motion to terminate or limit or

• preserving privilege Written • Questions asked by officer

• Notice of questions required

• Responses recorded by officer

Served in writing

A deposition is a method of discovery in which a party conducts a written or oral examination of another (ie, the deponent) under oath and outside of court. In an oral deposition, the parties' attorneys question the deponent. Like at a trial, any objections to these questions must be stated on the record or they may be waived. But unlike a trial, a judge is not present to rule on any objections. As a result, the objection is noted, the examination proceeds, and the deponent must answer the questions unless refusing to answer is necessary to:

• enforce a court-ordered limitation (eg, an order limiting the deposition's scope)

• present a motion to terminate or limit the deposition (eg, to prevent unreasonable annoyance or embarrassment of the deponent) or

• preserve a privilege (eg, privilege against self-incrimination)—as seen here.

The questioning party may adjourn or complete the deposition before filing a motion to compel a response. If the deponent is a nonparty, the motion must be filed where the deposition occurred. But if the deponent is a party (as seen here), it must be filed where the lawsuit is pending. Therefore, the company's attorney should proceed with the deposition and file a motion in State A federal court to compel the employee's answer

(Choices A, B & D). The judge will then assess the merits of the employee's privilege claim and decide if a response is required.

Educational objective:

When a deponent refuses to answer a question at a deposition, the questioning party may file a motion to compel a response. When the deponent is a nonparty, that motion must be filed in the district where the deposition occurred. But when the deponent is a party, the motion must be filed where the lawsuit is pending.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 30(c)(2) (objections at depositions).

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 37(a)(2)–(3) (motion to compel deposition answer).

explanation.zh:
交存

类型程序异议

口头

(最常见的)

• 律师提问

• 没有问题通知

• 军官记录的答复

明确记录在案

需要答复,除非:

• 执行法院命令的限制

• 提出终止或限制的动议;

• 保留特权

• 需要的问题通知

• 军官记录的答复

书面任职

作证是一种证据开示方法,即一方对宣誓后和法庭外的另一方(即被告)进行书面或口头检查,在口头证词中,当事人的律师对被告提出质询。与审判一样,对这些问题的任何反对意见都必须记录在案,否则可以放弃,但与审判不同,法官不在场对任何反对意见作出裁决。因此,指出反对,考试进行,应答者必须回答问题,除非拒绝回答是必须的,以便:

• 执行法院命令的限制(例如限制作证范围的命令)

· 提出终止或限制证词的动议(例如,防止不合理的烦恼或使责任人尴尬)或

• 保留特权(例如,防止自证其罪的特权)——如这里所见。

质询方可以在提出强制答复的动议前中止或者完成质证,如果质证方是非质证方,必须在质证发生地提出质证.但是,如果被告是当事方(如这里所见),则必须提交诉讼待决地点。 因此,公司的律师应着手作证,并向州法院提出动议。

法官随后将评估雇员的特权要求的案情,并决定是否需要答复。

学习要点：

质证人拒绝在质证时回答问题时,质证方可以提出强制答复的动议,质证人为非质证方的,必须在质证发生地的区提出.但当被告是一方时,必须在诉讼未决的地方提出动议。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 30(c)(2)(在作证时提出异议)。

• Fed. R. Civ. P.37(a)(2)-(3)(迫使证词回答的动议)。

stem:
A plaintiff filed an action in federal district court and served the defendant with the summons and complaint. The defendant moved to dismiss the complaint for failure to state a claim.

Instead of opposing the motion to dismiss, the plaintiff voluntarily dismissed the action and filed a new action alleging the same claims and addressing the pleading defects outlined in the defendant's motion to dismiss. The defendant moved to dismiss the second action, and the plaintiff voluntarily dismissed the second action instead of filing opposition papers.

The plaintiff has filed a third action asserting the same claims and new allegations that are responsive to the defendant's second motion. The defendant has moved to dismiss the third action; the plaintiff opposes the motion.
stemZh:
原告在联邦地区法院提起诉讼，并向被告送达了传票和诉状。被告提出了驳回诉讼的动议，理由是诉状未提出任何可成立的主张。

原告未反对该驳回动议，而是自愿撤回了该诉讼，并提起了一项新的诉讼，主张相同的主张，并回应了被告在驳回动议中指出的诉状中的陈述缺陷。被告再次提出了驳回动议，原告未提交反对文件，而是自愿撤回了第二次诉讼。

原告第三次提起诉讼，主张相同的主张，并新增了回应被告第二次驳回动议的主张。被告提出了驳回动议，原告对此提出反对。
ask: Is the court likely to grant the defendant's motion?
askZh: 法院是否会很可能批准被告的驳回动议？

options.en: No, because the plaintiff has promptly and diligently attempted to address the pleading defects.
options.zh: 不会，因为原告已及时且勤勉地尝试解决陈述缺陷。

options.en: No, because the plaintiff voluntarily dismissed each previous action before the defendant filed an answer or moved for summary judgment.
options.zh: 不会，因为原告在被告提出答复或驳回动议之前自愿撤回了每次诉讼。

options.en: Yes, because the plaintiff failed to seek a court order dismissing the second action.
options.zh: 是的，因为原告未寻求法院命令撤回第二次诉讼。

options.en: Yes, because the plaintiff's previously dismissed actions asserting the same claims operate as an adjudication on the merits.
options.zh: 是的，因为之前主张相同主张的被撤回诉讼构成实质问题的裁决。

explanation.en:
Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 41(a), a plaintiff may voluntarily dismiss a suit without a court order by filing (1) a stipulation of dismissal signed by all the parties or (2) a notice of dismissal before the defendant serves an answer or a summary judgment motion. Here, no court order was required since the plaintiff voluntarily dismissed the first and second actions before an answer or summary judgment motion was filed (Choice C).

A voluntary dismissal is generally entered without prejudice. This means that the plaintiff can sue the defendant on the same claim in the future. However, a voluntary dismissal is with prejudice and operates as an adjudication on the merits when stated in an order, notice, or stipulation of dismissal OR the two-dismissal rule applies. This rule applies when the plaintiff:

• voluntarily dismissed the first action in federal or state court without a court order and

• voluntarily dismissed the second action based on the same claim in federal court by filing a notice of dismissal.

Here, the plaintiff likely dismissed both actions by a notice of dismissal since there is no indication that the court issued an order or the parties signed a stipulation. Since these actions asserted the same claims, the second dismissal operated as an adjudication on the merits. Therefore, the court will likely grant the defendant's motion to dismiss the third action.

(Choice A) The fact that the plaintiff has promptly and diligently attempted to address the pleading defects raised by the defendant does not affect the application of the two-dismissal rule.

(Choice B) Although the plaintiff voluntarily dismissed each previous action before the defendant filed an answer or moved for summary judgment, the two-dismissal rule still bars the third action.

Educational objective:

Under the two-dismissal rule, a voluntary dismissal of a second action operates as an adjudication on the merits when the plaintiff voluntarily dismissed (1) the first action in federal or state court without a court order and (2) the second action based on the same claim in federal court by filing a notice of dismissal.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 41(a) (voluntary dismissals).

explanation.zh:
根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第41(a)条,原告可以不经法院命令而自愿驳回诉讼,提出(1) 由所有各方签署的驳回规定,或(2) 在被告作出答复或即决判决之前发出驳回通知。在这方面,不需要法院命令,因为原告在提出答复或即决判决动议之前自愿驳回了第一和第二起诉讼(C选择案)。

自愿驳回一般不带偏见,这意味着原告今后可以就同一诉讼要求起诉被告。但是,如果在命令、通知或驳回规定中作出声明,或者适用两项驳回规则,则自愿驳回是有偏见的,并且是对案情的裁决。

• 未经法院命令,自愿驳回联邦或州法院的第一项诉讼;

• 在联邦法院根据同一要求自愿驳回第二项诉讼,提出驳回通知。

在这方面,原告可能以驳回通知的方式驳回这两项诉讼,因为没有迹象表明法院下达了命令,或者双方当事人签署了规定。由于这些行动都提出了同样的要求,第二次驳回是对案情的裁决,因此,法院可能同意被告提出的驳回第三次诉讼的动议。

(Choice A)原告迅速而勤奋地试图解决被告提出的抗辩缺陷的事实,不影响二免规则的适用.

(Choice B)虽然原告在被告提出答复或提出即决判决前自愿驳回先前的每一项诉讼,但两项免责规则仍然禁止第三次诉讼。

学习要点：

根据两项免责规则,当原告自愿驳回(1)联邦或州法院未下达法院命令的第一项诉讼和(2)基于同一理由的第二项诉讼时,对第二项诉讼的自愿驳回可作为对案情的裁决。向联邦法院提出驳回要求的通知。

参考资料

• Fed.R. Civ.P.41(a)(自愿解雇)。

stem:
An electrician and a plumber filed separate diversity actions against a construction company in which they both claim that the company failed to pay them the amount specified in their contracts. The company defended on the ground that the electrician and plumber failed to complete their work on time. The electrician served a request for admission on the company, requesting that the company admit that it repeatedly denied contractors such as the electrician access to the construction site. The company did not respond to the request.

Forty-five days after the electrician's request was served, the plumber asked the court during a pretrial conference to enter an order conclusively establishing the fact that the company repeatedly denied contractors access to the construction site. The plumber relied on the company's failure to timely respond to the electrician's request for admission.
stemZh:
一名电工和一名水管工分别在基于不同州籍管辖权的诉讼中起诉一家建筑公司，他们声称该公司未按合同支付款项。该公司辩称，电工和水管工未能按时完成工作。电工向公司提出了一个请求承认的申请，要求公司承认其反复拒绝向包括电工在内的承包商提供进入施工现场的许可。公司未对此请求作出回应。

电工的请求送达后45天，水管工在一次预审会议上请求法院发布一项裁定，确认该公司反复拒绝向承包商提供进入施工现场的许可。水管工依据公司未能及时回应电工的请求承认申请的事实提出请求。
ask: Is the court likely to enter the order?
askZh: 法院是否会批准该裁定？

options.en: No, because the construction company has sixty days to respond to the electrician's request for admission.
options.zh: 不会，因为建筑公司有60天时间回应电工的请求承认申请。

options.en: No, because the plumber cannot rely on the construction company's failure to respond to the request for admission in the electrician's action.
options.zh: 不会，因为水管工不能依据建筑公司未及时回应电工的请求承认申请的事实提出请求。

options.en: Yes, because the construction company's failure to respond to the electrician's request for admission within 30 days after service is treated as an admission.
options.zh: 会，因为建筑公司未在送达请求承认申请后30天内回应，视为承认。

options.en: Yes, because the court has the authority to enter orders at pretrial conferences that will expedite litigation.
options.zh: 会，因为法院在预审会议上有权发布加速诉讼的裁定。

explanation.en:
In a request for admission, a party requests that another party admit the truth about matters within the scope of discovery that relate to facts, the application of law to facts, opinions about either, or the genuineness of documents. The party served with such a request must serve a written response within 30 days that:

• admits the matter

• specifically denies the matter in whole or in part

• explains why the matter cannot be admitted or denied or

• objects that the matter falls outside the scope of discovery. A party's failure to adequately respond within 30 days results in the matter being admitted and conclusively established in the pending action. However, it does not serve as an admission for any other purpose and cannot be used against the party in another proceeding.

Here, the electrician and the plumber filed separate actions against the construction company. The electrician then served the company with a request to admit that it repeatedly denied contractors access to the construction site. The company's failure to respond within 30 days after the request was served results in the matter being established in the electrician's action (Choice A). However, the plumber cannot rely on the company's failure to respond in the electrician's action, so the court is unlikely to enter the plumber's requested order (Choice C).

(Choice D) At a pretrial conference, a federal court has broad authority to consider matters and enter appropriate orders that will help expedite litigation, improve the trial's quality, and facilitate settlement. Here, an order establishing that the company repeatedly denied contractors access to the construction site would be improper since the plumber cannot rely on the company's failure to respond in the electrician's action.

Educational objective:

A party's failure to adequately respond to a request for admission within 30 days after the request is served results in the matter being admitted and conclusively established in the pending action. However, it does not serve as an admission for any other purpose and cannot be used against the party in another proceeding.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 36 (requests for admission).

• 8B Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 2264 (3d ed. 2020) (explaining the effect of failing to respond to a request for admission).

explanation.zh:
当事人在受理请求书中,要求另一方承认涉及事实、法律对事实的适用、对其中之一的意见或文件的真实性等证据开示范围内事项的真相。被送达方必须在30天内作出书面答复,说明:

• 承认此事

• 具体否认全部或部分事项

• 解释为何不能承认或否认此事;

• 证据开示事项不属于证据开示范围的物体:一方未能在30天内作出充分答复,导致该事项被受理,并在未决诉讼中得到最终确认。但是,它并非为任何其他目的的承认,不能在另一程序中用于对抗该当事人。

在此,电工和水管工分别对建筑公司提起诉讼,然后电工为该公司服务,要求该公司承认它一再拒绝承包商进入建筑工地。公司在请求送达后30天内未作出答复,结果为电商行为(Choice A)中确定的事项.然而,水管工不能依靠公司在电工的行动中未能回应,因此法院不太可能进入水管工要求的订单(Choice C).

(Choice D)在预审会议上,联邦法院有广泛的权力审议事项,并下达适当的命令,这将有助于加快诉讼,提高审判质量,促进解决.在此,一项规定该公司一再拒绝承包商进入施工现场的命令是不适当的,因为水管工不能依赖该公司未能对电工的行动作出反应。

学习要点：

当事人在请求送达后30天内未对受理请求作出充分答复,导致该事项在未决诉讼中被受理和最终确定。但是,它并非为任何其他目的的承认,不能在另一程序中用于对抗该当事人。

参考资料

• Fed.R. Civ.P.36(申请录取)。

• 8B Charles Alan Wright 等人,《联邦惯例和程序》第2264条(3d编,2020年)(解释未答复入院申请的后果)。

stem:
During an interview, a company's chief executive officer (CEO) made a prepared statement denying that the company was in merger talks with one of its competitors. After the interview aired, the company's stock price dropped, and an investor sold his stock in the company at a great loss. Two weeks later, the company announced that it was merging with its competitor.

The investor filed a lawsuit against the company in an appropriate federal court based on misrepresentation. After the parties held their initial planning conference, the investor requested that the company produce all documents and data related to the CEO's prepared statement and the subsequent announcement of the merger. In response, the company carefully screened its records and produced approximately three million documents, including electronically stored information. It also produced a privilege log of documents withheld. After production, the company realized that it had inadvertently produced 102 potentially privileged documents.

The company immediately notified the investor of the inadvertent disclosure, provided a basis for its privilege claim, and asked that the documents be immediately returned. The investor, who disputed the company's privilege claim, immediately isolated the documents from the rest of the production but refused to return them.

The investor has presented the documents and the parties' privilege arguments to the court for a determination of the privilege claim. A hearing was scheduled to be held in 15 days. In response, the company promptly moved for an injunction that would require the investor to immediately return the documents to the company and destroy any copies in his possession before the hearing.
stemZh:
在一次采访中，一家公司的首席执行官（CEO）发表了一份准备好的声明，否认该公司正在与竞争对手进行合并谈判。采访播出后，该公司股价下跌，一名投资者以巨大损失卖出了该公司股票。两周后，该公司宣布正在与竞争对手进行合并。

投资者在适当的联邦法院提起诉讼，指控该公司存在误导行为。在双方举行初步会议后，投资者要求公司提供与CEO准备好的声明以及随后合并公告相关的所有文件和数据。对此，公司仔细审查了其记录，并提供了大约三百万份文件，包括电子存储的信息。它还提供了一份特权清单，列出了未提供的文件。在提供文件后，公司意识到其无意中提供了102份可能具有特权的文件。

公司立即通知投资者无意中披露了文件，提供了其特权主张的依据，并要求投资者立即归还文件。投资者质疑公司的特权主张，立即将文件与其他文件隔离，但拒绝归还。

投资者已向法院提交了文件和双方的特权主张，以确定特权主张。听证会定于15天后举行。对此，公司迅速提出一项禁令，要求投资者立即将文件归还给公司，并在听证会前销毁其拥有的任何副本。
ask: How should the court rule on the company's motion?
askZh: 法院应如何裁定公司的禁令请求？

options.en: Deny the motion, because the company has waived attorney-client privilege by disclosing the documents to a third party.
options.zh: 驳回禁令请求，因为公司通过向第三方披露文件而放弃了律师-客户特权。

options.en: Deny the motion, because the investor promptly sequestered the documents and presented the information to the court.
options.zh: 驳回禁令请求，因为投资者迅速隔离了文件并将信息提交给法院。

options.en: Grant the motion, because the investor has failed to return the documents.
options.zh: 批准禁令，因为投资者未能归还文件。

options.en: Grant the motion, because the party that produced the privileged information determines whether it is returned, sequestered, or destroyed.
options.zh: 批准禁令，因为提供特权信息的一方决定是否归还、隔离或销毁文件。

explanation.en:
When privileged information is inadvertently produced, FRCP 26(b)(5)(B) permits the producing party to promptly notify the receiving party of the disclosure and provide the basis for the privilege claim. After being notified, the receiving party must:

• promptly return, sequester, or destroy the information and any copies

• not use or disclose the information until the privilege claim is resolved and

• take reasonable steps to retrieve information already disclosed to others. This rule gives the receiving party the option to return, sequester, or destroy the documents at issue because the rule contemplates that the receiving party may dispute the privilege claim. In this situation, sequestering the documents achieves the purpose of the rule— protecting the potentially privileged information—while enabling the receiving party to present the documents and the disputed privilege claim to the court for resolution.

Here, the investor properly sequestered the documents and presented the parties' privilege dispute to the court for resolution. Therefore, the court will likely deny the company's motion for an injunction requiring the investor to immediately return and destroy the purportedly privileged documents before a hearing on the privilege claim.*

*However, the investor may still have to return or destroy the documents if the court later determines that they are in fact privileged.

(Choice A) An inadvertent disclosure does not waive the privilege so long as the disclosing party took reasonable steps to prevent disclosure—eg, carefully screened its records and produced a privilege log—and promptly rectified the disclosure (as seen here).

(Choice C) Since the investor sequestered the privileged documents, he is not required to immediately return them to the company.

(Choice D) The party that received (as opposed to produced) the privileged information determines whether it is returned, sequestered, or destroyed when disputing the producing party's privilege claim.

Educational objective:

After being notified that privileged information was produced, the receiving party must (1) promptly return, sequester, or destroy the information and any copies, (2) not use or disclose the information until the claim of privilege is resolved, and (3) take reasonable steps to retrieve information already disclosed.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 26(b)(5) (production of privileged materials).

• Fed. R. Evid. 502(b) (describing inadvertent disclosure).

explanation.zh:
在无意中提供特权信息时,FRCP 26(b)(5)(B)允许生产方迅速将披露通知接收方,并为特权要求提供依据。

• 迅速归还、扣押或销毁资料和任何副本

• 在特权要求得到解决之前不使用或披露信息;

• 采取合理步骤检索已经向他人披露的信息,该规则给予接收方返回、扣押或销毁有关文件的选择权,因为该规则设想接收方可对特权要求提出异议。在这种情况下,扣押文件达到规则的目的——保护可能享有特权的信息,同时使接收方能够向法院提出文件和有争议的特权要求,以便解决。

在此,投资方妥善扣押了这些文件,并将当事人的特权纠纷提交法院解决。因此,法院可能会驳回公司关于要求投资人立即退回和销毁据称享有特权的文件的禁止令的动议。

* 然而,如果法院后来确定这些文件事实上享有特权,投资方仍可能不得不退回或销毁这些文件。

(选择A) 无意的披露不会放弃特权,只要披露方采取合理步骤防止披露——例如仔细筛选其记录并制作特权记录——并迅速纠正披露(见这里)。

(C选择)由于投资方扣押了这些特权文件,他无需立即归还公司。

(Choice D)收到(而不是出示)特权信息的当事人,在对生产方的特权要求提出异议时,确定该特权信息是否被退回、扣押或销毁。

学习要点：

接收方在接到关于提供保密信息的通知后,必须(1) 迅速退回、扣押或销毁该信息和任何副本,(2) 在特权要求得到解决之前不使用或披露该信息,(3) 采取合理措施。获取已披露信息的步骤。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P.26(b)(5)(生产特许材料)。

• Fed. R. Evid. 502(b)(说明无意披露)。

stem: A pedestrian sued an out-of-state driver in a federal district court for allegedly hitting the pedestrian in a crosswalk, which the pedestrian claims resulted in $1 million in medical expenses, lost wages, and pain and suffering. The driver filed an answer denying liability.
stemZh: 一名行人在美国联邦地区法院起诉一名外州司机，指控其在人行横道上撞到该行人，该行人声称因此产生了 100 万美元的医疗费用、损失工资和痛苦与精神损害。司机提交了答辩状，否认其有责任。
ask: Which of the following must the pedestrian automatically provide the driver without waiting for a discovery request?
askZh: 以下哪一项必须行人自动向司机提供，而无需等待证据开示请求？

options.en: A copy of the pedestrian's medical bills for her alleged injuries.
options.zh: 行人对其所声称伤害的医疗账单的副本。

options.en: A copy of the pedestrian's medical insurance agreement.
options.zh: 行人医疗保险协议的副本。

options.en: A list of the cases in which the pedestrian has been a witness over the previous four years.
options.zh: 过去四年中，行人作为证人参与的案件清单。

options.en: The name of a witness who knows about the driver's past car accidents.
options.zh: 了解司机过去汽车事故的证人的姓名。

explanation.en:
Required discovery disclosures

(FRCP 26(a))

Type Required disclosures Time to disclose

Initial disclosures*

• Persons with relevant information

• Items in party's possession that support claim/defense

• Computation of damages & supporting material

• Relevant insurance policies

• ≤ 14 days after initial planning conference

• ≤ 30 days after post-conference service

or joinder

• As court orders or parties stipulate Expert testimony

• Identity of expert witnesses

• Expert's written report

• If no report, subject matter & summary of testimony

• ≥ 90 days before trial

• ≤ 30 days after disclosure to rebut evidence

• As court orders or parties stipulate Pretrial disclosures*

• Testifying witnesses

• Deposition testimony to be used at trial

• Documents/exhibits to be used at trial

• ≥ 30 days before trial

• As court orders

FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

*Does not apply to evidence used solely for impeachment.

Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 26(a), parties are required to make initial disclosures, disclosures of expert testimony, and pretrial disclosures even without a discovery request. A party must initially disclose:

• the name, address, and phone number of persons with relevant information that the party may use to support a claim or defense

• all documents, electronically stored information, and tangible things in the party's possession that the party may use to support a claim or defense

• any insurance agreement with a company that may be liable for all or part of any judgment and

• a computation of damages and the materials on which it was based.

All of this information must be disclosed within 14 days after the initial planning conference or by a date set by the court or parties.* Here, since part of the pedestrian's damages are based on her medical expenses, she must provide the driver with a copy of her medical bills without waiting for a discovery request.

*If a party is added after the initial planning conference, initial disclosures must be made within 30 days after service or joinder of that party.

(Choice B) The pedestrian does not need to provide a copy of her health insurance agreement because her insurance company will not be liable. Instead, the driver must provide his automobile insurance agreement because his insurance company may be liable for the pedestrian's damages.

(Choice C) A testifying expert witness (not seen here) must disclose a written report that lists the cases in which the witness has testified over the past four years. But this is only required if the witness (1) is a specially hired expert or (2) regularly gives expert testimony as part of his/her employment duties with the party.

(Choice D) Testimony from a witness who knows about the driver's past driving habits may be used to impeach the driver's trial testimony. But initial disclosures do not apply to witnesses or evidence used solely for impeachment.

Educational objective:

A party's initial disclosures must include (1) persons and items that the party may use to support a claim or defense, (2) any insurance agreement with a company that may be liable, and (3) a computation of damages and the materials on which it was based.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 26(a)(1) (required initial disclosures).

explanation.zh:
必要的证据开示披露

(FRCP 26(a))

披露时间

初步披露*

• 有相关信息的人

• 当事方拥有的、支持索赔/辩护的物品

• 损害的计算和辅助材料

• 相关保险单

• 在初步规划会议后14天

• 会议服务30天后

或合并

• 法院命令或当事方规定专家证词

• 鉴定人的身份

• 专家的书面报告

• 如果没有报告、主题事项和证词摘要

• 审判前90天

• 在披露后30天反驳证据

• 法院命令或当事方规定审前披露*

• 鉴定证人

• 将在审判中使用的证言

• 审判时使用的文件/用品

• 审判前30天

• 作为法院命令

FRCP = 联邦民事诉讼规则。

* 不适用于仅用于弹劾的证据。

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第26(a)条,即使没有提出证据开示请求,当事人也必须作出初步披露、披露专家证词和审前披露。

• 当事人可以用来支持索赔或辩护的相关信息的姓名、地址和电话号码

• 当事人可能用来支持索赔或抗辩的所有文件、电子存储的信息以及当事人拥有的有形物品

• 与可能对任何判决或部分判决负责的公司签订的任何保险协议;

• 计算损害及其所依据的材料。

所有这些资料必须在最初规划会议之后的14天内或法院或当事方确定的日期内公布。 * 在此,由于行人的部分损失是以其医疗费用为依据的,她必须向司机提供一份她的副本。医疗账单没有等待 证据开示请求。

* 如果一方是在初步规划会议之后增列的,则必须在该方任职或加入后30天内作出初步披露。

(Choice B) 行人无需提供她的医疗保险协议副本,因为她的保险公司将不承担责任.相反,司机必须提供他的汽车保险协议,因为他的保险公司可能对行人的损失负责.

(C组)作证的专家证人(此处未见)必须披露一份书面报告,其中列出证人在过去四年中作证的案件。但是,只有在证人(1)是专门雇用的专家或(2)作为他/她受雇于当事人的一部分定期提供专家证词的情况下,才要求这样做。

(Choice D)证人对驾驶员过去驾驶习惯的了解的证言可能被用来弹劾驾驶员的审判证言,但最初的披露并不适用于证人或仅用于弹劾的证据.

学习要点：

当事人的初始披露必须包括:(1)当事人可以用来支持索赔或抗辩的个人和物品,(2)与可能负有责任的公司达成的任何保险协议,以及(3)对损害及其所依据的材料进行计算。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 26(a)(1)(需要初步披露)。

stem:
A woman's house burned down after the wiring in her refrigerator sparked and started a fire. The following week, the woman received adequate notice that a class action had been filed in federal court against the manufacturer of the refrigerator for damages caused by the refrigerator's faulty wiring system. The woman did nothing when she received the notice and was not named as a class representative.

The court certified the class action after determining that common questions of law and fact predominated and that the class action was the best method to fairly and efficiently adjudicate the dispute. During discovery, the named class representatives reached a proposed settlement with the manufacturer. At a hearing, the woman objected to the proposed settlement on the ground that it was inadequate to cover the damage to her house. Despite her objection, the court approved the settlement after concluding that it was fair, reasonable, and adequate.

The woman then sued the manufacturer in another federal court to recover damages for the remaining damage to her house. The manufacturer moved to dismiss this suit.
stemZh:
一名女子的房屋在她的冰箱线路短路引发火灾后被烧毁。一周后，该女子收到了足够的通知，得知一项针对冰箱制造商的集体诉讼已在联邦法院提起，原因是冰箱的线路系统存在缺陷导致的损害。该女子在收到通知后未采取任何行动，也未被列为集体诉讼的代表。

法院在确定共同法律和事实问题占主导地位，并且集体诉讼是公平且高效解决争议的最佳方法后，确认了该集体诉讼。在证据开示阶段，集体诉讼的代表与制造商达成了一项拟议的和解协议。在听证会上，该女子以和解协议不足以赔偿其房屋损失为由反对该协议。尽管她提出异议，法院在得出该和解协议公平、合理且充足后批准了该协议。

该女子随后在另一家联邦法院起诉制造商，要求赔偿其房屋剩余损失。制造商提出了驳回诉讼的动议。
ask: Is the court likely to grant the manufacturer's motion?
askZh: 法院是否很可能批准制造商的动议？

options.en: No, because the woman objected to the proposed class action settlement.
options.zh: 否，因为该女子反对了拟议的集体诉讼和解协议。

options.en: No, because the woman was not a named representative in the class action.
options.zh: 否，因为该女子未被列为集体诉讼的代表。

options.en: Yes, because the court certified the class action.
options.zh: 是，因为法院确认了该集体诉讼。

options.en: Yes, because the woman failed to opt out of the class action.
options.zh: 是，因为该女子未从集体诉讼中退出。

explanation.en:
Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 23 recognizes three types of class actions: prejudicial risk, final equitable relief, and common question. Here, the court certified (ie, authorized) a "common question" class action against the manufacturer because it determined that (1) common questions of law and fact predominated and (2) the class action was the best method to fairly and efficiently adjudicate the dispute.

In "common question" class actions, adequate notice must be provided to all class members because they have the right to opt out of the class action and sue on their own behalf.* If a class member fails to opt out, he/she cannot pursue an individual suit involving the same claim. Instead, that class member is bound by any resulting final judgment or court-approved settlement, compromise, or voluntary dismissal.

Here, the woman failed to opt out of the class action because she did nothing after receiving adequate notice of the class action. This means that she is bound by the court-approved settlement and barred from asserting an individual suit against the manufacturer. Therefore, the court will likely grant the manufacturer's motion to dismiss her suit.

*In "prejudicial risk" and "final equitable relief" class actions, notice is not required because class members do not have a right to opt out. Instead, a court has the discretion to provide notice and an opportunity to opt out of such class actions.

(Choice A) A class member who objects to a proposed settlement shows that his/her interests diverge from those of the class. As a result, an objection allows the class member to appeal if the court approves the proposal—but not to file an individual suit.

(Choice B) Named class representatives and unnamed class members alike are bound by a court-approved settlement except for those members who opted out of the class action (not seen here).

(Choice C) The fact that the court certified the class action allowed the class action to proceed in federal court. However, it does not provide a basis for dismissing the woman's suit.

Educational objective:

A class member must opt out of a "common question" class action to pursue an individual suit involving the same claim. Otherwise, the class member is bound by any final judgment or court-approved settlement, compromise, or voluntary dismissal of the class action.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 23(c)(2) (notice requirements for "common question" class action).

• Matsushita Elec. Indus. Co., Ltd. v. Epstein, 516 U.S. 367, 378–79 (1996) (explaining that class members who fail to opt out of a class action are bound by a resulting court-approved settlement agreement).

explanation.zh:
《联邦民事诉讼规则23》承认三类集体诉讼:损害性风险、最终公平救济和共同问题。在此,法院认证(即授权)了针对制造商的“共同问题”集体诉讼,因为法院认定(1) 共同法律问题和事实占主导地位,(2) 集体诉讼是公正、高效地裁决争议。

在“共同问题”集体诉讼中,必须向所有阶级成员提供适当的通知,因为他们有权选择退出集体诉讼并代表自己提起诉讼。相反,该类成员受任何最终判决或法院批准的和解、妥协或自愿驳回的约束。

在此,该妇女没有选择退出集体诉讼,因为她在收到有关集体诉讼的充分通知后没有采取任何行动,这意味着她受法院批准的和解的约束,不能对制造商提出个人诉讼。因此,法院可能批准制造商驳回其诉讼的动议。

* 在"司法前风险"和"最终公平救济"类诉讼中,由于阶级成员无权选择退出,因此不需要通知,相反,法院有权提供通知,并有机会选择退出这类集体诉讼.

(Choice A)一个反对提议的和解的阶级成员表明,他/她的利益不同于该阶级的利益,因此,如果法院批准该提议,反对允许该阶级成员提出上诉,但不提起个人诉讼。

(Choice B) 已命名的阶级代表和未命名的阶级成员均受法院批准的和解的约束,但选择退出集体诉讼(此处不见)的成员除外.

(C组)法院认证集体诉讼的事实允许集体诉讼在联邦法院进行,但是它并没有为驳回该妇女的诉讼提供依据。

学习要点：

阶级成员必须选择退出“共同问题”集体诉讼,以提起涉及同一债权的个别诉讼。 否则,阶级成员将受到任何最终判决或法院批准的和解、妥协或自愿驳回集体诉讼的约束。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P.23(c)(2)(“共同问题”集体诉讼的通知要求)。

· Matsushita Elec. Indus. Co., Ltd.诉Epstein, 516 U.S. 367, 378–79 (1996年)(解释未能选择退出集体诉讼的阶级成员受由此产生的法院核准的和解协议的约束)。

stem: A company sued a competitor in federal court, alleging that the competitor stole the company's trade secrets regarding its 3D printing technology. The company is concerned that discovery will lead to disclosure of its other trade secrets.
stemZh: 一家公司在美国联邦法院起诉竞争对手，指控竞争对手窃取了该公司关于其 3D 打印技术的商业秘密。该公司担心证据开示会导致其其他商业秘密的泄露。
ask: What is the most efficient strategy for the company to protect these trade secrets from disclosure?
askZh: 该公司最有效的策略是什么，以防止这些商业秘密被披露？

options.en: Assert that its trade secrets are privileged.
options.zh: 主张其商业秘密具有特权性质。

options.en: File a motion for an ex parte temporary restraining order.
options.zh: 提出一项紧急临时禁令申请。

options.en: Obtain a stipulation that limits the scope of discovery.
options.zh: 达成一项限制证据开示范围的协议。

options.en: Withhold information relating to its trade secrets.
options.zh: 拒绝提供与其商业秘密相关的信息。

explanation.en:
Discovery stipulations

(FRCP 29)

Depositions Parties may stipulate that depositions be taken:

• before any person

• at any time or place

• on any notice

• in any manner Other discovery procedures Parties may stipulate to modifications:

• limiting scope of discovery

• expanding limits set by other rules

• extending time to complete particular requests* FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

*Court approval required if extension would interfere with deadlines for completing all discovery, hearing a motion, or trial.

Parties can use various methods of discovery to obtain nonprivileged information that is relevant and proportional to the needs of the case. The broad scope of discovery requires disclosure of evidence that could be used at trial as well as information that may lead to the discovery of such evidence. As a result, it is possible that discovery could lead to the disclosure of the company's other trade secrets.

To protect that information from disclosure, the company could confer with the competitor to reach an agreement that modifies discovery rules and procedures. FRCP 29 allows the parties to stipulate to modifications that:

• expand the limits imposed by rules governing discovery (eg, increase the number of interrogatories above 25)

• extend the time to complete particular discovery requests (eg, allow more than 30 days to respond to a request for production) or

• limit the scope of discovery (eg, bar discovery of certain materials—as the company seeks to do here).

A stipulation would be more efficient and less expensive than pursuing a motion to obtain a court order to modify the scope of discovery. Therefore, a stipulation is the most efficient strategy to prevent disclosure of the company's other trade secrets.

(Choice A) Trade secrets are not privileged, so this assertion could not be used to protect that information.

(Choice B) The company could file a motion for an ex parte temporary restraining order (TRO) to protect its other trade secrets from disclosure. But that would not be the most efficient strategy since an ex parte TRO generally remains in effect for only 14 days or until a preliminary-injunction hearing can take place—whichever occurs first.*

*An ex parte TRO automatically remains in effect for 14 days unless that time period is (1) shortened by the court or (2) extended by the court for good cause or based on the adverse party's consent.

(Choice D) Since the company's other trade secrets are likely discoverable, they cannot be withheld without a stipulation or court order that limits the scope of discovery.

Educational objective:

Discovery stipulations between the parties are an efficient way to modify discovery rules and procedures. They can be used to (1) expand the limits imposed by discovery rules, (2) extend the time to complete particular discovery requests, or (3) limit the scope of discovery.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 29 (discovery stipulations).

• 23 Am. Jur. 2d Depositions and Discovery § 10 (2019) (explaining stipulations regarding discovery).

explanation.zh:
证据开示规定

(燃料浓缩方案29)

保存方可规定在下列情况下取证:

• 在任何人面前

• 在任何时间或地点

• 接到通知后

• 以任何方式,缔约方可规定修改:

• 限制证据开示范围

• 扩大其他规则规定的限制

• 延长完成具体请求的时间* FRICP=联邦民事诉讼规则。

* 如果延期会妨碍完成所有证据开示、审理一项动议或审判的最后期限,则需要法院批准。

缔约方可以使用各种证据开示方法获取与案件需要相关和相称的非特权信息。证据开示的范围很广,需要披露可在审判时使用的证据以及可能导致证据开示此类证据的信息,因此,证据开示可能导致披露公司的其他商业秘密。

为了保护信息不被披露,公司可以与竞争对手商谈,以便达到修改证据开示规则和程序的协议。FRCP 29允许各方对修改规定:

• 扩大关于证据开示的规则所规定的限制(例如,审讯次数超过25次)

• 延长完成特定证据开示请求的时间(例如,允许30多天对生产请求作出答复)或

· 限制证据开示的范围(例如,酒吧证据开示某些材料——如公司试图在这里做的那样)。

一项规定比要求获得法院命令以改变证据开示范围的动议更有效、更便宜,因此,一项规定是防止披露公司其他商业秘密的最有效战略。

(Choice A) 商业秘密没有特权,因此这一断言不能用来保护这些信息.

(Choice B)公司可以提出单方面临时限制令(TRO)的动议,以保护其其他商业秘密不被泄露.但这不是最有效的战略,因为单方面TRO一般只有效14天,或直到可以进行初步禁止审讯为止——无论哪种情况先发生。

* 单方面TRO自动有效14天,除非该期限(1)由法院缩短或(2)由法院因正当理由或根据敌方同意延长。

(Choice D)由于公司的其他商业秘密有可能被证据开示,因此,如果没有限制证据开示范围的规定或法院命令,这些秘密就不能被扣留。

学习要点：

当事人之间的证据开示规定是修改证据开示规则和程序的有效途径,可用于(1)扩大证据开示规则规定的限度,(2)延长完成特定证据开示请求的时间,或(3)限制证据开示规则和程序的范围。证据开示。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P.29(证据开示规定)。

• 23 Am. Jur. 2d 交存和证据开示§10(2019)(解释关于证据开示的规定)。

stem:
An employee from State A sued his former company in a federal court in State A for discrimination in violation of federal employment law.

The employee served an officer of the company with a subpoena to attend a deposition in the city where the employee now resides. The city is 175 miles away from the company's headquarters in State B and 200 miles away from where the officer resides in State A. The officer performs all her employment duties at the company's headquarters.
stemZh:
一名来自 A 州的员工在 A 州的联邦法院起诉其前雇主，指控其违反联邦就业法中的歧视行为。

该员工向公司的一名高级职员送达了传票，要求其前往员工现居住的城市参加庭外宣誓询问。该城市距离公司总部所在地 B 州有 175 英里，距离该高级职员居住的 A 州有 200 英里。该高级职员的所有工作职责均在公司总部所在地履行。
ask: Must the officer comply with the subpoena?
askZh: 该高级职员必须遵守传票吗？

options.en: No, because the city is located 200 miles away from the officer's residence.
options.zh: 否，因为该城市距离高级职员的住所地有 200 英里。

options.en: No, because the city is located in a different state than the company's headquarters.
options.zh: 否，因为该城市与公司总部所在地处于不同的州。

options.en: Yes, because the city is located 175 miles away from the company's headquarters.
options.zh: 是，因为该城市距离公司总部所在地有 175 英里。

options.en: Yes, because the city is located in the state where the officer resides.
options.zh: 是，因为该城市位于高级职员居住的州。

explanation.en:
Place of compliance for subpoenas

(FRCP 45(c))

Trial, hearing, or deposition

Subpoena may command person's attendance:

• within 100 miles of where person resides, is employed, or regularly transacts business or

• within state where person resides, is employed, or regularly transacts business when person is: – party or party's officer or – commanded to attend trial & would not incur substantial expense Other discovery Subpoena may command:

• production of documents, tangible things, or ESI within 100 miles of where person resides, is employed, or regularly transacts business and

• inspection of premises at place to be inspected FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure; ESI = electronically stored information

A subpoena is a written court order that commands a person to attend a trial, hearing, or deposition OR to produce documents or things in his/her possession. Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 45(c) limits a subpoena's reach, so it may command attendance at a trial, hearing, or deposition:

• within 100 miles of where the subpoenaed person resides, is employed, or regularly transacts business or

• within the state where the subpoenaed person resides, is employed, or regularly transacts business if he/she is a party or a party's officer (or a person commanded to attend trial who would not incur substantial expense). Here, the subpoena commanded an officer of the company (defendant) to attend a deposition in the State A city where the employee resides. The city is 175 miles away from where the officer regularly transacts business (the company's headquarters) and 200 miles away from the officer's State A residence. But since the city where the deposition will occur is in the state where the officer resides, the subpoena may command her attendance at the deposition (Choices A & C). Therefore, the officer must comply with the subpoena.

(Choice B) The city where the deposition will occur is located in a different state (State A) than the company's headquarters (State B)—where the officer performs all her

employment duties. However, the subpoena can still command the officer's attendance since she resides in State A.

Educational objective:

A subpoena can compel attendance at a trial, hearing, or deposition within 100 miles of where the subpoenaed person resides, works, or transacts business. It can also compel attendance of the parties and their officers—and persons commanded to attend trial who would not incur substantial expense—within the state where the person resides, works, or transacts business.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 45(c) (place of compliance for subpoena).

explanation.zh:
传票遵守地点

(FRCP 45(c))

审判、听讯或作证

Subpoena可以指挥人员出席:

• 在人员居住、受雇或经常交易的100英里以内;

· 在人员居住、受雇或经常从事商业活动的国家内,如果人员是:当事方或当事方的官员或奉命出席审判并不会引起大笔费用;

• 在人员居住、受雇或经常从事商业交易的100英里之内,制作文件、有形物品或ESI;

• 视察待视察的场所民事诉讼规则;ESI = 电子存储信息

传票是法院的一项书面命令,命令某人出席审判、听讯或作证,或出示其拥有的文件或物品。《联邦民事诉讼规则》第45(c)条限制传票的送达范围,因此可以命令出席审判、听讯或作证:

• 在被传唤者居住、受雇或经常交易的100英里以内;

• 在被传唤者居住、受雇或经常从事商业活动的国家内,如果他/她是一方或一方的官员(或奉命出席审判而不会引起大笔费用的人)。在此,传票命令公司的一名官员(被告)参加在雇员居住国A市的一次证词。该市距离该官员经常进行业务交易的地点(公司总部)175英里,距离该官员的A州官邸200英里.但是,由于证词发生的城市位于警官居住的地方,传票可以命令她出席证词(Choices A & C)。 因此,警官必须服从传票。

(Choice B) 将进行取证的城市位于与公司总部(B州)不同的州(A州)——官员在那里履行她的全部职责。

然而,传票仍然可以命令警官从她开始就出庭。住在A州。

学习要点：

传票可以迫使被传票人在其居住、工作或交易地点100英里以内出席审判、听讯或作证。它还可以迫使当事人及其官员(以及受命出席审判而不会花费大笔费用的人)在当事人居住、工作或交易业务的国家内出庭。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 45(c)(传票遵守地点)。

stem:
A symphony was scheduled to perform a famous songwriter's music at a concert in 10 days. After a disagreement with the symphony's conductor, the songwriter told the conductor that he could no longer use her songs. The conductor stated that he was going to proceed with the concert as planned.

The songwriter filed a verified complaint against the conductor and the symphony in a federal district court for copyright infringement. The songwriter also moved for a temporary restraining order (TRO) to stop the concert from proceeding. The songwriter did not provide notice to the defendants but argued that the court should immediately issue an ex parte TRO.
stemZh:
一场交响乐团计划在10天后的一场音乐会中演奏一位著名词曲作者的音乐。在与交响乐团指挥发生争执后，这位词曲作者告诉指挥，她不能再使用自己的歌曲。指挥表示他将按计划继续进行音乐会。

词曲作者向联邦地区法院提起诉讼，起诉指挥和交响乐团侵犯版权。词曲作者还申请临时禁令（TRO），以阻止音乐会进行。词曲作者未向被告发出通知，但辩称法院应立即签发一项无证人听证的TRO。
ask: How will the federal district court likely rule on the songwriter's motion?
askZh: 联邦地区法院如何裁定词曲作者的申请？

options.en: Deny the motion, because notice must be given to an opposing party before a court may issue a TRO.
options.zh: 驳回申请，因为法院在签发TRO前必须向对方当事人发出通知。

options.en: Deny the motion, because the songwriter's attorney failed to certify in writing why the defendants need not be notified.
options.zh: 驳回申请，因为词曲作者的律师未能书面说明为何无需通知被告。

options.en: Grant the motion, because an ex parte TRO is justified under the circumstances.
options.zh: 批准申请，因为在此情况下无证人听证的TRO是合理的。

options.en: Grant the motion, because federal courts have exclusive jurisdiction over claims based on copyright infringement.
options.zh: 批准申请，因为联邦法院对基于版权侵权的索赔拥有专属管辖权。

explanation.en:
Preliminary relief

(FRCP 65)

Type Required contents Effect

Preliminary injunction

Notice of hearing

• State reasons issued

• Reasonably describe acts restrained or required

• Specify terms

Persons bound upon receiving actual notice of order:

• parties to the case

• parties' officers, agents, employees & attorneys

• anyone in active concert/participation with above persons

Temporary restraining order

Ex parte

(no notice)

Above requirements plus:

• date & hour issued

• why injury is irreparable

• why issued without notice

• promptly filed with clerk & entered into record FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

A temporary restraining order (TRO) is a court order that commands a party to do or stop doing a specified action for 14 days or until a preliminary-injunction hearing can take place—whichever occurs first. This preserves the parties' status quo until the court can fully consider the issue at a hearing. Unlike a preliminary injunction, a TRO may be issued without notice to the nonmovant (ie, ex parte). But to prevent abuse and protect the rights of all involved, a federal court can issue an ex parte TRO only if:

• the movant files an affidavit or verified complaint containing specific facts showing that he/she will suffer immediate and irreparable harm before the nonmovant can be heard and

• the movant's attorney certifies in writing any efforts made to give notice and the reasons why notice should not be required (Choice A).*

Here, even if the songwriter's verified complaint specifically shows that she will suffer immediate and irreparable harm, the songwriter's attorney failed to certify in writing why

the defendants need not be notified. As a result, an ex parte TRO is not justified under the circumstances, and the court will likely deny the songwriter's motion (Choice C).

*Additionally, a federal court will issue a preliminary injunction or TRO only if the movant provides security (eg, a bond) sufficient to pay the costs and damages if the nonmovant is improperly restrained.

(Choice D) Although federal courts have exclusive jurisdiction over copyright infringement claims, this does not provide a basis to grant a TRO.

Educational objective:

A temporary restraining order can be issued without notice only if (1) the movant files an affidavit or verified complaint that specifically shows he/she will suffer immediate and irreparable harm and (2) the movant's attorney certifies in writing any efforts made to give notice and why notice is not required.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 65(b) (requirements for an ex parte TRO).

• 11A Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 2952 (3d ed. 2020) (explaining the process for issuing an ex parte TRO).

explanation.zh:
初步救济

(FRCP 65) (法语).

需要的内容类型

初步禁令

听讯通知

• 提出国家理由

• 合理描述受约束或需要的行为

• 指定术语

接到实际命令通知的人:

• 案件当事方

• 政党官员、代理人、雇员和律师

• 与上述人员积极进行音乐/参与的任何人

临时限制令

单方面

(无通知)

高于所需经费外加:

• 印发日期和时数

• 伤害为何无法弥补

• 为何未经通知印发

• 迅速向书记员备案并记录在案 FRICP=联邦民事诉讼规则。

临时禁止令(TRO)是法院的命令,命令一方在14天之内采取或停止采取特定行动,或直到可以进行初步禁止审讯为止——无论哪种情况先发生。这保持了当事人的现状,直到法院能够在庭审中充分审议这个问题,与初步禁令不同的是,可以不通知非动议方(即单方面)而签发TRO。但是,为了防止滥用和保护所有有关方面的权利,联邦法院只有在下述情况下才能发布单方面TRO:

• 机动部队提交书面证词或经核实的起诉状,其中包含具体事实,表明在听取非机动人员的陈述之前,他或她将立即遭受不可弥补的伤害;

• 莫万律师书面证明为发出通知所作的任何努力以及不需要发出通知的理由(Choice A)。

在这里,即使歌曲作者经核实的起诉状具体表明她会立即遭受无法弥补的伤害,但歌曲作者的律师没有书面证明为什么

因此,在当时情况下,单方面的TRO是没有道理的,法庭很可能驳回作曲者的动议(Choice C)。

* 此外,只有在机动车提供足以支付费用和损害的担保(例如保证金)时,如果非机动车人受到不当限制,联邦法院才会发布初步禁令或TRO。

(Choice D) 尽管联邦法院对侵犯版权的索赔拥有专属管辖权,但这并不能提供准予TRO的依据.

学习要点：

只有在(1) Movant提交宣誓书或经核实的起诉状,具体表明他/她将受到立即和不可弥补的损害,(2) Movant的律师书面证明他/她已做出任何努力的情况下,才可不经通知签发临时限制令。通知和为什么不需要通知。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 65(b)(对单方面TRO的要求)。

• 11A Charles Alan Wright等人,《联邦惯例和程序》第2952节(3d编,2020年)(解释发布单方面TRO的程序)。

stem:
A plaintiff from State A sued a defendant from State B in a federal court in State B. The plaintiff claims that the defendant breached a provision of their contract, which resulted in $100,000 in damages. The defendant filed and served an answer denying liability.

Three months later, the plaintiff stopped performing his duties under the contract. The defendant would now like to assert a claim against the plaintiff for breach of contract for $80,000.
stemZh:
一名原告来自 A 州，在 B 州的联邦法院起诉一名来自 B 州的被告。原告声称被告违反了他们合同中的条款，导致了 100,000 美元的损害。被告提交并送达了答辩状，否认了责任。

三个月后，原告停止履行合同下的义务。被告现在希望对原告提出违约合同的索赔，金额为 80,000 美元。
ask: What is the best way for the defendant to pursue her claim?
askZh: 被告追索其主张的最佳方式是什么？

options.en: File a new suit in the same court.
options.zh: 在同一家法院提起新的诉讼。

options.en: File a reply.
options.zh: 提交答复状。

options.en: File an amended answer as a matter of course.
options.zh: 作为当然事项提交修订后的答辩状。

options.en: Move for leave to file a supplemental answer.
options.zh: 申请许可提交补充答辩状。

explanation.en:
Amended v. Supplemental pleading

(FRCP 15)

Amended pleading • Asserts transaction, occurrence, or event that arose before pleading to be amended was filed

• Amend by right, with opposing party's written consent, or by leave of court

• Supersedes pleading to be amended Supplemental pleading

• Asserts transaction, occurrence, or event that arose after pleading to be supplemented was filed

• Supplement by leave of court

• Does not supersede pleading to be supplemented FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure

Parties can modify their pleadings in two ways:

• Amended pleadings – to set forth a transaction, occurrence, or event that arose before the pleading to be amended was filed

• Supplemental pleadings – to set forth a transaction, occurrence, or event that arose after the pleading to be supplemented was filed

Here, the plaintiff allegedly breached his contractual duties three months after the defendant filed and served her answer. Therefore, the best way for the defendant to pursue a counterclaim for breach of contract is to move for leave (ie, permission) to file a supplemental answer that sets forth that claim. The court will then determine whether to allow the supplemental pleading.

(Choice A) The defendant could file a new suit against the plaintiff in the same court, but this would likely be more time-consuming and expensive than filing a supplemental answer in the pending action. Therefore, this is not the best way for the defendant to pursue her breach-of-contract claim.

(Choice B) Filing a reply is not the best way for the defendant to assert her counterclaim against the plaintiff. That is because a reply is typically a response made by the plaintiff to the defendant's answer and is permitted only when the court orders one (not seen here).*

*A reply can also be a response by the defendant to a plaintiff's counterclaim answer, a third-party answer, or a crossclaim answer—none of which is seen here.

(Choice C) An amended answer would have been proper had the defendant's breach-of-contract claim arisen before she filed her original answer. And even if it had, she could not

have amended her answer as a matter of course—ie, without the court's permission or the plaintiff's written consent. That is because more than 21 days have elapsed since her answer was served.

Educational objective:

An amended pleading is used to set forth a transaction, occurrence, or event that arose before the pleading to be amended was filed. In contrast, a supplemental pleading is used to set forth a transaction, occurrence, or event that arose after the pleading to be supplemented was filed.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 15 (amended and supplemental pleadings).

• 61A Am. Jur. 2d Pleading § 669 (2019) (explaining the difference between an amended and supplemental pleading).

explanation.zh:
修正诉补充答辩

(FRCP15)

• 提出抗辩前发生的交易、事件或事件已提出修正

• 经对方书面同意或法院许可,以正确方式修正

• 替代请求修正的补充请求

• 提出补充请求后产生的交易、发生或事件

• 经法院许可的补充

• 不取代要求补充FRCP = 联邦民事诉讼规则

当事方可以两种方式修改其诉状:

• 修正书状 -- -- 列出在提出修正书状之前发生的交易、事件或事件

• 补充书状 -- -- 列出在提出补充书后发生的交易、发生或事件

在此,据称原告在被告提出并答复三个月后违反了合同义务。因此,被告对违反合同提出反诉的最好办法是(e) 请求(即允许)提出补充答复,提出这一请求。然后,法院将决定是否允许补充上诉。

(Choice A) 被告可以在同一法院对原告提起新的诉讼,但这可能比在未决诉讼中提出补充答复更为费时和昂贵。因此,这不是被告提出违约索赔的最佳方式。

(选择B) 提交答辩书并不是被告对原告提出反诉的最佳方式。这是因为,答复通常是原告对被告的答复,只有在法院下令答复(此处不见)的情况下才允许答复。

* 答复也可以是被告对原告反诉的答复、第三方的答复,也可以是反诉的答复——这里没有看到。

如果被告在提出最初的答复之前就提出了违反合同的索赔,修正后的答复本来是适当的。

当然,她已经修改了答案 未经法庭许可或原告的书面同意。这是因为,自从她得到答复以来,已经超过21天。

学习要点：

修正的抗辩书用于说明在提出修正抗辩之前发生的交易、发生或事件。与此相反,补充性抗辩用于说明在提出补充抗辩之后发生的交易、发生或事件。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P.15(修正和补充书状)。

• 61A Am. Jur. 2d 书状第669条(2019年)(解释修正书状和补充书状之间的区别)。

In contrast, a supplemental pleading is used to set forth a transaction, occurrence, or event that arose after the pleading to be supplemented was filed.

stem:
A mail clerk domiciled in State A slipped and fell on ice that had formed near the loading dock of the building in State B where the clerk's State B employer leased space for its headquarters. The building was owned and operated by a State C corporation. As a result of the fall, the clerk was injured and the employer's expensive computer he was carrying was badly damaged.

The clerk sued the building owner for negligence in a federal district court in State B, seeking $100,000 in personal-injury damages. The employer has filed a timely motion to intervene, asserting an $80,000 negligence claim against the building owner for the damage to its computer.
stemZh:
一名在 A 州有住所的邮差在 B 州某建筑物的装卸码头附近滑倒摔伤。该建筑物由 C 州公司所有并运营，该邮差的雇主在 B 州租赁该建筑物作为总部。由于摔倒，邮差受伤，其雇主携带的昂贵电脑也严重损坏。

邮差在 B 州联邦地区法院起诉建筑物所有者，指控其疏忽，要求 100,000 美元的个人伤害赔偿。雇主已及时提出介入动议，主张对建筑物所有者提出 80,000 美元的疏忽索赔，以赔偿其电脑的损坏。
ask: Is the court likely to grant the employer's motion to intervene?
askZh: 法院很可能批准雇主的介入动议吗？

options.en: No, because although the employer has an interest in the clerk's action, that interest is not likely to be impaired in the employer's absence.
options.zh: 否，因为尽管雇主在邮差的诉讼中有利益，但该利益在雇主缺席时不太可能受损。

options.en: No, because the clerk chose not to join the employer as a co-plaintiff in his action.
options.zh: 否，因为邮差选择不将雇主作为共同原告加入其诉讼中。

options.en: Yes, because the employer is an indispensable party.
options.zh: 是，因为雇主是不可或缺的当事人。

options.en: Yes, because the employer's claim shares common questions of law and fact with the clerk's action.
options.zh: 是，因为雇主的索赔与邮差的诉讼在法律和事实上有共同的问题。

explanation.en:
Intervention

(FRCP 24)

Intervention of right

• On timely motion, court must permit intervention when either: – nonparty's interest in case not adequately represented by existing parties & deciding case may impair nonparty's ability to protect that interest – federal statute gives unconditional right to intervene Permissive intervention

• On timely motion, court may permit intervention when either: – nonparty's claim or defense shares common question of law or fact with main action – federal statute gives conditional right to intervene

• Court must consider whether intervention will unduly delay or prejudice adjudication of original parties' rights FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

A nonparty can join a case to protect his/her interest by timely filing a motion to intervene under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (FRCP) 24.* There are two types of intervention:

• Intervention of right – the court must permit an intervention when (1) the nonparty's interest is inadequately represented by the existing parties and (2) deciding the case may impair the nonparty's ability to protect that interest.

• Permissive intervention – the court may permit an intervention when the nonparty's claim or defense shares a common question of law or fact with the main action. But a court may deny permissive intervention if it would unduly delay or prejudice the adjudication of the original parties' rights. Here, the employer timely moved to intervene in the clerk's action against the building owner. Although the employer's interest (property-damage claim) is inadequately represented by the existing parties, deciding the clerk's personal-injury action is not likely to impair the employer's ability to protect its interest (no intervention of right). But since both actions are based on the owner's alleged negligence (common questions of law and fact), the court will likely allow the employer to permissively intervene (Choice A).

*To determine if a motion to intervene is timely filed, the court considers (1) the length of time the movant knew or should have known about its threatened interest, (2) the prejudice to the parties if intervention is permitted, and (3) the prejudice to the movant if intervention is denied.

(Choice B) The clerk's decision to exclude the employer as a co-plaintiff does not affect the employer's ability to intervene.

(Choice C) Under FRCP 19, an indispensable party must be joined in a lawsuit. But the employer is not an indispensable party because the employer's absence would not affect the court's ability to provide relief to the clerk or the employer's ability to protect its related property interest.

Educational objective:

Intervention must be permitted when the nonparty's interest is inadequately represented and deciding the case may impair his/her ability to protect that interest (ie, intervention of right). And intervention may be permitted when the nonparty's claim or defense shares a common question with the main action (ie, permissive intervention).

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 24 (intervention).

explanation.zh:
干预

(FRCP24)

权利的干预

• 在及时提出动议时,法院必须允许以下两种情况下的干预: 由现有当事方不能充分代表非当事方的利益和裁决案件可能损害非当事方保护该利益的能力; 联邦法规赋予无条件的干预权允许干预

• 在及时提出动议后,法院可允许进行干预,条件是:-非当事方的主张或辩护与主要行动有共同的法律或事实问题-联邦法规给予有条件的干预权

• 法院必须考虑干预是否会不适当地拖延或影响对原当事人权利的裁决

非当事方可加入案件,根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第24条及时提出干预动议,以保护其利益。

• 干预权利——当(1) 现有当事方未充分代表非当事方的利益和(2) 裁决案件可能损害非当事方保护该利益的能力时,法院必须允许干预。

• 允许性干预——当非当事方的主张或辩护与主要诉讼有共同的法律问题或事实时,法院可以允许干预。但法院如果会不适当地拖延或损害对原当事人权利的裁决,可以拒绝允许性干预。 在这方面,雇主及时采取行动干预书记员对建筑业主的诉讼。虽然现有当事方没有充分代表雇主的利益(财产损害索赔),但决定书记员的人身伤害行为不会损害雇主保护其利益的能力(不干预权利)。但是,由于这两项行动都是基于业主指称的疏忽(常见的法律和事实问题),法院很可能允许雇主随意干预(Choice A)。

* 为了确定干预动议是否及时提出,法院审议了(1) 机动军知道或应当知道其受威胁利益的时间长度,(2) 如果允许干预,对当事人的偏见,(3) 机动军的偏见,如果拒绝干预。

(Choice B)书记员决定排除雇主为共同原告并不影响雇主的干预能力.

(选择C)根据FRCP 19,一个不可或缺的当事方必须参与诉讼,但雇主不是不可或缺的当事方,因为雇主不在不会影响法院向书记员提供救济的能力或雇主保护其能力。相关财产权益。

学习要点：

在非当事方的利益没有得到充分代表的情况下必须允许干预,对案件的裁决可能损害其保护该利益的能力(即权利干预)。当非当事方的主张或辩护与主要行动(即允许干预)有共同的问题时,可以允许干预。

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P.24(干预)。

stem:
On March 1, 2017, a woman tripped and fell on a cruise ship, sustaining severe injuries. On February 28, 2018, she brought a diversity action in federal court against the entity she believed owned the cruise ship. The entity was served with process the same day. The entity immediately forwarded the complaint to the office of legal counsel for the corporation that owned the cruise ship.

Two weeks later, the entity filed and served its answer in which it denied ownership of the cruise ship. The entity explained that it was merely a ticketing agency with a name similar to the corporation that owned the ship.

The next day, the woman amended her complaint to substitute the corporation that owned the cruise ship as the defendant and had process served on the corporation. The corporation immediately moved to dismiss the suit, arguing that the statute of limitations had expired.

The applicable statute of limitations for the claim is one year from the date the accident allegedly occurred. The law establishing this statute of limitations does not mention relation back.
stemZh:
2017年3月1日，一名女子在游轮上绊倒并跌倒，造成严重伤害。2018年2月28日，她在美国联邦法院提起基于不同州籍管辖权的诉讼，起诉她认为拥有该游轮的实体。该实体当天收到诉讼文书送达。该实体立即将其投诉转交给拥有该游轮的公司法律事务办公室。

两周后，该实体提交并送达了其答辩状，否认拥有该游轮。该实体解释称，它只是一个售票代理，其名称与拥有该游轮的公司相似。

第二天，该女子修改其投诉，将拥有该游轮的公司作为被告，并向该公司送达了诉讼文书。该公司立即提出驳回诉讼动议，理由是诉讼时效已过。

该索赔的适用诉讼时效为事故发生之日起一年。确立该诉讼时效的法律未提及诉讼时效的延长。
ask: Should the court grant the corporation's motion to dismiss?
askZh: 法院应否批准该公司的驳回诉讼动议？

options.en: No, because the amended complaint relates back to the date the original complaint was filed.
options.zh: 否，因为修改后的投诉可追溯至原投诉提交的日期。

options.en: No, because the woman may freely amend her complaint once as a matter of course.
options.zh: 否，因为该女子可以自由修改其投诉，作为常规事项。

options.en: Yes, because the amended complaint was filed after the statute of limitations expired.
options.zh: 是，因为修改后的投诉是在诉讼时效届满后提出的。

options.en: Yes, because the applicable law does not mention relation back.
options.zh: 是，因为适用的法律未提及诉讼时效的延长。

explanation.en:
An amended complaint filed after the statute of limitations has expired is prohibited unless the relation-back doctrine applies. This doctrine treats the amended complaint as if it were filed on the same date as the original complaint. An amendment that changes a defendant "relates back" only if the statute of limitations allows (not seen here) OR when:

• the amendment concerns the same transaction or occurrence as the original complaint

• the new party received notice of the suit within 90 days after the original complaint was filed and

• the new party knew or should have known that the suit would have been brought against it but for a mistake concerning the proper party's identity.

Here, the woman's amended complaint concerns the same cruise ship accident. The corporation that owns the cruise ship received notice when the ticketing agency forwarded the complaint. And the corporation should have known that the suit would have been brought against it but for the woman's mistake about its identity. As a result, the amendment relates back to the date the original complaint was filed on February 28, 2018—before the statute of limitations expired. Therefore, the corporation's motion to dismiss should be denied (Choices C & D).

(Choice B) A party may amend its complaint once as a matter of course—ie, without the court's permission or the opposing party's written consent—within 21 days after being served with an answer. But the amendment must be filed (or relate back to an original pleading filed) before the statute of limitations expires.

Educational objective:

An amended complaint will "relate back" to the date of the original complaint if (1) the same occurrence is at issue, (2) the new party received notice of the suit within 90 days after the original complaint was filed, and (3) the new party knew or should have known the suit would have been brought but for a mistake about its identity.

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 15(c) (relation back of amended pleadings).

• Krupski v. Costa Crociere S.p.A, 560 U.S. 538, 557 (2010) (holding that the relation-back doctrine applies when a company should have known that it would have been

sued had the plaintiff not made a mistake).

explanation.zh:
法定时效期满后提出的修正性起诉状,除非适用关系回溯原则,否则是禁止的,该原则将修正后的起诉状视为与原起诉状在同一日期提出的。只有在诉讼时效允许(此处不见)或有下列情形时,才能修改被告“追溯”的修正案:

• 修正案涉及与原起诉状相同的交易或事件

• 新当事方在提出原始起诉状后90天内收到诉讼通知;

• 新当事方知道或应该知道,如果不是在适当当事方的身份上犯错误,本会对其提起诉讼。

在此,该妇女经修改的起诉状涉及同一邮轮事故,拥有该邮轮的公司在售票机构提交起诉状时收到了通知。公司应该知道 诉讼会带来与它对立,但 女人的错误 有关其身份。因此,修正案涉及的是2018年2月28日――诉讼时效到期之前――提出原始起诉状的日期,因此,应当驳回该公司的驳回申请(Choices C & D)。

(选择B) 一当事方在得到答复后的21天内,当然可以修改其起诉状一次——即未经法院同意或对方的书面同意。但修正案必须在诉讼时效期满前提出(或与已提出的原始诉状有关)。

学习要点：

修改后的起诉状,如果 (1) 同一案件发生争议, (2) 新当事人在原起诉状提出后90日内收到诉讼通知, (3) 新当事人知道或者应当知道本来可以提起诉讼的 除非是认错人

参考资料

• Fed. R. Civ. P.15(c)(与经修正的书状的关系)。

• Krupski诉Costa Crociere S.p.A, 560 U.S.538, 557(2010)(认为当一家公司知道本来会是公司时,即适用关系背学说)

如果原告没有犯错,则被起诉。
