ask: Which of the following acts by the United States Senate would be constitutionally IMPROPER?
askZh: 美国参议院的下列法案中,有哪一项将在宪法上改进?

options.en: The Senate appoints a commission to adjudicate finally a boundary dispute between two states.
options.zh: 参议院任命一个委员会,最终裁定两个邦之间的边界争端。

options.en: The Senate decides, with the House of Representatives, that a disputed state ratification of a proposed constitutional amendment is valid.
options.zh: 参议院与众议院决定,有争议的州批准拟议的宪法修正案是有效的.

options.en: The Senate determines the eligibility of a person to serve as a senator.
options.zh: 参议院决定一个人担任参议员的资格.

options.en: The Senate passes a resolution calling on the President to pursue a certain foreign policy.
options.zh: 参议院通过决议,呼吁总统推行一定的外交政策.

explanation.en:
Independent legislative powers

(legislative-action process not required)

Legislative body Powers

House of Representatives

• Impeach federal officials

• Elect President (when electoral-college threshold not met)

• Determine internal rules & members' eligibility

• Punish/expel members for bad behavior Senate • Try impeached federal officials

• Confirm/reject presidential appointments

• Approve/reject treaties

• Determine internal rules & members' eligibility

• Punish/expel members for bad behavior Full Congress • Propose constitutional amendments

• Decide disputes regarding ratification of amendments Article I prescribes the method Congress (ie, the House of Representatives and the Senate) must use to take any action that alters the legal rights of persons outside the legislative branch (ie, legislative action). Under this method, most legislative action must be:

• approved by both houses of Congress (ie, bicameralism) and

• presented to the President for approval or disapproval (ie, presentment). But certain legislative powers are independent and do not require bicameralism and/or presentment. These include:

• the power of the Senate, together with the House of Representatives, to decide disputes regarding the ratification of amendments (no presentment required)

(Choice B) and

• the power of the Senate to determine a person's eligibility to serve as a senator (no bicameralism or presentment required) (Choice C).

These independent legislative powers do not include the power to appoint a commission to adjudicate boundary disputes between two states. Therefore, it would be constitutionally improper for the Senate to do so without adhering to bicameralism and presentment.

(Choice D) A resolution does not amount to legislative action because it is a nonbinding recommendation that has no effect on the legal rights of persons outside the legislative

branch. Therefore, the Senate can pass a resolution calling on the President to pursue a certain foreign policy without adhering to bicameralism or presentment.

Educational objective:

Absent narrow exceptions, all legislative action must be approved by both houses of Congress (ie, bicameralism) AND presented to the President for approval or disapproval (ie, presentment).

References

• Coleman v. Miller, 307 U.S. 433, 456 (1939) (explaining that Congress controls the promulgation of the adoption of constitutional amendments).

• INS v. Chadha, 462 U.S. 919, 952 (1983) (explaining that legislative action is subject to bicameralism and presentment when Congress alters the legal rights, duties, and relations of persons outside the legislative branch).

explanation.zh:
独立立法权

(不需要立法-行动程序)

立法机构

众议院

• 弹劾联邦官员

• 选举总统(选举-联谊会门槛未达到)

• 确定内部规则和成员的资格

• 惩罚/驱逐行为不良的议员

• 确认/拒绝总统任命

• 批准/反对条约

• 确定内部规则和成员的资格

• 惩罚/驱逐行为不良的成员修正案

• 就批准修正案的争议作出裁决 第一条规定了国会(即众议院和参议院)必须使用何种方法来采取任何改变立法部门以外人员合法权利的行动(即立法行动)。根据这种方法,大多数立法行动必须是:

• 议会两院批准(即两院制)和

· 提交总统批准或不批准(即呈递),但某些立法权力是独立的,不需要两院制和(或)呈递。

• 参议院与众议院一起作出决定的权力关于批准修正案的争议(无需提交)

(选择B)和

• 参议院有权决定一个人是否有资格担任参议员(不需要两院制或介绍)(选择C)。

这些独立的立法权力不包括任命一个委员会来裁决两个州之间的边界争端的权力,因此,在宪法上,参议院这样做而不坚持两院制和表现是不适当的。

(选择D) 决议不等于立法行动,因为它是一项不具约束力的建议,对立法之外的人的合法权利没有影响。

因此,参议院可以通过一项决议,呼吁总统奉行某种外交政策,而不必遵守两院制或提出。

学习要点：

在没有狭义例外的情况下,所有立法行动都必须由国会两院(即两院制)批准,并提交总统批准或不批准(即,呈递).

参考资料

• Coleman诉Miller案,307 U.S.433,456(1939)(解释国会控制宪法修正案的颁布)。

• INS诉Chadha案,462 U.S.919,952(1983)(解释立法行动须实行两院制,并在国会改变立法部门以外人员的法律权利、义务和关系时提出)。

stem:
A federal statute enacted pursuant to the power of Congress to enforce the Fourteenth Amendment prohibits any state from requiring any of its employees to retire from state employment solely because of their age. The statute expressly authorizes employees required by a state to retire from state employment solely because of their age to sue the state government in federal district court for any damages resulting from that state action.

On the basis of this federal statute, a retiree sues State X in federal district court. State X moves to dismiss the suit on the ground that Congress lacks authority to authorize such suits against a state.
stemZh:
一项联邦法律，根据国会执行第十四修正案的权力，禁止任何州要求其雇员仅因年龄而退休。该法律明确授权那些因年龄而被州要求退休的雇员，可向联邦地区法院起诉该州政府，以获得因该州行为而产生的任何损害赔偿。

基于该联邦法律，一名退休人员在美国联邦地区法院起诉州 X。州 X 提出驳回诉讼动议，理由是国会无权授权此类针对州的诉讼。
ask: Which of the following is the strongest argument that the retiree can offer in opposition to the state's motion to dismiss this suit?
askZh: 以下哪一项是退休人员反对州提出驳回诉讼动议的最强有力论据？

options.en: When Congress exercises power vested in it by any provision of the Constitution, Congress has unlimited authority to authorize private actions for damages against a state.
options.zh: 当国会行使宪法赋予其的任何条款的权力时，国会拥有无限权力授权公民对州提起损害赔偿诉讼。

options.en: When Congress exercises power vested in it by the Fourteenth Amendment, Congress may enact appropriate remedial legislation expressly subjecting the states to private suits for damages in federal court.
options.zh: 当国会行使由第十四修正案赋予其的权力时，国会可以颁布适当的补救性立法，明确使州对联邦法院中的私人损害赔偿诉讼承担责任。

options.en: While the Eleventh Amendment applies to suits in federal court by citizens of one state against another state, it does not apply to such suits by citizens against their own states.
options.zh: 虽然第十一修正案适用于公民对另一州提起的诉讼，但它不适用于公民对自身州提起的诉讼。

options.en: While the Eleventh Amendment restrains the federal judiciary, that amendment does not limit the power of Congress to modify the sovereign immunity of the states.
options.zh: 虽然第十一修正案限制联邦司法权，但该修正案并不限制国会修改州主权豁免权的权力。

explanation.en:
Eleventh Amendment

(state immunity from suit in federal court)

Immunity • Suit brought by private party or foreign government

• Suit against state official violating state law

• Exceptions: – State consents to suit – Immunity removed by 13th, 14th, or 15th Amendment – State official sued for injunctive or declaratory relief – Damages to be paid by state officer personally (not state treasury) – State official sued for prospective (not retroactive) damages to be paid by state treasury No immunity

• Suit brought by United States or other state

• Suit against local government (eg, counties, municipalities)

• Bankruptcy proceedings The Eleventh Amendment generally forbids the federal courts from hearing private suits for damages against the states. Congress cannot override this ban, even to exercise one of its constitutionally enumerated powers (Choices A & D). But there is a narrow exception to this rule when Congress is clearly acting to enforce the Civil War Amendments (eg, Fourteenth Amendment—as seen here). In that case, it may enact appropriate remedial legislation expressly subjecting the states to private suits for damages in federal court.

(Choice C) The Eleventh Amendment applies to all private suits for damages against the states—including suits by citizens against their own state. But it does not bar Congress from authorizing such suits as a means of enforcing the Civil War Amendments.

Educational objective:

The Eleventh Amendment generally forbids the federal courts from hearing private suits for damages against the states. But Congress can authorize such suits when it is clearly acting to enforce the Civil War Amendments (ie, Thirteenth, Fourteenth, and Fifteenth Amendments).

References

• United States v. Georgia, 546 U.S. 151, 158–59 (2006) (explaining that the Fourteenth Amendment allows Congress to abrogate state sovereign immunity by authorizing private suits for damages against the states).

explanation.zh:
第十一次修正

(国家豁免联邦法院的诉讼)

• 私人或外国政府提出的诉讼

• 对违反州法律的国家官员提起诉讼

• 例外:- 国家同意诉 - 第13、14或15修正案取消豁免 - 国家官员被起诉要求强制或宣告性救济 - 国家官员个人(不是国库)应支付的损害 - 国家官员被起诉预期(不是)国家财政应支付的赔偿

• 美国或其他国家提出的诉讼

• 起诉地方政府(例如县、市)

第十一修正案一般禁止联邦法院审理针对各州的私人损害赔偿诉讼,国会不能推翻这一禁令,甚至不能行使宪法列举的一项权力(Choices A & D)。但这一规则有一个狭义的例外,即国会显然正在采取行动执行内战修正案(例如,第十四修正案——在这里可以看到)。在这种情况下,法院可以颁布适当的补救立法,明确要求各州在联邦法院接受私人损害赔偿诉讼。

第十一修正案适用于所有针对各州的私人损害赔偿诉讼,包括公民针对本州的诉讼。 但它并不妨碍国会授权将此类诉讼作为实施内战修正案的手段。

学习要点：

第十一条修正案一般禁止联邦法院审理针对各州的私人损害赔偿诉讼.但国会在明确采取行动执行内战修正案(即第十三、十四和十五修正案)时,可以授权此类诉讼。

参考资料

• 美国诉格鲁吉亚案,546 U.S.151,158-59(2006年)(解释第十四修正案允许国会通过授权对各州提出损害赔偿的私人诉讼而废除国家主权豁免)。

stem:
A federal statute extends federal minimum wage requirements to all dry cleaning stores. The statute contains express findings that, when combined, the wages received by dry cleaning workers have a substantial impact on the national economy and on the flow of goods and services in interstate commerce. These findings are supported by information presented to Congress during committee hearings on the legislation.

A small dry cleaning store operates exclusively within a community in the center of a geographically large state. It has no customers from outside the state. It employs three workers, each of whom is paid less than the federal minimum wage.
stemZh:
一项联邦法律将联邦最低工资要求扩展适用于所有干洗店。该法律包含明确的认定，即干洗工所获得的工资对全国经济以及商品和服务在州际贸易中的流动具有实质性影响。这些认定得到了国会立法听证会上提交给国会的信息的支持。

一家小型干洗店仅在其所处的州内一个社区内运营。它没有来自州外的客户。它雇佣了三名工人，每位工人都获得的工资低于联邦最低工资。
ask: Must this dry cleaning store comply with the statute imposing the federal minimum wage requirements on all dry cleaning stores?
askZh: 这家干洗店必须遵守适用于所有干洗店的该法律所规定的联邦最低工资要求吗？

options.en: No, because the store does no business in interstate commerce.
options.zh: 否，因为该店不从事州际贸易业务。

options.en: No, because the wages of the store's three workers do not have a substantial impact on interstate commerce.
options.zh: 否，因为该店三名工人的工资对州际贸易没有实质性影响。

options.en: Yes, because the commerce clause vests Congress with plenary legislative authority over labor relations.
options.zh: 是，因为宪法的商业条款赋予国会对劳资关系的完全立法权。

options.en: Yes, because the wages paid by dry cleaning stores have a substantial impact on interstate commerce.
options.zh: 是，因为干洗店支付的工资对州际贸易有实质性影响。

explanation.en:
The Article I commerce clause gives Congress broad power to regulate interstate commerce—ie, nearly all activities involving two or more states. This includes the power to regulate the following:

• channels of interstate commerce (eg, highways, waterways)

• instrumentalities of interstate commerce (eg, trucks, trains)

• persons or things moving in interstate commerce (eg, goods, electricity) and

• in-state activities that—singly or in the aggregate—substantially impact interstate commerce. Here, the federal statute requires all dry cleaning stores to pay their employees a minimum wage. This includes the small dry cleaning store that employs three low-wage workers, whose wages alone do not have a substantial impact on interstate commerce. But when the wages paid by all dry cleaning stores are added together (ie, aggregated), they do have a substantial impact on interstate commerce (Choice B). Therefore, Congress can regulate these wages under the commerce clause, and the store must comply with the minimum wage requirement.

(Choice A) Although the store does no business in interstate commerce, Congress can regulate the store's wages since the aggregate wages paid by all dry cleaning stores have a substantial impact on interstate commerce.

(Choice C) The commerce clause does not vest Congress with plenary (ie, absolute) legislative authority over labor relations. Congress can only regulate labor relations that substantially affect interstate commerce, and states can also regulate labor relations so long as they comply with the dormant commerce clause.

Educational objective:

The commerce clause gives Congress broad authority to regulate interstate commerce— including in-state activities that substantially impact interstate commerce singly or in the aggregate.

References

• Gonzales v. Raich, 545 U.S. 1, 17 (2005) (holding that Congress can regulate purely local activities that are part of an economic class of activities that have a substantial effect on interstate commerce).

• NLRB v. Jones & Laughlin Steel Corp., 301 U.S. 1, 36–37 (1937) (recognizing that Congress's commerce powers extend to activities that impact interstate commerce independently or in combination with other sources).

explanation.zh:
第一条商业条款赋予国会管理州际商业的广泛权力——即几乎所有涉及两个或两个以上州的活动。

• 州际商业渠道(例如高速公路、水道)

• 州际商务工具(例如卡车、火车)

• 在州际商业中流动的人员或物品(例如货物、电力)和

· 州内活动——单独或合计——对州际商业产生实质影响,在这方面,联邦法规要求所有干洗店向雇员支付最低工资。这包括雇用三名低工资工人的小型干洗店,这些工人的工资单靠对州际商务没有重大影响。但当所有干洗店支付的工资加在一起(即,汇总)时,确实对州际商业(Choice B)有重大影响.因此,国会可以根据商业条款管理这些工资,商店必须遵守最低工资要求。

(Choice A) 虽然该店在州际商务中不从事任何业务,但国会可以管理该店的工资,因为所有干洗店支付的工资总额对州际商务有重大影响.

(选择C)商业条款并没有赋予国会全体会议(即绝对)对劳资关系的立法权力.国会只能规范对州际商业有重大影响的劳动关系,各州也可以规范劳动关系,只要遵守休眠的商业条款.

学习要点：

商业条款赋予国会管理州际商业的广泛权力——包括州内活动,这些活动单独或总共对州际商业产生重大影响。

参考资料

• Gonzales诉Raich案,545 U.S. 1, 17 (2005)(认为国会可以管制纯当地活动,这些活动属于对州际商务有重大影响的经济类活动)。

• NLRB诉Jones & amp;Laughlin Steel Corp.,301 U.S. 1, 36–37 (1937年)(承认国会的商务权力扩大到独立或与其他来源共同影响国家间商务的活动)。

stem:
A jury convicted a federal district court judge of bribery. When the judge subsequently refused to resign from his office, the House of Representatives adopted and presented to the Senate an article of impeachment that charged the judge with bribery. Pursuant to its rules for impeachment, the Senate authorized a committee of senators to hold closed-door hearings to take testimony and receive evidence related to the impeachment charge. At the conclusion of the hearings, the committee reported the facts and summarized the evidence to the full Senate. Based on the committee's report, the Senate voted to convict the judge and remove him from office.

The judge has filed suit in federal court to enjoin the Senate from removing him from office. The judge claims that the Senate violated Article I of the U.S. Constitution by prohibiting the full Senate from taking part in the hearings.
stemZh:
一名联邦地区法院法官被陪审团判定犯有受贿罪。当该法官随后拒绝辞去其职务时，众议院通过并提交参议院一项弹劾条款，指控该法官犯有受贿罪。根据其弹劾规则，参议院授权一组参议员举行闭门听证会，以听取证词并接收与弹劾指控相关的证据。在听证会结束后，该委员会向参议院全体报告了事实并总结了证据。根据委员会的报告，参议院投票决定谴责该法官并将其从职务上解除。

该法官在联邦法院提起诉讼，请求法院阻止参议院将其从职务上解除。该法官声称，参议院违反了美国宪法第一条，禁止全体参议院参与听证会。
ask: If the court dismisses the judge's action, what will be the most likely reason?
askZh: 如果法院驳回该法官的诉讼，最可能的原因是什么？

options.en: The action involves a nonjusticiable political question.
options.zh: 该诉讼涉及一个不可裁决的政治问题。

options.en: The action is moot.
options.zh: 该诉讼已失去诉讼资格。

options.en: The judge lacks standing.
options.zh: 该法官缺乏诉讼资格。

options.en: The U.S. Supreme Court has original and exclusive jurisdiction over the action.
options.zh: 美国最高法院对该诉讼拥有专属和排他性的管辖权。

explanation.en:
Nonjusticiable political questions

(issues incapable of judicial resolution)

• Recognition of foreign governments

• Reception of ambassadors

• Nature of wars/hostilities

• Partisan gerrymandering

• Guarantee of republican form of government

• Recognition of Native American tribes

• House/Senate rules for impeachment

• Ratification process for constitutional amendments Article III of the U.S. Constitution grants federal courts the power to decide justiciable cases and controversies. However, some actions are not capable of judicial resolution (ie, nonjusticiable). This includes actions implicating the political-question doctrine. Under this doctrine, federal courts are prohibited from deciding political questions that should be resolved by another branch of government. A case presents a nonjusticiable political question when:

• the issue has been reserved to the executive or legislative branch and/or

• there is a lack of judicially discoverable and manageable standards to resolve the issue.

Here, the judge seeks to enjoin the Senate from removing him from office. He claims that the Senate violated Article I of the U.S. Constitution by prohibiting the full Senate from participating in the evidentiary hearings. However, the impeachment and removal of federal judges is a power reserved solely to Congress,* and there are no standards to help a court resolve an impeachment process issue. Therefore, the court will most likely dismiss the judge's action because it involves a nonjusticiable political question.

*Congress also has the exclusive power to impeach and remove the President, Vice President, and other federal officers (eg, the U.S. Attorney General).

(Choice B) A suit is also nonjusticiable if it is moot—ie, when the suit no longer presents an actual controversy for the court to resolve. Here, the judge's action is not moot since his harm has not been resolved. However, the federal courts cannot provide relief because his claim presents a nonjusticiable political question.

(Choice C) The judge has standing because he suffered an injury-in-fact (removal from office) that was caused by the challenged action (impeachment procedure) and is redressable by the remedy sought (injunction).

(Choice D) The U.S. Supreme Court has original jurisdiction over cases that affect ambassadors, public ministers, or consuls OR involve a state as a party (neither seen here). Additionally, the Supreme Court has exclusive jurisdiction over suits between states (not seen here).

Educational objective:

Federal courts must dismiss a suit that presents a nonjusticiable political question. This occurs when (1) the Constitution reserves the issue to another branch of government and/or (2) the court lacks judicially discoverable and manageable standards to resolve the issue.

References

• Nixon v. United States, 506 U.S. 224, 238 (1993) (holding that the impeachment process presents a nonjusticiable question that is reserved to the legislative branch).

• Baker v. Carr, 369 U.S. 186, 210–17 (1962) (explaining the political-question doctrine).

• 32 Am. Jur. 2d Fed. Courts § 574 (2020) (listing common examples of political questions).

explanation.zh:
不可审理的政治问题

(无法司法解决的问题)

• 承认外国政府

• 接待大使

• 战争/敌对行动的性质

• Partisan采石场

• 保障共和政体

• 承认美洲原住民部落

• 众议院/参议院弹劾规则

• 批准宪法修正案的程序 《美国宪法》第三条赋予联邦法院裁决可审理的案件和争议的权力,但有些行动无法通过司法途径解决(即不可审理)。这包括涉及政治问题理论的行动。根据这一理论,联邦法院不得就应当属于以下范畴的政治问题作出裁决:一个案件提出了不可审理的政治问题:

• 这个问题被保留给行政部门或立法机构和(或)

· 缺乏可司法发现和可管理的标准来解决这一问题。

在此,法官试图命令参议院免去他的职务,他声称参议院禁止参议院全体议员参加证据听证会,违反了美国宪法第一条.然而,对联邦法官的弹劾和罢免是只留给国会的权力,* 没有标准帮助法院解决弹劾程序问题.因此,法院极有可能驳回法官的行动,因为它涉及一个不可审理的政治问题。

*国会还拥有弹劾和罢免总统,副总统和其他联邦官员(如美国总检察长)的专属权力.

(Choice B)如果诉讼没有实际意义,那么诉讼也是不可审理的——当诉讼不再引起实际争议供法院解决时,在这方面,法官的行动没有实际意义,因为他的伤害尚未解决。然而,联邦法院不能提供补救,因为他的诉求提出了不可审理的政治问题。

(选择C) 法官之所以能站立,是因为他遭受了因受到质疑的行动(弹劾程序)造成的实际伤害(离职),并且可以通过所寻求的补救(禁止)予以补救。

(Choice D) 美国最高法院对影响大使,公使,或领事或涉及一国为一方的案件拥有原审管辖权(这里都看不到).此外,最高法院对各州之间的诉讼拥有专属管辖权(此处不见)。

学习要点：

联邦法院必须驳回提出不可审理的政治问题的诉讼,这发生在(1) 《宪法》将问题保留给另一政府部门和(或)(2) 法院缺乏司法上可发现和可管理的标准来解决问题。

参考资料

^ 尼克松诉美国案,506 U.S.224,238(1993)(认为弹劾程序提出了一个不可审理的问题,保留给立法部门).

· Baker诉Carr案,369 U.S.186, 210–17 (1962)(解释政治问题理论)。

• 32 Am. Jur. 2d Fed. Courts §574(2020)(列举政治问题的共同例子)。

stem: Congress passed a statute providing that parties could no longer seek review in the U.S. Supreme Court of final judgments in criminal matters made by the highest court in each state.
stemZh: 国会通过了一项法律，规定当事人不能再就各州最高法院作出的刑事事项的最终判决向美国最高法院寻求复审。
ask: What is the best argument supporting the constitutionality of the statute?
askZh: 支持该法律合宪性的最佳论点是什么？

options.en: Congress has the power to make exceptions to the appellate jurisdiction of the Supreme Court.
options.zh: 国会拥有对最高法院上诉管辖权的例外情形的制定权力。

options.en: Criminal matters are traditionally governed by state law.
options.zh: 刑事事项传统上由州法律管辖。

options.en: The proper means of federal judicial review of state criminal matters is by habeas corpus.
options.zh: 联邦法院对州刑事事项的司法审查的适当方式是通过人身保护令。

options.en: The review of state court judgments is not within the original jurisdiction of the Supreme Court.
options.zh: 州法院判决的审查不在最高法院的原始管辖权范围内。

explanation.en:
SCOTUS jurisdiction

Type Definition Applicability

Original

(Congress cannot adjust)

Case filed directly in SCOTUS

Cases involving either:

• ambassador/public minister/consul or

• state as party Appellate

(Congress may limit)

Case filed after decision by either:

• lower federal court or

• highest state court

All other cases by either:

• writ of certiorari or

• direct appeal (rare)

SCOTUS = Supreme Court of the United States.

The U.S. Supreme Court (SCOTUS) has appellate jurisdiction to review a final judgment of lower federal courts and the highest state courts when the judgment turns on federal law. But the Article III exceptions clause gives Congress almost unlimited power to regulate or make exceptions to this jurisdiction. Therefore, that is the best argument supporting the constitutionality of the statute prohibiting SCOTUS from reviewing final judgments in criminal matters made by the highest court in each state.

(Choice B) Although criminal matters are traditionally governed by state law, SCOTUS can review final judgments in state criminal cases involving an alleged violation of the Constitution, a federal law, or a treaty.

(Choice C) A person in custody can file a petition for a writ of habeas corpus in federal court to challenge the legality of his/her detention. But a habeas corpus petition is a separate civil suit—not part of the criminal appeals process. So, the better argument is that Congress can make exceptions to SCOTUS's appellate jurisdiction.

(Choice D) The review of state court judgments is not within SCOTUS's very limited original jurisdiction (ie, power to hear a case first and render a decision). But it is within SCOTUS's appellate jurisdiction.

Educational objective:

The U.S. Supreme Court's appellate jurisdiction extends to final judgments of lower federal courts and the highest state courts when the judgment turns on federal law. But the Article III exceptions clause gives Congress extensive power to regulate and make exceptions to this jurisdiction.

References

• Ex parte McCardle, 74 U.S. 506, 514 (1869) (establishing that Congress has almost unlimited power to make exceptions to the Supreme Court's appellate jurisdiction).

explanation.zh:
SCOTUS管辖权

类型 定义的适用

原文

(大会不能调整)

案件直接提交至SCOTUS

涉及下列案件:

• 大使/公使/领事或

• 作为当事方提出上诉

(大会可能限制)

案件在裁决后由下列任何一方提交:

• 下级联邦法院或

• 最高法院

所有其他案件:

• 证书状或

• 直接上诉(很少)

SCOTUS = 美国最高法院.

美国最高法院(SCOTUS)拥有上诉管辖权,可以在判决转向联邦法时审查下级联邦法院和最高州法院的最后判决.但是第三条的例外条款赋予国会几乎无限的权力来规范或规定这一管辖权的例外.因此,这是支持禁止SCOTUS审查各州最高法院对刑事事项作出的最后判决的法规是否符合宪法的最佳论据。

(Choice B) 虽然刑事问题传统上由州法律管辖,但最高司法法院可以审查州刑事案件中涉及据称违反宪法、联邦法律或条约的最终判决。

(C) 被拘留者可向联邦法院申请人身保护令状,对拘留的合法性提出质疑。 但人身保护令状是单独的民事诉讼,不属于刑事上诉程序。因此,更好的论据是国会可以对SCOTUS的上诉管辖权作出例外规定.

(Choice D) 对州法院判决的复审不属于SCOTUS非常有限的原始管辖权(即首先审理案件并作出裁决的权力),但它属于SCOTUS的上诉管辖权.

学习要点：

美国最高法院的上诉管辖权延伸到联邦下级法院和最高州法院在判决转向联邦法时的最后判决.但第三条的例外条款赋予国会广泛的权力来管理和规定这一管辖权的例外.

参考资料

• Ex parte McCardle,74 U.S. 506,514 (1869)(规定国会几乎拥有无限的权力,可以对最高法院的上诉管辖权作出例外规定)。

stem: The National AIDS Prevention and Control Act is a new, comprehensive federal statute that was enacted to deal with the public health crisis caused by the AIDS virus. Congress and the President were concerned that inconsistent lower court rulings with respect to the constitutionality, interpretation, and application of the statute might adversely affect or delay its enforcement and thereby jeopardize the public health. As a result, they included a provision in the statute providing that all legal challenges concerning those matters may be initiated only by filing suit directly in the United States Supreme Court.
stemZh: 《国家艾滋病预防与控制法》是一项新的、全面的联邦法律，旨在应对由艾滋病病毒引起的公共卫生危机。国会和总统担心，关于该法律合宪性、解释和适用的不一致的下级法院裁决可能会对该法律的执行产生不利影响或拖延，从而危及公共健康。因此，他们在该法律中加入了一项条款，规定所有关于上述事项的法律挑战只能通过直接向美国最高法院提起诉讼的方式进行。
ask: Is the provision authorizing direct review of the constitutionality, interpretation, or application of this statute only in the United States Supreme Court constitutional?
askZh: 该条款授权仅在美利坚合众国最高法院对本法律的合宪性、解释或适用进行直接审查，是否符合宪法？

options.en: No, because it denies persons who wish to challenge this statute the equal protection of the laws by requiring them to file suit in a court different from that in which persons who wish to challenge other statutes may file suit.
options.zh: 否，因为它剥夺了希望挑战本法律的人们获得法律平等保护的权利，要求他们必须在不同于其他法律挑战者可提起诉讼的法院提起诉讼。

options.en: No, because it is inconsistent with the specification in Article III of the original jurisdiction of the United States Supreme Court.
options.zh: 否，因为它与《美国宪法》第三条关于美利坚合众国最高法院原始管辖权的规定不一致。

options.en: Yes, because Article III provides that the jurisdiction of the United States Supreme Court is subject to such exceptions and such regulations as Congress shall make.
options.zh: 是，因为《美国宪法》第三条提供，美利坚合系法院的管辖权应受国会所制定的例外和规章的约束。

options.en: Yes, because it is authorized by the Article I power of Congress to enact all laws that are "necessary and proper" to implement the general welfare.
options.zh: 是，因为它得到了《美国宪法》第一条关于国会制定所有为实施公共福利所必需和适当的法律的权力的授权。

explanation.en:
SCOTUS jurisdiction

Type Definition Applicability

Original

(Congress cannot adjust)

Case filed directly in SCOTUS

Cases involving either:

• ambassador/public minister/consul or

• state as party Appellate

(Congress may limit)

Case filed after decision by either:

• lower federal court or

• highest state court

All other cases by either:

• writ of certiorari or

• direct appeal (rare)

SCOTUS = Supreme Court of the United States.

Article III gives the U.S. Supreme Court (SCOTUS) original jurisdiction—ie, the authority to directly review a case—in two rare circumstances:

• when a case affects an ambassador, public minister, or consul and

• when a state is a party to the suit. Congress cannot expand or restrict SCOTUS's original jurisdiction beyond Article III's specifications (Choice C). Since the statutory provision attempts to do so by authorizing SCOTUS to directly review challenges to the National AIDS Prevention and Control Act, it is unconstitutional.

(Choice A) This provision implicates the equal protection component of the Fifth Amendment because it treats persons challenging this statute differently than persons challenging other statutes. But since the provision does not substantially impact a fundamental right or protected class, it likely does not violate this component.

(Choice D) Article I allows Congress to enact laws that are "necessary and proper" (ie, reasonably appropriate) to carry out its enumerated powers—including the power to spend for the public's general welfare. But when doing so, it cannot violate other constitutional provisions (eg, Article III—as seen here).

Educational objective:

Article III gives the U.S. Supreme Court original jurisdiction over cases (1) that affect an ambassador, public minister, or consul or (2) in which a state is a party. And Congress cannot alter SCOTUS's original jurisdiction.

References

• Marbury v. Madison, 5 U.S. 137, 174–76 (1803) (holding that Congress cannot alter the Supreme Court's original jurisdiction).

• 32 Am. Jur. 2d Federal Courts § 453 (2019) (defining original and appellate jurisdiction).

(大会可能限制)

案件在裁决后由下列任何一方提交:

• 下级联邦法院或

• 最高法院

所有其他案件:

• 证书状或

• 直接上诉(很少)

SCOTUS = 美国最高法院.

第三条赋予美国最高法院(SCOTUS)在两种罕见情况下直接审查案件的权力:

• 案件影响到大使、公使或领事;

• 当一个国家是诉讼当事方时,国会不能扩大或限制SCOTUS的原管辖权,超出第三条的规格(Choice C)。由于该法律规定试图通过授权SCOTUS直接审查对《国家艾滋病预防和控制法》的质疑来达到这一目的,这不符合宪法。

(选择A) 这项规定涉及第五修正案的平等保护部分,因为它对质疑该规约的人的待遇不同于对其他规约提出质疑的人。但是,由于这项规定对基本权利或受保护的阶层没有重大影响,因此它可能不会违反这一组成部分。

(Choice D) 第一条允许国会颁布"必要和适当的"(即合理适当的)法律,以行使其列举的权力——包括为公众普遍福利而花费的权力.但是,在这样做的时候,它不能违反其他宪法规定(例如,第三条——如这里所见)。

第三条赋予美国最高法院对(1) 影响大使、公使或领事或(2) 州为一方的案件的原始管辖权。 国会不能改变SCOTUS的原始管辖权。

• 32 Am. Jur. 2d联邦法院第453条(2019年)(界定原管辖权和上诉管辖权)。

stem: In order to reduce the federal deficit, Congress enacted a statute imposing a five percent national retail sales tax. The tax was levied upon all retail sales in the United States and applied equally to the sales of all kinds of goods.
stemZh: 为了减少联邦赤字，国会通过了一项法律，征收百分之五的全国零售销售税。该税项对美国所有零售销售征收，并对所有种类商品的销售一视同仁。
ask: Is this tax constitutional as applied to retail sales of newspapers?
askZh: 该税项是否适用于报纸零售销售的宪法性？

options.en: No, because retail sales taxes are within the taxing power of the states.
options.zh: 否，因为零售销售税属于各州的征税权范围。

options.en: No, because the imposition of a tax on the sale of newspapers violates the freedom of the press.
options.zh: 否，因为对报纸销售征税违反了言论自由。

options.en: Yes, because it is within Congress's power to tax.
options.zh: 是，因为国会拥有征税的权力。

options.en: Yes, because the tax is necessary to serve the compelling interest of balancing the federal budget.
options.zh: 是，因为该税项是为实现平衡联邦预算的迫切利益所必需的。

explanation.en:
The taxing and spending clause (ie, general welfare clause) gives Congress broad authority to raise revenue through taxation. This includes the power to impose indirect taxes (eg, sales tax) if they are applied equally in every state AND are reasonably related to revenue production—as seen here.

But a tax also must respect other constitutional provisions—including the First Amendment freedom of the press. The retail sales tax does so here because it is generally applicable to all goods and in no way targets press operations (Choice B). And since the sales tax does not implicate any other constitutional provisions, it is a constitutional exercise of Congress's taxing power—even as applied to retail sales of newspapers.

(Choice A) Retail sales taxes are within the taxing power of the states as well as Congress's enumerated taxing power.

(Choice D) The tax need not be necessary to serve a compelling interest because it is generally applicable and does not target the press.

Educational objective:

Indirect taxes must be applied equally in every state and reasonably related to revenue production. And such taxes cannot violate any other constitutional provision—eg, by targeting the press in violation of the First Amendment.

References

• Leathers v. Medlock, 499 U.S. 439, 447 (1991) (holding that the government may not exercise its taxing power to single out the press or target small groups of speakers).

explanation.zh:
税收和支出条款(即一般福利条款)赋予国会通过税收来增加收入的广泛权力.这包括有权征收间接税(例如销售税),如果这些税在每一个州都得到同等适用,并且与收入生产有合理的关系——如这里所见。

但是,税收也必须尊重其他宪法条款,包括第一修正案的新闻自由。 零售销售税是在这里实行的,因为它一般适用于所有商品,绝不针对新闻业务(Choice B)。由于销售税不涉及任何其他宪法条款,因此这是对国会征税权的宪法行使,即使适用于报纸的零售。

(Choice A)零售销售税属于各州的征税权以及国会列举的征税权.

(Choice D) 税因普遍适用而不针对新闻界,因此没有必要为迫切利益服务。

间接税必须平等地适用于各州,并且与收入生产有合理关系。 而这种税不能违反任何其他宪法规定,例如违反第一修正案,针对新闻界。

stem: "Look-alike drugs" is the term used to describe nonprescription drugs that look like narcotic drugs and are sold on the streets as narcotic drugs. After extensive hearings, Congress concluded that the sale of look-alike drugs was widespread in this country and was creating severe health and law-enforcement problems. To combat these problems, Congress enacted a comprehensive statute that regulates the manufacture, distribution, and sale of all look-alike drugs in the United States.
stemZh: “外观相似药物”是指那些外观类似麻醉药品的非处方药，这些药物在街头被当作麻醉药品出售。经过广泛的听证会后，国会得出结论认为，这种外观相似药物的销售在美国非常普遍，并造成了严重的健康和执法问题。为了解决这些问题，国会通过了一项全面的法律，规范美国所有外观相似药物的制造、分销和销售。
ask: Which of the following sources of constitutional authority can most easily be used to justify the authority of Congress to enact this statute?
askZh: 以下哪一项宪法授权来源最便于用来证明国会通过该法律的权力？

options.en: The commerce clause.
options.zh: 商业条款。

options.en: The enforcement powers of the Fourteenth Amendment.
options.zh: 第十四修正案的执法权力。

options.en: The general welfare clause.
options.zh: 福利条款。

options.en: The spending power.
options.zh: 支出权力。

explanation.en:
Commerce power to regulate

activities that substantially affect interstate commerce

To determine if Congress can regulate, consider whether:

• activity is economic in nature (then substantial effect presumed)

• jurisdictional element limits reach to activities with direct connection to interstate commerce

• express congressional findings that activity substantially affects interstate commerce and

• strong link between activity & effect on interstate commerce Congress's extensive power to regulate interstate commerce extends to nearly all activities that (1) involve two or more states or (2) have a substantial effect on interstate commerce. To determine whether activities have a substantial effect that triggers Congress's commerce power, courts consider whether:

• the activities are economic in nature (if so, a substantial effect is presumed)

• the regulation has a jurisdictional element that limits its reach to activities with a direct connection to or effect on interstate commerce

• there are express congressional findings concerning the activities' effect on interstate commerce and

• there is a strong link between the regulated activities and that effect.

Here, the commerce clause most easily justifies Congress's enactment of a statute that regulates the manufacture, distribution, and sale of look-alike drugs. That is because, while some of these activities may only occur in one state (eg, manufacturing), all of them are economic in nature. It is therefore presumed that these activities have a substantial effect on interstate commerce and are subject to Congress's commerce powers.

(Choice B) The Fourteenth Amendment enforcement clause authorizes Congress to enact legislation enforcing the amendment's other provisions. But those other provisions only apply to state actors—not the private individuals likely selling look-alike drugs here.

(Choices C & D) The taxing and spending clause (ie, general welfare clause) gives Congress the power to tax and spend for the general welfare. But here, the comprehensive statute regulating the manufacture, distribution, and sale of look-alike drugs goes beyond merely taxing and spending.

Educational objective:

An activity is presumed to have a substantial effect on interstate commerce that warrants regulation by Congress when the activity is economic in nature.

References

• Gonzales v. Raich, 545 U.S. 1, 32–33 (2005) (upholding the constitutionality of a federal drug law since in-state marijuana cultivation substantially affects interstate commerce).

explanation.zh:
商业监管权

影响国家间商业的活动

为了确定国会是否能够监管,考虑:

• 活动具有经济性质(当时假定的重大影响)

• 管辖权要素限制与州际商务直接相关的活动

• 表示国会的结论,即活动对州际商业和

· 活动和对州际商务的影响之间的密切联系,国会管理州际商务的广泛权力扩大到几乎所有(1)涉及两个或两个以上州或(2)对州际商务有重大影响的活动。为了确定活动是否具有引发国会商业权力的重大影响,法院考虑:

• 活动具有经济性质(如果具有经济性质,可推定有实质影响)

• 该条例具有管辖权要素,其范围限于与州际商务有直接联系或对其产生影响的活动

• 关于这些活动对州际商务的影响,国会有明确的调查结果和

• 受管制的活动与这种效果之间有密切的联系。

这里,商业条款最容易成为国会颁布一项法规的理由,该法规对长相相似的药物的制造、分销和销售进行管理。这是因为,虽然其中一些活动可能只发生在一个国家(例如制造业),但都是经济性质的。因此,可以推定这些活动对州际商务有重大影响,并受国会商业权力的制约.

(Choice B)第十四修正案的执行条款授权国会颁布执行修正案其他条款的立法。 但其他条款只适用于国家行为者,而不是可能在这里出售类似药物的私人。

(Choices C & D) 征税和支出条款(即一般福利条款)赋予国会征税和为一般福利支出的权力.但是,在这里,规范长相药物的制造、分销和销售的全面法规不仅仅是征税和开支。

学习要点：

一项活动被认为对州际商务有重大影响,如果该项活动是经济活动,则需要国会加以管制。

参考资料

stem: Congress enacted a statute prohibiting discrimination in the rental of residential property anywhere in the United States on the basis of sexual orientation or preference by any person or entity, public or private.
stemZh: 国会通过了一项法律，禁止在美国任何地方基于性取向或性偏好对住宅财产的租赁进行歧视，由任何个人或实体，公共或私人实施。
ask: Which of the following provisions provides the strongest basis for Congress's authority to enact this statute?
askZh: 以下哪项条款为国会制定该法律的权力提供了最强有力的依据？

options.en: The commerce clause of Article I, Section 8.
options.zh: 第一修正案第八款的商业条款。

options.en: The enforcement clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.
options.zh: 第十四修正案的执行条款。

options.en: The general welfare clause of Article I, Section 8.
options.zh: 第一修正案第八款的一般福利条款。

options.en: The privileges and immunities clause of Article IV.
options.zh: 第四修正案的特权与豁免条款。

explanation.en:
The commerce clause of Article I, section 8 gives Congress broad regulatory authority over most activities involving two or more states. This includes the power to regulate:

• the channels of interstate commerce (eg, airports)

• the instrumentalities of interstate commerce (eg, planes)

• people and things moving in interstate commerce (eg, commercial shipments) and

• activities that, singly or in the aggregate, substantially affect interstate commerce (presumed when activity is economic in nature).

Here, Congress enacted a statute prohibiting discrimination based on sexual orientation in the rental of residential property. Since renting is an economic activity, there is a strong presumption that this activity substantially affects interstate commerce. Therefore, the commerce clause provides the strongest basis for Congress's authority to enact this statute to regulate that activity.

(Choice B) Under the Fourteenth Amendment's enforcement clause, Congress can enact legislation to enforce the amendment's other provisions against state actors—but not private actors (eg, residential landlords).

(Choice C) The Article I, section 8 taxing and spending clause (ie, general welfare clause) only empowers Congress to tax and spend for the general welfare—not to prohibit rental discrimination.

(Choice D) The Article IV privileges and immunities clause prohibits states from discriminating against out-of-state citizens by denying them a right of state citizenship. But this clause is a limitation on state power—not a basis for congressional authority.

Educational objective:

The commerce clause grants Congress extensive authority to regulate (1) the channels of interstate commerce, (2) the instrumentalities of interstate commerce, (3) persons and things moving in interstate commerce, and even (4) activities that substantially affect interstate commerce.

References

• Heart of Atlanta Motel, Inc. v. United States, 379 U.S. 241, 258 (1964) (holding that the commerce clause allows Congress to prohibit racial discrimination by local motels serving travelers).

explanation.zh:
第一条第8节的商务条款赋予国会对涉及两个或两个以上国家的大多数活动的广泛管制权。

• 州际商业渠道(例如机场)

• 国家间商业工具(例如飞机)

• 在州际商业(例如商业货运)中流动的人员和物品

• 单独或合计地对州际商务产生重大影响的活动(假定活动属于经济活动)。

在这方面,国会颁布了一项法规,禁止在出租住宅地产方面基于性取向的歧视,因为出租是一种经济活动,因此有强烈的假定,这种活动会严重影响州际商业。因此,商业条款为国会颁布这一法规以管理这项活动提供了最坚实的基础。

(Choice B)根据第十四修正案的执行条款,国会可以颁布立法,执行修正案针对国家行为者的其他规定,而不是针对私人行为者(例如住宅房东).

第一条第8节征税和开支条款(即一般福利条款)只授权国会为一般福利征税和开支,而不是禁止租金歧视。

(Choice D)第四条的特权与豁免条款禁止国家歧视州外公民,剥夺他们国家公民权。 但这一条款是对国家权力的限制,而不是国会权力的基础。

学习要点：

商务条款赋予国会广泛权力,对(1)州际商务的渠道,(2)州际商务的工具,(3)在州际商务中移动的人员和物品,甚至(4)对州际商务有重大影响的活动进行管理.州际商业。

stem:
A federal statute admitting a state to the Union granted the state certain public lands and established some very ambiguous conditions on the state's subsequent disposition of these lands. This federal statute also required the new state to write those exact same conditions into its state constitution.

One hundred years later, a state statute dealing with the sale of these public lands was challenged in a state court lawsuit on the ground that it was inconsistent with the conditions contained in the federal statute and with the provisions of the state constitution that exactly copy the conditions contained in the federal statute.

The trial court decision in this case was appealed to the state supreme court. In its opinion, the state supreme court dealt at length with the ambiguous language of the federal statute and with cases interpreting identical language in federal statutes admitting other states to the union. The state supreme court opinion did not discuss the similar provisions of the state constitution, but it did hold that the challenged state statute is invalid because it is "inconsistent with the language of the federal statute and therefore is inconsistent with the identical provisions of our state constitution."
stemZh:
一项联邦法律承认一个州加入联邦，向该州授予了某些公共土地，并对该州随后处置这些土地设定了某些非常模糊的条件。该联邦法律还要求新州将其州宪法中包含与联邦法律中相同条件。

一百年后，一项关于处置这些公共土地的州法律在州法院诉讼中被挑战，理由是该法律与联邦法律中的条件以及与复制联邦法律条件的州宪法条款不一致。

本案的初审法院判决被上诉至州最高法院。在意见中，州最高法院详细讨论了联邦法律中模糊的措辞以及解释其他州加入联邦的联邦法律中相同措辞的案例。州最高法院的意见没有讨论州宪法中类似的条款，但它认为被挑战的州法律无效，因为该法律"与联邦法律的措辞不一致，因此与我们州宪法中的相同条款不一致。"
ask: If the losing party in the state supreme court seeks review of the decision of that court in the United States Supreme Court, how should the United States Supreme Court proceed?
askZh: 如果州最高法院的败诉方寻求在美国最高法院对州最高法院的裁决进行审查，美国最高法院应该如何处理？

options.en: The court should accept the case for review and determine the validity of the interpretation of the federal statute if it is an important and substantial question.
options.zh: 法院应接受案件进行审查，并确定联邦法律的解释是否是一个重要且重大的问题。

options.en: The court should ask the state supreme court to indicate more clearly whether it relied on the state constitutional provision in rendering its decision.
options.zh: 法院应要求州最高法院说明其在裁决中是否依赖州宪法条款。

options.en: The court should decline to review the case because a decision by a state supreme court concerning the proper disposition of state public lands is not reviewable by the United States Supreme Court.
options.zh: 法院应拒绝审查此案，因为州最高法院关于州公共土地适当处置的裁决不能由美国最高法院进行审查。

options.en: The court should decline to review the case on the ground that the decision of the state supreme court rests on an adequate and independent state ground.
options.zh: 法院应以州最高法院的裁决基于一个充分且独立的州法律理由为由拒绝审查此案。

explanation.en:
The Supreme Court of the United States (SCOTUS) has appellate jurisdiction to review decisions issued by lower federal courts and the highest state courts that concern important and substantial issues of federal law. But SCOTUS has no jurisdiction to review a state court decision that is supported by state-law grounds that are both:

• adequate – when state law completely resolves the matter such that the application of federal law would not affect the outcome of the case and

• independent – when the state court did not rely on federal law to reach its decision. Here, a state statute dealing with the sale of certain public lands was challenged in state court and held to be inconsistent with a federal statute and the state constitution (adequate state grounds). But the state supreme court's decision relied on federal case law that interpreted identical language in other federal statutes (no independent state grounds)

(Choice D). Therefore, SCOTUS should review the state supreme court's interpretation if it is an important and substantial question.

(Choice B) The state supreme court explicitly stated that it relied on federal case law, so no clarification is needed. But even if the grounds for the state court's decision were unclear, SCOTUS would not ask the state court for clarification. Instead, SCOTUS would assume that the state court used federal law to reach its decision, rule on the federal issue, and remand the case to state court to resolve any remaining state-law issues.

(Choice C) SCOTUS can review a state supreme court decision—even if it involves the proper disposition of state public lands—as long as that decision was not based on adequate and independent state-law grounds.

Educational objective:

The U.S. Supreme Court has no jurisdiction to review a state court decision based on an adequate state-law ground that completely resolves the case independent of federal law.

References

• Michigan v. Long, 463 U.S. 1032, 1040–41 (1983) (explaining when a state supreme court judgment rests on adequate and independent state-law grounds).

• 4 Am. Jur. 2d Appellate Review § 44 (2019) (listing the rules to determine whether a decision rests on adequate and independent state grounds).

explanation.zh:
美国最高法院(SCOTUS)拥有上诉管辖权,可以审查下级联邦法院和州最高法院作出的涉及联邦法重要实质问题的裁决.但SCOTUS无权审查州法院的裁决,该裁决有州法理由支持,这些理由包括:

• 适当——当州法律完全解决了问题,联邦法律的适用不会影响案件的结果时;

• 独立 — — 当州法院不依靠联邦法律作出决定时。 在此,州法院对涉及出售某些公共土地的州法规提出质疑,认为该州法规不符合联邦法规和州宪法。但州最高法院的裁决依据联邦判例法解释其他联邦法规中相同的语言(没有独立的州理由)

因此,如果国家最高法院的解释是一个重要和实质性的问题,最高法院应审查这种解释。

(Choice B)州最高法院明确指出,它依赖联邦判例法,因此不需要澄清。 但即使州法院裁决的理由不明确,SCOTUS也不会要求州法院澄清。相反,SCOTUS会假设州法院利用联邦法律作出决定,对联邦问题作出裁决,并将案件发回州法院解决任何剩余的州法问题.

SCOTUS可以审查州最高法院的裁决——即使它涉及适当处置州的公共土地——只要该裁决不是基于充分和独立的州法理由。

学习要点：

美国最高法院没有管辖权审查州法院基于充分完全独立于联邦法律的州法依据。

参考资料

• 密歇根州诉Long案,463 U.S. 1032, 1040–41(1983)(解释州最高法院何时根据适当和独立州法理由作出判决)。

• 4 Am. Jur. 2d 上诉复审第44条(2019年)(列出规则,以确定裁决是否基于充分和独立的国家理由)。

stem:
The National Ecological Balance Act prohibits the destruction or removal of any wild animals located on lands owned by the United States without express permission from the Federal Bureau of Land Management. Violators are subject to fines of up to $1,000 per offense.

After substantial property damage was inflicted on residents of a state by hungry coyotes, the state legislature passed the Coyote Bounty Bill, which offers $25 for each coyote killed or captured within the state. A national forest, owned by the federal government, is located entirely within the state. Many coyotes live in the national forest.

Without seeking permission from the Bureau of Land Management, a hunter shot several coyotes in the national forest and collected the bounty from the state. As a result, he was subsequently tried in federal district court, convicted, and fined $1,000 for violating the National Ecological Balance Act. The hunter appealed his conviction to the United States Court of Appeals.
stemZh:
《国家生态平衡法》禁止在属于美国所有的土地上，未经联邦土地管理局明确许可，破坏或移除任何野生动物。违反该法的行为，每项违规可处以最高 1,000 美元的罚款。

在一只饥饿的郊狼对某州居民造成重大财产损失后，该州立法机关通过了《郊狼赏金法案》，该法案规定，凡在该州内捕杀或捕捉到一只郊狼，可获得 25 美元的赏金。一个由联邦政府所有的国家森林完全位于该州境内。许多郊狼生活在该国家森林中。

一名猎人在未经土地管理局许可的情况下，在该国家森林中射杀了几只郊狼，并从该州领取了赏金。因此，他随后在联邦地区法院受审，被判定有罪，并因违反《国家生态平衡法》被处以 1,000 美元的罚款。该猎人就其定罪向美国上诉法院提出上诉。
ask: On appeal, should the Court of Appeals hold the National Ecological Balance Act constitutional as applied to the hunter?
askZh: 在上诉中，上诉法院应否认定《国家生态平衡法》适用于该猎人且合宪？

options.en: No, because Congress may not use its delegated powers to override the Tenth Amendment right of the state to legislate in areas of traditional state governmental functions, such as the protection of the property of its residents.
options.zh: 否，因为国会不能利用其委托的权力来推翻第十修正案所保障的州在传统州政府职能领域立法的权利，例如保护其居民财产。

options.en: No, because Congress violates the full faith and credit clause of Article IV when it punishes conduct that has been authorized by state action.
options.zh: 否，因为当国会惩罚已被州行为授权的行为时，违反了《联邦宪法》第四条中的完全诚信条款。

options.en: Yes, because Article I, Section 8, of the Constitution authorizes Congress to enact all laws necessary and proper to advance the general welfare.
options.zh: 是，因为《联邦宪法》第一条、第八条授权国会制定所有为促进公共福利所必需且适当的法律。

options.en: Yes, because the property clause of Article IV, Section 3, of the Constitution authorizes such federal statutory controls and sanctions.
options.zh: 是，因为《联邦宪法》第四条、第三款中的财产条款授权此类联邦立法控制和制裁。

explanation.en:
Article IV clauses

Clause Requirements

Full faith & credit States must recognize public acts, records & judicial proceedings of other states

Privileges & immunities

States cannot deny rights of state citizenship to citizens of other states

Property Congress can dispose of & regulate federal land/territories

Guarantee Federal government must guarantee states republican form of government & protect states from invasion

The Article IV, section 3 property clause gives Congress complete power to dispose of and regulate federally owned land and territories—including the wildlife living thereon. As a result, Congress can prohibit the destruction or removal of wild animals on federal land without permission from the Federal Bureau of Land Management. And since the hunter shot coyotes in a national forest without permission, he can be prosecuted under this statute. Therefore, the court should hold this statute constitutional as applied to the hunter.

(Choice A) The Tenth Amendment reserves to the states (or to the people) all powers not expressly given to the federal government by the Constitution—including the police power to protect residents' property. But Congress can use its delegated powers to override a state's Tenth Amendment powers. And when it does so, the Article VI supremacy clause prescribes that the federal law supersedes the conflicting state law.

(Choice B) The full faith and credit clause of Article IV requires states to respect public acts, records, and judicial proceedings of other states. Therefore, Congress does not violate this clause by punishing conduct that has been authorized by a state.

(Choice C) Article I, section 8 authorizes Congress to enact laws that are "necessary and proper" to carry out its enumerated powers—including the power to tax and spend for the general welfare. But Congress is not taxing or spending here, so the necessary and proper clause cannot justify the statute.

Educational objective:

Under the property clause, Congress has absolute power over federally owned land and territories—including the power to prohibit the destruction or removal of wild animals living thereon.

References

• Kleppe v. New Mexico, 426 U.S. 529, 540–41 (1976) (stating that Congress's plenary power over federal lands "includes the power to regulate and protect the wildlife living there").

explanation.zh:
第四条条款

条款要求

完全信任和信用国家必须承认其他国家的公共行为、记录和司法程序

特权和豁免

国家不得剥夺其他国家公民的国家公民权

财产大会可以处理和管理联邦土地/领土

联邦政府必须保证各州的共和政府形式,保护各州不受入侵。

第四条第三款财产条款赋予国会处置和管理联邦拥有的土地和领土,包括生活在其中的野生动物的全部权力。因此,国会可以禁止未经联邦土地管理局许可在联邦土地上破坏或清除野生动物.由于猎人擅自在国林中射杀野狼,因此可以根据本法规对他进行起诉。 因此,法院应该将本法规视为适用于猎人。

(Choice A)第十修正案保留给各州(或人民)所有宪法未明确赋予联邦政府的权力——包括警察保护居民财产的权力.但国会可以利用其授权来推翻州第十次修正案的权力。 而当它这样做时,第六条至上条款则规定联邦法取代相互冲突的州法。

(Choice B)第四条的完全信念和信用条款要求各国尊重其他国家的公共行为、记录和司法程序。 因此,国会没有违反这一条款,惩罚国家授权的行为。

(C选择) 第一条第八款授权国会颁布"必要和适当"的法律,以行使其列举的权力——包括征税和为一般福利开支的权力.但国会在此并不征税或开支,因此必要和恰当的条款不能成为法规的理由.

学习要点：

根据财产条款,国会对联邦拥有的土地和领土拥有绝对权力,包括有权禁止毁坏或清除居住在其中的野生动物。

参考资料

^ Kleppe诉新墨西哥,426 U.S.529,540–41 (1976)(规定国会对联邦土地的全权"包括管理和保护生活在那里的野生动物的权力").

stem: A proposed federal statute would prohibit all types of discrimination against minorities on the basis of their race in every business transaction executed anywhere in the United States by any person or entity, governmental or private.
stemZh: 一项拟议的联邦法律将禁止在美国任何地方由任何个人或实体，无论是政府还是私人，进行的所有形式的基于种族的少数族裔歧视，适用于所有商业交易。
ask: Is this proposed federal statute likely to be constitutional?
askZh: 这项拟议的联邦法律是否很可能符合宪法？

options.en: No, because it would invade the powers reserved to the states by the Tenth Amendment.
options.zh: 否，因为它会侵犯第十修正案所保留给各州的权力。

options.en: No, because it would regulate purely local transactions that are not in interstate commerce.
options.zh: 否，因为它将规范纯粹的本地交易，这些交易不属于州际商业。

options.en: Yes, because it could reasonably be viewed as a means of enforcing the provisions of the Thirteenth Amendment.
options.zh: 是，因为它可以合理地被视为执行第十三修正案条款的一种手段。

options.en: Yes, because it could reasonably be viewed as an exercise of Congress's authority to enact laws for the general welfare.
options.zh: 是，因为它可以合理地被视为国会行使制定促进公共福利法律的权力。

explanation.en:
Congress's power to enforce the Civil War Amendments

Amendment Effects Congress's enforcement powers

Thirteenth Prohibits government & private actors from engaging in slavery/involuntary servitude

• Prohibit badges/incidents of slavery

• Override state 11th Amendment immunity Fourteenth Prohibits states from denying equal protection, due process, or privileges/immunities of national citizenship

• Remedy/prevent violations with proportional & congruent legislation

• Override state 11th Amendment immunity Fifteenth Prohibits states & federal government from denying or abridging voting rights based on race, color, or previous servitude

• Ban methods of voter discrimination

• Override state 11th Amendment immunity

Section 1 of the Thirteenth Amendment prohibits all government and private entities from engaging in slavery or involuntary servitude. And the Section 2 enforcement clause gives Congress the power to forbid any racial discrimination that can reasonably be viewed as a "badge or incident of slavery" (eg, discrimination in housing, education, or employment). Since racial discrimination against minorities in business transactions can reasonably be viewed as a relic of slavery, the proposed federal statute banning this conduct is likely constitutional.

(Choice A) The Tenth Amendment reserves to the states all powers that the Constitution does not expressly grant to the federal government (eg, police powers). But the Thirteenth Amendment expressly grants Congress the authority to enact legislation addressing slavery and involuntary servitude (as seen here).

(Choice B) The fact that the statute would regulate purely local transactions that do not have a substantial effect on interstate commerce shows that it cannot be supported by the commerce clause. But Congress can still enact this statute pursuant to its power to enforce the Thirteenth Amendment.

(Choice D) The taxing and spending clause gives Congress the authority to tax or spend for the general welfare—not to enact any type of law for this purpose (eg, prohibiting discrimination).

Educational objective:

The Thirteenth Amendment (1) prohibits all government and private entities from engaging in slavery or involuntary servitude and (2) empowers Congress to ban any type of racial discrimination that can reasonably be viewed as a badge or incident of slavery.

References

• Patterson v. McLean Credit Union, 491 U.S. 164, 192 (1989) (explaining that the Thirteenth Amendment empowers Congress to identify the badges and incidents of slavery and to legislate to end them).

explanation.zh:
国会执行内战修正案的权力

修正案效果 国会的执行权

第13条 禁止政府和私人行为者从事奴役/非自愿奴役

• 禁止奴隶制的徽章/事件

• 取代第11次修正的豁免 14 禁止国家拒绝给予平等保护、正当程序或国家公民身份的特权/豁免

• 补救/防止有比例和一致立法的侵权行为

• 取代州第十一修正案豁免 第十五修正案禁止州和联邦政府以种族、肤色或以前奴役为由拒绝或放弃投票权

• 禁止选民歧视方法

• 取代第11次修正的豁免

第十三修正案第一节禁止所有政府和私人实体从事奴役或非自愿奴役.而第2节的执行条款则赋予国会权力,禁止任何可以合理地视为"奴役的恶行或事件"(如住房,教育,或就业方面的歧视)的种族歧视.由于在商业交易中对少数群体的种族歧视可以合理地视为奴隶制的遗迹,因此拟议的禁止这种行为的联邦法规可能是宪法性的。

(Choice A)第十修正案将宪法没有明确授予联邦政府的所有权力(如警察权力)保留给各州.但第十三修正案明确授权国会颁布立法,解决奴役和非自愿奴役问题(如本文所示).

(Choice B) 法规将规范对州际商务没有实质影响的纯当地交易这一事实表明,它不能得到商务条款的支持.但国会仍然可以根据其执行第十三修正案的权力颁布这一法规.

(Choice D) 征税和支出条款授权国会为一般福利征税或支出,而不是为此目的颁布任何类型的法律(例如禁止歧视)。

学习要点：

第十三修正案(1)禁止所有政府和私人实体从事奴役或非自愿奴役,(2)授权国会禁止可合理视为奴役徽章或事件的任何形式的种族歧视。

参考资料

• Patterson诉McLean信用社,491 U.S.164,192(1989年)(解释第十三修正案授权国会查明奴隶制的徽章和事件并立法予以终止)。

stem:
A state law provides for an award of damages against anyone who publishes the name of a rape victim. Pursuant to that law, a woman sued a local newspaper in state court after the newspaper identified her as a rape victim.

The state trial and appellate courts rejected the claim, holding that the state law was invalid under both the state constitution and the First Amendment of the U.S. Constitution. The state supreme court affirmed, holding specifically: "We think that this well-intentioned law very likely violates the First Amendment of the federal Constitution. We need not, however, decide that issue, because the law assuredly violates our state constitution, which provides even greater protection to the right of the press to report the news."

The woman petitioned for review in the U.S. Supreme Court.
stemZh:
一州法律规定，任何人公布强奸受害者的姓名，均可获得损害赔偿。根据该法律，一名女子在报纸将其识别为强奸受害者后，向州法院起诉该当地报纸。

州初审法院和上诉法院驳回了该主张，认为该州法律在州宪法和美国宪法第一修正案下均无效。州最高法院确认了这一判决，特别指出："我们认为，这项善意的法律很可能违反了美国宪法第一修正案。然而，我们无需决定该问题，因为该法律无疑违反了我们的州宪法，该州宪法对新闻自由的保护更为充分。"

该女子向美国最高法院申请复审。
ask: Is the U.S. Supreme Court likely to review the state supreme court judgment?
askZh: 美国最高法院是否有可能审查州最高法院的判决？

options.en: No, because the First Amendment prohibits the imposition of liability for the publication of truthful information.
options.zh: 否，因为第一修正案禁止对发表真实信息的法律责任。

options.en: No, because the judgment of the state supreme court rests upon an adequate and independent state-law ground.
options.zh: 否，因为州最高法院的判决基于充分且独立的州法律依据。

options.en: Yes, because the supremacy clause does not permit a state to create rights greater than those conferred by the federal Constitution.
options.zh: 是，因为联邦宪法的优越性条款不允许州创建比联邦宪法赋予的更广泛的权益。

options.en: Yes, because the U.S. Supreme Court's appellate jurisdiction extends to cases arising under federal law.
options.zh: 是，因为美国最高法院的上诉管辖权涵盖根据联邦法律提起的案件。

explanation.en:
Adequate & independent state ground

(precludes SCOTUS review)

Adequate State ground fully resolves matter & application of federal law would not affect outcome

Independent State court did not rely on federal law to reach conclusion

SCOTUS = Supreme Court of the United States

The U.S. Supreme Court (SCOTUS) may exercise its appellate jurisdiction to review a judgment of the highest court of a state if that judgment turned on federal law. But SCOTUS may not review a state court judgment that rests on an adequate and independent state ground—ie:

• a state ground that fully resolves the matter such that the application of federal law would not affect the outcome of the case (adequate) and

• the state court did not rely on federal law to reach its conclusion (independent). Here, the state supreme court indicated that the state law very likely violates the U.S. Constitution. But the court also stated that it need not decide that federal issue because the law assuredly violates the state constitution. Since the state ground fully resolves the matter and the court did not rely on federal law to interpret the state constitution, SCOTUS is unlikely to review the state court judgment (Choice D).

(Choice A) The First Amendment freedom of the press generally bars liability for publicizing truthful information. But this does not provide a basis for SCOTUS to decline to review a case. Instead, review is improper here because the state court decision was based on an adequate and independent state ground.

(Choice C) The Article VI supremacy clause establishes that the U.S. Constitution and federal laws trump conflicting state laws. Therefore, states cannot restrict rights conferred by the U.S. Constitution. However, states are always free to create greater rights and protections than the U.S. Constitution does.

Educational objective:

The U.S. Supreme Court cannot review a state court judgment that rests on an adequate and independent state ground—ie, (1) a state ground fully resolves the matter such that the application of federal law would not affect the outcome of the case and (2) the state court did not rely on federal law to reach its conclusion.

References

• Michigan v. Long, 463 U.S. 1032, 1041 (1983) (holding that a state supreme court can plainly state that its decision rests on adequate and independent state-law grounds).

• 4 Am. Jur. 2d Appellate Review § 42 (2019) (explaining the adequate and independent state ground doctrine).

explanation.zh:
充足的独立状态地面( I)

(前作SCOTUS审查).

有充分的国家理由充分解决问题,联邦法律的适用将不影响结果

独立的州法院没有依靠联邦法律得出结论

SCOTUS = 美国最高法院

美国最高法院(SCOTUS)可行使上诉管辖权,审查州最高法院的判决,如果判决转向联邦法。但是,SCOTUS不得复审基于充分和独立的国家理由的州法院判决,即:

• 完全解决此事的州理由,即联邦法律的适用不影响案件结果(充分)和

• 州法院没有依靠联邦法律(独立)得出结论。 在这方面,州最高法院表示州法律极有可能违反美国宪法。但法院也表示,它不需要决定联邦问题,因为法律确实违反了州宪法.由于州基础完全解决了这个问题,法院也没有依靠联邦法律来解释州宪法,所以SCOTUS不太可能复审州法院的判决(Choice D).

(Choice A)第一修正案的新闻自由通常禁止公开真实信息的责任。 但这并不能为SCOTUS拒绝复审案件提供依据。相反,审查在这里是不恰当的,因为州法院的裁决是基于充分和独立的国家理由。

(选择C)第六条至上条款规定,美国宪法和联邦法律凌驾于相互冲突的州法律之上。 因此,各州不能限制美国宪法赋予的权利。然而,各州总是可以自由创造比美国宪法更大的权利和保护.

学习要点：

美国最高法院不能审查州法院基于充分和独立的国家理由作出的判决,即:(1)州法院充分解决了问题,联邦法律的适用不会影响案件的结果;(2)州法院没有依靠联邦法律得出结论。

参考资料

• 密歇根州诉Long案,463 U.S. 1032, 1041(1983)(认为州最高法院可以明确声明其裁决基于适当和独立州法理由)。

• 4 Am. Jur. 2d 上诉复审第42条(2019年)(解释适当和独立的国家基础理论)。

stem: City police officers shot and killed a woman's friend as he attempted to escape arrest for an armed robbery he had committed. The woman brought suit in federal district court against the city police department and the police officers involved, seeking only a judgment declaring unconstitutional the state statute under which the police acted. That newly enacted statute authorized the police to use deadly force when necessary to apprehend a person who has committed a felony. In her suit, the woman alleged that the police would not have killed her friend if the use of deadly force had not been authorized by the statute. The defendants filed a motion to dismiss the woman's suit.
stemZh: 城市警察射杀了一名女子的朋友，因为该朋友试图逃避对一起持械抢劫案的逮捕。该女子在联邦地区法院起诉城市警察部门及涉案警察，仅要求作出一项判决，认定警察所依据的州法律违宪。该新颁布的法律授权警察在必要时使用致命武力逮捕已犯重罪的人。在她的诉讼中，该女子声称，如果该法律未授权使用致命武力，警察就不会杀死她的朋友。被告方提出了驳回诉讼动议。
ask: How should the federal district court rule on this motion?
askZh: 联邦地区法院应如何裁定该动议？

options.en: Deny the motion, because the suit raises a substantial federal question.
options.zh: 驳回动议，因为该诉讼提出了一个重大的联邦问题。

options.en: Grant the motion, because the Eleventh Amendment prohibits federal courts from deciding cases of this type.
options.zh: 批准动议，因为第十一修正案禁止联邦法院审理此类案件。

options.en: Grant the motion, because the suit does not present a case or controversy.
options.zh: 批准动议，因为该诉讼并未呈现一个案件或争议。

explanation.en:
Justiciability

(suitability for judicial resolution)

Case or controversy Prohibits advisory opinions under three doctrines:

• Standing – plaintiff must allege injury-in-fact caused by challenged action & redressable by remedy sought

• Ripeness – claim must present actual controversy involving past injury or present threat of injury

• Mootness – claim must be unresolved Adequate & independent state grounds

SCOTUS cannot review final state court judgment that rests on adequate & independent state grounds

Political question Court cannot hear case if issue presented:

• is reserved for executive/legislative branches or

• lacks judicially manageable standards for resolution SCOTUS = Supreme Court of the United States.

Article III restricts federal judicial power to actual cases or controversies—ie, disputes that are capable of judicial resolution. As a result, federal courts can only issue a declaratory judgment if the dispute presents a real and immediate danger to a party's interests. Otherwise, the dispute would not satisfy Article III's case-or-controversy requirement since a judgment would amount to an impermissible advisory opinion—ie, a judicial opinion that determines the validity of a law without resolving an actual dispute.

Here, the woman sought a declaratory judgment that the state statute under which the police had killed her friend was unconstitutional. But the statute does not present a real and immediate danger to the woman since there is no indication that it poses any present or future harm to her. This means that the woman does not have any interest at stake to satisfy Article III's case-or-controversy requirement. Therefore, the federal court should grant the defendants' motion to dismiss the suit to avoid rendering an advisory opinion.

(Choice A) The woman's suit raises a federal question because she is challenging the constitutionality of a statute. However, the court must still dismiss her claim because no case or controversy exists.

(Choice B) The Eleventh Amendment bars private parties (and foreign governments) from suing states in federal court. But it does not apply to suits against local governments (eg, the city) or their affiliates (eg, the police department and its officers).

(Choice D) The political-question doctrine prevents federal courts from adjudicating issues that (1) are reserved to the executive or legislative branches or (2) lack judicially manageable standards for resolution. But since federal courts regularly determine the constitutionality of state statutes, this doctrine does not apply here.

Educational objective:

Article III's case-or-controversy requirement prohibits federal courts from issuing declaratory judgments unless the dispute presents a real and immediate danger to a party's interests. Otherwise, the judgment would amount to an impermissible advisory opinion.

References

• Ashcroft v. Mattis, 431 U.S. 171, 172–73 (1977) (holding that a father's emotional harm caused by the police shooting his son did not present an injury that would allow him to seek a declaratory judgment).

可审理性

(适合司法解决)

案例或争议禁止根据以下三种理论发表咨询意见:

• 身份 - 原告必须声称受到质疑的诉讼造成事实伤害,而且可以通过寻求的补救予以补救

• Ripeness - 索赔必须涉及过去伤害或目前伤害威胁的实际争议

• 模拟 - 索赔必须得到解决

SCOTUS不能审查基于充分和独立的国家理由的州法院最后判决

政治问题法院不能审理下列案件:

• 专供行政/立法部门使用;

• 缺乏SCOTUS = 美国最高法院的司法管理标准。

第三条将联邦司法权限于实际案件或争议,即能够司法解决的争议。因此,只有在争端对一方的利益构成实际和直接的危险时,联邦法院才能作出宣告性判决。否则,争端将无法满足第三条关于案件或争议的要求,因为判决将构成不允许的咨询意见,即司法意见,在不解决实际争端的情况下确定法律的有效性。

在此,该妇女要求作出宣布性判决,认为警察杀害她朋友的州法规违宪。但是,该法规并没有给妇女带来真正和直接的危险,因为没有迹象表明该法规目前或将来对她造成任何伤害。这意味着妇女没有任何利害关系来满足第三条的要求。因此,联邦法院应批准被告提出的上诉请求。驳回诉讼,以避免发表咨询意见。

(Choice A) 妇女的诉讼提出了联邦问题,因为她质疑法规的合宪性,但是,法院仍然必须驳回她的申诉,因为没有案件或争议。

(Choice B)第十一修正案禁止私人政党(和外国政府)向联邦法院起诉各州,但不适用于针对地方政府(如城市)或其下属机构(如警察局及其官员)的诉讼。

(Choice D)政治问题学说阻止联邦法院裁决(1)保留给行政部门或立法部门或(2)缺乏司法上可管理解决标准的问题.但由于联邦法院定期决定州法规是否符合宪法,此学说在此不适用.

学习要点：

第三条的案件或争议要求禁止联邦法院作出宣告性判决,除非争端对一方的利益构成实际和直接的危险,否则判决将构成不允许的咨询意见。

参考资料

• Ashcroft诉Mattis,431 U.S.171,172–73(1977年)(认为警察枪杀他儿子给父亲造成的感情伤害不会造成伤害,使他能够寻求宣告性判决)。

stem:
Congress provides funds to states that can be used to reimburse medical providers for procedures they perform for low-income individuals. A state that participates in this federal program enacted a statute that prohibits reimbursing providers for the cost of performing vasectomies for men.

A doctor who routinely performs vasectomies for low-income men has submitted numerous requests for reimbursement pursuant to the program. However, the commissioner of the state agency administering the program has repeatedly denied the doctor's requests pursuant to the state statute.

The doctor sued the commissioner in a federal district court, seeking an injunction against the enforcement of the statute on the ground that it violates men's right to privacy.
stemZh:
国会向参与该联邦计划的州提供资金，这些资金可用于补偿为低收入个体进行手术的医疗提供者。一个参与该联邦计划的州颁布了一项法律，禁止补偿提供者为男性进行输精管结扎手术的成本。

一位经常为低收入男性进行输精管结扎手术的医生已根据该计划提交了多项报销请求。然而，管理该计划的州机构的委员多次根据该州法律拒绝了该医生的请求。

该医生在联邦地区法院起诉该委员，要求颁布禁令，阻止该法律的执行，理由是该法律侵犯了男性的隐私权。
ask: Assuming that this federal district court has previously held that men have a privacy right to obtain vasectomies, how should the district court proceed with the doctor's suit?
askZh: 假设该联邦地区法院此前已认定男性有权获得输精管结扎手术的隐私权，该地区法院应如何处理该医生的诉讼？

options.en: Determine the merits of the suit, because federal courts have exclusive jurisdiction over federal-law claims.
options.zh: 审查该诉讼的实质问题，因为联邦法院对联邦法主张拥有专属管辖权。

options.en: Determine the merits of the suit, because the doctor has standing.
options.zh: 审查该诉讼的实质问题，因为该医生具有诉讼资格。

options.en: Refuse to adjudicate the merits of the suit and dismiss it, because the Eleventh Amendment bars this type of action in federal court.
options.zh: 拒绝审查该诉讼的实质问题并驳回诉讼，因为第十一修正案禁止此类诉讼在联邦法院进行。

options.en: Refuse to adjudicate the merits of the suit and stay the suit until a man seeking a vasectomy joins the suit.

explanation.en:
Article III standing

(suing on another's behalf)

Organization members

Organization has standing if:

• members have standing to sue on their own behalf

• their injuries relate to organization's purpose AND

• lawsuit does not require member participation (if damages sought) Third party Injured plaintiff has standing when:

• parties share inextricably close relationship (eg, doctor/patient) AND

• obstacle prevents third party from suing (eg, privacy/retaliation concern) Child Parent has standing unless parental rights have been limited by court OR lawsuit may adversely affect child

Assignor Assignee has standing if assigned legal claim for ordinary & good faith business purpose

In federal litigation, parties are generally limited to asserting their own rights and not the rights of a third party. That is because the third party will likely be the most effective advocate of his/her own interests. However, the third-party standing doctrine permits an injured plaintiff to assert the rights of a third party when:

• the plaintiff and the third party share an inextricably close relationship and

• genuine obstacles prevent the third party from asserting his/her rights. Here, enforcement of the statute harmed the doctor since he was denied reimbursement for performing vasectomies for men. Doctors share an inextricably close relationship with their patients. Additionally, the men's low-income status, fear of retaliation, and privacy concerns pose genuine obstacles that may prevent the men from challenging vasectomy restrictions. Therefore, the doctor has standing to assert that the statute violates men's right to privacy, and the court should hear the merits of the doctor's suit.

(Choice A) Federal and state courts have concurrent jurisdiction over federal-law claims unless the Constitution or Congress expressly provides federal courts with exclusive jurisdiction (not seen here).

(Choice C) The Eleventh Amendment generally bars federal courts from adjudicating suits against a state government for monetary relief—not suits against a state official for injunctive relief (as seen here).

(Choice D) A federal court can stay (ie, suspend) a suit to force a party to comply with a court order or protect a party's rights. But here, the federal court need not stay the action until a man seeking a vasectomy joins the suit because the doctor has third-party standing.

Educational objective:

Under the third-party standing doctrine, an injured plaintiff may assert a third party's rights when (1) the parties share an inextricably close relationship and (2) genuine obstacles prevent the third party from asserting his/her rights.

References

• Singleton v. Wulff, 428 U.S. 106, 118 (1976) (concluding that "it generally is appropriate to allow a physician to assert the rights of women patients as against governmental interference").

• U.S. Const. art. III, § 2 (case-or-controversy requirement).

• 16 Am. Jur. 2d Constitutional Law § 145 (2020) (explaining third-party standing requirements).

explanation.zh:
第三条

(代表他人发言)

组织成员

如果:

• 成员有权代表自己提起诉讼

• 他们的受伤与组织的宗旨有关;

• 诉讼不要求成员参与(如果要求损害赔偿)处于下列状态:

• 各方有着不可分割的密切关系(如医生/病人),

• 阻碍第三方起诉(例如隐私/报复问题),除非父母的权利受到法院或诉讼的限制,否则儿童父母有地位

为普通和诚信商业目的转让的法律债权的,受让人具有资格

在联邦诉讼中,当事人一般限于主张自己的权利,而不是第三方的权利,这是因为第三方很可能是其自身利益的最有效维护者。然而,第三方常设原则允许受害原告在下列情况下主张第三方的权利:

• 原告与第三方有着不可分割的密切关系,

• 阻碍第三方维护其权利的真正障碍:在这方面,由于医生为男子进行输精管切除手术而被拒绝报销,执行该法规损害了医生的利益;医生与病人有着密不可分的密切关系。此外,男子的低收入地位、对报复的恐惧以及隐私方面的关切构成了真正的障碍,可能妨碍男子对输精管切除术的限制提出质疑。因此,医生有权主张该法规侵犯了男子的隐私权,法院应审理医生诉讼的案情。

(Choice A) 联邦法院和州法院对联邦法债权拥有共同管辖权,除非宪法或国会明确规定联邦法院拥有专属管辖权(此处不见).

第十一项修正案一般禁止联邦法院裁决对州政府提出的金钱救济诉讼,而不是对州官员提出的禁止救济诉讼(见这里)。

(Choice D) 联邦法院可以中止(即中止)一项诉讼,以迫使当事人遵守法院命令或保护当事人的权利.但在这里,联邦法院不必在寻求输精管切除术的人因为医生有第三方地位而加入诉讼之前中止诉讼.

学习要点：

根据第三方常设原则,如果(1) 当事人有着不可分割的密切关系,(2) 真正妨碍第三方主张其权利的障碍,受害原告可以主张第三方的权利。

参考资料

· Singleton诉Wulff案,428 U.S.106,118(1976)(包括“一般允许医生维护女性病人反对政府干涉的权利是适当的”)。

• 美国康斯特公司第3条第2款(案件或争议要求)。

• 16 Am. Jur. 2d.《宪法》第145条(2020年)(解释第三方地位要求)。

stem:
A city ordinance requires that its mayor must have been continuously a resident of the city for at least five years at the time he or she takes office. The plaintiff, who is thinking about running for mayor in an election that will take place next year, will have been a resident of the city for only four and one-half years at the time the elected mayor would take office. Before he decides to run for mayor, the plaintiff wants to know whether he could lawfully assume that position if he were elected.

As a result, the plaintiff files suit in the local federal district court for a declaratory judgment that the city's five-year-residence requirement is unconstitutional and that he is entitled to a place on his political party's primary election ballot for mayor. He names the chairman of his political party as the sole defendant and does not join any election officials. The chairman responds by joining the plaintiff in requesting the court to declare the city's residence requirement invalid.
stemZh:
一项市议会法令规定，该市市长必须在就职时已连续居住该市至少五年。原告正在考虑明年参加市长竞选，届时他将只在市长就职时已居住该市四年半。在决定是否竞选之前，原告想知道，如果他当选，他是否可以合法地担任该职位。

因此，原告在当地的联邦地区法院提起诉讼，请求宣告该市的五年居住要求违宪，并主张他有权被列入其政党的市长初选选票上。他将自己政党的主席作为唯一被告，未加入任何选举官员。该主席回应称，请求法院宣告该市的居住要求无效。
ask: What should the court do in this case?
askZh: 法院在这种情况下应该怎么做？

options.en: Issue the declaratory judgment, because a residency requirement of this type is a denial of the equal protection of the laws.
options.zh: 作出宣告判决，因为这种类型的居住要求是剥夺了法律上的平等保护。

options.en: Issue the declaratory judgment, because the plaintiff will have substantially complied with the residency requirement.
options.zh: 作出宣告性判决，因为届时原告已基本符合居住要求。

options.en: Refuse to determine the merits of this suit, because there is no case or controversy.
options.zh: 拒绝审理此案的实质问题，因为不存在案件或争议。

options.en: Refuse to issue the declaratory judgment, because an issue of this kind involving only a local election does not present a substantial federal constitutional question.
options.zh: 拒绝作出宣告判决，因为仅涉及地方选举的此类问题并不提出重大的联邦宪法问题。

explanation.en:
Article III of the Constitution limits federal judicial power to actual cases or controversies—ie, disputes that are capable of judicial resolution. This case-or-controversy requirement is not met unless the plaintiff has standing—ie, a personal stake

in the outcome of the case. To have standing, the plaintiff must allege three elements:

• Injury-in-fact – actual or imminent harm that is concrete and particularized

• Causation – the injury is fairly traceable to the defendant's challenged conduct

• Redressability – a favorable judicial decision will likely remedy or prevent the alleged injury Here, the plaintiff sued to have the city's residency requirement invalidated. But he has not suffered actual or imminent harm since he has merely thought about running for mayor and any injury to him is purely hypothetical (no injury-in-fact). And even if the plaintiff could allege such harm, he still lacks standing because that injury would not be fairly traceable to the chairman of his political party (no causation). Therefore, there is no actual case or controversy, and the court should refuse to determine the merits of this suit.

(Choice A) The residency requirement triggers the equal protection clause since it discriminates against persons who have lived in the city for less than five years. But this does not create an actual case or controversy since the plaintiff still lacks standing.

(Choice B) The fact that the plaintiff will have "substantially complied" with the residency requirement if and when he runs for mayor is no basis for the court to declare the requirement invalid.

(Choice D) The plaintiff's suit does present a substantial federal constitutional question since it challenges the constitutionality of the city's residency requirement. As a result, the court has subject-matter jurisdiction to hear this suit. But it cannot adjudicate the suit because there is no case or controversy.

Educational objective:

Article III's case-or-controversy requirement is not met unless the plaintiff has standing—ie, suffered an injury-in-fact that was caused by the defendant's challenged conduct and is redressable by the courts.

References

• Lujan v. Defs. of Wildlife, 504 U.S. 555, 560–61 (1992) (holding that standing requires proof of an injury-in-fact, causation, and redressability).

explanation.zh:
《宪法》第三条将联邦司法权限于实际案件或争议,即:能够司法解决的争端。这一案件或争议要求没有得到满足,除非原告具有个人地位。键

原告必须申述以下三个要素,才能具有资格:

• 实际伤害 -- -- 具体和具体的实际或即将发生的伤害

• 因果关系——损害可以相当地追溯到被告受到质疑的行为

· 可补救性 -- -- 有利的司法判决可能补救或防止所称的损害。 原告在此起诉,要求取消该市的居住要求。但是他并没有受到实际或即将发生的伤害,因为他只是考虑竞选市长,对他的任何伤害都是纯粹的假设(没有实际伤害)。即使原告可以指称这种伤害,他仍然缺乏地位,因为这种伤害不能相当地追溯到其政党主席身上(没有因果关系)。因此,不存在实际案件或争议,法院应拒绝确定这一诉讼的案情。

(Choice A)居住要求触发了平等保护条款,因为它歧视在城市居住不到5年的人,但这并不产生实际案件或争议,因为原告仍然缺乏地位。

(Choice B)原告在竞选市长时将"基本遵守"居住要求的事实,如果法院不能依据该要求宣布无效.

(Choice D)原告的诉讼确实提出了重大的联邦宪法问题,因为它质疑该市居住要求的合宪性,因此,法院有审理这一诉讼的属事管辖权.但是,它不能裁决诉讼,因为没有案件或争议。

学习要点：

第三条的案件要求或争议要求没有得到满足,除非原告具有地位,遭受了因被告受到质疑的行为而造成的损害,而且法院可以予以补救。

参考资料

· Lujan诉Devs of Wildish, 504 U.S. 555, 560-61(1992年)(认为这种地位需要证明事实伤害、因果关系和可补救性)。

stem:
The President issued an executive order banning the extraction of natural gas on federal land. An oil and gas company that had been drilling for natural gas on federal land sued the President in federal court and sought a preliminary injunction that would prevent the executive order from going into effect.

Before the federal judge ruled on the injunction, an employee of the oil company left an envelope of cash on the judge's doorstep with a note that stated, "Remember who your friends are." The next day, the judge issued a nationwide injunction preventing the executive order from taking effect. Several months later, a local newspaper broke the story about the envelope of cash, the note, and the judge's subsequent ruling. The judge has not been indicted for bribery, but the President has called for the judge's immediate removal.
stemZh:
总统发布了一项行政命令，禁止在联邦土地上开采天然气。一家石油和天然气公司在联邦土地上进行天然气开采，随后在联邦法院起诉总统，要求颁布临时禁令，以阻止该行政命令生效。

在联邦法官对禁令作出裁决之前，该石油公司的员工在法官家门口留下了一个装有现金的信封，并附上一张纸条，上面写着："记住谁是你的朋友。" 第二天，法官颁布了全国范围的禁令，阻止该行政命令生效。几个月后，一家当地报纸曝光了信封、纸条以及法官随后裁决的事件。法官尚未因受贿被起诉，但总统呼吁立即解除法官的职务。
ask: May the President constitutionally remove the federal judge?
askZh: 总统是否有宪法依据解除该联邦法官的职务？

options.en: No, because a federal judge can only be removed by impeachment.
options.zh: 否，因为联邦法官只能通过弹劾程序被解除职务。

options.en: No, because the federal judge has not been indicted for bribery.
options.zh: 否，因为该联邦法官尚未因受贿被起诉。

options.en: Yes, because bribery is an impeachable offense.
options.zh: 是，因为受贿是可弹劾的罪行。

options.en: Yes, because the President's removal power is absolute.
options.zh: 是，因为总统的解除职务权力是绝对的。

explanation.en:
The Constitution divides the federal government into three coequal branches that possess distinct powers (ie, separation of powers). The President has the power to appoint federal judges with the Senate's advice and consent. Federal judges have lifetime tenure during good behavior, which helps guarantee judicial independence. And Congress has the sole power to impeach and remove federal judges for treason, bribery, or other high crimes and misdemeanors, which helps ensure judicial integrity.

Here, the President seeks the removal of the federal judge, who has been accused of bribery. Although bribery is an impeachable offense, only Congress has the power to remove a federal judge by impeachment (Choice C). Therefore, the President may not constitutionally remove the federal judge.

(Choice B) The fact that the federal judge has not been indicted for bribery has no bearing on whether the President can remove the federal judge from office.* That is because the power to impeach and remove federal judges belongs to Congress—not the President.

*An indictment is not required for a federal judge to be impeached and removed from office because the House of Representatives—not a grand jury—determines whether the judge's conduct constitutes an impeachable offense.

(Choice D) The Constitution is silent about the President's removal of federal executive officers, but the U.S. Supreme Court has repeatedly held that the President has near-absolute authority to remove such officers. But though the President's removal power is

broad, it does not include the power to remove federal judges.

Educational objective:

The President has the power to appoint federal judges with the Senate's advice and consent, but Congress has the sole power to impeach and remove federal judges for treason, bribery, or other high crimes and misdemeanors.

References

• U.S. Const. art. II, § 2 (vesting the President with the power to appoint federal judges).

• U.S. Const. art. II, § 4 (stating that Congress may impeach and remove federal judges from office for treason, bribery, or other high crimes and misdemeanors).

• U.S. Const. art. III, § 1 (granting lifetime tenure to federal judges during good behavior).

explanation.zh:
《宪法》将联邦政府分为三个平等分支,拥有不同权力(即三权分立),总统有权在参议院的建议和同意下任命联邦法官。联邦法官在良好行为期间拥有终身任期,这有助于保障司法独立。 而国会拥有弹劾和罢免叛国罪、贿赂罪或其他严重罪行和轻罪联邦法官的唯一权力。诚信。

在此,总统寻求罢免被指控受贿的联邦法官,虽然贿赂是可弹劾的罪行,但只有国会有权通过弹劾(Choice C)罢免联邦法官.因此,根据宪法,总统不得罢免联邦法官。

(Choice B) 联邦法官未因受贿被起诉的事实与总统能否解除联邦法官的职务?弹劾和罢免联邦法官属于国会而不是总统。

* 联邦法官不必受到弹劾和免职,因为众议院——不是大陪审团——决定法官的行为是否构成可弹劾的罪行。

(Choice D)宪法对总统罢免联邦执行官员一事保持沉默,但美国最高法院一再认定总统拥有几乎绝对的权力罢免这些官员.

从广义上讲,它不包括撤换联邦法官的权力。

学习要点：

总统有权根据参议院的建议和同意任命联邦法官,但国会只有权力以叛国罪,贿赂罪,或其他严重罪行和轻罪弹劾和罢免联邦法官.

参考资料

• 美国康斯特第2条第2款(授权总统任命联邦法官)。

· 美国康斯特第2条第4款(规定国会可以以叛国罪、贿赂罪或其他严重罪行和轻罪弹劾和罢免联邦法官)。

· 美国康斯特第3条第1款(在良好行为期间给予联邦法官终身任期)。
