stem:
In response to a terrorist attack that occurred within the United States, Congress authorized the President to use military force against nations, organizations, and persons the President determined were responsible for the attack. Pursuant to this authorization, enemy combatants were seized in a foreign country and transported to a foreign location under the de facto control of the United States, which was well outside the area of military activity. The President ordered that a military tribunal be convened in that location to try the enemy combatants.

Prior to the attack, Congress, pursuant to its constitutional authority, had authorized the use of military tribunals and set out procedures to guarantee specific basic rights that the tribunals must provide, such as the right of a defendant to hear the evidence against him. The procedural rules for the military tribunal established by the presidential order did not provide for those basic rights.
stemZh:
为应对在美国境内发生的恐怖袭击，国会授权总统对总统认定负责此次袭击的国家、组织和个人使用军事力量。根据该授权，敌方战斗人员被在外国扣押并运送到美国实际控制的外国地点，该地点远在军事行动区域之外。总统下令在该地点召开军事法庭审判敌方战斗人员。

在袭击发生前，根据其宪法授权，国会已授权使用军事法庭，并制定了程序以确保军事法庭必须提供的基本权利，例如被告有权听取针对他的证据。总统下令设立的军事法庭的程序规则并未包含这些基本权利。
ask: Does the President have the constitutional authority to convene this military tribunal?
askZh: 总统是否有宪法授权召开此次军事法庭？

options.en: No, because a military tribunal only has power over current members of the U.S. armed forces.
options.zh: 否，因为军事法庭的权力仅限于美国武装部队现任成员。

options.en: No, because the procedures adopted for the President's military tribunal conflict with the procedures adopted by Congress.
options.zh: 否，因为总统的军事法庭所采用的程序与国会所采用的程序相冲突。

options.en: Yes, because Congress authorized the President to use military force that led to the seizure of the enemy combatants.
options.zh: 是，因为国会授权总统使用导致扣押敌方战斗人员的军事力量。

options.en: Yes, because the President has plenary power over military tribunals as commander in chief.
options.zh: 是，因为总统作为最高统帅，对军事法庭拥有完全权力。

explanation.en:
Article II grants the President constitutional authority over a wide range of domestic and foreign policy areas, including serving as commander in chief of the U.S. military. Congress also has authority over military matters, including the power to establish military courts and tribunals. When these coequal branches of government share power, the Youngstown framework determines whether the President acted within his/her constitutional authority. This framework considers whether there was congressional:

• authorization – in which case the President had maximum authority to act and that act is likely valid

• silence – in which case the act is valid so long as it (1) fell within the President's Article II powers and (2) did not interfere with another branch's powers or

• opposition – in which case the President had minimal authority to act and that act is likely invalid. Here, Congress authorized the use of military tribunals and set out procedures to guarantee defendants specific basic rights. However, these rights were not included in the President's executive order that provided procedural rules for a tribunal to try certain enemy combatants. Since the congressional authorization and the executive order are in opposition, the President does not have the constitutional authority to convene this military tribunal.

(Choice A) A military tribunal can exercise jurisdiction over current members of the U.S. armed forces as well as enemy combatants and enemy civilians.

(Choice C) Although Congress authorized the President to use military force that led to the seizure of the enemy combatants, Congress also guaranteed specific basic rights to defendants tried in a military tribunal. Since the executive order did not include these rights, the President cannot convene the tribunal.

(Choice D) The President, acting as the commander in chief, does not have plenary (ie, exclusive) power over military tribunals. Instead, the President shares this power with Congress and must abide by congressional requirements.

Educational objective:

The President has minimal constitutional authority to act when Congress opposes the President's actions in an area over which the executive and legislative branches share authority.

References

• Youngstown Sheet & Tube Co. v. Sawyer, 343 U.S. 579, 635–38 (1952) (Jackson, J., concurring) (setting forth the tripartite framework for analyzing the constitutionality of presidential actions).

• Hamdan v. Rumsfeld, 548 U.S. 557, 613 (2006) (holding that a military tribunal created by an executive order is invalid when the procedures that will govern the tribunal contravene existing federal law).

explanation.zh:
第二条赋予总统对广泛的国内外政策领域的宪法权力,包括担任美军总司令.国会还拥有军事事务的权力,包括设立军事法庭和法庭的权力.当这些平等政府部门分享权力时,Youngstown框架决定总统在其宪法权力范围内行事。这一框架考虑国会是否:

• 授权——在这种情况下,总统拥有采取行动的最大权力,该行为可能有效;

• 沉默——在这种情况下,只要:(1) 该行为属于总统第二条的权力范围,(2) 不干预另一分支的权力,或

– 反对 — — 在这种情况下,总统几乎没有采取行动的权力,而这一行为可能无效。 国会授权使用军事法庭,并制定程序保障被告的具体基本权利。然而,这些权利没有列入总统的行政命令,该行政命令规定了法庭审判某些敌方战斗人员的程序规则。由于国会授权和行政命令遭到反对,总统确实反对。宪法没有权力召集这个军事法庭。

(Choice A)军事法庭可以对美国武装部队的现任成员以及敌方战斗人员和敌方平民行使管辖权.

(Choice)虽然国会授权总统使用导致俘虏敌方战斗人员的军事力量,但国会也保障在军事法庭受审的被告的具体基本权利.由于行政命令不包括这些权利,庭长不能召集法庭。

(Choice D) 总统作为总司令,对军事法庭没有全体会议(即专属)权力,相反,总统与国会分享这一权力,必须遵守国会的要求.

学习要点：

当国会反对总统的行动时,总统在行政和立法部门共同拥有权力的领域拥有极少的宪法权力。

参考资料

· Youngstown Sheet & Tube Co.诉Sawyer案,343 U.S. 579, 635–38 (1952)(Jackson, J.,同意)(为分析总统行动的合宪性制定了三方框架)。

• Hamdan诉Rumsfeld,548 U.S. 557, 613(2006年)(认为行政命令设立的军事法庭在法庭管理程序违反现行联邦法时无效)。

stem:
A federal statute requires the National Bureau of Standards to establish minimum quality standards for all beer sold in the United States. The statute also provides that public hearings must precede adoption of the standards, and that once they are adopted, the standards will be subject to judicial review. While the proposed standards have not yet been announced, several Bureau officials have publicly expressed opinions indicating a belief that pasteurized beer is safer than unpasteurized beer. However, these officials have not stated whether they intend to include a pasteurization requirement in the standards.

A brewery that produces unpasteurized beer is concerned that, after the appropriate proceedings, the Bureau may adopt quality standards that will prohibit the sale of unpasteurized beer. The brewery has sued in federal district court to enjoin the Bureau from adopting standards that would prohibit the sale of unpasteurized beer.
stemZh:
一项联邦法律要求国家标准局制定所有在美国销售的啤酒的最低质量标准。该法律还规定，在采用这些标准之前必须举行公开听证会，并且一旦这些标准被采用，它们将受到司法审查。尽管尚未公布拟议的标准，但几位局官员已经公开表示意见，表明他们认为巴氏杀菌啤酒比未巴氏杀菌啤酒更安全。然而，这些官员并未说明他们是否打算在标准中加入巴氏杀菌要求。

一家生产未巴氏杀菌啤酒的酿酒厂担心，在适当的程序之后，该局可能会通过质量标准，从而禁止销售未巴氏杀菌啤酒。该酿酒厂在美国联邦地区法院提起诉讼，要求阻止该局通过禁止销售未巴氏杀菌啤酒的标准。
ask: How should the district court proceed with the suit?
askZh: 地区法院应该如何处理此案？

options.en: Determine whether the Bureau could reasonably believe that pasteurization is the safest process by which to brew beer and, if so, refuse to issue the injunction against the Bureau.
options.zh: 确定该局是否可以合理地认为巴氏杀菌是酿造啤酒最安全的过程，如果可以，则拒绝对局发出禁令。

options.en: Determine whether the process used by the brewery is as safe as pasteurization and, if so, issue the injunction against the Bureau.
options.zh: 确定该酿酒厂使用的工艺是否与巴氏杀菌一样安全，如果是，则对局发出禁令。

options.en: Refuse to adjudicate the merits of the suit and dismiss it, because it does not involve a justiciable case or controversy.
options.zh: 拒绝审理此案的实质内容并驳回诉讼，因为此案不构成可诉的案件或争议。

options.en: Refuse to adjudicate the merits of the suit at this time and stay the action until the Bureau has actually issued beer-quality standards.
options.zh: 拒绝在现阶段审理此案的实质内容并中止诉讼，直到该局实际发布啤酒质量标准为止。

explanation.en:
Justiciability

(suitability for judicial resolution)

Case or controversy Prohibits advisory opinions under three doctrines:

• Standing – plaintiff must allege injury-in-fact caused by challenged action & redressable by remedy sought

• Ripeness – claim must present actual controversy involving past injury or present threat of injury

• Mootness – claim must be unresolved Adequate & independent state grounds

SCOTUS cannot review final state court judgment that rests on adequate & independent state grounds

Political question Court cannot hear case if issue presented:

• is reserved for executive/legislative branches or

• lacks judicially manageable standards for resolution SCOTUS = Supreme Court of the United States.

A federal court should not proceed with a suit unless it is justiciable—ie, appropriate for judicial resolution—based on the following Article III requirements: (1) case or controversy, (2) no adequate and independent state grounds, and (3) no political questions. The case-or-controversy requirement is met if the plaintiff has standing—ie, suffered an injury-in-fact that was caused by the defendant and is redressable by the court. An injury-in-fact exists if the plaintiff alleges actual, or an immediate threat of, harm. Therefore, a court should dismiss a suit that is:

• unripe – the suit is based on the mere potential for, or future threat of, harm or

• moot – the suit no longer presents a live (ie, actual) controversy for the court to resolve. Here, the brewery filed suit in federal district court to enjoin the Bureau from adopting standards that would prohibit the brewery from selling unpasteurized beer. But this suit does not involve a justiciable case or controversy because the Bureau has not adopted such standards (no actual harm) and public hearings that must precede the adoption have yet to occur (no imminent harm). Therefore, the court should refuse to adjudicate the merits of this unripe suit and dismiss it.

(Choices A & B) Since this suit is not justiciable, the court cannot consider its merits—eg, whether (1) the Bureau could reasonably believe that pasteurization is the safest process or (2) the brewery's process is as safe as pasteurization.

(Choice D) A federal court can stay (ie, suspend) a suit to (1) force a party to comply with a court order or (2) protect a party's rights. However, a federal court must dismiss a suit when, as here, it does not present a justiciable case or controversy.

Educational objective:

Article III limits the jurisdiction of federal courts to justiciable cases or controversies. This requires proof that the plaintiff has suffered an injury-in-fact—ie, an actual, or immediate threat of, harm. Therefore, a federal court must dismiss a suit involving future or resolved harm.

References

• U.S. Const. art. III, § 2 (case or controversy requirement).

• Texas v. United States, 523 U.S. 296, 300 (1998) (explaining when a claim is unripe for adjudication).

explanation.zh:
可审理性

(适合司法解决)

案例或争议禁止根据以下三种理论发表咨询意见:

• 身份 - 原告必须声称受到质疑的诉讼造成事实伤害,而且可以通过寻求的补救予以补救

• Ripeness - 索赔必须涉及过去伤害或目前伤害威胁的实际争议

• 模拟 - 索赔必须得到解决

SCOTUS不能审查基于充分和独立的国家理由的州法院最后判决

政治问题法院不能审理下列案件:

• 专供行政/立法部门使用;

• 缺乏SCOTUS = 美国最高法院的司法管理标准。

联邦法院不应根据第三条的下列要求进行诉讼,除非诉讼是可由法院审理的,即适合司法解决:(1) 案件或争议;(2) 没有适当和独立的国家理由;(3) 没有政治问题。如果原告是站立的,遭受了由被告造成的、法院可以补救的伤害,即符合案件或争议要求,如果原告声称有实际伤害或直接的伤害威胁,即存在伤害。因此,法院应驳回以下诉讼:

• 排除损害 -- -- 诉讼所依据的仅仅是可能或未来可能造成的损害或威胁。

— — 模拟 — — 诉讼不再为法院解决带来现场(即实际)争议。 在此,酿酒厂向联邦地区法院提起诉讼,要求该局通过禁止酿酒厂出售未消毒啤酒的标准。但这项诉讼不涉及可由法院审理的案件或争议,因为主席团没有通过这种标准(没有实际损害),在通过之前必须举行的公开听证会尚未举行(没有迫在眉睫的损害)。因此,法院应拒绝裁决这一不诉讼的案情并驳回其裁决。

(Choices A & B) 由于这项诉讼不能由法院审理,法院不能考虑其案情——例如:(1) 主席团是否能够合理地认为消毒是最安全的过程,或者(2) 酿酒厂的工艺与消毒一样安全。

(Choice D) 联邦法院可以中止(比如,中止)一项诉讼,以便(1)迫使一方当事人遵守法院命令或(2)保护当事人的权利。 但是,联邦法院必须驳回一项诉讼,因为如同这里一样,它没有提出可由法院审理的案件或争议。

学习要点：

第三条将联邦法院的管辖权限于可审理的案件或争议,这需要证明原告遭受了实际伤害、实际伤害威胁或直接伤害威胁。因此,联邦法院必须驳回涉及未来损害或解决损害的诉讼。

参考资料

• 美国康斯特公司第3条第2款(案件或争议要求)。

• Texas诉美国案,523 U.S. 296, 300 (1998)(解释一项要求何时不能裁定)。

stem:
A federal statute appropriated $7 million for a nationwide essay contest on "How the United States Can Best Stop Drug Abuse." The statute indicates that its purpose is to generate new, practical ideas for eliminating drug abuse in the United States. Contest rules set forth in the statute provide that winning essays are to be selected based on the "originality, aptness, and feasibility of their ideas."

The statute expressly authorizes a first prize of $1 million, 50 second prizes of $100,000 each, and 100 third prizes of $10,000 each. It also states that judges for the contest are to be appointed by the President of the United States with the advice and consent of the Senate and that all residents of the United States who are not employees of the federal government are eligible to enter and win the contest.

A provision of the statute authorizes any taxpayer of the United States to challenge its constitutionality.
stemZh:
一项联邦法律拨款700万美元用于全国性的征文比赛，主题为“美国如何最有效地阻止毒品滥用”。该法律指出其目的是产生新的、实际的消除美国毒品滥用的想法。法律中规定的比赛规则说明，获奖文章将根据其‘想法的原创性、恰当性和可行性’进行选择。

该法律明确授权设立一等奖100万美元，50个二等奖各10万美元，以及100个三等奖各1万美元。它还规定，比赛的评委应由美国总统在参议院的建议和同意下任命，并且所有在美国居住且不是联邦政府雇员的居民都有资格参加并赢得比赛。

该法律的一项条款授权任何美国纳税人对本法律的合宪性提出挑战。
ask: In a suit by a federal taxpayer to challenge the constitutionality of the statute, how should the court rule?
askZh: 在一名联邦纳税人提起的诉讼中挑战该法律的合宪性，法院应如何裁决？

options.en: Hold the statute constitutional, because it is reasonably related to the general welfare, it states concrete objectives, and it provides adequate criteria for conducting the essay contest and awarding the prize money.
options.zh: 认定该法律合宪，因为其与公共福利密切相关，指明了具体目标，并为进行征文比赛和分配奖金提供了充分的标准。

options.en: Hold the statute unconstitutional, because it does not provide sufficient guidelines for awarding the prize money appropriated by Congress and, therefore, unconstitutionally delegates legislative power to the contest judges.
options.zh: 认定该法律违宪，因为该法律未为国会拨款的奖金分配提供足够的指导方针，因此违宪地将立法权委托给比赛评委。

options.en: Hold the statute unconstitutional, because its relationship to legitimate purposes of the spending power of Congress is too tenuous and conjectural to satisfy the necessary and proper clause of Article I.
options.zh: 认定该法律违宪，因为其与国会支出权力的合法目的之间的关系过于脆弱和推测性，无法满足《宪法》第一修正案的必要且适当条款。

options.en: Refuse to decide its merits, because the suit involves policy questions that are inherently political and, therefore, nonjusticiable.
options.zh: 拒绝审理其实质问题，因为该诉讼涉及本质上属于政治性的政策问题，因此不可裁决。

explanation.en:
Congress's taxing & spending powers

(U.S. Const. art. I, sec. 8, cl. 1)

Taxing • Direct taxes – must be: – apportioned evenly among states and – reasonably related to revenue raising

• Indirect taxes – must be: – uniformly applied in every state and – reasonably related to revenue raising

• Export taxes – always unconstitutional Spending • Funds must be spent for general welfare

• Conditions on receipt of funds must: – be clearly stated & unambiguous – be reasonably related to federal interest in funded program – not require states to engage in unconstitutional activity and – not unduly coerce states into accepting The spending clause gives Congress the broad power to appropriate (ie, spend) money for the general welfare—ie, any purpose reasonably related to a concrete public objective. But any conditions placed on the receipt of appropriated funds must:

• be clearly stated

• be reasonably related to the purpose of the expenditure

• not induce the recipient to do anything unconstitutional and

• not unduly coerce the recipient to accept the funds. Here, a federal statute conditioned the appropriation of $7 million on a nationwide essay contest that is reasonably related to a concrete public objective of generating ideas to eliminate drug abuse. The selection criteria are clearly set forth in the contest rules, and there is no evidence that these conditions are unduly coercive or would induce the recipient to engage in unconstitutional conduct. Therefore, the statute should be ruled constitutional.

(Choice B) Under the nondelegation doctrine, Congress may only delegate its legislative authority to others if it provides an intelligible principle to guide them. Since the statute here does provide sufficient guidelines for awarding the prize money, it does not unconstitutionally delegate legislative power to the contest judges.

(Choice C) This statute is related to a legitimate purpose of the spending clause since it seeks to eliminate drug abuse for the general welfare. But since the spending clause is an

express source of congressional power, Congress need not use its implied powers under the necessary and proper clause to enact this statute.

(Choice D) A suit is nonjusticiable if it presents a political question—ie, requires courts to decide a matter that (1) the Constitution has reserved to the legislative or executive branch or (2) lacks judicially manageable standards for resolution. Since courts have the constitutional authority and ability to determine if Congress has properly exercised its powers, this suit presents a justiciable issue.

Educational objective:

The spending clause allows Congress to place conditions on the receipt of federal funds if those conditions (1) are clearly stated, (2) are reasonably related to the purpose of the expenditure, (3) do not induce unconstitutional behavior, and (4) are not unduly coercive.

References

• U.S. Const. art. I, § 8, cl. 1 (taxing and spending clause).

• South Dakota v. Dole, 483 U.S. 203, 207–08 (1987) (holding that conditions on a federal expenditure must be unambiguous and reasonably related to the purpose of the expenditure).

explanation.zh:
国会的税收和开支权力

(《美国法典》第1条第8款,第1项)

• 直接税必须:国家间平均分摊,而且与税收有合理关系

• 间接税必须:在每一个州统一适用,而且与税收有合理联系

• 出口税——总是违宪的开支——资金必须用于一般福利

● 接受资金的条件必须:明确声明和毫不含糊,与联邦对资助方案的利益有合理联系,不要求各州从事违宪活动,不过分强迫各州接受支出条款国会拥有为一般福利(即支出)资金的广泛权力——任何目的与具体公共目标有合理关系。但是,对收到批款规定的任何条件必须:

• 明确说明

• 与支出目的有合理关系

• 不诱导接受者采取任何违宪行为;

• 不得不适当地强迫受援者接受资金,在这方面,一项联邦法规规定拨款700万美元用于全国范围的散文比赛,这与产生消除药物滥用思想的具体公共目标有合理关系。选拔标准在竞争规则中有明确规定,没有证据表明这些条件具有不适当的强制性,或会诱导受奖者从事违宪行为,因此,该法规应具有宪法性。

(Choice B)在不委托学说下,国会只有在规定了一项明晰的原则来指导他们时,才能将其立法权授予他人.由于这里的法规确实为奖金的授予提供了足够的准则,因此它没有违宪地将立法权授予参赛法官.

(选择C)这一法规与支出条款的合法目的有关,因为它力求消除滥用毒品以谋取普遍福利。

明确国会权力的来源,国会无需根据必要和适当的条款使用其默示权力来颁布这一法规.

诉讼如果提出政治问题,即要求法院裁决:(1) 《宪法》保留给立法或行政部门或(2) 缺乏司法上可管理的解决办法的问题,则不可审理。由于法院拥有宪法权力和确定国会是否适当行使其权力的能力,这一诉讼提出了可由法院审理的问题。

学习要点：

支出条款允许国会对接受联邦资金设置条件,如果这些条件(1)有明确规定,(2)与支出目的有合理关系,(3)没有诱发违宪行为,(4)没有不当行为.强制。

参考资料

• 南达科他州诉Dole案,483 U.S.203,207-08(1987年)(认为联邦开支的条件必须明确,并与开支的目的有合理联系)。

stem: A federal statute prohibits the sale or resale, in any place in this country, of any product intended for human consumption or ingestion into the human body that contains designated chemicals known to cause cancer, unless the product is clearly labeled as dangerous.
stemZh: 一项联邦法律禁止在本国内任何地方出售或转售任何旨在供人类食用或摄入人体的含有已知致癌化学物质的产品，除非该产品明确标示为危险品。
ask: The constitutionality of this federal statute may be justified most easily on which of the following bases?
askZh: 该联邦法律的合宪性最可能基于以下哪一依据得到最轻易的证明？

options.en: Congress's power to enforce the Fourteenth Amendment.
options.zh: 国会执行第十四修正案的权力。

options.en: Congress's power to promote science and the useful arts.
options.zh: 国会促进科学和实用艺术的权力。

options.en: Congress's power to provide for the general welfare.
options.zh: 国会为公共福利提供保障的权力。

options.en: Congress's power to regulate commerce among the states.
options.zh: 国会监管州际商业的权力。

explanation.en:
Commerce clause

(U.S. Const. art. I, § 8)

Congress can regulate:

• channels of interstate commerce

• instrumentalities of interstate commerce

• persons/things moving in interstate commerce

• activities that substantially affect interstate commerce The Article I commerce clause grants Congress broad authority to regulate commerce among the states. This includes any activity that has a substantial effect on interstate commerce. If the regulated activity is economic in nature, a substantial effect is presumed.

Here, the federal statute requires sellers to clearly label products that contain cancer-causing chemicals as dangerous. Selling dangerous consumables is an economic activity

that is presumed to substantially affect interstate commerce. Therefore, Congress can regulate this activity under its commerce power.

(Choice A) The Fourteenth Amendment's enforcement clause enables Congress to pass laws enforcing the amendment's other provisions. But since these provisions only apply to state action, Congress cannot regulate the labeling practices of private entities on this basis.

(Choice B) The Article I copyright and patent clause empowers Congress to pass laws that promote science and the useful arts—which are not implicated here.

(Choice C) The taxing and spending clause only allows Congress to tax and spend for the general welfare of the United States. Since the federal statute does not involve such activities, this would not justify the statute.

Educational objective:

The Article I commerce clause grants Congress broad authority to regulate commerce among the states. This includes any activity that substantially affects interstate commerce (eg, economic activities).

References

• United States v. Sullivan, 332 U.S. 689, 697–98 (1948) (holding that a federal drug-labeling statute is a proper exercise of Congress's commerce power).

explanation.zh:
商务条款

(美国康斯特第1条第8款)

国会可以规定:

• 州际商业渠道

• 国家间商业工具

• 在州际商业中流动的人员/物品

· 对州际商业有重大影响的活动 第一条 商业条款赋予国会管理州际商业的广泛权力,其中包括对州际商业有重大影响的任何活动。如果受管制的活动具有经济性质,则假定会产生实质性影响。

这里,联邦法规要求销售者明确标注含有致癌化学品的产品为危险品。 出售危险的消耗品是一种经济活动。

被认为对州际商务有重大影响。因此,国会可以在其商业权力下管理这一活动。

(Choice A) 第十四修正案的执行条款使国会能够通过法律来实施修正案的其他条款。 但是,由于这些条款只适用于国家行动,国会不能据此规范私人实体的标签做法。

(Choice B)第一条版权和专利条款授权国会通过促进科学和实用艺术的法律,而这些法律在此没有涉及。

(Choice) 征税和支出条款只允许国会为美国的总体福利征税和支出,由于联邦法规不涉及此类活动,这不能成为法规的理由.

学习要点：

第一条商业条款赋予国会管理各州间商业的广泛权力,包括任何严重影响州际商业的活动(例如经济活动)。

参考资料

• 美国诉Sullivan案,332 U.S.689,697–98(1948)(认为联邦药品标签法规是适当行使国会的商业权力)。

stem: In order to provide funds for a system of new major airports near the 10 largest cities in the United States, Congress levies a tax of $25 on each airline ticket issued in the United States. The tax applies to every airline ticket, even those for travel that does not originate in, terminate at, or pass through any of those 10 large cities.
stemZh: 为了为美国10个最大城市附近的新主要机场系统提供资金，国会对其在美国境内发行的每张航空机票征收25美元的税。该税适用于每一张航空机票，即使这些机票的旅行并不起始于、终止于或经过这10个大城市中的任何一个。
ask: Is this tax constitutional as applied to the issuance in the United States of an airline ticket for travel between two cities that will not be served by any of the new airports?
askZh: 该税是否适用于在美国境内发行一张用于两个不会被新机场服务的城市之间旅行的航空机票时具有宪法效力？

options.en: No, because the burden of the tax outweighs its benefits for passengers whose travel does not originate in, terminate at, or pass through any of the 10 largest cities.
options.zh: 否，因为对于那些旅行不始于、终止于或经过这10个最大城市的乘客来说，该税的负担超过了其好处。

options.en: No, because the tax adversely affects the fundamental right to travel.
options.zh: 否，因为该税不利地影响了旅行的基本权利。

options.en: Yes, because an exemption for the issuance of tickets for travel between cities that will not be served by the new airports would deny the purchasers of all other tickets the equal protection of the laws.
options.zh: 是，因为对不会被新机场服务的城市之间旅行的机票发行免除该税，将剥夺其他机票购买者的平等保护。

options.en: Yes, because Congress has broad discretion in choosing the subjects of its taxation and may impose taxes on subjects that have no relation to the purpose for which those tax funds will be expended.
options.zh: 是，因为国会拥有广泛的税收选择权，可以对与这些税收资金将被使用的用途无关的事项征税。

explanation.en:
Congressional taxing power

Type of tax

Definition Constitutional requirements

Direct • Taxes on persons or their property

• Payment cannot be avoided

Allowed if:

• apportioned proportionately among states

• reasonably related to revenue production Indirect • Taxes on goods/transactions

• Payment can be avoided or shifted to another (eg, consumer)

Allowed if:

• identical taxation in every state

• reasonably related to revenue production Export • Taxes on goods/services leaving the country

Not allowed

The taxing and spending clause grants Congress the broad power to impose indirect taxes on the subject of its choosing. The taxed subject need not have any relation to the purpose for which the tax funds will be spent. Instead, an indirect tax is constitutional as long as it is (1) identical in every state and (2) reasonably related to revenue production.

Here, Congress has imposed a $25 tax on airline tickets. This indirect tax is identical in every state since it applies to all airline tickets issued in the U.S. And the tax is reasonably related to raising revenues for a system of new major airports near the 10 largest cities. Therefore, this tax is constitutional—even as applied to airline tickets for travel between cities that will not be served by the new airports.

(Choice A) Courts do not weigh the burdens and benefits of a tax to determine its constitutionality.

(Choice B) The Fifth Amendment due process clause generally prohibits the federal government from substantially impairing persons' fundamental rights (eg, the right to travel). And though a tax on airline tickets may affect the right to travel, a minimal tax of $25 would not substantially impair this right.

(Choice C) This type of exemption—which does not appear in the tax levied by Congress— may raise equal protection concerns since it treats similarly situated passengers differently. But the exemption would not deny passengers equal protection of the laws

since it (1) does not substantially impact a fundamental right or protected class and (2) would likely pass rational basis scrutiny.

Educational objective:

Under the taxing and spending clause, Congress can impose indirect taxes on goods or transactions as long as the taxes are (1) identical in every state and (2) reasonably related to revenue production. This is true even if the taxes have no relation to the purpose for which the funds will be spent.

References

• Fernandez v. Wiener, 326 U.S. 340, 355–63 (1945) (holding that an IRS inheritance tax is constitutional since it is indirect, identical in every state, and reasonably related to revenue production).

explanation.zh:
国会征税权

税种

宪法要求

• 个人或财产税

• 无法避免付款

允许:

• 各国按比例分摊

• 与收入生产有合理关系的间接货物/交易税

• 付款可以避免或转嫁给他人(例如消费者)

允许:

• 各州征税相同

• 与收入生产有合理关系离开该国

不允许

税收和支出条款赋予国会对其选择的主体征收间接税的广泛权力。 被征税主体不需要与税收资金的用途有任何关系。相反,间接税只要(1)在各州相同,(2)与收入生产有合理关系,就符合宪法。

在这里,国会对机票征收了25美元税,这种间接税在各州都是一样的,因为它适用于美国发行的所有机票.税收与为10号公路附近的新机场系统增加收入有关因此,这种税是符合宪法的,甚至适用于旅行机票。城市之间,新机场将不提供服务。

(Choice A)法院不权衡税收的负担和好处以确定其合宪性.

(Choice B)第五修正案正当程序条款一般禁止联邦政府严重损害个人的基本权利(如旅行权).虽然机票税可能影响旅行权,但25美元的最低税不会严重损害这一权利。

(C选择)这种豁免——国会征收的税中并不出现这种豁免——可能会引起平等保护问题,因为它对待处境相似的乘客是不同的。 但这种豁免不会剥夺乘客对法律的平等保护。

因为它(1) 对基本权利或受保护的阶层没有实质性的影响,(2) 很可能通过合理的基础审查。

学习要点：

根据征税和支出条款,国会可对货物或交易征收间接税,只要这些税(1)在各州相同,(2)与收入生产有合理关系。即使这些税项与该税项的目的无关,也确实如此。资金将会花掉。

参考资料

• Fernandez诉Wiener案,326 U.S. 340, 355–63 (1945)(认为国税局的继承税是符合宪法的,因为它是间接的,在每个州都是相同的,并且与收入生产有合理关系)。

stem:
In order to reduce the federal deficit, Congress passed, and the President signed into law, a statute that grants the President line-item veto power. Pursuant to this power, the President has the authority to cancel specific spending and tax-benefit measures that have been enacted into law.

Several members of Congress who voted against the legislation have sued the appropriate federal officials in a federal district court. The members of Congress claim that the statute is unconstitutional because it violates the requirements of the federal legislative process. The federal officials move to dismiss the suit.
stemZh:
为了减少联邦赤字，国会通过并由总统签署成为法律的一项法案，赋予总统逐项否决权。根据该权力，总统有权取消已通过的特定支出和税收福利措施。

几位在该立法中投反对票的国会议员在美国联邦地区法院对适当的联邦官员提起诉讼。这些国会议员声称该法案违宪，因为它违反了联邦立法程序的要求。联邦官员提出驳回诉讼的动议。
ask: Which of the following is the most appropriate basis for the court to dismiss this suit?
askZh: 以下哪一项是法院驳回该诉讼最适当的依据？

options.en: The Eleventh Amendment bars suits of this kind in federal court.
options.zh: 第十一修正案禁止在联邦法院提起此类诉讼。

options.en: The members of Congress do not have standing.
options.zh: 这些国会议员没有诉讼资格。

options.en: The suit presents a nonjusticiable political question.
options.zh: 该诉讼提出了一个不可裁决的政治问题。

options.en: The U.S. Supreme Court has exclusive jurisdiction over the action.
options.zh: 美国最高法院对该行动拥有专属管辖权。

explanation.en:
Article III standing

(suing on one's own behalf)

General rule

Plaintiff must prove:

• injury-in-fact – concrete & particularized harm (actual or imminent)

• causation – harm traceable to defendant's conduct AND

• redressability – favorable judicial decision can remedy harm Citizen No standing as mere citizen

Legislator Must prove personal stake in dispute & concrete injury to challenge constitutionality of government action

Taxpayer Standing to challenge taxes owed—but not government spending unless:

• challenging legislation enacted under taxing & spending power AND

• legislation exceeds limits imposed by establishment clause Federal courts can only hear suits in which the plaintiff has standing—ie, a personal stake in the outcome of the case. A federal or state legislator has standing to challenge the constitutionality of government action in the rare instance that the action caused the legislator personal and concrete harm—eg, by nullifying the legislator's vote. Institutional, abstract harm shared equally by all legislators in that respective body does not confer standing.

Here, several members of Congress have challenged the constitutionality of the federal statute. However, the statute has not caused the members to suffer personal and concrete injuries since they were able to vote against the statute and can vote to repeal it in the future. Instead, they are asserting institutional, abstract harm that is shared equally by all other members of Congress. Therefore, the most appropriate basis to dismiss the suit is that the members of Congress lack standing.*

*In Clinton v. City of New York, the U.S. Supreme Court held that plaintiffs who would lose funding or tax benefits have standing to challenge line-item veto power, which was subsequently found unconstitutional as a violation of the federal legislative process.

(Choice A) The Eleventh Amendment generally prohibits suits in federal court against state governments—not federal officials (as seen here).

(Choice C) The political-question doctrine prevents federal courts from adjudicating issues that (1) are reserved to the executive or legislative branch or (2) lack judicially manageable standards for resolution. But since federal courts regularly determine the constitutionality of federal laws, this doctrine does not apply here.

(Choice D) The U.S. Supreme Court has exclusive jurisdiction over suits between states (not seen here).

Educational objective:

A legislator has standing to challenge the constitutionality of government action when that action causes the legislator personal and concrete harm—not institutional, abstract harm shared equally by all legislators in that respective body.

References

• U.S. Const. art. III, § 2 (case-or-controversy requirement).

• Raines v. Byrd, 521 U.S. 811, 829–30 (1997) (holding that members of Congress lack standing when the challenged government action causes an institutional and abstract harm instead of personal and concrete harm).

• 32 Am. Jur. 2d Constitutional Law § 153 (2020) (explaining legislator standing requirements).

第三条

(以个人名义)

一般规则

原告必须证明:

• 实际伤害——具体和具体伤害(实际或即将发生)

• 因果关系——可追溯到被告行为的伤害和

• 可补救性 -- -- 有利的司法裁决可以弥补损害

立法者必须证明个人在争端和具体伤害中的利害关系,以质疑政府行动的合宪性

纳税人有权对所欠税款提出质疑,但政府开支除外:

• 对在征税和消费权力下颁布的立法提出质疑

· 立法超过设立条款规定的限度 联邦法院只能审理原告有诉讼资格的诉讼,即案件结果涉及个人利益的诉讼。联邦或州立法者有权质疑政府行动的合宪性,因为这一行动给立法者造成了个人和具体伤害,例如使立法者的投票无效。各机构所有立法者平等分担的体制性、抽象损害并不赋予地位。

在此,一些国会议员对联邦法规的合宪性提出了质疑,然而,该法规并没有造成议员个人和具体伤害,因为他们能够投票反对该法规,并且可以投票废除该法规。反之,他们主张的是所有其他国会议员都同样分担的体制性抽象损害,因此,驳回诉讼的最适当依据是国会议员缺乏地位。

* 在克林顿诉纽约市案中,美国最高法院认为,将失去资金或税收优惠的原告有权对线性项目否决权提出质疑,这随后被认定违反宪法,违反了联邦立法程序。

(Choice A) 第十一修正案一般禁止向联邦法院起诉州政府,而不是联邦官员(如本文所示)。

(C选择)政治问题学说阻止联邦法院裁决(1)保留给行政或立法部门或(2)缺乏司法上可管理解决标准的问题.但由于联邦法院定期确定联邦法律的合宪性,此学说在此不适用.

(Choice D) 美国最高法院对各州之间的诉讼拥有专属管辖权(此处不见).

学习要点：

当政府行动给立法者造成个人和具体伤害时,立法者有权质疑政府行动的合宪性,而不是该机构所有立法者平等分担的体制性和抽象伤害。

参考资料

· Raines诉Byrd案,521 U.S.811, 829–30 (1997年)(认为在受到质疑的政府行动造成体制和抽象伤害而不是个人和具体伤害时,国会议员缺乏地位)。

• 32 Am. Jur. 2d.《宪法》第153条(2020年)(解释立法者的长期要求)。

stem:
A certain mineral is added to bodies of fresh water to prevent the spread of freshwater parasites. The presence of those parasites threatens the health of the organisms living in rivers and streams throughout the country and imperils the freshwater commercial fishing industry. This mineral is currently mined only in State A.

In order to raise needed revenue, Congress recently enacted a statute providing for the imposition of a $100 tax on each ton of the mineral mined in the United States. Because it will raise the cost of the mineral, this tax is likely to reduce the amount added to freshwater rivers and streams and, therefore, is likely to have an adverse effect on the interstate freshwater commercial fishing industry.

The mineral producers in State A have filed a lawsuit in federal court challenging this tax solely on constitutional grounds.
stemZh:
一种特定的矿物被添加到淡水体中以防止淡水寄生虫的传播。这些寄生虫的存在威胁着全国河流和溪流中生物的健康，并危及淡水商业捕鱼行业。目前，这种矿物仅在A州开采。

为了筹集所需资金，国会最近通过了一项法律，规定对在美国开采的每吨该矿物征收100美元的税。由于这种税会提高该矿物的成本，因此很可能会减少添加到淡水河流和溪流中的该矿物数量，因此很可能会对该州际淡水商业捕鱼行业产生不利影响。

A州的矿物生产商在联邦法院提起诉讼，仅以宪法理由挑战该税。
ask: Is this tax constitutional?
askZh: 该税是否符合宪法？

options.en: No, because it is likely to have an adverse effect on the freshwater commercial fishing industry and Congress has a responsibility under the commerce clause to protect, foster, and advance such interstate industries.
options.zh: 否，因为该税很可能会对该淡水商业捕鱼行业产生不利影响，而国会根据商业条款有责任保护、促进和推动此类州际行业。

options.en: No, because only producers in State A will pay the tax and, therefore, it is not uniform among the states and denies the mineral producers equal protection of the laws.
options.zh: 否，因为只有A州的生产商将支付该税，因此该税在各州之间并不统一，剥夺了矿物生产商获得法律平等保护的权利。

options.en: Yes, because the power of Congress to impose taxes is plenary, this tax does not contain any provisions extraneous to tax needs or purposes, and it is not barred by any prohibitory language in the Constitution.
options.zh: 是，因为国会征收税的权力是完整的，该税不包含任何与税收需求或目的无关的条款，并且不受宪法中的任何禁止性语言的限制。

options.en: Yes, because the tax is a necessary and proper means of exercising federal authority over the navigable waters of the United States.
options.zh: 是，因为该税是行使联邦对美国可航行水域的权威的必要且适当手段。

explanation.en:
Congressional taxing power

Type of tax

Definition Constitutional requirements

Direct • Taxes on persons or their property

• Payment cannot be avoided

Allowed if:

• apportioned proportionately among states

• reasonably related to revenue production Indirect • Taxes on goods/transactions

• Payment can be avoided or shifted to another (eg, consumer)

Allowed if:

• identical taxation in every state

• reasonably related to revenue production Export • Taxes on goods/services leaving the country

Not allowed

The taxing and spending clause gives Congress plenary (ie, exclusive) power to raise federal revenue by imposing taxes. But Congress can only impose an indirect federal tax if it is:

• imposed identically in every state where the taxed goods are found (ie, geographically uniform) and

• reasonably related to revenue production (ie, no provisions extraneous to tax purposes). Here, Congress imposed a $100 indirect tax on a mineral mined in the U.S. The tax is imposed uniformly in every state where the mineral is or may be found and does not contain provisions unrelated to the need for revenue production. Therefore, it complies with the taxing and spending clause. And though the tax only impacts the mineral producers in State A, there is no evidence of intentional discrimination that would raise equal protection concerns—or any other constitutional prohibition (Choice B). Therefore, the tax is constitutional.

(Choice A) The commerce clause vests Congress with broad authority to regulate interstate commerce. But it does not obligate Congress to protect, foster, or advance interstate industries like freshwater commercial fishing.

(Choice D) The necessary and proper clause allows Congress to enact legislation reasonably necessary to carry out its enumerated powers (eg, taxation). But Congress can only use its taxing power to raise revenue—not to exercise authority over navigable waters.

Educational objective:

Indirect federal taxes comply with the taxing and spending clause so long as they are (1) identical in every state where the taxed goods are located and (2) reasonably related to revenue production.

国会征税权

税种

宪法要求

• 个人或财产税

• 无法避免付款

允许:

• 各国按比例分摊

• 与收入生产有合理关系的间接货物/交易税

• 付款可以避免或转嫁给他人(例如消费者)

允许:

• 各州征税相同

• 与收入生产有合理关系离开该国

不允许

税收和开支条款赋予国会全体会议(即专属)通过征收税收来提高联邦收入的权力。 但国会只有在以下情况下才能征收联邦间接税:

• 在发现已征税货物(即地理统一)的每个州实行相同的规定;

• 与收入生产有合理关系(即与税收目的无关的规定)。在这里,国会对美国开采的矿物征收100美元间接税.在矿产品被发现或可能被发现的每一个州都统一征税,不包含与收入生产需要无关的规定,因此符合征税和支出条款。虽然该税只影响到A州的矿物生产者,但没有证据表明有意歧视会引起平等保护问题——或任何其他宪法禁令(Choice B)。

(Choice A)商业条款赋予国会管理州际商业的广泛权力,但并没有规定国会有义务保护、促进或推进州际工业,如淡水商业捕鱼。

必要和适当的条款允许国会颁布合理必要的立法来行使其列举的权力(如税收 ) 。 但国会只能利用其征税权来增加收入,而不是对通航水域行使权力。

学习要点：

间接联邦税符合征税和支出条款,只要它们(1)在被征税货物所在的每个州相同,(2)与收入生产有合理关系。

stem:
A federal statute requires any individual or entity owning more than 100 cars to ensure that at least 10 percent of those cars are electric-powered.

A city that owns over 500 cars has sued the federal official responsible for enforcing this statute in federal district court, seeking an injunction prohibiting enforcement of the statute on the ground that it is unconstitutional.
stemZh:
联邦法规要求拥有100辆以上汽车的任何个人或实体确保至少10%的汽车是电动的。

一个拥有500多辆汽车的城市在联邦地区法院起诉了负责执行该法规的联邦官员,以该法规违宪为由寻求禁止执行该法规的禁令.
ask: Should the court grant the injunction?
askZh: 法院是否应该批准禁令?

options.en: No, because the federal government has sovereign immunity and cannot be sued without its explicit consent.
options.zh: 不,因为联邦政府享有主权豁免,未经其明确同意,不得起诉。

options.en: No, because the statute is valid under the commerce clause and does not violate the Tenth Amendment.
options.zh: 不,因为根据商业条款,法规是有效的,没有违反第十修正案。

options.en: Yes, because as applied to state and local governments, the statute exceeds Congress's power under the commerce clause.
options.zh: 是的,因为适用于州政府和地方政府的法规超越了国会在商业条款下的权力.

options.en: Yes, because the statute violates the reserved rights of the states under the Tenth Amendment.
options.zh: 是的,因为该法规侵犯了各州根据第十修正案保留的权利。

explanation.en:
The commerce clause grants Congress broad power to regulate interstate commerce, including:

• channels of interstate commerce

• instrumentalities of interstate commerce

• persons/things moving in interstate commerce and

• activities that substantially affect interstate commerce. But Congress must comply with other constitutional provisions when exercising its commerce power. This includes the Tenth Amendment, which prohibits Congress from commandeering state or local governments by requiring them to (1) enforce a federal law or (2) enact a state or local law.

Here, Congress enacted a statute requiring individuals and entities owning over 100 cars (like the city) to ensure that at least 10 percent of those cars are electric-powered. This is a valid exercise of Congress's commerce power since cars are instrumentalities of interstate commerce (Choice C). And since the statute does not require the city to enforce it against others or enact related laws, the statute does not violate the Tenth Amendment. Therefore, the court should deny the injunction(Choice D).

(Choice A) The federal government enjoys sovereign immunity from suits seeking monetary damages. But this immunity does not extend to suits seeking nonmonetary relief—eg, an injunction (as seen here).

Educational objective:

Congress has broad power to regulate interstate commerce. But the Tenth Amendment limits this power by prohibiting Congress from requiring state or local governments to (1) enforce a federal law or (2) enact a state or local law.

References

• Reno v. Condon, 528 U.S. 141, 149–51 (2000) (holding that a federal statute regulating states' commercial activity does not violate the Tenth Amendment since it does not require states to enact or enforce any laws).

商业条款赋予国会管理州际商务的广泛权力,包括:

• 州际商业渠道

• 国家间商业工具

• 在州际商业和

在这里,国会颁布了一项法规,要求拥有超过100辆汽车的个人和实体(如城市)确保至少10%的汽车是电动的.这是国会商业权力的有效行使,因为汽车是州际商业的工具(Choice C).并且由于该法规并不要求城市对他人强制执行或颁布相关法律,该法规并不违反第十修正案,因此,法院应当驳回禁令(Choice D).

(Choice A)联邦政府享有寻求金钱损失的诉讼的主权豁免,但这种豁免并不延伸至寻求非金钱救济的诉讼,例如强制令(见这里)。

学习要点：

国会拥有广泛的权力来规范州际商业,但第十修正案禁止国会要求州或地方政府(1)执行联邦法律或(2)颁布州或地方法律,从而限制了这一权力.

stem:
A congressional committee investigated the pharmaceutical industry and found that the high cost of prescription drugs purchased and sold in the United States negatively impacted the nation's economy and the health of its citizens. In response, Congress passed a statute that regulates "the retail prices of every purchase or sale of prescription drugs in the United States."

A group of pharmaceutical companies challenged the constitutionality of this statute in federal court.
stemZh:
国会的一个委员会调查了制药业,发现制药业的成本很高。在美国购买和销售的处方药对国家经济产生了不利影响及其公民的健康。对此,国会通过法规,规范"美国每次购销处方药的零售价格".

一群制药公司在联邦法院对这一法规是否符合宪法提出质疑。
ask: What is the strongest argument in support of the constitutionality of this statute?
askZh: 支持本规约合宪性的最有力论据是什么?.

options.en: Congress may enact statutes for the general welfare.
options.zh: 国会可颁布普遍福利法规。

options.en: Congress may regulate the prices of all domestic purchases and sales of goods.
options.zh: 国会可以规范一切国内购销商品的价格.

options.en: The Constitution grants Congress the power to regulate the interstate transportation of prescription drugs.
options.zh: 《宪法》赋予国会管理州际运输处方的权力。药物。

options.en: The purchases and sales of prescription drugs in the United States substantially impact interstate commerce in the aggregate.
options.zh: 美国境内处方药的购买与销售，总体而言对州际商业产生实质影响。

explanation.en:
The commerce clause gives Congress broad power to regulate interstate and foreign commerce. This includes:

• the channels of interstate and foreign commerce (eg, roadways)

• the instrumentalities of interstate and foreign commerce (eg, vehicles)

• persons and things moving in interstate or foreign commerce (eg, goods and services) and

• in-state activities that, singly or in the aggregate, substantially impact interstate or foreign commerce. Since Congress's commerce power is broad, federal statutes are constitutional if there is any rational basis for concluding that the regulated activity substantially affects interstate or foreign commerce. This can be shown through express congressional findings.

Here, the federal statute regulates the retail prices of prescription drugs in the United States. Congress has the authority to regulate such products' interstate transportation, but this statute also regulates in-state purchases and sales (Choice C). Since the congressional committee found that the high cost of prescription drugs negatively impacted the nation's economy, it is rational to conclude that their aggregated in-state purchases and sales substantially impact interstate commerce. Therefore, this is the strongest argument to support this statute.

(Choice A) The taxing and spending clause empowers Congress to tax and spend for the general welfare. But regulating prices is not equivalent to taxing or spending.

(Choice B) Congress cannot regulate the prices of every domestic purchase and sale of goods since it cannot regulate purely in-state sales that do not substantially affect interstate commerce.

Educational objective:

The commerce clause empowers Congress to regulate (1) channels and instrumentalities of, (2) persons and things moving in, and (3) in-state activities that—singly or in the aggregate—substantially affect interstate or foreign commerce.

References

• Gonzales v. Raich, 545 U.S. 1, 17 (2005) (explaining Congress's broad authority under the commerce clause).

商业条款赋予国会管理州际和外国商业的广泛权力。

• 国家间和对外商业的渠道(例如公路)

• 国家间和对外商务工具(例如车辆)

• 在国家间或外国商业(例如货物和服务)中流动的人员和物品;

• 单独或总共对国家间或外国商业产生重大影响的国内活动。由于国会的商业权力广泛,如果有合理依据认定受管制的活动对州际或外国商业有重大影响,联邦法规是宪法性的,这可以通过国会的明确调查结果来证明.

在这里,联邦法规规范了美国处方药的零售价格,国会有权监管此类产品的州际运输,但这一法规也规范了州内采购和销售(Choice C).由于国会委员会发现处方药的高成本对国民经济产生了负面影响,因此可以合理地得出结论,它们的总的州内购买和销售对州际商业产生了重大影响.因此,这是支持这一章程的最有力论点。

(Choice A) 税收和支出条款授权国会为一般福利征税和支出。 但调节价格并不等于税收或支出。

(Choice B)国会不能规范每一次国内购销商品的价格,因为它不能规范不会对州际商务产生重大影响的纯州内销售.

学习要点：

商业条款授权国会对(1) 进入国内的人和物品的渠道和工具、(2) 以及(3) 对国家间或外国商业有实质性影响的国内活动进行管理。

stem:
Congress enacted a statute that requires all males between the ages of 18 and 30 to register with the Selective Service Agency, which is responsible for drafting individuals to serve in the armed forces in the event of war. Males who fail to register are not eligible to receive federal student aid for college.

An 18-year-old male refused to register and was denied federal student aid pursuant to the statute. The student challenged the federal statute in federal court, arguing that the statute discriminated on the basis of sex and age.
stemZh:
国会颁布了一项法规,要求所有年龄在18至30岁之间的男性都必须在选择服役机构登记,该机构负责征召个人在战争中服役.未注册的男性没有资格获得联邦大学生援助.

一名18岁的男性拒绝注册,并且根据法规被拒绝联邦学生援助,学生在联邦法院对联邦法规提出质疑,认为法规基于性别和年龄的歧视.
ask: Is the statute constitutional?
askZh: 法规合宪吗?

options.en: No, because the statute violates the due process clause of the Fifth Amendment.
options.zh: 不,因为法规违反了第五修正案的正当程序条款。

options.en: No, because the statute violates the equal protection clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.
options.zh: 不,因为法规违反了第十四修正案的平等保护条款。

options.en: Yes, because Congress has broad power to raise and regulate the armed forces.
options.zh: 是的,因为国会拥有广泛的权力来提高和管理武装部队。

options.en: Yes, because federal student aid for college is a privilege, not a right.
options.zh: 是的,因为联邦学生资助大学 是一种特权,不是权利。

explanation.en:
The necessary and proper clause allows Congress to take actions that are reasonably necessary to carry out its enumerated Article I powers. As a result, Congress may establish and require citizens to register for a military draft to carry out its enumerated power to raise and regulate the U.S. armed forces.* However, Congress must still comply with other constitutional provisions when exercising this broad power, including the equal protection component of the Fifth Amendment due process clause.

This component applies when the federal government discriminates against similarly situated persons. Sex-based discrimination is subject to intermediate scrutiny, which requires the government to show that its action is substantially related to an important government interest. This standard is met here because the U.S. Supreme Court held in Rostker v. Goldberg that a male-only requirement for military draft registration is substantially related to the government's important interest in national defense.

Age-based discrimination is subject to mere rational basis scrutiny, under which the challenger need only show that the challenged government action is not related to a legitimate government interest. Since the government will be able to overcome the higher hurdle of intermediate scrutiny to justify its sex-based discrimination, the student's age discrimination claim will also fail. Therefore, the statute complies with the Fifth Amendment due process clause and is constitutional (Choice A).

*Congress also has the power to declare war and authorize the President to call state National Guard units into action without the approval of the state governor to execute federal laws, suppress insurrections, and repel invasions.

(Choice B) The Fourteenth Amendment equal protection clause applies to discrimination by state governments, not the federal government.

(Choice D) Due process protections historically extended to rights—not privileges. But this distinction has been abandoned, so it is irrelevant whether federal student aid for college is a privilege or a right.

Educational objective:

Congress has broad power to raise and regulate the U.S. armed forces, including establishing and requiring citizens to register for a military draft. When exercising this power, Congress does not violate the equal protection component of the Fifth Amendment by restricting registration to males in a specified age range.

References

• U.S. Const. art. I, § 8 (power to raise and regulate armed forces).

• Rostker v. Goldberg, 453 U.S. 57, 83 (1981) (holding that Congress can use its broad authority to raise and regulate the armed forces to require only males in a certain age range to register for a military draft).

explanation.zh:
必要和适当的条款允许国会采取合理必要的行动,以行使第一条规定的权力。因此,国会可能建立并要求公民注册军事草案,以行使其列举的提升和管制美国的权力.* 然而,国会在行使这一广泛权力时仍必须遵守其他宪法规定,包括第五修正案正当程序条款的平等保护部分。

如果联邦政府歧视处境类似的人,则适用这一构成部分。基于性别的歧视受到中间审查,要求政府表明:其行动与一个重要的政府密切相关美国最高法院在Rostker诉Goldberg案中认为,只有男性才能登记军事草案的要求与政府在国防方面的重要利益密切相关。

基于年龄的歧视仅受到合理依据的审查,根据这种审查,质疑者只需表明,受到质疑的政府行动与合法政府利益无关。由于政府能够克服中间审查的较高障碍,为其基于性别的歧视辩护,学生的年龄歧视主张也将失败。因此,该规约符合第五修正案的正当程序条款,符合宪法(选择A)。

*国会还有权宣战,授权总统未经州州长批准,召集州国民警卫队部队行动,执行联邦法律,镇压叛乱,击退入侵.

(Choice B)第十四修正案的平等保护条款适用于州政府而不是联邦政府的歧视.

(选择D) 正当程序保护在历史上延伸到权利,而不是特权。 但这种区分已被放弃,因此,联邦学生对大学的援助是特权还是权利无关紧要。

学习要点：

国会拥有广泛的权力来提升和规范美国武装部队,包括建立和要求公民登记军事草案.在行使这一权力时,国会没有违反《第五修正案》的平等保护内容,将登记限制在一定年龄范围内的男性。

参考资料

• 美国康斯特第1条第8款(组建和管理武装部队的权力)。

• Rostker诉Goldberg案,453 U.S.57,83(1981)(认为国会可以利用其广泛的权力来提高和管制武装部队,只要求一定年龄范围内的男性登记军事草案)。

stem: The Sports Championship Revenue Enhancement Act is a federal statute that was enacted as part of a comprehensive program to eliminate the federal budget deficit. That act imposed, for a period of five years, a 50% excise tax on the price of tickets to championship sporting events. Such events included the World Series, the Super Bowl, major college bowl games, and similar championship sports events.
stemZh: 《体育锦标赛收入增加法》是作为消除联邦预算赤字综合方案的一部分颁布的联邦法规。该法案对冠军体育赛事的门票价格征收50%的消费税,为期五年。 此类赛事包括世界大赛、超级杯、大型大学生碗赛以及类似的冠军体育赛事。
ask: Is this federal tax likely constitutional?
askZh: 这种联邦税是否符合宪法?

options.en: No, because a 50% tax is likely to reduce attendance at championship sporting events and, therefore, is not rationally related to the legitimate interest of Congress in eliminating the budget deficit.
options.zh: 不,因为50%的税可能会减少参加冠军体育赛事,因此,与国会消除预算赤字的合法利益没有合理联系。

options.en: No, because Congress violates the equal protection component of the Fifth Amendment by singling out championship sporting events for this tax while failing to tax other major sporting, artistic, or entertainment events to which tickets are sold.
options.zh: 不,因为国会违反第五修正案的平等保护内容,为这项税单专门指定了冠军体育赛事,而未对出售门票的其他重大体育、艺术或娱乐活动征税。

options.en: Yes, because an act of Congress that appears to be a revenue raising measure on its face is not rendered invalid because it may have adverse economic consequences for the activity taxed.
options.zh: 是的,因为国会的法案表面上似乎是一种增收措施,并不因其可能对征税的活动产生不利的经济后果而被宣布无效。

options.en: Yes, because the compelling national interest in reducing the federal budget deficit justifies this tax as a temporary emergency measure.
options.zh: 是的,因为国家迫切希望减少联邦预算赤字,因此这一税收作为一项临时紧急措施是合理的。

explanation.en:
The taxing and spending clause vests Congress with broad taxing power. This allows Congress to impose an indirect tax (eg, excise tax) so long as it is:

• imposed uniformly in every state where the taxed goods are found and

• reasonably related to revenue raising on its face. Such taxes are constitutional even if they have an adverse economic impact on, or otherwise burden, the thing taxed.

Here, the federal statute imposed a 50% excise tax on tickets to championship sporting events. This indirect tax is applied uniformly to all such events, regardless of where they are held. And though the tax may create adverse economic consequences (eg, reduced attendance) for these events, it is reasonably related to raising revenues to eliminate the budget deficit (Choice A). Therefore, the tax is likely constitutional.

(Choice B) This excise tax triggers equal protection concerns since it taxes championship sporting events differently than other major events. But since neither the events nor the attendees are a protected class, the tax need only pass rational basis scrutiny. Therefore, the tax likely complies with the equal protection component.

(Choice D) Congress does not need a compelling national interest or emergency powers to justify the use of its broad taxing power.

Educational objective:

Congress can impose indirect taxes so long as they are (1) uniformly applied in every state where the taxed goods are found and (2) reasonably related to revenue production. This power is not diminished by the fact that such taxes may burden or restrict the thing taxed.

References

• Flint v. Stone Tracy Co., 220 U.S. 107, 151 (1911) ("[T]he terms duties, imposts and excises are generally treated as embracing the indirect forms of taxation").

• Fernandez v. Wiener, 326 U.S. 340, 362 (1945) ("It has long been settled that an Act of Congress which on its face purports to be an exercise of the taxing power, is not any the less so because the tax is burdensome or tends to restrict or suppress the thing taxed").

explanation.zh:
税收和支出条款赋予国会广泛的征税权。 这使得国会可以征收间接税(例如消费税),只要:

• 在发现已征税货物的每一州统一规定;

• 与表面上的增收有合理关系,即使这些税对所征税项有不利的经济影响或其他负担,也是符合宪法的。

在这方面,联邦法规对参加锦标赛的门票征收50%的消费税。 这种间接税统一适用于所有此类赛事,无论它们在哪里举行。尽管税收可能对这些事件造成不利的经济后果(比如,减少出席率),但它与增加收入以消除预算赤字(选择A)有合理关系。 因此,税收很可能符合宪法。

(Choice B)这一消费税引发了平等保护问题,因为它对锦标赛体育赛事的征税与其他重大赛事不同。 但是,由于赛事和参赛者都不是受保护的阶层,因此税收只需通过合理的基础审查即可。因此,税收可能符合平等保护的内容。

(Choice D)国会不需要令人信服的国家利益或紧急权力来为其广泛征税权的运用辩解.

学习要点：

国会可以征收间接税,只要:(1) 统一适用于每个发现被征税货物的州;(2) 与收入生产有合理关系。 这种权力不会因为这种税可能负担或限制被征税的东西而减弱。

参考资料

^ Flint v. Stone Tracy Co., 220 U.S.107,151 (1911) ("[T]he terms duty, imposts and critics 通常被视作接受间接形式的税收").

· Fernandez v. Wiener, 326 U.S. 340, 362(1945)( " 一项国会法案,表面上声称是行使征税权,但并非因为征税负担沉重或倾向于限制或压制所征税物,就不那么如此").

stem: On the basis of scientific studies showing a causal relationship between the consumption of "red meat" (principally beef) and certain forms of cancer, a federal statute prohibits all commercial advertising of red-meat products. The statute does not, however, restrict the sale of red-meat products. Producers of red meat have challenged the statute as a violation of their free speech rights protected by the First Amendment.
stemZh: 根据显示"红肉"(主要是牛肉)消费与某些癌症形式之间因果关系的科学研究,联邦法规禁止红肉产品的一切商业广告.然而,该法规并不限制红肉制品的销售. 红肉生产商质疑该法规,称其侵犯了受第一修正案保护的言论自由权利.
ask: Is the court likely to find the statute constitutional?
askZh: 法院是否认为规约符合宪法?

options.en: No, because it does not serve a substantial government interest.
options.zh: 不,因为它不符合政府的重大利益。

options.en: No, because it is more extensive than necessary to serve the government interest in preventing certain cancers.
options.zh: 不,因为要为政府预防某些癌症的利益服务是绝对必要的。

options.en: Yes, because it does not affect speech protected by the First Amendment.
options.zh: 是的,因为它不影响 受第一修正案保护的言论。

options.en: Yes, because it serves a legitimate government interest in protecting public health.
options.zh: 是的,因为它符合政府保护公共健康的合法利益。

explanation.en:
The government can ban commercial speech that (1) is false or misleading or (2) concerns unlawful activity. But all other commercial speech is protected by the First Amendment, albeit to a lesser extent than other forms of expression (eg, political speech). This means that the government can only regulate protected commercial speech if the government proves that its regulation directly advances a substantial government interest and is not more extensive than necessary to serve that interest.

Here, the red-meat advertisements are protected commercial speech since there is no evidence that they are false or misleading and red meat is a lawful product (Choice C). And the statute prohibiting these advertisements likely advances the government's substantial interest in protecting the public from certain cancers (Choice A). But the statute is more extensive than necessary to achieve that interest since a cancer warning in those advertisements (instead of a total ban) would suffice. Therefore, the statute will likely be found unconstitutional.

(Choice D) A legitimate government interest is never sufficient to justify the regulation of protected speech.

Educational objective:

The government can only regulate protected commercial speech if the regulation (1) directly advances a substantial government interest and (2) is not more extensive than necessary to serve that interest.

References

• Cent. Hudson Gas & Elec. Corp. v. Pub. Serv. Comm'n, 447 U.S. 557, 564 (1980) (providing the test for determining whether the government's regulation of protected commercial speech is constitutional).

explanation.zh:
政府可以禁止(1)虚假或误导或(2)涉及非法活动的商业言论,但所有其他商业言论都受到第一修正案的保护,尽管程度低于其他表达形式(如政治言论).这意味着,只有在政府证明政府的管制直接促进政府的重大利益,而且范围不超过服务于这种利益所必需的范围的情况下,政府才能管制受保护的商业言论。

在这里,红肉广告是受保护的商业言论,因为没有证据表明这些广告是虚假或误导的,红肉是合法产品(Choice C).禁止这些广告的法规可能会提高政府保护公众免受某些癌症(Choice A)的极大兴趣.但是,为了实现这一利益,该法规的范围比必要的还要广泛,因为在这些广告中发出癌症警告(而不是全面禁止)就足够了。 因此,该法规很可能被认为违宪了。

(Choice D)政府的合法利益永远不足以成为管制受保护言论的理由.

学习要点：

政府只能管理受保护的商业言论,条件是:(1) 该条例直接促进政府的重大利益;(2) 范围不超过服务于该利益所必需的范围。

参考资料

• Cent. Hudson Gas & Elec. Corp. v. Pub. Serv. Comm'n, 447 U.S. 557, 564(1980年)(提供检验标准以确定政府对受保护的商业言论的管制是否符合宪法)。

stem:
Several sites on a mountain within federal public lands are regarded as sacred to a group of people that has gathered there for years to perform religious ceremonies. The United States Forest Service recently issued a permit to a private developer to construct a ski facility in an area that includes the sites that are sacred to the group.

The group has filed suit in federal district court against the Forest Service to force cancellation of the permit, claiming solely that the permit violates its First Amendment right to the free exercise of religion. The Forest Service has conceded that the group's religious beliefs are sincere and that construction of the ski facility will adversely affect the group's religious practices.
stemZh:
联邦公共土地上的一座山上的几个遗址,对于多年来聚集在那里举行宗教仪式的一群人来说被认为是神圣的.美国林业局最近向一名私人开发商颁发了许可证,允许其在包括该团体圣地在内的地区建造滑雪设施。

该团体向联邦地区法院提起诉讼,要求林业局强制吊销许可证,仅声称许可证侵犯了其自由行使宗教权的第一修正案。林业局承认,该团体的宗教信仰是真诚的,建造滑雪设施将对该团体的宗教活动产生不利影响。
ask: What must the group show to prevail on its First Amendment claim?
askZh: 小组必须显示哪些内容在《第一修正案》的要求上占上风?

options.en: Construction of the ski facility will have a discriminatory impact on the group's religious practices in relation to the practices of other religious groups.
options.zh: 建造滑雪设施将对团体的宗教产生歧视性影响。与其他宗教团体的做法有关的习俗。

options.en: The burden on the group's religious practices that will be imposed by construction of the ski facility outweighs the government's interest in allowing the facility.
options.zh: 建造滑雪设施将给该团体的宗教活动带来负担,这超出了政府允许该设施的兴趣。

options.en: The government can serve its legitimate interest in allowing the ski facility by issuing a permit that is less burdensome on the group's religious practices.
options.zh: 政府通过发放对团体宗教活动负担较小的许可证,可以符合其允许滑雪设施的合法利益。

options.en: The permit issued by the government is aimed at suppressing the religious practices of the group.
options.zh: 政府发放的许可证旨在压制该群体的宗教习俗。

explanation.en:
First Amendment free exercise of religion

Burden Applicability Level of scrutiny

Incidental Generally applicable to all persons Rational basis scrutiny:

• burden rationally related to

• legitimate government interest Direct Intentionally targets religious belief/practice

Strict scrutiny:

• burden necessary to achieve

• compelling government interest The United States Forest Service issued a permit for the construction of a ski facility on land sacred to a religious group. As a result, the group filed suit to cancel the permit since the construction would adversely affect its First Amendment right to perform religious ceremonies. The group's likelihood of success depends on whether that burden is either:

• incidental – triggering rational basis scrutiny, where the challenger will fail unless the challenger shows that the burden has no rational relation to any legitimate government interest or

• direct – triggering strict scrutiny, where the challenger will prevail unless the government meets the nearly impossible task of showing that the burden is necessary to achieve a compelling government interest.

Therefore, to have the greatest chance of prevailing on its First Amendment claim, the group must show that the government-issued permit is aimed at suppressing (ie, directly burdens) the group's religious practices.

(Choice A) The ski facility's discriminatory impact on the group's religious practices allows the group to bring a free exercise claim. But that claim will likely fail unless the group can show that the discriminatory impact was intentional, which would create a presumption of invalidity that would be difficult for the government to rebut.

(Choice B) A free exercise challenge will be analyzed under rational basis or strict scrutiny, neither of which weighs the burden on religion against the government's interest.

(Choice C) To prevail, the group must show that the permit directly burdens its religious practices. Once it does so, the burden shifts to the government to show that its compelling (not merely legitimate) interest in the ski facility cannot be achieved by less burdensome means.

Educational objective:

Incidental burdens on the free exercise of religion are typically upheld under rational basis review. But direct burdens are almost always invalidated under strict scrutiny.

References

• Emp't Div. v. Smith, 494 U.S. 872, 878–79 (1990) (establishing the direct/incidental burden test).

• Church of Lukumi Babalu Aye v. City of Hialeah, 508 U.S. 520, 546 (1993) (applying strict scrutiny to a city ordinance that intentionally targeted a religious practice).

explanation.zh:
第一修正案 自由行使宗教

负担适用程度

通常适用于所有人

• 与合理相关的负担

• 政府的合法利益直接针对宗教信仰/实践

严格检查:

• 实现必要的负担

• 引起政府的兴趣 美国林业局颁发了在宗教团体圣地上建造滑雪设施的许可证。因此,该团体提出取消许可证的诉讼,因为建筑工程将对其举行宗教仪式的第一修正案权利产生不利影响。

● 偶然——触发理性的基础审查,除非质疑者表明负担与任何合法政府利益没有合理关系,否则质疑者将失败;

· 直接 – 触发严格的审查,除非政府完成几乎不可能的任务,表明负担是实现政府迫切利益所必需的,否则挑战者将占优势。

因此,为了在《第一修正案》的要求上获得最大机会,该团体必须表明,政府颁发的许可证旨在压制(即直接负担)该团体的宗教活动。

(Choice A)滑雪设施对团体宗教实践的歧视性影响使得团体可以提出自由锻炼主张.但是,除非该团体能够证明歧视性影响是故意的,否则这一主张可能失败,这将产生政府难以反驳的无效推定。

(Choice B)自由锻炼挑战将在合理基础或严格审查下分析,两者都不以政府的利益来权衡宗教的负担.

为了取得胜利,该团体必须表明,许可证直接加重了其宗教活动的负担。 一旦这样做,负担就转移到政府身上,以表明其对滑雪设施的迫切利益(不仅仅是合法利益)不能靠更少的利益来实现。累赘的手段。

学习要点：

对自由行使宗教的附带负担通常在合理的基础上进行审查后得到维持,但直接负担几乎总是在严格审查下变得无效。

参考资料

• Emp't Div.诉Smith, 494 U.S.872,878–79(1990年)(确立直接/偶然负担测试)。

• Lukumi Babalu Aye诉Hialeah市案,508 U.S.520, 546(1993年)(严格审查一项蓄意针对宗教习俗的城市法令)。

stem:
A federal statute requires all males between the ages of 18 and 26 to register with the Selective Service Agency, which is responsible for drafting individuals to serve in the armed forces in the event of war. The statute makes it a felony to fail to register but provides an exemption for individuals who hold a sincere religious objection to war. The statute allows the federal government to question the sincerity and reasonableness of religious objections. The provisions of the statute are inseverable.

An 18-year-old man applying for federal student loans noted on the loan application that he had not registered with the Selective Service Agency. A representative of the Agency contacted the man, and the man said that he had no intention of registering due to his religious belief that all war is wrong. After refusing to register on several more occasions, the man was arrested and charged under the federal statute.
stemZh:
联邦法规要求所有18至26岁的男性在选择服务机构注册,该机构负责征召个人在战争中服役.法规规定不登记为重罪,但规定了对真心反对战争的个人的豁免,法规允许联邦政府质疑宗教反对的诚意和合理性.章程的规定不可动摇。

一名申请联邦学生贷款的18岁男子在贷款申请中指出,他没有在选择性服务局登记。该机构的一名代表与该男子联系,该男子说,他无意登记,因为他的宗教信仰是所有战争都是错的。在多次拒绝登记后,此人根据联邦法规被逮捕和指控。
ask: What is the man's strongest argument that the federal statute is unconstitutional?
askZh: 他最强烈的论据是什么 联邦法规违宪?

options.en: The statute denies him the equal protection of the laws because it only applies to men.
options.zh: 该法规剥夺了他对法律的平等保护,因为它只适用于男子。

options.en: The statute denies him the equal protection of the laws because it only applies to those between the ages of 18 and 26.
options.zh: 该法规剥夺了他对法律的平等保护,因为它只适用于18至26岁的人。

options.en: The statute violates his right to freely exercise his religious beliefs by allowing the government to challenge the reasonableness of those beliefs.
options.zh: 该法规允许政府质疑这些信仰的合理性,侵犯了他自由行使宗教信仰的权利.

options.en: The statute violates his right to freely exercise his religious beliefs by allowing the government to challenge the sincerity of those beliefs.
options.zh: 法规允许政府质疑这些信仰的诚意,侵犯了他自由行使宗教信仰的权利.

explanation.en:
The First Amendment free exercise clause prohibits the government from punishing an individual for any sincerely held religious belief. As a result, any government inquiry is limited to whether a professed belief is sincere—not whether that belief is reasonable or true (Choice D). Here, the federal statute allows the government to challenge the reasonableness of any religious objection to Selective Service registration. Therefore, this is the man's strongest argument that the federal statute is unconstitutional.

(Choice A) A federal law that intentionally discriminates based on gender or nonmarital birth violates the equal protection component of the Fifth Amendment unless it passes intermediate scrutiny. This standard of scrutiny is likely met here because, as the U.S. Supreme Court held in Rostker v. Goldberg, the male-only requirement is substantially related to the government's important interest in national defense.

(Choice B) Under the Fifth Amendment's equal protection component, a federal law that does not impact a fundamental right or protected class is generally valid under mere rational basis scrutiny. Age is not a protected class, so the statute's application to those between the ages of 18 and 26 is likely valid.

Educational objective:

The free exercise clause allows the government to question whether a religious belief is sincerely held but not whether that belief is reasonable or true.

References

• United States v. Seeger, 380 U.S. 163, 184–85 (1965) (explaining that the government's only task is to determine whether a professed religious belief is sincerely held).

• Rostker v. Goldberg, 453 U.S. 57, 78–79 (1981) (holding that a law exempting women from the draft does not violate the equal protection component of the Fifth Amendment).

explanation.zh:
《第一修正案》的自由锻炼条款禁止政府惩罚任何真诚持有的宗教信仰的个人。因此,政府的任何调查都仅限于宣称的信仰是否真诚,而不是这种信仰是否合理或真实(Choice D)。在这里,联邦法规允许政府质疑任何宗教反对选择性服务注册的合理性。 因此,这是此人最强烈的论据,即联邦法规违宪。

(Choice A) 有意基于性别或非婚生的歧视的联邦法律违反了第五修正案中的平等保护内容,除非经过中间审查。 这一审查标准可能在这里得到满足,因为作为美国。最高法院在Rostker诉Goldberg案中认为,只要求男性的要求与政府在国防方面的重要利益有实质关系。

(Choice B)在第五修正案的平等保护部分中,一项不影响基本权利或受保护阶级的联邦法律一般在仅仅理性的基础审查下有效.年龄不是受保护的阶层,因此法规对18至26岁人群的适用很可能有效.

学习要点：

自由锻炼条款允许政府质疑宗教信仰是否真诚持有,但该信仰是否合理或真实。

参考资料

· 美国诉Seeger案,380 U.S. 163,184–85(1965)(解释政府的唯一任务是确定是否真心信奉宗教信仰)。

· Rostker诉Goldberg案,453 U.S.57,78-79(1981)(认为将妇女排除在草案之外的法律不违反第五修正案的平等保护部分)。

stem:
A city ordinance prohibits the location of "adult theaters and bookstores" (theaters and bookstores presenting sexually explicit performances or materials) in residential or commercial zones within the city. The ordinance was intended to protect surrounding property from the likely adverse secondary effects of such establishments. Adult theaters and bookstores are freely permitted in the areas of the city zoned industrial, where those adverse secondary effects are not as likely.

A storekeeper was denied a zoning permit to open an adult theater and bookstore in a building owned by him in an area zoned commercial. As a result, the storekeeper brought suit in an appropriate court challenging the constitutionality of the zoning ordinance.
stemZh:
一项城市法令禁止将"成人剧场和书店"(展示性明显的表演或材料的剧院和书店)设在市内的住宅或商业区.该法令旨在保护周围的财产免受这类设施可能产生的副作用。在城市工业区,成人剧院和书店是自由允许的,因为那里的副副作用不大。

一名店主被拒绝颁发分区许可,无法在他拥有的一栋建筑中开设成人剧院和书店,结果,店主向适当的法院提起诉讼,质疑分区条例是否符合宪法。
ask: Which of the following statements regarding the constitutionality of this city ordinance is most accurate?
askZh: 以下哪些关于该市法令是否符合宪法的声明最为准确?

options.en: The ordinance is invalid, because a city may not enforce zoning regulations that deprive potential operators of adult theaters and bookstores of their freedom to choose the location of their businesses.
options.zh: 该法令无效,因为一个城市可能不会执行分区条例,剥夺可能经营成人剧院和书店的人选择企业所在地的自由。

options.en: The ordinance is invalid, because a city may not zone property in a manner calculated to protect property from the likely adverse secondary effects of adult theaters and bookstores.
options.zh: 该法令无效,因为一个城市不得以保护财产免受成人剧院和书店可能带来的副作用的方式划分财产。

options.en: The ordinance is valid, because a city may enforce this type of time, place, and manner regulation on speech-related businesses, so long as the regulation is designed to serve a substantial governmental interest and does not unreasonably limit alternative avenues of communication.
options.zh: 该法令是有效的,因为城市可以对与言论有关的企业实施这种时间、地点和方式的监管,只要该监管旨在服务于政府的重大利益,而且不会不合理地限制其他途径。交流。

options.en: The ordinance is valid, because a city may enforce zoning restrictions on speech-related businesses to ensure that the messages they disseminate are acceptable to the residents of adjacent property.
options.zh: 该法令是有效的,因为一个城市可以对与言论有关的企业实施分区限制,以确保它们传播的信息为邻近财产的居民所接受。

explanation.en:
Speech regulations

Type Definition Test

Content-based

• Facial discrimination

• Primary purpose targets message, subject, or idea

Strict scrutiny

• Necessary & narrowly tailored to achieve compelling interest Content-neutral

• Regulates time, place, or manner of speech

Intermediate scrutiny

• Narrowly tailored to achieve important interest

• Alternative avenues of communication remain Adult theaters and bookstores are speech-related businesses that are protected by the First Amendment. As a result, government regulation of such businesses is subject to constitutional review. If the regulation targets what is being said (ie, content-based restriction), it is subject to strict scrutiny and presumptively unconstitutional. But if the regulation targets the time, place, or manner of speech (ie, content-neutral restriction), it is subject to intermediate scrutiny and generally acceptable.

In Renton v. Playtime Theatres, Inc., the Supreme Court held that zoning ordinances for adult-entertainment businesses are time, place, and manner restrictions. That is because such ordinances target the secondary effects that adult businesses have on the surrounding community—not the acceptability of their content. As a result, these ordinances are valid so long as they pass intermediate scrutiny—ie, are narrowly tailored to serve a substantial or important government interest and do not unreasonably limit alternative avenues of communication (Choice B).

(Choice A) A city can enforce zoning regulations that restrict adult theater and bookstore operators' freedom to choose the location of their businesses so long as the regulation survives intermediate scrutiny.

(Choice D) A zoning ordinance is a content-based restriction if its primary purpose is to ensure that the messages disseminated by speech-related businesses are acceptable to residents. Such a restriction is almost certainly invalid since it must pass strict scrutiny—ie, be necessary and narrowly tailored to achieve a compelling government interest.

Educational objective:

Time, place, and manner restrictions (eg, zoning ordinances) are valid so long as they are narrowly tailored to serve a substantial government interest and do not unreasonably limit alternative avenues of communication.

References

• Renton v. Playtime Theatres, Inc., 475 U.S. 41, 46–47 (1986) (explaining that zoning ordinances for adult-entertainment businesses are time, place, and manner restrictions).

explanation.zh:
言论条例

类型定义测试

基于内容

• 表面歧视

• 主要目的目标信息、主题或想法

严格审查

• 为实现令人信服的利益而制定的必要和狭义规定

• 规定发言的时间、地点或方式

中间审查

• 为实现重要利益而设计得很少

• 成人剧院和书店是受《第一修正案》保护的与言论有关的企业,因此,政府对这类企业的管理须接受宪法审查。如果该条例针对的是所说的话(即基于内容的限制),则须受到严格审查,并推定违宪。但是,如果该条例针对的是言论的时间、地点或方式(即内容中性限制),则须接受中间审查,并普遍接受。

在Renton诉Playtime Theatres, Inc.案中,最高法院认定,成人娱乐业的分区条例是时间、地点和方式限制。这是因为这些法令针对的是成人企业对周围社区产生的次要影响,而不是其内容的可接受性。因此,只要通过中间审查,这些法令就具有效力,即为服务于实质性或重要的政府利益而作的狭义调整,而且不会不合理地限制其他交流渠道(Choice B)。

(Choice A)一个城市可以执行分区条例,限制成人剧场和书店经营人选择其企业所在地的自由,只要该条例在中间审查中幸存下来.

(Choice D)分区法令是一项基于内容的限制,如果它的主要目的是确保与言论有关的企业所传播的信息为居民所接受。这种限制几乎肯定无效,因为它必须经过严格的审查——即,为了实现令人信服的政府利益,必须进行严格审查,并作狭义调整。

学习要点：

时间、地点和方式限制(例如分区条例)只要是狭义的,符合政府的重大利益,而且不会不合理地限制其他沟通渠道,就有效。

参考资料

· Renton诉Playtime Theatres, Inc., 475 U.S.41, 46–47(1986)(解释成人娱乐业分区条例是时间、地点和方式限制)。

stem:
Insurance is provided in a state only by private companies. Although the state insurance commissioner inspects insurance companies for solvency, the state does not regulate their rates or policies. An insurance company charges higher rates for burglary insurance to residents of one part of a county in the state than to residents of another section of the same county because of the different crime rates in those areas.

A resident of that county was charged the higher rate by the insurance company because of the location of her residence. She sues the insurance company, alleging that the differential in insurance rates unconstitutionally denies her the equal protection of the laws.
stemZh:
保险只在一个国家由私营公司提供,虽然国家保险专员检查保险公司的偿付能力,但国家不规范其费率或保险单。保险公司向州内一个县的一个部分的居民收取的盗窃保险费率高于同一县另一个部分的居民,因为这些地区的犯罪费率不同.

该县的一位居民因住所所在地被保险公司收取更高的费率,她起诉保险公司,声称保险费率的差异不符合宪法,剥夺了她受到法律的平等保护。
ask: Will the resident's suit succeed?
askZh: 居民的服饰会成功吗?

options.en: No, because the constitutional guarantee of equal protection of the laws is not applicable to the actions of these insurance companies.
options.zh: 不,因为对法律的平等保护的宪法保障不适用于这些保险公司的行动。

options.en: No, because there is a rational basis for the differential in insurance rates.
options.zh: 不,因为保险费率差别是有合理依据的。

options.en: Yes, because the higher crime rate in the resident's neighborhood demonstrates that the county police are not giving persons who reside there the equal protection of the laws.
options.zh: 是的,因为居民街区的犯罪率较高表明,县警察没有给予居住在该地的人同等的法律保护。

options.en: Yes, because the insurance rate differential is inherently discriminatory.
options.zh: 是的,因为保险费率差别本质上是歧视性的。

explanation.en:
State-action doctrine

Traditional government function

• Private actor performs traditional & exclusive government function (eg, running elections)

Significant government involvement

• Government & private actor have mutually beneficial relationship (eg, joint activity or venture)

• Government creates nexus by affirmatively facilitating or authorizing private action (eg, police officer acting under color of law)

• Government is pervasively intertwined in private entity's management or control The Constitution (excluding the Thirteenth Amendment) only applies to government actors. But in rare circumstances, a private actor is viewed as a government actor (and subject to the Constitution) under the state-action doctrine. This doctrine applies when:

• the private actor performs a traditional and exclusive government function or

• the government is significantly involved in the private actor's activities. Therefore, the resident can only challenge the private insurance company's discriminatory conduct on equal protection grounds if the state-action doctrine applies.

Here, the company does not perform a traditional and exclusive government function since insurance has historically been provided by private entities. And though the state inspects all insurance companies for solvency, it does not regulate their rates and policies. But even if it did, state regulation (however substantial) does not amount to significant government involvement since this an ordinary government activity. Therefore, the resident's suit will fail because equal protection guarantees do not apply to the company's actions.

(Choice B) Equal protection challenges undergo rational basis review when the challenged action does not impact a fundamental right or protected class. But since the insurance company's actions cannot be challenged on equal protection grounds, it does not matter whether there is a rational basis for the insurance rate differential.

(Choices C & D) The higher crime rate in the resident's neighborhood may demonstrate that county police are not giving neighborhood residents the equal protection of the laws. And the insurance rate differential is inherently discriminatory. But these facts are irrelevant in this suit against a private insurance company.

Educational objective:

The state-action doctrine applies when (1) a private actor performs a traditional and exclusive government function or (2) the government is significantly involved in the private

actor's activities. The private actor is then treated as a government actor and bound by the Constitution.

References

• Am. Mfrs. Mut. Ins. Co. v. Sullivan, 526 U.S. 40, 52 (1999) (holding that private insurance companies are not government actors unless there is proof of significant government involvement in their activities).

explanation.zh:
国家行动理论

传统政府职能

• 私人行为者履行传统和专属政府职能(如选举)

政府的重大参与

• 政府和私人行为者有互利关系(例如联合活动或企业)

• 政府通过积极促进或授权私人行动(例如警官依法行事)建立关系

• 政府在私营实体的管理或控制中普遍交织在一起。 《宪法》(不包括第十三修正案)只适用于政府行为者。但是,在国家行动理论下,私人行为者被视为政府行为者(并受《宪法》制约)。

• 私人行为者履行传统和排他性政府职能;

• 政府大量参与私人行为者的活动,因此,居民只有在适用国家行动原则的情况下,才能以平等保护的理由对私营保险公司的歧视行为提出质疑。

这里,公司不履行传统和专属的政府职能,因为保险历来是由私人实体提供的。 尽管国家检查所有保险公司的偿付能力,但它并没有监管它们的费率和政策。但即便如此,国家监管(无论多么重大)并不等于政府的重大参与,因为这是政府的一项普通活动。因此,居民的诉讼将失败,因为平等保护保障不适用于公司的行为。

(Choice B) 当受到质疑的行动没有影响到基本权利或受保护的阶层时,对平等保护的挑战进行合理的基础审查。但由于保险公司的行为不能以平等保护为由提出质疑,保险费率差异是否有合理依据并不重要.

(Choices C&D) 居民街区的犯罪率较高可能表明郡警察并没有给予邻里居民同等的法律保护,保险费率差别本质上是歧视性的.但是这些事实在针对一家私人保险公司的诉讼中并不重要.

学习要点：

国家行动学说适用于(1)私人行为者履行传统和排他性政府职能或(2)政府大量参与私人活动的情况。

演员的活动,私人演员随后被视为政府演员,受宪法约束.

参考资料

• Am.Mfrs. Mut. Ins. Co.诉Sullivan, 526 U.S. 40, 52 (1999)(认为私人保险公司不是政府行为者,除非有证据表明政府大量参与其活动)。
