stem:
Congress recently enacted a statute creating a program that made federal loans available to family farmers who had been unable to obtain loans from private lenders. Congress appropriated a fixed sum of money to fund loans made pursuant to the program and gave a designated federal agency discretion to decide which applicants were to receive the loans.

Two weeks after the program was established, a family farmer applied to the agency for a loan. Agency officials promptly reviewed her application and summarily denied it.

The farmer has sued the agency in federal district court, claiming only that the denial of her application without the opportunity for a hearing violated the due process clause of the Fifth Amendment. The farmer claims that she could have proved at such a hearing that without the federal loan it would be necessary for her to sell her farm.
stemZh:
国会最近颁布了一项法规,制定了一项方案,向无法从私人贷款人那里获得贷款的家庭农民提供联邦贷款。国会拨出一笔固定数额的资金,用于资助根据该方案提供的贷款,并赋予联邦指定机构决定哪些申请人接受贷款的酌处权。

在该方案建立两周后,一名家庭农民向该机构申请贷款,该机构官员立即审查了她的申请并立即予以拒绝。

该农民在联邦地区法院起诉该机构,只声称在没有机会听审的情况下拒绝其申请违反了第五修正案的正当程序条款。这名农民声称,她本来可以在这样的听证会上证明,没有联邦贷款,她就必须出售她的农场.
ask: Should the court uphold the agency's decision?
askZh: 法庭应该维持该机构的决定吗?

options.en: No, because due process requires federal agencies to provide a hearing before making any factual determination that adversely affects an identified individual based on his or her particular circumstances.
options.zh: 否,因为正当程序要求联邦机构在根据特定情况作出对被识别者产生不利影响的事实认定之前提供听证。

options.en: No, because the denial of a loan may deprive the farmer of an established liberty interest to pursue her chosen occupation.
options.zh: 不,因为拒绝贷款可能剥夺农民从事其选择的职业的既定自由权益。

options.en: Yes, because the applicable statute gives the farmer no legitimate claim of entitlement to receive a loan.
options.zh: 是的,因为适用的法规没有给予农民获得贷款的权利的合法要求。

options.en: Yes, because the spending clause of Article I, Section 8, gives Congress plenary power to control the distribution of appropriated funds in any manner it wishes.
options.zh: 是的,因为第一条第8节的支出条款赋予国会全体权力,以它所希望的任何方式控制所拨款项的分配。

explanation.en:
Due process rights

Right Applicability Examples

Life Government deprives person of life • Execution

Liberty Government significantly restrains person's physical freedom, exercise of fundamental rights, or freedom of choice

• Incarceration

• Commitment to mental institution

• Loss of parental rights Property Government deprives benefit from person legally entitled to receive it

• Suspension from public school

• Termination of welfare benefits

• Loss of public employment (not at will) The Fifth Amendment due process clause requires that the federal government provide an individual with notice and a meaningful opportunity to be heard when it deprives that individual of life, liberty, or property. Under this clause, a property interest exists when an individual is legally entitled to a benefit—but mere anticipation of (or need for) a benefit does not create a protected interest.

Here, the farmer applied for a federal loan under the newly enacted statute. But she was not legally entitled to the loan because the statute gave a federal agency the discretion to decide which applicants would receive loans. And since her need for a loan was not an interest protected by the due process clause, the agency was not obligated to provide her with an opportunity for a hearing. Therefore, the agency's decision should be upheld.

(Choice A) Due process only requires a hearing when the government deprives an individual of a protected life, liberty, or property interest (not seen here).

(Choice B) Pursuing one's chosen occupation is not a liberty interest protected by the due process clause.

(Choice D) Although Article I, Section 8 gives Congress broad authority to control the distribution of appropriated funds, that authority is subject to many constitutional limitations—including the Fifth Amendment due process clause.

Educational objective:

Fifth Amendment due process protections are triggered when the federal government deprives an individual of life, liberty, or property. An individual has a protected property interest when he/she is legally entitled to (not merely anticipating or needing) a benefit.

References

• Bd. of Regents of State Colls. v. Roth, 408 U.S. 564, 577 (1972) (defining property interests protected by procedural due process).

适当程序权利

正确适用

• 处决

政府大大限制个人的人身自由、基本权利的行使或选择自由。

• 监禁

• 对精神病院的承诺

• 丧失父母权利 财产政府剥夺依法有权领取者的福利

• 停止上公立学校

• 终止福利福利

• 丧失公共就业(不是随意的) 第五项修正案的正当程序条款要求联邦政府在剥夺个人生命、自由或财产时,向个人提供通知和有意义的陈述机会。根据这一条款,当个人在法律上有权获得一项福利时即存在财产权益,但仅仅预期(或需要)某项福利并不产生受保护的权益。

在此,农民根据新颁布的法规申请联邦贷款,但她没有法律权利获得贷款,因为法规赋予联邦机构决定哪些申请人将获得贷款的酌处权。由于她需要贷款不是正当程序条款所保护的利息,该机构没有义务为她提供听证机会,因此,应当维持该机构的决定。

(Choice A) 正当程序只要求当政府剥夺个人受保护的生命,自由或财产权益(此处不见)时进行听证.

(Choice B)追求自己选择的职业不是受正当程序条款保护的自由利益.

(选择D)虽然第一条,第8节赋予国会广泛的权力来控制所拨款项的分配,但这一权力受到许多宪法限制——包括第五修正案的正当程序条款.

学习要点：

第五修正案在联邦政府剥夺个人生命、自由或财产时启动正当程序保护。 当个人在法律上有权(而不仅仅是预期或需要)获得福利时,他(她)拥有受保护的财产权益。

参考资料

• 州州长诉Roth案Bd.,408 U.S. 564,577(1972)(确定受程序正当程序保护的财产权益)。

stem:
In one state, certain advanced diagnostic medical technologies were located only in hospitals, where they provided a major source of revenue. In many other states, such technologies were also available at "diagnostic centers" that were not affiliated with hospitals.

A group of physicians announced its plan to immediately open in the state a diagnostic center that would not be affiliated with a hospital. The state hospital association argued to the state legislature that only hospitals could reliably handle advanced diagnostic medical technologies. The legislature then enacted a law prohibiting the operation in the state of diagnostic centers that were not affiliated with hospitals.
stemZh:
在一个州,某些先进的诊断医学技术只存在于医院,它们提供了主要的收入来源。 在很多其他州,这些技术也存在于与医院无关的“诊断中心 ” 。

一组医生宣布计划立即在州内开设一个诊断中心,这个中心不会附属于医院.州立医院协会向州立立法机构提出,只有医院才能可靠地处理先进的诊断医学技术.立法机关随后颁布了一项法律,禁止在不附属于医院的诊断中心运作。
ask: The group of physicians filed suit challenging the constitutionality of the state law. What action should the court take?
askZh: 医生小组提起诉讼,质疑州法律的合宪性。法院应采取何种行动?

options.en: Dismiss the suit without reaching the merits, because the suit is not ripe.
options.zh: 免去官司而未达事理,因官司未熟.

options.en: Invalidate the law, because it imposes an undue burden on access to medical services in the state.
options.zh: 法律无效,因为它给获得国家医疗服务造成了不适当的负担。

options.en: Uphold the law, because the legislature could rationally believe that diagnostic centers not affiliated with hospitals would be less reliable than hospitals.
options.zh: 维护法律,因为立法机构可以合理地认为,与医院无关的诊断中心不如医院可靠。

options.en: Uphold the law, because the provision of medical services is traditionally a matter of legitimate local concern that states have unreviewable authority to regulate.
options.zh: 维护法律,因为提供医疗服务传统上是当地正当关切的问题,国家无权进行审查。

explanation.en:
The constitutionality of a discriminatory law can be challenged under the equal protection clause. Such challenges are generally reviewed under the rational basis test, which requires that the law be rationally related to any legitimate state interest. And since any reasonable, conceivable purpose that may have motivated the legislature to pass the law will satisfy this test, laws subject to the rational basis test are usually upheld.

Here, a state law discriminates against physicians who wish to operate an unaffiliated diagnostic center by requiring that diagnostic centers be affiliated with hospitals. Since the legislature could rationally believe that unaffiliated diagnostic centers would be less reliable than hospitals, the law is rationally related to a legitimate state interest—providing safe medical services. Therefore, the law satisfies the rational basis test and should be upheld.

(Choice A) A court will dismiss a suit without reaching the merits if it is not ripe—ie, if the plaintiff has yet to suffer actual harm or an imminent threat thereof. But since this law threatens the physicians' immediate plan to open a diagnostic center in the state, their suit is ripe for litigation.

(Choice B) Discriminatory laws that unduly burden a fundamental right are presumptively invalid and reviewed under strict scrutiny, which requires that the law be necessary to serve a compelling state interest. But access to medical services is not a fundamental right, so this law need only survive rational basis scrutiny.

(Choice D) State laws and regulations are always subject to constitutional limits, so the state does not have the unreviewable authority to regulate the provision of medical services—even if it is traditionally a matter of legitimate local concern.

Educational objective:

Under the equal protection clause, discriminatory laws are generally reviewed under the rational basis test—ie, the law must be rationally related to any legitimate state interest. And any reasonable, conceivable purpose that may have motivated the legislature in passing the law will satisfy this test.

References

• U.S. Const. amend. XIV (equal protection clause).

• Heller v. Doe, 509 U.S. 312, 319–20 (1993) (explaining that any reasonable, conceivable legislative purpose will satisfy rational basis scrutiny).

• Barsky v. Board of Regents, 347 U.S. 442, 449 (1954) (finding that a state has broad power to regulate the health profession).

explanation.zh:
根据平等保护条款,可以对歧视性法律的合宪性提出质疑,这种质疑一般根据合理依据标准进行审查,该标准要求法律与任何合法国家利益合理相关。由于任何可能促使立法机关通过法律的合理、可想象的目的都将满足这一检验标准,因此,通常都坚持经过合理基础检验的法律。

在这方面,州法律通过要求诊断中心附属于医院,歧视希望经营无附属诊断中心的医生。由于立法机构可以合理地认为,与医院相比,无关联的诊断中心不可靠,法律与合法国家利益——提供安全医疗服务——有合理联系。因此,法律符合合理的基础检验标准,应予以维护。

(Choice A) 如果诉讼不成熟,如果原告尚未遭受实际伤害或迫在眉睫的伤害威胁,法院将驳回诉讼,而不达成案情。但由于这部法律威胁着医生们立即计划在州内开设一个诊断中心,因此他们的诉讼已经成熟,可以提起诉讼.

(Choice B) 对基本权利造成不适当负担的歧视性法律推定无效,并经过严格审查加以审查,这就要求法律是为令人信服的国家利益服务所必需的。但是获得医疗服务并不是一项基本权利,因此这项法律只需要经过合理的基础审查。

(Choice D) 国家法律和规章总是受宪法限制,因此国家没有不受审查的权力来管理医疗服务的提供——即使传统上这是当地正当关注的问题。

学习要点：

根据平等保护条款,歧视性法律一般通过合理依据检验加以审查,即法律必须与任何合法国家利益合理挂钩。任何可能促使立法机关通过法律的合理、可想象的目的都将满足这一标准。

参考资料

• 美国康斯特修正十四(平等保护条款)。

· Heller诉Doe案,509 U.S. 312, 319–20(1993)(解释任何合理、可想象的立法目的都将满足合理的基础审查)。

• Barsky诉摄政委员会案,347 U.S.442,449(1954)(调查国家有广泛权力管理保健职业)。

stem: A state statute requires all workers' compensation actions filed in state court to be decided by a judge. A woman brought a workers' compensation action in state court against her employer for injuries she sustained at work. The woman demanded a jury trial, but the court denied her request pursuant to the state statute.
stemZh: 州法规要求所有在州法院提起的工人赔偿诉讼都由法官裁决,一名妇女因工伤向州法院提起工人赔偿诉讼。该妇女要求陪审团审判,但法院根据州法规驳回了她的请求。
ask: Is the state statute likely constitutional?
askZh: 州法规是否符合宪法?

options.en: No, because denying a jury trial only in workers' compensation actions violates equal protection of the laws.
options.zh: 不,因为只在工人赔偿行动中拒绝陪审团审判违反了法律的平等保护。

options.en: No, because the Seventh Amendment guarantees the woman a jury trial.
options.zh: 不,因为第七修正案 保证妇女有一个陪审团审判。

options.en: No, because the Sixth Amendment requires a jury to decide the outcome of the case.
options.zh: 不,因为第六修正案要求陪审团决定案件结果.

options.en: Yes.
options.zh: 对

explanation.en:
The first 10 amendments to the U.S. Constitution (ie, the Bill of Rights) protect individuals from government overreach. These protections limit the power of the federal government, and most apply to the states with equal force through incorporation into the Fourteenth Amendment due process clause—with three exceptions:

• The Third Amendment prohibition against the government quartering soldiers in individuals' homes

• The Fifth Amendment requirement of a grand jury indictment to charge a person with a capital offense

• The Seventh Amendment guarantee of a jury trial in civil cases* Here, the state court denied the woman's jury trial demand pursuant to a state statute requiring judges to decide the outcome of workers' compensation suits. Since the right to a jury trial in civil cases has not been incorporated into the Fourteenth Amendment due process clause, this right does not apply in state court. As a result, the woman has no right to a jury trial, and the statute is likely constitutional (Choice B).

*The Supreme Court incorporates a protection under the Bill of Rights into the Fourteenth Amendment due process clause if the protection is fundamental to the scheme of ordered liberty or deeply rooted in the history and tradition of the United States.

(Choice A) The statute implicates the Fourteenth Amendment equal protection clause because it treats workers' compensation claimants differently than other civil claimants. However, the statute does not substantially impact a fundamental right or protected class, so rational basis scrutiny applies. Since this low level of scrutiny is easily met, the statute likely complies with the equal protection clause.

(Choice C) The Sixth Amendment right to a jury trial attaches to any criminal proceeding in which the defendant could be sentenced to more than six months in prison. But since the woman filed a civil action, this right does not apply here.

Educational objective:

Every Bill of Rights protection applies to the states except (1) the Third Amendment prohibition against the government quartering soldiers in individuals' homes, (2) the Fifth Amendment requirement of a grand jury indictment for capital offenses, and (3) the Seventh Amendment right to a jury trial in civil cases.

References

• Minneapolis & St. Louis R.R. Co. v. Bombolis, 241 U.S. 211, 217–18 (1916) (explaining that the Seventh Amendment right to a jury trial in civil cases does not apply to the states).

• McDonald v. City of Chi., 561 U.S. 742, 765 n.13 (2010) (reaffirming that the Seventh Amendment guarantee of a civil jury trial has not been incorporated into the Fourteenth Amendment due process clause).

explanation.zh:
美国宪法的前10项修正案(即权利法案)保护个人不受政府过度侵犯.这些保护限制了联邦政府的权力,大多数通过纳入第十四修正案的正当程序条款,以同等效力适用于各州,但有三种例外:

• 第三修正案禁止政府士兵在个人家中驻扎

• 《第五修正案》要求大陪审团起诉某人犯有死刑罪

• 第七修正案保证在民事案件中进行陪审团审判。 * 在这方面,州法院根据要求法官决定工人赔偿诉讼结果的州法规,驳回了妇女陪审团审判的要求。由于在民事案件中接受陪审团审判的权利尚未纳入第十四修正案的正当程序条款,这项权利不适用于州法院,因此,妇女无权接受陪审团审判,法规可能符合宪法(Choice B)。

* 最高法院将《权利法案》规定的保护纳入第十四修正案的正当程序条款,如果保护对有秩序的自由制度至关重要或深深植根于美国的历史和传统。

(Choice A) 法规涉及第14号修正案的平等保护条款,因为它对待工人的赔偿要求者不同于其他民事要求者。然而,该法规并没有对基本权利或受保护的阶层产生实质性的影响,因此适用合理的基础审查。 由于这种低水平的审查很容易达到,因此该法规可能符合平等保护条款。

(C) 第六修正案对陪审团审判的权利赋予了任何可判处被告6个月以上监禁的刑事诉讼,但既然妇女提起民事诉讼,这项权利在此不适用。

学习要点：

每项《权利法案》保护都适用于各州,但(1) 《第三修正案》禁止政府士兵在个人家中驻扎,(2) 《第五修正案》关于对死刑罪进行大陪审团起诉的规定,以及(3) 《第七修正案》修改民事案件陪审团审判权.

参考资料

· Minneapolis & St.Louis R.R. Co.诉Bombolis案,241 U.S.211,217–18 (1916)(解释第七修正案在民事案件中接受陪审团审判的权利不适用于各州)。

• McDonald v. City of Chi., 561 U.S.742, 765 n.13 (2010)(重申第七修正案关于民事陪审团审判的保障尚未纳入第十四修正案正当程序条款)。

stem:
A state has a statute providing that an unsuccessful candidate in a primary election for a party's nomination for elected public office may not become a candidate for the same office at the following general election by nominating petition or by write-in votes.

A woman sought her party's nomination for governor in the primary election. After losing in the primary, the woman filed nominating petitions containing the requisite number of signatures to become a candidate for the office of governor in the following general election. The chief elections officer of the state refused to certify the woman's petitions solely because of the above statute. The woman then filed suit in federal district court challenging the constitutionality of this statute.
stemZh:
州有法规规定,在政党竞选公职提名的初级选举中未通过的候选人不得在下一次大选中通过提名请愿或书面投票成为同一职位的候选人。

一名妇女在初选中寻求其政党的州长提名,在初选中败选后,该名妇女提出了提名申请,其中包含成为以下一般州长职位候选人所需的签名数量:州选举事务负责人仅因为上述法规而拒绝核证妇女的申请,然后该妇女向联邦地区法院提起诉讼,质疑该法规是否符合宪法。
ask: If the court holds that the statute constitutes a severe restriction, which of the following is the proper burden of persuasion in this suit?
askZh: 如果法院认定规约构成严重限制,那么在本诉讼案中,以下哪些是适当的说服责任?

options.en: The state must demonstrate that the statute is rationally related to a legitimate state interest.
options.zh: 国家必须表明该法规与合法国家利益合理相关。

options.en: The state must demonstrate that the statute is the least restrictive means of achieving a compelling state interest.
options.zh: 国家必须表明,该法规是实现令人信服的国家利益的限制性最小的手段。

options.en: The woman must demonstrate that the statute is not necessary to achieve a compelling state interest.
options.zh: 妇女必须证明,法规对于实现迫切的国家利益是不必要的。

options.en: The woman must demonstrate that the statute is not rationally related to a legitimate state interest.
options.zh: 妇女必须证明法规与合法国家利益没有合理联系。

explanation.en:
State-election restrictions

Restriction Examples Test

Ordinary

(nondiscriminatory)

• Voter registration

• Photo-ID requirement

• Disallowing write-in voting

Rational basis: challenger must show restriction lacks rational relationship to legitimate state interest

Severe

(discriminatory)

• Poll tax

• Disallowing third-party candidacies

• Property-ownership requirement

Strict scrutiny: state must show restriction is necessary to achieve compelling state interest

States may regulate their own elections by requiring voters and candidates to abide by certain requirements. But these regulations must comply with the First Amendment and the Fourteenth Amendment equal protection clause, which together secure an individual's right to vote and freely associate. If the electoral regulation is challenged under either constitutional provision, the standard for evaluating that regulation depends on the severity of the burden imposed. A court will apply either:

• rational basis review – applies to ordinary (nondiscriminatory) burdens and requires the challenger to prove that the regulation is not rationally related to a legitimate state interest or

• strict scrutiny – applies to severe (discriminatory) burdens and requires the state to prove that its regulation is the least restrictive means of achieving a compelling state interest.

Here, a state statute prohibits a loser of a primary election from running for the same public office in the general election (ie, "sore-loser law"). This infringed upon the woman's right to access the ballot as a political candidate (ie, her right to vote and freely associate). And if the court holds that the statute constitutes a severe restriction on that right, then the state must demonstrate that the statute is the least restrictive means of achieving a compelling state interest.

(Choices A & D) Rational basis review places the burden of persuasion on the challenging party—not the state—when ordinary electoral regulations are involved.

(Choice C) Strict scrutiny places the burden of persuasion on the state to demonstrate that a law is necessary (ie, the least restrictive means) to achieve a compelling state interest.

Educational objective:

When an electoral regulation imposes an ordinary burden, the challenging party must prove that the regulation is not rationally related to a legitimate state interest (ie, rational basis test). But if the burden is severe, the state must show that the regulation is the least restrictive means of achieving a compelling state interest (ie, strict scrutiny).

References

• U.S. Const. amend. I (freedom of association).

• U.S. Const. amend. XIV (equal protection clause).

• Burdick v. Takushi, 504 U.S. 428, 433–34 (1992) (explaining that the level of scrutiny of an election law depends on the severity of the restriction).

explanation.zh:
州选举限制

限制实例测试

普通类

(不歧视)

• 选民登记

• 照片识别要求

• 拒绝书面投票

合理依据:质疑者必须显示限制与合法国家利益缺乏合理关系

严重

(歧视)

• 选票税

• 取消第三方候选人资格

• 财产所有权要求

严格审查:国家必须显示限制对实现令人信服的国家利益是必要的

国家可通过要求选民和候选人遵守某些要求来规范自己的选举。但是这些条例必须符合第一修正案和第十四修正案的平等保护条款,这些条款共同保障个人的选举权和自由结社权.如果根据《宪法》的任何一项条款对选举条例提出质疑,则该条例的评估标准取决于所施加的负担的严重程度。

• 合理的基础审查——适用于普通(非歧视性)负担,要求质疑者证明该条例与合法国家利益没有合理联系;

• 严格审查——适用于严重(歧视性)负担,要求国家证明它的管制是实现迫切国家利益的限制性最小的手段。

在此,州法规禁止初级选举失败者在大选中竞选同一公职(即"孤寡法").这侵犯了妇女作为政治候选人参加投票的权利(即她的选举权和自由结社权)。如果法院认定该法规构成对这项权利的严格限制,那么国家必须证明该法规是实现迫切国家利益的限制性最小的手段.

在涉及普通选举条例时,合理的基础审查将说服责任放在有挑战性的政党而不是国家身上。

(Choice C)严格审查将说服的责任放在了国家上,以证明为了实现令人信服的国家利益,法律是必要的(即限制性最小的手段).

学习要点：

当选举条例规定普通负担时,挑战方必须证明该条例与合法国家利益没有合理联系(即合理的基础测试).但是如果负担很重,国家必须表明该条例是实现迫切国家利益(即严格审查)的限制性最小的手段.

参考资料

• 美国康斯特修正案一(结社自由)。

• 美国康斯特修正十四(平等保护条款)。

· Burdick诉Takushi, 504 U.S. 428, 433–34(1992年)(解释选举法的审查程度取决于限制的严重程度)。

stem:
A state legislature enacted a statute that allowed executors to claim a tax deduction for the sale of securities that were purchased by an estate after the decedent's death. After the statute was enacted, the state suffered a significant decrease in revenue because the number of estates that claimed the tax deduction was greater than originally projected. To recover this lost revenue, the legislature amended the statute to prevent an estate from claiming the deduction unless the decedent owned the securities prior to death. The amendment was made retroactive so that its effective date was when the statute was initially enacted.

Before the amendment was enacted, an executor sold securities that he had purchased for a decedent's estate after her death. The executor attempted to claim the tax deduction on the estate's tax returns but the state agency that processes tax returns denied his claim even though the estate had purchased the securities before the amendment was enacted. The executor has filed suit against the agency to challenge the constitutionality of the retroactive application of the amendment.
stemZh:
一个州立法机关颁布了一项法规,允许执行人要求从出售死者死后财产购买的证券中扣除税款。该法规颁布后,该州的收入大幅下降,因为主张减税的庄园数量比原先预计的要多。为了收回这一损失的收入,立法机关修正了法规,以防止财产要求扣除,除非死者在死亡前拥有这些证券。修正案具有追溯效力,因此其生效日期是规约最初颁布之时。

在修正案颁布前,一名执行人出售了他死后为死者财产购买的证券.执行人试图要求从遗产的纳税申报中扣除税款,但处理纳税申报的国家机关拒绝了他的要求,即使遗产在修正案颁布之前已经购买了证券。执行人对该机构提起诉讼,质疑追溯适用修正案是否符合宪法。
ask: Is the executor's suit likely to succeed?
askZh: 执行官的诉讼能否成功?

options.en: No, because the retroactive application of the amendment was necessary to achieve a compelling government interest.
options.zh: 否,因为追溯适用修正案对于实现令人信服的政府利益是必要的。

options.en: No, because the retroactive application of the amendment was rationally related to a legitimate government interest.
options.zh: 不,因为追溯适用该修正案与合法政府利益合理相关。

options.en: Yes, because the amendment constitutes a bill of attainder.
options.zh: 是的,因为修正 构成一个达到法案。

options.en: Yes, because the amendment violates the due process clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.
options.zh: 是的,因为修正案违反了第十四修正案的正当程序条款。

explanation.en:
The Fourteenth Amendment substantive due process clause prevents states from depriving persons of life, liberty, or property without adequate justification. Civil laws that retroactively impair an ordinary right—eg, the right to claim a tax deduction—must undergo rational basis scrutiny. Under this test, the law is presumed valid until the challenger shows that the law's retroactive application has no rational relation to any legitimate government interest.

Here, the executor challenged the amendment's retroactive application since it prevented the estate from claiming the tax deduction on its tax returns, which is an ordinary right. But since the state suffered a significant decline in revenue after the statute was enacted, the retroactive application of the amendment was rationally related to the state's legitimate interest in recovering the lost revenue. This means that the amendment does not violate the Fourteenth Amendment due process clause (Choice D). Therefore, the executor's suit is unlikely to succeed.

(Choice A) The retroactive application of a law that affects a fundamental right (eg, voting) is subject to strict scrutiny—ie, the government must prove that the law is necessary to achieve a compelling government interest. But here, the amendment's retroactive application affects an ordinary right and is therefore subject to rational basis scrutiny.

(Choice C) A bill of attainder is a legislative act that punishes a specified person or group without a judicial trial. But since the amendment applies to all persons who purchase securities, it is not a bill of attainder. Additionally, the amendment seeks to increase the state's revenue—not punish individuals. .

Educational objective:

Laws that retroactively impair an ordinary right—eg, the right to claim a tax deduction— can be challenged on substantive due process grounds. Such laws are reviewed under rational basis scrutiny and generally are presumed valid.

explanation.zh:
第十四修正案的实质性正当程序条款禁止国家无正当理由剥夺人的生命、自由或财产。追溯损害普通权利的民法——例如要求减税的权利——必须经过合理的基础审查。根据这一检验标准,在质疑者表明法律的追溯适用与任何合法政府利益无合理关系之前,推定法律有效.

在此,执行人对该修正案的追溯适用提出质疑,因为它阻止了破产财产对其纳税申报要求减税,这是一项普通权利。但由于该州在法规颁布后收入大幅下降,追溯适用该修正案与该州收回损失收入的合法权益有合理联系.这意味着修正案没有违反第十四修正案的正当程序条款(Choice D),因此执行官的诉讼不太可能成功.

(Choice A) 追溯适用一项影响某项基本权利(如投票)的法律受到严格的审查——即政府必须证明,法律是实现令人信服的政府利益所必需的。但在这里,修正案的追溯适用影响了一项普通权利,因此受到合理的基础审查。

获得者法案(Choice C)是未经司法审判就惩罚特定个人或团体的法案,但由于修正案适用于所有购买证券的人,因此它不是获得者法案。此外,该修正案寻求增加国家收入,而不是惩罚个人。

学习要点：

追溯损害普通权利,例如要求减税的权利的法律,可以根据实质性的适当程序理由受到质疑,这些法律经过合理的审查,一般被推定有效。

stem: The legislature of State B enacted a statute requiring that all law enforcement officers in that state be United States citizens. A lawfully admitted noncitizen became a permanent resident five years before the enactment of this statute. He sought employment as a forensic pathologist in the state coroner's office. He was denied that job solely because he was not a citizen. The resident noncitizen thereupon brought suit in federal district court against appropriate state officials seeking to invalidate this citizenship requirement on federal constitutional grounds.
stemZh: B州的立法机关颁布了一项法规,要求该州的所有执法人员必须是美国公民,合法入境的非公民在本法规颁布五年前成为永久居民。他寻求在国家验尸官办公室担任法医病理学家,但仅仅因为他不是公民而被拒绝。常住非公民随即向联邦地区法院提起诉讼,控告以联邦宪法理由试图使这一公民身份要求无效的有关州官员。
ask: Which of the following is the strongest ground upon which to attack this citizenship requirement?
askZh: 以下哪些是违反公民身份要求的最有力理由?

options.en: The requirement constitutes an ex post facto law as to previously admitted noncitizens.
options.zh: 这一要求是对先前被接纳的非公民的事后法律。

options.en: The requirement denies noncitizens equal protection of the laws guaranteed by the Fourteenth Amendment.
options.zh: 这一要求剥夺了非公民对第十四修正案所保障的法律的平等保护。

options.en: The requirement denies noncitizens the right to employment in violation of the privileges or immunities clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.
options.zh: 这项规定剥夺了非公民的就业权,违反了第十四修正案的特权或豁免条款。

options.en: The requirement deprives noncitizens of a fundamental right to employment without the due process of law under the Fourteenth Amendment.
options.zh: 这一要求剥夺了非公民在没有第十四修正案规定的适当法律程序的情况下就业的基本权利。

explanation.en:
Fourteenth Amendment protections

Clause Applicability

Equal protection Discriminatory treatment of similarly situated people

Due process Substantive – deprivation of life, liberty, or property without adequate justification

Procedural – deprivation of life, liberty, or property without adequate process

Privileges or immunities*

Interference with rights of national citizenship

*Rarely a correct answer.

Citizenship requirements (as seen here) are discriminatory since they deny resident noncitizens benefits or opportunities that are generally available to U.S. citizens. As a result, laws with this requirement can be attacked on equal protection grounds. And since citizenship is a suspect class (triggering strict scrutiny review), these laws are rarely upheld.

(Choice A) An ex post facto law typically refers to a criminal statute that retroactively imposes punishment. Although federal and state governments are barred from passing such laws, State B's statute is civil (not criminal) in nature and has no retroactive effect—ie, there is no requirement that noncitizens currently holding law enforcement positions be terminated.

(Choice C) The Fourteenth Amendment privileges or immunities clause only protects citizens (not noncitizens or corporations) from unreasonable state interference with the narrowly defined rights of national citizenship.

(Choice D) A state law that impacts a fundamental right can be challenged on Fourteenth Amendment due process (or equal protection) grounds. But since employment is not a fundamental right, State B's citizenship requirement cannot be attacked on this basis.

Educational objective:

Citizenship requirements are discriminatory since they deny resident noncitizens benefits or opportunities that are generally available to citizens. As a result, they are strictly scrutinized (and rarely upheld) on equal protection grounds.

References

• Cabell v. Chavez-Salido, 454 U.S. 432, 437 (1982) (explaining that a resident noncitizen can challenge citizenship requirement for public employment).

explanation.zh:
第十四修正案的保护

条款的适用

同等保护 对处境相似者的歧视性待遇

实质性 -- -- 剥夺生命、自由或财产,不充分说明理由

程序性----未经适当程序剥夺生命、自由或财产

特权和豁免*

干涉国家公民权利

* 几乎是一个正确的答案。

公民身份要求(如本文所示)是歧视性的,因为它们剥夺了常住非公民普遍享有的福利或机会,因此,具有这一要求的法律可以平等保护为由受到攻击。而由于公民身份是可疑的类别(触发严格审查),这些法律很少得到维护.

(Choice A) 事后法律通常是指追溯处罚的刑事法规.虽然联邦和州政府被禁止通过这类法律,但B州的法规具有民事性质(而非刑事性质),没有追溯效力,即目前担任执法职务的非公民无须终止。

(C选择)第十四修正案的特权或豁免条款只保护公民(不是非公民或公司)免受国家不合理的干涉,不受狭隘界定的公民权的干涉。

(Choice D ) 影响基本权利的州法可以根据第十四修正案的正当程序(或平等保护)理由提出质疑。 但是,由于就业不是一项基本权利,B 国的公民身份要求不能因此受到攻击。

学习要点：

公民身份要求是歧视性的,因为它们剥夺了常住非公民普遍享有的福利或机会,因此,在平等保护的基础上严格审查(而且很少坚持)。

参考资料

• Cabell诉Chavez-Salido案,454 U.S.432,437(1982年)(解释定居的非公民可以对公共就业的公民身份要求提出质疑)。

stem: A federal statute prohibits websites from displaying sexually explicit material on their homepages. The purpose of the statute is to prevent minors from easily accessing such material. Several website owners who have been prosecuted for violating the statute have defended on the ground that the prosecution is unconstitutional.
stemZh: 一项联邦法规禁止网站在主页上展示有性特征的材料,其目的是防止未成年人轻易获得这些材料。一些网站所有者因违反法规而受到起诉,他们以起诉违宪为由辩护。
ask: Are the website owners likely to prevail in this defense?
askZh: 网站所有者在这场辩护中能否占上风?

options.en: No, because sexually explicit materials are not protected speech.
options.zh: 不,因为性显性材料不受保护的言论。

options.en: No, because the government has extensive power to regulate the Internet.
options.zh: 不,因为政府有广泛的权力来管理互联网。

options.en: Yes, because the government may not punish the broadcast of sexually explicit material.
options.zh: 是的,因为政府可能不会惩罚 播放性明显的材料。

options.en: Yes, because there are less restrictive means available to protect children from harmful material.
options.zh: 是的,因为保护儿童免受有害物质影响的手段较少。

explanation.en:
The First Amendment free speech clause protects the right to freely communicate information and ideas—even through the Internet. To ensure such protection, a content-based restriction on speech is presumptively unconstitutional and only enforceable if it

survives strict scrutiny. This means that the government can only restrict speech based on what is being said (ie, its message or ideas) if it can prove that the restriction is the least restrictive means (ie, narrowly tailored) to achieve a compelling government interest.

Here, the federal statute targets speech based on its content by prohibiting websites from displaying sexually explicit material on their homepages. The government may have a compelling interest in preventing minors from easily accessing such material. However, less restrictive means are available to achieve this interest—eg, requiring sexually explicit materials to be identified so parents can limit what their children can access. Therefore, the statute cannot survive strict scrutiny, and the prosecution of the website owners is likely unconstitutional.

(Choice A) The First Amendment does not protect certain forms of speech, including obscenity. Sexually explicit materials are only considered obscene, and fall outside the First Amendment's protections, in the rare instance when they satisfy the Miller test (not seen here).

(Choice B) The government does have power to regulate the Internet, but it must comply with constitutional provisions such as the First Amendment when doing so.

(Choice C) The government may punish radio and television stations for broadcasting sexual and offensive speech over the airwaves. That is because the government has extensive power to regulate the broadcast spectrum, which has a limited number of frequencies.

Educational objective:

Content-based government regulations of speech—even speech communicated via the Internet—must survive strict scrutiny. This requires the government to prove that the regulation is the least restrictive means to achieve a compelling government interest.

References

• Reno v. Am. Civil Lib. Union, 521 U.S. 844, 879 (1997) (holding that the compelling government interest of protecting minors from sexually explicit materials on the Internet can be achieved by means other than a ban).

explanation.zh:
第一修正案的言论自由条款保护通过互联网自由传递信息和思想的权利,为了确保这种保护,基于内容的对言论的限制被认为是违宪的,只有这样才能执行。

这意味着,政府只能根据所说的话(即其信息或思想)限制言论,如果它能够证明限制是限制最少的手段(即,狭义的调整),以实现令人信服的政府。利息

联邦法规禁止网站在自己的主页上展示有性倾向的材料,以基于其内容的言论为目标。 政府可能迫切希望防止未成年人轻易获取这些材料。然而,为了实现这种利益,可以采取的限制较少的手段——例如,需要确定性特征材料,以便父母能够限制其子女获得的东西。因此,规约无法经受严格的审查,对网站所有者的起诉可能违宪。

(Choice B) 政府确实有管理互联网的权力,但在这样做时必须遵守宪法条款,如第一修正案.

政府可以惩罚广播电视台通过广播广播进行性攻击性言论。 这是因为政府拥有广泛的权力来监管广播频谱,而广播频谱的频率有限。

学习要点：

以内容为基础的政府言论条例 — — 甚至通过互联网传达的言论 — — 必须经过严格的审查。 这要求政府证明,这一条例是实现政府迫切利益的最低限制性手段。

stem:
To preserve the appearance and accessibility of its capitol building, a state enacted a law prohibiting "the display of any sign on any portion of the public sidewalk surrounding" the building.

A group of five demonstrators who wanted to protest inadequate state funding for children's services applied for a permit to march single file on the sidewalk surrounding the capitol building. Each demonstrator planned to carry a two-foot-square sign that would read, "Our lawmakers do not care about our children."

The group's permit application was denied pursuant to the state law, and the group has filed an action challenging the law's constitutionality.
stemZh:
为了保持其卡皮托尔建筑的外观和无障碍性,一个州颁布了一项法律,禁止"在建筑周围的公共人行道的任何部分展示任何标志".

5名示威者试图抗议国家为儿童服务提供的资金不足,他们申请许可证,以便在卡皮托尔大楼周围的人行道上游行。每个示威者计划携带一个两英尺平方的标志,上面写着"我们的立法者不关心我们的孩子".

该团体的许可申请根据州法律被驳回,该团体已提起诉讼,质疑该法的合宪性。
ask: Should the court uphold the law's constitutionality?
askZh: 朝廷应维持法律的合宪性吗?

options.en: No, because even though the sidewalk at issue is not a public forum, the prohibition against the display of signs is more restrictive than needed to serve a legitimate government interest.
options.zh: 不,因为即使有关人行道不是一个公共论坛,禁止显示标志的禁令比为合法政府利益服务所必须的更为严格。

options.en: No, because the sidewalk at issue is a public forum, and the prohibition against the display of signs is not narrowly tailored to serve a substantial government interest.
options.zh: 不,因为有关人行道是一个公共论坛,禁止显示标志的禁令并不局限于满足政府的重大利益。

options.en: Yes, because even though the sidewalk at issue is a public forum, the prohibition against the display of signs is necessary to serve a compelling public interest.
options.zh: 是的,因为即使有关人行道是一个公共论坛,禁止显示标志对于促进公众利益是必要的。

options.en: Yes, because the sidewalk at issue is not a public forum, and the prohibition against the display of signs is reasonable.
options.zh: 是的,因为有关人行道不是一个公共论坛,禁止显示标志是合理的。

explanation.en:
The First Amendment protects the right to freely communicate information and ideas through speech or conduct—even on government property. But the government can impose reasonable time, place, or manner restrictions (ie, content-neutral regulations) on speech that occurs in a public forum so long as those restrictions pass intermediate scrutiny. This requires the government to prove that the restriction:

• is narrowly tailored to serve a substantial government interest and

• leaves open ample alternative channels of communication. Here, the group's permit application was denied pursuant to a content-neutral law that prohibits the display of any sign on the sidewalk surrounding the capitol building—a public forum (Choices A & D). And though the state has a substantial interest in preserving the appearance and accessibility of its capitol building, the law is not narrowly tailored to serve that interest. That is because alternative measures that burden substantially less speech could be used effectively—eg, prohibiting signs near the entrance. Therefore, the law is unconstitutional.

(Choice C) Content-based restrictions on speech that occurs in a public forum must be necessary and narrowly tailored to serve a compelling government interest (ie, strict scrutiny). But this law is content-neutral.

Educational objective:

Content-neutral restrictions on the time, place, or manner of speech in a public forum must (1) be narrowly tailored to serve a substantial government interest and (2) leave open ample alternative channels of communication.

References

• Frisby v. Schultz, 487 U.S. 474, 481 (1988) (setting forth the test for determining whether the government's regulation of the time, place, or manner of expression in a public forum is valid).

explanation.zh:
第一修正案保护通过言论或行为自由传递信息和思想的权利,甚至在政府财产上也是如此。但政府可以对公共论坛中发生的言论施加合理的时间、地点或方式限制(即内容中立条例),只要这些限制通过中间审查即可。 这要求政府证明这种限制:

• 范围狭小,以服务于政府的重大利益;

· 留下充足的其他通信渠道:在此,根据一项内容中立的法律,该团体的许可证申请被拒绝,该法律禁止在卡皮托尔大楼周围的人行道上展示任何标志——一个公共论坛(Choices A & D)。尽管国家非常关心保持其顶楼的外观和无障碍性,但法律并没有为这种利益作狭义的调整。这是因为可以有效地使用使言论负担大大降低的替代措施,例如禁止在入口附近设立标志。 因此,法律是违宪的。

(C选择 ) 公共论坛中发生的基于内容的对言论的限制必须是必要的,并且是狭义的,以服务于令人信服的政府利益(即严格审查 ) 。 但这项法律的内容是中立的。

学习要点：

对公共论坛发言的时间、地点或方式实行内容中立的限制,必须:(1) 作狭义的调整,以服务于政府的重大利益;(2) 留出充分的其他交流渠道。

参考资料

• Frisby诉Schultz案,487 U.S.474,481 (1988年)(规定了确定政府在公共论坛中对时间、地点或表达方式的规范是否有效的标准)。

stem: The United States government demonstrated that terrorist attacks involving commercial airliners were perpetrated exclusively by individuals of one particular race. In response, Congress enacted a statute imposing stringent new airport and airline security measures only on individuals of that race seeking to board airplanes in the United States.
stemZh: 美国政府表明,涉及商业航空公司的恐怖袭击完全是某一种族的个人所为。作为回应,国会颁布了一项法规,对试图登上美国飞机的该种族个人只规定了严格的新机场和航空公司安全措施。
ask: Which of the following provides the best ground for challenging the constitutionality of this statute?
askZh: 以下哪一项是挑战《公约》的最佳依据:本规约的合宪性?

options.en: The commerce clause of Article I, Section 8.
options.zh: 第一条第8节的商业条款。

options.en: The due process clause of the Fifth Amendment.
options.zh: 第五修正案的正当程序条款。

options.en: The privileges and immunities clause of Article IV.
options.zh: 第四条的特权和豁免条款。

options.en: The privileges or immunities clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.
options.zh: 第十四修正案的特权或豁免条款。

explanation.en:
A law that treats similarly situated persons differently may violate the constitutional principle of equal protection, which applies to the federal government through the Fifth Amendment due process clause. This is especially likely when the law intentionally discriminates against a suspect class (eg, race). That is because the government must clear the highest hurdle—strict scrutiny—to justify such a law. And since this federal statute intentionally targets a particular race, due process provides the best ground to challenge the statute.

*The equal protection clause of the Fourteenth Amendment applies only to states and localities—not the federal government.

(Choice A) The commerce clause grants Congress broad plenary power to regulate the instrumentalities of interstate commerce—eg, planes, trains, automobiles. Therefore, this clause supports Congress's authority to regulate airports and airlines.

(Choice C) The Article IV privileges and immunities clause generally prohibits states from discriminating against citizens of other states. But it does not apply to the federal government.

(Choice D) The Fourteenth Amendment privileges or immunities clause applies to states— not the federal government—and bars them from depriving individuals of the very limited rights of national citizenship.

Educational objective:

Equal protection principles apply to the federal government through the Fifth Amendment due process clause. And under this clause, federal laws that intentionally discriminate against a suspect class (eg, race) are almost always invalidated under strict scrutiny.

References

• Bolling v. Sharpe, 347 U.S. 497, 499–500 (1954) (holding that equal protection principles apply to the federal government through the Fifth Amendment due process clause).

explanation.zh:
区别对待处境相似者的法律可能违反宪法中的平等保护原则,该原则通过第五修正案的正当程序条款适用于联邦政府。当法律有意歧视可疑阶层(如种族)时,这种情况尤其可能发生。 这是因为政府必须清除最大障碍 — — 严格审查 — — 才能证明这种法律是合理的。并且由于这个联邦法规有意针对某一特定种族,正当程序为质疑法规提供了最好的依据.

* 第十四修正案的平等保护条款仅适用于州和地方,而不是联邦政府。

(Choice A)商业条款赋予国会广泛的全体会议权力,对州际商业工具——例如飞机、火车、汽车——进行管理,因此,这一条款支持国会管理机场和航空公司的权力。

(C选择)第四条的特权和豁免条款一般禁止各州歧视其他州的公民,但不适用于联邦政府.

(Choice D)第十四修正案的特权或豁免条款适用于各州,而不是联邦政府,并禁止他们剥夺个人有限的国籍权利。

学习要点：

平等保护原则通过第五修正案的正当程序条款适用于联邦政府。 根据这一条款,有意歧视嫌疑阶级(如种族)的联邦法律几乎总是在严格审查下无效。

stem: A federal statute provides health care benefits to U.S. citizens but excludes noncitizens. A group of resident noncitizens who were denied health care benefits pursuant to the statute brought a suit in federal court challenging the statute on constitutional grounds. The group specifically claims that the statute violates the equal protection component of the Fifth Amendment due process clause.
stemZh: 联邦法规向美国公民提供医疗保健福利,但不包括非公民。 根据法规被剥夺医疗保健福利的一群居民非公民向联邦法院提起诉讼,以宪法为由对法规提出质疑。该集团具体声称,该法规违反了第五修正案正当程序条款的平等保护部分。
ask: Is the federal statute likely constitutional?
askZh: 联邦法规可能符合宪法吗?

options.en: No, because the statute is not necessary to achieve an important government interest.
options.zh: 不,因为章程对于实现重要的政府利益是不必要的.

options.en: No, because the statute is not substantially related to an important government interest.
options.zh: 不,因为章程与重要的政府利益没有实质性关系。

options.en: Yes, because the statute is necessary to achieve a legitimate government interest.
options.zh: 是的,因为法规是实现合法政府利益的必要条件。

options.en: Yes, because the statute is rationally related to a legitimate government interest.
options.zh: 是的,因为法规与合法政府利益合理相关.

explanation.en:
Congress has plenary (ie, exclusive) authority over immigration and naturalization, so federal laws based on citizenship are presumptively constitutional. To rebut this presumption and show that such a law violates the equal protection component of the Fifth Amendment, the challenger must show that the law is not rationally related to a legitimate government interest—ie, that the law is arbitrary or unreasonable.

Here, the federal statute provides health care benefits to U.S. citizens but excludes noncitizens. The U.S. Supreme Court has repeatedly held that Congress has a legitimate interest in providing benefits only to citizens because U.S. citizens have closer ties to the U.S. than noncitizens. Since the federal statute is rationally related to this interest, the statute is likely constitutional and the group of resident noncitizens is unlikely to prevail.

(Choices A & C) There is no level of scrutiny that requires the government to show that its statute is not necessary to achieve an important government interest or is necessary to achieve a legitimate government interest. Instead, strict scrutiny (not applicable here) requires the government to show that its statute is necessary to achieve a compelling state interest.

(Choice B) Intermediate scrutiny requires a government to show that its action is substantially related to an important government interest when such an action discriminates against a quasi-suspect class (not seen here).

Educational objective:

The equal protection component of the Fifth Amendment requires federal laws based on citizenship to satisfy rational basis scrutiny. This level of scrutiny places the burden on the challenger to prove that the law is not rationally related to a legitimate government interest.

References

• U.S. Const. art. I, § 8, cl. 4 (federal immigration and naturalization power).

• Mathews v. Diaz, 426 U.S. 67, 79–80 (1976) (explaining that Congress may provide benefits to citizens and exclude noncitizens).

explanation.zh:
国会拥有对移民和归化的全体(即专属)权力,因此基于公民身份的联邦法律是推定的宪法.为了反驳这一推定,并表明这种法律违反了第五修正案的平等保护部分,质疑者必须表明法律与合法政府利益没有合理联系,即法律是任意或不合理的。

在这里,联邦法规为美国公民提供医疗保健福利,但将非公民排除在外. 美国最高法院一再认为,国会有合法利益只为公民提供福利,因为美国.与非公民相比,公民与美国的关系更为密切。 由于联邦法规与这种利益有合理联系,因此法规可能符合宪法,居留的非公民群体不太可能占上风。

(Choices A & C)没有要求政府表明其章程对于实现政府的重要利益或对于实现政府的合法利益来说没有必要的严格审查.相反,严格审查(在此不适用)要求政府表明其法规是实现迫切国家利益的必要条件。

(Choice B) 中间审查要求政府表明,如果这种行动歧视准嫌疑阶级(此处不见),则其行动与政府的重要利益密切相关。

学习要点：

第五修正案的平等保护部分要求基于公民身份的联邦法律满足合理的基础审查.这种审查程度使质疑者承担举证责任,证明法律与合法政府利益没有合理联系。

参考资料

• 美国康斯特第1条第8款第4项(联邦移民和归化权)。

• Mathews诉Diaz案,426 U.S.67,79-80(1976年)(解释国会可以向公民提供福利,排斥非公民)。

stem:
A state wanted to prevent its only major league baseball team, which was privately owned and operated, from moving to a rival state. After a heated political debate in the legislature, the state enacted legislation providing for a one-time grant of $10 million in state funds to the team to cover part of the projected income losses the team would suffer during the next five years if it remained in that state. The legislation required that the team remain in the state for at least ten years if it accepted the grant.

After accepting the grant, the team owners decided to build a new $150 million stadium in the state. As plans for the construction of the new stadium proceeded, it became evident that all of the contractors and subcontractors would be white males, and that they had been chosen by the team owners without any public bids because these contractors and subcontractors had successfully built the only other new baseball stadium in the region.

Several contractors who were females or members of minority racial groups filed suit against the team owners in federal district court to compel public solicitation of bids for the construction of the team's new stadium on an equal opportunity basis, and to enjoin construction of the stadium until compliance was ensured. Their only claim was that the contracting practices of the team owners denied them the equal protection of the laws in violation of the Fourteenth Amendment.
stemZh:
一个州希望阻止其唯一一支由私人拥有和运营的大型联赛棒球队转投敌对州.在立法机构激烈的政治辩论之后,国家颁布了立法,规定向小组提供1 000万美元的一次性国家资金,以弥补小组今后五年内如果继续工作将遭受的部分收入损失。立法规定,如果小组接受赠款,则小组必须留在该州至少十年。

接受补助后,球队业主决定在州内新建一座1.5亿美元的体育场,随着新体育场的建设计划展开,所有承包商和分包商显然都将是白人男性,而且他们曾经是由于这些承包商和分包商成功地建造了该区域其他唯一的新棒球场,因此由球队业主在没有公开招标的情况下选定。

一些女性或少数种族团体的承包商在联邦地区法院对团队所有人提起诉讼,迫使公众为在机会平等的基础上建造团队新体育场进行招标,并责令他们唯一的主张是,团队所有人的合同做法剥夺了他们受到法律的平等保护,违反了第十四修正案。
ask: In this suit, what will the court probably rule?
askZh: 在这件诉讼案中,法庭可能裁决什么?

options.en: In the absence of additional evidence of state involvement in the operations or decisions of the team owners, a one-time grant of state monies to them is insufficient to warrant treating their actions as subject to the limitations of the Fourteenth Amendment.
options.zh: 在缺乏国家参与团队所有人业务或决定的更多证据的情况下,一次性给予他们国家资金不足以证明他们的行动受第十四修正案的限制。

options.en: The intense public preoccupation with the activities of major league baseball teams coupled with the fact that baseball is considered a national pastime is sufficient to justify application of the Fourteenth Amendment to the activities of major league teams.
options.zh: 公众热衷于主要联赛棒球队的活动,再加上棒球被视为国家消遣,足以证明有理由对主要联赛球队的活动适用第十四修正案.

options.en: The issues presented by this case are nonjusticiable political questions because there is a lack of judicially manageable standards to resolve them and the court is likely to be deeply involved in partisan politics.
options.zh: 本案提出的问题是不可审理的政治问题,因为缺乏司法上可以管理的标准来解决,法院很可能深入参与党派政治.

options.en: The nexus between the actions of the team owners and the one-time grant of monies to them by the state is sufficiently substantial to subject their actions to the limitations of the Fourteenth Amendment.
options.zh: 团队所有者的行动与国家一次性给予他们资金之间的联系足够实质性,使其行动受到第十四修正案的限制。

explanation.en:
State-action doctrine

Traditional government function

• Private actor performs traditional & exclusive government function (eg, running elections)

Significant government involvement

• Government & private actor have mutually beneficial relationship (eg, joint activity or venture)

• Government creates nexus by affirmatively facilitating or authorizing private action (eg, police officer acting under color of law)

• Government is pervasively intertwined in private entity's management or control The Constitution generally limits government actors. But under the state-action doctrine, a private actor is considered a government actor—and similarly bound by the Constitution—when (1) the private actor performs a traditional and exclusive government function or (2) the government is significantly involved in the private actor's activities. Therefore, the contractors can only challenge the private baseball team owners' discriminatory contracting practices on equal protection grounds if the state-action doctrine applies.

Here, the team owners are not performing a traditional and exclusive government function by building a baseball stadium. And though they received a one-time grant of state funds, government funding—however substantial—is insufficient to convert private conduct into state action (Choice D). Therefore, in the absence of additional evidence of significant state involvement in the team owners' operations or decisions, the court will probably rule that the team owners' actions are not subject to the Fourteenth Amendment.

(Choice B) Although major league baseball is a national pastime that intensely preoccupies the public, it is not a traditional government function that would trigger the state-action doctrine.

(Choice C) The political-question doctrine bars federal courts from hearing cases that present issues that (1) are reserved for the executive or legislative branches or (2) lack judicially manageable standards for resolution. But since courts often resolve equal protection claims involving discriminatory executive or legislative policies—without becoming involved in partisan politics—this doctrine does not apply.

Educational objective:

The Constitution generally applies to government actors—not private actors. But under the state-action doctrine, a private actor will be treated as a government actor when (1) the

private actor performs a traditional and exclusive government function or (2) the government is significantly involved in the private actor's activities.

References

• Brentwood Acad. v. Tenn. Secondary Sch. Athletic Ass'n, 531 U.S. 288, 296–98 (2001) (listing scenarios in which the state-action doctrine is applied).

explanation.zh:
国家行动理论

传统政府职能

• 私人行为者履行传统和专属政府职能(如选举)

政府的重大参与

• 政府和私人行为者有互利关系(例如联合活动或企业)

• 政府通过积极促进或授权私人行动(例如警官依法行事)建立关系

• 政府在私营实体的管理或控制方面普遍交织在一起通常限制政府行为者。但根据国家行动学说,当(1) 私人行为者履行传统和排他性政府职能或(2) 政府在很大程度上参与政府行为者—— 并且同样受《宪法》约束—— 私人行为者被视为政府行为者。因此,如果适用国家行动原则,承包商只能以平等保护的理由,对私人棒球队业主的歧视性合同做法提出质疑。

在这里,球队主力并没有通过建造棒球场来履行传统和专属的政府职能.尽管他们一次性获得了国家资金的赠款,但政府的资金——尽管如此巨大——不足以将私人行为转化为国家行动(Choice D)。因此,在没有更多证据表明国家大量参与团队所有者的业务或决定的情况下,法院可能会裁定团队所有者的行为不受第十四修正案的约束.

(Choice B)虽然主要的联赛棒球是一种全国性的消遣,它强烈地占据了公众的注意力,但它并不是一个传统的政府职能会触发国家行动学说.

(C) 政治问题学说阻止联邦法院审理提出(1) 保留给行政部门或立法部门或(2) 缺乏司法上可管理解决标准的问题的案件。但是,由于法院往往解决涉及歧视性行政或立法政策的平等保护要求——而不卷入党派政治——这一理论不适用。

学习要点：

《宪法》一般适用于政府行为者,而不是私人行为者,但是,根据国家行动理论,在(1) 国家行动时,私人行为者将被视为政府行为者。

私人演员履行传统和排他性政府职能,或(2)政府大量参与私人演员的活动。

参考资料

· Brentwood Acad诉Tenn. Second Sch. Athletic Ass'n, 531 U.S.288, 296–98(2001年)(列出适用国家行动理论的情况)。

stem:
Congress enacted a federal statute that awards funds to nongovernmental organizations in the United States and around the world to combat the spread of a deadly airborne virus. The statute requires that the funds be used strictly for research and testing related to the virus. The last section of the statute conditions the award of the funds on the recipient's agreement to publicly announce its support for free-trade policies.

A U.S. nongovernmental organization that is headquartered abroad qualifies for funding under the federal statute. The organization does not want to publicly support free-trade policies because it believes that such support will alienate certain foreign governments with which the organization works. As a result, the organization has filed suit in federal court, seeking a declaratory judgment that the statute's condition requiring the announcement of support for free-trade policies compels speech and is therefore unconstitutional as applied to it.
stemZh:
国会颁布了联邦法规,向美国和世界各地的非政府组织提供资金,以打击致命的空中病毒的传播.章程规定资金应严格用于与病毒有关的研究和检测,章程最后一节规定,资金的授予须由接受方同意公开宣布支持自由贸易政策。

根据联邦法规,总部设在国外的美国非政府组织有资格获得资金。该组织不想公开支持自由贸易政策,因为它认为这种支持会疏远该组织与之合作的某些外国政府.因此,该组织向联邦法院提起诉讼,要求作出宣告性判决,认为规约要求宣布支持自由贸易政策的条件迫使人们发表言论,因此对其适用违宪。
ask: How should the court rule?
askZh: 朝廷该如何裁决?

options.en: Declare that the condition is constitutional, because Congress may compel speech by imposing conditions on the receipt of federal funds.
options.zh: 宣布该条件符合宪法,因为国会可以通过对接受联邦资金附加条件来强制言论.

options.en: Declare that the condition is constitutional, because the organization is headquartered abroad and therefore lacks constitutional protections.
options.zh: 宣布这一条件符合宪法,因为该组织总部设在国外,因此缺乏宪法保护。

options.en: Declare that the condition is unconstitutional, because Congress cannot impose conditions on the receipt of federal funds.
options.zh: 宣布这一条件违宪,因为国会不能对接受联邦资金强加条件.

options.en: Declare that the condition is unconstitutional, because the condition infringes upon the organization's First Amendment right to free expression.
options.zh: 宣布该条件违宪,因为该条件侵犯了该组织的第一修正案自由表达的权利.

explanation.en:
Conditions on government funding

Funded activities

Government can restrict use of funds to authorized purposes

"Grant monies must be used for the acquisition, construction, and maintenance of appropriate performance facilities"

Funding recipients

Government cannot restrict protected conduct unrelated to funding's purpose

"Recipient must agree to refrain from all kinds of political lobbying calculated to secure additional tax support for the performing arts"

The taxing and spending clause gives Congress broad power to spend federal revenue for the general welfare. Congress may place conditions on the receipt of federal funds so long as those conditions comply with the U.S. Constitution—including the First Amendment right to free expression (Choice C). The success of a First Amendment challenge to a conditional spending provision depends on whether the condition is placed on:

• funded activities – in which case the government can insist that the funds be used for authorized purposes (eg, requiring that funds be used only for research and testing) or

• funding recipients – in which case the government cannot restrict the recipient's right to engage in constitutionally protected conduct that falls outside the funding's purpose or scope (Choice A).

Here, the federal statute places a condition on funding recipients by requiring them to publicly support a policy promoting free trade. This falls outside of the funding's purpose and scope to combat the virus and infringes upon the U.S. organization's First Amendment right to free expression. Therefore, this requirement is unconstitutional as applied to the organization.

(Choice B) A constitutional challenge can be raised by a U.S. citizen located anywhere in the world or a foreign citizen located within U.S. territories—no one else possesses rights under the Constitution. Therefore, this U.S. organization headquartered abroad is protected by the Constitution.

Educational objective:

Congress can insist that federal funds be used for an authorized purpose, but it cannot restrict a funding recipient's right to engage in constitutionally protected conduct that is unrelated to the funding's purpose or scope.

References

• Agency for Int'l Dev. v. All. for Open Soc'y Int'l, Inc., 570 U.S. 205, 221 (2013) (holding that a federal funding program violated the First Amendment by conditioning funds on requirements unrelated to the program's purpose).

• Agency for Int'l Dev. v. All. for Open Soc'y Int'l, Inc., 140 S. Ct. 2082, 2086 (2020) ("Foreign citizens outside U.S. territory do not possess rights under the U.S. Constitution").

政府供资条件

供资活动

政府可将资金的使用限制于授权用途

“赠款必须用于购置、建造和维护适当的性能设施”。

受资助者

政府不能限制与供资目的无关的受保护行为

"接受者必须同意不进行各种政治游说,为表演艺术争取额外的税收支持".

税收和支出条款赋予国会将联邦收入用于一般福利的广泛权力,只要这些条件符合美国规定,国会就可以对接受联邦资金设置条件.《宪法》——包括《第一修正案》的言论自由权(选择C)。 《第一修正案》能否成功对有条件的支出规定提出质疑,取决于条件是否在于:

在此,联邦法规对资助受援者设置了一个条件,要求他们公开支持一项促进自由贸易的政策。 这不属于资助的目的和范围,也侵犯了美国的利益。(b) 言论自由的权利。因此,对该组织适用的这一要求不符合宪法。

(Choice B)一个位于世界任何地方的美国公民或位于美国领土内的外国公民可以提出宪法上的质疑——没有人根据宪法拥有权利。 因此,这个美国。总部设在国外的组织受《宪法》保护。

学习要点：

国会可以坚持联邦资金用于授权目的,但不能限制资金接受者从事与资金目的或范围无关的受宪法保护的行为的权利.

参考资料

• Int'l Dev. v. All. for Open Soc'y Int'l, Inc., 570 U.S. 205, 221 (2013年)(认为联邦供资方案违反第一修正案,规定资金与方案目的无关的要求)。

• Int'l Dev. v. All. for Open Soc'y Int'l, Inc., 140 S. Ct. 2082, 2086 (2020) ("美国境外外国公民不拥有美国宪法规定的权利").

stem:
A state statute permits the termination of parental rights when the state proves by a preponderance of the evidence that a child has been a victim of neglect.

A state agency initiated a proceeding in state court to terminate a woman's parental rights based on allegations that she repeatedly abused her child. The agency provided the woman with adequate notice of the hearing. At the hearing, the attorneys for the agency and the woman presented evidence, examined witnesses, and made opening and closing statements. The court found by a preponderance of the evidence that the child was a victim of neglect and entered an order terminating the woman's parental rights.

The woman has appealed the court's order, alleging that the termination of her parental rights was unconstitutional.
stemZh:
州法规允许终止父母的权利,如果国家以大量证据证明儿童是忽视的受害者。

一个国家机构在州法院提起诉讼,终止妇女的父母权利,理由是她一再虐待她的孩子,该机构向该妇女发出了适当的听证通知。在听证会上,该机构的律师和该名妇女提供了证据,讯问了证人,并作了开场和最后陈述。法院根据大部分证据认定,该儿童是忽视的受害者,并下达了终止该妇女父母权利的命令。

该妇女对法院的命令提出上诉,声称终止其父母权利不符合宪法。
ask: How should the appellate court rule in this case?
askZh: 上诉法院应如何对此案作出裁决?

options.en: Affirm the order, because a court can terminate parental rights by using a preponderance-of-the-evidence burden of proof.
options.zh: 确认该命令,因为法院可以使用主要证据举证责任来终止父母的权利。

options.en: Affirm the order, because the state's interest in the child's welfare outweighs the woman's interest in the burden of proof used at the proceeding.
options.zh: 确认该命令,因为国家对于儿童福利的利益大于妇女在诉讼程序中使用的举证责任方面的利益。

options.en: Reverse the order, because the statute denies the woman a right of national citizenship.
options.zh: 推翻该命令,因为该法规剥夺了妇女取得国籍的权利。

options.en: Reverse the order, because the statute violates due process.
options.zh: 推翻命令,因为法规违反正当程序。

explanation.en:
A state must provide procedural due process before depriving an individual of a life, liberty, or property interest (eg, parental rights). This requires that the government provide reasonable notice and a meaningful opportunity to be heard before a neutral decision-maker—as was provided to the woman here. Procedural due process also requires that the proper burden of proof be applied at such hearings. To determine the proper burden (and any other process due), the court must balance three factors:

• The private interest affected by the deprivation

• The risk of erroneous deprivation of that interest through current procedures and the probable value of additional or substitute procedural safeguards

• The government's interest, including the fiscal and administrative burdens that other safeguards would entail

Here, the woman has an interest in maintaining her parental rights, while the state has an interest in ensuring the child's welfare. However, there is a high risk of erroneously terminating parental rights since the state need only prove its case by a preponderance of the evidence. This risk can be mitigated by requiring the state to satisfy a higher burden of proof (eg, clear and convincing evidence). Therefore, the statute violates due process, and the appellate court should reverse the order terminating the woman's parental rights

(Choices A & B).

(Choice C) The Fourteenth Amendment privileges or immunities clause prohibits states from denying citizens a right of national citizenship, which does not include parental rights.

Educational objective:

A state seeking to terminate parental rights must prove its case by at least clear and convincing evidence to comply with procedural due process.

References

• Santosky v. Kramer, 455 U.S. 745, 768–69 (1982) (holding that the Fourteenth Amendment due process clause requires states to prove their case by at least clear and convincing evidence when terminating parental rights).

• Mathews v. Eldridge, 424 U.S. 319, 335 (1976) (listing the three factors used to assess compliance with procedural due process).

explanation.zh:
国家必须在剥夺个人生命、自由或财产利益(如父母权利)之前提供程序上的适当法律程序。这要求政府提供合理的通知和在中立的决策者面前发表意见的有意义的机会,正如这里向妇女提供的那样,程序正当程序还要求在这种听证会上适用适当的举证责任。为了确定适当的负担(以及任何其他应有程序),法院必须平衡三个因素:

• 受剥夺影响的私人利益

• 通过现行程序错误剥夺这种权益的风险以及额外或替代程序保障的可能价值

• 政府的利益,包括其他保障措施将带来的财政和行政负担

在此,妇女希望维持其父母权利,而国家希望确保儿童的福利。然而,错误地终止父母权利的风险很大,因为国家只需要通过大量证据来证明其情况。通过要求国家承担更高的举证责任(如明确和令人信服的证据),可以减轻这种风险,因此,法规违反了正当程序,上诉法院应撤销终止妇女父母权利的命令。

(选择A和B).

(C选择)第十四修正案的特权或豁免条款禁止各州剥夺公民的国籍权,这不包括父母的权利.

学习要点：

寻求终止父母权利的国家必须至少通过明确和令人信服的证据来证明其理由,以遵守正当程序。

参考资料

• Santosky诉Kramer案,455 U.S.745,768–69(1982年)(认为第十四修正案的适当程序条款要求各国在终止父母权利时至少通过明确和令人信服的证据来证明其案情)。

• Mathews诉Eldridge,424 U.S. 319, 335(1976)(列出评估遵守程序正当程序情况所用的三个因素)。

stem:
A state barber licensing statute provides that the Barber Licensing Board may revoke a barber license if it finds that a licensee has used his or her business premises for an illegal purpose.

A licensed barber in the state was arrested by federal narcotics enforcement agents on a charge of selling cocaine in his barbershop in violation of federal laws. However, the local United States Attorney declined to prosecute, and the charges were dropped.

Nevertheless, the Barber Licensing Board commenced a proceeding against the barber to revoke his license on the ground that he used his business premises for illegal sales of cocaine. At a subsequent hearing before the board, the only evidence against the barber was affidavits by unnamed informants, who were not present or available for cross-examination. Their affidavits stated that they purchased cocaine from the barber in his

barbershop. Based solely on this evidence, the board found that the barber used his business premises for an illegal purpose and ordered his license revoked.
stemZh:
州理发师执照条例规定,理发师执照委员会如果发现被许可人将其营业场所用于非法目的,可吊销理发师执照。

该州一名持照理发师因被控违反联邦法律在他的理发店出售可卡因而被联邦缉毒执法人员逮捕,但当地美国检察官拒绝起诉,指控被撤销.

尽管如此,巴伯许可证颁发委员会还是以理发师利用他的营业场所非法销售可卡因为由,对该理发师提起诉讼,要求吊销他的执照。在委员会随后举行的一次听证会上,唯一不利于理发师的证据是无名告密者的证词,他们没有在场,也没有机会进行盘问。

委员会仅根据这一证据就认定,理发师将他的商务场所用于非法目的,并下令吊销他的执照。
ask: In a suit to have this revocation set aside, what is the barber's best constitutional argument?
askZh: 在要求撤销的诉讼中,理发师的最佳宪法论据是什么?

options.en: Article III requires a penalty of the kind imposed on the barber to be imposed by a court rather than an administrative agency.
options.zh: 第三条要求由法院而不是行政机构对理发师处以何种惩罚。

options.en: The administrative license revocation proceeding was invalid because it denied full faith and credit to the dismissal of the criminal charges by the United States Attorney.
options.zh: 行政许可吊销程序无效,因为它拒绝给予充分信任和信贷美国检察官驳回刑事指控。

options.en: The barber's inability to cross-examine his accusers denied him a fair hearing and caused him to be deprived of his barber license without due process of law.
options.zh: 理发师无法盘问其指控者,剥夺了他的公正审理权,导致他未经正当法律程序被剥夺理发师执照.

options.en: The existence of federal laws penalizing the illegal sale of cocaine preempts state action relating to drug trafficking of the kind involved in the barber's case.
options.zh: 对非法销售可卡因进行处罚的联邦法律的存在预先阻止了与理发师案所涉贩毒有关的诉讼。

explanation.en:
A person has a property interest in a benefit that is conferred by state law (eg, professional license, welfare benefits). The Fourteenth Amendment due process clause safeguards this interest by requiring states to follow certain procedures before intentionally depriving persons thereof. This typically includes providing persons with:

• adequate notice of the charges or proceedings against them and

• a meaningful opportunity to be heard—ie, to confront adverse witnesses and present arguments—before a neutral decision-maker.

Here, the Barber Licensing Board commenced a proceeding to revoke the barber's license. The only evidence presented against the barber was affidavits by unnamed informants, who were not present or available for cross-examination. Therefore, the barber's best argument to have his revocation set aside is that his inability to confront his accusers denied him a fair hearing and due process of law.

(Choice A) Article III limits the power of the federal courts. It does not apply to state courts or any other state proceedings (as seen here).

(Choice B) The full faith and credit clause requires states to recognize valid judgments issued by other states—not charges dismissed by the United States Attorney (or other states).

(Choice D) Under the Article IV supremacy clause, a state law is void if it is preempted by federal law. But federal laws penalizing the illegal sale of cocaine do not preempt state action relating to drug trafficking because these laws are not in conflict.

Educational objective:

Due process requires that the government provide persons with (1) adequate notice and (2) a meaningful opportunity to be heard by a neutral decision-maker—and to confront adverse witnesses—before intentionally depriving them of life, liberty, or property.

References

• Willner v. Comm. on Character & Fitness, 373 U.S. 96, 103 (1963) (explaining that "procedural due process often requires confrontation and cross-examination of those whose word deprives a person of his livelihood").

一个人在州法律赋予的福利(如职业执照、福利福利)中拥有财产利益。《第十四修正案》的正当程序条款要求国家遵循某些程序,然后才故意剥夺人的权利,从而保障了这种利益。

• 适当通知对他们的指控或诉讼;

· 在一个中立的决策者面前听取意见,即面对不利的证人和提出论据。

在此,巴伯许可证发放委员会启动了吊销理发师执照的程序,针对理发师提出的唯一证据是无名告密者的证词,他们不在场或无法进行盘问。因此,理发师将他的撤销搁置的最好论点是,他无法与指控者对质,剥夺了他的公正审讯和正当法律程序。

(Choice A)第三条限制联邦法院的权力,不适用于州法院或任何其他州诉讼(参见本文).

(Choice B) 完全的信仰和信用条款要求各州承认其他州下达的有效判决,而不是美国检察官(或其他州)驳回的指控。

根据第四条至上条款,如果联邦法律先行禁止,则州法无效。 但是,惩罚非法销售可卡因的联邦法律不会因为这些法律没有冲突而先行禁止州关于贩毒的行动。

学习要点：

正当程序要求政府向个人提供(1) 充分的通知和(2) 在故意剥夺他们的生命、自由或财产之前,让中立的决策者听取他们的意见,并对抗不利的证人。

参考资料

stem: A state adopted a rule denying admission to its bar to anyone who was currently or had previously been a member of a subversive group. The state's bar-application form was modified to ask applicants whether they were or had previously been members of any subversive organization. An applicant refused to answer the question and was denied bar admission on that basis. The applicant challenged the decision, arguing that the question infringed upon his freedom of association.
stemZh: 一个国家通过了一项规则,拒绝目前或以前是颠覆集团成员的任何人进入其律师协会。修改了州律师协会申请表,以询问申请人是否曾是或曾经是任何颠覆组织的成员,一名申请人拒绝回答问题,并以此为由被拒绝允许其入境。申诉人对该决定提出质疑,认为这个问题侵犯了他的结社自由。
ask: Is the applicant likely to prevail?
askZh: 申请人可能胜诉吗?

options.en: No, because membership in a subversive group constitutes endorsement of the group's illegal activities.
options.zh: 不,因为加入一个颠覆集团构成对该集团非法活动的认可。

options.en: No, because the Constitution does not apply to the bar.
options.zh: 不,因为宪法不适用于酒吧。

options.en: Yes, because denying bar admission based on any association with a subversive organization violates the First Amendment.
options.zh: 是的,因为以任何与颠覆组织的联系为由拒绝允许入境违反了第一修正案。

options.en: Yes, because inquiring into an applicant's association with a subversive organization to deny bar admission violates the First Amendment.
options.zh: 是的,因为调查申请人与颠覆组织的联系 拒绝律师的入境 违反了第一修正案

explanation.en:
The First Amendment, as applied to the states through the Fourteenth Amendment, protects the right to freely associate with any group or organization—including subversive organizations. As a result, the government cannot inquire about a person's associations for the sole purpose of withholding a right or benefit because of that person's beliefs. Instead, the government must show that the inquiry is necessary (ie, the least restrictive means) to protect a legitimate state interest.

Here, an applicant was denied bar admission for refusing to answer whether he was or had been a member of any subversive organization. This question (and the associated rule) relates to the state's legitimate interest in ensuring that applicants have the requisite character and professional competence to practice law. But since that interest can be protected through less-restrictive means—eg, requiring a list of references and other personal/professional information—the question infringed upon the applicant's freedom of association. As a result, he is likely to prevail.

(Choice A) Membership in a subversive group does not necessarily constitute endorsement of the group's illegal activities since the individual may have joined for other, nonsubversive reasons.

(Choice B) The Constitution (excluding the Thirteenth Amendment) applies only to government action. The rule at issue here constitutes government action since it was adopted by the state. Therefore, the Constitution applies.

(Choice C) The government may punish individuals (eg, by denying bar admission) who are active members of subversive organizations and have the specific intent to further the organizations' illegal activities.

Educational objective:

The First Amendment prohibits the government from inquiring into a person's associations unless that inquiry is necessary to protect a legitimate state interest.

References

• Baird v. State Bar of Ariz., 401 U.S. 1, 6–7 (1971) (holding that a state can only inquire about a person's associations if it is necessary to serve a legitimate state interest).

explanation.zh:
第一修正案通过第十四修正案适用于各州,保护自由参加任何团体或组织(包括颠覆组织)的权利。因此,政府不能仅仅为下列目的查询一个人的社团:(b) 由于该人的信仰而剥夺其权利或利益。相反,政府必须表明调查对于保护合法国家利益是必要的(即限制性最小的手段)。

在此,一名申请人因拒绝回答他是否是或曾经是任何颠覆组织的成员而被拒绝允许入境。这一问题(及相关规则)涉及国家确保申请人具有从事法律工作的必要性质和专业能力的合法利益。但是,由于这种利益可以通过限制较少的手段加以保护,例如需要一份参考书和其他个人/专业资料的清单,因此,这个问题侵犯了申请人的结社自由,因此他很可能会胜诉。

(Choice A) 加入颠覆团体不一定构成认可该团体的非法活动,因为个人可能出于其他非颠覆性原因加入。

(Choice B)宪法(不包括第十三修正案)只适用于政府行动,这里所争论的规则是自国家通过以来的政府行动,因此宪法适用.

(C选择) 政府可以惩罚那些是颠覆组织积极成员并具有促进这些组织非法活动的具体意图的个人(例如,拒绝律师入境)。

学习要点：

《第一修正案》禁止政府调查一个人的社团,除非这种调查是保护合法国家利益所必需的。

参考资料

• Baird v. State Bar of Ariz, 401 U.S. 1, 6–7(1971)(认为国家只有在为合法国家利益服务时才能查询个人的社团)。

stem:
A company wanted to expand the size of the building it owned that housed the company's supermarket by adding space for a coffeehouse. The company's building was located in the center of five acres of land owned by the company and wholly devoted to parking for its supermarket customers.

City officials refused to grant a required building permit for the coffeehouse addition unless the company established in its store a childcare center that would take up space at least equal to the size of the proposed coffeehouse addition, which was to be 20% of the existing building. The city officials' action was authorized by provisions of the applicable zoning ordinance.

In a suit filed in state court against the appropriate city officials, the company challenged this childcare-center requirement solely on constitutional grounds. The lower court upheld the requirement even though the city officials presented no evidence and made no findings to justify it other than a general assertion that there was a shortage of childcare facilities in the city. The company appealed.
stemZh:
一家公司希望通过增加咖啡馆的空间来扩大它拥有的容纳该公司超市的大楼的面积.该公司的大楼位于该公司拥有的五英亩土地的中心,专门供超市客户停放。

城市官员拒绝为增加咖啡馆发放必要的建筑许可证,除非公司在其商店中设立一个儿童保育中心,占用的空间至少相当于拟议的咖啡馆增加的面积,即20%。城市官员的行动得到下列条款的授权:适用分区条例。

在州法院针对有关城市官员提出的诉讼中,该公司仅以宪法为由对儿童保育中心要求提出质疑。下级法院维持了这一要求,尽管市政府官员没有提出证据,也没有做出结论来证明其合理性,只是笼统地声称该市缺乏儿童保育设施,公司提出上诉。
ask: How should the appellate court rule on the constitutionality of the requirement imposed by the city on the issuance of this building permit?
askZh: 上诉法院应如何裁定该市对颁发建筑许可证的要求是否符合宪法?

options.en: The requirement is constitutional, because the burden was on the company to demonstrate that there was no rational relationship between this requirement and a legitimate governmental interest, and the company could not do so because the requirement is reasonably related to improving the lives of families and children residing in the city.
options.zh: 这一要求符合宪法,因为证明这一要求与政府合法利益之间没有合理关系的责任在于公司,而公司不能这样做,因为这一要求是合理相关的。改善居住在该市的家庭和儿童的生活。

options.en: The requirement is constitutional, because the burden was on the company to demonstrate that this requirement was not necessary to vindicate a compelling governmental interest, and the company could not do so on these facts.
options.zh: 这一要求符合宪法,因为公司有责任证明这一要求对于维护令人信服的政府利益是不必要的,而公司不能根据这些事实这样做。

options.en: The requirement is unconstitutional, because the burden was on the city to demonstrate a rough proportionality between this requirement and the impact of the company's proposed action on the community, and the city failed to do so.
options.zh: 这一要求是违宪的,因为城市有责任证明这一要求与公司拟议行动对社区的影响之间的粗略相称,而城市未能做到这一点。

options.en: The requirement is unconstitutional, because the burden was on the city to demonstrate that this requirement was necessary to vindicate a compelling governmental interest, and the city failed to meet its burden under that standard.
options.zh: 这一要求是违宪的,因为城市有责任证明这一要求是维护政府迫切利益所必须的,而城市未能履行该标准规定的责任。

explanation.en:
Fifth Amendment takings

Type Attributes

Physical • Possession or permanent physical invasion of property

Regulatory • Deprivation of all economically beneficial uses

• Restricts use under totality of circumstances: – character of government action – economic impact – reasonable investment-back expectations Exaction • Condition to obtain building/development permit

Destruction • Destruction of property or property interest (eg, easements, liens)

An exaction occurs when a local government conditions the issuance of a building or development permit on a landowner's promise to dedicate part of the property for public use. And an exaction amounts to a Fifth Amendment taking requiring just compensation unless the government establishes:

• an essential nexus – the imposed condition substantially advances a legitimate government interest and

• rough proportionality – individualized and quantifiable findings show that the proposed development's impact on the community is roughly proportional to the imposed condition's impact on the landowner.

Here, the city conditioned the grant of a building permit on the company's promise to establish a childcare center in its store without just compensation. This condition substantially advances its legitimate interest in alleviating the shortage of childcare facilities. But the city failed to present any evidence to establish a rough proportionality between that condition and the impact of the company's proposed action on the community. Therefore, the appellate court should rule that this exaction amounts to an unconstitutional taking.

(Choice A) The city had the burden to demonstrate that the imposed condition substantially advances the city's legitimate interest in expanding childcare facilities.

(Choices B & D) Neither the company nor the city had the burden to demonstrate that the childcare-center requirement was necessary to vindicate a compelling government interest.

Educational objective:

An exaction is a Fifth Amendment taking unless the government shows: (1) an essential nexus between the imposed condition and a legitimate government interest and (2) a rough proportionality between the condition's impact on the landowner and the proposed development's impact on the community.

References

• Nollan v. Cal. Coastal Comm'n., 483 U.S. 825, 837 (1987) (explaining the essential nexus requirement).

• Dolan v. City of Tigard, 512 U.S. 374, 391 (1994) (requiring the government to provide individualized findings to show a rough proportionality between the exaction and the projected impact of the development).

explanation.zh:
第五次修正

类型属性

• 拥有财产或永久侵犯财产

• 剥夺所有经济利益用途

• 在所有情况下限制使用:- 政府行动的性质 - 经济影响 - 合理的投资回报预期• 获得建筑/开发许可证的条件

• 破坏财产或财产权益(例如地役权、留置权)

当地方政府根据地主承诺将部分财产用于公共用途而规定发放建筑物或开发许可证的条件时,即为征收。勒索相当于第五次修正,要求给予公正的赔偿,除非政府规定:

• 基本联系 -- -- 强加的条件大大促进了政府的合法利益;

• 粗略的相称性——个性化和可量化的研究结果显示,拟议发展对社区的影响与强加的条件对土地所有者的影响大致相称。

在此,城市以公司承诺在其商店中建立一个没有公正补偿的儿童保育中心作为发放建筑许可证的条件,这一条件大大促进了其缓解儿童保育设施短缺的合法利益。但是,该市没有提出任何证据来证明这一条件与公司拟议行动对社区的影响之间的粗略相称性。 因此,上诉法院应裁定这一勒索行为构成违宪收受。

(Choice A) 城市有责任证明,强加的条件大大促进了城市扩大儿童保育设施的合法利益。

(选择B & D)无论公司还是城市都没有责任证明儿童保育中心的要求是维护政府迫切利益所必需的。

学习要点：

征收是第五修正案,除非政府表明:(1) 附加条件与政府合法利益之间的基本联系;(2) 条件对土地所有者的影响与拟议开发的影响之间的粗略相称性。对社区的影响。

参考资料

• Nollan诉Cal. Coastern, 483 U.S. 825, 837(1987)(解释基本联系要求)。

· Dolan诉Tigard市,512 U.S. 374, 391(1994年)(要求政府提供个性化调查结果,以显示收割量与发展的预期影响之间的粗略相称性)。

stem:
A state in which several popular ski resorts are located has enacted a law requiring state certification of ski instructors. Under the law, applicants for certification must attend a monthlong course, pass a test, and pay a fee of $1,000. The stated purpose of the law is to "promote uniformity in the methods of ski instruction at the state's ski areas."

Shortly before the law's enactment, when the state did not require certification of ski instructors, a woman moved to the state intending to find employment as a ski instructor. The woman had been a ski instructor in another state for many years. But since her move, even though ski resorts in the state have found her to be highly qualified, no resort will offer her a contract for employment as a ski instructor because she has not received the required state certification.
stemZh:
滑雪场有多家受欢迎的滑雪胜地所在的州已经颁布了一项法律,要求滑雪教官获得国家认证。 根据法律,申请认证者必须参加一个月的课程,通过测试,并支付1000美元的费用。法律的公开宗旨是"促进该州滑雪区滑雪教学方法的统一性".

在法律颁布前不久,当国家不要求滑雪教官认证时,一名妇女移居该州,打算找到一名滑雪教官的工作. 该妇女曾在另一个州担任过滑雪教官多年.但自从她搬家后,尽管州内的滑雪胜地发现她具有很高的资质,但没有任何度假胜地会向她提供一份雇佣滑雪教练的合同,因为她没有得到所需的州级认证.
ask: As applied to the woman, does the state certification requirement constitute a violation of the contracts clause?
askZh: 根据适用于妇女的规定,国家认证要求是否构成违反合同条款?

options.en: No, because her ability to contract for employment with the state is not being impaired.
options.zh: 不,因为她与国家签订就业合同的能力没有受到损害。

options.en: No, because she has no existing contract that is being impaired.
options.zh: 不,因为她没有 现有的合同正在受损。

options.en: Yes, because as applied to an otherwise qualified ski instructor, the requirement is not rationally related to a legitimate government interest.
options.zh: 是的,因为适用于原本合格的滑雪教练,这一要求与合法政府利益没有合理联系。

options.en: Yes, because the requirement substantially impairs her ability to contract for employment in the absence of an important government objective.
options.zh: 是的,因为这一要求在缺乏一项重要的政府目标的情况下严重损害了她签订就业合同的能力。

explanation.en:
The contracts clause restricts state laws—not court decisions or federal legislation—that substantially impair existing contracts. Therefore, this clause does not apply to future contracts.

Here, the state law interferes with the woman's ability to obtain an employment contract as a ski instructor. But since she has not been hired by a ski resort, the law does not impair any existing contract. Therefore, the state certification requirement does not violate the contracts clause as applied to the woman.

(Choice A) The contracts clause applies to private contracts (ie, agreements with non-government parties) and public contracts (ie, agreements with government entities). But

the woman's ability to contract for employment with the state is irrelevant since this clause only protects existing contracts.

(Choices C & D) The contracts clause would only apply if the woman—qualified or not— had an existing contract. And had one existed, a substantial impairment of that contract would only be upheld if it was reasonable and narrowly tailored (not just rationally related) to an important and legitimate government interest (here, promoting uniformity in ski-instruction methods in the state).

Educational objective:

The contracts clause restricts state laws that substantially impair existing (not future) contracts.

References

• U.S. Const. art. I, § 10 (contracts clause).

• Gen. Motors Corp. v. Romein, 503 U.S. 181,186 (1992) (explaining that the contracts clause only applies when a state law substantially impairs an existing contractual relationship).

合同条款限制严重损害现有合同的州法律,而不是法院裁决或联邦立法,因此,这一条款不适用于未来的合同。

在这方面,州法律干涉了妇女作为滑雪教练获得就业合同的能力。 但是,由于她没有被滑雪胜地雇用,法律并不影响任何现有的合同。因此,国家认证要求并不违反适用于妇女的合同条款。

(选择A)合同条款适用于私人合同(即与非政府当事方的协议)和公共合同(即与政府实体的协议)。

妇女与国家签订就业合同的能力无关紧要,因为这一条款只保护现有的合同。

合同条款只有在妇女(无论是否合格)有现行合同的情况下才适用。如果存在一项合同,那么,只有该合同是合理的,而且符合政府重要和合法的利益,而且范围狭小(不仅仅是合理关联的)(在这里,促进滑雪教学方法的统一性)。页:1
