stem:
A 16-year-old girl received $3,000 on her birthday to buy a car. Later that week, the girl noticed an old car parked in her neighbor's driveway. A sign posted on the car's windshield read: "For Sale! $5,000 O.B.O." The girl contacted the neighbor about purchasing the car for $5,000. He agreed to sell it to her for a $1,000 down payment and monthly payments of $75 until the car was paid off.

The girl made regular payments until she turned 18 years old. Soon after turning 18, the girl attempted to pay off the car. The neighbor rejected the girl's lump-sum payment, returned all of her prior payments, and took possession of the car.
stemZh:
一个16岁的女孩在生日时收到3000美元买车,那个星期晚些时候,女孩注意到一辆老车停在邻居的车道上,车挡风玻璃上贴着一个牌子,上面写着:"为了卖!5000 O.B.O.",女孩联系邻居说要以5000美元买车,他同意以1000美元的首付和每月75美元的价格卖给她,直到车款付清.

这名女孩定期付款,直到她18岁为止,18岁后不久,这名女孩试图还清这辆车,邻居拒绝了这名女孩的一次性付款,退还了她以前的所有付款,并占有了这辆车。
ask: If the girl sues the neighbor for breach of contract, will she be likely to prevail?
askZh: 如果女孩告邻居违约,她会不会胜诉?

options.en: No, because the girl was a minor when she agreed to buy the car, so the contract was void .
options.zh: 不,因为女孩是未成年人 当她同意购买汽车, 所以合同无效。

options.en: No, because the neighbor voided the contract by returning the girl's prior payments.
options.zh: 不,因为邻居把女孩的前期付款还给她,所以合同无效。

options.en: Yes, because the contract ceased to be voidable by either party once the girl turned 18 years old.
options.zh: 是的,因为一旦女孩年满18岁,任何一方的合同就不再可以取消。

options.en: Yes, because the girl ratified the contract after she reached the age of majority.
options.zh: 是的,因为女孩在成年后就批准了合同。

explanation.en:
Unmarried, unemancipated minors (ie, persons under the age of 18) lack capacity to contract because of their infancy. As a result, any contract entered by a minor is voidable by the minor.* This means that the minor can either:

• void the contract before or soon after turning 18 by (1) disaffirming the contract through words or actions and (2) returning any still-existing benefit received under the contract or

• ratify the contract after turning 18 by (1) failing to timely void the contract or (2) otherwise agreeing to be bound by it—eg, by attempting to render performance of or payment under the contract.

The contract becomes enforceable if the minor ratifies it.

Here, the girl was a 16-year-old minor when she contracted to buy the neighbor's car for $5,000. The neighbor tried to disaffirm the contract after the girl turned 18 by returning her prior payments and taking possession of the car. However, the contract was voidable only by the girl (Choices B & C). And since she ratified the contract soon after turning 18 by attempting to pay off the car, the contract was enforceable. Therefore, the girl will likely prevail in a suit against the neighbor for breach of contract.

*By statute in some jurisdictions, certain contracts entered by a minor (eg, student loan agreements, insurance contracts) are not voidable by the minor but instead are fully enforceable by the other contracting party.

(Choice A) A void contract is invalid upon creation. But a contract entered by a minor is merely voidable, meaning that it is valid until the minor takes steps to avoid it.

Educational objective:

Minors lack capacity to contract, so a minor who enters a contract can either (1) void the contract before or soon after turning 18 or (2) ratify the contract after turning 18—eg, by attempting to render performance of or payment under the contract.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 14 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (incapacity based on infancy).

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 85 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (promise to perform voidable duty).

未婚、未成年的未成年人(即18岁以下者)由于年幼而缺乏订立合同的能力,因此,未成年人订立的任何合同均可被未成年人废除。

• 在18岁之前或之后不久,通过(1) 通过言词或行动否定合同,(2) 退还根据合同而获得的任何现有利益或

· 在18岁之后批准合同,办法是(1)未能及时使合同无效,或者(2)以其他方式同意受其约束,例如试图履行合同或根据合同付款。

如果未成年人批准,合同就可执行。

在这里,这名女孩是16岁的未成年人,当时她签约以5000美元的价格购买邻居的车。 邻居试图在女孩18岁后拒绝确认合同,还原了之前的付款,并占有了汽车。然而,合同只能由女孩(Choices B & C)作废。 由于她18岁后不久就通过试图支付车款批准了合同,合同是可以执行的。因此,在针对邻居违反合同的诉讼案中,女孩很可能胜诉。

* 根据某些法域的法规,未成年人签订的某些合同(例如,学生贷款协议、保险合同)不能被未成年人废除,而是被另一缔约方完全执行。

(Choice A)无效合同在设定时无效,但未成年人订立的合同只是无效的,也就是说,在未成年人采取步骤予以撤销之前合同是有效的。

学习要点：

未成年人缺乏订立合同的能力,因此,订立合同的未成年人可以(1) 在18岁之前或18岁之后宣布合同无效,或者(2) 在18岁之后批准合同,根据合同履行或付款。

参考资料

• 重述(第二份)合同第85条(1981年《普通法》)(承诺履行可撤销的义务)。

stem:
A computer retail outlet contracted to service a bank's computer equipment for one year at a fixed monthly fee under a contract that was silent as to assignment or delegation by either party. Three months later, the retail outlet sold the service portion of its business to an experienced and well-financed computer service company. The only provision in the agreement between the retail outlet and the computer service company relating to the outlet's contract with the bank stated that the outlet "hereby assigns all of its computer service contracts to the computer service company."

The computer service company performed the monthly maintenance required under the service contract. Its performance was defective, however, and caused damage to the bank's operations.
stemZh:
一家计算机零售商店承包为一家银行的计算机设备服务一年,每月固定收费,合同未提及任何一方的指派或授权。三个月后,零售外卖将其业务的服务部分出售给一家经验丰富,资金充足的计算机服务公司.零售外卖与计算机服务公司协议中唯一与该外卖与银行的合同相关的规定是,该外卖"由此将其所有计算机服务合同分配给计算机服务公司".

计算机服务公司按服务合同要求每月进行维修,但业绩有缺陷,对银行业务造成损害。
ask: Whom can the bank sue for damages arising from the computer service company's defective performance?
askZh: 银行能向谁起诉计算机服务公司的缺陷性能引起的损失?

options.en: Either the retail outlet or the computer service company, because since each has the right to enforce the bank's performance of its contract with the retail outlet, mutuality of remedy renders either potentially liable for the defective performance.
options.zh: 无论是零售外卖还是计算机服务公司,因为由于每个都有权强制银行履行与零售外卖的合同,相互补救使得要么对有缺陷的履约承担潜在责任。

options.en: Either the retail outlet or the computer service company, because the bank has not released the outlet and the bank is an intended beneficiary of the outlet's agreement with the computer service company.
options.zh: 无论是零售外卖还是计算机服务公司,因为银行没有放行外卖,银行是该外卖与计算机服务公司的协议的预期受益人.

options.en: The computer service company only, because it is a qualified and a financially responsible supplier of computer services.
options.zh: 计算机服务公司只是因为它是合格且财务上负责的计算机服务供应商.

options.en: The retail outlet only, because the computer service company made no promises to the bank.
options.zh: 零售出口只因为电脑服务公司对银行没有承诺.

explanation.en:
Contractual duties can be delegated by a party (ie, the promisor) to a nonparty (ie, the delegatee). An assignment of the entire contract will be construed as an assignment of rights and a delegation of duties. But even after a delegation of duties, the promisor remains liable for breach if the delegatee fails to perform—unless the promisee agrees to release the promisor from his/her duties.

Here, the computer retail outlet and the bank entered a service contract that was silent as to assignment or delegation by either party. The retail outlet assigned the entire contract (ie, rights and duties) to a computer service company, but the bank did not release the retail outlet from its duties. So even though the computer service company was qualified and financially responsible, the bank can sue the retail outlet for damages arising from the computer service company's defective performance (Choice C).

When, as here, the promisor delegates his/her duties by forming a separate contract with the delegatee, the promisee of the original contract becomes an intended beneficiary of that separate contract. This allows the promisee to sue the delegatee (in addition to the promisor) in the event of a breach. The bank, as the intended beneficiary of the agreement between the retail outlet and the computer service company, can therefore sue the computer service company for damages—even though it made no promises to the bank

(Choice D).

(Choice A) Under the mutuality-of-remedy doctrine, neither party to a contract can obtain specific performance unless that remedy is available to both parties. But this doctrine is irrelevant to determining whom the bank can sue for damages.

Educational objective:

A party to a contract (ie, the promisor) can delegate his/her duties to a nonparty (ie, the delegatee). But even after this occurs, the promisor remains liable for breach if the delegatee fails to perform—unless the promisee agrees to release the promisor from his/her duties.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 318 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that delegation of a contractual duty does not discharge the promisor's liability for breach).

explanation.zh:
合同义务可由一方当事人(即本票人)委托给非当事人(即委托人),整个合同的转让将被理解为权利的转让和职责的下放。但是即使在职责下放之后,如果委托人不履行——除非保证人同意解除该义务,则该抵押人仍须承担违约责任。

在此,计算机零售站和银行订立了一项服务合同,其中未提及任何一方的指派或授权。零售出口将整个合同(即权利和义务)分配给了一家计算机服务公司,但银行没有解除该零售出口的责任。因此,即使计算机服务公司具备资格并承担财务责任,银行仍可就计算机服务公司有缺陷的性能(Choice C)引起的损害而起诉零售出口.

象这里一样,当抵押人通过同委托人订立单独合同来分配其职责时,原始合同的保证人将成为该单独合同的预期受益人。这允许承诺人(除本票人外)在下述情况下起诉代表:银行作为零售商与银行之间协议的预期受益人。因此,计算机服务公司可以起诉计算机服务公司。损害——尽管它没有向银行许诺

(中文(简体) ).

(Choice A)根据相互赔偿原则,除非双方均可得到这种补救,否则合同任何一方都不能获得具体履行,但这一原则与确定银行可以向谁起诉损害无关。

学习要点：

合同的一方当事人(即抵押人)可以将他/她的职责委托给非当事人(即委托人),但即使发生这种情况,如果委托人不履行义务,抵押人仍须承担违约责任——除非保证人同意释放抵押人。职责。

参考资料

• 重述(第二份)第318条(1981年《美国法律》)(解释合同责任的下放并不解除汇兑人违约的责任)。

stem: On January 5, a creditor loaned $1,000 to a debtor under a contract calling for the debtor to repay the loan at the rate of $100 per month payable on the first day of each month. On February 1, at the debtor's request, the creditor agreed to permit payment on February 5. On March 1, the debtor requested a similar time extension and the creditor replied, "Don't bother me each month. Just change the date of payment to the fifth of the month. But you must now make the payments by cashier's check." The debtor said, "Okay," and made payments on March 5 and April 5 by cashier's check. On April 6, the creditor sold the loan contract to a bank but did not tell the bank about the agreement permitting payments on the fifth of the month. On April 6, the bank wrote to the debtor: "Your debt to [the creditor] has been assigned to us. We hereby inform you that all payments must be made on the first day of the month."
stemZh: 1月5日,一名债权人根据合同向一名债务人贷款1000美元,要求债务人按每月第一天每月100美元的利率偿还贷款。2月1日,应债务人要求,债权人同意于2月5日付款,3月1日,债务人要求类似的延期,债权人回答说:"每个月不要打扰我,只需将付款日期改为每月第五个.但你现在必须用出纳的支票付款。” 债务人说,“好,”并于3月5日和4月5日用出纳的支票付款。4月6日,债权人将贷款合同出售给一家银行,但并未告知银行允许当月5日付款的协议. 4月6日,银行致函债务人:"你欠[债权人]的债务已经转让给了我们.我们特此通知你,所有款项必须在每月的第一天支付。”
ask: Can the debtor justifiably insist that the payment date for the rest of the installments is the fifth of each month?
askZh: 债务人是否有理由坚持其余分期付款的付款日期是每个月的第五个?

options.en: No, because a contract modification is not binding on an assignee who had no knowledge of the modification.
options.zh: 不,因为合同修改对不知道修改的受让人没有约束力。

options.en: No, because although the creditor waived the condition of payment on the first of the month, the bank reinstated it.
options.zh: 不,因为虽然债权人在月一时放弃了付款条件,但银行恢复了这一条件。

options.en: Yes, because although the creditor waived the condition of payment on the first of the month, the creditor could not assign to the bank his right to reinstate that condition.
options.zh: 是的,因为虽然债权人在该月的第一个月放弃了付款条件,但债权人不能将他恢复该条件的权利转让给银行。

options.en: Yes, because the creditor could assign to the bank only those rights the creditor had in the contract at the time of the assignment.
options.zh: 是,因为债权人只能向银行转让债权人在转让时在合同中享有的权利。

explanation.en:
Assignment of contractual rights

Limitations • Assignment permitted unless it: – materially increases obligor's contractual duties or risks – materially reduces obligor's chance of obtaining performance or – is void (not merely prohibited) under contract provision Requirements • Present intent to immediately assign right

• Consideration generally required to make assignment irrevocable – Exceptions: promissory estoppel, delivery of document symbolizing assigned right (eg, stock certificate), delivery of written & signed assignment Assignee's rights

• Assumes all of assignor's rights as contract stands at time of assignment, subject to claims/defenses that: – accrued before obligor received notice of assignment or – stem from assignor's present or future failure to perform

• Assignor loses rights & therefore cannot enforce contract An assignment is the transfer of rights under a contract to another (ie, assignee). The assignee takes all of the rights of the assignor as the contract stands at the time of the assignment.

Here, the contract between the debtor and the creditor called for the debtor to make payments on the first day of each month. The parties effectively modified that contract when the creditor promised to accept payments on the fifth day of each month in exchange for the debtor's promise to make the payments by cashier's check.* Since this occurred before the creditor assigned his rights under the loan contract to the bank, the debtor can justifiably insist that the payment date for the rest of the installments is the fifth of each month.

*Note that there was consideration for the creditor's promise to accept payment at a later date (and the modification was effective) because the debtor altered his preexisting duty to pay the debt by promising to make future payments by cashier's check.

(Choice A) There is no rule that makes a contract modification ineffective as to an assignee simply because the assignee had no notice of it. As such, the assignee (here, the bank) is bound by the modification.

(Choices B & C) It is true that if a party waives a condition, that party may reinstate the condition with respect to future acts of performance. However, that rule is not applicable

here because the parties modified the contract by mutual agreement and the opportunity to reinstate a condition was no longer available.

Educational objective:

An assignee (ie, one to whom rights under a contract are transferred) takes all of the assignor's rights as the contract stands at the time of the assignment.

explanation.zh:
合同权利的转让

• 允许转让,除非:在实质上增加承付人的合同义务或风险,在实质上减少承付人获得履约的机会,或根据合同规定,转让无效(不仅仅是禁止)。立即转让右侧

• 一般需要对价使转让不可撤销 -- -- 例外:本票不容反悔、送交象征所转让权利的文件(例如库存证书)、送交书面转让和签字转让

• 假定转让人作为合同的所有权利在转让时都存在,但有下列权利要求/抗辩:在承付人收到转让通知之前产生的,或转让人目前或今后不履行义务造成的。

• 转让人丧失权利,因此不能执行合同 转让是指根据合同向另一人(即受让人)转让权利,受让人按照转让时的合同取得转让人的所有权利。

在此,债务人与债权人之间的合同要求债务人在每月的第一天付款。当债权人承诺在每月第五天接受付款以换取债务人承诺通过出纳支票付款时,当事人对合同作了有效的修改。 * 因为这是在债权人根据合同转让其权利之前发生的。债务人有理由坚持认为,其余分期付款的付款日期是每个月的第五个。

* 注意到考虑到债权人承诺接受以后的付款(而且修改是有效的),因为债务人改变了其原先的偿债义务,承诺今后通过出纳支票付款。

(选择A) 没有任何规则仅仅因为受让人没有通知而使合同修改对受让人无效,因此,受让人(这里的银行)受修改的约束。

(选择B和C)如果一方当事人放弃一项条件,该当事人确实可以恢复有关未来履行行为的条件。

在此,因为双方通过相互协议修改了合同,而且不再有机会恢复一项条件。

学习要点：

受让人(即合同下的权利被转让给的受让人)取得转让人的所有权利,如同转让时的合同一样。

stem:
Under the terms of a written contract, a contractor agreed to construct a garage for a homeowner for $10,000. Nothing was stated in the parties' negotiations or in the contract about progress payments during the course of the work. After completing 25% of the garage strictly according to the homeowner's specifications, the contractor assigned his rights under the contract to a bank as security for an $8,000 loan. The bank immediately notified the homeowner of the assignment.

The contractor then, without legal excuse, abandoned the job before it was half-complete. The contractor subsequently defaulted on the loan from the bank. The

contractor has no assets. It will cost the homeowner at least $8,000 to get the garage finished by another builder.
stemZh:
根据书面合同的规定,承包商同意为房主建造一个10 000美元的车库,在双方的谈判或合同中均未说明工程过程中的进度付款。在严格按照房主的规格完成25%的车库后,承包商将合同规定的权利转让给了一家银行,作为8 000美元贷款的担保,银行立即通知房主。

因此,承包人在半工半读之前就放弃了该项工作,后来承包人拖欠了银行的贷款。

房主至少要花费8 000美元才能让另一个建筑商完成车库。
ask: If the bank sues the homeowner for $8,000, which of the following will the court decide?
askZh: 如果银行以8000美元起诉房主,法院将作出下列决定:

options.en: The bank wins, because the bank as a secured creditor over the contractor is entitled to priority over the homeowner's unsecured claim against the contractor.
options.zh: 银行胜出,因为银行作为有担保债权人,有权优先于房主对承包商的无担保债权。

options.en: The bank wins, because the contract was in existence and the contractor was not in breach when the bank gave the homeowner notice of the assignment.
options.zh: 银行胜诉,因为合同已经存在,而且当银行向房主发出转让通知时承包商没有违反合同。

options.en: The homeowner wins, because her claim against the contractor arose prior to the contractor's default on his loan from the bank.
options.zh: 房主胜诉,因为她对承包商的索赔是在承包商拖欠银行贷款之前提出的。

options.en: The homeowner wins, because her right to recoupment on account of the contractor's breach is available against the bank as the contractor's assignee.
options.zh: 房主胜诉,因为她因承包商违约而获得补偿的权利可以由作为承包商受让人的银行支付。

explanation.en:
Assignment of contractual rights

Limitations • Assignment permitted unless it: – materially increases obligor's contractual duties or risks – materially reduces obligor's chance of obtaining performance or – is void (not merely prohibited) under contract provision Requirements • Present intent to immediately assign right

• Consideration generally required to make assignment irrevocable – Exceptions: promissory estoppel, delivery of document symbolizing assigned right (eg, stock certificate), delivery of written & signed assignment Assignee's rights

• Assumes all of assignor's rights as contract stands at time of assignment, subject to claims/defenses that: – accrued before obligor received notice of assignment or – stem from assignor's present or future failure to perform

• Assignor loses rights & therefore cannot enforce contract A party to a contract is generally free to assign (ie, transfer) its contractual rights to another. The recipient of those rights (assignee) then steps into the shoes of the assigning party (assignor) and assumes all of the assignor's contractual rights to the obligor's performance as they stand at the time of the assignment. However, those rights are subject to any claims or defenses that:

• accrued before the obligor received notice of the assignment or

• stem from the assignor's present or future failure to perform (Choice B). Here, the contractor assigned his contractual rights to the bank—including the right to sue the homeowner for money owed under the contract up to the amount of the bank loan ($8,000). However, the bank's recovery is subject to the homeowner's right to recoup $8,000 for the contractor's subsequent failure to finish the garage. Since this fully offsets the bank's recovery, the court will decide for the homeowner.

(Choice A) The priority of secured and unsecured claims is relevant in bankruptcy proceedings and other situations where claims are paid in order of priority. But here, the bank's secured-creditor status over the contractor does not affect the homeowner's right to offset the bank's recovery.

(Choice C) Had the homeowner's claim been unrelated to the contractor's failure to perform, the timing of the breach and when she received notice of the assignment would

affect her ability to prevail. But the time that the contractor defaulted on the bank's loan is irrelevant to her success.

Educational objective:

An assignee assumes all of the assignor's contractual rights that exist at the time of the assignment. However, the assignment is subject to any claims or defenses that (1) the obligor could have raised before receiving notice of the assignment or (2) stem from the assignor's failure to perform.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 336 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (defenses against assignee).

• 转让人丧失权利,因此不能强制执行合同。 合同一方一般可以自由地将其合同权利转让(即转让)给另一方。这些权利的接受人(受让人)然后步入出让方(转让人)的境地,承担转让人在转让时履行义务的所有合同权利。然而,这些权利须服从于下列任何要求或辩护:

• 在承付人收到转让通知之前累计或

• 转让人目前或将来不履行合同(Choice B)。 在此,承包商将其合同权利转让给银行,包括有权对房主根据合同所欠的款项提起诉讼,数额不超过银行贷款的数额(8 000美元)。但是,银行的追偿要视房主对承包商后来未能完成车库的赔款8000美元的权利而定,由于这完全抵消了银行的追偿,法院会为房主作出决定.

(选择A) 有担保和无担保债权的优先权与破产程序和按优先顺序偿付债权的其他情形有关。但在此,银行对承包商的担保债权人地位并不影响房主抵消银行追偿的权利.

(选择C) 如果房主的索赔与承包人未履约无关,违约的时间和她在接到转让通知时将

但是承包商拖欠银行贷款的时间 与她的成功无关

学习要点：

受让人承担转让时存在的转让人的所有合同权利,但转让必须服从(1)承付人在收到转让通知之前可以提出的任何要求或抗辩,或者(2)产生于转让人未能履行义务。

参考资料

• 重述(第二份)第336条(1981年《美国法律》)(对受让人的抗辩)。

stem:
An elderly woman underwent major surgery and spent two weeks in the hospital. The woman continued to take powerful pain medication for several weeks after she returned home. During her recovery, she offered to sell her car for $450 to her neighbor, who owned a house-cleaning service. The neighbor said, "That's great! I need a car to transport all the people who work for me to their job sites."

In fact, the woman's car was worth $3,000, and the neighbor knew this. He was also aware that the woman had undergone surgery and noted that she seemed "out of it" because of the medication she was taking.

Several days later, the woman's son found out about the deal and contacted the neighbor, telling him that the woman would sell him the car, but for $3,450. The next day, when the neighbor tendered $450 and demanded that the woman give him the car, she refused.
stemZh:
一名老年妇女接受了重大手术,在医院呆了两周,她回家后连续几周继续服用强力止痛药。在康复期间,她提出以450美元的价格将自己的车卖给拥有房屋清洁服务的邻居,邻居说:"太好了!我需要一辆车来运送所有为我工作的人到他们的工作地点".

事实上,这个女人的车值3000美元,邻居知道这一点,他也知道这个女人接受了手术,并且注意到她因为服用的药物而显得"出局了".

几天后,女方的儿子发现交易,并联系邻居,告诉他女方会把车卖给他,但卖了3450美元,第二天,邻居出价450美元,要求女方给他车,她拒绝了.
ask: If the neighbor sues the woman for breach of contract, will he be likely to prevail?
askZh: 如果邻居告女人违约,他会不会胜诉?

options.en: No, because the contract was voidable due to the woman's apparent incapacity.
options.zh: 不,因为由于妇女明显无行为能力,合同无效。

options.en: No, because the woman put nothing in writing.
options.zh: 不,因为女人没有写字。

options.en: Yes, because the neighbor's reliance on the otherwise voidable contract made it enforceable.
options.zh: 是的,因为邻居对原本可以撤销的合同的依赖使其可以执行.

options.en: Yes, because the woman's offer and the neighbor's acceptance created an enforceable contract.
options.zh: 是的,因为妇女的要约 和邻居的承诺创造了可执行的合同。

explanation.en:
Incapacity to form contract

Infancy • Person under 18 enters contract

• Voidable if disaffirmed by minor before or soon after turning 18

• Minor must return any still-existing benefit received under contract Mental illness

• Mental capacity so deficient that party cannot reasonably understand (or act in relation to) nature or consequences of contract AND other party had reason to know

• Voidable if disaffirmed by incapacitated party when lucid or by legal representative Intoxication • Party too intoxicated to reasonably understand (or act in relation to) nature or consequences of contract AND other party had reason to know

• Voidable if promptly disaffirmed by intoxicated party upon becoming sober

• Intoxicated party must offer to return any consideration received & may be liable for fair value of goods or services provided A valid contract is generally formed when a mutual agreement is supported by adequate consideration—eg, when the woman offered to sell her car and the neighbor accepted. That contract is enforceable unless the breaching party establishes a defense (Choice D). Incapacity due to intoxication is a defense when:

• an intoxicated party could not reasonably understand or act in relation to the nature or consequences of the contract (eg, selling a car worth $3,000 for only $450) and

• the other party had reason to know of the intoxication (eg, noticing that the intoxicated party was "out of it" when the contract was formed). This renders a contract voidable, so it can be set aside if the intoxicated party acts promptly (ie, within a reasonable time) to disaffirm it upon becoming sober. And here, the woman likely was still under medication when she disaffirmed the contract by refusing to give the neighbor the car, so the neighbor is unlikely to prevail.

(Choice B) A contract need only be in writing and signed by the party to be charged if it falls within the statute of frauds. This rule applies to contracts for the sale of goods for $500 or more, but it does not apply to this contract to sell the car for only $450.

(Choice C) Under the doctrine of promissory estoppel, a party can enforce a promise on which it relied when no valid contract was formed. But the doctrine only allows recovery if

the party's reliance was reasonable and caused substantial detriment—neither of which is seen here.

Educational objective:

Incapacity due to intoxication renders a contract voidable if the intoxicated party could not reasonably understand the nature or consequences of the contract AND the other party had reason to know of the intoxication. The contract can then be set aside if the intoxicated party promptly disaffirms it upon becoming sober.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 12–16 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (incapacity to contract).

explanation.zh:
无法订立合同

• 18岁以下者签约

• 18岁以前或18岁之后不久,如果未成年人否认,可变形;

• 未成年人必须退还根据合同领取的任何现有福利

• 心理能力有缺陷,以致当事人无法合理理解(或与)合同的性质或后果,而另一方当事人有理由知道

• 如无行为能力的一方在清醒时或法定代表人醉酒后予以否认,可变质;• 当事方太醉,无法合理理解(或行为与)其性质或后果合同和其他当事方有理由知道

• 醉酒一方一旦清醒后,如果迅速失去确认,是可以挥霍的

· 醉酒方必须主动提出退还所收到的任何对价,并可能要承担货物或服务的公允价值责任,条件是在相互协议得到适当对价支持的情况下——例如,当妇女要约向她出售时,通常会形成有效的合同;该合同可执行,除非违约方确定(Choice D) 醉酒导致能力不足是以下情况下的辩护:

• 醉酒方无法合理地理解合同的性质或后果或采取行动(例如,仅售价3 000美元的汽车450美元);

• 另一方当事人有理由知道中毒(例如,注意到醉方在合同订立时“退出”了)。这使合同变得无效,因此,如果醉酒一方(即在合理时间内)在清醒时迅速采取行动否定合同,合同就可以被撤销。而在这里,当她拒绝给邻居车以拒绝确认合同时,这个女人很可能还在服药,所以邻居不太可能获胜.

(Choice B)如果合同属于防止欺诈法的范围,合同只需要书面形式并由收费方签署,本规则适用于500美元或以上的货物销售合同,但不适用于本合同仅售价450美元的汽车.

(C选择)根据允诺禁反言原则,当没有订立有效合同时,当事一方可以执行它所依赖的许诺。

当事人的依赖是合理的,并且造成了相当大的损害——这里没有看到这一点。

学习要点：

如果被醉方不能合理理解合同的性质或后果,而另一方当事人有理由知道该中毒情况,则因中毒而丧失能力使合同无效。如果醉酒方在清醒时立即否认合同,则合同可以被撤销。

参考资料

· 合同重述(第二次)第12至16条(1981年《美国法律》)(无法履行合同)。

stem: During an ice storm, a man's car slipped down an embankment and became lodged against a large tree. The man called a towing company and told the company's manager that the car was 100 feet down the embankment. "That's lucky," said the manager, "because our winch only goes 100 feet." After the manager and the man agreed on a price, an employee of the company attempted to reach the car but could not because the car turned out to be 120 feet down the embankment.
stemZh: 在一场冰风暴中,一个人的车滑下堤岸,然后被困在一棵大树上,他打电话给一家拖车公司,告诉公司的经理,这辆车在堤岸下100英尺处."很幸运",经理说,"因为我们的绞盘只走100英尺",在经理和那个人商定价格后,公司的一名雇员试图到达汽车,但因汽车在堤下120英尺而未能到达.
ask: Is the towing company's performance excused on the grounds of mistake?
askZh: 拖车公司的表现是否以错误为由免除?.

options.en: No, because both parties were uncertain about the distance.
options.zh: 不,因为双方都不确定距离

options.en: No, because the towing company assumed the risk by the manager's failure to examine the distance himself.
options.zh: 不,因为拖车公司承担了风险 因为经理没有亲自检查距离

options.en: Yes, because at the time of contracting, both parties were mistaken about a basic assumption on which the contract was based.
options.zh: 是的,因为在订立合同时,双方对合同所依据的基本假设都是错误的。

options.en: Yes, because the agreement did not allocate the risk of mistake to either party.
options.zh: 是的,因为协议没有将错误的风险分配给任何一方。

explanation.en:
When party assumes risk of mistake

Express Contract allocates risk to party

Conscious ignorance

Party enters contract despite conscious ignorance of facts related to mistake

Adjudication Court allocates risk to party because reasonable under circumstances

When both parties enter a contract based on the same mistake (ie, mutual mistake), the contract is voidable by the adversely affected party if:

• the mistake relates to a basic assumption of the contract

• the mistake materially affects the agreed-upon exchange of performances (ie, the adversely affected party cannot fairly be required to carry it out) and

• the adversely affected party does not assume the risk of the mistake.

Here, both parties entered the agreement based on the erroneous belief that the man's car was 100 feet down the embankment (Choice A). That mistake relates to a basic assumption of the contract since the towing company's winch only goes 100 feet. And it materially affects the agreed-upon exchange because the towing company cannot be expected to tow a car that its winch cannot reach. Therefore, the towing company's performance will be excused because it also did not assume the risk of the mistake—ie:

• the agreement did not expressly allocate the risk of the mistake to the towing company

• there is no indication that the towing company knew that the man's car was probably more than 100 feet down the embankment and contracted to tow it anyway and

• it would not be reasonable for a court to allocate the risk of the mistake to the towing company when its winch cannot even reach the car (Choice D).

(Choice B) A party's failure to know or discover facts before entering into a contract (eg, the manager's failure to examine the distance himself) does not prevent the party from avoiding the contract.

Educational objective:

The adversely affected party can avoid a contract on the grounds of mutual mistake if (1) the mistake relates to a basic assumption of the contract, (2) the mistake materially affects the agreed exchange of performances, and (3) the adversely affected party does not assume the risk of the mistake.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 152 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when mutual mistake makes a contract voidable).

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 154 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when a party bears the risk of a mistake).

explanation.zh:
当事人承担错误风险时

合同将风险分配给当事方

意识无知

当事人尽管自觉不了解与错误有关的事实,但仍签订合同

裁决法院将风险分配给当事方,因为情况合理

当双方基于同一错误(即相互错误)订立合同时,合同是:受不利影响的当事方可撤销:

• 错误涉及合同的基本假设

• 错误在实质上影响到商定的交流表演(即不能要求受到不利影响的一方进行这种交流)和

• 受害方不承担错误的风险。

在此,双方以男子的汽车在堤岸下100英尺(Choice A)的错误信念签订协议,这个错误与合同的基本假设有关,因为牵引公司的绞盘只走100英尺.这对协议的交换有实质性影响 因为不能指望拖车公司因此,拖车公司的表现将被免除。因为它也没有承担错误的风险——即:

• 协议没有明确将错误风险分配给拖车公司

- 没有迹象表明拖车公司知道此人的车可能离堤下100英尺以上,并签约拖车。

• 当牵引公司连绞盘都达不到汽车时(Choice D),法院将错误风险分配给拖引公司是不合理的。

(Choice B)一方在订立合同前未能知道或发现事实(例如,经理没有亲自检查距离)并不妨碍该方宣告合同无效.

学习要点：

如果 (1) 错误与合同的基本假设有关, (2) 错误对约定的履约交换有实质影响,(3) 受到不利影响的当事人不承担错误的风险。

参考资料

• 重述(第二次)第152条(1981年《美国法律》)(当相互错误使合同无效时)。

• 重述(第二次)第154条(1981年《美国法律》)(当一方当事人承担错误风险时)。

stem:
A buyer expressed interest in purchasing an industrial air-conditioning system manufactured by the seller. The parties agreed orally on a price of $100,000 for the system, but continued to negotiate over several points. When all matters regarding the air-conditioning system were finally settled, the parties signed a written agreement. It

provided that the price for the system, which would be delivered on June 1, would be $110,000. The written agreement, a lengthy form contract, did not contain a merger clause.

The seller delivered the system on June 1, but the buyer refused to pay more than $100,000, citing the earlier oral agreement as to price.

The seller sued the buyer for the additional $10,000 under the written agreement.
stemZh:
买方表示有兴趣购买由卖方制造的工业空调系统,双方口头商定该系统的价格为10万美元,但继续就几个问题进行谈判。当有关空调系统的所有事项最终得到解决时,双方签署了一项书面协议。

但该系统将于6月1日交付,价格为110 000美元。书面协议是一份冗长的形式合同,其中没有兼并条款。

卖方于6月1日交付了该系统,但买方拒绝支付超过10万美元,援引了早先关于价格的口头协议。

卖方根据书面协议起诉买方,要求追加10 000美元。
ask: Is the court likely to admit the evidence of the orally agreed price of $100,000?
askZh: 法院是否可能承认口头商定的10万美元价格的证据?

options.en: No, because the buyer assumed the risk of any mistake as to price.
options.zh: 不,因为买方承担了价格错误的风险。

options.en: No, because the oral price term would contradict an express term in the written agreement.
options.zh: 否,因为口头价格条款会与书面协议中的明确条款相矛盾。

options.en: Yes, because the oral price term is relevant to whether the writing should be reformed.
options.zh: 是的,因为口头价格术语与是否应该改革书面形式有关。

options.en: Yes, because the written agreement did not contain a merger clause.
options.zh: 是的,因为书面协议中没有兼并条款。

explanation.en:
Integration

Type Definition Effect

Complete integration

Writing that sets forth parties' final agreement about all terms

• Excludes parol evidence within scope of agreement

• Parol evidence inadmissible to supplement (ie, add to) or contradict contract Partial integration

Writing that sets forth parties' final agreement about some terms

• Excludes parol evidence inconsistent with agreement

• Parol evidence admissible to supplement (not contradict) contract Under the UCC parol evidence rule, evidence of any prior agreement (or contemporaneous oral agreement) cannot be used to contradict the terms of an integrated writing. A writing is integrated if the parties intended for it to be a final expression of their agreement about some or all of the terms.

Here, the parties intended for the written contract to be the final expression of their agreement since they entered into the contract only after they had settled "all matters" regarding the purchase of the air-conditioning system. As a result, the court is unlikely to admit evidence of the $100,000 oral price term because it contradicts the $110,000 price term expressed in the written contract.

(Choice A) Evidence used to establish a defense to formation or enforceability of a contract (eg, mistake) is excepted from the parol evidence rule. Here, there is no evidence of mistake (eg, that the $110,000 price term in the written contract was due to a clerical error). But if there were, evidence of the mistake would be admissible.

(Choice C) Evidence used to establish a ground for granting a remedy (eg, reformation) is also excepted from the parol evidence rule. Mistake and misrepresentation are grounds for granting reformation, but the oral price term is evidence of neither.

(Choice D) A merger clause is strong but not definitive evidence that a contract is completely integrated. But here, it does not matter whether the contract was completely or partially integrated; in either case, the parties cannot use parol evidence to contradict the written terms.

Educational objective:

The UCC parol evidence rule bars evidence of any prior agreement (or contemporaneous oral agreement) that contradicts the terms of an integrated writing.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

References

• U.C.C. § 2-202 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (parol evidence rule).

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 214 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (exceptions to parol evidence rule).

explanation.zh:
一体化

类型定义效果

完全整合

写出当事人关于所有条款的最后协议

• 排除协议范围内的虚假证据

• 为补充(即补充、补充)或与合同相抵触而不予受理的假释证据

写出当事人关于某些条款的最后协议

• 排除不符合协议的虚假证据

• 根据UCC parol证据规则,任何先前协议(或同时口头协议)的证据不能用来与综合书面条款相矛盾。如果当事人打算将书面形式作为对部分或全部条款的约定的最后表示,则书面形式即为综合形式。

在此,双方打算将书面合同作为最后协议的表示,因为他们只有在解决了有关购买空调系统的"所有事项"后才签订合同.因此,法院不太可能接受10万美元口头价格条款的证据,因为它与书面合同中表述的11万美元价格条款相矛盾.

(Choice A) 用于确立对合同的订立或可执行性进行辩护的证据(例如错误),被排除在parol证据规则之外。这里没有错误的证据(例如,书面合同中的11万美元价格条款是由于文书错误),但是如果有错误,错误的证据是可以接受的。

(Choice)用于确立给予补救的理由的证据(例如,重归正统)也被排除在parol证据规则之外. 错误和错报是准予重归正统的理由,但口头价格术语是两者都不存在的证据.

(Choice D) 合并条款是有力但并非明确的证据,证明合同是完全一体化的。 但在这里,合同是完全还是部分一体化并不重要;无论哪种情况,当事人都不得使用口头证据来反驳书面条款。

学习要点：

UCC parol证据规则禁止任何与综合书写条款相矛盾的事先协议(或同时期口头协议)的证据.

UCC = 统一商法典

• 重述(第二)第214条(1981年《美国法律》)(证据规则的例外)。

stem:
A homeowner went to an appliance store to purchase a new refrigerator. The homeowner's old refrigerator had just been destroyed by an electrical surge, and he needed to purchase a new one immediately to prevent food spoilage. The homeowner did not understand English, so he conversed with the salesperson in Spanish.

The homeowner told the salesperson about the electrical surge and explained that he did not have enough cash for a new refrigerator. The salesperson told the homeowner not to worry because the appliance store offered no-interest financing for a "small finance fee." Then the homeowner signed a contract printed in English. The contract provided for a purchase price of $900, payable in three equal monthly installments, plus a finance fee of $500. The homeowner made three installment payments of $300 each but never paid the finance fee.
stemZh:
一个屋主到一家电器店购买新冰箱,屋主的旧冰箱刚刚被电潮冲毁,他需要立即购买新冰箱,以防止食物腐烂.屋主不懂英语,于是用西班牙语和推销员交谈.

屋主向售货员讲述了电潮的情况,并解释说他没有足够的现金买新的冰箱.售货员告诉房东不要担心,因为电器店提供"小额融资费"的无息融资,后来房东签署了一份英文印制的合同.合同规定,购买价900美元,分三个等值的月分期付款,加上500美元的财务费,房主分三次分期付款,每次300美元,但从未支付财务费。
ask: If the appliance store sues the homeowner for breach of contract and seeks to exclude any evidence of the conversation between the homeowner and the salesperson, how will the court likely rule?
askZh: 如果电器店起诉房主违约,并试图排除房主与售货员谈话的任何证据,那么法院将如何裁决?

options.en: Admit the evidence as proof of a collateral agreement.
options.zh: 承认证据作为担保协议的证明.

options.en: Admit the evidence as proof of unfair surprise in the contract's terms.
options.zh: 承认证据作为合同条款中不公平惊喜的证据.

options.en: Exclude the evidence as contradicting an unambiguous term of the contract.
options.zh: 排除与合同明确规定相矛盾的证据。

options.en: Exclude the evidence on the basis of a finding that the contract was completely integrated.
options.zh: 排除基于一项结论的证据,即合同是完全一体化的。

explanation.en:
The parol evidence rule bars evidence of prior or contemporaneous communications between contracting parties that contradict the unambiguous terms of a written contract that is completely or partially integrated.* But this rule does not apply to evidence that is offered to establish a defense to the enforceability of the contract. One such defense is unconscionability, which is available if the contract involves some element of unfair surprise.

Here, the homeowner signed a written contract to purchase the refrigerator. Before doing so, the homeowner had told the salesperson about his financial situation, and the salesperson had told the homeowner that the store offered no-interest financing for a "small fee." Evidence of this conversation shows that the $500 finance fee for a $900 refrigerator was not in line with the homeowner's expectations—particularly since the contract was in English. Therefore, the court should admit the conversation as proof of unconscionability due to unfair surprise.

*However, evidence of prior or contemporaneous communications that supplement (ie, add to) but do not contradict the writing is only barred by the parol evidence rule if the contract is completely integrated.

(Choice A) The parol evidence rule does not apply to evidence of a collateral agreement— ie, a separate deal with its own consideration. But here, the conversation between the salesperson and the homeowner did not concern a separate deal since it directly applied to the sale of the refrigerator.

(Choice C) Evidence that the finance fee was characterized as "small" would ordinarily be barred by the parol evidence rule because it contradicts the unambiguous, $500 finance fee in the contract's terms. But since the evidence helps show that the fee unfairly surprised the homeowner, it is admissible.

(Choice D) Even if a contract is completely integrated, parol evidence may be offered to establish a defense to the enforceability of the contract (eg, unconscionability).

Educational objective:

The parol evidence rule does NOT bar evidence of prior or contemporaneous communications between contracting parties when the evidence is offered to establish a defense to enforceability (eg, unconscionability).

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 214 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (exceptions to parol evidence rule).

explanation.zh:
口头证据规则排除了缔约方之间事先或同时通信的证据,这些通信与完全或部分合并的书面合同的明确规定相矛盾。 * 但这一规则不适用于所提供的证据。这种抗辩之一是不合乎情理的,如果合同涉及某种不公平的意外因素,这种抗辩是可以利用的。

在这里,房主签署了购买冰箱的书面合同,在此之前,房主已经告诉售货员他的财务状况,售货员告诉房主,店主以"小费"提供无息融资.对话的证据表明,900美元冰箱的500美元融资费不符合房主的期望,特别是因为合同是英文的。因此,法院应当承认,由于不公平的惊喜,谈话是不合理的证据。

* 然而,只有在合同完全融为一体的情况下,补充(即添加)但不与书面内容相矛盾的先前或同时期通信的证据才被parol证据规则所禁止。

(Choice A) parol证据规则不适用于附带协议的证据——即单独处理其本身的对价.但在这里,售货员与房主的对话并不涉及单独的交易,因为它直接适用于冰箱的销售.

(Choice)证明融资费被定性为"小额"的证据通常会被parol证据规则所禁止,因为它与合同条款中毫不含糊的500美元融资费相矛盾.但是,由于有证据表明这笔费用不公平地使房主感到惊讶,因此可以受理。

(Choice D)即使一项合同是完全一体化的,也可以提供可论证的证据,以证明合同的可执行性(例如,不合理性)。

学习要点：

当提出证据以确立对可执行性(例如,不合理性)的辩护时,朴素证据规则并不禁止缔约方之间事先或同时通信的证据。

参考资料

• 重述(第二)第214条(1981年《美国法律》)(证据规则的例外)。

stem:
An elderly widow had one child, an adult son, who lived out-of-state. The widow was in poor health, so she hired a live-in caregiver to tend to her daily needs. Knowing that the widow owned a successful bakery business, the caregiver befriended the widow in order to convince her to sell her business to the caregiver. When the widow later decided to sell the business to her son, the caregiver became upset. She falsely told the widow that there were no other reliable caregivers available in the widow's community. The caregiver then threatened to quit her job and never speak to the widow again unless the widow agreed to sell the business to the caregiver. Although the widow knew that there were other caregivers available, she depended on the caregiver and was terrified of being without her. The widow therefore executed a contract selling the business to the caregiver for less than half its market value.

Shortly thereafter, the widow was placed under the son's guardianship. When the son learned about the contract and the caregiver's threat, he sued to have the contract annulled on the widow's behalf.
stemZh:
一个年长的寡妇有一个孩子,一个成年的儿子,住在州外,寡妇身体欠佳,所以她雇了一个住家的照顾者照顾日常需要.知道寡妇拥有一家成功的面包店生意,照顾者与寡妇结为好友,以说服她把生意卖给照顾者,当寡妇后来决定把生意卖给她的儿子时,照顾者变得心烦意乱.她谎称寡妇所在社区没有其他可靠的照料者,随后,照料者威胁要辞去工作,除非寡妇同意将企业卖给照料者,否则再也不与寡妇说话。虽然寡妇知道还有其他照顾者,但她依赖照顾者,并害怕没有她,因此寡妇执行了一份合同,以不到一半的市场价值将企业卖给照顾者。

此后不久,寡妇被置于儿子的监护之下,儿子得知合同和照顾者的威胁后,他起诉要求代表寡妇废除合同。
ask: On what basis is the son most likely to prevail?
askZh: 儿子最有可能胜出的依据是什么?

options.en: Duress.
options.zh: 杜丽丝

options.en: Lack of capacity.
options.zh: 缺乏能力。

options.en: Misrepresentation.
options.zh: 说法不当.

options.en: Undue influence.
options.zh: 不当影响.

explanation.en:
A contract is voidable for undue influence if a party's assent was the product of unfair or excessive persuasion by someone who dominated or shared a special relationship of trust and confidence with that party. Persuasion is unfair or excessive if it seriously impairs the assenting party's ability to exercise free and competent judgment. The following factors are relevant to making this determination:

• Susceptibility of the assenting party (eg, elderly, in poor health)

• Unfairness of the resulting bargain (eg, sale of business for less than half its market value)

• Unavailability of independent advice (eg, attorney unavailable to discuss sale) Here, the widow relied on the caregiver to tend to her daily needs (dominant relationship). The caregiver's threat to quit and never speak to the widow again likely impaired the widow's judgment and persuaded her to sell the caregiver her business. This is further evidenced by the below-market sales price (unfair bargain) and the widow's age and poor health (susceptibility). Therefore, the son is most likely to prevail on this basis.

(Choice A) Duress renders a contract voidable if a party's assent was induced by an improper threat that left the party with no reasonable alternative but to succumb to that threat. Here, even if the caregiver's threat was improper, the widow had a reasonable alternative (eg, hiring a new caregiver).

(Choice B) A person placed under another's guardianship lacks the capacity to contract, so a contract entered by that person is void (not merely voidable). But here, the widow was placed under the son's guardianship after she agreed to sell her business to the caregiver.

(Choice C) A contract is voidable for a misrepresentation that (1) was fraudulent or material, (2) induced assent to the contract, and (3) was justifiably relied on by the assenting party. But since the widow knew other caregivers were available, her reliance on the caregiver's misrepresentation was unjustified.

Educational objective:

Undue influence renders a contract voidable when assent stemmed from unfair or excessive persuasion by someone who dominated or shared a special relationship of trust and confidence with the assenting party.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 177 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when undue influence makes a contract voidable).

explanation.zh:
如果当事人的同意是由支配或与该当事人有特殊的信任关系的人进行不公平或过度劝说的结果,则合同因影响不当而无效。劝告如果严重损害了同意方的行使能力,是不公平或过分的。下列因素与作出这一裁定有关:

• 同意方的可接受性(例如老年人,健康状况不佳)

• 由此产生的交易不公平(例如,以低于市场价值一半的价格出售企业)

· 得不到独立的咨询(例如,无法讨论买卖问题的律师)。 在此,寡妇依靠照料者照顾她的日常需要(主要关系)。照顾者威胁要退出,再也不和寡妇说话,这可能会损害寡妇的判断力,劝说她卖掉照顾者的业务.低于市场的销售价格(不公平交易)和寡妇的年龄和健康状况差(怀疑)进一步证明了这一点,因此,儿子最有可能在这一基础上占上风。

(Choice A)如果一方当事人的同意是由不当的威胁诱发的,而这种威胁使当事人别无选择,只能屈从于这种威胁,则合同就变得无效。在这里,即使照顾者的威胁是不适当的,寡妇也有合理的选择(例如雇用新的照顾者).

(Choice B) 受他人监护的人缺乏签订合同的能力,因此此人签订的合同是无效的(不仅仅是无效的).但在这里,寡妇在儿子同意将生意卖给照顾者后,被置于儿子的监护之下.

(选择C) 合同可以作虚假陈述而无效,即(1)是欺诈性的或实质性的,(2)是引致对合同的同意,(3)是同意方有理由依赖的。但是,由于寡妇知道还有其他照顾者,她依赖照顾者的虚假陈述是没有道理的。

学习要点：

不当影响使合同无效,因为同意是由支配或与同意方有特殊信任和信心关系的人的不公平或过度说服。

参考资料

• 重述(第二次)合同§177(1981年《美国法律》)(当不当影响使合同可以撤销时)。

stem: In a written and signed contract, a buyer agreed to purchase Lot 1 in a subdivision from a developer. Unbeknownst to either party, there was an error in the subdivision's recorded plat, and two separate lots had each been designated as "Lot 1." The buyer intended to purchase the Lot 1 located in the southern half of the subdivision, while the developer intended to sell the Lot 1 located in the northern half of the subdivision. On the day of the closing, the developer presented the buyer with a deed for the northern Lot 1.
stemZh: 在一份书面和签署的合同中,买方同意从开发商处购买分块中的Lot 1。对于任何一方来说,分块记录的plat有误,而且每个分块被指定为“Lot 1 ” 。买方打算这样做。购买位于分区南半部的Lot 1,而开发商打算出售位于分区北半部的Lot 1. 关闭当天,开发商向买方出示了北方Lot 1的地契.
ask: Which of the following statements concerning this exchange is accurate?
askZh: 以下哪些关于这一交换的声明是准确的?

options.en: The buyer can enforce the contract for the sale of the northern Lot 1 if he waives the misunderstanding and adopts the developer's understanding of "Lot 1."
options.zh: 买方如果放弃了误解,采纳开发商对"Lot 1"的理解,可以执行北方Lot 1的销售合同.

options.en: The buyer can enforce the contract for the sale of the southern Lot 1, because the risk of a plat error can be allocated to the developer that created the plat.
options.zh: 买方可以执行南洛特1号的销售合同,因为电镀错误的风险可以分配给创建电镀的开发商.

options.en: The developer can enforce the contract for the sale of the northern Lot 1, because it did not know or have reason to know of the buyer's interpretation of "Lot 1" when the contract was made.
options.zh: 开发商可以执行北方Lot 1的销售合同,因为它不知道或没有理由知道买方在合同订立时对"Lot 1"的解释.

options.en: The parties must seek reformation of the contract, and the court will decide which of the plats is the true "Lot 1."
options.zh: 双方必须寻求合同改革,法院将裁定哪一个牌子是真正的"洛特1".

explanation.en:
Misunderstanding of material term

General rule Waiver

Neither / both parties know of misunderstanding

No contract formed Either party can enforce other party's understanding

One party knows of misunderstanding

Contract formed based on unknowing party's understanding

Unknowing party can enforce knowing party's understanding

A misunderstanding arises when there is no meeting of the minds because the parties to a contract assign different meanings to the same term. Where the misunderstanding involves a material term and neither party (or both parties) knew or had reason to know of the misunderstanding, ordinarily there is no contract. However, either party can waive the misunderstanding and choose to enforce the contract in accordance with the other party's understanding.

Here, the buyer and the developer assigned different meanings to the term "Lot 1." Neither party was aware of the misunderstanding, and there is no indication that either of them had reason to know of the misunderstanding. Although this would ordinarily result in no contract, the buyer can waive his own misunderstanding to enforce the contract for the sale of the northern Lot 1—the developer's understanding of "Lot 1."

(Choice B) A court can allocate the risk of a mistake—ie, an erroneous belief of fact held by one or both parties—to a party upon a finding that it is reasonable in the circumstances to do so (eg, based on that party's culpability). But a court cannot allocate the risk of a misunderstanding—ie, the attachment of different meanings to the same term.

(Choice C) The developer cannot enforce the sale of the northern Lot 1 simply because he was unaware of the buyer's misinterpretation. And though the developer could waive the misunderstanding, this would allow the developer to enforce the contract based on the buyer's understanding (the southern Lot 1)—not the developer's understanding (the northern Lot 1).

(Choice D) When a writing fails to reflect the true meaning of the parties, either party may ask the court to reform the contract to accurately express the parties' agreement. But such reformation is generally a remedy for a mistake, not a misunderstanding.

Educational objective:

A misunderstanding involving a material term ordinarily results in no contract if neither (or both) parties knew or had reason to know of the misunderstanding. However, one party

can waive the misunderstanding and enforce the contract in accordance with the other party's understanding.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 20 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (effect of misunderstanding).

explanation.zh:
对实质性术语的误解

一般规则

双方都不知道误会

任何一方不得强制执行另一方的理解

有一方知道误会

B. 根据不知情方的理解订立的合同

不知所措的一方可以强制执行知己的理解

如果由于合同当事人对同一术语赋予不同的含义而未能达成共识,就会产生误解。如果误解涉及一个实质性术语,而且任何一方(或双方)都不知道或有理由知道误解,则通常没有合同。然而,任何一方均可放弃误解,并根据另一方的理解选择执行合同.

在这里,买方和开发商对"Lot 1"一词赋予了不同的含义,双方都没有意识到这一误解,也没有迹象表明其中任何一方有理由知道这一误解.虽然这通常不会导致任何合同,但买方可以放弃自己的误解,执行北方Lot 1的销售合同——开发商对"Lot 1"的理解.

(Choice B)法院可以根据认定在当时情况下这样做是合理的(例如,根据当事人的罪责),将错误的风险——即对一方或双方持有的事实的错误信念——分配给一方当事人。但是,法院不能将误解的风险分配给同一术语,即附加不同含义的风险。

(Choice C) 开发商不能仅仅因为不知道买方的误解而强制出售北方Lot 1.虽然开发商可以放弃误解,但这样可以让开发商根据买方的理解(南方Lot 1)——而不是开发商的理解(北方Lot 1)——执行合同.

(Choice D)当书面无法反映当事人的真实含义时,任何一方均可要求法院修改合同以准确表达当事人的约定,但这种修改一般是对错误的补救,而不是误解.

学习要点：

涉及实质性术语的误解通常不会产生任何合同,如果任何一方(或双方)都不知道或有理由知道这种误解。

可以放弃误解,并按照合同规定执行合同对方的理解。

参考资料

• 重述(第二次)合同§20(1981年《美国法律》)(误解的影响)。

stem:
A commercial baker and an ingredient supplier orally agreed that the baker would purchase 1,000 pounds of flour from the supplier for a price between 50 and 75 cents per pound. The parties agreed that they would determine the final price upon delivery. The supplier promised to deliver the flour in two weeks.

Later that day, the baker sent the supplier a signed note reminding the supplier about the terms of their agreement, including the quantity of flour. The supplier received the note, read it, and took no further action. When the supplier failed to deliver the flour, the baker sued the supplier for breach of contract.
stemZh:
一名商业面包师和一名配料供应商口头商定,面包师将向供应商购买1,000磅面粉,价格在每磅50至75美分之间,双方商定在交货时确定最后价格。供应商承诺在两周内交付面粉.

当天晚些时候,面包师向供应商发了一份签名的纸条,提醒供应商他们协议的条款,包括面粉的数量,供应商收到了纸条,阅读了纸条,没有采取进一步行动.当供应商未能交付面粉时,面包师起诉供应商违约.
ask: Can the baker enforce the contract against the supplier?
askZh: 面包师能对供应商执行合同吗?

options.en: No, because the parties did not agree to a definitive price term.
options.zh: 不,因为双方不同意一个确定的价格条款。

options.en: No, because the supplier did not sign the note.

explanation.en:
Statute of frauds requirements

Writing Physical or electronic document(s) containing reasonable basis to believe contract was formed (eg, receipt, check, emails) AND

• at common law – identifies parties, subject matter, consideration, time & nature of performance

• under UCC – lists quantity of goods (contract enforceable only up to written quantity) Signature General rule – handwritten signature from, or other mark identifying, party to be charged (eg, letterhead, electronic signature, initials)

• Merchant exception – between merchants, written confirmation that satisfies statute of frauds as to sender will bind both parties if no written objection within 10 days UCC = Uniform Commercial Code,

The UCC statute of frauds applies to contracts for the sale of goods valued at $500 or more. To be enforceable, these agreements must be evidenced by a writing that:

• provides a reasonable basis to believe a contract was formed (eg, the baker's note)

• lists the quantity of goods sold or the means to determine quantity (eg, 1,000 pounds of flour) and

• is signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought (here, the supplier)

(Choice B). However, the UCC relaxes the signature requirement in agreements between merchants—ie, regular dealers of the goods involved in the transaction. Under the merchant exception, a written confirmation need only be signed by one merchant and sent to the other merchant. If the recipient has reason to know the confirmation's contents and does not object within 10 days, then it is enforceable against both merchants.

Here, the baker and the supplier are both merchants—regular dealers in flour. The baker's signed note was a sufficient writing because it confirmed that a contract was formed and listed the quantity of goods sold. Additionally, the supplier had reason to know the contents of the note (received and read it) and did not object within 10 days. Therefore, the contract was enforceable against both parties.

(Choice A) Although the parties did not agree to a definitive price term, they did agree to determine the final price at delivery. And even if they are unable to do so, the contract is enforceable since UCC gap-fillers will supply the price term at the time of delivery.

(Choice D) An oral agreement is unenforceable when, as here, it is subject to the statute of frauds. However, the parties' oral agreement was memorialized in a written confirmation that satisfied the merchant exception to this statute and can therefore be enforced.

Educational objective:

Under the merchant exception to the UCC statute of frauds, a confirmation signed and sent by one merchant to another binds both parties if the recipient has reason to know its contents and does not object within 10 days.

References

• U.C.C. § 2-201 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (describing the UCC statute of frauds).

• U.C.C. § 2-305(1)(b) (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (describing open price terms).

写载有相信合同成立的合理依据的实物或电子文件(例如收据、支票、电子邮件)和

• 在普通法中确定当事方、主题事项、对价、履行的时间和性质

• 根据《统一商法典》 -- -- 列出货物数量(合同可执行,但仅限于书面数量)一般规则 -- -- 被控告方(例如,信头、电子签字、缩写)

• 商家之间的商业例外,如果在10天内没有书面反对,满足对发货人的防止欺诈法的书面确认将约束双方,

《UCC防止欺诈法》适用于价值500美元或500美元以上的货物销售合同。

• 提供合理依据,使人相信合同已经订立(如面包师的纸条)

• 列出所售货物的数量或确定数量的手段(如1 000磅面粉)和

• 由被请求执行的当事人(此处指供应商)签署;

然而,《统一商法典》放宽了交易所涉货物的普通经销商之间的协议中的签字要求。根据商家的例外规定,书面确认只需由一位商家签字并发送给另一位商家,如果接受确认者有理由知道确认的内容并在10天内没有提出异议,则书面确认可以对两位商家强制执行.

在这里,面包师和供应商都是普通的面粉商,面包师签的纸条足够了,因为它证实合同已经订立,并列出销售的货物数量。此外,供应商有理由知道该说明的内容(收到并阅读),在10天内没有提出异议,因此,合同对双方当事人都是可以执行的。

(Choice A)虽然双方当事人没有约定一个确定的价格条款,但他们确实同意在交货时确定最终价格,而且即使他们无法这样做,合同也是可以执行的,因为UCC漏洞填充器会在交货时提供价格条款.

(Choice D) 口头协议,如此处所述,受防止欺诈法约束时,是无法执行的,但当事人的口头协议是以书面确认的形式予以纪念的,满足了商家对这一法规的例外,因此可以执行。

学习要点：

根据《UCC公司防止欺诈法》的商人例外规定,如果收款人有理由知道其内容并在10天内不提出异议,则由一名商人签署并向另一商人发出的确认书对双方具有约束力。

参考资料

• U.C.C.§2-201(Am.Law Inst. & Unif.Law Comm'n 2020)(说明UCC防止欺诈法)。

• U.C.C.§2-305(1)(b)(Am.Law Inst. & Unif.Law Comm'n 2020)(说明开放价格条款)。

stem:
A man who wanted to sell his home executed a written listing agreement with a real estate broker. The agreement was signed by both parties and gave the broker the exclusive right to sell the home for 60 days. It also gave her the right to receive a commission for up to 30 days after the exclusivity period had terminated if the home sold to a buyer with whom the broker had negotiated during the exclusivity period. A clause in the agreement provided that any modifications must be in writing.

Two weeks later, the parties orally agreed to extend the exclusivity period by 60 days (for a total of 120 days). The 120-day exclusivity period ended without a sale. Twenty days later, a buyer with whom the broker had negotiated while the exclusivity period was still in force offered to purchase the home. The man accepted the offer and concluded the sale but refused to pay the broker a commission.
stemZh:
一个想卖掉房子的人与房地产经纪人执行了书面的上市协议,协议由双方签署,并给予经纪人独家出售房子60天的权利.它还使她有权在独家经营期结束后30天内收取佣金,如果该住房出售给经纪人在独家经营期间与之谈判的买方。协议中的一项条款规定任何修改必须以书面形式进行。

两周后,双方口头同意将排他性期限延长60天(共计120天),120天的排他性期限结束,没有出售。20天后,经纪人在独占期仍然有效时与之谈判的买方主动提出要购买住房,此人接受了要约并完成了销售,但拒绝向经纪人支付佣金。
ask: If the broker sues the man for breach of contract, will she be likely to prevail?
askZh: 如果经纪人告男子违约,她会不会胜诉?

options.en: No, because the parties waived the right to modify the written agreement.
options.zh: 不,因为当事人放弃了修改书面协议的权利。

options.en: No, because the parol evidence rule will prevent proof of the parties' oral agreement.
options.zh: 不,因为parol证据规则将阻止证明当事人的口头协议。

options.en: Yes, because the original agreement is not subject to the statute of frauds.
options.zh: 是的,因为原始协议不受防止欺诈法的约束。

options.en: Yes, because the parties' oral agreement was an effective modification of their written agreement.
options.zh: 是的,因为当事人的口头协议是对其书面协议的有效修改。

explanation.en:
"No oral modification" (NOM) clause

Common law

(contracts for services or real estate)

• NOM clause enforceable only if modification must be in writing under statute of frauds

UCC

(contracts for sale of goods)

• All parties are merchants – NOM clause always enforceable

• > 1 party is nonmerchant – NOM clause in merchant's form must be separately signed by nonmerchant(s) to be enforceable UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

At common law, a prior written contract can be modified by a subsequent oral agreement unless the modified contract falls within the statute of frauds. This is true even if the written contract contains a "no oral modification" (NOM) clause purporting to require that any modification be in writing (Choice A). That is because of the common-law principle that the parties to a contract should not be deterred from changing their minds. However, any modification (oral or written) must still be supported by consideration to be enforceable.

Here, the parties orally agreed to extend the exclusivity period by 60 days. Although the written agreement contained a NOM clause, the modified exclusivity period did not need to be evidenced by a writing since no statute of frauds provision applies.* And since there was consideration—60 more days of exclusivity in exchange for 60 more days of service—the parties' oral agreement effectively modified their written agreement.

The terms of the modified contract are found partly in the original written agreement and partly in the modifying oral agreement. As a result, the broker had the right to receive a commission for up to 30 days after the 120-day exclusivity period had ended if the home sold to a buyer with whom she had negotiated during that period—which it did. Therefore, the broker will likely prevail.

*Contracts to pay a real estate broker a commission ordinarily fall outside the land-contract provision of the statute of frauds. Some jurisdictions have added a provision to their statute of frauds requiring such contracts to be in writing, but that is not the case here.

(Choice B) The parol evidence rule generally prevents proof of prior or contemporaneous agreements that modify or contradict the terms of a written contract. But this rule does not prevent proof of subsequent agreements between the parties—eg, the oral agreement entered after the written listing agreement was executed.

(Choice C) The agreement to pay the real estate broker a commission is not subject to the statute of frauds. Nevertheless, the broker can only prevail if the oral modification agreement also falls outside of the statute of frauds.

Educational objective:

Common law ignores "no oral modification" clauses and allows written contracts to be modified by subsequent oral agreements unless the modified contract falls within the statute of frauds.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 149 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (oral modifications).

explanation.zh:
"无口头修改"(NOM)条款

普通法

(服务或房地产合同)

• NOM条款只有在根据防止欺诈法必须以书面形式修改的情况下才可执行

UCC 化学式

(货物销售合同)

• 所有当事方均为商人——NOM条款永远可以执行

• > 1方为非商船 – 商船形式的NOM条款必须由非商船单独签署,方可执行UCC=统一商法典.

在普通法中,先前的书面合同可以通过随后的口头协议加以修改,除非修改的合同属于防止欺诈法的范围。即使书面合同载有“不作口头修改”(NOM)条款,旨在要求任何修改必须是书面的(Choice A)。这是因为英美法原则,即不应阻止合同当事人改变主意,但任何修改(口头或书面修改)仍须经过对价方可执行。

在此,双方当事人口头同意将排他性期限延长60天,虽然书面协议载有NOM条款,但修改后的排他性期限不需要书面证明,因为没有关于欺诈的法规条款适用。对价60天的独家经营 换来60天的独家经营双方的口头协议有效地修改了书面协议协议。

修改后的合同条款部分见于原始书面协议,部分见于修改后的口头协议.因此,在120天专营期结束后,如果该房屋出售给她在此期间与之谈判的买主,经纪人有权收取最多30天的佣金,因此,经纪人很可能胜诉。

* 支付房地产经纪人的佣金的合同通常不在防止欺诈法的土地合同规定范围之内。有些法域在其防止欺诈法中增加了一项规定,要求此类合同必须是书面的,但这里的情况并非如此。

(Choice B) parol证据规则一般不能证明修改或违背书面合同条款的先前或当时的协议。但是,这一规则并不妨碍证明当事方之间后来达成协议——例如,在执行书面列名协议之后达成的口头协议。

(C选择) 向房地产经纪人支付佣金的协议不受防止欺诈法的约束,但只有在口头修改协议也不属于防止欺诈法的情况下,经纪人才能优先。

学习要点：

英美法忽略了"不得口头修改"条款,允许书面合同被后续口头协议修改,除非修改的合同属于防止欺诈法.

参考资料

• 重述(第二)第149条(1981年《美国法律》)(口头修改)。

stem:
A ski-shop operator, in a telephone conversation with a glove manufacturer, ordered 12 pairs of vortex-lined ski gloves at the list price of $600 per dozen "for delivery in 30 days." The glove manufacturer orally accepted the offer and immediately faxed to the ski-shop operator this signed memo: "Confirming our agreement today for your purchase of a

dozen pairs of vortex-lined ski gloves for $600, the shipment will be delivered in 30 days." Although the ski-shop operator received and read the manufacturer's message within minutes after its dispatch, she changed her mind three weeks later about the purchase and rejected the conforming shipment when it timely arrived.
stemZh:
滑雪店的运营商在与手套制造商的电话交谈中,订购了12双涡线滑雪手套,单价为每打600美元,"供30天内交付". 手套制造商口头接受了这一要约,并立即传真至滑雪店.操作员签署备忘录:"确认我们今天同意你购买

有十几双涡流线滑雪手套600美元 30天后交货"虽然滑雪店的运营商在它之后几分钟内收到并读取了制造商的信息3周后她改变主意了货物及时运抵时即予以拒绝。
ask: On learning of the rejection, does the manufacturer have a cause of action against the ski-shop operator for breach of contract?
askZh: 在得知拒绝后,制造商是否有理由对滑雪店经营者违反合同提起诉讼?

options.en: No, because the ski-shop operator neither paid for nor accepted any of the goods tendered.
options.zh: 没有,因为滑雪场的经营者既没有支付,也没有接受任何招标的货物。

options.en: No, because the ski-shop operator never signed a writing evidencing a contract with the manufacturer.
options.zh: 不,因为滑雪店的运营商 从来没有与制造商签署书面证明合同。

options.en: Yes, because the gloves were identified in the contract and tendered to the ski-shop operator.
options.zh: 是的,因为手套在合同中被确认 并招标给滑雪场的运营商。

options.en: Yes, because the manufacturer's faxed memo to the ski-shop operator was sufficient to make the agreement enforceable.
options.zh: 是的,因为制造商传真给滑雪店运营商的备忘录 足以使协议可以执行。

explanation.en:
Statute of frauds requirements

Writing Physical or electronic document(s) containing reasonable basis to believe contract was formed (eg, receipt, check, emails) AND

• at common law – identifies parties, subject matter, consideration, time & nature of performance

• under UCC – lists quantity of goods (contract enforceable only up to written quantity) Signature General rule – handwritten signature from, or other mark identifying, party to be charged (eg, letterhead, electronic signature, initials)

• Merchant exception – between merchants, written confirmation that satisfies statute of frauds as to sender will bind both parties if no written objection within 10 days UCC = Uniform Commercial Code,

Under the statute of frauds, a contract for the sale of goods of $500 or more is only enforceable if it is in a writing signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought. The UCC relaxes these requirements in transactions between merchants so that the statute of frauds is met as to both parties if one party sends a written confirmation and the recipient does not object in writing within 10 days. The written confirmation must:

• provide a reasonable basis to believe a contract was formed (eg, memo confirming the order)

• contain the quantity of the goods or a means to determine it (eg, 12 pairs of vortex-lined ski gloves) and

• contain a signature or other identification sufficient to bind the sender (eg, sender's fax number) Here, the manufacturer faxed the ski-shop operator a memo confirming the order for 12 pairs of vortex-lined ski gloves, which the ski-shop operator did not object to until three weeks later (ie, after the 10-day deadline). Since the fax number will identify the manufacturer as the sender, the memo will be sufficient to bind both parties—even without the ski-shop-operator's signature (Choice B). Therefore, the manufacturer has a cause of action for breach of contract.

(Choice A) There are three exceptions to the UCC statute of frauds, one of which applies when some amount of payment or goods was received and accepted (not seen here). But since the parties here are merchants, the manufacturer's memo created an enforceable agreement.

(Choice C) The gloves did not need to be tendered to the ski-shop operator to create an enforceable contract. The written confirmation merely needed to evidence the merchants' agreement and identify the quantity of the goods.

Educational objective:

Under the UCC, a transaction between merchants satisfies the statute of frauds as to both parties if (1) one party sends a written confirmation that satisfies the statute of frauds and (2) the other party does not object in writing within 10 days.

References

• U.C.C. § 2-201 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (statute of frauds formal requirements).

• 商家之间的商业例外,如果在10天内没有书面反对,满足对发货人的防止欺诈法的书面确认将约束双方,

根据防止欺诈法,500美元或500美元以上的货物销售合同只有以被请求执行方签署的书面形式才能执行。UCC在商家之间的交易中放宽了这些要求,以便如果一方发出书面确认,接受方在10天内不提出书面反对,则符合对双方的防止欺诈法。

• 为相信合同已订立提供合理依据(例如,确认订单的备忘录)

• 载有货物数量或确定货物的手段(例如12双涡线滑雪手套)和

• 载有足以绑定发件人(例如发件人的传真号码)的签名或其他身份证明。 在此,制造商传真给滑雪店经营人一份备忘录,确认12双涡线滑雪手套的订单,滑雪店经营人不反对由于传真号码将指明制造商为发送者,备忘录将足以约束双方,即使没有滑雪店-操作者的签名(Choice B)。因此,制造商有违约诉讼的理由。

(Choice A) UCC法规的欺诈行为有三种例外,其中一种例外适用于收到和接受一定金额的付款或货物(此处不见)时. 但是由于这里的当事人是商人,制造商的备忘录创造了可执行的协议.

(C) 不需要向滑雪场经营人招标,以订立可执行的合同,书面确认仅需证明商家的协议和确定货物数量。

学习要点：

根据《统一商法典》,如果(1)一方发出符合防止欺诈法的书面确认书,(2)另一方在10天内没有提出书面异议,则商家之间的交易满足了对双方防止欺诈法的要求。

参考资料

• U.C.C.§2-201(Am.Law Inst. & Unif.Law Comm'n 2020)(欺诈形式要求法规)。

stem:
A landowner, having suffered severe losses on bad investments, was money-poor but land-rich by inheritance, owning several thousand acres of unencumbered timberland. He had a

large family, and his fixed personal expenses were high. Pressed for cash, he advertised a proposed sale of standing timber on a choice 2,000-acre tract. The only response was an offer by a logger who owned a large, integrated construction enterprise, after inspection of the advertised tract.

The logger offered to buy, sever, and remove the standing timber from the advertised tract at a cash price 70% lower than the regionally prevailing price for comparable timber rights. The landholder, by then in desperate financial straits and knowing little about timber values, signed and delivered to the logger a letter accepting the offer.
stemZh:
土地所有者由于投资不善而蒙受严重损失,但因继承财产而富有土地,拥有几千英亩的未支配林地。

他按着现金的要求,在2000英亩的地盘上宣传了出售木材的建议。唯一的答复是在检查了公布的路段之后,由拥有大型综合建筑企业的伐木工提出的要约。

伐木商主动提出以比可比木材权的区域通行价格低70%的现金价格购买、砍伐和从广告区清除固定木材。土地拥有者当时处于绝望的金融困境,对木材价值知之甚少,他们签署并向伐木者递交了接受要约的信。
ask: If, before the logger commences performance, the landholder's investment fortunes suddenly improve and he wishes to get out of the timber deal with the logger, which of the following legal concepts affords his best prospect of effective cancellation?
askZh: 如果在伐木者开始履约之前,土地所有者的投资财富突然增加,他希望与伐木者摆脱木材交易,那么以下哪些法律概念提供了他有效取消的最佳前景?

options.en: Bad faith.
options.zh: 恶信.

options.en: Duress.
options.zh: 杜丽丝

options.en: Equitable estoppel.
options.zh: 公平不容反悔。

options.en: Unconscionability.
options.zh: 不可思议.

explanation.en:
The defense of unconscionability is available when a contract's bargaining process and/or the contract terms were so unfair to one party that no reasonable person would have agreed to it. When this occurs, the court can modify or cancel (ie, refuse to enforce) the contract. Factors used to determine whether a contract is unconscionable include:

• sophistication and knowledge of each party (eg, the parties' unequal knowledge of the timber industry)

• disparity between the parties' bargaining power (eg, the landowner is money-poor and the logger is the only potential buyer)

• disparity between the value of consideration exchanged by the parties (eg, the sale of timber rights on choice land for a price that is significantly lower than the prevailing rate) and

• one-sidedness of contract terms (eg, the contract terms overwhelmingly favor the logger). Therefore, unconscionability provides the landowner his best prospect of effective cancellation of the contract.

(Choice A) Good faith and fair dealing demand only actual honesty; here, there is no indication that the logger failed to meet this standard. Therefore, bad faith is not the landowner's best argument.

(Choice B) Duress serves as a defense to contract enforceability only if a contracting party's assent was induced by an improper threat—which did not occur here.

(Choice C) Equitable estoppel is a doctrine that prevents one party from changing its position after the other party has detrimentally relied on a misrepresentation of fact made by the first party. Here, however, the logger did not make a misrepresentation of fact to the landowner, so this doctrine does not apply.

Educational objective:

A party may assert the defense of unconscionability if the bargaining process and/or terms of the contract were so unfair to that party when the contract was made that no reasonable person would have agreed to it.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 208 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (unconscionable contract or contract term).

explanation.zh:
当合同的谈判过程和/或合同条款对一方当事人如此不公平以致任何理智的人都不会同意时,就可提出不合理性的抗辩。发生这种情况时,法院可以修改或取消(即拒绝执行)合同.用于确定合同是否不合理的因素包括:

• 各方的先进程度和知识(例如,各方对木材工业的不甚了解)

• 当事方之间的讨价还价能力差距(例如,土地所有者缺钱,伐木者是唯一潜在的买家)

• 双方交换的对价价值(例如,以大大低于现行价格的价格出售选择土地上的木材权利)和

合同条款的片面性(例如,合同条款压倒性地有利于伐木商),因此,不合理性为土地所有人提供了有效取消合同的最佳前景。

(Choice A) 诚信和公平交易只要求实际诚实;在这里,没有迹象表明伐木者没有达到这个标准。 因此,恶意并不是地主的最佳论据。

(Choice B) Durress只有在合同方的同意是由不当威胁诱发的情况下,才作为订立合同可执行性的辩护理由,而这种威胁并非在这里发生。

(C) 公平不容反悔原则是在另一方不利地依赖第一当事方歪曲事实之后,阻止一当事方改变其立场。然而,在此处,伐木商没有向土地所有人歪曲事实,因此这一理论不适用。

学习要点：

如果谈判过程和(或)合同条款在订立合同时对该当事人如此不公平,以致没有理智的人同意,一方当事人可以主张不合理。

参考资料

• 重述(第二次)合同第208条(1981年《宪法》)(不合理的合同或合同条款)。

stem: A contractor agreed to remodel a homeowner's garage for $5,000. Just before the parties signed the one-page written contract, the homeowner called to the contractor's attention the fact that the contract did not specify a time of completion. The parties orally agreed but did not specify in the contract that the contractor would complete the work in 60 days, and then they both signed the contract. The contract did not contain a merger clause. The contractor failed to finish the work in 60 days. The homeowner has sued the contractor for breach of contract.
stemZh: 一个承包商同意以5 000美元改造一个房主的车库,就在双方签署一页书面合同之前,房主提请承包商注意,合同没有规定完工时间。双方口头同意,但没有在合同中说明承包商将在60天内完成工程,然后双方都签署了合同,合同中没有兼并条款,承包商在60天内未能完成工程。房主起诉承包商违反合同。
ask: Is the court likely to admit evidence concerning the parties' oral agreement that the work would be completed in 60 days?
askZh: 法院是否可能接受当事人口头同意在60天内完成工作的证据?

options.en: No, because the court must ascertain the meaning of the agreement from the terms of the written contract.
options.zh: 不,因为法院必须从书面合同的条款中确定协议的含义。

options.en: No, because the oral agreement was merely part of the parties' negotiations.
options.zh: 不,因为口头协议只是双方谈判的一部分。

options.en: Yes, because the contract is ambiguous.
options.zh: 是的,因为合同是模糊的。

options.en: Yes, because the time limit is an additional term that does not contradict the partially integrated written contract.
options.zh: 是,因为时限是附加条款,并不与部分综合书面合同相抵触。

explanation.en:
Integration

Type Definition Effect

Complete integration

Writing that sets forth parties' final agreement about all terms

• Excludes parol evidence within scope of agreement

• Parol evidence inadmissible to supplement (ie, add to) or contradict contract Partial integration

Writing that sets forth parties' final agreement about some terms

• Excludes parol evidence inconsistent with agreement

• Parol evidence admissible to supplement (not contradict) contract The parol evidence rule generally bars evidence of prior or contemporaneous agreements to modify or contradict the unambiguous terms of an integrated writing. But if the writing is partially integrated—ie, sets forth the parties' final agreement about some, but not all, terms—the parties can introduce supplemental evidence (oral or written) that is consistent with the writing and does not contradict its terms.

Here, just before the parties signed the written contract, they orally agreed that the remodeling of the garage was to be completed within 60 days. The contract was partially integrated because it did not specify a time to complete the remodeling and did not contain a merger clause. As a result, evidence of the parties' oral agreement is likely admissible because the time limit is an additional term that does not contradict the written contract

(Choice B).

(Choices A & C) Evidence used to clarify the meaning of an ambiguous contract term is excepted from the parol evidence rule. But here, the terms of the written contract are not ambiguous. Instead, the parties' oral agreement is admissible because it is being used to supplement (and does not contradict) the terms of the written contract.

Educational objective:

The parol evidence rule does not bar evidence of prior or contemporaneous agreements to supplement (ie, add to) the terms of a partially integrated writing, provided that the evidence is consistent with and does not contradict the written terms.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 216 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (parol evidence is admissible to explain or supplement a term when agreement is partially integrated).

explanation.zh:
一体化

类型定义效果

完全整合

写出当事人关于所有条款的最后协议

• 排除协议范围内的虚假证据

• 为补充(即补充、补充)或与合同相抵触而不予受理的假释证据

写出当事人关于某些条款的最后协议

• 排除不符合协议的虚假证据

• 允许补充(不矛盾)合同的假释证据 假释证据规则一般禁止提出先前或当时协议的证据,以修改或违背综合书面的明确条款。但是,如果书写是部分结合的——即列出当事方关于某些但并非全部条款的最后协议——当事方可以提出与书写一致、不违背其条款的补充证据(口头或书面证据)。

在这里,就在双方签署书面合同之前,他们口头同意在60天内完成车库的改造.合同部分被整合,因为它没有规定完成重修的时间,也没有包含合并条款.因此,当事人口头协议的证据可能可以接受,因为时限是一个不与书面合同相抵触的附加条款

(中文(简体) ).

(Choices A & C) 用于澄清一个模棱两可的合同术语含义的证据除外于parol证据规则,但在这里,书面合同的条款并不含糊。相反,当事人的口头协议是可以接受的,因为它被用来补充(而且并不抵触)书面合同的条款。

学习要点：

parol证据规则并不禁止提供先前或同时期协议的证据,以补充(即补充)部分综合书面形式的条款,条件是证据与书面形式一致且不矛盾。

• 重述(第二篇)第216条(1981年《Am.Law Inst.》)(在协议部分合并时,可接受解释或补充一个术语的parol证据)。

stem:
A doctor was employed at a hospital when she applied for a personal loan from a bank. She accurately disclosed her income in the loan application. Before the bank had reached a decision regarding the loan application, the doctor was fired from the hospital. The doctor decided not to inform the bank of this fact because she feared that the bank would refuse to give her the loan.

A few days later, a bank representative called the doctor and informed her that her loan application was approved. The doctor accepted the terms of the loan and signed the loan agreement. Before disbursing the funds, the bank learned of the doctor's firing and refused to honor the loan agreement.
stemZh:
一名医生在向一家银行申请个人贷款时受雇于一家医院,她在贷款申请中准确地披露了自己的收入,在银行就贷款申请作出决定之前,医生被医院开除。医生决定不将这一事实通知银行,因为她担心银行会拒绝给她贷款。

几天后,一名银行代表打电话给医生,告知她贷款申请获得批准,医生接受了贷款条件,并签署了贷款协议.在支付资金之前,银行得知医生解雇,拒绝履行贷款协议.
ask: If the doctor sues the bank for breach of contract, will she be likely to prevail?
askZh: 如果医生告银行违约 她会不会胜诉?

options.en: No, because the doctor's ability to repay the loan was a condition precedent to the disbursement of the funds.
options.zh: 不,因为医生偿还贷款的能力是支付资金的一个先决条件。

options.en: No, because the doctor's nondisclosure of her firing was a fraudulent misrepresentation.
options.zh: 不,因为医生不透露她的枪声 是虚假的歪曲

options.en: Yes, because the bank's reliance on the doctor's disclosure of her income in the loan application was unjustifiable.
options.zh: 是的,因为银行依赖医生在贷款申请中披露她的收入是不合理的。

options.en: Yes, because the loan agreement was memorialized in a signed writing.
options.zh: 是的,因为贷款协议是用一份签名的书写的。

explanation.en:
When disclosure is required to avoid misrepresentation

Previous assertion • Disclosure would prevent previous assertion from being a misrepresentation or fraudulent or material Mistake about basic assumption

• Disclosure would correct other party's mistake about basic assumption of contract AND

• Failure to disclose would constitute lack of good faith & fair dealing Fiduciary relationship

• Other party is entitled to know fact because of confidential/fiduciary relationship

Mistake about writing

• Disclosure would correct other party's mistake about contents or effect of writing that embodies agreement

A misrepresentation is an untrue assertion of fact that makes a contract voidable by the adversely affected party when all of the following elements are met:

• The misrepresentation was fraudulent (ie, made knowingly or recklessly with the intent to induce the other party's assent to the contract) OR material (ie, likely to induce a reasonable person's assent).*

• The misrepresentation induced assent to the contract.

• The adversely affected party justifiably relied on the misrepresentation.

Nondisclosure of a known fact is treated as an untrue assertion if, among other things, the nondisclosing party knows that disclosure is necessary to prevent a previous assertion from being fraudulent.

Here, the doctor accurately disclosed her income in the loan application but was then fired. She knew that she needed to disclose this fact to the bank to prevent her previous disclosure from being fraudulent but failed to do so. Since the bank was unaware of her firing, it justifiably agreed to give her a loan. Therefore, the contract is voidable by the bank, and the doctor is unlikely to prevail in her breach-of-contract suit.

*A misrepresentation is also material if the maker knows that it will likely induce this particular party's assent—even if a reasonable person would not be induced.

(Choice A) A condition precedent is an explicit contract term requiring a future event to occur before a party becomes obligated to perform. But here, there is no indication that the

bank's obligation to disburse the funds was explicitly conditioned on the doctor's ability to repay the loan.

(Choice C) Reliance is almost always justified unless the misrepresentation was obviously false or known by the adversely affected party to be false. Here, the doctor's disclosure was accurate (not obviously false) when it was made and the bank was unaware of her firing when it approved the loan, so the bank's reliance was justified.

(Choice D) The fact that the loan agreement was memorialized in a signed writing does not prevent it from being voidable on the basis of the doctor's fraudulent misrepresentation.

Educational objective:

Nondisclosure of a known fact is treated as an untrue assertion of fact (ie, misrepresentation) if the nondisclosing party knows that disclosure is necessary to prevent a previous assertion from being fraudulent.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 161 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when nondisclosure is a misrepresentation).

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 164 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when misrepresentation makes a contract voidable).

explanation.zh:
在要求披露以避免虚报时

• 披露可以防止先前的断言是虚假陈述或欺诈或基本假设的重大错误

• 披露将纠正另一方当事人对合同基本假设和

• 不披露将构成缺乏诚信和公平交易信托关系

• 其他当事方由于保密/信托关系而有权了解事实

写作错误

• 披露将纠正另一方对体现协议的书面内容或效果的错误

虚报是对事实的不实断言,使受不利影响的当事方在满足下列所有因素时可以撤销合同:

• 谎报是欺诈性的(即故意或轻率的,意图诱使另一方同意合同)或材料(即有可能诱使有理智的人同意)。

• 错误陈述导致同意合同。

• 受不利影响的一方有理由依赖错误陈述。

不披露已知事实被视为不真实的断言,如果除其他外,非披露方知道为防止先前的断言被欺诈而必须披露。

在此,医生在贷款申请中准确地披露了她的收入,但随后被解雇,她知道她需要向银行披露这一事实,以防止她先前的披露被欺骗,但未能这样做。由于银行不知道她被解雇,因此有理由同意向她提供贷款。 因此,银行可以撤销合同,医生不太可能在她的违约诉讼中胜诉。

* 如果制造者知道,即使不会诱导一个通情达理的人,也有可能引起该特定当事方的同意,则虚报也是重要的。

(Choice A)一个条件先例是明确的合同条款,要求当事人在履行义务之前发生未来事件。

银行支付资金的义务明确取决于医生偿还贷款的能力。

(选择C) 依赖几乎总是有道理的,除非谎报显然是虚假的,或被受到不利影响的一方知道是虚假的。在这里,医生的披露是准确的(不是明显虚假的),在做出时,银行在批准贷款时并不知道她被解雇,所以银行的依赖是有道理的.

(Choice D)贷款协议以署名书面纪念的事实,并不妨碍以医生的欺诈性谎报为由予以撤销.

学习要点：

不披露已知事实被视为对事实的不实断言(即不实陈述),如果非披露方知道为防止先前的断言被欺诈而有必要披露。

参考资料

• 重述(第二次)第161条(1981年《美国法律》)(当不披露是虚假陈述时)。

• 重述(第二次)合同第164条(1981年《美国法律》)(如果错误陈述使合同可以无效)。
