explanation.zh:
对违反非法合同的追偿

期望损害

(业绩损失的全额价值)

• 有理由不了解非法性的政党*

• 政党大有作为,缺乏非法目的

• 合同可分割成合法/非法部分或

• 合同非法,因为违反仅为增加收入而设计的许可证要求

(给予的利益的合理价值)

• 有理由不了解非法性的政党*

• 责任小于其他当事方或

• 当事方在达到非法目的之前退出,并且没有从事严重不当行为如果另一方也有理由无知,则禁止以这种理由作为依据。

当一方或双方的目的、订立或履行违反法律时,即产生非法合同,这些合同通常无效,违反合同则无追索权。但是,如果一方当事人缺乏非法目的,而且主要根据合同履行,则产生例外,该当事人可以就违约要求获得预期损害赔偿,即使他/她知道另一方当事人的非法目的。

• 履约方采取行动促进另一方的非法目的,或

• 非法目的涉及严重的社会伤害(例如对人类生命的威胁)。

在此,该合同是非法的,因为猎人的目的是使用步枪在规定的猎火鸡季节之外狩猎,然而,店主通过将步枪交给猎人来进行实质性的表演,并没有自己的非法目的.尽管店主知道猎人的非法目的,但店主并没有采取任何行动来推进(Choice B). 此外,在季后两周的狩猎并不涉及严重的社会伤害.因此,在违反合同的诉讼案中,店主很可能占上风。

* 如果履约方不知道另一方的非法目的,则无需作进一步的分析。

(Choice A) 店主不必否认合同的非法目的,例如告诉猎人不要在即将到来的狩猎旅行中使用步枪。店主没有采取行动推进猎人的非法目的,也没有造成严重社会伤害的威胁,这就足够了。

出售步枪的合同本身并不非法(没有法定限制,此处不见),但合同仍是非法的,因为猎人打算将步枪用于非法目的。

学习要点：

非法合同通常无效,对违反合同没有追偿权,但是,实质性地履行和缺乏非法目的的一方——即使他/她知道另一方的非法目的——也可以追偿,除非(1)履约方采取行动进一步(二) 目的涉及严重的社会损害。

参考资料

• 重述(第二)第182条(1981年《美国法律》)(解释在另一方目的非法时履行合同的效果)。

stem:
A seller and a buyer have dealt with each other in hundreds of separate grain contracts over the last five years. In performing each contract, the seller delivered the grain to the buyer and, upon delivery, the buyer signed an invoice that showed an agreed-upon price for that delivery. Each invoice was silent in regard to any discount from the price for prompt payment. The custom of the grain trade is to allow a 2% discount from the invoice price for payment within 10 days of delivery. In all of their prior transactions and without objection from the seller, the buyer took 15 days to pay and deducted 5% from the invoice price.

The seller and the buyer recently entered into a contract for a single delivery of wheat at a price of $300,000. The same delivery procedure and invoice were used for this contract as had been used previously. The seller delivered the wheat and the buyer then signed the invoice. On the third day after delivery, the buyer received the following note from the seller: "Payment in full in accordance with signed invoice is due immediately. No discounts permitted. s/Seller."
stemZh:
在过去五年中,卖方和买方在数百份单独的谷物合同中相互交易。在履行每项合同时,卖方向买方交付了谷物,交货后,买方签署了一张发票,该发票显示了该交货的商定价格,但每张发票都未提及从价格中扣除任何立即付款的折扣。谷物贸易的习惯是允许在交货后10天内从发票价格中扣除2%的付款折扣。 在所有以前的交易中,在卖方没有异议的情况下,买方花了15天才付款并从发票价格中扣除5%。

卖方和买方最近签订了一份单次交付小麦的合同,价格为300 000美元,与以前一样,该合同采用了同样的交付程序和发票。卖方交付了小麦,买方随后在发票上签字,交货后第三天,买方收到了卖方的下列通知:"按照署名发票全额付款应立即支付,不允许折扣。
ask: Which of the following statements concerning these facts is most accurate?
askZh: 以下哪些关于这些事实的陈述最为准确?

options.en: The custom of the trade controls, and the buyer is entitled to take a 2% discount if he pays within 10 days.
options.zh: 贸易管制的习惯,如果买方在10天内付款,则有权享受2%的折扣。

options.en: The parties' course of dealing controls, and the buyer is entitled to take a 5% discount if he pays within 15 days.
options.zh: 双方当事人的交易控制过程,如果买方在15天内付款,则有权享受5%的折扣。

options.en: The seller's retraction of his prior waiver controls, and the buyer is entitled to no discount.
options.zh: 卖方撤销其先前的放弃管制,买方无权享受折扣。

options.en: The written contract controls, and the buyer is entitled to no discount because of the parol evidence rule.
options.zh: 书面合同的管制,买方由于parol证据规则而无权享受折扣。

explanation.en:
Course of performance, course of dealing & trade usage

Course of performance

Sequence of conduct that is relevant to understanding agreement between parties if:

• agreement involves repeated occasions for performance by one party AND

• other party accepts performance without objection Course of dealing

Sequence of conduct concerning previous transactions between parties that establishes common basis of understanding for interpreting their conduct

Trade usage Practice or method of dealing in parties' business or industry that is observed with enough regularity to justify expectation that it will be observed in instant case

Under the UCC parol evidence rule, evidence of a prior agreement (or contemporaneous oral agreement) cannot be used to contradict the terms of a final written agreement. But evidence of the parties' course of performance, the parties' course of dealing, or trade usage can always be used to explain or supplement those terms. If the evidence is inconsistent, priority is given as follows:

• Express terms prevail over all others

• Course of performance prevails over course of dealing and trade usage

• Course of dealing prevails over trade usage Here, the contract at issue was silent regarding discounts for prompt payment. However, in all of their hundreds of prior transactions and without objection from the seller, the buyer had taken 15 days to pay and deducted 5% from the invoice price. This established a course of dealing that can be used to supplement the terms of the contract (Choice D). And although the custom of the trade is to allow a 2% discount for payment within 10 days, the parties' course of dealing controls (Choice A). Therefore, the buyer is entitled to a 5% discount if he pays within 15 days.

(Choice C) Waiver (or retraction thereof) is not an issue in this question because the contract was silent regarding discounts for prompt payment. In other words, there was no relevant term capable of being waived.

Educational objective:

Express contractual terms prevail over all others, the parties' course of performance prevails over their course of dealing and trade usage, and their course of dealing prevails over trade usage.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

References

• U.C.C. § 2-202 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (parol evidence rule).

explanation.zh:
履约过程、交易和贸易使用过程

课程

与理解当事方之间协议有关的行为顺序,如果:

• 协议涉及一方当事人一再履行的情况;

• 另一方接受履约而无异议

当事人之间以往交易的行为顺序为解释其行为建立共同的理解基础;

在当事人的工商业中,如果遵守的做法或处理方法具有足够的规律性,因而有理由期望在本案中遵守这种做法

根据UCC parol证据规则,事先协议(或同时期口头协议)的证据不能用来与最后书面协议的条款相矛盾.但当事人履约过程、当事人交易过程或贸易惯例的证据总是可以用来解释或补充这些术语。证据不一致的,优先处理如下:

• 明示条件优于所有其他条件

• 整个交易过程和贸易使用过程中都以业绩为准

交易过程优先于贸易惯例 此处,所涉合同没有提及迅速付款的折扣。然而,在其所有数百项前期交易中,在卖方无异议的情况下,买方花了15天的时间付款并从发票价格中扣除了5%。这确立了一种交易过程,可用来补充合同条款(Choice D)。 尽管贸易习惯是允许在10天内给予2%的付款折扣,但双方的交易过程控制(Choice A)。因此,如果买方在15天内付款,他有权获得5%的折扣。

放弃(或撤回)不是这个问题的问题,因为合同对迅速付款的折扣未作规定,换言之,没有相关的词语可以放弃。

学习要点：

明确合同条款优先于所有其他条款,当事人的履约过程优先于交易过程和贸易习惯,其交易过程优先于贸易习惯。

UCC = 统一商法典

参考资料

• U.C.C.§2-202(Am.Law Inst. & Unif.Law Comm'n 2020)(假释证据规则)。

stem:
A toy company contracted with a manufacturer to produce gel packets used to simulate water in its faux aquarium toy. On May 1, in a writing signed by both parties, the manufacturer agreed to deliver 1 million gel packets for a total price of $1 million to be paid on June 1, the date of delivery. The writing specified that any modification of its terms required the toy company's signed, written consent.

On May 15, the manufacturer called the toy company to explain that it was running low on raw material and would need more time to produce the desired quantity of gel packets. The parties agreed in the telephone conversation to postpone the delivery date to July 1. On July 1, the manufacturer delivered the gel packets to the toy company, which refused to accept or pay for them.
stemZh:
一家玩具公司与一家制造商签订合同,生产用来模拟其水族馆玩具中的水的凝胶包。5月1日,厂商在双方签署书面协议,同意交付100万胶包,总价100万美元,于交付日期6月1日支付.书面规定,修改其条款需要玩具公司签署书面同意。

5月15日,制造商给玩具公司打电话,解释其原材料不足,需要更多时间生产所期望的数量的凝胶包,双方在电话交谈中同意将交货日期推迟到7月1日.7月1日,制造商向玩具公司交付了胶包,玩具公司拒绝接受或支付.
ask: Is the manufacturer likely to prevail in a breach-of-contract suit against the toy company?
askZh: 制造商是否可能在针对玩具公司的违约诉讼中占优势?

options.en: No, because any modification to the parties' agreement required the toy company's signed, written consent.
options.zh: 没有,因为对双方协议的任何修改都需要玩具公司签署书面同意。

options.en: No, because there was no consideration to support the May 15 agreement.
options.zh: 没有,因为没有对价支持5月15日的协议.

options.en: Yes, because the manufacturer reasonably relied on the toy company's having waived the signed-writing requirement.
options.zh: 是的,因为制造商合理地依赖玩具公司放弃了签字书写要求。

options.en: Yes, because the May 15 agreement was enforceable under the statute of frauds.
options.zh: 是的,因为5月15日的协议 根据防止欺诈法是可强制执行的。

explanation.en:
"No oral modification" (NOM) clause

Common law

(contracts for services or real estate)

• NOM clause enforceable only if modification must be in writing under statute of frauds

UCC

(contracts for sale of goods)

• All parties are merchants – NOM clause always enforceable

• > 1 party is nonmerchant – NOM clause in merchant's form must be separately signed by nonmerchant(s) to be enforceable UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

The UCC statute of frauds applies to contracts for the sale of goods for $500 or more (eg, 1 million gel packets for $1 million) and renders them unenforceable unless they are in a writing that:

• provides a reasonable basis to believe a contract was formed

• states the quantity of goods to be sold and

• is signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought. Modifications to a contract that falls within and satisfies this statute generally need not be in writing because the enforceability of the initial contract passes to any modifications. However, the UCC will enforce a "no oral modification" (NOM) clause that requires modifications to be in writing. A NOM clause can be waived by the parties through words or conduct, and the waiver cannot be retracted if a party has materially changed its position in reasonable reliance on the waiver.

Here, the parties' May 1 contract fell within and satisfied the statute of frauds. As a result, their May 15 oral agreement did not violate this statute (Choice D). Although the contract contained a NOM clause that prohibited modifications without the toy company's written consent, the toy company waived the clause on May 15 by orally agreeing to postpone the delivery date to July 1 (Choice A). And since the manufacturer materially and reasonably relied on the waiver by delivering the gel packets on that date, it will likely prevail.

(Choice B) Consideration is not required to modify a contract for the sale of goods, but any modification must be sought in good faith and comply with reasonable commercial standards of fair dealing.

Educational objective:

The UCC will enforce a "no oral modification" (NOM) clause even if the modification would not otherwise need to be in a writing that satisfies the statute of frauds. NOM clauses can be waived through the parties' words or conduct, and the waiver cannot be retracted if a party has materially changed position in reasonable reliance on the waiver.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

References

• U.C.C. § 2-201 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (formal requirements for the statute of frauds).

• U.C.C. § 2-209 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (modification, rescission, and waiver).

explanation.zh:
"无口头修改"(NOM)条款

普通法

(服务或房地产合同)

• NOM条款只有在根据防止欺诈法必须以书面形式修改的情况下才可执行

UCC 化学式

(货物销售合同)

• 所有当事方均为商人——NOM条款永远可以执行

• > 1方为非商船 – 商船形式的NOM条款必须由非商船单独签署,方可执行UCC=统一商法典.

《UCC公司防止欺诈法》适用于500美元或500美元以上的货物销售合同(如100万美元的100万美元胶包),使其无法执行,除非书面说明:

• 为相信合同已经订立提供合理依据

• 说明所售货物的数量;

对属于本法规范围并符合本法规的合同的修改通常不需要以书面方式进行,因为最初合同的可执行性会影响到任何修改。然而,UCC会执行"不口头修改"(NOM)条款,要求修改必须是书面的.当事人可以通过文字或行为放弃NOM条款,如果当事人在合理依赖放弃的情况下实质性地改变了其立场,则放弃不能撤销。

在此,当事双方的5月1日合同属于防止欺诈法的范围并符合该法规,因此,他们5月15日的口头协议没有违反该法规(Choice D)。虽然合同中包含NOM条款,禁止未经玩具公司书面同意进行修改,但玩具公司在5月15日口头同意将交货日期推迟到7月1日(Choice A),从而放弃了该条款.由于制造商在该日期交付凝胶包,从而在物质上和合理上依赖于放弃权,因此这种放弃很可能会占上风。

(Choice B) 无需对价修改货物销售合同,但必须本着诚意寻求修改,并遵守合理的公平交易商业标准。

学习要点：

UCC将强制执行一项"不口头修改"(NOM)条款,即使修改不需要用符合防止欺诈法的书面形式.NOM条款可以通过当事人的言词或行为放弃,如果一方当事人在合理依赖放弃的情况下实质性地改变了立场,则放弃不得撤销。

UCC = 统一商法典。

参考资料

• U.C.C.§2-201(Am.Law Inst. & Unif.Law Comm'n 2020)(对防止欺诈法的正式要求)。

• U.C.C.§2/209(Am.Law Inst. & Unif.Law Comm'n 2020)(修改、撤销和放弃)。

stem:
A woman owned a large ranch, which she orally offered to sell to her stable manager for $250,000. The stable manager eagerly accepted her offer, and the woman wrote and gave him an unsigned note that read, "I agree to sell you my ranch for $250,000."

The stable manager gave the woman a small down payment to seal the deal and then took possession of the ranch with the woman's permission. Shortly thereafter, the stable manager received a letter from the woman stating that another buyer had offered to buy the ranch for $425,000 and that she would not sell it to the stable manager unless he buys it for that price.
stemZh:
一位女性拥有一个大型牧场,她口头提出要以25万美元的价格卖给她的马厩经理,马厩经理急切地接受了她的要约,这位女性写下并给了他一封没有署名的纸条,上面写着"我同意以25万美元的价格卖给你".

马场经理给了该妇女一笔小额定金,以封存交易,然后征得该妇女同意后占有牧场.此后不久,马厩经理收到该妇女的信,称另一家买主提出以425 000美元买下牧场,除非马厩经理为此价格买下牧场,否则她不会卖给马厩经理。
ask: If the stable manager sues the woman for specific performance, which of the following concepts would best support his claim?
askZh: 如果稳定经理起诉妇女的具体表现,以下哪些概念最能支持他的主张?

options.en: Anticipatory breach.
options.zh: 预知破戒.

options.en: Good faith and fair dealing.
options.zh: 诚信与公平交易.

options.en: Part performance.
options.zh: 部分表现.

options.en: Quantum meruit.
options.zh: 量子梅鲁特.

explanation.en:
The statute of frauds applies to contracts for the sale of land (eg, the ranch). It requires that the contract (1) be in writing, (2) be signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought, and (3) contain all essential terms. Therefore, the woman and stable manager's oral agreement and the woman's unsigned note each violated this statute.

However, a contract for the sale of land that violates this statute may still be enforceable if the part-performance exception applies. This requires proof that the buyer has done at least two of the following:

• Taken possession of the property (as the stable manager did here)

• Made substantial improvements to the property (not seen here)

• Paid some or all of the purchase price (here, the stable manager made a small down payment) The buyer can then bring an action in equity for specific performance. However, part performance will not support an ordinary action at law for money damages.

(Choice A) Anticipatory breach* occurs when one party communicates to the other party that it will not perform under the contract. The other party can treat this as a breach and sue immediately or demand performance. Here, although the woman told the stable manager that she would not sell him the ranch for the agreed-upon price, this would not overcome the statute of frauds.

*This is also called anticipatory repudiation.

(Choice B) The duty of good faith and fair dealing implied in every contract requires that neither party interfere with the other party's performance of the contract or right to receive the benefits thereof. But the stable manager cannot assert a breach of this duty without first proving that an enforceable contract exists.

(Choice D) Quantum meruit entitles a party who has conferred a benefit on another in a quasi-contractual relationship to damages for the reasonable value of the benefit, but not specific performance.

Educational objective:

A contract involving land that violates the statute of frauds is enforceable on part-performance grounds if the buyer has done at least two of the following: taken possession

of the property, substantially improved it, and/or paid any portion of the purchase price.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 129 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (action in reliance; specific performance).

explanation.zh:
防止欺诈法适用于土地出售合同(例如牧场),它要求合同(1)是书面的,(2)由要求执行的一方签署,(3)包含所有基本条款。因此,妇女和稳定经理的口头协议和妇女未署名的纸条都违反了这一法规。

但是,违反本法规的土地出售合同,如果这要求证明买方至少完成了其中两项履约例外。如下:

• 占有财产(如稳定经理在这里所做的那样)

• 财产得到重大改善(此处不见)

· 支付部分或全部购货价款(这里,稳定经理做了少量定金),买方然后可以就具体履约提起股权诉讼,但部分履约不能支持普通的金钱损害赔偿诉讼。

(Choice A)预期违约 * 发生于一方当事人向另一方当事人告知其不履行合同时,另一方当事人可将此视为违约,并立即起诉或要求履行义务。在此,虽然该妇女告诉稳定经理,她不会以商定的价格出售牧场,但这并不能克服欺诈的法规。

* 也称预告性休妻。

(Choice B) 每项合同所隐含的诚信和公平交易义务都要求任何一方不得干预另一方履行合同或享有其利益的权利。但是,稳定的管理人员不能在未首先证明存在可执行合同的情况下声称违反了这项义务。

(Choice D)量子计量符使给予准合同关系中的另一方好处的一方有权因该好处的合理价值而获得损害赔偿,但不能具体履行。

学习要点：

涉及违反防止欺诈法的土地的合同,如果买方至少完成了下列两项行为,则基于部分履约理由可以强制执行:

财产,大为改善,和/或支付购买价款的任何部分。

参考资料

• 重述(第二次)合同第129条(1981年《美国法律》)(依赖行动;具体履行)。

stem:
A rancher and a fancier of horses signed the following writing: "For $5,000, the rancher will sell to the fancier a gray horse that the fancier may choose from among the grays on the rancher's ranch."

The fancier refused to accept delivery of a gray horse timely tendered by the rancher or to choose among those remaining, on the grounds that during their negotiations the rancher had orally agreed to include a saddle, worth $100, and also to give the fancier the option to choose a gray or a brown horse. The fancier insisted on one of the rancher's brown horses, but the rancher refused to part with any of his browns or with the saddle as demanded by the fancier.
stemZh:
一名牧场主和一匹马的风扇签下以下写法:"为了5000美元,牧场主将向风扇出售一匹灰色马,而风扇可以从牧场主牧场的灰人中选择".

风扇拒绝接受牧场主及时交付灰色马匹,或拒绝在剩下的人中作出选择,理由是在谈判期间,牧场主口头同意包括一个价值100美元的马鞍,也给了风扇一个选择.风扇坚持要一个牧场主的棕色马匹,但牧场主拒绝按照风扇的要求与任何棕色或鞍马分开。
ask: If the fancier sues the rancher for damages and seeks to introduce evidence of the alleged oral agreement, what evidence will the court likely admit?
askZh: 如果粉丝起诉牧场主要求赔偿损失,并试图提出所谓口头协议的证据,那么法院会承认哪些证据?

options.zh: 鞍,但不选择选择棕马.

options.zh: 选择棕马的选择,但不选择鞍.

options.en: Neither the saddle nor the option to choose a brown horse.
options.zh: 既不是马鞍,也不是选择棕色马匹的选择.

explanation.en:
Admissibility of consistent additional terms

(not barred by parol evidence rule)

Common law

Term would naturally be omitted from contract under the circumstances

UCC Term not so important that, if agreed upon, it certainly would have been included in contract

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

The UCC parol evidence rule* generally bars evidence of a prior or contemporaneous agreement that contradicts the final written contract. But evidence of a consistent additional term is admissible unless a court determines the term is so important that it would have certainly been included in the contract. Because that standard is difficult to establish, such evidence is usually admissible.

Here, the written contract signed by the parties allowed the fancier to purchase and select a gray horse. As a result, evidence of the oral agreement to allow the fancier to purchase and select a brown horse contradicted the contract and is not admissible (Choices A & C). But because the term to include a $100 saddle would not have certainly been included in the contract, evidence of that part of the oral agreement is admissible (Choice D).

*Contracts for the sale of goods (eg, horses) are governed by Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC).

Educational objective:

Under the UCC parol evidence rule, evidence of consistent additional terms is admissible unless the court determines the term is so important that, if agreed upon, it would have certainly been included in the contract.

References

• U.C.C. § 2-202 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (when parol evidence of consistent additional term is admissible).

explanation.zh:
一致的补充条款的可受理性

(不受parol证据规则禁止)

普通法

在这种情况下,合同中自然省略期限

UCC 任期不重要,如果商定,它肯定会被列入合同

UCC = 统一商法典

UCC parol证据规则* 通常禁止提出与最后书面合同相矛盾的先前或当时协议的证据。但是,除非法院认定该术语如此重要,以致于该术语肯定已包括在合同中,否则关于一个一致的额外条款的证据是可以接受的,因为这一标准难以确定,因此通常可以接受这种证据。

在这里,双方签署的书面合同允许粉丝购买和选择一匹灰马,因此,允许粉丝购买和选择棕马的口头协议证据与合同相矛盾,不能受理(Choices A &但是,由于合同中肯定没有列入包括100美元鞍的术语,因此口头协议的这一部分证据是可以接受的(Choice D)。

* 货物(例如马)销售合同受《统一商法典》第2条管辖。

学习要点：

根据UCC parol证据规则,除非法院认定该术语如此重要,如经协议,该术语肯定已列入合同,否则可接受一致的额外条款证据。

参考资料

• U.C.C.§2-202(Am.Law Inst. & Unif.Law Comm'n 2020)(当可接受关于一致增加任期的口头证据时)。

stem: A developer contracted in writing with a buyer to sell a house on a one-acre lot for $100,000. The developer told the buyer that the lot abutted a national park and that the water for the house came from a natural artesian spring. The developer knew that both these representations were important to the buyer and that both were false. The buyer moved into the house and eight months later learned that a private golf course was being constructed on the adjacent land and that the water for the house came from the city reservoir. The buyer immediately sued the developer to avoid the contract. The construction of the golf course will probably increase the market value of the buyer's property, and the water from the city reservoir exceeds all established standards for drinking water.
stemZh: 一个开发商与买主书面签订合同,在一英亩的地块上出售一栋房子,售价为10万美元,开发商告诉买主,这批土地破坏了一个国家公园,房子的水来自天然的马先蒿泉水.开发商知道这两件事对买方都很重要,而且都是虚假的。 买方搬进房子,8个月后得知,在邻近的土地上正在建造一个私人高尔夫球场,而且房子的水源也是假的。买方立即起诉开发商以宣告合同无效。 建造高尔夫球场可能会增加买方财产的市场价值,而城市水库的水量超过了所有既定标准。饮用水。
ask: Is the buyer likely to prevail?
askZh: 买方可能胜诉吗?

options.en: No, because eight months exceeds a reasonable time for contract avoidance.
options.zh: 不,因为8个月超过宣告合同无效的合理时间。

options.en: No, because the developer's misstatements caused no economic harm to the buyer.
options.zh: 不,因为开发商的错报没有对买方造成任何经济损害.

options.en: Yes, because the buyer retained the power to avoid the contract due to fraud.
options.zh: 是的,因为买方因欺诈而保留宣告合同无效的权力。

options.en: Yes, because the contract was void ab initio.
options.zh: 是的,因为合同从一开始就是无效的。

explanation.en:
Factors used to determine reasonable time to avoid contract

Extent to which:

• delay enabled (or might have enabled) party with power of avoidance to speculate at other party's risk

• delay resulted (or might have resulted) in justifiable reliance by other party or third party

• ground for avoidance was result of either party's fault

• other party's conduct contributed to delay Misrepresentation is a defense to enforceability that makes a contract voidable by the adversely affected party. This defense is available when:

• the misrepresentation was fraudulent (ie, made knowingly or recklessly with intent to induce the other party's assent to the contract) OR material (ie, likely to induce a reasonable person's assent)

• the misrepresentation induced assent to the contract and

• the adversely affected party justifiably relied on the misrepresentation.

If the misrepresentation was fraudulent, then the adversely affected party must seek to avoid the contract within a reasonable time after learning of the misrepresentation.* Otherwise, the power to avoid the contract is lost.

Here, the developer fraudulently misrepresented both the location of the lot and the water source, which induced the buyer to purchase the house. Because the developer's statements were not obviously false, the buyer justifiably relied on them. And since the buyer immediately sued the developer to avoid the contract after discovering the misrepresentation eight months later, the buyer retained the power to avoid the contract and will likely prevail (Choice A).

*If the misrepresentation was nonfraudulent, then the reasonable time period begins to run when the party knows or has reason to know about the misrepresentation.

(Choice B) A party may avoid a contract for misrepresentation even if the resulting contract causes that party no economic harm.

(Choice D) The contract was not void ab initio (ie, invalid from the outset). Rather, it was voidable, meaning that it operated as a valid contract until the buyer took steps to avoid it.

Educational objective:

To avoid a contract for fraudulent misrepresentation, the adversely affected party must seek this remedy within a reasonable time after learning of the misrepresentation.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 164 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when misrepresentation makes a contract voidable).

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 381 cmt. b (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when power to avoid contract is lost due to delay).

explanation.zh:
确定宣告合同无效的合理时间所使用的因素

在多大程度上:

• 允许(或可能允许)具有撤销权的当事人对另一方当事人的风险进行推测

• 延误导致(或可能导致)其他当事方或第三方的正当依赖

• 宣告合同无效的理由是任何一方的过失造成的

• 另一方当事人的行为造成拖延,错误陈述是对可执行性的一种辩护,使受不利影响的当事人可以撤销合同。

• 虚假陈述是欺诈性的(故意或轻率地作出,意图促使另一方同意合同)或材料(即有可能促使有理智的人同意)

• 虚假陈述导致同意合同;

• 受到不利影响的一方有理由依赖这种歪曲。

如果虚假陈述是欺诈性的,则受害方必须在得知虚假陈述后的合理时间内设法宣告合同无效。 * 否则,宣告合同无效的权力将丧失。

在这里,开发商对批量位置和水源都进行了欺诈性歪曲,导致买方购买了这栋房子。 由于开发商的陈述并非明显虚假,买方有理由依赖这些说法。由于买方在8个月后发现虚假陈述后立即起诉开发商宣告合同无效,因此买方保留了宣告合同无效的权力,并有可能优先(Choice A)。

* 如果不虚报,则当当事人知道或有理由知道虚报情况时,合理时限开始计算。

(选择B)即使由此产生的合同未对该当事人造成任何经济损害,当事人仍可宣告虚假合同无效。

(Choice D) 合同并非从一开始就无效(即从一开始就无效),而是可以无效,也就是说,在买方采取步骤宣告合同无效之前,合同是有效的合同。

学习要点：

为了避免欺诈性虚报合同,受害方必须在得知虚报后的合理时间内寻求这一补救。

参考资料

• 重述(第二次)合同第164条(1981年《美国法律》)(如果错误陈述使合同可以无效)。

• 重述(第二份)第381 cmt. b条(1981年《美国法律》)(当由于拖延而丧失了宣告合同无效的权力)。

stem: A buyer purchased a new car from a dealer under a written contract that provided that the price of the car was $20,000 and that the buyer would receive a "trade-in allowance of $7,000 for the buyer's old car." The old car had recently been damaged in an accident. The contract contained a merger clause stating: "This writing constitutes the entire agreement of the parties, and there are no other understandings or agreements not set forth herein." When the buyer took possession of the new car, she delivered the old car to the dealer. At that time, the dealer claimed that the trade-in allowance included an assignment of the buyer's claim against her insurance company for damage to the old car. The buyer refused to provide the assignment. The dealer sued the buyer to recover the insurance payment. The dealer has offered evidence that the parties agreed during their negotiations for the new car that the dealer was entitled to the insurance payment.
stemZh: 一名买家从经销商处购买了一辆新车，签订的书面合同规定车辆价格为 20,000 美元，并且买家将获得其旧车的折价 7,000 美元。该旧车最近在一次事故中受损。合同中包含一个合并条款，规定："本文件构成双方的全部协议，且未在此列出任何其他理解或协议。" 当买家拿到新车时，她将旧车交付给了经销商。此时，经销商声称折价包含买家对保险公司就旧车损坏所拥有的索赔权的转让。买家拒绝提供转让。经销商起诉买家要求获得保险赔偿。经销商提供了证据，证明双方在协商购买新车时同意经销商有权获得保险赔偿。
ask: Should the court admit this evidence?
askZh: 法院是否应采纳该证据？

options.en: No, because the dealer's acceptance of the old car bars any additional claim by the dealer.
options.zh: 否，因为经销商接受旧车的行为排除了经销商的任何额外索赔。

options.en: No, because the merger clause bars any evidence of the parties' prior discussions concerning the trade-in allowance.
options.zh: 否，因为合并条款排除了有关折价的双方先前讨论的任何证据。

options.en: Yes, because a merger clause does not bar evidence of fraud.
options.zh: 是，因为合并条款不能排除欺诈的证据。

options.en: Yes, because the merger clause does not bar evidence to explain what the parties meant by "trade-in allowance."
options.zh: 是，因为合并条款不能排除解释双方所称的"折价"含义的证据。

explanation.en:
Exceptions to parol evidence rule

Evidence of prior or contemporaneous oral or written agreement is admissible to establish:

• whether writing is integrated and, if so, completely or partially

• meaning of ambiguous term

• defense to formation or enforcement (eg, fraud, duress, mistake)

• ground for granting or denying remedy (eg, rescission, reformation)

• subsequent contract modifications

• condition precedent to effectiveness The UCC parol evidence rule generally bars evidence of a prior written agreement (or contemporaneous oral agreement) to contradict the terms of an integrated writing. But the parol evidence rule does not bar such evidence, and such evidence is always admissible, when it is used to clarify the meaning of an ambiguous contract term. This is true regardless of whether the contract is completely or partially integrated.

Here, the written contract failed to state whether an assignment of the buyer's insurance claim was included in the term "trade-in allowance." The contract contained a merger clause, which indicates that the contract was completely integrated.* But the merger clause does not bar evidence to explain what the parties meant by "trade-in allowance." Therefore, the court should admit the evidence that the parties agreed during their negotiations for the new car that the dealer was entitled to the insurance payment (Choice B).

*A merger clause is strong, but not conclusive, evidence that a contract is completely integrated.

(Choice A) A buyer's mere acceptance of goods does not waive its potential claims against a seller.

(Choice C) Evidence used to establish a defense to formation or enforceability of a contract (eg, fraud) is excepted from the parol evidence rule. But there is no indication of fraud in this case, so this exception is irrelevant.

Educational objective:

Even when a contract is completely integrated (eg, as evidenced by a merger clause), the parol evidence rule does not bar evidence to clarify the meaning of an ambiguous contract term.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 214 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (exceptions to parol evidence rule).

explanation.zh:
口头证据规则的例外

1. 先前或当时口头或书面协议的证据可以成立:

• 写作是综合的,如果是,是完全的还是部分的

• 模棱两可一词的含义

• 为组建或执行辩护(例如欺诈、胁迫、错误)

• 给予或拒绝补救的理由(如撤销、改造)

• 随后的合同修改

· 以效力为先决条件的先例 22 统一商业法的口头证据规则一般禁止提供先前书面协议(或同时口头协议)的证据,以与综合书面条款相矛盾。但是,parol证据规则并不禁止这种证据,而且当使用这种证据来澄清一个模棱两可的合同术语的含义时,这种证据总是可以接受的,无论合同是完全还是部分合并的,都是如此。

在此,书面合同没有说明买方保险索赔的转让是否包含在"交易津贴"这一术语中. 合同包含一项合并条款,这表明合同是完全一体化的. * 但合并条款.因此,该规则并不禁止提供证据来解释当事人“交易津贴”的含义。法院应当承认双方当事人在谈判新车期间同意的证据。交易商有权获得保险金(Choice B)。

* 合并条款有力但并非决定性地证明合同是完全一体化的。

(选择A) 买方仅仅接受货物并不放弃其对卖方的潜在索赔。

(Choice C) 用于为合同的订立或可执行性确立辩护的证据(例如欺诈)被排除在parol证据规则之外。 但在本案中没有欺诈的迹象,因此这一例外无关紧要。

学习要点：

即使一项合同是完全一体化的(例如,兼并条款所证明的),parol证据规则并不禁止证据澄清一个模棱两可的合同术语的含义。

UCC = 统一商法典

参考资料

• 重述(第二)第214条(1981年《美国法律》)(证据规则的例外)。

stem: On March 1, a homeowner contacted a builder about constructing an addition to the homeowner's house. The builder orally offered to perform the work for $200,000 if his pending bid on another project was rejected. The homeowner accepted the builder's terms, and the builder then prepared a written contract that both parties signed. The contract did not refer to the builder's pending bid. One week later, upon learning that his pending bid on the other project had been accepted, the builder refused to perform any work for the homeowner.
stemZh: 3月1日,一位房主与一位建筑商联系,说要增建房主的房屋,建筑商口头提出,如果他在另一项目上待决的投标被拒绝,要以20万美元完成工程.房主接受了建筑商的条件,建筑商随后准备了一份双方签署的书面合同,合同中并未提及建筑商的待投标.一周后,该建筑商得知他对另一个项目的待决投标已被接受后,拒绝为房主做任何工作。
ask: Can the homeowner recover for the builder's nonperformance?
askZh: 房主能为建造者不履约而恢复吗?

options.en: No, because efficiency principles justify the builder's services being directed to a higher-value use.
options.zh: 不,因为效率原则证明建筑商的服务是用于更高价值的用途。

options.en: No, because the builder's duty to perform was subject to a condition.
options.zh: 不,因为建筑商的履行义务是有条件的。

options.en: Yes, because the builder's attempt to condition his duty to perform rendered the contract illusory.
options.zh: 是的,因为建筑商试图限制他履行义务,使合同变得虚幻。

options.en: Yes, because the parol evidence rule would bar the builder from presenting evidence of oral understandings not included in the final writing.
options.zh: 是的,因为parol证据规则将禁止建筑商提出未包括在最后写作中的口头谅解的证据。

explanation.en:
Exceptions to parol evidence rule

Evidence of prior or contemporaneous oral or written agreement is admissible to establish:

• whether writing is integrated and, if so, completely or partially

• meaning of ambiguous term

• defense to formation or enforcement (eg, fraud, duress, mistake)

• ground for granting or denying remedy (eg, rescission, reformation)

• subsequent contract modifications

• condition precedent to effectiveness The parol evidence rule generally bars evidence of a prior or contemporaneous agreement to modify or contradict the terms of an integrated writing. But this rule does not apply when a party is attacking the validity of the agreement—eg, by asserting there was a condition precedent to effectiveness that failed to occur. As a result, evidence of such a condition precedent is admissible.

Here, before the contract was signed, the parties orally agreed that it would become binding (ie, take effect) only if the builder's other pending bid was rejected—a condition precedent to effectiveness. Therefore, the parol evidence rule does not bar evidence of the oral agreement to prove that the contract failed to take effect because the builder's other pending bid was accepted (Choice D). Accordingly, the homeowner cannot recover for the builder's nonperformance because the builder's performance never became due.

(Choice A) Efficiency principles justify (but do not excuse) a breach if it is more economically advantageous for a party to breach and pay damages than to perform. But the builder did not breach the contract, and even if he had, the facts do not indicate that it was economically advantageous for him to do so.

(Choice C) An illusory promise is one so vague that the promisor has discretion whether to perform. Here, the builder's promise was not illusory because he was obligated to perform if his pending bid was rejected.

Educational objective:

Evidence used to establish a condition precedent that must occur before a contract becomes effective is admissible under the parol evidence rule.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 217 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (integrated agreement subject to oral requirement).

explanation.zh:
口头证据规则的例外

1. 先前或当时口头或书面协议的证据可以成立:

• 写作是综合的,如果是,是完全的还是部分的

• 模棱两可一词的含义

• 为组建或执行辩护(例如欺诈、胁迫、错误)

• 给予或拒绝补救的理由(如撤销、改造)

• 随后的合同修改

· 效力的先决条件 parol证据规则一般禁止提出先前或当时同意修改或违背综合书面条款的证据。但是,当一方当事人攻击协议的有效性时,例如声称没有发生效力的一个先决条件的先例,则该规则不适用,因此,这种条件的先例的证据是可以接受的。

在此,在签署合同之前,双方当事人口头商定,只有在建筑商的其他待决投标被拒绝的情况下,合同才具有约束力(即生效)——这是生效的一个先决条件。因此,parol证据规则并不妨碍口头协议证明合同未能生效的证据,因为建筑商的其他待投标被接受(Choice D)。因此,房主无法为建筑商的不履约行为收回款项,因为建筑商的履约行为从未到期。

(选择A) 效率原则如果违反和支付损害赔偿金对一方比履约更具有经济优势,则有理由(但不能原谅)违约。但是建筑商并没有违反合同,即使他违反了合同,但事实并未表明他这样做对经济有利。

(Choice C)一个虚幻的允诺是如此的模糊,以致于混居者可以斟酌是否履行. 在这里,建造者的允诺并不是虚幻的,因为如果他的待出价被拒绝,他有义务履行.

学习要点：

用于确立合同生效前必须发生的条件先例的证据,根据parol证据规则是可以接受的。

参考资料

stem: A janitorial service contracted in writing with a hospital for a one-year term. Under the terms of the contract, the janitorial service agreed to clean the hospital daily in accordance with the hygiene standards of the city's health code. Because the janitorial service did not clean a patient's room in accordance with the required hygiene standards, the patient contracted an infection that required continued hospitalization. In addition to suing the hospital, the patient sued the janitorial service for breach of contract.
stemZh: 与医院签订书面合同的看管服务期为一年。根据合同规定,看门人同意每天清扫医院。符合本市卫生法规的卫生标准.由于看管服务没有按照规定的卫生标准清理病人的房间,病人感染了需要继续住院的疾病。除了起诉医院外,病人还起诉看门服务公司违反合同。
ask: Which of the following statements is most accurate with respect to the breach of contract claim against the janitorial service?
askZh: 下列哪些声明最准确地涉及违反《公约》的行为:对清洁工的合同索赔?

options.en: The janitorial service is liable to the patient as a matter of public policy, because it violated the city's health code.
options.zh: 护理服务作为公共政策对病人负责,因为它违反了城市的健康守则。

options.en: The patient cannot sue on the contract, because she was not named in the contract.
options.zh: 病人不能对合同提出控告,因为合同中没有给她起名。

options.en: The patient has no claim for breach of contract against the janitorial service, because she is an incidental beneficiary.
options.zh: 病人对看管服务公司不主张违约,因为她是附带受益人。

options.en: The patient is an intended third-party beneficiary under the contract, because the janitorial service's promise was intended to benefit all hospital patients.
options.zh: 患者是合同中预定的第三方受益人,因为看管服务的承诺旨在惠及所有医院患者.

explanation.en:
A third-party beneficiary is a nonparty to a contract who receives some advantage or benefit from that contract. There are two types of third-party beneficiaries:

• Intended – who receive a direct benefit from the contract because the contracting parties so intended (eg, the contract provides that payment will go directly to a third party)

• Incidental – who receive some indirect benefit from the contract even though there was no contractual intent to benefit them (ie, all third-party beneficiaries who are not intended beneficiaries) Only intended beneficiaries—not incidental beneficiaries—have contractual rights and may sue to enforce them.

Here, the patient is an incidental beneficiary to the janitorial service–hospital contract because there is no indication that the parties intended for the contract to directly benefit the patient (Choice D). Instead, the contract was designed for all patients to indirectly benefit from hygienic rooms. Therefore, the patient has no claim for breach of contract against the janitorial service.*

*The patient may, however, have a tort claim against the janitorial service.

(Choice A) A contractual party's violation of public policy may render that contract unenforceable, but it does not provide a nonparty with the right to sue under that contract.

(Choice B) The patient could have sued on the contract had she been a named or unnamed intended beneficiary.

Educational objective:

Intended beneficiaries receive a direct benefit from a contract because the contracting parties so intended, while incidental beneficiaries receive an indirect benefit from a contract even though there was no contractual intent to benefit them. Only intended (not incidental) beneficiaries can sue to enforce the contract.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 302 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (intended and incidental beneficiaries).

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 315 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (no right to enforce for incidental beneficiaries).

第三方受益人是收到部分合同的非合同当事方。优惠或从该合同中受益。第三方受益人有两种:

• 意向 -- -- 由于订约方的意向而直接受益于合同(例如,合同规定付款将直接交给第三方)

· 偶然的 -- -- 即使没有合同意图使他们受益,却从合同中获得一些间接利益(即,不是预期受益者的所有第三方受益人)合同权利,并可以起诉强制执行这些权利。

* 不过,病人可以向清洁工提出侵权要求。

预定受益人从合同中直接受益,因为订约方有此意向,而附带受益人则从合同中间接受益,尽管没有合同意向使他们受益。只有预期的(而非偶然的)受益人才能起诉执行合同。

stem: An accountant and a bookkeeper, as part of a contract dissolving their accounting business, agreed that each would contribute $100,000 to fund an annuity for a clerk who was a longtime employee of the business. The clerk's position would be terminated at the dissolution, and he did not have a retirement plan. The accountant and the bookkeeper informed the clerk of their plan to fund an annuity for him. The clerk, confident about his financial future because of the promised annuity, purchased a retirement home. The accountant later contributed his $100,000 to fund the annuity, but the bookkeeper stated that he could afford to contribute only $50,000. The accountant agreed in writing that the bookkeeper should contribute only $50,000.
stemZh: 一名会计师和一名簿记员作为解除其会计业务的合同的一部分,同意每人出资10万美元,为长期受雇于该业务的书记员提供年金。书记员的职务将在解散时终止,他没有退休计划,会计和簿记员通知书记员他们计划为他资助年金.书记员因为承诺的年金而对自己的财务前途充满信心,于是购买了一座退休住宅. 会计师后来为年金出资了10万美元,但书记员表示他只能支付5万美元.会计师书面同意,记账员只应出资5万美元.
ask: Does the clerk have a valid basis for an action against the bookkeeper for the unpaid $50,000?
askZh: 书记员对欠账五万美元的账务员提起诉讼,是否有有效依据?.

options.en: No, because the clerk was bound by the modification of the contract made by the accountant and the bookkeeper.
options.zh: 没有,因为书记员受会计和记账员修改合同的约束.

options.en: No, because the clerk was only a donee beneficiary of the contract between the accountant and the bookkeeper and had no vested rights.
options.zh: 不,因为书记员只是会计和记账员合同的受赠人,没有既得权利.

options.en: Yes, because the clerk's reliance on the promised annuity prevented the parties from changing the terms of the contract.
options.zh: 是的,因为书记员依靠承诺的年金使当事人无法改变合同条款。

options.en: Yes, because the promise to establish the annuity was made binding by consideration from the clerk's many years of employment.
options.zh: 是的,因为确定年金的承诺是经过书记员多年工作对价才有约束力的。

explanation.en:
Third-party beneficiaries

(ie, nonparties who benefit from contract)

Type Definition Right to enforce

Intended • Receive direct benefit from contract because contracting parties intended to benefit them

• Eg, A promises to paint B's house if B promises to pay $500 to C

Yes

Incidental • Receive indirect benefit from contract even though there was no contractual intent to benefit them

• Eg, A promises to buy B a car manufactured by C

No

A third-party beneficiary is a nonparty to a contract who receives some advantage or benefit from that contract. If the contracting parties intended for the contract to benefit the third party, the third party is an intended beneficiary. Only intended (not incidental) beneficiaries have enforceable rights under the contract. Those rights vest when the beneficiary:

• detrimentally relies on the rights created

• manifests assent to the contract at one party's request or

• files a lawsuit to enforce the contract. Once this occurs, the original contracting parties are bound to perform the contract. Any efforts to rescind or modify the contract after vesting are void unless the beneficiary agrees to the rescission or modification.

Here, the clerk was an intended beneficiary of the accountant-bookkeeper contract because the parties' promise to fund an annuity for the clerk was clearly intended to benefit him. The clerk detrimentally relied on the promised annuity by purchasing a retirement home (vesting). And since he did so before the accountant and the bookkeeper agreed that the bookkeeper would contribute $50,000 less, their attempt to modify the contract was void. As a result, the clerk has a valid basis for an action against the bookkeeper for the unpaid $50,000 (Choice A).

(Choice B) A donee beneficiary is an intended beneficiary of a gift promise, while a creditor beneficiary is an intended beneficiary to whom the promisee owed money. The rule for vesting is the same for both.

(Choice D) Under the bargained-for exchange test for consideration, past performance (eg, the clerk's many years of employment) does not constitute the consideration required to

enforce a contract. Instead, the clerk can enforce the accountant-bookkeeper contract because of his third-party beneficiary status.

Educational objective:

An intended beneficiary's contractual rights vest when the beneficiary (1) detrimentally relies on the rights created, (2) manifests assent to the contract, or (3) files a lawsuit to enforce it. Any efforts to rescind or modify the contract after vesting are void unless the beneficiary agrees to the rescission or modification.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 302 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (intended and incidental beneficiaries).

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 311 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (variation of a duty to a beneficiary).

explanation.zh:
第三方受益人

(即从合同中受益的非当事人)

类型 定义 强制执行的权利

• 直接受益于合同,因为订约方打算从中受益

• 例如,A承诺,如果B承诺向C支付500美元,就画B的房子

对

• 尽管没有合同意向,但从合同中获得间接利益让他们受益

• 例如,A承诺购买C制造的汽车B

没有

第三方受益人是指从合同中获得某种好处或从合同中受益的非合同当事人,如果合同当事人打算使合同惠及第三方,则第三方为预期受益人。只有预期的(而非偶然的)受益人才能根据合同享有可执行的权利。

• 有害地依赖所创造的权利

• 应一方当事人的请求表明同意合同,或

• 为强制执行合同提起诉讼,一旦发生这种情况,原始合同方有义务履行合同,任何在背书后撤销或修改合同的努力均属无效,除非受益人同意撤销或修改合同。

在此,书记员是会计-簿记员合同的预期受益人,因为当事人承诺为书记员提供年金显然是为了让他受益。书记官通过购买退休金(vensting)来有害地依赖承诺的年金。 由于他在会计师和簿记员同意书记员将少捐5万美元之前这样做,他们修改合同的企图是无效的。因此,书记员对账务员未支付5万美元(Choice A)的诉讼有有效依据.

(Choice B) 受赠人受益人是赠与承诺的预期受益人,而债权人受益人则是受赠人欠款的预期受益人。

(Choice D)根据供对价的议定交换标准,过去的业绩(例如书记员多年的工作)不构成需要对价的问题。

相反,书记员可以因其第三方受益人身份而强制执行会计-簿记员合同。

学习要点：

如果受益人(1) 不利地依赖所设定的权利,(2) 表明同意合同,或(3) 提起诉讼强制执行合同,则预期受益人的合同权利背书。背书后撤销或修改合同的任何努力均属无效,除非受益人同意撤销或修改合同。

参考资料

• 重述(第二份)合同第302条(1981年《安曼法律》)(意向受益人和附带受益人)。

• 重述(第二)合同第311条(1981年《普通法》)(对受益人义务的变动)。

stem:
On June 1, an appliance manufacturer telephoned a supplier to determine whether the supplier could provide 300 washing machine motors of a particular model by October 1. The supplier offered to do so at a price of $300 per motor (a total price of $90,000). The manufacturer's representative said, "Deal." The next day the manufacturer's representative sent the supplier an unsigned note on company letterhead that stated, "I am happy that you are going to supply us with the motors. I will call you soon to talk about another order." The manufacturer then sent catalogs to its regular customers advertising washing machines that included the specified motors.

The manufacturer did not hear from the supplier until July 1, when the supplier called to say that it would be unable to supply the motors because it was no longer carrying that model. At that time, the manufacturer had received no orders for the machines with the specified motors.

The manufacturer sued the supplier for breach of contract, and the supplier raised the statute of frauds as a defense.
stemZh:
6月1日,一家电器制造商给一家供应商打电话,确定供应商能否在10月1日前提供300台特定型号的洗衣机发动机,供应商提出以每台发动机300美元的价格提供(总价90 000美元).制造商的代表说"Deal",次日制造商的代表在公司信笺上给供应商发了一封未署名的纸条,上面写道:"我很高兴你能给我们提供发动机.我很快会打电话给你谈谈另一个订单。” 然后,制造商向普通客户发送了目录,宣传包括特定发动机在内的洗衣机。

制造商直到7月1日才从供应商那里听到消息,供应商打电话说由于不再携带该型号,无法供应发动机.当时,制造商没有收到关于装有指定发动机的机器的订单。

制造商起诉供应商违约,供应商提出防止欺诈法作为辩护.
ask: Is the supplier's statute of frauds defense likely to succeed?
askZh: 供应商的防止欺诈法辩护是否可能成功?

options.en: No, because the manufacturer distributed the catalogs in reliance on the contract, making the contract enforceable under the statute of frauds.
options.zh: 不,因为制造商根据合同分发目录,使合同可根据防止欺诈法强制执行。

options.en: No, because the supplier failed to object to the contents of the note sent by the manufacturer.
options.zh: 不,因为供应商没有反对制造商发出的说明的内容。

options.en: Yes, because the manufacturer's note failed to contain a signature.
options.zh: 是的,因为制造商的纸条没有包含签名。

options.en: Yes, because there is no writing that contains the quantity term of the contract.
options.zh: 是的,因为没有包含合同数量期限的书面文件。

explanation.en:
Statute of frauds requirements

Writing Physical or electronic document(s) containing reasonable basis to believe contract was formed (eg, receipt, check, emails) AND

• at common law – identifies parties, subject matter, consideration, time & nature of performance

• under UCC – lists quantity of goods (contract enforceable only up to written quantity) Signature General rule – handwritten signature from, or other mark identifying, party to be charged (eg, letterhead, electronic signature, initials)

• Merchant exception – between merchants, written confirmation that satisfies statute of frauds as to sender will bind both parties if no written objection within 10 days UCC = Uniform Commercial Code,

Under the UCC statute of frauds, contracts for the sale of goods of $500 or more (as seen here) must be in a writing that states the quantity of goods to be sold and signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought. If the contract is between merchants, then a written confirmation will bind both parties if:

• the confirmation is sent within a reasonable time

• the confirmation satisfies the statute of frauds as to the sender and

• the recipient does not object in writing within 10 days. Here, the manufacturer's representative sent the supplier an unsigned note on company letterhead to confirm their agreement for the supply of motors. But this confirmation does not satisfy the statute of frauds because it failed to state the quantity of the motors to be sold. Therefore, the supplier's statute-of-frauds defense will succeed.

Had the confirmation listed the quantity of motors being sold, it would have been binding as to both parties and defeated the supplier's statute-of-frauds defense. That is because (1) the manufacturer's letterhead was an identifying mark that satisfied the signature requirement under the statute of frauds and (2) the supplier never objected to the written confirmation (Choices B & C).

(Choice A) Under the doctrine of promissory estoppel, a party's reliance may serve as an alternative basis for recovery when no valid contract was formed—but it does not make a contract enforceable under the statute of frauds. Additionally, this doctrine only applies if reliance was reasonable and caused substantial detriment (eg, had the manufacturer received orders).

Educational objective:

Under the UCC, a written confirmation between merchants satisfies the statute of frauds as to both parties if it (1) is sent within a reasonable time, (2) satisfies the statute of frauds—ie, signed writing with quantity stated—as to the sender, and (3) is not objected to in writing within 10 days.

References

• UCC § 2-201 (statute of frauds requirements).

explanation.zh:
防止欺诈法要求

写载有相信合同成立的合理依据的实物或电子文件(例如收据、支票、电子邮件)和

• 在普通法中确定当事方、主题事项、对价、履行的时间和性质

• 根据《统一商法典》 -- -- 列出货物数量(合同可执行,但仅限于书面数量)一般规则 -- -- 被控告方(例如,信头、电子签字、缩写)

• 商家之间的商业例外,如果在10天内没有书面反对,满足对发货人的防止欺诈法的书面确认将约束双方,

根据《UCC公司防止欺诈法》,销售500美元或500美元以上的货物(如此处所示)的合同必须以书面形式载明拟出售的货物数量,并由寻求执行的一方签署。如果合同是商家之间的,则书面确认对双方具有约束力,条件是:

• 在合理时间内发出确认书;

• 证实符合关于发送人的防止欺诈法,

• 接收方在10天内没有书面提出异议,在此,制造商代表向供应商发出公司信笺上未署名的说明,确认他们同意供应发动机。但这一确认并不能满足防止欺诈法的要求,因为它没有说明要出售的发动机的数量,因此供应商的防止欺诈法辩护会成功.

如果确认书列出所出售的发动机数量,对双方都具有约束力,并击败供应商的欺诈法规辩护。这是因为(1)制造商的信笺是符合防止欺诈法规定的签名要求的识别标志,(2)供应商从未反对书面确认(Choices B & C)。

(选择A) 根据期初禁止反悔原则,当未订立有效合同时,一方当事人的依赖可作为追偿的替代依据——但它并未使合同根据防止欺诈法可以强制执行。此外,只有在依赖是合理的并造成重大损害(例如,如果制造商收到订单)的情况下,这一理论才适用。

学习要点：

根据《统一商法典》,商家之间的书面确认符合防止欺诈法,如果(1) 是在合理时间内发出的,(2) 符合防止欺诈法,即与发件人一样,在书面上签字并注明数量,(3) 不反对在10天内以书面形式提交。

参考资料

• UCC§2-201(防止欺诈法要求)。

stem:
A collector owned a large number of rare baseball cards. Each card was sealed and placed in a protective binder. Each binder was labeled by league, team, and decade. The collector met with a man who was interested in purchasing some of the cards. After reviewing all of the binders, the man offered to purchase the cards of "every player who had ever played for [his favorite team]." The collector accepted the offer.

The man wired the purchase price to the collector and subsequently received all of the collector's binders that had been labeled with the name of the man's favorite team. However, the man had intended for his purchase to include cards from any other teams for which his favorite team's players had ever played.
stemZh:
一个收藏家拥有大量稀有的棒球卡,每张卡片被封装并放入保护装订箱中,每张装订箱被联赛,球队和十年贴上标签,收藏家与一位有兴趣购买部分卡片的人会面.在检阅了所有的装订品后,男方提出购买"所有曾经为[他最喜爱的团队]踢球的球员"的牌. 收藏家接受了这个要约.

男子将购买价款汇给收藏家,随后收到了收藏家所有贴有男子最喜爱团队名称的装订品.然而,这名男子原本打算购买的卡片包括他最喜爱的球队的球员曾经为其他球队出场过的卡片.
ask: In an action by the man against the collector for specific performance, which of the following, if proved, would best support the man's claim?
askZh: 在男子针对收藏家的具体表演的诉讼中,如果证明以下哪一种行为最能支持男子的主张?

options.en: Both parties knew that there was a misunderstanding.
options.zh: 双方都知道存在误解。

options.en: Neither party knew that there was a misunderstanding.
options.zh: 双方都不知道有误解。

options.en: The collector knew that there was a misunderstanding, but the man did not.
options.zh: 收藏家知道有误会,但那个人没有.

options.en: The man knew that there was a misunderstanding, but the collector did not.
options.zh: 此人知道有误会,但收藏家没有.

explanation.en:
A misunderstanding arises when the parties to a contract assign different meanings to the same term. When the misunderstanding involves a material term, whether a valid contract was formed depends on who knew or had reason to know that there was a misunderstanding:*

• neither party OR both parties – in which case no contract was formed because there was no meeting of the minds

• one party – in which case a valid contract was formed, and the unknowing party's meaning of the term controls

Here, the man offered to purchase the cards of "every player who had ever played for [his favorite team]." He understood this to include cards from other teams while the collector did not, so the parties assigned different meanings to the same material term. If the collector knew (or had reason to know) that there was a misunderstanding but the man did not, then a valid contract formed according to the man's understanding of the term. Therefore, this fact would best support the man's claim for specific performance.

*In determining what a party knew or had reason to know, the objective test typically used in contract law does not apply. Instead, it is each party's actual knowledge or reason to know of the misunderstanding that governs—not what a reasonable person would have known.

(Choices A & B) No contract was formed if both parties OR neither party knew that there was a misunderstanding, so these circumstances would not support the man's claim for specific performance.

(Choice D) Fairness governs the effect of misunderstandings on contract formation. Here, if the man knew about the misunderstanding but the collector did not, it would be unfair to force the collector to give the man the cards from the other teams.

Educational objective:

A misunderstanding involving a material term prevents contract formation when neither party OR both parties knew or had reason to know about the misunderstanding. However, if only one party knew or had reason to know, then a valid contract is formed using the unknowing party's meaning of the term.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 20 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (effect of misunderstanding).

explanation.zh:
当合同当事人对同一术语赋予不同的含义时,就会产生误解。 当误解涉及一个实质性术语时,有效合同是否成立取决于谁知道或有理由知道存在误解:*

• 双方或任何一方都没有达成合同,因为双方意见不一致

• 一方当事人——在这种情况下,一项有效的合同已经形成,而不知所措的当事人对该术语的含义加以控制;

在这里,男方提出购买"所有曾经为[他最喜爱的团队]出场的球员"的牌,他认为这包括了其他球队的牌,而收藏者却没有,因此双方为同一个物质术语分配了不同的含义.如果收藏家知道(或有理由知道)存在误解,但男子没有,那么根据男子对该术语的理解就形成了有效的合同,因此,这个事实最好支持男子对具体履行的要求。

* 在确定一方当事人知道或有理由知道的情况时,合同法中通常采用的客观检验标准不适用,而是每一方实际知道或有理由知道管辖的是误解,而不是理智的人会知道什么。

(Choices A & B) 如果双方或双方均不知道存在误解,则没有订立合同,因此这些情况不能支持当事人关于具体履约的索赔。

(Choice D)公平支配着误解对合同形成的影响,在这里,如果这个人知道误解,但收藏家没有,那么强迫收藏家把来自其他团队的卡片交给这个人是不公平的.

学习要点：

涉及实质性术语的误解,在任何一方或双方均不知道或有理由知道这一误解时,都会妨碍合同的订立。然而,如果只有一方当事人知道或有理由知道,则使用该术语的不知情方的含义订立有效的合同。

参考资料

• 重述(第二次)合同§20(1981年《美国法律》)(误解的影响)。

stem: Collection of a debtor's $2,000 debt to a creditor was barred by the applicable statute of limitations. The debtor sold and delivered his car to a buyer under a written agreement, signed by the buyer, in which the buyer promised to pay the $2,000 purchase price to the creditor "in satisfaction of [the debtor's] debt to [the creditor]."
stemZh: 债务人欠债权人的2 000美元债务的收取因适用的债务人根据书面协议将其汽车出售并交付给买方,该协议由债务人签署。买方承诺向买方支付2 000美元采购款债权人"清偿[债务人]对[债权人]的债务".
ask: Can the creditor recover the $2,000 from the buyer?
askZh: 债权人能否从买受人处收回2000美元?

options.en: No, because payment of the $2,000 to the creditor would undermine the statutory public policy against enforcement of stale claims.
options.zh: 不,因为向债权人支付2 000美元将破坏针对强制执行呆滞债权的法定公共政策。

options.en: No, because the creditor's rights as an intended beneficiary are subject to any defenses available to the contracting parties between themselves.
options.zh: 否,因为债权人作为预期受益人的权利须服从订约双方之间可以使用的任何抗辩。

options.en: Yes, because the buyer's promise to pay $2,000 to the creditor is enforceable by the creditor regardless of whether the debtor was legally obligated to pay the creditor anything.
options.zh: 是的,因为买受人向债权人支付2,000美元的承诺可由债权人执行,而不论债务人是否在法律上有义务向债权人支付任何款项。

options.en: Yes, because the buyer's promise to pay $2,000 to the creditor revived the uncollectible debt.
options.zh: 是的,因为买方承诺向债权人支付2 000美元,从而恢复了无法收回的债务。

explanation.en:
Third-party beneficiaries

(ie, nonparties who benefit from contract)

Type Definition Right to enforce

Intended • Receive direct benefit from contract because contracting parties intended to benefit them

• Eg, A promises to paint B's house if B promises to pay $500 to C

Yes

Incidental • Receive indirect benefit from contract even though there was no contractual intent to benefit them

• Eg, A promises to buy B a car manufactured by C

No

A third-party beneficiary is a nonparty to a contract who receives some advantage or benefit from that contract. There are two types of third-party beneficiaries:

• Intended – who receive a direct benefit from the contract because the contracting parties so intended (eg, the contract provides that payment will go directly to a third party)

• Incidental – who receive some indirect benefit from the contract even though there was no contractual intent to benefit them (ie, all third-party beneficiaries who are not intended beneficiaries)

Only intended beneficiaries—not incidental beneficiaries—have contractual rights and may sue to enforce them.

Here, the debtor and the buyer agreed that the buyer would pay the $2,000 purchase price directly to the creditor in satisfaction of the debtor's debt to the creditor. This made the creditor an intended third-party beneficiary of the debtor-buyer agreement. Therefore, the creditor can enforce the buyer's promise to pay the $2,000. This is true regardless of whether the debtor was legally obligated to pay the creditor anything (given that the applicable statute of limitations had run) (Choice D).

(Choice A) There is no statutory public policy against enforcement of stale claims. And here, the buyer's promise to pay the creditor the $2,000 is enforceable even if the creditor was time-barred from collecting the debt from the debtor.

(Choice B) The promisor (eg, the buyer) can raise any defense against the third-party beneficiary (eg, the creditor) that the promisor had against the original promisee (eg, the

debtor). But there is no indication that the buyer has a defense against the debtor that could be raised against the creditor in this case.

(Choice D) The buyer's promise to pay $2,000 to the creditor did not revive the uncollectible debt—ie, a suit by the creditor to collect the $2,000 from the debtor would still be barred by the applicable statute of limitations.

Educational objective:

Third-party beneficiaries are nonparties who receive some advantage or benefit from a contract. But only intended beneficiaries have contractual rights and may sue to enforce them.

References

• 17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts § 426 (2020) (intended versus incidental beneficiaries).

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 302 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (intended and incidental beneficiaries).

explanation.zh:
第三方受益人

(即从合同中受益的非当事人)

类型 定义 强制执行的权利

• 直接受益于合同,因为订约方打算从中受益

• 例如,A承诺,如果B承诺向C支付500美元,就画B的房子

对

• 尽管没有合同意向,但从合同中获得间接利益让他们受益

• 例如,A承诺购买C制造的汽车B

没有

第三方受益人是收到部分合同的非合同当事方。优惠或从该合同中受益。第三方受益人有两种:

• 意向 -- -- 由于订约方的意向而直接受益于合同(例如,合同规定付款将直接交给第三方)

• 意外 -- -- 尽管没有合同意向,但却从合同中获得一些间接利益(即所有第三方受益人不是预期受益人)

只有预期受益者,而不是附带受益者,才有合同权利,并可以提起诉讼强制执行这些权利。

在这方面,债务人和买方商定,买方将直接向债权人支付2,000美元购买价款,以清偿债务人对债权人的债务,从而使债权人成为债务人与买方之间的协议的预期第三方受益人。因此,债权人可以强制执行买方支付2,000美元的承诺,无论债务人在法律上是否有义务向债权人支付任何款项(如果适用的诉讼时效已经生效)(Choice D)。

(Choice A)没有针对强制执行呆滞债权的法定公共政策,在这方面,买方向债权人支付2000美元的承诺是可以执行的,即使债权人有时间向债务人收取债务。

(Choice B)本票人(如买方)可以对本票人对原始保证人(如买方)对第三方受益人(如债权人)提出任何抗辩。

但是没有迹象表明买方对债务人有可以在此情况下对债权人提出的抗辩。

(选择D)买方向债权人支付2,000美元的承诺并没有使无法收回的债务复活——即债权人向债务人收取2,000美元的诉讼仍将受到适用的诉讼时效限制。

学习要点：

第三方受益人是从合同中获得某种好处或利益的非当事方,但只有预期受益人才享有合同权利,并可以起诉强制执行这些权利。

参考资料

• 17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts §426(2020年)(意向受益人与附带受益人对照)。

• 重述(第二份)合同第302条(1981年《安曼法律》)(意向受益人和附带受益人)。

stem: A builder borrowed $10,000 from a lender to finance a small construction job under a contract with a homeowner. The builder gave the lender a writing that stated, "Any money I receive from the homeowner will be paid immediately to the lender, regardless of any demands from other creditors." The builder died after completing the job but before the homeowner paid. The lender demanded that the homeowner pay the $10,000 due to the builder directly to the lender. The homeowner refused, saying that he would pay directly to the builder's estate everything that he owed the builder.
stemZh: 建房人向贷款人借款1万美元,根据与房主签订的合同,为小型建设工作融资.建房人给出贷人写了一封信,写道"我从房主那里得到的任何钱,无论其他债权人有何要求,都会立即付给出贷人",建房人完成工作后却在房主支付之前死亡.贷款人要求房主直接向贷款人支付欠建房人的1万美元,房主拒绝,表示将直接向建房人的财产支付欠建房人的一切款项.
ask: Is the lender likely to succeed in an action against the homeowner for $10,000?
askZh: 贷款人能否以10 000美元成功起诉房主?

options.en: No, because the builder's death terminated the lender's right to receive payment directly from the homeowner.
options.zh: 不,因为建筑商的死终止了贷款人直接从房主那里收取款项的权利.

options.en: No, because the writing the builder gave to the lender did not transfer to the lender the right to receive payment from the homeowner.
options.zh: 不,因为建筑商给予出贷人的书面文件没有向出贷人转让收取房主付款的权利。

options.en: Yes, because the builder had manifested an intent that the homeowner pay the $10,000 directly to the lender.
options.zh: 是的,因为建筑商已经表明 有意让房主直接向贷款人支付一万美元。

options.en: Yes, because the lender is an intended beneficiary of the builder-homeowner contract.
options.zh: 是的,因为出贷人是建筑商-业主合同的预期受益人。

explanation.en:
Assignment of contractual rights

Limitations • Assignment permitted unless it: – materially increases obligor's contractual duties or risks – materially reduces obligor's chance of obtaining performance or – is void (not merely prohibited) under contract provision Requirements • Present intent to immediately assign right

• Consideration generally required to make assignment irrevocable – Exceptions: promissory estoppel, delivery of document symbolizing assigned right (eg, stock certificate), delivery of written & signed assignment Assignee's rights

• Assumes all of assignor's rights as contract stands at time of assignment, subject to claims/defenses that: – accrued before obligor received notice of assignment or – stem from assignor's present or future failure to perform

• Assignor loses rights & therefore cannot enforce contract An assignment is the transfer of rights under a contract to another (ie, assignee). No formalities are needed for an assignment, but there must be a present intent to transfer the rights immediately. A party's promise to pay money received pursuant to a contract to a third party is not an assignment of the party's contractual rights, but a promise of future payment. Therefore, the third party in that situation is not an assignee.

Here, the builder promised to pay the lender the $10,000 the builder received from the homeowner pursuant to the builder-homeowner contract. This promise of future payment was not an assignment and therefore did not transfer to the lender the right to receive payment directly from the homeowner. As a result, the lender is unlikely to succeed in an action against the homeowner for $10,000.

(Choice A) A gratuitous assignment (ie, one that is not supported by consideration) is automatically revoked upon the death, incapacity, or bankruptcy of the assignor. But no valid assignment occurred here, so the builder's death is irrelevant.

(Choice C) Regardless of the builder's subjective intent, the lender was not an assignee and therefore has no right to receive the $10,000 payment directly from the homeowner.

(Choice D) The lender was not an intended beneficiary of the builder-homeowner contract because the contract did not provide that the homeowner would pay the $10,000 directly to the lender.

Educational objective:

A party's promise to pay money received pursuant to a contract to a third party is not an assignment of the party's contractual rights, but a promise of future payment.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 321 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (assignment of future rights).

explanation.zh:
合同权利的转让

• 允许转让,除非:在实质上增加承付人的合同义务或风险,在实质上减少承付人获得履约的机会,或根据合同规定,转让无效(不仅仅是禁止)。立即转让右侧

• 一般需要对价使转让不可撤销 -- -- 例外:本票不容反悔、送交象征所转让权利的文件(例如库存证书)、送交书面转让和签字转让

• 假定转让人作为合同的所有权利在转让时都存在,但有下列权利要求/抗辩:在承付人收到转让通知之前产生的,或转让人目前或今后不履行义务造成的。

• 转让人丧失权利,因此不能强制执行合同与另一人(即受让人)订立的合同。转让不需要任何手续,但必须存在转移该转让的现意。权利立即。一方当事人承诺向第三方支付根据合同收到的款项,不是转让该方的合同权利,而是承诺未来付款,因此,在这种情况下的第三方不是受让人。

在此,建筑商承诺向贷款人支付建筑商根据建筑商-屋主合同从房主那里得到的10 000美元。这种未来付款的承诺不是转让,因此没有将直接从房主那里收取款项的权利转让给出贷人,因此,出贷人不可能成功地对房主提起1万美元的诉讼。

(Choice A) 无偿的转让(即未经对价支持的转让)在转让人死亡、丧失行为能力或破产时自动被取消。 但此处没有发生有效的转让,因此建造人的死亡无关紧要。

(C选择)无论建筑商的主观意图如何,出贷人都不是受让人,因此无权直接从房主那里收取1万美元的付款。

(Choice D) 出贷人不是建造人-房主合同的预期受益人,因为合同没有规定房主直接向出贷人支付10 000美元。

学习要点：

当事人承诺向第三方支付根据合同收到的款项,不是转让当事人的合同权利,而是承诺未来付款。

参考资料

• 重述(第二)合同第321条(1981年《普通法》)(未来权利的转让)。

stem:
For several weeks, a buyer's agent and an aircraft salesperson negotiated over the purchase price of a plane. After agreeing to a purchase price of $250,000, the agent signed a written contract to purchase the plane on behalf of the buyer. The contract contained a merger clause and called for a $10,000 deposit that the aircraft company could retain as liquidated damages if the buyer failed to accept delivery of the plane. The agent gave the salesperson a check for $10,000.

The buyer subsequently refused to accept delivery of the plane. The aircraft company tried to deposit the check pursuant to the liquidated damages provision, but the agent had issued a stop-payment order. The aircraft company sued the buyer to recover the $10,000. The buyer has offered the agent's testimony that the salesperson orally agreed during their negotiations that the deal would not be finalized until the buyer's wife approved it, which she did not.
stemZh:
几周来,买方的代理人和飞机销售员就飞机的购买价进行了谈判,在同意25万美元的购买价之后,代理人代表买方签署了购买飞机的书面合同。合同载有一项合并条款,要求飞机公司在买方未接受飞机交货时可保留1万美元的押金作为违约赔偿金,代理人向售货员开具了1万美元的支票。

买方随后拒绝接受飞机交货,飞机公司试图根据违约赔偿金规定交存支票,但代理公司已发出停付令,飞机公司起诉买方收回1万美元。买方提供了代理商的证词,即销售商在谈判期间口头同意,在买方妻子批准之前,交易不会最终完成,但她没有同意。
ask: Should the court admit this testimony?
askZh: 法庭应该承认这个证词吗?

options.en: No, because the merger clause bars any evidence of the parties' prior discussions concerning the sale of the plane.
options.zh: 不,因为合并条款禁止任何证据,说明当事方先前就飞机的销售进行的讨论。

options.en: No, because the testimony contradicts the writing by making the parties' duties conditional.
options.zh: 不,因为证词与书面内容相矛盾,使当事人的义务成为有条件的.

options.en: Yes, because the parol evidence rule does not bar the introduction of evidence for the purpose of showing that no contract was formed.
options.zh: 是的,因为parol证据规则并不禁止为证明没有订立合同而提出证据。

options.en: Yes, but only for the purpose of proving that the written contract was only partially integrated.
options.zh: 是的,但只是为了证明书面合同只是部分合并。

explanation.en:
A written contract that contains a merger clause is presumed to be a complete integration—ie, a complete and final expression of the parties' agreement as to all of the terms. As a result, the parol evidence rule bars evidence of prior or contemporaneous communications that supplement or contradict the writing. However, the parol evidence rule does not apply to evidence offered to prove that no contract was formed— eg, because there was a condition precedent to the existence of the contract that failed to occur.

Here, the agent signed a written contract to buy the plane on the buyer's behalf. The contract contained a merger clause, which ordinarily would bar any evidence of the parties' prior discussions concerning the sale. However, the agent's testimony shows that the parties agreed that the deal would not be finalized until the buyer's wife approved it—a condition precedent to the existence of the contract. Therefore, the court should admit the testimony to show that no contract was formed because the buyer's wife did not approve the contract (Choice A).

(Choice B) Even if the testimony contradicts the writing by making the parties' duties conditional, the testimony is not barred by the parol evidence rule since it is offered to prove that no contract was formed.

(Choice D) Although the merger clause creates a presumption that the agreement was completely integrated, this presumption can be rebutted with evidence that the agreement was only partially integrated—ie, a final expression as to some (but not all) of the terms. As a result, the agent's testimony is admissible for that purpose. But it is also admissible to prove that the written contract never came into being because a condition precedent failed to occur.

Educational objective:

The parol evidence rule bars evidence of prior or contemporaneous communications that supplement or contradict the terms of a contract that is completely integrated (eg, as evidenced by a merger clause). But this rule does not apply to evidence offered to prove that no contract was formed.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 214 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (exceptions to parol evidence rule).

explanation.zh:
载有合并条款的书面合同被推定为完全的一体化——即完全和最后地表达了当事方对所有条款的协议。因此,parol证据规则将先前或当时的通信证据作为补充或与书面内容相矛盾的证据。但是,parol证据规则不适用于为证明没有订立合同而提供的证据——例如,因为存在合同没有发生的前提条件。

在此,代理商签署了一份代表买方购买飞机的书面合同,合同中包含一项合并条款,这通常会排除当事人先前有关出售的讨论的任何证据。然而,代理人的证言表明,双方当事人同意在买方妻子批准后才能完成交易,这是合同存在的一个先决条件。因此,法院应当承认这些证词,以表明没有订立合同,因为买方的妻子没有批准合同(Choice A)。

(Choice B)即使证词与书面内容相矛盾,使当事人的义务成为有条件的,证词也不受到parol证据规则的禁止,因为提供证据是为了证明没有订立合同。

(Choice D) 虽然合并条款推定协议是完全一体化的,但这种推定可以被证明协议只是部分一体化的证据所反驳——即对部分(但不是全部)条款的最后表述。因此,为此目的,代理人的证词是可以接受的,但也可以证明书面合同从未订立,因为一个条件先例没有出现。

学习要点：

parol证据规则排除了先前或当时通信补充或违背完全一体化的合同条款的证据(例如,合并条款所证明)。但这一规则不适用于为证明未订立合同而提供的证据。

参考资料

• 重述(第二)第214条(1981年《美国法律》)(证据规则的例外)。

stem: An actor straight out of drama school and an agent entered into a one-year written contract that described the services the agent would provide. Because he was eager for work, the actor agreed, in the contract, to pay the agent 15% of his yearly earnings. At the end of the year, the actor was so pleased with his many roles that he gave the agent 20% of his earnings. After the first contract had expired, the actor and the agent decided to continue working together. They photocopied their old contract, changed the date, and signed it. At the end of the year, a dispute arose as to what percentage of earnings the actor owed. It is a trade practice in the acting profession for actors to pay their agents 10% of their yearly earnings, payable at the end of the year.
stemZh: 一名演员直接从戏剧学校毕业,一名经纪人签订了一份一年的书面合同,其中描述了经纪人将提供的服务。 由于他渴望工作,演员在合同中同意支付经纪人每年收入的15%。年末,演员对自己的众多角色感到非常满意,将20%的收入给了经纪人,在第一份合同到期后,演员和经纪人决定继续合作.他们复制了旧合同,更改了日期,并签署了合同。 年底,在演员欠下多少收入的问题上产生了争议。演员行业的一种行业做法是支付其代理人每年收入的10%,到年底支付。
ask: What percentage of the actor's earnings is a court most likely to award the agent?
askZh: 法院最有可能判给代理人的是演员收入的多少百分比?

options.en: 20%, because course of dealing is given greater weight than trade usage.
options.zh: 20%,因为交易过程比贸易惯例更受重视.

options.en: 15%, because it was an express term of the contract.
options.zh: 15%,因为这是合同的一个明确条款。

options.en: 10%, because trade usage is the applicable default rule.
options.zh: 10%,因为贸易惯例是适用的缺省规则.

options.en: Nothing, because the contract is too indefinite.
options.zh: 没什么 因为合同太无限期了

explanation.en:
Course of performance, course of dealing & trade usage

Course of performance

Sequence of conduct that is relevant to understanding agreement between parties if:

• agreement involves repeated occasions for performance by one party AND

• other party accepts performance without objection Course of dealing

Sequence of conduct concerning previous transactions between parties that establishes common basis of understanding for interpreting their conduct

Trade usage Practice or method of dealing in parties' business or industry that is observed with enough regularity to justify expectation that it will be observed in instant case

Courts adhere to rules of construction when interpreting contracts. The purpose of these rules is to assist the court in determining the meaning of ambiguous terms. Evidence relevant to this determination includes the contract's express terms, the parties' course of performance, the parties' course of dealing, and the industry's trade usage. When these are inconsistent with one another, priority is given as follows:

1. Express terms 2. Course of performance 3. Course of dealing 4. Trade usage Here, the second contract executed by the actor and the agent expressly stated that the agent would receive 15% of the actor's yearly earnings. Although the actor gave 20% of his yearly earnings to the agent when the first contract ended, this was not a course of dealing between the parties because it occurred only once (Choice A). And even though the acting profession's practice is to pay agents 10% of yearly earnings, an express term is given greater weight than trade usage when they are inconsistent. Therefore, a court will likely award the agent 15% (Choice C).

(Choice D) A contract may be void if certain essential terms (eg, subject matter, consideration, duration) are indefinite. But here, the essential terms of the contract were not indefinite—ie, the subject matter was the agent's services, the consideration was 15% of the actor's yearly earnings, and the duration was one year.

Educational objective:

In interpreting contracts, (1) express terms prevail over all others, (2) course of performance prevails over course of dealing and trade usage, and (3) course of dealing prevails over trade usage.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 203 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (rules of construction to interpret a contract).

explanation.zh:
履约过程、交易和贸易使用过程

课程

与理解当事方之间协议有关的行为顺序,如果:

• 协议涉及一方当事人一再履行的情况;

• 另一方接受履约而无异议

当事人之间以往交易的行为顺序为解释其行为建立共同的理解基础;

在当事人的工商业中,如果遵守的做法或处理方法具有足够的规律性,因而有理由期望在本案中遵守这种做法

法院在解释合同时遵守建筑规则,这些规则的目的是协助法院确定含糊不清的术语的含义。与这一确定有关的证据包括合同的明确条款、当事人的路线履约情况、当事人的交易过程和行业的贸易习惯。如果两者不一致,则优先考虑如下:

1. 明示条款 2. 履行过程 3. 交易过程 4. 交易习惯 此处,行为者和代理人执行的第二份合同明确规定,代理人将获得行为者年收入的15%.虽然演员在第一份合同结束时将其年收入的20%交给代理人,但这不是当事人之间的交易过程,因为它只发生一次(Choice A)。尽管演员行业的做法是支付代理商的年收入的10%,但当交易方式不一致时,一个明确术语比交易用法更受重视。 因此,法院可能会判给代理商的15%(选择C ) 。

(选择D)如果某些基本条款(如主题、对价、期限)是无限期的,合同可能无效。但在这里,合同的基本条件不是无限期的,问题在于代理人的服务,考虑的是演员年收入的15%,期限是一年。

学习要点：

在解释合同时,(1)明确条款优先于所有其他条款,(2)履约过程优先于交易过程和贸易惯例,(3)交易过程优先于贸易惯例。

参考资料

• 重述(第二)合同第203条(1981年《安曼法律》)(解释合同的建筑规则)。

stem:
A real estate developer solicited bids from general contractors to build residences on 50 lots owned by the developer. A general contractor, in turn, solicited bids from subcontractors for the various aspects of the construction process. A company submitted a bid of $1 million for performing the electrical work. This bid was based on a careless omission of the cost of an electrical component called for in the specifications prepared by the developer. The other bids received by the general contractor for the electrical work ranged from $1.25 million to $1.3 million, which were in line with the general contractor's own estimate for the electrical work. The general contractor used the company's bid of $1 million for performing the electrical work in submitting its bid to the developer.

After the general contractor's bid was accepted by the developer and the general contractor, in turn, accepted the company's bid, but before any work on the residences began, the company discovered its error. Although the company will make no profit from the job instead of the $100,000 profit it would have made had it correctly read the specifications, enforcement of its contract with the general contractor would not be unconscionable.
stemZh:
一个房地产开发商向一般承包商招标,要求他们按开发商拥有的50块地建造住宅,然后向分包商招标建筑过程的各个方面。一家公司为完成电气工程投标100万美元,该投标所依据的是开发商编制的规格中要求的电元件成本的疏忽。一般承包商收到的其他电工投标从125万美元到130万美元不等,这符合一般承包商自己对电工的估计。总承包商在向开发商提交标书时,使用了该公司100万美元的报价来完成电气工程。

在总承包商的出价被开发商接受后,总承包商又接受了公司的出价,但在住宅的任何工程开始之前,公司发现了自己的错误.虽然该公司不会从这份工作中获得利润,而不会从它如果正确阅读规格本会得到的10万美元的利润中获利,但执行它与总承包商的合同并非不合理。
ask: Is it likely that the company can avoid the contract?
askZh: 公司是否可能撤销合同?

options.en: No, because the company's bid was based on its own carelessness in computing its bid.
options.zh: 不,因为公司的出价 是基于自己在计算其出价时的粗心大意

options.en: No, because the enforcement of the contract would not be unconscionable.
options.zh: 不,因为执行合同并非不合理。

options.en: Yes, because the general contractor had reason to know of the mistake.
options.zh: 是的,因为总承包商有理由知道这个错误。

options.en: Yes, because there was a misunderstanding that prevented the formation of the contract.
options.zh: 是的,因为存在一种误解,妨碍了合同的订立。

explanation.en:
A valid contract is generally formed when a mutual agreement is supported by adequate consideration, such as when the general contractor accepted the company's bid of $1 million for performing the electrical work. Although the company omitted the cost of an item when computing its bid, its unilateral mistake is not grounds to avoid the contract unless:

• the mistake would make enforcement of the contract against the nonmistaken party unconscionable (eg, due to a substantial difference between contract price and actual value) or

• the nonmistaken party caused, or knew or had reason to know of, the mistake.

Here, the facts stipulate that enforcement of the contract would not be unconscionable

(Choice B). But the other bids received by the general contractor ranged from $1.25 million to $1.3 million—a 25% to 30% discrepancy from the company's bid. Since the other bids were in line with the general contractor's own estimate for the electrical work, the general contractor had reason to know that the company's $1 million bid was based on a mistake. As a result, the company can likely avoid the contract.

(Choice A) The mistaken party's negligence with regard to its mistake (eg, the company's careless computing of its bid) does not prevent that party from avoiding the contract.

(Choice D) A misunderstanding occurs when the parties attach different meanings to the same material term (eg, price). Here, the erroneous $1 million bid did not create a misunderstanding that would prevent contract formation since "$1 million" has just one meaning.

Educational objective:

Unilateral mistake is not grounds to avoid a contract unless (1) the mistake would make enforcement of the contract unconscionable or (2) the nonmistaken party caused, or knew or had reason to know of, the mistake.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 153 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when unilateral mistake makes a contract voidable).

explanation.zh:
一项有效的合同一般是在相互协议得到充分对价支持的情况下形成的,例如,总承包商接受了该公司为完成电气工程提出的100万美元的报价。虽然该公司在计算出价时省略了某一项目的成本,但其单方面错误不是宣告合同无效的理由,除非:

• 错误将使对非被监视的当事方执行合同不合理(例如,由于合同价格和实际价值之间的重大差异)或

· 非被监视的一方造成或知道或有理由知道错误。

在这方面,事实表明,执行合同并非不合理。

(Choice B). 但总承包商收到的其他投标从125万美元到130万美元不等,与公司的投标相差25%到30%。由于其他投标符合总承包商自己对电气工程的估计,总承包商有理由知道该公司100万美元的投标是建立在错误基础上的,因此,该公司有可能撤销合同。

(Choice A)错误的当事人对其错误的疏忽(如公司对其出价的粗心大意计算)并不妨碍该当事人撤销合同.

(Choice D) 当双方对同一个物质术语(如价格)附加不同的含义时,就会产生误解. 在此,错误的100万美元出价并没有造成会妨碍合同订立的误解,因为"100万美元"只有一个意义.

学习要点：

单方面错误不是宣告合同无效的理由,除非(1)该错误将使合同的执行不合理,或者(2)非当事一方造成或知道或有理由知道错误。

参考资料

• 重述(第二次)合同第153条(1981年《美国法律》)(当单方面错误使合同无效时)。

stem:
A landowner advertised a proposed sale of standing timber on a choice 2,000-acre tract. A construction enterprise offered a fair price for the timber rights in question. The landowner accepted the offer and the parties entered into a written contract.

Later, without legal excuse and over the landowner's strong objection, the construction enterprise repudiated the contract before commencing performance. The landowner could not afford to hire a lawyer and take legal action, and he made no attempt to assign any cause of action he might have had against the construction enterprise.

If the construction enterprise is sued for breach of the contract by the landowner's next-door neighbor, whose view of a nearby lake is obscured by the standing timber, will the
stemZh:
一个土地所有者在2000英亩的土地上公布了出售固定木材的要约,一个建筑企业对有关木材权利提供了公平的价格,土地所有者接受了这一要约,双方签订了一份书面合同。

后来,在没有法律借口的情况下,由于地主的强烈反对,建筑企业在开始履行合同前就取消了合同.土地所有者无力聘请律师和采取法律行动,他也没有试图指定他可能对建筑企业提起的任何诉讼。

如果建筑企业因地主的隔壁邻居违反合同而被起诉,而隔壁邻居对附近湖泊的看法被站立的木材所掩盖,那么该建筑企业是否将:
ask: neighbor prevail?
askZh: 邻居占上风?

options.en: No, because the neighbor is a maintainer of nuisance litigation.
options.zh: 不 因为邻居是骚扰诉讼的维护者

options.en: No, because the neighbor is only an incidental beneficiary, if any, of the contract.
options.zh: 不,因为邻居只是合同的附带受益人,如果有的话。

options.en: Yes, because the neighbor is a surrogate for the landowner in view of his inability to enforce the contract.
options.zh: 是的,因为邻居是地主的代孕人 因为他无法执行合同

options.en: Yes, because the neighbor is a third-party intended beneficiary of the contract.
options.zh: 是的,因为邻居是合同的第三方预期受益人。

explanation.en:
A third-party beneficiary is a nonparty to a contract who receives some advantage or benefit from that contract. Unlike intended beneficiaries, incidental beneficiaries—ie, those whom the contracting parties did not intend to benefit directly—have no right to sue under the contract.

Here, the neighbor is at most an incidental beneficiary of the contract between the landowner and the construction enterprise since there was no contractual intent to benefit the neighbor (eg, improve the neighbor's view of the lake). As an incidental beneficiary, the neighbor has no right to sue under the contract. Therefore, the neighbor will not prevail in a breach-of-contract suit against the construction enterprise (Choice D).

(Choice A) The neighbor would not be accused of maintaining nuisance litigation (ie, bringing a bad-faith claim to harass someone) since the neighbor presumably believed (incorrectly) that he/she had the right to enforce the contract.

(Choice C) A surrogate is one who acts on behalf of another party. But here, the neighbor has no right under the contract or otherwise to enforce the contract on the landowner's behalf.

Educational objective:

An incidental beneficiary—ie, a nonparty to a contract who receives some advantage or benefit from that contract even though the contracting parties did not intend to benefit him/her—has no right to sue under the contract.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 302 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (intended & incidental beneficiaries).

explanation.zh:
第三方受益人是指从合同中获得一定好处或从中受益的非合同当事人。与预期受益人不同的是,附带受益人——即缔约方无意直接受益的受益人——无权根据合同提起诉讼。

在这里,邻居充其量是地主与建筑企业合同的附带受益人,因为没有合同意向让邻居受益(例如,改善邻居对湖的视野).作为附带受益人,邻居无权根据合同提起诉讼,因此邻居不会在针对建筑企业的违约诉讼(Choice D)中胜诉.

(Choice A)邻居不会被指控维持骚扰诉讼(即提出恶意骚扰某人的主张),因为邻居大概(不正确)认为他/她有权执行合同.

(Choice C) 代孕者是代表另一方行事的代孕者,但在这里,邻居无权根据合同或其他方式代表地主执行合同.

学习要点：

附带受益人,即从合同中获得某种好处或从合同中受益的非合同当事方,即使合同当事方无意为他/她谋取好处,也无权根据合同提起诉讼。

参考资料

• 重述(第二份)合同第302条(1981年《安曼法律》)(意向和附带受益人)。
