stem: Before putting her home up for sale, a homeowner painted the living room ceiling to conceal major water damage caused by a leaking roof that had not yet been repaired. On the first day the home was offered for sale, the homeowner gave a buyer a personal tour. The homeowner made no statements at all regarding the water damage or the roof. Without discovering the water damage or the leaking roof and without consulting a lawyer, the buyer immediately agreed in writing to buy the home for $200,000. Before the closing date, the buyer discovered the water damage and the leaking roof. The cost of repair was estimated at $22,000. The buyer has refused to go through with the purchase.
stemZh: 在将她送回家出售之前,一位房主涂上了客厅天花板,以掩盖一个尚未修复的漏水屋顶造成的重大水毁,在住房被出售的第一天,房主给一位买主进行了一次个人巡视。房主根本没有就水损坏或屋顶作出任何陈述,没有发现水损坏或屋顶漏水,也没有咨询律师,买方立即书面同意以20万美元的价格购买房屋。在关闭日期之前,买方发现了水损坏和漏水的屋顶,修复费用估计为22 000美元,买方拒绝购买。
ask: If the homeowner sues the buyer for breach of contract, is the homeowner likely to prevail?
askZh: 如果房主起诉买主违约,房主是否可能优先?

options.en: No, because no contract was formed since the buyer did not have a real opportunity to understand the essential terms of the contract.
options.zh: 不,因为买方没有真正的机会理解合同的基本条款,所以没有订立合同。

options.en: No, because the homeowner concealed evidence of the water damage and of the leaking roof.
options.zh: 没有,因为房主隐瞒了 水损坏的证据 和漏水的屋顶。

options.en: Yes, because the buyer acted unreasonably by failing to employ an inspector to conduct an independent inspection of the home.
options.zh: 是的,因为买方没有雇用一名检查员对住宅进行独立检查,因而行为不合理。

options.en: Yes, because the homeowner made no affirmative statements of fact about the water damage or the leaking roof.
options.zh: 是的,因为房主没有 肯定的事实陈述 关于水损坏 或泄漏屋顶。

explanation.en:
When reliance on misrepresentation is justified

Fact

(almost always justified)

If untrue assertion is presented as fact, party's reliance justified unless:

• assertion is patently false or

• party knows assertion is false Opinion*

(rarely justified)

If untrue assertion is presented as opinion, party's reliance justified only if:

• facts as speaker understands them are consistent with or justify opinion

• relationship of trust & confidence exists

• party reasonably believes speaker has special expertise or

• party is particularly susceptible to type of misrepresentation involved *A statement of opinion is also a statement of fact—and can therefore be a misrepresentation—because it states that a person has a particular state of mind.

Misrepresentation is an untrue assertion of fact made by words or conduct (eg, concealment—an act intended to prevent discovery of facts). When this occurs, a contract is voidable by the adversely affected party if:

• the misrepresentation was fraudulent (ie, made knowingly or recklessly with intent to induce the other party's assent to the contract) OR material (ie, likely to induce a reasonable person's assent)

• the misrepresentation induced assent to the contract and

• the adversely affected party justifiably relied on the misrepresentation. Here, the homeowner painted the living room ceiling to conceal water damage and a leaking roof. As a result of this fraudulent misrepresentation, the buyer decided to purchase the home. And since the homeowner never mentioned the water damage or roof during the personal tour, the buyer justifiably relied on the misrepresentation. Therefore, the buyer can avoid the contract and the homeowner is unlikely to prevail.

(Choice A) No contract is formed (ie, the apparent contract is void) if a fraudulent misrepresentation prevents a party from knowing the character or essential terms of the transaction and the party did not have a reasonable opportunity to understand those terms. But there is no evidence that the buyer did not understand the essential terms of the contract here.

(Choice C) A party's reliance on a misrepresentation is justified unless the misrepresentation is patently false (eg, if the water damage was visible) or the party knows it to be false. Therefore, the buyer's failure to inspect the home does not bar relief.

(Choice D) An affirmative statement is not required for a misrepresentation to occur. Affirmative conduct intended to prevent another from discovering a fact (eg, concealment) also qualifies as a misrepresentation.

Educational objective:

A contract is voidable for misrepresentation if (1) the misrepresentation was fraudulent or material, (2) it induced assent to the contract, and (3) the adversely affected party justifiably relied on the misrepresentation.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 164 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when misrepresentation makes a contract voidable).

explanation.zh:
有理由依赖虚报

事实

(几乎总是有道理的)

如果提出不真实的主张是事实,则当事人的依赖是合理的,除非:

• 断言明显不实或

• 当事方知道断言是虚假意见*

(无正当理由)

如果以不实之词作为意见提出,则当事人的依赖只有在下列情况下才有正当理由:

• 发言者理解的事实与意见一致或有正当理由

• 存在信任和信心关系

• 当事人有理由相信发言者具有特殊的专门知识,或

· 当事方特别容易受到所涉类型的不实陈述的伤害。 * 意见陈述也是对事实的陈述,因此可能是一种不实陈述,因为它表明一个人具有某种精神状态。

错误陈述是言语或行为(例如,隐瞒行为)对事实的不实断言。目的是防止发现事实。发生下列情况之一的,受害方可以撤销合同:

• 虚假陈述是欺诈性的(故意或轻率地作出,意图促使另一方同意合同)或材料(即有可能促使有理智的人同意)

• 虚假陈述导致同意合同;

• 受害方有理由依赖虚假陈述,屋主在客厅天花板上涂上遮盖水损坏和漏水的屋顶,由于这种虚假陈述,买方决定购买住房。由于房主在个人参观期间从未提到过水损坏或屋顶,买方有理由依赖错误的说法。 因此,买方可以宣告合同无效,房主不太可能胜诉。

(选择A) 如果欺诈性虚假陈述使一方当事人无法了解交易的性质或基本条件,且当事人没有合理机会理解这些条件,则未订立合同(即表面合同无效)。但没有任何证据表明买方不了解合同的基本条款。

(C选择)一方对虚假陈述的依赖是正当的,除非该虚假陈述是明显虚假的(例如,如果水损害是明显的),或者该方知道其是虚假的,因此,买方未能检查住宅并不妨碍救济。

(Choice D) 假说不需要肯定声明。 旨在防止他人发现一个事实(如隐瞒)的肯定行为也属于假说。

学习要点：

如果(1) 虚假陈述是欺诈或重大内容,(2) 导致同意合同,(3) 受到不利影响的当事人有理由依赖虚假陈述,则合同因虚假陈述而无效。

参考资料

• 重述(第二次)合同第164条(1981年《美国法律》)(如果错误陈述使合同可以无效)。

stem: The owner of a fleet of taxis contracted with a dealer in petroleum products for the purchase and sale of the fleet owner's total requirements of gasoline and oil for one year. As part of that agreement, the petroleum dealer also agreed with the fleet owner that for one year the petroleum dealer would place all his advertising with the fleet owner's wife, who owned her own small advertising agency. When the wife was informed of the contract, she declined to accept an advertising account from another company because she could not handle both accounts during the same year. The fleet owner performed his contract with the petroleum dealer for six months, and during that time the petroleum dealer placed his advertising with the wife. At the end of the six months, the fleet owner and the wife were divorced, and the fleet owner then told the petroleum dealer that he had no further obligation to place his advertising with the fleet owner's now ex-wife. The petroleum dealer thereupon notified the ex-wife that he would no longer place his advertising with her.
stemZh: 与石油产品经销商签订合同的出租车车队所有人购买和销售车队所有人一年汽油和石油的总需求。作为该协定的一部分,石油经销商还同意船队所有人的意见,即一年之内,石油经销商将把所有广告都寄给船队所有人的妻子,后者拥有自己的小型广告代理。当妻子被告知合同时,她拒绝接受另一家公司的广告账户,因为她在同一年无法处理这两个账户。船队业主与石油商履行合同六个月,在此期间,石油商向妻子投放广告。6个月后,舰队老板和妻子离婚,舰队老板随后告诉石油商,他不再有义务将自己的广告投放到舰队老板现在的前妻身上.石油经销商随即通知前妻,他不再向她发布广告。
ask: In an action by the wife against the petroleum dealer for breach of contract, will the wife likely succeed?
askZh: 在妻子对石油商违反合同的诉讼中,妻子可能胜诉吗?

options.en: No, because absent a provision in the contract to the contrary, the promisor and promisee of a third-party beneficiary contract retain by law the right to modify or terminate the contract.
options.zh: 不,因为合同中没有相反的规定,第三方受益人合同的抵押人和保证人依法保留修改或终止合同的权利。

options.en: No, because the agency relationship, if any, between the fleet owner and the wife terminated upon their divorce.
options.zh: 不 因为船队老板和妻子之间的代理关系 离婚后就终止了

options.en: Yes, because the fleet owner acted in bad faith in releasing the petroleum dealer from his duty with respect to the fleet owner's wife.
options.zh: 是的,因为船队老板不诚实地 解除了石油商对船队老板妻子的责任

options.en: Yes, because the petroleum dealer and the fleet owner could not, without the wife's consent, modify their contract so as to discharge the petroleum dealer's duties to the wife.
options.zh: 是的,因为未经妻子同意,石油商和船队所有人不能修改合同,以便履行石油商对妻子的责任。

explanation.en:
Third-party beneficiaries

(ie, nonparties who benefit from contract)

Type Definition Right to enforce

Intended • Receive direct benefit from contract because contracting parties intended to benefit them

• Eg, A promises to paint B's house if B promises to pay $500 to C

Yes

Incidental • Receive indirect benefit from contract even though there was no contractual intent to benefit them

• Eg, A promises to buy B a car manufactured by C

No

A third-party beneficiary is a nonparty to a contract who receives some advantage or benefit from that contract. If the contracting parties intended for the contract to benefit the third party, the third party is an intended beneficiary. Only intended (not incidental) beneficiaries have enforceable rights under the contract. Those rights vest when the beneficiary:

• detrimentally relies on the rights created

• manifests assent to the contract at one party's request or

• files a lawsuit to enforce the contract. Once this occurs, the original contracting parties are both bound to perform the contract. Any effort to rescind or modify the contract after vesting is void unless the beneficiary agrees to the rescission or modification.

Here, the wife was an intended beneficiary of the contract between the fleet owner and the petroleum dealer because the contract provided that the petroleum dealer would use the wife's advertising agency for a year. The wife detrimentally relied on the contract when she declined another account because she could not handle two accounts at the same time— vesting her rights. As a result, she will likely succeed because the fleet owner cannot rescind (ie, cancel) or modify the contract without the now ex-wife's consent (Choice A).

(Choice B) The fleet owner was not acting as an agent for the wife because she did not direct him to enter into the contract on her behalf. Instead, the wife was an intended beneficiary of the contract, and her consent was required to modify the contract— regardless of the divorce proceeding.

(Choice C) Because the wife's contractual rights had vested, the fleet owner could not in good or bad faith release the petroleum dealer from his duty with respect to the wife.

Educational objective:

An intended beneficiary's contractual rights vest when the beneficiary (1) detrimentally relies on the rights created, (2) manifests assent to the contract, or (3) files a lawsuit to enforce it. Any effort to rescind or modify the contract after vesting is void unless the beneficiary agrees to the rescission or modification.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 302 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (intended and incidental beneficiaries).

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 311 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (variation of a duty to a beneficiary).

explanation.zh:
第三方受益人

(即从合同中受益的非当事人)

类型 定义 强制执行的权利

• 直接受益于合同,因为订约方打算从中受益

• 例如,A承诺,如果B承诺向C支付500美元,就画B的房子

对

• 尽管没有合同意向,但从合同中获得间接利益让他们受益

• 例如,A承诺购买C制造的汽车B

没有

第三方受益人是指从合同中获得某种好处或从合同中受益的非合同当事人,如果合同当事人打算使合同惠及第三方,则第三方为预期受益人。只有预期的(而非偶然的)受益人才能根据合同享有可执行的权利。

• 有害地依赖所创造的权利

• 应一方当事人的请求表明同意合同,或

• 为执行合同提起诉讼,一旦发生这种情况,原始合同双方均有义务履行合同,任何在背书后撤销或修改合同的努力均属无效,除非受益人同意撤销或修改合同。

在此,妻子是船队所有人与石油经销商之间合同的预期受益人,因为合同规定石油经销商使用妻子的广告代理一年。妻子拒绝了另一个账户,因为她不能同时处理两个账户——赋予她权利——而不利地依赖合同。因此,她很可能会成功,因为船队所有人未经现在的前妻同意不能撤销(ie,取消)或修改合同(Choice A).

(Choice B) 舰队老板没有代理妻子,因为她没有指示他代表她签订合同.相反,妻子是合同的预期受益人,修改合同必须征得其同意——无论离婚程序如何。

(C选择)由于妻子的合同权利已经获得,船队所有人不能善意地解除石油商对妻子的责任。

学习要点：

如果受益人(1) 不利地依赖所设定的权利,(2) 表明同意合同,或(3) 提起诉讼强制执行合同,则预期受益人的合同权利背书。背书后撤销或修改合同的任何努力均属无效,除非受益人同意撤销或修改合同。

参考资料

• 重述(第二份)合同第302条(1981年《安曼法律》)(意向受益人和附带受益人)。

• 重述(第二)合同第311条(1981年《普通法》)(对受益人义务的变动)。

stem: A buyer and a seller entered into a written contract for the sale of a copy machine, using the same form contract that they had used a number of times in the past. The contract stated that payment was due 30 days after delivery and provided that the writing contained the complete and exclusive statement of the parties' agreement. On several past occasions, the buyer had taken a 5% discount from the contract price when paying within 10 days of delivery, and the seller had not objected. On this occasion, when the buyer took a 5% discount for paying within 10 days, the seller objected because his profit margin on this particular machine was smaller than on his other machines.
stemZh: 买方和卖方订立了销售复制机的书面合同,使用与以往多次使用相同的形式合同。合同规定,应在交货后30天付款,但书面必须载有双方当事人协议的完整和排他性声明。过去几次,买方在交货后10天内付款时从合同价格中扣除了5%的折扣,卖方没有提出异议。在此情况下,买方在10天内支付了5%的折扣,卖方表示反对,因为他在这一机器上的利润率比其他机器小。
ask: If the seller sues the buyer for breach of contract, may the buyer introduce evidence that the 5% discount was a term of the agreement?
askZh: 如果卖方起诉买方违反合同,买方能否提出证据证明5%的折扣是协议的条款?

options.en: No, because the seller timely objected to the buyer's proposal for different terms.
options.zh: 不,因为卖方及时反对买方提出的不同条款的建议。

options.en: No, because the writing contained the complete and exclusive agreement of the parties.
options.zh: 不,因为书写中包含了双方的完整和排他性协议.

options.en: Yes, because a modification made in good faith does not require consideration.
options.zh: 是的,因为善意修改不需要对价。

options.en: Yes, because evidence of course of dealing is admissible even if the writing contains the complete and exclusive agreement of the parties.
options.zh: 是的,因为即使书面文件载有当事方的完整和排他性协议,交易过程的证据也是可以接受的。

explanation.en:
Under the UCC parol evidence rule, evidence of a prior agreement (or contemporaneous oral agreement) cannot be used to contradict the terms of a final written agreement. But the following evidence can be used to explain or supplement those terms, regardless of whether the agreement is completely or partially integrated:*

• Course of performance – sequence of conduct that is relevant to understanding an agreement between the parties if (1) the agreement involves repeated occasions for performance by a party and (2) the other party accepts performance without objection

• Course of dealing – sequence of conduct concerning previous transactions between the parties that establishes a common basis of understanding for interpreting their conduct

• Trade usage – any practice or method of dealing in the parties' business or industry that is practiced with enough regularity to justify an expectation that it will be practiced in the instant case Here, on several past occasions, the buyer had taken a 5% discount from the contract price when paying within 10 days of delivery, and the seller had not objected. This established a course of dealing between the parties that can be used to supplement the contract at issue, which was silent regarding discounts for early payment. Therefore, evidence of the 5% discount is admissible even if the writing contains the complete and exclusive agreement of the parties (ie, even if the writing is completely integrated) (Choice B).

*Priority is given as follows: (1) express contractual terms prevail over all others, (2) course of performance prevails over course of dealing and trade usage, and (3) course of dealing prevails over trade usage.

(Choice A) There was an established course of dealing between the parties, so the seller's objection to the 5% discount—after the buyer had acted in accordance with the course of dealing—was ineffective.

(Choice C) Under the UCC, a good-faith modification is enforceable without consideration. But the enforceability of a modification is not at issue here.

Educational objective:

The UCC parol evidence rule always allows course of performance, course of dealing, and trade usage to be used to explain or supplement the terms of a final written agreement— even one that is completely integrated.

References

• U.C.C. § 2-202 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (parol evidence rule).

explanation.zh:
根据UCC parol证据规则,事先协议(或同时期口头协议)的证据不能用来与最后书面协议的条款相矛盾.但以下证据可用于解释或补充这些术语,而不论协议是完全还是部分结合的:*

• 履行过程 -- -- 与理解当事人之间的协议有关的行为顺序,如果(1) 协议涉及一方当事人一再履行的情形,(2) 另一方当事人无异议接受履行

• 交易过程 -- -- 关于当事人之间以往交易的系列行为,为解释其行为建立共同的理解基础

• 贸易惯例——双方当事人的商业或工业中的任何交易惯例或方法,如果其惯例或方法具有足够的规律性,足以证明有理由期望在本案中将采用这种做法。在交货后10天内支付合同价款时,卖方没有提出异议。这确定了当事人之间可用来补充合同的交易过程。关于提前付款的折扣问题没有提及。因此,即使写作中包含当事人的完整和排他性协议(即即使写作是完全整合的)(Choice B),5%折扣的证据也是可以接受的.

* 优先权如下:(1) 明确合同条款优先于所有其他条款,(2) 履约过程优先于交易过程和贸易惯例,(3) 交易过程优先于贸易惯例。

(Choice A)双方当事人之间有既定的交易过程,因此卖方在买方按照交易过程行事之后对5%折扣的反对无效。

根据《统一商法典》,善意修改是可执行的,无需对价,但此处并不涉及修改的可执行性。

学习要点：

UCC parol证据规则总是允许使用履约过程、交易过程和贸易惯例来解释或补充最后书面协议的条款——即使是完全一体化的协议。

参考资料

• U.C.C.§2-202(Am.Law Inst. & Unif.Law Comm'n 2020)(假释证据规则)。

stem: A buyer, who was a minor both in fact and appearance, bought on credit and took delivery of a telescope from a 30-year-old seller for an agreed price of $100. Soon after reaching the age of majority, the buyer encountered the seller and said, "I am sorry for not having paid you that $100 for the telescope when the money was due, but I found out it was only worth $75. So I now promise to pay you $75." The buyer subsequently repudiated her promise and refused to pay the seller anything.
stemZh: 买方在事实上和外表上都是未成年人,他以100美元的商定价格从一个30岁的卖方处借钱购买并交付望远镜。到了成年年龄后不久,买家就遇到了卖家,并说:"我很抱歉在钱到期时没有付你那100美元给望远镜,但我发现这只值75美元.所以我现在承诺付给你75美元。” 买主后来拒绝了她的承诺,拒绝给卖方任何东西。
ask: In an action for breach of contract by the seller against the buyer, what amount of damages will the seller likely recover?
askZh: 在卖方对买方提出的违约诉讼中,卖方可以收回多少损害赔偿?

options.en: Nothing, because the buyer was a minor at the time of the original transaction.
options.zh: 没有,因为买方在原始交易时是未成年人。

options.en: Nothing, because there was no consideration for the promise made by the buyer after reaching majority.
options.zh: 没有,因为没有考虑到买方在达到多数之后所作的许诺。
75 美元。

explanation.en:
An unmarried, unemancipated minor (ie, person under the age of 18) lacks capacity to enter a contract. This means that any contract the minor enters is voidable, so the minor can either:

• void the contract before or soon after turning 18 by (1) disaffirming it through words or actions and (2) returning any still-existing benefit received under it or

• ratify the contract after turning 18 by (1) failing to timely void the contract or (2) agreeing to be bound by it.

The contract becomes enforceable if the minor ratifies it. However, if the ratification is made by a promise to perform only part of the contract, enforcement is limited to that promise to partially perform.

Here, the buyer was a minor when she originally agreed to purchase a telescope from the seller for $100. Although the buyer had not paid the $100 when she reached the age of majority, she ratified the contract by retaining the telescope and promising to perform part of the contract by paying only $75. This made the contract enforceable—but only to the extent of the promise for partial performance. Therefore, the seller likely will only recover $75 (Choices A & D).

(Choice B) Certain promises are enforceable even without consideration. This includes a party's promise to perform a voidable duty (ie, ratification), so long as the new promise is not also voidable. Therefore, the buyer's promise to pay $75 made after reaching majority is enforceable without consideration.

Educational objective:

A minor lacks capacity to contract, so the minor can choose to (1) void the contract before or soon after turning 18 or (2) ratify it after turning 18. If the contract is ratified by a promise to perform only part of the contract, enforcement is limited to that promise to partially perform.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 14 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (incapacity based on infancy).

explanation.zh:
未婚、未成年的未成年人(即18岁以下的人)没有签订合同的能力,这意味着未成年人签订的任何合同都是无效的,因此未成年人可以:

• 18岁之前或之后不久,通过(1) 以言词或行动否定合同,(2) 退还根据合同获得的任何现有利益,或

• 18岁之后批准合同,方法是(1) 未能及时使合同无效或(2) 同意受其约束。

合同如经未成年人批准即可执行,但如果通过承诺只履行合同的一部分而批准,则强制执行仅限于部分履行该承诺。

在这里,买方是一名未成年人,当时她最初同意向卖方购买一台望远镜,价格为100美元。 虽然买方在她成年时没有支付100美元,但她还是通过保留望远镜和保证履行部分义务的方式批准了合同。合同只支付75美元。这使得合同可以执行——但仅限于对下列事项的承诺:因此,卖方可能只收回75美元(选择费)A & D) (中文(简体) ).

某些承诺即使不加对价也是可以执行的,这包括一方承诺履行可以撤销的义务(即批准),只要新的承诺不是也可以取消。因此,买方在达到多数后作出的支付75美元的承诺是可执行的,无须对价。

学习要点：

未成年人缺乏订立合同的能力,因此未成年人可以选择(1)在18岁之前或18岁之后宣布合同无效,或者(2)在18岁之后批准合同。如果合同得到只履行部分合同的承诺的批准,则强制执行仅限于部分履行该承诺。

stem: A father and his adult daughter encountered an old family friend on the street. The daughter said to the family friend, "How about lending me $1,000 to buy a used car? I'll pay you back with interest one year from today." The father added, "And if she doesn't pay it back as promised, I will." The family friend thereupon wrote out and handed to the daughter his personal check, payable to her, for $1,000, and she subsequently used the funds to buy a used car. When the debt came due, both the daughter and the father refused to repay any part of it.
stemZh: 一个父亲和他的成年女儿在街上遇到一个老家朋友,女儿对这个家朋友说:"借我一千美元买辆二手车怎么样?父亲补充道:"如果她不按约定还钱,我会的。" 家庭朋友随即写了信,将他个人的支票交给女儿, 付给她,1000美元,她后来用到了当债务到期时,女儿和父亲都拒绝偿还其中任何一部分。
ask: In an action by the family friend against the father to recover $1,000 plus interest, which of the following statements would summarize the father's best defense?
askZh: 在家庭朋友对父亲的一次追讨中,收回1000美元加利息,以下的哪些陈述可以总结父亲最好的辩护?

options.en: He received no consideration for his conditional promise to the family friend.
options.zh: 他对家庭朋友的有条件承诺没有得到对价。

options.en: His conditional promise to the family friend was not made for the primary purpose of benefiting himself (the father).
options.zh: 他对家庭朋友的有条件承诺并非主要是为了让自己(父亲)受益。

options.en: His conditional promise to the family friend was not to be performed in less than a year from the time it was made.
options.zh: 他对家庭朋友的有条件承诺在作出后不到一年的时间内不会兑现。

options.en: The loan by the family friend was made without any agreement concerning the applicable interest rate.
options.zh: 家庭朋友的贷款没有就适用的利率作出任何协议。

explanation.en:
Contracts subject to the statute of frauds are enforceable only if they are (1) in a writing that provides a reasonable basis to believe a contract was formed and (2) signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought. Here, the check from the family friend may have satisfied the writing requirement. But since it was not signed by the father, the contract is unenforceable if it is subject to the statute of frauds.

A suretyship is a promise to assume responsibility for a duty incurred by another (eg, the father's promise to pay the loan if the daughter does not). Under the main-purpose rule, suretyships are subject to the statute of frauds unless they are made for the promisor's own economic advantage. Therefore, the father's best defense is that his suretyship was primarily made to benefit his daughter, so it is subject to and unenforceable under the statute of frauds.

(Choice A) The suretyship is supported by consideration because each promise was induced by the promises of the other parties. The family friend loaned the daughter $1,000 based on both promises to pay him back (and vice versa).

(Choice C) A one-year contract is not subject to the statute of frauds if it is possible to perform within one year (even if the parties agree on a later completion date). Here, it was possible for the daughter or father to pay the loan within a year, so this would not trigger the statute of frauds.

(Choice D) An agreement concerning an applicable interest rate was not needed to form an enforceable contract.

Educational objective:

A suretyship is a promise to assume responsibility for a duty incurred by another. Unless a suretyship is made for the promisor's own economic advantage, it is subject to the statute of frauds—ie, it must be in writing and signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 112 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (requirement of suretyship).

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 116 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (main-purpose rule).

explanation.zh:
受防止欺诈法管辖的合同只有在(1)书面提供合理依据相信合同已订立和(2)由寻求执行的当事人签署的情况下才可强制执行。在此,家庭朋友的支票可能满足了书面要求,但由于没有父亲签署,如果合同受制于防止欺诈法,则合同不可执行。

担保是承诺对他人承担的责任承担责任(例如,如果女儿不支付贷款,父亲承诺支付贷款)。在主要目的规则下,担保人受防止欺诈法的约束,除非这些担保人是为了其自身的经济利益而设的。因此,父亲最好的辩护是,他的保证权主要是为了给女儿带来好处,因此根据防止欺诈法,它必须服从和不可执行。

(Choice A) 担保得到对价的支持,因为每个承诺都是由其他方的承诺诱导的。 家庭朋友将女儿的1000美元借给了他(反之亦然 ) 。

(C选择) 一年期合同如果可以在一年内履行,则不受防止欺诈法的约束(即使双方当事人约定了以后的完成日期).在这里,女儿或父亲有可能在一年内偿还贷款,因此这不会引发诈骗法规.

(选择D) 订立可执行的合同不需要关于适用利率的协议。

学习要点：

保证是承诺对另一人承担的某项义务承担责任。 除非保证是为自己的经济好处而作,否则它受防止欺诈法的约束——即它必须是书面的,并由被执行方签署。请求。

• 重述(第二)第116条(1981年《美国法律》)(主要目的规则)。

stem: A farmer contracted to sell 100,000 bushels of wheat to a buyer. When the wheat arrived at the destination, the buyer discovered that the farmer had delivered only 96,000 bushels. The buyer sued the farmer for breach of contract. At the trial of the case, the court found that the written contract was intended as a complete and exclusive statement of the terms of the agreement. The farmer offered to prove that in the wheat business, a promise to deliver a specified quantity is considered to be satisfied if the delivered quantity is within 5% of the specified quantity. The buyer objected to the offered evidence.
stemZh: 一个农民承包向买主出售10万匹小麦,小麦到达目的地后,买主发现这名农民只交付了96,000匹小麦,买主起诉这名农民违约.在审理此案时,法院认定,书面合同意在作为协议条款的完整和排他性说明。农民提出要证明,在小麦业中,如果交付的数量不超过规定数量的5%,则承诺交付一定数量,买方反对提供的证据。
ask: Is the court likely to admit the evidence offered by the farmer?
askZh: 法院是否可能接受农民提供的证据?

options.en: No, because the offered evidence is inconsistent with the express language of the agreement.
options.zh: 不,因为所提供的证据与协议的明确措辞不一致。

options.en: No, because the written contract was totally integrated.
options.zh: 不,因为书面合同是完全整合的。

options.en: Yes, because the offered evidence demonstrates that the farmer substantially performed the contract.
options.zh: 是的,因为所提供的证据表明,农民在很大程度上履行了合同。

options.en: Yes, because the offered evidence explains or supplements the agreement by usage of trade.
options.zh: 是的,因为所提供的证据通过使用贸易来解释或补充协议。

explanation.en:
UCC parol evidence rule

Description Priority of evidence

Inadmissible Prior/contemporaneous agreements that contradict written contract

Express terms always control

Admissible Course of performance

Sequence of conduct under contract involving repeated occasions for performance

Course of performance > course of dealing & trade usage

Course of dealing

Sequence of conduct pertaining to previous contracts

Course of dealing > trade usage

Trade usage Regular practice or method of dealing in that particular business/industry

N/A

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

Under the UCC's parol evidence rule, the express terms of a completely integrated, written contract cannot be contradicted by evidence of inconsistent prior or contemporaneous agreements. However, evidence of trade usage can be admitted to explain or supplement contract terms so long as that evidence is reasonably consistent with the contract's express language.* Trade usage refers to a practice or method of dealing that is observed with such regularity in the industry that the parties to a contract would be expected to observe it.

Here, the farmer delivered 96,000 bushels of wheat instead of the 100,000 bushels expressly required by the completely integrated contract. However, evidence shows that in the wheat industry, a delivery is satisfied if the delivered quantity is within 5% of the quantity specified in the contract. And since this evidence of trade usage is reasonably consistent with the contract's express language, the court is likely to admit the farmer's evidence of trade usage to supplement the contract (Choices A & B).

*Under the majority rule, trade usage is consistent with express language in the contract unless the usage completely negates specific express language.

(Choice C) Under the UCC's perfect-tender rule, a seller breaches a contract for the sale of goods when those goods or their delivery do not perfectly conform to the contract's terms (as seen here). Therefore, evidence showing that the farmer substantially performed is unlikely to be admitted because it does not excuse the farmer's breach.

Educational objective:

The UCC parol evidence rule allows the admission of evidence of trade usage to explain or supplement a contract's terms if that evidence is reasonably consistent with the express language of the contract.

References

• U.C.C. § 2-202 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (trade usage is admissible to explain or supplement contract's terms).

• U.C.C. § 1-303 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (definition of trade usage).

explanation.zh:
UCC parol 证据规则

证据的优先权

与书面合同相抵触的事先/合同

快速条款总是控制

可受理的成绩

合同下涉及多次履行的行为顺序

履约过程 > 交易和贸易使用过程

交易过程

与以前合同有关的行为顺序

交易过程 > 贸易用途

特定企业/行业的正常交易做法或方法

不详

UCC = 统一商法典。

根据UCC的parol证据规则,完全一体化的书面合同的明确规定不能与先前或当时的协议不一致的证据相矛盾。然而,只要证据与合同的明示措词合理一致,贸易惯例的证据可以被承认解释或补充合同条款。 * 贸易惯例是指遵守这种规则的一种做法或方法。在行业中,合同各方将遵守合同。

在此,农民交付了96 000只小麦,而不是完全综合合同明确要求的10万只小麦。但是,有证据表明,在小麦业,如果交付的数量在合同规定的数量的5%以内,则交付就已得到满足。由于这种贸易惯例的证据与合同的明示语言合理一致,法院很可能接受农民关于贸易惯例的证据来补充合同(Choices A & B)。

* 根据多数规则,贸易惯例与合同中的明示语言一致,除非该惯例完全否定具体的明示语言。

(选择C)根据UCC的完美招标规则,当货物或其交付不完全符合合同条款时,卖方违反货物销售合同(见这里)。因此,证明农民有相当成绩的证据不可能被承认,因为它不能成为农民违反合同的理由。

学习要点：

UCC parol证据规则允许承认贸易惯例的证据,以解释或补充合同条款,如果这种证据与合同的明确语言合理一致。

参考资料

• 《美国法典》第2-202条(《Am.Law Inst. & Unif.Law Comm'n 2020》(贸易惯例可以用来解释或补充合同条款)。

• U.C.C.§1-303(Am.Law Inst. & Unif.Law Comm'n 2020)(贸易使用的定义)。

stem:
A seller borrowed $5,000 from a bank. Soon thereafter the seller filed for bankruptcy, having paid nothing on his debt to the bank.

Five years after the debt had been discharged in bankruptcy, the seller contracted to sell certain goods to a buyer for $5,000. The contract provided that the buyer would pay the $5,000 to the bank. The only debt that the seller ever owed the bank is the $5,000 debt that was discharged in bankruptcy. The seller delivered the goods to the buyer, who accepted them.
stemZh:
卖方向一家银行借了5000美元,不久之后卖方就申请破产,没有偿还他欠银行的债务。

在债务在破产中解除五年后,卖方合同以5,000美元向买方出售某些货物,合同规定买方向银行支付5,000美元。卖方欠银行的唯一债务是破产时解除的5000美元债务,卖方将货物交给买方,买方接受了这些债务。
ask: If the bank becomes aware of the contract between the seller and the buyer, and the buyer refuses to pay anything to the bank, is the bank likely to succeed in an action against the buyer for $5,000?
askZh: 如果银行知道卖方与买方之间的合同,而买方拒绝向银行支付任何款项,银行是否有可能以5 000美元对买方提起诉讼?

options.en: No, because the buyer's promise to pay the bank was not supported by consideration.
options.zh: 不,因为买方向银行付款的承诺没有得到对价的支持。

options.en: No, because the seller's debt was discharged in bankruptcy.
options.zh: 不,因为卖方的债务在破产中解除。

options.en: Yes, because no consideration is required to support a promise to pay a debt that has been discharged in bankruptcy.
options.zh: 是的,因为不需要对价支持偿还债务的承诺。破产时退伍.

options.en: Yes, because the bank was an intended beneficiary of the contract between the buyer and the seller.
options.zh: 是的,因为银行是买方与卖方之间合同的预期受益人。

explanation.en:
A third-party beneficiary is a nonparty to a contract who receives some advantage or benefit from that contract. If the contracting parties intended for the contract to benefit the third party, the third party is an intended beneficiary with enforceable rights under the contract. That right vests when the beneficiary:

• detrimentally relies on the rights created

• manifests assent to the contract at one party's request or

• files a lawsuit to enforce the contract. Once this occurs, the original contracting parties are bound to perform the contract.

Here, the bank was an intended third-party beneficiary of the buyer-seller contract because the seller agreed to sell the buyer goods in exchange for the buyer paying the bank $5,000. The bank's right to enforce the buyer-seller contract will vest once the bank files a lawsuit to enforce it. Therefore, the bank will likely succeed in an action against the buyer for $5,000.

(Choice A) The buyer's promise to pay the bank was supported by consideration since the buyer agreed to pay the bank $5,000 in exchange for the seller's goods.

(Choice B) The fact that the seller's debt to the bank was discharged in bankruptcy is irrelevant because an intended beneficiary can be a creditor or a donee beneficiary. A creditor beneficiary can recover to satisfy a debt. A donee beneficiary can recover to receive a gift. Therefore, the bank is likely an intended donee beneficiary.

(Choice C) Although no consideration is required to support a promise to pay a debt discharged in bankruptcy, this is not a reason for the bank to succeed. Instead, the bank will succeed because it is an intended beneficiary.

Educational objective:

Intended third-party beneficiaries receive a direct benefit from a contract because the contracting parties intended to benefit them. They have the right to file a lawsuit to enforce the contract.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 302 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (intended and incidental beneficiaries).

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 304 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (duties owed to intended beneficiaries).

explanation.zh:
第三方受益人是指从合同中获得一定好处或从中受益的非合同当事人。如果订约方打算使合同有利于第三方,则第三方是预期受益人,根据合同享有可强制执行的权利。

• 有害地依赖所创造的权利

• 应一方当事人的请求表明同意合同,或

• 为强制执行合同提起诉讼,一旦发生这种情况,原始合同方有义务履行合同。

在此,该银行是买方-卖方合同的预期第三方受益人,因为卖方同意出售买方的货物,以换取买方支付银行5000美元。银行执行买方-卖方合同的权利将赋予银行提起诉讼强制执行合同的权利。 因此,银行很可能以5,000美元对买方提起诉讼。

(Choice A)买方承诺向银行付款得到了对价的支持,因为买方同意向银行支付5,000美元以换取卖方的货物。

(Choice B)出卖人对银行的债务在破产中解除的事实无关紧要,因为预期受益人可以是债权人或受赠方受益人,债权人受益人可以收回清偿债务.受赠者可以恢复接受礼物。因此,该银行很可能是预定受益人。

(Choice)尽管不需要对价支持偿还破产时解除的债务的承诺,但这并非银行成功的理由。 相反,银行会成功,因为它是预期的受益人。

学习要点：

预定的第三方受益人从合同中获得直接利益,因为订约方打算从中受益,他们有权提起诉讼强制执行合同。

stem:
A radio manufacturer and a retailer, after extensive negotiations, entered into a final, written agreement in which the manufacturer agreed to sell and the retailer agreed to buy all of its requirements of radios, estimated at 20 units per month, during the period from January 1, 2017 to December 31, 2019, at a price of $50 per unit. A dispute arose in late December 2019, when the retailer returned 25 undefective radios to the manufacturer for full credit after the manufacturer had refused to extend the contract for a second three-year period.

In an action by the radio manufacturer against the retailer for damages due to return of the 25 radios, the manufacturer introduces the written agreement, which expressly permitted the retailer to return defective radios for credit but was silent as to return of undefective radios for credit. The retailer seeks to introduce evidence that during the three years of the agreement it had returned, for various reasons, 125 undefective radios, for which the manufacturer had granted full credit. The manufacturer objects to the admissibility of this evidence.
stemZh:
无线电台制造商和零售商经过广泛谈判,达成了最后的书面协议,其中制造商同意出售,零售商同意购买无线电台的所有要求,估计在2002年12月31日之前每月购买20台。2017年1月1日至2019年12月31日,每台售价50美元. 2019年12月下旬,零售商在制造商拒绝续约第二次后,将25台不合格收音机退回给制造商,要求其全额信用.为期三年。

在无线电厂商对零售商提出的因归还25台无线电而造成损失的诉讼中,制造商提出了书面协议,明确允许零售商归还有缺陷的无线电台以获得信贷,但对于退回25台无线电机却保持沉默。该零售商试图提出证据表明,在协议的三年内,由于各种原因,它归还了125台不合格收音机,制造商已给予这些收音机全额信贷。制造商反对接受这一证据。
ask: How will the trial court probably rule as to the admissibility of the evidence proffered by the retailer?
askZh: 审判法院如何可能裁定零售商提供的证据的可采性?

options.en: Admissible, because course-of-performance evidence, when available, is considered the best indication of what the parties intended the writing to mean.
options.zh: 可予接受,因为履约过程证据(如果有的话)被认为是当事方意图说明书面内容的最佳表示。

options.en: Admissible, because the evidence supports an agreement that is not within the relevant statute of frauds.
options.zh: 可受理,因为证据支持一项不属于有关防止欺诈法范围的协议。

options.en: Inadmissible, because the evidence is barred by the parol evidence rule.
options.zh: 不能接受,因为证据被 parol 证据规则禁止。

options.en: Inadmissible, because the express terms of the agreement control when those terms are inconsistent with the course of performance.
options.zh: 不允许,因为当协议条款与履约过程不一致时,协议的明确规定加以控制。

explanation.en:
UCC parol evidence rule

Description Priority of evidence

Inadmissible Prior/contemporaneous agreements that contradict written contract

Express terms always control

Admissible Course of performance

Sequence of conduct under contract involving repeated occasions for performance

Course of performance > course of dealing & trade usage

Course of dealing

Sequence of conduct pertaining to previous contracts

Course of dealing > trade usage

Trade usage Regular practice or method of dealing in that particular business/industry

N/A

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

Contracts for the sale of goods (eg, radios) are governed by Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC). Under the UCC's parol evidence rule, the express terms of a final, written contract cannot be contradicted by evidence of inconsistent prior or contemporaneous agreements. But when a contract is silent on an issue, its terms can be supplemented with evidence of a course of performance—ie, a sequence of conduct under a contract that involves repeated occasions for performance.

Here, the radio manufacturer and the retailer entered a final, written requirements contract for the sale of radios. Near the end of the contract, the retailer returned 25 undefective radios for credit, as it had previously done with 125 undefective radios. The contract expressly permitted the return of defective radios, but it was silent as to the return of undefective radios (Choice D). Therefore, evidence of this course of performance is admissible since it is the best indication of what the parties intended the writing to mean

(Choice C).

(Choice B) Under the statute of frauds, certain types of contracts—eg, contracts for the sale of goods greater than $500—are only enforceable if they are written and signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought. But here, the contract is within the statute of frauds since it called for the sale of an estimated 20 radios per month, at $50 per radio, for 36 months (ie, greater than $500).

Educational objective:

The parol evidence rule prohibits evidence of inconsistent prior agreements that contradict a final, written contract. But when a contract is silent on an issue, its terms can be explained or supplemented with evidence of a course of performance—ie, a sequence of conduct under a contract involving repeated occasions for performance.

References

• U.C.C. § 2-202 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (parol evidence rule).

UCC = 统一商法典。

货物销售合同(如无线电)受《统一商法典》第2条管辖。根据《统一商法典》的parol证据规则,最后书面合同的明确规定不能与先前或当时的协议不一致的证据相矛盾。但是,当合同对某一问题保持沉默时,其条款可辅之以履约过程的证据,即合同下涉及多次履约的系列行为。

在此,无线电厂商和零售商签订了一份销售无线电机的最终书面需求合同,在合同即将结束时,零售商归还了25台不缺陷的无线电机以获得信贷,这与以前125台不缺陷的无线电机一样。合同明确允许归还有缺陷的无线电台,但对归还无缺陷无线电台(Choice D)却保持沉默。因此,这种履约过程的证据是可以接受的,因为它最能说明当事方意图说明什么。

(中文(简体) ).

(选择B) 根据防止欺诈法,某些类型的合同——例如,销售金额超过500美元的货物的合同——只有在由寻求执行的当事方书面和签署的情况下才能执行。但在这里,合同属于防止欺诈法的范围,因为它要求每月出售约20台无线电,每台50美元,为期36个月(即超过500美元).

学习要点：

parol证据规则禁止出现与最后书面合同相矛盾的先前协议的证据。但是,当合同对某一问题保持沉默时,其条款可以以履约过程的证据加以解释或补充——即合同下的一系列行为,涉及多次履约。

参考资料

stem: A mechanic agreed in writing to make repairs to a landscaper's truck for $12,000. The mechanic properly made the repairs, but when the landscaper tendered payment, the mechanic refused to deliver the truck unless the landscaper promised to pay an additional $2,000. The customary charge for such work was $14,000. Because the landscaper needed the truck immediately to fulfill existing contractual obligations, and because no rental trucks of the same type were available, the landscaper promised in writing to pay the mechanic an additional $2,000. The mechanic then delivered the truck.
stemZh: 一名机械师书面同意以 12,000 美元修理一名园林工人的卡车。机械师完成修理后，园林工人提出付款，但机械师拒绝交车，除非园林工人承诺额外支付 2,000 美元。此类修理的通常收费为 14,000 美元。园林工人急需卡车履行现有合同，且没有同类型卡车可租，于是书面承诺额外支付 2,000 美元。机械师随后交付卡车。
ask: Will the mechanic be able to enforce the landscaper's promise to pay the additional $2,000?
askZh: 机械师能否执行园艺师的承诺 支付额外的2000美元?

options.en: No, because the landscaper had no reasonable alternative but to yield to the mechanic's wrongful threat.
options.zh: 不,因为景观学家没有合理的选择 只能屈服于机械师的错误威胁

options.en: No, because the mechanic exerted undue influence over the landscaper with respect to the modification.
options.zh: 不,因为技工对园艺师施加了不当的改变影响。

options.en: Yes, because the landscaper could have obtained possession of the truck through legal action rather than by agreeing to the increased payment.
options.zh: 是的,因为景观设计师可以通过法律行动,而不是通过同意增加付款,获得对卡车的拥有权。

options.en: Yes, because the modified contract price did not exceed a reasonable price.
options.zh: 是的,因为修改的合同价格没有超过合理的价格。

explanation.en:
Duress may serve as a defense to contract enforceability if a contracting party's assent was induced by an improper threat from another contracting party—eg, a threat that breached the contractual duty of good faith and fair dealing. When this occurs, the contract becomes voidable and can be rescinded if the threatened party:

• had no reasonable alternative but to succumb to the improper threat and

• promptly (ie, within a reasonable time) disaffirmed the contract. Here, the mechanic breached his duty of good faith and fair dealing when he refused to deliver the truck unless the landscaper paid an additional $2,000 (improper threat). Since the landscaper needed the truck immediately to fulfill existing contractual obligations and no similar rental trucks were available, he had no choice but to succumb to the threat (no reasonable alternative). As a result, his promise cannot be enforced if he promptly disaffirmed it.

(Choice B) Undue influence makes a contract voidable when a party assented due to unfair or excessive persuasion from someone who dominated (eg, prison guard/prisoner) or held a special relationship of trust and confidence with (eg, attorney/client) the assenting party—neither of which is seen here.

(Choice C) Since the landscaper needed the truck immediately to fulfill existing contractual obligations, his ability to later obtain possession through legal action was not a reasonable alternative.

(Choice D) Although the modified contract price was customary and reasonable, this modification was still induced by an improper threat because it violated the mechanic's duty of good faith and fair dealing.

Educational objective:

A contract that is assented to under duress induced by an improper threat from another contracting party is voidable if the victim (1) had no reasonable alternative but to succumb to the improper threat and (2) promptly (ie, within a reasonable time) disaffirmed the contract.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 174–176 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (duress caused by physical compulsion and improper threat).

stem: A 17-year-old boy started a business mowing lawns for his neighbors. As the boy's business grew, he received requests for lawn services from homeowners in neighborhoods located several miles away. The boy lived with his parents and had use of the family's old pickup truck after 4:00 p.m. each day to carry his lawn maintenance equipment to the other neighborhoods. However, the boy believed that it was necessary to own a truck that could be used for his business at any hour. He therefore entered a contract with a used-car dealership to purchase a truck.
stemZh: 一个17岁的男孩为邻居开办了一个割草场,随着男孩生意的发展,他收到了几英里外的街区业主提出的草坪服务请求.男孩与父母住在一起,每天下午4点后使用家里的旧皮卡将他的草坪维修设备运到其他街区。然而,这名男孩认为必须拥有一辆卡车,可以随时用于他的生意,因此,他与一家废车经销商签订了购买卡车的合同。
ask: Which of the following statements best describes the contract between the boy and the used-car dealership?
askZh: 下列哪些陈述最能说明男孩与废车经销商之间的合同?

options.en: The contract for necessaries is enforceable.
options.zh: 必要物品的合同是可执行的。

options.en: The contract is voidable only by the boy.
options.zh: 合同只能由男孩废除。

options.en: The contract is voidable by either party.
options.zh: 任何一方均可撤销合同。

options.en: The contract is void and unenforceable.
options.zh: 合同无效,无法执行。

explanation.en:
An unmarried, unemancipated minor (ie, person under the age of 18) lacks capacity to contract, so any contract entered by the minor is voidable by the minor. However, the contract is not voidable by the other contracting party. This means that the minor has the sole power to either:

• void the contract before or soon after turning 18 by (1) disaffirming the contract through words or actions and (2) returning any still-existing benefit received under the contract or

• ratify the contract after turning 18 by (1) failing to timely void the contract or (2) otherwise agreeing to be bound by it.

However, if the minor seeks to void a contract for necessaries, then the minor can still incur liability for the reasonable value of the necessaries under a quasi-contract theory. "Necessaries" is a flexible term that generally includes food, clothing, shelter, and anything else that (1) is actually required for the minor's support or well-being and (2) has not been provided by the minor's parent or guardian.

Here, the 17-year-old boy contracted with the dealership to purchase a truck because he believed that it was necessary to own a truck that could be used for his business. But the boy did not actually require a new truck because he had use of the family's pickup truck to carry his lawn maintenance equipment to other neighborhoods. Therefore, the necessaries exception does not apply here, and the contract is voidable only by the boy (Choices A, C & D).

Educational objective:

Minors lack capacity to contract, so a contract entered by a minor is voidable by the minor. However, a minor who chooses to disaffirm a contract for necessaries (eg, food, clothing, shelter) must pay for their reasonable value.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 14 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (incapacity based on infancy).

• 42 Am. Jur. 2d Infants §§ 56–63 (2020) (infant liability for necessaries).

• 42 Am. Jur. 2d Infants §§ 64–69 (2020) (examples of necessaries).

explanation.zh:
未婚,未解除婚约的未成年人(即未满18岁的人)缺乏签订合同的能力,因此,未成年人签订的任何合同都可以被未成年人废除,但是,合同不能被其他签约方废除.这意味着未成年人有下列权利:

• 在18岁之前或之后不久,通过(1) 通过言词或行动否定合同,(2) 退还根据合同而获得的任何现有利益或

• 18岁之后批准合同,方式是(1)未能及时使合同无效或(2)以其他方式同意受其约束。

但是,如果未成年人试图废除一项必要物品的合同,那么根据准合同理论,未成年人仍然可以承担对必要物品合理价值的责任。"需要者"是一个灵活的术语,一般包括食物,衣着,住所,以及其它任何(1)为未成年人的赡养或福利而实际需要的,(2)没有由未成年人的父母或监护人提供.

在这里,17岁的男孩与经销商签约购买一辆卡车,因为他认为必须拥有一辆可以用于他生意的卡车.但男孩实际上并不需要一辆新卡车,因为他曾使用家里的皮卡将他的草坪维修设备运送到其他街区.因此,这里不适用必要例外,合同只能由男孩(Choices A, C & D)作废.

学习要点：

未成年人没有签订合同的能力,因此未成年人签订的合同可以被取消,但是,如果未成年人选择拒绝签订必要的合同(如食品、衣服、住所),就必须支付合理价值。

参考资料

• 重述(第二)第14条(1981年《法律》)(因婴儿而丧失能力)。

· 42 Am. Jur. 2d Infants § 56–63 (2020年)(必须的婴儿责任)。

· 42 Am. Jur. 2d Infants § 64–69(2020年)(危急情况实例)。

stem:
On March 15, in a writing signed by both parties, a manufacturer agreed to sell 40,000 pens at $1 each to a retailer, delivery to be made in two equal installments on April 1 and May 1. The contract was silent as to the time of payment, but on March 25 the two parties orally agreed that the entire purchase price was to be paid on delivery of the second installment.

On April 1, the manufacturer delivered 20,000 pens, and the retailer accepted them. The manufacturer then demanded payment of $20,000. When the retailer refused to make the payment, the manufacturer sued the retailer for breach of contract. In its defense, the retailer proffered evidence of the March 25 oral agreement.
stemZh:
3月15日,一家制造商在双方签署的一份书面书中同意向零售商出售4万支笔,每支笔价1美元,于4月1日和5月1日分两批交付.合同未提及付款时间,但双方于3月25日口头同意,在交付第二批货时支付全部购货价款.

4月1日,制造商交付了2万支笔,零售商接受了,制造商随后要求支付2万美元,当零售商拒绝支付时,制造商起诉零售商违约.在辩护中,零售商提供了3月25日口头协议的证据.
ask: Is the manufacturer likely to succeed in its action?
askZh: 制造商能否成功采取行动?

options.en: No, because even though the March 25 oral agreement is not effective, payment is due at the time of the second installment.
options.zh: 不,因为即使3月25日的口头协议无效,在第二次分期付款时仍应付款。

options.en: No, because the March 25 oral agreement was an effective modification of the written contract.
options.zh: 不,因为3月25日的口头协议是对书面合同的有效修改。

options.en: Yes, because the parol evidence rule bars the introduction of evidence of an oral agreement modifying a written contract.
options.zh: 是的,因为parol证据规则禁止提出修改书面合同的口头协议的证据。

options.en: Yes, because there was no consideration to support the modification.
options.zh: 是的,因为没有对价支持这一修改。

explanation.en:
Unwritten modifications of contracts

Contract silent on modification

(common law & UCC)

• Unwritten modification valid unless statute of frauds applies

Contract clause requires written modification

Common law

• Clause unenforceable

• Unwritten modification valid unless statute of frauds applies UCC • Clause enforceable (ie, unwritten modification invalid) if: – contract written & signed – clause separately signed by nonmerchant if sued by merchant

• Clause waived (ie, unwritten modification valid) if: – parties intended unwritten modification – one party materially changed position in reliance UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

Under the UCC statute of frauds, contracts for the sale of goods for $500 or more (eg, 40,000 pens at $1 each) must be in a writing that states the quantity of goods to be sold and is signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought. However, modifications to a contract that falls within and satisfies this statute need not be in writing unless they affect the subject matter of the contract or the quantity of goods to be sold.

Here, the March 15 contract for the sale of pens needed to be, and was, in a writing that satisfied the statute of frauds. But the March 25 agreement that the entire purchase price would be paid on delivery of the second installment did not need to be in writing since it affected neither subject matter nor quantity. Therefore, the March 25 oral agreement was an effective modification of the written contract. And since the retailer's refusal to pay for the first installment on delivery was not a breach, the manufacturer is not likely to succeed.

(Choice A) Where a contract for the sale of goods is silent as to the time of payment, the UCC "fills the gap" with a provision that payment is due when the buyer receives the goods. Therefore, had the March 25 oral agreement been ineffective, payment for each installment of pens would have been due upon receipt.

(Choice C) The parol evidence rule generally bars extrinsic evidence of a prior oral or written agreement to modify or contradict the terms of a final written agreement (eg, March 15 contract). But this rule does not bar evidence of subsequent agreements between the parties (eg, March 25 oral agreement).

(Choice D) Under the UCC, contract modifications are binding without consideration so long as they are made in good faith. This requires honesty and observance of reasonable commercial standards of fair dealing in the trade.

Educational objective:

Modifications to a contract that falls within and satisfies the UCC statute of frauds do NOT need to be in writing unless they affect subject matter or quantity.

References

• U.C.C. § 2-201 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (statute of frauds).

• U.C.C. § 2-209 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (contract modification requirements).

explanation.zh:
合同的不成文修改

合同未提及修改问题

(普通法和UCC)

• 非书面修改有效,除非适用防止欺诈法

合同条款需要书面修改

普通法

• 条款不可执行

• 非书面修改有效,除非防止欺诈法适用UCC 条款(即无书面修改无效),条件是:如果商家起诉,则非商家单独签署合同书面和签署的条款

• 条款(即无书面修改有效)放弃,条件是:当事人打算无书面修改;一方当事人在依赖UCC=统一商法典时实际上改变了立场。

根据《UCC公司防止欺诈法》,500美元或500美元以上的货物销售合同(例如,每笔4万笔1美元)必须以书面形式说明拟出售货物的数量,并由被请求执行的一方签署。然而,对属于本规约范围并符合本规约的合同的修改不必是书面的,除非这些修改影响到合同标的或所售货物的数量。

在这里,3月15日的钢笔销售合同需要而且当时是符合防止欺诈法的书面合同。但3月25日的协议,即第二批货物交付时将支付全部购货价款,由于该协议既不影响标的,也不影响数量,因此不需要书面方式.因此,3月25日的口头协议是对书面合同的有效修改,由于零售商拒绝支付交货后的首期付款并非违约,因此制造商不太可能成功.

(Choice A)销售货物合同对付款时间保持沉默的,UCC"补足空白",规定在买方收到货物时付款到期.因此,如果3月25日的口头协议无效,每笔分期付款应在收到后支付。

(选择C) parol证据规则一般禁止事先口头或书面同意修改或违背最后书面协议条款(例如3月15日合同)的外部证据。但这一规则并不妨碍当事人之间嗣后协议的证据(如3月25日的口头协议).

(选择D)根据《统一商法典》,合同的修改只要是善意的,就具有约束力,这需要诚实和遵守公平交易的合理商业标准。

学习要点：

属于并符合《统一商法典》关于欺诈的法规的合同的修改不必是书面的,除非这些修改影响到标的物或数量。

参考资料

• U.C.C.§2-201(Am.Law Inst. & Unif.Law Comm'n 2020)(防止欺诈法)。

• U.C.C.§2/209(Am.Law Inst. & Unif.Law Comm'n 2020)(合同修改要求)。

stem: A debtor's $1,000 contractual obligation to the aunt was due on July 1. On the preceding June 15, the aunt called her niece and said, "As my birthday gift to you, you may collect on July 1 the $1,000 the debtor owes me." The aunt also called the debtor and told him to pay the $1,000 to her niece on July 1. On July 1, the debtor, saying that he did not like the niece and wouldn't pay anything to her, paid the $1,000 to the aunt, who accepted it without objection.
stemZh: 债务人对姨妈的1000美元合同义务应于7月1日到期. 前6月15日,姨妈打电话给她的侄女,说:"作为我送给你的生日礼物,你可以在7月1日收取债务人欠我的1000美元. "姨妈还给债务人打了电话,告诉他:7月1日向侄女支付1000美元,7月1日债务人表示不喜欢侄女,不愿向她支付任何东西,向姑姑支付1000美元,姑姑无异议接受.
ask: Will the niece succeed in an action for $1,000 against the debtor?
askZh: 外甥女是否会成功以1000美元起诉债务人?

options.en: No, because the aunt's acceptance of the $1,000, without objection, was in effect the revocation of a gratuitous assignment.
options.zh: 不,因为姑姑毫无异议地接受了1000美元,实际上就是取消了无缘无故的指派.

options.en: No, because the debtor cannot be compelled to render performance to an assignee whom he finds personally objectionable.
options.zh: 不,因为不能强迫债务人将履约行为交给他认为自己可以反对的受让人。

options.en: Yes, because the aunt had effectively assigned the $1,000 debt to her.
options.zh: 是的,因为姨妈已经把1000美元的债务 给了她。

options.en: Yes, because the aunt's calls to the niece and the debtor effected a novation.
options.zh: 是的,因为姨妈给侄女的电话 和债务人进行了更新。

explanation.en:
Assignment of contractual rights

Limitations • Assignment permitted unless it: – materially increases obligor's contractual duties or risks – materially reduces obligor's chance of obtaining performance or – is void (not merely prohibited) under contract provision Requirements • Present intent to immediately assign right

• Consideration generally required to make assignment irrevocable – Exceptions: promissory estoppel, delivery of document symbolizing assigned right (eg, stock certificate), delivery of written & signed assignment Assignee's rights

• Assumes all of assignor's rights as contract stands at time of assignment, subject to claims/defenses that: – accrued before obligor received notice of assignment or – stem from assignor's present or future failure to perform

• Assignor loses rights & therefore cannot enforce contract An assignment is the transfer of rights under a contract to a third party. A gratuitous assignment—ie, one that is not supported by consideration such as money—can generally be revoked by words or conduct.

Here, the aunt transferred her right to collect the $1,000 debt to her niece. The assignment was gratuitous because it was a birthday gift to the niece and the aunt asked for nothing in return. However, the debtor paid the $1,000 to the aunt—not the niece. By accepting the $1,000 without objection, the aunt effectively revoked the gratuitous assignment to the niece (Choice C). Therefore, the niece will not succeed in an action against the debtor.

(Choice B) There is no rule that excuses a party from rendering performance to an assignee whom the party finds personally objectionable.

(Choice D) A novation is a substitute contract in which the parties agree to replace an original contracting party with a new party. But here, the debtor never agreed to replace the aunt with the niece (no novation).

Educational objective:

An assignment (ie, transfer of contractual rights) that is not supported by consideration can be revoked by words or conduct.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 321 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (assignment of future rights).

explanation.zh:
合同权利的转让

• 允许转让,除非:在实质上增加承付人的合同义务或风险,在实质上减少承付人获得履约的机会,或根据合同规定,转让无效(不仅仅是禁止)。立即转让右侧

• 一般需要对价使转让不可撤销 -- -- 例外:本票不容反悔、送交象征所转让权利的文件(例如库存证书)、送交书面转让和签字转让

• 假定转让人作为合同的所有权利在转让时都存在,但有下列权利要求/抗辩:在承付人收到转让通知之前产生的,或转让人目前或今后不履行义务造成的。

• 转让人丧失权利,因此不能强制执行合同 转让是指将合同下的权利转让给第三方,无缘无故的转让——即没有金钱等考虑因素支持的转让——一般可以通过文字或行为加以撤销。

在此,姨妈将她向侄女收取1 000美元债务的权利转让给了她的侄女,这项转让是无意义的,因为它是送给侄女的生日礼物,姨妈不要求任何回报,但债务人向姨妈而不是侄女支付了1 000美元。姨妈毫无异议地接受这1 000美元,实际上取消了对侄女(Choice C)的无偿转让。 因此,侄女不会对债务人提起诉讼。

(Choice B) 没有任何规则能为一方当事人向该当事人认为个人可反对的受让人提供履行义务的借口。

(Choice D) 更新是一种替代合同,双方在合同中同意以新的当事人取代原签约方,但在这里,债务人从未同意用侄女代替姨妈(没有更新)。

学习要点：

未经对价支持的转让(即合同权利的转让)可以通过文字或行为予以撤销。

参考资料

• 重述(第二)合同第321条(1981年《普通法》)(未来权利的转让)。

stem:
An aircraft broker sought to purchase on behalf of its client a private jet from a fleet owned by a corporation. In a telephone conversation between the broker and the corporation's finance manager, the broker offered $9 million for the jet. The manager agreed on the condition that the broker give the corporation a $250,000 deposit toward the jet's purchase price and a copy of the broker's agreement with the client. The broker complied with the manager's request.

Subsequently, the broker and the corporation exchanged written drafts of a contract memorializing their agreement. None of the drafts were signed by the parties. Two months later, the corporation notified the broker that the jet was not for sale and disputed the existence of an enforceable contract.
stemZh:
一名飞机经纪人试图代表客户从一家公司拥有的机队购买一架私人飞机,在经纪人与该公司财务经理的电话交谈中,经纪人为飞机提供了900万美元。经理同意这样的条件,即经纪人向该公司提供25万美元的押金,以支付飞机的购货价款和经纪人与客户的协议副本。

随后,经纪人和公司交换了一份纪念其协议的合同书面草稿,双方均未签署任何草稿。两个月后,该公司通知经纪人,该喷气式飞机不出售,并质疑存在可执行的合同。
ask: Is there an enforceable contract between the broker and the corporation?
askZh: 经纪人和公司之间是否有可执行的合同?

options.en: No, because partial payment of the jet's purchase price did not take the contract out of the statute of frauds.
options.zh: 不,因为部分支付喷气机的购货价款并没有使合同脱离防止欺诈法.

options.en: No, because the broker never signed a writing evidencing a contract with the corporation.
options.zh: 不,因为经纪人从未与公司签署过一份证明合同的书面文件。

options.en: Yes, because the agreement was memorialized in the written drafts of the contract exchanged by the parties.
options.zh: 是的,因为双方交换的合同的书面草案对协议进行了纪念。

options.en: Yes, because the broker paid $250,000 for the jet and the corporation accepted that payment.
options.zh: 是的,因为经纪人支付了25万美元 喷气机和公司接受了这笔付款。

explanation.en:
The UCC statute of frauds applies to contracts for the sale of goods for $500 or more (eg, private jet sold for $9 million). These contracts generally must be in writing and signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought to be enforceable. However, one exception applies when some amount of payment was made and accepted.* The effect of a partial payment turns on whether the contract is for:

• separable goods – in which case, the contract is enforceable up to the quantity of goods paid for in full or

• an indivisible good – in which case, the entire contract is enforceable.

Here, the broker–corporation contract violated the statute of frauds because none of the written drafts exchanged by the parties were signed (Choice C). However, the broker paid $250,000 (partial payment) toward the jet (indivisible good) and the corporation presumably accepted that payment. Therefore, the contract is excepted from the statute of frauds and is enforceable in its entirety (Choice A).

*The exception also applies when some amount of goods have been received and accepted.

(Choice B) The fact that the broker never signed a writing evidencing a contract with the corporation is irrelevant. That is because the corporation is the party against whom enforcement is sought and the one whose signature was therefore needed to satisfy the statute of frauds.

Educational objective:

A contract is excepted from the UCC statute of frauds when some amount of payment was made and accepted. A partial payment for separable goods renders the contract enforceable only up to the quantity paid for in full, while a partial payment for an indivisible good renders the entire contract enforceable.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

References

• U.C.C. § 2-201 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (statute of frauds formal requirements).

explanation.zh:
《UCC防止欺诈法》适用于500美元或以上的货物销售合同(例如以900万美元出售的私人喷气机),这些合同一般必须是书面的,并由要求强制执行的当事方签署。但是,当支付并接受某些数额时,适用一种例外。 * 部分付款的影响取决于合同是否适用于:

• 可分离货物 -- -- 在这种情况下,合同可强制执行,但以全额支付的货物数量为限,或

· 不可分割的商品——在这种情况下,整个合同是可执行的。

在此,经纪人-公司合同违反了防止欺诈法,因为双方交换的书面草稿均未签署(Choice C)。然而,经纪人向喷气机(无形货物)支付了250 000美元(部分付款),该公司大概接受了这笔付款,因此,合同被排除在防止欺诈法之外,可以全部执行(Choice A)。

* 例外情况也适用于收到和接受某些货物的情况。

(Choice B) 经纪人从未与公司签署书面证明合同的事实无关。这是因为公司是寻求执行的一方,因此是其签字以满足防止欺诈法要求的一方。

学习要点：

在支付和接受某些款项时,合同被排除在UCC防止欺诈法之外。对可分离货物的部分付款使得合同只能以全额支付的数量为限才能执行,而部分可分割货物的部分付款则使合同得以执行。为不可分割的商品付款使得整个合同可以执行。

UCC = 统一商法典。

参考资料

• U.C.C.§2-201(Am.Law Inst. & Unif.Law Comm'n 2020)(欺诈形式要求法规)。

stem:
For an agreed price of $20 million, a construction company contracted with a real estate developer to design and build on the developer's commercial plot a 15-story office building. In excavating for the foundation and underground utilities, the construction company encountered a massive layer of granite at a depth of 15 feet. By reasonable safety criteria, the building's foundation required a minimum excavation of 25 feet.

When the contract was made, neither the real estate developer nor the construction company was aware of the subsurface granite and neither party had hired a qualified expert to test for subsurface granite.

Claiming accurately that removal of enough granite to permit the construction as planned would cost the construction company an additional $3 million and a probable net loss on the contract of $2 million, the construction company refused to proceed with the work unless the real estate developer would promise to pay an additional $2.5 million for the completed building.
stemZh:
协议价2000万美元,由一家建筑公司与房地产开发商签约,在开发商的商业地块上设计和建造一座15层的办公楼.在为地基和地下公用设施挖掘时,建筑公司在15英尺深处遇到了巨大的花岗岩层,根据合理的安全标准,该建筑的地基要求至少挖掘25英尺.

在签订合同时,房地产开发商和建筑公司都没有意识到地下花岗岩,双方都没有聘请合格的专家来测试地下花岗岩.

建筑公司声称,如果拆除足够的花岗岩,以便按计划施工,将使建筑公司另外损失300万美元,合同可能净损失200万美元,除非房地产开发商承诺再为完工的大楼支付250万美元。
ask: If the real estate developer refuses and sues the construction company for breach of contract, which of the following will the court probably decide?
askZh: 如果房地产开发商拒绝并起诉建筑公司违约,法院可能会裁定以下哪一项?

options.en: The construction company is excused, because the contract is voidable on account of the parties' mutual mistake concerning an essential underlying fact.
options.zh: 建筑公司可以免责,因为合同可以无效,因为双方在基本事实上相互错误。

options.en: The construction company is excused under the modern doctrine of supervening impossibility, which includes severe impracticability.
options.zh: 建筑公司根据后来不可能发生的现代学说被免除责任,其中包括严重不切实际。

options.en: The real estate developer prevails, because the construction company assumed the risk of encountering subsurface granite that was unknown to the real estate developer.
options.zh: 房地产开发商占优势,因为建筑公司承担了遇到地表地下花岗岩的风险,而地产开发商对此一无所知.

options.en: The real estate developer prevails, unless subsurface granite was previously unknown anywhere in the vicinity of the real estate developer's construction site.
options.zh: 房地产开发商占上风,除非在房地产开发商的建筑工地附近任何地方,地表下的花岗岩以前都不为人所知.

explanation.en:
When party assumes risk of mistake

Express Contract allocates risk to party

Conscious ignorance

Party enters contract despite conscious ignorance of facts related to mistake

Adjudication Court allocates risk to party because reasonable under circumstances

When both parties enter a contract based on the same mistake (ie, mutual mistake), the contract is voidable by an adversely affected party if:

• the mistake relates to a basic assumption of the contract

• the mistake materially affects the agreed-upon exchange of performances (ie, the adversely affected party cannot fairly be required to carry it out) and

• the adversely affected party did not assume the risk of the mistake.

Here, when the contract was made, neither party knew that there was a massive layer of granite 15 feet below the surface. That mutual mistake related to a basic assumption of the contract since the building's foundation required a minimum excavation of 25 feet. And it materially affected the agreed-upon exchange since removing the granite would cost the construction company $3 million and likely cause a net loss of $2 million. However, the court will probably decide that the construction company assumed the risk of encountering the subsurface granite because:

• there is a foreseeable risk of encountering subsurface granite in excavation projects like this one and

• as a professional builder, the construction company should have been aware of this risk and so acted unreasonably by failing to hire a qualified expert to test for subsurface granite (Choice D).

Therefore, the real estate developer will likely prevail in a breach-of-contract suit against the construction company (Choice A).

(Choice B) As with mutual mistake, the doctrine of impossibility does not apply where the adversely affected party assumed the risk of the event that rendered performance impossible or severely impracticable (here, encountering subsurface granite).

Educational objective:

Mutual mistake renders a contract voidable by the adversely affected party when (1) the mistake relates to a basic assumption of the contract, (2) the mistake materially affects the agreed-upon exchange of performances, and (3) the adversely affected party did not assume the risk of the mistake.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 153 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (one party's mistake makes contract voidable).

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 154 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when party bears risk of mistake).

explanation.zh:
当事人承担错误风险时

合同将风险分配给当事方

意识无知

当事人尽管自觉不了解与错误有关的事实,但仍签订合同

裁决法院将风险分配给当事方,因为情况合理

当双方基于同一错误(即相互错误)订立合同时,合同是:受不利影响的当事方可撤销:

• 错误涉及合同的基本假设

• 错误在实质上影响到商定的交流表演(即不能要求受到不利影响的一方进行这种交流)和

• 受害方没有承担错误的风险。

在此,当合同签订时,双方都不知道地表下方有一层巨大的花岗岩,这种相互错误与合同的基本假设有关,因为大楼的地基要求至少挖掘25英尺.它对商定的交换造成了实质性影响,因为移除花岗岩将花费建筑公司300万美元,并可能造成200万美元的净损失。然而,法院可能会裁定建筑公司承担遇到地下花岗岩的风险,因为:

• 在这种挖掘项目中,可能遇到地下花岗岩;

• 作为专业建筑商,建筑公司应意识到这一风险,因此没有雇用合格的专家来测试地下花岗岩(Choice D)。

因此,房地产开发商很可能在针对建筑公司(Choice A)的违约诉讼中占优势。

(Choice B)与相互错误一样,如果受到不利影响的当事方承担了使履行变得不可能或严重不可行的事件的风险(在这里,遇到地下花岗岩),则不适用不可能理论。

学习要点：

相互错误使受不利影响的当事人在(1) 错误与合同的基本假设有关时可以宣告合同无效,(2) 错误对商定的履约交换有实质影响,(3) 受不利影响的当事人没有承担错误的风险。

参考资料

• 重述(第二)第153条(1981年《美国法律》)(一方当事人的错误使合同可以无效)。

• 重述(第二)第154条(1981年《美国法律》)(当当事方承担错误风险时)。

stem: During negotiations to purchase a used car, a buyer asked a dealer whether the car had ever been in an accident. The dealer replied: "It is a fine car and has been thoroughly inspected and comes with a certificate of assured quality. Feel free to have the car inspected by your own mechanic." In actuality, the car had been in a major accident, and the dealer had repaired and repainted the car, successfully concealing evidence of the accident. The buyer declined to have the car inspected by his own mechanic, explaining that he would rely on the dealer's certificate of assured quality. At no time did the dealer disclose that the car had previously been in an accident. The parties then signed a contract of sale. After the car was delivered and paid for, the buyer learned that the car had been in a major accident.
stemZh: 在购买一款废旧车的谈判中,买方询问一名经销商该车是否曾发生事故,经销商回答说:"这是一辆精良的汽车,经过彻底检查,并出具了质量有保证的证书."实际上,这辆车发生了重大事故,经销商修复并重新油漆了这辆车,成功地隐瞒了事故的证据。买方拒绝由自己的机械师检查汽车,解释说他将依赖经销商的保证质量证书,而经销商从未透露汽车以前曾发生事故。双方随后签订了一份销售合同,在交付汽车并支付货款后,买方得知该汽车发生了重大事故.
ask: If the buyer sues the dealer to rescind the transaction, is the buyer likely to succeed?
askZh: 如果买方起诉经销商撤销交易,买方是否有可能成功?

options.en: No, because the buyer had the opportunity to have the car inspected by his own mechanic and declined to do so.
options.zh: 不,因为买方有机会让自己的机械师检查汽车,并拒绝这样做。

options.en: No, because the dealer did not affirmatively assert that the car had not been in an accident.
options.zh: 不,因为经销商没有肯定地断言这辆车没有发生意外。

options.en: Yes, because the contract was unconscionable.
options.zh: 是的,因为合同不合理

options.en: Yes, because the dealer's statement was intentionally misleading and the dealer concealed evidence of the accident.
options.zh: 是的,因为经销商的陈述是故意误导的,经销商隐瞒了事故的证据.

explanation.en:
Misrepresentation is an untrue assertion of fact often made in an affirmative statement. It can also be asserted through conduct—ie, an act of concealment intended to prevent discovery of facts or nondisclosure (Choice B). When either form of misrepresentation occurs, a contract is voidable and can be rescinded by the adversely affected party if:

• the misrepresentation was fraudulent (ie, made knowingly or recklessly with intent to induce the other party's assent to the contract) OR material (ie, likely to induce a reasonable person's assent)

• the misrepresentation induced assent to the contract and

• the adversely affected party justifiably relied* on the misrepresentation. Here, the dealer repaired and repainted the car to conceal accident damage. This fraudulent misrepresentation, along with the dealer's misleading statements about the car's history, induced the buyer to purchase the car. And since the dealer's misrepresentations were not obviously false (eg, had the accident damage been visible) or known by the buyer to be false, he justifiably relied on them. Therefore, his action to rescind the contract is likely to succeed.

*This element is met unless the misrepresentation was patently and obviously false or the adversely affected party knew that it was false.

(Choice A) The buyer's failure to have the car inspected by his own mechanic does not make his reliance on the dealer's misrepresentations unjustified or prevent him from rescinding the contract.

(Choice C) A contract is unconscionable when (1) the contract terms are one-sided or create unfair surprise or (2) the bargaining process provides no meaningful choice to a party (neither of which is seen here).

Educational objective:

A contract is voidable for misrepresentation if (1) the misrepresentation was fraudulent or material, (2) it induced assent to the contract, and (3) the adversely affected party justifiably relied on it.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 164 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when misrepresentation makes a contract voidable).

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 168–72 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when reliance on assertions of fact or opinion is justified).

explanation.zh:
错误陈述是对事实的不实断言,常常是在肯定声明中作出的断言,也可以通过行为----即旨在防止发现事实或不披露事实的隐瞒行为(Choice B)。当出现任何形式的虚假陈述时,合同是可撤销的,可由受不利影响的缔约方:

• 虚假陈述是欺诈性的(故意或轻率地作出,意图促使另一方同意合同)或材料(即有可能促使有理智的人同意)

• 虚假陈述导致同意合同;

• 受不利影响的一方有理由依赖* 虚假陈述,在此,经销商修复并重新油漆了汽车,以掩盖事故损害。这种虚假的歪曲,加上经销商对汽车历史的误导性陈述,促使买方购买了汽车.由于经销商的不实陈述显然不是虚假的(例如,如果事故损害是显而易见的),或者买方知道是虚假的,因此他有理由依赖这些陈述。 因此,他撤销合同的行动很可能是成功的。

* 本要件已得到满足,除非该虚假陈述显然是虚假的,或受害方知道其虚假。

(Choice A) 买方未能让自己的机械师检查汽车,这并不能使他依赖经销商的不实之词,或者阻止他撤销合同。

(选择C) 合同如果(1) 合同条款是单方面的或造成不公平的意外,或(2) 谈判过程没有为一方当事人提供有意义的选择(此处不见于此)。

学习要点：

如果(1) 虚假陈述是欺诈或重大内容,(2) 导致同意合同,(3) 受到不利影响的当事人有理由依赖合同,则合同因虚假陈述而无效。

参考资料

• 重述(第二次)合同第164条(1981年《美国法律》)(如果错误陈述使合同可以无效)。

• 重述(第二次)168-72号合同(1981年《美国法律》)(如果有理由依赖对事实或意见的断言)。

stem: In order to raise revenue, a city required home-repair contractors who performed work within the city limits to pay a licensing fee to a city agency. A contractor who was unaware of the fee requirement agreed to perform home repairs for a city resident. After the contractor completed the work, the resident discovered that the contractor had not paid the licensing fee, and she refused to pay for the repairs, which were otherwise satisfactory.
stemZh: 为了增加收入,一个城市要求在城市界限内从事住房维修的承包商向城市机构支付许可证费,不知道收费要求的承包商同意为城市居民进行住房维修。在承包商完成工程后,居民发现承包商没有支付许可费,她拒绝支付修理费,否则是令人满意的。
ask: If the contractor sues the resident for breach of contract, how is the court likely to rule?
askZh: 如果承包商起诉居民违反合同,法院如何作出裁决?

options.en: Although the contract violates the law and is void, the court will require the homeowner to pay the contractor the reasonable value of the work accepted.
options.zh: 虽然合同违法且无效,但法院将要求房主向承包商支付所接受工程的合理价值。

options.en: Although the contract violates the law, the court will find that public policy does not bar enforcement of the contract, because the purpose of the fee is merely to raise revenue.
options.zh: 尽管合同违反了法律,但法院将认定公共政策并不禁止执行合同,因为收费的目的只是增加收入。

options.en: Because the contract violates the law and is void, the court will not enforce it.
options.zh: 由于合同违反法律,无效,法院不会执行.

options.en: Because the purpose of the fee is merely to raise revenue, the court will find that the contract does not violate the law but will allow the contractor to recover his costs only.
options.zh: 由于收费的目的只是为了增加收入,法院将裁定合同不违反法律,而只允许承包商收回他的费用。

explanation.en:
Weighing public policy v. Interest in enforcing illegal contract

Public policy Interest in enforcing

• Strength of policy as shown by legislature or courts

• Likelihood nonenforcement will further policy

• Seriousness and/or deliberateness of misconduct

• Connection between misconduct & contract

• Parties' justified expectations

• Forfeiture that would result from nonenforcement

• Special public interest in enforcement

Illegal contracts are generally void as against public policy. But if a contract is illegal solely because a party does not have a required license, then the enforceability of the contract depends on whether the purpose behind the licensing requirement is:

• economic (eg, raise revenue) – in which case the contract is enforceable or

• regulatory (eg, protect public health or safety) – in which case the contract is unenforceable if the public policy behind the requirement clearly outweighs the interest in enforcing the contract.

Here, the contract between the contractor and resident was illegal because the contractor had not paid the required licensing fee to the city agency. But since the purpose of this fee is merely to raise revenue for the city, the court will likely find that public policy does not bar enforcement of the contract (Choice C).

(Choice A) Had the contract been void on public-policy grounds, then the court may have required the homeowner to pay restitution damages (ie, the reasonable value of the work accepted) to avoid unjust enrichment.

(Choice D) The contract does violate the law. But public policy does not bar its enforcement, and the contractor is entitled to recover the full contract price—not his costs only.

Educational objective:

When a party does not have a required license, the enforceability of the contract depends on whether the purpose behind the requirement is (1) economic, in which case the contract is enforceable, or (2) regulatory, in which case it is unenforceable if the public policy behind the requirement clearly outweighs the interest in enforcement.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 181 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when failure to comply with licensing requirement makes contract unenforceable).

explanation.zh:
监督公共政策与执行非法合同的利害关系

执行公共政策的利益

• 立法机构或法院显示的政策力量

• 不强制执行的可能性将进一步制定政策

• 不当行为的严重性和(或)蓄意性

• 不当行为与合同之间的联系

• 缔约方的合理期望

• 不执行会造成没收

• 执法方面的特别公共利益

与公共政策相比,非法合同一般是无效的。 但是,如果仅仅因为一方当事人没有所要求的许可证而合同是非法的,那么合同的可执行性取决于许可证要求的目的是否是:

• 经济(例如增加收入)——在这种情况下,合同可以执行或

管制(例如保护公共卫生或安全)——在这种情况下,如果要求背后的公共政策明显超过执行合同的利益,则合同是无法执行的。

在此,承包商与居民之间的合同是非法的,因为承包商没有向城市机构支付所要求的许可证费。但由于这种收费的目的仅仅是为城市增加收入,法院可能会发现公共政策并不禁止执行合同(Choice C).

(选择A) 如果合同因公共政策原因而无效,那么法院可能已经要求房主支付归还赔偿金(即所接受工作的合理价值),以避免不公平的致富。

合同确实违反了法律,但公共政策并不妨碍合同的执行,承包人有权收回全部合同价格,而不仅仅是他的费用。

学习要点：

当一方当事人没有规定的许可证时,合同的可执行性取决于该要求背后的目的是否是(1)经济的,在这种情况下,合同是可强制执行的,或者(2)规章的,在这种情况下,如果公共政策是不可强制执行的。要求背后显然大于对强制执行的兴趣。

参考资料

• 重述(第二)合同第181条(1981年《阿姆法》)(如果不遵守许可证要求使合同无法执行)。

stem:
In a telephone conversation, a jewelry maker offered to buy 100 ounces of gold from a precious metals company if delivery could be made within 10 days. The jewelry maker did not specify a price, but the market price for 100 ounces of gold at the time of the conversation was approximately $65,000. Without otherwise responding, the company delivered the gold six days later.

In the meantime, the project for which the jewelry maker planned to use the gold was canceled. The jewelry maker therefore refused to accept delivery of the gold or to pay the $65,000 demanded by the company.
stemZh:
在电话交谈中,一位珠宝制造商提出,如果能在10天内交货,就向一家贵金属公司购买100盎司黄金。珠宝制造商没有具体说明价格,但谈话时100盎司黄金的市场价格约为65,000美元,没有其他回应,6天后公司交付了黄金.

在此期间,珠宝制作人计划使用黄金的项目被取消,珠宝制作人因此拒绝接受黄金交付或支付公司要求的65,000美元.
ask: Is there an enforceable contract between the jewelry maker and the company?
askZh: 珠宝制造商与公司之间是否有可执行的合同?

options.en: No, because the parties did not agree on a price term.
options.zh: 不,因为双方没有约定价格条件。

options.en: No, because the parties did not put their agreement in writing.
options.zh: 不,因为双方没有将其协议以书面形式提出。

options.en: Yes, because the absence of a price term does not defeat the formation of a valid contract for the sale of goods where the parties otherwise intended to form a contract.
options.zh: 是的,因为没有价格条款并不影响订立有效的货物销售合同,而当事人本来打算订立合同。

options.en: Yes, because the company relied on an implied promise to pay when it delivered the gold.
options.zh: 是的,因为公司在交付黄金时 依靠默示承诺支付

explanation.en:
The UCC statute of frauds applies to contracts for the sale of goods of $500 or more (eg, gold valued at $65,000—as seen here) and renders such contracts unenforceable unless they are in a writing that:

• provides a reasonable basis to believe a contract was formed

• states the quantity of goods to be sold* and

• is signed with an identifying mark by the party against whom enforcement is sought. However, this statute does not apply when (1) the goods are specially manufactured, (2) the party against whom enforcement is sought admits to the contract, or (3) some amount of payment or goods was received and accepted.

Here, there is no indication that the gold was specially manufactured for the jewelry maker or that the jewelry maker admitted to a contract with the company. And though the company delivered the gold to the jewelry maker, the jewelry maker refused to accept delivery. Therefore, the contract is not excepted from the statute of frauds. And since the parties did not put their agreement into writing, it is unenforceable.

*The contract is only enforceable up to the written quantity.

(Choices A & C) A contract for the sale of goods is enforceable even if the price term is missing or incorrectly stated. But even though the absence of a price term does not affect the enforceability of the contract between the jewelry maker and the company, the contract is still unenforceable because the parties failed to put it in writing.

(Choice D) Under the doctrine of promissory estoppel, the company's reliance on an implied promise to pay would provide an alternative basis for recovery only if such reliance was reasonable and caused the company substantial detriment (eg, turning down substantial business to fulfill the jewelry maker's request—not seen here).

Educational objective:

Contracts for the sale of goods of $500 or more are not subject to the statute of frauds if (1) the goods are specially manufactured, (2) the party against whom enforcement is sought admits to the contract, or (3) some amount of goods or payment was received and accepted.

References

• UCC § 2-201 (statute of frauds formal requirements).

explanation.zh:
《UCC防止欺诈法》适用于500美元或以上的货物(如此处所见价值65 000美元的黄金)的销售合同,并使得这类合同无法执行,除非书面表明:

• 为相信合同已经订立提供合理依据

• 说明待售货物的数量* 和

• 由被请求强制执行的一方签署识别标志,但如果(1)货物是专门制造的,(2)被请求强制执行的一方承认合同,或(3)某些数额的,则不适用本法规。收讫并接受付款或货物。

这里没有迹象表明黄金是为珠宝制作人专门制造的,也没有迹象表明珠宝制作人承认与公司签订了合同,虽然公司将黄金交给珠宝制作人,但珠宝制作人拒绝接受交货.因此,合同不被排除在防止欺诈法之外,而且由于双方当事人没有将其协议写成书面,因此无法执行。

* 合同只有在书面数量范围内才能执行。

(Choices A & C) 货物销售合同即使缺少价格条件或表述不正确,也可执行。但是,即使没有价格条款并不影响珠宝制作人与公司之间的合同的可执行性,但合同仍然无法执行,因为双方当事人没有将其写成书面.

(Choice D) 根据期初不容反悔原则,公司对默示承诺的依赖,只有在这种依赖是合理的并且给公司造成重大损害(例如,拒绝实质性承诺)的情况下,才会为追偿提供另一种依据。以完成珠宝制作人的要求,这里没有看到。

学习要点：

如果(1) 货物是专门制造的,(2) 被请求强制执行的一方承认合同,或(3) 收到了一些货物或付款,则500美元或500美元以上的货物销售合同不受防止欺诈法的约束。已经接受。
