stem: A dry goods retailer telephoned a towel manufacturer and offered to buy a minimum of 500 and a maximum of 1,000 large bath towels for $5 each, to be delivered in 30 days. The manufacturer orally accepted this offer and promptly sent the following letter to the retailer, which the retailer received two days later: "This confirms our agreement today by telephone to sell you 500 large bath towels for 30-day delivery. /s/ Manufacturer." Twenty-eight days later, the manufacturer tendered to the retailer 1,000 (not 500) conforming bath towels, all of which the retailer rejected because it had found a better price term from another supplier. Because of a glut in the towel market, the manufacturer cannot resell the towels except at a loss.
stemZh: 一名干货零售商给一个毛巾制造商打电话,提出购买至少500件,最多1000件大浴巾,每件5美元,30天内交付.制造商口头接受了这一要约,并迅速向零售商发出以下信件,两天后,零售商收到了这封信:"这证实了我们今天通过电话将500块大浴巾卖给你,供30天送货./s/制造商" 28天后,制造商向零售商招标了1000(不是500)个符合要求的浴巾,零售商都拒绝了,因为从另一供应商那里找到了更好的价格条件.由于毛巾市场过量,厂商除了亏损外无法转售毛巾.
ask: In a suit by the manufacturer against the retailer, which of the following will most likely be the decision?
askZh: 在制造商针对零售商的诉讼案中,最有可能的是以下哪一项决定?

options.en: The manufacturer can enforce a contract for 1,000 towels, because the retailer ordered and the manufacturer tendered that quantity.
options.zh: 制造商可以执行1000条毛巾的合同,因为零售商订购,制造商招标该数量.

options.en: The manufacturer can enforce a contract for 500 towels, because the manufacturer's letter of confirmation stated that quantity term.
options.zh: 制造商可以执行500条毛巾的合同,因为制造商的确认书中写明了数量期限.

options.en: There is no enforceable agreement, because the manufacturer's letter of confirmation did not state a price term.
options.zh: 没有可执行的协议,因为制造商的确认书没有说明价格条件。

options.en: There is no enforceable agreement, because the retailer never signed a writing.
options.zh: 没有可执行的协议,因为零售商从未签署过书面协议.

explanation.en:
Exceptions to UCC statute of frauds

Applicability Effect

Merchant's confirmation

• Both parties are merchants

• One party sends written & signed confirmation

• Recipient has reason to know contents

• No written objection within 10 days

• Enforceable against both parties for quantity confirmed

• Recipient's signature not required

Specially manufactured goods

• Indication that goods are for buyer

• Goods are specially manufactured & not sellable in ordinary course of business

• Seller substantially began manufacturing or committed to procurement

• Enforceable against both parties

• No writing required

Admission • One party admits to contract in pleadings or court

• Enforceable against that party for quantity admitted

• No writing required Payment/delivery • Payment was made & accepted OR goods were delivered & accepted

• Enforceable against both parties for quantity paid for/delivered

• No writing required UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

Under the UCC statute of frauds, contracts for the sale of goods of $500 or more must generally be in writing and signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought. However, if both parties are merchants and one party sends a written and signed confirmation, the contract will be enforceable against both parties—up to the quantity term stated in the confirmation—if the recipient:

• receives the confirmation and has reason to know of its contents and

• fails to object to the contents in writing within 10 days of receiving the confirmation. Here, the retailer offered to buy 500 to 1,000 large bath towels for $5 each. The manufacturer accepted that offer orally, and since the resulting contract is for $500 or more, it falls within the statute of frauds. The manufacturer then sent a signed letter of confirmation to the retailer for 500 large bath towels, which the retailer received. And although the retailer never signed a writing, both parties are merchants (Choice D). Therefore, the manufacturer's confirmation made the contract enforceable against both parties for 500 towels (the stated quantity term).

(Choice A) The contract would be enforceable against the retailer for 1,000 towels if the retailer had accepted the manufacturer's tender of that quantity. But since the retailer rejected all the towels, the manufacturer's delivery did not make the contract enforceable.

(Choice C) Under the UCC, an enforceable contract can be created without stating a price term. In that case, the UCC "fills the gap" with a reasonable price at the time of delivery.

Educational objective:

Under the UCC statute of frauds, a contract between two merchants is enforceable against both parties if (1) one party sends a written and signed confirmation of the contract, (2) the recipient has reason to know the contents of that confirmation, and (3) the recipient fails to object in writing within 10 days.

References

• U.C.C. § 2-201 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (statute of frauds).

explanation.zh:
UCC法规的例外

适用效果

Merchant的确认

• 双方均为商人

• 一方发出书面和签名确认

• 收件人有理由知道内容

• 10天内无书面反对意见

• 可对双方强制执行确认的数量

• 不需要收件人签字

特殊制成品

• 表明货物是为买方提供的

• 货物是专门制造的,在正常经营过程中无法出售;

• 卖方基本上开始制造或承诺采购

• 可对双方强制执行

• 不需要书面说明

• 一方当事人在诉状或法院中承认合同

• 就所允许的数量而言,可对该当事方强制执行

• 没有要求书面付款/交货 付款和接受其他资源货物交付和接受

• 可按支付/交付的数量对双方强制执行

• 不要求书面UCC=统一商法典。

根据《UCC公司防止欺诈法》,500美元或500美元以上的货物销售合同一般必须是书面的,并由寻求执行的一方签署。但是,如果双方为商家,一方发出书面和经签字的确认书,则合同可对双方强制执行,但不得超过确认书中规定的数量期限,条件是:

• 得到确认并有理由知道其内容;

· 在收到确认书后10天内未对书面内容提出异议,在此,零售商提出购买500至1000块大浴巾,每块5美元.制造商口头接受了该要约,由于由此产生的合同是500美元或500美元以上,因此属于防止欺诈法的范围,制造商随后向零售商发出了500条大型浴巾的签名确认信,零售商收到了这封信。尽管零售商从未签署过书面文件,但双方都是商人(Choice D),因此,制造商的确认使得合同可以对双方执行500毛巾(说明的数量期限).

(Choice A)如果零售商接受了制造商的该批量标书,则1000毛巾的零售商可以执行合同,但由于零售商拒绝了所有毛巾,制造商的交货并没有使合同可以执行.

(C选择) 根据UCC,可以不说明价格条款而创建可执行的合同,在这种情况下,UCC"填补缺口"在交货时以合理的价格.

学习要点：

根据《统一商法典》关于欺诈的法规,如果(1)一方发出书面和签署的合同确认书,(2)接受人有理由知道该确认书的内容,(3)接受人,则两个商家之间的合同可以对双方强制执行。未在10天内以书面形式提出异议。

参考资料

• U.C.C.§2-201(Am.Law Inst. & Unif.Law Comm'n 2020)(防止欺诈法)。

stem:
An elderly woman, who had two adult children, wished to employ a live-in companion so that she might continue to live in her own home. The woman, however, had only enough income to pay one-half of the companion's $2,000 monthly salary. Learning of their mother's plight, her son and daughter agreed with each other in a signed writing that on the last day of January and each succeeding month during their mother's lifetime, each would give the mother $500. The mother then hired the companion.

The son and daughter made the agreed payments in January, February, and March. In April, however, the son refused to make any payment and notified his sister and mother that he would make no further payments.
stemZh:
一名年长妇女有两个成年子女,希望雇用一名同居伴侣,以便她能够继续住在自己的家中,但是,她的收入只够支付伴侣月薪2 000美元的一半。得知母亲的困境后,她的儿子和女儿在一份签名的信中同意,在1月的最后一天和母亲生前的下个月,每人会给母亲500美元,然后由母亲聘请同伴。

儿子和女儿于1月、2月和3月支付了商定的款项,但儿子于4月拒绝支付任何款项,并通知其姐姐和母亲他不再支付款项。
ask: Will the mother succeed in an action for $500 brought against the son after April 30?
askZh: 4月30日后,母亲是否会成功起诉儿子500美元?.

options.en: No, because a parent cannot sue her child for breach of a promise for support.
options.zh: 不,因为父母不能起诉她的孩子 违反赡养承诺。

options.en: No, because the son and daughter intended their payments to their mother to be gifts.
options.zh: 不,因为儿子和女儿 打算把他们付给母亲的钱作为礼物。

options.en: Yes, because by making his first three payments, the son confirmed his intent to contract.
options.zh: 是的,因为通过他的前三次付款, 儿子确认了他打算签约。

options.en: Yes, because the mother is an intended beneficiary of a contract between the son and daughter.
options.zh: 是的,因为母亲是儿子和女儿之间合同的预期受益人。

explanation.en:
Third-party beneficiaries

(ie, nonparties who benefit from contract)

Type Definition Right to enforce

Intended • Receive direct benefit from contract because contracting parties intended to benefit them

• Eg, A promises to paint B's house if B promises to pay $500 to C

Yes

Incidental • Receive indirect benefit from contract even though there was no contractual intent to benefit them

• Eg, A promises to buy B a car manufactured by C

No

A third-party beneficiary is a nonparty to a contract who receives some benefit from that contract. The third party can enforce the contract if he/she is an intended beneficiary— ie, one whom the contracting parties intended to benefit directly.

Here, the son and daughter entered into the contract to give the mother $500 each month. Although the mother was not a party to that contract, the son and the daughter intended to confer a gift upon the mother—$500 monthly from each child. Therefore, the mother was an intended beneficiary of the contract and will succeed in an enforcement action against the son (Choice B).

(Choice A) There is no rule that a parent cannot sue a child for breach of a promise for support, but such a promise may be unenforceable for another reason—eg, if the promise lacks consideration. Here, however, the son and daughter's exchanged promises were supported by consideration.

(Choice C) The son confirmed his intent to contract when he agreed with the daughter that each would give the mother $500 monthly. Therefore, the first three payments are irrelevant to the son's intent to contract.

Educational objective:

A person who is not a party to a contract may still enforce that contract if he/she is an intended beneficiary—ie, a third party whom the contracting parties intended to benefit directly.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 302 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (intended and incidental beneficiaries).

explanation.zh:
第三方受益人

(即从合同中受益的非当事人)

类型 定义 强制执行的权利

• 直接受益于合同,因为订约方打算从中受益

• 例如,A承诺,如果B承诺向C支付500美元,就画B的房子

对

• 尽管没有合同意向,但从合同中获得间接利益让他们受益

• 例如,A承诺购买C制造的汽车B

没有

第三方受益人是合同的非当事方,从合同中获得一定的利益,第三方如果是合同的预期受益人——即订约方打算直接受益的受益人——可以强制执行合同。

在此,儿子和女儿签订了每月给母亲500美元的合同,虽然母亲不是该合同的当事方,但儿子和女儿打算给母亲一个礼物——每个孩子每月500美元。因此,母亲是合同的预期受益人,将对儿子采取强制执行行动(Choice B)。

(选择A) 没有任何规则规定父母不能起诉儿童违反赡养承诺,但这种承诺可能由于另一个原因而无法执行——例如,如果承诺缺乏对价。然而,在此,儿子和女儿的交换承诺得到了对价的支持.

(Choice C) 儿子在与女儿约定每人每月给母亲500美元时,确认了他签订合同的意图,因此,前三次付款与儿子签订合同的意图无关.

学习要点：

非合同当事方的人,如果他/她是合同的预期受益人——即第三方,订约方打算直接受益,则仍可强制执行该合同。

参考资料

• 重述(第二份)合同第302条(1981年《安曼法律》)(意向受益人和附带受益人)。

stem:
A flour manufacturer contracted to deliver to a baker her flour requirements for a one-year period. Before delivery of the first scheduled installment, the flour manufacturer sold its business and assigned all of its sale contracts to a reputable and longtime flour wholesaler. The flour manufacturer informed the baker of this transaction.

When the flour wholesaler tendered the first installment to the baker in compliance with the manufacturer-baker contract, the baker refused to accept the goods.
stemZh:
面粉制造商承包向面包师提供为期一年的面粉需求,在首次预定的分期交付之前,面粉制造商将其业务出售,并将其所有销售合同分配给声誉良好的长期面粉厂。面粉制造商将这笔交易通知面包师。

当面粉批发商按照制造商-面包商的合同向面包师招标第一批分期付款时,面包师拒绝接受货物。
ask: Which of the following arguments, if any, legally support(s) the baker's rejection of the goods?
askZh: 下列哪些理由在法律上支持面包师拒绝货物?

options.en: Duties under an executory bilateral contract are assumable only by an express promise to perform on the part of the delegatee, and language of "assignment" in the transfer for value of a bilateral sale-of-goods contract effects only a transfer of rights, not a delegation of duties.
options.zh: 一项可执行的双边合同下的义务只能通过委托人明确承诺履行而推定,而双边货物销售合同价值转让中的“转让”一词只能是权利的转让,而不是下放职责。

options.en: Executory requirements contracts are nonassignable.
options.zh: 执行需求合同不可转让。

options.en: Executory requirements contracts are nonassignable, duties under an executory bilateral contract are assumable only by an express promise to perform on the part of the delegatee, and language of "assignment" in the transfer for value of a bilateral sale-of-goods contract effects only a transfer of rights, not a delegation of duties.
options.zh: 执行需求合同是不可转让的,执行的双边合同下的义务只能通过委托人明确承诺履行来计算,在转让双边货物价值时使用“转让”一词合同只影响权利的转让,而不是责任的下放。

options.en: No argument legally supports the baker's rejection of the goods.
options.zh: 没有论据在法律上支持面包师拒绝货物.

explanation.en:
Contract provisions prohibiting assignments/delegations

Type of provision

Explicit prohibitions Assignment of rights

Delegation of duties

None N/A Allowed

Specific Assignment of rights & delegation of duties

Barred

Assignment of rights only Barred Allowed

Delegation of duties only Allowed Barred

General Assignment of "the contract"

Unless stated otherwise, bilateral contracts for the sale of goods can be assigned in their entirety, and this will be construed as an assignment of rights and a delegation of duties to a nonparty (ie, delegatee). Such assignments are generally valid, even for an executory requirements contract—ie, an uncompleted contract for the sale of as many goods as the buyer needs during a specified period (Choice B). The delegatee's acceptance of the assignment constitutes a promise to perform the duties, and the promisee must accept that performance.

Here, the flour manufacturer assigned the baker's requirements contract to the flour wholesaler (delegatee), and the baker refused to accept the wholesaler's first installment of flour. However, this general language of "assignment" operates as a transfer of rights and a delegation of duties. The wholesaler's acceptance of that assignment is a promise to perform—ie, to sell the baker as much flour as she needs for one year (Choices A & C). Therefore, no argument legally supports the baker's rejection of the goods.

Educational objective:

The assignment of an entire contract is construed as an assignment of rights and a delegation of duties to a nonparty (ie, delegatee). The delegatee's acceptance of the assignment constitutes a promise to perform the delegator's duties, and the promisee must accept that performance.

References

• U.C.C. § 2-210 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (explaining that a general assignment is an assignment of rights and a delegation of duties).

explanation.zh:
禁止转让/委托的合同规定

规定类型

明文禁止权利的转让

职责的下放

无 允许

权利的转让和职责的下放

被拒绝

只允许转让权利

授权

“合同”的一般转让

除非另有说明,销售货物的双边合同可以全部转让,这将被解释为向非当事人(即委托人)转让权利和下放职责。这种转让一般是有效的,即使对于一项执行需求合同来说也是有效的,即一项未完成的销售合同,其数量相当于买方在特定时期内所需要的数量(Choice B)。委托人接受转让构成履行该职责的承诺,承诺人必须接受这一履行。

在这里,面粉制造商将面包师的需求合同交给了面粉批发商(delegatee),面包师拒绝接受批发商的面粉第一批发货.然而,这种“转让”的一般语言是权利的转让和职责的下放,批发商接受这一转让是一种承诺,即履行——即按面包师一年的需要销售多少面粉(Choices A & C)。因此,没有任何论据在法律上支持面包师拒绝货物。

学习要点：

整个合同的转让被理解为权利转让和向非当事人(即委托人)下放职责。委托人接受转让即构成履行委托人职责的承诺,承诺人必须接受这一履行。

参考资料

• 《美国法典》第2-210条(Am.Law Inst. & Unif.Law Comm'n 2020)(解释一般性转让是权利的转让和职责的下放)。

stem: A breeder bought a two-month-old registered boar at auction from a seller for $800. No express warranty was made. Fifteen months later, tests by experts proved conclusively that the boar had been born incurably sterile. If this had been known at the time of the sale, the boar would have been worth no more than $100. In an action by the breeder against the seller to avoid the contract and recover the price paid, the parties stipulate that, as both were and had been aware, the minimum age at which the fertility of a boar can be determined is about 12 months.
stemZh: 育种者以800美元的价格向卖家拍卖购买了一只两个月的注册野猪.15个月后,专家的测试确凿证明:野猪生下来就无菌了如果在出售时已经知道这一点,野猪的价值将不超过100美元。 在育种者对卖方提出的宣告合同无效和收回已付价款的诉讼中,双方规定,正如双方过去和现在都知道的那样,最低限价可以确定野猪生育率的年龄约为12个月。
ask: Which of the following will the court probably decide?
askZh: 法庭可能会裁定以下哪一个?

options.en: The breeder wins, because the parties were mutually mistaken as to the boar's fertility when they made the agreement.
options.zh: 育种者获胜,因为双方在达成协议时都对野猪的生育能力有共同的错误.

options.en: The breeder wins, because the seller impliedly warranted that the boar was fit for breeding.
options.zh: 养殖者获胜,因为卖方暗中要求野猪适合饲养。

options.en: The seller wins, because any mistake involved was unilateral, not mutual.
options.zh: 卖方获胜,因为任何错误都是单方面的,而不是相互的。

options.en: The seller wins, because the breeder assumed the risk of the boar's sterility.
options.zh: 卖方获胜,因为饲养者承担了野猪不育的风险。

explanation.en:
When party assumes risk of mistake

Express Contract allocates risk to party

Conscious ignorance

Party enters contract despite conscious ignorance of facts related to mistake

Adjudication Court allocates risk to party because reasonable under circumstances

Mutual mistake occurs when both parties enter into a contract based on the same mistake. In such cases, the contract may be voidable by the adversely affected party if:

• the mistake relates to a basic assumption of the contract

• the mistake materially affects the agreed-upon exchange of performances (ie, the adversely affected party cannot fairly be required to carry it out) and

• the adversely affected party did not assume the risk of the mistake.

One way a party assumes the risk of a mistake is by proceeding with conscious ignorance (ie, awareness of his/her limited knowledge) of the facts related to the mistake.

Here, both the breeder and the seller likely entered the contract based on an erroneous belief that the boar would be fertile—a basic assumption of the contract—as evidenced by the $800 sales price (Choice C). That mutual mistake materially affected the agreed-upon exchange since the boar's actual worth was no more than $100. However, the breeder assumed the risk that the boar would turn out to be sterile because the breeder was aware that the boar's fertility could not be known at the time of the sale (Choice A). As a result, the seller probably wins.

(Choice B) Under the UCC, a seller impliedly warrants that goods are fit for a particular purpose if the seller knows or should know that the buyer requires the goods for a particular purpose (eg, to breed) AND is relying upon the seller's expertise to provide suitable goods (eg, had the breeder lacked knowledge of fertility).

Educational objective:

Mutual mistake renders a contract voidable by the adversely affected party when (1) the mistake relates to a basic assumption of the contract, (2) the mistake materially affects the agreed-upon exchange of performances, and (3) the adversely affected party did not assume the risk of the mistake.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 152 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when mutual mistake makes a contract voidable).

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 154 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when a party bears the risk of a mistake).

explanation.zh:
当事人承担错误风险时

合同将风险分配给当事方

意识无知

当事人尽管自觉不了解与错误有关的事实,但仍签订合同

裁决法院将风险分配给当事方,因为情况合理

如果双方基于同一错误订立合同,就会发生相互错误。在这种情况下,有下列情形之一的,受害方可以撤销合同:

• 错误涉及合同的基本假设

• 错误在实质上影响到商定的交流表演(即不能要求受到不利影响的一方进行这种交流)和

• 受害方没有承担错误的风险。

一方承担错误风险的一种方式是,对与错误有关的事实进行自觉的无知(即对其有限的了解)。

在此,育种者和卖方都有可能根据一种错误的信念订立合同,即野猪是肥沃的——这是合同的基本假设——800美元销售价格(Choice C)就是证明。由于野猪的实际价值不超过100美元,这种相互错误实际上影响了商定的交换。然而,育种者承担了野猪变成无菌的风险,因为育种者知道猪的生育力在出售时(Choice A)尚不得而知,因此,卖方可能获胜.

(选择B)根据《统一商法典》,如果卖方知道或应当知道买方要求货物用于某一特定目的(例如繁殖),并依赖卖方的专门知识提供适当货物,则卖方默示保证货物适合某一特定目的。商品(例如,如果育种者不了解生育能力)。

学习要点：

相互错误使受不利影响的当事人在(1) 错误与合同的基本假设有关时可以宣告合同无效,(2) 错误对商定的履约交换有实质影响,(3) 受不利影响的当事人没有承担错误的风险。

UCC = 统一商法典

参考资料

• 重述(第二次)第152条(1981年《美国法律》)(当相互错误使合同无效时)。

• 重述(第二次)第154条(1981年《美国法律》)(当一方当事人承担错误风险时)。

stem:
The owner of a new office building contracted with a well-known landscaper to design and install landscaping around the building for $30,000. The agreement was memorialized in writing, was signed by both parties, and called for a budget of $5,000 for trees, shrubs, sod, and materials. The contract required the landscaper to complete the work within six months. Due to an unexpected increase in the price of trees and shrubs, the landscaper abandoned the project and never completed any of the work.

Three years after the landscaper's deadline, the building owner sued the landscaper for breach of contract. In the jurisdiction, the statute of limitations for breach of a services contract is two years after the breach, and the statute of limitations for breach of a sale-of-goods contract is four years.
stemZh:
新办公楼的业主与著名景观设计师签约,设计并安装了建筑周围的景观设计,费用为3万美元.协议经过书面纪念,双方签署,并要求为树木,灌木,豆类和材料编列5000美元的预算,合同要求园林师在6个月内完成工程.由于树木和灌木价格意外上涨,景观设计师放弃了该项目,从未完成任何工程.

风景名胜区落户3年后,建筑业主起诉风景名胜区人违约.在法域,违反服务合同的诉讼时效为违反合同两年后,违反货物销售合同的诉讼时效为四年。
ask: Can the owner recover damages from the landscaper?
askZh: 业主能向园艺师追讨损失吗?.

options.en: No, because the contract is divisible with respect to the services and goods, and the landscaper's breach is therefore subject to the two-year statute of limitations.
options.zh: 不,因为合同在服务和货物方面是可分割的,因此,地貌景观者违反合同须遵守两年的诉讼时效。

options.en: No, because the contract primarily calls for services, and the landscaper's breach is therefore subject to the two-year statute of limitations.
options.zh: 否,因为合同主要要求提供服务,因此,景观设计师的违反须遵守两年的诉讼时效。

options.en: Yes, because the landscaper's breach was a result of an increase in the price of goods, and his breach is therefore subject to the four-year statute of limitations.
options.zh: 是的,因为景观者违约是商品价格上涨的结果,因此他的违约受四年诉讼时效的限制.

options.en: Yes, because the landscaper's breach was willful, and he is therefore estopped from denying that his breach is subject to the four-year statute of limitations.
options.zh: 是的,因为地貌学家的违反是故意的,因此他无法否认他的违反是受到四年时效限制的。

explanation.en:
Contracts for the sale of goods are governed by Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC), while contracts for services are governed by common law. However, some contracts involve the sale of goods and the rendering of services. To determine which law applies to a "mixed" or "hybrid" contract, courts ask whether its predominant purpose was the sale of goods or the rendering of services. The following factors are relevant to this determination:

• The contract's language

• The nature of the supplier's business (ie, whether it typically provides goods or services)

• The relative value of the goods and services

• The nature of the final product (ie, whether it can be described as a good or service) Here, the building owner contracted to buy goods (eg, trees, shrubs, sod) and services (ie, designing and installing the landscaping). The owner likely hired the well-known landscaper due to his skill in performing landscaping services, and the $5,000 budget for goods was just one-sixth of the $30,000 contract price. Therefore, the contract primarily calls for services and is subject to the jurisdiction's two-year statute of limitations. And since the owner sued three years after the breach, the owner cannot recover damages from the landscaper.

(Choice A) The predominant-purpose test is unnecessary when a contract is divisible—ie, when the payment for goods can easily be separated from the payment for services. But here, the contract is likely indivisible since it combined the sale of the trees, shrubs, and sod with their installation.

(Choices C & D) The predominant-purpose test focuses on the parties' reason for entering the contract—not for breaching it. Therefore, it is irrelevant that the landscaper's breach was (1) a result of an increase in the price of goods or (2) willful.

Educational objective:

Sale-of-goods contracts are governed by the UCC, while services contracts are governed by common law. When a contract calls for the sale of goods AND the rendering of services, the contract's primary purpose determines whether the UCC or common law applies.

References

• Bonebrake v. Cox, 499 F.2d 951, 960 (8th Cir. 1974) (applying the predominant-purpose test to determine which statute of limitations applies to a mixed contract

for goods and services).

• Princess Cruises, Inc. v. Gen. Elec. Co., 143 F.3d 828, 833 (4th Cir. 1998) (listing factors that courts consider when applying the predominant-purpose test).

explanation.zh:
货物销售合同受《统一商法典》第2条管辖,服务合同受普通法管辖,但有些合同涉及货物销售和服务的提供。为了确定哪些法律适用于“混合”或“混合”合同,法院询问其主要目的是销售货物还是提供服务。

• 合同用语

• 供应商业务的性质(即,无论是一般提供货物还是服务)

• 货物和服务的相对价值

• 最终产品的性质(即,无论是货物还是服务) 此处,建筑主订约购买商品(如树木、灌木、草)和服务(即设计和安装景观美化)。业主可能因为从事景观美化服务的技能而雇用了著名景观师,5 000美元的货物预算只是30 000美元合同价格的六分之一。因此,合同主要要求提供服务,并且受该法域两年诉讼时效的限制,而且由于业主在违约三年后提起诉讼,所以业主无法向园艺师追索损失。

(Choice A) 当合同可以分割时,即货物付款很容易与服务付款分开时,主要目的检验是不必要的。但在这里,合同可能是不可分割的,因为它结合了树木,灌木的销售,和它们的安装.

主要的检验标准侧重于当事人订立合同的理由,而不是违反合同的理由,因此,景观者违反合同是(1)货物价格上涨或(2)故意造成的,这一点并不重要。

学习要点：

货物销售合同受《统一商法典》管辖,服务合同受普通法管辖,如果合同要求销售货物和提供服务,则合同的主要目的决定《统一商法典》或普通法是否适用。

参考资料

• Bonebrake诉Cox案,499 F.2d 951,960(1974年第8次Cir.) (适用主要目的检验,以确定何种时效适用于混合合同)

(商品与服务)。

• Princess Cruises, Inc. v. Gen. Elec. Co., 143 F.3d 828, 833(1998年第4次Cir.)(法院在适用主要目的测试时考虑的列名因素)。

stem: An elderly aunt owned two cars, a new one and an old one. She offered to sell the old car to her niece for $500. Knowing that her aunt owned two cars, the niece tried to trick the aunt into selling the new car by drawing up a contract that stated: "I agree to sell my nicest car to my niece for $500." The aunt noticed the niece's trick but signed the contract anyway, believing that it could not possibly refer to her new car, which was worth more than $30,000. The niece attempted to pay the aunt $500 several days later. However, the aunt refused to take the money or part with either car, stating that she had changed her mind in light of the niece's dirty trick.
stemZh: 一位年长的阿姨拥有两辆汽车,一辆新车和一辆旧车,她提出以500美元的价格把旧车卖给她的侄女,知道她姨妈拥有两辆汽车,侄女试图通过起草一份合同来欺骗姨妈出售新车:"我同意以500美元的价格把最好的车卖给我的侄女",姨妈注意到侄女的诡计,但无论如何都签了合同,认为这不可能是指她的新车,这辆车价值超过3万美元.几天后,侄女试图向姨妈支付500美元,但姨妈拒绝拿钱或用车中的任何一辆,称她因侄女的肮脏诡计而改变主意.
ask: If the niece sues the aunt for breach of contract, what will the court likely find?
askZh: 如果侄女告姨妈违约,法庭会发现什么?

options.en: The aunt is contractually obligated to sell her new car for $500.
options.zh: 姨妈根据合同有义务以500美元的价格出售她的新车。

options.en: The aunt is contractually obligated to sell her old car for $500.
options.zh: 姨妈按合同有义务以500美元的价格出售她的旧车。

options.en: The aunt can elect to sell either car for $500 or void the contract.
options.zh: 姨妈可以选择以500美元的价格出售汽车,或者取消合同。

options.en: There was no contract.
options.zh: 没有合同。

explanation.en:
Contract formation generally occurs when both parties objectively manifest their assent to an exchange—eg, when the aunt and niece signed a written contract for the sale of the aunt's "nicest car." But sometimes there is a misunderstanding because the parties have attached different meanings to the same material term. This prevents contract formation under two circumstances:

• Neither party knows or has reason to know of the misunderstanding.

• Both parties know or have reason to know of the misunderstanding. The result is different when only one party knows or has reason to know of the misunderstanding. In that case, a valid contract is formed, and the unknowing party's meaning of the term controls.

Here, the aunt believed that "nicest car" could not possibly refer to her new car and so understood the term to mean her old car. The niece knew this because the aunt had offered to sell her old car—not her new car. However, the niece intended "nicest car" to mean the aunt's new car. The aunt knew this because she noticed the niece's trick. Therefore, both parties knew of the misunderstanding, and the court will likely find that there was no contract.

(Choices A & B) Had the niece been unaware of the misunderstanding, her meaning ("new car") would control and the aunt would have been obligated to sell her new car. Alternatively, had the aunt been unaware of the misunderstanding, her meaning ("old car") would control and she would have been obligated to sell her old car. But since both parties knew of the misunderstanding, there was no contract.

(Choice C) A misunderstanding may prevent contract formation (as seen here), but it is never grounds to void (ie, cancel) a contract.

Educational objective:

A misunderstanding occurs when the contracting parties attach different meanings to the same material term. This prevents contract formation when neither OR both parties know or have reason to know of the misunderstanding.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 20 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (effect of misunderstanding).

explanation.zh:
当双方客观地表示同意交换时,例如,当姨妈和侄女签署了一份出售姨妈的"最好车"的书面合同时,合同的订立一般会发生。附加了同一物质术语的不同含义。这妨碍在两种情况下订立合同:

· 双方都不知道或有理由知道误解。

• 双方都知道或有理由知道误解。当只有一方当事人知道或有理由知道误解时,结果就不同了。在这种情况下,一项有效的合同成立,不知不觉的当事人对该术语的含义加以控制。

在这里,姨妈认为,“最漂亮的车”不可能指她的新车,因此理解这个词指的是她的旧车。 侄女知道这一点是因为姨妈提出要卖她的旧车,而不是她的新车。然而,侄女打算用"最美的车"来表示姨妈的新车,姨妈知道这一点是因为她注意到侄女的诡计,因此,双方都知道误会,法庭很可能会发现没有合同.

(Choices A & B)如果侄女不知道这个误解,她的意思("新车")会控制,姨妈有义务卖掉她的新车.或者,如果姑妈不知道这个误解,那么她的意思(“旧车 ” ) 就能控制住她,她也有义务卖掉她的旧车。 但既然双方都知道这个误解,就没有合同。

(C) 误解可能妨碍合同的订立(如此处所示),但绝不是合同无效(即取消)的理由。

学习要点：

当订约双方对同一实质性术语附加不同的含义时,就会产生误解,在双方或双方均不知道或有理由知道误解时,就无法订立合同。

参考资料

• 重述(第二次)合同§20(1981年《美国法律》)(误解的影响)。

stem:
A chemical corporation owned and operated a chemical processing plant. An accidental spill occurred, which made the plant unsafe for processing any chemicals. The chemical corporation subsequently entered a written and signed contract to sell the plant to a paint manufacturer for $2 million. The paint manufacturer planned to move its operations to the plant after closing the sale, and the chemical corporation assured the paint manufacturer that the plant was suitable and safe for that purpose.

The chemical corporation hired a hazardous waste company to clean up the chemical spill, and the plant was made safe for operations one week before closing the sale. Two days before closing, the paint manufacturer learned about the chemical spill from the local newspaper and refused to go through with the closing.
stemZh:
一家化学公司拥有并经营一个化学加工厂,发生了意外溢出,使工厂无法安全地加工任何化学品。化学公司随后签订了一份书面合同,以200万美元将工厂卖给一家油漆制造商。油漆制造商计划在出售结束后将其业务转移到该厂,化学公司向油漆制造商保证,该厂是适合和安全的。

化工公司聘请了一家有害废料公司清理化学溢出物,工厂在关闭销售前一周安全运行.关闭前两天,涂料制造商从当地报纸得知化学溢出事件,拒绝通过关闭.
ask: If the chemical corporation sues the paint manufacturer for breach of contract, which party is likely to prevail?
askZh: 如果化学公司起诉油漆制造商违约,哪一方可能胜诉?

options.en: The chemical corporation, because it cured the misrepresentation regarding the suitability and safety of the plant before closing.
options.zh: 化学公司,因为它在关闭前纠正了有关工厂是否合适和安全的错误说法。

options.en: The chemical corporation, because it had no duty to notify the paint manufacturer about the chemical spill.
options.zh: 化学公司,因为它没有义务将化学品泄漏通知油漆制造商。

options.en: The paint manufacturer, because it can be presumed that the paint manufacturer was harmed by the chemical corporation's misrepresentation.
options.zh: 颜料制造商,因为可以推定颜料制造商因化工公司的虚报而受到伤害.

options.en: The paint manufacturer, because the chemical spill rendered title to the plant unmarketable.
options.zh: 油漆制造商,因为化学溢出使得工厂的所有权无法出售。

explanation.en:
A misrepresentation is an untrue assertion of fact that makes a contract voidable by the adversely affected party when:

• the misrepresentation was fraudulent (ie, made knowingly or recklessly with the intent to induce the other party's assent to the contract) OR material (ie, likely to induce a reasonable person's assent)

• the misrepresentation induced assent to the contract and

• the adversely affected party justifiably relied on the misrepresentation.

However, a misrepresentation can be cured, and the contract is no longer voidable, if the circumstances change in such a way that the misrepresentation becomes true before the adversely affected party avoids the contract.

Here, the chemical corporation fraudulently misrepresented that its plant was suitable and safe for operations, thereby inducing the paint manufacturer to enter the contract. But since the corporation cured the misrepresentation by making the plant safe for operations before closing, the manufacturer could not subsequently avoid the contract. Therefore, the manufacturer's refusal to close was a breach, and the corporation is likely to prevail.

(Choice B) The chemical corporation did have a duty to notify the paint manufacturer about the spill since it knew that this made the plant unsafe for the manufacturer's intended operations. But the corporation will still prevail because it cured its misrepresentation.

(Choice C) A misrepresentation cannot be cured to the extent that the adversely affected party can prove that it was actually harmed by relying on the misrepresentation. But there is no presumption to that effect, nor is there evidence that the manufacturer was harmed by the misrepresentation.

(Choice D) In land-sale contracts, the seller impliedly warrants that it will convey marketable title to the buyer upon closing. Here, the chemical spill affected the manufacturer's intended use of the plant but did not render title unmarketable. And regardless, this defect was cured before closing.

Educational objective:

A fraudulent or material misrepresentation can be cured—and the contract is no longer voidable by the adversely affected party—if the circumstances change in such a way that the misrepresentation becomes true before the adversely affected party avoids the contract.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 165 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that a misrepresentation is cured if the facts come into accord with the assertion).

explanation.zh:
虚假陈述是对事实的不实断言,使受不利影响的当事人在下述情况下可撤销合同:

• 虚假陈述是欺诈性的(故意或轻率的,意图促使另一方同意合同)或材料(即可能促使有理智的人同意)

• 虚假陈述导致同意合同;

• 受到不利影响的一方有理由依赖这种歪曲。

但是,如果情况发生变化,在受到不利影响的当事人宣告合同无效之前,虚假陈述成为事实,则可以纠正错误陈述,合同不再可以撤销。

在这里,化工公司谎称其工厂适合而且安全操作,从而诱使油漆制造商签订合同。但是,由于该公司在关闭之前使工厂安全运行,从而纠正了虚假的说法,因此制造商随后无法宣告合同无效。因此,制造商拒绝关闭是违反合同,而且公司可能胜诉。

(Choice B) 化工公司确实有义务将溢出的情况通知涂料制造商,因为它知道这会使工厂对制造商的预定业务不安全。 但是,该公司仍然会胜诉,因为它纠正了它的错误说法。

(C选择) 虚报不能治愈,以至于受到不利影响的一方能够证明依靠虚报而实际受到损害.但是,没有这方面的推定,也没有证据表明制造商受到虚假陈述的损害。

(Choice D)在土地销售合同中,卖方默示保证在关闭时向买方传递可销售所有权,在此,化学溢出影响了制造商对工厂的预期使用,但并未导致所有权无法销售。不论如何,这个缺陷在关闭前被治愈.

学习要点：

如果情况发生变化,在受不利影响的当事方宣告合同无效之前,虚假或重大错误陈述是真实的,则欺诈性或重大错误陈述是可以纠正的,受到不利影响的当事方就不再可以撤销合同。

参考资料

• 重述(第二)第165条(1981年《阿姆法》)(解释如果事实与断言一致,则纠正虚报)。

stem: A farmer who wanted to sell her land received a letter from a developer that stated, "I will pay you $1,100 an acre for your land." The farmer's letter of reply stated, "I accept your offer." Unbeknownst to the farmer, the developer had intended to offer only $1,000 per acre but had mistakenly typed "$1,100." As both parties knew, comparable land in the vicinity had been selling at prices between $1,000 and $1,200 per acre.
stemZh: 一个想卖掉她土地的农民收到了一个开发商的一封信,信中说:"我会为你的土地付你1100美元一英亩",该农民的回信中说:"我接受你的要约",对于这个农民来说,开发商本打算只提供每块1000美元.如双方所知,附近可比土地每亩售价在1 000美元至1 200美元之间。
ask: Which of the following states the probable legal consequences of the correspondence between the parties?
askZh: 下列哪一项声明了当事方之间通信可能产生的法律后果?

options.en: There is a contract formed at a price of $1,000 per acre.
options.zh: 有一项合同,每英亩1 000美元。

options.en: There is a contract formed at a price of $1,100 per acre.
options.zh: 有一项合同,每亩1 100美元。

options.en: There is no contract, because the parties attached materially different meanings to the price term.
options.zh: 没有合同,因为双方当事人对价格术语附加了实质上不同的含义。

options.en: There is no enforceable contract, because the developer is entitled to rescission due to a mutual mistake as to a basic assumption of the contract.
options.zh: 不存在可执行的合同,因为开发商有权因对合同基本假设的相互错误而撤销合同。

explanation.en:
A valid contract is generally formed when a mutual agreement is supported by adequate consideration, such as when the developer offered to pay $1,100 an acre for the farmer's land and the farmer accepted. Although the developer intended to offer only $1,000, his unilateral mistake is not grounds to avoid the contract unless:

• the mistake would make enforcement of the contract unconscionable (eg, due to a substantial difference between contract price and actual value) or

• the nonmistaken party (ie, the farmer) caused, or knew or had reason to know of, the mistake. Here, the developer's mistake would not make enforcement of the contract unconscionable since the developer stands to lose just $100 per acre. The farmer did not cause the mistake and had no reason to know of it since comparable land in the vicinity had been selling at prices between $1,000 and $1,200 per acre. As a result, a valid contract was formed at a price of $1,100 per acre (Choice A).

(Choice C) A misunderstanding occurs when the parties attach different meanings to the same material term (eg, price). Here, the mistakenly typed "$1,100" did not create a misunderstanding since "$1,100" has just one meaning. But if it had, the misunderstanding would have prevented the formation of a contract.

(Choice D) There was no mutual mistake here since only the developer (not the farmer) was mistaken as to the contract price.

Educational objective:

Unilateral mistake is not grounds to avoid a contract unless (1) the mistake would make enforcement of the contract unconscionable or (2) the nonmistaken party caused, or knew or had reason to know of, the mistake.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 153 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when unilateral mistake makes a contract voidable).

一项有效的合同一般是在相互协议得到充分对价后形成的,例如,开发商提出为农民的土地支付1 100美元一英亩,农民接受。虽然开发商只打算提供1000美元,但他单方面的错误不是宣告合同无效的理由,除非:

• 错误将使合同的执行不合理(例如,由于合同价格与实际价值之间的重大差异)或

^ 非被监视方(即农民)造成或知道或有理由知道错误。在这里,开发商的错误不会使合同的执行不合理,因为开发商每英亩只损失100美元。该农民没有造成错误,也没有理由知道,因为附近可比土地每亩售价在1000美元至1200美元之间,因此,以每亩1100美元的价格(Choice A)组成了有效的合同.

(Choice C) 当双方将不同的含义附加到同一个物质术语(如价格)时,就发生了误解. 在此,错误地打出的"$1,100"并没有产生误解,因为"$1,100"只有一个含义.但是,如果有,这种误解会妨碍合同的订立。

(Choice D)这里没有共同的错误,因为只有开发商(而不是农民)被误认为合同价格.

学习要点：

单方面错误不是宣告合同无效的理由,除非(1)该错误将使合同的执行不合理,或者(2)非当事一方造成或知道或有理由知道错误。

stem:
A ceramics studio contracted with an artist to produce cups and saucers designed by the artist. The artist was an established designer of collectible ceramic dinnerware, and the studio did production work for many artists who created ceramic dinnerware. The price and quantity term of the contract read: "2,000 sets of the cups and saucers at $5 each, payable on delivery." The contract contained a merger clause.

The studio produced the cups and saucers and delivered them along with a bill for $20,000 (4,000 pieces at $5 per piece). The artist refused to pay more than $10,000 (2,000 sets at $5 per set).

At the trial of the studio's action against the artist for breach of contract, the studio introduced evidence of an established practice in the studio industry to price cup-and-saucer sets on a per-piece, not a per-set, basis.
stemZh:
一家陶瓷工作室与一位艺术家签约,生产由艺术家设计的杯子和酱料,艺术家是收藏陶瓷晚餐器皿的既定设计师,工作室为许多发明陶瓷晚餐器皿的艺术家做了生产工作.合同的价格和数量条款为:"两千套杯子和调料,每套5美元,交付时支付",合同中包含合并条款.

工作室生产了杯子和调料,并连同2万美元的账单(4000件每件5美元)一起交付,艺术家拒绝支付1万多美元(2000套每件5美元).

在审判工作室对艺人违反合同的诉讼时,工作室引入了工作室行业既定做法的证据,即按每件而不是每套价格定价杯式和杯式套装.
ask: Is the studio's evidence admissible?
askZh: 录音室的证据可以接受吗?

options.en: No, because such evidence would vary an unambiguous term of the contract.
options.zh: 否,因为这些证据会改变合同的明确条款。

options.en: No, because the agreement was completely integrated.
options.zh: 不,因为协议是完全一体化的。

options.en: Yes, because evidence of trade usage is always admissible.
options.zh: 是的,因为贸易使用的证据总是可以接受的。

options.en: Yes, because the usage of trade is offered to give meaning to the contract.
options.zh: 是的,因为贸易的使用是为了赋予合同以意义。

explanation.en:
Under the UCC parol evidence rule, evidence of any prior agreement (or any contemporaneous oral agreement) cannot be used to contradict the terms of a final written agreement. But the following evidence can always be used to explain or supplement those terms, regardless of whether the terms appear ambiguous:*

• Course of performance – sequence of conduct that is relevant to understanding an agreement between the parties if (1) the agreement involves repeated occasions for performance by a party and (2) the other party accepts performance without objection

• Course of dealing – sequence of conduct concerning previous transactions between the parties that establishes a common basis of understanding for interpreting their conduct

• Trade usage – any practice or method of dealing in the parties' business or industry that is practiced with enough regularity to justify an expectation that it will be practiced in the instant case Therefore, the studio's evidence of an established practice in the studio industry to price cup-and-saucer sets on a per-piece (not a per-set) basis is admissible because it is offered to give meaning to the contract.

*Priority is given as follows: (1) express contract terms prevail over all others, (2) course of performance prevails over course of dealing and trade usage, and (3) course of dealing prevails over trade usage.

(Choice A) Even if the terms of a written contract appear unambiguous, the UCC allows a party to explain or supplement the terms by evidence of trade usage, course of dealing, or course of performance.

(Choice B) If the agreement was completely integrated (ie, intended as a final and complete statement of the parties' agreement), then the studio could not explain or supplement its terms with evidence of consistent additional terms. But integration has no effect on the studio's ability to do so with evidence of trade usage (or course of dealing or performance).

(Choice C) Evidence of trade usage is admissible only to explain or supplement (not contradict) the terms of a final written agreement.

Educational objective:

The UCC parol evidence rule always allows use of the following evidence to explain or supplement the terms of a final written agreement: course of performance, course of dealing, and trade usage.

References

• U.C.C. § 2-202 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (parol evidence rule).

explanation.zh:
根据UCC parol证据规则,任何先前协议(或任何同时期口头协议)的证据不能用来与最后书面协议的条款相矛盾。但以下证据总是可以用来解释或补充这些术语,无论这些术语是否显得含糊不清:*

• 履行过程 -- -- 与理解当事人之间的协议有关的行为顺序,如果(1) 协议涉及一方当事人一再履行的情形,(2) 另一方当事人无异议接受履行

• 交易过程 -- -- 关于当事人之间以往交易的系列行为,为解释其行为建立共同的理解基础

• 贸易惯例——当事人的工商业中的任何交易惯例或方法,只要有足够的规律性,就有理由期望在本案中将采用这种做法。工作室行业按每件(而不是每套)定价的杯式和苏打机是允许的,因为它是为了赋予合同意义。

* 优先权如下:(1) 明确合同条款优先于所有其他条款;(2) 履约过程优先于交易过程和贸易惯例;(3) 交易过程优先于贸易惯例。

(Choice A) 即使书面合同的条款似乎不明确,《统一商法典》允许一方当事人通过贸易惯例、交易过程或履约过程的证据解释或补充条款。

(Choice B)如果协议是完全整合的(i,意为双方协议的最后完整声明),那么工作室无法用一致的额外条款的证据来解释或补充其条款.但结合对工作室在贸易使用(或交易过程或表演)的证据上这样做的能力没有任何影响.

(选择C) 贸易惯例的证据只能用于解释或补充(不矛盾)最后书面协议的条款。

学习要点：

UCC parol证据规则总是允许使用下列证据解释或补充最后书面协议的条款:履约过程、交易过程和贸易用途。

参考资料

• U.C.C.§2-202(Am.Law Inst. & Unif.Law Comm'n 2020)(假释证据规则)。

stem:
A patient owed a physician $25,000 for professional services. The physician orally assigned this claim to her adult daughter as a wedding gift. Shortly thereafter, on suffering sudden, severe losses in the stock market, the physician assigned by a signed writing the same claim to her stockbroker in partial satisfaction of advances legally made by the stockbroker in the physician's previous stock-market transactions. Subsequently, the patient, without knowledge of either assignment, paid the physician the $25,000 then due, which the physician promptly lost at a horse track. The physician remains solvent.

Assume that Article 9 of the Uniform Commercial Code does NOT apply to either of the assignments in this situation.
stemZh:
一名病人欠一名医生25,000美元的专业服务费,医生口头将这笔索赔作为结婚礼物交给她的成年女儿。此后不久,由于股市突然严重亏损,经签有字的医生指派,向她的股票经纪人提出同样的索赔,以部分满足股票经纪人在医生以前的股票市场上合法垫款的要求。随后,病人在不知晓任何一项任务的情况下,向医生支付了25 000美元,医生在马场上立即损失。

假定《统一商法典》第9条不适用于这种情形下的任何一项转让。
ask: Which of the following is a correct statement of the parties' rights and liabilities?
askZh: 下列哪一种是对当事人的权利和义务的正确表述?

options.en: As the assignee prior in time, the daughter can recover $25,000 from the patient, who acted at her peril in paying the physician.
options.zh: 正如受让人在时间之前所做的那样,女儿可以从病人那里收回25 000美元,因为病人在支付医生费用时冒着生命危险。

options.en: As the sole assignee for value, the stockbroker can recover $25,000 from the patient, who acted at her peril in paying the physician.
options.zh: 作为价值的唯一受让人,股票经纪人可以从病人那里追回25 000美元,病人在支付医生费用时冒着危险行事。

options.en: Neither the daughter nor the stockbroker can recover from the patient, but the daughter, though not the stockbroker, can recover $25,000 from the physician.
options.zh: 女儿和股票经纪人都无法从病人身上恢复,但女儿虽然不是股票经纪人,但可以从医生那里恢复25,000美元.

options.en: Neither the daughter nor the stockbroker can recover from the patient, but the stockbroker, though not the daughter, can recover $25,000 from the physician.
options.zh: 无论是女儿还是股票经纪人都无法从病人那里恢复过来,但是股票经纪人虽然不是女儿,但可以从医生那里恢复25,000美元.

explanation.en:
Assignment of contractual rights

Type Revocability Warranties

Gratuitous Revocable unless:

• obligor already performed

• document symbolizing assigned right (eg, stock certificate) delivered

• written & signed assignment delivered

• promissory estoppel applies

None

For value Irrevocable Assignor warrants that he/she:

• has right to assign

• is not subject to limitations/defenses unknown to assignee

• will not defeat/impair assigned rights An assignment is the transfer of a contractual right to another. Where there has been a subsequent assignment of the same right, the priority of those competing assignments depends on whether the first assignment was:

• revocable – in which case, the first assignment is automatically revoked and the second assignment has priority or

• irrevocable – in which case, the first assignment has priority unless the second assignee was a bona fide purchaser for value who lacked notice of the first assignment. Here, the physician orally assigned her claim for the $25,000 owed by the patient to her daughter as a wedding gift. That oral assignment was valid.* However, it was revocable because it was gratuitous and no exception applies (see above table). This means that the assignment to the daughter was automatically revoked when the physician subsequently assigned the same claim to her stockbroker. Accordingly, the daughter has no right to the $25,000 (Choices A & C).

The physician's assignment to the stockbroker was for value (namely, in partial satisfaction of advances), so it was irrevocable. Every assignment for value carries an implied warranty that the assignor will not do anything to defeat or impair the

assigned right. The physician breached that warranty by accepting the $25,000 owed by the patient and losing it at the horse track. As a result, the stockbroker can recover $25,000 from the physician.

However, the stockbroker cannot recover that amount from the patient. The reason is that the assignee's rights against the obligor are subject to any defenses that the obligor had against the assignor. Payment by the obligor (patient) to the assignor (physician) can be raised as a defense, provided that the payment was made before the obligor had notice of the assignment (as seen here). Therefore, the patient did not act at her peril in paying the physician (Choice B).

*Oral assignments are generally valid. However, a writing is required for (1) wage assignments, (2) assignments of interests in land, and (3) assignments intended as security instruments under Article 9 of the Uniform Commercial Code—none of which apply here.

Educational objective:

A subsequent assignment of the same right revokes any prior revocable assignment. If the first assignment was irrevocable, it has priority unless the second assignee was a bona fide purchaser for value who lacked notice.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 342 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (subsequent assignment of same right).

explanation.zh:
合同权利的转让

类型可替换性保证书

除下列情形外,无正当理由可换:

• 已履行的承付人

• 证明所交权利的文件(例如库存证书)

• 完成书面和签名任务

• 临时禁止反悔

无

就价值而言,不可撤销的指派人有权:

• 有权转让

• 不受受让人所不知道的限制/抗辩

转让是指将合同权利转让给另一权利。如果随后发生了同一权利的转让,这些竞合转让的优先权取决于第一项任务是:

• 可撤销——在这种情况下,第一次转让自动被取消,第二次转让具有优先权或

• 不可撤销 -- -- 在这种情况下,第一次转让具有优先权,除非第二受让人是无第一次转让通知的价值善意购买人。在此,医生口头将病人欠女儿的25 000美元作为结婚礼物转让给她,这项口头分配是有效的。 * 但是,可以撤销,因为它是免费的,没有例外(见上表)。这意味着当医生随后将同一索赔要求分配给其股票经纪人时,对女儿的指派就自动取消,因此,女儿无权领取25,000美元(Choices A & C)。

医生对股票经纪人的指派价值(即部分满足于每项价值转让都包含一项默示保证,即:转让人将不采取任何行动挫败或损害

医生接受了病人所欠的25,000美元并在马场损失,违反了保修规定,因此,股票经纪人可以从医生那里收回25,000美元。

然而,股票经纪人无法从病人那里收回这笔金额,原因是受让人对承付人的权利受到承付人对转让人的任何抗辩。承付人(病人)对转让人(医生)的付款可作为抗辩提出,条件是付款是在承付人收到转让通知之前作出的(见这里)。因此,病人在支付医生费用时没有冒着危险行事(Choice B)。

口头转让一般有效,但必须以书面形式进行(1)工资转让,(2)土地权益转让,(3)根据《统一商法典》第9条打算作为担保文书的转让,其中不适用。

学习要点：

同一权利的后续转让撤销了任何先前可撤销的转让,如果第一次转让不可撤销,则该转让具有优先权,除非第二受让人是价值方面的善意购买人,而且该受让人没有发出通知。

参考资料

• 重述(第二次)第342条(1981年《美国法律》)(随后转让相同权利)。

stem:
A famous musician entered into a written agreement with an interior decorator, who was well known for his avant-garde designs, to design and decorate the musician's recording studio. The agreement was silent as to assignment or delegation by either party.

Before beginning the work, the interior decorator sold his decorating business to a man under an agreement in which the interior decorator assigned to the man, and the man agreed to complete, the recording-studio contract. The man, a world-renowned decorator of excellent repute, advised the musician of the assignment, and supplied her with information confirming his financial responsibility and past commercial success all over the world.
stemZh:
一位著名音乐家与一位内部装饰师达成书面协议,他以先锋派设计著称,设计并装饰了音乐家的录音室,协议中未提及任何一方指派或授权.

在开工前,室内装饰师将他的装饰业务卖给了一位男子,协议中由室内装饰师指派给男子,男子同意完成录制-studio合同.这名男子是一位世界知名的优秀名人,他向音乐家建议了这项任务,并向她提供了信息,证实他的经济责任和过去在世界各地的商业成功.
ask: If the musician allows the man to perform and approves his design plan, but the man fails without legal excuse to complete the decorating as agreed, against whom does the musician have an enforceable claim for breach of contract?
askZh: 如果音乐家允许男方表演并批准其设计计划,但男方在没有合法借口的情况下未能按约定完成装饰,音乐家对谁有可强制执行的违约要求?

options.en: Either the first interior decorator, because his agreement with the man did not discharge his duty to the musician; or the man, because the musician was an intended beneficiary of the agreement between the first interior decorator and the man.
options.zh: 要么是第一位室内装饰师,因为他与男方的协议没有履行对音乐家的职责;要么是男方,因为音乐家是第一位室内装饰师与男方的协议的预期受益者.

options.en: The first interior decorator only, because his agreement with the man did not discharge his duty to the musician, and the man made no express promise to the musician.
options.zh: 第一位室内装潢师只是因为他与男方的协议没有履行对音乐人的职责,男方也没有对音乐人做出明确的承诺.

options.en: The man only, because the first interior decorator's duty to the musician was discharged when he obtained a decorator of excellent repute (the man) to perform the recording-studio contract.
options.zh: 只因为第一位室内装饰师对音乐家的职责在获得一位出色的声望(男声)的装饰师来履行录音- studio合同时被解除.

options.en: The man only, because the musician was an intended beneficiary of the agreement between the first interior decorator and the man, and the interior decorator's duty to the musician was discharged when she permitted the man to do the work and approved his design.
options.zh: 男方只是因为音乐家是第一位室内装潢师与男方达成协议的预期受益者,而室内装潢师对音乐家的责任在她允许男方完成作品并批准其设计时被解除.

explanation.en:
Nondelegable contractual duties

Delegation not permitted when:

• other contracting party has substantial interest in having delegating party perform (eg, in personal-services contract involving taste or special skill) or

• delegation is prohibited by contract Obligations under a contract can generally be delegated unless:

• the other party to the contract has a substantial interest in having the delegating party perform (eg, in a personal-services contract involving taste or a special skill) or

• the delegation is prohibited by the contract (eg, the contract says "this contract may not be assigned").

However, a party may consent to a delegation that would otherwise be prohibited. After a successful delegation, the delegator remains liable under the contract unless the other party agrees to a release.

Here, the famous musician had a substantial interest in having the interior decorator perform the recording-studio contract—particularly since the interior decorator was well known for his avant-garde designs. As a result, the interior decorator cannot delegate his duties to the man without the musician's consent. And even if the musician does consent, the interior decorator will not be released from liability. Therefore, if the musician consents to the delegation and the man fails to complete the job, the musician can sue the interior decorator for breach.

When, as here, a contracting party (the interior decorator) delegates his/her duties by forming a separate contract with the delegatee (the man), the other party to the original contract (the musician) becomes an intended beneficiary of that separate contract. The intended beneficiary can then sue the delegatee (in addition to the delegator) in the event of a breach. The musician, as the intended beneficiary of the agreement between the interior decorator and the man, can therefore sue the man for breach as well (Choices B, C & D).

Educational objective:

Delegation of contractual obligations is permitted unless (1) the other party to the contract has a substantial interest in having the delegating party perform or (2) the delegation is prohibited by the contract. After a delegation, the delegating party remains liable under the contract unless the other party agrees to a release.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 302 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (intended and incidental beneficiaries).

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 318 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (delegation of performance of duty).

explanation.zh:
不可转让的合同义务

在下列情况下,不允许授权:

• 其他缔约方对委托方履行合同(例如涉及品味或特殊技能的个人服务合同)或

• 合同禁止授权,合同规定的义务一般可以授权,除非:

• 合同另一方对委托方履行合同(如涉及品味或特殊技能的个人服务合同)或

• 合同禁止授权(例如,合同规定"本合同不得转让").

但是,一方当事人可以同意本来被禁止的代表团,在成功授权之后,除非另一方当事人同意解除合同,否则授权人仍须承担合同规定的责任。

在此,著名音乐家对室内装饰者履行录音-录音合同有极大的兴趣,特别是因为室内装饰者以其前卫设计著称。因此,内部装饰者未经音乐家同意不能将职责委托给男方,即使音乐家同意,内部装饰者也不会免除责任.因此,如果音乐家同意代表团,而男方未能完成任务,音乐家可以起诉室内装饰师违约.

如此处所述,订约方(内部装饰者)通过与委托方(男方)订立单独合同来代表其职责时,原始合同的另一方(音乐家)成为该单独合同的预期受益人。如果发生违约,预期受益人可以起诉委托人(除授权人外)。因此,音乐家作为室内装饰者和男方之间协议的预期受益者,也可以起诉男方违约(Choices B, C & D).

学习要点：

允许转让合同义务,除非(1)合同另一方对委托方履行合同有重大利益,或者(2)合同禁止授权。经代表团同意后,授权方仍根据合同承担责任,除非另一方同意解除合同。

参考资料

• 重述(第二份)合同第302条(1981年《安曼法律》)(意向受益人和附带受益人)。

• 重述(第二次)合同第318条(1981年《行政法》)(授权履行职责)。

stem:
A tree-cutter who was an expert in removing branches that threaten tall buildings contracted, in a signed writing, to lift and trim branches near a building where a major conference was scheduled to occur. An exculpatory clause in the contract provided that the tree-cutter would not be liable for any physical damage to the building occurring during removal of the branches. There was also a clause providing for per diem damages if the tree-cutter did not complete performance by a specified date and a clause providing that "time is of the essence." Another clause provided that any subsequent agreement for extra work under the contract must be in writing and signed by both parties.

With ample time remaining under the contract for commencement and completion of his performance, the tree-cutter notified the building owner that he was selling his business to a landscaper, who was equally an expert in removing branches that threaten tall buildings, and that the landscaper had agreed to "take over the contract."
stemZh:
一名在拆除威胁高楼的树枝方面担任专家的植树人通过一份签名的书写合同,在预定举行重大会议的建筑附近抬起树枝和修剪树枝。合同中的一项开脱罪责条款规定,树木开口者对拆除树枝期间对建筑物造成的任何实际损害不负赔偿责任。还有一个条款规定,如果树开口人未在规定日期前完成履约,则每日可赔偿损失,还有一个条款规定,“时间至关重要”。由双方书面签署。

由于在合同下还有充足的时间开始和完成他的表演,这棵树的捕食者通知建筑主,他正在将他的生意卖给一位景观学家,他同样是拆除威胁到高楼的分支的专家,而景观学家同意"接管合同".
ask: If the building owner refuses to accept the landscaper's services, which of the following clauses in the contract will best support the owner's contention that the tree-cutter's duties under the contract were not delegable without the owner's consent?
askZh: 如果建筑业主拒绝接受园林管理员的服务,那么合同中的以下哪些条款最能支持业主关于未经业主同意,该树木砍伐者在合同下的义务是不可转让的的论点?

options.en: The exculpatory clause.
options.zh: 释罪条款.

options.en: The extra-work clause.
options.zh: 外工条款.

options.en: The liquidated-damage clause.
options.zh: 清偿损失条款。

options.en: The "time is of the essence" clause.
options.zh: "时间是关键"条款.

explanation.en:
Assignment v. Delegation

Assignment Transfer of contractual rights to another (ie, assignee)

Delegation Transfer of contractual duties to another (ie, delegatee)

An exculpatory clause releases a party (eg, the tree-cutter) from liability for damages caused during the execution of the contract. Such a clause would effectively release that party from liability for damages caused by a delegatee (eg, the landscaper) as well.

This goes against the controlling principle that a delegating party is not released from liability for damages caused by a delegatee unless the other party to the contract (eg, the building owner) expressly agrees to a release. As a result, the exculpatory clause best supports the building owner's contention that the tree-cutter's duties were not delegable without the owner's consent.

(Choice B) The extra-work clause limits the scope of work to be done, but it says nothing about who is permitted to perform that work.

(Choice C) The liquidated-damage clause sets forth a fixed measure of damages for breach; it has no bearing on whether the tree-cutter can delegate his duties without the building owner's consent.

(Choice D) The "time is of the essence" clause indicates that performance by the time specified in the contract is crucial for the building owner to receive the benefit of the bargain. But this clause does not determine whether the tree-cutter can delegate his duties without the building owner's consent.

Educational objective:

An exculpatory clause releases a party from liability for damages caused during the execution of the contract. This would include damages caused by a delegatee, so the party to be released cannot delegate his/her duties without the other party's consent.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 318 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (delegation of duties).

explanation.zh:
派任诉代表团

向另一人(即受让人)转让合同权利

将合同职责移交给他人(即代表)

一项免责条款免除了一方当事人(例如树木开垦人)对合同执行期间所造成损害的赔偿责任,这一条款将有效地免除该当事人对委托人(例如景观设计人)所造成损害的赔偿责任。

这违背了控制原则,即除非合同的另一方(如建筑所有人)明确同意解除对委托方造成的损害的赔偿责任,否则不得免除其赔偿责任。因此,免除罪责条款最能支持建筑业主的主张,即未经业主同意,植树人的职责是不能被免除的.

(Choice B) 工作外条款限制所要完成的工作的范围,但没有提到谁被允许从事这项工作。

(选择C) 清算损害条款规定了对违约损害的固定尺度;这不影响树木开口者是否可以不经建筑所有人同意而委托他履行他的职责。

(Choice D)"时间是关键"条款表明,在合同规定的时间内履行对建筑所有人获得交易收益至关重要.但是,这一条款并不能确定树木开口人是否可以不经建筑业主同意而委托他负责.

学习要点：

免责条款免除了一方当事人对合同执行期间所造成损害的赔偿责任,这包括委托人造成的损害,因此,未经另一方当事人同意,被解除责任的当事人不能下放职责。

参考资料

• 重述(第二次)合同第318条(1981年《行政法》)(下放职责)。

stem:
In a written contract, an architect agreed to draw up the plans for and to supervise construction of a client's new house. In return, the client agreed to pay the architect a fee of $10,000 to be paid upon the house's completion. After completion, the client claimed erroneously but in good faith that the architect's plans were defective. The client orally offered to pay the architect $7,500 in full settlement of the claim for the fee. The architect orally accepted that offer despite the fact that the reasonable value of his services was in fact $10,000. The client paid the architect $7,500 pursuant to their agreement.

The architect subsequently sued the client for the remaining $2,500. In a preliminary finding, the trier of fact found that there were no defects in the architect's plans.
stemZh:
在一份书面合同中,一名建筑师同意起草一个客户新房的计划并监督其建造,作为回报,客户同意向建筑师支付一万美元,待房子完工后再支付.竣工后,客户提出错误但善意地声称建筑师的计划有缺陷,客户口头提出向建筑师支付7,500美元,以完全解决有关费用的索赔.建筑师口头接受了这一要约,尽管其服务的合理价值实际上为10 000美元,客户根据协议向建筑师支付了7 500美元。

建筑师随后起诉客户,要求其支付剩下的2500美元,在初步调查结论中,事实调查者发现建筑师的计划没有缺陷.
ask: Will the architect be likely to prevail in his action against the client for $2,500?
askZh: 建筑师是否会以2500美元胜诉客户?.

options.en: No, because the architect's acceptance of partial payment constituted a novation.
options.zh: 不,因为建筑师接受部分付款构成更新。

options.en: No, because the architect's promise to accept $7,500 became binding when the client made the payment.
options.zh: 不,因为建筑师承诺接受7500美元,在委托人付款时就具有约束力了.

options.en: Yes, because payment of $7,500 cannot furnish consideration for the architect's promise to surrender his claim.
options.zh: 是的,因为支付7,500美元不能算作建筑师承诺交出索赔。

options.en: Yes, because the oral agreement to modify the written contract is not enforceable.
options.zh: 是的,因为修改书面合同的口头协议不能执行。

explanation.en:
Exceptions to preexisting-duty rule

Main rule Promise to perform (or performance of) preexisting duty is not consideration

Common-law exceptions

New/altered consideration

New duty added or preexisting duty altered (eg, acceleration of due date)

Ratification of voidable duty

New promise to perform voidable duty (eg, upon reaching age of majority)

Honest dispute Scope of duty honestly disputed

Unexpected event Fair & equitable modification in view of unanticipated circumstances

Renewed promise Renewed promise to pay preexisting debt despite technical defense (eg, statute of limitations, bankruptcy) if written or partially performed

Third party Third party offers additional promise that is contingent on performance of preexisting duty

UCC exception Modification Modification sought in good faith—ie, honesty and observance of reasonable commercial standards of fair dealing

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

A settlement agreement must be supported by consideration. There is no consideration if one party merely promises to perform or performs a preexisting duty. But there is consideration if the scope of that duty is disputed in good faith. For example, a creditor can promise to settle an honestly disputed debt for a lesser amount than billed. If the debtor then pays that lesser amount, the creditor's promise becomes binding and the creditor cannot sue for the remainder of the billed amount even if it was actually owed.

Here, the architect contracted to draw up the plans for and supervise the construction of the client's house for $10,000. After completion, the client claimed that the plans were defective and offered to settle for $7,500. Although there were no defects in the plans, the architect's promise to surrender his claim in exchange for $7,500 was supported by consideration since the client disputed the architect's performance in good faith (Choice C). And since this promise became binding when the client made the payment, the architect is unlikely to prevail.

(Choice A) The architect's acceptance of partial payment was not a novation—ie, a new contract that substitutes a new party for one of the original parties. Instead, it was an accord and satisfaction—ie, the tender and acceptance of an alternate performance that discharges a contractual obligation.

(Choice D) The architect and client were attempting to settle a dispute, not modify their contract. Oral settlement agreements are generally enforceable if their terms are sufficiently precise. And even when a writing is required under the statute of frauds, an oral settlement becomes enforceable when one party performs (eg, by making the settlement payment—as seen here).

Educational objective:

A claim can be settled by entering a settlement agreement as long as it is supported by consideration. There is no consideration if one party merely promises to perform (or performs) a preexisting duty. But there is consideration if the scope of that duty is disputed in good faith.

References

UCC = 统一商法典。

和解协议必须得到对价的支持,如果一方当事人仅仅承诺履行或履行先前存在的义务,则不考虑,但如果善意地对这一义务的范围有争议,则不考虑。例如,债权人可以承诺以低于账单的金额清偿有争议的债务。 如果债务人随后支付了较低的金额,则债权人的承诺具有约束力,债权人不能对账单的剩余金额提起诉讼,即使该金额是实际欠。

在此,建筑师承包了10 000美元的客户住宅建筑计划并监督施工,完工后,客户声称计划有缺陷,并提议以7 500美元结算。虽然计划没有缺陷,但由于客户对建筑师诚信的表现(Choice C)提出质疑,建筑师承诺以7,500美元换取其索赔要求得到了对价的支持.而由于这个承诺在委托人付款时变得具有约束力,建筑师不太可能占上风.

(Choice D)建筑师和客户试图解决争端,而不是修改合同,口头和解协议如果条件足够精确,一般可以执行.即使防止欺诈法要求书面形式,当一方当事人履行义务(例如通过支付和解款——如这里所见)时,口头和解就可强制执行。

stem: A notorious spendthrift who was usually broke for that reason received the following letter from his uncle, a wealthy and prudent man: "I understand you're in financial difficulties again. I promise to give you $5,000 on your birthday next month, but you'd better use it wisely or you'll never get another dime from me." The spendthrift thereupon signed a contract with a car dealer to purchase a $40,000 automobile and to make a $5,000 down payment on the day after his birthday.
stemZh: 一个臭名昭著的散文家,通常因为这个原因而破产,他收到了他叔叔的以下信件,一个富有而谨慎的人:"我理解你又陷入了财政困境.我答应下个月你生日时给你五千美元 但你最好用得着,不然你永远得不到我一分钱。" 在那里花掉的钱 与汽车商签了合同购买一辆40 000美元的汽车,并支付5 000美元的首期付款。生日过后
ask: If the spendthrift sues the uncle for $5,000 after the uncle learned of the car-purchase contract and then repudiated his promise, which of the following is the uncle's best defense?
askZh: 如果在舅舅得知购车合同后告舅舅五千美元,然后背弃承诺,以下哪一个是舅舅最好的辩护?

options.en: A promise to make a gift in the future is not enforceable.
options.zh: 承诺在未来做礼物是无法执行的。

options.en: Reliance by the promisee on a promise to make a future gift does not make the promise enforceable unless injustice can be avoided only by such enforcement.
options.zh: 承诺人依靠承诺提供未来礼物并不能使承诺成为可执行的,除非只有通过这种执行才能避免不公正。

options.en: Reliance by the promisee on a promise to make a future gift does not make the promise enforceable unless that reliance also results in an economic benefit to the promisor.
options.zh: 承诺人依靠承诺提供未来礼物并不能使承诺成为可执行的,除非这种依赖也给交易人带来经济利益。

options.en: Reliance by the promisee on a promise to make a future gift does not make the promise enforceable unless the value of the promised gift is substantially equivalent to the promisee's loss by reliance.
options.zh: 承诺人依赖承诺提供未来礼物并不能使承诺成为可执行的,除非承诺的礼物的价值与承诺人因依赖而遭受的损失基本相等.

explanation.en:
Promises binding without consideration

Pay debt barred by technical defense

Promise to pay debt that would be enforceable absent technical defense to enforcement (eg, statute of limitations, bankruptcy)

Perform voidable duty

Promise to perform voidable duty, provided that new promise is not also voidable (eg, minor reaffirms promise to perform contract after reaching age of majority)

Pay for material benefits received

Promise to pay for material benefits received in the past & not intended as a gift (eg, promise to pay for emergency services previously received)

Promissory estoppel

Any promise (eg, promise of future gift) if:

• promisor should reasonably expect promisee to rely on promise

• promisee relies on promise to his/her detriment and

• injustice can be avoided only by enforcement of promise To be enforceable, a contract must be supported by consideration—ie, a bargained-for exchange of promises or performance. A promise to make a gift—eg, the uncle's promise to give the spendthrift $5,000 on his birthday without asking for anything in return—does not involve a bargained-for exchange and is generally unenforceable. But under the doctrine of promissory estoppel, a gift promise may be enforceable if:

• the promisor should reasonably expect the promisee to rely on the promise

• the promisee relies on the promise to his/her detriment and

• injustice can be avoided only by enforcement of the promise (Choice A). Here, the uncle promised to gift the spendthrift $5,000 on his birthday. The uncle likely should have expected the spendthrift to rely on that promise since the uncle knew about the spendthrift's financial difficulties. And the spendthrift did rely on that promise when he entered into a car-purchase contract and agreed to make a $5,000 down payment the day after his birthday. As a result, the uncle's best defense is that the spendthrift's reliance on the promise does not make it enforceable unless injustice can be avoided only by such enforcement.

(Choice C) Promissory estoppel (also known as detrimental reliance) does not require proof that the promisee's reliance resulted in an economic benefit to the promisor.

(Choice D) The value of the promised gift need not be substantially equivalent to the promisee's loss by reliance for promissory estoppel to apply. However, the promisee's

remedy is limited to actual loss suffered in reliance on the promise—not necessarily the full value of the promise.

Educational objective:

A party's promise to make a gift is enforceable under the doctrine of promissory estoppel if (1) the promisor should reasonably expect the promisee to rely on that promise, (2) the promisee detrimentally relies on that promise, and (3) injustice can be avoided only by enforcement of that promise.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 71 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (bargained-for exchange).

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 90 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (promissory estoppel).

承诺不作对价而具有约束力

承诺在无技术辩护的情况下向强制执行支付可强制执行的债务(例如,诉讼时效、破产)

履行可撤销的职责

承诺履行可撤销的义务,但新承诺不得也无效(例如,小承诺重申在成年后履行合同的承诺)

承诺支付过去收到的物质福利(如承诺支付先前收到的紧急服务),而不是作为礼物提供的。

正式禁止反悔

任何承诺(例如,未来赠与的承诺),如果:

• 期货人应合理地期望许诺人依赖许诺

• 承诺人依赖对其不利的许诺;

· 只有通过执行许诺才能避免不公正现象。 一项合同必须经过对价——即为了交换承诺或履行而谈判——才能执行。允诺做礼物——例如,叔父承诺在生日时给花掉的5000美元而不要求任何回报——并不涉及讨价还价的交换,一般是无法执行的。但根据期中禁止反悔原则,在下列情况下,赠与承诺可以执行:

• 汇兑人应当合理地期望承诺人依赖承诺

• 承诺人依赖对其不利的承诺;

• 只有通过执行承诺(Choice A)才能避免不公正。 在此,叔叔答应在他生日时赠送5 000美元。叔叔可能早就料到 浪费者会依赖这个承诺 因为叔叔知道 浪费者的经济困难当他签了汽车购买合同 同意在他生日的第二天支付五千美元的首期付款时 花销者确实依赖这个承诺因此,叔父的最好辩护是,耗子对承诺的依赖不能使它可以执行,除非只能通过这样的执行来避免不公正.

(C选择) 初级禁止反悔(也称为有害的依赖)并不要求证明承诺人的依赖给抵押者带来了经济利益。

(Choice D) 允诺赠与的价值不必在实质上等同于受允人因依赖期初禁止反悔而丧失的财产。

补救办法仅限于依靠许诺而遭受的实际损失——不一定是许诺的全部价值。

学习要点：

一方当事人承诺提供礼物,如果(1) 汇兑人应当合理期望该质押人依赖该质押,(2) 许诺人不利地依赖该质押,(3) 只有通过下列手段才能避免不公正:执行这一承诺。

· 重述(第二次)第90条(1981年第80号法律)(禁止反悔)。

stem:
A nonprofit organization that ran an after-school baseball program for at-risk elementary school students was fundraising for the purchase of a vacant lot to construct a baseball diamond. An executive, a well-known philanthropist, mailed a signed letter to the organization. In the letter, the executive pledged to give the organization $200,000 for the after-school baseball program. The organization accepted the letter. Shortly thereafter, the executive died.

The organization filed a claim against the executive's estate for the $200,000 pledged in the letter.
stemZh:
一个非营利组织为有风险的小学生开办了一个课后棒球方案,为购买空地建造棒球钻石筹集资金。一名执行官,著名慈善家,向该组织寄发了一封签名的信,执行官在信中承诺给该组织20万美元用于课后棒球计划,该组织接受了这封信.此后不久,执行官去世.

该组织就信中承诺的20万美元对执行官的房产提出索赔.
ask: Is the organization likely to prevail?
askZh: 该组织是否可能占上风?

options.en: No, because a promise to make a gift at some time in the future is not legally enforceable.
options.zh: 不,因为承诺在未来某个时候做礼物是无法在法律上强制执行的。

options.en: No, because an agreement to contribute money for a specific purpose is only binding when it is supported by consideration.
options.zh: 否,因为为某一特定目的捐款的协议只有在得到对价支持时才具有约束力。

options.en: Yes, because the estate is estopped from denying the executive's charitable contribution to the organization.
options.zh: 是的,因为庄园被阻止 拒绝执行官对组织的慈善贡献。

options.en: Yes, because the organization's acceptance of the executive's promise established bargained-for consideration.
options.zh: 是的,因为该组织接受执行官的许诺,是谈判确定的供对价的。

explanation.en:
A promise to make a gift is generally unenforceable because it does not involve the bargained-for consideration required to form a valid contract. However, most courts will enforce a charitable subscription, which is a promise to contribute money or property to a charitable institution. They typically do so on promissory estoppel grounds, but this is somewhat of a legal fiction because detrimental reliance—the key to promissory estoppel—is not required. It is enough that the promisor reasonably expected to induce reliance on the promise.*

Here, the executive pledged to give the nonprofit organization $200,000 for its after-school baseball program, and he should have reasonably expected the organization to rely on his promise. Since the promise was a charitable subscription, the court can enforce it without proof that the organization detrimentally relied on it—eg, by purchasing the lot. Therefore, the organization is likely to prevail because the executive's estate is estopped from denying his charitable contribution to the organization.

*Similarly, courts will enforce a gift promise made in anticipation of a marriage (ie, marriage settlement) without proof of detrimental reliance. The reason is that marriages— like charitable institutions—are deemed socially useful and desirable, so promises made to benefit or encourage them should be enforced.

(Choice A) A promise to make a gift at some time in the future is legally enforceable if the elements of promissory estoppel are satisfied.

(Choice B) Most courts reject the view that a charitable organization's promise to use a monetary gift for a specific purpose is sufficient consideration to form a binding contract. But here, the lack of consideration does not prevent the organization from enforcing the executive's promise because promissory estoppel applies.

(Choice D) A promise to make a gift does not involve bargained-for consideration. Therefore, the organization's acceptance of the executive's promise did not establish a bargained-for exchange.

Educational objective:

Charitable subscriptions—ie, promises to contribute money or property to a charitable institution—are enforceable on promissory estoppel grounds without proof of detrimental reliance. All that is needed is proof that the promisor reasonably expected to induce reliance on the promise.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 90(2) (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (charitable subscription binding without proof of detrimental reliance).

explanation.zh:
作出赠与的承诺一般是不能执行的,因为它不涉及为达成有效合同而必须商谈的对价。然而,大多数法院将强制执行慈善订阅,这是向慈善机构捐款或财产的承诺。他们通常以不定期禁止反悔为理由这样做,但这是法律上的虚构,因为不需要有害的依赖,即不期禁止反悔的关键。汇兑人有理由期望诱使对承诺的依赖就足够了。

在这里,执行官承诺给非营利组织20万美元用于其课后棒球计划,他应该合理地期望该组织能依靠自己的承诺.由于承诺是慈善性的,法院可以在没有证据证明该组织通过购买地块而不利地依赖承诺的情况下执行承诺。因此,该组织很可能会占上风,因为执行官的地产不得否认他对该组织的慈善贡献.

* 类似地,法院将在没有不利依赖证据的情况下,执行在期待结婚(即婚姻和解)时作出的赠与承诺。原因是,婚姻,如慈善机构一样,被认为对社会有用和可取,因此,应当履行对婚姻有利的承诺或鼓励婚姻的承诺。

(Choice A) 在未来某个时候作出赠与的承诺,如果符合期中禁止反悔的要件,则在法律上可以执行.

(Choice B)大多数法院都否定了这样一种观点,即慈善组织承诺将金钱礼物用于特定目的就足以对价形成具有约束力的合同.但在这里,缺乏对价并不妨碍该组织执行执行执行官的承诺,因为期权不容反悔适用.

(Choice D) 做出赠与的承诺并不涉及讨价还价的对价,因此,该组织接受执行官的承诺并没有建立讨价还价的交换关系.

学习要点：

慈善认购——即承诺向慈善机构捐献金钱或财产——可在没有不利依赖证据的情况下,以本意不容反悔的理由加以执行。所需要的只是证明,该套期货商有理由期望诱导对承诺的依赖。

参考资料

• 重述(第二次)第90(2)条(1981年《普通法》)(慈善签署具有约束力,没有不利依赖的证据)。

stem:
A man moved into his widowed grandfather's farmhouse. At the time, the man worked as a power plant operator earning a substantial salary plus benefits. Nevertheless, the man left that job to farm his grandfather's land after the grandfather orally promised the man that if he did so, he would inherit the farm. The man borrowed money to purchase farm equipment, cleared the land, installed irrigation, and planted crops. The grandfather told neighbors and family members that the farm belonged to the man.

Fifteen years later, the grandfather died testate. The grandfather's will specifically devised the farm to his oldest son. The man immediately filed a complaint seeking legal title to the farm.
stemZh:
有个男人搬进了他丧偶的祖父的农舍,当时,他担任发电厂的操作员,挣得大量工资和津贴。尽管如此,这名男子在祖父口头向该男子保证,如果他这样做,他将继承该农场之后,就离开了这个工作,他借钱购买农具、清理土地、安装灌溉和种植作物。祖父告诉邻居和家人,农场属于该男子.

15年后,祖父去世了,祖父遗嘱专门将农场设计给他的长子,这名男子立即提出申诉,要求获得农场的合法所有权。
ask: Is the man likely to prevail?
askZh: 那人有可能获胜吗?

options.en: No, because contracts for the sale or transfer of land fall under the statute of frauds and must be in writing in order to be enforceable.
options.zh: 不,因为出售或转让土地的合同属于防止欺诈法的范围,必须以书面形式才能强制执行。

options.en: No, because the grandfather and man's conduct was insufficient to indicate the assent required to create an implied-in-fact contract.
options.zh: 不,因为祖父和男人的行为不足以表明需要同意才能订立一项隐含事实的合同。

options.en: Yes, because the court will construct a quasi-contract between the man and the grandfather to remedy unjust enrichment of the grandfather's estate.
options.zh: 是的,因为法院将构建一个准合同 男人和祖父之间的 补救不公正的 增加祖父的遗产。

options.en: Yes, because the man reasonably and detrimentally relied on the grandfather's promise.
options.zh: 是的,因为这个人 合理和有害地依赖祖父的承诺。

explanation.en:
Contracts for the sale or transfer of land fall under the statute of frauds and must therefore be in writing to be enforceable. Since the grandfather's promise to the man was oral, there is no enforceable contract (Choice A). However, the man can still prevail under a theory of promissory estoppel. This equitable doctrine allows a party to enforce another's promise when no valid contract was formed. It applies when:

• the promisor reasonably expected to induce reliance on the promise

• the enforcing party reasonably relied on the promise

• the enforcing party suffered substantial detriment as a result of such reliance and

• injustice can only be avoided by enforcing the promise. Here, the grandfather should have reasonably expected the man to rely on his promise that the man would inherit the farm. In reasonable reliance on that promise, the man left his job to farm the land. This caused the man to suffer substantial detriment, as evidenced by the fact that he borrowed money and gave up a substantial salary plus benefits. And since it would be unjust not to enforce the grandfather's promise—especially after the man had farmed the land for 15 years—the man is likely to prevail.

(Choice B) An implied-in-fact contract arises when the parties' conduct indicates the requisite assent to be bound. But here, whether the grandfather and man's conduct was sufficient to imply a contract is irrelevant because only an express, written contract to transfer the farm would have been enforceable.

(Choice C) Courts can construct a quasi-contract* to compensate a party for a benefit conferred upon another and prevent the other's unjust enrichment. Here, quasi-contract might be a basis for the man to recover compensation for valuable improvements made to the land—but not title to the farm.

*This is also called an implied-in-law contract.

Educational objective:

Promissory estoppel applies when (1) the promisor reasonably expected to induce reliance on the promise, (2) the enforcing party reasonably relied on that promise, (3) the enforcing party suffered substantial detriment as a result, and (4) injustice can only be avoided by enforcing the promise.

References

• Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 90 (Am. Law Inst. 2011) (promise reasonably inducing action or forbearance).

出售或转让土地的合同属于防止欺诈法的范围,因此必须以书面形式执行,因为祖父对男子的承诺是口头的,因此没有可执行的合同(Choice A)。然而,在期中反悔理论下,此人仍然可以占上风.这一公平原则允许当事一方在没有有效合同的情况下执行另一方的承诺。在下列情况下适用:

• 合理预期会诱使依赖许诺的套期商

• 执行方合理依赖承诺

• 由于这种依赖,执行方蒙受了巨大损失;

• 只有通过执行诺言才能避免不公正,在这方面,祖父应该合理地期望男子依靠他的承诺,即男子将继承农场,在合理依靠这一承诺的情况下,男子离开工作去耕种土地。这导致该男子遭受重大损害,他借钱并放弃大量工资加福利就证明了这一点。由于不执行祖父的诺言是不公正的,特别是在他耕种了15年之后,他很可能获胜。

(选择B) 当当事人的行为表明必须同意受约束时,即产生默示事实合同。但在这里,祖父和男人的行为是否足以暗示合同无关紧要,因为只有转让农场的明示书面合同才能执行。

(选择C)法院可以订立一项准合同* 以补偿一方给予另一方的利益,并防止另一方不公正地获利。在这方面,准合同可能是该男子就对土地作出的宝贵改善——但不是对农场的所有权——获得赔偿的依据。

* 这又称为默示法律合同。
