stem:
On December 15, a doctor received from a retailer of office supplies an offer consisting of its catalog and a signed letter stating, "We will supply you with as many of the items in the enclosed catalog as you order during the next calendar year. We assure you that this offer and the prices in the catalog will remain firm throughout the coming year."

On January 15, having at that time received no reply from the doctor, the retailer notified the doctor that effective February 1, it was increasing the prices of certain specified items in its catalog.
stemZh:
12月15日,一位医生从一家办公用品零售商那里收到一份由其目录和一封签名的信组成的要约,信中说:"我们将提供您在下一日历年订购的所附目录中尽可能多的物品.我们向你们保证,这项要约和目录中的价格在来年将保持不变。”

1月15日,由于当时没有收到医生的答复,零售商通知医生,从2月1日起,正在增加目录中某些特定物品的价格.
ask: Is the price increase effective with respect to catalog orders the retailer receives from the doctor during the month of February?
askZh: 对于零售商在2月份从医生那里收到的目录订单,价格上涨是否有效?

options.en: No, because the retailer is a merchant with respect to office supplies; and its original offer, including the price term, was irrevocable throughout the month of February.
options.zh: 不,因为零售商在办公用品方面是商人;其最初的要约,包括价格条件在内,在整个2月份都是不可撤销的。

options.en: No, because the retailer's original offer, including the price term, became irrevocable under the doctrine of promissory estoppel.
options.zh: 不,因为零售商最初的要约,包括价格条款,在期货不容反悔的理论下变得不可撤销.

options.en: Yes, because the period for which the retailer gave assurance that it would not raise prices was longer than three months.
options.zh: 是的,因为零售商保证不会提高价格的时间超过三个月。

options.en: Yes, because the retailer received no consideration to support its assurance that it would not increase prices.
options.zh: 是的,因为零售商没有得到任何对价来支持其保证不会提高价格。

explanation.en:
Under the UCC firm-offer rule, merchants are defined as:

persons who regularly deal in goods of the kind involved in the contract

persons who, by their occupation, hold themselves out as having knowledge or skills peculiar to the practices or goods involved or

any businessperson when the transaction is of a commercial nature.

A merchant's firm offer is irrevocable—and cannot be modified—for the time stated in the offer or a reasonable time if none is stated. But in no case will a firm offer remain irrevocable for more than three months.

Here, on December 15, the doctor received a catalog and a signed letter from the retailer offering to supply office supplies at the catalog prices and assuring that the offer would remain open for one year. The retailer is a merchant who regularly deals in office supplies, so its offer was firm. And although the specified time period exceeds the three-month limit, the retailer's offer is still irrevocable for three months—until March 15 (Choice C). Therefore, the retailer's attempt to increase prices was not effective with respect to February orders.

(Choice B) Under the doctrine of promissory estoppel, an offer becomes irrevocable if (1) the offeror could reasonably foresee that the offeree would rely on the offer and (2) the offeree reasonably and detrimentally relied on that offer. But here, there is no indication that the doctor relied on the retailer's offer or suffered any detriment.

(Choice D) A firm offer is irrevocable even if there is no consideration for the assurance that the offer will be held open. Therefore, the lack of consideration does not make the retailer's price increase effective.

Educational objective:

A merchant's written and signed assurance that an offer will be held open (ie, firm offer) can never exceed three months—even if the offer states that it will be held open for a longer period.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

References

U.C.C. § 2-205 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (firm offers).

根据UCC公司要约规则,商人的定义是:

定期交易合同所涉货物的人

因其职业而认为自己具有与所涉做法或货物特有的知识或技能的人,或

* 交易属于商业性质的商人。

商人的确定要约在要约所述时间内是不可撤销的,如果没有说明,则不能修改,但无论如何,确定要约在三个月以上是不可撤销的。

在此,医生于12月15日收到一份目录和零售商的签名信,表示愿意按目录价格提供办公用品,并保证要约将持续一年。零售商是定期经营办公用品的商人,因此其要约是坚定的。 尽管规定的期限超过了三个月的限制,但零售商的要约在三个月内仍然是不可撤销的——直到3月15日(Choice C)为止。因此,零售商提高价格的企图对2月的订单无效。

(选择B)根据期初禁止反悔原则,如果(1)发价人能够合理地预见到发价人将依赖发价,(2)发价人合理和有害地依赖该发价,则发价就不可撤销。但在这里,没有迹象表明医生依赖零售商的要约或遭受任何损害.

(Choice D)即使没有考虑是否保证维持该要约,确定的要约也是不可撤销的,因此,不考虑并不能使零售商的价格上涨有效。

学习要点：

商人的书面和签署的保证,即一项要约(即坚定要约)将公开举行,即使要约表明要公开举行时间更长,也不得超过三个月。

stem:
A buyer sent a seller an offer to buy 50 tons of cotton of a specified quality. The offer contained no terms except those specifying the amount and quality of the cotton. The seller then sent an acknowledgment by fax. The acknowledgment repeated the terms of the buyer's offer and stated that shipment would occur within five days. Among 12 printed terms on the acknowledgment was a statement that any dispute about the cotton's quality would be submitted to arbitration. Neither the buyer nor the seller said anything further about arbitration.

The seller shipped the cotton, and it was accepted by the buyer. A dispute arose between the buyer and the seller as to the quality of the cotton, and the seller asserted that the dispute had to be submitted to arbitration. The buyer instead sued the seller in court.
stemZh:
买方向卖方发出要购50吨特定质量的棉花的要约,除了列明棉花数量和质量的条款外,该要约不含任何条件,卖方随后以传真方式发出确认函。承认书重复了买方要约的条款,并声明将在五天内发货,在承认书上的12个印刷条款中有一项声明,即关于棉花质量的任何争议都将提交仲裁。买方和卖方都没有进一步说明仲裁问题。

卖方发运了棉花,买方接受了,买方与卖方就棉花质量发生纠纷,卖方声称必须将纠纷提交仲裁,买方反而向法院起诉卖方。
ask: In that suit, which of the following arguments best supports the seller's position that the buyer must submit the dispute to arbitration?
askZh: 在该诉讼案中,以下哪些论点最能支持卖方的立场,即买方必须将纠纷提交仲裁?

options.en: Arbitration is a more efficient method of resolving disputes than resolving them in court.
options.zh: 仲裁是解决争端的一种比在法庭上解决争端更有效的方法。

options.en: The provision for arbitration did not contradict any term in the buyer's offer.
options.zh: 仲裁条款与买方要约中的任何条款并不矛盾。

options.en: The provision for arbitration did not materially alter the parties' contract.
options.zh: 关于仲裁的规定没有实质性地改变当事人的合同。

options.en: The seller's acknowledgment containing a provision for arbitration constituted a counteroffer that was accepted by the buyer when it accepted delivery of the cotton.
options.zh: 载有仲裁条款的卖方的承认构成买方在接受交货时接受的反价棉花 棉花 棉花 棉花 棉花

explanation.en:
Effect of new terms in reply to offer

Common law

(mirror-image)

Offer rejected Reply treated as counteroffer

UCC

(battle of the forms)

≥1 party is nonmerchant

Offer accepted unless reply expressly required assent to new/revised terms New/revised terms treated as proposed additions to contract All parties are merchants

Offer accepted unless reply expressly required assent to new/revised terms New terms become part of contract unless: offer expressly required assent to new terms new terms materially alter contract or offeror objects within reasonable time Revised terms follow split authority & are either: treated as new terms or cancelled out under knockout rule UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

At common law, contract formation is governed by the mirror-image rule. But the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC)—which applies to contracts for the sale of goods (eg, cotton)— follows the battle-of-the-forms rule. Under this rule, an acceptance of an offer is effective even if it contains new terms. And if both parties (ie, offeror and offeree) are merchants, the new terms become part of the contract unless:

the offer expressly requires the offeror's assent to new terms the offeror objects within a reasonable time or the new terms materially alter the contract. Here, both parties are likely merchants since the buyer offered to buy 50 tons of cotton. This offer was silent as to arbitration, so that provision in the seller's acknowledgement (acceptance) was a new term. The buyer's offer did not expressly require her assent to new terms, and she accepted the shipment without objecting to the new term. Therefore, the arbitration provision became part of the contract if it did not materially alter the contract, which supports the seller's position that the dispute must be resolved through arbitration.

(Choice A) To determine whether a contract dispute must be arbitrated, courts consider the intent of the parties as expressed in the contract—not whether arbitration is more efficient.

(Choice B) The standard for determining whether a new term becomes part of the contract is whether that term materially alters the contract—not whether it contradicts the offer.

(Choice D) Under the common law mirror-image rule, the seller's acknowledgment containing a new term would constitute a counteroffer. But since this transaction is governed by the UCC, the battle-of-the-forms rule applies.

Educational objective:

Under the battle-of-the-forms rule, an acceptance is effective even when it contains new terms. If both parties are merchants, the new terms become part of the contract unless (1) the offer expressly required the offeror's assent to new terms, (2) the offeror objected within a reasonable time, or (3) the new terms materially alter the contract.

References

U.C.C. § 2-207 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2019) (battle-of-the-forms rule).

explanation.zh:
新条款对答复要约的效力

普通法

(影视)

拒绝的要约

UCC 化学式

(战斗形式)

≥1党非商贾

承诺要约,除非明确要求答复同意新条款/修订条款 将新条款/修订条款视为合同的拟议增补条款 当事各方均为商人

承诺要约,除非明确要求答复同意新条款/修订条款合同,除非:明确要求给予新条款的同意的新条款在合理时间内,修改后的条款遵循了分权制,并且是:根据淘汰规则UCC = 统一商法典作为新条款处理或取消。

在普通法中,合同的订立受镜像规则管辖,但适用于货物销售合同(如棉花)的统一商法典(UCC)遵循了形式战规则。根据这项规则,承诺要约即使包含新的条款也是有效的。如果双方(即发价人和要约人)都是商人,新条款将成为合同的一部分,除非:

发价明确要求发价人同意发价人反对的新条款。(a) 合理时间或新条款实质上改变了合同。在这方面,双方都可能是商人,因为买方提出要购买50吨棉花。这一要约对仲裁保持沉默,因此卖方承认(承诺)中的规定是一个新的术语,买方的要约没有明确要求她同意新的条款,她承诺了装运,没有反对新的术语。因此,如果仲裁条款没有实质性地改变合同,它就成为合同的一部分,这支持卖方的立场,即争议必须通过仲裁解决。

(选择A) 为了确定合同纠纷是否必须仲裁,法院考虑合同中表达的当事人的意图,而不是仲裁是否更为有效。

(Choice B) 确定新条款是否成为合同一部分的标准是该条款是否实质性地改变了合同,而不是它是否与要约相矛盾。

(Choice D)根据英美法镜像规则,卖方包含一个新术语的承认将构成反价,但由于这一交易受UCC管辖,因此适用形式之争规则。

学习要点：

根据 " 形式战 " 规则,承诺即使载有新条款也有效。如果双方当事人都是商人,则新条款成为合同的一部分,除非(1)发价明确要求发价人同意新条款,(2)发价人反对(a) 在合理时间内,或(3) 新条款实质上改变了合同。

stem:
On July 18, a printer manufacturer received an order for the purchase of 500 printers from a wholesaler. The wholesaler had mailed the purchase order on July 15. The order required shipment of the printers no earlier than September 15 and no later than October 15. Typed conspicuously across the front of the order form was the following: "Wholesaler reserves the right to cancel this order at any time before September 1." The manufacturer's mailed response, "We accept your order," was received by the wholesaler on July 21.

The wholesaler did not cancel the order, and the manufacturer shipped the printers to the wholesaler on September 15. When the printers, conforming to the order in all respects, arrived on October 10, the wholesaler refused to accept them.
stemZh:
7月18日,一家打印机制造商收到批发商订购500台打印机的订单,批发商于7月15日邮寄了订单,订单要求打印机的装运时间不得早于9月15日,不得晚于10月15日.在订单表格正面对面的打字明显有以下内容:"商家保留在9月1日前的任何时候取消这一订单的权利",制造商的邮寄回复"我们接受你的订单"于7月21日被批发商收到.

批发商没有取消订单,制造商于9月15日将打印机运往批发商,当打印机在各方面都符合订单要求,于10月10日抵达时,批发商拒绝接受.
ask: Which of the following is an accurate statement as of October 10 after the wholesaler rejected the printers?
askZh: 在批发商拒绝印刷厂后,截至10月10日,以下哪些是准确的报表?

options.en: In view of the wholesaler's right to cancel its order prior to September 1, the shipment of the printers on September 15 was only an offer by the manufacturer.
options.zh: 鉴于批发商在9月1日前有权取消订单,9月15日的打印机装运只是制造商的要约.

options.en: The wholesaler's order for the printers, even if initially illusory, became a binding promise to accept and pay for them.
options.zh: 批发商对印刷厂的订单,即使最初是虚幻的,也成为了接受和支付印刷厂的有约束力的承诺.

options.en: The wholesaler's order was an offer that became an option after shipment by the manufacturer.
options.zh: 批发商的订单是在制造商发货后成为一种选择的要约。

options.en: The wholesaler's right to cancel was a condition subsequent, the failure of which resulted in an enforceable contract.
options.zh: 批发商取消合同的权利是后来的一项条件,如果失败,合同就可强制执行。

explanation.en:
An offer is a communication that expresses a present intent to be legally bound to a contract and gives power to the recipient to conclude a contract by acceptance. However, there is no present intent to be legally bound if the offer is illusory because it imposes no obligation on or causes no legal detriment to the offeror. As a result, acceptance of an offer that is illusory does not form a contract. But such an offer will become legally binding if:

circumstances change such that the offer imposes obligations on both parties and the offer is accepted after the change in circumstances. Once an offer is legally binding, it can be accepted to create an enforceable contract. Under the UCC, an offer to buy goods can be accepted by shipping or promising to ship conforming goods.

Here, the wholesaler's purchase order was initially illusory because the wholesaler reserved the right to cancel the order at any time before September 1. But the order became non-illusory after that date and was effectively accepted when the manufacturer shipped conforming printers on September 15. As a result, the wholesaler must accept and pay for those printers.

(Choice A) The manufacturer's shipment of the printers would have been an offer (specifically, a counteroffer) had it shipped nonconforming printers with a notice of accommodation. But since the manufacturer shipped conforming printers, that shipment was an acceptance (not an offer).

(Choice C) An option is a type of contract in which one party promises to hold a separate offer open for a specified period of time in exchange for consideration (not seen here).

(Choice D) The wholesaler's right to cancel the order was not a condition subsequent—ie, an uncertain future event that, if it occurs, excuses a party's existing duty to perform under a contract.

Educational objective:

An offer that is illusory will become legally binding if (1) circumstances change such that the offer imposes obligations on both parties and (2) the offer is accepted after the change in circumstances.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 77 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (discussing illusory and alternative promises).

U.C.C. § 2-206 (explaining that an order to buy goods for shipment may be accepted by the shipment of conforming goods).

explanation.zh:
发价是表明在法律上受合同约束的当前意向并赋予承诺方通过承诺订立合同的权力的通信。但是,如果要约没有给要约人带来任何义务或不会给要约人带来任何法律上的损害,则目前并不存在对要约有法律约束力的意图,因此,承诺不为要约构成合同。但是,如果:

情况发生变化,以致要约给双方当事人带来义务,要约是在情况变化后被承诺。一旦要约具有法律约束力,就可承诺其订立可执行的合同。根据《统一商法典》,可承诺关于购买货物的要约,或承诺运输符合要求的货物。

在这里,批发商的定购单起初是虚幻的,因为批发商保留了9月1日前随时取消定购的权利.但订单在该日之后成为非纸质,并在制造商于9月15日发运符合规格的打印机时被有效承诺,因此批发商必须承诺并支付这些打印机的费用.

(Choice A) 制造商装运的打印机如果装运不符合要求的打印机并附有住宿通知,就是一种要约(具体来说,是一种反价)。但是,由于制造商装运了符合要求的打印机,这批货物是一种承诺(不是要约)。

(C选择)一种选择是一类合同,其中一方当事人承诺在规定期限内单独开出要约,以换取对价(此处不见)。

(Choice D)批发商取消订单的权利并不是后来的一项条件——如果发生这种情况,就成为一方当事人根据合同履行现有义务的借口的不确定的未来事件。

学习要点：

如果(1)情况发生变化,使要约对双方当事人都产生义务,(2)在情况发生变化后承诺要约,则不切实际的要约将具有法律约束力。

UCC = 统一商法典。

参考资料

《美国法典》第2-206条(解释为装运而购买货物的订单可通过装运符合要求的货物予以承诺)。

stem: An employer encourages "wellness" on the part of his employees and supports various physical fitness programs to that end. Learning that one of his employees was a dedicated jogger, the employer promised to pay her a special award of $100 if she were to run one mile in less than six minutes on the following Saturday. The employee thanked him and did in fact run a mile in less than six minutes on the day specified. Shortly thereafter, however, the employer discovered that for more than a year the employee had been running at least one mile in less than six minutes every day as part of her personal fitness program. He then refused to pay the $100.
stemZh: 雇主鼓励雇员“健康”并支持各种身体健康为此制定方案。得知他的一位雇员是一名专职的慢跑运动员,雇主答应给她100美元特别奖,如果她在下一个星期六不到6分钟跑一英里。雇员感谢了他,事实上在规定的当天不到6分钟就跑了一英里,但不久之后,雇主发现,一年多来,雇员每天在不到6分钟的时间内跑至少一英里。他拒绝支付100美元。
ask: In an action by the employee against the employer for breach of contract, which of the following best summarizes the probable decision of the court?
askZh: 在雇员就违反合同对雇主提出的诉讼中,以下哪一项最能概括法院可能的裁决?

options.en: The employee wins, because running a mile in less than six minutes is a significantly demanding enterprise.
options.zh: 员工获胜,因为不到6分钟跑一英里是一个要求很高的企业.

options.en: The employee wins, because she ran the specified mile as requested, and her motives for doing so are irrelevant.
options.zh: 雇员获胜,因为她按要求跑过规定的里程,她这样做的动机无关紧要.

options.en: The employer wins, because it is a compelling inference that his promise did not induce the employee to run the specified mile.
options.zh: 雇主胜诉,因为令人信服的推论是,他的承诺没有诱导雇员运行规定的里程。

options.en: The employer wins, because the employee's running of the specified mile was beneficial, not detrimental, to her in any event.
options.zh: 雇主获胜,因为雇员运行规定的里程无论如何对她有利而不是有害。

explanation.en:
Elements of valuable consideration

Bargained-for exchange

Each party's willingness to enter agreement must be induced by other party's act/promise

Legal detriment Each party must relinquish legal right by either:

performing (or promising to perform) act that is not legally required or refraining (or promising to refrain) from performing legally permissible act Forming a valid contract requires consideration—ie, a bargained-for exchange of promises or performance. This requires each party to:

perform or promise to perform some act that is not legally required or refrain or promise to refrain from performing some legally permissible act. Here, the employer promised to pay the employee $100 if she were to run a mile in less than six minutes on the following Saturday, and the employee ran the mile as requested. This exchange (employer's promise for employee's performance) provided the necessary consideration to form a binding contract—regardless of the employee's motives for running the mile. Therefore, the court should decide that the employee wins.

(Choice A) The fact that running a mile in less than six minutes is a significantly demanding enterprise is irrelevant to determining whether bargained-for consideration exists.

(Choice C) Although the employee runs at least one mile in less than six minutes every day, this does not give rise to an inference that the employer's promise did not induce her to run the specified mile.

(Choice D) The employee suffered a legal detriment (as is required for consideration) by running the specified mile because she was not legally required to perform this act.

Educational objective:

Contracts must be supported by consideration—ie, a bargained-for exchange of promises or performance—which requires each party to (1) perform or promise to perform an act that is not legally required or (2) refrain or promise to refrain from performing some legally permissible act.

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 71 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (bargained-for exchange as consideration).

每一方同意达成协议的意愿必须受到另一方的行为/承诺的诱导

每一方必须通过以下方式放弃法律权利:

(Choice D) 该雇员因跑出规定的里程而受到法律损害(需要对价),因为法律没有要求她从事这种行为。

ask: Which of the following fact patterns most clearly suggests an implied-in-fact contract?
askZh: 以下哪些事实模式最明显地表明存在默示事实合同?

options.en: A contractor, thinking that he was paving a customer's driveway, for which the contractor had an express contract, mistakenly paved the neighbor's driveway while the neighbor looked on without saying anything or raising any objection.
options.zh: 一名承包商认为他在铺设一个顾客的车道,承包商有一份明确的合同,他错误地铺设了邻居的车道,而邻居却看不见,没有说什么,也没有提出任何反对意见。

options.en: A county tax assessor mistakenly bills a person for taxes on the neighbor's property, which the person, in good faith, pays.
options.zh: 郡税评估员错误地向一个人收取邻居财产的税费,此人本着诚意支付.

options.en: A physician treated a horseback rider without the rider's knowledge or consent while he was unconscious as the result of a fall from his horse.
options.zh: 一名骑马者坠马后失去意识，医生在其不知情、也未取得其同意的情况下为其治疗。

options.en: At her mother's request, an accountant filled out and filed her mother's "E-Z" income-tax form (a simple, short form).
options.zh: 应母亲的要求,一位会计师填写并提交了母亲的"E-Z"所得税表(简表,简表).

explanation.en:
Implied contracts

Implied-in-fact Formed when party manifests assent by conduct rather than spoken or written words Eg, contractor mistakenly paves driveway & owner does not object Implied-in-law*

("quasi")

Constructed by court to prevent unjust enrichment when party receives benefit from another who reasonably expects compensation Eg, physician treats unconscious person

*Implied-in-law contracts are not true contracts since they lack mutual assent.

An implied-in-fact contract arises when a party's assent to enter a contract is inferred from the party's conduct or failure to act. This inference arises when a party (1) intentionally engages or fails to engage in conduct and (2) knows or has reason to know that the conduct may cause the other party to understand that the party assents.

Here, the neighbor looked on without saying anything or raising any objection while the contractor mistakenly paved the neighbor's driveway. The neighbor's failure to object creates a reasonable inference that the neighbor assented to the work, so this fact pattern most clearly suggests an implied-in-fact contract.

(Choice B) Property owners have a preexisting legal duty to pay property taxes. Therefore, a tax bill is a demand to perform that preexisting duty—not an offer to form a contract.

(Choice C) In the absence of a contract between the parties, the court may construct an implied-in-law contract to prevent one party from being unjustly enriched by a benefit conferred upon it by another (eg, when an unconscious person receives treatment from a physician—as seen here).

(Choice D) A communication is not an offer unless it creates an objectively reasonable expectation that the offeror is willing to enter into a binding contract. A reasonable person would not interpret the mother's request that her daughter fill out a simple income-tax form as willingness to enter into a contract, so none was formed here.

Educational objective:

An implied-in-fact contract can be created by a party's conduct or failure to act if the party (1) intentionally engages or fails to engage in conduct and (2) knows or has reason to know that assent can be inferred from that conduct.

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 19 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (conduct as manifestation of assent).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 69 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (acceptance by silence).

explanation.zh:
隐含合同

当当事方以行为而不是口头或书面言论表示同意时,即为默示成立例如,承包商错误地铺设了车道,车主并不反对Implied-in-law*

("qua".

在当事人从合理预期得到赔偿的另一方获得利益时,由法院制定预防不正当致富措施。

* 法律合同不是真正的合同,因为它们缺乏相互同意。

一方当事人同意订立合同,是从该当事人的行为或不行为推断出来的,即产生默示事实合同。当当事一方(1)故意从事或不从事行为,而且(2)知道或有理由知道该行为可能使另一方了解该方的同意时,即产生这种推论。

在这里,邻居看时什么也没说,也没有提出任何反对意见,而承包商却错误地铺上了邻居的车道。邻居的不反对创造了一个合理的推断,认为邻居同意了这部作品,因此这个事实模式最明显地暗示了一个隐含在事实中的契约.

财产所有者有支付财产税的原有法定义务,因此,税单是要求履行该原有义务,而不是要求订立合同。

(选择C)在当事人之间没有订立合同的情况下,法院可订立一项默示法律合同,以防止一方当事人因另一方给予的利益而不公正地获益(例如,无意识者从他人处获得治疗)。医生——见此).

(Choice D) 通信不是要约,除非它创造了客观上合理的预期,即要约人愿意订立有约束力的合同。一个通情达理的人不会将母亲要求她女儿填写简单的所得税表解释为愿意签订合同,所以没有在这里形成.

学习要点：

如果当事人(1)故意从事或未从事行为,而且(2)知道或有理由知道可以从该行为中推断出同意,则当事人的行为或不行为可以产生默示事实合同。

参考资料

stem: A restorer of classic cars offered to completely repair and refurbish his neighbor's car for $35,000. The neighbor was anxious to return her classic car to its former glory but had not expected the restoration to cost $35,000. She said to the restorer, "The car is already in good condition. Will you consider taking $29,000 to restore it?" The restorer was incensed and said, "Absolutely not!" The neighbor then agreed to pay the restorer $35,000 to restore her car.
stemZh: 一个经典汽车的修复者提出用35000美元彻底修理和翻新他的邻居的汽车,邻居急于将她的经典汽车恢复到以前的辉煌,但没想到修复会花费35000美元.她对修复者说:"这辆车已经处于良好状态,你是否考虑拿29000美元来修复它?"修复者被烧了,说:"绝对不要!"随后邻居同意给修复者35000美元来修复她的汽车.
ask: Is there a binding contract between the restorer and the neighbor for the restoration of the classic car?
askZh: 修复者与邻居之间是否有关于修复经典汽车的有约束力的合同?

options.en: No, because the neighbor's statement was both a rejection of the restorer's offer and a counteroffer that the restorer did not accept.
options.zh: 不,因为邻居的声明既是拒绝恢复者的要约,也是恢复者不接受的反价.

options.en: No, because the restorer is a merchant with respect to car restoration and his offer to restore the car was not firm.
options.zh: 不,因为修复者是汽车修复方面的商人,他提出的修复汽车的要约并不坚定.

options.en: Yes, because the neighbor's statement was a valid acceptance that contained only minor additional terms.
options.zh: 是的,因为邻居的声明是有效的接受,只包含少量附加条款.

options.en: Yes, because the neighbor's statement was not a rejection of the restorer's offer but rather an inquiry into different terms.
options.zh: 是的,因为邻居的声明 不是拒绝 修复者的要约 而是对不同条件的调查。

explanation.en:
Contracts for services (eg, restoration) are governed by the common law, which follows the mirror-image rule for contract formation. Under this rule, an acceptance must match the terms of the offer exactly. A purported acceptance that contains different or additional terms acts as a rejection of the original offer and as a counteroffer. However, mere suggestions or inquiries that the offeror is free to accept or reject do not. The offeree can therefore accept the original offer in spite of such suggestions or inquiries.

Here, the restorer offered to repair and refurbish the neighbor's classic car for $35,000. Although the neighbor asked if the restorer would consider taking $29,000 instead, this was a mere inquiry that the restorer could accept or reject—not a rejection of the restorer's offer and a counteroffer (Choice A). Therefore, the neighbor's subsequent acceptance of the restorer's $35,000 offer was effective and created a binding contract between them for the restoration of the classic car.

(Choice B) Under the UCC, a merchant's offer to buy or sell goods is firm (ie, irrevocable) if it is written, is signed by the merchant-offeror, and provides assurances that it will remain open for a period of time. However, the UCC does not apply to contracts for services (as seen here).

(Choice C) Under the UCC battle-of-the-forms rule for contract formation, an acceptance that contains revised or new terms is valid unless it is expressly conditioned on the offeror's assent to those terms. But this contract is governed by the common law mirror-image rule, under which an acceptance that contains different or additional terms (not seen here) is invalid.

Educational objective:

Under the mirror-image rule, a purported acceptance that contains different or additional terms acts as a rejection and as a counteroffer; however, mere suggestions or inquiries that the offeror is free to accept or reject do not.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

References

17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts § 80 (2020) (necessity that acceptance comply with offer, generally).

17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts § 86 (2020) (collateral or immaterial matters; inquiries, requests, suggestions, or directions).

服务合同(如恢复)受普通法管辖,普通法遵循合同订立时的镜像规则,根据这一规则,承诺书必须完全符合要约的条件。含有不同或附加条款的所谓承诺是对原始要约的拒绝和反价,但是,仅仅建议或查询要约人可自由承诺或拒绝,并不成立。因此,尽管有此类建议或查询,被发价人仍可承诺原发价。

在这里,修复者提出以35000美元修理和翻新邻居的经典汽车,虽然邻居问修复者是否会考虑取29000美元,但这仅仅是一个调查,修复者可以承诺或拒绝,而不是拒绝.因此,邻居后来承诺恢复者35,000美元的要约是有效的,并在他们之间创造了一份修复经典车厢的具有约束力的合同。

(Choice B)在UCC下,商家的买卖商品要约,如果写成,由商家/商家签署,并且保证在一段时间内保持营业状态,是坚定的(即不可撤销的).然而,UCC不适用于服务合同(如本文所示)。

(选择C)根据《统一商法典》关于合同订立形式之争的规则,载有修订条款或新条款的承诺是有效的,除非明确以发价人同意这些条款为条件。但本合同受普通法镜像规则管辖,根据该规则,包含不同或附加条款(此处不见)的承诺无效.

学习要点：

根据镜像规则,包含不同或附加条款的所谓承诺是拒绝和反价;然而,仅仅暗示或询问要约人可以自由承诺或拒绝并不表示拒绝。

UCC = 统一商法典

参考资料

17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts § 80(2020年)(一般说来,承诺符合要约的必要性)。

17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts § 86(2020年)(附带或非实质性事项;询问、请求、建议或指示)。

stem: On June 1, a widget manufacturer entered into a written agreement with a tool maker, in which the tool maker agreed to produce and sell to the widget manufacturer 12 sets of newly designed dies to be delivered August 1 for the price of $50,000, payable ten days after delivery. Encountering unexpected expenses in the purchase of special alloy steel required for the dies, the tool maker advised the widget manufacturer that production costs would exceed the contract price. On July 1 the widget manufacturer and the tool maker signed a modification to the June 1 agreement increasing the contract price to $60,000. After timely receipt of 12 sets of dies conforming to the contract specifications, the widget manufacturer paid the tool maker $50,000 but refused to pay more.
stemZh: 6月1日,一个部件制造商与一个工具制造商达成书面协议,其中工具制造商同意生产并向部件制造商出售12套新设计的产品,待8月1日交付,价格为50 000美元,应在10天后支付。由于在购买死亡所需的特殊合金钢方面出现意外开支,制造器告知部件制造商,生产成本将超过合同价格。7月1日,部件制造商和工具制造商签署了对6月1日协议的修改,将合同价格提高到6万美元.在及时收到符合合同规格的12套死亡后,部件制造商向工具制造商支付了50 000美元,但拒绝支付更多。
ask: Which of the following concepts of the Uniform Commercial Code, dealing expressly with the sale of goods, best supports an action by the tool maker to recover $10,000 for breach of the widget manufacturer's July 1 promise?
askZh: 《统一商法典》中明确涉及货物销售的下列哪些概念最能支持工具制造者采取行动,因违反部件制造商7月1日的承诺而追回10 000美元?

options.en: Bargained-for exchange.
options.zh: 讨价还价

options.en: Modification of contracts without consideration.
options.zh: 未经对价修改合同。

options.en: Promissory estoppel.
options.zh: 正式禁止反悔。

options.en: Unconscionability in the formation of contracts.
options.zh: 订立合同不合理。

explanation.en:
Modifying existing contracts

Governing law Requirements

Common law

Traditional view

Parties' agreement New consideration

Modern view Parties' agreement New consideration unless modification is fair & equitable due to unanticipated circumstances UCC Parties' agreement Good faith (ie, honesty & observance of reasonable commercial standards of fair dealing) New consideration not required UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

At common law, contract modification generally requires a new bargained-for exchange that alters the duties of both parties in some way (ie, new consideration). But the UCC, which deals expressly with the sale of goods, allows modifications without consideration so long as they are sought in good faith. Good faith requires honesty and observance of reasonable commercial standards of fair dealing. And if either party fails to perform his/her obligations under the modified contract, then the other party can recover for breach.

Here, the widget manufacturer entered a contract to buy dies (ie, cutting tools) from the tool maker. Due to unexpected expenses in purchasing the steel required for the dies, the parties signed a modification agreement increasing the contract price by $10,000. This modification was not a bargained-for exchange since the tool maker's duties were unaltered

(Choice A). But since dies are goods, the UCC rule applies and allows modification without consideration, which supports the tool maker's action to recover the unpaid $10,000.

(Choice C) Had the tool maker's action been for promissory estoppel instead of breach, the tool maker might have been able to recover damages for its reliance on the widget manufacturer's promise to pay the increased price. However, promissory estoppel is a common law doctrine, not a UCC concept.

(Choice D) A court can refuse to enforce a contract if there was unconscionability in its formation—ie, unfairness due to surprise or unequal bargaining power. But even if the formation of the contract was unconscionable, the court's likely response (ie, refusing to enforce the contract) would mean that neither party could recover for breach.

Educational objective:

Under the UCC, contracts for the sale of goods can be modified without consideration provided that the modification is sought in good faith. Good faith entails honesty and observance of reasonable commercial standards of fair dealing.

References

U.C.C. § 2-209 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (explaining that an agreement modifying a sale-of-goods contract needs no consideration to be binding).

explanation.zh:
修改现有合同

管辖法律的要求

普通法

传统观点

缔约方协定

现代观点 缔约方的协议 新的对价,除非由于意料之外的情况,修改是公平和公平的善意(即诚实和遵守公平交易的合理商业标准)所需的UCC= 统一商法典。

在英美法系中,合同修改一般要求以新的条件交换,以某种方式改变双方的义务(即新的对价)。但明确处理货物销售的《统一商法典》允许修改,只要是善意寻求的,无需对价。 诚信要求诚实和遵守合理的公平交易商业标准。如果任何一方未能履行经修改的合同规定的义务,则另一方当事人可以赔偿违约。

在此,部件制造商签订了一项合同,从工具制造者那里购买死亡(即切割工具)。 由于购买死亡所需钢材的意外费用,双方签署了一份修改协议,合同价格增加了10,000美元。由于工具制造者的职责没有改变,因此这一修改不是交易交易

(Choice A). 但是由于死亡是商品,UCC规则适用,允许不经对价而修改,这支持工具制造者收回未付的10,000美元的行动.

如果工具制造者的行为是针对期货禁止反悔而不是违约,那么工具制造者可能已经能够因依赖部件制造商承诺支付增加的价格而获得损害赔偿。然而,期权不容反悔是普通法学说,而不是UCC的概念.

(选择D) 如果合同的订立不合理,法院可以拒绝执行,即由于出乎意料或谈判能力不平等而不公平。但即使合同的订立不合理,法院可能作出的反应(即拒绝执行合同)将意味着任何一方都不能因违约而获得赔偿。

学习要点：

根据《统一商法典》,可以不考虑而修改货物销售合同,但必须本着诚意进行修改,诚信意味着诚实和遵守合理的公平交易商业标准。

参考资料

U.C.C.§2/209(Am.Law Inst. & Unif.Law Comm'n 2020)(解释修改货物销售合同的协议无需对价具有约束力)。

stem: A lawn service company agreed in writing to purchase from a supplier all of its requirements for lawn care products during the next calendar year. In the writing, the supplier agreed to fulfill those requirements and to give the company a 10% discount off its published prices, but it reserved the right to increase the published prices during the year. After the parties had performed under the agreement for three months, the supplier notified the company that it would no longer give the company the 10% discount off the published prices.
stemZh: 一家草坪服务公司书面同意在下一个日历年向供应商购买其对草坪护理产品的所有要求。在书面中,供应商同意满足这些要求,并给予公司10%的公布价格折扣,但它保留了在年内提高公布价格的权利.在双方根据协议履行三个月后,供应商通知公司,将不再向公司提供公布价格的10%折扣。
ask: Does the company have a viable claim against the supplier for breach of contract?
askZh: 公司对供应商违反合同有可行的索赔要求吗?

options.en: No, because the absence of a minimum quantity term rendered the company's promise illusory.
options.zh: 不,因为没有最低数量期限 使得公司的承诺是虚幻的。

options.en: No, because the supplier could, and did, revoke its offer with respect to future deliveries.
options.zh: 否,因为供应商可以而且确实撤销了其对未来交货的要约。

options.en: Yes, because part performance of the agreement by both parties made it enforceable for the full year.
options.zh: 是的,因为双方部分履行协议使得协议在全年可以执行.

options.en: Yes, because the company's agreement to buy all of its lawn care products from the supplier made the agreement enforceable.
options.zh: 是的,因为公司同意向供应商购买其所有的草坪护理产品,使得协议可以执行.

explanation.en:
Contract terms for sale of goods

(Article 2 UCC)

Terms Requirements Effect if missing

Goods to be sold

Must be reasonably identified No contract

Quantity Must be certain or able to be made certain by reference

to objective facts

Price N/A Gap-filler: reasonable price

at time of delivery

Time of delivery

Gap-filler: reasonable time

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) governs contracts for the sale of goods. Under the UCC, an offer becomes irrevocable once it is accepted. The resulting contract must contain definite terms that:

reasonably identify the goods to be sold and

specify a quantity of goods to be sold that is certain or capable of being made certain by reference to objective facts.

The quantity term is sufficiently definite in a requirements contract—ie, a contract for the sale of as many goods as the buyer needs during a specified period—because the buyer's actual requirements can be determined objectively.

Here, the lawn service company and the supplier entered into a requirements contract wherein the lawn service company agreed to buy all of its lawn care products from the supplier for one year at a 10% discount.* Although this contract did not contain a certain quantity, the terms were sufficiently definite because the company's actual requirements could be determined objectively. Therefore, the contract was enforceable for its entire one-year term, and the supplier breached the contract by refusing to give the discount three

months later (Choice B).

*The supplier reserved the right to increase its published prices—not to revoke the 10% discount on those prices.

(Choice A) A promise is illusory, and therefore unenforceable, if the promisor has discretion whether to perform at all (eg, X promises to buy such goods as X wishes to order from Y). But here, the absence of a minimum quantity term does not render the company's promise illusory since it is still required to buy (and the supplier is still required to sell) all lawn care products it actually needs.

(Choice C) A contract whose terms would otherwise be too vague to be enforced may become enforceable based on part performance if the parties' subsequent acts supply the needed clarification of the terms (not needed here).

Educational objective:

Contracts for the sale of goods must specify a quantity of goods to be sold that is certain or capable of being made certain by reference to objective facts—eg, the buyer's actual requirements for a product can be used to determine quantity under a requirements contract.

References

U.C.C. § 2-306 cmt. 2 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (explaining that the quantity term is sufficiently definite in output and requirements contracts).

stem: A man sent an email to a friend that stated: "Because you have been a great friend to me, I am going to give you a rare book that I own." The friend replied by an email that said: "Thanks for the rare book. I am going to give you my butterfly collection." The rare book was worth $10,000; the butterfly collection was worth $100. The friend delivered the butterfly collection to the man, but the man refused to deliver the book.
stemZh: 有个男人给一个朋友发了一封邮件,说:"因为你是我的好朋友,所以我要给你一本我拥有的珍稀书",这位朋友用一封邮件回答说:"感谢这本珍稀的书.我要把我的蝴蝶收藏送给你。” 珍贵的书价值一万美元;蝴蝶收藏价值100美元。这位朋友把蝴蝶收藏交给了那个男人,但是那个男人拒绝把书交给他。
ask: If the friend sues the man to recover the value of the book, how should the court rule?
askZh: 若友人告人以复书之价值,朝廷应如何判之?

options.en: For the friend, because she conferred a benefit on the man by delivering the butterfly collection.
options.zh: 给这位朋友,因为她通过送蝴蝶收藏品给这位男子带来了好处.

options.en: For the friend, because she gave the butterfly collection to the man in reliance on receiving the book.
options.zh: 对于朋友来说,因为她把蝴蝶收藏交给了依靠收到书的人.

options.en: For the man, because the consideration given for his promise was inadequate.
options.zh: 对他来说,因为对他的承诺的对价是不够的。

options.en: For the man, because there was no bargained-for exchange to support his promise.
options.zh: 对于那个男人来说,因为没有讨价还价的交换支持他的诺言.

explanation.en:
Elements of valuable consideration

Bargained-for exchange

Each party's willingness to enter agreement must be induced by other party's act/promise

Legal detriment Each party must relinquish legal right by either:

performing (or promising to perform) act that is not legally required or refraining (or promising to refrain) from performing legally permissible act Formation of a contract generally requires a bargained-for exchange of promises or performance (ie, valuable consideration). The bargained-for exchange requirement is not met unless each party's willingness to enter into the contract was induced by the other party's act or promise. So if either of the parties intended to make a gift, this requirement cannot be met.

Here, the man promised to give a rare book to his friend. The man clearly intended to make a gift since he did not ask for anything in exchange. This means that the man's promise was not induced by the friend's promise to give him her butterfly collection, so there was no bargained-for exchange (ie, consideration) to support his promise. Therefore, no contract arose between the parties, and the court should rule in favor of the man.

(Choice A) The mere fact that the friend conferred a benefit on the man by delivering the butterfly collection does not mean that the man has an enforceable obligation to deliver the book to the friend.

(Choice B) In the absence of consideration, the doctrine of promissory estoppel provides a basis to enforce a promise upon which a party reasonably and detrimentally relied. However, this doctrine can only be invoked if it is the only way to avoid substantial injustice (not seen here).

(Choice C) Instead of giving inadequate consideration, the friend gave no consideration at all since the man did not bargain for her return promise to deliver the butterfly collection. And parties generally cannot challenge a contract on the ground that the consideration given for their promises was inadequate (eg, due to a difference in economic value).

Educational objective:

A promise to make a gift is generally unenforceable because it does not involve the bargained-for exchange that is required to constitute valuable consideration.

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 71 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (bargained-for exchange).

重要考虑因素

交易交换

每一方同意达成协议的意愿必须受到另一方的行为/承诺的诱导

每一方必须通过以下方式放弃法律权利:

履行(或承诺履行)法律不要求或不履行的行为(或承诺履行)(不履行)合同的订立一般要求(单位:千美元)以换取承诺或业绩(即:除非各方愿意,否则不符合商定的交换要求。订立合同是由另一方的行为或承诺诱导的。因此,如果任何一方打算作出礼物,就不能满足这一要求。

在这里,他答应给朋友一本珍贵的书,由于他没有要求任何东西作为交换,他显然打算做一件礼物.这意味着这个男人的许诺并不是因为朋友的许诺而诱使给他她的蝴蝶收藏,所以没有讨价还价的交换(即对价)来支持他的许诺.因此,当事人之间没有订立合同,法院应作出有利于当事人的裁决。

stem: A restaurant supplier sent a letter to a regular customer offering to sell the customer an industrial freezer for $10,000. Two days later, the customer responded with a letter that stated: "I accept your offer on the condition that you provide me with a warranty that the freezer is merchantable." In response to the customer's letter, the supplier called the customer and stated that the offer was no longer open. The supplier promptly sold the freezer to another buyer for $11,000.
stemZh: 一个餐馆供应商给一个普通客户发了一封信,提议以10 000美元的价格向客户出售工业冷藏柜。 两天后,客户回信说:"我接受你的出价,条件是你给我一个保证,冷冻柜是可买卖的",供应商在回应客户信件时给客户打电话,并声明该出价不再开放.供应商迅速以11 000美元的价格将冷藏柜卖给另一家买方。
ask: If the customer sues the supplier for breach of contract, is the customer likely to prevail?
askZh: 如果客户起诉供应商违反合同,客户是否可能胜诉?

options.en: No, because the customer's letter added a term, making it a counteroffer.
options.zh: 不,因为顾客的信增加了一个术语,使它成为一个反价.

options.en: No, because the subsequent sale to a bona fide purchaser for value cut off the claims of the customer.
options.zh: 不,因为随后为了价值而向善意购买者出售,切断了客户的债权。

options.en: Yes, because the customer's letter was an acceptance of the supplier's offer, since the warranty of merchantability was already implied in the sale.
options.zh: 是的,因为客户的信件是对供应商要约的承诺,因为销售中已经隐含了可交易性的保证。

options.en: Yes, because the supplier's letter was a firm offer that could not be revoked for a reasonable time.
options.zh: 是的,因为供应商的信件是一份在合理时间内无法撤销的确定要约。

explanation.en:
Effect of new terms in reply to offer

Common law

(mirror-image)

Offer rejected Reply treated as counteroffer

UCC

(battle of the forms)

≥1 party is nonmerchant

Offer accepted unless reply expressly required assent to new/revised terms New/revised terms treated as proposed additions to contract All parties are merchants

Offer accepted unless reply expressly required assent to new/revised terms New terms become part of contract unless: offer expressly required assent to new terms new terms materially alter contract or offeror objects within reasonable time Revised terms follow split authority & are either: treated as new terms or cancelled out under knockout rule UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

Under the common law, an acceptance is only effective if it is the mirror-image of the terms in the offer. This rule has been relaxed by Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC), which governs contracts for the sale of goods (eg, industrial freezers). The UCC uses the battle-of-the-forms rule, where any reasonable manifestation of acceptance—even one including new terms—is effective unless it is expressly conditioned on the offeror's assent to the new terms.

Here, the customer's letter conditioned his acceptance on the freezer's warranty of merchantability. But under the UCC, this warranty is implied in all contracts for the sale of goods by a merchant—ie, one who regularly deals in goods of the kind involved in the contract (like the supplier). Therefore, the letter did not add a term (Choice A). Instead, it was an acceptance of the supplier's offer that created an enforceable contract. And since the supplier breached that contract by selling the freezer to another buyer, the customer is likely to prevail.

(Choice B) The sale of the freezer to a bona fide purchaser—ie, one who purchased for value and in good faith—may prevent the customer from seeking specific performance from the supplier. However, this would not prevent the buyer from obtaining a legal remedy (ie, damages) for the supplier's breach.

(Choice D) A firm offer is a merchant's signed, written offer to buy or sell goods that promises to hold the offer open for a period of time—not seen here.

Educational objective:

Under the UCC's battle-of-the-forms rule, any reasonable manifestation of acceptance (even one including new terms) is effective unless it is expressly conditioned on the offeror's assent to the new terms.

References

U.C.C. § 2-207 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2019) (battle-of-the-forms rule).

U.C.C. § 2-314 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2019) (implied warranty of merchantability).

承诺要约,除非明确要求答复同意新条款/修订条款合同,除非:明确要求给予新条款的同意的新条款在合理时间内,修改后的条款遵循了分权制,并且是:根据淘汰规则UCC = 统一商法典作为新条款处理或取消。

根据普通法,承诺只有在是要约中条款的反射图时才有效,《统一商法典》第2条放宽了这一规则,该条管辖货物销售合同(例如工业冷藏器)。UCC采用形式之争规则,在承诺的任何合理表现——即使是包括新条款在内的条件——是有效的,除非明确以发价人同意新条款为条件。

此处,顾客的信将他的承诺以冷冻机的可交易性保证为条件。 但根据UCC,这种保证是所有销售货物合同中隐含的。因此,该信件没有增加一个术语(选择A)。 相反,是承诺供应商的要约才产生了可执行的合同。由于供应商向另一买方出售冷藏柜违反了该合同,因此,客户可能胜诉。

(Choice B) 将冷藏柜出售给善意购买者,即以价值和诚意购买的善意购买者,可能妨碍客户向供应商寻求具体履约。然而,这并不妨碍买方就供应商的违约获得法律补救(即损害赔偿)。

(Choice D) 一项确定的要约是商人签署的书面要约,即购买或销售承诺在一段时间内保持该要约开放的商品——这里看不到。

学习要点：

根据UCC形式战规则,任何合理表示承诺(甚至包括新条款在内的条件)都是有效的,除非明确以要约人同意新条款为条件。

stem: A restaurant owner sent a signed order form to a produce supplier that read: "Please ship us 100 pounds of potatoes at your current price." The supplier received the order form on November 9. Later the same day, the supplier mailed the owner a letter with the proper address and postage. The letter stated that the order had been accepted at the supplier's current price for potatoes. On November 10, before receiving the supplier's reply, the owner telephoned the supplier to inform the supplier that the owner had found a closer supplier and was canceling the order. The supplier asked the owner to reconsider, but the owner refused. On November 11, the owner received the supplier's letter. Relying on the owner's telephone call, the supplier never shipped any potatoes to the restaurant.
stemZh: 一位餐馆老板向一家产品供应商寄发了签了名的订单表,上面写着:"请按你目前的价格将100磅的土豆运送给我们",供应商于11月9日收到了订单表.同日晚些时候,供货商向店主邮寄了一封附有适当地址和邮资的信,信中称,订单已按供货商的马铃薯现价接受.11月10日,在接到供货商回复之前,业主打电话通知供货商,指货商已经找到更接近的供货商,正在取消订单,供货商要求货主重新考虑,但货主拒绝了.11月11日,店主收到供货商的信,依靠店主的电话,供货商从未将任何土豆运往餐厅.
ask: As of November 12, is there an enforceable contract between the supplier and the owner?
askZh: 截至11月12日,供应商与所有人之间是否有可执行的合同?

options.en: No, because the owner effectively revoked its offer before it was properly accepted.
options.zh: 不,因为房东在被适当接受之前就有效地取消了要约。

options.en: No, because the owner's offer could be accepted only by shipment of the goods, and the supplier never shipped the potatoes.
options.zh: 不,因为只有发货才能接受货主的要约,供应商从未发货过土豆.

options.en: Yes, because the owner's offer was irrevocable for a reasonable time.
options.zh: 是的,因为所有者的要约 在合理的时间内是不可撤销的。

options.en: Yes, because the supplier effectively accepted the owner's offer before the owner revoked it.
options.zh: 是的,因为供应商在业主撤销要约之前已经有效接受了业主的要约。

explanation.en:
Contract negotiations by mail*

Offeror's actions

Offer Effective upon receipt

Revocation of offer

Offeree's actions

Acceptance

(mailbox rule)

Effective upon dispatch Exceptions—effective upon receipt if: improperly stamped/addressed acceptance by mail unreasonable rejection mailed before acceptance (first received is effective) acceptance of option contract offer states acceptance effective only upon receipt Rejection/counteroffer Effective upon receipt

*Applicable under common law & UCC.

Contracts for the sale of goods (eg, potatoes) are governed by Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC). Under the UCC, a seller can accept a buyer's offer to purchase goods for prompt or immediate shipment by promising to ship, or by shipping, the goods. Once accepted, the offer cannot be revoked because a contract has been formed.

Here, the restaurant owner sent the produce supplier a signed order form that read: "Please ship us 100 pounds of potatoes at your current price." This was an offer that the supplier could accept by promising to ship, or by shipping, the potatoes (Choice B). On November 9, the supplier mailed the owner an acceptance letter that was effective when sent—not upon receipt.* This means that the owner's attempt to revoke its offer on November 10 was ineffective, and there is an enforceable contract between the parties (Choice A).

*An acceptance by mail is generally effective when sent (not upon receipt). But this mailbox rule does not apply to (1) option contracts, which require that the acceptance be received before the offer expires, or (2) offers that specify that acceptance must be received by a certain date.

(Choice C) Certain offers are irrevocable. This includes firm offers—ie, a merchant's written and signed assurance that the offer will be held open for the time stated in the offer or a reasonable time (not to exceed 90 days). No firm offer was made here, however, so the owner could revoke its offer at any time prior to acceptance.

Educational objective:

An offer to buy goods for prompt or immediate shipment can be accepted by promising to ship (or by shipping) the goods. Once the offer has been accepted, it cannot be revoked because a contract has already been formed.

References

U.C.C. § 2-206 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (offer and acceptance).

stem:
On November 1, an accountant and a lawyer contracted for the sale of the law books the accountant had inherited from his father. The lawyer agreed to pay the purchase price of $10,000 when the accountant delivered the books on December 1.

On November 10, the lawyer received a signed letter from the accountant that stated: "I have decided to dispose of the bookshelves containing the law books you have already purchased. If you want the shelves, I will deliver them to you along with the books on December 1 at no additional cost to you. Let me know before November 15 whether you want them. I will not sell them to anyone else before then." On November 14, the lawyer faxed and the accountant received the following message: "I accept your offer of the shelves." The accountant was not a merchant with respect to either law books or bookshelves.
stemZh:
11月1日,一名会计师和一名律师签约出售会计师从父亲那里继承的法律书籍,律师同意在会计师于12月1日交付书籍时支付1万美元的购买价.

11月10日,律师收到会计师的签名信,信中称:"我已决定处置包含你已经购买的法律书籍的书架.如果你想要书架,我会在12月1日连同书籍一起交给你,不增加你的费用,在11月15日之前告诉我,你是否想要这些书。11月14日,律师传真,会计师收到如下信息:“我接受你提出的架子”会计师既不是法律书籍也不是书架的商人。
ask: Why is the accountant contractually obligated to deliver the shelves?
askZh: 为什么会计师根据合同有义务交付书架?

options.en: Because the accountant's letter (received by the lawyer on November 10) and the lawyer's fax message of November 14 constituted an effective modification of the original sale-of-books contract.
options.zh: 因为会计师函(律师于11月10日收到)和律师于11月14日发来的传真信息,构成了对原售书合同的有效修改.

options.en: Because the accountant's letter (received by the lawyer on November 10) waived the bargained-for consideration that would otherwise be required.
options.zh: 因为会计师的信件(律师于11月10日收到)放弃了本来需要的讨价还价的对价.

options.en: Because the lawyer provided a new bargained-for exchange by agreeing to take the shelves.
options.zh: 因为律师同意拿起货架 提供了新的交易条件

options.en: Because the lawyer's fax message of November 14 operated to rescind unilaterally the original sale-of-books contract.
options.zh: 因为律师11月14日的传真信息是单方面取消原售书合同.

explanation.en:
Modifying existing contracts

Governing law Requirements

Common law

Traditional view

Parties' agreement New consideration

Modern view Parties' agreement New consideration unless modification is fair & equitable due to unanticipated circumstances UCC Parties' agreement Good faith (ie, honesty & observance of reasonable commercial standards of fair dealing) New consideration not required UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

Contracts for the sale of goods (eg, law books) are governed by Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC). Under the UCC, an existing contract cannot be modified or rescinded unilaterally (Choice D). Instead, all parties must agree to the modification. Additionally, the modification must be sought in good faith, which requires honesty and observance of reasonable commercial standards of fair dealing. But new consideration—ie, a bargained-for exchange of promises or performance that was not part of the original contract—is not required.

Here, the lawyer contracted to buy law books from the accountant for $10,000. Both parties agreed to modify that contract when the lawyer (1) received the accountant's letter offering to deliver the bookshelves with the books and (2) accepted that offer by fax. There is no indication that either party acted in bad faith. And since new consideration was not required to modify the contract, the accountant is contractually obligated to deliver the books and the shelves (Choice B).

(Choice C) The lawyer's agreement to take the shelves did not provide a new bargained-for exchange because the accountant was going to dispose of the shelves anyway. In other words, the accountant was not induced by the lawyer's agreement. But this is immaterial since consideration is not required to modify a sale-of-goods contract.

Educational objective:

Under the UCC, a contract for the sale of goods can be modified by agreement of all the parties if that modification is sought in good faith. New consideration is not required.

References

U.C.C. § 2-209 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (modification of existing contracts).

explanation.zh:
修改现有合同

管辖法律的要求

普通法

传统观点

缔约方协定

现代观点 缔约方的协议 新的对价,除非由于意料之外的情况,修改是公平和公平的善意(即诚实和遵守公平交易的合理商业标准)所需的UCC= 统一商法典。

货物销售合同(例如法律书籍)受《统一商法典》第2条管辖。 根据《统一商法典》,现有的合同不能单方面修改或撤销(Choice D)。 相反,所有当事方都必须同意修改。此外,必须本着诚意寻求修改,这需要诚实和遵守合理的公平交易商业标准。但是,不需要新的对价,即交换承诺或业绩的讨价还价,而不是原始合同的一部分。

在此,律师以10 000美元向会计师购买法律书籍,双方同意修改合同,条件是律师(1)收到会计师的函文,要约用书本交付书架,(2)通过传真接受这一要约。没有迹象表明任何一方的行为都是恶意的,而且由于不需要新的对价来修改合同,因此会计师根据合同有义务交付账簿和书架(Choice B)。

(Choice C)律师同意取货架并没有提供新的讨价还价交易,因为会计师无论如何都要处理货架,换句话说,会计师不是由律师同意诱导的。但这一点并不重要,因为不需要对价修改货物销售合同。

学习要点：

根据《统一商法典》,如果真诚地寻求修改,货物销售合同可由所有当事方协议修改,无需作新的对价。

参考资料

U.C.C.§2/209(Am.Law Inst. & Unif.Law Comm'n 2020)(修改现有合同)。

stem: A private high school was in the market for new desks and chairs for its classrooms. It had inquired into the cost of acquiring 1,000 new desks and chairs from a particular vendor. On June 15, the vendor sent a signed letter to the private high school offering to sell 1,000 desks and chairs for $30,000. The letter stated that the private high school's acceptance would be effective only if the vendor actually received it by June 25. On June 23, the private high school mailed its signed, written acceptance of the vendor's offer. On June 24, the vendor, after concluding that the price it originally requested was too low, directly notified the private high school that it was revoking its offer. The vendor received the private high school's acceptance on June 26.
stemZh: 一所私立高中正在为其教室购买新的课桌和椅子,并询问从某一供应商购买1 000张新的课桌和椅子的费用。6月15日,该供应商向民办高中发了一封签名信,要约以3万美元的价格出售1000张桌椅,信中表示,只有在6月25日前供应商实际收到后,该民办高中的承诺才会有效.6月23日,民办高中发信,书面承诺卖主的要约,6月24日,卖主在认定原先要求的价格太低后,直接通知民办高中取消要约.供应商于6月26日收到私立高中的承诺.
ask: Was an enforceable contract between the private high school and the vendor formed?
askZh: 私立高中和供应商之间是否签订了可执行的合同?

options.en: No, because the vendor did not actually receive the acceptance until June 26.
options.zh: 没有,因为供应商直到6月26日才实际收到验收单。

options.en: No, because the vendor revoked the offer on June 24.
options.zh: 不,因为供应商于6月24日取消了要约。

options.en: Yes, because the private high school mailed its acceptance on June 23.
options.zh: 是的,因为私立高中于6月23日寄出验收信.

options.en: Yes, because under the UCC firm-offer rule, the vendor's offer was irrevocable.
options.zh: 是的,因为根据UCC公司要约规则,供应商的要约是不可撤销的.

explanation.en:
Contract negotiations by mail*

Offeror's actions

Offer Effective upon receipt

Revocation of offer

Offeree's actions

Acceptance

(mailbox rule)

Effective upon dispatch Exceptions—effective upon receipt if: improperly stamped/addressed acceptance by mail unreasonable rejection mailed before acceptance (first received is effective) acceptance of option contract offer states acceptance effective only upon receipt Rejection/counteroffer Effective upon receipt

*Applicable under common law & UCC.

Once an offer has been made, a binding contract will be formed if the offeree accepts the offer before it terminates (eg, before the allotted response time expires). Under the mailbox rule, acceptance by mail is:

permitted if mail is a reasonable method of communicating acceptance—eg, because the offer was communicated by mail—and

effective upon dispatch—ie, when the acceptance is properly addressed and placed with the postal service with paid postage.

However, the mailbox rule does not apply if it is inconsistent with the offer's terms, such as when the offer states that acceptance is effective only upon receipt.*

Here, the vendor's offer stated that an acceptance would be effective only if it was actually received by June 25. Therefore, the mailbox rule does not apply. And since the vendor did not actually receive the private high school's acceptance until June 26—after the allotted time for acceptance had expired—it was ineffective. As a result, no contract was formed.

*The reason is that the offeror, as master of the offer, can dictate the manner and means by which the offer may be accepted.

(Choices B & D) Contracts for the sale of goods (eg, desks, chairs) are governed by the UCC. Under the UCC firm-offer rule, a merchant's written and signed assurance that an offer will remain open is irrevocable for the time stated in the offer. The vendor's offer was

therefore irrevocable through June 25, and the vendor could not revoke it on June 24. Nevertheless, there is no contract because the high school's acceptance was not received in time.

(Choice C) Although the private high school mailed its acceptance on June 23, the vendor's offer stated that acceptance would be effective when received—not upon dispatch.

Educational objective:

The mailbox rule does not apply if it is inconsistent with the offer's terms, such as when the offer states that acceptance is effective only upon receipt.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

References

17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts § 98 (2019) (mailbox rule).

出价人的行为

收到后生效

放弃要约

(邮箱规则)

承诺(首次收到即有效)之前邮寄的邮件不适当地盖章/处理的承诺不合理拒绝(首次收到即有效) 承诺选择合同要约的国家只有在收到时才生效拒付/结付

如果邮件是传递承诺的合理方法——例如,因为要约是通过邮件传递的——以及

(a) 接收手续一经发出即生效——如果接收手续得到妥善处理,并用有薪邮资寄到邮政部门。

但是,如果邮箱规则与要约条款不一致,例如,要约规定承诺只有在收到时才有效,则不适用。

* 原因是发价人作为发价的主人,可以决定承诺发价的方式和手段。

(Choices B & D) 货物销售合同(如办公桌、椅子)由UCC公司管辖,根据UCC公司要约规则,一个商家书面和签定的关于要约将继续开放的保证,在要约所述时间内是不可撤销的。

因此,直到6月25日是不可撤销的,供应商无法在6月24日撤销合同,但是,由于没有及时收到高中的录取。

虽然私立高中于6月23日寄出承诺信,但供应商的要约说,承诺在收讫时有效,而不是在发送时有效。

学习要点：

信箱规则如果与要约条款不一致则不适用,例如当要约声明承诺只有在收到时才有效时.

UCC = 统一商法典。

17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts § 98 (2019) (邮箱规则).

stem: A niece had worked in her aunt's bookstore for many years. The bookstore business, which was housed in a building that the aunt leased, was independently appraised at $200,000. The aunt decided to retire. She wrote to the niece, expressing her affection for the niece and offering to sell her the bookstore business for $125,000 if the landlord would agree to a transfer of the lease. The letter also specified when the aunt would transfer the business. The niece wrote back accepting her aunt's offer. In a phone call to the niece, the aunt stated that the landlord had approved the transfer of the lease and that she would now ask her attorney to draft a written contract so that there would be a record of the terms. Before the attorney had finished drafting the document, the aunt changed her mind about selling the business and informed the niece of her decision.
stemZh: 一个侄女在姨妈的书店工作多年,住在姨妈租来的一栋楼内的书店生意,被独立估价为20万美元,姨妈决定退休.她写信给侄女,表达了对侄女的爱意,并提议如果房东同意转租的话,以12.5万美元的价格将书店业务卖给她,信中还明确了姨妈何时转卖业务.侄女回信接受了姨妈的要约,姨妈在给侄女的电话中表示,房东已经批准了租约的转让,现在她要她的律师起草一份书面合同,以便有合同条款的记录.在律师起草完文件之前,姑姑改变了卖掉生意的想法,将她的决定通知了侄女.
ask: In an action for breach of contract brought by the niece against her aunt, is the niece likely to prevail?
askZh: 在侄女对姨妈提起的违反合同诉讼中,侄女能否胜诉?

options.en: No, because the motivation for the transfer of the business was the aunt's affection for her niece, not the price.
options.zh: 不,因为转移生意的动机 是姨妈对她侄女的爱 不是代价

options.en: No, because the promised consideration was inadequate in light of the market value of the business.
options.zh: 不,因为考虑到企业的市场价值,承诺的对价不充分。

options.en: Yes, because the condition concerning the landlord's assent to the transfer of the lease was beyond the control of either party.
options.zh: 是的,因为房东同意转让租约的条件超出了任何一方的控制范围。

options.en: Yes, because the document being drafted by the attorney was merely a record of an agreement already made, not a condition to it.
options.zh: 是的,因为律师正在起草的文件仅仅是一份已经达成的协议的记录,而不是它的一个条件。

explanation.en:
Contract conditions

Condition precedent

Uncertain future event that, if it occurs, creates party's obligation to perform (e.g., A agrees to hire B if B graduates college)

Condition subsequent

Uncertain future event that, if it occurs, excuses party's existing obligation to perform (e.g., B agrees to work for C until B graduates college)

A binding contract is formed when one party (ie, the offeror) makes an offer and the other party (ie, the offeree) accepts it. The resulting contract can contain certain conditions affecting the parties' duty to perform:

condition precedent – an uncertain future event that, if it occurs, creates a party's duty to perform

condition subsequent – an uncertain future event that, if it occurs, excuses a party's existing duty to perform

Here, the niece accepted the aunt's offer to sell the bookstore for $125,000 if the landlord agreed to transfer the lease. This created a condition precedent that triggered the aunt's duty to perform once the landlord agreed to the transfer. The aunt then told the niece that she would ask her attorney to draft a written contract. But this did not create a condition because conditions cannot be added unilaterally after contract formation.

Additionally, the parties' agreement to memorialize the contract in a final writing after a binding contract had been formed does not prevent enforcement of their original informal agreement. This is true even if the contemplated writing is never prepared. Therefore, the niece is likely to prevail in her breach of contract action.

(Choice A & B) Contracts must be supported by valuable consideration—ie, a bargained-for exchange of promises or performance. Here, the aunt's promise to sell her business and

the niece's promise to pay $125,000 constituted the necessary bargained-for exchange— even if the aunt was partially motivated by affection. And since equivalence in value is not required, it does not matter that the business is worth $200,000.

(Choice C) Contracts are often conditioned on events that are beyond the control of either party (eg, the landlord's assent to the transfer of the lease), and this fact has no effect on the outcome of this dispute.

Educational objective:

Once a binding contract is formed, the fact that the parties further agree that the contract will be memorialized in a final writing does not prevent enforcement of the original agreement—even if the writing is never prepared.

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 27 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (existence of contract where written memorial is contemplated).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 224–25 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (defining and explaining contract conditions).

explanation.zh:
合同条件

条件先例

不确定的未来事件,如果发生,将产生当事人履行义务的义务(例如,A同意雇用B,如果B大学毕业生)

随后的条件

不确定的未来事件,如果发生,则会为当事人履行现有义务提供借口(例如,B同意为C工作,直到B大学毕业)

如果一方当事人(即发价人)提出要约,另一方当事人(即被要约人)接受,则订立具有约束力的合同。

有条件的先例——如果发生不确定的未来事件,就会产生一方当事人履行义务的义务

(b) 事后条件——如果发生不确定的未来事件,即为当事人履行现有义务提供借口;

在这里,侄女接受了姨妈的要约,如果房东同意转租,则以12.5万美元的价格将书店卖掉,这创造了一个条件先例,一旦房东同意转租,姨妈就应履行这一义务。姨妈随后告诉侄女,她会请她的律师起草一份书面合同,但这并没有造成条件,因为在合同订立后不能单方面增加条件。

此外,双方当事人同意在具有约束力的合同订立后以最后书面形式对合同进行纪念,但这并不妨碍其原始非正式协议的执行,即使设想的书面从未准备好,也属实。因此,侄女很可能在违反合同的诉讼中占优势。

(Choice A & B) 合同必须得到宝贵的对价的支持,即通过谈判交换承诺或业绩。

侄女承诺支付125,000美元,这构成了必要的交易——即使姨妈部分是出于感情动机,而且由于不需要等价,因此生意价值20万美元并不重要。

(C) 合同往往以任何一方无法控制的事件(例如房东同意转让租约)为条件,这一事实对争议的结果没有影响。

学习要点：

一旦形成具有约束力的合同,双方当事人进一步商定以最后书面形式纪念合同这一事实并不妨碍执行原始协议——即使书面从未准备好。

参考资料

合同的重述(第二)§27(1981年《美国法律》)(合同中包含有书面纪念)。

重述(第二次)224-25号合同(1981年《美国法律》)(界定和解释合同条件)。

stem:
A homeowner and a contractor entered into a contract under which the homeowner agreed to pay the contractor $50,000 for remodeling the homeowner's basement according to a set of plans.

After the work was completed, the homeowner honestly believed that there were defects in the contractor's work as well as departures from the plans. In fact, the contractor had fully performed. The homeowner offered to pay the contractor $35,000 in full settlement in exchange for the contractor's promise to surrender his entire claim. The contractor accepted the homeowner's offer, and the homeowner paid the contractor $35,000. The reasonable value of the work was $35,000.
stemZh:
房屋所有人和承包商订立了一项合同,根据该合同,房屋所有人同意向承包商支付5万美元,用于按照一套计划翻修房屋所有人地下室。

工程完成后,房主诚实地认为,承包商的工作有缺陷,而且偏离了计划,事实上,承包商已经完全完成了工程。房主提出向承包商全额支付35 000美元,以换取承包商承诺交出他的全部索赔,房主接受了房主的要约,房主向承包商支付了35 000美元。工程的合理价值为35 000美元。
ask: Is the contractor likely to succeed in an action challenging the validity of the settlement agreement?
askZh: 承包者是否可能成功对和解协议的有效性提出质疑?

options.en: No, because the homeowner honestly disputed the amount he owed the contractor.
options.zh: 不,因为房主诚实地质疑他欠承包商的数额。

options.en: No, because the reasonable value of the work was only $35,000.
options.zh: 不,因为工程的合理价值只有35 000美元。

options.en: Yes, because the contractor reasonably relied on the homeowner's contractual promise to pay the full $50,000, and that promise should be enforced to avoid injustice.
options.zh: 是的,因为承包商有理由依赖房主的合同承诺全额支付5万美元,而这一承诺应当强制执行以避免不公正。

options.en: Yes, because the homeowner's payment of $35,000 cannot furnish consideration for the contractor's relinquishment of a claim for $50,000.
options.zh: 是的,因为房主的35 000美元的付款不能作为承包商放弃50 000美元索赔的对价。

explanation.en:
Ways to discharge contractual obligations

Full performance of contractual obligations Impossibility, impracticability, or frustration of purpose Release (in writing only) Mutual rescission Substituted contract Contract or covenant not to sue Accord & satisfaction Novation Mnemonic: FIRM SCAN

One method of discharging contractual obligations is by an accord (new contract) and satisfaction (performance of the accord). An accord is created when the parties to a contract agree to give and accept something different in satisfaction of their existing contractual obligations. Since an accord is a new contract, it must be supported by consideration. Where the new consideration is worth less than what was agreed to in the original contract, it will only be sufficient if:

there is a good-faith dispute as to the amount owed or the new consideration is of a different type than what was owed under the original contract (eg, goods in lieu of cash). Here, the homeowner offered to pay the contractor $35,000 in full satisfaction of his contractual obligation to pay the contractor $50,000. The contractor agreed to that lesser amount (accord), and the homeowner paid it (satisfaction). Since the homeowner honestly believed that there were defects in the contractor's work and departures from the plans (good-faith dispute), the homeowner's payment of $35,000 furnished sufficient consideration to form a valid accord (Choice D). Therefore, the contractor will likely not succeed.

(Choice B) The fact that the reasonable value of the work was only $35,000 does not excuse the homeowner from his obligation to pay the $50,000 contract price. Instead, the homeowner's obligation was discharged by an accord (new contract for $35,000) and satisfaction (payment of the $35,000).

(Choice C) The doctrine of promissory estoppel enables a party who reasonably and detrimentally relied on a promise to enforce that promise even though no valid contract was formed. But here, the contractor's reliance on the homeowner's contractual promise is irrelevant.

Educational objective:

An accord requires consideration to be valid. That consideration can only be worth less than what was agreed to in the original contract if (1) there is a good-faith dispute as to the amount owed or (2) the new consideration is of a different type than what was owed under the original contract.

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 281 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (accord and satisfaction).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 74 cmt. c (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that payment of a disputed amount is consideration for a return promise).

explanation.zh:
履行合同义务的方法

完全履行合同义务 可能、不可行或目的落空 释放(仅书面形式) 相互撤销替代合同或契约 不起诉协议和满足 Novation Mnemonic: FIRM SCAN

履行合同义务的一种方法是协议(新合同)和满足(协议的履行)。当合同双方同意提供和接受不同的东西以履行其现有的合同义务时,就产生了协议,因为协议是一份新的合同,因此必须得到对价的支持。如果新的对价价值低于原始合同中约定的价值,则只有在下述情况下才足够:

关于所欠金额存在善意争议,或者新的对价与原合同下所欠金额(例如货物代替现金)不同。在此,房主提出向承包商支付35 000美元,以完全履行其向承包商支付50 000美元的合同义务,承包商同意这一数额较低(accord),房主也支付了这笔费用(抵偿)。由于房主诚实地认为承包人的工作存在缺陷和偏离计划(诚信纠纷),房主的35 000美元付款为形成有效协议提供了充分的对价(Choice D)。因此,承包商很可能不会成功。

(Choice B) 工程的合理价值仅为35,000美元这一事实并不能免除房主支付5万美元合同价的义务。相反,房主的债务是通过一项协议(新合同,价值35 000美元)和抵偿(支付35 000美元)来履行的。

(C选择)允诺禁反言的理论使合理和有害地依赖承诺的一方当事人能够执行该承诺,即使没有订立有效的合同。但在这里,承包商依赖房主的合同承诺是无关紧要的.

学习要点：

协议要求对价是有效的。如果(1)对所欠金额存在善意争议,或者(2)新的对价与所欠金额不同,则对价的价值可能低于原始合同中商定的价值。根据原始合同。

参考资料

重述(第二次)合同§74 cmt. c(1981年《美国法律》)(解释支付有争议的金额是对价回报承诺)。

That consideration can only be worth less than what was agreed to in the original contract if (1) there is a good-faith dispute as to the amount owed or (2) the new consideration is of a different type than what was owed under the original contract.
explanation.ruleZh: 协议要求对价是有效的。如果(1)对所欠金额存在善意争议,或者(2)新的对价与所欠金额不同,则对价的价值可能低于原始合同中商定的价值。根据原始合同。

stem: A business contracted in writing with a shareholder who owned all of a corporation's outstanding stock to purchase the stock at a specified price per share. At the time this contract was executed, the business's contracting officer said to the shareholder, "Of course, our commitment to buy is conditioned on our obtaining approval of the contract from our parent company." The shareholder replied, "Fine. No problem." The parent company orally approved the contract, but the shareholder changed her mind and refused to consummate the sale on two grounds: (1) when the agreement was made there was no consideration for her promise to sell; and (2) the parent company's approval of the contract was invalid.
stemZh: 与拥有公司所有未清股票的股东签订书面合同,按每股特定价格购买股票。执行本合同时,企业承包干事对股东说,"当然,我们购买的承诺取决于我们从母公司获得合同的批准",股东回答说:"很好.没问题",母公司口头批准了合同,但股东改变主意,拒绝完成销售,理由有二:(1)协议达成时,没有对价她承诺出售;和(2)母公司对合同的批准无效。
ask: If the business sues the shareholder for breach of contract, is the business likely to prevail?
askZh: 如果该企业起诉股东违约,该企业是否可能占上风?

options.en: No, because mutuality of obligation between the parties was lacking when the agreement was made.
options.zh: 否,因为订立协议时当事人之间缺乏义务的相互性。

options.en: No, because the condition of the parent company's approval of the contract was an essential part of the agreed exchange and was not in a signed writing.
options.zh: 不,因为母公司批准合同的条件是协议交换的一个基本部分,不是在一份签字的书面中。

options.en: Yes, because any possible lack of consideration for the shareholder's promise to sell was expressly waived by the shareholder when the agreement was made.
options.zh: 是的,因为股东在达成协议时明确放弃了对股东出售承诺的任何对价。

options.en: Yes, because the business's promise to buy, bargained for and made in exchange for the shareholder's promise to sell, was good consideration even though it was expressly conditioned on an event that was not certain to occur.
options.zh: 是的,因为企业承诺购买、讨价还价和作为交换股东承诺出售的交换条件,这是很好的对价,尽管它明确地以一个不确定的事件为条件。

explanation.en:
Elements of valuable consideration

Bargained-for exchange

Each party's willingness to enter agreement must be induced by other party's act/promise

Legal detriment Each party must relinquish legal right by either:

performing (or promising to perform) act that is not legally required or refraining (or promising to refrain) from performing legally permissible act A contract is a legally enforceable agreement that is created when a mutual agreement is supported by valuable consideration—ie, a bargained-for exchange of promises or performance. However, performance can be delayed or discharged by a condition—ie, an uncertain future event that must occur before performance becomes due or is discharged. There are two types of conditions:

Condition precedent* – delays performance until a specified event occurs Condition subsequent – excuses performance once a specified event occurs Here, the business promised to purchase, and the shareholder promised to sell, all of the shareholder's stock in a corporation. This exchange of promises provided valuable consideration to form a valid contract. But the parties' performance of that contract was contingent upon the business obtaining approval of the agreement from its parent company—a condition precedent. Since that condition precedent was met when the parent company approved the purchase, the business would likely prevail in a breach-of-contract action based on the shareholder's refusal to sell.

*A condition concurrent arises when each party's obligation to perform is a condition precedent to the other party's obligation to perform (ie, when performance is due simultaneously).

(Choices A & C) Mutuality of obligation between the parties was not lacking, and their agreement was supported by consideration, because the business's promise to purchase stock was induced by the shareholder's promise to sell it (and vice versa).

(Choice B) There is no rule requiring that a condition be included in a signed writing.

Educational objective:

A contract is generally formed when a mutual agreement is supported by valuable consideration and may include conditions that delay (condition precedent) or excuse (condition subsequent) a party's promised performance.

explanation.zh:
重要考虑因素

交易交换

每一方同意达成协议的意愿必须受到另一方的行为/承诺的诱导

每一方必须通过以下方式放弃法律权利:

履行(或承诺履行)法律不要求或不履行的行为(或承诺履行)合同是法律上可执行的协议,如果当共同协议得到有价值的支持时,承诺或表现的交换然而,履约情况可能因某种条件而推迟或解除,即未来发生的不确定事件。必须在履行到期或解除义务之前发生。

条件先例* – 延迟执行直到特定事件发生 条件随后 -一旦发生特定事件,便提供借口股东承诺出售, 股东的所有股票在一个这种交换承诺为形成有效合同提供了宝贵的对价,但当事人履行合同的条件是企业获得母公司对协议的批准,这是前提条件。由于母公司批准购买时满足了这一条件的先例,因此,在基于股东拒绝出售的违约诉讼中,企业很可能占上风。

* 当每一方当事人履行义务时,同时产生一个条件,这是另一方当事人履行义务的一个先决条件(即同时履行义务的时间)。

(Choices A & C) 当事人之间义务的相互性并不缺乏,他们的协议得到了对价的支持,因为企业购买股票的承诺是由股东出售股票的承诺引起的(反之亦然).

(Choice B)没有规定要求在署名的写作中包括一个条件.

学习要点：

合同一般是在相互协议得到宝贵对价支持的情况下订立的,其中可能包括推迟(先决条件先例)或借口(先决条件随后)一方当事人承诺履行的条件。

stem: A general contractor about to bid on a construction job for an office building invited a carpenter and several others to bid on the carpentry work. The carpenter agreed to bid if the general contractor would agree to give the carpenter the job provided that his bid was lowest and the general contractor was awarded the main contract. The general contractor so agreed. The carpenter, incurring time and expense in preparing his bid, submitted the lowest carpentry bid. The general contractor used the carpenter's bid in calculating its own bid, which was successful.
stemZh: 即将对办公楼建筑工程进行招标的一位总承包商邀请了一位木匠和其他几位承包商对木工工程进行招标。木工同意投标,如果总承包商同意给予木工工作,条件是他的出价最低,总承包商被授予主合同,总承包商同意。木工在准备出价时花费了时间和费用,提交了最低的木工出价,总承包商在计算自己的出价时使用了木工的出价,结果成功.
ask: Which of the following best supports the carpenter's position that the general contractor is obligated to award the carpentry subcontract to the carpenter?
askZh: 以下哪些最能证明木工的立场,即总承包商有义务将木工分包给木工?

options.en: The carpenter detrimentally relied on the general contractor's conditional promise in preparing his bid.
options.zh: 木匠在准备出价时严重依赖总承包商的有条件承诺。

options.en: The carpenter gave consideration for the general contractor's conditional promise to award the carpentry subcontract to the carpenter.
options.zh: 木工就总承包商附条件承诺把木工分包合同授予该木工提供了对价。

options.en: The general contractor has an implied duty to deal fairly and in good faith with all bidders whose bids the general contractor used in calculating its main bid to the building owner.
options.zh: 总承包商有默示义务与所有投标人进行公平和善意的交易,总承包商在计算其向建筑业主的主要出价时使用了这些投标人。

options.en: The general contractor has an obligation to the owner of the building to subcontract with the carpenter because the carpenter's bid was used in calculating the general contractor's bid, and the carpenter is an intended beneficiary of that obligation.
options.zh: 一般承包商对建筑物所有人有义务与木匠进行分包,因为木匠的投标被用于计算一般承包商的投标,木匠是该义务的预期受益人。

explanation.en:
Elements of valuable consideration

Bargained-for exchange

Each party's willingness to enter agreement must be induced by other party's act/promise

Legal detriment Each party must relinquish legal right by either:

performing (or promising to perform) act that is not legally required or refraining (or promising to refrain) from performing legally permissible act A contract is generally formed when an exchange of promises is supported by valuable consideration—ie, a bargained-for exchange of promises or performance. However, performance under that agreement can be made contingent upon a condition. There are two types of conditions:

Condition precedent – where a party's duty to perform arises upon the occurrence or nonoccurrence of an uncertain future event (ie, the event creates the duty)

Condition subsequent – where a party's duty to perform is released upon the occurrence or nonoccurrence of an uncertain future event (ie, the event extinguishes the duty)

Here, the carpenter offered to bid on the carpentry work in exchange for the contractor's promise to award the carpenter the subcontract. This exchange of promises provided valuable consideration to form a binding agreement. The contractor's performance of that agreement was contingent upon the carpenter submitting the lowest bid and the contractor receiving the main contract. Since these conditions precedent occurred, the contractor was obligated to award the subcontract to the carpenter.

(Choice A) The doctrine of promissory estoppel allows a party to enforce a promise on which it reasonably and detrimentally relied when no valid contract was formed. A contract was formed here, so the carpenter's reliance is irrelevant.

(Choice C) The duty of good faith and fair dealing is implied in every contract—but not bids and other mere offers. Therefore, this duty would extend to the carpenter, but not other bidders with whom no contract was formed.

(Choice D) An intended beneficiary is a person who is intentionally given an advantage under a contract to which the person is not a party and may therefore enforce those contractual obligations. Here, the carpenter's bid was used in the contractor and building owner's agreement. But since there is no evidence that this agreement was intended to benefit the carpenter, he is merely an incidental beneficiary who has no right to enforce the agreement.

Educational objective:

A contract is generally formed when an exchange of promises is supported by valuable consideration and may include conditions that delay (condition precedent) or extinguish (condition subsequent) a party's promised performance.

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 71 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (bargained-for exchange as consideration).

17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts § 447 (conditions precedent).

17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts § 453 (conditions subsequent).

explanation.zh:
重要考虑因素

交易交换

每一方同意达成协议的意愿必须受到另一方的行为/承诺的诱导

每一方必须通过以下方式放弃法律权利:

履行(或承诺履行)法律不要求或不履行的行为(或承诺履行)合同一般在下列情况下订立:承诺得到宝贵对价的支持,即谈判交换承诺或履行。但是,根据该协定履行义务的条件是:条件。有两种条件:

条件先例——当一方当事人的履约义务发生或不发生不确定的未来事件时(即该事件产生义务)

事后的条件——当发生或不发生不确定的未来事件(即该事件消灭该义务)时,当事一方的履行义务即予解除。

在此,木工提出要对木工工程进行投标,以换取承包商向木工提供分包合同的承诺,这种交换承诺为形成具有约束力的协议提供了宝贵的对价。承包商履行该协议取决于木工提交最低标书和收到主合同的承包商,由于这些条件有先例,承包商有义务将分包合同授予木工。

(Choice A)本意不容反悔的学说允许当事一方在未订立有效合同时执行它合理和有害地依赖的许诺,在此形成了合同,因此木匠的依赖无关紧要.

每项合同都隐含着诚信和公平交易的义务,但不包括出价和其他纯粹的要约,因此,这项义务适用于木工,但不包括未与之订立合同的其他投标人。

(选择D)意向受益人是指根据当事人不是当事人的合同故意获得好处从而可能强制执行这些合同义务的人。在此,木匠的出价被用于承包商和建筑业主的协议中,但由于没有证据表明该协议是为了让木匠受益,他只是一个附带受益人,无权执行协议。

学习要点：

合同一般是在交换承诺得到宝贵对价支持时订立的,可能包括推迟(先决条件先例)或取消(条件随后)一方当事人承诺履行的条件。

参考资料

重述(第二次)第71条(1981年《美国法律》)(作为对价而谈判交换)。

17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts § 447(先决条件先例)。

17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts § 453(随后的条件)。
