stem:
On November 1, an accountant and a lawyer contracted for the sale of the law books the accountant had inherited from his father. The lawyer agreed to pay the purchase price of $10,000 when the accountant delivered the books on December 1.

On November 10, the lawyer received a signed letter from the accountant that stated: "I have decided to dispose of the bookshelves containing the law books you have already purchased. If you want the shelves, I will deliver them to you along with the books on December 1 at no additional cost to you. Let me know before November 15 whether you want them. I will not sell them to anyone else before then." On November 14, the lawyer faxed and the accountant received the following message: "I accept your offer of the shelves." The accountant was not a merchant with respect to either law books or bookshelves.

On November 12, the accountant told the lawyer that he had decided not to part with the shelves.
stemZh:
11月1日,一名会计师和一名律师签约出售会计师从父亲那里继承的法律书籍,律师同意在会计师于12月1日交付书籍时支付1万美元的购买价.

11月10日,律师收到会计师的签名信,信中称:"我已决定处置包含你已经购买的法律书籍的书架.如果你想要书架,我会在12月1日连同书籍一起交给你,不增加你的费用,在11月15日之前告诉我,你是否想要这些书。11月14日,律师传真,会计师收到如下信息:“我接受你提出的架子”会计师既不是法律书籍也不是书架的商人。

11月12日,会计师告诉律师,他决定不与书架分开.
ask: Will this communication operate as a legally effective revocation of his offer to deliver the shelves?
askZh: 这份来文是否在法律上有效地取消了他交付货架的要约?

options.en: No, because by delaying his acceptance until November 14, the lawyer detrimentally relied on the accountant's promise not to sell the shelves to anyone else in the meantime.
options.zh: 不,因为律师把他的接受推迟到11月14日, 有害地依赖会计的承诺 不出售架子 在此期间任何人。

options.en: No, because the accountant had given a signed assurance that the offer would be held open until November 15.
options.zh: 没有,因为会计师已经签过字,保证要约会一直到11月15日。

options.en: Yes, because the accountant was not a merchant with respect to bookshelves.
options.zh: 是的,因为会计在书架方面不是商人

options.en: Yes, because the lawyer had a preexisting obligation to pay $10,000 for the law books.
options.zh: 是的,因为律师早就有义务 为法律书籍付一万美元

explanation.en:
Irrevocable offers

Type Description Consideration Duration

UCC Firm offer Merchant gives written & signed assurance that offer will remain open

Not required Specified or reasonable time

Common law

Option contract Offeror promises to keep offer open in exchange for consideration

Required

Partial performance (unilateral contracts)

Offeror invites acceptance only by performance & offeree begins to perform

Reasonable time for full performance

Promissory estoppel*

Offeror could reasonably foresee reliance on offer & offeree reasonably relies to his/her detriment

Not required Reasonable time

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

*Also referred to as "detrimental reliance."

Under the UCC, an existing contract can be modified by agreement (ie, offer and acceptance) of the parties. An offer to modify a contract is generally revocable prior to acceptance. But such an offer is irrevocable if it is a firm offer—ie, a merchant's written and signed assurance that his/her offer will be kept open for a period of time.

Here, the accountant's letter offering to modify the sales contract was signed and assured the lawyer that the offer would be held open until November 15. Nevertheless, the accountant's offer was revocable since he is not a merchant with respect to bookshelves

(Choice B). Therefore, the accountant effectively revoked the offer before it was accepted by telling the lawyer on November 12 that he had decided not to part with the shelves.

(Choice A) Under the doctrine of promissory estoppel, an otherwise revocable offer becomes irrevocable if (1) the offeror could reasonably foresee that the offeree would rely on the offer and (2) the offeree reasonably and detrimentally relied on that offer. But even

if the lawyer reasonably relied on the accountant's offer, he suffered no detriment—eg, expenses to prepare for the shelves' delivery.

(Choice D) The fact that the lawyer had a preexisting obligation to pay $10,000 for the law books shows that there would have been no new consideration for the proposed modification. But consideration is not required to modify a sale-of-goods contract.

Educational objective:

Under the UCC, an offer to modify a contract is generally revocable unless it is a firm offer— ie, a merchant's written and signed assurance that his/her offer will remain open for a period of time.

References

U.C.C. § 2-205 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (firm offers).

根据《统一商法典》,现有合同可通过双方当事人的协议(即要约、要约和承诺)加以修改,修改合同的要约一般在承诺之前可以撤销。但是,如果这种要约是坚定的要约——即商人的书面和签署的保证,即其要约将保留一段时间,则不可撤销。

在此,会计师提出修改销售合同的信件已经签署,并向律师保证,该要约将持续到11月15日,但是,会计师的要约是可以撤销的,因为他在书架方面不是商人。

因此,会计师在11月12日告知律师他决定不与书架分开时,在被承诺之前就有效地取消了这一要约。

(选择A) 根据本意不容反悔的理论,如果(1) 发价人可以合理地预见到发价人将依赖发价,(2) 发价人合理和有害地依赖发价,则本意可撤销的发价就不可撤销。

如果律师合理依赖会计的要约,他不会蒙受任何损失,例如准备货架交货的费用。

(Choice D)律师先前有义务为法律书籍支付10,000美元这一事实表明,对拟议的修改没有新的对价,但并不需要对价修改货物销售合同。

学习要点：

根据《统一商法典》,修改合同的要约一般是可以撤销的,除非是坚定的要约——即商人的书面和签署的保证,即其要约将在一段时间内继续开放。

参考资料

U.C.C.§2-205(Am.Law Inst. & Unif.Law Comm'n 2020)(公司要约)。

stem: A car dealer owed a bank $10,000, due on June 1. The dealer subsequently sold a car to a buyer at a price of $10,000, payable at $1,000 per month beginning on June 1. The dealer then telephoned the bank to ask whether the bank would accept payments of $1,000 per month for 10 months beginning June 1, without interest, in payment of the dealer's debt to the bank. The bank agreed to that arrangement, and the dealer then asked the buyer to make his car payments directly to the bank. When the buyer tendered the first payment to the bank, the bank refused the payment, asserting that it would accept payment only from the dealer. On June 2, the bank demanded that the dealer pay the debt in full immediately. The dealer refused to pay, and the bank sued the dealer to recover the $10,000.
stemZh: 汽车经销商欠银行一万美元,6月1日到期,经销商随后以一万美元的价格将一辆车卖给买主,6月1日起每月应支付1000美元.交易商随后打电话给银行,询问银行是否接受从6月1日起的10个月内每月1 000美元的付款,不计利息,以支付交易商对银行的债务。银行同意了这一安排,经销商随后要求买方直接向银行支付车款,当买方向银行投标时,银行拒绝付款,声称只接受经销商的付款。6月2日,银行要求经销商立即全额偿还债务,经销商拒绝支付,银行起诉经销商索回1万美元.
ask: In this suit, which of the following arguments best supports the bank's claim for immediate payment?
askZh: 在这项诉讼案中,下列哪些理由最能支持银行要求立即付款?

options.en: The agreement to extend the time for payment was not in writing.
options.zh: 延长付款时间的协议不是书面的。

options.en: The dealer could not delegate its duty to pay to the buyer.
options.zh: 交易商不能将其付款义务委托给买方。

options.en: The dealer gave no consideration for the agreement to extend the time of payment.
options.zh: 交易商没有对价延长付款时间的协议。

options.en: The dealer's conduct was an attempted novation that the bank could reject.
options.zh: 庄家的行为是银行可以拒绝的企图更新.

explanation.en:
Consideration problems that prevent contract formation

Gift No bargained-for exchange

Token consideration No inducement to bargain if performance entirely devoid of value

Sham consideration No legal detriment & no inducement to bargain if recited performance not intended to be completed Preexisting duty / past consideration

No legal detriment if performance already owed or completed

Illusory promise No legal detriment if apparent promise imposes no obligation

Contract modifications must generally be supported by new consideration—ie, each party must alter its duties in some way—unless the modification is fair and equitable in light of unanticipated circumstances. The promise to perform, or the performance of, a preexisting duty is insufficient for new consideration and will not discharge the parties' duties under the initial (ie, unmodified) contract.

Here, the car dealer owed the bank $10,000, due on June 1. When the dealer asked whether the bank would accept installment payments beginning on June 1, the bank agreed. But the reason for the dealer's request (ie, the car sale) is not a circumstance that renders consideration unnecessary since it was completely unrelated to the debt owed to the bank. And since the dealer had a preexisting duty to pay that debt, he gave no consideration for the agreement to extend the time of payment. Therefore, the bank has a claim for immediate payment.

(Choice A) A writing is not required to modify a contract unless the statute of frauds applies to the modified contract (not seen here).

(Choice B) Absent a contrary term, either party to a contract can delegate its duty of performance to a third party. However, this would not extinguish the party's liability for breach should the third party fail to perform.

(Choice D) A novation is a new contract that (1) substitutes a new party for one of the original parties, (2) discharges the original party's obligations, and (3) requires agreement by all the parties involved. But here, the bank never agreed to substitute the buyer or discharge the dealer's debt.

Educational objective:

Modification of an existing contract requires new consideration unless the modification is fair and equitable due to unanticipated circumstances. A promise to perform a preexisting duty does not constitute new consideration.

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 73 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that performance of a pre-existing legal duty is not consideration).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 89 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that modification of a contract without new consideration is binding if it is fair and equitable in view of unanticipated circumstances).

explanation.zh:
审议妨碍合同订立的问题

无价交换

如果业绩完全没有价值,则不鼓励讨价还价

如果背弃不准备完成的履约行为,没有法律损害,也没有诱导进行交易

已到期或已完成的履约行为无法律损害

如果表面承诺不产生任何义务,则法律上无损害

对合同的修改一般必须辅之以新的对价,即每一当事方都必须以某种方式改变其义务,除非在意料之外的情况下,修改是公平和平等的。履行或履行原有义务的承诺不足以供新的对价,而且不会履行最初(即未经修改)合同规定的当事人的职责。

在这里,汽车经销商欠银行1万美元,到期日为6月1日,当经销商问银行是否会接受6月1日开始的分期付款时,银行同意.但经销商提出要求(即汽车销售)的原因并不是因为与欠银行的债务完全无关而使对价变得没有必要.由于经销商有偿还债务的义务,因此他没有对价延长付款时间的协议,因此,银行有权要求立即付款。

(选择A)除非防止欺诈法适用于修改的合同(此处不见),否则无须书面形式修改合同。

(选择B)如果没有相反的条款,合同的任何一方均可将其履约义务委托给第三方,但是,如果第三方不履约,这不会取消该方对违约的责任。

(Choice D) 更新是新合同,该合同 (1)将新当事人替换为原当事人之一,(2)解除原当事人的义务,(3)要求有关各方达成协议.但在这里,银行从未同意替代买方或解除经销商的债务.

学习要点：

对现有合同的修改需要新的对价,除非由于意料之外的情况,修改是公平和平等的,履行先前存在的职责的承诺不构成新的对价。

参考资料

重述(第二)第89条(1981年《Am.Law Inst.》)(解释在没有新对价的情况下修改合同,如果在意料之外的情况下是公平和平等的,则具有约束力)。

stem: On May 1, an uncle mailed a letter to his adult nephew that stated: "I am thinking of selling my pickup truck, which you have seen and ridden in. I would consider taking $7,000 for it." On May 3, the nephew mailed the following response: "I will buy your pickup for $7,000 cash." The uncle received this letter on May 5 and on May 6 mailed a note that stated: "It's a deal." On May 7, before the nephew had received the letter of May 6, he phoned his uncle to report that he no longer wanted to buy the pickup truck because his driver's license had been suspended.
stemZh: 5月1日,一位叔叔寄信给他的成年侄子,信中写道:"我想卖掉我的皮卡车,你们已经看到并骑上了,我会考虑拿7000美元买它" 5月3日,侄子邮寄了以下答复:"我会以7000美元现金买下你的皮卡",叔叔于5月5日和5月6日收到这封信,寄来一张纸条,上面写着:"这是个交易",5月7日,在侄子收到5月6日的信件之前,他给叔叔打电话报告说,由于他的驾照被吊销,他不再想买皮卡.
ask: Which of the following statements concerning this exchange is accurate?
askZh: 以下哪些关于这一交换的声明是准确的?

options.en: There was a contract as of May 3.
options.zh: 截至5月3日,有一份合同。

options.en: There was a contract as of May 5.
options.zh: 截至5月5日,已有一份合同。

options.en: There was a contract as of May 6.
options.zh: 截至5月6日已有合同.

options.en: There is no contract.
options.zh: 没有合同。

explanation.en:
Contract negotiations by mail*

Offeror's actions

Offer Effective upon receipt

Revocation of offer

Offeree's actions

Acceptance

(mailbox rule)

Effective upon dispatch Exceptions—effective upon receipt if: improperly stamped/addressed acceptance by mail unreasonable rejection mailed before acceptance (first received is effective) acceptance of option contract offer states acceptance effective only upon receipt Rejection/counteroffer Effective upon receipt

*Applicable under common law & UCC.

Contract formation begins with an offer that expresses more than a mere willingness to negotiate. The offer must (1) communicate definite terms to the offeree and (2) make an objectively reasonable expression of the offeror's intent to enter a binding contract. Here, the uncle's May 1 letter was not an offer since he was merely "thinking" of selling his pickup truck and would "consider" taking $7,000. In contrast, the nephew's May 3 response was an offer because it expressed definite terms ("$7,000 cash") and an intent to be bound ("I will buy").

Once an offer has been made, a contract will be formed if the offeree accepts the offer before it is revoked. Under the mailbox rule, acceptance by mail is:

permitted if mail is a reasonable method of communicating acceptance—eg, when the offer was communicated by mail and

effective upon dispatch—ie, when the acceptance is properly addressed and placed with the postal service with paid postage.

Here, the uncle received the nephew's offer on May 5. The uncle reasonably accepted this offer by mailing a note on May 6 since the parties had been negotiating by mail. As a result, there was a binding contract as of May 6 that prevented the nephew from revoking his offer on May 7 (Choices A & B).

(Choice D) Had the subject matter of the offer become illegal prior to acceptance, the offer would have been terminated by law and no contract would have been formed. Here, the nephew's suspended license only made it illegal for him to drive the truck—not to purchase it. Therefore, this did not cause the offer to terminate.

Educational objective:

An offer to form a contract must (1) communicate definite terms to the offeree and (2) make an objectively reasonable expression of the offeror's intent to enter a binding contract. Such an offer can then be accepted by mail, and will be effective upon dispatch, if a mailing is a reasonable method of communicating acceptance.

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 24 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (requirements for an offer).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 63 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (requirements for acceptance).

17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts § 98 (Am. Law Inst. 2019) (mailbox rule).

explanation.zh:
邮寄合同谈判*

出价人的行为

收到后生效

放弃要约

出价人的行为

承诺情况

(邮箱规则)

承诺(首次收到即有效)之前邮寄的邮件不适当地盖章/处理的承诺不合理拒绝(首次收到即有效) 承诺选择合同要约的国家只有在收到时才生效拒付/结付

* 根据普通法和UCC适用。

合同的订立首先要发出不止表示谈判意愿的要约,要约必须(1)向被要约人传达明确的条款,(2)客观上合理地表达要约人订立具有约束力的合同的意图。在这里,叔叔的5月1日信并不是一个要约,因为他只是"想"卖掉他的皮卡,并且会"考虑"要7000美元.相比之下,侄子5月3日的回复是发价,因为它表达了明确的条件("7000美元现金")和受约束的意图("我会买").

发出要约后,如果被要约人承诺要约,则合同即告成立。根据邮箱规则,邮件接收为:

如果邮件是传达承诺的合理方法——例如,当要约是通过邮件传递,而且

(a) 接收手续一经发出即生效——如果接收手续得到妥善处理,并用有薪邮资寄到邮政部门。

在此,叔父于5月5日收到侄子的要约,叔父在5月6日通过邮寄照会的方式合理地承诺了这一要约,因为双方一直在通过邮件谈判.因此,截至5月6日,有一份具有约束力的合同阻止了侄子在5月7日(Choices A & B)撤销他的要约.

(Choice D)如果要约标的在被承诺之前成为非法,那么要约就会被依法终止,并且没有订立合同.此处,侄子的吊销执照只是使他驾驶卡车——而不是购买卡车——是非法的,因此,这并没有导致要约终止。

学习要点：

订立合同的要约必须(1)向被要约人传达明确的条款,(2)客观上合理表达要约人订立具有约束力的合同的意图。如果邮寄是传达承诺的合理方法,则这种要约可以通过邮件承诺,并在发送时生效。

参考资料

合同重述(第二)§24(1981年《美国法律》)(要约要求)。

合同重述(第二)§63(1981年《美国法律》)(承诺要求)。

17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts §98(Am. Law Inst. 2019)(邮箱规则)。

stem: An Impressionist painting valued at $400,000 was stolen from an art collector's home. The collector, who had insured the painting for $300,000 with an insurance company, promised to pay $25,000 to a full-time investigator for the insurance company if he effected the return of the painting to her in good condition. The insurance company's rules permit its investigators to accept and retain rewards from policyholders for the recovery of insured property. The investigator, by long and skillful detective work, recovered the picture and returned it undamaged to the collector.
stemZh: 这幅价值40万美元的印象主义画是从一个艺术收藏家的家里偷来的。 收藏家向一家保险公司投保了30万美元的画作。 他承诺,如果保险公司的专职调查员实施此行为,将支付25 000美元。把她的画还给她保险公司的规则允许其调查人员接受并保留来自下列机构的奖励:投保人收回被保险财产。调查员通过长期和高超的侦探工作,找回了照片,并将照片还给了收藏家,没有损坏.
ask: If the collector refuses to pay the investigator anything, and he sues her for $25,000, what is the probable result under the prevailing modern rule?
askZh: 如果收藏家拒绝向调查员支付任何费用,而他起诉她要25 000美元,那么在现行现代规则下,可能的结果是什么?

options.en: The collector wins, because the insurance company, the investigator's employer, had a preexisting duty to return the recovered painting to the collector.
options.zh: 收藏家获胜,因为保险公司,调查员的雇主,有将收回的油画归还收藏家的原职.

options.en: The collector wins, because the investigator owed the insurance company a preexisting duty to recover the picture if possible.
options.zh: 收集者获胜,因为调查员欠保险公司一项事先存在的责任,即尽可能收回照片。

options.en: The investigator wins, because the collector will benefit more from return of the $400,000 painting than from receiving the $300,000 policy proceeds.
options.zh: 调查员胜诉,因为收藏家从40万美元的画作的回报中得益大于从30万美元的政策收益中得益。

options.en: The investigator wins, because the preexisting duty rule does not apply if the promisee's (the investigator's) duty was owed to a third person.
options.zh: 调查员胜诉,因为如果承诺人(调查员)的责任是对第三人承担的,则原有的职责规则不适用。

explanation.en:
Preexisting duty rule

Traditional common law rule

Promise to perform, or performance of, preexisting duty does not constitute consideration

Modern exception Consideration exists if preexisting duty owed to third person (ie, nonparty to contract)

An enforceable contract must be supported by consideration—ie, a bargained-for exchange of promises or performance. Under the preexisting duty rule, the promise to perform, or the performance of, a legal duty that is already owed generally does not qualify as consideration. But under the modern exception to this rule, such a promise or performance is consideration if the preexisting duty is owed to a third person—ie, someone who is not a party to the contract in question.

Here, the art collector promised to pay the investigator $25,000 to find and return her stolen painting. Although the investigator owed his employer (the insurance company) a preexisting duty to recover that painting if possible, the insurance company was a third person with respect to the investigator's agreement with the collector (Choice B). This means that the traditional preexisting duty rule does not apply, and the investigator's recovery of the painting is sufficient consideration for the collector's promise. Therefore, the investigator will probably win.

(Choice A) Had the collector promised to pay the reward to the insurance company, then its preexisting duty under the insurance policy would make the collector's promise unenforceable. But since the collector promised to pay the investigator, the insurance company's preexisting duty is irrelevant.

(Choice C) The fact that the collector will benefit more from the return of the painting than from receiving the policy proceeds has no effect on the outcome of this dispute.

Educational objective:

The promise to perform, or the performance of, a preexisting duty is not consideration unless the preexisting duty is owed to a third person (ie, someone who is not a party to the contract in question).

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 73 cmt. d (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that the performance of a preexisting contractual duty can be consideration if the duty is not owed to the promisor).

explanation.zh:
原已存在的职责规则

传统的普通法规则

承诺履行或履行先前存在的职责不构成对价

如果对第三人(即非合同当事方)的原有义务存在对价

一项可执行的合同必须得到对价的支持,即谈判交换承诺或履行。根据先前存在的责任规则,承诺履行或履行已经承担的法律责任一般不视为考虑因素。但是,根据这一规则的现代例外,如果先前存在的义务是对第三人——即不是有关合同当事方的人——承担的,则这种承诺或履行是对价的。

在这里,艺术收藏家承诺向调查员支付25 000美元,以找到并归还她被盗的画作。 虽然调查员欠他的雇主(保险公司)一项事先存在的责任,尽可能收回那幅画作,但保险公司是第三人。关于调查员与收藏家的协议(Choice B),这意味着传统的原有职责规则不适用,调查员收回画作是对收藏家承诺的充分对价。因此,调查员可能会获胜。

(Choice A)如果收藏家承诺向保险公司支付赏金,那么其根据保险单的原有义务将使收藏家的承诺无法执行.但是,由于收藏家承诺向调查员支付报酬,保险公司原有的职责并不重要.

(Choice C) 收藏家从画作的返还中得益大于从政策收益中得益的事实对这场纠纷的结果没有影响.

学习要点：

承诺履行或履行原已存在的义务不予以对价,除非原已存在的义务是对第三人(即不是有关合同当事方的人)承担的。

stem: A testator, whose nephew was his only heir, died leaving a will that gave his entire estate to charity. His nephew, knowing full well that the testator was of sound mind all of his life, and having no evidence to the contrary, nevertheless filed a suit contesting the testator's will on the ground that the testator was incompetent when the will was signed. The testator's executor offered the nephew $5,000 to settle the suit, and the nephew agreed.
stemZh: 一名立遗嘱人去世时留有遗嘱，将全部遗产捐给慈善机构；其侄子是唯一的法定继承人。侄子明知立遗嘱人终生心智健全，也没有任何相反证据，却仍提起诉讼，主张立遗嘱人在签署遗嘱时不具备行为能力，要求否定遗嘱效力。遗嘱执行人提出支付侄子 5,000 美元以和解该诉讼，侄子同意。
ask: If the executor then repudiates the agreement and the foregoing facts are proved or admitted in the nephew's suit against the executor for breach of contract, is the nephew entitled to recover under the prevailing view?
askZh: 如果执行人随后驳回协议,且上述事实在侄子对执行人提出的违约诉讼中得到证明或承认,那么侄子是否有权根据普遍观点进行追偿?

options.en: No, because an agreement to oust the court of its jurisdiction to decide a will contest is contrary to public policy.
options.zh: 不,因为放弃法院裁决遗嘱的管辖权的协议违反公共政策。

options.en: No, because the nephew did not bring the will contest in good faith.
options.zh: 不,因为侄子没有带遗嘱 善意地竞争。

options.en: Yes, because the agreement was a bargained-for exchange.
options.zh: 是的,因为协议是交易

options.en: Yes, because the law encourages the settlement of disputed claims.
options.zh: 是的,因为法律鼓励解决有争议的索赔。

explanation.en:
A contract is generally formed when a mutual agreement is supported by valuable consideration—ie, a bargained-for exchange of promises or performance. A promise to surrender a claim or defense can serve as consideration for a settlement agreement so long as:

the claim or defense is valid or subject to a good-faith dispute or the surrendering party honestly believes that the claim or defense may be valid. If the surrendering party knows that the claim or defense is invalid, an agreement to surrender it lacks consideration and is therefore unenforceable.

Here, the nephew agreed to settle his suit contesting the testator's will in exchange for $5,000. But the nephew did not honestly believe that his claim was valid (ie, he did not bring the will contest in good faith) since he knew that the testator was of sound mind his whole life and had no contrary evidence. Therefore, the nephew's settlement agreement with the executor is unenforceable for lack of bargained-for consideration, and the nephew is not entitled to recover (Choice C).

(Choices A & D) The law does encourage the settlement of legal claims—but not those brought in bad faith. Had the nephew brought the will contest in good faith, there would have been no issue with settling out of court.

Educational objective:

A promise to surrender a claim or defense constitutes consideration for a settlement agreement so long as (1) the claim or defense is valid or subject to a good-faith dispute or (2) the surrendering party believes that the claim or defense may be valid.

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 74 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (settlement of claims).

explanation.zh:
一项合同一般是在相互协议得到宝贵的对价——即:以换取承诺或表现允诺交出债权或辩护可作为和解协议的考虑因素,因此长于:

权利要求或辩护是有效的,或受到善意的争议,或移交方诚实地认为权利要求或辩护可能是有效的。如果移交方知道索赔或抗辩无效,则移交协议缺乏对价,因此无法执行。

在这里,侄子同意解决其诉讼,对遗嘱人的意愿提出质疑,以换取5000美元。 但是侄子并不诚实地认为他的主张是正当的(即他没有诚意地将遗嘱人提出来竞争),因为他知道遗嘱人心智健全。因此,侄子与执行人达成的和解协议由于缺乏讨价还价的对价而无法执行,侄子无权收回(Choice C)。

法律的确鼓励解决法律权利要求,但不是恶意提出的,如果侄子诚意地提出遗嘱争议,庭外和解就不会有任何问题。

学习要点：

只要(1) 要求或辩护是有效的或受到善意的争议,或者(2) 移交方认为要求或辩护可能有效,承诺提交债权或辩护即构成对和解协议的对价。

参考资料

合同重述(第二)§74(1981年《美国法律》)(债权的解决)。

stem: A woman was driving home from a crowded shopping mall when a passenger van ran through a stoplight at great speed and hit the woman's car. A physician who witnessed the incident pulled over to the woman's car and saw that her shoulder was seriously injured. The physician told the woman he was a licensed surgeon before helping her out of the car. The woman was delirious and too shaken to speak as the physician removed several glass fragments from her shoulder and applied temporary sutures to close the wound. When the physician finished, he took the woman's contact information and promised to check on her condition later.
stemZh: 一名妇女从拥挤的购物中心开车回家,当时一辆客车高速通过停电灯,撞到了该妇女的汽车,一名目睹事件的医生停车到该妇女的汽车上,看到她的肩膀受重伤。医生告诉该妇女,他在帮助她下车之前是一名持有执照的外科医生,该妇女神智不清,而且过于震撼,无法说话,因为医生从她的肩上取出几块玻璃碎片,并施用临时缝合以关闭伤口。当医生完成后,他拿走了该妇女的联系信息,并承诺日后检查她的状况.
ask: If the physician subsequently sends the woman a bill for his services, will she be obligated to pay it?
askZh: 如果医生随后向该妇女开具服务账单,她是否有义务支付费用?

options.en: No, because it would be unconscionable to require that the woman pay for the physician's emergency medical services.
options.zh: 不,因为要求妇女支付医生的紧急医疗服务费用是不合理的。

options.en: No, because the physician had a duty to render aid to the woman once he saw that she was injured.
options.zh: 没有,因为医生一旦看到妇女受伤,就有义务向她提供援助。

options.en: Yes, because an implied-in-fact contract was created when the woman allowed the physician to treat her.
options.zh: 是的,因为妇女允许医生治疗她时,就产生了隐含事实的合同。

options.en: Yes, because the law will imply a promise to pay for emergency services the physician rendered to the woman.
options.zh: 是的,因为法律将意味着承诺支付医生向妇女提供的紧急服务。

explanation.en:
In the absence of any contractual relationship between the parties, courts have the power to construct an implied-in-law ("quasi") contract to prevent unjust enrichment when:

the plaintiff has conferred a measurable benefit (eg, medical services) on the defendant the plaintiff acted without gratuitous intent and it would be unfair to let the defendant retain the benefit without compensating the plaintiff. Unfair retention of a benefit arises when (1) the defendant had an opportunity to decline the benefit but knowingly accepted it or (2) the plaintiff had a reasonable excuse for not giving the defendant such opportunity—often because of an emergency. This allows the plaintiff in a quasi-contract action to recover restitutionary damages equal to the reasonable value of the benefit conferred.

Here, the physician conferred a measurable benefit on the woman when he removed glass from her shoulder and closed the wound. Medical services are typically provided with the expectation of compensation. And since the woman was delirious and too shaken to speak, it was reasonable for the physician to act without obtaining her express consent. Therefore, she must pay the physician's bill because the law will imply a promise to pay for his service.

(Choice A) Allowing the woman to retain a benefit without compensating the physician would be unjust—not unconscionable. Unconscionability instead arises when a contract is so unfair to one party that no reasonable person in that position would have agreed to it.

(Choice B) The physician may have had a moral duty to aid the woman once he saw that she was injured, but he had no legal duty to do so.

(Choice C) An implied-in-fact contract arises when the parties' conduct (or failure to act) demonstrates their mutual intent to contract. But here, a court would not find that the woman intended to contract with the physician since she was delirious and unable to speak.

Educational objective:

Courts will construct an implied-in-law ("quasi") contract where the plaintiff has conferred a measurable benefit on the defendant without gratuitous intent and it would be unfair to let the defendant retain the benefit without compensating the plaintiff.

References

Restatement (Third) of Restitution & Unjust Enrichment § 20 (Am. Law Inst. 2011) (protection of another's life or health).

explanation.zh:
在当事人之间不存在任何合同关系的情况下,法院有权在下述情况下订立一项默示法律(“quasi”)合同,以防止不公正的致富:

原告给予被告以可以衡量的利益(例如医疗服务),而原告的行为没有无故意图,如果让被告保留利益而不赔偿原告是不公平的。当:(1) 被告有机会拒绝其福利但明知故犯地接受这种福利,或者(2) 原告有合理的理由不给予被告这种机会——往往是由于紧急情况。这使准合同诉讼中的原告能够收回与所给予利益的合理价值相等的损害赔偿。

在此,医生将玻璃从肩膀上取出并关上伤口,给该妇女带来了可衡量的好处,通常医疗服务都期望得到补偿。由于该妇女神智不清,无法说话,医生在没有得到她明确同意的情况下行事是合理的。 因此,她必须支付医生的账单,因为法律将意味着支付医生服务费的承诺。

(选择A) 允许妇女保留福利而不补偿医生是不公正的,而不是不合乎情理的,相反,如果合同对一方如此不公平,而处于这种地位的合理人不会同意,则会产生不合乎情理的情况。

(Choice B) 医生一旦看到妇女受伤,就可能负有道义责任来帮助她,但他没有法律义务这样做。

当双方的行为(或不行为)表明双方有订立合同的意向时,就会产生隐含的契约。 但在这方面,法院不会发现该妇女有意与医生订立合同,因为她精神错乱,无法说话。

学习要点：

法院将构建一项隐含法律("quasi")合同,其中原告给予被告以可衡量的利益而无无无端意图,而且让被告保留利益而不补偿原告是不公平的.

参考资料

重述(第三篇)《恢复原状和不公正的浓缩》第20条(《2011年宪法》)(保护他人的生命或健康)。

stem:
A businesswoman entered into a contract with a painter by the terms of which he was to paint the businesswoman's office for $1,000 and was required to do all the work over the following weekend so as to avoid disruption of her business.

If the painter had started to paint on the following Saturday morning, he could have finished before Sunday evening. However, he stayed home that Saturday morning and did not start to paint until Saturday afternoon. By late Saturday afternoon, the painter realized that he had underestimated the time it would take to finish the job if he continued to work alone. The painter phoned the businesswoman at her home and accurately informed her that it was impossible to finish the work over the weekend unless he hired a helper. He also stated that to do so would require an additional charge of $200 for the work. The businesswoman told the painter that she apparently had no choice but to pay "whatever it takes" to get the work done as scheduled.

The painter hired an assistant to help finish the painting and paid him $200. The businesswoman has offered to pay the painter $1,000. The painter is demanding $1,200.
stemZh:
一名女商人与一名画家签订了合同,合同规定他要给女商人办公室画1000美元,并被要求在接下来的周末完成所有的工作,以避免业务中断.

如果画家在次日星期六早上开始画画,他本可以在星期日晚上之前完成,不过,他星期六早上留在家里,直到星期六下午才开始画画.到了星期六下午下旬,画家意识到他低估了如果继续独自工作完成这项工作所需的时间.画家给家里的女商人打电话,并准确地告知她,除非他雇了一位帮手,否则不可能在周末完成工作,他还指出,要做到这一点,需要额外收费200美元。女商人告诉画家,她显然别无选择,只能付出"不惜一切代价"才能如期完成作品.

画家聘请了一位助手帮助完成画作,并给了他200美元,女商人提出要给画家1000美元,画家要求1200美元.
ask: How much is the painter likely to recover?
askZh: 画家能恢复多少?

options.en: $1,000 only, because the businesswoman received no consideration for her promise to pay the additional sum.
options.zh: 仅1 000美元,因为女商人没有对价她承诺支付额外款项。

options.en: $1,000 only, because the businesswoman's promise to pay "whatever it takes" is too uncertain to be enforceable.
options.zh: 仅1000美元,因为女商人承诺支付"无论付出多少"都太不确定,无法执行.

options.en: $1,200, because the impossibility of the painter's completing the work alone discharged the original contract and a new contract was formed
options.zh: 1,200美元,因为画家无法独自完成工程 解除了原合同和新合同

options.en: $1,200, in order to prevent the businesswoman's unjust enrichment.
options.zh: 1200美元,为了防止女商人的不正当致富.

explanation.en:
Modifying existing contracts

Governing law Requirements

Common law

Traditional view

Parties' agreement New consideration

Modern view Parties' agreement New consideration unless modification is fair & equitable due to unanticipated circumstances UCC Parties' agreement Good faith (ie, honesty & observance of reasonable commercial standards of fair dealing) New consideration not required UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

At common law, contract modifications must be supported by new consideration—ie, each party must alter its duties in some way—unless the modification is fair and equitable in light of unanticipated circumstances. But the promise to perform, or the performance of, a preexisting duty is insufficient for new consideration and cannot support a modification.

Here, the painter attempted to modify the $1,000 contract by telling the businesswoman that he needed to hire a helper, which would require an additional charge of $200. Although the businesswoman agreed to pay "whatever it takes," the painter had a preexisting duty to finish painting over the weekend. Therefore, the businesswoman received no consideration for her promise to pay the additional sum, and the painter is likely to recover $1,000 only.

(Choice B) There is no consideration if either party makes an illusory promise—ie, one that essentially pledges nothing because it is too uncertain (or because the promising party can choose whether to honor it). But the businesswoman's promise to pay "whatever it takes" was not too uncertain since it was a response to the painter's statement that he needed an additional $200 to finish the work.

(Choice C) Contractual duties can be discharged due to impossibility—eg, when an unanticipated or extraordinary event makes it impossible to perform. But here, the painter's inability to finish the work was due to his own delay—not an unanticipated or extraordinary event.

(Choice D) A party may recover restitution damages to prevent unjust enrichment if the party conferred a non-gratuitous benefit on another without a contractual obligation to do so. Here, the painter conferred a non-gratuitous benefit by paying the helper $200 to finish

the work. However, since the painter was already obligated to paint the office for $1,000, the businesswoman was not unjustly enriched by his expenditure.

Educational objective:

At common law, contract modifications generally must be supported by new consideration, which requires both parties to alter their duties in some way. Performing or promising to perform a preexisting duty is insufficient for consideration and will not support a modification.

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 73 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that performance of a preexisting legal duty is not consideration).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 89 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that modification of a contract without new consideration is binding if it is fair and equitable in view of unanticipated circumstances).

explanation.zh:
修改现有合同

管辖法律的要求

普通法

传统观点

缔约方协定

现代观点 缔约方的协议 新的对价,除非由于意料之外的情况,修改是公平和公平的善意(即诚实和遵守公平交易的合理商业标准)所需的UCC= 统一商法典。

在普通法中,对合同的修改必须辅之以新的对价——即每一当事方都必须以某种方式改变其义务——除非在意料之外的情况下这种修改是公平和平等的。但是,履行或履行原有义务的承诺不足以供新的对价,不能支持修改。

在这里,画家试图修改1000美元的合同,告诉女商人,他需要雇用一名助手,这就需要额外收费200美元.虽然女商人同意支付"无论付出什么代价",但画家有在周末完成绘画的事先存在的义务.因此,女商人没有得到任何对价,因为她承诺支付额外金额,画家可能只收回1000美元.

(Choice B) 如果任何一方作出虚幻的承诺,即基本上不作任何承诺,因为承诺过于不确定(或因为有希望的一方可以选择是否遵守承诺),则没有任何对价。但女商人承诺支付"无论付出什么代价"并非太不确定,因为它是对画家的说法的回应,即他需要额外的200美元才能完成这部作品.

(C类)由于不可能履行合同义务——例如,由于意外或非常事件,无法履行合同义务。但在这里,画家无法完成这部作品是由于他本人的延迟——并不是一个意料之外或非常的事件.

(Choice D)如果一方当事人向另一方授予非无故利益而无合同义务者,当事人可以要求赔偿损害,以防止不公正的致富。

然而,由于画家已经有义务为办公室画1 000美元,该女商人并没有因为自己的开支而不公正地获利。

学习要点：

在普通法中,合同的修改一般必须辅之以新的对价,这就要求双方以某种方式改变其义务。履行或承诺履行先前存在的职责是不够的,不会支持修改。

参考资料

重述(第二)第73条(1981年《阿姆法》)(解释未考虑履行先前存在的法律义务)。

重述(第二)第89条(1981年《Am.Law Inst.》)(解释在没有新对价的情况下修改合同,如果在意料之外的情况下是公平和平等的,则具有约束力)。

stem:
An ice hockey goalie received word that his favorite team's only backup goaltender had been injured in an accident and would likely be unable to play during the upcoming season. The goalie sent a letter to the team's general manager on September 18 offering to play for the team for an annual salary of $450,000. The general manager received the offer letter on September 21 and, in desperation, immediately mailed the goalie a letter accepting the offer on behalf of the team.

On September 22, the team's injured goaltender made a miraculous recovery and the general manager sent the goalie a second letter rejecting the goalie's offer. The goalie received the general manager's rejection on September 25 and received the general manager's acceptance the following day.
stemZh:
一名冰球守门员收到消息称,他最喜欢的球队唯一的后备守门员在一次事故中受伤,在即将到来的赛季中很可能无法出场.守门员于9月18日致函球队总经理,要约为球队出场,年薪45万美元.总经理于9月21日收到要约信,在绝望中立即将代表球队承诺要约的信寄给守门员.

9月22日,球队受伤的守门员奇迹般恢复,总经理给守门员发了第二封信,拒绝了守门员的要约.守门员于9月25日收到总经理的拒绝,并于次日收到总经理的承诺.
ask: Was a contract formed between the goalie and the ice hockey team?
askZh: 守门员和冰球队有合同吗?

options.en: No, because the goalie received the general manager's rejection before the acceptance.
options.zh: 不,因为守门员在验收前收到了总经理的拒绝.

options.en: No, because there was no meeting of the minds between the goalie and the general manager.
options.zh: 不,因为守门员和将军之间没有想法经理

options.en: Yes, because the team assumed the risk that the backup goaltender would recover from his injury.
options.zh: 是的,因为团队承担了 后备守门员从受伤中恢复的风险。

options.en: Yes, because the team effectively accepted the goalie's offer prior to the attempted rejection.
options.zh: 是的,因为球队在尝试拒绝之前 有效地接受了守门员的要约。

explanation.en:
Contract formation requires both an offer and an acceptance (ie, mutual assent). Under the mailbox rule, an acceptance by mail is generally effective upon dispatch, while a rejection is effective only upon receipt. If the offeree has a change of heart and sends:

An acceptance followed by a rejection – a contract is formed upon dispatch of the acceptance, regardless of which communication is received first

A rejection followed by an acceptance – a contract is formed if the acceptance is received first; in contrast, no contract is formed if the rejection is received first*

Here, the general manager sent a letter accepting the goalie's offer followed by a second letter rejecting the offer. Because the acceptance was sent first, a contract was formed upon dispatch of the acceptance. This is true even though the goalie received the general manager's rejection before the acceptance (Choice A). Therefore, an enforceable contract exists between the goalie and the ice hockey team because the team effectively accepted the goalie's offer prior to the attempted rejection.

*However, the offeree may be estopped from enforcing the contract if the offeror received the rejection first and detrimentally relied upon it.

(Choice B) "Meeting of the minds" refers to the parties' mutual assent to form a contract based on agreed-upon terms. Here, there was a meeting of the minds because the goalie offered to play for the team for $450,000 and the general manager accepted the terms of that offer.

(Choice C) The fact that the team assumed the risk of the injured goaltender's recovery would prevent the team from asserting certain defenses to enforcement of a contract (eg, impracticability). But here, the question is whether the parties formed a contract.

Educational objective:

Where an offeree mails an acceptance and later mails a rejection, a contract is formed upon dispatch of the acceptance—regardless of which communication is received first.

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 63 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (time when acceptance takes effect).

explanation.zh:
订立合同既需要要约,也需要承诺(即相互同意)。根据邮箱规则,邮件承诺一般在发送时生效,而拒绝则只在发送时生效。收据。如果被发价人改变主意并发送:

承诺之后即为拒绝 -- -- 合同在发出承诺时订立,而不论首先收到哪一份通知

拒绝,然后是承诺 -- -- 如果先收到承诺,则形成合同;而如果先收到拒绝,则形成合同*

在此,总经理发出一封信,承诺守门员的要约,随后又发出第二封信,拒绝该要约,由于承诺是先发出的,因此在承诺通知发出时就形成了合同。尽管守门员在承诺前收到了总经理的拒绝(Choice A),但情况确实如此.因此,守门员和冰球队之间存在可执行的合同,因为球队在尝试拒绝之前有效地承诺了守门员的要约.

* 然而,如果发价人首先收到拒绝通知,并且不利地依赖该通知,则被发价人可能被阻止执行合同。

(Choice B)"心灵之会"是指当事人双方同意根据约定的条件订立合同.在此,由于守门员提出以45万美元的价格为球队出场,总经理承诺了这一出价的条件,因此产生了一场想法.

(Choice C) 球队承担受伤守门员恢复的风险会阻止球队对合同的执行提出某些辩护(例如不切实际),但这里的问题是双方是否组成合同.

学习要点：

如果被发价人寄送承诺书,然后寄送拒绝书,则在发出承诺书时即订立合同,不论首先收到通知。

stem: A debtor owed a lender $1,500. The statute of limitations barred recovery on the claim. The debtor wrote to the lender, stating, "I promise to pay you $500 if you will extinguish the debt." The lender agreed.
stemZh: 债务人欠贷款人1500美元,诉讼时效禁止收回债权,债务人写信给贷款人说,“我保证,如果你能消灭债务,就付给你500美元。” 贷款人同意。
ask: Is the debtor's promise to pay the lender $500 enforceable?
askZh: 债务人承诺向放款人支付500美元是否可以执行?

options.en: No, because the debtor made no promise not to plead the statute of limitations as a defense.
options.zh: 不,因为债务人没有保证不以诉讼时效作为辩护理由。

options.en: No, because there was no consideration for the debtor's promise.
options.zh: 不,因为没有对价债务人的承诺。

options.en: Yes, because the debtor's promise provided a benefit to the lender.
options.zh: 是的,因为债务人的承诺为放款人提供了好处。

options.en: Yes, because the debtor's promise to pay part of the barred antecedent debt needs no consideration to be enforceable.
options.zh: 是的,因为债务人承诺支付部分被禁的前债,无需考虑是否可以执行。

explanation.en:
Exceptions to preexisting-duty rule

Main rule Promise to perform (or performance of) preexisting duty is not consideration

Common-law exceptions

New/altered consideration

New duty added or preexisting duty altered (eg, acceleration of due date)

Ratification of voidable duty

New promise to perform voidable duty (eg, upon reaching age of majority)

Honest dispute Scope of duty honestly disputed

Unexpected event Fair & equitable modification in view of unanticipated circumstances

Renewed promise Renewed promise to pay preexisting debt despite technical defense (eg, statute of limitations, bankruptcy) if written or partially performed

Third party Third party offers additional promise that is contingent on performance of preexisting duty

UCC exception Modification Modification sought in good faith—ie, honesty and observance of reasonable commercial standards of fair dealing

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

A promise to perform a preexisting duty is generally unenforceable for lack of consideration. But under a long-established exception to this rule, a debtor's renewed promise to pay all or part of a preexisting debt is enforceable if:

the debtor renewed the promise despite the existence of a technical defense to recovery of the original debt (eg, statute of limitations, bankruptcy) and

the renewed promise was made in writing or partially performed.

Here, the statute of limitations barred recovery on the lender's claim against the debtor for $1,500. Despite this defense, the debtor made a renewed promise to pay $500 of the preexisting debt. And though there was no consideration for this promise, it was made in a written letter (Choice B). Therefore, the debtor's promise to pay $500 is enforceable without consideration.

(Choice A) Although the debtor made no promise to waive his statute-of-limitations defense, his renewed promise to pay part of the debt is still enforceable since it was made in writing despite being time-barred. And that promise will defeat the statute-of-limitations defense with respect to $500 of the debt.

(Choice C) Early case law described the consideration requirement in terms of benefit to the promisee (here, the lender), whereas modern courts focus instead on legal detriment to the promisor (here, the debtor). But whether the debtor's promise was a benefit or a detriment is irrelevant because consideration is not required.

Educational objective:

A promise to perform a preexisting duty is generally unenforceable. But a debtor's renewed promise to pay all or part of a preexisting debt is enforceable if the debtor renewed his/her promise despite a technical defense (eg, statute of limitations) AND the renewed promise was made in writing or partially performed.

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 82 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that a renewed promise to pay a preexisting debt is binding if that debt would be binding except for the statute of limitations).

explanation.zh:
原职规则的例外

主要规则 承诺履行(或履行)原已存在的职责不考虑

普通法例外

新的/更改的审议

诚实争议 诚实争议的责任范围

由于意外情况,公平和公平修改

虽有技术辩护(例如,诉讼时效、破产),但书面或部分履行的重新承诺偿还原有债务

第三方提供附加承诺,以履行先前存在的职责

本着诚意、诚实和遵守《统一商法典》的公平交易的合理商业标准

UCC = 统一商法典。

履行原已存在义务的承诺,由于缺乏对价,一般是无法执行的。 但根据这一规则早已确立的例外,债务人重新承诺偿付原已存在的全部或部分债务,如果:

尽管存在对收回原始债务(例如诉讼时效、破产)的技术辩护理由,债务人仍重新承诺;

重新承诺是书面作出的或部分履行的。

在此,诉讼时效法规禁止收回贷款人对债务人的1,500美元债权,尽管有这一辩护,债务人仍再次承诺支付原先存在的500美元债务。虽然没有对价这一承诺,但它是在一封信(Choice B)中作出的。 因此,债务人承诺支付500美元是可执行的,无需对价。

(Choice A) 尽管债务人没有承诺放弃其法定限制抗辩,但他重新承诺偿还部分债务仍然可以执行,因为它是书面作出的,尽管已经过期。而这一承诺将挫败对500美元债务的限制法规辩护。

(选择C)早期判例法从对保证人(这里是放款人)的利益的角度描述了对价要求,而现代法院则侧重于对本票人(这里是债务人)的法律损害。但是,债务人的许诺是好处还是损害并不重要,因为不需要对价。

学习要点：

履行原已存在义务的承诺一般是无法执行的。 但是,债务人重新承诺偿付原已存在的全部或部分债务,如果债务人不顾技术辩护(例如,诉讼时效)和重新承诺而重新承诺,是可以执行的。承诺以书面作出或部分履行。

stem:
A written construction contract, under which a contractor agreed to build a new house for a landowner at a fixed price of $200,000, contained the following provision: "Prior to construction or during the course thereof, this contract may be modified by mutual agreement of the parties as to 'extras' or other departures from the plans and specifications provided by the landowner and attached hereto. Such modifications, however, may be authorized only in writing, signed by both parties."

During construction, the contractor incorporated into the structure overhanging gargoyles and other "extras" orally requested by the landowner for orally agreed prices in addition to the contract price. The landowner subsequently refused to pay anything for such extras, aggregating $30,000 at the agreed prices, solely on the ground that no written, signed authorization for them was ever effected.
stemZh:
一份书面建筑合同规定,承包商同意以20万美元的固定价格为土地所有者建造新的房屋,合同中载有以下规定:“在建造之前或在建造过程中,经双方同意,可以对本合同进行修改,以“extras”或其他方式背离土地所有者及其所附的计划和规格。但是,这种修改只能以书面批准,双方签字".

在施工期间,承包商将土地所有人口头要求的除合同价格外的口头商定价格纳入超挂的gargoyles和其他“extras”。土地所有者随后拒绝支付这些额外款项,按商定价格计算,共计30 000美元,其唯一理由是从未执行过书面、签名的授权。
ask: If the contractor sues the owner on account of the "extras," which, if any, of the following will effectively support the landowner's defense?
askZh: 如果承包商以"extras"为由起诉业主,如果有的话,以下哪些内容将有效支持地主的辩护?

options.en: The parol evidence rule and the failure of an express condition.
options.zh: parol证据规则和明示条件的失败.

options.en: The parol evidence rule and the statute of frauds.
options.zh: 帕罗尔证据规则和防止欺诈法。

options.en: The preexisting duty rule and the failure of an express condition.
options.zh: 原有义务规则和明示条件的失效。

options.en: Neither the parol evidence rule, the preexisting duty rule, the failure of an express condition, nor the statute of frauds.
options.zh: 无论是陈词滥调的证据规则、原有的责任规则、明示条件的失败,还是防止欺诈法。

explanation.en:
The parol evidence rule generally prevents a party to a written contract from presenting evidence of a prior or contemporaneous agreement that contradicts the terms of the contract as written. But this rule does not bar evidence of subsequent agreements between the parties (eg, the parties' oral modifications regarding "extras" that occurred after the contract was entered) (Choices A & B).

An express condition is an explicit clause stating that an uncertain future event will (1) create a duty to perform (ie, condition precedent) or (2) extinguish a duty to perform (ie, condition subsequent). In addition, a party's duty to perform is excused if a condition precedent fails to occur. Here, the landowner's duty to pay for extras required a written modification signed by both parties—not the occurrence of an uncertain future event. Therefore, the failure to make such a writing was not a failure of an express condition (Choices A & C).

Under the statute of frauds, certain types of contract modifications must be in writing and signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought. But a signed writing is not required to modify a construction contract if the modified contract can be completed within one year. And here, there is no indication that construction would necessarily take more than one year (Choice B).

Contract modifications require new consideration—ie, each party must alter his/her duties in some way. But a promise to perform, or the performance of, a preexisting duty does not constitute consideration. Here, the parties agreed that any "extras" would require a written modification—ie, there was no preexisting duty to provide extras. Therefore, the parties' oral modifications were supported by consideration (Choice C).

Educational objective:

In a contract dispute, (1) the parol evidence rule can exclude evidence that contradicts a written contract, (2) the failure of an express condition can excuse a duty to perform, (3) the statute of frauds can invalidate an unwritten or unsigned contract, and (4) the preexisting duty rule can make a contract unenforceable for lack of consideration.

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 213 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that an integrated writing supersedes inconsistent terms of prior agreements).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 225 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that the non-occurrence of a condition precedent discharges the duty to perform when the condition can

no longer occur).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 125 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (statute of frauds vis-à-vis transfers of land).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 73 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that performance of a preexisting legal duty is not consideration).

explanation.zh:
parol证据规则一般禁止书面合同的一方当事人出示与书面合同条款相抵触的先前或当时协议的证据。但这一规则并不妨碍当事人之间嗣后协议的证据(例如,当事人对合同签订后发生的"extras"的口头修改)(Choices A & B).

明确的条件是一项明确条款,规定不确定的未来事件(1) 产生履行义务(即条件先例)或(2) 取消履行义务(即随后的条件)。此外,如果一项条件先例未能发生,则免除一方的履约义务,在此情况下,地主支付额外款项的义务需要双方签署书面修改,而不是出现不确定的未来事件。因此,未能作出这样一份书面声明并不是明示条件的失败(Choices A & C).

根据防止欺诈法,某些类型的合同修改必须以书面形式进行,并由寻求执行的当事人签署。但是,如果修改后的合同能在一年内完成,则不需要签署书面文件来修改建筑合同。 这里没有迹象表明建造工程必定需要一年以上的时间(Choice B)。

修改合同需要新的对价,即每一当事方必须以某种方式改变其义务,但履行或履行先前存在的义务的承诺并不构成对价。在这方面,双方同意,任何“extras”都需要书面修改,即不存在事先存在的提供额外修改的义务,因此,双方口头修改得到了对价的支持(Choice C)。

学习要点：

在合同纠纷中,(1) parol证据规则可以排除与书面合同相矛盾的证据,(2) 明示条件的不履行可以免除履行义务,(3) 防止欺诈法可以使未书面或未签字的合同无效,(4)原已存在的责任规则可能使合同因得不到对价而无法执行。

参考资料

重述(第二)第213条(1981年《美国法律》)(解释综合书面形式取代先前协议不一致的条款)。

重述(第二)第225条合同(1981年《阿姆法》)(解释不发生条件先例在条件允许时解除履行义务的义务)

stem:
A seller and a farmer formed a written, signed contract for the sale of a 500-acre tract of farmland. The contract provided for exchange of the deed for $500,000 in cash on January 15. On January 15, the seller notified the farmer that because the tenant currently residing on the farmland wrongfully refused to quit the premises, the seller could not deliver possession until January 30. On January 30, the farmer accepted the conveyance, paid the $500,000, and took possession of the farmland while reserving his rights to any damages caused by the seller's breach.

The farmer had purchased 500 head of cattle to be delivered to the farmland on January 15. Because he did not have possession of the farmland on that date, he had to rent another pasture for $2,000 to graze the cattle for 15 days. The seller had no reason to know the farmer purchased cattle or planned to graze them on the farmland. Throughout January, the farmland's market value was $510,000 and its fair monthly rental value was $5,000.
stemZh:
卖方和农民签订了一份出售500英亩农田的书面合同,合同规定在1月15日以50万美元现金交换地契。1月15日,卖方通知农民,由于目前居住在农田的租户错误地拒绝退房,卖方直到1月30日才能交付所有权。1月30日,该农民接受了运输工具,支付了50万美元,并占有农田,同时将他的权利保留给卖方违约造成的任何损害。

这名农民购买了500头牛,于1月15日送到农田,因为他当时没有农田,他不得不以2,000美元租用另一座牧场,在15天内放牧这些牛。卖方没有理由知道该农民购买牛或计划在农田上放牧,在整个1月份,农田的市场价值为51万美元,其公平月租金价值为5 000美元。
ask: In an action by the farmer against the seller for damages, what is the farmer is entitled to recover?
askZh: 在农民对卖方提出的损害赔偿诉讼中,农民有权追回什么?

options.en: $2,500 only (the fair rental value of the farmland for 15 days).
options.zh: 仅2 500美元(农田15天的公平租赁价值)。

options.en: $2,500 (the fair rental value of the farmland for 15 days), plus $2,000 (the cost of grazing the cattle elsewhere for 15 days).
options.zh: 2 500美元(农田15天的公平租赁价值)加上2 000美元(在其他地方放牧15天的费用)。

options.en: Nominal damages only, because the market value of the land exceeded the contract price.
options.zh: 名义损害只是因为土地的市场价值超过了合同价格。

options.en: Nothing, because by paying the purchase price on January 30, he waived whatever cause of action he may have had.
options.zh: 没有,因为通过1月30日支付购买价款,他放弃了任何可能的行动原因.

explanation.en:
Alternative bases for recovery when loss in value uncertain

Delayed use of property Fair rental value of property during period of delay OR

Interest on value of property made unproductive by breach Defective or unfinished construction

Diminution in market price of property caused by breach OR

Reasonable cost of completing performance or remedying defects A nonbreaching party's recovery is typically based on the loss in value to that party caused by the breach. But if the loss in value cannot be proved with reasonable certainty and there is a reasonable alternative to loss in value, the nonbreaching party may claim damages based on that alternative. For example, if a breach delays the use of property, the nonbreaching party may recover damages based on:

the fair rental value of the property during the period of the delay or interest on the value of the property that has been made unproductive by the breach. Here, the seller breached the land-sale contract by failing to deliver possession of the farmland on January 15 as agreed. On January 30, the farmer accepted the conveyance, paid the purchase price, and took possession of the farmland while reserving his right to sue for any damages caused by the seller's breach (Choice D). As a result, the farmer is entitled to recover $2,500—the fair rental value of the farmland for the 15-day period during which he was denied possession.

However, the farmer is not entitled to recover $2,000 for the cost of grazing the cattle elsewhere for 15 days. The reason is that consequential damages arising from the nonbreaching party's special circumstances are only recoverable if the breaching party (1) knew about the special circumstances or (2) could have reasonably foreseen the harm, in light of those circumstances, that would result from the breach. Here, the seller had no reason to know that the farmer had purchased cattle or planned to graze them on the farmland (Choice B).

(Choice C) The fact that the market value of the farmland ($510,000) exceeded the contract price ($500,000) does not limit the farmer's recovery to nominal damages only.

Educational objective:

If a breach delays the use of property, the nonbreaching party may recover damages based on (1) the fair rental value of the property during the delay period or (2) interest on the value of the property made unproductive by the breach.

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 348 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (alternatives to loss in value of performance).

explanation.zh:
价值损失不确定时的替代回收依据

延迟期间财产公允租赁价值

因违反合同而丧失生产性财产价值的利息未完成的施工

违反《公约》造成财产市场价格下降

履约完成或弥补缺陷的合理费用 受害方的追偿通常以违约给该方造成的价值损失为依据。但是,如果价值损失不能以合理的确定性加以证明,而且有合理的替代价值损失的办法,则未受影响方可以根据这一备选办法要求赔偿损失。例如,如果违反规定延误了财产的使用,则不违反合同的当事人可依据下列理由追索损害赔偿:

(a) 迟延期间财产的公允租赁价值或因违反合同而丧失生产性财产价值的利息。在此,卖方未能按照协议于1月15日交付对农田的占有,从而违反了土地销售合同。1月30日,该农民接受了运输,支付了购买价款,并占有农田,同时保留对卖方违约造成的任何损失提起诉讼的权利(Choice D)。因此,农民有权收回2,500美元,即他被拒绝占有的15天期间农田的公平租金价值。

然而,农民无权收回在别处放牧15天的费用2 000美元。理由是,只有在违约方(1)知道这些特殊情况或(2)根据这些情况可以合理地预见损害的情况下,由不受影响方的特殊情况引起的间接损害才可予赔偿,在此,卖方没有理由知道,该农民购买了牛或计划在农田上放牧(Choice B)。

(C) 农田的市场价值(510,000美元)超过了合同价格(500,000美元),这一事实并不限于农民的恢复,只是名义上的损失。

学习要点：

违约延误使用财产的,不违约方可以依据 (1) 逾期期间财产的公允租赁价值或者 (2) 因违约导致无生产性财产价值的利息,追偿损害赔偿.

参考资料

合同重述(第二)§348(1981年《美国法律》)(履约价值损失的替代办法)。

stem: A fugitive was wanted for murder. The authorities offered the following reward: "$20,000 to anyone who provides information leading to the arrest and conviction of this fugitive." A private detective knew of the reward, located the fugitive, and brought him to the authorities, who arrested him. The authorities then determined that although the fugitive had, in fact, committed the crime, he had been directed to do so by his boss. The authorities and the fugitive then agreed that in exchange for the fugitive's testimony against his boss, all charges against the fugitive would be dropped. The fugitive testified and was released. The authorities refused to pay the reward to the private detective on the ground that the fugitive was never convicted.
stemZh: 一个逃犯因谋杀而被通缉,当局给予以下奖励: "2万美元给任何提供导致逮捕和定罪逃犯的信息的人。" 一名私人侦探知道奖励,找到了逃犯,把他带到了警察局。当局随后认定,虽然逃犯事实上犯下了罪行,但他是被其老板指示这样做的。当局和逃犯随后同意,作为交换,逃犯对上司的证词,对逃犯的所有指控都将撤销,逃犯作证后被释放。当局拒绝向私人侦探支付赏金,理由是逃犯从未被定罪。
ask: Would the private detective be likely to prevail in a breach of contract action against the authorities?
askZh: 私人侦探是否会在针对当局的违反合同诉讼中获胜?

options.en: No, because the express conditions set out in the reward offer were not met.
options.zh: 不,因为没有满足奖励条件

options.en: No, because the private detective failed to notify the authorities that he had accepted the reward offer.
options.zh: 没有,因为私家侦探没有通知当局 他接受了赏金

options.en: Yes, because the authorities' agreement with the fugitive was against public policy.
options.zh: 是的,因为当局与逃犯的协议违反了公共政策。

options.en: Yes, because the authorities themselves prevented the conviction of the fugitive.
options.zh: 是的,因为当局本身阻止了对逃犯的定罪。

explanation.en:
When nonoccurrence of condition is excused

Waiver Party waives condition by words or conduct

Wrongful interference Party wrongfully prevents or interferes with condition's occurrence Estoppel Party indicates condition will not be enforced AND

Other party reasonably & detrimentally relies on belief that condition has been waived Disproportionate forfeiture

Party substantially performed & will be significantly harmed if condition is enforced

A party may generally avoid performance until a condition precedent—ie, an uncertain future event that must occur before either or both party's performance becomes due—has occurred. The nonoccurrence of a condition may be excused, however, if the party protected by the condition wrongfully prevents or interferes with its occurrence (eg, through a breach of the implied duty of good faith and fair dealing).

Here, the authorities' duty to pay the reward was subject to two conditions precedent—the arrest and conviction of the fugitive. The implied duty of good faith and fair dealing imposed a duty on the authorities to refrain from hindering either condition's occurrence. However, they breached that duty by agreeing to drop all charges against the fugitive despite their determination that he had committed the crime, thus excusing the express condition of conviction that was not met (Choice A). Therefore, the detective's suit will likely prevail.

(Choice B) In a unilateral contract, an offeree who accepts by completing the requested performance must give notice if he/she has reason to know that the completed performance will not come to the offeror's attention within a reasonable time. Here, there was no need for the detective to notify the authorities that he had accepted their reward offer because they learned of his performance when he brought the fugitive to them.

(Choice C) Whether the authorities' agreement with the fugitive was against public policy goes to the enforceability of the agreement between the fugitive and the authorities; it has no bearing on the outcome of this dispute.

Educational objective:

The nonoccurrence of a condition may be excused if the party protected by the condition wrongfully prevents or interferes with its occurrence (eg, through a breach of the implied duty of good faith and fair dealing).

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 224–25 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (conditions and effect of non-occurrence).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 245 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when a party's wrongful interference excuses a condition).

explanation.zh:
在不发生状况的情况下

放弃方通过言词或行为放弃条件

错误干预方 错误地防止或干预条件的发生 Estoppel 方 表示的条件将不予执行,

另一当事方合理和有害地依赖关于放弃附加条件的信念,不相称的没收

如果执行条件,缔约方将受到重大损害( M)

一当事方一般可以避免履约,直至出现条件先例,即必须在其中一方或双方履约到期之前发生的不确定的未来事件。但是,如果受该条件保护的当事人错误地防止或干预了该条件的发生(例如,通过违反善意和公平交易的默示义务),则不发生该条件可以免除。

在这方面,当局支付奖金的义务有两项先例——逮捕逃犯并将其定罪——隐含的诚信和公平交易义务使当局有义务避免妨碍这两个条件的发生。然而,他们违反了这项义务,同意撤销对逃犯的所有指控,尽管他们断定他犯下了罪行,从而免除了未满足的明确定罪条件(Choice A)。因此,侦探的官司很可能会胜诉.

(Choice B)在单方面合同中,如果被发价人有理由知道已完成的履行不会在合理时间内引起发价人的注意,则通过完成所要求的履行而接受的发价人必须发出通知.在此,侦探没有必要通知当局,他接受了他们的奖励,因为他们在将逃犯带给他们时得知了他的表现。

(C) 当局与逃犯的协议是否违反公共政策,取决于逃犯与当局之间协议的可执行性;这与这一纠纷的结果无关。

学习要点：

如果受该条件保护的当事人错误地防止或干预了该条件的发生(例如,通过违反默示的诚信和公平交易义务),则该条件的不发生可以免除。

参考资料

重述(第二)第245条(1981年《美国法律》)(当一方当事人的不当干预为条件辩护时)。

stem:
On May 1, a seller and a buyer entered into a written contract, signed by both parties, for the sale of a tract of land for $100,000. Delivery of the deed and payment of the purchase price were scheduled for July 1. On June 1, the buyer received a letter from the seller repudiating the contract. On June 5, the buyer bought a second tract of land at a higher price as a substitute for the first tract. On June 10, the seller communicated a retraction of the repudiation to the buyer.

The buyer did not tender the purchase price for the first tract on July 1 but subsequently sued the seller for breach of contract.
stemZh:
5月1日,一个卖方和一个买方签订了一份由双方签署的书面合同,以10万美元的价格出售一块土地,预定7月1日交付地契并支付购买价款。6月1日,买方收到卖方驳回合同的信件. 6月5日,买方以更高的价格购买了第二段土地,作为第一段的替代. 6月10日,卖方向买方转达了撤销合同的决定.

买方并未在7月1日提出第一段采购价款,但随后起诉卖方违约。
ask: Will the buyer likely prevail?
askZh: 买方可能胜诉吗?

options.en: No, because the buyer's tender of the purchase price on July 1 was a constructive condition to the seller's duty to tender a conveyance.
options.zh: 不,因为买方在7月1日提出购买价款是卖方提供运输工具义务的一个建设性条件。

options.en: No, because the seller retracted the repudiation prior to the agreed time for performance.
options.zh: 不,因为卖方在商定的履行时间之前撤回了休妻。

options.en: Yes, because the buyer bought the second tract as a substitute for the first tract prior to the seller's retraction.
options.zh: 是的,因为买方在卖方撤回合同之前购买了第二道作为第一道的替代品。

options.en: Yes, because the seller's repudiation was not retractable after it was communicated to the buyer.
options.zh: 是的,因为卖方的休妻在通知买方后是不可撤销的。

explanation.en:
A party's failure to perform his/her contractual duties at the time performance is due constitutes a breach. A breach can also occur before the time for performance is due under the doctrine of anticipatory repudiation. This doctrine applies when a party clearly and unequivocally repudiates (ie, indicates an unwillingness to perform) a promise. A repudiation can be retracted if the nonrepudiating party receives notice of the retraction before:

canceling the contract materially changing position in reliance on the repudiation or indicating that he/she considers the repudiation to be final (Choice D). But until the repudiation is retracted, the nonrepudiating party may (1) treat the repudiation as a breach or (2) ignore it and demand performance pursuant to the contract. The nonrepudiating party may also suspend its own performance if commercially reasonable.

Here, the seller anticipatorily repudiated the contract on June 1. The seller then attempted to retract the repudiation on June 10. However, the buyer had already materially changed position in reliance on the repudiation by purchasing a substitute tract of land on June 5

(Choice B). As a result, the seller's retraction was ineffective. And since the seller's unretracted repudiation is a breach of contract, the buyer is likely to prevail.

(Choice A) In a contract for real property, the tender of the purchase price and the conveyance of the deed generally must occur simultaneously. However, the seller's repudiation allowed the buyer to suspend payment.

Educational objective:

A party who anticipatorily repudiates a contract may retract the repudiation if the nonrepudiating party is notified of the retraction before (1) canceling the contract, (2) materially changing position in reliance on the repudiation, or (3) indicating that he/she considers the repudiation to be final.

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 253 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (effect of an anticipatory repudiation).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 256 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (retraction of repudiation).

explanation.zh:
一方当事人未能在应履行合同义务时履行合同义务即构成违约,也可在根据预告性休克原则应履行合同之前发生违约。当当事一方明确和毫不含糊地拒绝(即指明如果不予驳回的一方拒绝,可以撤销休妻。在下列情况下收到撤回通知:

以休妻为由取消合同,实质性地改变合同状况,或表明他/她认为休妻是最终的(Choice D)。但是,在撤销休妻之前,不休妻一方可以(1)将休妻视为违约,或者(2)不理会,要求按照合同履行合同,如果商业上合理,不休妻一方也可以中止自己的履行。

在此,卖方有意于6月1日宣布合同无效,卖方然后试图于6月10日撤销合同。但是,买方在6月5日购买了替代土地,从而在实质上改变了依赖休妻的立场。

因此,卖方撤回合同无效,而且由于卖方未撤销合同是违反合同,因此买方可能胜诉。

(选择A)在不动产合同中,购买价款的投标和地契的转让一般必须同时进行,但卖方的放弃允许买方暂停付款。

学习要点：

有意拒绝合同的一方当事人,如果在 (1) 解除合同之前通知未拒绝合同的当事人撤销合同,(2) 以放弃合同为由实质性改变立场,或(3) 表明他/她;认为休妻是终极的

参考资料

重述(第二次)合同第256条(1981年《普通法》)(休妻的重述)。

stem: A painter contracted with an apartment manager to paint three identical apartment units for $1,000 each. The contract provided for the manager's payment of $3,000 upon the painter's completion of the work on all three units. The painter did not ask for any payment when the first unit was completely painted, but she demanded $2,000 after painting the second unit. Assume that the manager rightfully refused the painter's demand for payment.
stemZh: 一名画家与一名公寓经理签约,将三个相同的公寓单元各画1 000美元,合同规定,在画家完成三个单元的工作后,经理要支付3 000美元。画家在第一单元完全画完后没有要求任何付款,但在画完第二单元后她要求2000美元,假设经理正确地拒绝了画家的付款要求.
ask: If the painter immediately terminates the contract without painting the third unit, what is the painter entitled to recover from the manager?
askZh: 如果画家当即终止合同而不给第三单位画画画,画家有权向经理讨回什么?

options.en: Nothing, because payment was expressly conditioned on completion of all three units.
options.zh: 没有,因为付款显然以三个单位的完工为条件。

options.en: The amount equal to the increase in the combined value of the two painted units resulting from the painter's work.
options.zh: 金额等于画家作品导致两个绘画单位综合价值的增加.

options.en: The painter's expenditures plus anticipated "profit" in painting the first two units, up to a maximum recovery of $2,000.
options.zh: 画家在绘画前两个单位时的支出加上预期的"利润",最高可回收2000美元.

options.en: The reasonable value of the painter's services in painting the two units, less the manager's damages, if any, for the painter's failure to paint the third unit.
options.zh: 画家在绘画两个单位时的服务的合理价值,减去经理人因画家未能绘画第三单位而可能造成的损失.

explanation.en:
Restitutionary damages

Definition Damages awarded to restore to claimant the value of whatever benefit was conferred upon recipient Purpose Prevent unjust enrichment

Measure Reasonable value of work performed or services rendered (ie, cost of recipient obtaining comparable performance) If applicable, extent to which recipient's property has increased in value or recipient's other interests have been advanced In the event of breach, the breaching party can recover restitutionary damages for the reasonable value of the work performed before the breach, less any damages suffered by the nonbreaching party. Restitutionary damages ensure that the nonbreaching party is not unjustly enriched by the work performed by the breaching party prior to the breach.

Here, the painter breached the contract by immediately terminating the contract after the apartment manager rightfully refused the painter's early payment demand. As the breaching party, the painter is entitled to the reasonable value of her services in painting the two units, less the manager's damages, if any, for her failure to paint the third unit (eg, the increased cost of another painter) (Choices A & B).

(Choice C) A nonbreaching party who has partially performed can generally recover for the costs of the work performed plus expectation damages (ie, anticipated profits). But here the painter is the breaching party and so is not entitled to recover this amount.

Educational objective:

The breaching party can recover restitutionary damages for the reasonable value of the work performed before the breach, less any damages suffered by the nonbreaching party.

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 371 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (measure of restitution interest).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 374 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (restitution in favor of breaching party).

explanation.zh:
恢复原状

赔偿给索赔人的赔偿金,以恢复给予索赔人的任何好处的价值防止不正当致富

计量已完成的工作或提供的服务的合理价值(即获得服务的费用)在适用的情况下,收款人的财产价值增加的程度在出现违约时,违约方可以按照违约前所完成的工作的合理价值,减去未违约方遭受的任何损害,收回赔偿损失。赔偿性损害赔偿确保不受影响方不因违约方在违约前所做的工作而不公正地增加。

在这里,画家违反了合同,在公寓经理正确地拒绝了画家的早期付款要求后,立即终止了合同.作为违约方,画家在为两个单位绘画时有权获得合理价值的服务,减去经理因未能为第三单位绘画而可能造成的损失(例如,另一个画家增加的费用)(Choices A & B)。

(Choice C) 部分完成的不受影响方一般可以收回已完成的工程成本加预期损失(即预期利润 ) 。 但在这里,画家是违约方,因此无权收回这一金额。

学习要点：

违约方可以按照违约前所完成的工作的合理价值,减去未违约方遭受的任何损失,收回赔偿损失。

stem:
A producer contracted to pay an inexperienced performer a specified salary to act in a small role in a play the producer was taking on a six-week road tour. The contract was for the duration of the tour.

On the third day of the tour, the performer was hospitalized with a stomach disorder. The producer replaced her in the cast with an experienced actor. One week later, the performer recovered, but the producer refused to allow her to resume her original role for the remainder of the tour.
stemZh:
一个制作人签约向经验不足的表演者支付特定工资,以在制作人正在从事的为期六周的公路巡演中扮演小角色。

巡演第三天,表演者因胃病住院,制片人以经验丰富的演员代替她在演艺圈.一周后,表演者康复,但制作人拒绝让她在余下巡演中恢复原有角色.
ask: In an action by the performer against the producer for breach of contract, which of the following, if proved, would be the producer's best defense?
askZh: 在表演者针对制片人违反合同的诉讼中,如果得到证明,以下哪一个才是制片人的最佳辩护?

options.en: Both the producer and the performer knew that a year earlier the performer had been incapacitated for a short period of time by the same kind of stomach disorder.
options.zh: 制片人和表演者都知道,一年前,表演者因同一种胃病而短期丧失了能力.

options.en: The actor, by general acclaim, was much better in the role than the performer had been.
options.zh: 演员一般赞誉,在角色上远胜于表演者.

options.en: The actor was the only replacement the producer could find, and the actor would accept nothing less than a contract for the remainder of the six-week tour.
options.zh: 演员是制片人唯一能找到的替补演员,演员会接受六周巡演剩余时间的不亚于合同.

options.en: The producer offered to employ the performer as the actor's understudy for the remainder of the six-week tour at the performer's original salary, but the performer declined.
options.zh: 制片人提出聘请表演者作为演员的副手,在6周巡演的余下时间按表演者的原工资支付,但表演者拒绝了.

explanation.en:
Ways to discharge contractual obligations

Full performance of contractual obligations Impossibility, impracticability, or frustration of purpose Release (in writing only) Mutual rescission Substituted contract Contract or covenant not to sue Accord & satisfaction Novation Mnemonic: FIRM SCAN

A party's duty to perform under a contract can be dismissed by impracticability. The defense of impracticability is available when:

an unanticipated or extraordinary event makes it impracticable for the party to perform the contract was formed under a basic assumption that the event would not occur and the party seeking discharge was not at fault. However, temporary impracticability merely suspends the party's duty to perform until the circumstances giving rise to the impracticability cease to exist—with one exception. If the delay makes performance materially more burdensome, the party's duty to perform is dismissed.

Here, the performer's illness suspended the producer's duty to employ the performer during the period that her illness prevented her from acting. The producer then replaced her with an experienced actor. If the actor was the only replacement the producer could find and would not take a contract for less than the remainder of the six-week tour, the producer's obligation to the performer would be dismissed. The reason is that it would be materially more burdensome for the producer to employ them both. Therefore, if proved, that is the producer's best defense.

(Choice A) If both the producer and the performer knew that a year earlier the performer had been incapacitated by the same kind of stomach disorder, the performer's illness would have been foreseeable. As a result, this fact would undermine the producer's impracticability defense.

(Choice B) The relative quality of the actor's performance is not a circumstance that would suspend or discharge the producer's contractual duty to the performer.

(Choice D) The producer's action in offering the performer a job as an understudy is irrelevant to the critical issue of whether the producer had the right to cancel the contract.

Educational objective:

A period of temporary impracticability suspends a party's duty to perform until the circumstances giving rise to the impracticability pass. But if the delay caused by the impracticability makes performance materially more burdensome, then the party's duty to perform is discharged.

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 261 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (discharge by supervening impracticability).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 269 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (temporary impracticability).

explanation.zh:
履行合同义务的方法

完全履行合同义务 可能、不可行或目的落空 释放(仅书面形式) 相互撤销替代合同或契约 不起诉协议和满足 Novation Mnemonic: FIRM SCAN

一方当事人根据合同履行的义务可能因不切实际而被解除。在下列情况下,可以提出不可行的辩护理由:

意外或非常事件使当事人履行合同不切实际,其基本假设是该事件不会发生,寻求解除合同的当事人没有过失。然而,暂时不可行只是中止了当事人的履行义务,直到导致不可行的情况不再存在为止——只有一个例外。逾期不履行的,从实质上加重执行负担的,撤销该党的履行义务.

在这里,表演者的病情中止了制作者在她病情阻碍她演艺期间雇佣表演者的职责,制作者随后用经验丰富的演员代替她.如果演员是制片人唯一能找到的替补演员,并且不会接受少于六周巡演剩余时间的合同,则制作人对表演者的义务将被解除.其原因是,生产厂商雇用两者将造成更大的负担。 因此,如果得到证明,这就是生产厂商的最佳辩护手段。

(Choice A) 如果制片人和表演者都知道一年前表演者因同类胃病而丧失能力,那么表演者的病情本来是可以预见的.因此,这个事实会破坏制片人的不实用性防御.

(Choice B) 演员表演的相对质量,不是暂停或解除制作人对表演者的合同义务的情况.

(Choice D) 制片人为表演者提供工作作为副业的行为与制片人是否有权取消合同这一关键问题无关.

学习要点：

临时不可行期中止当事人的履约义务,直至出现不可行证的情况。但是,如果由于不切实际而造成的拖延使履约工作在实质上更为繁琐,则该方的履约义务即告解除.

参考资料

重述(第二次)合同第261条(1981年第Am.Law Inst.)(因事后不可行而解除)。

重述(第二次)合同第269条(1981年《美国法律》)(暂时不可行)。

stem: A homeowner and a planner signed a detailed writing in which the planner, a landscape architect, agreed to landscape and replant the owner's residential property in accordance with a design prepared by the planner and incorporated in the writing. The owner agreed to pay $10,000 for the work upon its completion. At the owner's insistence, the written agreement contained a provision that neither party would be bound unless the owner's law partner, an avid student of landscaping, should approve the planner's design. Before the planner commenced the work, the owner's law partner, in the presence of both the owner and the planner, expressly disapproved the landscaping design. Nevertheless, the owner ordered the planner to proceed with the work, and the planner reluctantly did so. When the planner's performance was 40% complete, the owner repudiated his duty, if any, to pay the contract price or any part thereof.
stemZh: 房主和规划师签署详细书面文件,其中规划师,景观建筑师同意按照规划师编制并纳入书面内容的设计,进行地貌和重新种植业主的住宅财产.业主同意在工程完工后支付1万美元,在业主的坚持下,书面协议中包含一项规定,即除非业主的法律伙伴,景观美化的活跃学生,批准规划者的工程,否则任何一方都不受约束。在规划人开始工作之前,业主的法律合伙人在业主和规划人都在场的情况下,明确否定了景观设计。尽管如此,业主还是命令计划者继续施工,而计划者却不情愿地这样做了,当计划者的工作完成了40%时,如果有的话,业主放弃了支付合同价格或其中任何一部分的义务。
ask: If the planner now sues the owner for damages for breach of contract, which of the following concepts best supports the planner's claim?
askZh: 如果规划者现在起诉业主违约赔偿,那么以下哪些概念最能支持规划者的索赔?

options.en: Irrevocable waiver of condition.
options.zh: 无条件放弃条件。

options.en: Promissory estoppel.
options.zh: 正式禁止反悔。

options.en: Substantial performance.
options.zh: 表现不错

options.en: Unjust enrichment.
options.zh: 不正义的丰富。

explanation.en:
When nonoccurrence of condition is excused

Waiver Party waives condition by words or conduct

Wrongful interference Party wrongfully prevents or interferes with condition's occurrence Estoppel Party indicates condition will not be enforced AND

Other party reasonably & detrimentally relies on belief that condition has been waived Disproportionate forfeiture

Party substantially performed & will be significantly harmed if condition is enforced

A contracting party may generally avoid performance if a condition precedent—ie, an uncertain future event that must occur before either or both parties' performance becomes due—has not occurred. The nonoccurrence of a condition may be excused, however, if the party who benefits from the condition waives it by words or conduct. And the waiving party cannot retract the waiver if the other party has detrimentally relied on it.

Here, the agreement provided that it would be binding if the owner's law partner approved the planner's landscape design (condition precedent). The law partner disapproved the design (nonoccurrence), but the owner ordered the planner to proceed with the work anyway (waiver). And because the planner detrimentally relied on that waiver by completing 40% of the work, the owner could not retract it (ie, the waiver was irrevocable). Therefore, the concept of irrevocable waiver of condition best supports the planner's breach-of-contract claim.

(Choice B) Under the doctrine of promissory estoppel, a party can enforce a promise on which it reasonably and detrimentally relied when no valid contract was formed. But because a contract was formed here, this doctrine does not apply.

(Choice C) The planner did not substantially perform under the contract since his performance was only 40% complete.

(Choice D) The doctrine of unjust enrichment applies in the absence of a valid contract to prevent one party from receiving a benefit from another that was not rightfully earned and would be unfair to keep.

Educational objective:

Nonoccurrence of a condition precedent may be excused if the party who benefits from the condition waives it by words or conduct. The waiving party cannot retract the waiver if the other party has detrimentally relied on it.

explanation.zh:
在不发生状况的情况下

放弃方通过言词或行为放弃条件

错误干预方 错误地防止或干预条件的发生 Estoppel 方 表示的条件将不予执行,

另一当事方合理和有害地依赖关于放弃附加条件的信念,不相称的没收

如果执行条件,缔约方将受到重大损害( M)

如果一个条件性先例——即在任何一方或双方的履约义务到期之前必须发生的不确定的未来事件——没有发生,缔约方一般可以避免履约。但是,如果从该条件中受益的一方通过言词或行为放弃该条件,则可以免除不实行该条件。 如果另一方不利地依赖该条件,则放弃方不能撤回放弃。

在此,协议规定,如果业主的法律合伙人批准规划师的景观设计(条件先例),协议将具有约束力.法律合伙人不赞成设计(未成功),但业主命令规划者无论如何继续施工(放弃).由于规划者通过完成40%的工程来有害地依赖放弃,因此业主无法收回放弃(即放弃不可撤销 ) 。 因此,不可撤销放弃条件的概念最好支持规划者违反合同的要求。

(Choice B)根据本意不容反悔的理论,当事一方可以在没有订立有效合同时执行它合理和有害地依赖的许诺,但由于在此订立了合同,这一理论不适用。

(C) 规划员没有按照合同实质性地履行合同,因为他的履约工作仅完成了40%。

(Choice D)在缺乏有效合同的情况下适用不公正致富的理论,以防止一方当事人从另一方获得非正当所得的利益,而这种利益是不公平的。

学习要点：

如果从该条件中受益的一方通过言词或行为放弃该条件,则不出现该条件的先例可以免除,如果另一方对放弃的依赖不利,则放弃方不能撤回放弃。

stem: A buyer and a seller entered into a contract for the sale of 10,000 novelty bracelets. The seller had the bracelets in stock. The contract specified that the seller would ship the bracelets by a third-party carrier. However, the contract did not specify either who was to pay the costs of carriage or the place of tender for the bracelets.
stemZh: 买方和卖方订立了销售10,000个新手镯的合同,卖方持有手镯,合同规定卖方由第三方承运人运送手镯。然而,合同没有规定由谁支付运输费用或手镯的投标地点。
ask: On the above facts, when would the risk of loss of the bracelets pass to the buyer?
askZh: 关于上述事实,手镯丢失的风险何时会转移给买方?

options.en: When the bracelets were delivered to a carrier and a proper contract for their carriage was made.
options.zh: 当手镯交付给承运人并订立适当的运输合同时。

options.en: When the bracelets were identified to the contract by the seller, assuming that the goods conformed to the contract.
options.zh: 当卖方在合同中指明手镯时,假定货物符合合同规定。

options.en: When the bracelets were unloaded on the buyer's premises by the carrier.
options.zh: 当手镯被承运人卸在买方的房地时。

options.en: When the contract was made.
options.zh: 约时.

explanation.en:
Risk of loss in the absence of breach

(UCC § 2-509)

General rule If seller is merchant, risk of loss passes to buyer when buyer takes physical possession of goods If not, risk of loss passes to buyer when goods are delivered Goods to be shipped by carrier

Shipment contract (presumed) – risk of loss passes to buyer when goods are given to carrier & proper contract for shipment is made Destination contract – risk of loss passes to buyer when goods are delivered at place specified in contract Goods to be held by bailee

Risk of loss passes to buyer when: buyer receives negotiable document of title covering goods (eg, warehouse receipt) or bailee (eg, warehouseman) acknowledges buyer's right to possess goods UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

Contracts for the sale of goods (eg, novelty bracelets—as seen here) are governed by Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC). Under the UCC, the risk of loss generally passes to the buyer when the buyer receives the goods. But if the contract requires the seller to deliver the goods through a third-party carrier, the risk of loss passes to the buyer at different times depending on whether the contract is a:

shipment contract* – a contract that does not require delivery at a particular location, in which case the risk of loss passes to the buyer when goods are delivered to the carrier and a proper contract for their shipment is made or destination contract – a contract that requires delivery at a particular location, in which case the risk of loss passes to the buyer when goods are delivered at the place specified in the contract Here, the contract between the buyer and the seller specified that the seller would ship the goods by a third-party carrier but did not specify the place of tender (ie, delivery) for the bracelets. As a result, it is a shipment contract, and the risk of loss would pass to the buyer when the bracelets were delivered to a third-party carrier and a proper contract for their carriage (ie, shipment) was made (Choices B, C & D).

*The UCC presumes that a contract is a shipment contract unless it contains a "free on board" term or other term explicitly allocating the risk of loss. Merely indicating a shipping address does not make a contract a destination contract.

Educational objective:

A contract that requires the seller to deliver the goods by third-party carrier but does not specify a delivery location is a shipment contract. Under such a contract, the risk of loss shifts to the buyer when the seller delivers the goods to the carrier and makes a proper contract for their shipment.

References

U.C.C. § 2-509 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (risk of loss in the absence of breach).
