stem: A woman and her partner robbed a bank. Although they split the money they had stolen in half, the woman became greedy and decided to steal the partner's share. The woman knew that the partner had stashed his share of the money in a house that had been abandoned for some time. She decided to sneak into the house at night and steal the money. That night, the woman went to the back door of the house, and when she tried the doorknob, she discovered that it was unlocked. She snuck into the house, walked around until she found the partner's money in one of the rooms, and took it. A neighbor heard the woman rummaging in the house and immediately called the police. The police tracked the woman down and arrested her for burglary.
stemZh: 一个女人和她的伴侣抢劫了一家银行,虽然他们把偷来的钱分了一半,但是这个女人变得贪婪,决定偷拍拍的股份.女方知道伴侣将自己那份钱藏在被弃置了一段时间的房子里,她决定晚上潜入房子偷钱.当晚,女方走到后门,试探门把手时发现门把手是解锁的,她偷偷溜进屋里,走来走去,直到在一间房里找到伴侣的钱,然后拿走.一个邻居听到这个女人在屋里翻来翻去,立刻报警,警察追到那个女人,以入室盗窃罪逮捕她.
ask: In a jurisdiction that follows the common law with respect to criminal offenses, is the woman guilty of burglary?
askZh: 在依照普通法处理刑事犯罪的管辖区,妇女是否犯有盗窃罪?

options.en: No, because the back door to the house was unlocked.
options.zh: 不,因为房子的后门是解锁的

options.en: No, because the house was abandoned.
options.zh: 不 因为房子被废弃了

options.en: Yes, because the woman intended to permanently deprive the partner of the money.
options.zh: 是的,因为那个女人想永远剥夺伴侣的钱

options.en: Yes, because the woman used force to enter the house.
options.zh: 是的,因为女人用武力进入房子。

explanation.en:
Common-law burglary is the unlawful breaking and entering of another's dwelling at night with the specific intent to commit a felony therein. A dwelling is defined as a structure regularly occupied for habitation. Although the structure need not be occupied at the time of the breaking, it must not be abandoned. That is because common-law burglary seeks only to protect a person's right of habitation.

Here, the woman broke into the house at night with the specific intent to steal the partner's money (ie, to commit larceny) (Choice C). However, the house was abandoned when she broke in. As a result, the house does not constitute a dwelling for purposes of a common-law burglary, and the woman is not guilty of this crime.

(Choices A & D) A breaking can be accomplished by using even slight force, such as opening an unlocked door (as seen here). However, walking through an already open door would not constitute a breaking.

Educational objective:

For common-law burglary, a dwelling is defined as a structure regularly occupied for habitation. Although the structure need not be occupied at the time of the breaking, it must not be abandoned.

References

Wayne R. LaFave, 3 Substantive Criminal Law § 21.1(c) (3d ed. 2020) (defining "dwelling of another").

explanation.zh:
普通法中的入室盗窃是指在夜间非法闯入和进入另一人的住宅,其具体意图是在该住宅内犯下重罪,住房被定义为经常居住的结构。尽管在断裂时不需要有人占用建筑物,但也不能放弃,这是因为普通法盗窃只是为了保护一个人的居住权。

在这里,这名妇女在晚上闯进房子,其具体意图是偷走伴侣的钱(即偷盗)(Choice C),然而,房子在她闯进来时被废弃了.因此,出于普通法盗窃的目的,该房屋不构成住所,而该妇女则不构成犯罪。

(Choices A & D) 突破可以通过使用甚至轻微的强制来实现,比如打开一个解锁的门(如这里所见). 然而,穿过一个已经打开的门不会构成突破.

学习要点：

对于普通法中的入室盗窃,住宅被定义为经常居住的结构,虽然在拆房时不需要居住,但不得放弃。

参考资料

Wayne R. LaFave, 3 《实质性刑法》第21.1(c)节(3d ed.2020)(定义“居住他人”)。

stem:
A man who had become very drunk left a bar and started to walk home. Another patron of the bar, who had observed the man's condition, followed him. The patron saw the man stumble and fall to the ground near an alley. The patron then began to pull out a gun but saw that the man had passed out in the gutter. The patron reached into the man's pocket, grabbed his wallet, and started to walk away. When the patron heard police officers approaching, he dropped the wallet and ran off.

The crimes below are listed in descending order of seriousness.
stemZh:
酒醉成瘾的男子离开酒吧开始步行回家,酒吧的另一位赞助人,曾观察过男子的病情,跟着他,赞助人看见男子在一条小巷附近跌倒在地.赞助商随后开始拔枪,但看到男子在水沟里昏倒,赞助商伸进男子的口袋里,抢走钱包,开始走开,当赞助商听到警察靠近时,他把钱包放下,跑了.

以下罪行按严重程度依次排列。
ask: What is the most serious crime of which the patron properly could be convicted?
askZh: 何为最严重罪行,可以适当地判定赞助人有罪?

options.en: Robbery.
options.zh: 抢劫

options.en: Larceny.
options.zh: 淫业.

options.en: Attempted robbery.
options.zh: 抢劫未遂.

options.en: Attempted larceny.
options.zh: 企图盗窃.

explanation.en:
A defendant can be convicted of larceny if he/she:

unlawfully took and carried away the victim's property (even a short distance) with the intent to permanently deprive the victim of that property (ie, intent to steal). And the defendant can be convicted of the more serious crime of robbery if the property was taken from the victim's person or presence by force or intimidation. But if these (or any other) crimes are not completed, the defendant can be convicted of the less serious crime of attempt if he/she:

specifically intended to commit the crime and performed an act in furtherance of the crime. Here, the elements of larceny were met when the patron intentionally took a wallet from the man's pocket and started to walk away. And though the patron later dropped the wallet when he heard the police approaching, this is no defense. Therefore, the patron can be convicted of larceny—not attempted larceny (Choice D).

The patron likely intended to commit robbery when he followed the man and pulled out a gun in furtherance of the crime. But since the man then passed out in the gutter, the patron was able to take the wallet without using force or intimidation. As a result, the patron could be convicted of attempted robbery—but not a completed robbery (Choice A). Nevertheless, larceny is the most serious crime of which the patron could be convicted (Choice C).

Educational objective:

Larceny evolves into the more serious crime of robbery when the defendant takes property from the victim's person or presence by force or intimidation. But if an element of those (or any other) crimes is not completed, a defendant may be convicted of a less serious attempted crime.

explanation.zh:
被告人有下列情形之一的,可以以盗窃罪定罪: 1.

为了永久剥夺受害人的财产(即盗窃意图),非法抢走和夺走受害人的财产(甚至短距离)。如果财产是用武力或恐吓手段从受害人身上夺走或在场,被告可被判犯有更严重的抢劫罪。但是,如果这些(或任何其他)罪行没有完成,被告可以被判犯有未遂罪,如果:

(b) 专门意图实施犯罪并为促进犯罪而采取行动。在这里,盗窃的元素被满足 当赞助人故意从他的钱包口袋开始离开。虽然赞助商后来听到警察的到来就放下了钱包,但这不是什么辩护。 因此,赞助商可能被判犯有盗窃罪,而不是企图盗窃罪(Choice D)。

这名嫖客在跟踪他时可能打算抢劫,并拔出枪来推进犯罪。 但自从他随后昏倒在水沟里之后,嫖客得以在不使用武力或恐吓的情况下拿走钱包。因此,资助人可能被判犯有抢劫未遂罪,但不是完成抢劫罪(Choice A)。 尽管如此,盗窃是资助人可能被定罪的最严重罪行(Coice C)。

学习要点：

当被告通过武力或恐吓手段从受害人身上夺取财产或在场时,盗窃就演变为更为严重的抢劫罪。但是,如果这些(或任何其他)犯罪的要素尚未完成,被告可能被判犯有较轻的未遂罪行。

stem: A new gang member, hoping to impress the gang's leader, pointed a gun at a pedestrian and ordered her to give him her expensive watch, which she did. The gang member then tossed the watch to the gang leader, who was standing nearby. Although totally surprised by this act, the gang leader put the watch in his pocket. The pedestrian ran away.
stemZh: 一位新的帮派成员希望给帮派领导人留下深刻印象,用枪指着一个行人,命令她把昂贵的手表送给他,她做到了,该帮派成员随后将手表扔给了站在附近的帮派领导人.虽然对这个举动完全感到惊讶,但黑帮头目却把手表放在口袋里,行人跑了.
ask: What crime did the gang leader commit?
askZh: 帮派头目犯了什么罪?

options.en: Accessory after the fact to robbery.
options.zh: 劫后从犯.

options.en: Accomplice to robbery.
options.zh: 与劫相随.

options.en: Conspiracy to commit robbery.
options.zh: 密谋行劫.

options.en: Receiving stolen property.
options.zh: 接收被盗财产。

explanation.en:
The crime of receiving stolen property is committed when a person:

receives property that he/she knows was stolen with the intent to permanently deprive another of that property. Here, the gang leader knew that the watch was stolen since he witnessed the robbery—ie, the gang member's theft of the woman's watch through force or intimidation. The gang member then tossed the watch to the gang leader, who pocketed it—evidencing his intent to permanently deprive the woman of the watch. Therefore, the gang leader committed the crime of receiving stolen property.

(Choice A) An accessory after the fact is a person who aids or assists another (ie, the principal) by helping the principal avoid apprehension or conviction after the crime has been completed. Here, the gang leader did not play this role since his concealment of the watch did not help the gang member in such a manner.

(Choice B) An accomplice (1) knowingly aids or encourages the principal before or during a crime (2) with the intent that the crime be completed. Here, the gang leader was not an accomplice since the gang member acted of his own accord (ie, without aid or encouragement) to impress the gang leader.

(Choice C) Conspiracy is an agreement between two or more people to commit a crime that is entered with the intent to accomplish that crime. Since the gang leader was totally surprised by the gang member's act, they did not agree to commit the robbery.

Educational objective:

The crime of receiving stolen property is committed when a person (1) receives property that he/she knows was stolen (2) with the intent to permanently deprive another of that property.

explanation.zh:
接受被盗财产的犯罪,是指:

收受他(她)知道被盗的财产,意图永久剥夺他人的财产。在此,帮派头目知道,手表是自他目睹抢劫、帮派成员通过武力或恐吓盗窃妇女手表以来被偷走的。黑帮成员然后将手表扔给了黑帮头目,黑帮头目将手表袋藏起来——证明他打算永久剥夺这个女人的手表。 因此,黑帮头目犯了接收被盗财产的罪行。

(选择A) 事后的从犯是帮助或协助他人(即主犯),帮助主犯在犯罪结束后避免被捕或定罪的人。在这里,黑帮头目没有扮演这个角色,因为他隐藏的手表并没有以这种方式帮助黑帮成员.

(选择B) 共犯(1) 在犯罪之前或犯罪期间故意协助或鼓励主犯(2) 意图完成犯罪。在这里,黑帮头目不是同谋,因为黑帮成员是自愿(即没有援助或鼓励)给黑帮头目留下深刻印象的.

(Choice C)阴谋是两个或两个以上人之间为了完成这一犯罪而达成的一项犯罪协议,由于团伙头目对团伙成员的行为完全惊讶,他们不同意实施抢劫.

学习要点：

接受被盗财产罪是指一个人(1)接收他(她)知道被盗的财产(2),意图永久剥夺另一人的财产。

stem:
Hoping to give his wife an advantage in a national figure skating competition, a man shot one of the wife's competitors in the leg. The man only intended to wound the figure skater enough to deprive her of the use of her leg for a few months, but the bullet struck a major artery and the figure skater bled to death.

The crimes below are listed from most to least serious.
stemZh:
为了让妻子在全国花样滑冰比赛中获得优势,一名男子在腿上射杀了妻子的竞争对手之一.男子只打算将花样滑冰运动员伤得足够大,使她的腿无法使用数月,但子弹击中了大动脉,花样滑冰运动员流血致死.

以下罪行从最重到最低。
ask: In a common law jurisdiction, what is the most serious crime of which the man could properly be convicted?
askZh: 在英美法系管辖权中,男子可被适当定罪的最严重罪行是什么?

options.en: Murder.
options.zh: 谋杀

options.en: Voluntary manslaughter.
options.zh: 故意杀人

options.en: Involuntary manslaughter.
options.zh: 非自愿杀人

options.en: None of the above.
options.zh: 以上皆无.

explanation.en:
Homicide

Murder Common law Modern approach

Unlawful killing committed with malice aforethought:

Intent to kill Intent to cause serious bodily harm Depraved-heart murder Felony murder

First-degree: murder committed with:

premeditation & deliberation heinous acts (eg, bombing, torture) enumerated felony murder Second-degree: any murder that is not first-degree murder

Voluntary manslaughter

Intentional killing mitigated by either:

adequate provocation (ie, heat of passion) other mitigating factors (eg, imperfect self-defense) Involuntary manslaughter

Unintentional killing either:

caused by criminal negligence (or recklessness under MPC) occurs during commission of criminal act (eg, misdemeanor manslaughter) MPC = Model Penal Code.

Common law murder occurs when a person unlawfully kills another with malice aforethought, which requires proof of one of the following mental states:

Intent to kill

Intent to inflict serious bodily injury

Reckless disregard of an obvious or unjustifiably high risk of causing death or serious bodily injury (ie, depraved-heart murder)

Intent to commit an inherently dangerous felony (ie, felony-murder rule)

Here, the figure skater bled to death after the man shot her. Although the man did not intend to kill the figure skater, he did intend to wound her badly enough to deprive her of the use of her leg for a few months (serious bodily injury). Therefore, the man acted with the malice aforethought necessary to support a conviction for the most serious offense— murder (Choice D).

(Choice B) Voluntary manslaughter occurs when a person intentionally kills another based on (1) adequate provocation or (2) imperfect self-defense. Since the man was not provoked or acting in self-defense, he did not commit voluntary manslaughter.

(Choice C) Involuntary manslaughter is the unintentional killing of another with criminal negligence OR during the commission of an unlawful act separate from the killing itself. Here, the man cannot be convicted of involuntary manslaughter since the unlawful shooting was a part of the killing and was committed with malice aforethought (intent to seriously injure).

Educational objective:

A person who did not intentionally kill another may still be guilty of common law murder if he/she acted with (1) the intent to cause serious physical injury, (2) a reckless disregard of an obvious or high risk to human life, or (3) the intent to commit an inherently dangerous felony.

explanation.zh:
凶杀案

普通法

怀着恶意的预谋进行非法杀戮:

意图杀害意图造成严重身体伤害 堕落的心脏谋杀 重罪谋杀

一级谋杀:

预谋和审议令人发指的行为(如爆炸、酷刑)列举了二级重罪谋杀:任何不是一级谋杀的谋杀

故意杀人

减轻故意杀人行为:

适当的挑衅(即激情的热量) 其他减轻因素(如不完善的自卫)

非故意杀人者:

犯罪过失(或《刑法》规定的轻率行为)发生在犯罪行为(如轻罪过失杀人)期间。

普通法中的谋杀发生在一个人怀着恶意的预谋非法杀害另一个人时,这需要证明下列精神状态之一:

故意杀人

意图造成严重身体伤害

毫不留情地无视造成死亡或重伤的明显或无正当理由的高风险(即堕落-心脏谋杀)

意图实施固有的危险重罪(即重罪谋杀规则)

这名花样滑冰运动员在开枪打死她后流血身亡。 尽管该男子并不打算杀死花样滑冰运动员,但他确实打算把她的腿严重伤到几个月(严重身体伤害),从而剥夺了她的腿。因此,此人是怀有恶意的,这是支持对最严重的罪行——谋杀(Choice D)定罪所必需的。

(B项选择) 自愿过失杀人是指一个人根据(1) 适当的挑衅或(2) 不完整的自卫故意杀害另一人,由于此人不是被挑衅或自卫行为,所以他不是自愿过失杀人。

(C类)非自愿过失杀人是指在犯罪过失或实施与杀人本身分开的非法行为期间无意杀害他人的行为。在此,不能判定此人犯有非自愿过失杀人罪,因为非法射击是杀人的一部分,而且是怀有恶意的预谋(意图造成严重伤害)。

学习要点：

未故意杀害他人的人,如果有下列行为,仍可能犯有普通法谋杀罪:(1) 故意造成严重身体伤害,(2) 轻率地无视对人的生命的明显或高度危险,或(3) 意图犯下固有的罪行。危险重罪。

stem:
A brother knew that his sister was suffering from an advanced form of bone cancer and had approximately six months to live. The brother also knew that his sister was considering ending her life if her condition became unbearable. The brother decided to hasten his sister's death with a slow-acting poison so he could collect as the beneficiary of her life insurance policy. The poison caused the sister such severe nausea that she skipped her next scheduled chemotherapy appointment. The bus that the sister usually took to attend chemotherapy crashed that day, leaving no survivors.

Three days later, the sister was in unbearable pain from the poison. Believing that the pain was caused by her progressing cancer, the sister decided to end her own life with an overdose of pain medication. An autopsy conclusively established that the sister had enough poison in her system to cause intense pain but that the poison would not have killed her for another week. The coroner determined that the overdose had been the actual cause of her death. The coroner also predicted that the sister's bone cancer would have caused her death within the year.

The applicable jurisdiction does not classify suicide as a crime.
stemZh:
一个哥哥知道妹妹患有一种高级的骨癌,有大约6个月的时间可以活下来,他哥哥也知道,如果她的病情变得无法忍受,他姐姐正在考虑结束她的生命.他的兄弟决定用慢效的毒药加速他妹妹的死亡,这样他就可以将她作为寿险的受益人收集起来,毒药导致妹妹如此严重的恶心,以至于她跳过了下一次预定的化疗预约.姐姐通常为了参加化疗而搭乘的大巴当天坠毁,没有生还者.

三天后,她妹妹因中毒而承受了无法忍受的痛苦,她相信疼痛是她逐渐的癌症造成的,于是决定用过量的止痛药结束自己的生命.验尸结果证实,她姐姐体内的毒药足以引起剧烈疼痛,但毒药不会让她再死一个星期,验尸官确定,过量服用是她死亡的实际原因.验尸官还预测姐姐的骨癌本会在一年内导致她的死亡.

适用管辖权不将自杀列为犯罪。
ask: Can the brother properly be found guilty of common-law murder based on these facts?
askZh: 能否根据这些事实判定该兄弟犯有普通法谋杀罪?

options.en: No, because the brother's conduct actually extended the sister's life.
options.zh: 不,因为兄弟的行为实际上延长了妹妹的生命.

options.en: No, because the pain medication was the actual cause of the sister's death.
options.zh: 不,因为止痛药是 姐姐死亡的真正原因。

options.en: Yes, because a trier of fact could find that the brother's conduct was the actual and proximate cause of the sister's death.
options.zh: 是的,因为事实调查者可以发现兄弟的行为是姐姐死亡的实际和近因.

options.en: Yes, because an act that accelerates impending death is a legal cause of that death.
options.zh: 是的,因为加速即将死亡的行为是造成死亡的合法原因。

explanation.en:
Criminal homicide occurs when a person causes the death of another person while acting with the requisite mens rea—e.g., common-law murder (the most serious type of homicide) requires an intent to kill or other malice aforethought. Causation requires proof of both:

actual causation – (1) the victim would not have died but for the defendant's conduct or (2) when multiple causes exist, the defendant's conduct was a substantial factor in causing the victim's death and proximate causation – the death was a foreseeable consequence of the defendant's actions. Here, the sister died by an intentional overdose of pain medication (Choice B). But her brother had previously poisoned her to collect as the beneficiary of her life insurance policy (intent to kill). The poison was a substantial factor in her death because it caused her unbearable pain that made her decide to end her life (actual causation), and it was foreseeable that the poison would kill her (proximate cause). And since a trier of fact could find that the brother actually and proximately caused the sister's death, he can properly be found guilty of common-law murder.

(Choice A) The brother's conduct actually extended the sister's life since the poison caused her such severe nausea that she skipped her next scheduled chemotherapy appointment and avoided the fatal bus crash. But he can still be found guilty of common-law murder since his conduct actually and proximately caused her death.

(Choice D) An act that accelerates impending death is a proximate (i.e., legal) cause of that death only if the death was a foreseeable consequence of the defendant's actions. However, actual causation must also be established for the brother to be found guilty of common-law murder.

Educational objective:

Criminal homicide occurs when a person causes another's death with the requisite mens rea. Causation must be actual ("but for" or substantial factor) and proximate (foreseeable consequence).

explanation.zh:
犯罪杀人是指一个人在使用必要的犯罪意图(例如,普通法谋杀(最严重的杀人类型))时造成另一人死亡,这需要意图杀人或其他恶意的预谋。

实际因果关系—— (1) 受害人如果没有被告的行为就不会死亡,或者(2) 当存在多种原因时,被告的行为是造成受害人死亡的实质性因素,也是近因—— 死亡是可预见的后果。她的姐姐是故意服用过量止痛药(Choice B)而死亡的,但她的兄弟以前曾给她下毒,以作为她人寿保险的受益人(意图杀人)。毒药是她死亡的一个重大因素,因为它造成了她难以忍受的痛苦,导致她决定结束生命(实际因果关系),而且可以预见毒药会杀死她(近因)。而由于事实三者可以发现,他哥哥实际上和近似地造成了姐姐的死亡,因此他可以被正确地认定为普通法谋杀罪.

(Choice A) 哥哥的行为实际上延长了姐姐的生命,因为毒药导致她如此严重的恶心,以至于她跳过了下一次预定的化疗预约,避免了致命的公交车撞车.但是他仍然可以被判犯有普通法谋杀罪,因为他的行为实际上和近距离导致了她的死亡.

(Choice D)加速即将死亡的行为,只有在死亡是被告行为的可预见后果时,才构成该死亡的近亲(即法律)原因.然而,还必须确定该兄弟犯有普通法谋杀罪的实际因果关系。

学习要点：

犯罪杀人发生在一个人用必要的犯罪意图造成他人死亡时,因果关系必须是实际的(但)或实质性因素(可预见后果)。

stem: A man intended to rob a local convenience store that was rumored to contain a large safe. One night, the man walked into the convenience store, pointed a gun at the store owner, and demanded to know where the safe was kept. Frightened, the store owner pointed to a storage room located at the back of the store and approximately 20 feet from where the man and the store owner were standing. The man then moved the store owner to the storage room and forced him to open the safe. The man fled after taking the money in the safe, and the store owner immediately called the police. The man was later arrested and charged with robbery and kidnapping.
stemZh: 一名男子打算抢劫当地一家被传闻装有大保险箱的便利店,一天晚上,男子走进便利店,用枪指着店主,要求知道保险箱藏在哪里.惊慌失措,店主指向位于店后,距离店主和店主站立位置约20英尺处的一间储藏室,这名店主随后将店主搬到储藏室,强迫他打开保险箱.该男子在保险箱里拿钱后逃走,店主立即报警,此人后来被捕并被控抢劫和绑架.
ask: Can the man be properly convicted of kidnapping?
askZh: 此人能否因绑架罪被适当定罪?

options.en: No, because the man did not move the store owner more than was necessary to complete the robbery.
options.zh: 不,因为他没有移动 店主超过完成抢劫的必要。

options.en: No, because the storage room was only 20 feet away from the store owner.
options.zh: 不 因为储藏室离店主只有20英尺远

options.en: Yes, because the man unlawfully moved the store owner into the storage room during the commission of the robbery.
options.zh: 是的,因为这个人在抢劫期间 非法把店主搬进储藏室

options.en: Yes, because the man's conduct amounted to confinement of the store owner.
options.zh: 是的,因为他的行为 相当于禁止商店老板。

explanation.en:
Kidnapping

Common law

Forcibly abducting or stealing person from his/her own country & sending to another country

MPC Unlawfully moving or confining another to:

hold for ransom or as hostage facilitate commission of felony or flight thereafter injure/terrorize victim or another or interfere with governmental/political function Modern view

General Intentional & unlawful confinement involving:

some movement (asportation) or concealment Aggravated General kidnapping committed for:

ransom commission of other crime offensive purpose or child stealing MPC = Model Penal Code.

Kidnapping is:

the intentional and unlawful confinement of another against that person's will (eg, by force, threat, or fraud) coupled with either moving or hiding that person. A perpetrator need only move the victim a short distance—even a few feet—to satisfy the movement (ie, asportation) element of kidnapping (Choice B). However, for a kidnapping to occur incident to the commission of another offense, the movement of the victim must be more than is necessary to complete the other offense.* Otherwise, the perpetrator cannot be convicted of kidnapping.

Here, the man entered the store intending to commit robbery. The man then pointed a gun at the store owner (force) and moved him into the storage room (confinement) so that the store owner could open the safe. But since the movement of the store owner was no more than was necessary to complete the robbery, the man cannot be properly convicted of kidnapping (Choices C & D).

*Courts will consider several factors, including (1) the duration and significance of the movement, (2) whether the movement was an inherent part or independent of the other offense, and (3) whether the movement made the other offense easier to commit.

Educational objective:

For a kidnapping to occur incident to the commission of another offense, the victim must be moved more than is necessary to complete the other offense.

explanation.zh:
绑架

普通法

强行绑架或从其本国窃取人员并送往另一国

MPC 非法移动或限制他人:

为赎金或作为人质协助犯下重罪或逃跑,然后伤害/恐吓受害者或其他人或干涉政府/政治职能

一般故意和非法监禁,涉及:

为下列目的实施的某些行动(递解)或掩盖严重绑架:

其他犯罪犯罪目的或儿童盗窃罪=示范刑法。

绑架是:

(a) 违背他人意愿,蓄意非法监禁他人(例如通过武力、威胁或欺诈),同时转移或藏匿该人。行为人只需将受害人移动一段短距离——甚至几英尺——即可满足绑架(Choice B)的移动(即转移)因素。然而,如果绑架事件发生在另一罪行的实施上,则受害人的移动必须超过完成其他罪行的必要程度。 * 否则,犯罪者不能被判定犯有绑架罪。

在这里,这名男子进入商店准备抢劫,然后用枪指着店主(部队),将他搬进储藏室(封闭),以便店主打开保险箱。但由于店主的移动仅是完成抢劫所必需的,因此此人不能被适当判定绑架罪(Choices C & D).

* 法院将考虑若干因素,包括:(1) 运动的持续时间和意义,(2) 运动是固有的一部分还是独立于其他罪行,以及(3) 运动是否使其他罪行更容易实施。

学习要点：

绑架事件如要实施另一罪行,必须更多地转移受害人,以完成其他罪行。

stem: A man owned an investment portfolio that, for the past several years, had consistently outperformed the stock market average. When the overall stock market precipitously declined in a single day, the man immediately contacted his financial advisor to ask about the status of his investment portfolio. The advisor lied to the man and told him that due to the decline in the stock market, the value of his account was $250,000, an amount significantly less than what the man had anticipated. However, the decreased value was not attributable to the decline in the stock market but rather the advisor's negligence in managing the portfolio. The man demanded that his account be closed and that the remaining balance in the account be transferred to him within the next two days. The advisor agreed and, accordingly, closed the man's account and transferred the remaining balance two days later. Unbeknownst to the man, there had been a temporary recovery in the investment portfolio that had resulted in a $5,000 increase in the man's account balance the day before his account was closed. The advisor retained the $5,000.
stemZh: 过去几年来,一个人拥有的投资组合的业绩一直高于股票市场平均水平。当整个股票市场在一天内急剧下跌时,此人立即联系了他的财务顾问,询问他的投资组合的状况。顾问对男方撒谎,并告诉他,由于股市下跌,他的账户价值为25万美元,大大低于男方的预期.然而,价值下降的原因不是股票市场下跌,而是顾问在管理投资组合方面的疏忽。该名男子要求关闭他的账户,并在两天内将账户的剩余余额转至他,顾问同意,并据此关闭了该名男子的账户,两天后将剩余余额转至他。此人不知道的是,投资组合暂时恢复,导致此人账户关闭前一天账户余额增加5000美元,顾问保留了5000美元。
ask: In a jurisdiction that follows the common law with regard to property crimes, which crime has the advisor committed?
askZh: 在按照普通法处理财产犯罪的情况下,顾问犯下了何种犯罪?

options.en: Embezzlement.
options.zh: 贪zz痴.

options.en: False pretenses.
options.zh: 虚假的假象。

options.en: Larceny by trick.
options.zh: 以伎俩作淫.

options.en: Theft.
options.zh: 偷窃。

explanation.en:
Comparison of property offenses

Actus reus Mens rea

Embezzlement Conversion of lawfully possessed property that belongs to another

Specific intent to defraud/permanently deprive

Larceny Unlawful taking & carrying away of another's property

Larceny by trick

Knowingly misrepresenting a material fact to obtain possession of another's property

False pretenses

Knowingly misrepresenting a material fact to obtain title to another's property

Embezzlement is:

The conversion of lawfully possessed property that belongs to another with the specific intent to defraud the owner of that property. Conversion occurs when the person holding the property substantially interferes with the owner's right to the property—eg, by selling, damaging, or unreasonably withholding possession of the property. As a result, a conversion can be established by showing that the owner demanded the return of the property and the defendant failed to comply with that demand.*

Here, the financial advisor lawfully possessed the man's account. The man requested the return of the balance, but the advisor failed to fully comply with that request because she retained $5,000. This substantially interfered with the man's right to those funds, and there is no indication that she intended to return them. Therefore, the advisor has committed embezzlement.

*Although an owner can establish a conversion by showing that a demand was made but ignored by the defendant, an owner is generally not required to demand the return of the property for a defendant's acts to constitute conversion.

(Choice B) False pretenses is obtaining legal title to another's property by knowingly making a false representation of a past or present material fact with the specific intent to defraud. Here, while the advisor falsely represented that the decline in the stock market caused the decrease in the man's account, that representation was not made to obtain title to the $5,000.

(Choice C) Larceny by trick is obtaining possession of another's property by knowingly misrepresenting a past or present material fact. But here, the misrepresentation was not made to obtain possession of the man's money.

(Choice D) Under the Model Penal Code and many state criminal codes, common-law property offenses such as larceny, embezzlement, and false pretenses are treated as a single statutory crime of theft. However, this is a common-law jurisdiction, so the offense of theft is inapplicable.

Educational objective:

Embezzlement is the conversion of lawfully possessed property that belongs to another with the specific intent to defraud the owner of that property. Conversion can be established by proving that the defendant failed to comply with the owner's demand for return of the property.

explanation.zh:
财产犯罪比较

Actus reus Mens rea (英语).

属于另一财产的合法拥有财产的转换

欺诈/永久剥夺的具体意图

非法抢夺和带走他人财产

骗人

明知故犯地歪曲重要事实以获取他人财产的占有

虚假的假冒

明知故犯地歪曲事实以取得他人财产的所有权

贪污是:

将属于另一财产的合法拥有的财产转换为专门意图欺骗该财产的所有人。当拥有财产的人通过出售、损坏或不合理地扣留对财产的占有权等手段严重干扰所有人对该财产的权利时,即为转换。因此,如果表明业主要求归还财产,而被告没有遵守这一要求,就可以确定转换。

在这里,财务顾问合法拥有此人的账户,此人要求归还余额,但顾问没有完全遵守这一要求,因为她保留了5000美元。这严重干扰了男子对这些资金的权利,没有迹象表明她打算归还这些资金,因此,顾问犯有贪污罪。

* 尽管所有权人可以通过证明曾提出过要求但被被告忽略而确定转换,但一般并不要求所有权人要求返还财产,以便被告的行为构成转换。

(Choice B) 虚假的假象通过故意对过去或现在的重大事实作虚假陈述,并有欺诈的具体意图,从而获得对他人财产的合法所有权。在此,虽然顾问谎称股市下跌导致该男子账户减少,但该代表并未获得5 000美元的所有权。

骗局是故意歪曲过去或现在的物质事实来获取他人的财产。 但在这里,歪曲事实不是为了获取此人的钱财。

(Choice D) 根据《示范刑法》和许多州刑法,普通法中的财产犯罪,如盗窃、贪污和虚假的假冒行为,被视为一项单一的法定盗窃罪。然而,这是一项普通法管辖权,因此盗窃罪不适用。

学习要点：

贪污是指将合法拥有的财产转换为属于另一财产,其具体意图是欺骗该财产的所有人。转换可以通过证明被告未遵守业主归还财产的要求而予以确定。

stem:
A 22-year-old man went to a nightclub with a group of friends. The nightclub is known for its strict 18-and-up policy. While there, the man ran into a former coworker who introduced the man to her sister. Over the course of the night, the man and the sister danced and engaged in conversation. The sister told the man that she was 19 years old and attended the local university. Near closing time, the sister invited the man to her apartment. Unbeknownst to him, the sister was only 16 and had gotten into the club using a fake ID. Later that evening, the man had consensual sexual intercourse with the coworker's sister.

The age of consent in the jurisdiction is 17.
stemZh:
一个22岁的男子和一群朋友去了一家夜总会,夜总会以其严格的18加1政策而闻名,在那里,那个男子遇到了一个前同事,将他介绍给她的妹妹.整个晚上,男方和姐姐跳起舞来进行交谈,姐姐告诉男方她19岁,并在当地大学就读,接近关门时间,妹妹邀请男方到她的公寓.据他所知,她姐姐只有16岁,并用假身份证进入俱乐部,当晚晚些时候,这名男子与同事的妹妹进行了自愿性交.

辖区内同意年龄为17岁.
ask: Is the man guilty of statutory rape?
askZh: 那人是否犯有强奸罪?

options.en: No, because the man did not knowingly engage in sexual intercourse with a minor.
options.zh: 不,因为男子没有故意与未成年人发生性关系。

options.en: No, because the man's mistake of fact, under the totality of circumstances, was reasonable.
options.zh: 不,因为这个人的事实错误, 在所有情况下,是合理的。

options.en: Yes, because the man was negligent in failing to confirm the sister's age.
options.zh: 是的,因为那个男人没有确认她姐姐的年龄而疏忽了。

options.en: Yes, because the man's commission of the requisite actus reus is sufficient for a finding of guilt.
options.zh: 是的,因为此人犯下了必要的罪行 足以判定有罪

explanation.en:
Statutory rape arises when a defendant has sexual intercourse with a person under the age of consent. This is a strict liability crime, which means that it has no mens rea requirement. Instead, proof of the actus reus (here, intercourse with an underage person) is alone sufficient to support a conviction. As a result, the fact that the man did not knowingly engage in sexual intercourse with a minor does not absolve him of guilt (Choice A).

Additionally, mistake of fact is never a defense to a strict liability crime because this defense is predicated on the notion that the defendant's mistake negates the mens rea necessary to convict. So even though the coworker's sister misrepresented her age to the man, he cannot escape liability for statutory rape by establishing that he was reasonably mistaken about the victim's age (Choice B). Therefore, the man is guilty of statutory rape.

(Choice C) The man did not confirm the sister's age. But whether his failure to do so was negligent—or even reasonable—is irrelevant to this strict liability crime. All that matters is whether he committed the actus reus.

Educational objective:

Mistake of fact is never a defense to a strict liability crime—including statutory rape. Therefore, a defendant's reasonable mistake as to the victim's age will not serve as a defense to statutory rape.

explanation.zh:
如果被告与未满法定年龄的人发生性关系,则发生法定强奸行为,这是一项严格的责任犯罪,这意味着没有犯罪意图要求。相反,证明行为(在这里,与未成年人性交)本身就足以支持定罪,因此,男子没有故意与未成年人发生性关系这一事实并不能免除他的罪行(选择A)。

此外,事实错误从来不是严格责任罪的辩护理由,因为这一辩护所依据的概念是被告的错误否定了定罪所必需的犯罪意图。因此,即使同事的妹妹向男方谎报了她的年龄,他也不能通过证明他合理误认受害者的年龄(Choice B)来逃避法定强奸的责任。 因此,男方犯有法定强奸罪。

此人没有证实他姐姐的年龄,但他没有这样做是否是疏忽,甚至合理,与这一严格的责任罪行无关,重要的是他是否犯下了罪行。

学习要点：

错误的事实绝不是对严格责任罪的辩护,包括法定强奸罪。 因此,被告对受害者年龄的合理错误不会成为法定强奸罪的辩护理由。

stem:
An unemployed man was planning to rob a convenience store and staked out the store for several weeks. One evening, the man opened and entered through the front door of the store just before closing time and reached for the gun in his waistband as he approached the checkout counter. However, upon seeing the elderly clerk who reminded the man of his grandfather, the man changed his mind and ran out of the store. Finding the man's behavior suspicious, the clerk called the police, who later apprehended the man and charged him with burglary.

In the jurisdiction, burglary is defined as "breaking and entering any building or structure with the intent to commit a felony or to steal therein."
stemZh:
一个失业男子正计划抢劫一家便利店,在店里停了几个星期。 一天晚上,这个人在关门前打开店门,从店前门进去,然后用腰带拿枪。然而,在看到年长的书记员提醒他祖父时,他改变了主意,跑出商店。发现此人行为可疑,书记员报警,后来警方逮捕了此人并指控他入室盗窃.

在辖区内,入室盗窃被定义为"破门而入任何建筑物或结构,意图实施重罪或盗窃其中".
ask: Is the man likely to be found guilty of burglary?
askZh: 那人有可能被判犯有盗窃罪吗?

options.en: No, because the man had permission to enter the convenience store.
options.zh: 不,因为他有进入便利店的许可

options.en: No, because the man is guilty of only attempted burglary of the convenience store.
options.zh: 不,因为那人只犯有盗窃便利店的未遂罪

options.en: Yes, because the man intentionally broke into and entered the convenience store.
options.zh: 是的,因为他故意闯进便利店

options.en: Yes, because the man lost his status as an invitee when he entered the convenience store with the intent to commit robbery.
options.zh: 是的,因为这个人在进入便利店时失去了被邀请人的身份,目的是抢劫。

explanation.en:
This jurisdiction defines burglary as:

the breaking and entering of any building or structure with the intent to commit a felony (eg, robbery) or to steal therein. Breaking occurs when the defendant uses any degree of force to gain entry (eg, opening a door), and entering occurs when any part of the defendant's body or an object in his/her possession crosses into the structure. The breaking and entering also must have been unlawful—ie, without the owner's permission or legal privilege. A business gives the public permission to enter its premises during business hours, but not when it is closed.

Here, the man opened the front door and entered the convenience store with the intent to commit a robbery therein (Choice C). But since the store was still open to the public at that time, the man entered the store with the owner's permission. As a result, the man's entry was lawful, and he likely will not be found guilty of burglary.

(Choice B) A defendant is guilty of attempted burglary if he/she (1) intended to commit burglary, (2) committed an act in furtherance of the burglary, but (3) did not complete it. Legal impossibility is a defense to attempt if the defendant's actions would not constitute a crime even if completed. And since it is legally impossible to unlawfully break and enter a store that is open to the public, the man is not guilty of attempted burglary.

(Choice D) A minority of jurisdictions hold that a person loses his/her status as an invitee when entering an open business with the intent to commit a crime. However, a person retains that status in most jurisdictions (default rule on the MBE). Therefore, the man retained his status as an invitee, despite his intent to rob the store.

Educational objective:

Burglary requires that a breaking and entering be unlawful—ie, without the owner's permission or legal privilege. A business gives the public permission to enter its premises during business hours, but not when it is closed.

explanation.zh:
本法域将盗窃定义为:

* 闯入任何建筑物或结构,意图犯下重罪(如抢劫)或盗窃。当被告使用任何程度的武力获得进入(例如打开一扇门),当被告身体的任何部位或他/她拥有的物体交叉进入结构时,即发生闯入。闯入和进入也必须是非法的,没有业主的许可或法律特权,企业在营业时间允许公众进入其房地,但关闭时不允许。

在此,男方打开前门进入便利店,意图在店内抢劫(Choice C),但由于店铺当时仍向公众开放,男方经店主许可进入店内.因此,该男子的入境是合法的,他很可能不会被判犯有盗窃罪.

(Choice B) 被告如果(1) 打算进行盗窃,(2) 犯下助长盗窃的行为,但(3) 没有完成,则犯有盗窃未遂罪。如果被告的行为即使完成也不会构成犯罪,那么法律上是不可能的辩护理由。 由于非法闯入和进入向公众开放的商店在法律上是不可能的,因此此人没有盗窃未遂罪。

(Choice D)少数法域认为,某人在以犯罪为目的进入公开企业时丧失了被邀请人的地位,但是,在大多数法域中,某人保留了这一地位(关于MBE的违约规则)。因此,尽管他打算抢劫商店,他仍保留了被邀请者的身份。

学习要点：

盗窃要求未经所有人许可或法律特权的闯入和闯入为非法,企业在营业时间允许公众进入其房地,但关闭时不允许。

stem:
A man discovered that his business partner was making separate deals with other companies and was filled with rage. The man immediately decided to scare the business partner to force him to stop. The man knew that the business partner went to fitness classes on Wednesday mornings before work, so the following week, the man waited for the business partner to arrive at the gym. Once the man saw the business partner walk inside, the man placed a small bomb under the business partner's car. When the class ended, the man watched as the business partner entered the car and started the engine, causing the bomb to explode and instantly kill him.

A statute in the jurisdiction defines first-degree murder as an intentional and premeditated killing, one occurring during the commission of a common law felony, or one resulting from a heinous act. The statute defines second-degree murder as all other common law murders. Voluntary manslaughter is defined as a killing in the heat of passion upon an adequate legal provocation. Involuntary manslaughter is defined as an unintentional killing committed during an unlawful act or with criminal negligence.
stemZh:
一名男子发现他的商业伙伴正在与其他公司分别交易,并充满愤怒,男子立即决定吓唬商业伙伴,迫使他停下来.男方知道商业伙伴在上班前周三早上去健身班,所以在接下来的一周,男方等待商业伙伴到达健身房.男方看到商业伙伴走进去后,男方将一枚小炸弹放置在商业伙伴的车下,班级结束后,男方看着商业伙伴进入汽车并启动引擎,导致炸弹爆炸,当场将其炸死.

该法域的法规将一级谋杀定义为蓄意和预谋的谋杀,一种是在普通法重罪实施期间发生的,一种是令人发指的行为造成的。该法规将二级谋杀定义为所有其他普通法谋杀,将故意杀人定义为在充分的法律挑衅下在激情中杀人。非自愿过失杀人是指在非法行为期间或因犯罪疏忽而无意杀人。
ask: What is the most serious crime for which the man can properly be convicted?
askZh: 何为最重之罪,可适当判之?

options.en: First-degree murder.
options.zh: 一级谋杀。

options.en: Second-degree murder.
options.zh: 二级谋杀

options.en: Voluntary manslaughter.
options.zh: 故意杀人

options.en: Involuntary manslaughter.
options.zh: 非自愿杀人

explanation.en:
Murder

Common law Unlawful killing committed with malice aforethought: intent to kill intent to cause serious bodily harm depraved-heart murder felony murder Modern view* First-degree – murder committed due to: premeditation & deliberation heinous act (eg, bombing, torture) enumerated felony Second-degree – any murder that is not first-degree murder *The fact pattern on the MBE must supply a statute if you are to consider degrees of murder. Otherwise, apply the common-law rule.

Consistent with the modern view, the statute in this jurisdiction defines first-degree murder as:

an intentional and premeditated killing

a killing committed during the commission of a common law felony or

a killing resulting from a heinous act (ie, heinous murder).

A heinous murder is one that results from an especially egregious act, such as ambush (ie, lying in wait), torture, bombing, terrorism, or poisoning. Since the man used a bomb to cause the business partner's death, the man can be convicted of first-degree murder under the statute.

(Choice B) Second-degree murder is defined here as all other common law murders (listed in table above). Since the man only intended to scare the business partner, the man likely committed depraved-heart murder by acting with reckless indifference to human life. However, he can also be convicted of the more serious offense of first-degree murder.

(Choice C) Voluntary manslaughter is defined as a killing that is committed in the heat of passion upon adequate legal provocation.* Discovering that one's business partner is making separate deals is unlikely to constitute adequate provocation. Additionally, there was sufficient time (one week) between the provocation and the killing for a reasonable person to cool off. Therefore, the man would not be convicted of this crime.

*Remember that a killing committed in the heat of passion is not a defense to murder; it merely reduces murder to voluntary manslaughter.

(Choice D) Involuntary manslaughter is defined as an unintentional killing committed during an unlawful act (not seen here) or with criminal negligence—ie, the substantial failure to act as a reasonable person would act under similar circumstances. But the affirmative act of using a bomb goes beyond a mere failure to act.

Educational objective:

Under the modern view, a heinous murder—ie, one that results from an especially egregious act, such as ambush, torture, bombing, terrorism, or poisoning—constitutes first-degree murder.

explanation.zh:
谋杀

普通法 怀着恶意的预谋而非法杀人:意图杀人造成严重身体伤害 堕落-心脏谋杀 重罪谋杀 现代观点* 一级谋杀 一级谋杀:预谋和审议令人发指的行为(如爆炸、酷刑)列举了二级重罪。* MBE上的事实模式必须提供法规将考虑谋杀的程度。否则,适用普通法规则。

根据现代观点,本辖区的法规将一级谋杀定义为:

故意和有预谋的杀害

实施普通法重罪或

由令人发指的行为(即令人发指的谋杀)造成的杀戮。

令人发指的谋杀是特别令人发指的行为造成的,例如伏击(即躺着等)、酷刑、轰炸、恐怖主义或中毒。由于此人使用炸弹造成商业伙伴死亡,根据法规,此人可以被判一级谋杀罪.

(Choice B) 二级谋杀在这里被定义为所有其他普通法谋杀(列于上表 ) 。 由于此人只是为了吓唬商业伙伴,因此此人可能通过对人类生命的鲁莽漠不关心而犯下堕落-心脏谋杀。然而,他也可以被判犯有更严重的一级谋杀罪。

(选择C) 自愿过失杀人被定义为在激情的激情中犯下的杀人行为.* 发现个人的商业伙伴正在分别交易。这不可能构成充分的挑衅。此外,从挑衅到杀戮之间有足够的时间(一个星期)让一个有理智的人冷静下来,因此,此人不会被判犯有这一罪行。

* 记住在激情中杀人并不是谋杀的辩护;它只是将谋杀降低为自愿过失杀人。

(选择D)非自愿过失杀人的定义是,在非法行为期间(此处不见)或在刑事疏忽下(即严重不作为理智的人在类似情况下将采取行动)无意杀人。但是,使用炸弹的肯定行为不仅仅是不采取行动。

学习要点：

在现代人看来,一种令人发指的谋杀,即一种特别令人发指的行为,如伏击、酷刑、爆炸、恐怖主义或毒害,构成一级谋杀。

stem: A woman drove her car through the drive-through lane of a fast-food restaurant one afternoon. When she reached the microphone used to place orders, she said, "There's a man across the street with a rifle. He can see everything you do. If you do not do exactly what I tell you, he will shoot you. Put all the money from the register into a sack and give it to me when I drive up." The clerk did not see anyone across the street and was unsure whether anyone was there. However, unwilling to risk harm to himself, he put $500 in a paper bag and handed it to the woman when she drove up to the delivery window. The woman drove off with the money but was arrested a short time later. She had lied about there having been a man with a rifle and had acted alone.
stemZh: 一天下午,一个女人开车穿过快餐餐厅的车道,当她到达用来下订单的麦克风时,她说:"街对面有个男人拿着步枪,他可以看到你所做的一切.如果你不照我说的做,他会开枪打死你,把收银机上的钱都放进袋子里,当我开车上去时给我。” 书记员没有看到街对面的人,不知道有没有人在场。然而,他不愿冒伤害自己的风险,将500美元装在纸袋里,并在该妇女开车到分娩窗口时交给她,该妇女带着钱开车离开,但不久后被逮捕。她谎称有一个人拿着步枪,独自行动。
ask: What is the most serious crime of which the woman can be convicted?
askZh: 妇女可被定罪的最严重罪行是什么?

options.en: Embezzlement.
options.zh: 贪zz痴.

options.en: False pretenses.
options.zh: 虚假的假象。

options.en: Larceny.
options.zh: 淫业.

options.en: Robbery.
options.zh: 抢劫

explanation.en:
Robbery

(larceny by force v. intimidation)

Force Use of more force than necessary to acquire property or retain the property immediately thereafter

Intimidation Threat that places victim in reasonable apprehension of immediate death or serious physical injury to victim, close family member, or person present

Larceny is (1) the unlawful taking and carrying away of the victim's personal property (2) with the specific intent to permanently deprive the victim of that property. And larceny becomes robbery when:

the property is taken from the victim's person or presence and the taking is accomplished by force or intimidation. Since larceny is necessarily committed during robbery, it is a lesser included offense of robbery. And under the merger doctrine, a defendant can only be convicted of larceny (lesser offense) or robbery (greater offense).

Here, the woman committed larceny when she took $500 from the clerk and drove away. But she acquired the money by threatening to have the clerk immediately shot if he did not comply. And since the clerk gave her the money because he was unwilling to risk being harmed, the woman can be convicted of the more serious crime of robbery (Choice C).

(Choice A) Embezzlement occurs when a person in lawful possession of another's property fraudulently converts it. Since the woman took unlawful possession of the money, she cannot be convicted of embezzlement.

(Choice B) False pretenses requires proof that the defendant (1) knowingly misrepresented a past or existing material fact (2) with the intent to defraud and (3) thereby obtained title to another's property. Here, the woman lied to the clerk when she said that a man with a rifle was ready to shoot him. But since the woman never obtained title to the money, she cannot be convicted of false pretenses.

Educational objective:

Larceny becomes robbery when property is taken from the victim's person or presence by force or intimidation. Since larceny merges into the completed robbery, a defendant can be convicted of either crime—but not both.

explanation.zh:
抢劫

(以武力盗窃诉恐吓)

使用超出必要的武力获取财产或保留财产紧接其后的财产

恐吓威胁,使受害人有理由担心受害人、近亲或在场人员立即死亡或严重人身伤害

盗窃是(1)非法抢夺和带走受害人的个人财产(2),具体目的是永久剥夺受害人的财产。

财产取自受害人的人身或在场,并以武力取得;由于盗窃必然是在抢劫期间实施的,因此不包括盗窃抢劫罪而根据合并理论,被告只能被判盗窃罪(较轻的犯罪)或抢劫罪(较重的犯罪).

这名妇女从书记员那里拿了500美元并开车离开时犯下了盗窃罪,但她通过威胁说,如果书记员不服从命令,立即开枪打死他,从而获得了这笔钱。而由于书记员因为不愿冒险伤害她而给了她钱,所以该女子可以被判更严重的抢劫罪(Choice C).

(Choice A) 贪污是指合法占有他人财产的人以欺诈手段转换财产,由于妇女非法占有钱财,因此不能以贪污罪定罪。

(Choice B)假冒要求证明被告(1)故意歪曲过去或现有的实质性事实(2),意图诈骗,(3)从而获得对他人财产的所有权。在这里,那个女人对书记员撒谎,她说,一个持枪男子准备开枪打死他,但由于这个女人从未获得钱的产权,所以她不能被判犯有虚假的假冒罪.

学习要点：

当财产被从受害人的人身上夺走或被武力或恐吓而出现时,盗窃即为抢劫。 由于盗窃行为已合并为已完成的抢劫,被告可被判犯有任何一种罪行,但两者均不然。

stem: The CEO of a company, who spent many of her work hours surfing stamp-collector websites, frequently ordered expensive stamps that she had delivered to her work address. One day, a very rare and expensive stamp arrived in the mail. The CEO's assistant, who was resentful about the meager pay he received from the CEO, decided to steal the stamp. He checked the CEO's calendar and saw that she was attending the opera the following evening. The next night, after the CEO left for the opera, the assistant retrieved a spare key hidden under a rock and entered the CEO's home through the front door, which led straight into the living room where the stamp collection was prominently displayed. As the assistant searched through the stamp collection for the rare stamp, the front door suddenly opened and the CEO walked in. Upon seeing the assistant, the CEO reached into her purse, pulled out a gun, told the assistant to stay where he was, and called the police.
stemZh: 一家公司的首席执行官花了很多时间冲浪邮票收集网站,经常订购她送去工作地址的昂贵邮票。 有一天,一张非常罕见和昂贵的邮票运抵邮件。首席执行官的助手对从首席执行官那里得到的微薄工资感到不满,决定偷印章,他检查了首席执行官的日历,看到她在次日晚上参加歌剧演出.第二天晚上,在CEO出发参加歌剧演出后,助理找回了隐藏在一块石头下面的备用钥匙,通过前门进入CEO的家,这直接导致进入客厅,其中突出展示邮票收藏.当助理通过邮票藏品搜索稀有邮票时,前门突然打开,首席执行官走进来,看到助理后,首席执行官伸进她的钱包,拿出枪,告诉助理留在原地,并报警.
ask: In a common law jurisdiction, which of the following crime(s) can the assistant be found guilty of?
askZh: 在英美法系管辖权中,以下哪些罪行可以认定助理有罪?

options.en: No crime.
options.zh: 没有犯罪。

options.en: Burglary only.
options.zh: 只有盗窃

options.en: Attempted larceny only.
options.zh: 只企图盗窃

options.en: Burglary and attempted larceny.
options.zh: 盗窃和盗窃未遂

explanation.en:
Common law burglary requires proof that the defendant:

unlawfully broke and entered another's dwelling at night and did so with the specific intent to commit a felony (eg, larceny) therein. An unlawful breaking occurs if the defendant used any amount of force to create an opening into the dwelling without consent. And once the defendant enters the dwelling with the requisite intent, the burglary is complete. This means that there is no need to prove that the defendant completed the underlying felony to obtain a burglary conviction.

In addition, a burglary defendant who failed to complete the underlying felony is guilty of the attempted commission of that felony. That is because the defendant (1) specifically intended to commit the felony and (2) performed an overt act in furtherance of the felony— the unlawful breaking and entering.

Here, the assistant unlawfully broke and entered the CEO's home at night with the specific intent to commit larceny—ie, the unlawful taking and carrying away of another's personal property (rare stamp) with the specific intent to permanently deprive the owner of that property. Therefore, the assistant is guilty of burglary (Choices A & C). And since the assistant performed the overt act of unlawfully entering the CEO's home, he is also guilty of attempted larceny (Choice B).

Educational objective:

Burglary is complete when the defendant unlawfully breaks and enters another's dwelling with the specific intent to commit a felony therein—the underlying felony need not be committed. And a burglary defendant who fails to complete the underlying felony is also guilty of the attempted commission of that felony.

explanation.zh:
普通法盗窃要求被告证明:

被告在夜间非法闯入另一人的住所,其具体意图是犯下重罪(如盗窃),如果被告未经同意动用任何武力进入住所,则非法闯入。一旦被告以必要的意图进入住宅,入室盗窃即告结束。 这意味着没有必要证明被告完成了基本的重罪以获得入室盗窃定罪。

此外,一名未完成基本重罪的入室盗窃被告犯有下列罪行:企图犯下这一重罪这是因为被告(1) 专门意图实施重罪,(2) 采取公开行动推进重罪—— 非法闯入。

在这里,助理非法闯入首席执行官的家,在夜间有进行盗窃的具体意图——非法抢夺和带走他人的个人财产(稀有印章)的具体意图是永久剥夺其所有权。因此,助理犯有盗窃罪(Choices A & C)。 由于助理犯下了非法进入首席执行官家的公开行为,他也犯有盗窃未遂罪(Choice B)。

学习要点：

如果被告非法闯入另一人的住所,并有在其中犯下重罪的具体意图,则盗窃是完全的——根本的重罪无需实施。而一名未能完成基本重罪的入室盗窃被告,也犯下了未遂重罪。

stem:
An old man lived on the second floor of a small convenience store/gas station that he owned. One night he refused to sell a college student a six-pack of beer after hours, saying he could not violate the state laws. The student became enraged and deliberately drove his car into one of the gasoline pumps, severing it from its base. There was an ensuing explosion causing a ball of fire to go from the underground gasoline tank into the building. As a result, the building burned to the ground and the old man was killed.

The college student is charged with murder and arson in a common law jurisdiction.
stemZh:
一位老人住在他拥有的小便利店/加油站的二楼,一天晚上,他拒绝在几个小时后将六包啤酒卖给一名大学生,说他不能违反州法律.学生怒气冲天,故意将自己的车开进其中一个汽油泵,从它的基地切断,随后发生爆炸,导致一球火从地下汽油箱冲进大楼.因此,该建筑被烧成灰烬,老人被杀.

该大学生被控在普通法管辖区内谋杀和纵火。
ask: What is the most likely outcome of the student's trial?
askZh: 学生审判最可能的结果是什么?.

options.en: He will be convicted of both offenses.
options.zh: 他将被判犯有这两项罪行。

options.en: He will be convicted of arson and involuntary manslaughter.
options.zh: 他将被判犯有纵火罪和非自愿过失杀人罪。

options.en: He will be convicted of involuntary manslaughter and acquitted of arson.
options.zh: 他将被判犯有非自愿过失杀人罪,并被判犯有纵火罪。

options.en: He will be acquitted of both offenses.
options.zh: 他将被判无罪

explanation.en:
In a common law jurisdiction, a defendant can be convicted of murder if the prosecution proves beyond a reasonable doubt that the defendant killed another person with malice aforethought—eg, with reckless disregard of an obvious or high risk of serious bodily injury or death (depraved-heart or extreme-recklessness murder).

There is an unreasonably high risk that driving into a gasoline pump will cause an explosion that could seriously injure or kill others. And here, the student recklessly disregarded that risk when he deliberately drove into the pump (malice aforethought), causing an explosion that killed the old man. Therefore, the student will likely be convicted of murder.

Common law arson is the malicious (ie, intentional or reckless) burning of another's dwelling. Here, the student deliberately drove into the gasoline pump, so he recklessly caused the explosion and subsequent fire (malicious burning). And since that fire caused the building where the old man lived (dwelling) to burn down, the student will likely be convicted of arson as well (Choices C & D).

(Choices B & D) Involuntary manslaughter is a lesser degree of homicide that occurs when the defendant unintentionally kills another person through criminal negligence or an unlawful act (ie, without malice aforethought). But since the student acted with malice aforethought (recklessness), he will be convicted of the greater offense of murder.

Educational objective:

At common law, a defendant is guilty of murder when he/she kills another person with malice aforethought—eg, with reckless disregard for an obvious or high risk to life. And a defendant commits arson when he/she maliciously burns the dwelling of another.

explanation.zh:
在英美法系管辖权中,如果检方排除合理怀疑地证明被告蓄意杀害另一人,例如轻率地无视明显或高度的人身伤害风险,或死亡(堕落的-心脏或极端无耻的谋杀)。

开进汽油泵会造成爆炸,造成他人重伤或死亡的风险不合理高。在这里,这名学生在故意开车进入泵房时轻率地忽略了这一风险(意外),引发了一起炸死老人的爆炸。 因此,这名学生很可能被判犯有谋杀罪。

英美法则纵火是恶意(如故意或鲁莽)焚烧他人住宅的行为。 在这里,学生故意开车进入汽油泵,因此他鲁莽地造成了爆炸和随后的火灾(恶性燃烧 ) 。由于那场大火导致老人居住(居住)的大楼被烧毁,学生很可能也被判纵火罪(Choices C & D).

(Choices B & D)非自愿杀人是一种较轻的杀人行为,在被告因刑事过失或非法行为(即没有恶意预谋)无意杀害他人时发生。但是,由于学生有恶意的预谋,他将被判定有罪。更严重的谋杀罪

学习要点：

在普通法中,当被告怀着恶意的预谋杀害另一人时,即为谋杀罪,而轻率地无视明显或高度的生命危险。 当被告恶意地烧毁另一人的住所时,被告犯有纵火罪。

stem:
A man was at work when he received a call from his wife. She told the man that their neighbor had severely beaten their son for merely walking across the neighbor's lawn. Incensed, the man rushed home from work only to find the neighbor being led away in handcuffs by the police. Ten days later, the man was shopping at a local grocery store when he spotted the neighbor, who had been released on bail. As they crossed paths, the neighbor looked directly at the man and said, "Hitting your boy sure was fun." The man became enraged, immediately drew a knife, and stabbed the neighbor repeatedly, killing him.

The man was charged with murder. At trial, the man has requested that the court instruct the jury on voluntary manslaughter.
stemZh:
一名男子接到妻子的电话时正在上班,她告诉男子说,他们的邻居只因走过邻居的草坪就毒打他们的儿子。被绑起来,那人匆匆下班回家 发现邻居被铐着手铐带走10天后,这名男子在当地一家杂货店购物, 当他发现邻居时,他被保释出来当他们十字路口时,邻居直接看着那人,说道:"打你儿子确实很有趣",那人变得愤怒,立即拔刀,反复刺死邻居,杀死了他.

该男子被控谋杀,在审判中,该男子要求法院指示陪审团自愿过失杀人。
ask: Should the court grant the man's request?
askZh: 法庭应该同意他的请求吗?

options.en: No, because a reasonable person in the man's position would have cooled after 10 days.
options.zh: 不,因为一个有理智的人 在他的位置 10天后会冷却。

options.en: No, because words alone do not constitute adequate provocation.
options.zh: 不,因为单凭言词不足以构成挑衅。

options.en: Yes, because the man had not actually cooled off in the days between the son's beating and the neighbor's death.
options.zh: 是的,因为男人实际上没有冷却 在儿子的殴打和邻居的死亡之间的日子。

options.en: Yes, because the neighbor's taunt provoked the man again.
options.zh: 是的,因为邻居的嘲弄再次激怒了那个人.

explanation.en:
A court should issue an instruction on any offense of which a reasonable jury could convict the defendant. In a prosecution for murder, an instruction on voluntary manslaughter is warranted when a reasonable jury could find that the defendant intentionally killed the victim:

in response to adequate provocation – an act that would cause a sudden and intense passion in a reasonable person (eg, serious assault on a family member) and in the heat of passion – a reasonable person would not have cooled off in the time between the provocation and the killing, and the defendant did not cool off. However, the rekindling doctrine allows a defendant to argue that, even though enough time had passed since the initial provocation to allow for cooling off, another encounter with the victim was sufficient to "rekindle" the defendant's passion. Such encounters commonly involve mocking or taunts about the initial provocation.

Here, the man was adequately provoked after the neighbor severely beat the man's son. However, a reasonable person likely would have cooled off in the 10 days between the son's beating and the man's encounter with the neighbor. But since a reasonable jury could find that the neighbor's taunt—"Hitting your boy sure was fun"—was sufficient to rekindle the man's passion, the court should grant his request for a voluntary-manslaughter instruction (Choice A).

(Choice B) Mere words are typically not enough to constitute adequate provocation. But a second encounter involving taunting or mocking may be sufficient to rekindle passion from a prior adequate provocation (as seen here).

(Choice C) The man may not have actually cooled off in the time between the son's beating and the man's encounter with the neighbor. But since a reasonable person likely would have, this does not provide a basis for an instruction on voluntary manslaughter.

Educational objective:

Voluntary manslaughter is an intentional killing committed (1) in response to adequate provocation and (2) in the heat of passion. But even if enough time had passed for cooling off, a secondary encounter with the victim may be sufficient to rekindle the defendant's passion under the rekindling doctrine.

References

People v. Berry, 556 P.2d 777 (Cal. 1976) (establishing the rekindling doctrine).

explanation.zh:
法院应就任何罪行发布指示,如果合理的陪审团认为被告故意杀害了被告,则在对谋杀罪的起诉中,有必要就故意杀人作出指示。受害人:

面对适当的挑衅行为——这种行为会在理性人(如严重伤害家庭成员)和激情的炎热中引起突然和强烈的激情——理性人不会在挑衅和激怒之间降温。然而,重新点燃的理论允许被告争辩,尽管从最初的挑衅以来已经过了足够的时间才允许冷却,但与受害人的另一次遭遇足以“重新点燃”这种遭遇通常涉及嘲笑或嘲讽最初的挑衅行为。

在这里,这名男子在邻居毒打他的儿子后被充分激怒,然而,一个通情达理的人很可能在儿子被殴打和他与邻居相遇之间的10天中冷却下来.但是,由于一个合理的陪审团可以发现邻居的嘲弄——"打你儿子确实很有趣"——足以重新激发男人的热情,所以法庭应该批准他关于自愿杀人指令(Choice A)的请求.

(选择B ) 仅仅言语通常不足以构成充分的挑衅。 但涉及嘲弄或嘲弄的第二次遭遇可能足以从先前的充分挑衅(如这里所见)中重新激起激情。

(Choice C)这名男子在儿子被殴打和他与邻居相遇之间的时间里可能实际上没有降温,但是由于一个理性的人很可能会降温,这并不能为关于自愿过失杀人的指令提供依据.

学习要点：

故意杀人罪是故意杀人罪(1起),是对充分挑衅行为的回应,2起是激情冲动.但是,即使过去了足够的时间冷却,与受害人的第二次接触可能足以在重燃的学说下重新激发被告的热情。

参考资料

People v. Berry, 556 P.2d 777 (Cal. 1976)(建立重燃学说).

stem:
A driver stopped at a red traffic light in his home state. A stranger opened the passenger door, got in, and pointed a gun at the driver. The stranger then directed the driver to keep driving. They drove several miles, crossed into a neighboring state, and drove several more miles.

When they reached a remote location, the stranger ordered the driver to pull over. The stranger then robbed the driver of his wallet and cash and ordered him out of the car. The stranger drove off in the driver's car.

The stranger is charged with kidnapping in the neighboring state, which has adopted the Model Penal Code.
stemZh:
一名司机停在家乡州的红色交通灯口,一名陌生人打开乘客的门,上车,用枪指着司机,陌生人随后指示司机继续驾驶.他们开车数英里,穿过一个邻国,又开几英里。

当他们到达一个偏僻的地方时,陌生人命令司机停车,陌生人然后抢走了司机的钱包和现金,命令他下车,陌生人开车在司机的车上下车.

该陌生人被控在邻国绑架,该国通过了《示范刑法》。
ask: Can the stranger properly be convicted of kidnapping in the neighboring state?
askZh: 陌生人能否在邻邦被判绑架罪?

options.en: No, because any kidnapping took place in the driver's home state.
options.zh: 不,因为任何绑架 发生在司机的家乡。

options.en: No, because the restraint was incidental to the robbery.
options.zh: 不,因为限制是抢劫附带的

options.en: Yes, because the driver in effect paid a ransom for his release.
options.zh: 是的,因为实际上司机支付了赎金 释放他。

options.en: Yes, because the driver was transported under threat of force in the neighboring state.
options.zh: 是的,因为司机是在邻国武力威胁下运输的。

explanation.en:
A defendant can be prosecuted in any state where an essential part of the crime has occurred without violating double jeopardy. Under the Model Penal Code, kidnapping occurs when a victim is intentionally and unlawfully moved (or confined) for any of the following purposes:

to hold for ransom/reward or as a hostage/shield to facilitate commission of any felony or flight thereafter to inflict bodily injury on or terrorize the victim or another to interfere with performance of a governmental or political function An unlawful movement occurs when the victim is (1) removed from his/her residence or business or (2) taken a substantial distance from where he/she is found. And the movement must be more than incidental to the commission of another crime. To make this determination, courts consider the distance and duration of the movement as well as the increased danger the movement posed to the victim.

Here, the stranger entered the car, pointed a gun at the driver, and unlawfully forced him to drive a substantial distance into a neighboring state. This was done so that the stranger could rob the driver of his wallet, cash, and car. And since the driver was (1) forced to drive several miles in the neighboring state and (2) at risk of being shot while doing so, his kidnapping was more than incidental to the robbery (Choice B). As a result, the stranger can be convicted of kidnapping in the neighboring state.

(Choice A) The kidnapping did not only occur in the driver's home state because he was forced to drive across state lines.

(Choice C) A defendant can be convicted of kidnapping for moving a victim to hold for ransom. But the driver did not pay a ransom since the stolen cash, wallet, and car were not given in exchange for his release.

Educational Objective:

Under the Model Penal Code, unlawfully moving a victim a substantial distance through two states to facilitate a crime constitutes kidnapping in both states.

References

Model Penal Code § 212.1 (Am. Law Inst. 2019) (kidnapping).

explanation.zh:
被告可在犯罪基本部分发生且未违反双重危险的任何州受到起诉。根据《刑法典范本》,如果出于下列任何目的故意和非法转移(或监禁)被害人,即为绑架:

为勒索/奖励而扣留或作为人质/挡箭牌,为此后犯下重罪或逃跑提供便利,对受害人或他人造成人身伤害或恐吓,以干扰政府或政治职能的履行。(1) 受害人被从住所或企业中除名,或(2) 被带去大量距离他/她被发现的地方的距离 。还有另一桩案子为了作出这一确定,法院考虑了运动的距离和持续时间以及运动对受害者造成的更大危险。

在这里,陌生人进入了汽车,用枪指着司机,并非法迫使他开着相当长的距离进入邻国。 这样做是为了让陌生人可以抢走司机的钱包、现金和汽车。而由于司机(1)被迫在邻近州行驶数英里,(2)在行驶时面临被枪击的风险,因此他的绑架不止是抢劫的偶然事件(Choice B).因此,陌生人可以在邻国被判绑架罪.

(Choice A) 绑架事件不仅发生在司机的家乡州,因为他被迫驾驶越州线.

(Choice C) 被告可以因转移受害人扣留赎金而被判绑架罪。 但司机没有支付赎金,因为被盗现金、钱包和汽车没有作为释放条件。

教育目标:

根据《刑法典范本》,非法将受害人从两个州迁移到一个州以方便犯罪,在两个州都构成绑架。

参考资料

《刑法典范本》第212.1条(第2019号法律)(绑架)。

stem: A man and a woman dated for several weeks. During that time, the man repeatedly asked the woman to have sex. Each time, the woman responded that she would not have sex with the man unless they were married. One evening, the man promised the woman that they would elope the following weekend if she would agree to have sex. The woman agreed and the couple had sex. The following weekend, the man told the woman that he had no intention of eloping and only made that promise to get the woman's consent. The woman reported the man to the police, who later arrested and charged the man with rape.
stemZh: 一个男人和一个女人约会了几个星期,在此期间,那个男人一再要求这个女人做爱,每次,那个女人都回答说,除非她们结婚,否则她不会和那个男人发生性关系.一天晚上,男方向女方许诺,如果女方同意发生性关系,她们会在下一个周末私奔,女方同意,女方也发生了性关系.之后的周末,男方告诉女方他无意私奔,只许得到女方同意,女方将男方报告警方,女方随后逮捕并指控男方强奸.
ask: Is the man guilty of rape?
askZh: 那人是否犯有强奸罪?

options.en: No, because fraud in factum did not negate the woman's consent.
options.zh: 没有,因为事实上的欺诈并没有否定妇女的同意。

options.en: No, because fraud in the inducement did not negate the woman's consent.
options.zh: 不,因为诱导中的欺诈并不否定妇女的同意。

options.en: Yes, because the woman's consent was obtained by fraud in factum.
options.zh: 是的,因为妇女的同意 是在事实上通过欺诈获得的。

options.en: Yes, because the woman's consent was obtained by fraud in the inducement.
options.zh: 是的,因为妇女的同意是通过在引诱中欺诈获得的。

explanation.en:
Consent to sexual intercourse obtained by fraud

Type of fraud

Definition Effect

In factum Fraud pertains to nature of act—eg, doctor convinces patient that sexual act is part of medical exam Victim is unaware that he/she is consenting to sexual intercourse

Negates victim's consent

In inducement

Fraud pertains to what victim knows is an act of sexual intercourse—eg, defendant promises marriage in exchange for sex Victim is aware that he/she is consenting to sexual intercourse

Does not negate victim's consent

In most modern jurisdictions, rape is defined as sexual intercourse with another without that person's consent.* This means that rape did not occur if the victim consented to sexual intercourse. However, a victim's consent may be ineffective if it was obtained by fraud. There are two types of fraud:

Fraud in factum – when consent is obtained by fraud regarding the nature of the act itself, leaving the victim unaware that he/she consented to sexual intercourse and negating the victim's consent

Fraud in the inducement – when consent is obtained by fraud regarding what the victim knows is an act of sexual intercourse, which does not negate the victim's consent

As a result, consent obtained by fraud in factum is not a valid defense to rape, but consent obtained by fraud in the inducement is a valid defense.

Here, the man falsely promised the woman that they would elope if she agreed to have sex with him. Since the woman knew that the act to which she consented was sexual intercourse, her consent was obtained by fraud in the inducement (Choices A & C). This type of fraud did not negate the woman's consent, so the man is not guilty of rape (Choice D).

*At common law, rape was defined as (1) unlawful sexual intercourse (2) with a female who is not the defendant's wife (3) against her will by force or threat of force.

Educational objective:

Fraud in factum occurs when the fraud pertains to the nature of the act itself and negates a rape victim's consent. In contrast, fraud in the inducement occurs when fraud is used to

gain consent to what the victim knows is an act of sexual intercourse and does not negate the victim's consent.

explanation.zh:
同意通过欺诈进行性交

欺诈类型

定义效果

事实上,欺诈与行为的性质有关,例如,医生使病人相信性行为是体检的一部分。

取消受害者的同意

诱导

欺诈与受害人所知道的性交行为有关,例如,被告承诺结婚以换取性关系。 受害人意识到他或她同意性交。

不否定受害者的同意

在大多数现代司法管辖区中,强奸被定义为与他人发生性关系而不发生性关系。* 这意味着如果受害者同意性交,强奸就不会发生。但是,受害人的同意如果是通过欺诈手段获得的,可能无效。

事实上,当欺诈行为本身的性质得到同意时,受害人不知道自己同意性交并否认受害人的同意。

引诱中的欺诈——当通过欺诈获得受害人对性交行为知情的同意时,这并不否定受害人的同意

因此,通过事实上的欺诈获得的同意不是强奸的有效辩护,但通过欺诈获得的引诱同意是有效的辩护。

在此,男方向女方错误地承诺,如果女方同意与女方发生性关系,她们会私奔,因为女方知道她同意的性行为是性交,所以她的同意是通过欺骗手段获得的(Choices A & C)。这种欺诈行为并没有否定妇女的同意,因此男子没有强奸罪(Choice D)。

* 根据普通法,强奸的定义是(1) 与不是被告妻子的妇女非法性交(2) 违背她的意愿,通过武力或威胁使用武力。

学习要点：

当欺诈与行为本身的性质有关,并否定强奸时,即发生事实上的欺诈行为。反之,在利用欺诈手段进行欺诈时,就会发生欺诈行为。

获得对受害人所知的性行为的同意,并不否定受害人的同意。

stem: A woman's ex-husband was getting remarried. The woman believed that he was making a mistake and that she needed to stop him. On the day of his wedding, held outdoors at a park, the woman hid behind some bushes she knew her ex-husband would have to pass before entering the area where the ceremony would take place. When her ex-husband was a few feet away, the woman got his attention and told him to come behind the bushes to talk. When he resisted, the woman pulled out a gun and the husband reluctantly walked around the bushes to talk to her. The woman then proceeded to tell him that he could not get married. Once the ex-husband was able to convince the woman that he would not get married, he was able to leave and notified the police. The woman was subsequently arrested and charged with kidnapping.
stemZh: 一个女人的前夫要再婚,那女人认为他犯了错误,她需要阻止他.在他的婚礼当天,在公园的户外举行,这名妇女躲在一些灌木丛后面,她知道前夫在进入举行仪式的地区之前必须经过.当她前夫在几尺外时,那女人得到他的注意,叫他到灌木后面来说话,他反抗时,那女人拿出枪,丈夫不情愿地走在灌木丛里跟她说话.这名妇女接着告诉他,他不能结婚,一旦前夫能够说服该妇女,他不能结婚,他就可以离开,并通知警察,该妇女随后被逮捕并被指控绑架。
ask: Is the woman guilty of kidnapping?
askZh: 那女人是否犯有绑架罪?

options.en: No, because the ex-husband was not actually confined.
options.zh: 不,因为前夫实际上没有被禁闭。

options.en: No, because the ex-husband was only forced to move a few feet.
options.zh: 不,因为前夫只是被迫移动几英尺。

options.en: Yes, because the woman forced the ex-husband to go behind the bushes.
options.zh: 是的,因为那个女人强迫前夫去灌木丛后面

options.en: Yes, because the woman prevented the ex-husband from entering the area where the ceremony would take place.
options.zh: 是的,因为女人阻止前夫进入 举行仪式的地区地点。

explanation.en:
Kidnapping

Common law

Forcibly abducting or stealing person from his/her own country & sending to another country

MPC Unlawfully moving or confining another to:

hold for ransom or as hostage facilitate commission of felony or flight thereafter injure/terrorize victim or another or interfere with governmental/political function Modern view

General Intentional & unlawful confinement involving:

some movement (asportation) or concealment Aggravated General kidnapping committed for:

ransom commission of other crime offensive purpose or child stealing MPC = Model Penal Code.

Under the modern view, kidnapping is:

the intentional* and unlawful confinement of another against that person's will (eg, by force, threat, or fraud) coupled with either moving or hiding that person. Confinement occurs when the victim's freedom of movement is significantly restricted. It is not enough that the victim is prevented from taking a path or entering an area; the victim must be prevented from leaving an area or compelled to go somewhere the victim does not want to go. Additionally, the victim need only be moved a short distance to satisfy the movement requirement.

Here, the ex-husband was intentionally confined when the woman threatened him with a gun to compel him to come behind the bushes against his will (Choice A). And since the man was forced to walk a few feet, the movement requirement was also satisfied (Choice B). Therefore, the woman is guilty of kidnapping.

*General intent crimes such as kidnapping require only the intent to perform an act that is unlawful.

(Choice D) The man was confined because he was forced to go someplace he did not want to go—behind the bushes. Merely preventing a victim from taking a path or entering an area does not constitute confinement.

Educational objective:

Under the modern view, kidnapping is the unlawful and intentional confinement of another against that person's will, coupled with the movement or hiding of that person. To satisfy the movement requirement, the victim need only be moved a short distance.

References

Charles E. Torcia, 3 Wharton's Criminal Law § 207 (15th ed. 2020) (discussing kidnapping requirements).

explanation.zh:
绑架

普通法

强行绑架或从其本国窃取人员并送往另一国

MPC 非法移动或限制他人:

为赎金或作为人质协助犯下重罪或逃跑,然后伤害/恐吓受害者或其他人或干涉政府/政治职能

一般故意和非法监禁,涉及:

为下列目的实施的某些行动(递解)或掩盖严重绑架:

其他犯罪犯罪目的或儿童盗窃罪=示范刑法。

根据现代观点,绑架是:

违反他人意愿蓄意* 和非法监禁他人(如:威胁或欺诈),再加上移动或藏匿此人。当受害人的行动自由受到很大限制时,便会出现封闭。仅仅阻止受害者走一条道路或进入某一地区是不够的;必须防止受害者离开某一地区或被迫前往受害者不想去的地方。此外,为了达到行动要求,受害人只需移动一段短距离。

在此,前夫故意被禁锢,当时该女子用枪威胁他,迫使他违背自己的意愿(Choice A)赶到灌木丛后面去(Choice A),由于该男子被迫步行几英尺,运动要求也得到满足(Choice B).因此,该妇女犯有绑架罪。

* 一般意图犯罪,如绑架,仅要求意图从事非法行为。

这名男子因被迫去他不想去的地方而被监禁,在灌木丛后面,仅仅阻止受害者走上道路或进入某一地区并不构成监禁。

学习要点：

现代观点认为,绑架是违背他人意愿非法和蓄意地监禁他人,再加上该人的移动或藏匿,为了满足移动要求,只需将受害人转移一段短距离即可。

参考资料

Charles E. Torcia, 3 Wharton的刑法第207条(第15版,2020年)(讨论绑架要求)。

stem: While browsing in a clothing store, an actress decided to take a purse without paying for it. She placed the purse under her coat and took a couple of steps toward the exit. She then realized that a sensor tag on the purse would set off an alarm. She placed the purse near the counter from which she had removed it.
stemZh: 在一家服装店浏览时,一位女演员决定不付钱就拿一个钱包,她把钱包放在大衣下面,朝着出口迈出了几步,然后她意识到钱包上的传感器标签会触发警报.她把钱包放在柜台附近,从柜台上取走。
ask: Which crime, if any, has the actress committed?
askZh: 女演员犯了什么罪?

options.en: No crime, because the purse was never removed from the store.
options.zh: 没有犯罪,因为钱包从未被从店里拿走过。

options.en: No crime, because she withdrew from her criminal enterprise.
options.zh: 没有犯罪,因为她退出了犯罪事业。

options.en: Only attempted larceny, because she intended to take the purse out of the store.
options.zh: 只是企图偷盗 因为她打算把钱包从店里拿走

options.en: Larceny, because she took the purse from its original location and concealed it with the intent to steal.
options.zh: 偷盗,因为她把钱包 从原来的位置 并隐藏它的意图偷。

explanation.en:
Larceny is committed once a person (1) unlawfully takes and carries away another's personal property (2) with the specific intent to permanently deprive that person of his/her interest in the property. Carrying away (ie, asportation) occurs when property is moved even a short distance (eg, mere inches). And some jurisdictions only require that the property be brought under a person's dominion and control—no physical movement of the property is required.

Here, the actress decided to take a purse without paying for it (specific intent). As a result, she removed the purse from the counter (unlawful taking) and concealed it under her coat (carrying away). Therefore, she committed larceny—even though the purse was never removed from the store (Choice A).

(Choice B) Withdrawal (ie, abandonment) occurs when a person completely and voluntarily turns away from a crime before completing it. However, this defense only applies to attempted crimes and is not recognized in most jurisdictions. And since the actress completed the larceny once she concealed the purse, it is no defense here.

(Choice C) Attempt occurs when a defendant (1) has the specific intent to commit a crime, (2) commits an act in furtherance of that crime, but (3) does not complete it. Here, the actress will be convicted of larceny—not merely attempted larceny—since she did complete the crime.

Educational objective:

Larceny requires the carrying away (ie, asportation) of another's personal property. This occurs when the defendant moves the property a slight amount (majority rule) or brings the property under his/her dominion and control (minority rule).

explanation.zh:
一旦一个人(1)非法拿走和带走他人的个人财产(2),其具体意图是永久剥夺该人对该财产的权益,即实施盗窃。搬走(即移走)发生在财产移动甚至很短的距离(例如,只有一英寸)时。 有些法域只要求将财产置于一个人的管辖和控制之下,而不需要财产的实际移动。

在这里,女演员决定拿一个钱包而不付钱(具体意图),结果,她把钱包从柜台上移走(非法带走),并藏在她的外套下(运走).因此,她犯有盗窃罪,尽管从未将钱包从店里拿走(Choice A)。

(Choice B) 退出(即放弃)是指一个人在完成犯罪之前完全和自愿地放弃犯罪,然而,这一辩护只适用于未遂犯罪,并且在大多数法域不被承认.既然那个女演员把钱包藏起来 就完成了盗窃 这儿就没什么好辩护的了

(C类)当被告(1) 具有实施犯罪的具体意图时,(2) 实施促进该犯罪的行为,但(3) 不完成该犯罪时,未遂即发生。在此,女演员将被判犯有盗窃罪——而不仅仅是盗窃未遂罪——因为她确实完成了犯罪。

学习要点：

盗窃要求转移他人的个人财产(即转移),如果被告将财产略为转移(多数规则)或将财产置于其管辖和控制之下(少数群体规则)。

stem:
A man who owned a business believed that one of his employees was stealing computer equipment from the business. He decided to break into the employee's house one night, when he knew that the employee and her family would be away, to try to find and retrieve the equipment.

The man had brought a picklock to open the employee's back door. But when he tried the door, he found that it was unlocked, so he entered. As the man was looking around the house, he heard sounds outside and became afraid. He left the house but was arrested by police on neighborhood patrol.
stemZh:
拥有一家企业的一位男子认为,他的一位雇员正在从企业中盗窃计算机设备。某天晚上,当他知道该雇员和她的家人将离开时,他决定闯入该雇员的家,试图找到和收回设备。

这名男子带了一把锁打开了员工的后门,但当他尝试门时发现门是解锁的,于是进入了,当这名男子在屋子四周看时,听到外面的声音,变得害怕.他离开了房子,但在街区巡逻中被警察逮捕。
ask: What is the man's strongest defense to a burglary charge?
askZh: 这个人对盗窃指控最有力的防御是什么?

options.en: The back door to the house was unlocked.
options.zh: 房子的后门被解锁了.

options.en: The burglary was abandoned.
options.zh: 入室盗窃被废弃.

options.en: The house was not occupied at the time of his entry.
options.zh: 该房屋在他进入时未被占用.

options.en: The man did not intend to commit a crime inside the house.
options.zh: 此人无意在屋内犯罪。

explanation.en:
Most jurisdictions broadly define burglary as:

the unlawful entry of a building or other structure with the specific intent to commit any crime therein. An entry occurs when any part of a person's body (or an object in his/her control) crosses into the structure. And that entry is unlawful if it occurred without permission from the rightful possessor or legal privilege. But it only amounts to burglary if the person intended to commit a crime therein—not merely to retrieve his/her own property (as seen here). Therefore, the man's strongest defense is that he lacked the requisite intent.

(Choice A) Most jurisdictions have eliminated the common law "breaking" requirement for burglary—ie, the use of any amount of force to gain entry. But even if this requirement existed here, it was satisfied when the man opened the unlocked door.

(Choice B) Abandonment is a defense when a person intends to commit a crime but has a change of heart before completing it. Here, the man intended to recover his business equipment, not to commit a crime. Therefore, his best defense is that he never formed the requisite intent—not that he later abandoned it.

(Choice C) There is no requirement that the structure be occupied at the time of the entry, so the fact that the house was unoccupied would not serve as a defense to burglary.

Educational objective:

In most jurisdictions, burglary requires proof of two elements: (1) an unlawful entry of a building or other structure (2) with the specific intent to commit any crime therein. Therefore, a burglary does not occur if a person unlawfully enters a structure to retrieve his/her own property—not to commit a crime.

explanation.zh:
多数法域将盗窃广义定义为:

* 建筑物或其他结构非法进入,有实施任何犯罪的具体意图;当一个人的身体(或他/她控制的物体)的任何部位交叉时,即为条目。进入结构。如果未经合法拥有者许可或法律特权,这种入境是非法的。 但是,如果该人意图在入境时实施犯罪,而不仅仅是收回他/她自己的财产(如这里所见),这种入境就等于入室盗窃。因此,此人最强的防守是缺乏必要的意图.

(Choice A)大多数法域都取消了普通法对入室盗窃的“破门”要求——即使用任何武力获取入室权。 但即使存在这一要求,在男方打开解锁门时,也满足了。

(Choice B)当一个人打算犯罪,但在完成犯罪之前有改变心意时,弃置是一种辩护,在这里,这个人打算收回他的商业设备,而不是犯罪.因此,他最好的辩护是,他从来没有形成必要的意图,而不是后来放弃了意图。

(Choice C) 进入时没有要求建筑物被占用,因此房屋无人占用的事实不会成为盗窃的防御.

学习要点：

在大多数法域,入室盗窃要求证明两个要素:(1) 建筑物或其他结构的非法进入(2) 其具体意图是在那里实施任何犯罪。因此,如果一个人非法进入一个机构取回他/她自己的财产——而不是犯罪——则不会发生入室盗窃。

stem:
A man decided to kill his boss after she told him that he would be fired if his work did not improve. The man knew his boss was scheduled to go on a business trip on Monday morning. On Sunday morning, the man went to the company parking garage and put a bomb in the company car that his boss usually drove. The bomb was wired to go off when the car engine started. The man then left town. At 5:00 a.m. Monday, the man, after driving all night, was overcome with remorse and had a change of heart. He called the security officer on duty at the company and told him about the bomb. The security officer said he would take care of the matter. An hour later, the officer put a note on the boss's desk telling her of the man's call. The officer then looked at the car but could not see any signs of a bomb. He printed a sign saying, "DO NOT USE THIS CAR," put it on the windshield, and went to call the police. Before the police arrived, the company's vice president got into the car and started the engine. The bomb went off, killing her instantly.

The jurisdiction defines murder in the first degree as any homicide committed with premeditation and deliberation or any murder in the commission of a common law felony. Second-degree murder is defined as all other murder at common law. Manslaughter is defined by the common law.
stemZh:
她告诉老板如果工作没有改善,他就会被解雇,一个男人决定杀死他的老板,他知道自己的老板预定在星期一上午出差。星期天早上,这名男子去公司停车场,把炸弹放进公司汽车里,他老板通常开的汽车里,汽车发动机开动时炸弹被电线引爆,这名男子随后离开镇上,凌晨5点.星期一,这名男子在开车一整夜后,因悔恨而受挫,改过自新,他打电话给公司值班的保安员,告诉他炸弹的事,保安员说他会处理好这件事.一小时后,这名警官在老板的桌子上贴了张纸条,告诉她那人的电话,这名警官随后看了那辆车,却看不到任何炸弹的迹象,他打印了一个标语,写着"不要使用这个车",把它放在挡风玻璃上,然后去报警.警察赶到前,公司副总裁上车发动引擎,炸弹爆炸,当场炸死了她.

司法管辖权将一级谋杀定义为任何预谋和考虑的杀人或实施普通法重罪的任何谋杀,二级谋杀定义为普通法中所有其他谋杀。杀人罪由普通法定义.
ask: What is the most serious crime of which the man can be properly convicted?
askZh: 何为最严重罪行,此人可被适当定罪?

options.en: Murder in the first degree, because, with premeditation and deliberation, he killed whoever would start the car.
options.zh: 一级谋杀, 因为,通过预谋和考虑, 他杀了谁会发动汽车。

options.en: Murder in the second degree, because he had no intention of killing the company vice president.
options.zh: 第二度谋杀,因为他无意杀死公司副总裁.

options.en: Manslaughter, because he had no intent to kill at the time of the explosion.
options.zh: 因为爆炸时他无意杀人

options.en: Only attempted murder of his boss, because the vice president's death was the result of the security officer's negligence.
options.zh: 只有企图谋杀他的老板,因为副总统的死是保安官员的疏忽造成的.

explanation.en:
In this jurisdiction, first-degree murder includes felony murder and any homicide that is committed with:

premeditation – the defendant formed the specific intentto kill at some appreciable time before committing the criminal act and

deliberation – the defendant reached the decision to kill after cool and dispassionate reflection upon the criminal act and its likely consequences.

And under the doctrine of transferred intent, the defendant's specific intent to kill one person will be transferred to the person actually harmed by the defendant.

Here, the man planned to kill his boss (premeditation and deliberation) and planted a bomb in her car to do so. The bomb then killed the vice president. And though the man did not intend to kill the vice president, his intent to kill his boss with the bomb can be shifted onto the vice president under the doctrine of transferred intent (Choice B). Therefore, the man can be convicted of first-degree murder.

(Choice C) All crimes require proof of concurrence—ie, that the defendant had the requisite intent when the criminal act was committed. Here, the man had no intent to kill at the time of the explosion. But he did act with such intent when he committed the criminal act of planting the car bomb. And since that bomb caused the vice president's death, the man can be convicted of first-degree murder.

(Choice D) Although the man is guilty of attempted murder of his boss, he is also guilty of first-degree murder of the vice president. The security officer's negligence did not absolve the man of murder because the officer's actions were foreseeable—ie, not a superseding cause that would eliminate the man's liability.

Educational objective:

Under the doctrine of transferred intent, the defendant's specific intent to kill one person will be transferred to the person actually harmed by the defendant.

explanation.zh:
在这个管辖区内,一级谋杀包括重罪谋杀和任何与下列犯罪有关的谋杀:

预谋——被告在实施犯罪行为之前的某个相当长的时间内组成了杀人的具体意图;

评议 — — 被告在冷静和冷静地反思了犯罪行为及其可能的后果后作出了杀人的决定。

根据转移意图的理论,被告杀害一个人的具体意图将转移到被告实际伤害的人身上。

在这里,这名男子计划杀死他的老板(预谋和考虑),并在她的车上安放了一枚炸弹来做这件事. 炸弹随后杀死了副总统.尽管这个人并不打算杀死副总统,但是根据转移意图(Choice B)的理论,他用炸弹杀死老板的意图可以转移到副总统身上。 因此,此人可以被判一级谋杀罪。

所有罪行都需要证明同意,即被告在犯下犯罪行为时有必要的意图,在此,该人在爆炸时没有杀人的意图。但是,当他犯下放置汽车炸弹的罪行时,他确实有这种意图。 由于炸弹造成副总统的死亡,此人可以被判一级谋杀罪。

(Choice D)虽然此人犯有谋杀上司未遂罪,但也犯有一级谋杀副总统罪.安全官员的疏忽没有免除谋杀人的责任,因为安全官员的行为是可以预见的,而不是可以免除其责任的替代原因。

学习要点：

根据转移意图的理论,被告杀害一个人的具体意图将转移到被告实际伤害的人身上。
