stem:
A man owned land. He took out a loan that was secured by a mortgage on the land. The man had personal liability on the loan.

The man sold the land to a purchaser, who expressly assumed the mortgage debt. The purchaser failed to make two installment payments. To prevent default and foreclosure, the man paid the overdue installments. After making the payments, the man sued the purchaser for reimbursement.
stemZh:
一个人拥有土地,他借了一笔贷款,贷款是用抵押贷款担保的,他个人对贷款负有责任。

该男子将土地卖给了购买者,后者明确承担了抵押债务,购买者未能支付两笔分期付款,为防止违约和赎回,该男子支付了逾期的分期付款。在付款后,此人起诉购买者要求偿还。
ask: Is the man likely to prevail?
askZh: 那人有可能获胜吗?

options.en: No, because the man did not initiate foreclosure proceedings before seeking reimbursement.
options.zh: 不,因为此人在要求偿还之前没有启动赎回程序。

options.en: No, because the man was personally liable on the loan.
options.zh: 不,因为他个人要承担贷款责任

options.en: Yes, because the law of suretyship permits the man to seek reimbursement.
options.zh: 是的,因为保证法允许 男人寻求补偿。

options.en: Yes, because the man's transfer of the land discharged him from any personal liability on the loan.
options.zh: 是的,因为此人转让土地 免除了他个人的贷款责任

explanation.en:
Suretyship rights

(recourse for secondary obligor)

Specific performance

Court order requiring primarily obligor to specifically perform all or part of his/her contractual duties

Reimbursement Repayment for secondary obligor fulfilling all or part of primary obligor's underlying contractual duties

Restitution Repayment to secondary obligor to avoid unjust enrichment to primary obligor even when no duty exists

Subrogation Secondary obligor given rights of primary obligor & is protected as though an assignment of rights occurred

A mortgagor (ie, borrower) is generally free to transfer mortgaged property to another (ie, transferee). After the sale, the mortgage remains attached to the property and the mortgagor remains personally liable for the mortgage debt in the absence of a release by the mortgagee (eg, bank). However, the transferee's obligations with respect to that debt depend on whether the transferee:

took subject to the mortgage – in which case, the transferee is not personally liable for the debt or agreed to assume the mortgage – in which case, the transferee becomes primarily liable for the debt and the mortgagor becomes secondarily liable as a surety. If a transferee defaults on an assumed mortgage and the mortgagor then pays that debt, the mortgagor can seek reimbursement from the transferee under the law of suretyship.

Here, the purchaser expressly assumed the man's mortgage debt, so the purchaser became primarily liable for the debt and the man became secondarily liable as a surety (Choice D). The purchaser then defaulted by failing to make two installment payments. Since the man paid the overdue installments, the law of suretyship permits him to seek reimbursement from the purchaser. As a result, the man is likely to prevail.

(Choice A) A foreclosure proceeding can be initiated only by the mortgagee or the current holder of the mortgagee's security interest—not the mortgagor (eg, the man).

(Choice B) The right to seek reimbursement under the law of suretyship requires that the man be personally liable on the loan, which he was as a surety. Therefore, the man's personal liability provides a basis for him to prevail.

Educational objective:

When a mortgagor transfers mortgaged property to someone who assumes the mortgage, the transferee becomes primarily liable for the mortgage and the mortgagor becomes secondarily liable as a surety. So if the mortgagor pays the mortgage debt after the transferee defaults, the mortgagor can seek reimbursement.

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 5.3 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (assumption of a mortgage).

Restatement (Third) of Suretyship & Guaranty § 22 (Am. Law Inst. 1996) (surety's right to reimbursement).

explanation.zh:
担保权

(二级承付人的追索权)

强制履行

法院命令主要要求义务人具体履行其全部或部分合同义务

偿还履行主要义务人全部或部分基本合同义务的次要义务人的款项

向次要义务人偿还款项,以避免向主要义务人不公平地致富,即使没有义务

赋予初级义务人权利的二级义务人和被保护人,似乎权利转让已经发生

抵押权人(即借款人)一般可以自由地将抵押财产转让给他人(即:出售后,抵押权仍附属于该财产,抵押权仍存个人对抵押债务负有赔偿责任,如果贷款人没有解除抵押债务;但是,受让人对此的义务。债务取决于受让人是否:

受抵押 -- -- 在这种情况下,受让人对债务不负个人责任或同意承担抵押 -- -- 在这种情况下,受让人对债务负主要责任,抵押人作为担保人承担第二责任。如果受让人违约于假定的抵押,而抵押权人又偿付了该债务,抵押权人可以根据担保法向受让人寻求偿还。

在此,购买者明确承担了男子的抵押债务,因此购买者对债务负主要责任,而男子作为担保人(Choice D)承担第二责任。 购买者随后因未能分期付款而违约。由于该男子支付了逾期的分期付款,担保法允许他向购买者寻求补偿,因此,该男子很可能胜诉。

(选择A)赎回程序只能由抵押人或抵押人担保权益的现任持有人——而不是抵押人(例如男子)——启动。

(Choice B)根据担保法要求偿还的权利要求男子对作为保证人的贷款负个人责任,因此,男子的个人责任为他提供了胜诉的依据。

学习要点：

抵押权人将抵押财产转让给抵押权人时,受让人对抵押负主要责任,抵押权人作为担保人承担第二责任.因此,如果抵押贷款人在受让人违约后偿还抵押贷款债务,抵押贷款可以要求偿还。

参考资料

财产重报(第三期):抵押权第5.3条(《1997年宪法》)(抵押权的推定)。

重述(第三次)《保证和保证》第22条(《1996年法律》)(保证获得偿还的权利)。

stem:
Twenty-five years ago, a seller conveyed a lot of land to a buyer by a warranty deed. The seller at that time also executed and delivered an instrument in the proper form of a deed, purporting to convey a second lot of land to the buyer. The seller thought she had title to the second lot but did not; therefore, no title passed by virtue of that deed. The second lot consisted of three acres of brushland adjoining the west boundary of the first lot. The buyer has occasionally hunted rabbits on the second lot, but less often than annually. No one else came on the second lot except occasional rabbit hunters.

Twenty years ago, the buyer planted a row of evergreens in the vicinity of the opposite (east) boundary of the first lot and erected a fence just beyond the evergreens to the east. In fact, both the trees and the fence were placed on a neighboring lot, owned by a neighbor, which bordered the east boundary of the first lot. The buyer was unsure of the exact boundary, and placed the trees and the fence in order to establish his rights up to the fence. The fence is located 10 feet within the neighboring lot.

Now, the buyer has had his property surveyed and the title checked and has learned the facts.

The period of time to acquire title by adverse possession in the jurisdiction is 15 years.
stemZh:
25 年前，一名卖方通过附保证的地契，将第一块土地转让给买方。当时，卖方还签署并交付了另一份形式合格的地契，声称将第二块土地转让给买方。卖方以为自己拥有第二块土地的所有权，实际上却并非如此，因此该地契并未转移所有权。第二块土地是三英亩灌木地，与第一块土地的西界相邻。买方偶尔在第二块土地上猎兔，但频率不到每年一次。除偶尔前来的猎兔人外，没有其他人进入过该地块。

20 年前，买方在第一块土地另一侧，即东界附近，种植了一排常青树，并在树木东侧稍远处竖起围栏。事实上，树木和围栏都位于邻居所有的相邻地块上；该地块与第一块土地的东界相接。买方不确定确切边界，种树和设围栏是为了确立自己对围栏以内土地的权利。围栏位于邻居地块界内 10 英尺处。

现在，买方已对其土地进行测量并核查产权，得知了上述事实。

在该司法辖区，通过逆权占有取得土地所有权的法定期间为 15 年。
ask: In an appropriate action, to which of the following would the buyer likely obtain title?
askZh: 在适当的诉讼中,买方可能获得以下哪一种所有权?

options.en: The second lot but not the 10-foot strip of the neighboring lot.
options.zh: 第二块土地，但不包括邻居地块中宽 10 英尺的狭长土地。

options.en: The 10-foot strip of the neighboring lot but not the second lot.
options.zh: 邻居地块中宽 10 英尺的狭长土地，但不包括第二块土地。

options.en: Both the second lot and the 10-foot strip of the neighboring lot.
options.zh: 第二块土地以及邻居地块中宽 10 英尺的狭长土地。

options.en: Neither the second lot nor the 10-foot strip of the neighboring lot.
options.zh: 既不包括第二块土地，也不包括邻居地块中宽 10 英尺的狭长土地。

explanation.en:
To acquire title to another's land by adverse possession, a person's possession of the land must be:

Open and notorious – apparent or visible to a reasonable owner Continuous – uninterrupted for the statutory period Exclusive – not shared with the owner Actual – physical presence on the portion of the land to be adversely possessed Non-permissive – hostile and adverse to the owner Here, the buyer openly planted trees and built a fence 10 feet into a neighboring lot, which excluded the neighbor from that portion of his property. And since the trees and fence have continuously remained on the neighbor's property without his permission for over 15 years (the statutory period), the buyer likely obtained title to the 10-foot strip by adverse possession.

(Choices A & C) The buyer did not acquire title to the second lot by deed because the seller had no interest to convey. Therefore, the buyer could only acquire title by adverse possession. But since the buyer merely used the second lot to hunt rabbits less often than annually (no continuous use), he did not adversely possess that lot.

(Choice D) Although the buyer did not acquire title to the second lot, he did acquire title to the 10-foot strip of the neighboring lot by adverse possession.

Educational objective:

A person may acquire title to another's land by adverse possession if his/her possession of the land is open and notorious, continuous, exclusive, actual, and non-permissive (OCEAN). However, the adverse possessor can only acquire title to the portion of the land that he/she actually occupies.

explanation.zh:
为了通过不利的占有取得他人土地的所有权,一个人对土地的占有必须是:

公开和臭名昭著,对合理拥有者来说是显而易见的 持续,在法定期限内是不间断的 唯一,没有与拥有者分享 实际,在土地部分的实际存在是有害的 不可容忍的 敌对和不利的买主公开种植树木,在邻居的地盘上建了10英尺的围栏,把邻居排除在他那部分财产之外。由于树木和栅栏未经邻居许可而持续留在邻居的地产上超过15年(法定期限),买方可能通过逆权占有方式获得了10英尺地带的所有权.

(Choices A & C)买方没有通过契约获得第二块土地货物的所有权,因为卖方没有利益可言,因此买方只能通过逆权占有获得所有权。但是,由于买方只是利用第二块土地兔子猎杀的次数比每年少(没有连续使用),因此他并不消极地拥有这批兔子。

(Choice D)虽然买方没有获得第二块土地货物的所有权,但他确实通过不利的占有方式获得了邻居地块10英尺带的所有权。

学习要点：

如果一个人对土地的拥有是公开的、臭名昭著的、持续的、排他性的、实际的和不允许的(OCEAN),他/她可以通过不利的占有方式获得对他人土地的所有权。然而,不利的拥有者只能取得他/她实际占有的那部分土地的所有权。

stem:
A seller conveyed residential land to a buyer by a warranty deed that contained no exceptions and recited that the full consideration had been paid. To finance the purchase, the buyer borrowed 80% of the necessary funds from a bank. The seller agreed to finance 15% of the purchase price, and the buyer agreed to provide cash for the remaining 5%.

At the closing, the buyer signed a promissory note to the seller for 15% of the purchase price but did not execute a mortgage. The bank knew of the loan made by the seller and of the promissory note executed by the buyer to the seller. The buyer also signed a note to the bank, secured by a mortgage, for the 80% advanced by the bank.

The buyer has now defaulted on both loans. There are no applicable statutes.
stemZh:
卖方通过一份没有例外的保修契约向买方转交了住宅用地,并宣称已经支付了全部费用,为购买融资,买方向一家银行借款了80%的必要资金。卖方同意提供15%的购货价款,买方同意提供其余5%的现金。

在结算时,买方向卖方签了一张期票,价款为购货价款的15%,但没有执行抵押,银行知道卖方的贷款和买方向卖方执行的期票。买方还为银行预付80%的抵押款签署了一份给银行的票据。

买方现在拖欠了这两项贷款,没有适用的法规。
ask: Which loan has priority?
askZh: 哪笔贷款优先?

options.en: The bank's loan, because it was secured by a purchase-money mortgage.
options.zh: 银行的贷款,因为它是以购货款抵押担保的.

options.en: The bank's loan, because the seller can finance a part of the purchase price only by use of an installment land contract.
options.zh: 银行的贷款,因为卖方只能通过分期付款土地合同为部分购价融资。

options.en: The seller's loan, because a promissory note to a seller has priority over a bank loan for residential property.
options.zh: 卖方的贷款,因为给卖方的本票优先于银行对住宅财产的贷款。

options.en: The seller's loan, because the bank knew that the seller had an equitable vendor's lien.
options.zh: 卖方的贷款,因为银行知道卖方拥有公平的卖方留置权。

explanation.en:
The seller received a promissory note—ie, a legal document that creates or memorializes a debt—but no lien or mortgage to secure the debt. But when a seller transfers title to a buyer and any portion of the purchase price remains unpaid, an equitable vendor's lien may be implied by law. Therefore, the seller may have an equitable vendor's lien, but the deed recites that the full consideration was paid.

The bank received a promissory note secured by a mortgage—ie, a lien against real property given to secure a debt. Since the mortgage was given to secure the purchase price of the mortgaged property, it is a purchase-money mortgage (PMM). PMMs have super priority over all prior liens regardless of whether the PMM or those liens are recorded. Therefore, the bank's loan has priority—regardless of whether it knew of the seller's lien (Choices C & D).

(Choice B) A seller can finance the purchase of land through several means—including a PMM, equitable vendor's lien, and installment land contract. An installment land contract is an agreement where the debtor promises to make regular installment payments until the full contract price is paid (not seen here).

Educational objective:

An equitable vendor's lien is implied by law when a seller transfers title to a buyer and any portion of the purchase price remains unpaid. In contrast, a purchase-money mortgage is created when a mortgage is given to secure the purchase price of the mortgaged property, thereby giving it super priority over all other mortgages and liens.

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 7.2 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (priority of purchase-money mortgages)

explanation.zh:
卖方收到一张本票,即一项产生或纪念债务的法律文件,但没有担保债务的留置权或抵押权。但是,当卖方将所有权转让给买方,而购买价款的任何部分仍未支付时,法律可能暗示公平卖方的留置权。 因此,卖方可能拥有公平卖方的留置权,但契约背诵已支付全部考虑。

银行收到一份以抵押作为担保的本票,即以不动产作为抵押作为担保债务的留置权,由于抵押是为了担保抵押财产的购买价款,因此是一种购货款抵押。PMM对所有先前的留置权拥有超级优先权,无论PMM还是这些留置权是否被记录下来,因此,银行的贷款具有优先权——无论它是否知道卖方的留置权(Choices C & D)。

(Choice B) 卖方可以通过几种方式,包括PMM、公平供应商的留置权和分期土地合同,为购买土地提供资金。分期付款土地合同是指债务人承诺定期支付分期付款直至支付全部合同价格的协议(此处不见)。

学习要点：

当卖方将所有权转让给买方,而购买价款的任何部分仍未支付时,法律就暗示了公平卖方的留置权。相比之下,在为担保抵押财产的购买价款而提供抵押时,设定了购货款抵押权,从而使其优先于所有其他抵押权和留置权。

参考资料

重述(第三)财产:抵押权§7.2(《1997年美国法律》)(购置款抵押的优先权)

stem:
Two friends planned to incorporate a business together and agreed that they would own all of the corporation's stock in equal proportion.

A businesswoman conveyed land by a warranty deed to "the corporation and its successors and assigns." The deed was recorded.

Thereafter, the friends had a disagreement. No papers were ever filed to incorporate the business. There is no applicable statute.
stemZh:
两个朋友计划将一家企业合并,并商定他们将以同等比例拥有公司的所有股票。

一位女商人通过一份担保契约将土地传递给“公司及其继承人和分配人”。

此后,这些朋友意见不一,从未提交过将企业并入的文件,也没有适用的法规。
ask: Who owns the land?
askZh: 谁拥有土地?

options.en: The businesswoman, because the deed was a warranty deed.
options.zh: 女商人 因为契约是担保契约

options.en: The businesswoman, because the deed was void.
options.zh: 那个女商人 因为契约是无效的

options.en: The two friends as tenants in common, because they intended to own the corporation's stock in equal proportion.
options.zh: 这两个朋友是共同的租户,因为他们打算平等地拥有公司的股票。

options.en: The two friends as tenants in common, because they were the intended sole shareholders.
options.zh: 这两个朋友是共同的租户,因为他们是预定的唯一股东。

explanation.en:
Deed requirements

Requirements Valid Invalid

A deed is a document that conveys an interest in real property from the owner (grantor) to another (grantee). But to be valid, a deed must:

be in writing and signed by the grantor identify the grantor and the grantee contain words of transfer (eg, "deed over," "transfer," "give") and describe the property interest being transferred. If the deed refers to a nonexistent grantee (eg, a corporation that has not been legally formed), the deed is void and the property interest remains with the grantor.

Here, two friends planned to incorporate a business together. But since that corporation was never legally formed, the warranty deed that purported to convey the businesswoman's land to that corporation (a nonexistent grantee) was void. Therefore, no title was conveyed and the businesswoman still owns the land.

(Choice A) A deed to a nonexistent grantee (as seen here) is void. Therefore, the type of deed (ie, general warranty, special warranty, quitclaim) that was used in the failed conveyance is irrelevant.

(Choices C & D) Since the corporation was never legally formed (nonexistent grantee), the deed was void and the businesswoman retained ownership of the land. But had the corporation been legally formed, the property would have been owned by the corporation—not the two friends as tenants in common. Therefore, the two friends' intent to own the corporation's stock in equal proportion and be the sole shareholders is immaterial.

Educational objective:

A deed must (1) be in writing and signed by the grantor, (2) identify the grantor and the grantee, (3) contain words of transfer, and (4) describe the property interest being transferred. Therefore, a deed to a nonexistent grantee (eg, a corporation that has not been legally formed) is void.

stem:
A man borrowed money from a lender and mortgaged land that he owned to secure repayment of the loan. Before he had completely repaid the loan, the man conveyed the land to an investor, who expressly assumed the loan. The note and mortgage did not contain a due-on-sale clause.

After the investor had made several payments on the loan, she defaulted on two payments. The lender notified the man and the investor of its intention to accelerate the loan pursuant to the terms of the note and mortgage unless the default was cured within 60 days. When neither the man nor the investor made the required payment, the lender accelerated the loan and initiated foreclosure proceedings, naming both the man and the investor as party defendants. The foreclosure sale resulted in a deficiency. The lender has sought a deficiency judgment against only the man, because the investor has become insolvent in the meantime.

投资方多次支付贷款后,她两次违约,放款人通知男方和被投资方打算按照票据和抵押条件加快贷款,除非在60天内解决违约.当男方或投资方都没有按规定付款时,放款人加快贷款并启动赎回程序,将男方和投资方都命名为当事人被告. 赎回权的出售造成了缺陷.贷款人只寻求对男方作出不足额判决,因为投资者在此期间已经破产。
ask: Will the court likely find the man liable for the deficiency?

options.en: No, because the investor's express assumption of the loan released the man from liability.
options.zh: 不,因为投资人对贷款的明确假设 免除了他的责任。

options.en: No, because the lender must first seek to obtain a deficiency judgment against the investor.
options.zh: 否,因为放款人必须首先寻求获得对投资者的不足额判决。

options.en: Yes, because even after the assumption, the man remains liable as a surety of the investor in the absence of a release from the lender.
options.zh: 是的,因为即使在假设之后,在没有放款人释放的情况下,此人仍作为投资者的担保人承担责任。

options.en: Yes, because the note and mortgage did not contain a due-on-sale clause.
options.zh: 是的,因为纸币和抵押贷款没有 包含一个到期售后条款。

explanation.en:
A mortgage is an interest in real property given to a lender (mortgagee) to secure a debt. The debtor (mortgagor) can freely transfer mortgaged property to a grantee unless the mortgage states otherwise. After the transfer, the mortgage remains attached to the property and the debtor remains personally liable for the mortgage debt. But the grantee will become liable for the debt only if the grantee expressly agrees to assume the mortgage.

Assumption of a mortgage makes the grantee primarily liable for the debt and the debtor secondarily liable as a surety in the absence of a release from the lender (Choice A). This means a lender can sue the grantee, the debtor, or both for any deficiency resulting from a foreclosure sale (Choice B). If the debtor pays any amount of the deficiency, the debtor can seek reimbursement from the grantee.

(Choice D) A due-on-sale clause allows a lender to demand full payment of the remaining mortgage debt if the debtor sells the mortgaged property without the lender's permission. However, this type of clause (or the absence thereof) does not affect the debtor's liability to the lender for a deficiency judgment after a foreclosure sale.

Educational objective:

A grantee who assumes a mortgage is primarily responsible for a deficiency from a foreclosure sale, and the debtor is secondarily liable as a surety in the absence of a release from the lender. The lender can sue the grantee, the debtor, or both to recover the deficiency amount, and the debtor can seek reimbursement from the grantee.

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 5.1 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (assumption of a mortgage).

55 Am. Jur. 2d Mortgages § 967 (2019) (deficiency judgments).

抵押是给予出贷人(抵押人)以担保债务的不动产权益,债务人(抵押人)可以自由将抵押财产转让给受赠人,除非抵押人另有说明。转让后,抵押权仍附属于财产,债务人仍对抵押债务负个人责任,但只有在受赠方明确同意承担抵押权时,受赠方才对债务承担责任.

抵押的假设使受赠方对债务负主要责任,债务人在放款人不解除担保的情况下承担第二责任(选择A)。这意味着放款人可以就取消赎回权出售(Choice B)造成的任何不足向受赠人、债务人或两者起诉。 如果债务人支付任何差额,债务人可以要求受赠人偿还。

(Choice D)到期售出条款允许放款人要求全额偿还剩余抵押债务,如果债务人未经放款人许可出售抵押财产.然而,这类条款(或无此条款)不影响债务人在取消赎回权出售后对出贷人作出不足判决而承担的赔偿责任。

学习要点：

承担抵押权的受赠人对取消赎回权出售的不足负有主要责任,债务人在放款人不解除抵押权的情况下作为担保人承担第二责任。出贷人可以起诉受赠人,债务人,也可以同时起诉两者,以收回差额金额,债务人可以向受赠人寻求偿还.

stem: When a homeowner became ill, he properly executed a deed sufficient to convey his home to his nephew, who was then serving overseas in the military. Two persons signed as witnesses to qualify the deed for recording under an applicable statute. The homeowner handed the deed to his nephew's friend and said to her, "I want [the nephew] to have my home. Please take this deed for him." Shortly thereafter, the nephew's friend learned that the homeowner's death was imminent. One day before the homeowner's death, the nephew's friend recorded the deed. The nephew returned home shortly after the homeowner's death, learned about the deed, and took possession of the home. The homeowner had died intestate, leaving a daughter as his sole heir. When she asserted ownership of the home, the nephew brought an appropriate action against her to determine title. The law of the jurisdiction requires only two witnesses for a will to be properly executed.
stemZh: 当房主生病时,他正确地执行了一份足以将他的住所传给当时在海外服役的侄子的契约,两人作为证人签字,使契约有资格根据适用的法规进行记录。房主将地契交给了侄子的朋友,并对她说:"我要[侄子]有我的家,请你代他收下这个地契",不久,侄子的朋友得知房主的死迫在眉睫.房主去世前一天,侄子的好友记录了契据,房主去世后不久,侄子回家,得知契据,就占有了房屋,房主去世时没有遗嘱,留下了一个女儿作为唯一的继承人.当她声称拥有该住宅时,该侄子对她提起了适当的诉讼,以确定所有权,根据管辖法,只有两名证人才能适当执行遗嘱。
ask: If the court rules for the nephew and against the daughter, what will be the most likely explanation?
askZh: 如果朝廷为侄子和女儿裁决,那最可能的解释是什么?

options.en: The deed was delivered when the homeowner handed it to the nephew's friend.
options.zh: 地契是房主交给外甥朋友时交付的.

options.en: The delivery of the deed was accomplished by the recording of the deed.
options.zh: 契约的交付是通过契约记录完成的.

options.en: The homeowner's death consummated a valid gift causa mortis to the nephew.
options.zh: 房主的去世 给侄子一个有效的礼物

options.en: The homeowner's properly executed deed was effective as a testamentary document.
options.zh: 房主妥善执行的契约作为遗嘱文件有效.

explanation.en:
A deed is a legal instrument that transfers ownership of real property from the owner (grantor) to another (grantee). But to be effective, the deed must be:

delivered by the grantor – evidenced by the grantor's present intent to convey ownership to the grantee and accepted by the grantee – presumed if the transfer is beneficial to the grantee. Delivery is presumed when the deed has been recorded or is in the grantee's possession. Delivery also occurs when the deed is physically handed to the grantee's agent—ie, a third party acting on behalf of the grantee.

Here, the homeowner properly executed a deed conveying his home to the nephew. Since that transfer benefited the nephew, acceptance is presumed. Therefore, if the court rules in favor of the nephew, the most likely explanation is that the deed was delivered when the homeowner handed it to the nephew's friend (agent) and told her to take it on the nephew's behalf.

(Choice B) Recording a deed (ie, filing it in official land records) creates a presumption of delivery. But here, delivery occurred when the homeowner handed the deed to the nephew's friend, which happened before the deed was recorded.

(Choice C) A gift causa mortis (ie, deathbed gift) is a gift of personal property made in expectation of the grantor's imminent death. Here, the homeowner gifted real property (his home) to the nephew. And this gift was not made in expectation of imminent death since the homeowner's death became imminent after he delivered the deed.

(Choice D) A deed requires the grantor's present intent to convey ownership to the grantee—ie, the grantor must intend that title transfer immediately. And since a testamentary document (eg, a will or testament) only takes effect upon the testator's death (no intent to presently transfer), a deed cannot serve as a testamentary document.

Educational objective:

To effectively transfer an interest in real property, a deed must be (1) delivered by the grantor and (2) accepted by the grantee. The grantor can deliver the deed by handing it to the grantee's agent.

References

Restatement (Second) of Property: Donative Transfers § 32.3 (Am. Law Inst. 1992) (transfer relating to land).

stem:
A landowner mortgaged her land to a nationally chartered bank as security for a loan. The mortgage provided that the bank could, at its option, declare the entire loan due and payable if all or any part of the land, or an interest therein, was sold or transferred without the bank's prior written consent.

Subsequently, the landowner wanted to sell the land to a neighbor by an installment land contract, but the bank refused to consent. The neighbor's credit was good, and all mortgage payments to the bank were fully current.

The landowner and the neighbor consulted an attorney about their proposed transaction, their desire to complete it, and the bank's refusal to consent.
stemZh:
地主将她的土地抵押给一家国家租借银行作为贷款担保,条件是,如果全部或部分土地或其中的利息被出售或转让,银行可以自行宣布全部到期和应付款的贷款。未经银行事先书面同意。

随后,地主希望通过分期付款土地合同将土地出售给邻居,但银行拒绝同意,邻居的信贷很好,所有向银行的抵押付款都是按时支付的.

地主和邻居就他们提出的交易,他们完成交易的愿望,以及银行拒绝同意等问题咨询了一名律师.
ask: What would the attorney's best advice be?
askZh: 律师的最佳建议是什么?

options.en: By making the transfer in land contract form, the landowner will prevent enforcement of the due-on-sale clause if the mortgage payments are kept current.
options.zh: 通过以土地合同形式进行转让,如果抵押付款保持不变,土地所有者将阻止执行到期出售条款。

options.en: Even if the landowner transfers to the neighbor by land contract, the bank may accelerate the debt and foreclose if the full amount is not paid.
options.zh: 即使土地所有者通过土地合同向邻居转移,如果未全额支付,银行也可能加速债务和赎回.

options.en: The due-on-sale clause is void as an illegal restraint on alienation of the fee simple, so they may proceed.
options.zh: 到期出售条款无效,因为它是对简单转让费用的非法限制,因此可以继续进行。

options.en: The only effect of the due-on-sale clause is that the proposed transfer will automatically make the neighbor personally liable on the debt, whether or not the neighbor specifically agrees to assume it.
options.zh: 到期售后条款的唯一效果是,拟议的转让将自动使邻居对债务负个人责任,无论邻居是否具体同意承担债务.

explanation.en:
Common mortgage provisions

Acceleration clause Allows creditor to demand entire loan due & payable if debtor defaults

Due-on-sale clause Allows creditor to demand entire loan due & payable if debtor sells mortgaged property without permission

Due-on-encumbrance clause Allows creditor to accelerate mortgage obligation if debtor obtains second mortgage or otherwise encumbers property

Defeasance clause Requires creditor to give debtor legal title to property & release mortgage lien once all payments are made

Mortgage documents are used to convey a lender an interest in real property to secure debt. These documents may contain a due-on-sale clause, which allows the lender to demand full payment of the remaining mortgage debt if the debtor transfers the mortgaged property without the lender's consent. If the debtor is unable to pay, the lender can bring a foreclosure action to force the sale of the property to satisfy any remaining debt.

Here, the landowner seeks to transfer the mortgaged property to the neighbor through an installment land contract without the bank's consent. However, the method used to transfer the mortgaged property has no effect on the enforceability of a due-on-sale clause—even if mortgage payments are kept current (Choice A). The attorney should therefore advise the parties that the bank may accelerate the debt and foreclose if the full amount is not paid.

(Choice C) Due-on-sale clauses are restraints on alienation because they restrict a debtor's ability to transfer the mortgaged property. However, these restraints are considered reasonable and can be challenged only if the lender engaged in unconscionable conduct when exercising the clause.

(Choice D) Under the due-on-sale clause, the unauthorized transfer will make the landowner personally liable on the debt, but it would make the neighbor liable only if he specifically agreed to assume it.

Educational objective:

A due-on-sale clause allows a lender to demand full payment of the remaining mortgage debt if the debtor transfers the mortgaged property without permission. If the debtor is unable to pay, the lender may bring a foreclosure action to force the sale of the property to satisfy any remaining debt.

References

55 Am. Jur. 2d Mortgages § 415 (2019) (due-on-sale clauses).

Rustic Hills Shopping Plaza, Inc. v. Columbia Sav. & Loan Ass'n, 661 P.2d 254, 256–57 (Colo. 1983) (holding that the unauthorized transfer of mortgaged property by an installment land contract triggered the due-on-sale clause).

explanation.zh:
共同抵押规定

加速条款允许债权人在债务人违约时要求全部到期和应付贷款

到期出售条款允许债权人在债务人擅自出售抵押财产时要求获得到期应付的全部贷款

到期抵押条款允许债权人在债务人获得第二次抵押或以其他方式抵押财产时加快抵押债务

违约条款要求债权人在所有付款后给予债务人对财产的合法所有权并解除抵押留置权。

抵押贷款文件用于向放款人传达不动产权益以担保债务,这些文件可能包含一项到期售后条款,允许放款人要求全额偿付剩余抵押债务,如果债务人转让抵押财产.如果债务人无力付款,放款人可以提起取消赎回权诉讼,强迫出售财产以清偿任何剩余债务。

在此,地主寻求通过未经银行同意的分期付款土地合同将抵押财产转让给邻居.然而,转让抵押财产所使用的方法对到期出售条款的可执行性没有影响,即使抵押付款保持经常(选择A)。因此,律师应通知当事人,如果未全额支付债务,银行可以加速债务和赎回.

(选择C)到期出售条款是对转让的限制,因为它们限制了债务人转让抵押财产的能力。然而,这些限制被认为是合理的,只有在放款人在行使该条款时采取不合理的行为时才能提出质疑。

(Choice D) 根据售后到期条款,未经授权的转让将让土地所有者亲自对债务承担责任,但只有邻居明确同意承担债务,它才会让邻居承担责任.

学习要点：

到期售后条款允许放款人在债务人擅自转让抵押财产时要求全额偿还剩余抵押债务.如果债务人无力偿付,放款人可以提起取消赎回权诉讼,迫使出售财产清偿任何剩余债务。

参考资料

55 Am. Jur. 2d 抵押权第415条(2019年)(到期售后条款)。

Rustic Hills购物广场有限公司诉Columbia Sav. & League Ass'n案,661 P.2d 254,256–57 (Colo. 1983) (认为通过分期付款土地合同擅自转让抵押财产触发了到期出售条款).

stem:
A man who owned property in fee simple mortgaged the property to a bank to secure a loan of $100,000. The mortgage was promptly and properly recorded. The man later mortgaged the property to his mother to secure a loan of $50,000. This mortgage was also promptly and properly recorded. Subsequently, the man conveyed the property to a purchaser. About a year later, the purchaser borrowed $100,000 from an elderly widow and gave her a mortgage on the property to secure repayment of the loan. The widow did not know about the mortgage held by the mother. The understanding between the purchaser and the widow was that the purchaser would use the $100,000 to pay off the mortgage held by the bank and that the widow would therefore have a first mortgage on the property. The widow's mortgage was promptly and properly recorded. The purchaser paid the $100,000 received from the widow to the bank and obtained and recorded a release of the bank's mortgage.

The $50,000 debt secured by the mother's mortgage was not paid when it was due, and the mother brought an appropriate action to foreclose, joining the man, the purchaser, and the widow as defendants and alleging that the mother's mortgage was senior to the widow's mortgage on the property.
stemZh:
以收费方式拥有财产的男子将财产抵押给一家银行,以获得10万美元的贷款,并迅速和适当地记录了抵押情况,男子后来将财产抵押给母亲,以获得5万美元的贷款。随后,该男子将房产转给了购买者,大约一年后,购买者向一位老年寡妇借款10万美元,并给了她房产抵押贷款,以保证贷款的偿还。寡妇不知道母亲持有的抵押权,购买者与寡妇之间的理解是,购买者将使用10万美元来还清银行持有的抵押权,因此,寡妇将第一次抵押给寡妇。寡妇的抵押被迅速和适当地记录下来。购买者向银行支付了寡妇收到的10万美元,并获得并记录了释放银行的抵押贷款。

母房抵押担保的5万美元债务到期后未还清,母房提出适当诉讼赎回,与男方,购买方,遗孀合为被告,并称母房抵押权高于遗孀.财产抵押。
ask: If the court rules that the widow's mortgage is entitled to priority over the mother's mortgage, which of the following determinations are necessary to support that ruling?
askZh: 如果法院裁定寡妇的抵押有权优先于母亲的抵押,那么为支持这一裁决,下列哪些决定是必要的?

options.en: The bank's mortgage was originally senior to the mother's mortgage.
options.zh: 银行的抵押贷款最初是母亲的抵押贷款的高级贷款.

options.en: The widow is entitled to have the bank's mortgage revived for her benefit, and the widow is entitled to be subrogated to the bank's original position as senior mortgagee.
options.zh: 寡妇有权为她的利益恢复银行的抵押权,寡妇有权被取代银行作为高级抵押权人的原有地位。

options.en: There are no countervailing equities in favor of the mother.
options.zh: 没有有利于母亲的反补贴股票。

options.en: All of the above.
options.zh: 以上诸法.

explanation.en:
Lien priority is generally determined by who records first (ie, first in time, first in right). However, subrogation allows a third party who fully pays off a senior mortgage to take that senior mortgage's priority so long as the third party had no actual knowledge of junior interests.* This does not harm junior interests because they retain the same lien priority.

Here, the bank's mortgage was recorded first, so it had priority over the mother's mortgage. The widow's mortgage was recorded last. However, the widow's loan was used to fully pay off the bank's senior mortgage, and the widow did not know about the mother's mortgage. As a result, the widow acquired the bank's senior mortgage through subrogation. Also, there are no equities in the mother's favor because she has retained her second-in-priority status (Choices A, B & C).

*In a minority of jurisdictions, record notice is also sufficient to preclude subrogation.

Educational objective:

Subrogation allows a third party to take a senior mortgage's priority when the third party (1) fully pays off the senior mortgage and (2) has no actual knowledge of junior interests.

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 7.6 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (doctrine of subrogation).

留置权优先权一般由谁先记录(即,及时第一,右侧第一)来确定,但是,如果第三方实际不知道,代位权允许完全偿还高级抵押权的第三方取得该高级抵押权优先权。初级利益。 * 这不影响初级利益,因为他们保留同样的留置优先权。

在这里,银行的抵押贷款首先被记录下来,因此它优先于母亲的抵押贷款,寡妇的抵押贷款最后被记录下来,然而寡妇的贷款被用来完全还清银行的高级抵押贷款,寡妇不知道母亲的抵押贷款.因此,寡妇通过代位取得银行的高级抵押贷款,此外,由于她保留了第二优先的地位(Choices A, B & C),因此没有股票有利于母亲.

* 在少数法域,记录通知也足以排除代位。

学习要点：

代位让第三方在第三人(1)完全付清高级抵押时,可以取得高级抵押的优先权,(2)对初级利益没有实际了解.

sourceSetLabel: 不动产法 · 第 1 组
stem:
A mother executed a will devising vacant land to her son. The mother showed the will to her son.

Thereafter, the son purported to convey the land to a friend by a warranty deed that contained no exceptions. The friend paid value for the land and promptly recorded the deed without having first conducted any title search. The friend never took possession of the land.

The mother later died, and the will devising the land to her son was duly admitted to probate.

Thereafter, the friend conducted a title search for the land and asked the son for a new deed. The son refused, because the value of the land had doubled, but he offered to refund the purchase price to the friend.

The friend has sued to quiet title to the land.
stemZh:
母亲将遗嘱交给她儿子,母亲将遗嘱交给她儿子。

其后,他的儿子想通过一份没有例外的担保契约将土地传给朋友,朋友为土地支付了价值,并迅速记录了契约,但没有事先搜查任何产权,朋友从未拥有过土地。

母亲后来去世,为儿子设计土地的遗嘱被正式承认为遗嘱.

此后,这位朋友对土地进行了产权搜查,向儿子索要了新的契据,儿子拒绝了,因为土地的价值翻了一番,但他主动提出将购买价款退还给这位朋友.

那个朋友起诉 要求安静地拥有土地
ask: Is the friend likely to prevail?
askZh: 那个朋友有可能胜诉吗?

options.en: No, because the son had no interest in the land at the time of conveyance.
options.zh: 不,因为儿子在运输时对土地没有兴趣.

options.en: No, because the son offered to refund the purchase price.
options.zh: 不,因为儿子提出要退货

options.en: Yes, because of the doctrine of estoppel by deed.
options.zh: 是的,因为不容反悔的理论 通过行动。

options.en: Yes, because the deed was recorded.
options.zh: 是的,因为契约被记录下来了

explanation.en:
The doctrine of estoppel by deed (ie, after-acquired title) applies when a grantor conveys property to a grantee by warranty deed—not quitclaim deed—before the grantor has acquired title to that property. And once the grantor receives title, this doctrine will cause it to automatically transfer to the grantee. The grantee can then accept that transfer or reject it (and sue for damages).

Here, the son conveyed the land to a friend by a warranty deed before the son acquired title under his mother's will. But since the son received title when his mother later died, that title automatically transferred to the friend (Choice A). And since the friend accepted that transfer by suing to quiet title to the land, the friend will likely prevail because of the doctrine of estoppel by deed.

(Choice B) Although the son offered to refund the purchase price, the friend was not required to accept it. Instead, the friend chose to accept title to the land by suing to quiet title—not to recover damages.

(Choice D) Although the friend recorded the deed, this would only protect the friend from subsequent ownership claims. And since the son acquired title to the land before it automatically transferred to the friend, the recording would not protect against the son's earlier ownership claim.

Educational objective:

The doctrine of estoppel by deed applies when a grantor conveys property by warranty deed before acquiring title to that property. And once the grantor receives title, it will automatically transfer to the earlier grantee who can then accept or reject the transfer.

References

23 Am. Jur. 2d Deeds § 278 (2018) (estoppel by deed).

explanation.zh:
以契约方式(即事后取得的所有权)禁止反悔的原则适用于设保人在取得对财产的所有权之前,通过保修契约而不是放弃求偿契约向受赠人转让财产的情况。一旦设保人获得所有权,这一学说将使其自动转让给受赠人。 受赠人然后可以接受转让或拒绝转让(并起诉损害赔偿 ) 。

在此,儿子在儿子根据母亲的意愿获得所有权之前,通过一份保修契约将土地传给了一位朋友,但由于儿子在母亲后来去世时获得了所有权,该所有权自动转移给了朋友(Choice A)。由于这位朋友通过对土地的静默所有权提起诉讼而接受这项转让,由于通过行动禁止反悔的学说,这位朋友很可能占上风。

虽然儿子提出退还购货价款,但朋友不必接受,而选择接受土地的所有权,向安静的产权提起诉讼,而不是要求赔偿损失。

(Choice D)虽然这位朋友记录了契约,但这只会保护这位朋友免于后续的所有权主张.而由于儿子在土地自动转让给朋友之前就获得了土地的所有权,所以录音并不能抵挡儿子早先的所有权要求.

学习要点：

以契约方式禁止反悔的原则适用于设保人在取得财产所有权之前通过担保契约转让财产的情况,设保人一旦获得所有权,将自动转让给可以接受或拒绝转让的先行受赠人。

参考资料

23 Am. Jur. 2d Deds §278(2018)(契约委托书)。

stem:
A businessman executed a promissory note for $200,000 to a bank, secured by a mortgage on commercial real estate owned by the businessman. The promissory note stated that the businessman was not personally liable for the mortgage debt.

One week later, a finance company obtained a judgment against the businessman for $50,000 and filed the judgment in the county where the real estate was located. At the time the judgment was filed, the finance company had no actual notice of the bank's mortgage.

Two weeks after that filing, the bank recorded its mortgage on the businessman's real estate.

The recording act of the jurisdiction provides: "Unless the same be recorded according to law, no conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value and without notice or against judgment creditors without notice."

The finance company sued to enforce its judgment lien against the businessman's real estate. The bank intervened in the action, contending that the judgment lien was a second lien on the real estate and that its mortgage was a first lien.
stemZh:
一名商人向一家银行支付了20万美元的本票,以该商人所拥有的商业房地产抵押为担保,本票上写明该商人对抵押债务不负个人责任.

一周后,一家金融公司以5万美元获得了对这名商人的判决,并在房地产所在地的县立法院立案,在判决提交时,该金融公司并没有实际通知银行的抵押.

备案两周后,银行记录了对商人房地产的抵押.

辖区的录制行为规定:"除非依法记录同一情况,否则不动产的转让或抵押不得因价值而对后继购买人有利,无须通知,也不对判决胜诉债权人有利,无须通知".

金融公司提起诉讼,强制执行其对商人房地产的留置权判决,银行介入诉讼,辩称该判决留置权是房地产的第二留置权,其抵押权是第一留置权.
ask: Is the bank's contention correct?
askZh: 银行的论点正确吗?

options.en: No, because the businessman was not personally liable for the mortgage debt, and the mortgage was therefore void.
options.zh: 不,因为商人对抵押债务不负个人责任,因此抵押无效.

options.en: No, because the judgment lien was recorded before the mortgage, and the finance company had no actual notice of the mortgage.
options.zh: 不,因为判决留置权是在抵押之前记录的,而金融公司并没有实际的抵押通知.

options.en: Yes, because a mortgage prior in time has priority over a subsequent judgment lien.
options.zh: 是的,因为先前的抵押优先于随后的判决留置权。

options.en: Yes, because the recording of a mortgage relates back to the date of execution of the mortgage note.
options.zh: 是的,因为抵押权的记录 追溯到抵押书的执行日期。

explanation.en:
The priority of mortgages and other liens is generally determined by their recording dates—not by the order in which those interests were created (Choices C & D). Purchase-money mortgages (PMMs), however, have super priority over all other liens—whether or

not the PMM or those liens are recorded—because PMMs secure the purchase price of the mortgaged property.

Here, the businessman mortgaged commercial real estate he already owned to the bank (not a PMM). One week later, the finance company filed a judgment lien against the real estate in a jurisdiction whose recording act expressly protects judgment creditors who lack notice.* Since the judgment lien was recorded before the mortgage, the finance company lacked constructive (ie, record or inquiry) notice. Therefore, the judgment lien has first priority because the finance company also lacked actual notice of the bank's prior mortgage.

*Most recording acts protect only subsequent purchasers for value who lack notice of prior competing interests in the property—not judgment creditors since they do not pay value for an interest in the property.

(Choice A) A mortgage is enforceable even if no one is personally liable for payment of the mortgage debt.

Educational objective:

The priority of mortgages (and other liens) is generally determined by the order of recording unless the mortgage enjoys super priority as a purchase-money mortgage.

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 7.1 cmt. a (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (noting that recording acts may alter the priority of mortgages differently than their chronological creation).

explanation.zh:
抵押权和其他留置权的优先权一般取决于其记录日期,而不是这些权益的设定顺序(Choices C & D)。

不记录PMM或这些留置权,因为PMM保证了抵押财产的购买价格。

在这里,商人将他已经拥有的商业房地产抵押给银行(不是PMM ) 。 一周后,金融公司对一个法域的房地产提出了留置权判决,该法域的记录行为明确保护那些缺乏判决权的债权人。* 由于判决留置权是在抵押贷款之前记录的,因此金融公司缺乏建设性(即记录或查询)通知,因此判决留置权具有第一优先权,因为金融公司也缺乏银行先前抵押的实际通知。

* 多数记录行为只保护没有事先通知财产中相竞权益的后继购买人的价值,而不是判决胜诉的债权人,因为他们不支付财产中某一权益的价值。

(Choice A) 即使无人对抵押债务的偿付负有个人责任,抵押权也可以强制执行.

学习要点：

抵押(和其他留置权)的优先权一般由记录顺序决定,除非抵押作为购货款抵押享有超级优先权.

参考资料

重述(第三)财产:抵押权§7.1 cmt. a (Am. Law Inst. 1997)(指出记录行为可能改变抵押权的优先权,而改变抵押权的时间顺序设定)。

stem:
Eight years ago, a farmer, prior to moving to a distant city, conveyed his farm to his son by a quitclaim deed. The son paid no consideration. The son, who was 19 years old, without formal education, and without experience in business, took possession of the farm and operated the farm but neglected to record his deed. Subsequently, the farmer conveyed the farm to a friend by warranty deed. The friend, a substantial land and timber promoter, paid valuable consideration for the deed to him. He was unaware of the son's possession, his quitclaim deed, or his relationship to the farmer. The friend promptly and properly recorded his deed and began removing timber from the land. Immediately upon learning of the friend's actions, the son recorded his deed and brought an appropriate action to enjoin the friend from removing the timber and to quiet title in the son.

The recording act of the jurisdiction provides: "No conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value and without notice unless the same be recorded according to law."
stemZh:
八年前,一个农民,在迁居到一个遥远的城市之前,通过一份退耕还田的契约将他的农场传给儿子,儿子没有考虑.儿子19岁,没有受过正规教育,没有经商经验,他占有农场,经营农场,但忽略了记录他的地契,后来,农民通过担保地契将农场传给朋友。这名朋友是一块大片土地和木材的推销员,他为这份契约付出了宝贵的代价,他不知道儿子的地产、退货契约或他与农民的关系。这名朋友迅速和正确地记录了他的契约,并开始清除土地上的木材。得知朋友的行为后,儿子立即记录了他的行踪,并提起适当的诉讼,命令朋友从清除木材到安静的头衔那个儿子

辖区的录制行为规定:"不动产的转让或者抵押,不得对后继购买人进行价值优待,未经通知,除非依法予以记录.
ask: In this action, should the friend prevail?
askZh: 在这项行动中,朋友是否应该获胜?

options.en: No, because the equities favor the son.
options.zh: 不,因为股票喜欢儿子。

options.en: No, because the son's possession charged the friend with notice.
options.zh: 不,因为儿子的拥有 指控朋友注意。

options.en: Yes, because a warranty deed for valuable consideration takes priority over a quitclaim deed without consideration.
options.zh: 是的,因为一份值得考虑的担保书 优先于不考虑的退赔书。

options.en: Yes, because the farmer's subsequent conveyance to the friend revoked the gift to the son.
options.zh: 是的,因为农民后来给朋友的礼物 取消了给儿子的礼物。

explanation.en:
Recording acts are used to evaluate the priority of competing property interests. In a notice jurisdiction (as seen here), a bona fide purchaser's (BFP's) property interest has priority over an earlier property interest if the BFP lacked notice.

Here, the farmer gifted his farm to his son. The farmer then sold the farm to his friend. The friend was unaware of the son's prior interest when he purchased the farm (no actual notice), and the son had not recorded his deed at that time (no record notice). But since the son possessed and operated the farm, the friend was charged with inquiry notice of the son's prior interest. Therefore, the son's interest has priority and the friend will not prevail in the quiet title action.

(Choice A) The equities (ie, fairness factors) may favor the son since he was only 19 years old, lacked a formal education, and had no experience in acquiring property. But this information is irrelevant in determining whether his interest or the friend's has priority.

(Choice C) In a notice jurisdiction, a warranty deed for valuable consideration (eg, the friend's deed) only has priority over an earlier quitclaim deed without consideration (eg, the son's deed) if the recipient of the warranty deed lacked notice. Here, the friend had inquiry notice of the son's interest, so the friend will not prevail.

(Choice D) A gift of land is effective once it has been delivered by the grantor and accepted by the grantee (eg, the son). The grantor's subsequent conveyance of the land to a third party (eg, the friend) does not revoke the prior gift. Therefore, the friend will not prevail on this basis.

Educational objective:

In a notice jurisdiction, a bona fide purchaser without notice of an earlier property interest will prevail. Inquiry notice exists if a buyer knows, or should know, of circumstances that would prompt a reasonable person to investigate (eg, visible use of the property).

explanation.zh:
记录行为用于评价竞合财产权益的优先权,在通知法域(如此处所示),善意购买人的财产权益比早先的财产权益优先,如果该财产权益未发出通知。

此处,农民将他的农场送给儿子,然后农民将农场卖给了朋友,朋友在儿子购买农场时(没有实际通知)并不知道儿子之前的利害关系,儿子当时没有记录他的契据(没有记录通知).但是由于儿子拥有并经营农场,所以他的朋友被责成调查儿子先前的利害关系,因此,儿子的利益具有优先权,朋友不会在安静的产权诉讼中占上风.

(Choice A) 股票(e, 公平因素)可能从儿子年仅19岁起就对他有利,缺乏正规教育,也没有获得财产的经验。 但这种信息对于确定他的利益或朋友的优先权无关紧要。

(Choice C)在一个通知法域中,如果保修契约的接受人缺乏通知,则需要贵重考虑的保修契约(如朋友的契约)只有在没有考虑的情况下,才优先于早先的退赔契约(如儿子的契约).在这里,朋友有询问通知 儿子的利益,所以朋友不会胜诉。

(Choice D) 土地赠与经出让人交付并被出让人(如儿子)接受后即生效,出让人随后将土地转让给第三方(如朋友)并不撤销先前的赠与.因此,朋友不会因此获胜。

学习要点：

在通知法域中,善意买受人在不事先通知财产权益的情况下优先,如果买受人知道或应当知道会促使有理智的人进行调查的情况(例如财产的明显用途),则存在调查通知。

stem: A brother and sister owned in fee simple a large piece of property as tenants in common, each owning an undivided one-half interest. The brother and sister joined in mortgaging the property to their cousin by a properly recorded mortgage that contained a general warranty clause. The brother became disenchanted with land-owning and notified the sister that he would no longer contribute to the payment of installments due to the cousin. After the mortgage was in default and the cousin made demand for payment of the entire amount of principal and interest due, the sister tendered to the cousin, and the cousin deposited, a check for one-half of the amount due to the cousin. The sister then demanded a release of her undivided one-half interest. The cousin refused to release any interest in the property. The sister promptly brought an action against the cousin to quiet title to an undivided one-half interest in the property.
stemZh: 一个兄弟和姐妹在收费中拥有一个简单的大块财产,作为共同的租户,各自拥有一个不可分割的半个权益.该兄弟和姐妹通过载有一般担保条款的有适当记录的抵押,共同将财产抵押给他们的堂兄弟。该兄弟对拥有土地变得不感兴趣,并通知该姐妹,他不再向该堂兄弟支付分期付款。抵押贷款违约,堂兄弟要求支付全部到期本金和利息后,妹妹向堂兄弟招标,堂兄弟存了欠堂兄弟一半的支票.姐姐随后要求解除她未分割的一半权益,堂兄弟拒绝解除对该财产的任何权益,妹妹立即对堂兄弟提起诉讼,要求安静地拥有该财产未分割的一半权益。
ask: In such action, should the sister win or lose?
askZh: 在这样的行动中,妹妹是赢还是输?

options.en: Lose, because the cousin's title had been warranted by an express provision of the mortgage.
options.zh: 败诉,因为堂兄弟的头衔是因抵押权的一项明文规定而有理由的。

options.en: Lose, because there was no redemption from the mortgage.
options.zh: 输了,因为没有赎回抵押贷款。

options.en: Win, because the co-tenancy of the mortgagors was in common and not joint.
options.zh: 胜,因为抵押者的共同租借是共同的而不是共同的.

options.en: Win, because the sister is entitled to marshalling.
options.zh: 赢,因为妹妹有权召集

explanation.en:
Right of redemption

(regaining title after default on loan)

Timing Assertion of right

Equitable right

(always exists)

At any time prior to foreclosure sale Pay full amount of debt due (including interest) to lender

Statutory right

(if statute exists)

Statutory period after property has been sold in foreclosure

Pay foreclosure sale price to purchasing party

Tenants who jointly mortgage co-owned property are responsible for repaying that debt in proportion to their respective ownership interests (unless they agree otherwise). If the mortgage goes into default, any tenant can avoid foreclosure by exercising the equitable right of redemption. This right allows a tenant to cure the default by paying the full amount of the outstanding debt—including any amount owed by the other tenants. The paying tenant can then seek contribution (ie, reimbursement) from the other tenants for their share of the debt.

Here, the brother and sister (tenants in common) jointly mortgaged their property to the cousin. When the brother stopped paying his share of the debt, the mortgage went into default. And though the sister tried to redeem her one-half interest in the property by paying half the amount due, she could only cure the default by paying the full amount due. Therefore, there was no redemption from the mortgage, and the sister's quiet title action will fail.

(Choice A) A general warranty clause in a mortgage (as in a deed) promises that title is free of any encumbrances or defects. Although this guarantees that the cousin will acquire clear title upon foreclosure, it does not extinguish the sister's right to redeem the property.

(Choice C) The sister had to pay the full amount of the debt to redeem the property, regardless of whether she was a tenant in common or joint tenant.

(Choice D) Marshalling applies when (1) a senior creditor has a security interest in multiple assets and (2) a junior creditor has an interest in one of those assets. It requires the senior creditor to first foreclose on the asset against which it holds an exclusive security

interest to preserve the junior creditor's interest in the remaining asset. But since this case only involves one security interest (the mortgage), marshalling does not apply.

Educational objective:

The equitable right of redemption allows a debtor to avoid foreclosure by paying the full amount of the outstanding debt. This means that a tenant can only redeem co-owned property by paying the amount owed by all tenants.

References

55 Am. Jur. 2d Mortgages § 392 (2018) (common law right of redemption).

explanation.zh:
赎 赎 权

(贷款违约后取得所有权)

B. 行使权利的时间

平等权利

(永远存在)

在取消赎回权出售之前的任何时候,向放款人全额偿还所欠债务(包括利息)

法定权利

(如果有法规)

财产出售后的法定期限

向购买方支付赎回权销售价格

共同抵押共有财产的承租人负责按照各自所有者权益的比例偿还该债务(除非他们另有约定)。如果抵押贷款违约,任何房客都可以通过行使平等的赎回权来避免赎回权,这项权利允许房客通过全额偿付未偿债务——包括其他房客所欠的任何款项——来弥补违约。付款的房客然后可以要求其他房客为其债务份额缴款(即偿还)。

在这里,兄妹(共同的租户)共同将自己的财产抵押给堂兄弟,当兄弟不再支付他那份债务时,抵押就陷入违约.虽然妹妹试图通过支付一半的到期金额来赎回自己对房产的一半利息,但她只能通过全额支付到期金额来弥补违约,因此,抵押贷款没有赎回权,妹妹静静的产权诉讼将失败.

(Choice A) 抵押(如契约)中的一般担保条款保证所有权不受任何抵押或缺陷。虽然这保证了堂兄弟在赎回时会获得明确的所有权,但这并没有取消妹妹赎回财产的权利.

(Choice) 姐姐不得不全额偿还债务以赎回财产,无论她是共同租户还是共同租户.

(Choice D) Marshalling适用于(1)高级债权人对多项资产享有担保权益和(2)初级债权人对其中一项资产享有权益的情形。它要求高级债权人首先对其持有独家担保的资产进行抵押。

利息,以保全低级债权人对剩余资产的利益。但由于本案只涉及一种担保权益(抵押),重组不适用。

学习要点：

平等的赎回权允许债务人通过全额偿还未偿债务而避免赎回,这意味着房客只能通过支付所有房客所欠的金额来赎回共有财产。

参考资料

55 Am. Jur. 2d 抵押贷款第392条(2018年)(普通法规定的赎回权)。

stem:
A man died testate. The man's estate consisted of a residence as well as significant personal property. By his duly probated will, the man devised the residence to a friend, who was specifically identified in the will. The residue of the estate was given to a stated charity.

The man's friend, although alive at the time the man executed the will, had predeceased the man. The friend's wife and their child, who has a disability, both survived the man.

The value of the residence has increased significantly because of recent zoning changes. There is credible extrinsic evidence that the man wanted his friend to own the residence after the man's death so that the friend and his wife could care for their child there.

There is no applicable statute.
stemZh:
一个人死在遗嘱中,他的财产包括住所和重要的个人财产,根据他经过证明的遗嘱,他给一个朋友设计了住所,在遗嘱中明确指明了他的身份。遗产的残余物被交给了一个公开的慈善机构。

男方的朋友虽然在男方执行遗嘱时还活着,但已经先行将男方处死,这位朋友的妻子和他们的有残疾的孩子都活了下来.

由于最近的区划变化,住所的价值大大增加,有可信的外部证据表明,男子希望其朋友在男子死后拥有住所,以便朋友和妻子在那里照顾孩子。

没有适用的法规。
ask: If both the charity and the child claim the residence, to whom should the estate distribute the residence?
askZh: 如果慈善机构和孩子都要求居住,那么房产应分配给谁?

options.en: The charity, because the devise to the friend adeemed.
options.zh: 慈善机构,因为给朋友的 设计被认可。

options.en: The charity, because the devise to the friend lapsed.
options.zh: 慈善事业 因为给朋友的设定失效了

options.en: The child, because extrinsic evidence exists that the man's intent was to benefit the child.
options.zh: 儿童,因为有外部证据表明,男子的意图是使儿童受益。

options.en: The child, because no conditions of survivorship were noted in the will.
options.zh: 儿童,因为遗嘱中没有注明生存条件。

explanation.en:
Doctrines affecting conveyance by will

Lapse Causes devise to fail if beneficiary predeceases testator

Ademption Causes devise to fail by either:

extinction – specifically devised property not owned by testator (or destroyed or fundamentally changed) at death satisfaction – beneficiary received devised property (or other asset intended to satisfy devise) during testator's life Exoneration Allows beneficiary of specifically devised real property to use estate's remaining assets to pay off any encumbrances on that property

Abatement Reduces devises that cannot be satisfied by assets remaining after testator's debts are paid Residuary devises abated first, followed by general & then specific devises The man (testator) died testate and left his residence to the friend (beneficiary) under a valid will. However, the doctrine of lapse will cause a devise to fail if the beneficiary dies before the testator (as seen here). In that case, neither the beneficiary nor his/her heirs will acquire the devised property. Instead, it will become part of the general estate and be distributed in accordance with the rest of the will. And if there are no other provisions in the will, the property will be distributed under intestacy laws. But since the man left the residue of his estate to the charity, the estate should distribute the residence to the charity—not the child.

(Choice A) The doctrine of ademption will cause a specific devise to fail if the testator does not own the devised property upon death. But since the man owned the residence when he died, the devise to the friend did not adeem.

(Choice C) Although extrinsic evidence exists that the man's intent was to benefit the child, the parol evidence rule prohibits a court from rewriting a will that lacks significant ambiguities. And since the man's will was clear and unambiguous, such evidence cannot be used to support the child's claim to the residence.

(Choice D) Had the man's will included a condition of survivorship instructing that the residence go to the child in the event that the friend predeceased the man, the child would have received the residence. But since the man's will included no such condition, the residence should be distributed to the charity.

Educational objective:

The doctrine of lapse causes a devise to fail when the beneficiary predeceases the testator. The devised property will instead be distributed in accordance with other devises in the will or, if no others exist, in accordance with intestacy laws.

References

80 Am. Jur. 2d Wills § 1409 (2018) (doctrine of lapse).

explanation.zh:
影响意愿传递的理论

如果受益人死亡前遗嘱人设计失败

利用自首的诱因设计出失败:

消灭 -- -- 具体设计的财产在死亡清偿时不是由遗嘱人拥有(或毁坏或根本改变) -- -- 受益人在遗嘱人生命中收到指定的财产(或意在满足设定的其他资产)专门设计不动产,以利用破产财产的剩余资产来偿付对该财产的任何抵押

减值装置无法用在向遗嘱人偿还债务后留下的资产抵偿; 剩余装置首先减值,然后是一般和具体装置; 男子(遗嘱人)死后将住所留给朋友(受益人)。但是,如果受益人在遗嘱人之前死亡(如本文所示),失效的理论将会导致设计失败,在这种情况下,受益人或其继承人都不会获得设定的财产。相反,它将成为一般遗产的一部分,并按照其他遗嘱进行分配,如果遗嘱中没有其他规定,则财产将根据遗嘱法进行分配。但是,既然这个人把遗产的剩余部分留给了慈善机构,那么遗产应该把住所分配给慈善机构,而不是孩子。

如果遗嘱人死后不拥有预定的财产,那么,赎罪的学说将会导致一种具体的阴谋失败。既然他死后拥有住所,那么他的朋友的计谋就不存在了。

(Choice)虽然有外在证据证明此人的本意是让孩子受益,但parol证据规则禁止法院重写缺乏重大模糊性的遗嘱.而由于该男子的意志是明确和毫不含糊的,这种证据不能用来支持该儿童对住所的主张.

(Choice D)如果男方的遗嘱中包含一个幸存条件,指示如果朋友在男方去世前将住所交给孩子,孩子会收到住所.但由于男方的遗嘱中没有这样的条件,故住宅应分配给慈善机构.

学习要点：

失效的理论导致在受益人先于遗嘱人时,设计出的财产将按遗嘱中的其他设计分配,如果没有其他设计,则按照遗嘱法分配。

参考资料

80 Am. Jur. 2d Wills § 1409 (2018)(失效的理论).

stem:
A woman entered a hospital to undergo surgery and feared that she might not survive. She instructed her lawyer by telephone to prepare a deed conveying her property, a large tract of undeveloped land, as a gift to her nephew who lived in a distant state. Her instructions were followed, and, prior to her surgery, she executed a document in a form sufficient to constitute a deed of conveyance. The deed was recorded by the lawyer promptly and properly as she instructed him to do. The recorded deed was returned to the lawyer by the land record office. The woman, in fact, recovered from her surgery and the lawyer returned the recorded deed to her.

Before the woman or the lawyer thought to inform the nephew of the conveyance, the nephew was killed in an auto accident. The nephew's will left all of his estate to a satanic religious cult. The woman was very upset at the prospect of the cult acquiring the property.

The local taxing authority assessed the next real property tax bill on the property to the nephew's estate.

The woman brought an appropriate action against the nephew's estate and the cult to set aside the conveyance to the nephew.
stemZh:
一名妇女进入医院接受手术,并担心她可能无法存活,她通过电话指示她的律师准备一份契约,将她的财产,一大片未开发的土地,作为送给生活在遥远国家的侄子的礼物。在手术前,她用表格处决了一份文件足以构成运输契约。律师按照他的指示,迅速和适当地记录了这份契约。土地记录办公室将记录的契约还给了律师,事实上,该妇女手术后康复,律师将记录的契约还给她。

在女方或律师考虑告知外甥传道之前,外甥在一次汽车事故中丧生,外甥的遗嘱将所有遗产留给了邪教宗教邪教,该妇女对邪教获得财产的前景非常不满.

当地税务当局评估了该房产的下一个不动产税账单到侄子的庄园.

该妇女对侄子的遗产和邪教提起了适当的诉讼,将运输工具留给侄子。
ask: If the woman loses, what will be the likely reason?
askZh: 如果女人输了 会有什么原因?

options.en: Delivery of the deed is presumed from the recording of the deed.
options.zh: 契约的交付从契约记录中推定。

options.en: Disappointing the nephew's devisee would violate the religious freedom provisions of the First Amendment to the Constitution.
options.zh: 失望的侄子的阴谋会违反宪法第一修正案的宗教自由条款.

options.en: The gift of the property was inter vivos rather than causa mortis.
options.zh: 财产的赠品是死者之间的财产,而不是死后的财产。

options.en: The showing of the nephew's estate as the owner of the property on the tax rolls supplied what otherwise would be a missing essential element for a valid conveyance.
options.zh: 在税单上显示侄子的遗产为财产所有人,为有效运输提供了缺失的基本要素。

explanation.en:
A deed is a document that transfers ownership of real property from the owner (grantor) to another (grantee) once it has been:

delivered – presumed when the deed (1) has been recorded—ie, filed in the official land records—or (2) is in the grantee's physical possession and accepted – presumed when the transfer benefits the grantee. Once these requirements are met, the grantee owns the property and the transfer cannot be canceled—even if the land record office later returns the deed to the grantor.

Here, delivery of the deed to the nephew is presumed since the woman's lawyer (agent) recorded it as instructed. And though the nephew never learned of the deed, his acceptance is presumed since the conveyance benefited him. As a result, ownership of the property transferred to the nephew and was unaffected by the land record office's return of the recorded deed. Therefore, the woman will likely lose her action to set aside the conveyance.

(Choice B) The religious freedom provisions of the First Amendment protect persons from government action—not private individuals (as seen here). Therefore, disappointing the satanic cult by setting aside the conveyance would not violate protected religious freedoms—even if the woman had asked the court to do so because she disapproved of satanism.

(Choice C) An inter vivos gift is an irrevocable gift of land or personal property given during the grantor's life. A causa mortis gift is a revocable gift of personal property given in expectations of the grantor's imminent death. Therefore, though the woman gifted the land when she feared that she might not survive surgery, that gift could only be inter vivos. And since that inter vivos gift only became irrevocable when it was delivered and accepted, the woman will lose because the deed was delivered (and presumably accepted) when it was recorded.

(Choice D) A conveyance by deed is valid once there is delivery and acceptance. Whether the nephew's estate appeared as the owner of the property on the tax rolls is irrelevant.

Educational objective:

A deed transfers ownership of real property once it is delivered (presumed when it has been recorded) and accepted (presumed when the transfer benefits the grantee). After this occurs, the transfer is irrevocable.

explanation.zh:
契约是将不动产所有权从所有人(设保人)转让给另一人(设保人)的单证,条件是:

交付——推定转让(1)已记录——即已存档于正式土地记录——或(2)已由受赠方实际拥有并接受——推定转让使受赠方受益。一旦满足这些要求,受赠方就拥有财产,转让也不能取消,即使土地记录办公室后来将地契退还设保人。

在这里,向侄子交付契约是推定的,因为女方的律师(代理人)按照指示记录了契约。 虽然侄子从未得知契约,但他的接受是推定的,因为契约有利于他。因此,财产的所有权被转让给侄子,并且没有受到土地记录办公室归还有记录的地契的影响,因此,该妇女很可能失去撤销运输权的行动。

(Choice B) 第一修正案的宗教自由条款保护个人不受政府行为的影响,而不是个人(如此处所示)。因此,如果把传教渠道搁置起来,使邪教组织失望,这不会侵犯受保护的宗教自由,即使妇女因为不赞成邪教而要求法院这样做。

(Choice C) 死者间赠与是设保人生前赠予的不可撤销的土地或个人财产赠与,因期待设保人即将死亡而赠予的可收回的个人财产赠与。因此,虽然这名妇女在担心她可能无法从手术中存活下来时就献出了土地,但这种礼物只能是生前的礼物。由于这份死者之间的礼物只有在交付和接受时才不可撤销,因此该妇女将失去,因为契约是在记录时交付的(并可能接受)。

(Choice D) 契约转让一旦交付和接受,即为有效,无论侄子的遗产在税单上是否作为财产所有人出现,都是无关紧要的.

学习要点：

契约一旦交付(在记录时假定)和接受(在转让给受赠人带来好处时假定),即转让不动产的所有权。

stem:
A woman acquired title to a four-acre lot. Several years later, she executed a mortgage on the lot to a bank to secure repayment of a $100,000 loan. Subsequently, the woman executed a mortgage on the same four-acre lot to a finance company to secure repayment of a $50,000 loan. Both mortgages were promptly recorded.

The woman recently defaulted on both loans. The bank promptly initiated foreclosure proceedings and sent proper notice to all necessary parties. The current fair market value of the four-acre lot is $250,000.

The finance company has filed a timely motion in the foreclosure proceeding asking the court to require the bank to first foreclose on two of the four acres in the four-acre lot. The bank opposes this motion and insists that it has the right to subject the entire four-acre lot to the foreclosure sale.
stemZh:
一个女人获得了四英亩土地的产权,几年后,她对这批土地抵押给一家银行,以保证偿还10万美元的贷款.随后,该妇女对同一四英亩土地向一家金融公司抵押,以保证偿还5万美元的贷款,并立即记录了这两笔抵押。

这名妇女最近拖欠了两笔贷款,银行立即启动了取消赎回权程序,并向所有必要的当事方发出了适当的通知,目前4英亩土地的公平市场价值为25万美元。

金融公司在赎回程序中及时提出动议,要求法院要求银行在四英亩地块的四英亩土地中先行赎回两英亩土地.银行反对这一动议,坚持有权将全部四英亩地块进行赎回出售.
ask: Will the court grant the finance company's motion?
askZh: 法庭会批准金融公司的动议吗?

options.en: No, because the bank holds a purchase-money mortgage.
options.zh: 不,因为银行持有购钱抵押。

options.en: No, because the entire four-acre lot is subject to the bank's senior mortgage.
options.zh: 不,因为整个四英亩的地块 都受银行的高级抵押

options.en: Yes, because a pro rata foreclosure of the lot will not prejudice the rights of the bank.
options.zh: 是的,因为按比例取消赎回权 不会损害银行的权利。

options.en: Yes, because of the "two funds" rule of marshalling.
options.zh: 是的,因为"两基金"规则 集合。

explanation.en:
The priority of mortgages and other liens in the foreclosure process is generally determined by their recording dates. However, a different rule applies to purchase-money mortgages (PMMs)—ie, mortgages granted to secure the purchase price of the

mortgaged property. PMMs have super-priority over all other mortgages or liens, whether or not recorded.

Here, both the bank and the finance company have mortgages on the entire four-acre lot. The woman already owned the lot when she executed the mortgages, so neither mortgage is a PMM (Choice A). Therefore, the order of recording determines priority. And since the bank received its mortgage first and promptly recorded it, the bank has the senior mortgage and is entitled to foreclose on the entire four-acre lot.

(Choice C) Mortgagees are entitled to foreclose on the entire property subject to the mortgage unless otherwise provided by law. Therefore, the bank has no obligation to foreclose on a smaller two-acre parcel. Additionally, such a pro rata foreclosure could prejudice the bank's rights since there is no guarantee that two acres would sell for an amount sufficient to satisfy the bank's interest.

(Choice D) The "two funds" rule of marshalling applies when a senior creditor has two funds available to satisfy a debt (eg, a mortgage on multiple properties), and a junior creditor also has an interest in one of those funds. It requires the senior creditor to first look for satisfaction from the fund that is not shared so as to preserve the junior creditor's interest in the shared fund. But here, both mortgages are secured by a single fund—the four-acre lot.

Educational objective:

Priority of mortgages and other liens is generally based on the order in which they were recorded. Purchase-money mortgages, however, have super-priority over all other mortgages or liens, whether or not recorded.

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 7.2 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (priority of purchase-money mortgages).

explanation.zh:
抵押权和其他留置权在赎回程序中的优先权一般由下列因素决定:但是,另一种规则适用于购货款抵押(PMM),即:为担保购买价而发放的抵押贷款

PMM相对于所有其他抵押或留置,无论是否记录在内,都具有超级优先权.

这里,银行和金融公司都拥有整个四英亩地块的抵押权。 妇女执行抵押时已经拥有该地块,因此抵押权都不是PMM(Choice A),因此,记录顺序决定了优先权。而由于银行首先收到其抵押贷款,并迅速将其记录下来,银行拥有高级抵押贷款,并有权对全部四英亩土地进行赎回.

(C类)除非法律另有规定,抵押权人有权对抵押的全部财产进行抵押,因此,银行没有义务对较小的两英亩地块进行抵押。此外,这种按比例取消赎回权的做法可能损害银行的权利,因为无法保证两英亩的销售额足以满足银行的利息。

(Choice D)当高级债权人有两笔资金可用于清偿债务(例如,对多个财产的抵押),而低级债权人对其中一项资金也拥有权益时,即适用集合的"两基金"规则.它要求高级债权人首先从没有共享的基金中寻求清偿,以维护低级债权人在共享基金中的利益。 但在这里,两种抵押贷款都由一个单一基金——四英亩土地——担保。

学习要点：

抵押权和其他留置权的优先权一般以记录顺序为准,但购货款抵押权相对于所有其他抵押权或留置权具有超级优先权,无论是否记录.

参考资料

重述(第三)财产:抵押权第7.2条(《1997年宪法》)(购置款抵押的优先权)。

stem:
An uncle owned a valuable tract of land. The uncle executed a document in the form of a warranty deed of land, which was regular in all respects except that the only language designating the grantees in each of the granting and habendum clauses was: "The leaders of all the Protestant churches in County A." The instrument was acknowledged as required by statute and promptly and properly recorded. The uncle told his lawyer, but no one else, that he had made the conveyance as he did because he abhorred sectarianism in the Protestant movement and because he thought that the leaders would devote the asset to lessening sectarianism.

The uncle died suddenly and unexpectedly a week later, leaving a will that bequeathed and devised his entire estate to his niece. After probate of the will became final and the administration on the uncle's estate was closed, the niece instituted an appropriate action to quiet title to the land and properly served as defendant each Protestant church situated in the county.

The only evidence introduced consisted of the chain of title under which the uncle held, the probated will, the recorded deed, the fact that no person knew about the deed except the uncle and his lawyer, and the conversation the uncle had with his lawyer described above.
stemZh:
叔父拥有宝贵的土地,叔父以土地保证契约的形式执行了一份文件,该文件在所有方面都是正常的,只是每项授予和人身保护条款中指定受赠人的唯一语言是:"A县所有新教教会的领袖们",该乐器按照法规的要求得到了承认,并迅速,适当地记录下来.叔父告诉律师,但没人说,他这样做是因为他厌恶新教运动中的宗派主义,也因为他认为领导人将把资产用于减少宗派主义。

一周后叔叔突然出乎意料地去世,留下遗嘱,将他的整个遗产留给他的侄女设计.在遗嘱成为最终遗嘱,并关闭了对叔叔庄园的管理之后,侄女提起了适当的诉讼,静静地拥有土地的所有权,并适当地充当了位于该县的每个新教教堂的被告。

提出的唯一证据是叔叔持有的头衔链、遗嘱、有记录的契约、除了叔叔和他的律师之外没有人知道契约的事实,以及叔叔和他的律师的谈话。页:1
ask: In the action to quiet title, who will prevail and why?
askZh: 在静静的头衔中,谁会获胜,为什么?

options.en: The defendants, because a deed is prima facie valid until rebutted.
options.zh: 被告,因为一份契约在驳回之前是初步有效的。

options.en: The defendants, because recording established prima facie delivery until rebutted.
options.zh: 被告,因为录制在反驳前初步证实了交货。

options.en: The niece, because the state of the evidence would not support a finding of delivery of the deed.
options.zh: 侄女,因为证据的状态不能支持交付契约的结论。

options.en: The niece, because there is inadequate identification of grantees in the deed.
options.zh: 外甥女,因为契约中没有适当识别受赠人的身份.

explanation.en:
Deed requirements

Requirements Valid Invalid

Written & signed by grantor

Any written instrument signed by grantor

Oral (except permissible gift) Signed only by grantee

Identifies grantor & grantee

Separate grantor & grantee (except concurrent estates) Identifiable by name or description

Ambiguous/unidentifiable grantee(s) Nonexistent grantee

Identifies land Identifiable by reasonable certainty—eg: Government survey Metes & bounds Street, lot, house number

Ambiguous description (but extrinsic evidence admissible) Undefined part of larger parcel

Includes words of transfer

"Convey" "Transfer" "Grant" "Sell"

"Lease" "Rent" "License"

A deed is a legal instrument that transfers ownership of real property from the grantor (old owner) to the grantee (new owner). To be valid, a deed must:

be in writing and signed by the grantor unambiguously identify the grantor and grantee unambiguously describe the land and include words of transfer. When a deed transfers ownership to a group of grantees, the identities of the group members must be ascertainable with reasonable certainty—eg, "the present members of the United States Congress." Extrinsic evidence can be admitted to clarify ambiguities. But if the extrinsic evidence is also unclear, a court will not speculate as to the grantor's intent and the deed will be deemed void (ie, of no legal effect).

Here, the uncle attempted to deed his land to "the leaders of all the Protestant churches in County A." But that description was ambiguous because there is no way to identify the specific individuals belonging to that group. And though the uncle's conversation with his lawyer (extrinsic evidence) was introduced, it did not resolve this ambiguity. Therefore, the inadequate identification of the grantees rendered the uncle's deed void. And since the deed did not convey title to the defendants, the niece will prevail in her action to quiet title.

(Choice A) A deed is not prima facie valid if it does not meet the above requirements. And since the deed here cannot satisfy all these requirements (due to the ambiguous description of the grantees), it is invalid.

(Choices B & C) A deed is valid if it meets the above requirements, and the transfer of the described land is effective when the deed is delivered and accepted. While recording is prima facie evidence that the deed was delivered to the grantee, it does not establish the deed's validity.

Educational objective:

A valid deed (1) is in writing and signed by the grantor, (2) unambiguously identifies the grantor and grantee, (3) unambiguously describes the land, and (4) includes words of transfer. The identity of the parties and the land must be ascertainable with reasonable certainty, but extrinsic evidence can be used to resolve ambiguities.

契约是将不动产所有权从设保人(旧所有人)转让给受赠人(新所有人)的法律文书。

以书面形式并由设保人签字,明确指明设保人和受赠人对土地的描述,并包括转让的词语。当契约将所有权转让给一组受赠人时,必须能够以合理的确定性确定集团成员的身份,例如“美国国会的现任成员”。但是,如果外部证据也不清楚,法院不会推测出押人的意图,而该契约将被视为无效(即没有法律效力)。

在这里,叔叔试图将自己的土地让给"A县所有新教教会的领袖们",但这种描述模棱两可,因为无法识别属于该团体的具体个人.虽然他叔叔与律师的谈话(exrinsic evidence)被提出来,但这并不能解决这种模糊性。 因此,对受赠方的识别不足使得叔叔的契约无效。由于契约没有将所有权传递给被告,所以侄女在她的行动中会以安静的头衔为主.

(选择 A ) 一份契约如果不符合上述要求,则初步证据不成立。 由于该契约无法满足所有这些要求(因为受赠方的描述模棱两可),该契约无效。

(Choices B & C) 一份地契如果符合上述要求,则有效,且该地契的转让在交付和接受时有效.虽然记录是初步证据,证明该契约已交付给受赠人,但它不能证明该契约的有效性。

学习要点：

有效契约(1)是书面的,由设保人签署,(2)明确指明设保人和受赠人,(3)明确描述土地,(4)包括转让词语。当事人和土地的身份必须具有合理的确定性,但可以利用外部证据解决含糊不清的问题。

stem:
A businessman owned a hotel, subject to a mortgage securing a debt he owed to a bank. The businessman later acquired a nearby parking garage, financing part of the purchase price with a loan from a financing company, secured by a mortgage on the parking garage. Two years thereafter, the businessman defaulted on the loan owed to the bank, which caused the full amount of that loan to become immediately due and payable. The bank decided not to foreclose the mortgage on the hotel at that time, but instead properly sued for the full amount of the defaulted loan. The bank obtained and properly filed a judgment for that amount.

A statute of the jurisdiction provides: "Any judgment properly filed shall, for 10 years from filing, be a lien on the real property then owned or subsequently acquired by any person against whom the judgment is rendered." There is no other applicable statute, except the statute providing for judicial foreclosure of mortgages, which places no restrictions on deficiency judgments.

Shortly thereafter, the bank brought an appropriate action for judicial foreclosure of its mortgage on the hotel and of its judgment lien on the parking garage. The financing company was joined as a party defendant and appropriately sued for foreclosure of its mortgage on the parking garage, which was also in default. All procedures were properly followed, and the confirmed foreclosure sales resulted in the following: The net proceeds of the sale of the hotel to a third party were $200,000 less than the bank's mortgage balance. The net proceeds of the sale of the parking garage to a fourth party were $200,000 more than the financing company's mortgage balance.
stemZh:
一名商人拥有一家旅馆，并以旅馆设立抵押，担保其对银行所负的债务。后来，商人购买了附近的一座停车楼，以融资公司提供的贷款支付部分购价，并以停车楼设立抵押担保该笔贷款。两年后，商人未偿还银行贷款，致使该笔贷款全部立即到期。银行当时决定暂不就旅馆抵押权申请止赎，而是就逾期贷款全额提起诉讼。银行获得该金额的判决，并依法登记。

该司法辖区的法规规定：‘任何依法登记的判决，自登记之日起十年内，对判决债务人当时拥有或此后取得的不动产构成留置权。’除抵押权司法止赎法外，没有其他适用法规；该止赎法未限制不足额判决。

不久，银行提起适当诉讼，请求司法止赎其对旅馆的抵押权，以及其对停车楼的判决留置权。融资公司被列为被告，并适当请求止赎其对停车楼的抵押权；该贷款也已违约。所有程序均依法进行，经确认的止赎拍卖结果如下：旅馆售予第三人所得净款，比银行抵押债权余额少 200,000 美元；停车楼售予第四人所得净款，比融资公司的抵押债权余额多 200,000 美元。
ask: How should the $200,000 surplus arising from the sale of the parking garage be distributed?
askZh: 出售停车场产生的20万美元的盈余应如何分配?

options.en: It should be paid to the bank.
options.zh: 应付银行.

options.en: It should be paid to the businessman.
options.zh: 应付商人.

options.en: It should be paid to the financing company.
options.zh: 应当向融资公司支付.

options.en: It should be split equally between the bank and the financing company.
options.zh: 银行与融资公司应当平等分割.

explanation.en:
Proceeds from a foreclosure sale are typically distributed in the following order of priority:

Expenses from the sale (eg, attorneys' fees, court costs) Mortgage being foreclosed Junior liens, in order of lien priority Debtor, if any surplus remains Here, the financing company had the senior lien on the garage since its mortgage was placed on the property first. The bank later acquired a judgment lien on all the businessman's property—including a junior lien on the garage—when the businessman defaulted on the bank's loan. And since the foreclosure sale of the garage satisfied the financing company's entire mortgage and resulted in a $200,000 surplus, the bank (as the junior lienholder) should receive the surplus to cover the balance still owed for its mortgage on the hotel

(Choices B, C & D).

Educational objective:

The proceeds from a foreclosure sale are distributed in the following order of priority: (1) the expenses from the foreclosure sale, (2) the mortgage being foreclosed, (3) junior liens in order of priority, and (4) the debtor.

References

55 Am. Jur. 2d Mortgages § 705 (2019) (distribution of foreclosure sale proceeds).

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 7.4 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (effect of priority on distribution of foreclosure surplus).

stem:
A woman owned a tract of land in fee simple. By warranty deed, she conveyed the land in fee simple to her brother for a recited consideration of "$10 and other valuable consideration." The deed was promptly and properly recorded.

One week later, the woman and her brother executed a written document that stated that the conveyance of the land was for the purpose of establishing a trust for the benefit of the woman's grandson. The brother expressly accepted the trust and signed the document with the woman. This written agreement was not authenticated to be eligible for recordation and there never was an attempt to record it. The brother entered into possession of the land and distributed the net income from the land to the grandson at appropriate intervals.

Five years later, the brother conveyed the land in fee simple to an investor by warranty deed. The investor paid the fair market value of the land, had no knowledge of the written agreement between the woman and the brother, and entered into possession of the land. The grandson made demand upon the investor for distribution of income at the next usual time the brother would have distributed. The investor refused.

The grandson brought an appropriate action against the investor for a decree requiring her to perform the trust the brother had theretofore recognized.
stemZh:
一名妇女拥有一片土地,完全所有权,她通过担保契约,将土地以收费方式简单交给她的兄弟,以便她背诵对“10美元和其他有价值的考虑”的考虑。

一周后,该妇女及其兄弟执行了一份书面文件,其中指出,土地的运送是为了建立一个有利于该妇女孙子的信任。该兄弟明确接受信托并与该妇女签署了文件,但这项书面协议没有被证明有资格被记录,而且从未试图加以记录。该兄弟进入土地占有,并按适当间隔向孙子分配土地净收入.

五年后,该兄弟通过保税契约将土地以简单收费方式传递给投资人,投资人支付了土地的公平市场价值,不知道该妇女与该兄弟之间的书面协议,并开始占有土地.孙子要求投资人在其兄弟的下次正常时间分配收入,投资人拒绝了。

孙子对投资人提起了适当的诉讼,要求她履行他兄弟以前信任他的职责
ask: Which party is likely to prevail?
askZh: 哪个政党可能获胜?

options.en: The grandson, because a successor in title to the trustee takes title subject to the grantor's trust.
options.zh: 孙子,因为受托人所有权的继承人取得所有权时必须获得设保人的信任。

options.en: The grandson, because equitable interests are not subject to the recording act.
options.zh: 孙子,因为公平的利益不受录音法的约束.

options.en: The investor, because, as a bona fide purchaser, she took free of the trust encumbering the brother's title.
options.zh: 投资人,因为作为善意的购买者,她拿走了作为兄弟所有权抵押的信托.

options.en: The investor, because no trust was ever created since the woman had no title at the time of the purported creation.
options.zh: 投资人,因为没有建立过任何信托,因为该妇女在据称的创作时没有所有权。

explanation.en:
Types of recording acts

Type Effect Statutory language

Race Interest holder who records first will prevail "First record"

Notice Subsequent BFP without notice of earlier property interest will prevail

"Without notice," "In good faith"

Race-Notice Subsequent BFP (1) without notice of earlier property interest (2) who records first will prevail

"Without notice, who shall first record"

BFP = Bona fide purchaser.

Many interests affecting property can be recorded, including trusts affecting land. When different persons own such interests, recording acts are used to evaluate priority of competing interests. Under most recording acts, a subsequent property interest has priority over an earlier interest if the subsequent interest-holder was a bona fide purchaser (BFP)—ie, a person who (1) paid value and (2) lacked notice of the prior interest. There are three types of notice:

Actual – when a buyer has direct knowledge of a prior interest Constructive (ie, record) – when a document showing a prior interest was properly recorded in the land records and appears in the buyer's chain of title and Inquiry – when a buyer knows, or should know, of circumstances that would prompt a reasonable person to investigate (eg, visible use of the property by someone other than the seller). Here, the investor had no knowledge of the prior trust agreement when she purchased the land from the brother (no actual notice), and the brother's possession of the land gave her no reason to investigate further (no inquiry notice). And since the trust agreement was never recorded, the investor did not have constructive notice of the trust. Therefore, the investor was a BFP and took the land free of the trust.

(Choice A) A successor in title to a trustee does not necessarily take title subject to the trust. And here, since the investor (successor in title) had no notice of the trust when she purchased the land from the brother (trustee), she is not bound by the trust.

(Choice B) Equitable interests affecting property (eg, the grandson's trust) can be recorded and, when they are, give constructive notice to subsequent purchasers.

(Choice D) Although the woman no longer had title to the land when the trust was created, the brother did. Therefore, the trust was valid and enforceable against the brother. But it is

not enforceable against the investor—a BFP who lacked notice of the trust when she purchased the land.

Educational objective:

Most recording acts protect bona fide purchasers who lacked notice—actual (direct knowledge), constructive (prior recording in chain of title), or inquiry (circumstances warrant investigation)—of a prior competing property interest.
