explanation.zh:
记录行为的类型

类型效果法定语言

先录制的赛车股权持有者将领先"第一纪录"

其后不提前通知财产权益的通知将优先

"没有注意" "诚意"

种族通知 其后的BFP (1) 无须提前通知财产权益 (2) 将优先先行记录

"没有通知,谁应该先录"

BFP=真正的购买者。

影响财产的许多利益可以记录在案,包括影响土地的信托,如果不同人拥有这种利益,则用记录行为来评价竞合利益的优先权。根据大多数记录行为,如果随后的股东是善意购买者,即(1)支付价款的人和(2)没有事先通知利息,则随后的财产权益优先于先前的权益。通知有三种类型:

实际 -- -- 当买方直接知悉先前的利息(即记录)时 -- -- 当表明先前的利息的文件已适当记录在土地记录中并出现在买方的所有权链和调查中时 -- -- 当买方知道或应当知道B. 促使有理智的人进行调查的情况(例如:(b) 出卖人以外的人使用该财产。在此,当她从兄弟那里购买土地时,投资人并不知道先前的信托协议(没有实际通知),该兄弟对该土地的拥有使她没有理由进一步调查(没有调查通知)。而由于信托协议从未被记录,投资方对信托没有建设性的通知,因此,投资方是BFP公司,在没有信托的情况下拿走了土地.

(Choice A)受托人所有权的继承人不一定取得受委托人管辖的所有权,在这里,由于投资人(所有权继承人)在向兄弟(受托人)购买土地时没有接到信托通知,她不受委托人的约束.

(Choice B) 影响财产的公平权益(例如孙子的信托)可以被记录下来,当这些权益被记录下来时,可以向后续的购买者发出建设性的通知.

虽然在信托建立时,妇女不再对土地拥有所有权,但兄弟却这样做了,因此信托对兄弟是有效和可执行的。

不得对投资人强制执行——BFP在购买土地时没有通知信托。

学习要点：

多数记录行为都保护善意购买者,他们缺乏对先前竞合财产权益的通知——实际(直接知情)、推定(所有权链中预先记录)或询问(情况需要调查)。

stem:
A man owned land in fee simple of record on January 10. On that day, a friend loaned the man $50,000 and the man mortgaged the land to her as security for the loan. The mortgage was recorded on January 18.

The man conveyed the land to a buyer for valuable consideration on January 11. The friend did not know of this, nor did the buyer know of the mortgage to the friend, until both discovered the facts on January 23, the day on which the buyer recorded the man's deed.

The recording act of the jurisdiction provides: "No unrecorded conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value without notice, who shall first record." There is no provision for a period of grace and there is no other relevant statutory provision.

The friend sued the buyer to establish that her mortgage was good against the land.
stemZh:
1月10日,一名男子以简单记录的收费方式拥有土地,当日,一名朋友将这名男子贷款5万美元,男子将土地抵押给她,作为贷款的担保,抵押于1月18日录制.

这名男子于1月11日将土地转交买方作有价值的考虑。 朋友不知道这一点,买方也不知道该朋友的抵押贷款,直到双方于1月23日即买方记录此人契约的当天发现了事实。

辖区的录制行为规定:"未经记录的转让或者抵押不动产,不得对后续购买人进行价值优待,未经通知,应当先行记录";没有规定宽限期,没有其他规定.有关法律规定。

朋友起诉买方,证明她的抵押贷款不利于土地。
ask: For whom should the court decide?
askZh: 法庭应该为谁做决定?

options.en: The buyer, because he paid valuable consideration without notice before the friend recorded her mortgage.
options.zh: 买方,因为他在朋友记录她的抵押贷款之前,没有通知就支付了宝贵的报酬。

options.en: The buyer, because the friend's delay in recording means that she is estopped from asserting her priority in time.
options.zh: 买方,因为朋友在记录方面的延误意味着她无法及时申明其优先权。

options.en: The friend, because after the mortgage to her, the man's deed to the buyer was necessarily subject to her mortgage.
options.zh: 朋友,因为在向她抵押之后,男方对买主的契约必然要由她抵押.

options.en: The friend, because the buyer did not record his deed before her mortgage was recorded.
options.zh: 这位朋友,因为买方在记录其抵押贷款之前没有记录他的契约。

explanation.en:
Recording acts seek to promote certainty of title by creating a framework to determine the priority of competing property interests. In a race-notice jurisdiction (as seen here), a bona fide purchaser's (BFP's) property interest will have priority over an earlier property interest if the BFP:

lacked notice of the earlier interest at the time the BFP acquired his/her interest and recorded his/her interest at any time before the earlier interest was recorded. Here, the buyer was unaware of the friend's prior mortgage when he purchased the land. But since he did not record his deed until after the friend had recorded her mortgage, the court should decide for the friend.

(Choice A) Although the buyer paid valuable consideration without notice before the friend recorded her mortgage (ie, he was a BFP who lacked notice), he did not also record his deed before the friend recorded her mortgage.

(Choice B) The friend's delay in recording does not estop (ie, preclude) her from asserting her priority in time since there is no deadline for recording. She only needed to record her mortgage first (ie, before the buyer recorded his deed) to prevail in this race-notice jurisdiction. And since she did so, the court should find for the friend.

(Choice C) The man's deed to the buyer was not necessarily subject to the friend's mortgage. Instead, the friend will prevail because this jurisdiction has a race-notice statute and her mortgage was recorded first.

Educational objective:

In a race-notice jurisdiction, a bona fide purchaser's (BFP's) property interest has priority over an earlier competing property interest if the BFP (1) lacked notice of the earlier interest and (2) recorded first.

explanation.zh:
记录行为旨在通过建立一个确定竞合财产权益优先权的框架,提高所有权的确定性。在种族通知法域(如此处所示),善意买方的财产权益将优先于先前的财产权益,条件是:

在BFP取得他/她的利息并在记录他/她的利息之前的任何时候记录他/她的利息时,没有提前通知他/她的利息。但是由于他直到朋友将她的抵押记录下来后才记录他的契约,所以法庭应该为朋友做出决定.

(Choice A)虽然买方在朋友记录她的抵押贷款之前没有通知就支付了宝贵的考虑(即他是一个没有通知的BFP),但他也没有在朋友记录她的抵押贷款之前记录他的契约.

(Choice B) 朋友在录制上的延迟并没有阻止(ie, 排除)她及时坚持自己的优先权,因为没有录制的最后期限.她只需要先记录她的抵押贷款(即在买方记录他的契约之前),才能在这个种族通知法域中获胜。 既然她这样做了,法院应该为这位朋友找到。

(Choice C)男方对买家的契约不一定受制于朋友的抵押,相反,这位朋友将胜出,因为这个法域有种族通知法规,她的抵押被先记录下来.

学习要点：

在种族通知法域中,如果善意购买人的财产权益未通知先前的权益,而且 (2) 登记在先,则该财产权益优先于先前竞合的财产权益。

stem:
An environmentalist conveyed his land by quitclaim deed as a gift to his daughter, who did not then record her deed. Later, the environmentalist conveyed the land by warranty deed to a buyer, who paid valuable consideration, knew nothing of the daughter's claim, and promptly and properly recorded. Next, the daughter recorded her deed. Then the buyer conveyed the land by quitclaim deed to his son as a gift. When the possible conflict with the daughter was discovered, the son recorded his deed.

The land at all relevant times has been vacant unoccupied land.

The recording act of the jurisdiction provides: "No unrecorded conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value without notice, who shall first record." No other statute is applicable.

The son has sued the daughter to establish who owns the land.
stemZh:
一位环保主义者通过退让地契将自己的土地作为礼物送给他的女儿,而女儿后来没有记录她的地契.后来,环保主义者通过担保契约将土地转交给了一位买主,后者付出了宝贵的报酬,对女儿的主张一无所知,并迅速和适当地记录了下来。 接下来,女儿记录了她的契约。然后买方将土地作为礼物通过放弃认领地契转交给儿子,当发现可能与女儿发生冲突时,儿子记录了他的地契。

土地在所有有关时期都空置无人占用的土地。

辖区的录制行为规定:"未记录的不动产转让或者抵押,不得对后续购买人进行价值优待,应当先行记录",其他法规不予适用.

儿子起诉女儿 确定谁拥有土地。
ask: For whom will the court hold?
askZh: 朝廷会为谁着想?

options.en: The daughter, because she recorded before the son.
options.zh: 女儿,因为她在儿子面前录制.

options.en: The daughter, because the son was a subsequent donee.
options.zh: 女儿,因为儿子是后来的被害者.

options.en: The son, because the buyer's purchase cut off the daughter's rights.
options.zh: 儿子,因为买家的购买剥夺了女儿的权利.

options.en: The son, because the daughter was a donee.
options.zh: 儿子,因为女儿是神仙

explanation.en:
The priority of competing property interests is determined by the jurisdiction's recording act. In a race-notice jurisdiction (as seen here), a purchaser has priority over another's earlier property interest if the purchaser:

is bona fide (ie, a BFP) because the purchaser obtained an interest in property without notice of the earlier interest and recorded first. Under the Shelter Rule, a person who receives a property interest from a BFP is entitled to the same protection under the recording act as the BFP—even if that person would not otherwise be protected by the recording act.

Here, the buyer's purchase cut off the daughter's rights because the buyer knew nothing of the daughter's prior interest (BFP) and recorded his deed before the daughter recorded hers.* And though the son received the land as a gift from the buyer (not a BFP) and recorded his deed after the daughter recorded hers, the Shelter Rule entitles him to the buyer's protection under this jurisdiction's race-notice act. As a result, the court should rule for the son.

*Had the buyer recorded his deed after the daughter recorded hers, the buyer would not have had priority under the recording act and the daughter would have prevailed.

(Choices A & B) The recording act would not ordinarily protect the son from the daughter's prior claim since he was a donee (not a BFP) and the daughter recorded before him. But since he was gifted the land by a BFP (the buyer) who recorded before the daughter, the son is protected from her claim under the Shelter Rule.

(Choice D) The daughter's status as a donee would only matter if she were seeking to establish priority over an earlier competing interest in the land. Since she has the earlier claim here, her status as a donee is irrelevant.

Educational objective:

In a race-notice jurisdiction, a purchaser who lacks notice of an earlier property interest (BFP) and records first will prevail. And under the Shelter Rule, a person who receives a property interest from a BFP is entitled to the same protection under the recording act as the BFP.

explanation.zh:
竞合财产权益的优先权由该法域的记录行为决定.在一个种族通知法域中(如此处所示),购买者优先于另一个先前的如果购买者:

是善意的(即BFP),因为买方在未通知先前的权益的情况下获得了财产权益,并首先加以记录。根据《庇护规则》,从英国联邦警察局获得财产权益的人根据记录法有权获得与英国联邦警察局相同的保护,即使此人否则不会受到记录法的保护。

在此,买方的购买剥夺了女儿的权利,因为买方不知道女儿的先前利益(BFP),并在女儿记录女儿的契约之前记录了他的契约。根据《庇护规则》,他有权获得买方的根据本辖区的种族通知法提供保护。因此,朝廷应该为儿子作出裁决.

* 如果买方在女儿录制其契约之后记录其契约,买方就不会根据该记录法享有优先权,而女儿也会占上风。

(Choices A & B) 录音行为通常不会保护儿子免遭女儿先前的声称,因为他是一名受难者(不是BFP),而且女儿被记录在他面前。但是,由于他的土地是由一位BFP(买主)赠予的,后者在女儿面前作了记录,因此根据《庇护规则》,儿子不受她要求的保护。

女儿作为被害者的地位只有在她试图确立相对于先前对土地的相互竞争的利益的优先权的情况下才重要。 由于她在此拥有较早的主张,她作为被害者的地位是无关紧要的。

学习要点：

在种族通知法域中,买方如未事先通知财产权益(BFP)和记录,将首先优先。根据《庇护规则》,从联邦警察局获得财产权益的人有权获得与联邦警察局一样的录音保护。

stem:
A man wanted to downsize his home after his youngest child moved out to attend college. To finance the purchase, the man secured a loan from a bank and executed a promissory note in which he agreed to repay the bank's loan over a 30-year period. The loan was secured by a mortgage on the new home. The bank promptly and properly recorded the mortgage.

A year later, the man missed several mortgage payments and abandoned the home shortly thereafter. The bank initiated judicial foreclosure proceedings once it learned of the man's abandonment.
stemZh:
一个人在最小的孩子搬出去上大学后想缩小他的家规模,为了资助购买,他从一家银行获得贷款,并执行一张期票,其中同意在30年内偿还银行贷款.贷款是通过对新住房的抵押来担保的,银行迅速和适当地记录了抵押。

一年后,这名男子错过了几笔按揭付款,并在不久后放弃了住宅. 银行得知这名男子被放弃后,便启动了司法赎回程序.
ask: In a jurisdiction that follows the intermediate theory of mortgages, which of the following events first entitled the bank to take possession of the mortgaged property?
askZh: 在遵循抵押权中间理论的法域中,下列哪一种情况首先使银行有权占有抵押财产?

options.en: The man executing the mortgage.
options.zh: 执行抵押贷款的人

options.en: The man defaulting on the mortgage.
options.zh: 那个拖欠抵押贷款的人

options.en: The man abandoning the property.
options.zh: 弃财物者.

options.en: The bank foreclosing on the property.
options.zh: 银行抵押财产

explanation.en:
A lender's (mortgagee's) right to take possession of mortgaged property depends on the mortgage theory followed in that jurisdiction:

Lien theory (majority rule) – the mortgagor (borrower) is considered the owner of the mortgaged property, so the lender cannot take possession prior to foreclosure.

Title theory – the lender is considered the owner of the mortgaged property until the mortgage has been paid in full, so the lender may take possession at any time.*

Intermediate theory – the mortgagor is considered the owner of the mortgaged property until default, so the lender obtains legal title (ie, the right of ownership and possession) to the property upon default.

Since this jurisdiction follows the intermediate theory of mortgages, the man was entitled to possession of the home until he defaulted on the mortgage (Choice A). Therefore, the bank first acquired the right of ownership and possession of the home upon default.

*However, mortgage agreements typically limit this right so that the lender may take possession only upon default.

(Choice C) Under any mortgage theory, a lender may take possession of mortgaged property if it is abandoned by the mortgagor. But here, the man defaulted on the mortgage loan before he abandoned the property, so the bank was entitled to possession prior to his abandonment.

(Choice D) The bank was first entitled to take possession of the home when the man defaulted on the mortgage, which occurred prior to foreclosure.

Educational objective:

Under the intermediate theory of mortgages, a mortgagor is entitled to possession until default, at which time the lender acquires legal title (ie, the right to own and possess) to the mortgaged property.

explanation.zh:
出贷人(抵押人)占有抵押财产的权利取决于该法域采用的抵押理论:

Lien理论(多数规则) – 抵押权人(借款人)被认为是抵押财产的所有人,因此贷款人不能在赎回之前占有.

所有权理论 – 出贷人被视为抵押财产的所有人,直到抵押款全额清偿,因此出贷人可以随时占有. *

中间理论 – 抵押权在违约前被视为抵押财产的所有人,因此出贷人在违约时获得对该财产的合法所有权(即所有权和占有权).

由于该法域遵循抵押权的中间理论,男子有权占有该住房,直到他拖欠抵押权(Choice A)。 因此,银行首先在违约时获得该住房的所有权和占有权。

* 然而,抵押协议通常限制这一权利,使出贷人只能在违约时才能占有。

(C选择)根据任何抵押权理论,如果抵押权人放弃抵押财产,出贷人可以占有抵押财产.但在这里,这名男子在放弃财产之前就拖欠了抵押贷款,因此银行在放弃之前有权占有.

(Choice D)当男子拖欠抵押贷款时,银行首先有权占有住房,这发生在取消赎回权之前。

学习要点：

根据抵押权的中间理论,抵押权人有权在违约前占有,届时出贷人获得对抵押财产的合法所有权(即拥有和占有权)。

stem:
A land developer executed and delivered a promissory note and a mortgage securing the note to a bank. The bank was named as payee in the note and as mortgagee in the mortgage. The note also included a statement that the indebtedness evidenced by the note was "subject to the terms of a contract between the maker and the payee of the note executed on the same day" and that the note was "secured by a mortgage of even date." The mortgage was promptly and properly recorded.

Subsequently, the bank sold the land developer's note and mortgage to an investor and delivered to the investor a written assignment of the land developer's note and mortgage. The assignment was promptly and properly recorded. The bank retained possession of both the note and the mortgage in order to act as collecting agent.

Later, being short of funds, the bank sold the note and mortgage to an asset management company at a substantial discount. The bank executed a written assignment of the note and mortgage to the asset management company and delivered to it the note, the mortgage, and the assignment. The asset management company paid value for the assignment without actual knowledge of the prior assignment to the investor and promptly and properly recorded the assignment. The principal of the note was not then due, and there had been no default in payment of either interest or principal.
stemZh:
土地开发商执行并向一家银行交付了本票和抵押,该银行在票据中被指为收款人,在抵押中被指为抵押人。附注中还写明,该附注所证明的负债"须遵守同日执行的票据的制作人与收款人之间的合同条款",且该附注"以偶数日的抵押作保".迅速和正确记录。

随后,该银行将土地开发商的票据和抵押权出售给投资人,并向投资人交付了土地开发商的票据和抵押权的书面转让,该转让被及时,正确地记录下来.银行保留对票据和抵押的占有,以作为收款代理。

后来,由于资金短缺,银行以大幅折价将纸币和抵押给一家资产管理公司.银行执行书面转让票据和抵押给资产管理公司,向其交付票据,抵押,转让.资产管理公司在未实际了解先前转让情况的情况下向投资方支付了转让价值,并迅速和适当地记录了转让情况。该票据本金没有到期,也没有拖欠付款。利息或本金。
ask: If the issue of ownership of the land developer's note and mortgage is subsequently raised in an appropriate action by the investor to foreclose, for whom should the court hold?
askZh: 如果土地开发商的票据和抵押权的所有权问题随后被投资方在适当的诉讼中提出取消抵押权,那么法院应当为谁持有?

options.en: The asset management company as to both the note and the mortgage.
options.zh: 资产管理公司对票据和抵押权的处理.

options.en: The investor as to both the note and the mortgage.
options.zh: 投资人对票据和抵押权的处理.

options.en: The asset management company as to the note and the investor as to the mortgage.
options.zh: 资产管理公司关于票据,投资人关于抵押.

options.en: The investor as to the note and the asset management company as to the mortgage.
options.zh: 投资人关于票据和资产管理公司关于抵押权.

explanation.en:
Transfer of promissory note & mortgage

Transfer of both documents Both documents are transferred unless:

expressly prohibited in note/mortgage forbidden by statute or public policy or increases mortgagor's duties, burdens, risks

Transfer of note without mortgage

Transfer of mortgage without note*

Transfer is void

*Jurisdictions are split as to effect of transfer.

A mortgage is a document that gives the mortgagee (eg, bank) an interest in real property as security for an obligation owed by the mortgagor (ie, borrower). The obligation is typically memorialized in a promissory note. The mortgagee is generally free to transfer the promissory note and/or the mortgage securing that note unless:

the mortgage or note expressly states otherwise the transfer is forbidden by statute or public policy or the transfer will increase the duties, burdens, or risks on the mortgagor. The recipient of the transferred note/mortgage (ie, transferee) then acquires the right of foreclosure. However, the transferee can lose this right to a bona fide purchaser—ie, one who pays value for the property interest without notice of another's prior interest in the property.

Here, the investor acquired the right of foreclosure when it purchased the note and mortgage from the bank. The investor promptly and properly recorded the assignment (ie, transfer), providing record notice to any subsequent purchasers of that note and mortgage—including the asset management company. Since the asset management company was not a bona fide purchaser, it did not acquire the investor's right of foreclosure. Therefore, the court should hold for the investor as to both the note and the mortgage (Choices A, C & D).

Educational objective:

The recipient of a promissory note and mortgage securing that note acquires the right of foreclosure. However, the recipient can lose this right if the note and mortgage are subsequently conveyed to a bona fide purchaser—ie, one who pays value without notice of another's prior interest.

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 5.4 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (transfer of mortgages).

期票转让和抵押

转移两份文件,除非:

法规或公共政策所禁止的注解/抵押或增加抵押者的职责、负担、风险

无抵押的票据转让

无纸质抵押权的转让*

传输无效

* 关于移交的效力,管辖权是分开的。

抵押权是给予抵押人(如银行)不动产权益作为抵押权人(即借款人)所欠债务的担保的票据,该债务通常以本票的形式加以纪念。抵押人一般可以自由转让本票和/或为该本票作保的抵押,除非:

抵押贷款或票据明确规定,除非法规或公共政策禁止转让,否则转让将增加抵押贷款人的责任、负担或风险。被转让票据/抵押权的接受人(即受让人)然后取得取消赎回权,但受让人可能将这一权利失去给善意购买人的权利,即支付财产权益价值而未通知他人先前对财产权益的利益的人。财产。

在此,投资方在从银行购买票据和抵押时获得了赎回权.投资方迅速和适当地记录了转让(即转让),向该票据和抵押的任何随后的购买者——包括资产管理公司——提供记录通知。由于资产管理公司不是善意的购买者,它没有取得投资者的赎回权,因此,法院应当为投资人确定票据和抵押权(Choices A, C & D)。

学习要点：

对本票作保的期票和抵押的接受人取得取消赎回权,但如果该期票和抵押随后被传递给善意的购买人,而后者在不通知的情况下支付价值,则接受人可能丧失这一权利。别人以前的兴趣。

stem: A landowner executed an instrument in the proper form of a deed, purporting to convey his land to a friend. The landowner handed the instrument to the friend, saying, "This is yours, but please do not record it until after I am dead. Otherwise, it will cause me no end of trouble with my relatives." Two days later, the landowner asked the friend to return the deed to him because he had decided that he should devise the land to the friend by will rather than by deed. The friend said that he would destroy the deed and a day or so later falsely told the landowner that the deed had been destroyed. Six months ago, the landowner, who had never executed a will, died intestate, survived by a daughter as his sole heir. The day after the landowner's death, the friend recorded the deed from him. As soon as the daughter discovered this recording and the friend's claim to the land, she brought an appropriate action against the friend to quiet title to the land.
stemZh: 一个地主以契合的形式执行了一件文书,声称要将他的土地传递给朋友,地主把文书交给朋友说:"这是你的,但请在我死后再记录.否则,这不会使我与我的亲属发生任何麻烦。” 两天后,地主要求这位朋友把地契还给他,因为他决定他应该通过遗嘱而不是通过契约来设计土地给这位朋友。这位朋友说,他将破坏地契,一天左右之后,他谎称地契被破坏,半年前,从未执行遗嘱的地契人死后没有遗嘱,以女儿为唯一继承人幸存下来.地主死后第二天,这位朋友录下了他的契据,女儿一发现这段记录和这位朋友对土地的主张,她就对这位朋友提起了适当的诉讼,要求他安静地拥有土地的所有权.
ask: For whom should the court hold?
askZh: 法庭应该为谁辩护?

options.en: The daughter, because the death of the landowner deprived the subsequent recording of any effect.
options.zh: 女儿,因为地主的死亡剥夺了后来记录的任何效果.

explanation.en:
A deed is a document that transfers ownership of real property from the owner (grantor) to another (grantee) once it has been:

delivered – evidenced by the grantor's intent to presently convey ownership to the grantee and accepted – presumed when the transfer benefits the grantee. Delivery is presumed if the grantor hands the deed to the grantee. This presumption can generally be rebutted by evidence that the grantor did not intend to presently transfer ownership. But evidence that the grantor gave the deed to the grantee subject to an oral condition is inadmissible, so that condition cannot be enforced.

Here, delivery is presumed since the landowner handed the deed to the friend. And that presumption is not rebuttable since evidence of the landowner's oral condition ("please do not record it until after I am dead") is inadmissible. Therefore, the condition is not enforceable, and the court should hold for the friend.

(Choices A & D) Recording a deed (ie, filing it in the official land records) after the grantor's death creates a presumption of delivery. But this presumption can be rebutted by evidence that the grantor did not deliver the deed during his/her life. Here, though the deed was not recorded until after the landowner's death, it was delivered during his life (when he handed it to the friend). Therefore, the land was effectively conveyed to the friend.

(Choice B) Once a deed has been delivered and accepted, the grantee owns the property and the transfer cannot be canceled (eg, by destroying the deed). Therefore, the friend's dishonesty in reporting that he had destroyed the deed is inconsequential.

Educational objective:

A deed is delivered when the grantor intends to presently transfer ownership to the grantee (presumed when the deed is in the grantee's possession). Evidence that the grantor gave the deed to the grantee subject to an oral condition is inadmissible to rebut this presumption, and the condition is unenforceable.

explanation.zh:
契约是将不动产所有权从所有人(设保人)转让给另一人(设保人)的单证,条件是:

转让 — — 以设保人目前打算将所有权传递给受赠人并被接受为证据 — — 推定转让有利于受赠人。如果设保人将契约交给受赠人,则推定交付。这一推定一般可以通过设保人不打算转移所有权的证据予以反驳,但设保人将契约交给受赠人并附带口头条件的证据是不可受理的,因此该条件不能强制执行。

在这里,交货是推定的,因为地主将地契交给了朋友。 而这种推定是不可反驳的,因为地主口述条件的证据("请在我死前不要记录")是不可辩驳的。因此,该条件不能执行,法院应支持朋友。

(Choices A & D)在设保人死亡后记录一份地契(即将其存档于官方土地记录),从而产生交付的推定,但这种推定可以通过设保人在生前没有交付地契的证据予以反驳。在这里,虽然契约直到地主死后才被记录下来,但在地主的生前(当他把契约交给朋友的时候),契约是交付的,故土地被有效地传递给朋友。

(Choice B) 一旦一份契约被交付并被接受,受赠者将拥有财产,转让不能被取消(比如通过销毁契约)。因此,朋友在报告他销毁契约时的不诚实是不必要的。

学习要点：

当设保人打算目前将所有权转让给受赠人时(在受赠人拥有该契约时假定),即交付契约。设保人将契约交给受赠人并附带口头条件的证据,不能反驳这一推定,该条件不可执行。

stem:
A landowner needed money. His land was fairly worth $100,000, so the landowner tried to borrow $60,000 from a lender on the security of the land. The lender agreed, but only if the landowner would convey the land to the lender outright by warranty deed, with the lender agreeing orally to reconvey to the owner once the loan was paid according to its terms. The landowner agreed, conveyed the land to the lender by warranty deed, and received $60,000 cash from the lender. The lender promptly and properly recorded the landowner's deed.

Now, the landowner has defaulted on repayment with $55,000 still due on the loan. The landowner is still in possession.
stemZh:
一名土地所有人需要资金。其土地的合理价值为 100,000 美元，于是他试图以该土地作担保，向贷款人借款 60,000 美元。贷款人同意，但条件是土地所有人须通过附保证的地契，将土地直接转让给贷款人；贷款人则口头同意，只要借款按约清偿，就把土地重新转让给原所有人。土地所有人接受该条件，向贷款人交付了附保证的地契，并从贷款人处取得 60,000 美元现金。贷款人及时、依法登记了该地契。

现在，土地所有人拖欠还款，贷款余额仍有 55,000 美元未付；他仍占有该土地。
ask: Which of the following best states the parties' rights in the land?
askZh: 以下哪一个最能说明各方对土地的权利?

options.en: The attempted security arrangement is null as an unknown creature to the law, so the lender has only a personal right to $55,000 from the landowner.
options.zh: 未遂的担保安排作为法律的未知生物是无效的,因此出贷人只有地主55,000美元的个人权利.

options.en: The landowner, having defaulted, has no further rights in the land, so the lender may obtain summary eviction.
options.zh: 土地所有者违约后,对土地没有进一步的权利,因此放款人可以获得即时驱逐。

options.en: The lender may bring whatever foreclosure proceeding is appropriate under the laws of the jurisdiction.
options.zh: 出贷人可以根据法域的法律提起任何适当的赎回程序。

options.en: The lender's oral agreement to reconvey is invalid under the statute of frauds, so the lender owns the land outright.
options.zh: 根据防止欺诈法,贷款人口头同意重新征用土地是无效的,因此贷款人直接拥有土地。

explanation.en:
Mortgage alternatives

Absolute deed Debtor gives deed to creditor with intent to secure loan (ie, equitable mortgage)

Deed of trust Debtor gives deed of trust to third-party trustee as collateral for debt, & creditor can instruct trustee to foreclose upon default

Installment land contract

Debtor agrees to buy land through installment payments & gets immediate possession, but seller keeps legal title until paid in full

Sale-leaseback Seller leases property from buyer immediately after sale, & seller's rental payments function as repayments on loan

Equitable vendor's lien

Seller finances buyer's purchase with equitable vendor's lien when seller transfers title to buyer but purchase price not fully paid

A mortgage is a lien against real property that is given to secure a debt and is often memorialized in two documents:

Mortgage deed – a writing that conveys an interest in the real property to secure the debt Promissory note – a formal "IOU" in which the borrower promises to repay the debt according to the listed terms (eg, interest rate, payment schedule, acceleration clause) But an equitable mortgage can be established by an absolute deed (or other alternative means) that was intended to secure a debt. As a result, the deed recipient (like any other lender) may bring a foreclosure action if the debtor defaults on repaying the loan.

Here, the landowner conveyed his land to the lender outright by warranty deed. And since the lender agreed to reconvey the land once the loan was paid, the deed was intended to secure the landowner's debt. As a result, the deed will be treated as an equitable mortgage (ie, an absolute deed) (Choice A). This means that the lender can bring an appropriate foreclosure proceeding to recover the $55,000 still due on the loan.

(Choice B) A summary eviction is a legal procedure that allows a landlord to quickly remove a tenant from leased property without the formalities of a full trial. But it does not allow a lender (mortgagee) to remove a borrower (mortgagor) from mortgaged land.

(Choice D) A mortgage is subject to the statute of frauds, so it must be in writing, signed by the parties against whom it is to be enforced, and contain all essential terms. Therefore, the lender's oral agreement to reconvey the land is invalid under this statute. But the written warranty deed is valid under the statute, and extrinsic evidence (eg, the oral agreement) can be used to show the parties' intent to create a mortgage.

Educational objective:

A mortgage is typically evidenced by a mortgage deed and a promissory note. But an equitable mortgage can also be created when an absolute deed is made with the intent that it secure a debt.

References

Restatement (Third) of Prop.: Mortgages § 3.2 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (absolute deed as mortgage).

explanation.zh:
抵押替代方案

债务人向债权人提供地契,以获得贷款(即公平抵押)

债务人向第三方受托人提供信托契约作为债务的抵押,债权人可指示受托人在发生违约时取消抵押权

安装土地合同

债务人同意通过分期付款购买土地并立即拥有土地,但卖方在全额付款之前仍拥有合法所有权。

卖方在出售后立即向买方租赁财产,卖方的租金付款作为偿还贷款的作用

公平供应商留置权

卖方将所有权转让给买方,但购买价款未全额支付时,以公平卖方的留置权为买方的购买融资

抵押权是对不动产的留置权,这种留置权是用来担保债务的,并且往往通过两种文件加以纪念:

抵押契约 — — 表示对不动产的权益以担保债务本票 — — 正式的“IOU” ,其中借款人承诺根据所列条件(如利率、付款时间表、加速条款)偿还债务。平等抵押可以通过绝对的契约(或其他替代手段)加以确定,即:因此,契约接受人(与其他任何贷款人一样)可带来一笔债务人拖欠偿还贷款的,解除赎回权。

在这里,地主通过担保契约将他的土地直接转交给了放款人,由于放款人同意在贷款支付后重新征用土地,该契约意在为地主的债务提供担保。因此,地契将被视为公平的抵押(即绝对地契) (Choice A) 。 这意味着放款人可以提出适当的赎回程序,以收回贷款到期的55,000美元。

(Choice B) 即时拆迁是一种法律程序,允许房东在没有经过全面审判的手续的情况下迅速将租户从租来的地产上拆迁出去,但不允许贷款人(mortgagee)将借款人(mortgagagor)从抵押的土地中拆迁.

(Choice D) 抵押受防止欺诈法的约束,因此抵押必须以书面形式,由被执行抵押的当事人签署,并包含所有基本条件,因此,根据本法规,出贷人对土地的重新占有的口头协议无效.但书面担保契约根据法规是有效的,外部证据(如口头协议)可用于表明当事人设定抵押权的意图.

学习要点：

抵押贷款通常以抵押契约和本票作为证据。 但当一项绝对契约意图为债务提供担保时,也可以设定公平的抵押。

参考资料

重述(第三篇):抵押贷款第3.2条(Am.Law Inst. 1997)(绝对契约作为抵押贷款)。

stem:
A man conveyed land by quitclaim deed as a gift to his cousin, who did not then record the deed or take possession of the land. Six months later, when the man was still in possession, he conveyed the land by quitclaim deed as a gift to a friend, who knew nothing of the deed to the cousin. The friend did not record his deed. The man then vacated the land, and the friend took possession.

The recording act of the jurisdiction provides as follows: "No unrecorded conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value without notice, who shall first record."

Recently, the cousin learned about the friend's deed and possession, immediately recorded her deed, and sued the friend for possession and to quiet title. The friend then recorded his deed and raised all available defenses.
stemZh:
一个男子通过退让地契将土地作为礼物送给他的表弟,他后来没有记录地契或占有土地.半年后,当那人仍占有时,他通过退让地契将土地传递给一个朋友,他不知道对堂兄弟的契约,朋友没有记录他的契约,那人随后腾空了土地,朋友占有了土地.

辖区的录制行为规定如下:"未记载的不动产的转让或者抵押,对后继购买人的价值不作通知的,不得有好处,后者应当先作记录".

最近,堂兄弟得知了朋友的契据和财产,立即将她的契据记录下来,并起诉朋友的契据和安静的头衔,朋友随后记录了他的契据,并举出所有可用的辩护.
ask: For whom is the court likely to decide?
askZh: 对于谁,法院可能决定?

options.en: For the cousin, because she was first in time and the friend was not a purchaser.
options.zh: 对于表妹来说,因为她是第一个及时的,而朋友不是买家.

options.en: For the cousin, because the friend failed to first record.
options.zh: 对表妹来说,因为朋友没有第一次录音.

options.en: For the friend, because a subsequent good-faith donee has priority over a prior donee who fails to record.
options.zh: 对朋友来说,因为一个后来的善意的施展者比一个没有记录的前作者优先.

options.en: For the friend, because he was first in possession.
options.zh: 为了朋友 因为他是第一个占有者

explanation.en:
Priority of subsequent property interests

Recording act

Race Interest holder who records first will prevail

Notice Subsequent bona fide purchaser (BFP) without notice of earlier interest will prevail

Race-notice Subsequent BFP who lacks notice of earlier interest & records first will prevail

Common law

First in time

Earlier interest holder will prevail over subsequent interest holders

A jurisdiction's recording act is typically used to determine priority among competing interests in the same property. But if the recording act does not apply, priority will be determined under the common law "first-in-time" rule, which gives earlier property interests priority over subsequent property interests.

This jurisdiction's recording act (a race-notice statute) only protects subsequent purchasers for value who lack notice of a competing claim and record first. Since the man gifted his land to the cousin and then to the friend (ie, they were not purchasers), the recording act does not apply. Instead, the dispute will be resolved under the "first-in-time" rule. And the court will likely find for the cousin because she received her property interest before the friend received his.

(Choice B) Had the friend been a purchaser for value, he would have needed to record his property interest first to protect it under the jurisdiction's race-notice act. But since the friend was a gift recipient, the recording act does not apply and the friend will not lose on this basis.

(Choice C) An earlier donee's property interest always has priority over a subsequent donee's interest in a race-notice jurisdiction. The fact that the subsequent donee was a good-faith donee (ie, had no notice of the prior donee's interest) is immaterial.

(Choice D) The common law "first-in-time" rule gives priority to whoever acquires the property interest first—not whoever takes possession first. So, the cousin (not the friend) will prevail because she was gifted the land first.

Educational objective:

Priority among competing interests in the same property is generally evaluated under the jurisdiction's recording act. But if the recording act does not apply, priority will be assessed under the common law "first-in-time" rule, which prioritizes earlier property interests over subsequent ones.

explanation.zh:
后续财产权益的优先权

记录行为

先录制的种族利息持有人将获胜

事后善意购买人(BFP)如未事先通知其利益,将优先

事后,如果事先未通知利息和记录,将优先进行

普通法

时间第一

较早的利息持有人将优先于随后的利息持有人

法域的记录行为通常用来确定同一财产上竞合利益之间的优先权。但记录行为不适用的,将根据普通法的"先入为主"规则确定优先权,该规则赋予先前的财产权益优先于后续的财产权益.

本法域的录制行为(种族通知法规)只保护没有通知竞合债权并首先记录的后继购买人的价值。由于男方将土地赠与表妹,后又赠与朋友(即不是购买者),录音行为不适用,相反,争议将按照"先入为主"规则解决.法庭可能会找到她表弟 因为她收到她的财产权益 之前,她的朋友收到他。

(Choice B)如果这位朋友是价值购买者,他需要先记录他的财产权益,以便根据该法域的种族通知行为予以保护。但是由于朋友是礼物的接受者,录音行为并不适用,朋友也不会因此输掉.

(Choice)先行者的财产权益总是优先于后行者在种族通知管辖权中的利益,后行者是善意的(即没有注意到先行者的利益)这一事实无关紧要.

(Choice D)英美法的"先于时"规则赋予先获得财产权益的人优先,而不是先占有财产的人优先。 因此,表亲(不是朋友)将胜出,因为她先获得土地。

学习要点：

同一财产上相竞利益之间的优先权一般根据法域的记录法加以评估。但如果录音行为不适用,将根据普通法的"先入为主"规则评估优先权,该规则将先期财产权益优先于后期财产权益.

stem:
Ten years ago, a seller sold land to a buyer, who financed the purchase price with a loan from a bank that was secured by a mortgage on the land. The buyer purchased a title insurance policy running to both the buyer and the bank, showing no liens on the property other than the buyer's mortgage to the bank. Eight years ago, the buyer paid the mortgage in full.

Seven years ago, the buyer sold the land to an investor by a full covenant and warranty deed without exceptions.

Six years ago, the investor gave the land to a donee by a quitclaim deed.

Last year, the donee discovered an outstanding mortgage on the land that predated all of these conveyances. As a result of a title examiner's negligence, this mortgage was not disclosed in the title insurance policy issued to the buyer and the bank.

Following this discovery, the donee successfully sued the buyer to recover the amount of the outstanding mortgage.
stemZh:
十年前,一个卖主将土地卖给一个买主,买主通过以土地抵押为担保的银行贷款为购买价款融资.买方购买了对买方和银行的产权保险单,表明除了买方对银行的抵押之外,财产上没有留置权,8年前,买方全额支付了抵押。

七年前,买方通过一份完整的契约和担保契约,毫无例外地将土地卖给了投资者。

六年前,投资人通过一份退赔契约将土地交给了一头神仙.

去年,受赠方在所有这些承兑人之前的土地上发现了一笔尚未偿还的抵押贷款,由于产权审查员的疏忽,该抵押没有在向买方和银行签发的所有权保险单中披露。

在这次发现之后,受偿人成功地起诉买方,要求收回未偿抵押款。
ask: If the buyer sues the title insurance company to recover the amount he paid to the donee, is he likely to prevail?
askZh: 如果买方起诉产权保险公司以追偿他支付给受赠方的金额,他是否有可能胜诉?

options.en: No, because the buyer conveyed the land to an investor.
options.zh: 没有,因为买方将土地转给了投资者。

options.en: No, because the title insurance policy lapsed when the buyer paid off the bank's mortgage.
options.zh: 不,因为产权保险单在买方支付银行抵押贷款时失效。

options.en: Yes, because the buyer is protected by the title insurance policy even though he no longer owns the land.
options.zh: 是的,因为即使买方不再拥有土地,它仍受到产权保险的保护。

options.en: Yes, because the buyer was successfully sued by a donee and not by a bona fide purchaser for value.
options.zh: 是的,因为买方是被作案人成功起诉的,而不是被善意的买方以价值起诉的。

explanation.en:
A title insurance policy is a contract where the insurer agrees to indemnify (ie, compensate) the insureds within policy limits for any harm caused by title defects (eg, outstanding mortgages) not disclosed in the policy. There are two types of title insurance policies:

Owner's policy – issued to property owners and protects them from any reduction in the full market value of the property so long as it is (1) owned by the insureds and their heirs or (2) conveyed by warranty deed Lender's policy – issued to lenders and protects them from any reduction in the value or priority of their mortgage until the mortgage is paid in full or otherwise discharged Here, the buyer purchased a title insurance policy that was issued to the buyer (owner) and the bank (lender). The bank's policy lapsed once the buyer paid off the mortgage, but the buyer's policy remained in effect even after he conveyed the property by warranty deed

(Choices A & B). The buyer's right to the full market value of the property was then reduced by the donee's successful suit for the cost of the undisclosed outstanding mortgage. And since the buyer's policy protects against such losses, he can likely recover that cost from the title insurance company.

(Choice D) Since the buyer was protected by the title insurance policy, he could recover costs from a successful lawsuit. It is irrelevant that the buyer had been sued by a donee (ie, gift recipient) instead of a bona fide purchaser (ie, purchaser for value who lacks notice of a prior competing interest).

Educational objective:

There are two types of title insurance policies: (1) owner's policy, which remains in effect as long as the property is owned by the insured or conveyed by warranty deed and (2) lender's policy, which ends once the mortgage is discharged.

References

43 Am. Jur. 2d Insurance § 518 (2018) (title insurance policies).

explanation.zh:
所有权保险单是保险人同意在保险限额内赔偿(即赔偿)保险单中未披露的所有权缺陷(例如未清偿的抵押贷款)所造成的任何损害的合同。

业主政策——发放给财产所有人,并保护他们免受财产的全部市场价值的任何降低,只要它(1)是被保险人及其继承人拥有的,或者(2)是通过担保契约放款人政策传达的——发放给放款人并保护他们从其抵押价值或优先权的任何减少到抵押已全额付款或以其他方式解除义务向买方(所有人)和银行(放款人)开具的保险单。银行的保单在买方支付抵押贷款后失效,但买方的保单即使在他通过保单转交财产后仍然有效。

(Choices A & B). 买受人对财产的全部市场价值的权利随后因受赠人对未公开的未清抵押品成本的成功诉讼而减少.由于买方的保单可以防止这种损失,他有可能从所有权保险公司收回这笔费用。

(Choice D)由于买方受到所有权保险单的保护,他可以从成功的诉讼中收回费用。买方被一个受赠人(即礼品接受人)而不是一个善意购买人(即价值购买人,未通知先前的相竞利益)起诉无关紧要。

学习要点：

所有权保险单有两种:(1)所有者保单,只要财产为被保险人所有或通过担保契约传递,保单仍然有效;(2)贷款人保单,一旦解除抵押权,保单即告终止.

参考资料

43 Am. Jur. 2d Insurance § 518 (2018)(所有权保险单).

stem:
A farmer borrowed $100,000 from a bank and gave the bank a promissory note secured by a mortgage on the farm that she owned. The bank promptly recorded the mortgage, which contained an acceleration clause and a due-on-sale provision.

A few years later, the farmer borrowed $5,000 from a second bank and gave that bank a promissory note secured by a mortgage on her farm. The bank promptly recorded the mortgage.

Subsequently, the farmer defaulted on her obligation to the first bank, which then validly accelerated the debt and instituted nonjudicial foreclosure proceedings as permitted by the jurisdiction. The second bank received notice of the foreclosure sale but did not send a representative to the sale. At the foreclosure sale, a buyer who was not acting in collusion with the farmer outbid all other bidders and received a deed to the farm.

Several months later, the original farmer repurchased her farm from the buyer, who executed a warranty deed transferring the farm to her. After the farmer promptly recorded that deed, the second bank commenced foreclosure proceedings on the farm. The farmer denied the validity of the second bank's mortgage.
stemZh:
一名农民向一家银行借款10万美元,并给了该银行一张以她拥有的农场抵押为担保的本票,该银行迅速记录了抵押,其中包含一个加速条款和到期出售条款。

几年后,该农民向第二家银行借了5000美元,并给了该银行一张以她农场抵押为担保的本票,该银行迅速记录了抵押.

随后,该农民不履行对第一银行的义务,该银行随后有效地加速了债务,并提起了管辖当局允许的非司法取消赎回权诉讼。第二家银行收到了取消赎回权出售的通知,但没有派代表参加出售,在取消赎回权出售时,一个没有与农民串通的买方向所有其他投标人投标,并收到一份到农场的契约。

几个月后,原农户向买主重新购买了她的农场,买主执行了一份将农场转让给她的担保契约,在农民迅速记录了该契约后,第二家银行开始了农场的赎回程序。农民否认第二银行抵押贷款的有效性.
ask: Does the second bank continue to have a valid mortgage on the farm?
askZh: 第二家银行是否继续拥有有效的农场抵押贷款?.

options.en: No, because of the due-on-sale provision in the farmer's mortgage to the first bank.
options.zh: 不,因为农民向第一银行抵押贷款时的到期售价规定.

options.en: No, because the purchase at the foreclosure sale by the buyer under these facts eliminated the second bank's junior mortgage lien.
options.zh: 不,因为买方根据这些事实在取消赎回权销售时进行的购买取消了第二银行的次级抵押留置权。

options.en: Yes, because of the doctrine of estoppel by deed.
options.zh: 是的,因为不容反悔的理论 通过行动。

options.en: Yes, because the original owner reacquired title to the farm.
options.zh: 是的,因为原主人重新获得了农场的所有权。

explanation.en:
Foreclosure methods

Judicial sale

(all states)

Judicially supervised public sale of mortgaged property

Nonjudicial sale

(half of all states)

Privately conducted public sale of mortgaged property (permitted only if mortgage contains power-of-sale clause)

Strict foreclosure

(few states)

Foreclosure without sale of mortgaged property

About half of all states permit nonjudicial foreclosure proceedings—ie, a privately conducted public sale of the mortgaged property (as in this case). The foreclosure sale generally destroys all interests that are junior to the mortgage being foreclosed. As a result, junior interest holders are necessary parties who must be given notice of the foreclosure so that they can participate (or send a representative). Failure to notify a junior interest holder results in the preservation of that party's interest despite the foreclosure sale.

Here, the first bank instituted nonjudicial foreclosure proceedings after the farmer defaulted on her mortgage. The second bank (junior interest holder) received notice of the foreclosure sale but did not participate in or send a representative to the sale. This means that when the buyer purchased the farm in the foreclosure sale, the second bank's junior mortgage lien was eliminated. Accordingly, the second bank does not have a valid mortgage on the farm.

(Choice A) A due-on-sale provision allows the mortgagee to declare the entire loan balance due and payable if the mortgagor sells the property without the mortgagee's permission. This provision is not implicated here because the farmer never sold the farm.

(Choice C) The doctrine of estoppel by deed (ie, after-acquired title) applies when a person conveys unowned property to another by warranty deed. If that person later acquires title to the property, it automatically passes to the grantee. But this doctrine is clearly inapplicable here since the farmer owned the farm when she executed both mortgages.

(Choice D) The fact that the farmer reacquired title to the farm would matter only if the buyer and the farmer had been acting in collusion. In that case, the second bank could claim that the foreclosure sale was a fraud intended to eliminate its interest in the farm.

Educational objective:

A foreclosure sale destroys all interests that are junior to the foreclosing mortgage, so the junior interest holders are necessary parties who must be given notice of the foreclosure. Otherwise, their interests are preserved post-sale.

References

55 Am. Jur. 2d Mortgages § 592 (2019) (requirement to notify junior lienholders of foreclosure action).

explanation.zh:
取消赎回权的方法

司法销售

(所有州)

在司法监督下公开出售抵押财产

非司法销售

(占所有国家的一半)

私人公开出售抵押财产(只有在抵押权含有出售权条款的情况下才允许)

严格取消赎回权

(国家)

不出售抵押财产而取消赎回权

大约一半的州允许非司法性的取消赎回权程序,即私下公开出售抵押财产(如本案),取消赎回权的出售一般会破坏所有低于取消抵押权的权益。因此,初级利益持有人是必需的当事方,必须通知他们取消赎回权,以便他们能够参加(或派出代表)。尽管出售了赎回权,但由于未通知低级权益持有人,该当事人的利益仍得到保全。

在此,第一家银行在农民拖欠抵押贷款后提起了非司法性的取消赎回权诉讼,第二家银行(初级利息持有人)收到了取消赎回权出售的通知,但没有参加或派出代表参与出售。这意味着买方在赎回权销售中购买农场时,第二银行的次级抵押留置权被取消,因此第二银行对该农场没有有效的抵押权.

(Choice A)到期售出规定,如果抵押权人未经抵押权人许可而出售该房产,抵押权人可以宣布到期应付的全部贷款余额,因为农民从未出售该农场,因此本规定在此不受影响。

(C选择)以契约方式(即事后获得的所有权)禁止反悔的学说适用于某人通过保修契约将未拥有的财产传递给另一人的情况,如果该人后来获得该财产的所有权,则自动转给受赠人。但是,这个学说在这里显然不适用,因为农户在她执行两项抵押贷款时都拥有农场.

(Choice D)农民重新获得农场所有权的事实只有在买方和农民串通的情况下才重要,在这种情况下,第二家银行可以声称赎回权的出售是一种欺诈,意在消除其在农场中的利益。

学习要点：

取消赎回权的出售会破坏所有低于取消抵押权的权益,因此初级权益持有者是必须通知取消赎回权的必要当事人,否则,他们的利益在出售后会得到保护。

参考资料

55 Am. Jur. 2d Mortgages § 592 (2019)(要求通知初级留置权人取消赎回权行动)。

stem:
A landowner in fee simple mortgaged the land to an investor to secure repayment of the loan she made to him. The loan was due at the end of the growing season of the year in which it was made. The landowner maintained and operated an orchard on the land, which was his sole source of income. Halfway through the growing season, the landowner experienced severe health and personal problems and, as a result, left the state; his whereabouts were unknown. The investor learned that no one was responsible for the cultivation and care of the orchard on the land. She undertook to provide, through employees, the care of the orchard and the harvest for the remainder of the growing season. The net profits were applied to the debt secured by the mortgage on the land.

During the course of the harvest, the landowner's friend, a business invitee, was injured by reason of a fault in the equipment used. Under applicable tort case law, the owner of the premises would be liable for the friend's injuries. The friend brought an appropriate action against the investor to recover damages for the injuries suffered, relying on this aspect of tort law.
stemZh:
一个收费的地主将土地抵押给投资人,以保证她向投资人提供的贷款得到还款,这笔贷款应在贷款当年的生长季节结束时到期。土地所有者在土地上维持和经营了一个果园,这是他唯一的收入来源,在生长季节中,土地所有者经历了严重的健康和个人问题,因此离开了国家;他下落不明。投资方得知,没有人负责在土地上种植和照顾果园,她承诺通过雇员提供果园的照顾和种植季节剩余时间的收获。净利润适用于土地抵押担保的债务。

在收割过程中,土地所有者的朋友,一名商业受邀者,因所用设备的过错而受伤,根据适用的侵权案例法,该房地的所有人应对该朋友的伤害负责。该朋友根据侵权行为法的这一方面,对投资人提起了适当的诉讼,以追回所受伤害的损失。
ask: In such lawsuit, for whom should the court render judgment?
askZh: 在这种诉讼中,法院应当为谁作出判决?

options.en: The friend, because the investor was a mortgagee in possession.
options.zh: 朋友,因为投资人是占有的抵押权人.

options.en: The friend, but only if the state is a title theory state, because in other jurisdictions a mortgagee has no title interest but only a lien.
options.zh: 朋友,但只有在国家是所有权理论国家的情况下,因为在其他法域,抵押权人没有所有权权益,只有留置权。

options.en: The investor, because she acted as agent of the landowner only to preserve her security interest.
options.zh: 投资人,因为她只是作为地主的代理人,只是为了维护她的担保权益。

options.en: The investor, but only if the mortgage expressly provided for her taking possession in the event of danger to her security interest.
options.zh: 投资人,但只有在抵押权明确规定她在担保权益有危险时可以占有.

explanation.en:
Mortgage theories

Lien theory

(majority rule)

Lender receives security interest in property. Mortgagor retains title & possession unless lender forecloses.

Title theory Lender receives legal title & mortgagor retains right of possession. Title reverts to mortgagor once debt is paid.

Intermediate theory

Mortgagor retains title & possession until default, then full title passes to lender without foreclosure.

A mortgage is a lien against real property given to secure a debt. Under the lien theory of mortgages (adhered to by a majority of jurisdictions), a mortgage creates a security interest only and confers no right to possession of the mortgaged property. Regardless of the applicable mortgage theory, however, the mortgagee is entitled to take possession if the mortgagor abandons the mortgaged property (Choice B). A mortgagee who does so incurs liability as if he/she were the owner (eg, tort liability to anyone injured on the property).

Here, the landowner mortgaged land to the investor. When the landowner abandoned the property due to severe health and personal problems, the investor rightfully took possession—regardless of whether the mortgage expressly permitted her to do so (Choice D). And since the facts stipulate that the owner of the premises would be liable for the friend's injuries, the investor is liable. The court should therefore render judgment for the friend.

(Choice C) In lieu of taking possession, most mortgagees attempt to preserve their security interest by getting a court-appointed receiver (ie, agent) to manage the property. This shields the mortgagee from the liability risks of being a mortgagee in possession. But no receivership was created on these facts.

Educational objective:

The mortgagee can take possession of the mortgaged property if the mortgagor abandons it. Once in possession, the mortgagee incurs liability as if he/she were the owner.

References

55 Am. Jur. 2d Mortgages § 153 (2019) (specifying rights and liabilities of mortgagee in possession).

Essex Cleaning Contractors, Inc. v. Amato, 317 A.2d 411, 412 (N.J. Super. 1974) (discussing tort liability of mortgagees in possession).

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 4.1(c) (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (identifying mortgagee rights to take possession).

explanation.zh:
抵押金理论

连环理论

(多数规则)

出贷人收到财产的担保权益。 Mortgagor 保留所有权和占有权,除非出贷人解除抵押权。

所有权理论 贷款人获得合法所有权 & mortgagor 保留占有权,一旦偿还债务,所有权就恢复为抵押权。

中间理论

Mortgagor在违约前保留所有权和占有权,然后将全部所有权转给放款人,而不取消赎回权。

抵押权是对为担保债务而给予的不动产的留置权,根据抵押权留置理论(大多数法域都赞同),抵押权只设定担保权益,不赋予抵押财产的占有权。然而,不论适用的抵押权理论如何,如果抵押权人放弃抵押的财产(Choice B),抵押权人有权占有。这样做的抵押权人承担的赔偿责任如同所有权人一样(例如,对财产上受到伤害的任何人的侵权责任)。

土地所有者将土地抵押给投资人,当土地所有者由于严重的健康和个人问题而放弃财产时,投资人有权占有——无论抵押是否明确允许她这样做(Choice D)。由于事实规定该房地的所有人应对朋友的伤害负责,投资人应承担责任,因此法院应为朋友作出判决。

(C选择)大多数抵押权人不是占有,而是试图通过让法院指定的接收人(即代理人)管理财产来维护其担保权益,这保护了抵押权人免于成为占有抵押权人的赔偿责任风险。但并没有根据这些事实建立破产。

学习要点：

抵押权人放弃抵押财产的,抵押权人可以占有抵押财产,抵押权人一旦占有,即承担如同所有权人一样的责任.

参考资料

55 Am. Jur. 2d Mortgages § 153 (2019)(具体说明占有抵押权人的权利和义务)。

Essex Cleanning Contractors, Inc. v. Amato, 317 A.2d 411, 412 (N.J. Super. 1974)(讨论占有抵押物的侵权责任).

重述(第三)财产:抵押权第4.1(c)节(《1997年第Am.Law Inst.》)(确认抵押权人占有权)。

stem:
A baker borrowed funds from an investor to purchase a plot of land on which the baker planned to build a new bakery. In order to secure repayment of the loan, the baker signed a nonnegotiable promissory note and executed a mortgage to the investor.

Five years later, the investor sold her promissory note to a credit union by endorsing the note and promptly delivering it to the credit union. Due to a downturn in business, the baker was unable to make payments on the mortgage. The credit union now seeks to foreclose on the baker's plot of land.
stemZh:
面包师向投资者借钱购买一块地皮,面包师计划在该地建造一个新的面包店,为了保证偿还贷款,面包师签署了不可流通的本票,并向投资者执行了抵押.

5年后,投资方将她的本票卖给了一家信用社,认可了本票,并迅速将本票交给了信用社. 由于生意下滑,面包师无法支付抵押贷款.信用社现在试图赎回面包师的地皮。
ask: If the court denies the credit union's foreclosure, what is the most likely reason?
askZh: 如果法院否认信用社的赎回权,最可能的原因是什么?

options.en: The mortgage required a separate written assignment in order for the transferee-credit union to enforce the mortgage.
options.zh: 抵押要求单独书面转让,以便受让人-信贷联盟强制执行抵押。

options.en: The nonnegotiable promissory note required a separate document for assignment to the credit union, so neither the note nor the mortgage transferred.
options.zh: 不可转让的本票需要一份单独的凭证才能转让给信用社,因此该票据和抵押权都没有转让。

options.en: The transfer of the nonnegotiable promissory note modified the terms of the loan, resulting in a release of the baker's personal liability.
options.zh: 不可转让本票的转让修改了贷款条件,导致面包师个人责任解除.

options.en: The transfer of the nonnegotiable promissory note without the mortgage was void.
options.zh: 未抵押的不可转让本票转让无效.

explanation.en:
Transfer of promissory note & mortgage

Transfer of both documents Both documents are transferred unless:

expressly prohibited in note/mortgage forbidden by statute or public policy or increases mortgagor's duties, burdens, risks

Transfer of note without mortgage

Transfer of mortgage without note*

Transfer is void

*Jurisdictions are split as to effect of transfer.

To finance the purchase of real property, a borrower typically executes two documents that serve as evidence of the debt:

Promissory note – a formal "IOU" that sets forth the terms of the loan. It is the primary evidence of the debt and is not recorded in the deed records.

Mortgage (or deed of trust) – a lien that secures the loan by attaching the debt to a real property interest and providing a means of enforcement (eg, foreclosure). It is recorded in the deed records to provide notice of an outstanding debt attached to the real property.

A promissory note can be assigned to another (an assignee) independent of the mortgage

(Choice D). The mortgage automatically transfers with the note once the note has been properly assigned (unless the parties agree otherwise) (Choice A). A negotiable promissory note can be assigned by simply endorsing and delivering the note to the assignee. However, a nonnegotiable promissory note requires a separate assignment document to transfer ownership.

Here, the investor sought to assign her nonnegotiable promissory note by endorsing and delivering it to the credit union. However, this type of promissory note requires that a separate document be executed to assign this interest. The investor failed to execute such a document, so the note (and therefore the accompanying mortgage) did not transfer to the credit union. And since the credit union has no security interest in the land, it cannot initiate foreclosure proceedings against the baker.

(Choice C) A transfer of the mortgagee's interest in the promissory note changes the party who receives payment on the note, but it does not change the terms of the mortgagor's obligation. Therefore, the transfer of the note did not modify the terms of the loan or release the baker's personal liability.

Educational objective:

Although a negotiable promissory note can be transferred by endorsing and delivering the note to another, a nonnegotiable promissory note requires that a separate document of assignment be executed to transfer ownership.

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 5.4 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (transfer of mortgages).

explanation.zh:
期票转让和抵押

转移两份文件,除非:

法规或公共政策所禁止的注解/抵押或增加抵押者的职责、负担、风险

无抵押的票据转让

无纸质抵押权的转让*

传输无效

* 关于移交的效力,管辖权是分开的。

为了资助购买不动产,借款人通常执行作为债务证据的两份文件:

Promissory note — — 一个正式的“IOU ” , 它规定了贷款条件。 它是债务的主要证据,没有记录在契约记录中。

抵押(或信托契约)——通过将债务附加于不动产权益并提供强制执行手段(例如,取消赎回权)来担保贷款的留置权。它记录在契约记录中,以提供有关不动产未偿债务的通知。

期票可以转让给独立于抵押的另一(受让人)

(Choice D),在票据适当转让后,抵押权随票据自动转移(除非当事人另有约定)(Choice A)。 可转让本票只需认可并向受让人发送票据即可转让。但是,不可转让的本票需要单独的转让文件才能转让所有权。

在此,投资方试图通过认可将其交给信用社来转让她不可转让的本票,然而,这类本票要求执行一份单独的文件来转让这种利息。投资者没有执行这样的文件,因此纸币(以及随之而来的抵押贷款)没有转移给信用社。 由于信用社对土地没有担保权益,它不能对面包师提起赎回诉讼。

(C组选择)抵押人对本票的权益转移,变更了收到本票付款的当事人,但不变更抵押人义务条款.因此,该纸币的转让没有修改贷款条件,也没有解除面包师的个人责任.

学习要点：

虽然可转让的本票可以通过认可和向另一本票交付而转让,但不可转让的本票要求执行单独的转让单证以转让所有权。

参考资料

重述(第三)财产:抵押权第5.4条(《1997年美国法律》)(抵押权的转让)。

stem:
A man decided to give a cabin he owned to his daughter at his death. To accomplish this goal, he delivered to his attorney a deed that fully complied with the applicable statute of frauds and told his attorney to record the deed when he died unless he later gave the attorney instructions to the contrary.

Three weeks after dropping off the deed, the man properly drafted and executed his own will, which left all of his real property to his son.

One year later, the man died, and the attorney immediately recorded the deed. At the time of the man's death, the cabin was titled in his name and he owned no other real property. The daughter and the son now disagree as to who is entitled to ownership of the cabin.

Other than the jurisdiction's statute of frauds and statute of wills, there are no applicable statutes.
stemZh:
一个男子决定把一个他死时拥有的小屋交给他的女儿,为了实现这一目标,他向他的律师交付了一份完全符合适用的防止欺诈法的契约,并告诉他的律师在他死时要记录该契约,除非他后来给了该契约。律师指示相反。

放弃契约三周后,此人妥善起草并执行了自己的遗嘱,将所有不动产留给儿子.

一年后,这名男子死亡,律师立即记录了契约。 在他去世时,该小屋以他的名字命名,他没有其他不动产。 女儿和儿子现在对谁有权拥有小屋持有异议。

除辖区的防止欺诈法和遗嘱法规外,没有适用的法规.
ask: Who is entitled to ownership of the cabin?
askZh: 谁有权拥有小屋?

options.en: The daughter, because the attorney was, for gift-law purposes, a trustee for the daughter.
options.zh: 她的女儿,因为律师,为了赠与法律的目的,是...女儿,你这混蛋

options.en: The daughter, because the deed fully complied with the statute of frauds.
options.zh: 女儿,因为契约完全符合诈骗法规.

options.en: The son, because the deed was not delivered to the daughter during the man's lifetime.
options.zh: 儿子,因为契约在男方生前没有交给女儿.

options.en: The son, because the proper execution of the will revoked the earlier gift to the daughter.
options.zh: 儿子,因为遗嘱的正确执行,取消了之前送给女儿的礼物.

explanation.en:
Presumed delivery of deed

Physical delivery (eg, by hand or mail) Recording Unconditional delivery to agent Grantee obtains possession of deed A deed is a document that transfers ownership of real property from the owner (grantor) to another (grantee) once it has been:

delivered – evidenced by the grantor's intent to presently convey ownership to the grantee (ie, the grantor must not retain a right to recover the deed) and accepted – presumed when the transfer benefits the grantee. Delivery is presumed if the deed is recorded (ie, filed in official land records). But this presumption can be rebutted by evidence that the grantor did not intend to presently transfer ownership. And if the deed is not delivered during the grantor's lifetime, it is void and conveys no interest.

Here, the attorney recorded the deed (presumed delivery). But the man retained the right to recover the deed by instructing the attorney to record it upon the man's death unless he gave instructions to the contrary (presumption rebutted). Therefore, the deed was not delivered to the daughter during his lifetime. And since the deed is void, the son (as the beneficiary under the man's will) is entitled to ownership of the cabin.

(Choice A) Since the man retained a right to recover the deed (no present intent to transfer), the son owns the property. But had the man relinquished that right when he gave the deed to the attorney (intending to presently transfer ownership), the attorney would have been the daughter's trustee—ie, her fiduciary who would have been legally required to hold the deed for her benefit until the man's death.

(Choice B) A deed must comply with the statute of frauds—ie, be in writing and signed by the party to be bound. But to effectively transfer ownership of property, the deed must also be delivered during the grantor's lifetime (and accepted by the grantee).

(Choice D) A properly executed will does not revoke an earlier gift that has been both delivered and accepted. That is because the testator (person who made the will) no longer owns the gifted property at death. Therefore, the son is not entitled to ownership of the cabin on this basis.

Educational objective:

To effectively transfer ownership of real property, a deed must be delivered during the grantor's lifetime (and then accepted by the grantee). There is no delivery if the grantor retains a right to recover the deed.

explanation.zh:
推定交付契约

实物交付(例如,通过手或邮件) 记录无条件交付给代理人的受赠人获得对契约的占有 契约是将不动产所有权从所有者(受赠人)转让给另一人(受赠人)的文件,一旦:

转让——以设保人目前打算将所有权转移给受赠人(即设保人不得保留收回契约的权利)并被接受——推定转让使受赠人受益。如果契约被记录(即正式土地记录中存档),则推定已交付,但可以证明设保人目前不打算转让所有权作为反驳。如果在出押人生前没有交付契约,则契约无效,且不传递权益.

在此,律师记录了契约(推定交付),但该男子保留收回契约的权利,他指示律师在该人死亡时记录契约,除非他给出相反的指示(推定已驳回)。因此,在女儿生前没有将契约交给他,由于契约无效,儿子(作为男方的受益人)有权获得船舱的所有权。

(Choice A)由于男子保留收回契约的权利(目前没有转移的意图),所以儿子拥有财产。但是,如果该男子在将地契交给律师时放弃了这项权利(打算转让所有权),律师本来是女儿的受托人——她的女儿的受托人,她在法律上被要求为她的利益持有地契,直到那个人的死

(Choice B) 契约必须遵守防止欺诈法——即必须以书面形式由受约束的一方签署,但为了有效转让财产所有权,契约也必须在设保人存续期间交付(并被受赠方接受)。

(Choice D) 正确执行的遗嘱不会撤销之前已经交付和接受的礼物,这是因为遗嘱人(遗嘱人)不再拥有死亡时捐赠的财产。因此,儿子无权据此获得小屋的所有权。

学习要点：

为了有效转让不动产的所有权,必须在设保人存续期间交付契约(然后被受赠人接受),如果设保人保留收回契约的权利,则不交付。

stem:
A woman who owned a house executed a deed purporting to convey the house to her son and his wife. The language of the deed was sufficient to create a common law joint tenancy with right of survivorship, which is unmodified by statute in the jurisdiction. The woman mailed the deed to the son with a letter saying: "Because I intend you and your wife to have my house after my death, I am enclosing a deed to the house. However, I intend to live in the house for the rest of my life, so don't record the deed until I die. The deed will be effective at my death."

The son put the deed in his desk. The wife discovered the deed and recorded it without the son's knowledge. Subsequently, the son and the wife separated, and the wife, without telling anyone, conveyed her interest in the house to a friend who immediately reconveyed it to the wife.

The woman learned that the son and the wife had separated and also learned what had happened to the deed to the house. The woman then brought an appropriate action against the son and the wife to obtain a declaration that the woman was still the owner of the house and an order canceling of record the woman's deed and the subsequent deeds.
stemZh:
拥有房屋的妇女执行的契约旨在将房屋传达给儿子和妻子,契约的语言足以形成普通法中具有遗属权的共有租赁权,而该法域的法规对此未作修改。那妇人把契文寄给儿子,信上写道:"因为我打算你和你妻子在我死后有我的房子,我把契文附在房里,不过,我打算一辈子住在房里,所以不要记载契文,直到我死为止.契约在我死后有效".

儿子把契子放在桌子上,妻子发现了契子,并在儿子不知情的情况下记录下来.随后,儿子和妻子分居,妻子在未告诉任何人的情况下,将自己对房子的兴趣转达给一个朋友,他立即将房子重新交给妻子。

女子得知儿子和妻子分居,也得知房屋契据发生的事.随后,该妇女对儿子和妻子提起了适当的诉讼,以获得妇女仍然是房主的声明,并下令取消该妇女的契约和随后的契约。
ask: If the court determines that the woman owns the house in fee simple, what will be the likely explanation?
askZh: 如果法院认定妇女拥有房屋的费用很简单,那么可能的解释是什么?

options.en: The deed was not delivered.
options.zh: 契约没有送达。

options.en: The wife's conduct entitles the woman to equitable relief.
options.zh: 妻子的行为使妇女有权获得公平的救济。

options.en: The woman expressly reserved a life estate.
options.zh: 该妇女明确保留了终身财产。

options.en: The woman received no consideration for her deed.
options.zh: 该妇女的行为没有得到任何考虑。

explanation.en:
Presumed delivery of deed

Physical delivery (eg, by hand or mail) Recording Unconditional delivery to agent Grantee obtains possession of deed A deed is a legal instrument that transfers an interest in real property from the owner (grantor) to another (grantee) once it has been:

delivered – evidenced by the grantor's intent to presently transfer an interest to the grantee, even if the interest itself is a future interest (ie, the possessory rights transfer later) and accepted – presumed if the transfer benefits the grantee. Recording a deed (ie, depositing it in official land records) creates a presumption of delivery. But this presumption can be rebutted by evidence that the grantor did not intend to presently transfer an interest to the grantee—eg, if the transfer was contingent upon a future event.

Here, delivery is presumed since the wife recorded the deed. But that presumption can be rebutted since the woman mailed the deed with a letter explaining that she only wanted the son and wife to have her house after her death (transfer contingent upon future event). Therefore, the court will likely determine that the woman owns the house in fee simple because the deed was not delivered.

(Choice B) A court may grant an injured party equitable relief (eg, rescinding or reforming a deed) to prevent unjust enrichment of a wrongdoer when other remedies are insufficient. Here, the wife was likely a wrongdoer since she recorded and conveyed the deed without the son's knowledge. But the court can hold that the woman owns the property since the deed was not delivered (sufficient remedy), so equitable relief is not needed.

(Choice C) A life estate is a possessory interest in land that is limited in duration by a life (eg, "to A for life"). Here, the woman attempted to reserve a life estate in her letter—not in the deed. But had she reserved a life estate in the deed, she would not own the home in fee simple since her ownership interest would terminate upon her death.

(Choice D) Consideration (eg, monetary payment) is not needed to create a valid deed or to effectively transfer a property interest to another.

Educational objective:

To transfer an interest in real property, a deed must be delivered (and accepted). Delivery occurs when the grantor intends to presently transfer an interest to the grantee. Therefore, delivery is ineffective if the transfer is contingent upon a future event.

推定交付契约

实物交付(例如,通过手或邮件) 记录无条件交付给代理人的受赠人获得契约的占有权 契约是将不动产权益从所有人(受赠人)转让给另一人(受赠人)的法律文书,条件是:

已交付 -- -- 其证明是设保人打算目前将利息转让给受赠人,即使该利息本身是未来利息(即后期的占有式权利转让)并被接受 -- -- 如果转让使受赠人受益,则推定。将契约记录下来(即将契约存入正式土地记录)可产生交付的推定,但这种推定可以被证明设保人目前不打算将权益转让给受赠人的证据所反驳,例如,如果转让是以转让为条件的,这种推定可以被推翻。未来活动。

在此,可以推定是交货,因为妻子记录了契约,但这种推定可以反驳,因为妇女寄信给契约,信中解释说,她只想让儿子和妻子在死后拥有房子(转移取决于未来事件)。因此,法院可能会确定,由于契约没有交付,该妇女拥有房屋的费用可能很简单。

(选择B)法院可给予受害方公平救济(例如撤销或改革一项契约),以防止在其他补救办法不足的情况下使不法行为者获得不公正的财富。在此,妻子很可能是错的,因为她记录并传达了契约,而儿子却不知情。 但法院可以认定,由于契约没有交付(充分的补救),该妇女拥有财产,因此不需要公平的救济。

生命财产是土地的占有性权益,其期限以生命为限(如“终生为A”),在此情况下,妇女试图在其信件中保留生命财产,而不是在契约中。但是,如果她在地契上保留了终身财产,她就不会以简单收费的方式拥有住房,因为她的所有权权益将在她去世时终止。

(Choice D) 不需要考虑(如金钱支付)来创造有效的契约或有效地将财产权益转移给他人.

学习要点：

为了转移不动产权益,必须交付(并接受)契约,在设保人打算目前将权益转让给受赠人时即为交付,因此,如果转让取决于未来事件,则交付无效。

stem:
A man decided to give his farm to his nephew. The man took a deed to his attorney and told the attorney to deliver the deed to the nephew upon the man's death. The man also told the attorney to return the deed to him if he asked. None of these instructions to the attorney were in writing, and the deed was not recorded. The man then e-mailed the nephew informing him of the arrangement.

Shortly thereafter, the nephew died testate. In his will, he devised the farm to his daughter. Several years later, the man died intestate, survived by two sons. The nephew's daughter immediately claimed ownership of the farm and demanded that the attorney deliver the deed to her.
stemZh:
一个人决定把农场交给他的侄子,他把一份地契交给了律师,并告诉律师在他去世时把地契交给他的侄子,他还告诉律师,如果律师要求,就把地契还给他。给律师的这些指示没有一个是书面的,也没有记录契约,这名男子随后用电子邮件通知侄子安排。

此后不久,这名侄子就去世了,在遗嘱中,他为女儿设计了农场,几年后,这名男子死于无遗嘱,幸存了两个儿子.该侄子的女儿立即声称拥有农场,并要求律师将地契交给她。
ask: Must the attorney deliver the deed to the nephew's daughter?
askZh: 律师必须把契约交给侄子的女儿吗?

options.en: No, because a gratuitous death escrow is void unless supported by a written contract.
options.zh: 没有 因为除非有书面合同支持 否则无缘无故的死亡代管人无效

options.en: No, because the man never placed the deed beyond his control.
options.zh: 不,因为那个男人从来没有把 契约超出他的控制。

options.en: Yes, because the death of the nephew rendered the gratuitous death escrow irrevocable by the man.
options.zh: 是的,因为侄子的死 使得无缘无故的死亡 代管人不可撤销。

options.en: Yes, because the deed to the nephew was legally delivered when the man took it to his attorney.
options.zh: 是的,因为对侄子的契约是合法交付的 当男人把它交给他的律师。

explanation.en:
A deed effectively transfers ownership of a landowner's (grantor's) real property to another (grantee) when it is delivered to, and accepted by, the grantee. To deliver a deed through a valid death escrow, the grantor must:

give the deed to an escrow agent (eg, attorney) with instructions to transfer it to the grantee upon the grantor's death and relinquish the right to take back the deed (ie, by placing the deed beyond his/her control). Here, the man attempted to deliver a deed to the farm through a death escrow. Though he gave his attorney the deed with instructions to deliver it to the nephew upon the man's death, the man explicitly retained the right to have the deed returned to him if he asked. Since the man never placed the deed beyond his control, the death escrow was invalid (no delivery). As a result, the nephew never acquired ownership of the farm and could not devise it to his daughter. And since she has no interest in the farm, the attorney need not deliver the deed to her.

(Choice A) Since most death escrows are gratuitous, a contract (written or oral) is not required. Instead, the death escrow was void because the man retained the right to take back the deed.

(Choice C) A gratuitous death escrow becomes irrevocable once the grantor delivers the deed—not when the grantee dies.

(Choice D) Delivery is presumed when a deed is given to the grantee directly. But when the deed is given to an escrow agent, there is no delivery unless the grantor relinquishes his/her right to recover it. And since the man retained the right to have the deed returned, giving it to his attorney (escrow agent) did not constitute delivery.

Educational objective:

A deed is delivered through a valid death escrow when (1) the deed is given to an escrow agent with instructions to transfer it to the grantee upon the grantor's death, and (2) the grantor relinquishes the right to take back the deed.

explanation.zh:
一份地主(设保人)不动产的所有权在交付给受赠人并被受赠人接受时有效转让给另一人(设保人)。

将契约交给代管代理人(例如律师),并指示在设保人死后将其转让给受赠人,并放弃收回契约的权利(即将契约置于其控制之外)。此人试图通过死亡代管人向农场交付一份契约,虽然他给了他的律师契约,并指示在死者死后将契约交给侄子,但此人明确保留了将契约退还给他的权利。由于这名男子从未将契约置于他控制之外,因此死亡代管人无效(没有交付),因此,他的侄子从未获得农场的所有权,也无法为女儿设计农场。既然她对农场没有兴趣 律师就不必把地契交给她

由于大多数死亡代管人是无缘无故的,因此不需要签订(书面或口头)合同。 相反,死亡代管是无效的,因为此人保留收回契约的权利。

一旦出押人交付了契约,而不是当受赠人死亡时,无偿死亡代管人就不可撤销。

(Choice D) 直接交给受赠方的契约即为推定交付,但当契约交给代管代理人时,除非设保人放弃收回契约的权利,否则将不交付。由于该男子保留要求归还契约的权利,将契约交给其律师(scrow代理)并不构成交付。

学习要点：

契约通过有效的死亡代管人交付:(1) 契约交给代管人,并指示在设保人死亡时将其转让给受赠人;(2) 设保人放弃收回契约的权利。

stem: A man defaulted on a loan that was secured by a mortgage on his home. The lender brought an appropriate action to foreclose the mortgage and, at the judicial foreclosure sale, the home was sold to a buyer. Shortly thereafter, the man inherited sufficient funds to enable him to reacquire the home from the buyer, but the buyer declined to sell.
stemZh: 一名男子未能偿还其住宅上的抵押贷款。贷款人提起诉讼以实现抵押权，并在司法拍卖中，该房屋被卖给了买家。此后不久，该男子继承了足够的资金，使他能够从买家处重新购买该房屋，但买家拒绝出售。
ask: Which of the following would provide the man with legal justification for pursuing an action for specific performance to compel the buyer to transfer ownership of the home to the man?
askZh: 下列哪一项可以为该男子提起强制履行之诉、要求买家将房屋所有权转让给他提供法律依据？

options.en: The jurisdiction adheres to the doctrine of equitable redemption.
options.zh: 该司法辖区遵循衡平法上的赎回原则。

options.en: The jurisdiction does not follow the doctrine of merger.
options.zh: 该司法辖区不遵循合并原则。

options.en: The jurisdiction has enacted a statute that permits redemption.
options.zh: 该司法辖区已颁布一项允许赎回的法律。

options.en: The jurisdiction recognizes the lien theory of mortgages.
options.zh: 该司法辖区承认抵押权的留置理论。

explanation.en:
Right of redemption

(regaining title after default on loan)

Timing Assertion of right

Equitable right

(always exists)

At any time prior to foreclosure sale Pay full amount of debt due (including interest) to lender

Statutory right

(if statute exists)

Statutory period after property has been sold in foreclosure

Pay foreclosure sale price to purchasing party

When a debtor (here, the man) defaults on mortgage payments, the creditor can initiate foreclosure proceedings to force the sale of the mortgaged property to satisfy the unpaid debt. Once the property has been sold, jurisdictions with a statutory right of redemption allow the debtor to reclaim the property by paying the foreclosure sale price to the purchaser within a fixed period of time (typically between three months and two years).

Therefore, if the jurisdiction has enacted a statute that provides this right, the man would have legal justification to pursue an action for specific performance to compel the buyer to transfer ownership of the home to the man.

(Choice A) The doctrine of equitable redemption allows a debtor to reclaim mortgaged property at any time before a foreclosure sale by paying the full amount of the outstanding debt, plus any accrued interest. But a debtor can only reclaim mortgaged property after a foreclosure sale if the jurisdiction has enacted a statute providing this right.

(Choice B) The doctrine of merger applies in the mortgage context when the same person acquires ownership of both the mortgage and the mortgaged property. When this occurs, the mortgage merges into fee simple ownership of the property. But the fact that the jurisdiction does not follow this doctrine would not affect the outcome of this dispute.

(Choice D) Regardless of which mortgage theory the jurisdiction recognizes, the man will have the right to redeem his home from the buyer only if the jurisdiction has a statutory right of redemption.

Educational objective:

In jurisdictions with a statutory right of redemption, a debtor can reclaim property after a foreclosure sale by paying the foreclosure sale price to the purchaser within a fixed period of time.

References

30 Am. Jur. 2d Executions and Enforcement of Judgments § 291 (2020) (statutory right of redemption).

explanation.zh:
赎 赎 权

(贷款违约后取得所有权)

B. 行使权利的时间

平等权利

(永远存在)

在取消赎回权出售之前的任何时候,向放款人全额偿还所欠债务(包括利息)

法定权利

(如果有法规)

财产出售后的法定期限

向购买方支付赎回权销售价格

当债务人(这里的男子)拖欠抵押付款时,债权人可以启动取消赎回权程序,强迫出售抵押财产以清偿未偿债务。一旦财产被出售,具有法定赎回权的法域允许债务人通过在固定期限内(通常是在三个月至两年之间)向购买人支付赎回权出售价款来收回财产。

因此,如果法域颁布了规定这一权利的法规,男子将有法律理由要求采取具体履约行动,迫使买方将住房所有权转让给男子。

(Choice A)公平赎回原则允许债务人在解除赎回权出售之前的任何时候通过全额偿付未偿债务加上任何应计利息收回抵押财产。但债务人只有在解除赎回权出售后,如果法域颁布了规定这一权利的法规,才能收回抵押财产。

(Choice B)当同一人同时获得抵押和抵押财产的所有权时,合并原则适用于抵押权的情况,当发生这种情况时,抵押权合并为财产的收费简单所有权。但管辖权不遵循这一理论这一事实不会影响这一争议的结果。

(Choice D)无论法域承认哪一种抵押权理论,只有在法域拥有法定赎回权的情况下,该男子才有权向买方赎回其住房。

学习要点：

在有法定赎回权的法域,债务人可在取消赎回权出售后通过在固定期限内向购买人支付取消赎回权出售价款收回财产。

参考资料

30 Am. Jur. 2d. 处决和执行判决第291条(2020年)(法定赎罪权)。

stem:
A builder sold a new house to a buyer for use as the buyer's residence. The buyer paid 10% of the purchase price and financed the rest by executing a promissory note and purchase-money mortgage to the builder.

A year later, the buyer missed several mortgage payments to the builder and became unable to make payments. During that year, property values in the neighborhood declined substantially. The builder suggested that the buyer deed the house back to the builder to settle all claims and avoid the costs and other disadvantages of foreclosure. The buyer deeded the house back to the builder.
stemZh:
建筑商将新房子卖给买方用作买方的住所,买方支付了10%的购货价款,并通过执行期票和向建筑商提供购货款抵押来为其余部分融资。

一年后,买方未能向建筑商支付几笔抵押贷款,无法支付,当年,附近地区的房产价值大幅下降。建筑商建议买方将房屋归还建筑商,以结清所有索赔,避免取消赎回权的费用和其他不利条件,买方将房屋归还建筑商。
ask: Does the builder now own fee simple title to the house?
askZh: 建筑商现在拥有简单的房屋所有权吗?

options.en: No, because the deed back to the builder constitutes a disguised mortgage.
options.zh: 不,因为归还给建筑商的契约 构成变相抵押贷款。

options.en: No, because the owner of a personal residence cannot waive the right to foreclosure.
options.zh: 不,因为个人住所的所有人不能放弃赎回权。

options.en: Yes, because of the doctrine of equitable redemption.
options.zh: 是的,因为公平赎罪的理论。

options.en: Yes, because the transaction was reasonable and fair under the circumstances.
options.zh: 是的,因为在这种情况下交易是合理和公平的。

explanation.en:
Ways to avoid foreclosure

Equitable redemption*

Mortgagor pays full amount of outstanding debt (as increased by acceleration clause) plus any accrued interest

Deed in lieu of foreclosure

Mortgagor conveys all interest in mortgaged property to mortgagee

Renegotiating debt Parties renegotiate terms of promissory note & mortgage

*Many states also recognize a statutory right of redemption that permits a mortgagor to reclaim the property after a foreclosure sale.

In lieu of foreclosure, the mortgagor may convey title to the mortgaged property to the mortgagee ("deed in lieu of foreclosure"). This allows the grantee-mortgagee to take immediate possession of the property without the formalities of a foreclosure sale. Deed-in-lieu transactions are generally valid so long as they are fair to the grantor-mortgagor. However, they run the risk of being labeled as an equitable or "disguised"

mortgage (as opposed to a title conveyance) if it appears that the deed was intended only as security for the original mortgage.

Here, the buyer deeded the house back to the builder to avoid foreclosure. That transaction was reasonable and fair under the circumstances—particularly since property values had declined so much that any foreclosure sale might have resulted in a deficiency that the buyer would have been obligated to pay out of personal assets. And since there is no indication that the deed was intended only as security for the original mortgage (eg, had the buyer remained indebted to the builder or retained possession of the house), the builder owns the house in fee simple (Choice A).

(Choice B) The right to foreclose is held by the mortgagee (eg, builder)—not the mortgagor (eg, buyer)—and the mortgagee can waive this right by accepting a deed in lieu of foreclosure.

(Choice C) The doctrine of equitable redemption allows a mortgagor to prevent foreclosure by paying the full amount of the outstanding debt (as increased by an acceleration clause) plus interest. Had this doctrine been invoked, however, the buyer (not the builder) would own the home.

Educational objective:

A mortgagor can avoid foreclosure by conveying title to the mortgaged property to the mortgagee ("deed in lieu of foreclosure"). Deed-in-lieu transactions are generally valid so

long as they are fair to the grantor-mortgagor and not simply a means of continuing the original mortgage (ie, equitable or "disguised" mortgage).

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages & 8.5 cmt. b (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (discussing deeds in lieu of foreclosure).

explanation.zh:
避免取消赎回权的方法

公平赎罪*

Mortgagor全额支付未偿债务(根据加速条款增加)加任何应计利息

以契约代替赎回权

抵押权人向抵押人转让抵押财产的所有权益

重新谈判债务方重新谈判期票和抵押条件

* 许多州还承认法定赎回权,允许抵押者在赎回权出售后收回财产。

抵押权人可以代替赎回权将抵押财产的所有权传递给抵押人("代为赎回权"),这使得受赠人-抵押权人可以不经赎回权出售手续立即占有该财产.契约交易,只要对出押人-抵押人公平,一般是有效的,但有可能被贴上公平或“变相”的标签。

抵押(而不是所有权转让),如果该契约似乎只是作为原始抵押的担保。

在此,买方将房屋租回建筑商,以避免取消赎回权,在这种情况下,这种交易是合理和公平的,特别是因为财产价值下跌了太多,以至于任何取消赎回权的出售都可能造成缺陷,以致于买方本来有义务用个人资产付款,而且,由于没有迹象表明该契约只是作为原始抵押的担保(例如,如果买方仍欠建造人或保留对房屋的占有),则该建造人以简单收费(Choice A)拥有房屋.

抵押权由抵押人(例如,建筑人)持有,而不是抵押权人(例如,买方)持有,抵押权人可以通过接受契约代替抵押权而放弃这一权利。

(Choice)公平赎罪的学说允许抵押权人通过全额偿付未偿债务(根据加速条款增加)加上利息来防止赎回.但是,如果援引这一理论,买方(而不是建筑商)将拥有该住宅。

学习要点：

抵押权人可以通过将抵押财产的所有权转移给抵押人("以契约代替赎回")来避免赎回. Deed-in-lieu交易一般如此有效.

只要它们对出押人-抵押人公平,而不只是继续原始抵押的手段(即公平或“变相”抵押)。

参考资料

重述(第三)财产:抵押贷款和8.5 cmt. b (Am. Law Inst. 1997)(讨论契约以取代赎回)。

stem:
A landowner borrowed $100,000 from a lender and executed a valid mortgage on a commercial tract of land to secure the debt. The lender promptly recorded the mortgage.

A year later, the landowner conveyed the same tract to a developer by a deed that expressly stated that the conveyance was subject to the mortgage to the lender and that the grantee expressly assumed and agreed to pay the mortgage obligation as part of the consideration for the purchase. The mortgage was properly described in the deed, and the deed was properly executed by the landowner; however, because there was no provision or place in the deed for the developer to sign, he did not do so. The developer promptly recorded the deed.

The developer made the monthly mortgage payments of principal and interest for six payments but then stopped payments and defaulted on the mortgage obligation. The lender properly instituted foreclosure procedures in accordance with the governing law. After the foreclosure sale, there was a $10,000 deficiency due to the lender. Both the landowner and the developer had sufficient assets to pay the deficiency.

There is no applicable statute in the jurisdiction other than the statute relating to foreclosure proceedings.
stemZh:
土地所有者向贷款人借款10万美元,对商业土地进行了有效的抵押,以担保债务。

一年之后,地主通过一份契约向开发商传达了同样的道条,该契约明确规定,转让须由出贷人抵押,受赠人明确承担并同意支付抵押债务,作为考虑的一部分。抵押权在地契中得到了恰当的描述,地契由地契人妥善执行;然而,由于地契中没有任何规定或地方供开发商签署,他没有这样做。开发商迅速记录了地契。

开发商按月按六笔支付本金和利息,但随后停止支付,并拖欠了抵押债务,贷款人根据管理法正确地建立了赎回程序。取消赎回权出售后,贷款人欠下1万美元,地主和开发商都有足够的资产支付差额。

除与取消赎回权程序有关的法规外,该法域没有其他可适用的法规。
ask: At the appropriate stage of the foreclosure action, which party will the court decide is responsible for payment of the deficiency?
askZh: 在取消赎回诉讼的适当阶段,法院将决定哪一方负责支付差额?

options.en: The developer, because he accepted delivery of the deed from the landowner and in so doing accepted the terms and conditions of the deed.
options.zh: 开发商,因为他接受了地主交付的地契,从而接受了地契的条款和条件.

options.en: The developer, because he is estopped by his having made six monthly payments to the lender.
options.zh: 开发商,因为他因每月向贷款人支付六笔款项而被阻止。

options.en: The landowner, because he was the maker of the note and the mortgage, and at most the developer is liable only as a guarantor of the landowner's obligation.
options.zh: 地主,因为他是纸币和抵押的制造者,而开发者最多只能作为地主义务的担保人承担责任.

options.en: The landowner, because the developer was not a signatory to the deed.
options.zh: 地主,因为开发商不是地契的签字人.

explanation.en:
Transfer of mortgaged property

Effect on buyer/transferee Effecton seller

Subject to mortgage Does not agree to pay loan & is not liable for debt

Remains solely liable for debt

Assumption of mortgage

Agrees to pay loan & is primarily liable for debt

Becomes secondarily liable as surety

A mortgage is an interest in real property given to secure a debt. The debtor may freely transfer mortgaged property (unless otherwise agreed), but the mortgage will remain attached to that property even after it is transferred to another. The grantee's (eg, buyer's) obligations with respect to that mortgage depend on whether he/she either:

took subject to the mortgage – did not agree to pay and is not personally liable for the debt or assumed the mortgage – expressly agreed to pay and becomes primarily liable for the debt, while the original debtor becomes secondarily liable as a surety. Here, the landowner's deed to the developer stated that the developer expressly assumed and agreed to pay the mortgage. And though the developer did not sign the deed, he assumed the mortgage by accepting delivery of that deed (Choice D). Therefore, the developer is primarily liable for the lender's $10,000 deficiency. And since the developer has sufficient assets to pay the deficiency judgment, the landowner need not pay anything.

(Choice B) Because the developer assumed the mortgage once he accepted the landowner's transfer of the deed, he is liable for the deficiency judgment regardless of whether, or for how long, he had paid the mortgage.

(Choice C) Although the landowner was the maker of the note and mortgage, the landowner (not the developer) became secondarily liable as a guarantor (ie, surety) when the developer assumed primary liability for that mortgage.

Educational objective:

A grantee assumes a mortgage when he/she expressly agrees to pay the debt. The grantee then becomes primarily liable for that debt, while the original debtor becomes secondarily liable as a surety.

References

Restatement (Third) of Prop.: Mortgages § 5.1 (assumption of mortgage).
