explanation.zh:
抵押财产的转让

对买方/转让人的影响

不同意偿还贷款和不承担债务

独家承担债务责任者

抵押的推定

同意偿还贷款和债务

承担第二责任的担保人

抵押权是为担保债务而给予的不动产权益,债务人可以自由转让抵押财产(除非另有约定),但即使抵押权被转移至另一财产之后,抵押权仍将附属于该财产。受赠人(例如买方)对抵押的义务取决于他/她是否:

接受抵押 -- -- 不同意付款,也不对债务负个人责任,也不承担抵押 -- -- 明确同意付款并承担主要债务责任,而原始债务人则作为担保人承担第二责任。在此,地主给开发商的地契上写明,开发商明确假设并同意支付抵押贷款。 尽管开发商没有签署地契,但他通过接受交付地契(Choice D)来承担抵押贷款。因此,开发商对贷款人的1万美元不足负主要责任。 由于开发商有足够的资产来支付差额判断,土地所有者不需要支付任何费用。

(Choice B)由于开发商一旦接受地主转让地契,就承担了抵押权,因此无论他是否或支付抵押权的时间有多长,他都要对差额判断负责.

(C) 虽然土地所有者是纸币和抵押的制作人,但土地所有者(而不是开发者)作为担保人(即担保人)在开发者承担该抵押的主要责任时承担了第二责任。

学习要点：

受赠方在明确同意偿付债务时承担抵押权,然后受赠方对该债务负主要责任,而原始债务人则作为担保人承担第二责任。

stem:
A woman duly executed a will under which she devised her farm to her nephew and bequeathed the residue of her estate to her niece.

For 12 years after executing her will, the woman lived on her farm. Then she sold it and used the sale proceeds to purchase a home in the city, in which she lived until she died, never having changed her will.

Following the admission of the will to probate, both the nephew and the niece claimed ownership of the home. There is no applicable statute.
stemZh:
一名妇女正式执行了一份遗嘱,根据这份遗嘱,她为侄子设计了自己的农场,并将遗产的残余留给了侄女。

该女子在遗嘱执行后12年,一直住在她的农场上,然后卖掉,用出售所得在城里买房子,她一直住到死,从未改变过遗嘱。

在承认遗嘱后,侄子和侄女都声称拥有该住宅,没有适用法规。
ask: Who is the owner of the home?
askZh: 家主是谁?

options.en: The nephew, because of the doctrine of ademption.
options.zh: 侄子,因为empt的学说.

options.en: The nephew, because of the doctrine of equitable estoppel.
options.zh: 侄子,因为公平不容反悔的学说.

options.en: The niece, because of the doctrine of lapse.
options.zh: 侄女,因为有失传的学说.

options.en: The niece, because she is the residuary legatee.
options.zh: 她的侄女,因为她是遗孀

explanation.en:
Classification of devises

(conveyance by will)

Type Definition Examples

Specific Devise of specifically identified asset "my farm to my nephew"

General Devise (often of money) payable from general assets of estate

"$2,000 to my daughter" "one-half of my estate to my son" Demonstrative Devise primarily payable from designated source, but secondarily payable from general assets

"$2,000 to my daughter out of my bank account"

Residuary Devise of all property not disposed of by specific, general, or demonstrative devise

"all of the remainder of my estate to my niece"

The woman (testator) specifically devised her farm to the nephew (devisee). She later sold that farm and used the proceeds to purchase a home. But the nephew is not entitled to that home because of the doctrine of ademption, which causes a devise to fail in two circumstances:

Ademption by extinction – when the specifically devised asset is not owned by the testator (or is destroyed or fundamentally changed) at the time of death (as seen here) Ademption by satisfaction – when the devisee received the devised asset (or some other asset intended to satisfy the devise) during the testator's life (not applicable here) As a result, the devisee takes nothing unless the will expressly states otherwise. So, when a specifically devised asset (eg, the farm) is sold during the testator's lifetime, the sale proceeds—and any assets later acquired with those proceeds (eg, the home)—become part of the general estate. The general estate is then distributed in accordance with the remainder of the will. And since the woman's will bequeathed the residue of her estate to the niece, the niece owns the home as the residuary legatee (Choice A).

(Choice B) The doctrine of equitable estoppel bars a party from asserting a material fact that is inconsistent with a prior representation upon which another party detrimentally relied. But this doctrine does not apply here since no party has asserted contradictory facts.

(Choice C) The doctrine of lapse causes any type of devise to fail when the devisee dies before the testator. But since the nephew and niece (devisees) survived the woman (testator), neither devise will fail under this doctrine.

Educational objective:

Specific devises are adeemed by extinction when the devised asset is not owned by the testator (or is destroyed or fundamentally changed) upon death. And any type of devise is adeemed by satisfaction when the devised asset or a substituted asset is given during the testator's life. The devised asset will then join the general estate.

References

80 Am. Jur. 2d Wills § 1444 (2018) (doctrine of ademption).

explanation.zh:
装置的分类

(由意愿召集)

类型定义示例

特意设计"我的农场给我侄子"

由破产财产一般资产支付的一般设计(往往为金钱)

"两千美元给我的女儿" "我一半的遗产给我儿子" 示范性设计主要从指定来源支付,但从一般资产中支付

"两千美元给我的女儿 从我的银行账户"

设计所有未通过具体、一般或示范装置处理的财产

"我剩下的遗产给我侄女"

该妇女(检验员)专门为侄子(devisee)设计了自己的农场,后来她将该农场出售,并将所得收益用于购买住房。但侄子无权享受这个家,因为"赎罪"的学说导致一种在两种情况下失败的设定:

放弃消灭——当专门设计的资产不是在死亡时(如此处所示)由遗嘱人拥有(或被销毁或根本改变)时(通过抵偿而放弃)——当该装置收到所设计的资产(或其他一些资产)时。目的是满足该装置)在遗嘱人生命中(此处不适用),因此,除非遗嘱另有明文规定,否则任何设计都不需要。因此,当一个专门设计的资产(例如农场)在遗嘱人存续期间出售时,出售所得——以及后来用这些收益获得的任何资产(例如住宅)——成为一般财产的一部分。然后按照遗嘱的剩余部分分配一般遗产,而且由于妇女的遗嘱将遗产的剩余部分留给侄女,侄女作为剩余遗产(Choice A)拥有住宅。

(Choice B) 公平不容反悔原则禁止一当事方主张一个与另一当事方有害地依赖的先前陈述不一致的物质事实。但这一理论在此不适用,因为没有任何一方声称存在矛盾的事实。

错误的理论导致任何类型的设计在设计者死在遗嘱人之前都失败。 但是,由于侄子和侄女(devisees)活了下来,根据这一理论,任何一种设计都不会失败。

学习要点：

特定装置在被设计的资产不在遗嘱人所有(或被毁或根本改变)时被消灭。在遗嘱人生前给予被设定的资产或替代资产时,任何类型的设定都以抵偿而告终。 被设定的资产随后将加入一般财产。

参考资料

80 Am. Jur. 2d Wills § 1444 (2018)(引言).

stem:
A woman borrowed $100,000 from a bank and executed a promissory note to the bank in that amount. As security for repayment of the loan, the woman's brother gave the bank a mortgage on a tract of land solely owned by him. The brother did not sign the promissory note.

The woman subsequently defaulted on the loan, and after acceleration, the bank instituted foreclosure proceedings on the brother's land. The brother filed a timely objection to the foreclosure.
stemZh:
一名妇女向一家银行借了10万美元,并按此数额向该银行支付了本票,作为偿还贷款的担保,该妇女的兄弟向该银行抵押了他独有的一块土地,该兄弟没有在本票上签字。

这名妇女后来拖欠贷款,在加速贷款后,银行在兄弟的土地上提起了取消赎回权诉讼,兄弟及时对取消赎回权提出异议。
ask: Will the bank succeed in foreclosing on the tract of land?
askZh: 银行能否在土地上成功赎回?

options.en: No, because a mortgage from the brother is invalid without a mortgage debt owed by him.
options.zh: 不,因为兄弟的抵押贷款无效 没有他欠的抵押债务。

options.en: No, because the bank has an equitable mortgage rather than a legal mortgage.
options.zh: 不,因为银行有公平的抵押而不是合法的抵押。

options.en: Yes, because the bank has a valid mortgage.
options.zh: 是的,因为银行有有效的抵押贷款。

options.en: Yes, because the bank is a surety for the brother's mortgage.
options.zh: 是的 因为银行是兄弟抵押的担保

explanation.en:
Mortgage documents

Mortgage deed A writing that conveys an interest in collateral to secure a debt

Promissory note

A formal "IOU" in which the borrower promises to repay the debt according to the listed terms

A mortgage is a lien against real property given to secure repayment of a debt. If the debt (evidenced by a promissory note) belongs to someone other than the mortgagor, then the mortgagor is not personally liable for repaying that debt.* However, the mortgagee can foreclose on the mortgaged property if the debtor defaults.

Here, the woman received a $100,000 loan from the bank, which was evidenced by a promissory note. The brother did not sign the promissory note, so he is not personally liable for the debt. But since he used his tract of land to secure repayment of the woman's debt, the bank has a valid mortgage on that land. Therefore, the bank will succeed in foreclosing on the brother's land after the woman defaulted on the loan.

*The mortgagor would be personally liable for the debt if the mortgage itself contained language to that effect.

(Choice A) The fact that the mortgage debt is owed by someone else does not render the mortgage from the brother invalid. It merely means that the brother is not personally liable for repaying the mortgage debt.

(Choice B) An equitable mortgage is a mortgage alternative that arises when a party takes possession of the original deed to property with the intent that the property serve as security for a debt (not seen here).

(Choice D) A surety is a party who guarantees to pay another's debt in the event that person fails to do so. Here, the bank has not agreed to pay the debt for the woman if she defaults, so the bank is not a surety.

Educational objective:

A mortgage can be given to secure repayment of a debt owed by someone other than the mortgagor, and the mortgagee can foreclose on the mortgaged property if the debtor defaults.

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 1.3 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (mortgages securing obligations of nonmortgagors).

explanation.zh:
抵押文件

以担保债务为抵押权益的书面文件

原票

正式的"IOU",其中借款人承诺按照所列条件偿还债务.

抵押权是对房地产的留置,以保证债务的偿还。如果债务(以本票作为证据)属于抵押权人以外的人,则抵押权人不承担偿还该债务的个人责任。债务人违约的,取消抵押财产的赎回权.

在此,该妇女从银行得到一笔10万美元的贷款,这是一张本票所证明的,该兄弟没有在本票上签字,因此他不负个人债务。但是,由于他用他那片土地来保证偿还妇女的债务,银行对那块土地有有效的抵押权。 因此,在妇女拖欠贷款后,银行将成功地取消对该兄弟土地的抵押。

* 如果抵押贷款本身载有这方面的措辞,抵押贷款人将亲自对债务承担责任。

(Choice A) 抵押债务是他人所欠的事实并不使兄弟的抵押无效,仅仅意味着兄弟不负偿还抵押债务的个人责任.

(Choice B)公平抵押是当一方当事人占有财产原始契约,意图将该财产作为债务担保(此处不见)时产生的抵押选择。

(Choice D ) 担保人是指保证在对方不偿还债务时偿还对方债务的一方。 在这里,如果该妇女违约,银行没有同意为她偿还债务,因此银行不是担保人。

学习要点：

抵押权可以用于保证偿还除抵押权人以外的人所欠的债务,如果债务人违约,抵押权人可以取消抵押财产的抵押权.

参考资料

stem:
A woman owned several vacant lots in a subdivision. She obtained a $500,000 loan from a bank and executed and delivered to the bank a promissory note and mortgage describing Lots 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5. The mortgage was promptly and properly recorded.

Upon payment of $100,000, the woman obtained a release of Lot 2 duly executed by the bank. She altered the instrument of release to include Lot 5 as well as Lot 2 and recorded it. The woman thereafter sold Lot 5 to a man, an innocent purchaser, for value.

The bank discovered that the instrument of release had been altered and brought an appropriate action against the woman and the man to set aside the release as it applied to Lot 5. The woman did not defend against the action, but the man did.

The recording act of the jurisdiction provides: "No unrecorded conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value without notice, who shall first record."
stemZh:
一名妇女拥有一个分区的几个空地,她从一家银行获得50万美元的贷款,执行并向银行交付了一张期票和抵押贷款,说明Lots 1, 2, 3, 4, 和5. 抵押贷款得到了及时和适当的记录。

在支付了10万美元之后,该妇女获得了银行正式执行的Lot 2的释放,她修改了释放文书,将Lot 5和Lot 2也包括在内,并记录下来,随后,该妇女将Lot 5出售给一名男子,即一名无辜的购买者,以计价值。

银行发现释放文书被更改,对男女提起了适当的诉讼,以搁置对Lote 5的释放,该女子没有针对该诉讼进行辩护,但该男子这样做了。

辖区的录制行为规定:"未经记录的不动产转让或者抵押,对后继购买人的价值不作通知的,不得有好评,后者应当先作记录".
ask: Who should the court rule for?
askZh: 法庭应该为谁裁决?

options.en: The bank, because the alteration of the release was ineffective.
options.zh: 银行,因为修改发行无效.

options.en: The bank, because the man could have discovered the alteration by reasonable inquiry.
options.zh: 银行,因为这个人可以通过合理调查发现这个改变.

options.en: The man, because he was entitled to rely on the recorded release.
options.zh: 这个人,因为他有权依靠有记录的释放。

options.en: The man, because the bank was negligent in failing to check the recordation of the release.
options.zh: 这名男子,因为银行没有检查释放记录而玩忽职守。

explanation.en:
Void v. Voidable contracts

Void

(invalid upon creation)

Forgery Illegality Fraud in the factum (assent by trick) Duress by physical compulsion Voidable

(valid unless set aside)

Lack of capacity Mistake Misrepresentation Duress by threat Undue influence Fraud in the inducement Recording acts determine the priority of competing interests in the same land. In a race-notice jurisdiction (as seen here), a bona fide purchaser's (BFP's) subsequent property

interest has priority over an earlier property interest if the BFP (1) lacked notice and (2) recorded first. But a BFP cannot rely on a forged or altered document to establish priority under the recording act since that document is void.

Here, the woman sold Lot 5 to the man, an innocent purchaser for value (BFP), after altering the mortgage release for Lot 2 to include Lot 5. But since the alteration of the release was ineffective (ie, void), the man cannot rely on the release to establish his priority under the recording act (Choice C). Therefore, the court should rule for the bank and set aside the altered release.

(Choice B) The man would not have been a BFP if he could have discovered the alteration of the release by reasonable inquiry—eg, had a different recorded instrument explained that Lot 5 was not released. But since there is no evidence that he could have reasonably discovered the alteration, he was a BFP. Nevertheless, the bank will prevail because the altered release was ineffective.

(Choice D) The man cannot rely on the altered release to establish his priority because the recording act does not protect BFPs from forged or altered documents. As a result, the bank's negligence (ie, failure to use reasonable care) in failing to check the recordation of the release is immaterial.

Educational objective:

In a race-notice jurisdiction, a bona fide purchaser who (1) lacks notice and (2) records first will prevail. But a BFP cannot rely on a forged or altered document to establish priority since that document is void.

在这里,女方将5号地块卖给了男方,一名价值纯洁的购买者(BFP),之后将2号地块的抵押发行权更改为包括5号地块.但由于修改释放无效(即无效),男子不能依靠释放来确定其在录音法(Choice C)下的优先权. 因此,法院应当对银行作出裁决,并撤销修改后的释放.

(Choice B) 此人如果能够通过合理的调查发现对释放的更改,如果有另一种记录的仪器解释Lot 5没有释放,就不会是BFP。但是,由于没有证据表明他可以合理地发现这一改变,所以他是一个BFP. 尽管如此,银行会获胜,因为改变的释放无效.

(Choice D) 此人不能依靠被更改的释放来确定他的优先权,因为录音行为不能保护BFPs免受伪造或被更改的证件的伤害.因此,银行在未核对释放记录时的疏忽(即未采取合理谨慎措施)无关紧要。

学习要点：

在种族通知法域中,善意购买人(1) 缺乏通知和(2) 首先记录的,将优先,但BFP不能依赖伪造或变造的单证确立优先权,因为该单证无效。

stem:
A woman borrowed money from her local credit union to purchase an undeveloped lot on which to build her dream home. She executed a promissory note agreeing to repay the loan over a 10-year period. The loan was secured by a deed of trust that contained a power-of-sale clause. The deed of trust was promptly recorded.

After the woman missed five loan payments, the credit union accelerated the debt and instructed the trustee to initiate nonjudicial foreclosure proceedings as permitted by the jurisdiction. The trustee followed the jurisdiction's notice requirements and procedures. At the foreclosure sale, the credit union was the sole bidder. The winning bid was equal to the remaining obligation on the note, amounting to only 60% of the fair market value of the property.

The woman immediately filed an action against the credit union to set aside the foreclosure sale.
stemZh:
一名妇女向当地信用社借钱购买一个未开发的地块,用来建造自己的梦想家园。 她执行了一份期票,同意在10年内偿还贷款。贷款由一份信托契约担保,该契约载有一项出售权条款,信托契约被迅速记录。

在妇女未能支付5笔贷款后,信用社加快了债务,并指示受托人启动非司法性的解除赎回权程序,受托人遵守了该管辖区的通知要求和程序。在取消赎回权的销售中,信用社是唯一的出价人,中标额等于票据上剩余的债务,仅相当于财产公平市价的60%。

该妇女立即对信用社提起诉讼,要求撤销赎回权的出售。
ask: Is the woman likely to prevail?
askZh: 那女人有可能获胜吗?

options.en: No, because a court cannot overturn a nonjudicial foreclosure on a deed of trust.
options.zh: 不,因为法院不能推翻非司法的赎回权 对信托契约。

options.en: No, because there is no indication that the procedure or price would shock the conscience of the court.
options.zh: 没有,因为没有迹象表明程序或价格会震撼法院的良知.

options.en: Yes, because a deed of trust can be foreclosed upon only by judicial foreclosure.
options.zh: 是的,因为信任契约只能通过司法取消赎回权才能解除赎回权。

options.en: Yes, because a lender may not purchase the mortgaged property at a nonjudicial foreclosure.
options.zh: 是的,因为出贷人不得以非司法赎回方式购买抵押财产。

explanation.en:
Foreclosure methods

Judicial sale

(all states)

Judicially supervised public sale of mortgaged property

Nonjudicial sale

(half of all states)

Privately conducted public sale of mortgaged property (permitted only if mortgage contains power-of-sale clause)

Strict foreclosure

(few states)

Foreclosure without sale of mortgaged property

A debtor may give his/her interest in real property to a lender to secure a debt—usually through a mortgage or a deed of trust. A deed of trust is created when the debtor conveys the property interest to an impartial third party, as trustee, who holds title to the property for the lender's benefit. If the debtor pays the debt in full, then the trustee must reconvey the property to the debtor. But if the debtor defaults on loan payments, the trustee can initiate foreclosure proceedings (see table above).

The trustee can initiate nonjudicial foreclosure in about half of all states if the mortgage or deed of trust contains a power-of-sale clause—as seen here (Choice C). This allows the trustee to sell the property at a public auction without requesting permission from the court. However, the debtor can ask a court to overturn the foreclosure if the auction or sales process violated due process or the purchase price was grossly inadequate*

(Choice A).

Courts have consistently been unwilling to impose a "fair market value" standard on the purchase price, so the lender can credit bid up to the amount of the outstanding debt without paying additional cash (Choice D). Therefore, the winning bid is often below fair market value.

Here, there was no due process violation because the jurisdiction's notice requirements and procedures were followed. And though the credit union's winning bid was only 60% of the property's fair market value, it was equal to the remaining obligation on the note. Therefore, this credit bid was not grossly inadequate. Because neither the procedure nor the price would shock the conscience of the court, the woman is not likely to prevail in her action to set aside the foreclosure sale.

*Purchase prices have been deemed grossly inadequate if they are below 20% of the fair market value.

Educational objective:

Nonjudicial foreclosures are allowed in most states if the mortgage or deed of trust contains a power-of-sale clause. However, the court can overturn the foreclosure if the auction or sales process violated due process or the purchase price was grossly inadequate.

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages §8.3 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (adequacy of foreclosure sale price).

explanation.zh:
取消赎回权的方法

司法销售

(所有州)

在司法监督下公开出售抵押财产

非司法销售

(占所有国家的一半)

私人公开出售抵押财产(只有在抵押权含有出售权条款的情况下才允许)

严格取消赎回权

(国家)

不出售抵押财产而取消赎回权

债务人可以将其对不动产的权益交给放款人作为债务担保——通常是通过抵押或信托契约。如果债务人将财产权益传递给作为受托人的公正第三方,而该第三方为贷款人的利益而拥有财产所有权,那么,如果债务人全额偿还债务,受托人就必须将财产归还债务人。但如果债务人拖欠贷款付款,受托人可以启动赎回程序(见上表).

如果抵押或信托契约中包含出售权条款,受托人可以在大约一半的州提出非司法取消赎回权(如此处所示(Choice C)。这使得受托人在未经法院许可的情况下可以在公开拍卖中出售财产。但是,如果拍卖或销售程序违反正当程序或购买价格严重不足,债务人可以要求法院推翻取消赎回权。

(Choice A) (英语).

法院一直不愿将"公平市场价值"标准强加于购买价格,因此放款人可以不支付额外现金(Choice D)就将高达未偿债务金额的出价作为信贷.因此,中标往往低于公平市价。

在这里,没有违反正当程序,因为法域的通知要求和程序得到遵守。 尽管信用社的中标仅为财产公平市场价值的60%,但它与票据上的剩余债务相等。因此,这种信贷投标并不严重不足,因为程序或价格都无法震撼法院的良知,因此,妇女不太可能在撤销赎回权的诉讼中占上风。

* 购买价格如果低于公平市价的20%,则被认为严重不足。

学习要点：

如果抵押或信托契约中包含出售权条款,则大多数州允许非司法性取消赎回权,但是,如果拍卖或销售程序违反正当程序或购买价格严重不足,法院可以推翻取消赎回权。

参考资料

重述(第三)财产:抵押品第8.3节(《1997年宪法》)(赎回权销售价格的充分性)。

stem:
A developer entered into a valid written contract to purchase a large tract of land from a contractor for its fair market value of $500,000. The contract was assignable by the developer. The developer duly notified the contractor to convey title to her and her business partner whom the developer had not seen for many years.

When the developer learned that the business partner would have to sign certain documents in connection with the closing, she prevailed upon her brother to attend the closing and pretend to be the business partner. The developer and the brother attended the closing, and the contractor executed an instrument in the proper form of a deed purporting to convey the land to the developer and the business partner as tenants in common. The brother pretended that he was the business partner, and he signed the business partner's name to all the required documents. The developer provided the entire $500,000 consideration for the transaction. The deed was promptly and properly recorded.

Unknown to the developer or her brother, the business partner had died several months before the closing. The business partner's will, which was duly probated, devised "All my real estate to my nephew" and the residue of his estate to the developer.

The developer and nephew have been unable to agree as to the status or disposition of the land. The nephew brought an appropriate action against the contractor and the developer to quiet legal title to an undivided one-half interest in the land.
stemZh:
开发商签订了一份有效的书面合同,以50万美元的公平市场价值向承包商购买大片土地,开发商可转让合同。开发商正式通知承包商向她和她的商业伙伴传达开发商多年未见到的所有权。

当开发商得知商业伙伴必须签署与关闭有关的某些文件时,她说服她的兄弟出席关闭并假装是商业伙伴.开发商和兄弟出席了闭幕会,承包商以适当的契约形式执行了一项文书,旨在将土地作为共同租户转交给开发商和商业伙伴。哥哥假装自己是商业伙伴,他在所有所需文件上都签下了商业伙伴的名字,开发商为交易提供了全部50万美元的考虑,契据被及时,妥善记录.

开发商或她的兄弟不知道,企业合伙人在关闭前几个月就已经去世了,企业合伙人的遗嘱经过适当的验证,设计了"我所有的地产归我侄子",其地产的残余归开发商.

开发商和侄子一直无法就土地的地位或处置达成一致,侄子对承包商和开发商提起了适当的诉讼,以平息对土地未分割一半权益的合法所有权。
ask: In whom should the court hold that legal title to the land has vested?
askZh: 法院应把土地的合法所有权赋予谁?

options.en: All in the contractor.
options.zh: 都归承包商了

options.en: All in the developer.
options.zh: 所有在开发者。

options.en: One-half in the developer and one-half in the contractor.
options.zh: 开发者一半,承包商一半.

options.en: One-half in the developer and one-half in the nephew.
options.zh: 开发者一半,侄子一半.

Identifies land Identifiable by reasonable certainty—eg: Government survey Metes & bounds Street, lot, house number

Includes words of transfer

"Convey" "Transfer" "Grant" "Sell"

"Lease" "Rent" "License"

A tenancy in common is a concurrent ownership interest in land where each co-tenant has a separate share of the property but an equal right to possess the whole property (ie, separate but undivided interests). Co-tenants can receive this interest under a deed, but that deed is only valid if it:

is in writing and signed by the grantor unambiguously identifies the grantor and grantee unambiguously describes the land and includes words of transfer. A deed that names a nonexistent co-tenant is void as to that co-tenant. Therefore, the grantor retains the nonexistent co-tenant's interest and becomes tenants in common with the other co-tenant(s) named in the deed.

Here, the contractor attempted to deed land to the business partner and developer as tenants in common. But since the business partner had died several months earlier (and was therefore a nonexistent co-tenant), the portion of the deed naming him as grantee is void. Therefore, the court should hold that the contractor (the grantor) and the developer (other co-tenant) each have one-half interests in the land as tenants in common (Choices A & B).

(Choice D) Although the business partner devised his property to the nephew, the business partner had already died when the contractor attempted to deed him the land. Therefore, the deed did not convey the business partner an interest in the land that could pass to the nephew.

Educational objective:

When a tenancy in common is deeded to a nonexistent (eg, deceased) co-tenant, the deed is void as to that co-tenant and the grantor retains the co-tenant's interest. As a result, a tenancy in common forms between the grantor and the other co-tenant(s) named in the deed.

共同的租赁是土地的共同所有权权益,其中每个共同租户拥有财产的单独份额,但拥有拥有全部财产的平等权利(即单独但不可分割的权益)。共同租户可以凭契约获得这种权益,但该契约只有在下列情况下才有效:

以书面形式并由设保人签字,明确指明设保人和受赠人毫不含糊地描述土地,并包括转让的文字。一个没有共同租户的契约 对于共同租户来说是无效的因此,设保人保留不存在的共同租户的利益,成为与契约中指定的其他共同租户相同的租户。

在这里,承包商试图将地契让给商业伙伴和开发商作为共同租户。 但是,由于商业伙伴几个月前就去世了(因此是不存在的共同租户 ) , 将他命名为受赠者的契约部分是无效的。因此,法院应当认定,承包商(设保人)和开发商(其他共同租户)作为共同租户,各自对土地拥有一半的权益(Choices A & B)。

(Choice D)虽然商业伙伴为侄子设计了财产,但当承包商试图将土地转让给他时,商业伙伴已经死亡。因此,该契约没有向商业伙伴传达可以传给侄子的土地的权益。

学习要点：

当共有的租借权转让给不存在的(例如已故的)共同租借人时,该共同租借权无效,设保人保留共同租借人的利益,因此,设保人与契约中指定的其他共同租借人以共同形式租赁。

stem:
A franchisee owned a hotel, subject to a mortgage securing a debt that the franchisee owed to a bank. The franchisee later acquired a nearby parking garage, financing a part of the purchase price by a loan from a credit union, secured by a mortgage on the parking garage. Two years thereafter, the franchisee defaulted on the loan owed to the bank, which caused the full amount of that loan to become immediately due and payable. The bank decided not to foreclose the mortgage on the franchisee's hotel at that time but instead brought an action, appropriate under the laws of the jurisdiction and authorized by the mortgage loan documents, for the full amount of the defaulted loan. The bank obtained and properly filed a judgment for that amount.

A statute of the jurisdiction provides: "Any judgment properly filed shall, for ten years from filing, be a lien on the real property then owned or subsequently acquired by any person against whom the judgment is rendered." There is no other applicable statute, except the statute providing for judicial foreclosure of mortgages, which places no restriction on deficiency judgments.

The bank later brought an appropriate action for judicial foreclosure of its first mortgage on the hotel and of its judgment lien on the parking garage. The credit union was joined as a party defendant, and appropriately counterclaimed for foreclosure of its mortgage on the parking garage, which was also in default. All procedures were properly followed, and the confirmed foreclosure sales resulted as follows:

The bank purchased the hotel for $100,000 less than its mortgage balance.

The bank purchased the parking garage for an amount that is $200,000 in excess of the credit union's mortgage balance.
stemZh:
特许经营人拥有一家旅馆,但以抵押担保特许经营人欠银行的债务为条件。 特许经营人后来购置了附近的一个停车场,通过信贷协会的贷款为部分购买价融资,并以泊车抵押担保。两年后,特许经营人拖欠了欠银行的贷款,致使该贷款的全额立即到期应付。银行当时决定不取消对特许经营人的旅馆的抵押权,而是根据法域的法律,经抵押贷款文件授权,就违约贷款的全部数额提起诉讼。银行就这一数额取得了判决,并作出了适当的判决。

管辖权法规规定:"任何妥善立案的判决,自立案之日起十年内,应为判决所针对的任何人当时拥有或随后获得的不动产的留置权",除此之外,没有其他适用法规.法律规定对抵押权的司法取消,对不足额判决没有限制。

后来,该银行提起了适当的诉讼,要求从司法上取消其对旅馆的第一次抵押权和对停车场的留置权判决。信用社作为当事人被告加入,并适当反诉其取消对停车场抵押权的赎回权,该抵押权也是违约的,所有程序都得到了正确遵循,经确认的赎回权销售结果如下:

银行以低于其抵押贷款余额的10万美元购买了酒店.

银行以超过信用社抵押贷款余额20万美元收购停车场.
ask: How should the $200,000 surplus arising from the bid paid by the bank for the parking garage be paid?
askZh: 银行为停车场支付的标价所产生的20万美元的盈余应如何支付?

options.en: $100,000 to the bank and $100,000 to the credit union.
options.zh: 银行10万美元,信用社10万美元.

options.en: $100,000 to the bank and $100,000 to the franchisee.
options.zh: 10万美元给银行 10万美元给特许经营人

options.en: $100,000 to the credit union and $100,000 to the franchisee.
options.zh: 10万美元给信用社,10万美元给特许经营人.

options.en: $200,000 to the franchisee.
options.zh: 20万美元给特许经营人

explanation.en:
Proceeds from a foreclosure sale are typically distributed in the following order of priority:

Expenses from the sale (eg, attorneys' fees, court costs) Mortgage being foreclosed Junior liens, in order of lien priority Debtor, if any surplus remains Here, the credit union had the senior lien on the parking garage since its mortgage was placed on the property first. The bank later acquired a judgment lien on all the franchisee's property—including a junior lien on the garage—when the franchisee defaulted on the bank's loan. And since the foreclosure sale of the garage satisfied the credit union's entire mortgage and created a $200,000 surplus, the bank (as the junior lienholder) should receive $100,000 to cover the balance still owed under its mortgage on the hotel. The remaining surplus ($100,000) should then be distributed to the franchisee (Choices A, C & D).

Educational objective:

Proceeds from a foreclosure sale are typically distributed in the following order: expenses, foreclosed mortgage, junior liens, then the debtor.

References

55 Am. Jur. 2d Mortgages § 705 (2019) (distribution of foreclosure sale proceeds).

取消赎回权销售所得收益一般按下列优先顺序分配:

出售费用(例如律师费、法庭费用) 抵押款按优先留置权的先后顺序为初级留置权,如果仍有盈余的话,信用社在停车场设有高级留置权,因为抵押权是放在财产上的。首先,当特许经营人拖欠银行贷款时,银行后来获得了对特许经营人所有财产的留置权——包括停车场的初级留置权。而由于车库的赎回出售满足了信用社的全部抵押贷款,并创造了20万美元的盈余,银行(作为初级留置权人)应当收到10万美元,以弥补其酒店抵押贷款下仍拖欠的余额.剩余的盈余(10万美元)应分配给特许经营人(A、C和D类)。

学习要点：

取消赎回权出售的收益通常按以下顺序分配:支出、取消抵押权、初级留置权,然后是债务人。

stem:
A woman borrowed money from a bank in order to build a new barn on her 20-acre farm. The loan was secured by a 10-year mortgage on the farm. The mortgage contained an acceleration clause. After three years, the woman defaulted on the loan. The bank sent a certified letter to the woman notifying her of its intention to accelerate the loan unless she cured the default within 75 days.

The woman was unable to make the required payment by the 75-day deadline to cure the default. As a result, the bank accelerated the loan and initiated foreclosure proceedings against the woman. The day after being served with a summons and complaint, the woman informed the bank that she was able to make the two outstanding mortgage payments, including late fees and interest. The woman then filed a motion to dismiss the foreclosure proceedings.
stemZh:
一名妇女向一家银行借钱,以便在她20英亩的农场上建造一个新的谷仓,贷款由农场10年的抵押贷款担保,抵押贷款中包含一个加速条款,三年后,妇女拖欠贷款。银行向该妇女发出经认证的信函,通知她除非她在75天内治愈违约,否则银行打算加快贷款。

该妇女无法在75天的最后期限前支付必要的款项,以弥补违约,因此,银行加快了贷款并对该妇女提起了取消赎回权的诉讼。在接到传票和申诉的第二天,该妇女告诉银行,她能够支付两笔未支付的抵押贷款,包括滞纳金和利息,然后该妇女提出动议,要求撤销赎回诉讼。
ask: Should the motion to dismiss be granted?

options.en: No, because the bank initiated the foreclosure, which terminated the woman's right to redemption.

options.en: No, because the woman does not have enough money to force the bank to accept her payment.
options.zh: 不,因为女人没有足够的钱 强迫银行接受她的付款。

options.en: Yes, because the bank is clogging the equity of redemption by failing to accept her payment.
options.zh: 是的,因为银行因为不接受她的付款 正在挤压赎回的股本。

options.en: Yes, because the woman has properly exercised the statutory right of redemption.
options.zh: 是的,因为妇女适当地行使了法定的赎罪权。

explanation.en:
Common mortgage provisions

Acceleration clause Allows creditor to demand entire loan due & payable if debtor defaults

Due-on-sale clause Allows creditor to demand entire loan due & payable if debtor sells mortgaged property without permission

Due-on-encumbrance clause Allows creditor to accelerate mortgage obligation if debtor obtains second mortgage or otherwise encumbers property

Defeasance clause Requires creditor to give debtor legal title to property & release mortgage lien once all payments are made

Mortgage documents often contain an acceleration clause, which allows the lender to demand full payment of the remaining mortgage debt plus any accrued interest if the debtor (mortgagor) defaults on the mortgage loan. If the debtor is unable to pay, then the lender can move forward with foreclosure proceedings to recover any remaining debt.

However, the doctrine of equitable redemption gives the debtor an opportunity to retain the property and avoid foreclosure by paying the amount of the loan obligation currently owed at any time prior to the foreclosure sale. If the mortgage documents contain an acceleration clause, then the debtor must pay the full amount of the unpaid loan plus interest to redeem the property.

Here, the woman was unable to cure her default by the bank's 75-day deadline, so the bank initiated foreclosure proceedings. Although the woman was able to make the two outstanding mortgage payments plus late fees and interest, the acceleration clause required that she pay the full amount of the unpaid loan plus interest to redeem the property. Since the woman does not have enough money to do so, her motion to dismiss the foreclosure proceedings should be denied.

(Choice A) The foreclosure sale—not the initiation of the foreclosure proceedings— terminated the equitable right of redemption.

(Choice C) The principle of clogging the equity of redemption refers to a lender's attempt to deny the debtor the right to redemption after the mortgage is executed—eg, by including a waiver clause in the mortgage. Since no waiver occurred here, this principle does not apply.

(Choice D) Many states recognize a statutory right of redemption that allows a debtor to reclaim the property after a foreclosure sale—not before the sale, as the woman seeks to do here.

Educational objective:

An acceleration clause allows the lender to demand full payment of the remaining mortgage debt plus any accrued interest if the debtor defaults on the mortgage loan. If the debtor is unable to pay, then the lender can move forward with foreclosure proceedings.

explanation.zh:
共同抵押规定

加速条款允许债权人在债务人违约时要求全部到期和应付贷款

到期出售条款允许债权人在债务人擅自出售抵押财产时要求获得到期应付的全部贷款

到期抵押条款允许债权人在债务人获得第二次抵押或以其他方式抵押财产时加快抵押债务

违约条款要求债权人在所有付款后给予债务人对财产的合法所有权并解除抵押留置权。

抵押贷款文件往往载有一项加速条款,允许放款人要求全额偿付剩余的抵押贷款债务,如果债务人(抵押贷款人)拖欠抵押贷款,则要求全额偿付任何应计利息。如果债务人无力偿付,出贷人可以启动取消赎回权程序,收回任何剩余债务。

然而,公平赎回原则使债务人有机会通过支付取消赎回权出售前任何时候目前所欠的贷款债务,保留财产并避免取消赎回权。如果抵押文件载有加速条款,那么债务人必须全额支付未偿贷款加上利息以赎回财产。

在此,该女子无法在银行75天的最后期限前治愈她的违约,因此银行启动了赎回程序.虽然该妇女能够支付两笔未偿还的抵押贷款,加上迟付的手续费和利息,但加速条款要求她全额支付未偿贷款和利息,以赎回财产。由于该妇女没有足够的钱这样做,应拒绝她提出的取消赎回权诉讼的动议。

(选择A) 取消赎回权的出售——而不是取消赎回权程序的启动——终止了赎回权的公平性。

(C) 赎回权的公平性原则是指放款人在抵押权执行后试图剥夺债务人的赎回权,例如在抵押权中列入一项放弃条款。由于这里没有放弃,这一原则不适用。

(Choice D) 许多州承认法定赎回权,允许债务人在解除赎回权出售之后——而不是在出售之前——收回财产,正如妇女在此寻求的那样。

学习要点：

加速条款允许放款人要求全额偿还剩余的抵押债务,如果债务人拖欠抵押贷款,则要求支付任何应计利息。 如果债务人无力偿还,放款人可以启动取消赎回权程序。

stem:
A seller owned a tract of land in fee simple. The seller executed an instrument in the proper form of a deed, purporting to convey the land to a buyer in fee simple. The instrument recited that the conveyance was in consideration of "$5 cash in hand paid and for other good and valuable consideration." The seller handed the instrument to the buyer and the buyer promptly and properly recorded it.

Two months later, the seller brought an appropriate action against the buyer to cancel the instrument and to quiet title. In support, the seller proved that no money in fact had been paid by the buyer, notwithstanding the recitation, and that no other consideration of any kind had been supplied by the buyer.
stemZh:
卖方拥有一片土地,完全所有权,卖方以契约的适当形式执行了一项文书,目的是将土地以收费简单的方式转交给买方。票据背诵道,该票据是考虑"手头付了5美元现金,为了其他有价值和价值的考虑",卖方将票据迅速并妥善地交给了买方和买方.

两个月后,卖方对买方提起了适当的诉讼,要求取消票据并保持所有权安静。作为佐证,卖方证明,买方事实上没有支付任何款项,尽管有重复,而且买方没有提供其他任何类型的报酬。
ask: In such action, should the seller prevail?
askZh: 在此类诉讼中,卖方是否应当胜诉?

options.en: No, because any remedy the seller might have had was lost when the instrument was recorded.
options.zh: 不,因为在记录票据时,卖方可能已经失去了任何补救办法。

options.en: No, because the validity of conveyance of land does not depend upon consideration being paid, whether recited or not.
options.zh: 不,因为土地运输的有效性并不取决于是否得到支付,无论是否背诵。

options.en: Yes, because recordation does not make a void instrument effective.
options.zh: 是的,因为记录并不能使无效文书生效。

options.en: Yes, because the recitation of consideration paid may be contradicted by parol evidence.
options.zh: 是的,因为所付出的考虑的引用可能与口头证据相矛盾。

explanation.en:
Transfer by deed

Essential deed components Writing signed by grantor Identity of grantor & grantee Description of land Words of transfer Delivery Grantor's present intent to transfer title Presumed upon: physical delivery of deed recording unconditional delivery to agent grantee's possession of property/deed Acceptance Presumed when transfer benefits grantee

A plaintiff can bring a quiet title action to establish his/her title to land above all others (eg, by disputing the validity of a deed). A deed is an instrument used to convey an interest in real property from the owner (grantor) to another (grantee). The conveyance is effective once the deed is:

delivered by the grantor – presumed when the deed has been recorded or is in the grantee's possession and accepted by the grantee – presumed when the conveyance is beneficial to the grantee. The validity of the conveyance does not depend upon consideration (eg, payment for the property)—even if the deed states that consideration has been paid. However, the grantee may be liable for nonpayment.

Here, the seller properly executed a deed purporting to convey a tract of land to the buyer. The seller handed the deed to the buyer (delivery), who accepted and recorded it. And though the buyer never paid the "$5 cash in hand" or other consideration recited in the deed, the validity of the conveyance did not depend upon consideration being paid. Therefore, the transfer to the buyer was effective, and the seller should not prevail in his quiet title action.

(Choice A) Recording a deed (ie, depositing it into the official land records) does not cure any defects in the conveyance. Therefore, no remedy the seller might have had was lost when the deed was recorded.

(Choice C) Recording a void deed—a legally invalid deed that cannot prove title (eg, a forged deed)—does not make the deed effective. But here, the deed was not void since it was properly executed, delivered, and accepted.

(Choice D) Parol evidence—extrinsic evidence offered to contradict or modify a document—is admissible to show that the consideration recited in a deed has not been paid. But while that evidence is relevant to the grantee's liability for nonpayment, it does not affect the validity of the conveyance since consideration is not required. Therefore, the seller will not prevail by contradicting the consideration recited in the deed.

Educational objective:

A deed effectively transfers an interest in real property when the deed is (1) delivered by the grantor and (2) accepted by the grantee. Consideration is not required, even when the deed states that consideration has been paid.

References

Restatement (Third) of Prop.: Wills & Other Donative Transfers § 6.3 (Am. Law Inst. 2003) (gifts of land).

explanation.zh:
契约转让

基本契约组成部分 由设保人签名撰写土地描述 转让词 交付方目前的意图以下列条件推定转让所有权:实物交付契约,记录无条件交付给代理人受赠人转让福利受益人的假定接受

原告可以提起静悄悄的产权诉讼,确定他/她对土地的所有权高于所有其他人(例如,通过对契约的有效性提出异议),契约是用来将不动产权益从所有人(设保人)传递给另一人(设保人)的工具。一旦契约:

由设保人交付 -- -- 推定该契约已记录在案或由受赠方占有并被受赠方接受 -- -- 推定该转让对受赠方有利。转让是否有效并不取决于考虑(例如财产的支付),即使契约上写着已经支付考虑,但受赠方可能要对不支付承担赔偿责任。

在此,卖方妥善地执行了一份契约,旨在将一块土地转交买方,卖方将契约交给买方(交付),买方接受并记录了契约。虽然买方从未支付过契约中背诵的“手头5美元现金”或其他考虑,但运输工具的有效性并不取决于是否得到支付。因此,转让给买方是有效的,卖方不应在其静悄悄的所有权诉讼中居于优先地位。

记录一份契约(即将契约存入正式土地记录)并不能纠正运输工具的任何缺陷,因此,在记录契约时,卖方可能没有失去任何补救办法。

记录无效的契约,即不能证明所有权的无效契约(如伪造的契约),并不能使契约生效。但在这里,契约不是无效的,因为它是被执行、交付和接受的。

(Choice D) Parol证据——提出与文件相矛盾或修改文件的极端证据——可以受理,以表明一份契约中所背诵的考虑没有得到支付。但是,虽然该证据与受赠方不付款的责任相关,但并不影响运输的有效性,因为无需考虑,因此,卖方不会通过与契约中宣读的考虑相矛盾而取得优势。

学习要点：

契约如果(1)出让人交付的契约和(2)被受赠人接受的契约,则有效转让了不动产权益,即使契约表明已支付考虑,也不需要考虑。

参考资料

重述(第三篇):遗嘱和其他捐赠转让第6.3节(《2003年宪法》)(土地赠与)。

stem:
A homebuyer financed the purchase of a new home by executing a promissory note and purchase-money mortgage to his credit union. The mortgage was promptly recorded. The next year, the home developed foundation problems. The homebuyer was forced to take out a second mortgage with a bank to finance the repairs. The mortgage was properly recorded, and file-stamped copies were sent to the homebuyer and the credit union.

After making consistent payments for five years, the homebuyer defaulted on both mortgages. The homebuyer agreed to execute a deed in lieu of foreclosure to the credit union in satisfaction of the debt. The deed was signed, delivered, and properly recorded. The credit union then initiated foreclosure proceedings on its first mortgage in order to eliminate the second mortgage held by the bank.
stemZh:
一名购房人通过执行期票和向其信用社的购房款抵押来出资购买新房子,抵押贷款被迅速记录下来,次年,住宅出现了基础问题.购房人被迫与一家银行借出第二笔抵押贷款作为修缮资金,抵押贷款记录正确,并贴有档案印本寄给购房人和信用社.

在连续支付五年后,购房人拖欠了两笔抵押贷款。 购房人同意执行一份契约,以代替向信用社赎回债务的赎回权。 契约的签署、交付和记录正确。信用社随后对其第一次抵押启动了赎回程序,以便取消银行持有的第二次抵押。
ask: Is the credit union likely to prevail?
askZh: 信用社有可能获胜吗?

options.en: No, because the credit union had actual knowledge of the second mortgage when it accepted the deed in lieu of foreclosure.
options.zh: 不,因为信用社在接受取代赎回权的契约时实际知道第二次抵押.

options.en: No, because the deed in lieu of foreclosure automatically eliminated the second mortgage under the doctrine of merger.
options.zh: 不,因为代替赎回权的契约 自动取消了合并理论下的第二次抵押权

options.en: Yes, because the credit union impliedly retained the right to foreclose on the mortgage to eliminate junior liens.
options.zh: 是的,因为信用社隐含地保留了取消低级留置权的抵押权。

options.en: Yes, because the doctrine of merger does not apply to mortgages and the lender retains the right to foreclose.
options.zh: 是的,因为合并原则不适用于抵押,贷款人保留取消抵押权的权利。

explanation.en:
The homebuyer (mortgagor) executed a deed in lieu of foreclosure, under which he conveyed all interest in the mortgaged property to the credit union (mortgagee) to avoid foreclosure. This gave the credit union the right to take immediate possession of the property without the formalities of a foreclosure sale. However, by accepting the deed, the credit union may have lost the right to foreclose on its mortgage to eliminate the bank's junior mortgage, depending on the jurisdiction.

A minority of jurisdictions apply the doctrine of merger when the same person (here, the credit union) acquires the mortgagee's interest in real property and the mortgagor's interest in that same property (Choice D). When this occurs, the mortgage merges into the fee estate and is thereby extinguished. As a result, the mortgagee has no lien on which to foreclose and any junior liens are promoted in status.

However, most jurisdictions have adopted the Restatement's position that the merger doctrine does not apply to mortgages (default rule on the MBE). Instead, a mortgagee that receives a deed in lieu of foreclosure is treated as having impliedly retained the right to foreclose on its mortgage—unless it had actual knowledge of a junior lien. If so, then the mortgagee cannot foreclose on its mortgage to eliminate that junior lien (Choices C & D).

Here, the credit union received a file-stamped copy of the bank's mortgage, so the credit union had actual knowledge of this junior lien when it received the homebuyer's deed in lieu of foreclosure. As a result, the credit union is not likely to prevail in foreclosure proceedings on its first mortgage to eliminate the bank's junior mortgage.

(Choice B) Had the minority rule regarding merger applied, the deed in lieu of foreclosure would have automatically eliminated the credit union's first mortgage—not the bank's second mortgage.

Educational objective:

A mortgagee that receives a deed in lieu of foreclosure generally retains the right to foreclose on its mortgage. But if the mortgagee had actual knowledge of a junior lien, then it cannot foreclose on its mortgage to eliminate that lien.

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 8.5 cmt. b (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (discussing deeds in lieu of foreclosure).

explanation.zh:
购房人(mortgagor)执行了一份契约,以代替赎回权,根据该契约,他将抵押财产的所有权益转达给信用社(mortgagee)以避免赎回权.这使信用社有权在不办理赎回出售手续的情况下立即占有财产。然而,信用社通过接受契约,可能丧失了取消其抵押权以取消银行次级抵押的权利,这取决于法域。

少数法域适用合并原则,当同一人(这里,信用社)取得抵押人对不动产的权益和抵押人对同一财产的权益(Choice D)。当发生这种情况时,抵押权合并到收费财产中,从而被消灭,因此抵押权人没有抵押权可赎回,任何初级抵押权都得到提升。

然而,大多数法域都采取了重新陈述的立场,即合并原则不适用于抵押(关于MBE的违约规则)。相反,抵押权人收到代替赎回权的契约,则被视为隐含地保留了取消抵押权的权利,除非其实际知道次级留置权。如果是的话,抵押权人就不能取消其抵押权,以取消初级留置权(Choices C & D)。

在这里,信用社收到了银行抵押贷款的存档副本,因此信用社收到购房人契约代替赎回权时,实际知道这个初级留置权.因此,信用社不可能在取消银行初级抵押权的第一次抵押的赎回程序中占上风。

如果适用关于合并的少数规则,取代赎回权的契约将自动取消信用社的第一次抵押,而不是银行的第二次抵押。

学习要点：

抵押权人收到抵押物以代替赎回权,一般保留其抵押权。 但如果抵押权人实际知道初级抵押权,则不能取消抵押权以取消该抵押权。

参考资料

重述(第三)财产:抵押权第8.5 cmt.b条(《1997年美国法律》)(讨论以契约代替赎回)。

stem:
A carpenter decided to start a business with his friend. In order to fund the business, the carpenter took out a loan from a local bank. The carpenter signed a 30-year promissory note to the bank and secured the note with a mortgage on his cabin, which served as his primary residence. The mortgage included a due-on-sale clause and was promptly recorded by the bank.

After running a successful business together for 10 years, the carpenter wanted to reward his friend for all of his hard work. As a result, the carpenter conveyed the cabin by quitclaim deed as a gift to the friend. When the bank received notice that the cabin had been transferred to the friend, the bank demanded full payment of the remaining mortgage debt. When neither the carpenter nor the friend made the required payment, the bank initiated foreclosure proceedings.
stemZh:
一位木匠决定与朋友创业,为了资助这一业务,木匠从当地一家银行借了一笔贷款.木匠在给银行的30年期票上签了字,并在作为他主要住所的木屋上抵押了纸币作为担保,抵押中包括了到期售票条款,被银行及时记录.

在共同经营了10年的成功生意后,木匠想奖励他的朋友所有辛勤工作,结果木匠通过辞退契约传达了木舱,作为礼物送给朋友.当银行收到通知说小屋已经转给朋友时,银行要求全额偿还剩余的抵押贷款债务,当木匠和朋友都没有按规定付款时,银行启动了赎回程序.
ask: Will the bank likely prevail?
askZh: 银行会赢吗?

options.en: No, because a due-on-sale clause can only be enforced when the mortgaged property is sold to another.
options.zh: 否,因为只有在抵押财产出售给另一个人时才能执行到期出售条款。

options.en: No, because a due-on-sale clause cannot be enforced against a mortgage on a primary residence.
options.zh: 不,因为到期售票条款不能对主要住所的抵押权强制执行。

options.en: Yes, because the due-on-sale clause made the friend personally liable for the mortgage debt.
options.zh: 是的,因为到期出售条款 使朋友个人 负责抵押债务。

options.en: Yes, because the transfer of the mortgaged property triggered the due-on-sale clause.
options.zh: 是的,因为抵押财产的转让 触发了到期出售条款。

explanation.en:
Common mortgage provisions

Acceleration clause Allows creditor to demand entire loan due & payable if debtor defaults

Due-on-sale clause Allows creditor to demand entire loan due & payable if debtor sells mortgaged property without permission

Due-on-encumbrance clause Allows creditor to accelerate mortgage obligation if debtor obtains second mortgage or otherwise encumbers property

Defeasance clause Requires creditor to give debtor legal title to property & release mortgage lien once all payments are made

Mortgage documents are used to convey a lender (mortgagee) an interest in real property to secure repayment of a debt. These documents may contain a due-on-sale clause, which allows the lender to demand full payment of the remaining mortgage debt if the debtor (mortgagor) transfers the mortgaged property without the lender's consent (absent limited exceptions). If the debtor is unable to pay, then the lender can initiate foreclosure proceedings to recover any remaining debt.

Here, the carpenter gave the bank a mortgage on his residence, the cabin, to secure a loan. The mortgage contained a due-on-sale clause, which was triggered when the carpenter transferred the cabin to the friend by quitclaim deed and allowed the bank to demand full payment of the remaining loan balance. The fact that the cabin was gifted (not sold) has no impact on the bank's ability to enforce this clause (Choice A). And since the carpenter did not make the required payment, the bank will prevail in its foreclosure proceedings.

(Choice B) A due-on-sale clause can be enforced on a primary residence or any other real property used to secure repayment of a debt.

(Choice C) The due-on-sale clause made the carpenter (mortgagor) personally liable on the debt if the mortgaged property was conveyed without the bank's consent. The friend would be personally liable only if he agreed to assume the mortgage debt (not seen here).

Educational objective:

A due-on-sale clause allows a lender to demand full payment of the remaining mortgage debt if the debtor transfers the mortgaged property without the lender's permission. Although labeled a "due on sale" clause, the clause is triggered by most transfers—including gifts.

References

55 Am. Jur. 2d Mortgages § 415 (2019) (due-on-sale clauses).

共同抵押规定

加速条款允许债权人在债务人违约时要求全部到期和应付贷款

到期出售条款允许债权人在债务人擅自出售抵押财产时要求获得到期应付的全部贷款

到期抵押条款允许债权人在债务人获得第二次抵押或以其他方式抵押财产时加快抵押债务

违约条款要求债权人在所有付款后给予债务人对财产的合法所有权并解除抵押留置权。

抵押贷款文件用来向贷款人(抵押贷款人)传达不动产的利息,以保证债务的偿还。这些文件可能包含一个到期售后条款,如果债务人(抵押权人)未经出贷人同意而转让抵押财产,则允许出贷人要求全额偿还剩余的抵押债务(没有有限例外)。如果债务人无力偿付,出贷人可以启动赎回程序,收回任何剩余债务。

在这里,木匠给了银行他的住所,小屋的抵押贷款,以担保贷款. 抵押中包含一个到期售票条款,当木匠通过退货契约将小屋转让给朋友时,这个条款就被触发了,并允许银行要求全部贷款.船舱有天赋(没有出售)这一事实对银行强制执行的能力没有影响。由于木匠没有按规定付款,银行将优先取消赎回权诉讼程序。

(Choice B) 可在主要住所或任何其他用于确保偿还债务的不动产上强制执行到期出售条款。

(Choice C)到期售票条款规定,如果抵押财产未经银行同意而转移,木匠(mortgagor)个人对债务负有责任,朋友只有在同意承担抵押债务(此处不见)时才承担个人责任.

学习要点：

到期出售条款允许放款人要求债务人在未经放款人许可的情况下转让抵押财产时全额偿还剩余抵押债务,虽然标注了"到期出售"条款,但该条款是由大多数转让——包括赠与——引发的.

55 Am. Jur. 2d 抵押权第415条(2019年)(到期售后条款)。

stem:
A man who owned a farm in fee simple conveyed it to a friend by warranty deed. An adjoining neighbor asserted title to the farm and brought an appropriate action against the friend to quiet title to the farm. The friend demanded that the man defend her title under the deed's covenant of warranty, but the man refused. The friend then successfully defended at her own expense.

The friend brought an appropriate action against the man to recover her expenses incurred in defending against the adjoining neighbor's action to quiet title to the farm.
stemZh:
一个拥有一个收费农场的男子通过担保契约将它传递给一个朋友,一个毗邻的邻居声称拥有该农场的所有权,并对该朋友提起适当诉讼,要求他安静地拥有该农场的所有权。朋友要求男方根据契约的保修契约为她的头衔辩护,但男方拒绝了,这名男方随后以自己的费用成功辩护.

这名朋友对该男子提起了适当的诉讼,以收回她为抵御邻里为平息农场所有权而采取的行动而支付的费用。
ask: In this action, will the friend prevail?
askZh: 在这场行动中,这位朋友会胜出吗?

options.en: No, because the adjoining neighbor could have elected to sue either the man or the friend.
options.zh: 不,因为邻居可以选择 起诉他或者那个朋友

options.en: No, because the title the man conveyed was not defective.
options.zh: 不,因为他传递的头衔没有瑕疵。

options.en: Yes, because in effect it was the man's title that was challenged.
options.zh: 是的,因为实际上,这是 男人的头衔受到质疑。

options.en: Yes, because the man's deed to her included the covenant of warranty.
options.zh: 是的,因为男人对她的契约 包括保证契约。

explanation.en:
Covenants of title

(warranty & special warranty deeds)

Present covenants

(breached at time of conveyance)

Seisin Grantor owns interest being conveyed

Right to convey Grantor has legal right to convey interest

Against encumbrances

No encumbrances (eg, easements, mortgages) against interest conveyed

Future covenants

(breached upon interference with possession)

Warranty Grantor will defend & compensate grantee for lawful claims made against grantee's title

Quiet enjoyment Grantee's possession & enjoyment will not be disturbed by another's lawful claim of title

Further assurances

Grantor will take any actions reasonably necessary to perfect grantee's title

A warranty deed conveys a grantor's real property to a grantee with assurances that there are no defects in title—ie, no one else owns the land and it is free from encumbrances. The covenant of warranty is an assurance that the grantor will defend and compensate the grantee for lawful claims made against the grantee's title—eg, when a third party prevails against the grantee in a quiet title action.

Here, the man conveyed his farm to a friend by warranty deed. The friend demanded that the man defend her under the covenant of warranty after an adjoining neighbor asserted title to the farm through a quiet title action (Choice D). But the man was not required to do so because the neighbor did not have a lawful claim (as evidenced by the friend's successful defense). Therefore, the friend will not recover the expenses she incurred in defending that claim.

(Choice A) In a quiet title action, the plaintiff can sue all persons claiming an interest in the property to establish superior title. Here, the neighbor could not have elected to sue the man since he no longer claimed an interest in the farm (he had conveyed his interest to the friend). But had the neighbor prevailed against the friend (lawful claim), the friend could recover her expenses from the man under the covenant of warranty.

(Choice C) The neighbor's action against the friend was, in effect, challenging the man's title since the neighbor would only prevail if the man had conveyed defective title to the

friend. But the man was not required to defend that suit under the covenant of warranty (or compensate the friend) since he had not conveyed defective title.

Educational objective:

Under the covenant of warranty, the grantor of a warranty deed must defend and compensate the grantee for any lawful claims made against the grantee's title—eg, when the grantee is defeated in a third party's quiet title action.

explanation.zh:
标题盟约

(保证金和特别保证书)

现行公约

(运输时违反)

Seisin 出让人拥有被传递的利益

转让权人有转移权益的法律权利

反对抵押

对利息的抵押权(如地役权、抵押权)

未来的公约

(因干扰占有而违反)

担保人设保人将就受赠人对受赠人所有权的合法要求进行辩护和赔偿。

受赠人的占有和享有不会因他人合法主张所有权而受到影响

进一步保证

设保人将采取合理必要的行动,以完善受赠人的所有权

担保契约将设保人的不动产传递给受赠人,并保证所有权没有缺陷——即没有其他人拥有土地,没有抵押权。担保契约是一种保证,即设保人将为受赠人对受赠人所有权的合法债权进行辩护和赔偿,例如当第三方在静悄悄的所有权诉讼中对受赠人胜诉时。

这名男子通过保修契约将他的农场传递给一位朋友,这位朋友要求该男子在一个邻居通过静静的产权行动(Choice D)主张农场所有权后,根据保修契约为她辩护。但由于邻居没有合法的权利主张(如朋友的辩护成功所证明),因此,朋友不会收回她为维护这一权利主张而支付的费用。

(Choice A)在静悄悄的产权诉讼中,原告可以起诉所有主张财产权益的人,以确立上级产权.在这里,邻居不可能选择起诉此人,因为他不再声称对农场感兴趣(他已经向这位朋友转达了他的兴趣)。但是如果邻居胜过朋友(合法的权利主张),朋友可以根据保修契约向男人收回她的开支.

(Choice C)邻居对朋友的行动实际上是在挑战男人的头衔,因为邻居只有在男人把有缺陷的头衔传递给朋友时才会获胜.

但是,由于他没有传递有缺陷的产权,因此没有要求他根据保证(或补偿)契约为诉讼辩护。

学习要点：

根据担保契约,担保契约的出押人必须对受赠人对受赠人所有权提出的任何合法要求进行辩护和赔偿,例如当受赠人在第三方的静静所有权诉讼中被击败时。

stem:
A woman owned a lot, which was improved with a dwelling. Her neighbor owned an adjoining unimproved lot suitable for constructing a dwelling. The neighbor executed and delivered a deed granting to the woman an easement over the westerly 15 feet of her lot for convenient ingress and egress to a public street, since the woman's lot only abutted a dirt road. The woman did not then record the neighbor's deed. After the woman constructed and started using a driveway within the described 15-foot strip in a clearly visible manner, the neighbor borrowed $100,000 cash from the bank and gave the bank a mortgage on her lot. The mortgage was promptly and properly recorded. The woman then recorded the neighbor's deed granting the easement. The neighbor subsequently defaulted on her loan payments to the bank.

The recording act of the jurisdiction provides: "No conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value and without notice unless the same be recorded according to law."

In an appropriate foreclosure action as to the neighbor's lot, brought against the woman and the neighbor, the bank seeks, among other things, to have the woman's easement declared subordinate to the bank's mortgage, so that the easement will be terminated by completion of the foreclosure.
stemZh:
一名妇女拥有大量住房,住房得到改善,她的邻居拥有一个毗邻的、未经改善的、适合建造住房的土地。邻居处死并交付了一份契约,让这名妇女在她15英尺长的地盘上获得地役权,以方便地闯入和向一条公共街道进发,因为那名妇女的地役权只打破了一条土路,这名妇女没有记录邻居的地役权。在这位妇女以清晰可见的方式在描述的15英尺长的地带内建造并开始使用车道后,邻居向银行借了10万美元现金,并给了银行她的地盘抵押贷款,抵押贷款被迅速和正确地记录下来.这名妇女随后记录了邻居同意地役权的契约,邻居随后拖欠了对银行的贷款。

辖区的录制行为规定:"不动产的转让或者抵押,不得对后继购买人进行价值优待,未经通知,除非依法予以记录.

在对邻居的地产提起的一次适当的赎回诉讼中,银行除其他外,要求宣布该女子的地役权从属于银行的抵押权,这样,地役权将在完成后终止。赎回权。
ask: If the woman's easement is NOT terminated, what will be the reason?
askZh: 如果女方的地役权没有终止,那有什么原因?

options.en: The easement provides access from the woman's lot to a public street.
options.zh: 地役权提供妇女从地方进入公共街道的机会。

options.en: The recording of the deed granting the easement prior to the foreclosure action protects the woman's rights.
options.zh: 在解除赎回权行动之前,对批准地役权的契约进行记录,保护妇女的权利。

options.en: The woman's easement is appurtenant to her lot and thus cannot be separated from her lot.
options.zh: 女子的地役权是她自己的地役权,因此不能与她的地役权分开.

options.en: Visible use of the easement by the woman put the bank on notice of the easement.
options.zh: 女方明显使用地役权,将地役权通知银行.

explanation.en:
Recording acts are used to determine priority among competing property interests. In a notice jurisdiction (as seen here), a bona fide purchaser (BFP) has priority over an earlier property interest if the BFP took without notice of that interest. There are three types of notice:

Actual – a buyer has direct knowledge of a prior interest in land Record – a document showing a prior interest is properly recorded in the land records and appears in the buyer's chain of title Inquiry – a buyer knows, or should know, of circumstances that would prompt a reasonable person to investigate (eg, visible use of the property, reference to unrecorded transaction in recorded instrument) Here, the foreclosure would only terminate the woman's prior easement over the neighbor's lot if the bank had no notice of the easement when it obtained a mortgage from the neighbor. The bank had no direct knowledge of the easement (no actual notice), and it was recorded after the mortgage was conveyed (no record notice). But if visible use of the easement put the bank on inquiry notice, the easement would not be terminated by the foreclosure.

(Choice A) An easement by necessity allows an owner of a landlocked parcel to cross another's land to access a public road and only terminates when the necessity ends. Although the woman's easement allowed her to access a public street, her lot was not landlocked since it abutted another street (no necessity).

(Choice B) Recording the deed granting the easement prior to the mortgage (not the foreclosure action) would have protected the woman's rights. But since she recorded the deed after the mortgage was conveyed, the recording did not protect her (ie, no record notice).

(Choice C) An easement appurtenant—an easement that benefits the easement holder's land by granting limited use or control of another's land—cannot be separated (ie, conveyed separately) from the easement holder's land. But it is only binding on subsequent purchasers (eg, the bank) who take with notice of the easement.

Educational objective:

In a notice jurisdiction, a bona fide purchaser who acquires a property interest without notice (actual, record, or inquiry) of an earlier property interest will prevail. A buyer has inquiry notice when he/she knows, or should know, of circumstances that would prompt a reasonable person to investigate (eg, visible use of the property).

explanation.zh:
记录行为用于确定竞合财产权益之间的优先权,在通知法域(如此处所示),善意买受人(BFP)在未注意到该权益的情况下取得的财产权益优先于先前的财产权益。通知有三种类型:

实际 - 买方直接知道土地记录的先前权益 - 表明先前权益的文件适当记录在土地记录中,并出现在买方所有权链调查中 - 买方知道或应当知道会引发的情况合理人员进行调查(例如,明显使用财产,提及记录票据中未记录的交易),在此情况下,只有在银行没有通知下,取消赎回权才会终止妇女事先对邻居的地块的地役权。银行对地役权并不直接知情(没有实际通知),而是在抵押权发出后记录下来(没有记录通知)。但是,如果明显使用地役权使银行接到查询通知,则地役权不会因为赎回权而终止.

(Choice A) 迫不得已的地役权允许内陆地块的所有人穿越他人的土地进入公共道路,只有在迫不得已时才终止。尽管这名妇女的地役权允许她进入一条公共街道,但她的地盘并非地处内陆,因为它打破了另一条街道(没有必要)。

(Choice B) 记录在抵押之前准予地役权的契约(而不是取消赎回权的诉讼)会保护女性的权利。 但是,由于她在抵押权传递之后记录了地役权,该记录并没有保护她(没有记录通知)。

(C) 地役权附属地——通过有限使用或控制他人土地而使地役权持有者的土地受益的地役权附属地——不能与地役权持有者的土地分开(即分开传送)。但仅对注意到地役权的后续购买者(如银行)具有约束力。

学习要点：

在通知法域中,善意买受人取得财产权益而未通知(实际、记录或查询)先前财产权益的,以善意买受人为准。买受人在知道或应当知道会促使有理智的人进行调查的情况(例如财产的明显用途)时,有查询通知。

stem:
A man decided to purchase an apartment building. To finance this purchase, the man borrowed funds from a bank. The man executed a negotiable promissory note and a mortgage to the bank in order to secure repayment of the loan.

Two years later, the bank sold its promissory note to a mortgage company by endorsing and promptly delivering the note to the mortgage company. Shortly thereafter, the man stopped making payments on the mortgage, and the mortgage company initiated judicial foreclosure proceedings against him. The man has moved to dismiss the suit.
stemZh:
一名男子决定购买一栋公寓楼,为了资助这次购买,男子向一家银行借款,男子向银行支付了一笔可转让的本票和抵押贷款,以保证偿还贷款。

两年后,银行将本票出售给一家抵押公司,认可并迅速将本票交给抵押公司.此后不久,该男子停止支付抵押贷款,抵押公司对他提起了取消赎回权的司法诉讼,该男子已提出驳回诉讼。
ask: Should the motion to dismiss be granted?
askZh: 驳回动议是否应予批准?

options.en: No, because the mortgage was not assigned and is unenforceable by anyone except the bank.
options.zh: 不,因为抵押没有被转让 而且除了银行之外任何人都不能执行

options.en: No, because the mortgage will be deemed to have been transferred with the promissory note.
options.zh: 不,因为抵押将被视为与期票一起转移。

options.en: Yes, because the promissory note could not be assigned independent of the mortgage.
options.zh: 是的,因为期票不能独立于抵押而转让。

options.en: Yes, because the promissory note required a separate document for assignment to the mortgage company.
options.zh: 是的,因为本票需要一份单独的凭证才能转让给抵押公司。

explanation.en:
Transfer of promissory note & mortgage

Transfer of both documents Both documents are transferred unless:

expressly prohibited in note/mortgage forbidden by statute or public policy or increases mortgagor's duties, burdens, risks

Transfer of note without mortgage

Transfer of mortgage without note*

Transfer is void

*Jurisdictions are split as to effect of transfer.

To finance the purchase of real property, a borrower typically executes two documents that serve as evidence of the debt:

Promissory note – a formal "IOU" that sets forth the terms of the loan. It is the primary evidence of the debt and is not recorded in the deed records. Mortgage (or deed of trust) – a lien that secures the loan by attaching the debt to a real property interest and providing a means of enforcement (eg, foreclosure). It is recorded in the deed records to provide notice of an outstanding debt attached to the real property. If a lender decides to sell its security interest, the lender can assign the promissory note independent of the mortgage to an assignee (Choice C). A nonnegotiable promissory note requires a separate assignment document to transfer ownership (Choice D). However, a negotiable promissory note can be transferred by merely endorsing and delivering the note to the assignee. Once the promissory note is properly transferred, the mortgage automatically transfers with the note (unless the parties agreed otherwise)

(Choice A).

Here, the negotiable promissory note was properly transferred to the mortgage company upon its endorsement and delivery. The mortgage will be deemed to have automatically transferred to the mortgage company, so the mortgage company can enforce the mortgage through foreclosure. Therefore, the man's motion to dismiss this foreclosure proceeding should be denied.

Educational objective:

A nonnegotiable promissory note must be transferred by a separate document, while a negotiable promissory note can be transferred by endorsing and delivering the note. Either note can be transferred independent of the mortgage, and the mortgage will automatically transfer with the note (unless otherwise agreed).

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 5.4 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (transfer of mortgages).

explanation.zh:
期票转让和抵押

转移两份文件,除非:

法规或公共政策所禁止的注解/抵押或增加抵押者的职责、负担、风险

无抵押的票据转让

无纸质抵押权的转让*

传输无效

* 关于移交的效力,管辖权是分开的。

为了资助购买不动产,借款人通常执行作为债务证据的两份文件:

Promissory note — — 一个正式的“IOU ” , 它规定了贷款条件。 它是债务的主要证据,没有记录在契约记录中。抵押(或信托契约)——通过将债务附加于不动产权益并提供强制执行手段(例如,取消赎回权)来担保贷款的留置权。它记录在契约记录中,以提供附在不动产上的未偿债务的通知,如果出贷人决定出售其担保权益,出贷人可以将独立于抵押的期票转让给受让人(Choice C)。不可转让的本票需要单独的转让单证才能转让所有权(Choice D)。 然而,可转让的本票只能通过认可和将本票交给受让人而转让。期票适当转让后,抵押权随期票自动转移(除非当事人另有约定).

(Choice A) (英语).

在此,可转让本票在抵押公司背书和交付时被适当转让。抵押权将被视为自动转让给抵押权公司,因此抵押权公司可以通过赎回来强制执行抵押权,因此,男方驳回这一赎回程序的动议应被拒绝.

学习要点：

不可转让的本票必须通过单独的单证转让,而可转让的本票可以通过背书和交付票据转让。这两种票据都可以独立于抵押权转让,抵押权将随票据自动转让(除非另有约定).

参考资料

重述(第三)财产:抵押权第5.4条(《1997年美国法律》)(抵押权的转让)。

stem:
A newly married couple, anxious to start a life together, decided to build a new home. They financed the home by executing a 15-year promissory note and purchase-money mortgage to the bank. The mortgage, which contained a power-of-sale clause, was promptly recorded.

Seven years later, the couple legally separated. Neither could afford the mortgage payments on their individual salary, so they abandoned the home and stopped making mortgage payments. After the couple missed two payments, the bank decided to initiate a foreclosure proceeding.

The jurisdiction follows the title theory of mortgages and allows for nonjudicial foreclosures.
stemZh:
新婚夫妇急于共同生活,决定兴建新住宅,他们通过执行15年期票和向银行提供购房抵押贷款的方式为住宅提供资金,其中包含售权条款的抵押权被迅速记录下来.

7年后,这对夫妇合法分居,也无力支付个人工资的抵押款,因此他们放弃了住宅,不再按揭付款.在这对夫妇错过两笔付款后,银行决定启动赎回程序.

管辖遵循抵押权的所有权理论,允许非司法性赎回.
ask: Which of the following actions poses the most financial risk to the bank?
askZh: 下列哪些行动对银行构成最大的金融风险?

options.en: Accepting a deed in lieu of foreclosure.
options.zh: 接受契约代替赎回权.

options.en: Entering the property to make repairs prior to foreclosure.
options.zh: 在赎回前进入房产进行修理.

options.en: Foreclosing on the mortgage through a privately conducted public sale.
options.zh: 通过私人进行的公开销售来取消抵押权。

options.en: Leasing the home to a tenant.
options.zh: 把房子租给租户

explanation.en:
This jurisdiction follows the title theory of mortgages, so a lender is considered the owner of the mortgaged property until the mortgage debt is fully satisfied. This gives the lender the right to take possession of the property at any time (unless the mortgage states otherwise). If the lender takes possession, then it assumes the duty to take reasonable care of the property until foreclosure proceedings end.

The duty of reasonable care includes the duty not to commit waste that would impair the value of the property. As a result, the lender is liable to the borrower if the value of the property is reduced because of the lender's actions during foreclosure proceedings.

Here, if the bank chooses to lease the home, it runs the risk that the tenant will damage the property. Damage to the property reduces any equity that the borrower (here, the couple) may have in the home. Such damage would amount to waste, for which the bank would have to account to the couple during the foreclosure proceedings. Therefore, leasing the home to a tenant poses the most financial risk to the bank.

(Choice A) A borrower may deed all interest in the property to the lender in lieu of foreclosure. This poses minimal financial risk to the lender because it allows the lender to take immediate possession of the property without any further legal formalities and to generally reserve the right to pursue a deficiency against the debtor.

(Choice B) The bank may enter the property to make repairs prior to foreclosure because this would likely increase the value of the property—not impair it.

(Choice C) In jurisdictions that permit nonjudicial foreclosure, a lender may foreclose on a mortgage through a privately conducted public sale when the mortgage contains a power-of-sale clause (as seen here). This allows the bank to foreclose without court intervention.

Educational objective:

A lender has the right to take possession of mortgaged property but is liable to the borrower for any waste that the lender commits during foreclosure proceedings.

explanation.zh:
这一法域遵循抵押权的所有权理论,因此在抵押债务完全清偿之前,放款人被视为抵押财产的所有人.这使出贷人有权在任何时候占有该财产(除非抵押权另有规定),如果出贷人占有该财产,则它有义务合理照管该财产,直至解除赎回权程序结束。

合理谨慎的责任包括不从事可能损害财产价值的浪费行为的责任,因此,如果由于出贷人在解除赎回权程序期间的行为而使财产价值降低,出贷人对借款人负有责任。

在这里,如果银行选择租房,它就有可能让房客损坏房产,对房产的损害会减少借款人(这里,夫妇)在房屋中可能拥有的任何股本。这种损害将构成浪费,银行必须在取消赎回权的程序中向夫妻双方说明,因此,将住房出租给租户对银行构成最大的财务风险。

(选择A) 借款人可以向出贷人转让财产的所有权益,以代替取消赎回权。 这对出贷人构成最低限度的财务风险,因为它允许出贷人立即占有财产而无需办理任何进一步的法律手续。通常保留对债务人追索差额的权利。

银行可以在取消赎回权之前进入该财产进行修理,因为这样做可能会增加该财产的价值,而不是损害该财产。

(选择C)在允许非司法性取消赎回权的法域,如果抵押权包含一项销售权条款(如此处所示),放款人可通过私人进行的公开销售取消抵押权。这使银行可以在没有法院干预的情况下取消抵押。

学习要点：

出贷人有权占有抵押的财产,但对于出贷人在取消赎回权程序中所犯的任何浪费行为,应向借款人承担赔偿责任。

stem:
At the time of his death last week, a man owned a small farm. By his duly probated will, drawn five years ago, the man did the following:

1. He devised the farm "to my farmhand for the life of my wife, then to my cousin."

2. He gave "all the rest, residue and remainder of my estate, both real and personal, to my friend."

At his death, the man was survived by a son (his sole heir), the farmhand, the cousin, and the friend. The wife had died a week before the man.
stemZh:
在上周他去世时,一个男人拥有一个小农场,他五年前通过他正式证明的遗嘱,做了以下事情:

1. 他设计了农场"为了我妻子的性命,为了我的堂兄弟".

2. 他将"我的遗产的其余部分,剩余部分,无论是真实的还是个人的,都交给我的朋友".

在他去世时,这名男子由一位儿子(他唯一的继承人),农夫,堂兄弟,以及朋友幸存下来,妻子比男子早去世一周.
ask: Who has title to the farm?
askZh: 谁有农场的产权?

options.en: The cousin, in fee simple.
options.zh: 堂弟,费用简单。

options.en: The farmhand for life, remainder to the cousin.
options.zh: 一辈子的农夫 留给表弟

options.en: The friend, in fee simple.
options.zh: 那个朋友,费用很简单

options.en: The son, in fee simple.
options.zh: 儿子,费用简单。

explanation.en:
Doctrines affecting conveyance by will

Lapse Causes devise to fail if beneficiary predeceases testator

Ademption Causes devise to fail by either:

extinction – specifically devised property not owned by testator (or destroyed or fundamentally changed) at death satisfaction – beneficiary received devised property (or other asset intended to satisfy devise) during testator's life Exoneration Allows beneficiary of specifically devised real property to use estate's remaining assets to pay off any encumbrances on that property

Abatement Reduces devises that cannot be satisfied by assets remaining after testator's debts are paid Residuary devises abated first, followed by general & then specific devises Lapse (ie, the failure of a gift of property under a will) normally occurs when the beneficiary dies before the testator dies. But when a will gives a life estate pur autre vie— ie, a life estate measured by the life of someone other than the life tenant—lapse occurs when either the life tenant or the measuring life predeceases the testator. The life tenant's (or other measuring life's) predecease affects only the life tenant's interest, however, so any remainder interest is not defeated.

Here, the man's will devised a life estate pur autre vie in the farm to the farmhand (measured by the wife's life) and a remainder to the cousin. Because the wife died before the man, the doctrine of lapse caused the devise to the farmhand to fail. But since the cousin's remainder interest was not defeated by the wife's death, the cousin has title to the farm in fee simple (Choices B, C & D).

Educational objective:

When a will gives a life estate pur autre vie, the devise will lapse (ie, fail) if the life tenant or the measuring life dies before the testator. But the remainder interest, if any, will survive.

References

80 Am. Jur. 2d Wills § 1415 (2019) (death of life tenant before death of testator).

Restatement (Second) of Property: Donative Transfers § 34.6 (Am. Law Inst. 1992) (donee dies before donor).

explanation.zh:
影响意愿传递的理论

如果受益人死亡前遗嘱人设计失败

利用自首的诱因设计出失败:

消灭 -- -- 具体设计的财产在死亡清偿时不是由遗嘱人拥有(或毁坏或根本改变) -- -- 受益人在遗嘱人生命中收到指定的财产(或意在满足设定的其他资产)专门设计不动产,以利用破产财产的剩余资产来偿付对该财产的任何抵押

在遗嘱人的债务得到偿付后,剩余资产无法抵偿的减值装置首先得到减值装置,然后是一般和具体装置(即根据遗嘱赠予财产的失败),通常发生在受益人在遗嘱人死前死亡,但当遗嘱人给人一种生活财产时,即以终身房客以外的人的生命为衡量标准的生命财产,则在终身房客或计量生命的死亡前发生。终身房客的(或其他衡量终身房客的)死亡前,只影响终身房客的利益,因此任何剩余利息都不会落空。

在这里,这个男人的遗嘱设计了一个生活庄园,在农场里向农夫(以妻子的一生为衡量标准)和堂弟的余下部分。 因为妻子在男夫之前就去世了,失职的学说导致农夫的计谋失败。但是由于堂兄的剩余利息没有因为妻子的死而落败,因此堂弟在收费简单(Choices B,C & D)中拥有农场的所有权.

学习要点：

当遗嘱赋予了生命财产时,如果终身房客或测量生命在遗嘱人之前死亡,则计谋就会失效(即失败 ) 。 但剩余的利息(如果有的话)将会存续。

参考资料

80 Am. Jur. 2d Wills § 1415 (2019)(在遗嘱人死亡前死亡的终身房客).

财产重述(第二次):捐赠转让§34.6(《1992年宪法》)(捐赠者在捐赠者之前死亡)。

sourceSetLabel: 不动产法 · 第 2 组
stem:
A man borrowed $500,000 from a bank, securing the loan with a mortgage on a commercial building he owned.

The mortgage provided as follows: "No prepayment may be made on this loan during the first two years after the date of this mortgage. Thereafter, prepayment may be made in any amount at any time but only if accompanied by a prepayment fee of 5% of the amount prepaid."

One year later, the man received an unexpected cash gift of $1 million and wished to pay off the $495,000 principal balance still owed on the loan. Concerned that the bank might refuse prepayment—despite a rise in market interest rates in the year since the loan was made— or at least insist on the 5% prepayment fee, the man consulted an attorney concerning the enforceability of the above-quoted clause.

There is no applicable statute.
stemZh:
一名男子向一家银行借款50万美元,用他拥有的一座商业建筑的抵押贷款来担保贷款.

抵押贷款规定如下:"在抵押日之后的头两年内,不得对该项贷款进行预付,此后,可以随时进行预付,但必须同时支付预付金额的5%的预付费".

一年后,这名男子收到意外现金赠送100万美元,希望还清仍拖欠贷款的49.5万本金余额.该名男子担心银行可能拒绝预付款——尽管自贷款以来的一年中市场利率上升——或至少坚持5%的预付款费,但就上述条款的可执行性问题咨询了一名律师。

没有适用的法规。
ask: What is the attorney likely to say?
askZh: 律师会说什么?

options.en: The entire clause is unenforceable, because it violates a public policy favoring the prompt and early repayment of debt.
options.zh: 整个条款是无法执行的,因为它违反了有利于迅速和及早偿还债务的公共政策。

options.en: The entire clause is unenforceable, because the rise in interest rates will allow the bank to reloan the funds without loss.
options.zh: 整个条款是无法执行的,因为利率的上升将使银行能够重新借贷资金而不损失.

options.en: The two-year prepayment prohibition and the prepayment fee provision are both valid and enforceable.
options.zh: 两年预缴款禁令和预缴款规定既有效又可执行。

options.en: The two-year prepayment prohibition is unenforceable, but the prepayment fee provision is enforceable.
options.zh: 两年预付禁令是无法执行的,但预付费用规定是可强制执行的。

explanation.en:
Right to prepay mortgage

Common law Prepayment barred unless mortgage documents provide otherwise

Majority rule Prepayment allowed unless mortgage documents provide otherwise

Under the common law "perfect tender in time" rule, a mortgagor (debtor) has no right to prepay a mortgage debt unless the mortgage documents provide otherwise. However, the prevailing modern trend reverses this presumption and allows prepayment unless the mortgage documents provide otherwise.

Prepayment prohibitions or penalties contained in a mortgage are generally valid and enforceable.* They do not violate public policy because they serve the beneficial purpose of:

allowing the mortgagee to maintain the financial yield intended under the mortgage agreement and compensating the mortgagee for any losses suffered because of a prepayment (Choice A). As a result, the two-year prepayment prohibition and prepayment fee provision in the man's mortgage are valid and enforceable, even if the bank could reloan the funds to another without loss (Choices B & D).

*Roughly half of all states prohibit or restrict prepayment penalties on mortgaged residential property (eg, by limiting the penalty rate or time in which the penalty can be imposed).

Educational objective:

A debtor has the right to prepay a mortgage debt unless the mortgage provides otherwise. Prepayment prohibitions or penalties in a mortgage are generally valid and enforceable.

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages §§ 6.1–6.2 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (right to prepay mortgage).

explanation.zh:
预付抵押权

除非抵押贷款文件另有规定,否则不得支付预付款

除非抵押贷款文件另有规定,否则可以先付

根据普通法“及时完美投标”规则,除非抵押文件另有规定,抵押人(债务人)无权预先偿付抵押债务。然而,普遍的现代趋势扭转了这一推定,允许预付,除非抵押文件另有规定。

抵押贷款中的预付款禁令或处罚一般是有效的和可执行的。它们不违反公共政策,因为它们有利于:

允许抵押权人维持抵押协议规定的财务收益,并赔偿抵押权人因预付款而遭受的任何损失(选择A)。因此,男子抵押贷款中两年预付禁令和预付费用规定是有效和可执行的,即使银行可以将资金转借给另一人而不损失(Choices B & D).

* 仅有一半的州禁止或限制对抵押住宅财产的预付罚款(例如,限制罚款率或处罚时间)。

学习要点：

除抵押另有规定外,债务人有权预先偿付抵押债务,抵押中的预付禁令或处罚一般是有效的和可强制执行的。

stem: A creditor received a valid judgment against a debtor and promptly filed the judgment in the county land records. Two years later, the debtor purchased land in the county and promptly recorded the warranty deed to the land. Subsequently, the debtor borrowed $30,000 from his aunt, signed a promissory note for that amount, and secured the note with a mortgage on the land. The mortgage was promptly recorded. The aunt failed to make a title search before making the loan. The debtor made no payment to the creditor and defaulted on the mortgage loan from his aunt. A valid judicial foreclosure proceeding was held, in which the creditor, the aunt, and the debtor were named parties. A dispute arose as to which lien had priority. A statute of the jurisdiction provides: "Any judgment properly filed shall, for 10 years from filing, be a lien on the real property then owned or subsequently acquired by any person against whom the judgment is rendered." A second statute of the jurisdiction provides: "No unrecorded conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value without notice, who shall first record."
stemZh: 债权人收到对债务人的有效判决,并迅速将判决提交县土地记录,两年后,债务人在县内购买土地,并迅速记录土地的保税契约.随后,债务人向姑妈借了3万美元,在这笔金额的本票上签了字,并以土地抵押担保了该票据,该抵押权被迅速记录下来,姑妈在贷款前没有进行产权查询.债务人没有向债权人付款,也没有向姑妈偿还抵押贷款,进行了有效的司法取消赎回权程序,其中债权人、姑妈和债务人被指名道姓,对哪一种留置权享有优先权产生了争议。管辖规约规定:"任何妥善立案的判决,自立案之日起十年内,即为判决所针对的任何人当时拥有或随后获得的不动产的留置权. " 管辖规约第二项规定:"无记录的不动产运输工具或抵押,对后续购买人的价值不作通知的,应当先作记录".
ask: Who has the prior lien?
askZh: 之前的留置权是谁?

options.en: The aunt, because a judgment lien is subordinate to a mortgage lien.
options.zh: 姨妈,因为判决留置权从属于抵押留置权.

options.en: The aunt, because she is a mortgagee under a purchase-money mortgage.
options.zh: 姨妈,因为她是按购钱抵押的抵押权人。

options.en: The creditor, because its judgment was filed first.
options.zh: 债权人,因其判决是先备案的。

options.en: The creditor, because the aunt had a duty to make a title search of the property.
options.zh: 债权人,因为姨妈有义务对财产进行产权查询。

explanation.en:
Notice of competing property interests

Actual notice

Buyer has direct knowledge of prior interest in land

Record notice

Document showing prior interest in land is properly recorded & appears in buyer's chain of title

Inquiry notice

Buyer knows, or should know, of circumstances that would prompt reasonable person to investigate (eg, visible use of property, reference to unrecorded transaction in recorded instrument)

The priority of competing property interests is evaluated under the jurisdiction's recording act. Under a race-notice statute (as seen here), a bona fide purchaser's (BFP's) subsequent property interest has priority over an earlier competing property interest if the BFP:

lacked notice of the earlier interest at the time the BFP acquired his/her interest and recorded his/her interest at any time before the earlier interest was recorded. And a purchaser had constructive notice (ie, record notice) of an earlier property interest if a document showing that interest was properly recorded (ie, filed in the official land records) and appeared in the purchaser's chain of title.

Here, the creditor has the prior lien because it filed its judgment against the debtor in the county land records first. As a result, she had constructive notice of the creditor's prior interest when she acquired a mortgage lien on that property. Therefore, the aunt is not a BFP and the creditor has priority.

(Choices A & B) A judgment lien is not necessarily subordinate (inferior) to a mortgage. However, a judgment lien is subordinate to a purchase-money mortgage (PMM)—a mortgage that allows the buyer to purchase or improve the property. Here, the aunt's mortgage was not used by the debtor to purchase or improve the land (not a PMM). And since the creditor filed its judgment before the aunt recorded her mortgage, the creditor has the prior lien.

(Choice D) A purchaser (eg, the aunt) has no duty to conduct a title search before he/she acquires a property interest. But a purchaser who fails to do so cannot claim that he/she lacked notice of an earlier property interest that was properly recorded and in the purchaser's chain of title.

Educational objective:

In a race-notice jurisdiction, a bona fide purchaser's (BFP's) property interest has priority over an earlier interest if the BFP (1) lacked notice of that interest and (2) recorded first. But a BFP has constructive notice of the earlier interest if a document showing that interest was properly recorded and appeared in the purchaser's chain of title.

explanation.zh:
竞合财产权益通知

实际通知

买方直接了解土地的先前权益

录音通知

表明先前对土地有兴趣的文件被适当记录在买方的所有权链中

调查通知

买方知道或应当知道会促使有理智的人进行调查的情形(例如,明显使用财产,提及记录票据中未记录的交易)

竞合财产权益的优先权根据该法域的记录法加以评估。根据种族通知法规(如此处所示),善意购买人随后的财产权益优先于先前的财产权益。竞合财产权益,如果英国计划生育局:

在BFP取得他/她的权益并在记录他/她的权益之前的任何时候记录他/她的权益时,没有提前通知他/她的权益.如果证明利息记录正确(即正式土地记录中存档)并在买方所有权链中出现,则买方对先前财产权益有推定通知(即记录通知)。

在此,债权人拥有先前的留置权,因为它先在县土地记录中对债务人作出判决,因此,她在取得该财产的抵押留置权时有关于该债权人先前权益的建设性通知。因此,姨妈不是BFP,债权人享有优先权。

(Choices A & B)判决留置权不一定从属于抵押(inferior),但是,判决留置权从属于购买款抵押(PMM)——一种允许买方购买或改善财产的抵押。在此,该姨妈的抵押权并没有被债务人用来购买或改善土地(不是PMM ) 。 由于债权人在姨妈记录其抵押权之前提交了判决,因此债权人拥有先前的留置权。

(Choice D)购买者(如姨妈)在取得财产权益之前没有义务进行产权查询.但是,未这样做的买方不能声称他/她没有事先通知在买方所有权链中适当记录的财产权益。

学习要点：

在种族通知法域中,如果善意购买人的财产权益未发出该权益通知,而且(2)先予记录,则该权益优先于先前的权益。但是,如果证明该利息的文件被适当记录并出现在买方的所有权链中,BFP对早先的利息有建设性的通知。
