stem:
A man contacted his lawyer regarding his right to use a path that was on his neighbor's vacant land.

Fifteen years ago, after part of a path located on his land and connecting his cabin to the public highway washed out, the man cleared a small part of his neighbor's land and rerouted a section of the path through the neighbor's land.

Twelve years ago, the neighbor leased her land to some hunters. For the next 12 years, the hunters and the man who had rerouted the path used the path for access to the highway.

A month ago, the neighbor discovered that part of the path was on her land. The neighbor told the man that she had not given him permission to cross her land and that she would be closing the rerouted path after 90 days.

The man's land and the neighbor's land have never been in common ownership.

The period of time necessary to acquire rights by prescription in the jurisdiction is 10 years. The period of time necessary to acquire title by adverse possession in the jurisdiction is 10 years.
stemZh:
一名男子联系了他的律师,说他有权使用他邻居空地上的一条道路。

15年前,经过位于他土地上的一条路段和连接他小屋与公共高速公路的路段被冲走后,这名男子清理了邻居的一小部分土地,并改道了一条路段穿过邻居的路段.

12年前,邻居将她的土地租给一些猎人,在接下来的12年里,猎人和重新走过这条路的人利用这条路进入高速公路.

一个月前,邻居发现部分路段在她的土地上,邻居告诉男子她没有允许他穿越她的土地,90天后她就会关闭改道的道路.

人的土地与邻居的土地从未共同拥有.

在法域通过时效取得权利所需的时间为10年,在法域通过逆权占有取得所有权所需的时间为10年。
ask: What should the lawyer tell the man concerning his right to use the rerouted path on the neighbor's land?
askZh: 律师应该怎么告诉那个男人 他有权使用在邻居的土地上经过的路线?

options.en: The man has an easement by necessity to use the path.
options.zh: 此人因必要而有修行之道.

options.en: The man has an easement by prescription to use the path.
options.zh: 男方通过处方获得使用路径的便利.

options.en: The man has fee title by adverse possession of the land included in the path.
options.zh: 此人因不利地占有路径中的土地而拥有收费权。

options.en: The man has no right to use the path.
options.zh: 此人无权用道.

explanation.en:
An easement is a nonpossessory interest in land that gives the easement holder the right to use another's land for a limited purpose (eg, to use the path). One type of easement is an easement by prescription, which is acquired through use that is:

Open and notorious – apparent or visible to a reasonable owner Continuous – uninterrupted for the statutory period Actual – use of the land Nonpermissive – hostile and adverse to the owner (ie, without the owner's permission) Unlike with adverse possession, the use need not be exclusive of the owner or other users—including the owner's tenants (eg, the hunters).

Here, the man cleared a small portion of his neighbor's land and created a path through the land. For 12 years—which exceeds the 10-year statutory period—the man openly and continuously used the path to access the highway. And since he did so without the neighbor's permission, the man acquired an easement by prescription to use the path

(Choice D).

(Choice A) An easement by necessity arises when two parcels of land are separated from common ownership (not seen here), making it absolutely necessary for the owner of one parcel to cross the other parcel to access the land.

(Choice C) To acquire title by adverse possession, a person must have exclusive possession of the land—mere use is not enough.

Educational objective:

To acquire an easement by prescription, a person must use another's land in a way that is (1) open and notorious, (2) continuous, (3) actual, and (4) nonpermissive.

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes §§ 2.16–2.17 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (easement by prescription).

地役权是给予地役权持有人使用权的非占有性土地权益。另一块土地用于有限的用途(例如,使用路径)。一种劳役方式是通过处方获得的劳役,即:

公开和臭名昭著,对合理拥有者来说是显而易见的,在法定期限内是不间断的 实际使用土地 不容许,对拥有者是敌意和不利的(即未经拥有者许可)。不排斥所有者或其他使用者——包括所有者租户(如猎人).

这名男子清理了邻居的一小部分土地,并开辟了一条穿过土地的道路。 12年来——这超过了10年的法定期限——他公开和不断地使用这条道路进入高速公路。由于他这样做没有邻居的许可, 男子通过处方获得了地役权 使用路径

(中文(简体) ).

(Choice A) 当两块土地与共同所有权分离(此处不见)时,必然会产生地役权,因此,一个土地的所有人绝对有必要跨越另一块土地进入该土地。

(选择C)为了通过不利的占有方式获得所有权,一个人必须拥有土地的专属所有权——仅仅使用是不够的。

学习要点：

为了通过处方获得地役权,一个人必须使用他人的土地,其方式是:(1) 开放和臭名昭著,(2) 持续,(3) 实际,(4) 不容许。

stem:
A building with 40 residential units is owned by a corporation and operated as a cooperative. Each resident is a shareholder in the corporation as well as its tenant pursuant to a lease that is subject to the mortgage on the building. Each tenant is assessed an annual fee to cover part of the corporation's taxes, maintenance expenses, and mortgage obligation. Through poor management by the corporation's board of directors, the corporation failed to raise sufficient funds to pay the mortgage obligation. The bank that holds the mortgage on the building has begun foreclosure proceedings. A resident of the building who paid the annual assessment fee and is not a member of the board of directors has sought a declaratory judgment that a buyer at the foreclosure sale takes the building subject to her lease.

The applicable jurisdiction has not adopted a statute that addresses this situation.
stemZh:
拥有40个住宅单元的建筑物为公司所有,作为合作社经营,每个居民都是公司股东及其承租人,根据对建筑物抵押的租约。每个租户每年要缴纳一笔费用,以支付公司的部分税收、维持费和抵押债务。由于该公司董事会管理不善,该公司未能筹集到足够的资金来支付抵押债务,持有该建筑物抵押贷款的银行已经开始了赎回程序。支付年度评估费且不是董事会成员的大楼居民要求作出宣告性判决,宣布赎回权销售的买方将大楼租给其。

适用法域尚未通过处理这种情况的法规。
ask: How should the court rule?
askZh: 朝廷该如何裁决?

options.en: Against the resident, because she is personally liable for the mortgage obligation as a shareholder of the corporation.
options.zh: 对居民不利,因为她作为公司的股东对抵押义务负有个人责任。

options.en: Against the resident, because the lease is subject to the mortgage on the building.
options.zh: 对居民,因为租赁须按下列条件抵押:大楼。

options.en: For the resident, because she is not a member of the corporation's board of directors.
options.zh: 对居民来说,因为她不是公司董事会成员。

options.en: For the resident, because she paid her annual assessment fee.
options.zh: 对居民来说,因为她支付了年度评估费。

explanation.en:
Main types of common-interest communities

Property owners' association

Property owners must, as consequence of property ownership, belong to association & pay dues to it or Property owners in real-estate development must pay for use/maintenance of property held in common by individual owners, but association membership is optional Condominium Created by state statutes by filing declaration (or master deed) & plat with recording office in condominium's locality Declaration & bylaws set out rights & obligations of unit owners & fix shares for allocating expenses, taxes, voting rights Each owner is responsible for his/her own mortgage Cooperative Typically consists of land & one or more buildings owned by corporation that leases individual residential units to shareholders Resident is tenant who also owns one or more shares of stock in corporation & is prohibited from transferring interest separately from lease Cooperative has blanket mortgage A cooperative is a common-interest community that typically consists of land and one or more buildings owned by a corporation that leases individual residential units to its shareholders. Unlike a condominium, in which each unit owner is responsible for his/her own mortgage, a cooperative has a blanket mortgage that generally has priority over occupancy leases.

Since the leases are subject to the mortgage on the cooperative, a default on the blanket mortgage can result in foreclosure proceedings on the property, which in turn can terminate all leases. Therefore, the buyer at a foreclosure sale will not take the building subject to a resident's lease.

(Choice A) A shareholder in a cooperative is not personally liable for the cooperative's debts.

(Choice C) Members of a corporation's board of directors may incur liability for the board's poor management of the corporation.* However, this does not prevent the resident from suffering the consequences of the corporation's default on its mortgage obligation.

*However, many courts apply the business-judgment rule to insulate a director or an officer from liability for an honest but mistaken business decision.

(Choice D) Although the resident has paid her annual assessment fee, which includes her share of the mortgage obligation on the building, she can nevertheless lose her right to occupy her residential unit if the bank forecloses on that mortgage.

Educational objective:

Unlike a condominium, in which each unit owner is responsible for his/her own mortgage, a cooperative has a blanket mortgage that generally has priority over occupancy leases. A default on that mortgage can therefore result in foreclosure proceedings on the property, which in turn can terminate all leases.

explanation.zh:
主要类型的共同利益社区

财产所有人协会

财产所有者由于财产所有权,必须属于协会并支付应付款,房地产开发中的财产所有者必须支付个人所有者共同持有的财产的使用/维修费用,但协会成员资格是可选的。根据州法规通过备案声明(或主契约)和带有记录的标语创建共有办公场所的《地方宣言》和《细则》规定了单位所有人的权利和义务。分配开支、税收、表决权的固定份额合作社通常由将个人住宅单元出租给股东的公司拥有的土地和一栋或多栋建筑物组成 居民是租户,他们也拥有公司中的一股或多股股票,被禁止合作社有毛毯合作社是一个共同利益群体,通常由下列组成:个人租赁公司拥有的土地和一座或多座建筑物住房单位支付给股东。与每个单位所有者负责自己抵押的共有制不同,合作社拥有一揽子抵押,一般优先于占有租赁。

由于租赁须服从合作社的抵押,对一揽子抵押的违约可能导致财产的赎回程序,而这种程序又可以终止所有租赁。因此,在取消赎回权的销售中,买方将不按照居民的租约收回该建筑物。

(A组选择) 合作社的股东对合作社的债务不负个人责任.

(C) 公司董事会成员可能因董事会对公司管理不善而承担责任。 * 但是,这并不阻止居民因公司违约而承受抵押义务的后果。

* 然而,许多法院适用商业判断规则,使董事或官员免于对诚实但错误的商业决定承担责任。

(Choice D)虽然该居民已缴纳了年度评估费,包括她在该建筑物的抵押义务中的份额,但如果银行取消其抵押贷款,她仍可丧失占有住宅单元的权利。

学习要点：

与每个单位所有者负责自己抵押的共有制不同,合作社拥有一揽子抵押,一般优先于占有租赁。因此,不履行抵押权可导致对该财产的取消赎回权程序,从而终止所有租赁。

stem: A rancher whose land borders a stream used it to water his livestock. The owner of a small waterpark, in existence before the ranch, was located upstream of the rancher's land. The water park required a significant amount of water in order to function properly, so the owner diverted almost all of the stream water into the water park. No longer able to adequately water his livestock from the stream, the rancher filed an action against the owner.
stemZh: 一个土地与河水相接的牧场主利用河水灌溉他的牲畜,在牧场之前就已存在的一个小水公园的主人位于牧场主土地的上游。水上公园需要大量水才能正常运转,所以业主将几乎所有的溪流水分流到水上公园.牧场主已经无法从溪流中充分灌溉他的牲畜,因此对业主提起诉讼。
ask: In a jurisdiction that recognizes the riparian doctrine with regard to water usage, who will prevail?
askZh: 在承认关于用水的河岸学说的情况下,谁将占上风?

options.en: The owner, because he made reasonable use of the water.
options.zh: 主人,因为他合理使用水。

options.en: The owner, because his use of water has priority as he was on the land first.
options.zh: 主人,因为他的用水是优先的,因为他先在土地上。

options.en: The rancher, because he made beneficial use of the water.
options.zh: 牧场主,因为他利用了水

options.en: The rancher, because the owner's commercial use of the water unreasonably interfered with the rancher's domestic use.
options.zh: 牧场主,因为水主的商业使用不合理地干扰了牧场主的家庭使用.

explanation.en:
Water rights doctrines

Riparian doctrine

(eastern states)

Water belongs to owners of adjoining land Reasonable use that does not unreasonably interfere with downstream use permitted (reasonable-use doctrine) Domestic use trumps commercial use Water rights cannot be sold or transferred separate from adjoining land Prior-appropriation doctrine

(western states)

Water rights determined by priority of beneficial use ("first in time, first in right") Water rights are unconnected to adjoining land & can be sold or transferred separately Water rights have evolved differently in eastern states (where water is plentiful) and western states (where water is scarce). Eastern states favor the riparian doctrine, where water rights belong to riparians—ie, those who own the land that borders the watercourse. A riparian is generally free to make any reasonable use of the water that does not unreasonably interfere with downstream use.* However, domestic ("natural") use trumps commercial ("artificial") use and can be unlimited.

Here, the rancher used the stream to water his livestock (domestic use), while the owner used it to run his water park (commercial use). The owner's use of the water was likely unreasonable since he diverted so much of it into the water park that the rancher was no longer able to adequately water his livestock (Choice A). And since domestic use of water trumps commercial use in this riparian jurisdiction, the rancher is likely to prevail.

*This is known as the reasonable-use doctrine.

(Choices B & C) Western states follow the prior-appropriation doctrine (not applicable here), under which water rights are determined by the "first in time, first in right" rule. This gives the first person who uses or diverts water for a beneficial purpose (ie, agricultural, industrial, household) priority to use the water.

Educational objective:

Under the riparian doctrine (favored in eastern states), water rights belong to the owners of the land that borders the watercourse (ie, riparians). A riparian may make any reasonable use of water that does not unreasonably interfere with downstream use, and domestic ("natural") use of water trumps the commercial ("artificial") use of it.

References

78 Am. Jur. 2d Waters §§ 35, 37 (2020) (riparian rights generally and requirement for reasonable use).

explanation.zh:
水权理论

里尔主义

(东部各州)

水属于邻接土地所有者,合理使用不会不合理地干扰下游许可使用(合理使用原则) 家庭使用胜过商业使用 水权不能与邻接土地分开出售或转让先前占有原则

(西部各州)

水权由收益使用优先权决定("时间第一,权利第一") 水权与邻接土地不相连,可以分别出售或转让 水权在东部各州(其中水量充沛)和西部各有不同演变东部各州赞成河岸原则,因为河岸水权属于河岸人,即那些拥有与水道接壤的土地的人。河岸人一般可以自由使用不无道理的水。* 然而,国内("自然")使用超过商业("人工")使用并且可以是无限的。

在这里,牧场主利用溪流来浇灌他的牲畜(家庭用途),而业主则利用溪流来经营他的水上公园(商业用途).水主对水的使用可能不合理,因为他将水的很多分流到水上公园,以至于牧场主再也无法充分给自己的牲畜供水(Choice A).由于在河岸管辖区,家庭用水胜过商业用水,牧场主很可能占上风。

* 这被称为合理使用理论。

(Choices B & C) 西方国家遵循先前的占有原则(此处不适用),根据此原则,水权由"时间第一,权利第一"的规则决定.这使得首先使用或分流水用于有利目的(即农业、工业、家庭)的人优先使用水。

学习要点：

根据河岸学说(东部各州赞成),水权属于与水道接壤的土地(即河岸)的所有人.河岸人可以合理使用不会不合理地干预下游用水,家庭("自然")用水胜过商业("人工")用水.

参考资料

78 Am. Jur. 2d Waters & 35, 37 (2020年)(马里人的一般权利和合理使用的要求)。

stem:
A man owned a large tract of land that had frontage on a public highway. The land had no access to any other road.

Fifteen years ago, the man conveyed the rear half of the land to a woman and at the same time conveyed an express easement to the woman that provided access from her land across his retained land to the public highway.

The woman used the easement until she reconveyed the land back to the man 10 years ago. The deed to the man made no reference to the easement.

Five years ago, the man again conveyed the rear half of the land, this time to an investor in a deed that made no reference to any easement to the public highway.

Recently, the man told the investor that he could no longer cross the man's land for access to the public highway. A neighbor has told the investor that he can use her land for access to another public road "for a price."

The investor has sued the man for the right to cross the man's land to the public highway.
stemZh:
一个人拥有大片土地,在一条公共公路上有前台,没有其他道路。

15年前,这名男子将土地的后半部分转给一名妇女,同时向该妇女传达了明确的地役权,该妇女从她的土地进入了公共公路。

女方使用地役权,直到10年前重新将土地归还给男方,对男方的契约没有提到地役权.

五年前,这名男子再次将土地的后半部分传达给投资者,这次是在一份契约中没有提到任何对公共高速公路的升降权.

最近,这名男子告诉投资者,他不能再穿越他的土地进入公共公路。 一位邻居告诉投资者,他可以使用她的土地进入另一条公共道路“以换取价格 ” 。

投资方已起诉该男子,要求其有权穿越该男子的土地前往公共高速公路.
ask: For whom will the court likely decide?
askZh: 对于谁,法院可能决定?

options.en: The investor, because an easement will be implied.
options.zh: 投资人,因为将隐含地役权.

options.en: The investor, because the man is estopped by his grant of an easement to the woman.
options.zh: 投资人,因为男方因给予女方地役权而被阻止.

options.en: The man, because the express easement was terminated by the reconveyance.
options.zh: 这个人,因为直接的地役权被改造者终止了.

options.en: The man, because the investor can reasonably acquire another means of access to a public road.
options.zh: 这个人,因为投资人可以合理地获得进入公共道路的另一种途径。

explanation.en:
The man conveyed an easement to the woman that allowed her to cross his land to access a public highway. That easement terminated when the dominant estate (woman's tract) and servient estate (man's tract) merged into the hands of one owner after the woman conveyed her tract back to the man (Choices B & C). And though the man subsequently conveyed the rear half of his lot to the investor, a terminated easement is not re-created merely by re-severing the land into two parcels.

Additionally, the investor did not receive an easement by express grant because his deed made no reference to any easement to the public highway. But an easement by necessity will be implied if two elements are met:

Severance of common ownership – the dominant and servient estates were a single tract of land, and the owner retained part of the tract and conveyed the rest to another

Strict necessity – the easement is absolutely necessary for the use and enjoyment of the land (eg, the dominant tract is landlocked and has no access to a public road)

Here, the man owned both tracts (unity of estates) before he conveyed the back half to the investor (severance). And since the rear tract has no access to a public highway or any other road, an easement over the man's tract is absolutely necessary for the investor to use and enjoy his tract. Therefore, an easement will be implied and the court will likely decide for the investor.

(Choice D) The ability to create alternative access to a landlocked parcel by purchase of an easement over a neighbor's land does not defeat the creation of an easement by necessity.

Educational objective:

An easement by necessity is implied if (1) there was a unity of estates, (2) common ownership was severed, and (3) an easement is absolutely necessary to use and enjoy the land.

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 2.15 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (easement by necessity).

Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 7.5 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (termination of easement by merger).

explanation.zh:
男方向女方传达了一条地役权,允许女方通过自己的土地进入公共公路,但当女方将占支配地位的庄园(女方的庄园)和奴方的庄园(男方的庄园)合并到女方手中后,地役权就终止了。带回男人(Choices B & C),虽然他后来把后半身的地盘转移了对投资者来说,终止的地役权不能仅仅通过将土地重新分成两块来重新形成。

此外,投资人没有通过直接赠款获得地役权,因为他的地役权没有提到公共公路的任何地役权。 但是,如果满足两个因素,则必然意味着地役权:

共同所有权的严格性 -- -- 占支配地位和占有地位的庄园是单一土地,所有者保留了部分土地,并将其余土地转给另一土地。

严格必要性——地役权对于土地的使用和享用是绝对必要的(例如,占支配地位的路段是内陆的,没有公共道路)

在这里,此人在将后半部分(severance)传达给投资者之前,拥有两条道(财产的统一).而由于后方的路段无法进入公共高速公路或任何其他道路,因此在人行道上方的地役权对于投资者使用和享受他的地役权是绝对必要的。 因此,地役权将隐含在其中,而法院则有可能为投资者作出裁决。

(Choice D)通过在邻居的土地上购买地役权来创造对地役权的替代通道的能力不会因为必要而挫败地役权的产生.

学习要点：

如果(1) 财产统一,(2) 共同所有权被切断,以及(3) 使用和享用土地绝对需要地役权,则隐含必要性的地役权。

参考资料

财产的重述(第三):第2.15节(《2000年美国法律》)(按必要性出租)。

重述(第三)财产:Servitudes § 7.5(Am.Law Inst. 2000)(通过合并终止地役)。

stem:
Last year, a buyer and a seller entered into a valid contract for the sale of a parcel of real property. The contract contained no contingencies. The seller was killed in a car accident before the parcel was conveyed, but the closing eventually took place with the conveyance by a deed from the personal representative of the seller's estate.

The personal representative of the seller's estate wants to distribute the proceeds of the real property sale. The seller's will was executed many years ago and was duly admitted to probate. Paragraph 5 of his will leaves all of the seller's real property to his son, and Paragraph 6 leaves the residue of the estate to the seller's daughter. No other provisions of the will are pertinent to the question regarding to whom the proceeds of the sale should be distributed.
stemZh:
去年,买方和卖方订立了出售一包裹不动产的有效合同,合同中没有意外情况。卖方在包裹发送前死于车祸,但最终关闭卖方财产的个人代表签发了契约,以转让方式进行。

出卖人产业的个人代表要分配房地产销售所得,出卖人遗嘱多年前就已经执行,并正式承认了遗嘱.遗嘱第5款将卖方的所有不动产留给儿子,第6款将遗产的残余留给卖方的女儿。遗嘱中没有任何其他规定涉及销售收益应分配给谁的问题。
ask: What will determine who receives the proceeds?
askZh: 如何确定谁收到收益?

options.en: Whether Paragraph 5 refers specifically to the parcel of real property that was sold or simply to "all of my real property."
options.zh: 第5款是否具体提及被出售的不动产包裹,还是仅提及"我的全部不动产".

options.en: Whether the closing date originally specified in the contract was a date before or after the seller's death.
options.zh: 合同中原先规定的关闭日期是卖方死亡之前还是之后的日期。

options.en: Whether the jurisdiction has adopted the doctrine of equitable conversion.
options.zh: 管辖权是否采纳了公平转换原则。

options.en: Whether the sale was completed in accordance with a court order.
options.zh: 销售是否按照法院命令完成。

explanation.en:
The doctrine of equitable conversion controls the ownership and risk of loss of real property during the executory period. Under this doctrine, the buyer receives equitable title to the property once the parties enter a specifically enforceable land-sales contract (eg, one with no contingencies). In contrast, the seller retains legal title to the property and acquires the equitable right to receive the purchase price upon closing.

The buyer's equitable title is treated as a real property interest that is freely alienable, subject to the seller's equitable right to the purchase price. In contrast, the seller's right to the sale proceeds is treated as a personal property interest. Therefore, when the seller in this case died before closing, the doctrine of equitable conversion gave the right to the sale proceeds to his daughter, the beneficiary of his residuary estate.

(Choice A) Whether Paragraph 5 refers specifically to the parcel sold or simply to "all of my real property" is of no consequence since the seller's interest in the sale proceeds is a personal property (not real property) interest. The son had only a legal interest in the parcel that transferred to the buyer upon closing.

(Choice B) The sale proceeds would have passed to the daughter regardless of whether the closing date was scheduled before or after the seller's death.

(Choice D) The right to the sale proceeds depends on who had equitable title to the proceeds—not on the manner in which the sale was completed.

Educational objective:

Under the doctrine of equitable conversion, the buyer acquires equitable title to the property (real property interest) and the seller acquires an equitable right to the sale proceeds (personal property interest). These interests will be distributed accordingly if either party dies before closing.

References

27A Am. Jur. 2d Equitable Conversion § 13 (2020) (equitable conversion of interests under land-sale contract).

explanation.zh:
公平转换原则控制在执行期内不动产的所有权和损失风险。根据这一理论,一旦双方当事人订立一项具体可执行的土地销售合同(例如,一份无意外情况的合同),买受人就获得对财产的公平所有权。相比之下,出卖人保留对该财产的合法所有权,并在关闭时获得收取购买价款的公平权利。

买方的公平所有权被视为可自由转让的不动产权益,但以卖方对购买价款的公平权利为限,而卖方对出售所得的权利则被视为个人财产权益。因此,当本案的卖方在结案前死亡时,公平转换原则将出售收益的权利赋予他的女儿,即他剩余财产的受益人。

(Choice A)第5款是否具体提及已售的包裹,还是仅提及"我的全部不动产"并无任何后果,因为出卖人对出售所得权益是个人财产(而非不动产)权益.儿子在该包裹中只有合法权益,该包裹在关闭时转让给买方。

(Choice B)无论关闭日期是安排在卖方死亡之前还是之后,出售所得收益都会转给女儿。

(选择D) 出售收益权取决于谁对收益拥有公平所有权,而不是取决于完成出售的方式。

学习要点：

根据公平转换原则,买受人取得对财产的公平所有权(不动产权益),出卖人取得对出售收益的公平权利(个人财产权益)。如果任何一方在关闭前死亡,这些利益将相应分配。

参考资料

27A Am. Jur. 2d 公平转换§13(2020年)(根据土地销售合同公平转换权益)。

stem:
A man owned 80 acres of land, fronting on a town road. Two years ago, the man sold the back 40 acres to his cousin. The 40 acres sold to the cousin did not adjoin any public road. The man's deed to the cousin expressly granted a right-of-way over a specified strip of the man's retained 40 acres, so the cousin could reach the town road. The deed was promptly and properly recorded.

Last year, the cousin conveyed the back 40 acres to his friend. They had discussed the right-of-way over the man's land to the road, but the cousin's deed to the friend made no mention

of it. The friend began to use the right-of-way as the cousin had, but the man sued to enjoin such use by the friend.
stemZh:
一个人拥有80英亩的土地,前身是一条城镇道路,两年前,他把后面的40英亩卖给他的表弟,卖给表弟的40英亩没有邻接任何公共道路.男方对堂兄的契约明确授予了在男方保留了40英亩的指定条带上的通行权,因此堂弟可以到达镇江路,契约被及时,妥善地记录下来.

去年,堂兄把后方的40英亩土地转交给了朋友,他们讨论过人的土地过路权,但堂弟对朋友的契约却未提及.

朋友开始像表弟一样使用权利,但被告却要求朋友使用权利。
ask: For whom should the court decide?
askZh: 法庭应该为谁做决定?

options.en: The friend, because he has an easement by implication.
options.zh: 那个朋友,因为他有隐含的意思

options.en: The friend, because the easement appurtenant passed to him as a result of the cousin's deed to him.
options.zh: 这个朋友,因为地役权的附庸由于表亲对他的行为而传给了他.

options.en: The man, because the cousin's deed failed expressly to transfer the right-of-way to the friend.

explanation.en:
Distinctions between easements

Type Appurtenant Benefits easement holder's land Benefit & burden automatically transfer when land is conveyed In gross Benefits easement holder personally Burden (not benefit) automatically transfers when land is conveyed Purpose Affirmative Allows easement holder to do something on servient estate

Negative Restricts servient-estate owner's lawful use of servient estate

Creation Express Created by parties in writing that satisfies statute of frauds

Irrevocable license

License becomes irrevocable due to estoppel or coupling with another servitude

Implied Implied by law due to necessity (easement by necessity) Implied by fact due to prior use (easement by implication) By prescription Adversely acquired through OCAN—open/notorious, actual, continuous & nonpermissive use An easement appurtenant is an easement that benefits a parcel of land (dominant estate) by allowing the easement holder to use or control another parcel of land (servient estate) in a limited way. One common example is a right-of-way over the servient estate that provides access to the dominant estate. This type of easement is attached to the land, so subsequent owners of both estates are bound by the easement.*

Here, the man conveyed the back 40 acres to the cousin, along with an express right-of-way that allowed the cousin to cross the man's land to access the town road. Since that easement appurtenant is attached to the land, it passed to the friend when the cousin conveyed the back 40 acres to the friend—even though the deed did not expressly transfer the easement to the friend (Choice C). Therefore, the court should decide for the friend.

*However, an easement will not bind subsequent owners of the servient estate who take without actual, record, or inquiry notice of the easement.

(Choice A) An easement by implication will be created by law only if it is necessary for the use and enjoyment of property—eg, if the property cannot be accessed from a public road or existing easement. Here, an easement need not be implied because the friend has an easement appurtenant that provides access to the road.

(Choice D) Unlike an easement appurtenant (as seen here), an easement in gross benefits the easement holder personally but does not benefit a parcel of land (ie, has no dominant estate).

Educational objective:

An easement appurtenant benefits one parcel of land (dominant estate) by allowing the easement holder to use or control another parcel of land (servient estate) in a limited way. This type of easement is attached to the land, so subsequent owners of both the dominant and servient estates are bound by the easement.

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 1.5 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (defining appurtenant and in gross).

地役权之间的区别

租赁收益类型 租赁持有人的土地 收益和负担在土地时自动转移在总福利担保持有人中个人负担( 不受益) 自动平权允许地役权持有人做点什么

消极限制伺服器 - 州所有者合法使用伺服器产业

不可撤销许可证

由于不容反悔或与另一种奴役结合,许可证不可撤销

法律由于必要性(必要性的缓解)而受到阻碍 事实由于事先使用(默示的缓解)受到阻碍 通过OCAN恶意获取的处方 -- -- 开放/著名、实际、持续和不许可的使用 一种地役权附属物是一种地役权通过允许地役权持有人有限地使用或控制另一块土地(附属地),使一块土地(主要地产)受益。 一个常见的例子是对占有支配地位的地产的通行权。这种类型的地役权附属于土地,因此后两者的地役权所有者都受地役权的约束。

在这里,这名男子将后方的40英亩土地转交给了表亲,同时还有一条快速的右转通道,让表亲穿过男子的土地进入镇上的道路.由于地上附着了地役权,所以当堂兄将后方的40英亩地役权交给了朋友时,它就交给了朋友,尽管地役权并未明确转让给朋友(Choice C)。因此,法院应该为朋友做出决定。

* 然而,地役权将不约束占有地役权的后继所有人,而无需对地役权进行实际的、记录的或查询通知。

(选择A) 只有为了使用和享有财产,例如,如果财产无法从公共道路或现有地役权进入,法律才会通过暗示来规定地役权。在此,无需隐含地役权,因为朋友有地役权附属物,可提供道路通行.

(Choice D) 与地役权附属物(如这里所见)不同,地役权持有人个人在毛利益上的地役权附属物(e,没有占支配地位的地产),但并不给一块土地带来利益.

学习要点：

地役权附属地通过允许地役权持有人有限地使用或控制另一块土地(地役权附属地),使一块土地(占地产)受益。这种类型的地役权附属于土地,因此后来的占支配地位的和占优势的庄园的主人都受地役权的约束.

参考资料

stem:
A rancher owned in fee simple two adjoining lots, Lots 1 and 2. He conveyed Lot 1 in fee simple to his cousin. The deed was in usual form of a warranty deed with the following provision inserted in the appropriate place: "Grantor, for himself, his heirs and assigns, does covenant and agree that any reasonable expense incurred by grantee, his heirs and assigns, as the result of having to repair the retaining wall presently situated on Lot 1 at the common boundary with Lot 2, shall be reimbursed one-half the costs of repairs; and by this provision the parties intend a covenant running with the land."

The cousin conveyed Lot 1 in fee simple to a woman by warranty deed in usual and regular form. The deed omitted any reference to the retaining wall or any covenant. Fifty years after the rancher's conveyance to the cousin, the woman conveyed Lot 1 in fee simple to a developer by warranty deed in usual form. This deed omitted any reference to the retaining wall or the covenant.

There is no statute that applies to any aspect of the problems presented except a recording act and a statute providing for acquisition of title after 10 years of adverse possession. The deed from the rancher to the cousin was never recorded. All other deeds were promptly and properly recorded.

Lot 2 is now owned by the rancher's daughter, who took by intestate succession. The developer expended $3,500 on the retaining wall. Then he obtained all the original deeds in the chain of title from the rancher to himself. Shortly thereafter, the developer discovered the covenant in the rancher's deed to the cousin. The developer demanded that the daughter pay $1,750. When she refused, he instituted an appropriate action to recover that sum.
stemZh:
一名农场主拥有两个简单的附属地块,即Lots 1和2,他将Lots 1以简单的收费方式交给了他的表弟。"格伦托尔本人,他的继承人和被转让人,签订契约并商定,受赠人、他的继承人和被转让人因必须修复目前在Lot 1与Lot 2共同边界上的保留墙而支付的任何合理费用,应为:补偿了一半的修理费用;根据这项规定,双方打算与土地签订契约。”

该堂兄弟通过通常和正规形式的担保契约,将1号地块简单地交给妇女,该契约没有提及保留墙壁或任何契约。在牧场主给堂兄弟送货50年后,该妇女通过普通形式的担保契约向开发商简单地支付了1号地块的费用,该地块没有提到保留墙壁或契约。

除了记录法和规定在10年的逆权占有之后取得所有权的法规外,没有任何法规适用于所提出的问题的任何方面,牧场主对堂兄弟的契约从未记录过。所有其他行动都得到及时和适当的记录。

2号地块现在归牧场主的女儿所有,她继承了没有遗嘱的地块。开发商在保留墙上花费了3,500美元。然后他从牧场主手中获得了所有权链中的所有原始地契。此后不久,开发商在牧场主对堂兄弟的契约中发现了契约,开发商要求女儿支付1,750美元,当她拒绝时,他提起了适当的诉讼以收回这笔金额.
ask: If judgment is for the daughter, what will be the likely reason?
askZh: 如果判决是给女儿的 那可能是什么原因?

options.en: The cousin's deed from the rancher was never recorded.
options.zh: 牧场主的堂兄弟的契约从未被记录.

options.en: The developer did not know about the covenant until after he had incurred the expenses and, hence, could not have relied on it.
options.zh: 开发商在支付这笔费用之后才知道该契约,因此不可能依赖该契约。

options.en: The developer is barred by adverse possession.
options.zh: 开发者因持有不良而被禁止.

options.en: The developer's expenditures were not proved to be reasonable and customary.
options.zh: 开发商的支出没有被证明是合理和习惯的.

explanation.en:
A real covenant is an express promise regarding land that is enforceable by an action for money damages. Although the promising parties can enforce the covenant under contract law, the covenant can only bind successors in interest if the benefit/burden runs with the land. This requires proof of the following elements:

Writing – covenant is in a writing that satisfies the statute of frauds (eg, Lot 1 deed to the cousin)

Intent to run – promising parties intended for the covenant to run to their successors in interest (eg, deed says "heirs and assigns" and "running with the land")

Touch and concern – covenant relates to the use, enjoyment, or occupation of the benefited and burdened lands (eg, shared enjoyment of retaining wall)

Horizontal privity – promising parties simultaneously transferred the land and created the covenant (eg, covenant was created when Lot 1 was deeded to the cousin)

Vertical privity – successor of the benefited estate has a possessory interest (eg, developer owns Lot 1) and successor of the burdened estate has a promising party's entire estate or ownership interest (eg, daughter has rancher's fee simple in Lot 2)

Notice – person to be bound had notice of the covenant if he/she purchased the property (eg, daughter inherited Lot 2, so it is irrelevant that the cousin's deed was never recorded)

(Choice A)

Therefore, the daughter is bound by the covenant to pay reasonable expenses for the repairs. Judgment would likely be entered for the daughter if the developer's expenditures were not proved to be reasonable and customary.

(Choice B) Notice is not a requirement for successors in interest of land benefited by a real covenant (eg, the developer) to enforce it.

(Choice C) Persons who acquire land subject to a real covenant through adverse possession cannot enforce the covenant. But the developer acquired Lot 1 by deed—not through adverse possession.

Educational objective:

A real covenant will only bind successors in interest if the following elements are met: (1) writing, (2) intent to run, (3) touch and concern, (4) horizontal privity, (5) vertical privity, and (6) notice.

References

Restatement of Property §§ 530–38 (Am. Law Inst. 1944) (elements of real covenants).

explanation.zh:
真正的契约是土地方面的明确承诺,可以通过金钱损害诉讼予以执行。 尽管有希望的各方可以根据合同法执行契约,但契约只有在收益/负担与契约相关的情况下才能对利益继承人具有约束力。这需要证明下列因素:

写作 – 契约是符合防止欺诈法的写作(例如,给表亲的一号地契)

有意经营 – 承诺的政党打算以利益为目的竞选他们的继任者(例如,契约上写着"坚持和分配"和"与土地共奔").

接触和关切 -- -- 有关使用、享有或占领受益和负担沉重的土地的公约(例如,共享保留墙)

横向棱镜 — 有希望的各方同时转让土地并创建了契约(例如,当第1批土地被转让给表兄妹时,契约就是创建的)

纵向审慎 — 受益破产财产的继承人拥有占有性权益(例如,开发人拥有Lot 1),而负担沉重的破产财产的继承人则拥有有希望的一方的全部产业或所有权权益(例如,女儿拥有Lot 2中的牧场主收费简单)

通知——如果被约束的人购买了财产(例如女儿继承了Lot 2),他/她就会收到契约通知,因此表弟的契约从未被记录,这一点无关紧要.

(选择A)

因此,女儿受该契约的约束,必须支付合理的修理费用,如果证明开发者的开支不合理和惯常,则有可能为女儿作出判决。

(Choice B) 通知不是要求从实际契约中受益的土地(如开发商)的继承人强制执行通知。

(C) 通过不利地占有获得受实际契约约束的土地的人不能执行契约。 但开发商通过契约而不是通过不利地占有获得Lot 1。

学习要点：

真正的契约只有在满足下列要素的情况下才能约束利益上的继承人:(1) 书面,(2) 运行的意图,(3) 触摸和关注,(4) 横向的审慎,(5) 纵向的审慎,(6) 通知。

参考资料

重述财产第530-38条(1944年法律)(实际盟约要点)。

stem:
A seller owned a lot improved with an aging four-story warehouse. The warehouse was built to the lot lines on all four sides. On the street side, recessed loading docks permitted semi-trailers to be backed in. After the tractors were unhooked, the trailers extended into the street and occupied most of one lane of the street. Over the years, as the trailers became larger, the blocking of the street became more severe. The municipality advised the seller that the loading docks could not continue to be used because the trailers blocked the street; it gave the seller 90 days to cease and desist.

During the 90 days, the seller sold and conveyed the lot by warranty deed for a substantial consideration to a buyer. The problem of the loading docks was not discussed in the negotiations.

Upon expiration of the 90 days, the municipality required the buyer to stop using the loading docks. This action substantially reduced the value of the lot.
stemZh:
一个卖家拥有一个老旧的四层仓库,得到了很大的改善。 仓库建在四边的批量线路上。 在街上,停靠的装卸码头允许半拖车进入。拖拉机脱钩后,拖车延伸至街道内,占用街道一车道的大部分路段,多年来,随着拖车规模的扩大,对街道的封锁变得更加严重.市政府告知卖方,由于拖车挡住街道,装卸码头无法继续使用;它给卖方90天时间停运。

在90天内,卖方以保修契约方式将批量出售并转交买方,以便给予实质性考虑,在谈判中没有讨论装载码头的问题。

90天期满后,市政府要求买方停止使用装载码头,这一行动大大降低了货款的价值。
ask: If the buyer seeks cancellation of the deed and return of all monies paid, which claim should the buyer bring against the seller?
askZh: 如果买方要求取消契约并退还所有已付款项,买方应向卖方提出哪项要求?

options.en: Breach of the covenant of warranty.
options.zh: 违反保修约.

options.en: Failure of consideration.
options.zh: 考虑失败。

options.en: Misrepresentation.
options.zh: 说法不当.

options.en: Mutual mistake.
options.zh: 互相错误

explanation.en:
When disclosure is required to avoid misrepresentation

Previous assertion Disclosure would prevent previous assertion from being a misrepresentation or fraudulent or material Mistake about basic assumption

Disclosure would correct other party's mistake about basic assumption of contract AND

Failure to disclose would constitute lack of good faith & fair dealing Fiduciary relationship Other party is entitled to know fact because of confidential/fiduciary relationship Mistake about writing Disclosure would correct other party's mistake about contents or effect of writing that embodies agreement A misrepresentation is an untrue assertion of fact that makes a contract voidable by the adversely affected party when:

the misrepresentation is fraudulent OR material the misrepresentation induced assent to the contract and the adversely affected party justifiably relied on the misrepresentation. Nondisclosure of a known fact is tantamount to an assertion that it does not exist if, among other things, the party not disclosing the fact knows that:

disclosure would correct the other party's mistake about a basic assumption of the contract and the failure to disclose would violate the duty of good faith and fair dealing. Here, the seller misrepresented that the loading docks could continue to be used (basic assumption of the contract) by failing to disclose to the buyer that this was untrue (lack of good faith and fair dealing). As a result of this misrepresentation, the buyer purchased the lot. And because the misrepresentation was not obviously false or known by the buyer to be false, the buyer justifiably relied on it. Therefore, misrepresentation is the claim the buyer should bring against the seller.

(Choice A) A covenant of warranty is the seller's promise to protect the buyer against claims of superior title brought by another party (not seen here).

(Choice B) The buyer should not claim failure of consideration because the buyer's agreement with the seller was supported by consideration (ie, conveyance of the lot in exchange for the purchase price).

(Choice D) There was no mutual mistake that would make the contract voidable here because only one party, the buyer, was mistaken about the use of loading docks.

Educational objective:

Nondisclosure of a known fact is tantamount to an assertion that it does not exist if the party not disclosing the fact knows that (1) disclosure would correct the other party's mistake about a basic assumption of the contract and (2) the failure to disclose would violate the duty of good faith and fair dealing.

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 161 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when nondisclosure is a misrepresentation).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 164 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when misrepresentation makes a contract voidable).

explanation.zh:
在要求披露以避免虚报时

披露将防止先前的断言是虚报或欺诈或重大的基本假设错误。

披露将纠正另一方当事人对合同的基本假设和

不披露将构成缺乏诚信和公平交易 信托关系 另一方当事人有权了解事实,因为保密/信托关系 错误的书写 披露将纠正另一方当事人对内容的错误或1. 虚假陈述是对事实的不实断言,使受不利影响的当事人在下述情况下可撤销合同:

虚假陈述是欺诈性或重大内容的虚假陈述,导致对合同的同意,而受害方有理由依赖虚假陈述。不披露已知事实等于断言不存在这一事实,如果不披露事实的当事人知道:

披露将纠正另一方当事人对合同基本假设的错误,而不披露将违反诚信和公平交易的义务。在这方面,卖方错误地说,装载码头可以继续使用(合同的基本假设),因为它没有向买方披露这是不真实的(缺乏诚信和公平交易)。由于这种不实的说法,买方购买了这批货物,而且由于不实的说法显然不是虚假的,或被买方所知是虚假的,买方有理由依赖它。因此,虚报是买方应向卖方提出的索赔。

(Choice A)担保契约是卖方承诺保护买方免遭另一方当事人(此处不见)提出的上等所有权主张。

(Choice B)买方不应声称由于买方与卖方的协议得到了考虑的支持(即以批量运输换取购货价款)而未能进行审议。

(Choice D)不存在使合同在此无效的相互错误,因为只有买方一方对装载码头的使用有错误。

学习要点：

不披露已知事实等于断言如果不披露事实的当事人知道(1)披露将纠正另一方当事人对合同基本假设的错误,(2)不披露将不存在违反诚信和公平交易的义务。

参考资料

重述(第二次)合同第161条(1981年《美国法律》)(当不披露是虚假陈述时)。

重述(第二次)合同第164条(1981年《Am.Law Inst.》)(如果错误陈述使得合同可以作废)。

stem: A landowner granted an exclusive easement to a farmer to grow wheat for commercial use on a portion of the landowner's land for a period of 10 years. The easement made no mention of the transferability of the easement. For five years, the farmer grew wheat on the land. In year six of the easement, the farmer apportioned one-half of the easement to a rancher for grazing his cattle and the other half of the easement to a horticulturist for growing sunflowers. Unhappy with this arrangement, the landowner filed an action in court to invalidate the apportionment of the easement that he originally granted to the farmer.
stemZh: 地主给予农民独家的地役权,在十年内在地主部分土地上种植小麦用于商业用途,地役权没有提及地役权的可转让性,五年来,农民在土地上种植小麦.在地役权的第六年,农民将地役权的一半分配给牧场主放牧他的牛,而将地役权的另一半分配给园丁种植向日葵.由于这种安排,土地所有者向法院提起诉讼,要求取消他原先给予农民的地役权分配。
ask: Which of the following is the landowner's strongest argument that the apportionment of the easement is invalid?
askZh: 以下哪一个是地主最强烈的论点,认为地役权分配无效?

options.en: Easements that are for commercial use are not transferable.
options.zh: 用于商业用途的地役权是不可转让的。

options.en: The burden of the easement did not automatically transfer with the land when the easement was transferred by the farmer.
options.zh: 地役权的负担并没有在地役权发生时自动与土地转移.由农民转移。

options.en: The exclusive easement was apportioned without the landowner's consent.
options.zh: 独家地役权未经地主同意进行分配。

options.en: The rancher and the horticulturist did not use the land in the same way as the farmer.
options.zh: 牧场主和园艺家没有像农民一样使用土地.

explanation.en:
Distinctions between easements

Type Appurtenant Benefits easement holder's land Benefit & burden automatically transfer when land is conveyed In gross Benefits easement holder personally Burden (not benefit) automatically transfers when land is conveyed Purpose Affirmative Allows easement holder to do something on servient estate

Negative Restricts servient-estate owner's lawful use of servient estate

Creation Express Created by parties in writing that satisfies statute of frauds

Irrevocable license

License becomes irrevocable due to estoppel or coupling with another servitude

Implied Implied by law due to necessity (easement by necessity) Implied by fact due to prior use (easement by implication) By prescription Adversely acquired through OCAN—open/notorious, actual, continuous & nonpermissive use Easements are either appurtenant (for the benefit of another parcel of land) OR in gross (for the benefit of the easement holder personally—as seen here). Traditionally, the benefit of an easement in gross could not be transferred, but most courts now allow transfer if the easement is for commercial use or if the parties intended it to be transferable. Whether the easement can also be apportioned (ie, divided up) turns on whether it is:

nonexclusive – in which case the easement cannot be divided among multiple transferees or exclusive – in which case the easement generally can be divided among multiple transferees. However, the apportionment of an exclusive easement in gross is subject to the "one stock" rule. Under this rule, the collective use that the transferees can make of the easement is limited to the use that the transferor made of the easement (ie, the transferor's "stock").

Here, the farmer's easement in gross was transferable because it gave him the right to grow wheat for commercial use, and it could be apportioned because it was exclusive to him

(Choice A). Therefore, the landowner's strongest argument that the apportionment is invalid is that the rancher and the horticulturist did not use the land in the same way as the farmer (ie, to grow wheat).

(Choice B) The burden of an easement in gross automatically transfers when the land burdened by the easement (ie, the servient estate) is transferred. But this is irrelevant since the land in question was never transferred.

(Choice C) The servient-estate owner's consent is not required to apportion an exclusive easement.

Educational objective:

When an exclusive easement in gross is apportioned (ie, divided up), the "one stock" rule applies. This rule limits the collective use that the transferees can make of the easement to the use that the transferor made of the easement (ie, the transferor's "stock").

References

Miller v. Lutheran Conference & Camp Ass'n, 200 A. 646, 651–52 (Pa. Super. Ct. 1938) (explaining that the one-stock rule applies to the division of profits or easements in gross).

25 Am. Jur. 2d Easements and Licenses § 79 (transferability of easement in gross).

explanation.zh:
地役权之间的区别

租赁收益类型 租赁持有人的土地 收益和负担在土地时自动转移在总福利担保持有人中个人负担( 不受益) 自动平权允许地役权持有人做点什么

消极限制伺服器 - 州所有者合法使用伺服器产业

由符合防止欺诈法的当事人书面创建的快递

不可撤销许可证

由于不容反悔或与另一种奴役结合,许可证不可撤销

法律因必要性而受限制(根据必要性予以缓解) 因事先使用而受限制(根据暗示予以缓解) 通过OCAN恶意获取的处方 -- -- 开放/名义使用、实际使用、持续使用和不许可使用 -- -- 要么是附属物(对于(一) 从另一块土地得到利益)或(如此处所示,为地役权持有人个人的利益)。传统上,毛额地役权的好处不能转让,但如果地役权是用于商业用途或当事人打算将其转让,大多数法院现在允许转让。是否也可以分配地役权(i, 分割)则取决于是否:

非排他性——在这种情况下,地役权不能分给多个受让人或排他性——在这种情况下,地役权一般可以分给多个受让人。但是,在毛额中排他性地使用地役权的分摊适用"一股"规则. 根据这一规则,受让人可以集体使用的地役权仅限于转让人对地役权的利用(即转让人的集体使用)."股票").

在这里,农民的地役权毛额可以转让,因为它给了他种植小麦用于商业用途的权利,并且可以分配,因为它是专属于他的.

(Choice A.)因此,地主最强烈的认为分配无效的论点是,牧场主和园艺家没有像农民一样使用土地(即种植小麦).

当地役权所负担的土地(即占地权的地产)被转让时,地役权在毛额中自动转让的重担。但因为有关土地从未转让,所以这种负担并不重要。

(CC) 分配排他性地役权地役权人无须征得其同意。

学习要点：

当分摊毛额的专属地役权(i,分割)时,适用"一股"规则,这一规则将受让人可以集体使用的地役权限制在转让者对地役权(i,转让者"股")的利用范围内.

参考资料

Miller v. Lutheran Conference & Camp Ass'n, 200 A.646, 651–52 (Pa. Super. Ct. 1938)(解释一股制规则适用于利润或地役权毛额的划分).

25 Am. Jur. 2d 地役权与许可证§79(地役权转让毛额)。

stem:
A seller owns a 400-acre tract of land with 5,000 feet of frontage on a county highway. The seller and a buyer entered into a written agreement for the sale of a portion of the tract identified only as "a parcel of land, containing not less than 100 acres and having not less than 1,000 feet of frontage on the county highway, whose exact location and dimensions are to be determined by the parties hereto, at a price of $8,000 per acre."

Shortly after the execution of the agreement, the parties met to stake out the parcel of land to be sold, but they could not agree. The disagreement intensified, and the seller repudiated the contract.

The buyer has sued the seller for specific performance. The seller has asserted all available defenses.
stemZh:
卖方拥有一块400英亩土地,在一条县公路上铺设了5 000英尺的路面。 卖方和买方签订了一份书面协议,出售仅被确定为“一块土地,其中包含不少于100英亩,而且没有土地”的部分土地。县高速公路前方不足1000英尺,其具体位置和尺寸由这里的各方确定,每亩8000美元".

协议执行后不久,双方开会将待售的地块划出,但未能达成一致,分歧加剧,卖方放弃了合同。

买方起诉卖方要求具体履约,卖方主张所有可用的抗辩。
ask: Is the buyer entitled to specific performance of the contract?
askZh: 买方是否有权具体履行合同?

options.en: No, because a contract for the sale of real property that requires further agreement on an essential element cannot be specifically enforced.
options.zh: 不,因为要求就某一基本要素达成进一步协议的不动产销售合同不能具体执行。

options.en: No, because the purchase price was not fixed by, nor determinable under, the contract terms.
options.zh: 没有,因为采购价格没有按照合同条款确定,也无法确定。

options.en: Yes, because the contract bound the parties to act in good faith and to agree upon the specific land to be conveyed.
options.zh: 是的,因为合同规定当事人必须本着诚意行事,并商定要转交的具体土地。

options.en: Yes, because the equity powers of the court enable the court to appoint a master, or to take other appropriate action, to identify the land to be conveyed.
options.zh: 是的,因为法院的公平权力使法院能够指定一位主人,或采取其他适当行动,确定要转交的土地。

explanation.en:
Under the statute of frauds, contracts for the sale of land (ie, real estate contracts) are enforceable only if they are in writing, are signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought, and contain all essential terms. Essential terms include:

the identity of the parties words of intent to buy or sell a description of the property and the sales price. Although courts may liberally construe the property-description requirement, the writing must contain some evidence of the specific property to be sold. Here, the writing expressly stated that the parties had yet to agree on what land was to be conveyed. Therefore, the statute of frauds makes the contract unenforceable.

(Choice B) The sales price is also an essential term. It can be listed in gross (eg, at a set price) or determined by the actual quantity of land sold (eg, at a per-acre price). Therefore, the agreement to purchase the land "at a price of $8,000 per acre" satisfies this requirement.

(Choices C & D) The statute of frauds requires that a contract for the sale of land identify the land to be sold. Good faith and equity cannot provide relief for this omission.

Educational objective:

The statute of frauds requires that land-sale contracts contain all essential terms—ie, the identity of the parties, words of intent to buy or sell, a description of the property, and the sales price.

References

73 Am. Jur. 2d Statute of Frauds §§ 289, 305, 325, 329 (2020).

explanation.zh:
根据《防止欺诈法》,出售土地的合同(即房地产合同)只有在书面合同、由寻求执行的当事方签署并载有所有基本条件的情况下才能执行。

当事人的身份买卖财产说明联合国虽然法院可以自由解释财产描述要求,但书面形式必须包含某些有待出售的具体财产的证据。在这方面,该书面文件明确指出,当事方尚未商定应移交哪些土地,因此,防止欺诈法使合同无法执行。

(Choice B)销售价格也是一个必不可少的术语,可以按毛额(如按设定价格)列出,也可以按实际出售土地数量(如按每亩价格)确定.因此,"以每亩8000美元的价格"购买土地的协议满足了这一要求.

(Choices C & D) 防止欺诈法规定,出售土地的合同必须确定出售的土地,诚信和权益不能为这一遗漏提供补救。

学习要点：

防止欺诈法要求土地销售合同必须包含所有基本条件——即当事人的身份、买卖意向书、财产说明和销售价格。

参考资料

73 Am. Jur. 2d 《防止欺诈法》第289、305、325、329(2020年)。

stem:
A contractor retained a tract of 100 acres after he had developed the adjoining 400 acres as a residential subdivision. The contractor had effectively imposed restrictive covenants on each lot in the 400 acres. A buyer offered the contractor a good price for a five-acre tract located in a corner of the retained 100-acre tract far away from the existing 400-acre residential subdivision. The contractor conveyed the five-acre tract to the buyer and imposed the same restrictive covenants on the five-acre tract as he had imposed on the lots in the adjoining 400 acres. The contractor further covenanted that when he sold the remaining 95 acres of the 100-acre tract, he would impose the same restrictive covenants in the deed or deeds for the 95 acres. The contractor's conveyance to the buyer was promptly and properly recorded.

However, shortly thereafter, the contractor conveyed the remaining 95 acres to a real estate developer for $1,000,000 by a deed that made no mention of any restrictive covenants. The real estate developer had no actual knowledge of the restrictive covenants in the buyer's deed. The real estate developer now proposes to build an industrial park that would violate such restrictive covenants if they are applicable.

The recording act of the jurisdiction provides: "No conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value and without notice unless the same be recorded according to law."
stemZh:
一个承包商在开发了毗邻的400英亩作为住宅分区后,保留了100英亩的土地,承包商实际上对400英亩的每个土地实行了限制性契约。买方向承包商提供了五英亩土地的好价钱,该土地位于离现有400英亩住宅分区较远的100英亩土地保留地的一个角落。承包商将五英亩的地块转交给买方,并对五英亩的地块规定了与他对毗邻400英亩的地块规定的相同的限制性契约。承包人进一步约定,当他出售了其余的95英亩的100英亩土地时,他将在95英亩土地的地契或地契中实施同样的限制性契约,并且迅速和适当地记录了承包人向买方的转让。

然而,不久之后,承包商通过一份未提及任何限制性契约的契约,将剩余的95英亩土地以1 000 000美元的价格转给房地产开发商。房地产开发商并不实际了解买方契约中的限制性契约,房地产开发商现在提议建造一个工业园区,如果适用的话,将违反这些限制性契约。

辖区的录制行为规定:"不动产的转让或者抵押,不得对后继购买人进行价值优待,未经通知,除非依法予以记录.
ask: The buyer filed an appropriate action to enforce the restrictive covenants against the real estate developer's 95-acre tract. If the real estate developer prevails, what will be the most likely reason?
askZh: 买方对房地产开发商的95英亩土地提起了适当的诉讼,要求执行限制性契约。 如果房地产开发商占上风,那么最可能的原因是什么?

options.en: A covenant to impose restrictions is an illegal restraint on alienation.
options.zh: 实行限制的公约是对异化的非法限制。

options.en: Negative reciprocal covenants are not generally recognized.
options.zh: 消极的对等盟约没有得到普遍承认。

options.en: The deed imposing the restrictions was not in the chain of title for the 95 acres when the real estate developer purchased the land.
options.zh: 在房地产开发商购买95英亩土地时,实行限制的契约不在所有权链中。

options.en: The disparity in acreage means that the covenant can be personal only to the contractor.
options.zh: 土地面积的差别意味着,契约只能是承包者个人的。

explanation.en:
Notice of competing property interests

Actual notice

Buyer has direct knowledge of prior interest in land

Record notice

Document showing prior interest in land is properly recorded & appears in buyer's chain of title

Inquiry notice

Buyer knows, or should know, of circumstances that would prompt reasonable person to investigate (eg, visible use of property, reference to unrecorded transaction in recorded instrument)

A real covenant is an express promise to do (affirmative) or not do (restrictive) something on the land that is enforceable by an action for money damages. When a real covenant is not in writing—as seen with the real estate developer's deed—it can be enforced as an equitable servitude that is implied from a common scheme if three elements are met:

Intent to create common scheme – the owner intended to impose a covenant on all lots in the subdivision (eg, covenant imposed on each lot in the 400 acres and the buyer's 5-acre tract)

Restrictive servitude – the intended covenant was a promise not to do something on the land (explicitly stated here)

Notice – the person to be bound by the covenant had actual, record, or inquiry notice of it

Here, the real estate developer had no actual notice of the restrictive covenant in the buyer's deed. And since the buyer's 5-acre tract was separate from the 400-acre residential subdivision, the real estate developer lacked inquiry notice that his 95-acre lot was meant to be a part of either development. However, the buyer's deed containing the covenant was recorded. Therefore, the real estate developer would lack record notice, and therefore prevail, if the buyer's deed was not in the chain of title for the 95 acres when the real estate developer purchased the land.

(Choice A) A covenant is an illegal restraint on alienation if it imposes unreasonable restrictions on the sale or transfer of land—not merely on the use of land (as seen here).

(Choice B) Negative reciprocal covenants (ie, implied equitable servitudes) are generally recognized when there is a common scheme of development (eg, a residential subdivision).

(Choice D) The disparity in lot acreage is immaterial in determining whether the covenant is personal (ie, enforceable only between the promising parties) or runs with the land (ie, enforceable against successors in interest).

Educational objective:

Equitable servitudes can be implied from a common scheme if three elements are met: (1) intent to create a common scheme, (2) restrictive covenant, and (3) actual, record, or inquiry notice.

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 2.14 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (equitable servitude implied from a common scheme in a residential subdivision).

Restatement of Property § 539 (Am. Law Inst. 1944) (elements of equitable servitudes).

explanation.zh:
竞合财产权益通知

实际通知

买方直接了解土地的先前权益

录音通知

表明先前对土地有兴趣的文件被适当记录在买方的所有权链中

调查通知

买方知道或应当知道会促使有理智的人进行调查的情形(例如,明显使用财产,提及记录票据中未记录的交易)

真正的契约是明确承诺在土地上做(肯定的)或不做(限制的)可以通过金钱损害诉讼执行的事情。如果如房地产开发商的契约所示,真正的契约不是书面的,那么,如果符合以下三个要素,那么它可以作为共同计划中暗示的一种公平的奴役加以执行:

有意创造共同计划——业主打算对分区内的所有土地实行契约(例如,对400英亩的每个土地以及买方的5英亩土地实行契约)

限制性奴役 — — 所希望的契约是承诺不在该土地上做一些事情(此处明确阐述)

通知 -- -- 受公约约束的人有其实际、记录或查询通知

在这里,房地产开发商没有实际通知买方契约中的限制性契约,而且由于买方的5英亩土地与400英亩住宅分区分开,房地产开发商没有查询通知说他的95英亩土地是意在成为其中任何一个发展的一部分。然而,买方载有契约的契约被记录在案。因此,房地产开发商将缺乏记录通知,因此,如果买方认为95英亩的地契没有在产权链中房地产开发商购买了土地。

(Choice A) 盟约如果对土地的出售或转让施加不合理的限制——而不仅仅是对土地使用的限制(如这里所见),则是对转让的非法限制。

(Choice B) 消极的对等盟约(即,暗示的公平劳役)在有共同的发展计划(如住宅分区)时,一般被承认.

(Choice D) 在决定该契约是针对个人的(即,只在有希望的当事方之间执行)还是与土地一起运行(即,对利益继承人执行)方面,许多面积的差异是无关紧要的。

学习要点：

如果符合以下三个要素,共同计划可以暗示实行公平的奴役:(1) 打算建立共同计划,(2) 限制性的契约,(3) 实际的、记录的或查询通知。

参考资料

财产的重述(第三):第2.14节(《2000年宪法》)(住宅分区共同计划中暗示的公平奴役)。

重述财产第539条(1944年《行政法》)(平等奴役的要素)。

stem:
A man owned two adjoining parcels known as Lot 1 and Lot 2. Both parcels fronted a main street and abutted a public alley in the rear. Lot 1 was improved with a commercial building that covered all the main-street frontage of Lot 1. There was a large parking lot on the rear of Lot 1 with access from the alley only.

Fifteen years ago, the man leased Lot 1 to a tenant for 15 years. The tenant has continuously occupied Lot 1 since that time. Thirteen years ago, without the man's permission, the tenant began to use a driveway on Lot 2 as a better access between the main street and the parking lot than the alley.

Eight years ago, the man conveyed Lot 2 to his friend and, five years ago, the man conveyed Lot 1 to the tenant by a deed that recited "together with all the appurtenances."

Until last week, the tenant continuously used the driveway over Lot 2 to reach the parking lot in the rear of Lot 1.

Last week the friend commenced construction of a building on Lot 2 and blocked the driveway over Lot 2 used by the tenant to reach the parking lot in the rear of Lot 1 from the main street. The tenant has commenced an action to enforce an easement by prescription and to restrain the friend from blocking the driveway.

The period of time to acquire rights by prescription in the jurisdiction is 10 years.
stemZh:
一人拥有两块被称作Lot 1和Lot 2的附属包裹,两块包裹前方是一条主街,后方是一条公共巷道,Lot 1得到了改进,其商业建筑覆盖了Lot 1的所有主街前.洛特1号的后方有一个大型停车场,只能从小巷进入.

15年前,这名男子将Lot 1租给了一个租户,租户从那时起一直占据Lot 1.13年前,未经男方许可,房客开始使用Lot 2上的车道,作为与小巷相比,主街和停车场之间的通道更好.

八年前,这名男子将"洛特2"传达给他的朋友,五年前,那名男子将"洛特1"传递给房客,通过一份背诵"与所有附属物一起"的契约.

直到上周,房客一直使用Lot 2上空的车道到达Lot 1后面的停车场.

上周朋友开始在二号地块上建一座大楼 封锁了洛特上空的车道2由租户使用,从主街到达Lot 1后面的停车场.租户已开始采取行动,通过处方强制执行地役权,并限制朋友挡住车道。

在法域通过时效取得权利的期限为10年。
ask: If the tenant loses, what will be the most likely reason?
askZh: 如果房客输了,最可能的原因是什么?

options.en: No easement was mentioned in the deed from the man to the friend.
options.zh: 男子转让给朋友的地契中未提及地役权。

options.en: The man owned both Lot 1 and Lot 2 until eight years ago.
options.zh: 那个人在8年前就拥有了1号和2号

options.en: The mere use of an easement is not adverse possession.
options.zh: 仅仅使用地役权不是不利的占有。

options.en: The tenant has access to the parking lot from the alley.
options.zh: 租户可以从小巷进入停车场.

explanation.en:
An easement by prescription is a presumptive nonpossessory right to use another's land for a limited purpose that is acquired through OCAN—ie, use that is:

Open and notorious – apparent or visible to a reasonable owner Continuous – uninterrupted for the statutory period Actual – use of the land Nonpermissive – hostile and adverse to the owner Tenants cannot acquire a prescriptive easement over (1) the leased premises since they have permission to use them or (2) other lands owned by their landlord because tenants are said to stand in their landlord's place during the lease and therefore lack an adverse interest.

Here, the man leased Lot 1 to the tenant, who began to use the driveway on Lot 2 without the man's permission. Since the man owned both lots, the tenant's use did not become adverse until the man conveyed Lot 2 to his friend eight years ago. As a result, the tenant has not satisfied the 10-year statutory period to acquire a prescriptive easement and will likely lose.

(Choice A) Although no easement was mentioned in the friend's deed, an easement transfers automatically with the transfer of the servient (ie, burdened) estate. So had the tenant acquired an easement by prescription over Lot 2, the burden of the easement would have automatically transferred from the man to the friend when Lot 2 was conveyed.

(Choice C) Adverse possession requires that a person possess the land, but mere use is sufficient to obtain a prescriptive easement so long as the other elements are met (not seen here).

(Choice D) The tenant's access to the Lot 1 parking lot from the alley would not prevent him from acquiring an easement by prescription over Lot 2. But it would prevent him from acquiring an easement by necessity since this type of easement only arises when it is strictly necessary for the use and enjoyment of property. This includes when property (eg, Lot 1 parking lot) cannot be reached from a public road (eg, public alley).

Educational objective:

Tenants cannot acquire an easement by prescription (ie, OCAN) over the leased premises or other lands owned by their landlord.

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes §§ 2.16–2.17 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (easement by prescription).

explanation.zh:
时效式地役权是指为有限目的使用他人土地的推定非占有性权利,通过OCAN-ie获得,即:

公开和臭名昭著,对合理所有人来说是显而易见的,在法定期限内是不间断的 实际使用土地 不容许,对所有人不利 租户不能获得对(1)租赁房地的法规性地役权,因为他们有权使用这些土地或(2) 其房东拥有的其他土地,因为据说租户在租赁期间站在房东的位置,因此没有不利的权益。

在这里,男方将Lot 1租给房客,房客未经男方许可便开始使用Lot 2上的车道,由于男方拥有这两块车位,房客的用途并没有变得不利,直到男方在8年前将Lot 2转告朋友.因此,租户没有达到10年法定期限,以获得法定地役权,并可能失去。

(Choice A)虽然在朋友的契约中没有提到地役权,但地役权随着地役权(即负重财产)的转让而自动转移.如果租户通过处方获得地役权,超过第2批的地役权,当第2批的地役权被传递时,地役权的负担会自动从男方转移给朋友.

(C) 逆权占有要求一个人拥有土地,但只要满足其他要素(此处不见),仅仅使用即可获得法定地役权。

(Choice D) 租户从小巷进入Lot 1停车场并不妨碍他通过处方获得Lot 2的地役权.但它会阻止他因必要而获得地役权,因为只有在财产的使用和享有绝对必要时才产生这种地役权。这包括当公共道路(如公共巷道)无法到达地产(如Lot 1停车场)时。

学习要点：

租户不能通过处方(即OCAN)获得对出租房屋或其房东拥有的其他土地的地役权。

参考资料

sourceSetLabel: 不动产法 · 第 5 组
stem:
A seller entered into a written contract to sell a tract of land to an investor. The contract made no mention of the quality of title to be conveyed. The seller and the investor later completed the sale, and the seller delivered a warranty deed to the investor.

Soon thereafter, the value of the land increased dramatically. The investor entered into a written contract to sell the land to a buyer. The contract between the investor and the buyer expressly provided that the investor would convey a marketable title. The buyer's attorney discovered that the title to the land was not marketable and had not been marketable when the original seller had conveyed to the investor. The buyer refused to complete the sale.

The investor sued the original seller for breach of contract, claiming damages from the seller's failure to convey marketable title, which resulted in the investor's loss of the sale to the subsequent buyer.
stemZh:
卖方签订了一份向投资者出售一带土地的书面合同,合同未提及要转达的所有权质量,卖方和投资者后来完成了出售,卖方向投资者交付了一份担保契约。

不久之后,土地的价值急剧增加,投资者签订了向买方出售土地的书面合同,投资者与买方之间的合同明确规定,投资者将传达可销售的所有权。买方的律师发现,在原卖方向投资人转让土地时,该土地的所有权是不能出售的,因此无法出售,买方拒绝完成销售。

投资方起诉原卖方违反合同,因卖方未能将可销售所有权告知卖方而要求损害赔偿,导致投资方向后续买方出售损失。
ask: Who is likely to prevail on this count?
askZh: 谁会相信这一点?

options.en: The investor, because the law implies in such a contract a covenant that the title will be marketable.
options.zh: 投资人,因为法律在这种合同中暗示,所有权是可出售的。

options.en: The investor, because the original seller is liable for all reasonably foreseeable damages.
options.zh: 投资者,因为原卖方应对所有合理可预见的损害承担责任。

options.en: The original seller, because her contract obligations as to title merged into the deed.
options.zh: 原卖方,因为其所有权合同义务合并为契约。

options.en: The original seller, because she did not expressly agree to convey marketable title.
options.zh: 原卖方,因为她没有明确同意传递可销售的所有权。

explanation.en:
All contracts for the sale of land, unless otherwise stated, impliedly warrant that the seller will convey marketable title to the buyer upon closing (Choices A & D). However, once a deed is delivered to and accepted by the buyer, the doctrine of merger provides that all obligations contained within the land-sale contract merge into the deed. Those obligations can be enforced thereafter only if they are incorporated into the deed.

Here, the investor has sued the original seller for breach of contract, claiming damages from the seller's failure to convey marketable title. Although the investor's allegations appear to be true, he can only seek a remedy that arises from the deed—not the contract that merged with the deed. As a result, the original seller is likely to prevail.*

*The investor likely would have prevailed had he instead sued the original seller for breaching a covenant of title contained within the warranty deed that he received.

(Choice B) A seller may be liable for reasonably foreseeable damages that arise from a breach of a warranty in the deed or from fraudulent assertions in the land-sale contract. But neither ground has been asserted by the investor in this case.

Educational objective:

Under the doctrine of merger, all obligations contained within the land-sale contract merge into the deed and can be enforced thereafter only if they are incorporated into the deed.

explanation.zh:
除非另有说明,所有出售土地的合同都暗含着要求卖方在关闭时将可供销售的所有权传递给买方(Choices A & D)。但是,一旦向买方交付并被买方接受,合并原则规定,土地出售合同中包含的所有义务都并入契约,这些义务只有在并入契约后才能执行。

在此,投资方对原卖方提出了违约诉讼,要求赔偿卖方未能传达可销售所有权造成的损失。虽然投资人的指控似乎是真实的,但他只能寻求由契约产生的补救办法,而不是与契约合并的合同,因此,原卖方很可能胜诉。

* 如果投资人起诉原卖方违反他收到的保修契约中包含的所有权契约,他很可能胜诉。

(Choice B) 卖方可以对因契约中违反保修规定或土地销售合同中欺诈性主张而导致的可合理预见的损害承担责任。

学习要点：

根据合并原则,土地销售合同中包含的所有义务都并入地契,只有在并入地契后才能执行。

sourceSetLabel: 不动产法 · 第 5 组
stem:
A man conveyed the eastern half of a tract of vacant land to a woman by a warranty deed. The woman promptly recorded the deed. The land conveyed to the woman fronted on a public highway. The land retained by the man was landlocked.

One year later, the man died intestate, leaving a cousin as his only heir. The cousin visited the man's land for the first time and discovered that it had no access to a public highway. A neighbor who owned adjoining land fronting on the public highway offered to sell the cousin a right to cross the neighbor's land for access to the highway. Although the neighbor's price was reasonable, the cousin rejected the offer. The woman has refused to allow the cousin to cross her land for access to the public highway even though the woman's land is still vacant.

The cousin has sued the woman, seeking access across the woman's land to the public highway.
stemZh:
一名男子通过一份保修契约将一块空地的东半部传给一名妇女,该妇女立即将契约记录下来,土地在一条公共公路上传递给该妇女,该男子保留的土地是内陆的。

一年后,这名男子死于无遗嘱,留下了一位堂兄弟作为他唯一的继承人,堂兄弟第一次拜访了这名男子的土地,发现他无法进入公共公路.一个邻居在公共公路前拥有邻接土地,他提议出售表妹穿越邻居土地进入高速公路的权利,虽然邻居的价格合理,但表妹拒绝了这一提议.尽管该妇女的土地仍然空置,但该妇女拒绝允许该表妹穿越她的土地进入公共公路。

该表兄起诉了该妇女,寻求穿过该妇女的土地进入公共公路。
ask: Who is likely to prevail?
askZh: 谁可能胜出?

options.en: The cousin, based on necessity.
options.zh: 堂弟,出于必要.

options.en: The cousin, because the woman's land is still vacant.
options.zh: 堂弟,因为女子的土地仍然空闲.

options.en: The woman, because the cousin could obtain an alternative access to the highway from the neighbor.
options.zh: 那个女人,因为表亲可以从邻居那里得到一条高速公路的替代通道.

options.en: The woman, because the man failed to reserve an easement in his deed to the woman.
options.zh: 那个女人,因为那个男人没有在对那个女人的契约中保留地役权.

explanation.en:
Implied easements

Type Elements

Necessity Severance of common ownership Strict necessity for use & enjoyment of land Existing prior use Severance of common ownership Prior existing use Apparent & continuous Reasonable necessity for use & enjoyment of land An easement by necessity will be implied if the following elements are met:

Severance of common ownership – the dominant and servient estates were a single tract of land, and the owner retained part of the tract and conveyed the rest to another

Strict necessity – the easement is absolutely necessary for the use and enjoyment of the land (eg, the dominant tract is landlocked and has no access to a public road)

This type of easement runs with the land, meaning that subsequent owners of the dominant and servient estates are bound by the easement.

Here, the man owned the entire tract before he conveyed the eastern half to the woman, thereby severing common ownership. Since the land retained by the man has no access to a public highway or any other road, an easement over the woman's land was absolutely necessary for the man to use and enjoy his land. Therefore, an easement will be implied based on necessity (Choice D). And since the easement runs with the land, the cousin— who inherited the man's land—will likely prevail in his suit against the woman.

(Choice B) The fact that the woman's land is vacant rather than developed has no bearing on whether the cousin has the right to cross her land to reach the public highway.

(Choice C) The cousin's ability to obtain alternative access to the public highway by purchasing an easement over the neighbor's land does not extinguish his easement by necessity over the woman's land.

Educational objective:

An easement by necessity will be implied if (1) the dominant and servient estates were once a single tract of land, and the owner retained part of the tract and conveyed the rest to another, and (2) the easement is absolutely necessary for the use and enjoyment of the land.

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 2.15 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (easement by necessity).

explanation.zh:
隐性地役权

类型元素

使用和享有土地的严格必要性 现有使用权的严格必要性 现有使用权的严格必要性 现有使用权的严格必要性 现有使用权的严格必要性 使用和享有土地的明显和持续合理必要性 必要时的降级满足以下要素:

共同所有权的严格性 -- -- 占支配地位和占有地位的庄园是单一土地,所有者保留了部分土地,并将其余土地转给另一土地。

严格必要性——地役权对于土地的使用和享用是绝对必要的(例如,占支配地位的路段是内陆的,没有公共道路)

此类地役权随地而流转,意指后来占支配地位的和附庸的庄园的所有人受地役权的约束.

在这里,这名男子在将东半部传给妇女之前拥有整个土地,从而切断了共同所有权。由于男子保留的土地无法进入公共公路或任何其他道路,因此,对于男子使用和享用其土地而言,绝对有必要对女子的土地实行地役制,因此,根据必要性(Choice D),将隐含地役制。由于地役权随地而流转,继承男子土地的堂兄弟很可能胜诉于她。

(Choice B) 女方土地空置而非开发的事实,与堂兄弟是否有权穿越她的土地前往公共公路无关.

(Choice C) 堂兄弟通过在邻居的土地上购买地役权获得公共高速公路替代通道的能力,不会因为有必要而消灭他对于女性土地的地役权.

学习要点：

如果(1) 占支配地位的和附庸的庄园一度是单一土地,而所有者保留了部分土地,并将其余土地转给另一土地,那么必然就意味着地役权;(2) 地役权对于使用和享有土地绝对必要。陆地。

参考资料

财产的重述(第三):第2.15节(《2000年美国法律》)(按必要性出租)。

sourceSetLabel: 不动产法 · 第 5 组
stem:
A seller who owned land entered into a valid written agreement to sell the land to a buyer by installment purchase. The contract stipulated that the seller would deliver to the buyer, upon payment of the last installment due, "a warranty deed sufficient to convey a fee simple title." The contract contained no other provision that could be construed as referring to title.

The buyer entered into possession of the land. After making 10 of the 300 installment payments obligated under the contract, the buyer discovered that there was outstanding a valid and enforceable mortgage on the land, securing the payment of a debt in the amount of 25 percent of the purchase price that the buyer had agreed to pay. There was no evidence that the seller had ever been late in payments due under the mortgage, and there was no evidence of any danger of insolvency of the seller. The value of the land was then four times the amount due on the debt secured by the mortgage.

The buyer quit possession of the land, stopped making payments on the contract, and demanded that the seller repay the amounts that the buyer had paid under the contract. After the seller refused the demand, the buyer sued the seller to recover damages for the seller's alleged breach of the contract.
stemZh:
拥有土地的出卖人以分期付款方式向买受人出售土地的有效书面协议。合同规定,卖方在向买方支付到期的最后一次分期付款时,应向买方交付 " 足以传达收费简单所有权的担保契约 " 。 合同中没有任何其他条款可解释为提及所有权。

买方持有该土地,在根据合同承担的300笔分期付款中,买方在支付了10笔之后,发现该土地有一笔有效且可强制执行的抵押贷款尚未偿还,为支付25笔债务提供了担保。买方同意支付的价款的百分比。没有证据表明卖方拖欠了抵押款,而且没有证据表明卖方有任何破产的危险。土地的价值是按以下规定所欠债务的四倍:抵押贷款。

买方放弃了对土地的占有,停止了对合同的付款,并要求卖方偿还买方根据合同支付的款项。在卖方拒绝要求后,买方起诉卖方,要求就卖方据称违反合同的行为获得损害赔偿。
ask: Should damages be awarded to the buyer?
askZh: 是否应判给买方损害赔偿?

options.en: No, because an installment purchase contract is treated as a security device.
options.zh: 不,因为分期付款购货合同被视为一种担保手段。

options.en: No, because the time for the seller to deliver marketable title has not arrived.
options.zh: 不,因为卖方交付可销售所有权的时间尚未到来。

options.en: Yes, because an installment purchase contract is treated as a mortgage, and the outstanding mortgage impairs the buyer's equity of redemption.
options.zh: 是的,因为分期付款购买合同被视为抵押,而未偿还的抵押损害买方的赎回权。

options.en: Yes, because in the absence of a contrary express agreement, an obligation to convey marketable title is implied.
options.zh: 是,因为如果没有相反的明确协议,就暗示有义务传达可销售的所有权。

explanation.en:
"Red flags" for marketable title

Covenants Easements Leases Liens Gaps in chain of title Boundary disputes Existing zoning violations Adverse possession All land-sale contracts have an implied warranty that the seller will convey marketable title to the buyer upon closing unless otherwise stated. Title does not have to be perfect to be marketable. However, it must be reasonably free from doubt and under no threat of litigation, such that a reasonable person would accept and pay for it. In the case of an installment land contract—ie, one in which the buyer takes possession of the property and pays the purchase price over time—the seller need not deliver marketable title until the price is fully paid.

Here, after making 10 of the 300 installment payments, the buyer discovered that there was an outstanding mortgage on the land. Although an existing mortgage can render title unmarketable, the seller does not need to deliver marketable title until the buyer has made all installment payments. Therefore, damages should not be awarded to the buyer because the time for the seller to deliver marketable title has not arrived (Choice D).

(Choice A) The fact that an installment land contract is treated as a security device (namely, a mortgage) does not prevent the buyer from recovering damages if the seller is unable to deliver marketable title when it is due (not seen here).

(Choice C) An installment land contract is often treated as a mortgage, so the seller can bring a foreclosure action to regain possession of the property if the buyer defaults on payments. Although the buyer stopped making payments here, the seller has not yet attempted to enforce the contract. As a result, the buyer's equity of redemption (ie, pre-foreclosure right to cure the default by paying the entire past-due amount) is not at issue.

Educational objective:

Under an installment land contract, the seller does not need to deliver marketable title until the purchase price is fully paid.

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 3.4 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (installment land contracts).

77 Am. Jur. 2d Vendor and Purchaser § 93 (2020) (marketable title).

explanation.zh:
"红旗"可销量称号.

所有权链中的租赁漏洞 边界争端 现有侵犯分区行为所有土地销售合同都有卖方传达的默示保证书除非另有说明,否则在关闭时向买方出售所有权。所有权不必是完美的才能出售的,但是,所有权必须合理地不受怀疑,不受诉讼的威胁,这样才有理智的人会接受和支付所有权。在分期付款土地合同——即买方占有该财产并支付长期购买价款的合同——情况下,卖方在全额支付价款之前无须交付可销售所有权。

在此,买方在支付了300笔分期付款中的10笔之后,发现该地存在尚未支付的抵押贷款。虽然现有的抵押可以使所有权无法出售,但卖方无需在买方支付所有分期付款之前交付可销售所有权。因此,不应判给买方损害赔偿,因为卖方交付可销售所有权的时间尚未到来(Choice D)。

(Choice A)将分期付款土地合同作为担保手段(即抵押)处理这一事实并不妨碍买方在卖方到期时无法交付可销售所有权(此处不见)的情况下收回损害赔偿。

(C选择)分期付款土地合同通常被视为抵押,因此如果买受人拖欠付款,卖方可以提起取消赎回权诉讼,以重新占有财产。虽然买方在此停止付款,但卖方尚未试图执行合同,因此,买方的赎回股权(即通过支付全部逾期款项弥补违约的赎回权)不存在争议。

学习要点：

根据分期付款土地合同,在全额支付购货价款之前,卖方无需交付可销售所有权。

stem:
A seller contracted to sell land to a buyer for $300,000. The contract provided that the closing would be 60 days after the contract was signed and that the seller would convey to the buyer a "marketable title" by a quitclaim deed at closing. The contract contained no other provisions regarding the title to be delivered to the buyer.

A title search revealed that the land was subject to an unsatisfied $50,000 mortgage and a right-of-way easement over a portion of the land.

The buyer now claims that the title is unmarketable and has refused to close.
stemZh:
卖方合同约定向买方出售土地30万美元,合同规定关闭时间为合同签署后60天,卖方将在关闭时通过一份退出债权契约向买方转达“可出售所有权”。合同中没有关于向买方交付所有权的其他规定。

产权查询显示,该地有5万美元未满足的抵押贷款和部分土地的通行权减免.

买方现在声称所有权不能出售,并拒绝关闭。
ask: Is the buyer correct?
askZh: 买家说得对吗?

options.en: No, because nothing under these facts renders title unmarketable.
options.zh: 没有,因为根据这些事实,没有任何东西使产权无法出售。

options.en: No, because the buyer agreed to accept a quitclaim deed.
options.zh: 不,因为买方同意接受一份退货契约。

options.en: Yes, because the right-of-way easement makes the title unmarketable.
options.zh: 是的,因为路权的降级使得标题无法销售.

options.en: Yes, because the unsatisfied mortgage makes the title unmarketable.
options.zh: 是的,因为不满意的抵押使得产权无法出售.

explanation.en:
All land-sale contracts have an implied warranty that the seller will convey marketable title to the buyer upon closing unless otherwise stated. For example, the parties can eliminate this warranty by expressly contracting to transfer whatever title the grantor has to the buyer by a quitclaim deed (ie, without any warranties). But since the seller here has expressly promised to convey to the buyer a "marketable title" by quitclaim deed, this warranty remains in their land-sale contract (Choice B).

A warranty of marketable title (ie, merchantability) is a promise that title is reasonably free from doubt and under no threat of litigation such that a reasonable person would accept and pay for it. Title can be rendered unmarketable by encumbrances, existing zoning violations, or defects in the chain of title. Although a mortgage is an encumbrance, the seller has the right to satisfy the mortgage up to the time of closing—and will often use the sale proceeds to do so. As a result, the closing itself often renders title marketable (Choice D).

An easement is another type of encumbrance that will render title unmarketable if it reduces the property's value. Utility easements, for example, benefit the property by allowing others to service it, so they often have no effect on marketability. But right-of-way easements often burden the property by allowing another to travel over it—thereby reducing its value. Therefore, the buyer's claim that the title is unmarketable is correct, and the buyer can refuse to close (Choice A).

Educational objective:

Marketable title is implied in all land-sale contracts. Title can be rendered unmarketable by easements that reduce the land's value or by existing zoning violations—but not typically by mortgages since sale proceeds are often used to satisfy the mortgage debt.

explanation.zh:
所有土地销售合同都有默示保证,除非另有说明,卖方在关闭时将向买方传递可销售的所有权。例如,当事人可以取消这种担保,明确约定通过退出债权契约向买方转让设保人拥有的任何所有权(即没有任何担保)。但是,由于卖方在此明确承诺通过退出债权契约向买方传递"可销售产权",这种保修仍保留在其土地销售合同(Choice B)中.

对可销售所有权(即可交易性)的保证是一种保证,即所有权在合理情况下是没有疑问的,没有受到任何诉讼威胁,使有理智的人能够接受和支付所有权。所有权可能因抵押权、现有分区违规或所有权链的缺陷而不能出售。虽然抵押权是一种抵押权,但卖方有权在抵押权关闭之前满足抵押权的要求,并常常利用出售所得来履行抵押权,因此,抵押权关闭本身往往使所有权可以出售(Choice D)。

地役权是另一种抵押权,如果所有权降低财产的价值,则无法出售。 例如,地役权地役权通过允许他人为财产服务而使财产受益,因此,它们往往对可销售性没有影响。但是,路权地役权往往通过允许他人在地役权上旅行来给财产造成负担,从而降低其价值,因此,买方关于所有权不能出售的主张是正确的,买方可以拒绝关闭(Choice A)。

学习要点：

所有土地销售合同都隐含了可出售的所有权,由于地役权降低土地价值或现有的分区违规,所有权可能变得无法出售,但一般不是通过抵押贷款,因为出售收益往往被用来偿还抵押债务。

stem:
Two siblings, a brother and sister, own adjoining lots in the central portion of a city. Each of their lots had an office building. The sister decided to raze the existing building on her lot and erect a building of greater height. No statute or ordinance applies to prevent her from doing so and she has received all governmental approvals required to pursue her project.

After the sister had torn down the existing building, she proceeded to excavate deeper. She used shoring that met all local, state, and federal safety regulations, and the shoring was placed in accordance with those standards.

The brother notified the sister that cracks were developing in the building situated on his lot. The sister took the view that any subsidence suffered by the brother was due to the weight of his building, and correctly asserted that none would have occurred had the brother's soil been in its natural state. The sister continued to excavate.

The building on the brother's lot did suffer extensive damage, requiring the expenditure of $750,000 to remedy the defects.
stemZh:
有两个兄弟姐妹在一个城市的中部拥有毗邻的地块,每个地块都有一个办公楼,姐姐决定在她的地盘上夷平现有的建筑,并竖立一座高一些的建筑。没有任何法规或法令禁止她这样做,而且她已经获得政府批准,以便继续其项目。

姐姐拆掉现有建筑后,她开始挖得更深,她使用了符合所有地方、州和联邦安全条例的斜拉索,斜拉索是按照这些标准放置的。

该兄弟通知姐姐说,位于他地盘的建筑物里正在出现裂缝,姐姐认为,他兄弟遭受的任何潜伏都是由于他的建筑物的重量,并且正确地断言,如果有这种裂缝,就不会出现任何裂缝。哥哥的土壤处于自然状态,妹妹继续挖掘.

该兄弟地块上的建筑确实遭受了巨大的破坏,需要花费75万美元来弥补缺陷.
ask: Which of the following is the best comment concerning the brother's action to recover damages from the sister?
askZh: 关于兄弟向妹妹追偿损失的行动,以下哪一个是最佳评论?

options.en: Once land is improved with a building, the owner cannot invoke the common law right of lateral support.
options.zh: 一旦用建筑物改良土地,所有者不得援引普通法规定的横向支持权。

options.en: The sister cannot be held liable simply upon proof that support was removed, but may be held liable if negligence is proved.
options.zh: 姐妹不能仅凭证明支助被取消而承担责任,但如果证明存在过失,则可追究其责任。

options.en: The sister is liable because she removed necessary support for the brother's lot.
options.zh: 姐姐有责任 因为她取消了对弟弟的 必要支持

options.en: The sister's only obligation was to satisfy all local, state, and federal safety regulations.
options.zh: 姐姐的唯一义务是满足所有的地方、州和联邦安全规定。

explanation.en:
Withdrawal of lateral & subjacent support

Natural state Improved

Lateral Strictly liable for damage to adjacent land caused by subsidence

If damage to land & improvements would have occurred in land's natural state, strictly liable If not, liable if negligent

Subjacent

Landowners have a common law duty to provide lateral support to maintain adjacent land in its natural state—even if that land has been improved (Choice A). As a result, a landowner who withdraws lateral support from improved land is strictly liable for any resulting subsidence to the adjacent land if that harm would have occurred had the land been in its natural state. If not, the landowner is only liable if the withdrawal was negligent.

Here, the brother is only entitled to the amount of lateral support needed to maintain his lot in its natural state—ie, without the weight of his building. Since his building would not have been damaged had his soil been in its natural state, the sister cannot be held strictly liable for removing support (Choice C). However, she can still be held liable if negligence is proved.

(Choice D) The sister was obligated to satisfy all applicable local, state, and federal safety regulations—but she was also obligated to provide lateral support to the brother's adjacent lot. If she failed to use reasonable care to provide such support, then she can be liable for negligence.

Educational objective:

A landowner must provide lateral support to maintain adjacent land in its natural state— even if that land is improved. If the landowner removes lateral support, strict liability is imposed if the resulting harm would have occurred had the land been in its natural state. Otherwise, negligence liability is imposed.

References

Restatement (Second) of Torts §§ 817–18 (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (withdrawal of lateral support).
